name: FrameInvariants.RawBridge.polynomialEquiv_product
statement:
theorem polynomialEquiv_product (x y : Coord (Polynomials k)) (c : Fin 27) :
    polynomialEquiv k (product x y c) =
      AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawFrameIdeal.productCoordinate
        (polynomialEquiv k ∘ x) (polynomialEquiv k ∘ y) c
proof:
:= by
  simp [product, AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawFrameIdeal.productCoordinate,
    Bridge.coefficient_eq]

name: FrameInvariants.RawBridge.polynomialEquiv_equation
statement:
@[simp] theorem polynomialEquiv_equation (q : Equation) :
    polynomialEquiv k (equation k q) =
      AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawFrameIdeal.equation (equationEquiv q)
proof:
:= by
  cases q with
  | idempotence r i c =>
    have hv (r i : Fin 3) : polynomialEquiv k ∘ projector k r i =
        AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawFrameIdeal.universalVector r i := by
      funext c
      exact polynomialEquiv_projector k r i c
    simp only [equation, equationEquiv, Equiv.coe_fn_mk, map_sub,
      polynomialEquiv_product, polynomialEquiv_projector, hv,
      AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawFrameIdeal.equation]
  | traceOne r i =>
    simp [equation, trace, equationEquiv,
      AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawFrameIdeal.equation]
  | sumOne r c =>
    simp [equation, equationEquiv, unit_coordinate,
      AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawFrameIdeal.equation,
      AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawFrameIdeal.unitCoordinate]

name: FrameInvariants.RawBridge.map_frameIdeal
statement:
theorem map_frameIdeal :
    (frameIdeal k).map (polynomialEquiv k).toRingHom =
      AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawFrameIdeal.rawFrameIdeal (k := k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [frameIdeal, AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawFrameIdeal.rawFrameIdeal, Ideal.map_span]
  congr 1
  ext p
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨q, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨equationEquiv q, (polynomialEquiv_equation k q).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨q, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨equation k (equationEquiv.symm q), Set.mem_range_self _, ?_⟩
    simp

name: FrameInvariants.RawBridge.map_frameRadical
statement:
theorem map_frameRadical :
    (frameIdeal k).radical.map (polynomialEquiv k).toRingHom =
      (AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawFrameIdeal.rawFrameIdeal (k := k)).radical
proof:
:= by
  have hker : RingHom.ker (polynomialEquiv k).toRingHom ≤ frameIdeal k := by
    rw [(RingHom.injective_iff_ker_eq_bot (polynomialEquiv k).toRingHom).mp
      (polynomialEquiv k).injective]
    exact bot_le
  rw [Ideal.map_radical_of_surjective (f := (polynomialEquiv k).toRingHom)
    (polynomialEquiv k).surjective hker, map_frameIdeal]

name: FrameInvariants.RawBridge.coordinateRingEquiv_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem coordinateRingEquiv_mk (p : Polynomials k) :
    coordinateRingEquiv k (Ideal.Quotient.mk (frameIdeal k).radical p) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk
        (AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawFrameIdeal.rawFrameIdeal (k := k)).radical
        (polynomialEquiv k p)
proof: := rfl

name: FrameInvariants.RawBridge.polynomialEquiv_C
statement:
@[simp] theorem polynomialEquiv_C (a : k) :
    polynomialEquiv k (MvPolynomial.C a) = MvPolynomial.C a
proof:
:= by
  simp [polynomialEquiv]

name: FrameInvariants.RawBridge.polynomialEquiv_projector
statement:
@[simp] theorem polynomialEquiv_projector (r i : Fin 3) (c : Fin 27) :
    polynomialEquiv k (projector k r i c) =
      AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawFrameIdeal.universalVector r i c
proof:
:= by
  simp [polynomialEquiv, projector,
    AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawFrameIdeal.universalVector, coordinateEquiv]

name: FrameInvariants.RawBridge.unit_coordinate
statement:
theorem unit_coordinate {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (c : Fin 27) :
    (unit : Coord R) c = if c = 0 ∨ c = 1 ∨ c = 2 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases c <;> simp [unit, decode]

name: FrameInvariants.FiniteBridge.encoder_eq
statement:
theorem encoder_eq (second : Bool) (r : Fin 3) :
    Finite.encoder second r = OneBit.Finite.enc second r
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: FrameInvariants.FiniteBridge.spectralProjector_eq
statement:
theorem spectralProjector_eq (x : Finite.RationalCoord) (i : Fin 3) :
    Finite.spectralProjector x i = OneBit.Finite.proj x i
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i <;>
    simp only [Finite.spectralProjector, OneBit.Finite.proj, Bridge.product_eq, Bridge.unit_eq]

name: FrameInvariants.FiniteBridge.frames_eq
statement:
theorem frames_eq (second : Bool) (r i : Fin 3) :
    Finite.frames second r i = OneBit.Finite.frames second r i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Finite.frames, OneBit.Finite.frames, spectralProjector_eq, encoder_eq]

name: FrameInvariants.FiniteBridge.trace_eq
statement: theorem trace_eq (x : Finite.RationalCoord) : trace x = OneBit.Finite.tr x
proof: := rfl

name: FrameInvariants.FiniteBridge.lawful_iff
statement: theorem lawful_iff (second : Bool) : Finite.lawful second ↔ OneBit.Finite.lawful second
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Finite.lawful, OneBit.Finite.lawful, frames_eq,
    Bridge.product_eq, Bridge.unit_eq, trace_eq]

name: FrameInvariants.FiniteBridge.pair_eq
statement:
theorem pair_eq (second : Bool) (r s i j : Fin 3) :
    pair (Finite.frames second r i) (Finite.frames second s j) =
      OneBit.Finite.pair second r s i j
proof:
:= by
  simp only [pair, OneBit.Finite.pair, frames_eq, Bridge.product_eq, trace_eq]

name: FrameInvariants.FiniteBridge.triple_eq
statement:
theorem triple_eq (second : Bool) (i j l : Fin 3) :
    triple (Finite.frames second 0 i) (Finite.frames second 1 j) (Finite.frames second 2 l) =
      OneBit.Finite.triple second i j l
proof:
:= by
  simp only [triple, pair, OneBit.Finite.triple, frames_eq, Bridge.product_eq, trace_eq]

name: FrameInvariants.FiniteBridge.word_eq
statement:
theorem word_eq (second : Bool) :
    word (Finite.encoder second 0) (Finite.encoder second 1) (Finite.encoder second 2) =
      OneBit.Finite.word second
proof:
:= by
  simp only [word, OneBit.Finite.word, Bridge.product_eq, encoder_eq]

name: FrameInvariants.FiniteBridge.witnessDetector_eq
statement:
theorem witnessDetector_eq (second : Bool) :
    Finite.witnessDetector second = OneBit.Finite.detector second
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Finite.witnessDetector, detector, triple, pair, word_eq,
    Bridge.product_eq, trace_eq, OneBit.Finite.detector]

name: FrameInvariants.rationalWitness
statement: theorem rationalWitness : WitnessClaim
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [WitnessClaim, FiniteBridge.lawful_iff, FiniteBridge.pair_eq,
    FiniteBridge.triple_eq, FiniteBridge.witnessDetector_eq] using OneBit.rationalWitness

name: FrameInvariants.rationalWitness_not_equivalent_under_relabelling
statement: theorem rationalWitness_not_equivalent_under_relabelling : Inequivalence
proof:
:= by
  unfold Inequivalence
  rintro ⟨g, σ, π, hg⟩
  apply OneBit.rationalWitness_not_equivalent_under_relabelling
  refine ⟨FiniteBridge.toOldAut g, σ, π, ?_⟩
  intro r i
  change g.linear (OneBit.Finite.frames false r i) =
    OneBit.Finite.frames true (σ r) (π r i)
  simpa only [FiniteBridge.frames_eq] using hg r i

name: FrameInvariants.GenericBridge.fieldEquiv_evaluate
statement:
@[simp] theorem fieldEquiv_evaluate (p : Polynomials k) :
    fieldEquiv k (evaluate k p) = OneBit.rawMap k (RawBridge.polynomialEquiv k p)
proof:
:= by
  change fieldEquiv k (algebraMap (CoordinateRing k) (FunctionField k)
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ p)) = _
  rw [fieldEquiv, IsFractionRing.ringEquivOfRingEquiv_algebraMap,
    RawBridge.coordinateRingEquiv_mk]
  rfl

name: FrameInvariants.GenericBridge.fieldEquiv_scalar
statement:
@[simp] theorem fieldEquiv_scalar (a : k) :
    fieldEquiv k (scalar k a) = OneBit.scalar k a
proof:
:= by
  change fieldEquiv k (evaluate k (MvPolynomial.C a)) = _
  rw [fieldEquiv_evaluate, RawBridge.polynomialEquiv_C]
  rfl

name: FrameInvariants.GenericBridge.fieldEquiv_universal
statement:
@[simp] theorem fieldEquiv_universal (r i : Fin 3) (c : Fin 27) :
    fieldEquiv k (universal k r i c) = OneBit.universal k r i c
proof:
:= by
  change fieldEquiv k (evaluate k (projector k r i c)) = _
  rw [fieldEquiv_evaluate, RawBridge.polynomialEquiv_projector]
  rfl

name: FrameInvariants.GenericBridge.polynomial_projector
statement:
theorem polynomial_projector (r i : Fin 3) :
    RawBridge.polynomialEquiv k ∘ projector k r i =
      AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawFrameIdeal.universalVector r i
proof:
:= by
  funext c
  exact RawBridge.polynomialEquiv_projector k r i c

name: FrameInvariants.GenericBridge.polynomial_product
statement:
theorem polynomial_product (x y : Coord (Polynomials k)) :
    RawBridge.polynomialEquiv k ∘ product x y =
      OneBit.rawProduct k (RawBridge.polynomialEquiv k ∘ x)
        (RawBridge.polynomialEquiv k ∘ y)
proof:
:= by
  funext c
  exact RawBridge.polynomialEquiv_product k x y c

name: FrameInvariants.GenericBridge.polynomial_trace
statement:
theorem polynomial_trace (x : Coord (Polynomials k)) :
    RawBridge.polynomialEquiv k (trace x) =
      OneBit.rawTrace k (RawBridge.polynomialEquiv k ∘ x)
proof:
:= by
  simp [trace, OneBit.rawTrace, Function.comp_def]

name: FrameInvariants.GenericBridge.polynomial_sub
statement:
theorem polynomial_sub (x y : Coord (Polynomials k)) :
    RawBridge.polynomialEquiv k ∘ (x - y) =
      (RawBridge.polynomialEquiv k ∘ x) - (RawBridge.polynomialEquiv k ∘ y)
proof:
:= by
  funext c
  exact map_sub (RawBridge.polynomialEquiv k) (x c) (y c)

name: FrameInvariants.GenericBridge.polynomial_encoder
statement:
theorem polynomial_encoder (r : Fin 3) :
    RawBridge.polynomialEquiv k ∘ encoder k r = OneBit.encoder k r
proof:
:= by
  rw [encoder, polynomial_sub, polynomial_projector, polynomial_projector]
  rfl

name: FrameInvariants.GenericBridge.polynomial_word
statement:
theorem polynomial_word :
    RawBridge.polynomialEquiv k ∘ word (encoder k 0) (encoder k 1) (encoder k 2) =
      OneBit.word k
proof:
:= by
  simp only [word, polynomial_sub, polynomial_product, polynomial_encoder, OneBit.word]

name: FrameInvariants.GenericBridge.fieldEquiv_detector
statement:
@[simp] theorem fieldEquiv_detector :
    fieldEquiv k (genericDetector k) = OneBit.detector k
proof:
:= by
  rw [genericDetector, fieldEquiv_evaluate]
  congr 1
  simp only [detector, triple, pair, polynomial_trace, polynomial_product, polynomial_word,
    OneBit.detector]

name: FrameInvariants.GenericBridge.polynomial_pair0
statement:
theorem polynomial_pair0 (i j : Fin 3) :
    RawBridge.polynomialEquiv k (pairMeasurement k 0 i j) = OneBit.pairP k i j
proof:
:= by
  simp [pairMeasurement, pair, polynomial_trace, polynomial_product,
    polynomial_projector, OneBit.pairP]

name: FrameInvariants.GenericBridge.polynomial_pair1
statement:
theorem polynomial_pair1 (i j : Fin 3) :
    RawBridge.polynomialEquiv k (pairMeasurement k 1 i j) = OneBit.pairQ k i j
proof:
:= by
  simp [pairMeasurement, pair, polynomial_trace, polynomial_product,
    polynomial_projector, OneBit.pairQ]

name: FrameInvariants.GenericBridge.polynomial_pair2
statement:
theorem polynomial_pair2 (i j : Fin 3) :
    RawBridge.polynomialEquiv k (pairMeasurement k 2 i j) = OneBit.pairR k i j
proof:
:= by
  simp [pairMeasurement, pair, polynomial_trace, polynomial_product,
    polynomial_projector, OneBit.pairR]

name: FrameInvariants.GenericBridge.polynomial_triple
statement:
theorem polynomial_triple (i j l : Fin 3) :
    RawBridge.polynomialEquiv k (tripleMeasurement k i j l) = OneBit.triple k i j l
proof:
:= by
  simp only [tripleMeasurement, map_add, map_sub, map_mul, triple, pair,
    polynomial_trace, polynomial_product, polynomial_projector, polynomial_pair0,
    polynomial_pair1, polynomial_pair2, RawBridge.polynomialEquiv_C, OneBit.triple]

name: FrameInvariants.GenericBridge.fieldEquiv_measurement
statement:
@[simp] theorem fieldEquiv_measurement (m : Measurement) :
    fieldEquiv k (measurement k m) = OneBit.ledger k (oldSlot m)
proof:
:= by
  cases m with
  | pair r i j =>
    fin_cases r <;>
      simp [measurement, fieldEquiv_evaluate, polynomial_pair0, polynomial_pair1,
        polynomial_pair2, oldSlot, OneBit.ledger, OneBit.ledgerCell, OneBit.rawMap]
  | triple i j l =>
    simp [measurement, fieldEquiv_evaluate, polynomial_triple,
      oldSlot, OneBit.ledger, OneBit.ledgerCell, OneBit.rawMap]

name: FrameInvariants.GenericBridge.ledger_newSlot
statement:
theorem ledger_newSlot (q : Fin 4 × Fin 3 × Fin 3 × Fin 3) :
    OneBit.ledger k (oldSlot (newSlot q)) = OneBit.ledger k q
proof:
:= by
  rcases q with ⟨r, i, j, l⟩
  fin_cases r <;> rfl

name: FrameInvariants.GenericBridge.measurement_range
statement:
theorem measurement_range :
    (fieldEquiv k) '' Set.range (measurement k) = Set.range (OneBit.ledger k)
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨m, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨oldSlot m, (fieldEquiv_measurement k m).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨q, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨measurement k (newSlot q), Set.mem_range_self _,
      (fieldEquiv_measurement k _).trans (ledger_newSlot k q)⟩

name: FrameInvariants.GenericBridge.scalar_range
statement:
theorem scalar_range :
    (fieldEquiv k) '' Set.range (scalar k) = Set.range (OneBit.scalar k)
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨a, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨a, (fieldEquiv_scalar k a).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨a, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨scalar k a, Set.mem_range_self _, fieldEquiv_scalar k a⟩

name: FrameInvariants.GenericBridge.map_H
statement: theorem map_H : (H k).map (fieldEquiv k).toRingHom = OneBit.H k
proof:
:= by
  rw [H, RingHom.map_field_closure]
  change Subfield.closure ((fieldEquiv k) '' _) = _
  rw [Set.image_union, scalar_range, measurement_range]
  rfl

name: FrameInvariants.GenericBridge.map_B
statement: theorem map_B : (B k).map (fieldEquiv k).toRingHom = OneBit.B k
proof:
:= by
  rw [B, RingHom.map_field_closure]
  change Subfield.closure ((fieldEquiv k) '' _) = _
  rw [Set.image_union, Set.image_union, scalar_range, measurement_range,
    Set.image_singleton, fieldEquiv_detector]
  rfl

name: FrameInvariants.GenericBridge.mem_H
statement: theorem mem_H (x : FunctionField k) : x ∈ H k ↔ fieldEquiv k x ∈ OneBit.H k
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_H]
  exact (Subfield.map_mem_map (fieldEquiv k).toRingHom).symm

name: FrameInvariants.GenericBridge.mem_B
statement: theorem mem_B (x : FunctionField k) : x ∈ B k ↔ fieldEquiv k x ∈ OneBit.B k
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_B]
  exact (Subfield.map_mem_map (fieldEquiv k).toRingHom).symm

name: FrameInvariants.Bridge.decode_encode
statement: theorem decode_encode [CommRing R] (x : Coord R) : decode (encode x) = x
proof:
:= by
  funext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [decode, encode]

name: FrameInvariants.Bridge.encode_decode
statement: theorem encode_decode [CommRing R] (a : TauCeti.AlbertAlgebra R) : encode (decode a) = a
proof:
:= by
  ext i <;> fin_cases i <;> simp [decode, encode]
  all_goals rename_i j; fin_cases j <;> rfl

name: FrameInvariants.Bridge.encode_eq
statement: theorem encode_eq (x : Coord R) : encode x = toTau (f0FirstTitsEquiv x)
proof:
:= by
  ext i <;> fin_cases i <;> simp [encode, toTau, toTauRaw, f0FirstTitsEquiv, f0ToFirstTitsRaw]

name: FrameInvariants.Bridge.coordinateEquiv_apply
statement: theorem coordinateEquiv_apply (x : Coord R) : coordinateEquiv x = encode x
proof:
:=
  (encode_eq x).symm

name: FrameInvariants.Bridge.encode_old_product
statement: theorem encode_old_product (x y : Coord R) : encode (f0ProductK x y) = encode x * encode y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [encode_eq]
  rw [f0FirstTitsEquiv_f0ProductK, toTau_polarProduct]

name: FrameInvariants.Bridge.decode_product
statement: theorem decode_product (x y : Coord R) : decode (encode x * encode y) = f0ProductK x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← encode_old_product, decode_encode]

name: FrameInvariants.Bridge.trace_encode
statement: theorem trace_encode (x : Coord R) : TauCeti.AlbertAlgebra.trace (encode x) = trace x
proof:
:= by
  simp [encode, trace, TauCeti.AlbertAlgebra.trace_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ, add_assoc]

name: FrameInvariants.Bridge.encode_old_unit
statement: theorem encode_old_unit : encode (f0OneK : Coord R) = 1
proof:
:= by
  ext i <;> fin_cases i <;> simp [encode, f0OneK]
  all_goals rename_i j; fin_cases j <;> rfl

name: FrameInvariants.Bridge.unit_eq
statement: theorem unit_eq : (unit : Coord R) = f0OneK
proof:
:= by
  rw [unit, ← encode_old_unit, decode_encode]

name: FrameInvariants.Bridge.coefficient_eq
statement:
theorem coefficient_eq (i j k : Fin 27) :
    coefficient i j k = AlbertLean.Generated.tensorCoeff i j k
proof:
:= by
  simp [coefficient, decode_product, f0ProductK, tensorCoeffK, Pi.single_apply]

name: FrameInvariants.Bridge.product_tensor
statement:
theorem product_tensor [CommRing R] [Algebra ℚ R] (x y : Coord R) :
    product x y = fun k => ∑ i : Fin 27, ∑ j : Fin 27,
      x i * y j * algebraMap ℚ R (AlbertLean.Generated.tensorCoeff i j k)
proof:
:= by
  funext k
  unfold product
  simp_rw [coefficient_eq]

name: FrameInvariants.Bridge.product_eq
statement: theorem product_eq [Field R] [CharZero R] (x y : Coord R) : product x y = f0ProductK x y
proof:
:= by
  funext k
  unfold product f0ProductK tensorCoeffK
  simp_rw [coefficient_eq]

name: FrameInvariants.Bridge.encode_product
statement: theorem encode_product (x y : Coord R) : encode (product x y) = encode x * encode y
proof:
:= by
  rw [product_eq, encode_old_product]

name: FrameInvariants.Bridge.encode_unit
statement: theorem encode_unit : encode (unit : Coord R) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [unit_eq, encode_old_unit]

name: FrameInvariants.Bridge.model_core
statement:
theorem model_core :
    ∃ e : Coord R ≃ₗ[R] TauCeti.AlbertAlgebra R,
      (∀ x, e x = encode x) ∧ e unit = 1 ∧
      (∀ x y, e (product x y) = e x * e y) ∧
      (∀ x, TauCeti.AlbertAlgebra.trace (e x) = trace x)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨coordinateEquiv, coordinateEquiv_apply, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [coordinateEquiv_apply] using (encode_unit (R := R))
  · intro x y
    simpa only [coordinateEquiv_apply] using encode_product x y
  · intro x
    simpa only [coordinateEquiv_apply] using trace_encode x

name: FrameInvariants.oneBit
statement: theorem oneBit : Reconstruction k
proof:
:= by
  have old := OneBit.Bridge.oneBit_proof k
  have h := GenericTransfer.quadratic_basis
    (GenericBridge.fieldEquiv k) (H k) (B k) (OneBit.H k) (OneBit.B k)
    (genericDetector k) (OneBit.detector k) (GenericBridge.fieldEquiv_detector k)
    (GenericBridge.mem_H k) (GenericBridge.mem_B k)
    old.2.2.1 old.2.2.2.1 old.2.2.2.2
  exact ⟨GenericBridge.every_automorphism_lifts k, GenericBridge.fixedField_eq_B k,
    h.1, h.2.1, h.2.2⟩

name: FrameInvariants.rawFrameRing_isDomain
statement: theorem rawFrameRing_isDomain : DomainClaim k
proof:
:= by
  letI := AlbertLean.Generic.SourceScheduleReducedDomain.reducedCoordinateRing_isDomain k
  exact (RawBridge.coordinateRingEquiv k).toMulEquiv.isDomain

name: FrameInvariants.GenericTransfer.quadratic_basis
statement:
theorem quadratic_basis (e : M ≃+* N) (H B : Subfield M) (H' B' : Subfield N)
    (d : M) (d' : N) (hd : e d = d')
    (hH : ∀ x, x ∈ H ↔ e x ∈ H') (hB : ∀ x, x ∈ B ↔ e x ∈ B')
    (hne : d' ∉ H')
    (hquad : ∃ s p : H', d' ^ 2 - (s : N) * d' + (p : N) = 0)
    (hbasis : ∀ x : B', ∃! ab : H' × H',
      (ab.1 : N) + (ab.2 : N) * d' = (x : N)) :
    d ∉ H ∧
    (∃ s p : H, d ^ 2 - (s : M) * d + (p : M) = 0) ∧
    (∀ x : B, ∃! ab : H × H,
      (ab.1 : M) + (ab.2 : M) * d = (x : M))
proof:
:= by
  have back_mem (a : H') : e.symm (a : N) ∈ H := by
    apply (hH _).mpr
    simpa using a.property
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro h
    apply hne
    simpa [hd] using (hH d).mp h
  · obtain ⟨s, p, hp⟩ := hquad
    refine ⟨⟨e.symm s, back_mem s⟩, ⟨e.symm p, back_mem p⟩, ?_⟩
    apply e.injective
    simpa only [map_add, map_sub, map_mul, map_pow, map_zero,
      RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply, hd] using hp
  · intro x
    obtain ⟨ab, hab, huniq⟩ := hbasis ⟨e x, (hB x).mp x.property⟩
    let cd : H × H := (⟨e.symm ab.1, back_mem ab.1⟩,
      ⟨e.symm ab.2, back_mem ab.2⟩)
    have hcd : (cd.1 : M) + (cd.2 : M) * d = (x : M) := by
      apply e.injective
      simpa only [cd, map_add, map_mul, RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply, hd] using hab
    refine ⟨cd, hcd, ?_⟩
    intro yz hyz
    let old : H' × H' := (⟨e yz.1, (hH yz.1).mp yz.1.property⟩,
      ⟨e yz.2, (hH yz.2).mp yz.2.property⟩)
    have hold : (old.1 : N) + (old.2 : N) * d' = e x := by
      simpa only [old, map_add, map_mul, hd] using congrArg e hyz
    have heq : old = ab := huniq old hold
    apply Prod.ext
    · apply Subtype.ext
      apply e.injective
      have h := congrArg (fun z : H' × H' => (z.1 : N)) heq
      simpa only [old, cd, RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using h
    · apply Subtype.ext
      apply e.injective
      have h := congrArg (fun z : H' × H' => (z.2 : N)) heq
      simpa only [old, cd, RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using h

name: FrameInvariants.splitAlbertModel
statement: theorem splitAlbertModel : ModelClaim k

    simpa only [fromOldAction, RingEquiv.trans_apply, RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using this
  · intro hx g σ hσ
    have h := hx (toOldAut k g) (toOldAction k σ) (lifts_toOld k g σ hσ)
    apply (fieldEquiv k).injective
    simpa only [toOldAction, RingEquiv.trans_apply, RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply] using h

name: OneBit.Bridge.lifts_fromSource

theorem lifts_fromSource (g : ResidualAction.SourceAut (K := k)) :
    OneBit.Lifts k (fromSource k g) (fractionAction k g)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro a
    exact AlbertRawInvariantFieldLower.scalar_mem_invariantField k a g
  · intro r i c
    calc
      fractionAction k g (OneBit.universal k r i c) =
          SourceAutExtension.linearEquiv (R := OneBit.F k) g (universalF0 k r i) c :=
        congrFun (fractionAction_universalF0 k g r i) c
      _ = ∑ b : Fin 27, universalF0 k r i b *
          algebraMap k (OneBit.F k) (SourceAutExtension.baseLinear g (Pi.single b 1) c) :=
        SourceAutExtension.linearEquiv_apply_coordinate g _ c

name: OneBit.Bridge.lifts_unique
statement:
theorem lifts_unique (g : OneBit.Aut k) (σ τ : OneBit.F k ≃+* OneBit.F k)
    (hσ : OneBit.Lifts k g σ) (hτ : OneBit.Lifts k g τ) : σ = τ
proof:
:= by
  have hp : σ.toRingHom.comp (OneBit.rawMap k) =
      τ.toRingHom.comp (OneBit.rawMap k) := by
    apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
    · intro a
      exact (hσ.1 a).trans (hτ.1 a).symm
    · intro v
      cases v with
      | entry r i c => exact (hσ.2 r i c).trans (hτ.2 r i c).symm
  have hr : σ.toRingHom = τ.toRingHom := by
    apply IsFractionRing.ringHom_ext (A := ReducedCoordinateRing k)
    intro z
    obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective z
    exact RingHom.congr_fun hp p
  apply RingEquiv.ext
  intro x
  exact RingHom.congr_fun hr x

name: OneBit.Bridge.oneBit_proof
statement: theorem oneBit_proof : OneBit.Result k
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨every_automorphism_lifts k, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (fixedField_eq_core k).trans
      (AlbertInvariantField.invariantField_eq_ledgerDetectorField k)
  · exact AlbertRawDetectorNonmembership.detectorValue_not_mem_originalRawLedgerField k
  · exact AlbertActualDetectorPairCoefficients.exists_original_detector_quadratic k
  · change ∀ x : AlbertRawDetectorExactDegreeTwo.B k,
      ∃! ab : AlbertRawDetectorExactDegreeTwo.H k × AlbertRawDetectorExactDegreeTwo.H k,
        (ab.1 : OneBit.F k) + (ab.2 : OneBit.F k) *
          AlbertRawInvariantFieldLower.detectorValue k = (x : OneBit.F k)
    intro x
    obtain ⟨ab, hab⟩ := (AlbertRawDetectorExactDegreeTwo.detectorCoordinates_bijective k).2 x
    have hv : (ab.1 : OneBit.F k) + (ab.2 : OneBit.F k) *
        AlbertRawInvariantFieldLower.detectorValue k = (x : OneBit.F k) := by
      simpa only [AlbertRawDetectorExactDegreeTwo.detectorCoordinates_coe] using
        congrArg (fun z : AlbertRawDetectorExactDegreeTwo.B k => (z : OneBit.F k)) hab
    refine ⟨ab, hv, ?_⟩
    intro cd hcd
    apply (AlbertRawDetectorExactDegreeTwo.detectorCoordinates_bijective k).1
    apply Subtype.ext
    simpa only [AlbertRawDetectorExactDegreeTwo.detectorCoordinates_coe] using
      hcd.trans hv.symm

name: AlbertLean.encoder_cube
statement:
private theorem encoder_cube (c : Coord) (hc : LawfulEncoder c) :
    structuredProduct c (structuredProduct c c) = c
proof:
:= by
  rcases hc with ⟨hT, hS, hN⟩
  have h := characteristicIdentity c
  rw [hT, hS, hN] at h
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  simpa [sub_eq_add_neg] using h

name: AlbertLean.encoder_square_idempotent
proof:
:= by
  have h := jordanIdentity c c
  rw [encoder_cube c hc] at h
  exact h

name: AlbertLean.lawfulFrame_of_lawfulEncoder
statement:
theorem lawfulFrame_of_lawfulEncoder (c : Coord) (hc : LawfulEncoder c) :
    LawfulFrame c
proof:
:= by
  let a := structuredProduct c c
  have hcube : structuredProduct c a = c := encoder_cube c hc
  have hsquare : structuredProduct a a = a := encoder_square_idempotent c hc
  have hac : structuredProduct a c = c := by
    rw [productCommutative]
    exact hcube
  have hTa : traceN a = 2 := by
    rw [traceN_structuredProduct_eq_traceForm]
    have hT := hc.1
    have hS := hc.2.1
    have hSB : spurBilinear c c = -2 := by
      unfold spurN at hS
      unfold spurBilinear
      linarith
    rw [traceForm, hT, hSB]
    norm_num
  refine ⟨hc, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    fin_cases i
    · constructor
      · change structuredProduct ((2 : ℚ)⁻¹ • (a - c)) ((2 : ℚ)⁻¹ • (a - c)) =
          (2 : ℚ)⁻¹ • (a - c)
        rw [product_smul_left, product_smul_right, product_sub_left,
          product_sub_right, product_sub_right, hsquare, hac, hcube]
        norm_num
        module
      · change traceN ((2 : ℚ)⁻¹ • (a - c)) = 1
        rw [traceN_smul, traceN_sub, hTa, hc.1]
        norm_num
    · constructor
      · change structuredProduct (one - a) (one - a) = one - a
        rw [product_sub_left, product_sub_right, product_sub_right,
          (unitLaw one).1, (unitLaw a).1, (unitLaw a).2, hsquare]
        module
      · change traceN (one - a) = 1
        rw [traceN_sub, traceN_one, hTa]
        norm_num
    · constructor
      · change structuredProduct ((2 : ℚ)⁻¹ • (a + c)) ((2 : ℚ)⁻¹ • (a + c)) =
          (2 : ℚ)⁻¹ • (a + c)
        rw [product_smul_left, product_smul_right, productQBilinear.1,
          productQBilinear.2.2.1, productQBilinear.2.2.1,
          hsquare, hac, hcube]
        norm_num
        module
      · change traceN ((2 : ℚ)⁻¹ • (a + c)) = 1
        rw [traceN_smul, traceN_add, hTa, hc.1]
        norm_num
  · have hp01 : structuredProduct (projector c 0) (projector c 1) = 0 := by
      change structuredProduct ((2 : ℚ)⁻¹ • (a - c)) (one - a) = 0
      rw [product_smul_left, product_sub_left, product_sub_right,
        product_sub_right, (unitLaw a).2, hsquare, (unitLaw c).2, hcube]
      module
    have hp02 : structuredProduct (projector c 0) (projector c 2) = 0 := by
      change structuredProduct ((2 : ℚ)⁻¹ • (a - c))
        ((2 : ℚ)⁻¹ • (a + c)) = 0
      rw [product_smul_left, product_smul_right, product_sub_left,
        productQBilinear.2.2.1, productQBilinear.2.2.1,
        hsquare, hac, hcube]
      norm_num
      module
    have hp12 : structuredProduct (projector c 1) (projector c 2) = 0 := by
      change structuredProduct (one - a) ((2 : ℚ)⁻¹ • (a + c)) = 0
      rw [product_smul_right, productQBilinear.2.2.1,
        product_sub_left, product_sub_left,
        (unitLaw a).1, hsquare, (unitLaw c).1, hac]
      module
    intro i j hij
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
    · exact (hij rfl).elim
    · exact hp01
    · exact hp02
    · rw [productCommutative]
      exact hp01
    · exact (hij rfl).elim
    · exact hp12
    · rw [productCommutative]
      exact hp02
    · rw [productCommutative]
      exact hp12
    · exact (hij rfl).elim
  · change (2 : ℚ)⁻¹ • (a - c) + (one - a) + (2 : ℚ)⁻¹ • (a + c) = one
    norm_num
    module
  · change (2 : ℚ)⁻¹ • (a + c) - (2 : ℚ)⁻¹ • (a - c) = c
    norm_num
    module

statement:
theorem regressionM09 :
    m09LedgerTheta1.P 0 1 = q 1 36 ∧
    (ledger witnessThetaM).P 0 1 = q 4 3 ∧
    m09LedgerTheta1 ≠ ledger witnessThetaM
proof:
:= by
  have he1 : projector theta1E 1 = basisVec 1 := by
    rw [show projector theta1E 1 =
      one - structuredProduct theta1E theta1E by rfl, theta1E_square]
    funext k
    fin_cases k <;>
      norm_num [Theta1ESquare, one, basisVec, v, q, Fin.ext_iff]
  have hem0 : projector thetaME 0 = basisVec 0 := by
    rw [thetaME_eq_theta1E_fast]
    rw [show projector theta1E 0 =
      (2 : ℚ)⁻¹ • (structuredProduct theta1E theta1E - theta1E) by rfl,
      theta1E_square]
    funext k
    fin_cases k <;>
      norm_num [Theta1ESquare, theta1E, one, basisVec, v, q, Fin.ext_iff]
  have hf0coord : projector theta1F 0 1 = q 1 36 := by
    rw [show projector theta1F 0 =
      (2 : ℚ)⁻¹ • (structuredProduct theta1F theta1F - theta1F) by rfl,
      theta1F_square]
    norm_num [Theta1FSquare, theta1F, v, q]
  have hfm1coord : projector thetaMF 1 0 = q 4 3 := by
    rw [show projector thetaMF 1 =
      one - structuredProduct thetaMF thetaMF by rfl, thetaMF_square]
    norm_num [ThetaMFSquare, thetaMF, one, v, q]
  have hmut : m09LedgerTheta1.P 0 1 = q 1 36 := by
    simp [m09LedgerTheta1, ledger, witnessTheta1]
    rw [he1, traceForm_basis_1_scratch, hf0coord]
  have hbase : (ledger witnessThetaM).P 0 1 = q 4 3 := by
    simp [ledger, witnessThetaM]
    rw [hem0, traceForm_basis_0_scratch, hfm1coord]
  refine ⟨hmut, hbase, ?_⟩
  intro h
  have hp := congrArg (fun L : Ledger => L.P 0 1) h
  rw [hmut, hbase] at hp
  norm_num [q] at hp

proof:
:= by
  simp only [tauAlbertNorm, Fin.sum_univ_succ, Fin.sum_univ_zero, add_zero]
  change
    x.diag1 * x.diag2 * x.diag3 -
        (x.diag1 * TauCeti.Octonion.norm (zornToOctonion x.off23) +
          (x.diag2 * TauCeti.Octonion.norm (zornToOctonion x.off31) +
           x.diag3 * TauCeti.Octonion.norm (zornToOctonion x.off12))) +
        TauCeti.Octonion.trace

            zornToOctonion x.off23) = Hermitian3.cubicNorm x
  rw [zornToOctonion_norm, zornToOctonion_norm, zornToOctonion_norm,
    ← zornToOctonion_mul, ← zornToOctonion_mul, zornToOctonion_trace]

  ring

name: AlbertLean.productNorm_eq_cubicNorm
statement: theorem productNorm_eq_cubicNorm (x : Coord) : productNorm x = cubicNorm x
proof:
:= by
  have hs := productSpur_eq_spurN x
  rw [productSpur, productTrace_eq_traceN, productTrace_eq_traceN] at hs
  have hc0 := characteristicIdentity x
  have hc := congrArg traceN hc0
  simp only [traceN_sub, traceN_add, traceN_smul, traceN_zero, traceN_one] at hc
  rw [productNorm, productTrace_eq_traceN, productTrace_eq_traceN,
    productTrace_eq_traceN, traceN_structuredProduct_eq_traceForm,
    traceN_structuredProduct_eq_traceForm]
  rw [← traceN_structuredProduct_eq_traceForm,
    ← traceN_structuredProduct_eq_traceForm]
  ring_nf at hs hc ⊢
  linear_combination (1 / 3 : ℚ) * hc + (traceN x / 3) * hs

name: AlbertLean.cubicTraceResidual
statement:
private theorem cubicTraceResidual (x : Coord) :
    CubicJordan.residual productBilinearMap traceLinearMap one x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hs := productSpur_eq_spurN x
  have hn := productNorm_eq_cubicNorm x
  simp only [productSpur, productNorm, productTrace_eq_traceN] at hs hn
  have hc := characteristicIdentity x
  rw [← hs, ← hn] at hc
  calc
    CubicJordan.residual productBilinearMap traceLinearMap one x =
        (6 : ℚ) •
          (structuredProduct x (structuredProduct x x) -
            traceN x • structuredProduct x x +
            ((traceN x ^ 2 - traceN (structuredProduct x x)) / 2) • x -
            (traceN x ^ 3 / 6 -
              traceN x * traceN (structuredProduct x x) / 2 +
              traceN (structuredProduct x (structuredProduct x x)) / 3) • one) := by
      simp only [CubicJordan.residual, productBilinearMap, traceLinearMap,
        leftMulLinear, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk]
      module
    _ = 0 := by rw [hc]; simp

name: AlbertLean.jordanIdentity
statement:
theorem jordanIdentity (x y : Coord) :
    structuredProduct (structuredProduct x y) (structuredProduct x x) =
      structuredProduct x (structuredProduct y (structuredProduct x x))
proof:
:= by
  have htrace (a b c : Coord) :
      traceLinearMap (productBilinearMap (productBilinearMap a b) c) =
        traceLinearMap (productBilinearMap a (productBilinearMap b c)) := by
    change traceN (structuredProduct (structuredProduct a b) c) =
      traceN (structuredProduct a (structuredProduct b c))
    rw [traceN_structuredProduct_eq_traceForm,
      traceN_structuredProduct_eq_traceForm]
    exact traceFormAssociative a b c
  exact CubicJordan.jordan_of_cubic_trace_identity
    productBilinearMap traceLinearMap one productCommutative
    (fun z => (unitLaw z).1) htrace cubicTraceResidual x y

name: AlbertLean.leftMulMatrixTrace_eq_linearMapTrace

theorem leftMulMatrixTrace_eq_linearMapTrace
    (h : IsQBilinear structuredProduct) (x : Coord) :
    leftMulMatrixTrace x =
      LinearMap.trace ℚ Coord (leftMulLinear h x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hb : ∀ i : Slot, basisVec i = Pi.single i 1 := by
    intro i
    funext j
    simp [basisVec, Pi.single_apply, eq_comm]
  rw [LinearMap.trace_eq_matrix_trace ℚ (Pi.basisFun ℚ Slot)]
  simp_rw [leftMulMatrixTrace, hb]
  simp [Matrix.trace, leftMulLinear]

name: CubicJordan.linearResidual_eq_zero
statement:
theorem linearResidual_eq_zero
    (mul : V →ₗ[ℚ] V →ₗ[ℚ] V) (T : V →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ) (e : V)
    (comm : ∀ x y, mul x y = mul y x)
    (assocTrace : ∀ x y z, T (mul (mul x y) z) = T (mul x (mul y z)))
    (char : ∀ x, residual mul T e x = 0) (x y : V) :
    linearResidual mul T e x y = 0
proof:
:= by
  calc
    linearResidual mul T e x y = (1 / 6 : ℚ) •
        (residual mul T e (x + y) - residual mul T e (x - y) -
          (2 : ℚ) • residual mul T e y) := by
      simp only [linearResidual, residual, map_add, map_sub, map_smul,
        LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
        smul_eq_mul]
      simp only [comm y x, comm y (mul x x), ← assocTrace x x y]
      module
    _ = 0 := by rw [char, char, char]; simp

name: CubicJordan.jordan_of_cubic_trace_identity
statement:
theorem jordan_of_cubic_trace_identity
    (mul : V →ₗ[ℚ] V →ₗ[ℚ] V) (T : V →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ) (e : V)
    (comm : ∀ x y, mul x y = mul y x)
    (unit : ∀ x, mul e x = x)
    (assocTrace : ∀ x y z, T (mul (mul x y) z) = T (mul x (mul y z)))
    (char : ∀ x, residual mul T e x = 0) (x y : V) :
    mul (mul x y) (mul x x) = mul x (mul y (mul x x))
proof:
:= by
  have unitR (z : V) : mul z e = z := by rw [comm, unit]
  have hB₁ : T (mul x (mul x y)) = T (mul (mul x x) y) :=
    (assocTrace x x y).symm
  have hB₂ : T (mul (mul x x) (mul x y)) =
      T (mul (mul x (mul x x)) y) := by
    rw [← assocTrace, comm (mul x x) x]
  have hlin := linearResidual_eq_zero mul T e comm assocTrace char
  have hj : mul (mul x x) (mul x y) - mul x (mul (mul x x) y) = 0 := by
    calc
      mul (mul x x) (mul x y) - mul x (mul (mul x x) y) =
          (-1 / 2 : ℚ) •
            (mul x (linearResidual mul T e x y) -
              linearResidual mul T e x (mul x y)) -
          (T y / 6) • residual mul T e x +
          ((1 / 6 : ℚ) * T (mul (residual mul T e x) y)) • e := by
        simp only [linearResidual, residual, map_add, map_sub, map_smul,
          LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
          smul_eq_mul, unit, unitR, hB₁, hB₂]
        module
      _ = 0 := by rw [hlin, hlin, char]; simp
  have heq := sub_eq_zero.mp hj
  simpa only [comm (mul x y) (mul x x), comm y (mul x x)] using heq

name: AlbertLean.productQBilinear
statement: theorem productQBilinear : IsQBilinear structuredProduct
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x₁ x₂ y
    simp only [structuredProduct_eq_productForm]
    exact productForm_add_left x₁ x₂ y
  · intro a x y
    simp only [structuredProduct_eq_productForm]
    exact productForm_smul_left a x y
  · intro x y₁ y₂
    simp only [structuredProduct_eq_productForm]
    rw [productForm_commutative x (y₁ + y₂), productForm_add_left,
      productForm_commutative y₁ x, productForm_commutative y₂ x]
  · intro a x y
    simp only [structuredProduct_eq_productForm]
    rw [productForm_commutative x (a • y), productForm_smul_left,
      productForm_commutative y x]

name: AlbertLean.coordV_norm
statement:
private theorem coordV_norm (x : Coord) :
    Zorn.norm (coordV x) =
      v x 3 * v x 4 + v x 5 * v x 10 - v x 6 * v x 9 +
        v x 7 * v x 8

name: AlbertLean.regressionM01
statement:
theorem regressionM01 :
    m01TensorProduct (basisVec 0) (basisVec 11) (11 : Slot) = q (-1) 2 ∧
    m01TensorProduct (basisVec 11) (basisVec 0) (11 : Slot) = q 1 2 ∧
    m01TensorProduct (basisVec 0) (basisVec 11) ≠
      m01TensorProduct (basisVec 11) (basisVec 0)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [show m01TensorProduct (basisVec 0) (basisVec 11) =
        productForm (basisVec 0) (basisVec 11) -
          ((basisVec 0) 0 * (basisVec 11) 11) • basisVec 11 by
      simp [m01TensorProduct, tensorProduct_eq_productForm]]
    norm_num [productForm, basisVec, v, q, Fin.ext_iff]
  constructor
  · rw [show m01TensorProduct (basisVec 11) (basisVec 0) =
        productForm (basisVec 11) (basisVec 0) -
          ((basisVec 11) 0 * (basisVec 0) 11) • basisVec 11 by
      simp [m01TensorProduct, tensorProduct_eq_productForm]]
    norm_num [productForm, basisVec, v, q, Fin.ext_iff]
  · intro h
    have h11 := congrFun h (11 : Slot)
    simp [m01TensorProduct, tensorProduct_eq_productForm] at h11
    norm_num [productForm, basisVec, v, q, Fin.ext_iff] at h11

name: AlbertLean.regressionM05

name: AlbertLean.regressionM04T
statement:
theorem regressionM04T :

    cubicNorm m04TThetaM.cF = q 245 54 ∧
    ¬ LawfulFrameTriple m04TTheta1 ∧
    ¬ LawfulFrameTriple m04TThetaM
proof:
:= by
  have hn1 : cubicNorm m04TTheta1.cF = q 245 54 := by
    norm_num [m04TTheta1, m04TTheta1F, cubicNorm, v, q]
  have hnm : cubicNorm m04TThetaM.cF = q 245 54 := by
    norm_num [m04TThetaM, m04TThetaMF, cubicNorm, v, q]
  refine ⟨hn1, hnm, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro h
    have hf := h (1 : Fin 3)
    have hzero := hf.1.2.2
    have henc : encoder m04TTheta1 (1 : Fin 3) = m04TTheta1.cF := by rfl
    rw [henc] at hzero
    have hzero' : cubicNorm m04TTheta1.cF = 0 := by
      exact hzero
    rw [hn1] at hzero'
    norm_num [q] at hzero'
  · intro h
    have hf := h (1 : Fin 3)
    have hzero := hf.1.2.2
    have henc : encoder m04TThetaM (1 : Fin 3) = m04TThetaM.cF := by rfl
    rw [henc] at hzero
    have hzero' : cubicNorm m04TThetaM.cF = 0 := by

name: CompactOneBit.result_of_model
statement:
theorem result_of_model
    (inverse₁ : Function.LeftInverse fromAlbert toAlbert)
    (inverse₂ : Function.RightInverse fromAlbert toAlbert)
    (linear_add : ∀ x y, toAlbert (x+y) = toAlbert x + toAlbert y)
    (linear_smul : ∀ (a : ℚ) x, toAlbert (a • x) = a • toAlbert x)
    (maps_unit : toAlbert unit = 1)
    (maps_cubic : ∀ x, albertNorm (toAlbert x) = cubic x)
    (maps_product : ∀ x y, toAlbert (product x y) = toAlbert x * toAlbert y) :
    Result
proof:
:= by
  have h := AlbertLean.solution
  refine {
    inverse₁ := inverse₁
    inverse₂ := inverse₂
    linear_add := linear_add
    linear_smul := linear_smul
    maps_unit := maps_unit
    maps_cubic := maps_cubic
    maps_product := maps_product
    add_left := ?_
    smul_left := ?_
    add_right := ?_
    smul_right := ?_
    commutative := ?_
    unital := ?_
    symmetric := ?_
    nondegenerate := ?_
    associative_trace := ?_
    jordan := ?_
    characteristic := ?_
    printed_trace := ?_
    printed_spur := ?_
    printed_norm := ?_
    first_frames := ?_
    second_frames := ?_
    same_pairs := ?_
    same_centered := ?_
    first_value := ?_
    second_value := ?_
    unequal := ?_
    factor_three := ?_
    nontransport := no_compact_transporter
    invariant := detector_invariant }
  · simpa only [product_eq] using h.productQBilinear.1
  · simpa only [product_eq] using h.productQBilinear.2.1
  · simpa only [product_eq] using h.productQBilinear.2.2.1
  · simpa only [product_eq] using h.productQBilinear.2.2.2
  · simpa only [product_eq] using h.productCommutative
  · simpa only [product_eq, unit_eq] using h.unitLaw
  · simpa only [pairing_eq] using h.traceFormSymmetricNondegenerate.1
  · simpa only [pairing_eq, AlbertLean.NondegenerateTraceForm] using
      h.traceFormSymmetricNondegenerate.2
  · simpa only [pairing_eq, product_eq] using h.traceFormAssociative
  · simpa only [product_eq] using h.jordanIdentity
  · simpa only [product_eq, trace_eq, spur_eq, cubic_eq, unit_eq,
      AlbertLean.CharacteristicIdentity]
      using h.characteristicIdentity
  · simpa only [operatorTrace_eq, trace_eq] using h.printedInvariantsAgree.1
  · simpa only [operatorSpur_eq, spur_eq] using h.printedInvariantsAgree.2.1
  · simpa only [operatorNorm_eq, cubic_eq] using h.printedInvariantsAgree.2.2
  · intro r
    rw [frame_eq]
    have hw := h.witnessTheta1Lawful r
    simpa only [← oldTriple_first, encoder_oldTriple] using hw
  · intro r
    rw [frame_eq]
    have hw := h.witnessThetaMLawful r
    simpa only [← oldTriple_second, encoder_oldTriple] using hw
  · funext r i j
    fin_cases r
    · change pairs first 0 i j = pairs second 0 i j
      rw [congrFun (congrFun (pairs_eq first).1 i) j,
        congrFun (congrFun (pairs_eq second).1 i) j,
        oldTriple_first, oldTriple_second]
      exact congrArg (fun L => L.P i j) h.witnessSameLedger
    · change pairs first 1 i j = pairs second 1 i j
      rw [congrFun (congrFun (pairs_eq first).2.1 i) j,
        congrFun (congrFun (pairs_eq second).2.1 i) j,
        oldTriple_first, oldTriple_second]
      exact congrArg (fun L => L.Q i j) h.witnessSameLedger
    · change pairs first 2 i j = pairs second 2 i j
      rw [congrFun (congrFun (pairs_eq first).2.2 i) j,
        congrFun (congrFun (pairs_eq second).2.2 i) j,
        oldTriple_first, oldTriple_second]
      exact congrArg (fun L => L.R i j) h.witnessSameLedger
  · rw [centered_eq, centered_eq, oldTriple_first, oldTriple_second]
    exact congrArg AlbertLean.Ledger.C0 h.witnessSameLedger
  · rw [detector_eq, oldTriple_first]
    convert h.witnessDetectorValues.1 using 1 <;> norm_num [AlbertLean.q]
  · rw [detector_eq, oldTriple_second]
    convert h.witnessDetectorValues.2.1 using 1 <;> norm_num [AlbertLean.q]
  · simpa only [detector_eq, oldTriple_first, oldTriple_second] using
      h.witnessDetectorValues.2.2
  · intro X htrace
    have hold := h.detectorFactorThree (oldTriple X)
    rw [← trace_eq, ← word_eq] at hold
    simpa only [detector_eq, AlbertLean.cubicNormDetector, word_eq, cubic_eq]
      using hold htrace

name: CompactOneBit.toAlbert_eq
statement:
theorem toAlbert_eq (x : Coord) :
    toAlbert x = AlbertLean.hermitianToAlbert (AlbertLean.coordToHermitian x)
proof:
:= by
  apply TauCeti.AlbertAlgebra.ext
  · funext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [toAlbert, AlbertLean.hermitianToAlbert,
      AlbertLean.coordToHermitian, AlbertLean.v]
  · funext i
    fin_cases i <;>
      apply TauCeti.Octonion.ext <;>
      simp [toAlbert, AlbertLean.hermitianToAlbert, AlbertLean.coordToHermitian,
        AlbertLean.coordV, AlbertLean.coordS, AlbertLean.coordC,
        AlbertLean.zornToOctonion, AlbertLean.v]

    fromAlbert a = AlbertLean.hermitianToCoord (AlbertLean.albertToHermitian a)
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;>
    simp [fromAlbert, AlbertLean.hermitianToCoord, AlbertLean.albertToHermitian,
      AlbertLean.octonionToZorn]

name: CompactOneBit.albertNorm_eq
statement:
theorem albertNorm_eq (a : Albert) :
    albertNorm a = AlbertLean.tauAlbertNorm a
proof: := rfl

name: CompactOneBit.compactResult
statement: theorem compactResult : Result
proof:
:= by
  apply result_of_model
  · intro x
    rw [toAlbert_eq, fromAlbert_eq,
      AlbertLean.albertToHermitian_hermitianToAlbert,
      AlbertLean.hermitianToCoord_coordToHermitian]
  · intro x
    rw [fromAlbert_eq, toAlbert_eq,
      AlbertLean.coordToHermitian_hermitianToCoord,
      AlbertLean.hermitianToAlbert_albertToHermitian]
  · intro x y
    rw [toAlbert_eq, AlbertLean.coordToHermitian_add,
      AlbertLean.hermitianToAlbert_add, toAlbert_eq, toAlbert_eq]
  · intro a x
    rw [toAlbert_eq, AlbertLean.coordToHermitian_smul,
      AlbertLean.hermitianToAlbert_smul, toAlbert_eq]
  · rw [unit_eq, toAlbert_eq, AlbertLean.coordToHermitian_one,
      AlbertLean.hermitianToAlbert_one]
  · intro x
    rw [albertNorm_eq, toAlbert_eq,
      AlbertLean.tauAlbertNorm_hermitianToAlbert,
      AlbertLean.coordToHermitian_cubicNorm, cubic_eq]
  · intro x y
    rw [toAlbert_eq, product_eq,
      AlbertLean.coordToHermitian_structuredProduct,
      AlbertLean.hermitianToAlbert_jordan, toAlbert_eq, toAlbert_eq]

name: CompactOneBit.transports_toOldAut
statement:
theorem transports_toOldAut (g : Aut) (X Y : Triple)
    (h : Transports g X Y) :
    AlbertLean.Transports (toOldAut g) (oldTriple X) (oldTriple Y)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨h 0, h 1, h 2⟩

name: CompactOneBit.detector_invariant
statement:
theorem detector_invariant (g : Aut) (X Y : Triple)
    (h : Transports g X Y) : detector Y = detector X
proof:
:= by
  rw [detector_eq, detector_eq]
  exact AlbertLean.traceCubeDetector_invariant
    (toOldAut g) (oldTriple X) (oldTriple Y) (transports_toOldAut g X Y h)

name: CompactOneBit.no_compact_transporter
statement: theorem no_compact_transporter : ¬ ∃ g : Aut, Transports g first second
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨g, hg⟩
  apply AlbertLean.solution.noUnitalProductAutomorphismTransports
  refine ⟨toOldAut g, ?_⟩
  rw [← oldTriple_first, ← oldTriple_second]
  exact transports_toOldAut g first second hg

name: AlbertLean.Triality.CoordinateTensor.BS_nondegenerate
statement:
theorem BS_nondegenerate {s : SCoord K} (h : ∀ t : SCoord K, BS s t = 0) :
    s = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hphi : s.phi = 0 := by
    funext i
    have hi := h ({ p := uBasis i, phi := 0 } : SCoord K)
    fin_cases i <;> simpa [BS, evalU, uBasis] using hi
  have hp : s.p = 0 := by
    funext i
    have hi := h ({ p := 0, phi := uDualBasis i } : SCoord K)
    fin_cases i <;> simpa [BS, evalU, uDualBasis] using hi
  change s = ({ p := 0, phi := 0 } : SCoord K)
  exact SCoord.ext hp hphi

    funext i
    have hi := h ({ q := uBasis i, psi := 0 } : CCoord K)
    fin_cases i <;> simpa [BC, evalU, uBasis] using hi
  have hq : c.q = 0 := by
    funext i
    have hi := h ({ q := 0, psi := uDualBasis i } : CCoord K)
    fin_cases i <;> simpa [BC, evalU, uDualBasis] using hi
  change c = ({ q := 0, psi := 0 } : CCoord K)
  exact CCoord.ext hq hpsi

        + (1 - alpha * beta) * evalU c.psi s.p * evalU s.phi c.q
proof:
:= by
  simp only [nV, muV, pf_polar, pf_smul, decomposable_pf_zero,
    pf_hodgeStar_dualWedge_zero, BW_smul_left, BW_smul_right,

  intro s c
  rw [nV_muV, h]
  simp [nS, nC]

    (∀ s c, nV (muV alpha beta s c) = nS s * nC c) ↔ alpha * beta = 1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hw := h (sBasis 0) (cBasis 1)
    rw [composition_diagonal_witness] at hw
    simpa [nS_basis, nC_basis] using hw
  · exact composition_of_mul_eq_one

name: AlbertLean.Triality.CoordinateTensor.TrialityTensorCompositionTheorem
statement:
theorem TrialityTensorCompositionTheorem (alpha beta : K) :
    (∀ (v : VCoord K) (s : SCoord K) (c : CCoord K),
      triality v s c =
        v.r * evalU s.phi c.q
          + v.z * evalU c.psi s.p
          + BW v.omega (wedge2 s.p c.q)
          + pairW v.omega (dualWedge2 s.phi c.psi)) ∧
    (∀ (s : SCoord K) (c : CCoord K),
      muV alpha beta s c =
        { r := evalU c.psi s.p
          z := evalU s.phi c.q
          omega := alpha • wedge2 s.p c.q
            + beta • hodgeStar (dualWedge2 s.phi c.psi) }) ∧
    (∀ (s : SCoord K) (c : CCoord K),
      nV (muV alpha beta s c) =
        alpha * beta * evalU s.phi s.p * evalU c.psi c.q
          + (1 - alpha * beta) * evalU c.psi s.p * evalU s.phi c.q) ∧
    ((∀ (s : SCoord K) (c : CCoord K),
      nV (muV alpha beta s c) = nS s * nC c) ↔ alpha * beta = 1)
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨fun _ _ _ => rfl, fun _ _ => rfl, nV_muV alpha beta,
    composition_iff_mul_eq_one alpha beta⟩

name: AlbertLean.Triality.CoordinateTensor.composition_does_not_force_normalization
statement:
theorem composition_does_not_force_normalization :
    ∃ alpha beta : ℚ,
      (∀ s c, nV (muV alpha beta s c) = nS s * nC c) ∧
        alpha ≠ 1 ∧ beta ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨2, 1 / 2, ?_, by norm_num, by norm_num⟩
  exact composition_of_mul_eq_one (by norm_num)

name: AlbertLean.Triality.StructuredAdjoint.sourceExplicitAdjoint_characterization
statement:
theorem sourceExplicitAdjoint_characterization (x y : JCoord K) :
    sourceTraceForm (sourceExplicitAdjoint x) y = sourcePolar x x y / 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [sourceTraceForm_formula, sourcePolar_eq_formula]
  simp [sourceExplicitAdjoint, sourceMuS, sourceMuC, sourcePolarFormula,
    normalizedMuV, muV, nV, nS, nC, pf_coordinate, BV, BS, BC, triality,
    evalU, BW, pairW, wedge2, dualWedge2, hodgeStar]
  field_simp
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Triality.StructuredAdjoint.sourceAdjoint_characterization
statement:
theorem sourceAdjoint_characterization (x y : JCoord K) :
    sourceTraceForm (sourceAdjoint x) y = sourcePolar x x y / 2
proof:
:= by
  simpa [sourceAdjoint, sourceRecoveryData] using
    (sourceRecoveryData (K := K)).adjoint_characterization x y

name: AlbertLean.Triality.StructuredAdjoint.sourceAdjoint_eq_explicit
statement:
theorem sourceAdjoint_eq_explicit (x : JCoord K) :
    sourceAdjoint x = sourceExplicitAdjoint x
proof:
:= by
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  apply sourceTraceForm_nondegenerate
  intro y
  change sourceTraceFormLinear (sourceAdjoint x - sourceExplicitAdjoint x) y = 0
  simp only [map_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply]
  change sourceTraceForm (sourceAdjoint x) y -
      sourceTraceForm (sourceExplicitAdjoint x) y = 0
  rw [sourceAdjoint_characterization, sourceExplicitAdjoint_characterization]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Triality.StructuredAdjoint.sourceAdjoint_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem sourceAdjoint_one :
    sourceAdjoint (sourceOne : JCoord K) = sourceOne
proof:
:= by
  rw [sourceAdjoint_eq_explicit]
  ext <;>
    simp [sourceExplicitAdjoint, sourceOne, sourceMuS, sourceMuC,
      normalizedMuV, muV, nV, nS, nC, Pf, evalU, BW, pairW, wedge2,
      dualWedge2, hodgeStar]
  all_goals
    rename_i i
    fin_cases i <;> simp

theorem sourceCross_characterization (x y z : JCoord K) :
    sourceTraceForm (sourceCross x y) z =
      (sourcePolar x y z + sourcePolar y x z) / 2
proof:
:= by
  simpa [sourceCross, sourceRecoveryData] using
    (sourceRecoveryData (K := K)).cross_characterization x y z

name: AlbertLean.Triality.StructuredProduct.sourceCross_comm
statement: theorem sourceCross_comm (x y : JCoord K) : sourceCross x y = sourceCross y x
proof:
:=

name: AlbertLean.Triality.StructuredProduct.sourceCross_one_left
statement:
theorem sourceCross_one_left (x : JCoord K) :
    sourceCross sourceOne x = sourceTrace x • sourceOne - x
proof:
:= by
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  apply sourceTraceForm_nondegenerate
  intro y
  change sourceTraceFormLinear
    (sourceCross sourceOne x - (sourceTrace x • sourceOne - x)) y = 0
  simp only [map_sub, map_smul, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
    smul_eq_mul]
  change sourceTraceForm (sourceCross sourceOne x) y -
      (sourceTrace x * sourceTraceForm sourceOne y - sourceTraceForm x y) = 0
  rw [sourceCross_characterization, sourcePolar_swap_left x sourceOne y,
    sourcePolar_one, sourceTraceForm_one_left]
  rw [sourceTraceForm]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Triality.StructuredProduct.sourceCross_one_right
statement:
theorem sourceCross_one_right (x : JCoord K) :
    sourceCross x sourceOne = sourceTrace x • sourceOne - x
proof:
:= by
  rw [sourceCross_comm]
  exact sourceCross_one_left x

name: AlbertLean.Triality.StructuredProduct.sourceProduct_formula
statement:
theorem sourceProduct_formula (x y : JCoord K) :
    sourceProduct x y = (2 : K)⁻¹ •
      (sourceCross x y + sourceTrace x • y + sourceTrace y • x -
        sourceSpurBilinear x y • sourceOne)
proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Triality.StructuredProduct.sourceProduct_comm
statement: theorem sourceProduct_comm (x y : JCoord K) : sourceProduct x y = sourceProduct y x
proof:
:= by

  exact sourceTraceForm_symmetric

name: AlbertLean.Triality.StructuredProduct.sourceProduct_one_left
statement:
@[simp] theorem sourceProduct_one_left (x : JCoord K) :
    sourceProduct sourceOne x = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [sourceProduct_formula, sourceCross_one_left]
  have hS : sourceSpurBilinear (sourceOne : JCoord K) x = 2 * sourceTrace x := by
    simp [sourceSpurBilinear, sourceTraceForm_one_left]
    ring
  rw [hS]
  simp
  module

name: AlbertLean.Triality.StructuredProduct.sourceProduct_one_right
statement:
@[simp] theorem sourceProduct_one_right (x : JCoord K) :
    sourceProduct x sourceOne = x
proof:
:= by

  exact sourceProduct_one_left x

name: AlbertLean.Triality.StructuredProduct.sourceCross_self_eq_two_adjoint
statement:
theorem sourceCross_self_eq_two_adjoint (x : JCoord K) :
    sourceCross x x = (2 : K) • sourceAdjoint x
proof:
:= by
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  apply sourceTraceForm_nondegenerate
  intro y
  change sourceTraceFormLinear
    (sourceCross x x - (2 : K) • sourceAdjoint x) y = 0
  simp only [map_sub, map_smul, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
    smul_eq_mul]
  change sourceTraceForm (sourceCross x x) y -
      2 * sourceTraceForm (sourceAdjoint x) y = 0
  rw [sourceCross_characterization, sourceAdjoint_characterization]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Triality.StructuredProduct.sourceAdjoint_eq_product_square
statement:
theorem sourceAdjoint_eq_product_square (x : JCoord K) :
    sourceAdjoint x = sourceProduct x x - sourceTrace x • x + sourceSpur x • sourceOne
proof:
:= by
  have hS : sourceSpurBilinear x x = 2 * sourceSpur x := by
    rw [sourceSpurBilinear, sourceTraceForm, sourceSpurPolar_diagonal]
    ring
  rw [sourceProduct_formula, sourceCross_self_eq_two_adjoint, hS]
  module

name: AlbertLean.Triality.StructuredProduct.StructuredSourceProductTheorem
statement:
theorem StructuredSourceProductTheorem :
    (∀ x : JCoord K, sourceProduct sourceOne x = x) ∧
    (∀ x : JCoord K, sourceProduct x sourceOne = x) ∧
    (∀ x y : JCoord K, sourceProduct x y = sourceProduct y x) ∧
    (∀ x₁ x₂ y : JCoord K,
      sourceProduct (x₁ + x₂) y = sourceProduct x₁ y + sourceProduct x₂ y) ∧
    (∀ (a : K) (x y : JCoord K),
      sourceProduct (a • x) y = a • sourceProduct x y)
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨sourceProduct_one_left, sourceProduct_one_right, sourceProduct_comm,
    sourceProduct_add_left, sourceProduct_smul_left⟩

name: AlbertLean.Triality.ExteriorSix.BW_nondegenerate
statement: theorem BW_nondegenerate {w : W K} (h : ∀ v : W K, BW w v = 0) : w = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h12 : w .i12 = 0 := by
    simpa [BW, wBasis] using h (wBasis .i34)
  have h13 : w .i13 = 0 := by
    have hi := h (wBasis .i24)
    simp [BW, wBasis] at hi
    exact hi
  have h14 : w .i14 = 0 := by
    simpa [BW, wBasis] using h (wBasis .i23)
  have h23 : w .i23 = 0 := by
    simpa [BW, wBasis] using h (wBasis .i14)
  have h24 : w .i24 = 0 := by
    have hi := h (wBasis .i13)
    simp [BW, wBasis] at hi
    exact hi
  have h34 : w .i34 = 0 := by
    simpa [BW, wBasis] using h (wBasis .i12)
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;> simp [h12, h13, h14, h23, h24, h34]

statement: theorem pf_eq_half_BW_self (w : W K) : Pf w = ⅟ (2 : K) * BW w w
proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Triality.ExteriorSix.pf_coordinate
statement:
theorem pf_coordinate (w : W K) :
    Pf w = w .i12 * w .i34 - w .i13 * w .i24 + w .i14 * w .i23
proof:
:= by
  unfold Pf
  rw [show BW w w =
      2 * (w .i12 * w .i34 - w .i13 * w .i24 + w .i14 * w .i23) by
    simp [BW]
    ring]
  rw [← mul_assoc, invOf_mul_self, one_mul]

name: AlbertLean.Triality.ExteriorSix.pf_zero

proof:
:= by
  simp [pf_coordinate]

name: AlbertLean.Triality.ExteriorSix.pf_smul
statement: theorem pf_smul (a : K) (w : W K) : Pf (a • w) = a ^ 2 * Pf w
proof:
:= by
  rw [pf_coordinate, pf_coordinate]
  simp
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Triality.ExteriorSix.pf_polar
statement: theorem pf_polar (w v : W K) : Pf (w + v) = Pf w + Pf v + BW w v
proof:
:= by
  rw [pf_coordinate, pf_coordinate, pf_coordinate]
  simp [BW]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Triality.ExteriorSix.decomposable_pf_zero
statement: theorem decomposable_pf_zero (p q : U K) : Pf (wedge2 p q) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [pf_coordinate]
  simp [wedge2]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Triality.ExteriorSix.pf_basis_i12_add_i34

proof:

  rw [pf_coordinate]
  simp [wBasis]

name: AlbertLean.Triality.ExteriorSix.BS_symmetric
statement: theorem BS_symmetric (s t : SCoord K) : BS s t = BS t s
proof:
:= by
  simp [BS, add_comm]

name: AlbertLean.Triality.ExteriorSix.BC_symmetric
statement: theorem BC_symmetric (c d : CCoord K) : BC c d = BC d c

name: AlbertLean.Triality.ExteriorSix.BS_self_eq_two_nS

  simp [BS, nS]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Triality.ExteriorSix.BC_self_eq_two_nC
statement: theorem BC_self_eq_two_nC (c : CCoord K) : BC c c = 2 * nC c

name: AlbertLean.Triality.ExteriorSix.nS_basis

  fin_cases i <;> simp [nS, sBasis, evalU, uBasis, uDualBasis]

name: AlbertLean.Triality.ExteriorSix.mutationWitness_BW_i13_i24
statement:
theorem mutationWitness_BW_i13_i24 :
    BW (wBasis .i13 : W K) (wBasis .i24) = -1
proof: := BW_basis_i13_i24

name: AlbertLean.Triality.ExteriorSix.mutationWitness_wedge_i14
statement:
theorem mutationWitness_wedge_i14 :
    wedge2 (uBasis 0 : U K) (uBasis 3) = wBasis .i14
proof: := wedge2_basis_i14

name: AlbertLean.Triality.ExteriorSix.mutationWitness_wedge_i23
statement:

    wedge2 (uBasis 1 : U K) (uBasis 2) = wBasis .i23
proof: := wedge2_basis_i23

name: AlbertLean.Triality.ExteriorSix.mutationWitness_hodge_i13
statement:
theorem mutationWitness_hodge_i13 :
    hodgeStar (wDualBasis .i13 : Wdual K) = -wBasis .i24
proof: := hodgeStar_basis_i13

name: AlbertLean.Triality.ExteriorSix.mutationWitness_pf_i12_add_i34
statement:
theorem mutationWitness_pf_i12_add_i34 :
    Pf (wBasis .i12 + wBasis .i34 : W K) = 1
proof: := pf_basis_i12_add_i34

name: AlbertLean.Triality.ExteriorSix.mutationWitness_pf_normalization
statement:
theorem mutationWitness_pf_normalization :
    BW (wBasis .i12 + wBasis .i34 : W K)
        (wBasis .i12 + wBasis .i34) = 2 ∧
      Pf (wBasis .i12 + wBasis .i34 : W K) = 1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · simp [BW, wBasis]
    ring
  · exact pf_basis_i12_add_i34

name: AlbertLean.Triality.StructuredCubic.sourceSpur_formula
statement:
theorem sourceSpur_formula (x : JCoord K) :
    sourceSpur x =
      x.d1 * x.d2 + x.d1 * x.d3 + x.d2 * x.d3
        - nV x.v - nS x.s - nC x.c
proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Triality.StructuredCubic.sourceNorm_formula
statement:

    sourceNorm x =
      x.d1 * x.d2 * x.d3
        - x.d1 * nV x.v - x.d2 * nS x.s - x.d3 * nC x.c
        + triality x.v x.s x.c
proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Triality.StructuredCubic.source_diagonal_restrictions

theorem source_diagonal_restrictions (d1 d2 d3 : K) :
    sourceTrace (diagonal d1 d2 d3) = d1 + d2 + d3 ∧
    sourceSpur (diagonal d1 d2 d3) = d1 * d2 + d1 * d3 + d2 * d3 ∧
    sourceNorm (diagonal d1 d2 d3) = d1 * d2 * d3
proof:
:= by
  simp [sourceTrace, sourceSpur, sourceNorm, diagonal, nV, nS, nC, triality,
    Pf, evalU, BW, pairW, wedge2, dualWedge2]

theorem source_pureV_restrictions (v : VCoord K) :
    sourceTrace (pureV v) = 0 ∧ sourceSpur (pureV v) = -nV v ∧
      sourceNorm (pureV v) = 0

statement:
theorem source_offDiagonal_restrictions (v : VCoord K) (s : SCoord K) (c : CCoord K) :
    sourceTrace (offDiagonal v s c) = 0 ∧
    sourceSpur (offDiagonal v s c) = -nV v - nS s - nC c ∧
    sourceNorm (offDiagonal v s c) = triality v s c
proof:
:= by
  simp [sourceTrace, sourceSpur, sourceNorm, offDiagonal]

name: AlbertLean.Triality.StructuredCubic.sourceSpurPolar_formula
statement:
theorem sourceSpurPolar_formula (x y : JCoord K) :
    sourceSpurPolar x y =
      x.d1 * y.d2 + y.d1 * x.d2
      + x.d1 * y.d3 + y.d1 * x.d3
      + x.d2 * y.d3 + y.d2 * x.d3
      - BV x.v y.v - BS x.s y.s - BC x.c y.c
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sourceSpurPolar, sourceSpur, add_d1, add_d2, add_d3, add_v, add_s,
    add_c, nV_add, nS_add, nC_add]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Triality.StructuredCubic.sourceSpurPolar_symmetric
statement:
theorem sourceSpurPolar_symmetric (x y : JCoord K) :
    sourceSpurPolar x y = sourceSpurPolar y x
proof:
:= by
  rw [sourceSpurPolar_formula, sourceSpurPolar_formula, BV_symmetric, BS_symmetric,
    BC_symmetric]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Triality.StructuredCubic.sourceSpurPolar_diagonal
statement:
theorem sourceSpurPolar_diagonal (x : JCoord K) :
    sourceSpurPolar x x = 2 * sourceSpur x
proof:
:= by
  rw [sourceSpurPolar_formula, BV_self_eq_two_nV, BS_self_eq_two_nS,
    BC_self_eq_two_nC]
  simp only [sourceSpur]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Triality.StructuredCubic.sourceTraceForm_formula
statement:
theorem sourceTraceForm_formula (x y : JCoord K) :
    sourceTraceForm x y =
      x.d1 * y.d1 + x.d2 * y.d2 + x.d3 * y.d3
        + BV x.v y.v + BS x.s y.s + BC x.c y.c
proof:
:= by
  rw [sourceTraceForm, sourceSpurPolar_formula]
  simp only [sourceTrace]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Triality.StructuredCubic.sourceTraceForm_symmetric
statement:
theorem sourceTraceForm_symmetric (x y : JCoord K) :
    sourceTraceForm x y = sourceTraceForm y x
proof:
:= by
  rw [sourceTraceForm_formula, sourceTraceForm_formula, BV_symmetric, BS_symmetric,
    BC_symmetric]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Triality.StructuredCubic.sourceTraceForm_one_left
statement:
theorem sourceTraceForm_one_left (x : JCoord K) :
    sourceTraceForm (sourceOne : JCoord K) x = sourceTrace x
proof:
:= by
  rw [sourceTraceForm_formula]
  simp [sourceOne, sourceTrace]

name: AlbertLean.Triality.StructuredCubic.BV_nondegenerate
statement:
theorem BV_nondegenerate {v : VCoord K} (h : ∀ w : VCoord K, BV v w = 0) :
    v = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hr : v.r = 0 := by
    have hv := h ({ r := 0, z := 1, omega := 0 } : VCoord K)
    simpa [BV, BW] using hv
  have hz : v.z = 0 := by
    have hv := h ({ r := 1, z := 0, omega := 0 } : VCoord K)
    simpa [BV, BW] using hv
  have homega : v.omega = 0 := by
    apply BW_nondegenerate
    intro w
    have hv := h ({ r := 0, z := 0, omega := w } : VCoord K)
    simpa [BV] using hv
  change v = ({ r := 0, z := 0, omega := 0 } : VCoord K)
  exact VCoord.ext hr hz homega

name: AlbertLean.Triality.StructuredCubic.sourceTraceForm_nondegenerate
statement:
theorem sourceTraceForm_nondegenerate {x : JCoord K}
    (h : ∀ y : JCoord K, sourceTraceForm x y = 0) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hd1 : x.d1 = 0 := by
    have hx := h (diagonal 1 0 0)
    rw [sourceTraceForm_formula] at hx
    simpa [diagonal] using hx
  have hd2 : x.d2 = 0 := by
    have hx := h (diagonal 0 1 0)
    rw [sourceTraceForm_formula] at hx
    simpa [diagonal] using hx
  have hd3 : x.d3 = 0 := by
    have hx := h (diagonal 0 0 1)
    rw [sourceTraceForm_formula] at hx
    simpa [diagonal] using hx
  have hv : x.v = 0 := by
    apply BV_nondegenerate
    intro v
    have hx := h (pureV v)
    rw [sourceTraceForm_formula] at hx
    simpa [pureV] using hx
  have hs : x.s = 0 := by
    apply BS_nondegenerate
    intro s
    have hx := h (pureS s)
    rw [sourceTraceForm_formula] at hx
    simpa [pureS] using hx
  have hc : x.c = 0 := by
    apply BC_nondegenerate
    intro c
    have hx := h (pureC c)
    rw [sourceTraceForm_formula] at hx
    simpa [pureC] using hx
  change x =
    ({ d1 := 0, d2 := 0, d3 := 0, v := 0, s := 0, c := 0 } : JCoord K)
  exact JCoord.ext hd1 hd2 hd3 hv hs hc

name: AlbertLean.Triality.StructuredCubic.sourcePolar_swap_left
statement:
theorem sourcePolar_swap_left (x y z : JCoord K) :
    sourcePolar x y z = sourcePolar y x z
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sourcePolar]
  have hxyz : y + x + z = x + y + z := by abel
  have hxy : y + x = x + y := add_comm _ _
  rw [hxyz, hxy]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Triality.StructuredCubic.sourcePolar_swap_right
statement:
theorem sourcePolar_swap_right (x y z : JCoord K) :
    sourcePolar x y z = sourcePolar x z y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sourcePolar]
  have hxyz : x + z + y = x + y + z := by abel
  have hzy : z + y = y + z := add_comm _ _
  rw [hxyz, hzy]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Triality.StructuredCubic.sourcePolar_one
statement:
theorem sourcePolar_one (x y : JCoord K) :
    sourcePolar (sourceOne : JCoord K) x y = sourceSpurPolar x y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sourcePolar, sourceSpurPolar_formula, sourceNorm, sourceOne, add_d1,
    add_d2, add_d3, add_v, add_s, add_c, nV_add, nS_add, nC_add,
    triality_add_v, triality_add_s, triality_add_c, nV_zero, nS_zero, nC_zero,
    triality_zero_c, zero_add]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Triality.StructuredCubic.sourcePolar_diagonal
statement: theorem sourcePolar_diagonal (x : JCoord K) : sourcePolar x x x = 6 * sourceNorm x
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : x + x = (2 : K) • x := by
    ext <;> simp <;> ring
  have h3 : x + x + x = (3 : K) • x := by
    ext <;> simp <;> ring
  rw [sourcePolar, h3, h2, sourceNorm_smul, sourceNorm_smul]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Triality.StructuredCubic.StructuredSourceCubicTheorem
statement:
theorem StructuredSourceCubicTheorem :
    sourceTrace (sourceOne : JCoord K) = 3 ∧
    sourceSpur (sourceOne : JCoord K) = 3 ∧
    sourceNorm (sourceOne : JCoord K) = 1 ∧
    (∀ (a : K) (x : JCoord K), sourceNorm (a • x) = a ^ 3 * sourceNorm x) ∧
    (∀ x y : JCoord K,
      sourceTraceForm x y =
        x.d1 * y.d1 + x.d2 * y.d2 + x.d3 * y.d3
          + BV x.v y.v + BS x.s y.s + BC x.c y.c) ∧
    (∀ x : JCoord K, (∀ y : JCoord K, sourceTraceForm x y = 0) → x = 0) ∧
    (∀ d1 d2 d3 : K,
      sourceTrace (diagonal d1 d2 d3) = d1 + d2 + d3 ∧
      sourceSpur (diagonal d1 d2 d3) = d1 * d2 + d1 * d3 + d2 * d3 ∧
      sourceNorm (diagonal d1 d2 d3) = d1 * d2 * d3) ∧
    (∀ (v : VCoord K) (s : SCoord K) (c : CCoord K),
      sourceTrace (offDiagonal v s c) = 0 ∧
      sourceSpur (offDiagonal v s c) = -nV v - nS s - nC c ∧
      sourceNorm (offDiagonal v s c) = triality v s c)
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨sourceTrace_one, sourceSpur_one, sourceNorm_one, sourceNorm_smul,
    sourceTraceForm_formula, fun _ => sourceTraceForm_nondegenerate,
    source_diagonal_restrictions, source_offDiagonal_restrictions⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TitsGaugeReconstruction.relatedFixingFirst_of_gaugeRelated
proof:

theorem projectPair_pairing_right
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V)) (e f c q : V)

    omega (projectPair omega e f c) q = omega c q

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.projectPairs_pairing_right
statement:
theorem projectPairs_pairing_right
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V))
    (pairs : List (V × V)) (c q : V)
    (hortho : ∀ pair ∈ pairs, omega pair.1 q = 0 ∧ omega pair.2 q = 0) :
    omega (projectPairs omega pairs c) q = omega c q
proof:
:= by
  induction pairs generalizing c with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons pair pairs ih =>
      rcases pair with ⟨e, f⟩
      rw [projectPairs, ih]
      · exact projectPair_pairing_right omega e f c q
          (hortho (e, f) (by simp)).1 (hortho (e, f) (by simp)).2
      · intro pair hpair
        exact hortho pair (by simp [hpair])

statement:

    omega q (projectPairs omega pairs c) = omega q c
proof:
:= by
  induction pairs generalizing c with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons pair pairs ih =>
      rcases pair with ⟨e, f⟩

          (hortho (e, f) (by simp)).1 (hortho (e, f) (by simp)).2

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TwoCopyFractionDescent.firstPolynomialToFraction_injective
statement:
private theorem firstPolynomialToFraction_injective : Function.Injective
    (firstPolynomialToFraction : R (k := k) (ι := ι) →
      FractionRing (R₂ (k := k) (ι := ι)))
proof:
:=
  (IsFractionRing.injective (R₂ (k := k) (ι := ι))
    (FractionRing (R₂ (k := k) (ι := ι)))).comp
      (MvPolynomial.rename_injective Sum.inl Sum.inl_injective)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TwoCopyFractionDescent.secondPolynomialToFraction_injective
statement:
private theorem secondPolynomialToFraction_injective : Function.Injective
    (secondPolynomialToFraction : R (k := k) (ι := ι) →
      FractionRing (R₂ (k := k) (ι := ι)))
proof:
:=
  (IsFractionRing.injective (R₂ (k := k) (ι := ι))
    (FractionRing (R₂ (k := k) (ι := ι)))).comp
      (MvPolynomial.rename_injective Sum.inr Sum.inr_injective)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TwoCopyFractionDescent.eq_coefficient_of_fraction_copy_eq
statement:
theorem eq_coefficient_of_fraction_copy_eq
    (f : FractionRing (R (k := k) (ι := ι)))
    (A B : R (k := k) (ι := ι)) (α : ι →₀ ℕ)
    (hBα : B.coeff α ≠ 0)
    (hf : f = algebraMap (R (k := k) (ι := ι)) _ A /
      algebraMap (R (k := k) (ι := ι)) _ B)
    (hcopy : firstFractionCopy f = secondFractionCopy f) :
    f = algebraMap k (FractionRing (R (k := k) (ι := ι)))
      (A.coeff α / B.coeff α)
proof:
:= by
  have hB : B ≠ 0 := fun hzero => hBα (by simp [hzero])
  have hleftB : algebraMap (R₂ (k := k) (ι := ι))
      (FractionRing (R₂ (k := k) (ι := ι))) (firstCopy B) ≠ 0 := by
    have hc : firstCopy B ≠ 0 := by
      simpa only [firstCopy, map_zero] using
        (MvPolynomial.rename_injective Sum.inl Sum.inl_injective).ne hB
    simpa only [map_zero] using
      (IsFractionRing.injective (R₂ (k := k) (ι := ι))
        (FractionRing (R₂ (k := k) (ι := ι)))).ne hc
  have hrightB : algebraMap (R₂ (k := k) (ι := ι))
      (FractionRing (R₂ (k := k) (ι := ι))) (secondCopy B) ≠ 0 := by
    have hc : secondCopy B ≠ 0 := by
      simpa only [secondCopy, map_zero] using
        (MvPolynomial.rename_injective Sum.inr Sum.inr_injective).ne hB
    simpa only [map_zero] using
      (IsFractionRing.injective (R₂ (k := k) (ι := ι))
        (FractionRing (R₂ (k := k) (ι := ι)))).ne hc
  have hdiv :
      algebraMap (R₂ (k := k) (ι := ι))
        (FractionRing (R₂ (k := k) (ι := ι))) (firstCopy A) /
          algebraMap (R₂ (k := k) (ι := ι))
        (FractionRing (R₂ (k := k) (ι := ι))) (firstCopy B) =
        algebraMap (R₂ (k := k) (ι := ι))
        (FractionRing (R₂ (k := k) (ι := ι))) (secondCopy A) /
          algebraMap (R₂ (k := k) (ι := ι))
        (FractionRing (R₂ (k := k) (ι := ι))) (secondCopy B) := by
    simpa [hf, firstFractionCopy, secondFractionCopy,
      firstPolynomialToFraction, secondPolynomialToFraction,
      firstCopy, secondCopy, IsFractionRing.lift_algebraMap] using hcopy
  have hcross : firstCopy A * secondCopy B = secondCopy A * firstCopy B := by
    apply IsFractionRing.injective (R₂ (k := k) (ι := ι))
      (FractionRing (R₂ (k := k) (ι := ι)))
    simpa only [map_mul] using (div_eq_div_iff hleftB hrightB).mp hdiv
  rw [hf, fraction_eq_coefficient_ratio A B α hBα hcross]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawLedgerDetector.evaluation_rawLabelledLedger
statement:
theorem evaluation_rawLabelledLedger (f : k →+* L)
    (P : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 27 → L) :
    { P := fun i j => evaluationAlong f P (pairP k i j)
      Q := fun j l => evaluationAlong f P (pairQ k j l)
      R := fun l i => evaluationAlong f P (pairR k l i)
      C0 := fun i j l => evaluationAlong f P (centeredTriple k i j l) } =
      directLedger P
proof:
:= by
  rw [LabelledLedger.mk.injEq]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · funext i j
    simp [pairP, directLedger, evaluation_rawTrace, evaluation_rawProduct]
  · funext j l
    simp [pairQ, directLedger, evaluation_rawTrace, evaluation_rawProduct]
  · funext l i
    simp [pairR, directLedger, evaluation_rawTrace, evaluation_rawProduct]
  · funext i j l
    have hc (c : k) : evaluationAlong f P (MvPolynomial.C c) = f c := by
      simp [evaluationAlong]
    simp [centeredTriple, pairP, pairQ, pairR, directLedger,
      evaluation_rawTrace, evaluation_rawProduct, hc, map_ofNat,
      div_eq_mul_inv]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawLedgerDetector.product_symm
statement:
private theorem product_symm (x y : Fin 27 → L) :
    (structuredEquivK L).symm (f0ProductK x y) =
      AlbertLean.Triality.StructuredProduct.sourceProduct
        ((structuredEquivK L).symm x) ((structuredEquivK L).symm y)
proof:
:= by
  have h := GenericStructuredProductAgreesWithF0
    ((structuredEquivK L).symm x) ((structuredEquivK L).symm y)
  change structuredEquivK L (AlbertLean.Triality.StructuredProduct.sourceProduct
    ((structuredEquivK L).symm x) ((structuredEquivK L).symm y)) =
    f0ProductK (structuredEquivK L ((structuredEquivK L).symm x))
      (structuredEquivK L ((structuredEquivK L).symm y)) at h
  simp only [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at h
  have hh := congrArg (structuredEquivK L).symm h
  simpa only [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply] using hh.symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawLedgerDetector.trace_symm
statement:
private theorem trace_symm (x : Fin 27 → L) :
    sourceTrace ((structuredEquivK L).symm x) = f0TraceK x
proof:
:= by
  rw [AlbertLean.Comparison.GenericF0.sourceTrace_agrees_with_f0K]
  exact congrArg f0TraceK (LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply (structuredEquivK L) x)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawLedgerDetector.trace_product
statement:
private theorem trace_product (x y : Fin 27 → L) :
    f0TraceK (f0ProductK x y) =
      sourceTrace (AlbertLean.Triality.StructuredProduct.sourceProduct
        ((structuredEquivK L).symm x) ((structuredEquivK L).symm y))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← product_symm, trace_symm]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawLedgerDetector.source_frame_encoder_labels
statement:
theorem source_frame_encoder_labels
    (P : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 27 → L) (hraw : IsRawFrameFamily P) :
    ∀ r i, sourceProjector (sourceEncoders P r) i =
      (structuredEquivK L).symm (P r i)
proof:
:= by
  let E : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → JCoord L :=
    fun r i => (structuredEquivK L).symm (P r i)
  have hto : AlbertRawSourceDictionary.toF0Family E = P := by
    funext r i
    exact LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply (structuredEquivK L) (P r i)
  have hE : ∀ r, SourceFrameLaws.Laws (E r) := by
    apply (AlbertRawSourceDictionary.sourceFrameFamily_iff_f0Raw E).2
    rwa [hto]
  intro r i
  change sourceProjector ((structuredEquivK L).symm (P r 2 - P r 0)) i =
    (structuredEquivK L).symm (P r i)
  have henc : (structuredEquivK L).symm (P r 2 - P r 0) = E r 2 - E r 0 := by
    exact (structuredEquivK L).symm.map_sub _ _
  rw [henc]
  change sourceProjector (E r 2 - E r 0) i = E r i
  exact SourceFrameEncoderLaws.encoder_projectors (E r) (hE r) i

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawLedgerDetector.directLedger_eq_sourceLabelledLedger
statement:
theorem directLedger_eq_sourceLabelledLedger
    (P : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 27 → L)
    (hlabels : ∀ r i, sourceProjector (sourceEncoders P r) i =
      (structuredEquivK L).symm (P r i)) :
    directLedger P = sourceLabelledLedger (sourceEncoders P)
proof:
:= by
  rw [LabelledLedger.mk.injEq]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  all_goals simp only [directLedger, sourceLabelledLedger]
  · funext i j
    rw [hlabels, hlabels, ← trace_product]
  · funext j l
    rw [hlabels, hlabels, ← trace_product]
  · funext l i
    rw [hlabels, hlabels, ← trace_product]
  · funext i j l
    simp_rw [hlabels]
    rw [← product_symm, ← trace_product]
    simp_rw [← trace_product, trace_symm]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawLedgerDetector.evaluation_rawDetector
statement:
theorem evaluation_rawDetector (f : k →+* L)
    (P : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 27 → L) :
    evaluationAlong f P (rawDetector k) =
      sourceDetector (sourceEncoders P 0) (sourceEncoders P 1)
        (sourceEncoders P 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rawDetector, evaluation_rawTrace, evaluation_rawProduct,
    evaluation_rawProduct]
  have hw : evaluatedF0 k f P (rawWord k) =
      RationalTensorCircuit.word (P 0 2 - P 0 0) (P 1 2 - P 1 0)
        (P 2 2 - P 2 0) := by
    rw [rawWord, evaluatedF0_sub, evaluation_rawProduct,
      evaluation_rawProduct, evaluation_rawProduct, evaluation_rawProduct]
    simp
    rfl
  rw [hw]
  have hdet := RationalTensorCircuit.source_detector
      (sourceEncoders P 0) (sourceEncoders P 1) (sourceEncoders P 2)
  change sourceDetector (sourceEncoders P 0) (sourceEncoders P 1)
      (sourceEncoders P 2) = RationalTensorCircuit.detector
        (structuredEquivK L ((structuredEquivK L).symm (P 0 2 - P 0 0)))
        (structuredEquivK L ((structuredEquivK L).symm (P 1 2 - P 1 0)))
        (structuredEquivK L ((structuredEquivK L).symm (P 2 2 - P 2 0))) at hdet
  simp only [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at hdet
  exact hdet.symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawLedgerDetector.evaluation_rawLabelledLedger_eq_tau
statement:
theorem evaluation_rawLabelledLedger_eq_tau
    (f : k →+* L) (P : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 27 → L)
    (hraw : IsRawFrameFamily P) :
    { P := fun i j => evaluationAlong f P (pairP k i j)
      Q := fun j l => evaluationAlong f P (pairQ k j l)
      R := fun l i => evaluationAlong f P (pairR k l i)
      C0 := fun i j l => evaluationAlong f P (centeredTriple k i j l) } =
      labelledLedger (mapTriple (sourceEncoders P))
proof:
:= by
  rw [evaluation_rawLabelledLedger, directLedger_eq_sourceLabelledLedger _
    (source_frame_encoder_labels P hraw)]
  exact (labelledLedger_mapTriple (sourceEncoders P)).symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawLedgerDetector.evaluation_rawDetector_eq_tau
statement:
theorem evaluation_rawDetector_eq_tau (f : k →+* L)
    (P : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 27 → L) :
    evaluationAlong f P (rawDetector k) =
      TauLedgerInvariance.detector
        (mapTriple (sourceEncoders P) 0)
        (mapTriple (sourceEncoders P) 1)
        (mapTriple (sourceEncoders P) 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [evaluation_rawDetector]
  exact (tauDetector_sourceTauEquiv _ _ _).symm
