name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.partner_intermediate_pairings
statement:
theorem partner_intermediate_pairings
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V))
    (halt : ∀ x, omega x x = 0) (e v f : V)
    (hev : omega e v = 1) (hef : omega e f = 1) (a : K) :
    omega (v + a • e) v = a ∧
      omega f (v + a • e) = omega f v - a
proof:
:= by
  have hve := skew_of_alternating omega halt v e
  have hfe := skew_of_alternating omega halt f e
  constructor
  · simp only [map_add, map_smul, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
      halt v, zero_add, smul_eq_mul, hev]
    ring
  · simp only [map_add, map_smul, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
      smul_eq_mul, hfe, hef]
    ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.partner_centers_fix_first
statement:
theorem partner_centers_fix_first
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V))
    (halt : ∀ x, omega x x = 0) (e v f : V)
    (hev : omega e v = 1) (hef : omega e f = 1) (a : K) :
    omega ((v + a • e) - v) e = 0 ∧
      omega (f - (v + a • e)) e = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hee := halt e
  have hve := skew_of_alternating omega halt v e
  have hfe := skew_of_alternating omega halt f e
  constructor
  · simp only [map_sub, map_add, map_smul, LinearMap.sub_apply,
      LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, hee, sub_self,
      add_sub_cancel_left, smul_eq_mul, mul_zero]
  · simp only [map_sub, map_add, map_smul, LinearMap.sub_apply,
      LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hee, mul_zero,
      add_zero, hve, hfe, hev, hef]
    ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.partner_two_step_align
statement:
theorem partner_two_step_align
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V))
    (halt : ∀ x, omega x x = 0) (e v f : V)
    (hev : omega e v = 1) (hef : omega e f = 1) :
    let a
proof:
:= avoidanceScalar (omega f v)
    let w := v + a • e
    equiv omega halt (f - w) (omega f w)⁻¹
      (equiv omega halt (w - v) (omega w v)⁻¹ v) = f := by
  dsimp only
  apply two_step_align omega halt v
  · rw [(partner_intermediate_pairings omega halt e v f hev hef
      (avoidanceScalar (omega f v))).1]
    exact avoidanceScalar_ne_zero (omega f v)
  · rw [(partner_intermediate_pairings omega halt e v f hev hef
      (avoidanceScalar (omega f v))).2]
    exact sub_ne_zero.mpr (avoidanceScalar_ne (omega f v)).symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.partner_two_step_fixes_first
statement:
theorem partner_two_step_fixes_first
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V))
    (halt : ∀ x, omega x x = 0) (e v f : V)
    (hev : omega e v = 1) (hef : omega e f = 1) :
    let a
proof:
:= avoidanceScalar (omega f v)
    let w := v + a • e
    equiv omega halt (f - w) (omega f w)⁻¹
      (equiv omega halt (w - v) (omega w v)⁻¹ e) = e := by
  dsimp only
  obtain ⟨hfirst, hsecond⟩ := partner_centers_fix_first omega halt e v f hev hef
    (avoidanceScalar (omega f v))
  simp only [equiv_apply, hfirst, hsecond, mul_zero, zero_smul, add_zero]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.carrier_frame_images_orthogonal
statement:
theorem carrier_frame_images_orthogonal
    (E : Fin 3 → Carrier K)
    (hEidem : ∀ i, (E i : Mat6 K) * E i = E i)
    (hEsum : (E 0 : Mat6 K) + E 1 + E 2 = 1)
    {i j : Fin 3} (hij : i ≠ j) (x y : Vec6 K) :
    (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) x)
      (matrixAction (E j : Mat6 K) y) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let Q : Fin 3 → Vec6 K →ₗ[K] Vec6 K :=
    fun r => matrixAction (K := K) (E r : Mat6 K)
  have hQi : ∀ r, IsIdempotent (Q r) :=
    fun r => carrier_projector_action_idempotent (E r) (hEidem r)
  have hQsum : Q 0 + Q 1 + Q 2 = LinearMap.id :=
    carrier_frame_action_sum E hEsum
  have hcomp := comp_zero_of_complete_frame Q hQi hQsum i j hij
  exact different_images_orthogonal (omega (K := K)) (Q i) (Q j)
    (carrier_action_selfAdjoint (E i)) hcomp x y

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.weighted_pairings
statement:
theorem weighted_pairings
    (E : Fin 3 → Carrier K)
    (hEidem : ∀ i, (E i : Mat6 K) * E i = E i)
    (hEsum : (E 0 : Mat6 K) + E 1 + E 2 = 1)
    (u v : Vec6 K) (p : Fin 3 → K)
    (hp : ∀ i, p i = (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u)
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v)) :
    (∀ i j, (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u)
        (matrixAction (E j : Mat6 K) v) = if i = j then p i else 0) ∧
    (∀ i j, (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u)
        (matrixAction (E j : Mat6 K) u) = 0) ∧
    (∀ i j, (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v)
        (matrixAction (E j : Mat6 K) v) = 0)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i j
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j
      simp [hp i]
    · rw [if_neg hij]
      exact carrier_frame_images_orthogonal E hEidem hEsum hij u v
  · intro i j
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j
      exact omega_alternating (K := K) _
    · exact carrier_frame_images_orthogonal E hEidem hEsum hij u u
  · intro i j
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j
      exact omega_alternating (K := K) _
    · exact carrier_frame_images_orthogonal E hEidem hEsum hij v v

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.weighted_coordinates_injective
statement:
theorem weighted_coordinates_injective
    (E : Fin 3 → Carrier K)
    (hEidem : ∀ i, (E i : Mat6 K) * E i = E i)
    (hEsum : (E 0 : Mat6 K) + E 1 + E 2 = 1)
    (u v : Vec6 K) (p : Fin 3 → K)
    (hp : ∀ i, p i = (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u)
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v))
    (hpne : ∀ i, p i ≠ 0) (a b : Fin 3 → K)
    (hz : (∑ i, a i • matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u) +
      ∑ i, b i • matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v = 0) :
    a = 0 ∧ b = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨huv, huu, hvv⟩ := weighted_pairings E hEidem hEsum u v p hp
  have ha (j : Fin 3) : a j = 0 := by
    have h := congrArg (fun z => (omega (K := K)) z
      (matrixAction (E j : Mat6 K) v)) hz
    simp only [map_add, map_sum, map_smul, map_zero, LinearMap.add_apply,
      LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, huv, hvv] at h
    simp [hpne j] at h
    exact h
  have hb (j : Fin 3) : b j = 0 := by
    have h := congrArg (fun z => (omega (K := K)) z
      (matrixAction (E j : Mat6 K) u)) hz
    have hrev (i : Fin 3) :
        (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v)
          (matrixAction (E j : Mat6 K) u) =
          if i = j then -(p i) else 0 := by
      by_cases hij : i = j
      · subst j
        have hz' := omega_alternating (K := K)
          (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u + matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v)
        simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, omega_alternating] at hz'
        rw [if_pos rfl]
        linear_combination hz' + hp i
      · rw [if_neg hij]
        exact carrier_frame_images_orthogonal E hEidem hEsum hij v u
    simp only [map_add, map_sum, map_smul, map_zero, LinearMap.add_apply,
      LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, huu, hrev] at h
    simp [hpne j] at h
    exact h
  exact ⟨funext ha, funext hb⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.weightedCoordinateLinear_injective
statement:
theorem weightedCoordinateLinear_injective
    (E : Fin 3 → Carrier K)
    (hEidem : ∀ i, (E i : Mat6 K) * E i = E i)
    (hEsum : (E 0 : Mat6 K) + E 1 + E 2 = 1)
    (u v : Vec6 K) (p : Fin 3 → K)
    (hp : ∀ i, p i = (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u)
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v))
    (hpne : ∀ i, p i ≠ 0) :
    Function.Injective (weightedCoordinateLinear E u v)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  have hz : weightedCoordinateLinear E u v (x - y) = 0 := by
    rw [map_sub, hxy, sub_self]
  have hcoeff := weighted_coordinates_injective E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne
    (fun i => (x - y) (Sum.inl i)) (fun i => (x - y) (Sum.inr i))
    (by exact hz)
  rcases hcoeff with ⟨hl, hr⟩
  funext q
  rcases q with i | i
  · have hi := congrFun hl i
    simpa only [Pi.zero_apply, Pi.sub_apply, sub_eq_zero] using hi
  · have hi := congrFun hr i
    simpa only [Pi.zero_apply, Pi.sub_apply, sub_eq_zero] using hi

name: AlbertLean.Generic.CubicAutomorphism.polar_map
statement:
theorem polar_map (N : V → K) (g : V ≃ₗ[K] V)
    (hCubic : ∀ x, N (g x) = N x) (x y z : V) :
    polar N (g x) (g y) (g z) = polar N x y z
proof:
:= by
  have hxyz : N (g x + g y + g z) = N (x + y + z) := by
    rw [← g.map_add x y, ← g.map_add (x + y) z, hCubic]
  have hxy : N (g x + g y) = N (x + y) := by
    rw [← g.map_add x y, hCubic]
  have hxz : N (g x + g z) = N (x + z) := by
    rw [← g.map_add x z, hCubic]
  have hyz : N (g y + g z) = N (y + z) := by
    rw [← g.map_add y z, hCubic]
  simp only [polar, hxyz, hxy, hxz, hyz, hCubic]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.CubicAutomorphism.Data.map_polar
statement:
theorem map_polar (g : V ≃ₗ[K] V)
    (hCubic : ∀ x, D.cubic (g x) = D.cubic x) (x y z : V) :
    polar D.cubic (g x) (g y) (g z) = polar D.cubic x y z
proof:
:= by
  exact polar_map D.cubic g hCubic x y z

name: AlbertLean.Generic.CubicAutomorphism.Data.map_trace
statement:
theorem map_trace (g : V ≃ₗ[K] V) (hOne : g D.one = D.one)
    (hCubic : ∀ x, D.cubic (g x) = D.cubic x) (x : V) :
    D.trace (g x) = D.trace x
proof:
:= by
  have hp := D.map_polar g hCubic D.one D.one x
  rw [hOne] at hp
  exact congrArg (fun a => a / 2) hp

name: AlbertLean.Generic.CubicAutomorphism.Data.map_spurBilinear
statement:
theorem map_spurBilinear (g : V ≃ₗ[K] V) (hOne : g D.one = D.one)
    (hCubic : ∀ x, D.cubic (g x) = D.cubic x) (x y : V) :
    D.spurBilinear (g x) (g y) = D.spurBilinear x y
proof:
:= by
  have hp := D.map_polar g hCubic D.one x y
  rw [hOne] at hp
  exact hp

name: AlbertLean.Generic.CubicAutomorphism.Data.map_traceForm
statement:
theorem map_traceForm (g : V ≃ₗ[K] V) (hOne : g D.one = D.one)
    (hCubic : ∀ x, D.cubic (g x) = D.cubic x) (x y : V) :
    D.traceForm (g x) (g y) = D.traceForm x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [D.traceForm_formula, D.traceForm_formula]
  change D.trace (g x) * D.trace (g y) - D.spurBilinear (g x) (g y) =
    D.trace x * D.trace y - D.spurBilinear x y
  rw [D.map_trace g hOne hCubic, D.map_trace g hOne hCubic,
    D.map_spurBilinear g hOne hCubic]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.CubicAutomorphism.Data.map_adjoint
statement:
theorem map_adjoint (g : V ≃ₗ[K] V) (hOne : g D.one = D.one)
    (hCubic : ∀ x, D.cubic (g x) = D.cubic x) (x : V) :
    g (D.adjoint x) = D.adjoint (g x)
proof:
:= by
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  apply D.traceForm_nondegenerate
  intro w
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := g.surjective w
  simp only [map_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply]
  rw [D.map_traceForm g hOne hCubic, D.adjoint_characterization,
    D.adjoint_characterization, D.map_polar g hCubic]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.CubicAutomorphism.Data.map_cross
statement:
theorem map_cross (g : V ≃ₗ[K] V) (hOne : g D.one = D.one)
    (hCubic : ∀ x, D.cubic (g x) = D.cubic x) (x y : V) :
    g (D.cross x y) = D.cross (g x) (g y)
proof:
:= by
  simp [cross, D.map_adjoint g hOne hCubic]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.CubicAutomorphism.Data.map_product
statement:
theorem map_product (g : V ≃ₗ[K] V) (hOne : g D.one = D.one)
    (hCubic : ∀ x, D.cubic (g x) = D.cubic x) (x y : V) :
    g (D.product x y) = D.product (g x) (g y)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [product, map_smul, map_add, map_sub,
    D.map_cross g hOne hCubic, D.map_trace g hOne hCubic,
    D.map_spurBilinear g hOne hCubic, hOne]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.CubicAutomorphism.RecoveryPresentation.map_polar
statement:
theorem map_polar (g : V ≃ₗ[K] V)
    (hCubic : ∀ x, P.cubic (g x) = P.cubic x) (x y z : V) :
    D.polar (g x) (g y) (g z) = D.polar x y z
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.polar_formula, P.polar_formula]
  exact polar_map P.cubic g hCubic x y z

name: AlbertLean.Generic.CubicAutomorphism.RecoveryPresentation.map_trace
statement:
theorem map_trace (g : V ≃ₗ[K] V) (hOne : g D.one = D.one)
    (hCubic : ∀ x, P.cubic (g x) = P.cubic x) (x : V) :
    D.trace (g x) = D.trace x
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.trace_formula, P.trace_formula]
  have hp := P.map_polar g hCubic D.one D.one x
  rw [hOne] at hp
  exact congrArg (fun a => a / 2) hp

name: AlbertLean.Generic.CubicAutomorphism.RecoveryPresentation.map_traceForm
statement:
theorem map_traceForm (g : V ≃ₗ[K] V) (hOne : g D.one = D.one)
    (hCubic : ∀ x, P.cubic (g x) = P.cubic x) (x y : V) :
    D.traceForm (g x) (g y) = D.traceForm x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.traceForm_formula, P.traceForm_formula,
    P.map_trace g hOne hCubic, P.map_trace g hOne hCubic]
  have hp := P.map_polar g hCubic D.one x y
  rw [hOne] at hp
  rw [hp]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.CubicAutomorphism.RecoveryPresentation.map_adjoint
statement:
theorem map_adjoint [FiniteDimensional K V]
    (g : V ≃ₗ[K] V) (hOne : g D.one = D.one)
    (hCubic : ∀ x, P.cubic (g x) = P.cubic x) (x : V) :
    g (D.adjoint x) = D.adjoint (g x)
proof:
:= by
  apply D.map_adjoint D g
  · exact P.map_traceForm g hOne hCubic
  · exact P.map_polar g hCubic

name: AlbertLean.Generic.CubicAutomorphism.RecoveryPresentation.map_cross
statement:
theorem map_cross [FiniteDimensional K V]
    (g : V ≃ₗ[K] V) (hOne : g D.one = D.one)
    (hCubic : ∀ x, P.cubic (g x) = P.cubic x) (x y : V) :
    g (D.cross x y) = D.cross (g x) (g y)
proof:
:= by
  apply D.map_cross D g
  · exact P.map_traceForm g hOne hCubic
  · exact P.map_polar g hCubic

name: AlbertLean.Generic.CubicAutomorphism.RecoveryPresentation.map_product
statement:
theorem map_product [FiniteDimensional K V]
    (g : V ≃ₗ[K] V) (hOne : g D.one = D.one)
    (hCubic : ∀ x, P.cubic (g x) = P.cubic x) (x y : V) :
    g (D.product x y) = D.product (g x) (g y)
proof:
:= by
  apply D.map_product D g hOne
  · exact P.map_trace g hOne hCubic
  · exact P.map_traceForm g hOne hCubic
  · exact P.map_polar g hCubic

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TitsGauge.mul_adj
statement:
private theorem mul_adj (g : Mat3 R) (hg : g.det = 1) :
    g * g.adjugate = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.mul_adjugate, hg, one_smul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TitsGauge.adj_mul
statement:
private theorem adj_mul (g : Mat3 R) (hg : g.det = 1) :
    g.adjugate * g = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.adjugate_mul, hg, one_smul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TitsGauge.adj_adj
statement:
private theorem adj_adj (g : Mat3 R) (hg : g.det = 1) :
    g.adjugate.adjugate = g
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.adjugate_adjugate g (by decide), hg]
  simp

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TitsGauge.linear_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem linear_apply (g : Mat3 R) (hg : g.det = 1) (z : FirstTits R) :
    linear g hg z = act g z
proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TitsGauge.act_firstTitsOne
statement:
@[simp] theorem act_firstTitsOne (g : Mat3 R) :
    act g (firstTitsOne : FirstTits R) = firstTitsOne
proof:
:= by
  simp [act, firstTitsOne]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TitsGauge.act_firstTitsSquare
statement:
theorem act_firstTitsSquare (g : Mat3 R) (hg : g.det = 1) (z : FirstTits R) :
    act g (firstTitsSquare z) = firstTitsSquare (act g z)
proof:
:= by
  rcases z with ⟨a, b, c⟩
  have hbc : b * g * (g.adjugate * c) = b * c := by
    rw [mul_assoc b g, ← mul_assoc g g.adjugate, mul_adj g hg, one_mul]
  have hca : adjugate3 (g.adjugate * c) = adjugate3 c * g := by
    simp only [adjugate3_eq_matrixAdjugate, Matrix.adjugate_mul_distrib, adj_adj g hg]
  have hba : adjugate3 (b * g) = g.adjugate * adjugate3 b := by
    simp only [adjugate3_eq_matrixAdjugate, Matrix.adjugate_mul_distrib]
  apply Prod.ext
  · change a * a - b * c + trace3 (b * c) • 1 =
      a * a - b * g * (g.adjugate * c) + trace3 (b * g * (g.adjugate * c)) • 1
    rw [hbc]
  · apply Prod.ext
    · change (adjugate3 c - a * b + trace3 a • b) * g =
        adjugate3 (g.adjugate * c) - a * (b * g) + trace3 a • (b * g)
      rw [hca]
      simp only [add_mul, sub_mul, Matrix.smul_mul, mul_assoc]
    · change g.adjugate * (adjugate3 b - c * a + trace3 a • c) =
        adjugate3 (b * g) - (g.adjugate * c) * a + trace3 a • (g.adjugate * c)
      rw [hba]
      simp only [mul_add, mul_sub, Matrix.mul_smul, mul_assoc]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TitsGauge.act_firstTitsSharp
statement:
theorem act_firstTitsSharp (g : Mat3 R) (hg : g.det = 1) (z : FirstTits R) :
    act g (firstTitsSharp z) = firstTitsSharp (act g z)
proof:
:= by
  rcases z with ⟨a, b, c⟩
  have hbc : b * g * (g.adjugate * c) = b * c := by
    rw [mul_assoc b g, ← mul_assoc g g.adjugate, mul_adj g hg, one_mul]
  simp only [act, firstTitsSharp, adjugate3_eq_matrixAdjugate,
    Matrix.adjugate_mul_distrib, adj_adj g hg, hbc, sub_mul, mul_sub, mul_assoc]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TitsGauge.linear_polarProduct
statement:
theorem linear_polarProduct (g : Mat3 R) (hg : g.det = 1) (x y : FirstTits R) :
    linear g hg (polarProduct firstTitsSquare x y) =
      polarProduct firstTitsSquare (linear g hg x) (linear g hg y)
proof:
:= by
  have hs (z : FirstTits R) : linear g hg (firstTitsSquare z) =
      firstTitsSquare (linear g hg z) := act_firstTitsSquare g hg z
  simp only [polarProduct, map_smul, map_sub, hs, map_add]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TitsGauge.tauLinear_toTau
statement:
@[simp] theorem tauLinear_toTau (g : Mat3 R) (hg : g.det = 1) (z : FirstTits R) :
    tauLinear g hg (toTau z) = toTau (act g z)
proof:
:= by
  simp [tauLinear]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TitsGauge.tauLinear_one
statement: theorem tauLinear_one (g : Mat3 R) (hg : g.det = 1) : tauLinear g hg 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← toTau_firstTitsOne, tauLinear_toTau, act_firstTitsOne]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TitsGauge.tauLinear_mul
statement:
theorem tauLinear_mul (g : Mat3 R) (hg : g.det = 1) (x y : Albert R) :
    tauLinear g hg (x * y) = tauLinear g hg x * tauLinear g hg y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := (toTau (R := R)).surjective x
  obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := (toTau (R := R)).surjective y
  rw [← toTau_polarProduct, tauLinear_toTau, tauLinear_toTau, tauLinear_toTau]
  change toTau (linear g hg (polarProduct firstTitsSquare u v)) = _
  rw [linear_polarProduct, toTau_polarProduct]
  rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TitsGauge.tauTrace_tauLinear
statement:
theorem tauTrace_tauLinear (g : Mat3 R) (hg : g.det = 1) (x : Albert R) :
    TauCeti.AlbertAlgebra.trace (tauLinear g hg x) = TauCeti.AlbertAlgebra.trace x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := (toTau (R := R)).surjective x
  rw [tauLinear_toTau, tauTrace_toTau, tauTrace_toTau]
  rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TitsGauge.act_eq_inverse
statement:
theorem act_eq_inverse {K : Type*} [Field K] (g : Mat3 K) (hg : g.det = 1)
    (z : FirstTits K) : act g z = (z.1, z.2.1 * g, g⁻¹ * z.2.2)
proof:
:= by
  have h : IsUnit g.det := by rw [hg]; exact isUnit_one
  have hi : g⁻¹ = g.adjugate := by
    calc
      g⁻¹ = g⁻¹ * (g * g.adjugate) := by rw [mul_adj g hg, mul_one]
      _ = g.adjugate := by rw [← mul_assoc, Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul g h, one_mul]
  rw [hi]
  rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualOrientationField.normalized_gauge_formulas
statement:
theorem normalized_gauge_formulas (x : ExplicitFrameChart K) (hr1 : x.r1 = 1)
    (hz1 : x.z1 ≠ 0) :
    let g
proof:
:= BV (vectorA x) (vectorB x)
    x.z1 = nV (vectorA x) ∧
      x.r2 = (g - orientation x) / (2 * x.z1) ∧
      x.z2 = (g + orientation x) / 2 := by
  dsimp
  constructor
  · simp [nV, vectorA, Pf, BW, hr1]
  constructor
  · apply (eq_div_iff (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) hz1)).2
    simp [BV, BW, vectorA, vectorB, orientation, hr1]
    ring
  · simp [BV, BW, vectorA, vectorB, orientation, hr1]
    ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualOrientationField.gaugeAugmentedLedgerField_eq_orientationLedgerField
statement:
theorem gaugeAugmentedLedgerField_eq_orientationLedgerField
    (base : Subfield K) (x : ExplicitFrameChart K)
    (hr1 : x.r1 = 1) (hz1 : x.z1 ≠ 0) :
    gaugeAugmentedLedgerField base x = orientationLedgerField base x
proof:
:= by
  let L := ledgerField base (encoderA x) (encoderB x)
  let O := orientationLedgerField base x
  have hLO : L ≤ O := fun _ ht => Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inl ht)
  have hk : orientation x ∈ O := Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inr (by rfl))
  have hLedgerO : LedgerIn O (sourceLedger (encoderA x) (encoderB x)) := by
    rcases ledgerIn_ledgerField base (encoderA x) (encoderB x) with ⟨hP,hQ,hR,hC⟩
    exact ⟨fun i j => hLO (hP i j), fun j l => hLO (hQ j l),
      fun l i => hLO (hR l i), fun i j l => hLO (hC i j l)⟩
  have hd := powers_diag_mem O (encoderA x) (encoderB x) hLedgerO
  have hnA := norms_mem O (encoderA x) (hd.1 1) (hd.1 2)
  have hz : x.z1 ∈ O := by
    rw [(normalized_gauge_formulas x hr1 hz1).1]
    simpa only [encoderA] using hnA.1
  have hg : BV (vectorA x) (vectorB x) ∈ O := by
    simpa only [power, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_zero, encoderA, encoderB] using
      (power_sectors_mem O (encoderA x) (encoderB x) hLedgerO 1 1).1
  have hr2 : x.r2 ∈ O := by
    rw [(normalized_gauge_formulas x hr1 hz1).2.1]
    exact O.div_mem (O.sub_mem hg hk) (O.mul_mem (natCast_mem O 2) hz)
  have hz2 : x.z2 ∈ O := by
    rw [(normalized_gauge_formulas x hr1 hz1).2.2]
    exact O.div_mem (O.add_mem hg hk) (natCast_mem O 2)
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply Subfield.closure_le.2
    rintro t (ht | ht)
    · exact hLO ht
    · simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at ht
      rcases ht with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
      · rw [hr1]; exact O.one_mem
      · exact hz
      · exact hr2
      · exact hz2
  · apply Subfield.closure_le.2
    rintro t (ht | rfl)
    · exact Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inl ht)
    · rw [orientation]
      exact (gaugeAugmentedLedgerField base x).sub_mem
        ((gaugeAugmentedLedgerField base x).mul_mem
          (Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inr (by simp)))
          (Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inr (by simp))))
        ((gaugeAugmentedLedgerField base x).mul_mem
          (Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inr (by simp)))
          (Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inr (by simp))))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.UniformLedgerMeasurements.ledgerWeight_eq_powerWeight
statement:
@[simp] theorem ledgerWeight_eq_powerWeight (p j : Fin 3) :

proof:
:= by

name: AlbertLean.Generic.UniformLedgerMeasurements.rawJoint_sourceLedger
statement:
theorem rawJoint_sourceLedger (a b : JCoord K) (i j l : Fin 3) :
    rawJoint (sourceLedger a b) i j l =
      diagonalProduct i (spectralProjector a j) (spectralProjector b l)
proof:
:= by
  rw [diagonalProduct_apply, ← diagonal_trace]
  simp [rawJoint, sourceLedger]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.UniformLedgerMeasurements.H_sourceLedger
statement:
theorem H_sourceLedger (a b : JCoord K) (i p q : Fin 3) :
    H (sourceLedger a b) i p q =
      diagLinear i (sourceProduct (power a p) (power b q))
proof:
:= by
  rw [power_eq_weighted_projectors a p, power_eq_weighted_projectors b q]
  simp only [H]
  simp_rw [rawJoint_sourceLedger]
  simp only [ledgerWeight_eq_powerWeight]
  change (∑ j, ∑ l, powerWeight p j * powerWeight q l *
      diagonalProduct i (spectralProjector a j) (spectralProjector b l)) =
    diagonalProduct i (∑ j, powerWeight p j • spectralProjector a j)
      (∑ l, powerWeight q l • spectralProjector b l)
  simp only [map_sum, map_smul, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
    smul_eq_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
  conv_rhs => rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro l hl
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.UniformLedgerMeasurements.recovered_measurements
statement:
theorem recovered_measurements (a b : JCoord K)
    (hNa : sourceNorm a = 0) (hNb : sourceNorm b = 0) :
    nVx (sourceLedger a b) = nV a.v ∧ nSx (sourceLedger a b) = nS a.s ∧
    nCx (sourceLedger a b) = nC a.c ∧ nVy (sourceLedger a b) = nV b.v ∧
    nSy (sourceLedger a b) = nS b.s ∧ nCy (sourceLedger a b) = nC b.c ∧
    gV (sourceLedger a b) 1 1 = BV a.v b.v ∧
    gS (sourceLedger a b) 1 1 = BS a.s b.s ∧
    gC (sourceLedger a b) 1 1 = BC a.c b.c ∧
    t111 (sourceLedger a b) = triality a.v a.s a.c ∧
    t211 (sourceLedger a b) = triality b.v a.s a.c ∧
    t121 (sourceLedger a b) = triality a.v b.s a.c ∧
    t112 (sourceLedger a b) = triality a.v a.s b.c ∧
    t122 (sourceLedger a b) = triality a.v b.s b.c ∧
    t212 (sourceLedger a b) = triality b.v a.s b.c ∧
    t221 (sourceLedger a b) = triality b.v b.s a.c ∧
    t222 (sourceLedger a b) = triality b.v b.s b.c ∧
    uV (sourceLedger a b) = normalizedUV a.s b.s a.c b.c ∧
    uS (sourceLedger a b) = BS (sourceMuS a.c a.v) (sourceMuS b.c b.v) ∧
    uC (sourceLedger a b) = BC (sourceMuC a.v a.s) (sourceMuC b.v b.s)
proof:
:= by
  repeat' apply And.intro
  all_goals simp [nVx, nSx, nCx, nVy, nSy, nCy, half, gV, gS, gC, J, D, E,
    lVx, lSx, lCx, lVy, lSy, lCy, t111, t211, t121, t112, t122, t212,
    t221, t222, uV, uS, uC, H_sourceLedger, power, Matrix.cons_val_zero,
    Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_two, sourceProduct_one_left,
    sourceProduct_one_right, diagLinear_zero, diagLinear_one, diagLinear_two,
    sourceSquare_d1, sourceSquare_d2, sourceSquare_d3,
    sourceSquare_v, sourceSquare_s, sourceSquare_c, sourceProduct_d1,
    sourceProduct_d2, sourceProduct_d3, uV_centered, uS_centered, uC_centered,
    lV, lS, lC]
  all_goals try (solve | ring)
  · rw [sourceNorm_formula] at hNa
    linear_combination -hNa
  · rw [BV_add_left, BV_smul_left, muV_triality]
    ring
  · rw [BS_add_left, BS_smul_left, muS_triality]
    ring
  · rw [BC_add_left, BC_smul_left, muC_triality]
    ring
  · rw [BV_add_right, BV_smul_right,
      BV_symmetric a.v (normalizedMuV b.s b.c), muV_triality]
    ring
  · rw [BS_add_right, BS_smul_right,
      BS_symmetric a.s (sourceMuS b.c b.v), muS_triality]
    ring
  · rw [BC_add_right, BC_smul_right,
      BC_symmetric a.c (sourceMuC b.v b.s), muC_triality]
    ring
  · rw [sourceNorm_formula] at hNb
    linear_combination -hNb

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericClearedTransport.injective_of_evaluation_square
statement:
theorem injective_of_evaluation_square
    {R S F L : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Field F] [Field L]
    (i : R →+* F) (hi : Function.Injective i)
    (j : R →+* S) (e : S →+* L) (φ : F →+* L)
    (h : e.comp j = φ.comp i) : Function.Injective j
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  apply hi
  apply φ.injective
  have hx : e (j x) = φ (i x) := DFunLike.congr_fun h x
  have hy : e (j y) = φ (i y) := DFunLike.congr_fun h y
  rw [← hx, ← hy, hxy]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericClearedTransport.ratio_fixed_comp
statement:
theorem ratio_fixed_comp
    {S : Type*} [CommRing S] [IsDomain S]
    (a b : S) (hb : b ≠ 0) (α β : S ≃+* S)
    (hα : α a * b = a * α b)
    (hβ : β a * b = a * β b) :
    α (β a) * b = a * α (β b)
proof:
:= by
  have hαb : α b ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [map_zero] using α.injective.ne hb
  have hαβ : α (β a) * α b = α a * α (β b) := by
    simpa only [map_mul] using congrArg α hβ
  apply mul_right_cancel₀ hαb
  calc
    (α (β a) * b) * α b = (α (β a) * α b) * b :=
      mul_right_comm _ _ _
    _ = (α a * α (β b)) * b := by rw [hαβ]
    _ = (α a * b) * α (β b) := mul_right_comm _ _ _
    _ = (a * α b) * α (β b) := by rw [hα]
    _ = (a * α (β b)) * α b := mul_right_comm _ _ _

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericClearedTransport.ratio_fixed_inverse
statement:
theorem ratio_fixed_inverse
    {S : Type*} [CommRing S]
    (a b : S) (α : S ≃+* S)
    (hα : α a * b = a * α b) :
    α.symm a * b = a * α.symm b
proof:
:= by
  apply α.injective
  simpa only [map_mul, RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using hα.symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericClearedTransport.agreement_of_generic_cleared_transport
statement:
theorem agreement_of_generic_cleared_transport
    {R S F L : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Field F] [Field L]
    (i : R →+* F) (j : R →+* S) (e : S →+* L)
    (φ ψ : F →+* L) (α : S ≃+* S)
    (hleft : e.comp j = φ.comp i)
    (hright : (e.comp α.toRingHom).comp j = ψ.comp i)
    (a b : R) (hb : i b ≠ 0)
    (hclear : α (j a) * j b = j a * α (j b)) :
    φ (i a / i b) = ψ (i a / i b)
proof:
:= by
  have hl (x : R) : e (j x) = φ (i x) :=
    DFunLike.congr_fun hleft x
  have hr (x : R) : e (α (j x)) = ψ (i x) :=
    DFunLike.congr_fun hright x
  have h := congrArg e hclear
  simp only [map_mul] at h
  rw [hr a, hl b, hl a, hr b] at h
  have hφb : φ (i b) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [map_zero] using φ.injective.ne hb
  have hψb : ψ (i b) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [map_zero] using ψ.injective.ne hb
  rw [map_div₀, map_div₀]
  exact (div_eq_div_iff hφb hψb).2 h.symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ActualFrameCoverage.standardProjector_E
statement:
theorem standardProjector_E (i j : Fin 3) :
    standardProjector (K := K) i (standardE j) =
      if i = j then standardE j else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst i
    ext p
    rcases p with p | p <;> by_cases hp : p = j <;>
      simp [standardProjector, standardE, coordinateLabel, basisVector,
        Pi.single_apply, hp]
  · ext p
    rcases p with p | p <;> by_cases hpj : p = j <;>
      by_cases hpi : p = i <;>
      simp_all [standardProjector, standardE, coordinateLabel, basisVector,
        Pi.single_apply]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ActualFrameCoverage.standardProjector_F
statement:
theorem standardProjector_F (i j : Fin 3) :
    standardProjector (K := K) i (standardF j) =
      if i = j then standardF j else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst i
    ext p
    rcases p with p | p <;> by_cases hp : p = j <;>
      simp [standardProjector, standardF, coordinateLabel, basisVector,
        Pi.single_apply, hp]
  · ext p
    rcases p with p | p <;> by_cases hpj : p = j <;>
      by_cases hpi : p = i <;>
      simp_all [standardProjector, standardF, coordinateLabel, basisVector,
        Pi.single_apply]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ActualFrameCoverage.standard_hyperbolicTriple
statement:
theorem standard_hyperbolicTriple :
    HyperbolicTriple (omega (K := K)) standardE standardF
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    exact omega_basis_pair i
  all_goals
    intro i j hij
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
      simp_all [omega, omegaFun, standardE, standardF, basisVector,
        Pi.single_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ActualFrameCoverage.standard_spans
statement:
theorem standard_spans (x : Vec6 K) :
    ∃ a b : Fin 3 → K,
      x = (∑ j, a j • standardE j) + ∑ j, b j • standardF j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨fun j => x (Sum.inl j), fun j => x (Sum.inr j), ?_⟩
  funext p
  rcases p with p | p <;> fin_cases p <;>
    simp [standardE, standardF, basisVector, Fin.sum_univ_succ]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ActualFrameCoverage.exists_twelve_actual_carrier_frame_alignment
statement:
theorem exists_twelve_actual_carrier_frame_alignment
    (P : Fin 3 → Carrier K)
    (hidem : ∀ i, (P i : Mat6 K) * P i = P i)
    (htrace : ∀ i, jordanTrace (K := K) ((P i : Carrier K) : Mat6 K) = 1)
    (hsum : (P 0 : Mat6 K) + P 1 + P 2 = 1) :
    ∃ word : List (Step (K := K) (V := Vec6 K)), word.length = 12 ∧
      ∀ i, (wordMap omega word).comp (matrixAction (P i)) =
        (standardProjector i).comp (wordMap omega word)
proof:
:= by
  apply exists_twelve_actual_frame_alignment (K := K) (V := Vec6 K)
    (Q := fun i => standardProjector (K := K) i)
    (e := standardE (K := K)) (f := standardF (K := K))
    (omega (K := K)) omega_alternating omega_left_nondegenerate
    omega_right_nondegenerate
    (fun i => matrixAction (K := K) (P i : Mat6 K))
  · exact fun i => carrier_projector_action_idempotent (P i) (hidem i)
  · exact fun i => carrier_action_selfAdjoint (P i)
  · exact fun i => carrier_action_ne_zero_of_trace_one (P i) (htrace i)
  · exact carrier_frame_action_sum P hsum
  · exact standard_hyperbolicTriple (K := K)
  · exact standardProjector_E (K := K)
  · exact standardProjector_F (K := K)
  · exact standard_spans (K := K)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ActualFrameCoverage.exists_literal_twelve_actual_carrier_frame_alignment
statement:
theorem exists_literal_twelve_actual_carrier_frame_alignment
    (P : Fin 3 → Carrier K)
    (hidem : ∀ i, (P i : Mat6 K) * P i = P i)
    (htrace : ∀ i, jordanTrace (K := K) ((P i : Carrier K) : Mat6 K) = 1)
    (hsum : (P 0 : Mat6 K) + P 1 + P 2 = 1) :
    ∃ schedule : FixedTwelveSchedule (K := K) (V := Vec6 K),
      ∀ i, (fixedTwelveMap omega schedule).comp (matrixAction (P i)) =
        (standardProjector i).comp (fixedTwelveMap omega schedule)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨word, hlen, hintertwine⟩ :=
    exists_twelve_actual_carrier_frame_alignment P hidem htrace hsum
  let schedule := scheduleOfLengthTwelve word hlen
  refine ⟨schedule, ?_⟩
  intro i
  dsimp only [schedule]
  rw [fixedTwelveMap_scheduleOfLengthTwelve]
  exact hintertwine i

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.RawFrameIdeal.evaluation_universalMatrix
statement:
@[simp] theorem evaluation_universalMatrix
    (P : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Mat3 S) (r i a b : Fin 3) :
    evaluation (R := R) P (universalMatrix r i a b) = P r i a b
proof:
:= by
  simp [evaluation, universalMatrix]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.RawFrameIdeal.evaluationAlong_universalMatrix
statement:
@[simp] theorem evaluationAlong_universalMatrix
    (f : R →+* S) (P : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Mat3 S) (r i a b : Fin 3) :
    evaluationAlong f P (universalMatrix r i a b) = P r i a b
proof:
:= by
  simp [evaluationAlong, universalMatrix]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.RawFrameIdeal.equations_vanishAlong_iff
statement:
theorem equations_vanishAlong_iff (f : R →+* S)
    (P : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Mat3 S) :
    (∀ q, evaluationAlong f P (equation q) = 0) ↔ IsRawFrameFamily P
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro r i
      ext a b
      simpa [equation, Matrix.mul_apply, sub_eq_zero] using
        h (.idempotence r i a b)
    · intro r i
      simpa [equation, Matrix.trace, sub_eq_zero] using h (.traceOne r i)
    · intro r
      ext a b
      simpa [equation, Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.one_apply, sub_eq_zero] using
        h (.sumOne r a b)
  · intro h q
    cases q with
    | idempotence r i a b =>
        have hij := congrFun (congrFun (h.idempotent r i) a) b
        simpa [equation, Matrix.mul_apply, sub_eq_zero] using hij
    | traceOne r i =>
        simpa [equation, Matrix.trace, sub_eq_zero] using h.trace_one r i
    | sumOne r a b =>
        have hij := congrFun (congrFun (h.sum_one r) a) b
        simpa [equation, Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.one_apply, sub_eq_zero] using hij

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.RawFrameIdeal.equations_vanish_iff
statement:
theorem equations_vanish_iff (P : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Mat3 S) :
    (∀ q, evaluation (R := R) P (equation q) = 0) ↔ IsRawFrameFamily P
proof:
:= by
  simpa [evaluation, evaluationAlong] using
    (equations_vanishAlong_iff (R := R) (algebraMap R S) P)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.RawFrameIdeal.rawFrameIdeal_le_ker_iff
statement:
theorem rawFrameIdeal_le_ker_iff (P : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Mat3 S) :
    rawFrameIdeal (R := R) ≤ RingHom.ker (evaluation (R := R) P).toRingHom ↔
      IsRawFrameFamily P
proof:
:= by
  rw [← equations_vanish_iff (R := R) P]
  constructor
  · intro h q
    exact RingHom.mem_ker.mp (h (Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self q)))
  · intro h
    exact Ideal.span_le.2 (fun p hp => by
      rcases hp with ⟨q, rfl⟩
      exact RingHom.mem_ker.mpr (h q))

name: AlbertLean.Triality.RationalEvenFamily.norm_center
statement:
theorem norm_center (alpha r : K) (omega : W K) (rho : K) (hr : r ≠ 0) :
    nV (center alpha r omega rho) = rho ^ 2 / alpha
proof:
:= by
  change r * ((rho ^ 2 / alpha - Pf omega) / r) + Pf omega = rho ^ 2 / alpha
  rw [mul_div_cancel₀ _ hr]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Triality.RationalEvenFamily.center_root
statement:
theorem center_root (alpha r : K) (omega : W K) (rho : K)
    (ha : alpha ≠ 0) (hr : r ≠ 0) :
    rho ^ 2 = alpha * nV (center alpha r omega rho)
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_center alpha r omega rho hr]
  exact (mul_div_cancel₀ _ ha).symm

name: AlbertLean.Triality.RationalEvenFamily.norm_center_ne_zero
statement:
theorem norm_center_ne_zero (alpha r : K) (omega : W K) (rho : K)
    (ha : alpha ≠ 0) (hr : r ≠ 0) (hp : rho ≠ 0) :
    nV (center alpha r omega rho) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_center alpha r omega rho hr]
  exact div_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero 2 hp) ha

name: AlbertLean.Triality.RationalEvenFamily.center_eq
statement:
theorem center_eq (alpha : K) (B : VCoord K) (rho : K)
    (ha : alpha ≠ 0) (hr : B.r ≠ 0)
    (hroot : rho ^ 2 = alpha * nV B) :
    center alpha B.r B.omega rho = B
proof:
:= by
  have hn : nV B = rho ^ 2 / alpha :=
    (eq_div_iff ha).2 (by simpa only [mul_comm] using hroot.symm)
  apply VCoord.ext
  · rfl
  · change (rho ^ 2 / alpha - Pf B.omega) / B.r = B.z
    apply (div_eq_iff hr).2
    rw [← hn]
    change B.r * B.z + Pf B.omega - Pf B.omega = B.z * B.r
    ring
  · rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexDephasingAdapter.det_dephase_ne_zero
statement:
theorem det_dephase_ne_zero (X : Mat3 K) (hdet : X.det ≠ 0)
    (hrow : ∀ j, X 0 j ≠ 0) (hcol : ∀ i, X i 0 ≠ 0) :
    (dephase X).det ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [dephase_eq_diagonal_mul, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_mul,
    Matrix.det_diagonal, Matrix.det_diagonal]
  apply mul_ne_zero
  · apply mul_ne_zero
    · apply Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr
      intro i _
      exact div_ne_zero (hrow 0) (hcol i)
    · exact hdet
  · apply Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr
    intro i _
    exact inv_ne_zero (hrow i)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexDephasingAdapter.dephase_eq_dephased
statement:
theorem dephase_eq_dephased (X : Mat3 K)
    (hrow : ∀ j, X 0 j ≠ 0) (hcol : ∀ i, X i 0 ≠ 0) :
    dephase X = dephased (dephase X 1 1) (dephase X 1 2)
      (dephase X 2 1) (dephase X 2 2)
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [dephased, Matrix.cons_val_two,
      dephase_first_row X (hrow 0) hrow, dephase_first_col X (hrow 0) hcol]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexDephasingAdapter.overlap_row_sum
statement:
theorem overlap_row_sum (X : Mat3 K) (hdet : X.det ≠ 0) (i : Fin 3) :
    ∑ j, overlapOf X i j = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrFun (congrFun
    (Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv X (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hdet)) i) i
  simpa [overlapOf, Matrix.mul_apply] using h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexDephasingAdapter.overlap_col_sum
statement:
theorem overlap_col_sum (X : Mat3 K) (hdet : X.det ≠ 0) (j : Fin 3) :
    ∑ i, overlapOf X i j = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrFun (congrFun
    (Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul X (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hdet)) j) j
  simpa [overlapOf, Matrix.mul_apply, mul_comm] using h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexDephasingAdapter.A2_eq_opposite_overlap_product
statement:
theorem A2_eq_opposite_overlap_product (X : Mat3 K) (hdet : X.det ≠ 0) :
    A2 (overlapOf X 0 0) (overlapOf X 0 1) (overlapOf X 1 0) =
      overlapOf X 0 2 * overlapOf X 2 0
proof:
:= by
  have hr := overlap_row_sum X hdet 0
  have hc := overlap_col_sum X hdet 0
  simp [Fin.sum_univ_succ] at hr hc
  unfold A2
  rw [show 1-overlapOf X 0 0-overlapOf X 0 1 = overlapOf X 0 2 by
        linear_combination -hr,
      show 1-overlapOf X 0 0-overlapOf X 1 0 = overlapOf X 2 0 by
        linear_combination -hc]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexDephasingAdapter.inverseTranspose_entries
statement:
theorem inverseTranspose_entries (X : Mat3 K)
    (hopen : ∀ i j, overlapOf X i j ≠ 0) :
    ∀ i j, Matrix.transpose X⁻¹ i j ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro i j
  exact (entries_ne_zero_of_overlap_ne_zero X hopen).2 i j

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexDephasingAdapter.transpose_dephase_data
statement:
theorem transpose_dephase_data (X : Mat3 K) (hdet : X.det ≠ 0)
    (hopen : ∀ i j, overlapOf X i j ≠ 0) :
    (dephase (Matrix.transpose X⁻¹)).det ≠ 0 ∧
      (∀ i j, overlapOf (dephase (Matrix.transpose X⁻¹)) i j = overlapOf X i j) ∧
      (∀ i j, overlapOf (dephase (Matrix.transpose X⁻¹)) i j ≠ 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hentry := inverseTranspose_entries X hopen
  have hdetT : (Matrix.transpose X⁻¹).det ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Matrix.det_transpose, Matrix.det_nonsing_inv, Ring.inverse_eq_inv]
    exact inv_ne_zero hdet
  have hover (i j : Fin 3) :
      overlapOf (dephase (Matrix.transpose X⁻¹)) i j = overlapOf X i j := by
    rw [overlap_dephase _ hentry hdetT, overlap_inverseTranspose X hdet]
  exact ⟨det_dephase_ne_zero _ hdetT (hentry 0) (fun i => hentry i 0),
    hover, fun i j => (hover i j).symm ▸ hopen i j⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexDephasingAdapter.legal_of_all_overlap
statement:
theorem legal_of_all_overlap (a b c d : K) (hΔ : delta a b c d ≠ 0)
    (hopen : ∀ i j, overlap a b c d i j ≠ 0) : Legal a b c d
proof:
:= by
  have ht := overlap_table a b c d hΔ
  have hn (x y : K) (h : x/y ≠ 0) : x ≠ 0 := by
    intro hx
    exact h (by simp only [hx, zero_div])
  have hd : d ≠ 0 := by
    have hz := hopen 2 2
    rw [show overlap a b c d 2 2 = d*(a-1)/delta a b c d by
      simpa [Matrix.cons_val_two] using congrFun (congrFun ht 2) 2] at hz
    exact (mul_ne_zero_iff.mp (hn _ _ hz)).1
  have hd1 : d-1 ≠ 0 := by
    have hz := hopen 1 1
    rw [show overlap a b c d 1 1 = a*(d-1)/delta a b c d by
      simpa using congrFun (congrFun ht 1) 1] at hz
    exact (mul_ne_zero_iff.mp (hn _ _ hz)).2
  have hnu : nu (overlap a b c d 0 0) (overlap a b c d 0 1)
      (overlap a b c d 1 0) (overlap a b c d 1 1) d ≠ 0 := by
    have hh := nu_mul_delta a b c d hΔ
    have hz : nu (overlap a b c d 0 0) (overlap a b c d 0 1)
        (overlap a b c d 1 0) (overlap a b c d 1 1) d * delta a b c d ≠ 0 := by
      rw [hh]
      exact mul_ne_zero hd hd1
    exact (mul_ne_zero_iff.mp hz).1
  have hA2 : A2 (overlap a b c d 0 0) (overlap a b c d 0 1)
      (overlap a b c d 1 0) ≠ 0 := by
    have hh := A2_eq_opposite_overlap_product (dephased a b c d)
      (by simpa only [det_dephased] using hΔ)
    change A2 (overlap a b c d 0 0) (overlap a b c d 0 1)
      (overlap a b c d 1 0) = overlap a b c d 0 2 * overlap a b c d 2 0 at hh
    rw [hh]
    exact mul_ne_zero (hopen 0 2) (hopen 2 0)
  refine ⟨hΔ, hd, hd1, hnu, hA2, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hz := hopen 1 0
    rw [show overlap a b c d 1 0 = (c-d)/delta a b c d by
      simpa using congrFun (congrFun ht 1) 0] at hz
    exact hn _ _ hz
  · have hz := hopen 0 1
    rw [show overlap a b c d 0 1 = (b-d)/delta a b c d by
      simpa using congrFun (congrFun ht 0) 1] at hz
    exact hn _ _ hz
  · have hz := hopen 0 2
    rw [show overlap a b c d 0 2 = (c-a)/delta a b c d by
      simpa [Matrix.cons_val_two] using congrFun (congrFun ht 0) 2] at hz
    exact hn _ _ hz
  · have hz := hopen 2 0
    rw [show overlap a b c d 2 0 = (b-a)/delta a b c d by
      simpa [Matrix.cons_val_two] using congrFun (congrFun ht 2) 0] at hz
    exact hn _ _ hz

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexDephasingAdapter.dephase_inverseTranspose_entry22
statement:
theorem dephase_inverseTranspose_entry22 (a b c d : K)
    (hΔ : delta a b c d ≠ 0) (hba : b-a ≠ 0) (hca : c-a ≠ 0) :
    dephase (Matrix.transpose (dephased a b c d)⁻¹) 2 2 = td a b c d
proof:
:= by
  rw [dephased_inv_eq a b c d hΔ]
  change ((delta a b c d)⁻¹ * (a*d-b*c)) * ((delta a b c d)⁻¹ * (a-1)) /
    (((delta a b c d)⁻¹ * (b-a)) * ((delta a b c d)⁻¹ * (c-a))) = td a b c d
  unfold td
  field_simp [hΔ, hba, hca]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexDephasingAdapter.td_eq_dualRoot
statement:
theorem td_eq_dualRoot (a b c d : K) (h : Legal a b c d) :
    td a b c d = dualRoot (overlap a b c d 0 0) (overlap a b c d 0 1)
      (overlap a b c d 1 0) (overlap a b c d 1 1) d
proof:
:= by
  have ht := overlap_table a b c d h.delta_ne_zero
  have hp := congrFun (congrFun ht 0) 0
  have hq := congrFun (congrFun ht 0) 1
  have hr := congrFun (congrFun ht 1) 0
  have hs := congrFun (congrFun ht 1) 1
  have h22 := congrFun (congrFun ht 2) 2
  have h02 := congrFun (congrFun ht 0) 2
  have h20 := congrFun (congrFun ht 2) 0
  change overlap a b c d 0 0 = (a*d-b*c) / delta a b c d at hp
  change overlap a b c d 0 1 = (b-d) / delta a b c d at hq
  change overlap a b c d 1 0 = (c-d) / delta a b c d at hr
  change overlap a b c d 1 1 = a*(d-1) / delta a b c d at hs
  change overlap a b c d 2 2 = d*(a-1) / delta a b c d at h22
  change overlap a b c d 0 2 = (c-a) / delta a b c d at h02
  change overlap a b c d 2 0 = (b-a) / delta a b c d at h20
  have htheta : overlap a b c d 0 0 + overlap a b c d 0 1 +
      overlap a b c d 1 0 + overlap a b c d 1 1 - 1 = overlap a b c d 2 2 := by
    rw [hp, hq, hr, hs, h22]
    field_simp [h.delta_ne_zero]
    unfold delta
    ring
  have hlead := A2_eq_opposite_overlap_product (dephased a b c d)
    (by simpa only [det_dephased] using h.delta_ne_zero)
  change A2 (overlap a b c d 0 0) (overlap a b c d 0 1)
      (overlap a b c d 1 0) = overlap a b c d 0 2 * overlap a b c d 2 0 at hlead
  rw [dualRoot, A0, htheta, hlead, hp, h22, h02, h20]
  unfold td
  field_simp [h.delta_ne_zero, h.d_ne_zero, h.b_sub_a_ne_zero, h.c_sub_a_ne_zero]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexDephasingAdapter.dephased_pair_matrix_classification
statement:
theorem dephased_pair_matrix_classification
    (a b c d a' b' c' d' : K)
    (hΔ : delta a b c d ≠ 0) (hΔ' : delta a' b' c' d' ≠ 0)
    (hopen : ∀ i j, overlap a b c d i j ≠ 0)
    (hover : ∀ i j, overlap a' b' c' d' i j = overlap a b c d i j) :
    dephased a' b' c' d' = dephased a b c d ∨
      dephased a' b' c' d' = dephase (Matrix.transpose (dephased a b c d)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  have hopen' : ∀ i j, overlap a' b' c' d' i j ≠ 0 := by
    intro i j
    rw [hover i j]
    exact hopen i j
  have h := legal_of_all_overlap a b c d hΔ hopen
  have h' := legal_of_all_overlap a' b' c' d' hΔ' hopen'
  have hdet : (dephased a b c d).det ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [det_dephased] using hΔ
  have hdata := transpose_dephase_data (dephased a b c d) hdet hopen
  have hentry := inverseTranspose_entries (dephased a b c d) hopen
  let T := dephase (Matrix.transpose (dephased a b c d)⁻¹)
  let aT := T 1 1
  let bt := T 1 2
  let ct := T 2 1
  let dt := T 2 2
  have hT : T = dephased aT bt ct dt :=
    dephase_eq_dephased _ (hentry 0) (fun i => hentry i 0)
  have hΔT : delta aT bt ct dt ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← det_dephased, ← hT]
    exact hdata.1
  have hoverT : ∀ i j, overlap aT bt ct dt i j = overlap a b c d i j := by
    intro i j
    change overlapOf (dephased aT bt ct dt) i j = overlapOf (dephased a b c d) i j
    rw [← hT]
    exact hdata.2.1 i j
  have hopenT : ∀ i j, overlap aT bt ct dt i j ≠ 0 := by
    intro i j
    rw [hoverT i j]
    exact hopen i j
  have ht := legal_of_all_overlap aT bt ct dt hΔT hopenT
  have hdt : dt = dualRoot (overlap a b c d 0 0) (overlap a b c d 0 1)
      (overlap a b c d 1 0) (overlap a b c d 1 1) d :=
    (dephase_inverseTranspose_entry22 a b c d hΔ
      h.b_sub_a_ne_zero h.c_sub_a_ne_zero).trans (td_eq_dualRoot a b c d h)
  have hQ' : pairQuadratic (overlap a b c d 0 0) (overlap a b c d 0 1)
      (overlap a b c d 1 0) (overlap a b c d 1 1) d' = 0 := by
    simpa only [hover] using pairQuadratic_root a' b' c' d' hΔ'
  rcases roots_eq_or_eq_dual _ _ _ _ d d' h.A2_ne_zero h.d_ne_zero
      (pairQuadratic_root a b c d hΔ) hQ' with hd | hd
  · exact Or.inl (dephased_eq_of_overlap_of_d_eq a b c d a' b' c' d'
      hΔ hΔ' h.nu_ne_zero h'.nu_ne_zero hover hd)
  · right
    apply Eq.trans ?_ hT.symm
    apply dephased_eq_of_overlap_of_d_eq aT bt ct dt a' b' c' d'
      hΔT hΔ' ht.nu_ne_zero h'.nu_ne_zero
    · intro i j
      exact (hover i j).trans (hoverT i j).symm
    · exact hd.trans hdt.symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.FrameReducedDomain.radical_eq_parameter_kernel
statement:
theorem radical_eq_parameter_kernel :
    (rawFrameIdeal (R := k)).radical = RingHom.ker (psi k)
proof:
:= by
  apply radical_eq_ker_of_prime_field_squares _ _ (rawFrameIdeal_le_ker_psi k)
  intro p hp hraw
  letI : p.IsPrime := hp
  obtain ⟨X, hdet, hX⟩ := exists_localized_evaluation k p hraw
  refine ⟨GenericField k p, inferInstance,
    algebraMap (Residue k p) (GenericField k p),
    IsFractionRing.injective (Residue k p) (GenericField k p),
    evalAway (coefficientMap k p) X hdet, ?_⟩
  apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
  · intro c
    simp [psi, evaluationAlong, GLParameterDomain.coefficientMap, evalAway_algebraMap,
      GLParameterLocalization.baseEval, RawFramePrimeSquare.coefficientMap, residueMap]
  · intro q
    cases q with
    | entry r i a b => exact hX r i a b

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.FrameReducedDomain.rawFrameRadical_isPrime
statement: theorem rawFrameRadical_isPrime : (rawFrameIdeal (R := k)).radical.IsPrime
proof:
:= by
  rw [radical_eq_parameter_kernel]
  exact RingHom.ker_isPrime (psi k)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.CoefficientFieldInvolution.numerator_injective
statement: theorem numerator_injective : Function.Injective (numerator e)
proof:
:=
  (polynomialMap_injective B).comp (Polynomial.map_injective _ e.injective)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.CoefficientFieldInvolution.fieldHom_polynomial
statement:
@[simp] theorem fieldHom_polynomial (p : Polynomial B) :
    fieldHom e (algebraMap (Polynomial B) (Omega B) p) = numerator e p
proof:
:=
  IsFractionRing.lift_algebraMap _ p

name: AlbertLean.Generic.CoefficientFieldInvolution.fieldHom_base
statement:
@[simp] theorem fieldHom_base (b : B) :
    fieldHom e (algebraMap B (Omega B) b) = algebraMap B (Omega B) (e b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← polynomialMap_C B b, fieldHom_polynomial]
  simp [numerator]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.CoefficientFieldInvolution.fieldHom_T
statement: @[simp] theorem fieldHom_T : fieldHom e (T B) = T B
proof:
:= by
  simp [T, numerator]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.CoefficientFieldInvolution.fieldHom_involutive
statement:
theorem fieldHom_involutive (he : Function.Involutive e) :
    (fieldHom e).comp (fieldHom e) = RingHom.id (Omega B)
proof:
:= by
  apply IsFractionRing.ringHom_ext (A := Polynomial B)
  have h : ((fieldHom e).comp (fieldHom e)).comp
      (algebraMap (Polynomial B) (Omega B)) =
      algebraMap (Polynomial B) (Omega B) := by
    ext b
    · simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, polynomialMap_C, fieldHom_base]
      rw [he b]
    · change fieldHom e (fieldHom e (T B)) = T B
      rw [fieldHom_T, fieldHom_T]
  exact fun p => RingHom.congr_fun h p

name: AlbertLean.Generic.CoefficientFieldInvolution.fieldEquiv_base
statement:
@[simp] theorem fieldEquiv_base (he : Function.Involutive e) (b : B) :
    fieldEquiv e he (algebraMap B (Omega B) b) = algebraMap B (Omega B) (e b)
proof:
:=
  fieldHom_base e b

name: AlbertLean.Generic.CoefficientFieldInvolution.fieldEquiv_T
statement:
@[simp] theorem fieldEquiv_T (he : Function.Involutive e) :
    fieldEquiv e he (T B) = T B
proof: := fieldHom_T e

name: AlbertLean.Generic.CoefficientFieldInvolution.fieldEquiv_twice
statement:
@[simp] theorem fieldEquiv_twice (he : Function.Involutive e) (z : Omega B) :
    fieldEquiv e he (fieldEquiv e he z) = z
proof:
:=
  RingHom.congr_fun (fieldHom_involutive e he) z

name: AlbertLean.Generic.CoefficientFieldInvolution.fieldHom_commutes_reciprocal
statement:
theorem fieldHom_commutes_reciprocal (m : B) (hm : m ≠ 0) (hem : e m = m) :
    (fieldHom e).comp (reciprocalHom B m hm) =
      (reciprocalHom B m hm).comp (fieldHom e)
proof:
:= by
  apply IsFractionRing.ringHom_ext (A := Polynomial B)
  have h : ((fieldHom e).comp (reciprocalHom B m hm)).comp
      (algebraMap (Polynomial B) (Omega B)) =
      ((reciprocalHom B m hm).comp (fieldHom e)).comp
        (algebraMap (Polynomial B) (Omega B)) := by
    ext b
    · simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, polynomialMap_C, reciprocalHom_base,
        fieldHom_base]
    · change fieldHom e (reciprocalHom B m hm (T B)) =
        reciprocalHom B m hm (fieldHom e (T B))
      rw [reciprocalHom_T, map_div₀, fieldHom_base, hem, fieldHom_T,
        reciprocalHom_T]
  exact fun p => RingHom.congr_fun h p

name: AlbertLean.Generic.CoefficientFieldInvolution.fieldEquiv_commutes_reciprocal
statement:
theorem fieldEquiv_commutes_reciprocal (he : Function.Involutive e)
    (m : B) (hm : m ≠ 0) (hem : e m = m) :
    Function.Commute (fieldEquiv e he) (reciprocalEquiv B m hm)
proof:
:=
  fun z => RingHom.congr_fun (fieldHom_commutes_reciprocal e m hm hem) z

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.exists_common_detour
statement:
theorem exists_common_detour
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V))
    (hleft : IsLeftNondegenerate omega) (hright : IsRightNondegenerate omega)
    (x y : V) (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0) :
    ∃ z, omega z x ≠ 0 ∧ omega y z ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨zx, hzx⟩ := hleft x hx
  obtain ⟨zy, hzy⟩ := hright y hy
  by_cases hyzx : omega y zx ≠ 0
  · exact ⟨zx, hzx, hyzx⟩
  by_cases hzyx : omega zy x ≠ 0
  · exact ⟨zy, hzyx, hzy⟩
  refine ⟨zx + zy, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, not_ne_iff.mp hzyx, add_zero]
    exact hzx
  · simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, not_ne_iff.mp hyzx, zero_add]
    exact hzy

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.exists_two_step_alignment
statement:
theorem exists_two_step_alignment
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V))
    (halt : ∀ x, omega x x = 0)
    (hleft : IsLeftNondegenerate omega) (hright : IsRightNondegenerate omega)
    (x y : V) (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0) :
    ∃ z,
      equiv omega halt (y - z) (omega y z)⁻¹
        (equiv omega halt (z - x) (omega z x)⁻¹ x) = y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hzx, hyz⟩ := exists_common_detour omega hleft hright x y hx hy
  exact ⟨z, two_step_align omega halt x z y hzx hyz⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawGenericChartEvaluation.chartFrameLaws
proof:
:= by

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawGenericChartEvaluation.chartRawFamily_sourceEncoders
statement:
private theorem chartRawFamily_sourceEncoders :
    sourceEncoders (chartRawFamily k) = chartSourceTriple k
proof:
:= by
  funext r
  simp only [sourceEncoders, chartRawFamily, toF0Family,
    LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply, map_sub]
  change sourceProjector (chartSourceTriple k r) 2 -
      sourceProjector (chartSourceTriple k r) 0 = chartSourceTriple k r
  change (2 : K k)⁻¹ •
      (sourceProduct (chartSourceTriple k r) (chartSourceTriple k r) +
        chartSourceTriple k r) -
    (2 : K k)⁻¹ •
      (sourceProduct (chartSourceTriple k r) (chartSourceTriple k r) -
        chartSourceTriple k r) = chartSourceTriple k r
  rw [← smul_sub]
  have h :
      (sourceProduct (chartSourceTriple k r) (chartSourceTriple k r) +
          chartSourceTriple k r) -
        (sourceProduct (chartSourceTriple k r) (chartSourceTriple k r) -
          chartSourceTriple k r) =
        (2 : K k) • chartSourceTriple k r := by
    rw [two_smul]
    abel
  rw [h, smul_smul]
  norm_num

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawGenericChartEvaluation.chartEvaluation_rawLabelledLedger
statement:
theorem chartEvaluation_rawLabelledLedger :
    { P := fun i j => chartEvaluation k (pairP k i j)
      Q := fun j l => chartEvaluation k (pairQ k j l)
      R := fun l i => chartEvaluation k (pairR k l i)
      C0 := fun i j l => chartEvaluation k (centeredTriple k i j l) } =
      labelledLedger (mapTriple (chartSourceTriple k))
proof:
:= by
  rw [show chartEvaluation k = evaluationAlong
      (algebraMap k (K k)) (chartRawFamily k) from rfl]
  rw [evaluation_rawLabelledLedger_eq_tau]
  · rw [chartRawFamily_sourceEncoders]
  · exact chartRawFamily_isRaw k

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TauIntrinsicTrace.sourceLeftMul_conj
statement:
theorem sourceLeftMul_conj (g : Albert K ≃ₗ[K] Albert K)
    (hMul : ∀ x y, g (x * y) = g x * g y) (z : FirstTits K) :
    sourceLeftMul (sourceConjugate g z) =
      (sourceConjugate g).conj (sourceLeftMul z)
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro y
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := (sourceConjugate g).surjective y
  simp only [LinearEquiv.conj_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe,
    LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  change polarProduct firstTitsSquare (sourceConjugate g z) (sourceConjugate g w) =
    sourceConjugate g (polarProduct firstTitsSquare z w)
  apply (toTau (R := K)).injective
  simp only [toTau_polarProduct, toTau_sourceConjugate, hMul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TauIntrinsicTrace.tauTrace_invariant
statement:
theorem tauTrace_invariant (g : Albert K ≃ₗ[K] Albert K)
    (hMul : ∀ x y, g (x * y) = g x * g y) (x : Albert K) :
    TauCeti.AlbertAlgebra.trace (g x) = TauCeti.AlbertAlgebra.trace x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := (toTau (R := K)).surjective x
  have ht (u : FirstTits K) :
      LinearMap.trace K (FirstTits K) (sourceLeftMul u) =
        (9 : K) * TauCeti.AlbertAlgebra.trace (toTau u) := by
    rw [tauTrace_toTau]
    simpa only [trace3_eq_matrixTrace] using trace_sourceLeftMul u.1 u.2.1 u.2.2
  have h := LinearMap.trace_conj' (sourceLeftMul z) (sourceConjugate g)
  rw [← sourceLeftMul_conj g hMul z, ht, ht, toTau_sourceConjugate] at h
  exact mul_left_cancel₀ (by norm_num : (9 : K) ≠ 0) h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TauIntrinsicTrace.tauTrace_cube_invariant
statement:
theorem tauTrace_cube_invariant (g : Albert K ≃ₗ[K] Albert K)
    (hMul : ∀ x y, g (x * y) = g x * g y) (w : Albert K) :
    TauCeti.AlbertAlgebra.trace ((g w) * ((g w) * (g w))) =
      TauCeti.AlbertAlgebra.trace (w * (w * w))
proof:
:= by
  have h := tauTrace_invariant g hMul (w * (w * w))
  rw [hMul, hMul] at h
  exact h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.DetectorPolynomial.pEval_pClearedA
statement:
theorem pEval_pClearedA (F₀ VF : Coord) (t : ℚ) :
    pEval t (pClearedA F₀ VF) = clearedA F₀ VF t
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  change (X * C (F₀ i) + C (VF i)).eval t = t * F₀ i + VF i
  simp only [Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C,
    Polynomial.eval_X]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.DetectorPolynomial.pEval_pClearedB
statement:
theorem pEval_pClearedB (K₀ U V : Coord) (t : ℚ) :
    pEval t (pClearedB K₀ U V) = clearedB K₀ U V t
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  change (X * C (K₀ i) + X ^ 2 * C (U i) + C (V i)).eval t =
    t * K₀ i + t ^ 2 * U i + V i
  simp only [Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C,
    Polynomial.eval_pow, Polynomial.eval_X]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.DetectorPolynomial.pEval_pSwappedC
statement:
theorem pEval_pSwappedC (F₀ VF : Coord) (m t : ℚ) :
    pEval t (pSwappedC F₀ VF m) = swappedC F₀ VF m t
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  change (C m * C (F₀ i) + X * C (VF i)).eval t = m * F₀ i + t * VF i
  simp only [Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C,
    Polynomial.eval_X]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.DetectorPolynomial.pEval_pSwappedH
statement:
theorem pEval_pSwappedH (K₀ U V : Coord) (m t : ℚ) :
    pEval t (pSwappedH K₀ U V m) = swappedH K₀ U V m t
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  change (C m * X * C (K₀ i) + C (m ^ 2) * C (U i) +
      X ^ 2 * C (V i)).eval t =
    (m * t) * K₀ i + m ^ 2 * U i + t ^ 2 * V i
  simp only [Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C,
    Polynomial.eval_pow, Polynomial.eval_X]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.DetectorPolynomial.exists_delta_outer
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨C (m ^ 6) * p - X ^ 3 * q, ?_⟩
  intro t
  rw [Polynomial.eval_sub, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_mul,
    Polynomial.eval_C, Polynomial.eval_pow, Polynomial.eval_X]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.DetectorPolynomial.eval_detector_AB
proof:
:= by
  have hTriple :
      WitnessTriple.mk (pEval t (pConst E)) (pEval t (pClearedA F₀ VF))
          (pEval t (pClearedB K₀ U V)) =
        WitnessTriple.mk E (clearedA F₀ VF t) (clearedB K₀ U V t) :=
    (congrArg₂
      (fun e f : Coord => WitnessTriple.mk e f (pEval t (pClearedB K₀ U V)))
      (pEval_pConst t E) (pEval_pClearedA F₀ VF t)).trans
      (congrArg (WitnessTriple.mk E (clearedA F₀ VF t))
        (pEval_pClearedB K₀ U V t))
  exact (eval_pDetector t (pConst E) (pClearedA F₀ VF)
    (pClearedB K₀ U V)).trans (congrArg traceCubeDetector hTriple)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.DetectorPolynomial.eval_detector_CH
proof:
:= by
  have hTriple :
      WitnessTriple.mk (pEval t (pConst E)) (pEval t (pSwappedC F₀ VF m))
          (pEval t (pSwappedH K₀ U V m)) =
        WitnessTriple.mk E (swappedC F₀ VF m t) (swappedH K₀ U V m t) :=
    (congrArg₂
      (fun e f : Coord => WitnessTriple.mk e f (pEval t (pSwappedH K₀ U V m)))
      (pEval_pConst t E) (pEval_pSwappedC F₀ VF m t)).trans
      (congrArg (WitnessTriple.mk E (swappedC F₀ VF m t))
        (pEval_pSwappedH K₀ U V m t))
  exact (eval_pDetector t (pConst E) (pSwappedC F₀ VF m)
    (pSwappedH K₀ U V m)).trans (congrArg traceCubeDetector hTriple)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.DetectorPolynomial.eval_deltaPolynomial
statement:
theorem eval_deltaPolynomial (E F₀ VF K₀ U V : Coord) (m t : ℚ) :
    (deltaPolynomial E F₀ VF K₀ U V m).eval t =
      detectorDelta E F₀ VF K₀ U V m t
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (deltaPolynomial E F₀ VF K₀ U V m).eval t =
        m ^ 6 *
            (pDetector (pConst E) (pClearedA F₀ VF) (pClearedB K₀ U V)).eval t -
          t ^ 3 *
            (pDetector (pConst E) (pSwappedC F₀ VF m) (pSwappedH K₀ U V m)).eval t := by
      exact Classical.choose_spec (exists_delta_outer m
        (pDetector (pConst E) (pClearedA F₀ VF) (pClearedB K₀ U V))
        (pDetector (pConst E) (pSwappedC F₀ VF m) (pSwappedH K₀ U V m))) t
    _ = m ^ 6 * traceCubeDetector ⟨E, clearedA F₀ VF t, clearedB K₀ U V t⟩ -
          t ^ 3 * traceCubeDetector ⟨E, swappedC F₀ VF m t, swappedH K₀ U V m t⟩ :=
      congrArg₂ (fun a b : ℚ => m ^ 6 * a - t ^ 3 * b)
        (eval_detector_AB E F₀ VF K₀ U V t)
        (eval_detector_CH E F₀ VF K₀ U V m t)
    _ = detectorDelta E F₀ VF K₀ U V m t := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.DetectorPolynomial.deltaPolynomial_ne_zero_of_eval_ne_zero
statement:
theorem deltaPolynomial_ne_zero_of_eval_ne_zero
    (E F₀ VF K₀ U V : Coord) (m t : ℚ)
    (h : detectorDelta E F₀ VF K₀ U V m t ≠ 0) :
    deltaPolynomial E F₀ VF K₀ U V m ≠ 0

    Polynomial.eval_zero]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.DetectorPolynomial.deltaPolynomial_ne_zero_of_one
statement:

    (E F₀ VF K₀ U V : Coord) (m : ℚ)

    deltaPolynomial E F₀ VF K₀ U V m ≠ 0

  deltaPolynomial_ne_zero_of_eval_ne_zero E F₀ VF K₀ U V m 1 h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.DetectorPolynomial.finite_detectorDelta_zeros_of_one
statement:
theorem finite_detectorDelta_zeros_of_one
    (E F₀ VF K₀ U V : Coord) (m : ℚ)
    (h : detectorDelta E F₀ VF K₀ U V m 1 ≠ 0) :
    Set.Finite {t : ℚ | detectorDelta E F₀ VF K₀ U V m t = 0}
proof:
:= by
  have hp : deltaPolynomial E F₀ VF K₀ U V m ≠ 0 :=
    deltaPolynomial_ne_zero_of_one E F₀ VF K₀ U V m h
  have hroots := Polynomial.finite_setOfPred_isRoot hp
  simpa only [Polynomial.IsRoot, eval_deltaPolynomial] using hroots

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ScalarFibre.outer_eq_scaling_at_pivot
statement:
theorem outer_eq_scaling_at_pivot
    (u v u' v' : Vec3 K) (i j : Fin 3)
    (houter : outer v u = outer v' u')
    (hpivot : v i * u j ≠ 0) :
    ∃ t : K, t ≠ 0 ∧ u' = t • u ∧ v' = t⁻¹ • v
proof:
:= by
  have hvi : v i ≠ 0 := fun h => hpivot (by simp [h])
  have huj : u j ≠ 0 := fun h => hpivot (by simp [h])
  have hp := congrFun (congrFun houter i) j
  simp only [outer] at hp
  have hv'i : v' i ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hpivot
    rw [hp, h, zero_mul]
  have hu'j : u' j ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hpivot
    rw [hp, h, mul_zero]
  let t : K := u' j / u j
  have ht : t ≠ 0 := div_ne_zero hu'j huj
  refine ⟨t, ht, ?_, ?_⟩
  · funext k
    have hik := congrFun (congrFun houter i) k
    simp only [outer] at hik
    have hcross : u' k * u j = u' j * u k := by
      apply mul_left_cancel₀ hv'i
      calc
        v' i * (u' k * u j) = (v' i * u' k) * u j := by ring
        _ = (v i * u k) * u j := by rw [← hik]
        _ = (v i * u j) * u k := by ring
        _ = (v' i * u' j) * u k := by rw [hp]
        _ = v' i * (u' j * u k) := by ring
    change u' k = t * u k
    dsimp [t]
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div]
    exact (eq_div_iff huj).2 hcross
  · funext k
    have hkj := congrFun (congrFun houter k) j
    simp only [outer] at hkj
    change v' k = t⁻¹ * v k
    rw [inv_div]
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div]
    apply (eq_div_iff hu'j).2
    calc
      v' k * u' j = v k * u j := hkj.symm
      _ = u j * v k := by ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ScalarFibre.outer_eq_scaling
statement:
theorem outer_eq_scaling
    (u v u' v' : Vec3 K)
    (houter : outer v u = outer v' u')
    (hne : outer v u ≠ 0) :
    ∃ t : K, t ≠ 0 ∧ u' = t • u ∧ v' = t⁻¹ • v
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hpivot : ∃ i j, v i * u j ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h
    push_neg at h
    apply hne
    ext i j
    simpa [outer] using h i j
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij⟩ := hpivot
  exact outer_eq_scaling_at_pivot u v u' v' i j houter hij

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ScalarFibre.same_a_scalar_fibre
statement:
theorem same_a_scalar_fibre
    (a : Mat3 K) (u v u' v' : Vec3 K)
    (hblock : a * a - a = -(hat u * hat v))
    (hblock' : a * a - a = -(hat u' * hat v'))
    (htrace : Matrix.trace a = 1)
    (hnonzero : Matrix.adjugate a ≠ 0) :
    ∃ t : K, t ≠ 0 ∧ u' = t • u ∧ v' = t⁻¹ • v
proof:
:= by
  have hadj := adjugate_of_projector_trace_one a u v hblock htrace
  have hadj' := adjugate_of_projector_trace_one a u' v' hblock' htrace
  apply outer_eq_scaling u v u' v'
  · simpa only [neg_inj] using hadj.symm.trans hadj'
  · intro hout
    apply hnonzero
    rw [hadj, hout, neg_zero]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.common_detour_of_two_witnesses
statement:
theorem common_detour_of_two_witnesses
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V)) (x y zx zy : V)
    (hzx : omega zx x ≠ 0) (hzy : omega y zy ≠ 0) :
    ∃ z ∈ [zx, zy, zx + zy], omega z x ≠ 0 ∧ omega y z ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hyzx : omega y zx ≠ 0
  · exact ⟨zx, by simp, hzx, hyzx⟩
  by_cases hzyx : omega zy x ≠ 0
  · exact ⟨zy, by simp, hzyx, hzy⟩
  refine ⟨zx + zy, by simp, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, not_ne_iff.mp hzyx, add_zero]
    exact hzx
  · simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, not_ne_iff.mp hyzx, zero_add]
    exact hzy

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.fourStepPairWord_fixes
statement:
theorem fourStepPairWord_fixes
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V))
    (halt : ∀ x, omega x x = 0) (x z y v f q : V)
    (hxz : omega z x ≠ 0) (hzy : omega y z ≠ 0)
    (hxq : omega x q = 0) (hzq : omega z q = 0)
    (hyq : omega y q = 0) (hvq : omega v q = 0)
    (hfq : omega f q = 0) :
    wordMap omega (fourStepPairWord omega halt x z y v f hxz hzy) q = q
proof:
:= by
  let vp := firstAlignment omega halt x z y hxz hzy v
  have hzxq : omega (z - x) q = 0 := by
    simp only [map_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply, hzq, hxq, sub_zero]
  have hyzq : omega (y - z) q = 0 := by
    simp only [map_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply, hyq, hzq, sub_zero]
  have hAq : firstAlignment omega halt x z y hxz hzy q = q := by
    rw [firstAlignment_apply]
    simp only [equiv_apply, hzxq, hyzq, mul_zero, zero_smul, add_zero]
  have hvpq : omega vp q = 0 := by
    change omega (firstAlignment omega halt x z y hxz hzy v) q = 0
    rw [← hAq, firstAlignment_preserves, hvq]
  have hwpq : omega (vp + avoidanceScalar (omega f vp) • y) q = 0 := by
    simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply,
      smul_eq_mul, hvpq, hyq, mul_zero, add_zero]
  have hwvpq : omega ((vp + avoidanceScalar (omega f vp) • y) - vp) q = 0 := by
    simp only [map_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply, hwpq, hvpq, sub_zero]
  have hfwq : omega (f - (vp + avoidanceScalar (omega f vp) • y)) q = 0 := by
    simp only [map_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply, hfq, hwpq, sub_zero]
  change equiv omega halt
      (f - (vp + avoidanceScalar (omega f vp) • y))
      (omega f (vp + avoidanceScalar (omega f vp) • y))⁻¹
    (equiv omega halt
      ((vp + avoidanceScalar (omega f vp) • y) - vp)
      (omega (vp + avoidanceScalar (omega f vp) • y) vp)⁻¹
      (firstAlignment omega halt x z y hxz hzy q)) = q
  rw [hAq]
  simp only [equiv_apply, hwvpq, hfwq, mul_zero, zero_smul, add_zero]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.projectPair_orthogonal
statement:
theorem projectPair_orthogonal
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V))
    (halt : ∀ x, omega x x = 0) (e f c : V)
    (hef : omega e f = 1) :
    omega (projectPair omega e f c) e = 0 ∧
      omega (projectPair omega e f c) f = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hee := halt e
  have hff := halt f
  have hce := skew_of_alternating omega halt c e
  have hcf := skew_of_alternating omega halt c f
  have hfe := skew_of_alternating omega halt f e
  constructor <;>
    simp only [projectPair, map_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply, map_smul,
      LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hee, hff, hef, hfe, hce, hcf] <;>
    ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawTransportEndpoint.frame_transport_of_encoder
statement:
theorem frame_transport_of_encoder
    (P Q : Fin 3 → JCoord K) (hP : SourceFrameLaws.Laws P)
    (hQ : SourceFrameLaws.Laws Q) (g : SourceAut (K := K))
    (h : g.linear (P 2 - P 0) = Q 2 - Q 0) :
    ∀ i, g.linear (P i) = Q i
proof:
:= by
  have hp (x : JCoord K) (i : Fin 3) :
      g.linear (GenericTauLedger.sourceProjector x i) =
        GenericTauLedger.sourceProjector (g.linear x) i := by
    fin_cases i
    · change g.linear ((2 : K)⁻¹ • (sourceProduct x x - x)) =
        (2 : K)⁻¹ • (sourceProduct (g.linear x) (g.linear x) - g.linear x)
      rw [map_smul, map_sub, g.map_product]
    · change g.linear (sourceOne - sourceProduct x x) =
        sourceOne - sourceProduct (g.linear x) (g.linear x)
      rw [map_sub, g.map_one, g.map_product]
    · change g.linear ((2 : K)⁻¹ • (sourceProduct x x + x)) =
        (2 : K)⁻¹ • (sourceProduct (g.linear x) (g.linear x) + g.linear x)
      rw [map_smul, map_add, g.map_product]
  intro i
  rw [← SourceFrameEncoderLaws.encoder_projectors P hP i, hp, h,
    SourceFrameEncoderLaws.encoder_projectors Q hQ i]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawTransportEndpoint.eval_action_universal
statement:
private theorem eval_action_universal (phi : FF k →+* K)
    (g : SourceAut (K := K)) (r i : Fin 3) (c : Fin 27) :
    polynomialEvaluation k K phi
        (rawAction K g (universalVector (k := K) r i c)) =
      baseLinear g (genericPointAlong k K phi r i) c
proof:
:= by
  have hn := linearEquiv_natural (pointEvalAlg k K phi) g
    (universalVector (k := K) r i)
  have hu : (pointEvalAlg k K phi) ∘ universalVector (k := K) r i =
      genericPointAlong k K phi r i := by
    funext d
    simp [pointEvalAlg, polynomialEvaluation, evaluationAlong, universalVector]
  rw [hu] at hn
  have hb : linearEquiv (R := K) g (genericPointAlong k K phi r i) =
      baseLinear g (genericPointAlong k K phi r i) := by
    change linear (R := K) g (genericPointAlong k K phi r i) =
      baseLinear g (genericPointAlong k K phi r i)
    simpa [mapCoord] using
      (linearEquiv_on_constants (R := K) g (genericPointAlong k K phi r i))
  have he := (congrFun hn c).trans (congrFun hb c)
  change polynomialEvaluation k K phi
    (transformedUniversalVector K g r i c) = _ at he
  rw [← congrFun (rawAction_universalVector K g r i) c] at he
  exact he

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawTransportEndpoint.transported_evaluation_square
statement:
theorem transported_evaluation_square
    (phi psi : FF k →+* K) (g : SourceAut (K := K))
    (hscalar : originalCoefficientEmbedding k K phi =
      originalCoefficientEmbedding k K psi)
    (hpoint : ∀ r i, baseLinear g (genericPointAlong k K phi r i) =
      genericPointAlong k K psi r i) :
    ((evaluation k K phi).comp (reducedAction K g).toRingHom).comp
        (reducedCoefficientMap k K phi) = psi.comp (reducedInclusion k)
proof:
:= by
  apply Ideal.Quotient.ringHom_ext
  apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
  · intro t
    change polynomialEvaluation k K phi
        (rawAction K g (polynomialCoefficientMap k K
          (originalCoefficientEmbedding k K phi) (MvPolynomial.C t))) =
      psi (rawToFunction k (MvPolynomial.C t))
    rw [polynomialCoefficientMap_C]
    have hs := DFunLike.congr_fun hscalar t
    simpa [polynomialEvaluation, evaluationAlong, rawAction,
      originalCoefficientEmbedding] using hs
  · intro q
    cases q with
    | entry r i c =>
      change polynomialEvaluation k K phi
          (rawAction K g (polynomialCoefficientMap k K
            (originalCoefficientEmbedding k K phi)
            (universalVector (k := k) r i c))) =
        genericPointAlong k K psi r i c
      rw [polynomialCoefficientMap_universalVector, eval_action_universal]
      exact congrFun (hpoint r i) c

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawTransportEndpoint.final_cleared_agreement
statement:
theorem final_cleared_agreement
    (phi psi : FF k →+* K) (g : SourceAut (K := K))
    (hscalar : originalCoefficientEmbedding k K phi =
      originalCoefficientEmbedding k K psi)
    (hpoint : ∀ r i, baseLinear g (genericPointAlong k K phi r i) =
      genericPointAlong k K psi r i)
    (a b : RR k) (hb : reducedInclusion k b ≠ 0)
    (hclear : reducedAction K g (reducedCoefficientMap k K phi a) *
        reducedCoefficientMap k K phi b =
      reducedCoefficientMap k K phi a *
        reducedAction K g (reducedCoefficientMap k K phi b)) :
    phi (reducedInclusion k a / reducedInclusion k b) =
      psi (reducedInclusion k a / reducedInclusion k b)
proof:
:= by
  exact agreement_of_generic_cleared_transport
    (reducedInclusion k) (reducedCoefficientMap k K phi) (evaluation k K phi)
    phi psi (reducedAction K g) (reduced_evaluation_square k K phi)
    (transported_evaluation_square k K phi psi g hscalar hpoint) a b hb hclear
