name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowTrace.charpoly_eq_cubicNormalForm_of_det_constraints
statement:
theorem charpoly_eq_cubicNormalForm_of_det_constraints
    (X : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) K) (c d : K)
    (hdetX : X.det = c)
    (hdetOneX : (1 + X).det = -d) :
    X.charpoly = cubicNormalForm c d (-Matrix.trace X)
proof:
:= by
  have hDegree : X.charpoly.natDegree <= 3 := by
    rw [Matrix.charpoly_natDegree_eq_dim]
    simp
  have hLead : X.charpoly.coeff 3 = 1 := by
    simpa [Matrix.charpoly_natDegree_eq_dim] using X.charpoly_monic.coeff_natDegree
  have hZero : X.charpoly.eval 0 = -c := by
    simpa [hdetX] using charpoly_eval_zero_three X
  have hNegOne : X.charpoly.eval (-1) = d := by
    simpa [hdetOneX] using charpoly_eval_neg_one_three X
  have hNormal :=
    eq_cubicNormalForm_of_endpoints X.charpoly c d
      hDegree hLead hZero hNegOne
  simpa [charpoly_coeff_two_eq_neg_trace X] using hNormal

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowTrace.matrix_cubic_identity_of_det_constraints
statement:
theorem matrix_cubic_identity_of_det_constraints
    (X : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) K) (c d : K)
    (hdetX : X.det = c)
    (hdetOneX : (1 + X).det = -d) :
    X ^ 3 - Matrix.trace X • X ^ 2 +
        (-d - 1 - c - Matrix.trace X) • X - c • 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hCH := Matrix.aeval_self_charpoly X
  rw [charpoly_eq_cubicNormalForm_of_det_constraints X c d hdetX hdetOneX] at hCH
  simp only [cubicNormalForm, map_sub, map_add, map_mul, map_pow,
    Polynomial.aeval_X, Polynomial.aeval_C, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one,
    Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.one_mul, sub_mul, add_mul] at hCH
  convert hCH using 1 <;> module

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowTrace.trace_satisfies_quadratic_of_matrix_constraints
statement:
theorem trace_satisfies_quadratic_of_matrix_constraints
    (X U V : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) K) (c d : K)
    (hquad : X ^ 2 + X * U + V = 0)
    (hc : c ≠ 0) (hd : d ≠ 0)
    (hdetX : X.det = c)
    (hdetOneX : (1 + X).det = -d)
    (hdetV : V.det = c ^ 2)
    (hdetNegOne : (1 - U + V).det = d ^ 2) :
    Matrix.trace X ^ 2 +
        (quadraticPolynomial U V).coeff 5 * Matrix.trace X +
        ((quadraticPolynomial U V).coeff 4 + 2 * (1 + c + d) -
          (quadraticPolynomial U V).coeff 5) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let Z := -U - X
  have hDegreeX : X.charpoly.natDegree <= 3 := by
    rw [Matrix.charpoly_natDegree_eq_dim]
    simp
  have hDegreeZ : Z.charpoly.natDegree <= 3 := by
    rw [Matrix.charpoly_natDegree_eq_dim]
    simp
  have hLeadX : X.charpoly.coeff 3 = 1 := by
    simpa [Matrix.charpoly_natDegree_eq_dim] using X.charpoly_monic.coeff_natDegree
  have hLeadZ : Z.charpoly.coeff 3 = 1 := by
    simpa [Matrix.charpoly_natDegree_eq_dim] using Z.charpoly_monic.coeff_natDegree
  have hZeroX : X.charpoly.eval 0 = -c := by
    simpa [hdetX] using charpoly_eval_zero_three X
  have hNegOneX : X.charpoly.eval (-1) = d := by
    simpa [hdetOneX] using charpoly_eval_neg_one_three X
  have hEndpointsZ : Z.charpoly.eval 0 = -c ∧ Z.charpoly.eval (-1) = d := by
    simpa [Z] using complementary_charpoly_endpoints X U V c d hquad hc hd
      hdetX hdetOneX hdetV hdetNegOne
  have hFactor : quadraticPolynomial U V = X.charpoly * Z.charpoly := by
    simpa [Z] using quadraticPolynomial_eq_charpoly_mul X U V hquad
  have hScalar :=
    coeff_two_satisfies_quadratic_of_cubic_factorization
      X.charpoly Z.charpoly (quadraticPolynomial U V) c d
      hDegreeX hDegreeZ hLeadX hLeadZ hZeroX hEndpointsZ.1
      hNegOneX hEndpointsZ.2 hFactor
  rw [charpoly_coeff_two_eq_neg_trace X] at hScalar
  simpa using hScalar

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowTrace.eq_or_eq_or_eq_of_three_quadratic_roots
statement:
theorem eq_or_eq_or_eq_of_three_quadratic_roots
    (a b x y z : K)
    (hx : x ^ 2 + a * x + b = 0)
    (hy : y ^ 2 + a * y + b = 0)
    (hz : z ^ 2 + a * z + b = 0) :
    x = y ∨ x = z ∨ y = z
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hxy : x = y
  · exact Or.inl hxy
  by_cases hxz : x = z
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inl hxz)
  right
  right
  have hxyFactor : (x - y) * (x + y + a) = 0 := by
    linear_combination hx - hy
  have hxzFactor : (x - z) * (x + z + a) = 0 := by
    linear_combination hx - hz
  have hxySum : x + y + a = 0 :=
    (mul_eq_zero.mp hxyFactor).resolve_left (sub_ne_zero.mpr hxy)
  have hxzSum : x + z + a = 0 :=
    (mul_eq_zero.mp hxzFactor).resolve_left (sub_ne_zero.mpr hxz)
  linear_combination hxySum - hxzSum

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowTrace.matrix_eq_trace_reconstruction_of_constraints
statement:
theorem matrix_eq_trace_reconstruction_of_constraints
    (X U V : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) K) (c d : K)
    (hquad : X ^ 2 + X * U + V = 0)
    (hdetX : X.det = c)
    (hdetOneX : (1 + X).det = -d)
    [Invertible (U ^ 2 - V + Matrix.trace X • U +
      (-d - 1 - c - Matrix.trace X) • 1)] :
    X = (c • 1 - V * U - Matrix.trace X • V) *
      ⅟(U ^ 2 - V + Matrix.trace X • U +
        (-d - 1 - c - Matrix.trace X) • 1)
proof:
:= by
  exact matrix_reconstruction_of_right_quadratic
    X U V (Matrix.trace X) (-d - 1 - c - Matrix.trace X) c hquad
    (matrix_cubic_identity_of_det_constraints X c d hdetX hdetOneX)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowTrace.matrix_eq_trace_reconstruction_of_det_ne_zero
statement:
theorem matrix_eq_trace_reconstruction_of_det_ne_zero
    (X U V : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) K) (c d : K)
    (hquad : X ^ 2 + X * U + V = 0)
    (hdetX : X.det = c)
    (hdetOneX : (1 + X).det = -d)
    (hE : (U ^ 2 - V + Matrix.trace X • U +
      (-d - 1 - c - Matrix.trace X) • 1).det ≠ 0) :
    X = (c • 1 - V * U - Matrix.trace X • V) *
      (U ^ 2 - V + Matrix.trace X • U +
        (-d - 1 - c - Matrix.trace X) • 1)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  let E := U ^ 2 - V + Matrix.trace X • U +
    (-d - 1 - c - Matrix.trace X) • (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) K)
  let _ : Invertible E :=
    Matrix.invertibleOfIsUnitDet E (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (by simpa [E] using hE))
  have hReconstruct :=
    matrix_eq_trace_reconstruction_of_constraints X U V c d
      hquad hdetX hdetOneX
  simpa [E, Matrix.invOf_eq_nonsing_inv] using hReconstruct

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealOrthogonalExtensionAgreement.exists_raw_fraction
statement:
theorem exists_raw_fraction (f : FunctionField k) :
    ∃ a b : CoordinateRing k, rawToField k b ≠ 0 ∧
      f = rawToField k a / rawToField k b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, y, hy, hxy⟩ :=
    IsFractionRing.div_surjective (ReducedCoordinateRing k) f
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective x
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective y
  refine ⟨a, b, ?_, hxy.symm⟩
  change algebraMap (ReducedCoordinateRing k) (FunctionField k)
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk (rawFrameIdeal (R := k)).radical b) ≠ 0
  exact IsFractionRing.to_map_ne_zero_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors hy

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealOrthogonalExtensionAgreement.orthogonal_extension_agreement
statement:
theorem orthogonal_extension_agreement
    (f : FunctionField k) (hinv : IsConstantInvariant k f)
    {E : Type u} [Field E] [CharZero E]
    (left right : FunctionField k →+* E)
    (hbase : left.comp (scalarMap k) = right.comp (scalarMap k))
    (Q : Mat3 E) (hQ : IsOrthogonal Q)
    (htransport : ∀ r i, ringConjugate Q
      (left.mapMatrix (universalFamily k r i)) =
      right.mapMatrix (universalFamily k r i)) : left f = right f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, x, y, z, hD, hden, _hC, hconj⟩ :=
    exists_cayley_constant_sign_conjugation (left.comp (scalarMap k)) Q hQ
  let D : Mat3 k := signMatrix s
  let α := constantAction k D hD.transpose_mul hD.mul_transpose
  let leftD : FunctionField k →+* E := left.comp α.toRingHom
  have hleftDbase : leftD.comp (scalarMap k) = right.comp (scalarMap k) := by
    ext c
    change left (constantAction k D hD.transpose_mul hD.mul_transpose
      (scalarMap k c)) = right (scalarMap k c)
    rw [constantAction_scalar]
    exact congrArg (fun g : k →+* E => g c) hbase
  have hleftDfamily (r i : Fin 3) :
      leftD.mapMatrix (universalFamily k r i) =
        ringConjugate ((left.comp (scalarMap k)).mapMatrix D)
          (left.mapMatrix (universalFamily k r i)) := by
    calc
      _ = left.mapMatrix (α.toRingHom.mapMatrix (universalFamily k r i)) := rfl
      _ = left.mapMatrix
          (orthogonalConjugate ((scalarMap k).mapMatrix D)
            (universalFamily k r i)) := by
        exact congrArg left.mapMatrix
          (constantAction_universalFamily k D hD.transpose_mul hD.mul_transpose r i)
      _ = _ := by
        simp only [orthogonalConjugate, ringConjugate, map_mul]
        rfl
  have hleftDf : leftD f = left f := by
    exact congrArg left (hinv D hD.transpose_mul hD.mul_transpose)
  have htransportD : ∀ r i,
      ringConjugate (cayley (skew x y z))
        (leftD.mapMatrix (universalFamily k r i)) =
        right.mapMatrix (universalFamily k r i) := by
    intro r i
    rw [hleftDfamily]
    exact (hconj (left.mapMatrix (universalFamily k r i))).symm.trans (htransport r i)
  obtain ⟨a, b, hb, hf⟩ := exists_raw_fraction k f
  have hinvRatio : IsConstantInvariant k (rawToField k a / rawToField k b) := by
    rw [← hf]
    exact hinv
  have hratio := cayley_extension_agreement k leftD right hleftDbase
    a b hb hinvRatio ![x, y, z] hden htransportD
  have hfEq : leftD f = right f := by
    simpa only [← hf] using hratio
  exact hleftDf.symm.trans hfEq

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealOrthogonalExtensionAgreement.extensionOrthogonalTransportPreserves_of_isConstantInvariant
statement:
theorem extensionOrthogonalTransportPreserves_of_isConstantInvariant
    (f : FunctionField k) (hinv : IsConstantInvariant k f) :
    ExtensionOrthogonalTransportPreserves k f
proof:
:= by
  intro L instL
  letI : Field L := instL
  intro left right hbase E instE
  letI : Field E := instE
  intro j Q hQ htransport
  let base : k →+* E := (j.comp left).comp (scalarMap k)
  letI : CharZero E := FiniteQuadraticRoots.charZero_of_embedding base
  have hbaseE : (j.comp left).comp (scalarMap k) =
      (j.comp right).comp (scalarMap k) := by
    ext c
    exact congrArg j (congrArg (fun g : k →+* L => g c) hbase)
  exact orthogonal_extension_agreement k f hinv
    (j.comp left) (j.comp right) hbaseE Q hQ (by
      simpa only [ringConjugate, orthogonalConjugate] using htransport)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceRawActionComposition.rawAction_thenAut
statement:
theorem rawAction_thenAut (g h : SourceAut (K := k)) :
    rawAction k (thenAut g h) = (rawAction k g).comp (rawAction k h)
proof:
:= by
  apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
  · intro a
    simp [rawAction]
  · intro q
    cases q with
    | entry r i c =>
      change rawAction k (thenAut g h) (universalVector r i c) =
        rawAction k g (rawAction k h (universalVector r i c))
      rw [show rawAction k (thenAut g h) (universalVector r i c) =
          transformedUniversalVector k (thenAut g h) r i c from
        congrFun (rawAction_universalVector k (thenAut g h) r i) c]
      rw [show rawAction k h (universalVector r i c) =
          transformedUniversalVector k h r i c from
        congrFun (rawAction_universalVector k h r i) c]
      rw [transformedUniversalVector, transformedUniversalVector,
        linearEquiv_thenAut]
      have hm := mapVector_linearEquiv k g h (universalVector r i)
      rw [rawAction_universalVector, transformedUniversalVector] at hm
      exact (congrFun hm c).symm

proof:

  exact congrArg (Ideal.Quotient.mk (rawFrameIdeal (k := k)).radical)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FrameEncoder.encoder_identities
statement:
theorem encoder_identities
    (e0 e1 e2 : A)
    (hcomm : ∀ a b : A, a * b = b * a)
    (htwo : ∀ a : A, a + a = 0 → a = 0)
    (h0 : e0 * e0 = e0) (h1 : e1 * e1 = e1) (h2 : e2 * e2 = e2)
    (hsum : e0 + e1 + e2 = 1) :
    let x
proof:
:= e2 - e0
    x * x = e0 + e2 ∧
    x * (x * x) = x ∧
    x * x - x = e0 + e0 ∧
    1 - x * x = e1 ∧
    x * x + x = e2 + e2 := by
  dsimp only
  rcases pairwise_mul_eq_zero_of_sum_eq_one e0 e1 e2 hcomm htwo
      h0 h1 h2 hsum with ⟨h01, h02, h12⟩
  have h20 : e2 * e0 = 0 := by rw [hcomm, h02]
  have hxeq : (e2 - e0) * (e2 - e0) = e0 + e2 := by
    simp only [sub_mul, mul_sub, h0, h2, h02, h20, sub_zero, zero_sub]
    abel
  constructor
  · exact hxeq
  constructor
  · rw [hxeq]
    simp only [sub_mul, mul_add, h20, h2, h0, h02]
    abel
  constructor
  · rw [hxeq]
    abel
  constructor
  · rw [hxeq]
    calc
      1 - (e0 + e2) = (e0 + e1 + e2) - (e0 + e2) := by rw [hsum]
      _ = e1 := by abel
  · rw [hxeq]
    abel

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FrameEncoder.literal_projectors
statement:
theorem literal_projectors
    (e0 e1 e2 x : A) (htwoK : (2 : K) ≠ 0)
    (hminus : x * x - x = e0 + e0)
    (hmiddle : 1 - x * x = e1)
    (hplus : x * x + x = e2 + e2) :
    (2 : K)⁻¹ • (x * x - x) = e0 ∧
    1 - x * x = e1 ∧
    (2 : K)⁻¹ • (x * x + x) = e2
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [hminus, ← two_smul K e0, smul_smul]
    simp [htwoK]
  constructor
  · exact hmiddle
  · rw [hplus, ← two_smul K e2, smul_smul]
    simp [htwoK]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FrameEncoder.trace_encoder

    (htr0 : trace e0 = 1)
    (htr2 : trace e2 = 1) :
    trace x = 0 ∧ trace (x * x) = 2
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [hx, map_sub, htr2, htr0, sub_self]
  · rw [hsquare, map_add, htr0, htr2]
    norm_num

theorem classification (P Q : SecondStatement.MatrixPair)
    (hP : SecondStatement.Admissible P) (hQ : SecondStatement.Admissible Q) :
    SecondStatement.Equivalent (SecondStatement.triple P) (SecondStatement.triple Q) ↔
      SecondStatement.ledger (SecondStatement.triple P) =
        SecondStatement.ledger (SecondStatement.triple Q) ∧
      SecondStatement.detector (SecondStatement.triple P) =
        SecondStatement.detector (SecondStatement.triple Q)
proof:
:= by
  rw [triple_eq_mapTriple P, triple_eq_mapTriple Q, equivalent_mapTriple_iff,
    ledger_mapTriple, ledger_mapTriple, detector_mapTriple, detector_mapTriple,
    fullRelated_iff_ledger_detector _ _ ((admissible_iff P).mp hP)
      ((admissible_iff Q).mp hQ)]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hL, hD⟩
    exact ⟨congrArg ledgerCopy hL, hD⟩
  · rintro ⟨hL, hD⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TauReconstruction.every_fibre_two_classes
statement:
theorem every_fibre_two_classes (P : SecondStatement.MatrixPair)
    (hP : SecondStatement.Admissible P) : SecondStatement.TwoClassesAbove P
proof:
:= by
  let t := Matrix.det P.X
  have hp := (admissible_iff P).mp hP
  have ht : Admissible t := hp.2
  have hr := reciprocalParameter_ne_zero t ht.1
  have hsep := (parameterDelta_ne_zero_iff t ht.1).mp ht.2
  have hL : ledger (parameterTriple t ht.1) = ledger (coordinateTriple (sourcePair P)) :=
    (coordinateTriple_normalForm _ hp.1).ledger_eq
  change SecondStatement.Admissible (SecondStatement.normalizedPair t) ∧
    SecondStatement.Admissible (SecondStatement.normalizedPair (SecondStatement.m / t)) ∧
    SecondStatement.ledger (SecondStatement.triple (SecondStatement.normalizedPair t)) =
      SecondStatement.ledger (SecondStatement.triple P) ∧
    SecondStatement.ledger (SecondStatement.triple
      (SecondStatement.normalizedPair (SecondStatement.m / t))) =
      SecondStatement.ledger (SecondStatement.triple P) ∧
    SecondStatement.detector (SecondStatement.triple (SecondStatement.normalizedPair t)) ≠
      SecondStatement.detector (SecondStatement.triple
        (SecondStatement.normalizedPair (SecondStatement.m / t))) ∧
    ¬ SecondStatement.Equivalent (SecondStatement.triple (SecondStatement.normalizedPair t))
      (SecondStatement.triple (SecondStatement.normalizedPair (SecondStatement.m / t))) ∧
    ∀ Q, SecondStatement.Admissible Q →
      SecondStatement.ledger (SecondStatement.triple Q) =
        SecondStatement.ledger (SecondStatement.triple P) →
      SecondStatement.Equivalent (SecondStatement.triple (SecondStatement.normalizedPair t))
        (SecondStatement.triple Q) ∨
      SecondStatement.Equivalent (SecondStatement.triple
        (SecondStatement.normalizedPair (SecondStatement.m / t))) (SecondStatement.triple Q)
  simp only [statementMScalar_eq_witnessScale]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [admissible_iff, sourcePair_normalizedPair t ht.1]
    exact parameter_admissiblePair t ht
  · rw [admissible_iff, sourcePair_normalizedPair _ hr]
    exact parameter_admissiblePair _ (admissible_reciprocal t ht)
  · rw [normalizedTriple_eq_mapTriple t ht.1, triple_eq_mapTriple,
      ledger_mapTriple, ledger_mapTriple, hL]
  · rw [normalizedTriple_eq_mapTriple _ hr, triple_eq_mapTriple,
      ledger_mapTriple, ledger_mapTriple, parameter_ledger_reciprocal t ht.1, hL]
  · rw [normalizedTriple_eq_mapTriple t ht.1, normalizedTriple_eq_mapTriple _ hr,
      detector_mapTriple, detector_mapTriple]
    exact hsep
  · rw [normalizedTriple_eq_mapTriple t ht.1, normalizedTriple_eq_mapTriple _ hr,
      equivalent_mapTriple_iff]
    exact not_fullRelated_of_traceCubeDetector_ne hsep
  · intro Q hQ hQL
    have hq := (admissible_iff Q).mp hQ
    have hLQ : ledger (coordinateTriple (sourcePair Q)) =
        ledger (coordinateTriple (sourcePair P)) := by
      apply ledgerCopy_injective
      simpa only [triple_eq_mapTriple, ledger_mapTriple] using hQL
    have hF : PublicFibre t ht.1 (sourcePair Q) := ⟨hq.1, hLQ.trans hL.symm⟩
    rw [normalizedTriple_eq_mapTriple t ht.1, normalizedTriple_eq_mapTriple _ hr,
      triple_eq_mapTriple, equivalent_mapTriple_iff, equivalent_mapTriple_iff]
    exact publicFibre_cover t ht.1 _ hF

statement:

    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V)) (d : V) (t : K)
    (word : List (Step (K := K) (V := V))) (x : V) :

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.wordMap_preserves
statement:
theorem wordMap_preserves
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V))
    (halt : ∀ x, omega x x = 0)
    (word : List (Step (K := K) (V := V))) (x y : V) :
    omega (wordMap omega word x) (wordMap omega word y) = omega x y
proof:
:= by
  induction word with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons step word ih =>
      rcases step with ⟨d, t⟩
      rw [wordMap_cons_apply, wordMap_cons_apply,
        map_preserves omega halt d t, ih]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.wordMap_fixes_of_centers
statement:
theorem wordMap_fixes_of_centers
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V))
    (word : List (Step (K := K) (V := V))) (q : V)
    (hfix : ∀ step ∈ word, omega step.1 q = 0) :
    wordMap omega word q = q
proof:
:= by
  induction word with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons step word ih =>
      rcases step with ⟨d, t⟩
      rw [wordMap_cons_apply, ih]
      · simp only [map_apply, hfix (d, t) (by simp), mul_zero, zero_smul, add_zero]
      · intro step hstep
        exact hfix step (by simp [hstep])

proof:
:= by
  induction left with
  | nil => simp [wordMap]
  | cons step left ih =>
      rcases step with ⟨d, t⟩
      simp only [List.cons_append, wordMap, ih, LinearMap.comp_assoc]

    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.map_zero_parameter
statement:
theorem map_zero_parameter
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V)) (d : V) :
    map omega d 0 = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  simp [map_apply]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.wordMap_zero_parameters
statement:
theorem wordMap_zero_parameters
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V)) (directions : List V) :
    wordMap omega (directions.map fun d => (d, (0 : K))) = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  induction directions with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons d directions ih =>
      simp only [List.map_cons, wordMap, map_zero_parameter omega d, ih,
        LinearMap.id_comp]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.BlockEigenbasis.determinant_eq_det
statement: theorem determinant_eq_det (X : Mat2 K) : determinant X = X.det
proof:
:= by
  simp [determinant, Matrix.det_fin_two]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.BlockEigenbasis.determinant_affine
statement:
theorem determinant_affine (s t : K) (X : Mat2 K) :
    determinant (affine s t X) = s ^ 2 + s * t * trace2 X + t ^ 2 * determinant X
proof:
:= by
  simp [determinant, affine, trace2, Matrix.one_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.BlockEigenbasis.trace_eq_of_two_determinants
statement:
theorem trace_eq_of_two_determinants (s t : K) (hs : s ≠ 0) (ht : t ≠ 0)
    (X Y : Mat2 K) (hdet : determinant X = determinant Y)
    (haffine : determinant (affine s t X) = determinant (affine s t Y)) :
    trace2 X = trace2 Y
proof:
:= by
  rw [determinant_affine, determinant_affine, hdet] at haffine
  have hmul : (s * t) * (trace2 X - trace2 Y) = 0 := by
    linear_combination haffine
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp ((mul_eq_zero.mp hmul).resolve_left (mul_ne_zero hs ht))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.BlockEigenbasis.characteristic_roots
statement:
theorem characteristic_roots (X : Mat2 K) (sigma : K)
    (hroot : sigma ^ 2 = trace2 X ^ 2 - 4 * determinant X) :
    (lambdaPlus X sigma) ^ 2 - trace2 X * lambdaPlus X sigma + determinant X = 0 ∧
    (lambdaMinus X sigma) ^ 2 - trace2 X * lambdaMinus X sigma + determinant X = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> dsimp [lambdaPlus, lambdaMinus] <;>
    linear_combination hroot / 4

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.BlockEigenbasis.eigenbasis_det
statement:
theorem eigenbasis_det (X : Mat2 K) (sigma : K)
    (hb : X 0 1 ≠ 0) (hs : sigma ≠ 0) :
    determinant (eigenbasis X sigma) = 1
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [determinant, eigenbasis, matrix, lambdaPlus, lambdaMinus]
  field_simp [hb, hs]
  <;> ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.BlockEigenbasis.eigenbasis_intertwines
statement:
theorem eigenbasis_intertwines (X : Mat2 K) (sigma : K)
    (hb : X 0 1 ≠ 0) (hs : sigma ≠ 0)
    (hroot : sigma ^ 2 = trace2 X ^ 2 - 4 * determinant X) :
    X * eigenbasis X sigma = eigenbasis X sigma * eigenvalues X sigma
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hp, hm⟩ := characteristic_roots X sigma hroot
  have hdelta : -(X 0 1 * sigma) ≠ 0 := neg_ne_zero.mpr (mul_ne_zero hb hs)
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
  all_goals simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
  all_goals simp only [eigenbasis, eigenvalues, matrix, Matrix.of_apply,
    Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_zero',
    Matrix.cons_val_succ', mul_zero, zero_mul, add_zero, zero_add]
  · change X 0 0 * (X 0 1 / -(X 0 1 * sigma)) +
        X 0 1 * ((lambdaPlus X sigma - X 0 0) / -(X 0 1 * sigma)) =
      (X 0 1 / -(X 0 1 * sigma)) * lambdaPlus X sigma
    field_simp [hdelta]
    ring
  · change X 0 0 * X 0 1 + X 0 1 * (lambdaMinus X sigma - X 0 0) =
      X 0 1 * lambdaMinus X sigma
    ring
  · change X 1 0 * (X 0 1 / -(X 0 1 * sigma)) +
        X 1 1 * ((lambdaPlus X sigma - X 0 0) / -(X 0 1 * sigma)) =
      ((lambdaPlus X sigma - X 0 0) / -(X 0 1 * sigma)) *
        lambdaPlus X sigma
    field_simp [hdelta]
    dsimp [trace2, determinant] at hp
    linear_combination hp
  · change X 1 0 * X 0 1 + X 1 1 * (lambdaMinus X sigma - X 0 0) =
      (lambdaMinus X sigma - X 0 0) * lambdaMinus X sigma
    dsimp [trace2, determinant] at hm
    linear_combination -hm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawSourceDictionary.sourceFrameFamily_iff_f0Raw
statement:
theorem sourceFrameFamily_iff_f0Raw
    (E : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → JCoord K) :
    (∀ r, Laws (E r)) ↔ IsRawFrameFamily (toF0Family E)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hE
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro r i
      dsimp only [toF0Family]
      rw [← GenericStructuredProductAgreesWithF0]
      exact congrArg (structuredEquivK K) ((hE r).idempotent i)
    · intro r i
      dsimp only [toF0Family]
      rw [← sourceTrace_agrees_with_f0K]
      exact (hE r).trace_one i
    · intro r
      change ∑ i : Fin 3, structuredEquivK K (E r i) = f0OneK
      rw [← structuredEquivK_sourceOne]
      simpa [Fin.sum_univ_succ, map_add, add_assoc] using
        congrArg (structuredEquivK K) ((hE r).sum_one)
  · intro hE r
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro i
      apply (structuredEquivK K).injective
      rw [GenericStructuredProductAgreesWithF0]
      exact hE.idempotent r i
    · intro i
      rw [sourceTrace_agrees_with_f0K]
      exact hE.trace_one r i
    · apply (structuredEquivK K).injective
      rw [map_add, map_add, structuredEquivK_sourceOne]
      simpa [toF0Family, Fin.sum_univ_succ, add_assoc] using hE.sum_one r

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TitsDetectorIdentities.polarProduct_firstComponent_full
statement:
theorem polarProduct_firstComponent_full
    (A B C D E F : Mat3 R) :
    (polarProduct firstTitsSquare (A, B, C) (D, E, F)).1 =
      ⅟(2 : R) •
        (A * D + D * A - B * F - E * C +
          (trace3 (B * F) + trace3 (E * C)) • (1 : Mat3 R))
proof:
:= by
  have ht (X Y : Mat3 R) : trace3 (X + Y) = trace3 X + trace3 Y := by
    simpa only [trace3_eq_matrixTrace] using Matrix.trace_add X Y
  change ⅟(2 : R) •
      (((A + D) * (A + D) - (B + E) * (C + F) +
          trace3 ((B + E) * (C + F)) • (1 : Mat3 R)) -
        (A * A - B * C + trace3 (B * C) • (1 : Mat3 R)) -
        (D * D - E * F + trace3 (E * F) • (1 : Mat3 R))) = _
  simp only [add_mul, mul_add, ht, add_smul]
  congr 1
  abel

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TitsDetectorIdentities.tauTrace_toTau_mul_toTau
statement:
theorem tauTrace_toTau_mul_toTau
    (A B C D E F : Mat3 R) :
    TauCeti.AlbertAlgebra.trace
        (toTau (R := R) (A, B, C) * toTau (D, E, F)) =
      Matrix.trace (A * D) + Matrix.trace (B * F) + Matrix.trace (C * E)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← toTau_polarProduct, tauTrace_toTau,
    polarProduct_firstComponent_full]
  simp only [Matrix.trace_smul, Matrix.trace_add, Matrix.trace_sub,
    trace3_eq_matrixTrace, Matrix.trace_one, Fintype.card_fin, smul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat]
  have h :
      Matrix.trace (A * D) + Matrix.trace (D * A) -
          Matrix.trace (B * F) - Matrix.trace (E * C) +
          (Matrix.trace (B * F) + Matrix.trace (E * C)) * (3 : R) =
        (2 : R) *
          (Matrix.trace (A * D) + Matrix.trace (B * F) +
            Matrix.trace (C * E)) := by
    rw [Matrix.trace_mul_comm D A, Matrix.trace_mul_comm E C]
    ring
  rw [h, ← mul_assoc, invOf_mul_self, one_mul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TitsDetectorIdentities.firstTitsSquare_zero
statement:
theorem firstTitsSquare_zero (B C : Mat3 R) :
    firstTitsSquare (0, B, C) =
      (-B * C + trace3 (B * C) • (1 : Mat3 R),
        adjugate3 C, adjugate3 B)
proof:
:= by
  simp [firstTitsSquare, trace3_eq_matrixTrace]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TitsDetectorIdentities.tauTrace_cube_zero
statement:
theorem tauTrace_cube_zero (B C : Mat3 R) :
    let w
proof:
:= toTau (R := R) (0, B, C)
    TauCeti.AlbertAlgebra.trace (w * (w * w)) =
      (3 : R) * (Matrix.det B + Matrix.det C) := by
  dsimp only
  rw [← toTau_firstTitsSquare]
  rw [firstTitsSquare_zero, tauTrace_toTau_mul_toTau]
  simp only [Matrix.zero_mul, Matrix.trace_zero, zero_add,
    adjugate3_eq_matrixAdjugate, Matrix.mul_adjugate,
    Matrix.trace_smul, Matrix.trace_one, Fintype.card_fin, smul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TitsDetectorIdentities.jordan_commutator
statement:
private theorem jordan_commutator (E F A : Mat3 R) :
    matrixJordan E (matrixJordan F A) -
        matrixJordan F (matrixJordan E A) =
      (⅟(2 : R) * ⅟(2 : R)) •
        ((E * F - F * E) * A - A * (E * F - F * E))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [matrixJordan, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul]
  simp only [← smul_add, ← smul_sub, smul_smul]
  apply congrArg (fun M : Mat3 R => (⅟(2 : R) * ⅟(2 : R)) • M)
  simp only [mul_add, add_mul, mul_sub, sub_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  abel

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TitsDetectorIdentities.second_commutator
statement:
private theorem second_commutator (E F B : Mat3 R) :
    ⅟(2 : R) •
          (trace3 E • (⅟(2 : R) • (trace3 F • B - F * B)) -
            E * (⅟(2 : R) • (trace3 F • B - F * B))) -
        ⅟(2 : R) •
          (trace3 F • (⅟(2 : R) • (trace3 E • B - E * B)) -
            F * (⅟(2 : R) • (trace3 E • B - E * B))) =
      (⅟(2 : R) * ⅟(2 : R)) • ((E * F - F * E) * B)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Matrix.mul_smul, smul_sub, smul_smul, mul_sub, sub_mul,
    mul_assoc]
  module

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TitsDetectorIdentities.third_commutator
statement:
private theorem third_commutator (E F C : Mat3 R) :
    ⅟(2 : R) •
          (trace3 E • (⅟(2 : R) • (trace3 F • C - C * F)) -
            (⅟(2 : R) • (trace3 F • C - C * F)) * E) -
        ⅟(2 : R) •
          (trace3 F • (⅟(2 : R) • (trace3 E • C - C * E)) -
            (⅟(2 : R) • (trace3 E • C - C * E)) * F) =
      -(⅟(2 : R) * ⅟(2 : R)) • (C * (E * F - F * E))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Matrix.smul_mul, smul_sub, smul_smul, mul_sub, sub_mul,
    mul_assoc, neg_smul]
  module

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TitsDetectorIdentities.leftAction_commutator
statement:
theorem leftAction_commutator (E F : Mat3 R) (z : FirstTits R) :
    leftAction E (leftAction F z) - leftAction F (leftAction E z) =
      ((⅟(2 : R) * ⅟(2 : R)) •
          ((E * F - F * E) * z.1 - z.1 * (E * F - F * E)),
       (⅟(2 : R) * ⅟(2 : R)) • ((E * F - F * E) * z.2.1),
       -(⅟(2 : R) * ⅟(2 : R)) • (z.2.2 * (E * F - F * E)))
proof:
:= by
  rcases z with ⟨A, B, C⟩
  simp only [leftAction, polarProduct_firstLeft]
  apply Prod.ext
  · exact jordan_commutator E F A
  · apply Prod.ext
    · exact second_commutator E F B
    · exact third_commutator E F C

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceLocalizedSlotData.localDenominator_eq
statement:
theorem localDenominator_eq (frame : Fin 3) (stage : Fin 4) (pivot : Fin 3) :
    chartDenominator (localU k frame stage pivot) (localV k frame stage pivot) =
      algebraMap (Base k) (ParameterRing k)
        (slotDenominator k frame stage pivot)
proof:
:= by
  simp [chartDenominator, localU, localV, localParameter, slotDenominator,
    uPoly, vPoly, nS, nC, evalU, map_add, map_mul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceLocalizedSlotData.localScale_mul_denominator
statement:
theorem localScale_mul_denominator
    (frame : Fin 3) (stage : Fin 4) (pivot : Fin 3) :
    localScale k frame stage pivot *
      chartDenominator (localU k frame stage pivot) (localV k frame stage pivot) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [localDenominator_eq]
  change (↑(denominatorUnit k frame stage pivot)⁻¹ : ParameterRing k) * _ = 1
  rw [← (localized_slotDenominator_isUnit k frame stage pivot).unit_spec]
  exact Units.inv_mul _

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceLocalizedSlotData.map_localScale
statement:
theorem map_localScale {L : Type v} [Field L] (e : ParameterRing k →+* L)
    (frame : Fin 3) (stage : Fin 4) (pivot : Fin 3) :
    e (localScale k frame stage pivot) =
      (e (chartDenominator (localU k frame stage pivot)
        (localV k frame stage pivot)))⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg e (localScale_mul_denominator k frame stage pivot)
  have hn : e (chartDenominator (localU k frame stage pivot)
      (localV k frame stage pivot)) ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    simp [hz] at h
  apply (mul_right_cancel₀ hn)
  simpa [map_mul, hn] using h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertOrientationPairComparison.copySourceLedger_injective
statement:
private theorem copySourceLedger_injective :
    Function.Injective (copySourceLedger : SourceLedger K → LabelledLedger K)
proof:
:= by
  intro X Y h
  rw [SourceLedger.mk.injEq]
  rw [LabelledLedger.mk.injEq] at h
  simpa [copySourceLedger] using h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertOrientationPairComparison.sourceLedger_reflectChart
statement:
private theorem sourceLedger_reflectChart (a : K) (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (q : ExplicitFrameChart K) :
    sourceLedger (encoderA (reflectChart a q))
        (encoderB (reflectChart a q)) =
      sourceLedger (encoderA q) (encoderB q)
proof:
:= by
  have htriple :
      residualTriple (encoderA (reflectChart a q))
          (encoderB (reflectChart a q)) =
        (sourceAut a ha).linear ∘ residualTriple (encoderA q) (encoderB q) := by
    funext i
    fin_cases i
    · change diagonal (-1) 0 1 = theta a (diagonal (-1) 0 1)
      exact (theta_diagonal a (-1) 0 1).symm
    · change encoderA (reflectChart a q) = theta a (encoderA q)
      exact encoderA_reflectChart a q
    · change encoderB (reflectChart a q) = theta a (encoderB q)
      exact encoderB_reflectChart a q
  have hlabel := sourceLabelledLedger_invariant (sourceAut a ha)
    (residualTriple (encoderA q) (encoderB q))
  rw [← htriple, sourceLabelledLedger_residual,
    sourceLabelledLedger_residual] at hlabel
  exact copySourceLedger_injective hlabel

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertOrientationPairComparison.equationsVanish_reflectChart
statement:
private theorem equationsVanish_reflectChart (a : K) (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (q : ExplicitFrameChart K)
    (hq : EquationsVanish (explicitFrameEquationValues q)) :
    EquationsVanish (explicitFrameEquationValues (reflectChart a q))
proof:
:= by
  have hf := (equationsVanish_iff_source_fixedSpectrum q).1 hq
  apply (equationsVanish_iff_source_fixedSpectrum (reflectChart a q)).2
  rw [encoderA_reflectChart, encoderB_reflectChart]
  have hTA := sourceTrace_invariant (sourceAut a ha) (encoderA q)
  have hSA := sourceSpur_invariant (sourceAut a ha) (encoderA q)
  have hNA := sourceNorm_invariant (sourceAut a ha) (encoderA q)
  have hTB := sourceTrace_invariant (sourceAut a ha) (encoderB q)
  have hSB := sourceSpur_invariant (sourceAut a ha) (encoderB q)
  have hNB := sourceNorm_invariant (sourceAut a ha) (encoderB q)
  change sourceTrace (theta a (encoderA q)) = sourceTrace (encoderA q) at hTA
  change sourceSpur (theta a (encoderA q)) = sourceSpur (encoderA q) at hSA
  change sourceNorm (theta a (encoderA q)) = sourceNorm (encoderA q) at hNA
  change sourceTrace (theta a (encoderB q)) = sourceTrace (encoderB q) at hTB
  change sourceSpur (theta a (encoderB q)) = sourceSpur (encoderB q) at hSB
  change sourceNorm (theta a (encoderB q)) = sourceNorm (encoderB q) at hNB
  simpa only [hTA, hSA, hNA, hTB, hSB, hNB] using hf

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertOrientationPairComparison.gramV11_eq_two_nV
statement:
private theorem gramV11_eq_two_nV (q : ExplicitFrameChart K) :
    gramV11 q = 2 * nV (vectorA q)
proof:
:= by
  simp [gramV11, nV, vectorA, Pf, BW] <;> ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertOrientationPairComparison.gramV12_eq_BV
statement:
private theorem gramV12_eq_BV (q : ExplicitFrameChart K) :
    gramV12 q = BV (vectorA q) (vectorB q)
proof:
:= by
  simp [gramV12, BV, vectorA, vectorB, BW] <;> ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertOrientationPairComparison.gramV22_eq_two_nV
statement:
private theorem gramV22_eq_two_nV (q : ExplicitFrameChart K) :
    gramV22 q = 2 * nV (vectorB q)

:= by
  simp [gramV22, nV, vectorB, Pf, BW] <;> ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertOrientationPairComparison.orientation_sq_eq_of_sourceLedger_eq
statement:
theorem orientation_sq_eq_of_sourceLedger_eq
    (q q' : ExplicitFrameChart K)
    (hq : EquationsVanish (explicitFrameEquationValues q))
    (hq' : EquationsVanish (explicitFrameEquationValues q'))
    (hledger : sourceLedger (encoderA q) (encoderB q) =
      sourceLedger (encoderA q') (encoderB q')) :
    orientation q ^ 2 = orientation q' ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hf := (equationsVanish_iff_source_fixedSpectrum q).1 hq
  have hf' := (equationsVanish_iff_source_fixedSpectrum q').1 hq'
  have hm := recovered_measurements (encoderA q) (encoderB q)
    hf.2.2.1 hf.2.2.2.2.2
  have hm' := recovered_measurements (encoderA q') (encoderB q')
    hf'.2.2.1 hf'.2.2.2.2.2
  rcases hm with ⟨hnVx, hnSx, hnCx, hnVy, hnSy, hnCy, hgV, hgS, hgC,
    ht111, ht211, ht121, ht112, ht122, ht212, ht221, ht222, huV, huS, huC⟩
  rcases hm' with ⟨hnVx', hnSx', hnCx', hnVy', hnSy', hnCy', hgV', hgS', hgC',
    ht111', ht211', ht121', ht112', ht122', ht212', ht221', ht222',
    huV', huS', huC'⟩
  have h11 : gramV11 q = gramV11 q' := by
    calc
      gramV11 q = 2 * nV (vectorA q) := gramV11_eq_two_nV q
      _ = 2 * nVx (sourceLedger (encoderA q) (encoderB q)) := by
        change 2 * nV (encoderA q).v = _
        rw [hnVx]
      _ = 2 * nVx (sourceLedger (encoderA q') (encoderB q')) := by rw [hledger]
      _ = 2 * nV (vectorA q') := by
        change _ = 2 * nV (encoderA q').v
        rw [hnVx']
      _ = gramV11 q' := (gramV11_eq_two_nV q').symm
  have h12 : gramV12 q = gramV12 q' := by
    calc
      gramV12 q = BV (vectorA q) (vectorB q) := gramV12_eq_BV q
      _ = gV (sourceLedger (encoderA q) (encoderB q)) 1 1 := hgV.symm
      _ = gV (sourceLedger (encoderA q') (encoderB q')) 1 1 := by rw [hledger]
      _ = BV (vectorA q') (vectorB q') := hgV'
      _ = gramV12 q' := (gramV12_eq_BV q').symm
  have h22 : gramV22 q = gramV22 q' := by
    calc
      gramV22 q = 2 * nV (vectorB q) := gramV22_eq_two_nV q
      _ = 2 * nVy (sourceLedger (encoderA q) (encoderB q)) := by
        change 2 * nV (encoderB q).v = _
        rw [hnVy]
      _ = 2 * nVy (sourceLedger (encoderA q') (encoderB q')) := by rw [hledger]
      _ = 2 * nV (vectorB q') := by
        change _ = 2 * nV (encoderB q').v
        rw [hnVy']
      _ = gramV22 q' := (gramV22_eq_two_nV q').symm
  rw [orientation_sq q, orientation_sq q', h11, h12, h22]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertOrientationPairComparison.orientation_eq_sigma_of_normalized_gauge
statement:
private theorem orientation_eq_sigma_of_normalized_gauge
    (q : ExplicitFrameChart K) (h sigma : K)
    (hr1 : q.r1 = 1)
    (hz2 : q.z2 = (h + sigma) / 2)
    (hgram : gramV12 q = h) :
    orientation q = sigma
proof:
:= by
  have htwo : (2 : K) ≠ 0 := by norm_num
  have hz2mul : q.z2 * 2 = h + sigma := (eq_div_iff htwo).mp hz2
  rw [← hgram, gramV12, hr1] at hz2mul
  rw [orientation, hr1]
  linear_combination hz2mul

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertOrientationPairComparison.normalized_detector_pair_eq_or_swapped
statement:
theorem normalized_detector_pair_eq_or_swapped
    (q q' : ExplicitFrameChart K)
    (hopen : ResidualOpen (residualPairOfChart q))
    (hopen' : ResidualOpen (residualPairOfChart q'))
    (hledger : sourceLedger (encoderA q) (encoderB q) =
      sourceLedger (encoderA q') (encoderB q'))
    (a h sigma sigma' : K)
    (hq : EquationsVanish (explicitFrameEquationValues q))
    (hq' : EquationsVanish (explicitFrameEquationValues q'))
    (hr1 : q.r1 = 1) (hz1 : q.z1 = a)
    (hr2 : q.r2 = (h - sigma) / (2 * a))
    (hz2 : q.z2 = (h + sigma) / 2)
    (hr1' : q'.r1 = 1) (hz1' : q'.z1 = a)
    (hr2' : q'.r2 = (h - sigma') / (2 * a))
    (hz2' : q'.z2 = (h + sigma') / 2)
    (hsigma : sigma ≠ 0) (ha : 2 * a ≠ 0) :
    (sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1) (encoderA q) (encoderB q) =
        sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1) (encoderA q') (encoderB q') ∧
      sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1)
          (encoderA (companion q hopen)) (encoderB (companion q hopen)) =
        sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1)
          (encoderA (companion q' hopen')) (encoderB (companion q' hopen'))) ∨
    (sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1) (encoderA q) (encoderB q) =
        sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1)
          (encoderA (companion q' hopen')) (encoderB (companion q' hopen')) ∧
      sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1)
          (encoderA (companion q hopen)) (encoderB (companion q hopen)) =
        sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1) (encoderA q') (encoderB q'))
proof:
:= by
  have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := by
    intro haz
    apply ha
    rw [haz, mul_zero]
  have hgram : gramV12 q = h := by
    rw [gramV12, hr1, hz1, hr2, hz2]
    field_simp [ha0]
    ring
  have hgram' : gramV12 q' = h := by
    rw [gramV12, hr1', hz1', hr2', hz2']
    field_simp [ha0]
    ring
  have horient : orientation q = sigma :=
    orientation_eq_sigma_of_normalized_gauge q h sigma hr1 hz2 hgram
  have horient' : orientation q' = sigma' :=
    orientation_eq_sigma_of_normalized_gauge q' h sigma' hr1' hz2' hgram'
  have hsquares : sigma ^ 2 = sigma' ^ 2 := by
    rw [← horient, ← horient']
    exact orientation_sq_eq_of_sourceLedger_eq q q' hq hq' hledger
  have hfactor : (sigma - sigma') * (sigma + sigma') = 0 := by
    calc
      (sigma - sigma') * (sigma + sigma') = sigma ^ 2 - sigma' ^ 2 := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [hsquares, sub_self]
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hfactor with hsame | hopposite
  · have hs : sigma = sigma' := sub_eq_zero.mp hsame
    have hr2eq : q.r2 = q'.r2 := by rw [hr2, hr2', ← hs]
    have hz2eq : q.z2 = q'.z2 := by rw [hz2, hz2', ← hs]
    exact same_gauge_detector_pair_eq_or_swapped q q' hopen hopen' hledger
      a q.r2 q.z2 sigma hq hq' hr1 hz1 rfl rfl hr1' hz1'
      hr2eq.symm hz2eq.symm
      (by rw [hgram]; exact hr2)
      (by rw [hgram]; exact hz2)
      (by rw [hgram']; exact hr2)
      (by rw [hgram']; exact hz2)
      hsigma ha
  · have hs : sigma' = -sigma := by linear_combination hopposite
    have hqR := equationsVanish_reflectChart a ha0 q' hq'
    have hledgerR : sourceLedger (encoderA q) (encoderB q) =
        sourceLedger (encoderA (reflectChart a q'))
          (encoderB (reflectChart a q')) := by
      rw [sourceLedger_reflectChart a ha0 q']
      exact hledger
    have hr1R : (reflectChart a q').r1 = 1 := by
      simp [reflectChart, hz1', ha0]
    have hz1R : (reflectChart a q').z1 = a := by
      simp [reflectChart, hr1']
    have hr2R : (reflectChart a q').r2 = q.r2 := by
      rw [reflectChart, hr2, hz2', hs]
      field_simp [ha0]
      ring
    have hz2R : (reflectChart a q').z2 = q.z2 := by
      rw [reflectChart, hz2, hr2', hs]
      field_simp [ha0]
      ring
    have hgramR : gramV12 (reflectChart a q') = h := by
      calc
        gramV12 (reflectChart a q') = gramV12 q := by
          rw [gramV12, hr1R, hz1R, hr2R, hz2R, gramV12, hr1, hz1]
        _ = h := hgram
    have hsameR := same_gauge_detector_pair_eq_or_swapped q
      (reflectChart a q') hopen
      (residualOpen_reflectChart a ha0 q' hopen') hledgerR
      a q.r2 q.z2 sigma hq hqR hr1 hz1 rfl rfl hr1R hz1R
      hr2R hz2R
      (by rw [hgram]; exact hr2)
      (by rw [hgram]; exact hz2)
      (by rw [hgramR]; exact hr2)
      (by rw [hgramR]; exact hz2)
      hsigma ha
    have hreflect := detector_pair_reflectChart a ha0 q' hopen'
    rcases hsameR with hsameR | hswapR
    · left
      exact ⟨hsameR.1.trans hreflect.1,
        hsameR.2.trans hreflect.2⟩
    · right
      exact ⟨hswapR.1.trans hreflect.2,
        hswapR.2.trans hreflect.1⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertOrientationPairComparison.exists_normalized_orientation_transporter
statement:
theorem exists_normalized_orientation_transporter
    (q q' : ExplicitFrameChart K)
    (hopen : ResidualOpen (residualPairOfChart q))
    (hopen' : ResidualOpen (residualPairOfChart q'))
    (hledger : sourceLedger (encoderA q) (encoderB q) =
      sourceLedger (encoderA q') (encoderB q'))
    (hdetector : sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1)
        (encoderA q) (encoderB q) =
      sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1) (encoderA q') (encoderB q'))
    (a h sigma sigma' : K)
    (hq : EquationsVanish (explicitFrameEquationValues q))
    (hq' : EquationsVanish (explicitFrameEquationValues q'))
    (hr1 : q.r1 = 1) (hz1 : q.z1 = a)
    (hr2 : q.r2 = (h - sigma) / (2 * a))
    (hz2 : q.z2 = (h + sigma) / 2)
    (hr1' : q'.r1 = 1) (hz1' : q'.z1 = a)
    (hr2' : q'.r2 = (h - sigma') / (2 * a))
    (hz2' : q'.z2 = (h + sigma') / 2)
    (hsigma : sigma ≠ 0) (ha : 2 * a ≠ 0)
    (hbeta : UniformMomentActualDetector.actualBeta
      q a q.r2 q.z2 sigma ≠ 0) :
    (∃ G : DetOneMatrix K,
      G.g = (residualPairOfChart q').X * (residualPairOfChart q).X⁻¹ ∧
      G.gInv = (residualPairOfChart q).X * (residualPairOfChart q').X⁻¹ ∧
      (∀ d1 d2 d3 : K, (ResidualAction.sourceAut G).linear
        (diagonal d1 d2 d3) = diagonal d1 d2 d3) ∧
      (ResidualAction.sourceAut G).linear (encoderA q) = encoderA q' ∧
      (ResidualAction.sourceAut G).linear (encoderB q) = encoderB q') ∨
    (∃ G : DetOneMatrix K,
      G.g = (residualPairOfChart (reflectChart a q')).X *
          (residualPairOfChart q).X⁻¹ ∧
      G.gInv = (residualPairOfChart q).X *
          (residualPairOfChart (reflectChart a q')).X⁻¹ ∧
      (∀ d1 d2 d3 : K, (ResidualAction.sourceAut G).linear
        (diagonal d1 d2 d3) = diagonal d1 d2 d3) ∧
      (GenericReflectionGauge.sourceAut a (right_ne_zero_of_mul ha)).linear
          ((ResidualAction.sourceAut G).linear (encoderA q)) = encoderA q' ∧
      (GenericReflectionGauge.sourceAut a (right_ne_zero_of_mul ha)).linear
          ((ResidualAction.sourceAut G).linear (encoderB q)) = encoderB q')
proof:
:= by
  have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := by
    intro haz
    apply ha
    rw [haz, mul_zero]
  have hgram : gramV12 q = h := by
    rw [gramV12, hr1, hz1, hr2, hz2]
    field_simp [ha0]
    ring
  have hgram' : gramV12 q' = h := by
    rw [gramV12, hr1', hz1', hr2', hz2']
    field_simp [ha0]
    ring
  have horient : orientation q = sigma :=
    orientation_eq_sigma_of_normalized_gauge q h sigma hr1 hz2 hgram
  have horient' : orientation q' = sigma' :=
    orientation_eq_sigma_of_normalized_gauge q' h sigma' hr1' hz2' hgram'
  have hsquares : sigma ^ 2 = sigma' ^ 2 := by
    rw [← horient, ← horient']
    exact orientation_sq_eq_of_sourceLedger_eq q q' hq hq' hledger
  have hfactor : (sigma - sigma') * (sigma + sigma') = 0 := by
    calc
      (sigma - sigma') * (sigma + sigma') = sigma ^ 2 - sigma' ^ 2 := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [hsquares, sub_self]
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hfactor with hsame | hopposite
  · have hs : sigma = sigma' := sub_eq_zero.mp hsame
    have hr2eq : q.r2 = q'.r2 := by rw [hr2, hr2', ← hs]
    have hz2eq : q.z2 = q'.z2 := by rw [hz2, hz2', ← hs]
    obtain ⟨G, hg, hginv, hdiag, hA, hB⟩ :=
      same_gauge_transporter q q' hopen hopen' hledger hdetector
        a q.r2 q.z2 sigma hq hq' hr1 hz1 rfl rfl hr1' hz1'
        hr2eq.symm hz2eq.symm
        (by rw [hgram]; exact hr2)
        (by rw [hgram]; exact hz2)
        hsigma ha hbeta
    exact Or.inl ⟨G, hg, hginv, hdiag, hA, hB⟩
  · have hs : sigma' = -sigma := by linear_combination hopposite
    have hqR := equationsVanish_reflectChart a ha0 q' hq'
    have hledgerR : sourceLedger (encoderA q) (encoderB q) =
        sourceLedger (encoderA (reflectChart a q'))
          (encoderB (reflectChart a q')) := by
      rw [sourceLedger_reflectChart a ha0 q']
      exact hledger
    have hr1R : (reflectChart a q').r1 = 1 := by
      simp [reflectChart, hz1', ha0]
    have hz1R : (reflectChart a q').z1 = a := by
      simp [reflectChart, hr1']
    have hr2R : (reflectChart a q').r2 = q.r2 := by
      rw [reflectChart, hr2, hz2', hs]
      field_simp [ha0]
      ring
    have hz2R : (reflectChart a q').z2 = q.z2 := by
      rw [reflectChart, hz2, hr2', hs]
      field_simp [ha0]
      ring
    have hdetectorR : sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1)
        (encoderA q) (encoderB q) =
      sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1)
        (encoderA (reflectChart a q')) (encoderB (reflectChart a q')) := by
      exact hdetector.trans
        (ReflectionDetectorChart.detector_reflectChart a ha0 q').symm
    obtain ⟨G, hg, hginv, hdiag, hA, hB⟩ :=
      same_gauge_transporter q (reflectChart a q') hopen
        (residualOpen_reflectChart a ha0 q' hopen') hledgerR hdetectorR
        a q.r2 q.z2 sigma hq hqR hr1 hz1 rfl rfl hr1R hz1R
        hr2R hz2R
        (by rw [hgram]; exact hr2)
        (by rw [hgram]; exact hz2)
        hsigma ha hbeta
    have hrestore := restore_reflected_target q q' a ha0 G hA hB
    exact Or.inr ⟨G, hg, hginv, hdiag, hrestore.1, hrestore.2⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TensorDifferenceAlgebraicity.scalarRetraction_algebraMap
statement:
theorem scalarRetraction_algebraMap (x : H) :
    scalarRetraction H K (algebraMap H K x) = x
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.leftInverse_apply_of_inj
  exact LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr (algebraMap H K).injective

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TensorDifferenceAlgebraicity.scalarRetraction_one

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TensorDifferenceAlgebraicity.contractRight_tmul
statement:
@[simp] theorem contractRight_tmul (x y : K) :

      (scalarRetraction H K y) • x
proof:
:= by

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TensorDifferenceAlgebraicity.descentPolynomial_monic
statement:
theorem descentPolynomial_monic (a : K) (n : ℕ) :
    (descentPolynomial H K a n).Monic
proof:
:= by
  apply Polynomial.monic_of_natDegree_le_of_coeff_eq_one n
  · unfold descentPolynomial
    apply Polynomial.natDegree_le_of_degree_le
    apply (Polynomial.degree_sum_le _ _).trans
    apply Finset.sup_le
    intro m hm
    exact Polynomial.degree_le_of_natDegree_le
      ((Polynomial.natDegree_monomial_le _).trans
        (Nat.le.intro (Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mp hm)))
  · classical
    simp only [descentPolynomial, Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (n, 0)]
    · simp
    · intro m hm hne
      have hi : m.1 ≠ n := by
        intro hi
        apply hne
        apply Prod.ext hi
        have hs := Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mp hm
        omega
      simp [Polynomial.coeff_monomial, hi]
    · simp [Finset.mem_antidiagonal]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TensorDifferenceAlgebraicity.eval_descentPolynomial
statement:
theorem eval_descentPolynomial (a : K) (n : ℕ) :
    (descentPolynomial H K a n).eval₂ (algebraMap H K) a =
      contractRight H K
        ((a ⊗ₜ[H] (1 : K) - (1 : K) ⊗ₜ[H] a) ^ n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, (Commute.all (a ⊗ₜ[H] (1 : K)) (-((1 : K) ⊗ₜ[H] a))).add_pow']
  rw [← TensorProduct.tmul_neg]
  simp only [descentPolynomial, map_sum, Polynomial.eval₂_finsetSum,
    Polynomial.eval₂_monomial]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro m hm
  rcases m with ⟨i, j⟩
  rw [(contractRight H K).map_smul_of_tower (n.choose i)]
  simp only [Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_pow, one_pow,
    Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, mul_one, one_mul,
    contractRight_tmul, Algebra.smul_def, map_mul]
  simp [mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TensorDifferenceAlgebraicity.exists_monic_annihilator_of_tensorDifference_pow_eq_zero
statement:
theorem exists_monic_annihilator_of_tensorDifference_pow_eq_zero (a : K) (n : ℕ)
    (hpow : (a ⊗ₜ[H] (1 : K) - (1 : K) ⊗ₜ[H] a) ^ n = 0) :
    ∃ p : Polynomial H, p.Monic ∧ Polynomial.aeval a p = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨descentPolynomial H K a n,
    descentPolynomial_monic H K a n, ?_⟩
  rw [Polynomial.aeval_def, eval_descentPolynomial H K a n, hpow, map_zero]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.PrimitiveFrame.primitive_family_iff_raw
statement:
theorem primitive_family_iff_raw (P : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Mat3 K) :
    (∀ r, IsPrimitiveFrame (P r)) ↔ RawFrameIdeal.IsRawFrameFamily P
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hp
    have h := fun r => (primitiveFrame_iff_raw (P r)).mp (hp r)
    refine ⟨fun r i => (h r).1 i, fun r i => (h r).2.1 i, ?_⟩
    intro r
    simpa [Fin.sum_univ_succ, add_assoc] using (h r).2.2
  · intro hp r
    apply (primitiveFrame_iff_raw (P r)).mpr
    refine ⟨hp.idempotent r, hp.trace_one r, ?_⟩
    simpa [Fin.sum_univ_succ, add_assoc] using hp.sum_one r

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceRingChartZero.flatten_field
statement:

proof:

  fin_cases i <;> rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceRingChartZero.chartWithScale_field
statement:
theorem chartWithScale_field {K : Type v} [Field K] [CharZero K]
    (u : SCoord K) (v : CCoord K) :
    chartWithScale (chart0Denominator u v)⁻¹ u v = chart0 u v
proof:
:= by
  apply JCoord.ext <;>
    simp [chartWithScale, chart0, ringMuV, normalizedMuV, muV]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceRingChartZero.shiftZero_eq_source
statement:
theorem shiftZero_eq_source {K : Type v} [Field K] [CharZero K]
    (u : SCoord K) (v : CCoord K) (x : JCoord K) :
    shiftZero (chart0Denominator u v)⁻¹ u v (structuredEquivK K x) =
      structuredEquivK K
        (sourcePeirceReflection (chart0 u v)
          (sourcePeirceReflection (diagonalUnit 0) x))
proof:
:= by
  rw [shiftZero, flatten_field, chartWithScale_field]
  rw [show diagonalZero = structuredEquivK K (diagonalUnit 0) by
    funext i; fin_cases i <;> rfl]
  rw [ringReflection_eq_source]
  rw [ringReflection_eq_source]

      diagonalProjector, grouped, hat, pairU, p, Fintype.sum_sum_type,

      seedWeightedEquiv, commonPlaneMap, planeScale, p, basisVector,

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.CarrierLedgerInvariance.pairTrace_eq_jordanTrace_jordan
statement:
theorem pairTrace_eq_jordanTrace_jordan (A B : Carrier K) :
    pairTrace A B =
      jordanTrace (K := K) ((jordan A B : Carrier K) : Mat6 K)
proof:
:= by
  change (2 : K)⁻¹ * Matrix.trace ((A : Mat6 K) * (B : Mat6 K)) =
    (2 : K)⁻¹ * Matrix.trace (matrixJordan (A : Mat6 K) (B : Mat6 K))
  simp only [matrixJordan, Matrix.trace_smul, Matrix.trace_add, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [Matrix.trace_mul_comm (B : Mat6 K) (A : Mat6 K)]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.CarrierLedgerInvariance.pairTrace_invariant
statement:
theorem pairTrace_invariant (g : Aut (K := K)) (A B : Carrier K) :
    pairTrace (g.linear A) (g.linear B) = pairTrace A B
proof:
:= by
  rw [pairTrace_eq_jordanTrace_jordan,
    ← g.map_jordan, jordanTrace_invariant g,
    ← pairTrace_eq_jordanTrace_jordan]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.CarrierLedgerInvariance.jointTrace_invariant
statement:
theorem jointTrace_invariant (g : Aut (K := K)) (E F P : Carrier K) :
    jointTrace (g.linear E) (g.linear F) (g.linear P) = jointTrace E F P
proof:
:= by
  rw [jointTrace, ← g.map_jordan]
  exact pairTrace_invariant g E (jordan F P)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.CarrierLedgerInvariance.carrierLedger_invariant
statement:
theorem carrierLedger_invariant
    (g : Aut (K := K)) (E F P : Fin 3 → Carrier K) :
    carrierLedger (mapFrame g E) (mapFrame g F) (mapFrame g P) =
      carrierLedger E F P
proof:
:= by
  rw [CarrierLedger.mk.injEq]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · funext i j
    exact pairTrace_invariant g (E i) (F j)
  · funext j l
    exact pairTrace_invariant g (F j) (P l)
  · funext l i
    exact pairTrace_invariant g (P l) (E i)
  · funext i j l
    simp only [carrierLedger, mapFrame]
    rw [jointTrace_invariant,
      pairTrace_invariant g (E i) (F j),
      pairTrace_invariant g (F j) (P l),
      pairTrace_invariant g (P l) (E i)]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.CarrierLedgerInvariance.carrierLedger_eq_of_map
statement:
theorem carrierLedger_eq_of_map
    (g h : Aut (K := K))
    (E F P E' F' P' : Fin 3 → Carrier K)
    (hledger : carrierLedger E F P = carrierLedger E' F' P') :
    carrierLedger (mapFrame g E) (mapFrame g F) (mapFrame g P) =
      carrierLedger (mapFrame h E') (mapFrame h F') (mapFrame h P')
proof:
:= by
  rw [carrierLedger_invariant, carrierLedger_invariant, hledger]

proof:
:= by

      (fun i j => x (Sum.inl (i, j)))
      (fun i => x (Sum.inr (Sum.inl i)))
      (fun i => x (Sum.inr (Sum.inr i))) =
      grouped
      (fun i j => y (Sum.inl (i, j)))
      (fun i => y (Sum.inr (Sum.inl i)))
      (fun i => y (Sum.inr (Sum.inr i))) := congrArg Subtype.val h
  obtain ⟨ha, hu, hv⟩ := grouped_injective hg
  funext i
  rcases i with ⟨i, j⟩ | i
  · exact congrFun (congrFun ha i) j
  · rcases i with i | i
    · exact congrFun hu i
    · exact congrFun hv i

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowComponentEquivalence.right_quadratic_implies_anchored_equation
statement:
theorem right_quadratic_implies_anchored_equation
    (X A0 A0i A1 A2 : R) (hA0i : A0i * A0 = 1)
    (hquad : X ^ 2 + X * ((A0 + A1 - A2) * A0i) + A1 * A0i = 0) :
    X ^ 2 * A0 + X * (A0 + A1 - A2) + A1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hm := congrArg (fun Z : R => Z * A0) hquad
  simpa only [zero_mul, add_mul, mul_assoc, hA0i, mul_one] using hm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowComponentEquivalence.anchored_equation_implies_weighted_cslot
statement:
theorem anchored_equation_implies_weighted_cslot
    (X Xi Yi A0 A1 A2 : R)
    (hXiX : Xi * X = 1) (hXXi : X * Xi = 1)
    (hYiOne : Yi * (1 + X) = 1) (hOneYi : (1 + X) * Yi = 1)
    (hanchored : X ^ 2 * A0 + X * (A0 + A1 - A2) + A1 = 0) :
    A0 + Xi * A1 - Yi * A2 = 0
proof:
:= by
  let W := A0 + Xi * A1 - Yi * A2
  have hXOneXi : X * (1 + X) * Xi = 1 + X := by
    calc
      X * (1 + X) * Xi = (X + X * X) * Xi := by rw [mul_add, mul_one]
      _ = X * Xi + X * X * Xi := by rw [add_mul]
      _ = X * Xi + X * (X * Xi) := by rw [mul_assoc]
      _ = 1 + X := by rw [hXXi, mul_one]
  have hXOneYi : X * (1 + X) * Yi = X := by rw [mul_assoc, hOneYi, mul_one]
  have hid : X ^ 2 * A0 + X * (A0 + A1 - A2) + A1 = X * (1 + X) * W := by
    dsimp only [W]
    calc
      X ^ 2 * A0 + X * (A0 + A1 - A2) + A1 =
          (X * (1 + X)) * A0 + (1 + X) * A1 - X * A2 := by
        simp only [pow_two, mul_add, add_mul, mul_sub, mul_one, one_mul, mul_assoc]
        abel
      _ = (X * (1 + X)) * A0 + (X * (1 + X) * Xi) * A1 -
          (X * (1 + X) * Yi) * A2 := by rw [hXOneXi, hXOneYi]
      _ = X * (1 + X) * (A0 + Xi * A1 - Yi * A2) := by
        simp only [mul_sub, mul_add, mul_assoc]
  have hcleared : X * (1 + X) * W = 0 := hid.symm.trans hanchored
  have hOne : (1 + X) * W = 0 := by
    have hm := congrArg (fun Z : R => Xi * Z) hcleared
    simpa only [mul_zero, ← mul_assoc, hXiX, one_mul] using hm
  have hW : W = 0 := by
    have hm := congrArg (fun Z : R => Yi * Z) hOne
    simpa only [mul_zero, ← mul_assoc, hYiOne, one_mul] using hm
  exact hW

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowComponentEquivalence.cslot_sum_of_normalized_equation
statement:
theorem cslot_sum_of_normalized_equation
    (a0 X A0 A1 A2 : Mat3K K)
    (ha0 : a0.det ≠ 0) (hX : X.det ≠ 0)
    (hOneX : (1 + X).det ≠ 0)
    (hb1 : (X * a0).det ≠ 0)
    (hb2 : (-(1 + X) * a0).det ≠ 0)
    (hnormalized : A0 + X⁻¹ * A1 - (1 + X)⁻¹ * A2 = 0) :
    cslotSum a0 (X * a0) (-(1 + X) * a0) A0 A1 A2 = 0
proof:
:= by
  let S := cslotSum a0 (X * a0) (-(1 + X) * a0) A0 A1 A2
  have ha0b1 : a0 * (X * a0)⁻¹ = X⁻¹ := by
    calc
      a0 * (X * a0)⁻¹ = X⁻¹ * (X * a0 * (X * a0)⁻¹) := by
        simp only [← Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul X
          (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hX), Matrix.one_mul]
      _ = X⁻¹ := by
        rw [Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv (X * a0) (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hb1),
          Matrix.mul_one]
  have ha0b2 : a0 * (-(1 + X) * a0)⁻¹ = -(1 + X)⁻¹ := by
    let b2 : Mat3K K := -(1 + X) * a0
    have hb2product : -((1 + X) * (a0 * b2⁻¹)) = 1 := by
      calc
        -((1 + X) * (a0 * b2⁻¹)) = b2 * b2⁻¹ := by
          dsimp only [b2]
          simp only [neg_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]
        _ = 1 := Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv b2 (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hb2)
    have hproduct : (1 + X) * (a0 * b2⁻¹) = -1 := by
      calc
        (1 + X) * (a0 * b2⁻¹) = -(-((1 + X) * (a0 * b2⁻¹))) := by simp
        _ = -1 := by rw [hb2product]
    calc
      a0 * (-(1 + X) * a0)⁻¹ =
          (1 + X)⁻¹ * ((1 + X) * (a0 * b2⁻¹)) := by
        dsimp only [b2]
        rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul (1 + X)
          (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hOneX), Matrix.one_mul]
      _ = -(1 + X)⁻¹ := by rw [hproduct]; simp
  have ha0S : a0 * S = 0 := by
    dsimp only [S, cslotSum]
    simp only [mul_add, ← Matrix.mul_assoc,
      Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv a0 (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr ha0),
      ha0b1, ha0b2, Matrix.one_mul]
    simpa only [neg_mul, sub_eq_add_neg] using hnormalized
  have hm := congrArg (fun Z : Mat3K K => a0⁻¹ * Z) ha0S
  simpa only [mul_zero, ← Matrix.mul_assoc,
    Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul a0 (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr ha0), one_mul] using hm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowComponentEquivalence.components_of_goodSolution
statement:
theorem components_of_goodSolution
    (a0 a1 a2 X : Mat3K K)
    (ha0 : a0.det ≠ 0) (ha1 : a1.det ≠ 0) (ha2 : a2.det ≠ 0)
    (hX : GoodSolution (componentU a0 a1 a2) (componentV a0 a1)
      (a1.det / a0.det) (a2.det / a0.det) X) :
    ComponentSolution a0 a1 a2 X
proof:
:= by
  have hnX : X.det ≠ 0 := by rw [hX.det_eq]; exact div_ne_zero ha1 ha0
  have hnOne : (1 + X).det ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hX.det_one_add_eq]
    exact neg_ne_zero.mpr (div_ne_zero ha2 ha0)
  have hdetb1 : (X * a0).det = a1.det := by
    rw [Matrix.det_mul, hX.det_eq]
    field_simp [ha0]
  have hdetb2 : (-(1 + X) * a0).det = a2.det := by
    rw [Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_neg, hX.det_one_add_eq]
    simp only [Fintype.card_fin]
    norm_num
    field_simp [ha0]
  have hanchored := right_quadratic_implies_anchored_equation
    X a0.adjugate a0.adjugate⁻¹ a1.adjugate a2.adjugate
    (Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul a0.adjugate (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (by
      rw [Matrix.det_adjugate]
      exact pow_ne_zero 2 ha0)))
    (by simpa only [componentU, componentV, frameU, frameV] using hX.quadratic)
  have hnormalized := anchored_equation_implies_weighted_cslot
    X X⁻¹ (1 + X)⁻¹ a0.adjugate a1.adjugate a2.adjugate
    (Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul X (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hnX))
    (Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv X (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hnX))
    (Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul (1 + X) (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hnOne))
    (Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv (1 + X) (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hnOne)) hanchored
  refine ⟨hdetb1, hdetb2, ?_, hX.denominator_det_ne_zero⟩
  exact cslot_sum_of_normalized_equation a0 X a0.adjugate a1.adjugate a2.adjugate
    ha0 hnX hnOne (by rw [hdetb1]; exact ha1) (by rw [hdetb2]; exact ha2)
    hnormalized

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowComponentEquivalence.components_iff_goodSolution
statement:
theorem components_iff_goodSolution
    (a0 a1 a2 X : Mat3K K)
    (ha0 : a0.det ≠ 0) (ha1 : a1.det ≠ 0) (ha2 : a2.det ≠ 0) :
    ComponentSolution a0 a1 a2 X ↔
      GoodSolution (componentU a0 a1 a2) (componentV a0 a1)
        (a1.det / a0.det) (a2.det / a0.det) X
proof:
:=
  ⟨goodSolution_of_components a0 a1 a2 X ha0 ha1 ha2,
    components_of_goodSolution a0 a1 a2 X ha0 ha1 ha2⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3PrimitivePivot.exists_nonzero_diagonal_of_symmetric_idempotent
statement:
theorem exists_nonzero_diagonal_of_symmetric_idempotent
    (P : Mat3 K) (hsymm : P.transpose = P) (hidem : P * P = P)
    (hne : P ≠ 0) : ∃ j : Fin 3, P j j ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  push_neg at h
  have hs01 : P 1 0 = P 0 1 := congrFun (congrFun hsymm 0) 1
  have hs02 : P 2 0 = P 0 2 := congrFun (congrFun hsymm 0) 2
  have hs12 : P 2 1 = P 1 2 := congrFun (congrFun hsymm 1) 2
  have h00 := congrFun (congrFun hidem 0) 0
  have h11 := congrFun (congrFun hidem 1) 1
  have h22 := congrFun (congrFun hidem 2) 2
  simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ, h, hs01, hs02, hs12]
    at h00 h11 h22
  have ha : P 0 1 * P 0 1 = 0 := by
    linear_combination (h00 + h11 - h22) / 2
  have hb : P 0 2 * P 0 2 = 0 := by
    linear_combination (h00 + h22 - h11) / 2
  have hc : P 1 2 * P 1 2 = 0 := by
    linear_combination (h11 + h22 - h00) / 2
  have ha0 : P 0 1 = 0 := mul_self_eq_zero.mp ha
  have hb0 : P 0 2 = 0 := mul_self_eq_zero.mp hb
  have hc0 : P 1 2 = 0 := mul_self_eq_zero.mp hc
  apply hne
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [h, hs01, hs02, hs12, ha0, hb0, hc0]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3PrimitivePivot.trace_one_pivot_factor
statement:
theorem trace_one_pivot_factor
    (P : Mat3 K) (hsymm : P.transpose = P) (hidem : P * P = P)
    (htrace : Matrix.trace P = 1) (j : Fin 3) (hj : P j j ≠ 0) :
    ∀ i l, P i l = P i j * P l j / P j j
proof:
:= by
  intro i l
  apply (eq_div_iff hj).2
  have hs : P l j = P j l := congrFun (congrFun hsymm j) l
  rw [hs]
  exact minor_zero_of_symmetric_idempotent_trace_one P hsymm hidem htrace i l j

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3PrimitivePivot.outer_sandwich
statement:
theorem outer_sandwich
    (P F : Mat3 K) (v : Fin 3 → K) (n : K)
    (hP : ∀ i j, P i j = v i * v j / n) :
    P * F * P = Matrix.trace (P * F) • P
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.trace, Fin.sum_univ_succ, hP, div_eq_mul_inv]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3PrimitivePivot.corner_scalar
statement:
theorem corner_scalar
    (P F : Mat3 K) (v : Fin 3 → K) (n : K)
    (hP : ∀ i j, P i j = v i * v j / n)
    (hPF : P * F = F) (hFP : F * P = F) :
    F = Matrix.trace F • P
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [hPF, hFP] using outer_sandwich P F v n hP

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceVectorPairDephase.BV_evenV
statement:

proof:
:= by

    SourceVectorPairReflection.BV_reflectV B _ _ hB]

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceVectorPairDephase.evenV_add
statement:

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceVectorPairDephase.evenV_smul

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceVectorPairDephase.exists_two_even_pairs_dephasing
statement:
theorem exists_two_even_pairs_dephasing
    (v1 v2 : VCoord K) (s : K)
    (ha : nV v1 ≠ 0)
    (hGram : 4 * nV v1 * nV v2 - (BV v1 v2) ^ 2 ≠ 0)
    (hs : s ^ 2 = (BV v1 v2) ^ 2 - 4 * nV v1 * nV v2) :
    ∃ A1 B1 A2 B2 : VCoord K,
      nV A1 ≠ 0 ∧ nV B1 ≠ 0 ∧ nV A2 ≠ 0 ∧ nV B2 ≠ 0 ∧
      evenV A2 B2 (evenV A1 B1 v1) = targetFirst (nV v1) ∧
      evenV A2 B2 (evenV A1 B1 v2) =
        targetSecond (nV v1) (BV v1 v2) s
proof:
:= by
  let a := nV v1
  let h := BV v1 v2
  let m := nV v2
  let t := targetFirst a
  let z := targetSecond a h s
  let e : VCoord K := parityVector
  have he : nV e ≠ 0 := by simp [e]
  have ht : nV t = nV v1 := by simp [t, a, targetFirst_norm]
  have het : BV e t = 0 := by simp [e, t, targetFirst]
  obtain ⟨A1, B1, hA1, hB1, h1⟩ :=
    evenV_eq_of_centers e v1 t he ht.symm ha het
  let w := evenV A1 B1 v2
  have hwNorm : nV w = m := by
    simp [w, m, nV_evenV A1 B1 v2 hA1 hB1]
  have htw : BV t w = h := by
    rw [← h1]
    change BV (evenV A1 B1 v1) (evenV A1 B1 v2) = h
    rw [BV_evenV A1 B1 v1 v2 hA1 hB1]
  let u := orthogonalRemainder t w
  let q := targetRemainder a h s
  have hta : nV t ≠ 0 := by simpa [t, a, targetFirst_norm] using ha
  have htu : BV t u = 0 := BV_orthogonalRemainder t w hta
  have htq : BV t q = 0 := by
    have hq : q = orthogonalRemainder t z := by
      change targetRemainder a h s = orthogonalRemainder t z
      rw [targetRemainder, orthogonalRemainder]
      congr 1
      simp [projectionCoeff, t, z, target_pairing a h s ha, targetFirst_norm]
    rw [hq]
    exact BV_orthogonalRemainder t z hta
  have hu : nV u = (4 * a * m - h ^ 2) / (4 * a) := by
    have H := nV_orthogonalRemainder_identity t w hta
    rw [ht, hwNorm, htw] at H
    apply (eq_div_iff (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) ha)).2
    linear_combination H
  have hq : nV q = (4 * a * m - h ^ 2) / (4 * a) := by
    rw [targetRemainder_norm a h s ha, hs]
    ring
  have hu0 : nV u ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hu]
    exact div_ne_zero (by simpa [a, h, m] using hGram)
      (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) ha)
  have heq : BV e q = 0 := by
    change BV parityVector (targetRemainder a h s) = 0
    rw [targetRemainder_eq a h s ha]
    exact BV_parityVector_plane _ _
  have hte : BV t e = 0 := by rw [BV_symmetric]; exact het
  obtain ⟨A2, B2, hA2, hB2, _, _, h2, h2fix⟩ :=
    evenV_eq_fixing e t u q he (hu.trans hq.symm) hu0 heq hte htu htq
  refine ⟨A1, B1, A2, B2, hA1, hB1, hA2, hB2, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [h1, h2fix]
  · change evenV A2 B2 w = z
    have hwdecomp : w = u + projectionCoeff t w • t := by
      simp [u, orthogonalRemainder]
    rw [hwdecomp, evenV_add, h2, evenV_smul, h2fix]
    have hc : projectionCoeff t w = h / (2 * a) := by
      simp [projectionCoeff, htw, t, a, targetFirst_norm]
    rw [hc]
    change targetRemainder a h s + (h / (2 * a)) • targetFirst a =
      targetSecond a h s
    rw [targetRemainder]
    exact sub_add_cancel _ _

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawDetectorExactDegreeTwo.rawLedgerField_eq_originalRawLedgerField

proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawDetectorExactDegreeTwo.rawLedgerField_le_ledgerDetectorField
statement:

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawDetectorExactDegreeTwo.detector_relation
statement:
theorem detector_relation :
    detectorValue k ^ 2 -
        (detectorTrace k : F k) * detectorValue k +
        (detectorNorm k : F k) = 0
proof:
:=
  (exists_original_detector_quadratic k).choose_spec.choose_spec

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawDetectorExactDegreeTwo.detector_not_mem_base
statement: private theorem detector_not_mem_base : detectorValue k ∉ H k
proof:
:= by
  change detectorValue k ∉ rawLedgerField k
  rw [rawLedgerField_eq_originalRawLedgerField k]
  exact detectorValue_not_mem_originalRawLedgerField k

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawDetectorExactDegreeTwo.linear_zero_iff
statement:
theorem linear_zero_iff (a b : H k) :
    (a : F k) + (b : F k) * detectorValue k = 0 ↔ a = 0 ∧ b = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hb : b = 0 := by
      by_contra hb0
      have hbF : (b : F k) ≠ 0 := by
        intro hzero
        exact hb0 (Subtype.ext hzero)
      have hd : detectorValue k = -(a : F k) / (b : F k) := by
        field_simp [hbF]
        linear_combination h
      apply detector_not_mem_base k
      rw [hd]
      exact (H k).div_mem ((H k).neg_mem a.property) b.property
    have ha : a = 0 := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      simpa only [hb, Subfield.coe_zero, zero_mul, add_zero] using h
    exact ⟨ha, hb⟩
  · rintro ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    simp

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawDetectorExactDegreeTwo.quadraticSpan_eq_ledgerDetectorField
statement:
theorem quadraticSpan_eq_ledgerDetectorField :
    quadraticSpan k = ledgerDetectorField k
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨a, b, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact (ledgerDetectorField k).add_mem
      (rawLedgerField_le_ledgerDetectorField k a.property)
      ((ledgerDetectorField k).mul_mem
        (rawLedgerField_le_ledgerDetectorField k b.property)
        (detectorGenerator k).property)
  · rw [ledgerDetectorField]
    apply Subfield.closure_le.mpr
    intro x hx
    rcases hx with hx | hx
    · exact ⟨⟨x, Subfield.subset_closure hx⟩, 0, by simp⟩
    · simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
      rw [hx]
      exact ⟨0, 1, by simp⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawDetectorExactDegreeTwo.quadraticCoordinates_subfield_coe
statement:
private theorem quadraticCoordinates_subfield_coe
    {M : Type*} [Field M] (P Q : Subfield M) (h : P ≤ Q)
    (d : Q) (ab : P × P) :
    letI : Algebra P Q
proof:
:= (Subfield.inclusion h).toAlgebra
    ((quadraticCoordinates P Q d ab : Q) : M) =
      (ab.1 : M) + (ab.2 : M) * (d : M) := by
  rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawDetectorExactDegreeTwo.detectorCoordinates_coe
statement:
@[simp] theorem detectorCoordinates_coe (ab : H k × H k) :
    ((detectorCoordinates k ab : B k) : F k) =
      (ab.1 : F k) + (ab.2 : F k) * detectorValue k
proof:
:= by
  exact quadraticCoordinates_subfield_coe (H k) (B k)
    (rawLedgerField_le_ledgerDetectorField k) (detectorGenerator k) ab

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawDetectorExactDegreeTwo.detectorCoordinates_bijective
statement:
theorem detectorCoordinates_bijective :
    Function.Bijective (detectorCoordinates k)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro x y hxy
    have hval :
        (x.1 : F k) + (x.2 : F k) * detectorValue k =
          (y.1 : F k) + (y.2 : F k) * detectorValue k := by
      simpa only [detectorCoordinates_coe] using
        congrArg (fun z : B k => (z : F k)) hxy
    have hzero :
        ((x.1 - y.1 : H k) : F k) +
            ((x.2 - y.2 : H k) : F k) * detectorValue k = 0 := by
      push_cast
      linear_combination hval
    obtain ⟨hfirst, hsecond⟩ := (linear_zero_iff k
      (x.1 - y.1) (x.2 - y.2)).mp hzero
    exact Prod.ext (sub_eq_zero.mp hfirst) (sub_eq_zero.mp hsecond)
  · intro x
    have hx : (x : F k) ∈ quadraticSpan k := by
      rw [quadraticSpan_eq_ledgerDetectorField k]
      exact x.property
    obtain ⟨a, b, hab⟩ := hx
    refine ⟨(a, b), ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [detectorCoordinates_coe]
    exact hab.symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawDetectorExactDegreeTwo.ledgerDetectorField_finrank_eq_two

theorem ledgerDetectorField_finrank_eq_two :

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawDetectorExactDegreeTwo.ledgerDetectorField_finiteDimensional
