name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealFieldComparison.isRaw_mapMatrix
statement:
theorem isRaw_mapMatrix {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L]
    (j : K →+* L) (P : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Mat3 K)
    (hP : IsRawPrimitiveFrameFamily P) :
    IsRawPrimitiveFrameFamily (fun r i => j.mapMatrix (P r i)) where
  symmetric r i a b
proof:
:= by
    change j (P r i a b) = j (P r i b a)
    rw [hP.symmetric r i a b]
  idempotent r i := by
    rw [← map_mul]
    exact congrArg j.mapMatrix (hP.idempotent r i)
  trace_one r i := by
    change Matrix.trace ((P r i).map j) = 1
    rw [← AddMonoidHom.map_trace j, hP.trace_one, map_one]
  sum_one r := by
    simpa only [map_sum, map_one] using congrArg j.mapMatrix (hP.sum_one r)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealFieldComparison.genericPairTraceProduct_eq_universal_traces
statement:
theorem genericPairTraceProduct_eq_universal_traces :
    genericPairTraceProduct k =
      ((∏ i : Fin 3, ∏ j : Fin 3,
          Matrix.trace (universalFamily k 0 i * universalFamily k 1 j)) *
       (∏ j : Fin 3, ∏ l : Fin 3,
          Matrix.trace (universalFamily k 1 j * universalFamily k 2 l))) *
       (∏ l : Fin 3, ∏ i : Fin 3,
          Matrix.trace (universalFamily k 2 l * universalFamily k 0 i))
proof:
:= by
  simp [genericPairTraceProduct, RealReducedPairTraceOpen.reducedPairTraceProduct,
    cyclicPairTraceProduct, pairTracePolynomial, universalFamily, rawToField,
    Matrix.trace, Matrix.mul_apply]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealFieldComparison.universal_pairTrace_ne_zero
statement:
theorem universal_pairTrace_ne_zero :
    (∀ i j, Matrix.trace (universalFamily k 0 i * universalFamily k 1 j) ≠ 0) ∧
    (∀ j l, Matrix.trace (universalFamily k 1 j * universalFamily k 2 l) ≠ 0) ∧
    (∀ l i, Matrix.trace (universalFamily k 2 l * universalFamily k 0 i) ≠ 0)
proof:
:= by
  have htotal := genericPairTraceProduct_ne_zero k
  rw [genericPairTraceProduct_eq_universal_traces k] at htotal
  simpa only [mul_ne_zero_iff, Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff, Finset.mem_univ,
    forall_const, and_assoc] using htotal

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealFieldComparison.agree_at_of_extension_orthogonal_transport
statement:
theorem agree_at_of_extension_orthogonal_transport
    (f : FunctionField k) (_hinv : IsConstantInvariant k f)
    (htransport : ExtensionOrthogonalTransportPreserves k f)
    (L : Type u) [Field L]
    (left right : FunctionField k →+* L)
    (hagree : AgreeOnLedgerField k left right) : left f = right f
proof:
:= by
  letI : CharZero L := FiniteQuadraticRoots.charZero_of_embedding left
  letI : Invertible (2 : L) := invertibleOfNonzero (by norm_num)
  let P : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Mat3 L :=
    fun r i => left.mapMatrix (universalFamily k r i)
  let P' : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Mat3 L :=
    fun r i => right.mapMatrix (universalFamily k r i)
  have hbase : left.comp (scalarMap k) = right.comp (scalarMap k) :=
    agree_scalarMap_comp k left right hagree
  have hP : IsRawPrimitiveFrameFamily P :=
    isRaw_mapMatrix left _ (universalFamily_isRaw k)
  have hP' : IsRawPrimitiveFrameFamily P' :=
    isRaw_mapMatrix right _ (universalFamily_isRaw k)
  obtain ⟨hnz01, hnz12, hnz20⟩ := universal_pairTrace_ne_zero k
  have hnz01' : ∀ i j, Matrix.trace (P 0 i * P 1 j) ≠ 0 := by
    intro i j hzero
    apply hnz01 i j
    apply left.injective
    rw [map_zero, mapMatrix_trace, map_mul]
    exact hzero
  have hnz12' : ∀ j l, Matrix.trace (P 1 j * P 2 l) ≠ 0 := by
    intro j l hzero
    apply hnz12 j l
    apply left.injective
    rw [map_zero, mapMatrix_trace, map_mul]
    exact hzero
  have hnz20' : ∀ l i, Matrix.trace (P 2 l * P 0 i) ≠ 0 := by
    intro l i hzero
    apply hnz20 l i
    apply left.injective
    rw [map_zero, mapMatrix_trace, map_mul]
    exact hzero
  have hledger : labelledLedger (primitiveMatrixTauTriple P) =
      labelledLedger (primitiveMatrixTauTriple P') := by
    rw [show labelledLedger (primitiveMatrixTauTriple P) =
        mapLedgerValues left (universalLedger k) by
          simpa [P, universalLedger] using primitiveLedger_map left (universalFamily k),
      show labelledLedger (primitiveMatrixTauTriple P') =
        mapLedgerValues right (universalLedger k) by
          simpa [P', universalLedger] using primitiveLedger_map right (universalFamily k)]
    simpa only [mapLedgerValues, mapLedger] using mapLedger_eq_of_agreement k left right hagree
  obtain ⟨E, instE, j, Q, hQ, hconj⟩ :=
    exists_extension_orthogonal_of_acceptedLedger_eq
      P P' hP hP' hnz01' hnz12' hnz20' hledger
  letI : Field E := instE
  have hj : j (left f) = j (right f) :=
    htransport L inferInstance left right hbase E instE j Q hQ (by
      intro r i
      simpa [P, P', RingHom.comp_apply] using hconj r i)
  exact j.injective hj

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealFieldComparison.mem_ledgerField_of_extension_orthogonal_transport
statement:
theorem mem_ledgerField_of_extension_orthogonal_transport
    (f : FunctionField k) (hinv : IsConstantInvariant k f)
    (htransport : ExtensionOrthogonalTransportPreserves k f) :
    f ∈ ledgerField k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := FieldPointNilpotence.exists_base_of_field_embedding_agreement
    (ledgerField k) (FunctionField k) f (by
      intro L instL left right hagree
      exact agree_at_of_extension_orthogonal_transport
        k f hinv htransport L left right hagree)
  rw [← hh]
  change (h : FunctionField k) ∈ ledgerField k
  exact h.property

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ActualSplitThirdFrameAut.uncenteredCell_carrierLedger
statement:
@[simp] theorem uncenteredCell_carrierLedger
    (E F P : Fin 3 → Carrier K) (i j l : Fin 3) :
    uncenteredCell (carrierLedger E F P) i j l =
      jordanTrace (K := K)
        ((E i : Mat6 K) * matrixJordan (F j : Mat6 K) (P l : Mat6 K))
proof:
:= by
  simp [uncenteredCell, carrierLedger]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ActualSplitThirdFrameAut.labelledProbe_eq_two_split_joint
statement:
theorem labelledProbe_eq_two_split_joint
    (f a : Mat3 K) (u v : Vec3 K) (i : Fin 3) :
    labelledProbe f a i = 2 * jordanTrace (K := K)
      (grouped (diagonalUnit i) 0 0 *
        matrixJordan (grouped f 0 0) (grouped a u v))
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i <;>
    simp [labelledProbe, jordanTrace, matrixJordan, grouped, diagonalUnit,
      Matrix.trace, Matrix.mul_apply, Fintype.sum_sum_type,
      Fin.sum_univ_succ, hat] <;> ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ActualSplitThirdFrameAut.grouped_frame_threeSumZero
statement:
theorem grouped_frame_threeSumZero
    (P : Fin 3 → Carrier K)
    (a : Fin 3 → Mat3 K) (u v : Fin 3 → Vec3 K)
    (hP : ∀ i, (P i : Mat6 K) = grouped (a i) (u i) (v i))
    (hsum : (P 0 : Mat6 K) + P 1 + P 2 = 1) :
    ThreeSumZero u ∧ ThreeSumZero v
proof:
:= by
  have hhatU : hat (u 0) + hat (u 1) + hat (u 2) = 0 := by
    ext i j
    have h := congrFun (congrFun hsum (Sum.inl i)) (Sum.inr j)
    simpa [hP 0, hP 1, hP 2, grouped, Matrix.one_apply] using h
  have hhatV : hat (v 0) + hat (v 1) + hat (v 2) = 0 := by
    ext i j
    have h := congrFun (congrFun hsum (Sum.inr i)) (Sum.inl j)
    simpa [hP 0, hP 1, hP 2, grouped, Matrix.one_apply] using h
  constructor
  · intro j
    have h := congrFun (congrArg unhat hhatU) j
    fin_cases j <;> simpa [unhat, hat, add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc] using h
  · intro j
    have h := congrFun (congrArg unhat hhatV) j
    fin_cases j <;> simpa [unhat, hat, add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc] using h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ActualSplitThirdFrameAut.exists_split_actual_three_frame_jordanAut_of_labelled_probes
statement:
theorem exists_split_actual_three_frame_jordanAut_of_labelled_probes
    (E F P E' F' P' : Fin 3 → Carrier K)
    (f a a' : Fin 3 → Mat3 K)
    (u v u' v' : Fin 3 → Vec3 K)
    (hE : ∀ i, (E i : Mat6 K) = grouped (diagonalUnit i) 0 0)
    (hE' : ∀ i, (E' i : Mat6 K) = grouped (diagonalUnit i) 0 0)
    (hF : ∀ i, (F i : Mat6 K) = grouped (f i) 0 0)
    (hF' : ∀ i, (F' i : Mat6 K) = grouped (f i) 0 0)
    (hP : ∀ i, (P i : Mat6 K) = grouped (a i) (u i) (v i))
    (hP' : ∀ i, (P' i : Mat6 K) = grouped (a' i) (u' i) (v' i))
    (hPidem : ∀ i, (P i : Mat6 K) * P i = P i)
    (hPidem' : ∀ i, (P' i : Mat6 K) * P' i = P' i)
    (hPtrace : ∀ i, jordanTrace (K := K) (P i : Mat6 K) = 1)
    (hPtrace' : ∀ i, jordanTrace (K := K) (P' i : Mat6 K) = 1)
    (hPsum : (P 0 : Mat6 K) + P 1 + P 2 = 1)
    (hPsum' : (P' 0 : Mat6 K) + P' 1 + P' 2 = 1)
    (hfsum : f 0 + f 1 + f 2 = 1)
    (hf0 : f 0 * f 0 = f 0) (hf2 : f 2 * f 2 = f 2)
    (hf02 : f 0 * f 2 = 0) (hf20 : f 2 * f 0 = 0)
    (hprobeOpen : Matrix.det
      (grading * encoder (f 0) (f 2) - encoder (f 0) (f 2) * grading) ≠ 0)
    (hLabel : ∀ l i,
      labelledProbe (f 0) (a l) i = labelledProbe (f 0) (a' l) i ∧
      labelledProbe (f 1) (a l) i = labelledProbe (f 1) (a' l) i ∧
      labelledProbe (f 2) (a l) i = labelledProbe (f 2) (a' l) i)
    (hadj : ∀ l, Matrix.adjugate (a l) ≠ 0)
    (hrankTwo :
      (∃ p q, u 0 p * u 1 q - u 0 q * u 1 p ≠ 0) ∨
      (∃ p q, v 0 p * v 1 q - v 0 q * v 1 p ≠ 0)) :
    ∃ g : Aut (K := K),
      (∀ i, g.linear (E i) = E' i) ∧
      (∀ i, g.linear (F i) = F' i) ∧
      (∀ i, g.linear (P i) = P' i)
proof:
:= by
  have ha : ∀ l, a l = a' l := by
    intro l
    exact eq_of_orthogonal_idempotent_labelled_probes
      (f 0) (f 1) (f 2) (a l) (a' l)
      hfsum hf0 hf2 hf02 hf20 hprobeOpen (hLabel l)
  have hPcommon' : ∀ i, (P' i : Mat6 K) = grouped (a i) (u' i) (v' i) := by
    intro i
    rw [ha i]
    exact hP' i
  have hblock : ∀ i,
      a i * a i - a i = -(hat (u i) * hat (v i)) := by
    intro i
    apply top_left_projector_equation
    simpa [hP i] using hPidem i
  have hblock' : ∀ i,
      a i * a i - a i = -(hat (u' i) * hat (v' i)) := by
    intro i
    apply top_left_projector_equation
    simpa [hPcommon' i] using hPidem' i
  have htrace : ∀ i, Matrix.trace (a i) = 1 := by
    intro i
    apply grouped_trace_one (a i) (u i) (v i)
    simpa [hP i] using hPtrace i
  obtain ⟨hsumu, hsumv⟩ := grouped_frame_threeSumZero P a u v hP hPsum
  obtain ⟨hsumu', hsumv'⟩ :=
    grouped_frame_threeSumZero P' a u' v' hPcommon' hPsum'
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hu, hv⟩ := common_frame_scalar_fibre
    a u v u' v' hblock hblock' htrace hadj
      hsumu hsumu' hsumv hsumv' hrankTwo
  let g : Aut (K := K) := scalarAut t ht
  refine ⟨g, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (((scalarAut t ht).linear (E i) : Carrier K) : Mat6 K) =
      (E' i : Mat6 K)
    rw [scalarAut_grouped t ht (diagonalUnit i) 0 0 (E i) (hE i), hE' i]
    simp
  · intro i
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (((scalarAut t ht).linear (F i) : Carrier K) : Mat6 K) =
      (F' i : Mat6 K)
    rw [scalarAut_grouped t ht (f i) 0 0 (F i) (hF i), hF' i]
    simp
  · intro i
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (((scalarAut t ht).linear (P i) : Carrier K) : Mat6 K) =
      (P' i : Mat6 K)
    rw [scalarAut_grouped t ht (a i) (u i) (v i) (P i) (hP i),
      hPcommon' i, hu i, hv i]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ActualSplitThirdFrameAut.exists_split_actual_three_frame_jordanAut_of_same_ledger
statement:
theorem exists_split_actual_three_frame_jordanAut_of_same_ledger
    (E F P E' F' P' : Fin 3 → Carrier K)
    (f a a' : Fin 3 → Mat3 K)
    (u v u' v' : Fin 3 → Vec3 K)
    (hE : ∀ i, (E i : Mat6 K) = grouped (diagonalUnit i) 0 0)
    (hE' : ∀ i, (E' i : Mat6 K) = grouped (diagonalUnit i) 0 0)
    (hF : ∀ i, (F i : Mat6 K) = grouped (f i) 0 0)
    (hF' : ∀ i, (F' i : Mat6 K) = grouped (f i) 0 0)
    (hP : ∀ i, (P i : Mat6 K) = grouped (a i) (u i) (v i))
    (hP' : ∀ i, (P' i : Mat6 K) = grouped (a' i) (u' i) (v' i))
    (hPidem : ∀ i, (P i : Mat6 K) * P i = P i)
    (hPidem' : ∀ i, (P' i : Mat6 K) * P' i = P' i)
    (hPtrace : ∀ i, jordanTrace (K := K) (P i : Mat6 K) = 1)
    (hPtrace' : ∀ i, jordanTrace (K := K) (P' i : Mat6 K) = 1)
    (hPsum : (P 0 : Mat6 K) + P 1 + P 2 = 1)
    (hPsum' : (P' 0 : Mat6 K) + P' 1 + P' 2 = 1)
    (hfsum : f 0 + f 1 + f 2 = 1)
    (hf0 : f 0 * f 0 = f 0) (hf2 : f 2 * f 2 = f 2)
    (hf02 : f 0 * f 2 = 0) (hf20 : f 2 * f 0 = 0)
    (hprobeOpen : Matrix.det
      (grading * encoder (f 0) (f 2) - encoder (f 0) (f 2) * grading) ≠ 0)
    (hadj : ∀ l, Matrix.adjugate (a l) ≠ 0)
    (hrankTwo :
      (∃ p q, u 0 p * u 1 q - u 0 q * u 1 p ≠ 0) ∨
      (∃ p q, v 0 p * v 1 q - v 0 q * v 1 p ≠ 0))
    (hledger : carrierLedger E F P = carrierLedger E' F' P') :
    ∃ g : Aut (K := K),
      (∀ i, g.linear (E i) = E' i) ∧
      (∀ i, g.linear (F i) = F' i) ∧
      (∀ i, g.linear (P i) = P' i)
proof:
:= by
  have hLabel : ∀ l i,
      labelledProbe (f 0) (a l) i = labelledProbe (f 0) (a' l) i ∧
      labelledProbe (f 1) (a l) i = labelledProbe (f 1) (a' l) i ∧
      labelledProbe (f 2) (a l) i = labelledProbe (f 2) (a' l) i := by
    intro l i
    have hcell (j : Fin 3) :
        uncenteredCell (carrierLedger E F P) i j l =
          uncenteredCell (carrierLedger E' F' P') i j l :=
      congrArg (fun L : CarrierLedger K => uncenteredCell L i j l) hledger
    have hjoint (j : Fin 3) :
        jordanTrace (K := K)
            ((E i : Mat6 K) * matrixJordan (F j : Mat6 K) (P l : Mat6 K)) =
          jordanTrace (K := K)
            ((E' i : Mat6 K) * matrixJordan (F' j : Mat6 K) (P' l : Mat6 K)) := by
      simpa using hcell j
    have hprobe (j : Fin 3) :
        labelledProbe (f j) (a l) i = labelledProbe (f j) (a' l) i := by
      rw [labelledProbe_eq_two_split_joint (f j) (a l) (u l) (v l) i,
        labelledProbe_eq_two_split_joint (f j) (a' l) (u' l) (v' l) i]
      exact congrArg (fun x : K => 2 * x)
        (by simpa [hE i, hE' i, hF j, hF' j, hP l, hP' l] using hjoint j)
    exact ⟨hprobe 0, hprobe 1, hprobe 2⟩
  exact exists_split_actual_three_frame_jordanAut_of_labelled_probes
    E F P E' F' P' f a a' u v u' v'
    hE hE' hF hF' hP hP' hPidem hPidem' hPtrace hPtrace'
    hPsum hPsum' hfsum hf0 hf2 hf02 hf20 hprobeOpen hLabel hadj hrankTwo

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceRationalDetOneFamily.nonsing_inv_eq_specified
statement:
private theorem nonsing_inv_eq_specified (g : DetOneMatrix K) :
    g.g⁻¹ = g.gInv
proof:
:= by
  calc
    g.g⁻¹ = 1 * g.g⁻¹ := (Matrix.one_mul _).symm
    _ = (g.gInv * g.g) * g.g⁻¹ := by rw [g.gInv_mul_g]
    _ = g.gInv * (g.g * g.g⁻¹) := Matrix.mul_assoc _ _ _
    _ = g.gInv := by
      rw [Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv g.g
        (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (by simpa [g.det_g])), Matrix.mul_one]

statement:

proof:
:= by

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowQuadratic.coeff_one_eq_of_cubic_endpoints
statement:
theorem coeff_one_eq_of_cubic_endpoints
    (q : R[X]) (c d : R)
    (hqDegree : q.natDegree <= 3)
    (hqLead : q.coeff 3 = 1)
    (hqZero : q.eval 0 = -c)
    (hqNegOne : q.eval (-1) = d) :
    q.coeff 1 = q.coeff 2 - (1 + c + d)
proof:
:= by
  have hqConst : q.coeff 0 = -c := by
    exact q.coeff_zero_eq_eval_zero.trans hqZero
  have hqExpansion :=
    q.eval_eq_sum_range' (n := 4) (lt_of_le_of_lt hqDegree (by omega)) (-1)
  rw [hqNegOne] at hqExpansion
  simp [Finset.sum_range_succ, hqConst, hqLead] at hqExpansion
  linear_combination hqExpansion

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowQuadratic.eq_cubicNormalForm_of_endpoints
statement:
theorem eq_cubicNormalForm_of_endpoints
    (q : R[X]) (c d : R)
    (hqDegree : q.natDegree <= 3)
    (hqLead : q.coeff 3 = 1)
    (hqZero : q.eval 0 = -c)
    (hqNegOne : q.eval (-1) = d) :
    q = cubicNormalForm c d (q.coeff 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hqConst : q.coeff 0 = -c := by
    exact q.coeff_zero_eq_eval_zero.trans hqZero
  have hqLinear : q.coeff 1 = q.coeff 2 - (1 + c + d) :=
    coeff_one_eq_of_cubic_endpoints q c d hqDegree hqLead hqZero hqNegOne
  ext n
  by_cases h0 : n = 0
  · subst n
    simp only [cubicNormalForm, coeff_sub, coeff_add, coeff_X_pow,
      coeff_C_mul_X_pow, coeff_C_mul_X, coeff_C]
    simp [hqConst]
  by_cases h1 : n = 1
  · subst n
    simp only [cubicNormalForm, coeff_sub, coeff_add, coeff_X_pow,
      coeff_C_mul_X_pow, coeff_C_mul_X, coeff_C]
    simp [hqLinear]
  by_cases h2 : n = 2
  · subst n
    simp only [cubicNormalForm, coeff_sub, coeff_add, coeff_X_pow,
      coeff_C_mul_X_pow, coeff_C_mul_X, coeff_C]
    simp
  by_cases h3 : n = 3
  · subst n
    simp only [cubicNormalForm, coeff_sub, coeff_add, coeff_X_pow,
      coeff_C_mul_X_pow, coeff_C_mul_X, coeff_C]
    simp [hqLead]
  have hn : 3 < n := by omega
  have hqn : q.coeff n = 0 :=
    coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt (hqDegree.trans_lt hn)
  rw [hqn]
  simp only [cubicNormalForm, coeff_sub, coeff_add, coeff_X_pow,
    coeff_C_mul_X_pow, coeff_C_mul_X, coeff_C]
  simp [h0, h1, h2, h3]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowQuadratic.coeff_five_mul_of_cubic_bounds
statement:
theorem coeff_five_mul_of_cubic_bounds
    (q r : R[X])
    (hqDegree : q.natDegree <= 3)
    (hrDegree : r.natDegree <= 3) :
    (q * r).coeff 5 = q.coeff 2 * r.coeff 3 + q.coeff 3 * r.coeff 2
proof:
:= by
  have hq4 : q.coeff 4 = 0 :=
    coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt (hqDegree.trans_lt (by omega))
  have hq5 : q.coeff 5 = 0 :=
    coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt (hqDegree.trans_lt (by omega))
  have hr4 : r.coeff 4 = 0 :=
    coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt (hrDegree.trans_lt (by omega))
  have hr5 : r.coeff 5 = 0 :=
    coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt (hrDegree.trans_lt (by omega))
  rw [Polynomial.coeff_mul,
    Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_eq_sum_range_succ_mk]
  simp [Finset.sum_range_succ, hq4, hq5, hr4, hr5]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowQuadratic.coeff_four_mul_of_cubic_bounds
statement:
theorem coeff_four_mul_of_cubic_bounds
    (q r : R[X])
    (hqDegree : q.natDegree <= 3)
    (hrDegree : r.natDegree <= 3) :
    (q * r).coeff 4 =
      q.coeff 1 * r.coeff 3 + q.coeff 2 * r.coeff 2 + q.coeff 3 * r.coeff 1
proof:
:= by
  have hq4 : q.coeff 4 = 0 :=
    coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt (hqDegree.trans_lt (by omega))
  have hr4 : r.coeff 4 = 0 :=
    coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt (hrDegree.trans_lt (by omega))
  rw [Polynomial.coeff_mul,
    Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_eq_sum_range_succ_mk]
  simp [Finset.sum_range_succ, hq4, hr4]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowQuadratic.coeff_two_satisfies_quadratic_of_cubic_factorization
statement:
theorem coeff_two_satisfies_quadratic_of_cubic_factorization
    (q r p : R[X]) (c d : R)
    (hqDegree : q.natDegree <= 3)
    (hrDegree : r.natDegree <= 3)
    (hqLead : q.coeff 3 = 1)
    (hrLead : r.coeff 3 = 1)
    (hqZero : q.eval 0 = -c)
    (hrZero : r.eval 0 = -c)
    (hqNegOne : q.eval (-1) = d)
    (hrNegOne : r.eval (-1) = d)
    (hFactor : p = q * r) :
    q.coeff 2 ^ 2 - p.coeff 5 * q.coeff 2 +
        (p.coeff 4 + 2 * (1 + c + d) - p.coeff 5) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hqNormal :=
    eq_cubicNormalForm_of_endpoints q c d hqDegree hqLead hqZero hqNegOne
  have hrNormal :=
    eq_cubicNormalForm_of_endpoints r c d hrDegree hrLead hrZero hrNegOne
  have hqLinear : q.coeff 1 = q.coeff 2 - (1 + c + d) := by
    simpa [cubicNormalForm] using congrArg (fun f : R[X] => f.coeff 1) hqNormal
  have hrLinear : r.coeff 1 = r.coeff 2 - (1 + c + d) := by
    simpa [cubicNormalForm] using congrArg (fun f : R[X] => f.coeff 1) hrNormal
  have hpFive : p.coeff 5 = q.coeff 2 + r.coeff 2 := by
    rw [hFactor,
      coeff_five_mul_of_cubic_bounds q r hqDegree hrDegree,
      hqLead, hrLead]
    ring
  have hpFour :
      p.coeff 4 = q.coeff 1 + q.coeff 2 * r.coeff 2 + r.coeff 1 := by
    rw [hFactor,
      coeff_four_mul_of_cubic_bounds q r hqDegree hrDegree,
      hqLead, hrLead]
    ring
  rw [hpFive, hpFour, hqLinear, hrLinear]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertScheduleGenericComparison.unapply_point_of_native_abstract
statement:
private theorem unapply_point_of_native_abstract
    {L : Type u} [Field L] [CharZero L] [Algebra k L]
    (e : ParameterRing k →ₐ[k] L)
    (g : ResidualAction.SourceAut (K := L))
    (h : ∀ x : JCoord L,
      fieldScheduleUnapply k e 0 (structuredEquivK L x) =
        structuredEquivK L (g.linear x)) (r i : Fin 3) :
    structuredEquivK L
        (actionTriple g (fun j => scheduledFrame (fieldSchedule k e r) j) i) =
      fieldScheduleUnapply k e 0
        (mapPoint k e (scheduledPoint k r i))
proof:
:= by
  exact (congrArg (structuredEquivK L)
    (actionTriple_apply_abstract g
      (fun j => scheduledFrame (fieldSchedule k e r) j) i)).trans
    ((h (scheduledFrame (fieldSchedule k e r) i)).symm.trans
      (congrArg (fieldScheduleUnapply k e 0)
        (map_scheduledPoint_eq_fieldSchedule k e r i)).symm)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertScheduleGenericComparison.inverse_schedule_frame_abstract
statement:
private theorem inverse_schedule_frame_abstract
    {L : Type u} [Field L] [CharZero L] (Z : Schedule L) (i : Fin 3) :
    (scheduleAut Z).linear.symm (scheduledFrame Z i) =
      diagonalUnit (K := L) i
proof:
:= by
  have h : scheduledFrame Z i =
      (scheduleAut Z).linear (diagonalUnit (K := L) i) :=
    (scheduleAut_apply Z (diagonalUnit (K := L) i)).symm
  exact (congrArg (scheduleAut Z).linear.symm h).trans
    (sourceAut_inverse_cancel_abstract (scheduleAut Z)
      (diagonalUnit (K := L) i))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertScheduleGenericComparison.actionTriple_inverse_schedule_frame_abstract
statement:
private theorem actionTriple_inverse_schedule_frame_abstract
    {L : Type u} [Field L] [CharZero L] (Z : Schedule L) (i : Fin 3) :
    actionTriple (inverseSourceAut L (scheduleAut Z))
        (fun j => scheduledFrame Z j) i = diagonalUnit (K := L) i
proof:
:= by
  exact (actionTriple_apply_abstract _ _ i).trans
    ((inverseSourceAut_apply_abstract _ _).trans
      (inverse_schedule_frame_abstract Z i))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertScheduleGenericComparison.sourceEncoders_toF0Family_abstract
statement:
private theorem sourceEncoders_toF0Family_abstract
    {L : Type u} [Field L] [CharZero L]
    (P : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → JCoord L) (r : Fin 3) :
    sourceEncoders (toF0Family P) r = P r 2 - P r 0
proof:
:= by
  change (structuredEquivK L).symm
    (structuredEquivK L (P r 2) - structuredEquivK L (P r 0)) = _
  rw [← map_sub, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertScheduleGenericComparison.eq_residualTriple_abstract
statement:
private theorem eq_residualTriple_abstract
    {L : Type u} [Field L] [CharZero L]
    (s : Fin 3 → JCoord L) (a b : JCoord L)
    (h0 : s 0 = diagonal (-1) 0 1) (h1 : s 1 = a) (h2 : s 2 = b) :
    s = residualTriple a b
proof:
:= by
  funext r
  fin_cases r
  · exact h0
  · exact h1
  · exact h2

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertScheduleGenericComparison.charZero_of_injective_map
statement:
private theorem charZero_of_injective_map
    {R L : Type u} [CommRing R] [CharZero R] [Field L]
    (f : R →+* L) (hf : Injective f) : CharZero L where
  cast_injective m n h
proof:
:= Nat.cast_injective (R := R)
    (hf (by simpa only [map_natCast] using h))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertScheduleGenericComparison.embeddedLedger_eq_rawEvaluation
statement:
private theorem embeddedLedger_eq_rawEvaluation :
    embeddedLedger k =
      { P := fun i j =>
          evaluationAlong (algebraMap k (ComparisonField k)) (scheduledFamily k)
            (pairP k i j)
        Q := fun j l =>
          evaluationAlong (algebraMap k (ComparisonField k)) (scheduledFamily k)
            (pairQ k j l)
        R := fun l i =>
          evaluationAlong (algebraMap k (ComparisonField k)) (scheduledFamily k)
            (pairR k l i)
        C0 := fun i j l =>
          evaluationAlong (algebraMap k (ComparisonField k)) (scheduledFamily k)
            (centeredTriple k i j l) }
proof:
:= by
  rw [LabelledLedger.mk.injEq]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · funext i j
    change fractionEmbedding k
        (algebraMap (ReducedCoordinateRing k) (RawFunctionField k)
          (toReduced k (pairP k i j))) = _
    rw [fractionEmbedding_algebraMap]
    exact reducedComparisonMap_mk k (pairP k i j)
  · funext j l
    change fractionEmbedding k
        (algebraMap (ReducedCoordinateRing k) (RawFunctionField k)
          (toReduced k (pairQ k j l))) = _
    rw [fractionEmbedding_algebraMap]
    exact reducedComparisonMap_mk k (pairQ k j l)
  · funext l i
    change fractionEmbedding k
        (algebraMap (ReducedCoordinateRing k) (RawFunctionField k)
          (toReduced k (pairR k l i))) = _
    rw [fractionEmbedding_algebraMap]
    exact reducedComparisonMap_mk k (pairR k l i)
  · funext i j l
    change fractionEmbedding k
        (algebraMap (ReducedCoordinateRing k) (RawFunctionField k)
          (toReduced k (centeredTriple k i j l))) = _
    rw [fractionEmbedding_algebraMap]
    exact reducedComparisonMap_mk k (centeredTriple k i j l)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertScheduleGenericComparison.scheduledLedger_eq_source
statement:
private theorem scheduledLedger_eq_source :
    { P := fun i j =>
        evaluationAlong (algebraMap k (ComparisonField k)) (scheduledFamily k)
          (pairP k i j)
      Q := fun j l =>
        evaluationAlong (algebraMap k (ComparisonField k)) (scheduledFamily k)
          (pairQ k j l)
      R := fun l i =>
        evaluationAlong (algebraMap k (ComparisonField k)) (scheduledFamily k)
          (pairR k l i)
      C0 := fun i j l =>
        evaluationAlong (algebraMap k (ComparisonField k)) (scheduledFamily k)
          (centeredTriple k i j l) } =
      sourceLabelledLedger (scheduledSources k)
proof:
:= by
  have h := evaluation_rawLabelledLedger_eq_tau
    (k := k) (L := ComparisonField k)
    (algebraMap k (ComparisonField k)) (scheduledFamily k)
    (fieldF0Family_raw k (parameterEmbedding k))
  rw [labelledLedger_mapTriple] at h
  exact h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertScheduleGenericComparison.comparisonDetector_standard
statement:
private theorem comparisonDetector_standard :
    sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1)
        (comparisonA k) (comparisonB k) =
      sourceDetector (comparisonSources k 0)
        (comparisonSources k 1) (comparisonSources k 2)
proof:
:= by

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertScheduleGenericComparison.comparisonDetector_invariant
statement:
private theorem comparisonDetector_invariant :
    sourceDetector (comparisonSources k 0)
        (comparisonSources k 1) (comparisonSources k 2) =
      sourceDetector (scheduledSources k 0)
        (scheduledSources k 1) (scheduledSources k 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [comparisonSources_apply k 0, comparisonSources_apply k 1,
    comparisonSources_apply k 2]
  exact sourceDetector_invariant (comparisonAction k)
    (scheduledSources k 0) (scheduledSources k 1)
    (scheduledSources k 2)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertScheduleGenericComparison.comparisonDetector_evaluation
statement:
private theorem comparisonDetector_evaluation :
    sourceDetector (scheduledSources k 0)
        (scheduledSources k 1) (scheduledSources k 2) =
      evaluationAlong (algebraMap k (ComparisonField k)) (scheduledFamily k)
        (rawDetector k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [scheduledSources_apply k 0, scheduledSources_apply k 1,
    scheduledSources_apply k 2]
  exact (evaluation_rawDetector
    (k := k) (L := ComparisonField k)
    (algebraMap k (ComparisonField k)) (scheduledFamily k)).symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertScheduleGenericComparison.comparisonEvaluation_detector
statement:
private theorem comparisonEvaluation_detector :
    evaluationAlong (algebraMap k (ComparisonField k)) (scheduledFamily k)
        (rawDetector k) =
      fractionEmbedding k (detectorValue k)
proof:
:= by
  exact (fractionEmbedding_rawToFunction k (rawDetector k)).symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertScheduleGenericComparison.comparison_detector
statement:
theorem comparison_detector :
    sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1)
        (comparisonA k) (comparisonB k) =
      fractionEmbedding k (detectorValue k)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1)
        (comparisonA k) (comparisonB k) =
        sourceDetector (comparisonSources k 0)
          (comparisonSources k 1) (comparisonSources k 2) :=
      comparisonDetector_standard k
    _ = sourceDetector (scheduledSources k 0)
          (scheduledSources k 1) (scheduledSources k 2) :=
      comparisonDetector_invariant k
    _ = evaluationAlong (algebraMap k (ComparisonField k)) (scheduledFamily k)
          (rawDetector k) := comparisonDetector_evaluation k
    _ = fractionEmbedding k (detectorValue k) :=
      comparisonEvaluation_detector k

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexNormalizedTripleCore.trace_diagonalUnit_frameOfInvertible
statement:
theorem trace_diagonalUnit_frameOfInvertible (X : Mat3 K)
    (i j : Fin 3) :
    Matrix.trace (diagonalUnit i * frameOfInvertible X j) = overlapOf X i j
proof:
:= by
  rw [trace_diagonalUnit]
  fin_cases j <;> simp [frameOfInvertible, ComplexRow.GLFrame.conjugate, overlapOf,
    Matrix.mul_apply, diagonalUnit, Fin.sum_univ_succ]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexNormalizedTripleCore.primitiveEncoder_labels
statement:
theorem primitiveEncoder_labels (P : Fin 3 → Mat3 K) (hP : FrameLaws P) :
    HasProjectorLabels (primitiveMatrixEncoder P) (fun i => embed (P i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [primitiveMatrixEncoder, ← embed_sub_matrix]
  exact hasProjectorLabels_of_matrixFrame P hP

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexNormalizedTripleCore.overlap_eq_of_primitiveLedger_eq
statement:
theorem overlap_eq_of_primitiveLedger_eq
    (A B : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Mat3 K)
    (hA : ∀ r, FrameLaws (A r)) (hB : ∀ r, FrameLaws (B r))
    (hA0 : A 0 = diagonalFrame) (hB0 : B 0 = diagonalFrame)
    (X Y : Mat3 K) (hA1 : A 1 = frameOfInvertible X)
    (hB1 : B 1 = frameOfInvertible Y)
    (hledger : labelledLedger (primitiveMatrixTauTriple A) =
      labelledLedger (primitiveMatrixTauTriple B)) :
    ∀ i j, overlapOf Y i j = overlapOf X i j
proof:
:= by
  intro i j
  have hp := congrArg (fun L : LabelledLedger K => L.P i j) hledger
  simp only [labelledLedger, primitiveMatrixTauTriple] at hp
  rw [primitiveEncoder_labels (A 0) (hA 0) i,
    primitiveEncoder_labels (A 1) (hA 1) j,
    primitiveEncoder_labels (B 0) (hB 0) i,
    primitiveEncoder_labels (B 1) (hB 1) j] at hp
  rw [trace_embed_pair, trace_embed_pair, hA0, hB0, hA1, hB1] at hp
  simp only [diagonalFrame, trace_diagonalUnit_frameOfInvertible] at hp
  exact hp.symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexNormalizedTripleCore.primitiveLedger_mapFamily
statement:
theorem primitiveLedger_mapFamily (e : Mat3 K ≃ₗ[K] Mat3 K)
    (he : LedgerSymmetry e) (A : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Mat3 K) :
    labelledLedger (primitiveMatrixTauTriple (mapFamily e A)) =
      labelledLedger (primitiveMatrixTauTriple A)
proof:
:=
  ComplexRow.M3LedgerInvariance.primitiveLedger_invariant
    e he.one he.jordan he.trace A

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexNormalizedTripleCore.diagonal_encoder_eq_grading
statement:
theorem diagonal_encoder_eq_grading :
    encoder (diagonalFrame 0 : Mat3 K) (diagonalFrame 2) = grading
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    norm_num [encoder, diagonalFrame, diagonalUnit, grading, Fin.ext_iff]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexNormalizedTripleCore.primitiveEncoder_embed
statement:
private theorem primitiveEncoder_embed (P : Fin 3 → Mat3 K) :
    primitiveMatrixEncoder P = embed (encoder (P 0) (P 2))
proof:
:=
  (embed_sub_matrix (P 2) (P 0)).symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexNormalizedTripleCore.thirdFrame_eq_after_ledger_symmetry
statement:
theorem thirdFrame_eq_after_ledger_symmetry
    (A B : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Mat3 K)
    (hA : ∀ r, FrameLaws (A r)) (hB : ∀ r, FrameLaws (B r))
    (e : Mat3 K ≃ₗ[K] Mat3 K) (he : LedgerSymmetry e)
    (heLaws : ∀ r, FrameLaws (mapFamily e A r))
    (hfirst : mapFamily e A 0 = diagonalFrame)
    (hsecond : mapFamily e A 1 = B 1)
    (hBfirst : B 0 = diagonalFrame)
    (hdet : Matrix.det
      (grading * encoder (B 1 0) (B 1 2) -
        encoder (B 1 0) (B 1 2) * grading) ≠ 0)
    (hledger : labelledLedger (primitiveMatrixTauTriple A) =
      labelledLedger (primitiveMatrixTauTriple B)) :
    mapFamily e A 2 = B 2
proof:
:= by
  have hled : labelledLedger (primitiveMatrixTauTriple (mapFamily e A)) =
      labelledLedger (primitiveMatrixTauTriple B) :=
    (primitiveLedger_mapFamily e he A).trans hledger
  have hdiag : TauFrame (fun i => embed (diagonalUnit i : Mat3 K)) := by
    change TauFrame (fun i => embed (diagonalFrame i))
    rw [← hBfirst]
    exact embedded_tauFrame _ (hB 0)
  have htripleA : primitiveMatrixTauTriple (mapFamily e A) =
      matrixLedgerTriple (B 1) (mapFamily e A 2) := by
    funext r
    fin_cases r
    · change primitiveMatrixEncoder (mapFamily e A 0) = embed grading
      rw [hfirst, primitiveEncoder_embed, diagonal_encoder_eq_grading]
    · change primitiveMatrixEncoder (mapFamily e A 1) =
        embed (encoder (B 1 0) (B 1 2))
      rw [hsecond, primitiveEncoder_embed]
    · exact primitiveEncoder_embed (mapFamily e A 2)
  have htripleB : primitiveMatrixTauTriple B =
      matrixLedgerTriple (B 1) (B 2) := by
    funext r
    fin_cases r
    · change primitiveMatrixEncoder (B 0) = embed grading
      rw [hBfirst, primitiveEncoder_embed, diagonal_encoder_eq_grading]
    · exact primitiveEncoder_embed (B 1)
    · exact primitiveEncoder_embed (B 2)
  apply thirdFrame_eq_of_tauFrames (B 1) (mapFamily e A 2) (B 2)
      hdiag (embedded_tauFrame _ (hB 1)) (embedded_tauFrame _ (heLaws 2))
      (embedded_tauFrame _ (hB 2)) (hB 1).sum_eq_one
      (encoder_square_of_orthogonal (B 1 0) (B 1 2)
        ((hB 1).idempotent 0) ((hB 1).idempotent 2)
        ((hB 1).orthogonal 0 2 (by decide))
        ((hB 1).orthogonal 2 0 (by decide))) hdet
  rw [← htripleA, ← htripleB]
  exact hled

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceEvenRawTransport.genericReducedEmbedding_injective
statement:
theorem genericReducedEmbedding_injective (phi : FF k →+* K) :
    Function.Injective (genericReducedEmbedding k K phi)
proof:
:= by
  exact (IsFractionRing.injective (RR K) (FF K)).comp
    (reducedCoefficientMap_injective k K phi)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceEvenRawTransport.fractionCoefficientEmbedding_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp] theorem fractionCoefficientEmbedding_algebraMap
    (phi : FF k →+* K) (x : RR k) :
    fractionCoefficientEmbedding k K phi
        (algebraMap (RR k) (FF k) x) = genericReducedEmbedding k K phi x
proof:
:= by
  exact IsFractionRing.lift_algebraMap
    (genericReducedEmbedding_injective k K phi) x

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceEvenRawTransport.genericField_cleared_sourceEven_identity
statement:
theorem genericField_cleared_sourceEven_identity
    (phi : FF k →+* K)
    (a b : CR k) (hb : rawToFunction k b ≠ 0)
    (hinv : IsSourceInvariant k
      (rawToFunction k a / rawToFunction k b))
    (A B : VCoord (FF K)) (rho : FF K)
    (hA : nV A ≠ 0) (hB : nV B ≠ 0)
    (hroot : rho ^ 2 = nV A * nV B) (hrho : rho ≠ 0)
    (Q : AlbertLean.Triality.ParityEvenFourFactor.FourFixedParityFactorization
      A B rho hA hB hroot hrho) :
    sourceEvenSubstitution k (fractionCoefficientEmbedding k K phi)
        A B rho hA hB hroot hrho a *
      fractionCoefficientEmbedding k K phi (rawToFunction k b) =
    fractionCoefficientEmbedding k K phi (rawToFunction k a) *
      sourceEvenSubstitution k (fractionCoefficientEmbedding k K phi)
        A B rho hA hB hroot hrho b
proof:
:= by
  exact extension_cleared_sourceEven_identity k a b hb hinv
    (fractionCoefficientEmbedding k K phi) A B rho hA hB hroot hrho Q

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceEvenRawTransport.fractionCoefficientEmbedding_raw
statement:
@[simp] theorem fractionCoefficientEmbedding_raw
    (phi : FF k →+* K) (p : CR k) :
    fractionCoefficientEmbedding k K phi (rawToFunction k p) =
      algebraMap (RR K) (FF K)
        (reducedCoefficientMap k K phi (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ p))
proof:
:= by
  exact fractionCoefficientEmbedding_algebraMap k K phi
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ p)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceEvenRawTransport.fractionCoefficientEmbedding_universal
statement:
theorem fractionCoefficientEmbedding_universal
    (phi : FF k →+* K) (r i : Fin 3) :
    (fun c => fractionCoefficientEmbedding k K phi
      (SourceFractionActionUniversalF0.universalF0 k r i c)) =
        SourceFractionActionUniversalF0.universalF0 K r i
proof:
:= by
  funext c
  change fractionCoefficientEmbedding k K phi
      (rawToFunction k (universalVector (k := k) r i c)) =
    rawToFunction K (universalVector (k := K) r i c)
  rw [fractionCoefficientEmbedding_raw]
  change algebraMap (RR K) (FF K)
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (polynomialCoefficientMap k K
        (originalCoefficientEmbedding k K phi)
        (universalVector (k := k) r i c))) = _
  rw [polynomialCoefficientMap_universalVector]
  rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceEvenRawTransport.baseLinear_structured'
statement:
private theorem baseLinear_structured'
    {L : Type*} [Field L] [CharZero L]
    (g : SourceAut (K := L)) (x : JCoord L) :
    baseLinear g (structuredEquivK L x) =
      structuredEquivK L (g.linear x)
proof:
:= by
  change structuredEquivK L
    (g.linear ((structuredEquivK L).symm (structuredEquivK L x))) = _
  rw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceEvenRawTransport.extended_linear_of_natural'
statement:
theorem extended_linear_of_natural'
    {L : Type*} [Field L] [CharZero L] [Algebra K L]
    [Invertible (2 : L)]
    (gK : SourceAut (K := K)) (gL : SourceAut (K := L))
    (hn : ∀ x : JCoord K,
      SourceCoefficientMap.mapSource (algebraMap K L) (gK.linear x) =
        gL.linear (SourceCoefficientMap.mapSource (algebraMap K L) x)) :
    (linearEquiv (R := L) gK).toLinearMap = baseLinear gL
proof:
:= by
  apply (Pi.basisFun L (Fin 27)).ext
  intro c
  simp only [Pi.basisFun_apply]
  rw [← mapCoord_single (k := K) (R := L) c]
  change linear (R := L) gK
      (mapCoord (algebraMap K L) (Pi.single c 1)) = _
  rw [linearEquiv_on_constants]
  let x := (structuredEquivK K).symm (Pi.single c 1)
  change (algebraMap K L) ∘ structuredEquivK K (gK.linear x) = _
  have hmap (y : JCoord K) :
      structuredEquivK L (SourceCoefficientMap.mapSource (algebraMap K L) y) =
        (algebraMap K L) ∘ structuredEquivK K y := by
    exact LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply (structuredEquivK L) _
  rw [← hmap (gK.linear x)]
  refine (congrArg (structuredEquivK L) (hn x)).trans ?_
  have hx :
      structuredEquivK L (SourceCoefficientMap.mapSource (algebraMap K L) x) =
        mapCoord (algebraMap K L) (Pi.single c 1) := by
    rw [hmap]
    rw [show structuredEquivK K x = Pi.single c 1 from
      LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply _ _]
    rfl
  rw [← hx, baseLinear_structured']

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceEvenRawTransport.genericSourceSubstitution_eq_actual
statement:
theorem genericSourceSubstitution_eq_actual
    (phi : FF k →+* K) (j : FF K →+* L)
    (hj : ∀ a : K, j (algebraMap K (FF K) a) = algebraMap K L a)
    (gK : SourceAut (K := K)) (gL : SourceAut (K := L))
    (hn : ∀ x : JCoord K,
      SourceCoefficientMap.mapSource (algebraMap K L) (gK.linear x) =
        gL.linear (SourceCoefficientMap.mapSource (algebraMap K L) x)) :
    genericSourceSubstitution k (j.comp (fractionCoefficientEmbedding k K phi)) gL =
      (j.comp (algebraMap (RR K) (FF K))).comp
        ((reducedAction K gK).toRingHom.comp
          ((reducedCoefficientMap k K phi).comp
            (Ideal.Quotient.mk (rawFrameIdeal (k := k)).radical)))
proof:
:= by
  have hlin := extended_linear_of_natural' K gK gL hn
  have hnat (x : Fin 27 → FF K) :
      (fun c => j (linearEquiv (R := FF K) gK x c)) =
        linearEquiv (R := L) gK (fun c => j (x c)) := by
    funext c
    rw [linearEquiv_apply_coordinate, linearEquiv_apply_coordinate]
    simp only [map_sum, map_mul, hj]
  apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
  · intro a
    simp only [genericSourceSubstitution, MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_C,
      RingHom.comp_apply]
    change j (fractionCoefficientEmbedding k K phi
        (algebraMap k (FF k) a)) = _
    change j (fractionCoefficientEmbedding k K phi
        (rawToFunction k (MvPolynomial.C a))) = _
    rw [fractionCoefficientEmbedding_raw]
    simp only [reducedCoefficientMap, reducedCoefficientMapOf_mk,
      polynomialCoefficientMap_C]
    change j (algebraMap (RR K) (FF K)
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (MvPolynomial.C (originalCoefficientEmbedding k K phi a)))) =
      j (algebraMap (RR K) (FF K)
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (SourceRawAutomorphism.rawAction K gK
          (MvPolynomial.C (originalCoefficientEmbedding k K phi a)))))
    simp [SourceRawAutomorphism.rawAction]
  · intro q
    cases q with
    | entry r i c =>
      have hinput :
          (fun d => (j.comp (fractionCoefficientEmbedding k K phi))
            (SourceFractionActionUniversalF0.universalF0 k r i d)) =
          (fun d => j (SourceFractionActionUniversalF0.universalF0 K r i d)) := by
        funext d
        exact congrArg j (congrFun
          (fractionCoefficientEmbedding_universal k K phi r i) d)
      have hright :
          algebraMap (RR K) (FF K)
            (reducedAction K gK (reducedCoefficientMap k K phi
              (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (universalVector (k := k) r i c)))) =
          linearEquiv (R := FF K) gK
            (SourceFractionActionUniversalF0.universalF0 K r i) c := by
        calc
          _ = fractionAction K gK
              (SourceFractionActionUniversalF0.universalF0 K r i c) := by
            rw [SourceFractionActionUniversalF0.universalF0,
              Function.comp_apply, SourceFractionActionUniversalF0.rawToFunction,
              RingHom.comp_apply,
              SourceFractionActionUniversalF0.fractionAction_algebraMap_reduced]
            apply congrArg (fun z : RR K =>
              algebraMap (RR K) (FF K) (reducedAction K gK z))
            change Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (polynomialCoefficientMap k K
              (originalCoefficientEmbedding k K phi)
              (universalVector (k := k) r i c)) =
                Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (universalVector (k := K) r i c)
            rw [polynomialCoefficientMap_universalVector]
          _ = _ := congrFun
            (SourceFractionActionUniversalF0.fractionAction_universalF0 K gK r i) c
      simp only [genericSourceSubstitution, MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_X',
        RingHom.comp_apply]
      change baseLinear gL
        (fun d => (j.comp (fractionCoefficientEmbedding k K phi))
          (SourceFractionActionUniversalF0.universalF0 k r i d)) c =
        j (algebraMap (RR K) (FF K)
          (reducedAction K gK (reducedCoefficientMap k K phi
            (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (universalVector (k := k) r i c)))))
      rw [hinput, hright]
      have hn' := congrFun
        (hnat (SourceFractionActionUniversalF0.universalF0 K r i)) c
      have he := congrArg (fun m : (Fin 27 → L) →ₗ[L] (Fin 27 → L) =>
          m (fun d => j (SourceFractionActionUniversalF0.universalF0 K r i d)) c)
        hlin
      exact he.symm.trans hn'.symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceEvenRawTransport.reduced_cleared_sourceEven_identity
statement:
theorem reduced_cleared_sourceEven_identity
    (phi : FF k →+* K)
    (a b : CR k) (hb : rawToFunction k b ≠ 0)
    (hinv : FixedParityInvariantTransport.IsSourceInvariant k
      (rawToFunction k a / rawToFunction k b))
    (A B : VCoord K) (rho : K)
    (hA : nV A ≠ 0) (hB : nV B ≠ 0)
    (hroot : rho ^ 2 = nV A * nV B) (hrho : rho ≠ 0) :
    actualEvenRawAction K A B rho hA hB hroot hrho
        (reducedCoefficientMap k K phi (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ a)) *
      reducedCoefficientMap k K phi (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ b) =
    reducedCoefficientMap k K phi (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ a) *
      actualEvenRawAction K A B rho hA hB hroot hrho
        (reducedCoefficientMap k K phi (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ b))
proof:
:= by
  let iK : K →+* FF K := algebraMap K (FF K)
  let A0 := SourceVectorCoefficientMap.mapV iK A
  let B0 := SourceVectorCoefficientMap.mapV iK B
  let rho0 := iK rho
  have hA0 : nV A0 ≠ 0 := by simpa [A0] using iK.injective.ne hA
  have hB0 : nV B0 ≠ 0 := by simpa [B0] using iK.injective.ne hB
  have hr0 : rho0 ^ 2 = nV A0 * nV B0 := by
    simpa [A0, B0, rho0] using congrArg iK hroot
  have hp0 : rho0 ≠ 0 := by simpa [rho0] using iK.injective.ne hrho
  obtain ⟨R, cR, ⟨Q⟩⟩ :=
    AlbertLean.Triality.ParityEvenFourFactor.exists_oneRoot_four_fixedParity
      A0 B0 rho0 hA0 hB0 hr0 hp0
  letI : CharZero R.Carrier := cR
  let j : FF K →+* R.Carrier := R.embedding
  let beta : K →+* R.Carrier := j.comp iK
  letI : Algebra K R.Carrier := beta.toAlgebra
  letI : Invertible (2 : R.Carrier) := invertibleOfNonzero (by norm_num)
  let Ae := SourceVectorCoefficientMap.mapV beta A
  let Be := SourceVectorCoefficientMap.mapV beta B
  let rhoe := beta rho
  have hAe : nV Ae ≠ 0 := by simpa [Ae] using beta.injective.ne hA
  have hBe : nV Be ≠ 0 := by simpa [Be] using beta.injective.ne hB
  have hre : rhoe ^ 2 = nV Ae * nV Be := by
    simpa [Ae, Be, rhoe] using congrArg beta hroot
  have hpe : rhoe ≠ 0 := by simpa [rhoe] using beta.injective.ne hrho
  have Qe : AlbertLean.Triality.ParityEvenFourFactor.FourFixedParityFactorization
      Ae Be rhoe hAe hBe hre hpe := by
    simpa only [Ae, Be, rhoe, beta, A0, B0, rho0, j,
      SourceVectorCoefficientMap.mapV_comp, RingHom.comp_apply] using Q
  let gK := evenSourceAut A B rho hA hB hroot hrho
  let gE := evenSourceAut Ae Be rhoe hAe hBe hre hpe
  have hn : ∀ x : JCoord K,
      SourceCoefficientMap.mapSource (algebraMap K R.Carrier) (gK.linear x) =
        gE.linear (SourceCoefficientMap.mapSource (algebraMap K R.Carrier) x) := by
    intro x
    change SourceCoefficientMap.mapSource beta (gK.linear x) =
      gE.linear (SourceCoefficientMap.mapSource beta x)
    rw [← AlbertLean.Triality.RationalEvenFamilyNaturality.mapJ_eq_mapSource,
      ← AlbertLean.Triality.RationalEvenFamilyNaturality.mapJ_eq_mapSource]
    change AlbertLean.Triality.RationalEvenFamilyNaturality.mapJ beta
      (AlbertLean.Triality.SourceEvenAutomorphism.evenJEquiv
        A B rho hA hB hroot hrho x) =
      AlbertLean.Triality.SourceEvenAutomorphism.evenJEquiv
        Ae Be rhoe hAe hBe hre hpe
        (AlbertLean.Triality.RationalEvenFamilyNaturality.mapJ beta x)
    exact AlbertLean.Triality.RationalEvenFamilyNaturality.map_evenJEquiv
      beta A B rho hA hB hroot hrho x
  let theta := j.comp (fractionCoefficientEmbedding k K phi)
  have hclear := extension_cleared_sourceEven_identity k a b hb hinv
    theta Ae Be rhoe hAe hBe hre hpe Qe
  have hsub : sourceEvenSubstitution k theta Ae Be rhoe hAe hBe hre hpe =
      genericSourceSubstitution k theta gE := rfl
  rw [hsub] at hclear
  have hsquare := genericSourceSubstitution_eq_actual k K phi j
    (fun _ => rfl) gK gE hn
  have hsa := DFunLike.congr_fun hsquare a
  have hsb := DFunLike.congr_fun hsquare b
  have hbase (p : CR k) :
      theta (SourceFractionActionUniversalF0.rawToFunction k p) =
      j (algebraMap (RR K) (FF K)
        (reducedCoefficientMap k K phi (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ p))) := by
    exact congrArg j (fractionCoefficientEmbedding_raw k K phi p)
  rw [hsa, hsb, hbase a, hbase b] at hclear
  apply IsFractionRing.injective (RR K) (FF K)
  apply j.injective
  simpa only [RingHom.comp_apply, map_mul, RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe,
    RingEquiv.coe_toRingHom, actualEvenRawAction, gK] using hclear

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceVectorPairReflection.reflectV_add
statement:
theorem reflectV_add (a v w : VCoord K) :
    reflectV a (v + w) = reflectV a v + reflectV a w
proof:
:= by
  rw [reflectV, reflectV, reflectV, BV_add_right, add_div]
  module

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceVectorPairReflection.reflectV_smul
statement:
theorem reflectV_smul (a v : VCoord K) (k : K) :
    reflectV a (k • v) = k • reflectV a v
proof:
:= by

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceVectorPairReflection.reflectVLinear_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem reflectVLinear_apply (a v : VCoord K) :
    reflectVLinear a v = reflectV a v
proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceVectorPairReflection.BV_reflectV
statement:
theorem BV_reflectV (a v w : VCoord K) (ha : nV a ≠ 0) :
    BV (reflectV a v) (reflectV a w) = BV v w
proof:
:= by
  have hvw := nV_reflectV a (v + w) ha
  rw [reflectV_add, nV_add, nV_add,
    nV_reflectV a v ha, nV_reflectV a w ha] at hvw
  linear_combination hvw

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceVectorPairReflection.reflectV_eq_of_orthogonal
statement:
theorem reflectV_eq_of_orthogonal (a v : VCoord K)

proof:
:= by

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceVectorPairReflection.BV_orthogonalRemainder
statement:
theorem BV_orthogonalRemainder (y₁ y₂ : VCoord K)
    (hy₁ : nV y₁ ≠ 0) :
    BV y₁ (orthogonalRemainder y₁ y₂) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [orthogonalRemainder, sub_eq_add_neg, ← neg_smul, BV_add_right,
    BV_smul_right, projectionCoeff, BV_self_eq_two_nV]
  field_simp [hy₁]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceVectorPairReflection.nV_orthogonalRemainder_identity
statement:
theorem nV_orthogonalRemainder_identity (y₁ y₂ : VCoord K)
    (hy₁ : nV y₁ ≠ 0) :
    4 * nV y₁ * nV (orthogonalRemainder y₁ y₂) =
      4 * nV y₁ * nV y₂ - (BV y₁ y₂) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [orthogonalRemainder, nV_sub, nV_smul, BV_smul_right,
    BV_symmetric y₂ y₁, projectionCoeff]
  field_simp [hy₁]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceVectorPairReflection.nV_orthogonalRemainder_ne_zero
statement:
theorem nV_orthogonalRemainder_ne_zero (y₁ y₂ : VCoord K)
    (hy₁ : nV y₁ ≠ 0)
    (hGram : 4 * nV y₁ * nV y₂ - (BV y₁ y₂) ^ 2 ≠ 0) :
    nV (orthogonalRemainder y₁ y₂) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hu
  apply hGram
  rw [← nV_orthogonalRemainder_identity y₁ y₂ hy₁, hu]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FieldPointOpenWitness.not_isNilpotent_of_injective_witness
statement:
theorem not_isNilpotent_of_injective_witness
    (i : B →+* C) (hi : Function.Injective i)
    (w : B →+* L) (d : B) (hd : w d ≠ 0) :
    ¬ IsNilpotent (i d)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
  have hb : d ^ n = 0 := hi (by simpa only [map_pow, map_zero] using hn)
  have hw : (w d) ^ n = 0 := by
    simpa only [map_pow, map_zero] using congrArg w hb
  exact hd (show IsNilpotent (w d) from ⟨n, hw⟩).eq_zero

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FieldPointOpenWitness.exists_field_point_of_injective_witness
statement:
theorem exists_field_point_of_injective_witness
    (i : B →+* C) (hi : Function.Injective i)
    (w : B →+* L) (d : B) (hd : w d ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (E : Type u) (_ : Field E) (f : C →+* E), f (i d) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra h
  apply not_isNilpotent_of_injective_witness i hi w d hd
  apply FieldPointNilpotence.isNilpotent_of_forall_field_maps_zero
  intro E hE f
  by_contra hf
  exact h ⟨E, hE, f, hf⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericDetectorFamily.map_family
statement:
theorem map_family {D E : Type*} [CommRing D] [Algebra ℚ D]
    [CommRing E] [Algebra ℚ E] (e : CoefficientRing k →+* D) (f : D →+* E)
    (M : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) D) (t u : D) :
    f (family k e M t u) = family k (f.comp e) (M.map f) (f t) (f u)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [family, map_normalized, map_one, RingHom.comp_apply]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericDetectorFamily.j_comp_coefficient
statement: theorem j_comp_coefficient : (j k).comp (coefficient k) = ambientCoefficient k
proof:
:= by
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro p
  exact j_coefficient k p

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericDetectorFamily.genericValue_eq_family
statement:
theorem genericValue_eq_family : genericValue k =
    family k (ambientCoefficient k) ((rationalM k).map (includeBase k))
      (T (Base k)) (T (Base k))⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have h := normalized_source (genericChart k)
    (GenericNormalizedFrameChart.moment (fieldParameters k))
    (T (Base k)) (T (Base k))⁻¹
  change _ = genericValue k at h
  rw [← h, fieldParameters_moment]
  unfold family
  congr 1
  · funext i
    fin_cases i <;>
      simp [diagonalA, ambientCoefficient, GenericDeterminantOpen.dA2,
        genericChart, GenericNormalizedFrameChart.insert, ChartBridge.chartWithResidualPair,
        GenericNormalizedFrameChart.dA2, genericOpen, fieldParameters, baseParameters]
  · funext i
    fin_cases i <;>
      simp [diagonalB, ambientCoefficient, GenericDeterminantOpen.dB2,
        genericChart, GenericNormalizedFrameChart.insert, ChartBridge.chartWithResidualPair,
        GenericNormalizedFrameChart.dB2, genericOpen, fieldParameters, baseParameters]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericDetectorFamily.j_value
statement: theorem j_value : j k (value k) = genericValue k
proof:
:= by
  rw [value, map_family, j_comp_coefficient, j_localMoment, j_root, j_inverseRoot,
    genericValue_eq_family]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericDetectorFamily.deck_coefficient
statement:
private theorem deck_coefficient :
    (deck k).toRingHom.comp (ambientCoefficient k) = ambientCoefficient k
proof:
:= by
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro p
  exact deck_base k (ι k p)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericDetectorFamily.deck_moment
proof:
:= by
  ext i l
  exact deck_base k (rationalM k i l)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericDetectorFamily.j_mate
statement: theorem j_mate : j k (mate k) = deck k (genericValue k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mate, map_family, j_comp_coefficient, j_localMoment]
  simp only [map_mul, j_localDeterminant, j_inverseRoot, j_root, j_inverseDeterminant]
  rw [genericValue_eq_family]
  change _ = (deck k).toRingHom (family k _ _ _ _)
  rw [map_family, deck_coefficient, deck_moment]
  have ht : deck k (T (Base k)) = includeBase k (Matrix.det (rationalM k)) / T (Base k) :=
    deck_Delta k
  simp only [RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe, map_inv₀, ht,
    div_eq_mul_inv, _root_.mul_inv_rev, inv_inv]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowAdjugateSystem.componentSolution_of_adjugate_equations
statement:
theorem componentSolution_of_adjugate_equations
    (a b c : Fin 3 → Mat3 K)
    (hb : ∀ i, (b i).det ≠ 0)
    (heq : ∀ i, (a i).adjugate = b i * c i ∧
      (c i).adjugate = a i * b i ∧ (b i).adjugate = c i * a i)
    (hbsum : b 0 + b 1 + b 2 = 0) (hcsum : c 0 + c 1 + c 2 = 0)
    (hden : (reconstructionDenominator (componentU (a 0) (a 1) (a 2))
      (componentV (a 0) (a 1)) ((a 1).det / (a 0).det) ((a 2).det / (a 0).det)
      (Matrix.trace (normalizedX (a 0) (b 0) (b 1)))).det ≠ 0) :
    ComponentSolution (a 0) (a 1) (a 2) (normalizedX (a 0) (b 0) (b 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hp (i : Fin 3) :=
    (FourRowAdjoint.parametrized_iff_adjugate_equations (a i) (b i) (c i) (hb i)).mpr
      (heq i)
  have ha (i : Fin 3) : (a i).det ≠ 0 := (hp i).1 ▸ hb i
  apply componentSolution_of_raw (a 0) (a 1) (a 2) (b 0) (b 1) (b 2)
    (ha 0) (ha 1) (ha 2) (hp 0).1 (hp 1).1 (hp 2).1 hbsum _ hden
  simpa only [cslotSum, ← (hp 0).2, ← (hp 1).2, ← (hp 2).2] using hcsum

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowAdjugateSystem.adjugate_equations_of_componentSolution
statement:
theorem adjugate_equations_of_componentSolution
    (a0 a1 a2 X : Mat3 K)
    (ha0 : a0.det ≠ 0) (ha1 : a1.det ≠ 0) (ha2 : a2.det ≠ 0)
    (hX : ComponentSolution a0 a1 a2 X) :
    let a : Fin 3 → Mat3 K
proof:
:= ![a0, a1, a2]
    let b : Fin 3 → Mat3 K := ![a0, X * a0, -(1 + X) * a0]
    let c : Fin 3 → Mat3 K := fun i => (b i)⁻¹ * (a i).adjugate
    (∀ i, (a i).adjugate = b i * c i ∧
      (c i).adjugate = a i * b i ∧ (b i).adjugate = c i * a i) ∧
      b 0 + b 1 + b 2 = 0 ∧ c 0 + c 1 + c 2 = 0 := by
  dsimp only
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    fin_cases i
    · exact FourRowAdjoint.parametrized_adjugate_equations a0 a0 ha0 rfl
    · exact FourRowAdjoint.parametrized_adjugate_equations a1 (X * a0)
        (hX.det_b1 ▸ ha1) hX.det_b1
    · exact FourRowAdjoint.parametrized_adjugate_equations a2 (-(1 + X) * a0)
        (hX.det_b2 ▸ ha2) hX.det_b2
  · change a0 + X * a0 + -(1 + X) * a0 = 0
    simp only [neg_mul, add_mul, one_mul]
    abel
  · exact hX.inverse_adjugate_sum

proof:

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericDetectorSeparationCharZero.evalLocal_value
statement: theorem evalLocal_value : evalLocal k (value k) = GenericDetectorWitnessBaseChange.q k (atWitness (value ℚ))
proof:
:= by
  have hk : evalLocal k (value k) =
      family k (GenericDetectorWitnessBaseChange.witnessEval k) (parameterMoment.map (GenericDetectorWitnessBaseChange.q k)) 1 1 := by
    rw [value, map_family, eval_comp_coefficient, evalLocal_localMoment,
      evalLocal_root, evalLocal_inverseRoot]
  have hQ : atWitness (value ℚ) = family ℚ acceptedEval parameterMoment 1 1 := by
    rw [value, map_family, atWitness_comp_coefficient_public, atWitness_localMoment,
      atWitness_root, atWitness_inverseRoot]
  calc
    evalLocal k (value k) =
        family k (GenericDetectorWitnessBaseChange.witnessEval k) (parameterMoment.map (GenericDetectorWitnessBaseChange.q k)) 1 1 := hk
    _ = GenericDetectorWitnessBaseChange.q k (family ℚ acceptedEval parameterMoment 1 1) := by
      simpa only [map_one] using family_compare k 1 1
    _ = GenericDetectorWitnessBaseChange.q k (atWitness (value ℚ)) := congrArg (GenericDetectorWitnessBaseChange.q k) hQ.symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericDetectorSeparationCharZero.evalLocal_mate
statement: theorem evalLocal_mate : evalLocal k (mate k) = GenericDetectorWitnessBaseChange.q k (atWitness (mate ℚ))
proof:
:= by
  have hk : evalLocal k (mate k) =
      family k (GenericDetectorWitnessBaseChange.witnessEval k) (parameterMoment.map (GenericDetectorWitnessBaseChange.q k))
        (GenericDetectorWitnessBaseChange.q k witnessScale) (GenericDetectorWitnessBaseChange.q k witnessScale⁻¹) := by
    rw [mate, map_family, eval_comp_coefficient, evalLocal_localMoment]
    simp only [map_mul, evalLocal_localDeterminant, evalLocal_inverseRoot,
      evalLocal_root, evalLocal_inverseDeterminant, mul_one, one_mul]
  have hQ : atWitness (mate ℚ) =
      family ℚ acceptedEval parameterMoment witnessScale witnessScale⁻¹ := by
    rw [mate, map_family, atWitness_comp_coefficient_public, atWitness_localMoment]
    simp only [map_mul, atWitness_localDeterminant, atWitness_inverseRoot,
      atWitness_root, atWitness_inverseDeterminant, mul_one, one_mul]
  calc
    evalLocal k (mate k) =
        family k (GenericDetectorWitnessBaseChange.witnessEval k) (parameterMoment.map (GenericDetectorWitnessBaseChange.q k))
          (GenericDetectorWitnessBaseChange.q k witnessScale) (GenericDetectorWitnessBaseChange.q k witnessScale⁻¹) := hk
    _ = GenericDetectorWitnessBaseChange.q k (family ℚ acceptedEval parameterMoment witnessScale witnessScale⁻¹) :=
      family_compare k witnessScale witnessScale⁻¹
    _ = GenericDetectorWitnessBaseChange.q k (atWitness (mate ℚ)) := congrArg (GenericDetectorWitnessBaseChange.q k) hQ.symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericDetectorSeparationCharZero.generic_detector_ne_deck

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.GLConstantGrid.denominator_ne_zero_of_total_ne_zero
statement:
theorem denominator_ne_zero_of_total_ne_zero (t : Grid k)
    (ht : MvPolynomial.eval t (totalDenominator k) ≠ 0) (r : Fin 3) :
    Matrix.det (baseMatrix (k := k) t r) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have heval : MvPolynomial.eval t (denominator k r) =
      Matrix.det (baseMatrix (k := k) t r) := by
    have hhom : baseEval (RingHom.id k) (baseMatrix (k := k) t) =
        MvPolynomial.eval t := by
      apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
      · intro c; simp [baseEval]
      · rintro ⟨a,b,c⟩; simp [baseEval, baseMatrix]
    rw [← hhom]
    exact baseEval_denominator (RingHom.id k) (baseMatrix (k := k) t) r
  intro hr
  obtain ⟨c,hc⟩ := denominator_dvd_total k r
  apply ht
  rw [hc, MvPolynomial.eval_mul, heval, hr, zero_mul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.GLConstantGrid.baseMatrices_det_ne_zero
statement:
theorem baseMatrices_det_ne_zero (t : Grid k)
    (ht : MvPolynomial.eval t (totalDenominator k) ≠ 0) :
    ∀ r, Matrix.det (baseMatrices k t r) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro r hzero
  apply denominator_ne_zero_of_total_ne_zero k t ht r
  apply (scalarMap k).injective
  rw [map_zero, RingHom.map_det]
  have hm : (scalarMap k).mapMatrix (baseMatrix (k := k) t r) = baseMatrices k t r := by rfl
  rw [hm, hzero]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.GLConstantGrid.fractionAction_glAut_universalFamily
statement:
theorem fractionAction_glAut_universalFamily (t : Grid k)
    (ht : MvPolynomial.eval t (totalDenominator k) ≠ 0) (r i : Fin 3) :
    (fractionAction k (glAut (baseMatrix (k := k) t 0)
      (denominator_ne_zero_of_total_ne_zero k t ht 0))).toRingHom.mapMatrix
        (universalFamily k r i) =
      baseMatrices k t 0 * universalFamily k r i * (baseMatrices k t 0)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  let Q := baseMatrix (k := k) t 0
  let hQ := denominator_ne_zero_of_total_ne_zero k t ht 0
  rw [LedgerInvariantField.fractionAction_universalFamily_extended]
  rw [extension_glAut]
  change (scalarMap k).mapMatrix Q * universalFamily k r i *
      (scalarMap k).mapMatrix Q⁻¹ = _
  have hi : (scalarMap k).mapMatrix Q⁻¹ = ((scalarMap k).mapMatrix Q)⁻¹ := by
    symm
    apply Matrix.inv_eq_left_inv
    rw [← map_mul, Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul Q (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hQ), map_one]
  rw [hi]
  rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.GLConstantGrid.specialized_substitution_eq_fractionAction
statement:
theorem specialized_substitution_eq_fractionAction (t : Grid k)
    (ht : MvPolynomial.eval t (totalDenominator k) ≠ 0)
    (p : CoordinateRing k) :
    evaluationAlong (scalarMap k)
        (fun r i => baseMatrices k t 0 * universalFamily k r i *
          (baseMatrices k t 0)⁻¹) p =
      fractionAction k (glAut (baseMatrix (k := k) t 0)
        (denominator_ne_zero_of_total_ne_zero k t ht 0)) (rawToField k p)
proof:
:= by
  let g := glAut (baseMatrix (k := k) t 0)
    (denominator_ne_zero_of_total_ne_zero k t ht 0)
  have hhom : evaluationAlong (scalarMap k)
      (fun r i => baseMatrices k t 0 * universalFamily k r i *
        (baseMatrices k t 0)⁻¹) =
      (fractionAction k g).toRingHom.comp (rawToField k) := by
    apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
    · intro c
      simp only [evaluationAlong, MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_C, RingHom.comp_apply]
      change scalarMap k c = fractionAction k g (scalarMap k c)
      exact (fractionAction_scalar k g c).symm
    · intro q
      cases q with
      | entry r i a b =>
        simp only [evaluationAlong, MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_X', RingHom.comp_apply]
        exact congrFun (congrFun
          (fractionAction_glAut_universalFamily k t ht r i).symm a) b
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun hhom p

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.GLConstantGrid.evalAway_crossExpression_eq_zero_of_jordanInvariant
statement:
theorem evalAway_crossExpression_eq_zero_of_jordanInvariant
    (a b : CoordinateRing k) (hb : rawToField k b ≠ 0)
    (hinv : IsJordanInvariant k (rawToField k a / rawToField k b))
    (t : Grid k) (ht : MvPolynomial.eval t (totalDenominator k) ≠ 0) :
    evalAway (RingHom.id (F k)) (baseMatrices k t)
      (baseMatrices_det_ne_zero k t ht) (crossExpression k a b) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let g := glAut (baseMatrix (k := k) t 0)
    (denominator_ne_zero_of_total_ne_zero k t ht 0)
  have hi := hinv g
  have hbn : fractionAction k g (rawToField k b) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [map_zero] using (fractionAction k g).injective.ne hb
  have hcross :
      fractionAction k g (rawToField k a) * rawToField k b -
        fractionAction k g (rawToField k b) * rawToField k a = 0 := by
    have hdiv : fractionAction k g (rawToField k a) /
        fractionAction k g (rawToField k b) =
        rawToField k a / rawToField k b := by simpa using hi
    apply sub_eq_zero.mpr
    simpa only [mul_comm] using (div_eq_div_iff hbn hb).mp hdiv
  rw [evalAway_crossExpression]
  simp only [RingHom.id_comp, RingHom.id_apply]
  have hid (M : Mat3 (F k)) : (RingHom.id (F k)).mapMatrix M = M := by
    ext a b; rfl
  simp only [hid]
  rw [specialized_substitution_eq_fractionAction k t ht a,
    specialized_substitution_eq_fractionAction k t ht b]
  exact hcross

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericBetaNormNonzero.positive_beta_ne_zero
statement:
theorem positive_beta_ne_zero (epsilon beta Delta : FunctionField k)
    (haffine : genericValue k = epsilon + beta * Delta)
    (hepsilon : deck k epsilon = epsilon)
    (hbeta : deck k beta = beta) : beta ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hb
  have hd : genericValue k = epsilon := by simpa [hb] using haffine
  apply generic_detector_ne_deck k
  calc
    genericValue k = epsilon := hd
    _ = deck k epsilon := hepsilon.symm
    _ = deck k (genericValue k) := congrArg (deck k) hd.symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericBetaNormNonzero.negative_beta_ne_zero
statement:
theorem negative_beta_ne_zero (beta betaNeg : FunctionField k)
    (hpos : beta ≠ 0) (hneg : betaNeg = tau k beta) : betaNeg ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [hneg]
  simpa using (tau k).injective.ne hpos

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericBetaNormNonzero.evaluated_beta_norm_ne_zero
statement:
theorem evaluated_beta_norm_ne_zero
    (epsilon beta betaNeg Delta : FunctionField k)
    (haffine : genericValue k = epsilon + beta * Delta)
    (hepsilon : deck k epsilon = epsilon)
    (hbeta : deck k beta = beta)
    (hneg : betaNeg = tau k beta) : beta * betaNeg ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  mul_ne_zero (positive_beta_ne_zero k epsilon beta Delta haffine hepsilon hbeta)
    (negative_beta_ne_zero k beta betaNeg
      (positive_beta_ne_zero k epsilon beta Delta haffine hepsilon hbeta) hneg)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericBetaNormNonzero.sec_numerator_eval_ne_zero
statement:
theorem sec_numerator_eval_ne_zero (B : A)
    (z : Localization.Away B) (e : A →+* FunctionField k)
    (eB : e B ≠ 0)
    (ez : IsLocalization.Away.lift B (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr eB) z ≠ 0) :
    e (IsLocalization.Away.sec B z).1 ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  let ev : Localization.Away B →+* FunctionField k :=
    IsLocalization.Away.lift B (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr eB)
  let s := IsLocalization.Away.sec B z
  have hs : z * algebraMap A (Localization.Away B) (B ^ s.2) =
      algebraMap A (Localization.Away B) s.1 := IsLocalization.Away.sec_spec B z
  have hev := congrArg ev hs
  have hz : ev z ≠ 0 := by simpa [ev] using ez
  change e s.1 ≠ 0
  rw [map_mul, IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq, IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq,
    map_pow] at hev
  rw [← hev]
  exact mul_ne_zero hz (pow_ne_zero _ eB)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ProjectorSector.mixedS_pair
statement:
theorem mixedS_pair (s1 s2 : SCoord ℚ) (c1 c2 : CCoord ℚ)
    (u u' a a' r1 z1 r2 z2 : ℚ) :
    BS (mixedS s1 c1 u a r1 z1) (mixedS s2 c2 u' a' r2 z2) =
      u * u' * (momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2 0 1 + momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2 1 0) +
      u * a' * r2 * momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2 0 3 +
      a * z1 * u' * momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2 2 1 +
      a * a' * z1 * r2 * momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2 2 3 +
      u' * a * r1 * momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2 1 2 +
      a' * z2 * u * momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2 3 0 +
      a * a' * z2 * r1 * momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2 3 2
proof:
:= by
  simp [BS, mixedS, momentMatrix, evalU]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ProjectorSector.mixedC_pair
statement:
theorem mixedC_pair (s1 s2 : SCoord ℚ) (c1 c2 : CCoord ℚ)
    (u u' a a' r1 z1 r2 z2 : ℚ) :
    BC (mixedC s1 c1 u a r1 z1) (mixedC s2 c2 u' a' r2 z2) =
      u * u' * (momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2 2 3 + momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2 3 2) +
      u * a' * z2 * momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2 2 1 +
      a * r1 * u' * momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2 0 3 +
      a * a' * r1 * z2 * momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2 0 1 +
      u' * a * z1 * momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2 3 0 +
      a' * r2 * u * momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2 1 2 +
      a * a' * r2 * z1 * momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2 1 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [BC, mixedC, momentMatrix, evalU]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ProjectorSector.BV_add_left
statement:
private theorem BV_add_left (x y z : VCoord ℚ) :
    BV (x + y) z = BV x z + BV y z
proof:
:= by
  simp [BV, BW]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ProjectorSector.BV_add_right
statement:
private theorem BV_add_right (x y z : VCoord ℚ) :
    BV x (y + z) = BV x y + BV x z
proof:
:= by
