  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ProjectorSector.BV_smul_left
statement:
private theorem BV_smul_left (a : ℚ) (x y : VCoord ℚ) :
    BV (a • x) y = a * BV x y
proof:
:= by
  simp [BV, BW]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ProjectorSector.BV_smul_right
statement:
private theorem BV_smul_right (a : ℚ) (x y : VCoord ℚ) :
    BV x (a • y) = a * BV x y
proof:
:= by
  simp [BV, BW]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ProjectorSector.BV_plane_plane
proof:
:= by
  simp [BV, h1, h2, BW]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ProjectorSector.BV_plane_mu
statement:
private theorem BV_plane_mu (v : VCoord ℚ) (hv : v.omega = 0)
    (s : SCoord ℚ) (c : CCoord ℚ) :
    BV v (normalizedMuV s c) =
      v.r * evalU s.phi c.q + v.z * evalU c.psi s.p
proof:
:= by
  simp [BV, hv, normalizedMuV, muV, BW]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ProjectorSector.BV_mu_plane
statement:
private theorem BV_mu_plane (v : VCoord ℚ) (hv : v.omega = 0)
    (s : SCoord ℚ) (c : CCoord ℚ) :
    BV (normalizedMuV s c) v =
      v.r * evalU s.phi c.q + v.z * evalU c.psi s.p
proof:
:= by
  rw [BV_symmetric]
  exact BV_plane_mu v hv s c

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ProjectorSector.mixedV_pair
statement:
theorem mixedV_pair (v1 v2 : VCoord ℚ)
    (h1 : v1.omega = 0) (h2 : v2.omega = 0)
    (s1 s2 : SCoord ℚ) (c1 c2 : CCoord ℚ) (u u' a a' : ℚ) :
    BV (mixedV v1 s1 c1 u a) (mixedV v2 s2 c2 u' a') =
      u * u' * (v1.r * v2.z + v1.z * v2.r) +
      u * a' * (v1.r * momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2 1 3 +
        v1.z * momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2 3 1) +
      a * u' * (v2.r * momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2 0 2 +
        v2.z * momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2 2 0) +
      a * a' * (exteriorQ (momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2) -
        deltaX s1 s2 c1 c2 - deltaStarA s1 s2 c1 c2)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mixedV, BV_add_left, BV_add_right, BV_smul_left, BV_smul_right]
  rw [BV_plane_plane v1 v2 h1 h2,
    BV_plane_mu v1 h1 s2 c2, BV_mu_plane v2 h2 s1 c1]
  have hUV := normalizedUV_exterior_identity s1 s2 c1 c2
  change BV (normalizedMuV s1 c1) (normalizedMuV s2 c2) = _ at hUV
  rw [hUV]
  simp [momentMatrix]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.ThreeFrameCayleyLocalization.map_matrix_inv_of_isUnit
statement:
theorem map_matrix_inv_of_isUnit {R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (f : R →+* S) (A : Mat3 R) (hA : IsUnit (Matrix.det A)) :
    f.mapMatrix A⁻¹ = (f.mapMatrix A)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  symm
  apply Matrix.inv_eq_left_inv
  rw [← map_mul, Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ hA, map_one]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.ThreeFrameCayleyLocalization.localizedSkew_det_isUnit
statement:
theorem localizedSkew_det_isUnit (r : Fin 3) :
    IsUnit (Matrix.det (1 + localizedSkew k r))
proof:
:= by
  have hmap : (algebraMap (Base k) (ParameterRing k)).mapMatrix
      (1 + skewPoly k r) = 1 + localizedSkew k r := by
    rw [map_add, map_one]
    rfl
  have hd : Matrix.det (1 + localizedSkew k r) =
      algebraMap (Base k) (ParameterRing k) (denominator k r) := by
    rw [denominator, RingHom.map_det, hmap]
  rw [hd]
  exact localized_denominator_isUnit k r

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.ThreeFrameCayleyLocalization.evalAway_localizedSkew
statement:
theorem evalAway_localizedSkew (f : k →+* L) (x : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → L)
    (hden) (r : Fin 3) :
    (evalAway f x hden).mapMatrix (localizedSkew k r) =
      skew (x r 0) (x r 1) (x r 2)
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  change evalAway f x hden
    (algebraMap (Base k) (ParameterRing k) (skewPoly k r i j)) = _
  rw [evalAway_algebraMap]
  exact congrFun (congrFun (baseEval_skewPoly f x r) i) j

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.ThreeFrameCayleyLocalization.evalAway_localizedCayley
statement:
theorem evalAway_localizedCayley (f : k →+* L) (x : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → L)
    (hden) (r : Fin 3) :
    (evalAway f x hden).mapMatrix (localizedCayley k r) =
      cayley (skew (x r 0) (x r 1) (x r 2))
proof:
:= by
  change (evalAway f x hden).mapMatrix
    ((1 - localizedSkew k r) * (1 + localizedSkew k r)⁻¹) = _
  rw [map_mul, map_matrix_inv_of_isUnit _ _ (localizedSkew_det_isUnit k r),
    map_sub, map_one, map_add, map_one, evalAway_localizedSkew]
  rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealCayleyParameterDomain.totalDenominator_ne_zero
statement: theorem totalDenominator_ne_zero : totalDenominator k ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hz : skew (0 : k) 0 0 = (0 : Mat3 k) := by
    ext i j
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [skew]
  have he := baseEval_totalDenominator_ne_zero
    (RingHom.id k) (fun _ _ => 0) (fun r => by
      rw [hz, add_zero, Matrix.det_one]
      exact one_ne_zero)
  exact he (by rw [h, map_zero])

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealCayleyParameterDomain.map_localizedProjector
statement:
theorem map_localizedProjector {L : Type v} [Field L]
    (f : ParameterRing k →+* L) (r i : Fin 3) :
    f.mapMatrix (localizedProjector k r i) =
      columnProjector (f.mapMatrix (localizedCayley k r)) i
proof:
:= by
  ext a b
  simp [localizedProjector, columnProjector]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealCayleyParameterDomain.map_localizedCayley
statement:
theorem map_localizedCayley {L : Type v} [Field L]
    (f : ParameterRing k →+* L) (r : Fin 3) :
    f.mapMatrix (localizedCayley k r) = cayley (f.mapMatrix (localizedSkew k r))
proof:
:= by
  change f.mapMatrix ((1 - localizedSkew k r) * (1 + localizedSkew k r)⁻¹) = _
  rw [map_mul, map_matrix_inv_of_isUnit _ _ (localizedSkew_det_isUnit k r),
    map_sub, map_one, map_add, map_one]
  rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealCayleyParameterDomain.map_localizedSkew_isSkew
statement:
theorem map_localizedSkew_isSkew {L : Type v} [Field L]
    (f : ParameterRing k →+* L) (r : Fin 3) :
    IsSkew (f.mapMatrix (localizedSkew k r))
proof:
:= by
  ext a b
  fin_cases a <;> fin_cases b <;>
    simp [IsSkew, localizedSkew, skewPoly, Matrix.transpose_apply]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealCayleyParameterDomain.map_localizedSkew_denominator_ne_zero
statement:
theorem map_localizedSkew_denominator_ne_zero {L : Type v} [Field L]
    (f : ParameterRing k →+* L) (r : Fin 3) :
    Matrix.det (1 + f.mapMatrix (localizedSkew k r)) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hu := (localizedSkew_det_isUnit k r).map f
  rw [RingHom.map_det, map_add, map_one] at hu
  exact isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mp hu

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealCayleyParameterDomain.charZero_of_injective_map
statement:
private theorem charZero_of_injective_map
    {A : Type u} {L : Type v} [CommRing A] [CharZero A] [Field L]
    (f : A →+* L) (hf : Function.Injective f) : CharZero L where
  cast_injective m n h
proof:
:= Nat.cast_injective (R := A)
    (hf (by simpa only [map_natCast] using h))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealCayleyParameterDomain.localizedProjectors_are_raw
statement:
theorem localizedProjectors_are_raw :
    IsRawPrimitiveFrameFamily (localizedProjector k)
proof:
:= by
  let C := ParameterRing k
  let L := FractionRing C
  let inc : C →+* L := algebraMap C L
  have hinc : Function.Injective inc := IsFractionRing.injective C L
  letI : CharZero L := charZero_of_injective_map inc hinc
  letI : Invertible (2 : L) := invertibleOfNonzero (by norm_num)
  have hQ : ∀ r, IsOrthogonal (inc.mapMatrix (localizedCayley k r)) := by
    intro r
    rw [map_localizedCayley]
    exact cayley_orthogonal (map_localizedSkew_isSkew k inc r)
      (map_localizedSkew_denominator_ne_zero k inc r)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro r i a b
    simp [localizedProjector, mul_comm]
  · intro r i
    ext a b
    apply hinc
    change inc.mapMatrix (localizedProjector k r i * localizedProjector k r i) a b =
      inc.mapMatrix (localizedProjector k r i) a b
    rw [map_mul, map_localizedProjector]
    exact congrFun (congrFun (columnProjector_mul_self
      (inc.mapMatrix (localizedCayley k r)) (hQ r) i) a) b
  · intro r i
    apply hinc
    rw [map_one, AddMonoidHom.map_trace]
    change Matrix.trace (inc.mapMatrix (localizedProjector k r i)) = 1
    rw [map_localizedProjector]
    exact columnProjector_trace_one (inc.mapMatrix (localizedCayley k r)) (hQ r) i
  · intro r
    have hsum : (∑ i : Fin 3, localizedProjector k r i) =
        localizedProjector k r 0 + localizedProjector k r 1 + localizedProjector k r 2 := by
      simp [Fin.sum_univ_succ, add_assoc]
    rw [hsum]
    ext a b
    apply hinc
    change inc.mapMatrix (localizedProjector k r 0 + localizedProjector k r 1 +
      localizedProjector k r 2) a b = inc.mapMatrix 1 a b
    rw [map_add, map_add, map_one, map_localizedProjector,
      map_localizedProjector, map_localizedProjector]
    exact congrFun (congrFun (columnProjector_sum
      (inc.mapMatrix (localizedCayley k r)) (hQ r)) a) b

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealCayleyParameterDomain.rawFrameIdeal_le_ker_psi
statement:
theorem rawFrameIdeal_le_ker_psi :
    rawFrameIdeal (R := k) ≤ RingHom.ker (psi k)
proof:
:= by
  have hv := (equations_vanishAlong_iff
    (coefficientMap k) (localizedProjector k)).2 (localizedProjectors_are_raw k)
  refine Ideal.span_le.2 ?_
  rintro p ⟨q, rfl⟩
  exact RingHom.mem_ker.mpr (hv q)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RawFramePrimeSquare.residueMap_eq_evaluationAlong
statement:
theorem residueMap_eq_evaluationAlong :
    residueMap k p = evaluationAlong (coefficientMap k p) (genericFrame k p)
proof:
:= by
  apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
  · intro c
    simp [evaluationAlong, coefficientMap]
  · intro x
    cases x with
    | entry r i a b => simp [residueMap, coefficientMap, genericFrame,
        evaluationAlong, universalMatrix]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RawFramePrimeSquare.residueMap_eq_zero_of_mem
statement:
theorem residueMap_eq_zero_of_mem {x : A k} (hx : x ∈ p) :
    residueMap k p x = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [residueMap, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr hx]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RawFramePrimeSquare.genericFrame_isRaw
statement:
theorem genericFrame_isRaw (hraw : rawFrameIdeal (R := k) ≤ p) :
    IsRawPrimitiveFrameFamily (genericFrame k p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← equations_vanishAlong_iff (coefficientMap k p), ← residueMap_eq_evaluationAlong]
  intro q
  exact residueMap_eq_zero_of_mem k p (hraw (Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self q)))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RawFramePrimeSquare.genericFrame_conditions
statement:
theorem genericFrame_conditions (hraw : rawFrameIdeal (R := k) ≤ p) :
    (∀ r i, Matrix.transpose (genericFrame k p r i) = genericFrame k p r i) ∧
    (∀ r i, genericFrame k p r i * genericFrame k p r i = genericFrame k p r i) ∧
    (∀ r i, Matrix.trace (genericFrame k p r i) = 1) ∧
    (∀ r, genericFrame k p r 0 + genericFrame k p r 1 +
      genericFrame k p r 2 = 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h := genericFrame_isRaw k p hraw
  refine ⟨?_, h.idempotent, h.trace_one, ?_⟩
  · intro r i
    ext a b
    simpa [Matrix.transpose_apply] using (h.symmetric r i b a)
  · intro r
    simpa [Fin.sum_univ_succ, add_assoc] using h.sum_one r

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RawFramePrimeSquare.localizedProjectorSubstitution_X
statement:
@[simp] theorem localizedProjectorSubstitution_X (r i a b : Fin 3) :
    localizedProjectorSubstitution k
        (MvPolynomial.X (.entry r i a b)) =
      RealCayleyParameterDomain.localizedProjector k r i a b
proof:
:= by
  simp [localizedProjectorSubstitution, RealCayleyParameterDomain.psi, evaluationAlong]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RawFramePrimeSquare.exists_extension_and_localized_evaluation
statement:
theorem exists_extension_and_localized_evaluation
    (hraw : rawFrameIdeal (R := k) ≤ p) :
    ∃ (L : Type u) (_ : Field L) (f : GenericField k p →+* L)
      (x : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → L)
      (hden : ∀ r, Matrix.det (1 +
        AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.CayleyFrameCoverage.skew
          (x r 0) (x r 1) (x r 2)) ≠ 0),
      Function.Injective ((f.comp (algebraMap (Residue k p) (GenericField k p)))) ∧
      ∀ r i a b,
        evalAway (f.comp (coefficientMap k p)) x hden
            (localizedProjectorSubstitution k (MvPolynomial.X (.entry r i a b))) =
          f (residueMap k p (MvPolynomial.X (.entry r i a b)))
proof:
:= by
  letI : CharZero (GenericField k p) :=
    charZero_of_embedding (coefficientMap k p)
  obtain ⟨hsymm, hidem, htrace, hsum⟩ := genericFrame_conditions k p hraw
  obtain ⟨L, instL, f, a, b, c, hden, horth, hprojector⟩ :=
    exists_common_extension_cayley_parameters
      (genericFrame k p) hsymm hidem htrace hsum
  let x : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → L := fun r q => ![a r, b r, c r] q
  have hdenx : ∀ r, Matrix.det (1 + CayleyFrameCoverage.skew
      (x r 0) (x r 1) (x r 2)) ≠ 0 := by simpa [x] using hden
  refine ⟨L, instL, f, x, hdenx, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact f.injective.comp (IsFractionRing.injective (Residue k p) (GenericField k p))
  · intro r i row column
    rw [localizedProjectorSubstitution_X]
    change (evalAway (f.comp (coefficientMap k p)) x hdenx).mapMatrix
      (RealCayleyParameterDomain.localizedProjector k r i) row column =
      f.mapMatrix (genericFrame k p r i) row column
    rw [RealCayleyParameterDomain.map_localizedProjector, evalAway_localizedCayley]
    simpa [x] using congrFun (congrFun (hprojector r i) row) column

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceDiagonalPermutation.matrixPerm_trace
statement:
@[simp] theorem matrixPerm_trace (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) (A : Mat3 K) :
    Matrix.trace (matrixPerm σ A) = Matrix.trace A
proof:
:= by
  change (∑ i : Fin 3, A (σ.symm i) (σ.symm i)) = ∑ i : Fin 3, A i i
  exact σ.symm.sum_comp (fun i => A i i)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceDiagonalPermutation.matrixPerm_trace3
statement:
@[simp] theorem matrixPerm_trace3 (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) (A : Mat3 K) :
    trace3 (matrixPerm σ A) = trace3 A
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [trace3_eq_matrixTrace] using matrixPerm_trace σ A

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceDiagonalPermutation.matrixPerm_trace3_mul
statement:
@[simp] theorem matrixPerm_trace3_mul (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) (A B : Mat3 K) :
    trace3 (matrixPerm σ A * matrixPerm σ B) = trace3 (A * B)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_mul, matrixPerm_trace3]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceDiagonalPermutation.matrixPerm_adjugate3
statement:
@[simp] theorem matrixPerm_adjugate3 (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) (A : Mat3 K) :
    matrixPerm σ (adjugate3 A) = adjugate3 (matrixPerm σ A)
proof:
:= by

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceDiagonalPermutation.firstTitsPerm_apply
statement:

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceDiagonalPermutation.firstTitsPerm_one
statement:

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceDiagonalPermutation.firstTitsPerm_square
statement:
theorem firstTitsPerm_square (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) (z : FirstTits K) :
    firstTitsPerm σ (firstTitsSquare z) = firstTitsSquare (firstTitsPerm σ z)
proof:
:= by

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceDiagonalPermutation.firstTitsPerm_product
statement:

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceDiagonalPermutation.sourceFirstTits_product

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceDiagonalPermutation.sourceFirstTits_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem sourceFirstTits_one :

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceDiagonalPermutation.sourcePermutation_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem sourcePermutation_one (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) :
    sourcePermutation σ (sourceOne : JCoord K) = sourceOne

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceDiagonalPermutation.sourcePermutation_product
statement:
theorem sourcePermutation_product (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) (x y : JCoord K) :
    sourcePermutation σ (sourceProduct x y) =
      sourceProduct (sourcePermutation σ x) (sourcePermutation σ y)
proof:

  apply (sourceFirstTitsEquiv (K := K)).injective

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceDiagonalPermutation.sourcePermutation_trace
statement:
@[simp] theorem sourcePermutation_trace (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) (x : JCoord K) :
    sourceTrace (sourcePermutation σ x) = sourceTrace x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sourceFirstTits_trace, sourcePermutation_transport]
  simpa only [firstTitsPerm_apply, matrixPerm_trace] using sourceFirstTits_trace x

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceDiagonalPermutation.sourceFirstTits_diagonal
proof:
:= by
  apply Prod.ext
  · ext i j
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> rfl
  · apply Prod.ext <;> ext i j <;>
      fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> first | rfl | exact neg_zero

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceDiagonalPermutation.sourceFirstTits_diagonalUnit
statement:
theorem sourceFirstTits_diagonalUnit (i : Fin 3) :
    sourceFirstTitsEquiv (diagonalUnit (K := K) i) =
      (Matrix.diagonal (Pi.single i 1), 0, 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [diagonalUnit, sourceFirstTits_diagonal]
  apply Prod.ext
  · apply congrArg Matrix.diagonal
    funext j
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp
  · rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceDiagonalPermutation.matrixPerm_diagonalUnit
statement:
theorem matrixPerm_diagonalUnit (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) (i : Fin 3) :
    matrixPerm (K := K) σ (Matrix.diagonal (Pi.single i 1)) =
      Matrix.diagonal (Pi.single (σ i) 1)
proof:
:= by
  change (Matrix.diagonal (Pi.single i (1 : K))).submatrix σ.symm σ.symm = _
  rw [Matrix.submatrix_diagonal_equiv]
  congr 1
  funext j
  by_cases h : j = σ i
  · subst j
    simp
  · have hi : σ.symm j ≠ i := by
      intro heq
      apply h
      calc
        j = σ (σ.symm j) := (σ.apply_symm_apply j).symm
        _ = σ i := congrArg σ heq
    simp [Function.comp_apply, Pi.single_apply, h, hi, Ne.symm h, Ne.symm hi]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceDiagonalPermutation.sourcePermutation_diagonalUnit
statement:
@[simp] theorem sourcePermutation_diagonalUnit (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) (i : Fin 3) :
    sourcePermutation (K := K) σ (diagonalUnit i) = diagonalUnit (σ i)
proof:
:= by
  apply (sourceFirstTitsEquiv (K := K)).injective
  rw [sourcePermutation_transport, sourceFirstTits_diagonalUnit,
    sourceFirstTits_diagonalUnit]
  simp only [firstTitsPerm_apply, matrixPerm_diagonalUnit, map_zero]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowTomography.measurements_eq_mulVec
statement:
theorem measurements_eq_mulVec (Z : n × n → Matrix n n K) (A : Matrix n n K) :

proof:

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowTomography.transposeVector_eq_inverse_measurements
statement:
theorem transposeVector_eq_inverse_measurements
    (Z : n × n → Matrix n n K) (hZ : (measurementMatrix Z).det ≠ 0)
    (A : Matrix n n K) :
    transposeVector A = (measurementMatrix Z)⁻¹.mulVec (measurements Z A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [measurements_eq_mulVec, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
    Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hZ), Matrix.one_mulVec]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowTomography.eq_of_measurements_eq
statement:
theorem eq_of_measurements_eq
    (Z : n × n → Matrix n n K) (hZ : (measurementMatrix Z).det ≠ 0)
    {A B : Matrix n n K} (h : measurements Z A = measurements Z B) : A = B
proof:
:= by
  have hv : transposeVector A = transposeVector B := by
    rw [transposeVector_eq_inverse_measurements Z hZ A,
      transposeVector_eq_inverse_measurements Z hZ B, h]
  ext i j
  exact congrFun hv (j, i)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowTomography.eq_of_centered_measurements_eq

    (h : measurements Z A - offset = measurements Z B - offset) : A = B
proof:
:= by
  exact eq_of_measurements_eq Z hZ (sub_left_inj.mp h)

name: AlbertLean.Triality.RationalEvenFamilyInverse.C_mul_reflectV
statement:
theorem C_mul_reflectV (a b : VCoord K) (ha : nV a ≠ 0) :
    C a * C (reflectV a b) = -(C b * C a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [reflectV, map_sub, map_smul, mul_sub, mul_smul_comm, C_square,
    smul_smul]
  have hc : BV a b / nV a * nV a = BV a b := div_mul_cancel₀ _ ha
  rw [hc]
  have hp := C_polar a b
  rw [← hp]
  abel

name: AlbertLean.Triality.RationalEvenFamilyInverse.muS_reflectV_reverse
statement:
theorem muS_reflectV_reverse (a b : VCoord K) (ha : nV a ≠ 0)

      -sourceMuS (sourceMuC a s) b

:= by

name: AlbertLean.Triality.RationalEvenFamilyInverse.muC_reflectV_reverse

name: AlbertLean.Triality.RationalEvenFamilyInverse.reflectV_reflected_conjugate
statement:
theorem reflectV_reflected_conjugate (a b v : VCoord K) (ha : nV a ≠ 0) :
    reflectV a (reflectV (reflectV a b) v) =
      reflectV b (reflectV a v)
proof:
:= by
  have habv : BV (reflectV a b) v = BV b (reflectV a v) := by
    have h := SourceVectorPairReflection.BV_reflectV a b (reflectV a v) ha
    rw [SourceEvenAutomorphism.reflectV_involutive a v ha] at h
    exact h
  change SourceEvenAutomorphism.reflectVLinear a
      (v - (BV (reflectV a b) v / nV (reflectV a b)) • reflectV a b) = _
  rw [map_sub, map_smul]
  change reflectV a v -
    (BV (reflectV a b) v / nV (reflectV a b)) • reflectV a (reflectV a b) = _
  rw [SourceEvenAutomorphism.reflectV_involutive a b ha]
  change reflectV a v - (BV (reflectV a b) v / nV (reflectV a b)) • b =
    reflectV a v - (BV b (reflectV a v) / nV b) • b
  rw [habv, nV_reflectV a b ha]

 theorem evenV_reflected_reverse (a b v : VCoord K) (ha : nV a ≠ 0) :
    evenV a (reflectV a b) v = evenV b a v := by
  exact reflectV_reflected_conjugate a b v ha

 theorem evenS_reflected_neg_reverse (a b : VCoord K) (rho : K)
    (ha : nV a ≠ 0) (hrho0 : rho ≠ 0) (s : SCoord K) :
    evenS a (reflectV a b) (-rho) s = evenS b a rho s := by
  rw [evenS, evenS, muS_reflectV_reverse a b ha]
  simp only [inv_neg, smul_neg, neg_smul, neg_neg]

 theorem evenC_reflected_neg_reverse (a b : VCoord K) (rho : K)
    (ha : nV a ≠ 0) (hrho0 : rho ≠ 0) (c : CCoord K) :
    evenC a (reflectV a b) (-rho) c = evenC b a rho c := by
  rw [evenC, evenC, muC_reflectV_reverse a b ha]
  simp only [inv_neg, smul_neg, neg_smul, neg_neg]

 theorem evenC_reflected_neg_reverse (a b : VCoord K) (rho : K)

name: AlbertLean.Triality.RationalEvenFamilyInverse.evenC_reflected_neg_reverse
statement:
theorem evenC_reflected_neg_reverse (a b : VCoord K) (rho : K)

name: AlbertLean.Triality.RationalEvenFamilyInverse.sourceEvenAut_reflected_inverse
statement:
theorem sourceEvenAut_reflected_inverse
    (a b : VCoord K) (rho : K)
    (ha : nV a ≠ 0) (hb : nV b ≠ 0)
    (hrho : rho ^ 2 = nV a * nV b) (hrho0 : rho ≠ 0) :
    let hb' : nV (reflectV a b) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by simpa [nV_reflectV a b ha] using hb
    let hrho' : (-rho) ^ 2 = nV a * nV (reflectV a b) := by
      simpa [nV_reflectV a b ha] using hrho
    (sourceEvenAut a (reflectV a b) (-rho) ha hb' hrho'
      (neg_ne_zero.mpr hrho0)).linear =
      (sourceEvenAut a b rho ha hb hrho hrho0).linear.symm := by
  intro hb' hrho'
  apply LinearEquiv.ext
  intro x
  apply JCoord.ext
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · change evenV a (reflectV a b) x.v = evenV b a x.v
    exact evenV_reflected_reverse a b x.v ha
  · change evenS a (reflectV a b) (-rho) x.s = evenS b a rho x.s
    exact evenS_reflected_neg_reverse a b rho ha hrho0 x.s
  · change evenC a (reflectV a b) (-rho) x.c = evenC b a rho x.c
    exact evenC_reflected_neg_reverse a b rho ha hrho0 x.c

name: AlbertLean.Triality.RationalEvenFamilyInverse.parity_center_inverse
statement:
theorem parity_center_inverse (r : K) (w : ExteriorSix.W K) (rho : K) :
    center 1 r (inverseOmega w) (-rho) =
      reflectV (parityVector : VCoord K) (center 1 r w rho)
proof:
:= by
  rw [reflectV, nV_parityVector]
  apply VCoord.ext
  · simp [center, parityVector, BV, BW]
  · simp [center, parityVector, BV, BW, Pf_inverseOmega]
  · funext i
    fin_cases i <;>
      simp [center, parityVector, inverseOmega, BV, BW, wBasis] <;> ring

name: AlbertLean.Triality.RationalEvenFamilyInverse.fixedParity_family_inverse
statement:
theorem fixedParity_family_inverse (r : K) (w : ExteriorSix.W K) (rho : K)
    (hr : r ≠ 0) (hp : rho ≠ 0) :
    (familyAut parityVector (by simp) r (inverseOmega w) (-rho)
      hr (neg_ne_zero.mpr hp)).linear =
      (familyAut parityVector (by simp) r w rho hr hp).linear.symm
proof:
:= by
  unfold familyAut
  have h := sourceEvenAut_reflected_inverse
    (parityVector : VCoord K) (center 1 r w rho) rho
    (by simp) (norm_center_ne_zero 1 r w rho (by norm_num) hr hp)
    (by simpa only [nV_parityVector] using
      center_root 1 r w rho (by norm_num) hr) hp
  simpa only [nV_parityVector, parity_center_inverse] using h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceScheduleRawVanishing.fieldF0Family_raw
statement:

proof:

  exact (sourceFrameFamily_iff_f0Raw (fieldNativeFamily k e)).1

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceScheduleRawVanishing.field_comp_scheduleRawMap
statement:
theorem field_comp_scheduleRawMap (e : ParameterRing k →ₐ[k] L) :
    e.toRingHom.comp (scheduleRawMap k) =
      evaluationAlong (algebraMap k L) (fieldF0Family k e)
proof:
:= by
  apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
  · intro a
    simp [scheduleRawMap, evaluationAlong]
  · intro q
    cases q with
    | entry r i c =>
      simp only [RingHom.comp_apply]
      rw [scheduleRawMap_X]
      simpa [evaluationAlong, fieldF0Family, toF0Family, fieldNativeFamily, mapPoint] using
        congrFun (map_scheduledPoint_eq_fieldSchedule k e r i) c

    (q : EquationIndex) : e (scheduleRawMap k (equation q)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hv : evaluationAlong (algebraMap k L) (fieldF0Family k e) (equation q) = 0 :=
    (equations_vanishAlong_iff (algebraMap k L) (fieldF0Family k e)).2
      (fieldF0Family_raw k e) q
  have hc := DFunLike.congr_fun (field_comp_scheduleRawMap k e) (equation q)
  exact hc.trans hv

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceScheduleRawVanishing.rawFrameIdeal_le_ker_scheduleRawMap
statement:
theorem rawFrameIdeal_le_ker_scheduleRawMap
    (e : ParameterRing k →ₐ[k] L) (he : Function.Injective e) :
    rawFrameIdeal (k := k) ≤ RingHom.ker (scheduleRawMap k)
proof:
:= by
  apply Ideal.span_le.2
  intro x hx
  rcases hx with ⟨q, rfl⟩
  apply RingHom.mem_ker.mpr
  apply he
  rw [map_zero]
  exact equation_maps_to_zero k e q

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.firstAlignment_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem firstAlignment_apply
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V))
    (halt : ∀ x, omega x x = 0) (x z y : V)
    (hxz : omega z x ≠ 0) (hzy : omega y z ≠ 0) (q : V) :
    firstAlignment omega halt x z y hxz hzy q =
      equiv omega halt (y - z) (omega y z)⁻¹
        (equiv omega halt (z - x) (omega z x)⁻¹ q)
proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.firstAlignment_source
statement:
theorem firstAlignment_source
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V))
    (halt : ∀ x, omega x x = 0) (x z y : V)
    (hxz : omega z x ≠ 0) (hzy : omega y z ≠ 0) :
    firstAlignment omega halt x z y hxz hzy x = y
proof:
:=
  two_step_align omega halt x z y hxz hzy

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.firstAlignment_preserves
statement:
theorem firstAlignment_preserves
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V))
    (halt : ∀ x, omega x x = 0) (x z y : V)
    (hxz : omega z x ≠ 0) (hzy : omega y z ≠ 0) (q r : V) :
    omega (firstAlignment omega halt x z y hxz hzy q)
      (firstAlignment omega halt x z y hxz hzy r) = omega q r
proof:
:= by
  rw [firstAlignment_apply, firstAlignment_apply,
    equiv_preserves, equiv_preserves]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.fourStepPairWord_source
statement:
theorem fourStepPairWord_source
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V))
    (halt : ∀ x, omega x x = 0) (x z y v f : V)
    (hxz : omega z x ≠ 0) (hzy : omega y z ≠ 0)
    (hxv : omega x v = 1) (hyf : omega y f = 1) :
    wordMap omega (fourStepPairWord omega halt x z y v f hxz hzy) x = y
proof:
:= by
  let vp := firstAlignment omega halt x z y hxz hzy v
  have hyp : omega y vp = 1 := by
    rw [← firstAlignment_source omega halt x z y hxz hzy,
      firstAlignment_preserves, hxv]
  change equiv omega halt
      (f - (vp + avoidanceScalar (omega f vp) • y))
      (omega f (vp + avoidanceScalar (omega f vp) • y))⁻¹
    (equiv omega halt
      ((vp + avoidanceScalar (omega f vp) • y) - vp)
      (omega (vp + avoidanceScalar (omega f vp) • y) vp)⁻¹
      (firstAlignment omega halt x z y hxz hzy x)) = y
  rw [firstAlignment_source]
  exact partner_two_step_fixes_first omega halt y vp f hyp hyf

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.fourStepPairWord_partner
statement:
theorem fourStepPairWord_partner
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V))
    (halt : ∀ x, omega x x = 0) (x z y v f : V)
    (hxz : omega z x ≠ 0) (hzy : omega y z ≠ 0)
    (hxv : omega x v = 1) (hyf : omega y f = 1) :
    wordMap omega (fourStepPairWord omega halt x z y v f hxz hzy) v = f
proof:
:= by
  let vp := firstAlignment omega halt x z y hxz hzy v
  have hyp : omega y vp = 1 := by
    rw [← firstAlignment_source omega halt x z y hxz hzy,
      firstAlignment_preserves, hxv]
  change equiv omega halt
      (f - (vp + avoidanceScalar (omega f vp) • y))
      (omega f (vp + avoidanceScalar (omega f vp) • y))⁻¹
    (equiv omega halt
      ((vp + avoidanceScalar (omega f vp) • y) - vp)
      (omega (vp + avoidanceScalar (omega f vp) • y) vp)⁻¹ vp) = f
  exact partner_two_step_align omega halt y vp f hyp hyf

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceEvenReflections.nV_reflectV
statement:
theorem nV_reflectV (a v : VCoord K) (ha : nV a ≠ 0) :
    nV (reflectV a v) = nV v
proof:
:= by
  rw [reflectV, sub_eq_add_neg, ← neg_smul, nV_add, nV_smul, BV_smul_right, BV_symmetric v a]
  field_simp [ha]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceEvenReflections.nV_evenV
statement:
theorem nV_evenV (a b v : VCoord K) (ha : nV a ≠ 0)
    (hb : nV b ≠ 0) : nV (evenV a b v) = nV v
proof:
:= by
  rw [evenV, nV_reflectV a _ ha, nV_reflectV b v hb]

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceEvenReflections.nS_evenS
statement:
theorem nS_evenS (a b : VCoord K) (rho : K) (s : SCoord K)
    (hrho : rho ^ 2 = nV a * nV b) (hrho0 : rho ≠ 0) :
    nS (evenS a b rho s) = nS s
proof:
:= by
  rw [evenS, nS_smul, nS_sourceMuS, nC_sourceMuC]
  calc
    rho⁻¹ ^ 2 * (nV a * (nV b * nS s)) =
        (rho⁻¹ ^ 2 * (nV a * nV b)) * nS s := by ring
    _ = nS s := by rw [← hrho, ← mul_pow]; simp [hrho0]

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceEvenReflections.nC_evenC
statement:
theorem nC_evenC (a b : VCoord K) (rho : K) (c : CCoord K)
    (hrho : rho ^ 2 = nV a * nV b) (hrho0 : rho ≠ 0) :
    nC (evenC a b rho c) = nC c
proof:
:= by
  rw [evenC, nC_smul, nC_sourceMuC, nS_sourceMuS]
  calc
    rho⁻¹ ^ 2 * (nV a * (nV b * nC c)) =
        (rho⁻¹ ^ 2 * (nV a * nV b)) * nC c := by ring
    _ = nC c := by rw [← hrho, ← mul_pow]; simp [hrho0]

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceEvenReflections.C_mul_C_apply
statement:
theorem C_mul_C_apply (a b : VCoord K) (s : SCoord K) (c : CCoord K) :
    (C a * C b) (s, c) =
      (sourceMuS (sourceMuC b s) a,
        sourceMuC a (sourceMuS c b))
proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceEvenReflections.evenS_reverse
statement:
theorem evenS_reverse (a b : VCoord K) (rho : K) (s : SCoord K)
    (hrho : rho ^ 2 = nV a * nV b) (hrho0 : rho ≠ 0) :
    evenS b a rho (evenS a b rho s) = s
proof:
:= by
  change rho⁻¹ • muSLinear b (muCLinear a (rho⁻¹ • muSLinear a (muCLinear b s))) = s
  rw [(muCLinear a).map_smul, (muSLinear b).map_smul]
  have hc : muCLinear a (muSLinear a (muCLinear b s)) = nV a • muCLinear b s :=
    sourceMuC_sourceMuS a _
  rw [hc, (muSLinear b).map_smul]
  have hs : muSLinear b (muCLinear b s) = nV b • s := sourceMuS_sourceMuC b s
  rw [hs]
  simp only [smul_smul]
  have hn : rho⁻¹ * (rho⁻¹ * (nV a * nV b)) = 1 := by
    rw [← hrho]
    field_simp [hrho0]
  rw [hn, one_smul]

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceEvenReflections.evenC_reverse
statement:
theorem evenC_reverse (a b : VCoord K) (rho : K) (c : CCoord K)
    (hrho : rho ^ 2 = nV a * nV b) (hrho0 : rho ≠ 0) :
    evenC b a rho (evenC a b rho c) = c
proof:
:= by
  change rho⁻¹ • muCLinear b (muSLinear a (rho⁻¹ • muCLinear a (muSLinear b c))) = c
  rw [(muSLinear a).map_smul, (muCLinear b).map_smul]
  have hs : muSLinear a (muCLinear a (muSLinear b c)) = nV a • muSLinear b c :=
    sourceMuS_sourceMuC a _
  rw [hs, (muCLinear b).map_smul]
  have hc : muCLinear b (muSLinear b c) = nV b • c := sourceMuC_sourceMuS b c
  rw [hc]
  simp only [smul_smul]
  have hn : rho⁻¹ * (rho⁻¹ * (nV a * nV b)) = 1 := by
    rw [← hrho]
    field_simp [hrho0]
  rw [hn, one_smul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.matrixAction_weightedFirstMatrix
statement:
theorem matrixAction_weightedFirstMatrix (p : Fin 3 → K) :
    matrixAction (weightedFirstMatrix p) = weightedFirstAction p

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.first_projector_intertwines_weighted_coordinates
statement:
theorem first_projector_intertwines_weighted_coordinates
    (E : Fin 3 → Carrier K) (F0 : Carrier K)
    (hEsum : (E 0 : Mat6 K) + E 1 + E 2 = 1)
    (u v : Vec6 K) (p : Fin 3 → K)
    (hFu : ∀ i, matrixAction (F0 : Mat6 K)
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u) = p i • u)
    (hFv : ∀ i, matrixAction (F0 : Mat6 K)
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v) = p i • v) :
    (matrixAction (F0 : Mat6 K)).comp (weightedCoordinateLinear E u v) =
      (weightedCoordinateLinear E u v).comp (weightedFirstAction p)
proof:
:= by
  have hsumAction :
      matrixAction (E 0 : Mat6 K) + matrixAction (E 1 : Mat6 K) +
        matrixAction (E 2 : Mat6 K) = LinearMap.id :=
    carrier_frame_action_sum E hEsum
  have hu : u = ∑ i, matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u := by
    have h := LinearMap.congr_fun hsumAction u
    simpa only [LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.id_apply,
      Fin.sum_univ_three, add_assoc] using h.symm
  have hv : v = ∑ i, matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v := by
    have h := LinearMap.congr_fun hsumAction v
    simpa only [LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.id_apply,
      Fin.sum_univ_three, add_assoc] using h.symm
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro z
  change matrixAction (F0 : Mat6 K)
      ((∑ i, z (Sum.inl i) • matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u) +
        ∑ i, z (Sum.inr i) • matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v) =
    (∑ i, (∑ j, p j * z (Sum.inl j)) • matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u) +
      ∑ i, (∑ j, p j * z (Sum.inr j)) • matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v
  simp only [map_add, map_sum, map_smul, hFu, hFv]
  simp only [smul_smul]
  apply congrArg₂ (· + ·)
  · calc
      (∑ i, (z (Sum.inl i) * p i) • u) =
          (∑ i, p i * z (Sum.inl i)) • u := by
            rw [← Finset.sum_smul]
            simp only [mul_comm]
      _ = ∑ i, (∑ j, p j * z (Sum.inl j)) •
          matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u := by
            conv_lhs => rw [hu]
            rw [Finset.smul_sum]
  · calc
      (∑ i, (z (Sum.inr i) * p i) • v) =
          (∑ i, p i * z (Sum.inr i)) • v := by
            rw [← Finset.sum_smul]
            simp only [mul_comm]
      _ = ∑ i, (∑ j, p j * z (Sum.inr j)) •
          matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v := by
            conv_lhs => rw [hv]
            rw [Finset.smul_sum]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericReorientationBase.a_mul_invA

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericReorientationBase.localHom_twice_off

private theorem localHom_twice_off (ij : OffDiagonal) :
    localHom k (localHom k (loc k (offX k ij))) = loc k (offX k ij)
proof:
:= by
  rw [localHom_off, map_mul, map_mul, localHom_invWeight, localHom_weight,
    localHom_off, swapOff_swapOff]
  change (localInvWeight k ij.1.1 * localWeight k ij.1.2) *
    (localInvWeight k ij.1.2 * localWeight k ij.1.1 * loc k (offX k ij)) = _
  calc
    _ = (localInvWeight k ij.1.1 * localWeight k ij.1.1) *
        (localInvWeight k ij.1.2 * localWeight k ij.1.2) * loc k (offX k ij) := by ring
    _ = loc k (offX k ij) := by rw [localWeight_cancel, localWeight_cancel]; simp

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericReorientationBase.localHom_involutive
statement:
theorem localHom_involutive :
    (localHom k).comp (localHom k) = RingHom.id (LocalRing k)
proof:
:= by
  apply IsLocalization.ringHom_ext (Submonoid.powers (a k))
  ext z
  · change localHom k (localHom k (loc k (MvPolynomial.C z))) = loc k (MvPolynomial.C z)
    rw [localHom_C, localHom_C]
  · change localHom k (localHom k (loc k (MvPolynomial.X z))) = loc k (MvPolynomial.X z)
    rcases z with i | (i | ij)
    · change localHom k (localHom k (loc k (diagX k i))) = _
      rw [localHom_diag, localHom_diag]
      rfl
    · fin_cases i
      · change localHom k (localHom k (loc k (a k))) = _
        rw [localHom_a, localHom_a]
        rfl
      · exact localHom_twice_b k
      · exact localHom_twice_c k
    · exact localHom_twice_off k ij

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericReorientationBase.localHom_twice

  have h := congrArg (embed k) (a_mul_invA k)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericReorientationBase.embed_injective

:= by

    (Submonoid.powers (a k)) (embed k)).2
  intro p q
  constructor
  · exact congrArg (embed k)
  · intro h
    change embed k (loc k p) = embed k (loc k q) at h
    have hpq : p = q := iota_injective k (by simpa only [embed_loc] using h)
    exact congrArg (loc k) hpq

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericReorientationBase.baseHom_involutive

  intro p

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TitsTraceCube.tauTrace_cube
statement:
theorem tauTrace_cube (A B C : Mat3 R) :
    let x
proof:
:= toTau (R := R) (A, B, C)
    TauCeti.AlbertAlgebra.trace (x * (x * x)) =
      Matrix.trace (A * (A * A)) - 3 * Matrix.trace (A * (B * C)) +
        3 * Matrix.trace A * Matrix.trace (B * C) +
        3 * (Matrix.det B + Matrix.det C) := by
  dsimp only
  rw [← toTau_firstTitsSquare]
  simp only [firstTitsSquare, tauTrace_toTau_mul_toTau, mul_add, mul_sub,
    Matrix.mul_smul, mul_one, Matrix.trace_add, Matrix.trace_sub,
    Matrix.trace_smul, adjugate3_eq_matrixAdjugate, Matrix.mul_adjugate,
    Matrix.trace_one, Fintype.card_fin, Nat.cast_ofNat, smul_eq_mul,
    trace3_eq_matrixTrace]
  have h1 : Matrix.trace (B * (C * A)) = Matrix.trace (A * (B * C)) := by
    simp only [← Matrix.mul_assoc]
    rw [Matrix.trace_mul_cycle B C A]
  have h2 : Matrix.trace (C * (A * B)) = Matrix.trace (A * (B * C)) := by
    rw [Matrix.trace_mul_comm C (A * B), Matrix.mul_assoc]
  rw [h1, h2, Matrix.trace_mul_comm C B]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TitsTraceCube.commutator_word
statement:
theorem commutator_word (E F : Mat3 R) (z : FirstTits R) :
    embed E * (embed F * toTau z) - embed F * (embed E * toTau z) =
      toTau
        ((⅟(2 : R) * ⅟(2 : R)) •
            ((E * F - F * E) * z.1 - z.1 * (E * F - F * E)),
         (⅟(2 : R) * ⅟(2 : R)) • ((E * F - F * E) * z.2.1),
         -(⅟(2 : R) * ⅟(2 : R)) • (z.2.2 * (E * F - F * E)))
proof:
:= by
  have h (G : Mat3 R) (w : FirstTits R) :
      embed G * toTau w = toTau (leftAction G w) :=
    (toTau_polarProduct (G, 0, 0) w).symm
  rw [h F z, h E z, h E (leftAction F z), h F (leftAction E z),
    ← map_sub, leftAction_commutator]

        (rootSwappedChart witnessChart1 witnessChart1_open))
proof:
:= by

    (residualPairOfChart witnessChartM) witnessM_inFibre

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FibreMilestone.witness_fibre_classification
statement:
theorem witness_fibre_classification (Q R : ResidualPair ℚ)
    (hQ : InFibre witnessChart1 Q) (hR : InFibre witnessChart1 R) :
    LawfulFrameTriple (fibreTriple witnessChart1 Q) ∧
    LawfulFrameTriple (fibreTriple witnessChart1 R) ∧
    (FullRelated (fibreTriple witnessChart1 Q) (fibreTriple witnessChart1 R) ↔
      traceCubeDetector (fibreTriple witnessChart1 Q) =
        traceCubeDetector (fibreTriple witnessChart1 R))
proof:
:=
  ⟨lawful_of_inFibre _ witnessChart1_lawful Q hQ,
    lawful_of_inFibre _ witnessChart1_lawful R hR,
    fullRelated_iff_detector _ witnessChart1_open witness_rootSwap_detector_ne Q R hQ hR⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FibreMilestone.witness_fibre_has_two_classes
statement:
theorem witness_fibre_has_two_classes :
    ∃ Q R : ResidualPair ℚ,
      InFibre witnessChart1 Q ∧ InFibre witnessChart1 R ∧
      LawfulFrameTriple (fibreTriple witnessChart1 Q) ∧
      LawfulFrameTriple (fibreTriple witnessChart1 R) ∧
      ¬ FullRelated (fibreTriple witnessChart1 Q) (fibreTriple witnessChart1 R)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨residualPairOfChart witnessChart1, residualPairOfChart witnessChartM,
    original_inFibre _ witnessChart1_open, witnessM_inFibre, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa [fibreTriple] using witnessChart1_lawful
  · rw [fibreTriple_witnessM]
    exact witnessChartM_lawful
  · apply not_fullRelated_of_traceCubeDetector_ne
    simpa [fibreTriple, ← witnessChartM_eq_reinsert] using witnessCharts_detector_ne

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FibreMilestone.witness_fibre_invariant_affine
statement:
theorem witness_fibre_invariant_affine (Q : ResidualPair ℚ)
    (hQ : InFibre witnessChart1 Q) (f : WitnessTriple → ℚ)
    (hf : ∀ {U V}, FullRelated U V → f U = f V) :
    let X₀
proof:
:= chartWitnessTriple witnessChart1
    let X₁ := chartWitnessTriple (rootSwappedChart witnessChart1 witnessChart1_open)
    let Y := fibreTriple witnessChart1 Q
    (detectorBit X₀ X₁ Y = 0 ∨ detectorBit X₀ X₁ Y = 1) ∧
      f Y = f X₀ + (f X₁ - f X₀) * detectorBit X₀ X₁ Y := by
  exact ⟨detectorBit_zero_or_one witness_rootSwap_detector_ne
      (fullRelated_cover _ witnessChart1_open Q hQ),
    invariant_affine_in_detector witness_rootSwap_detector_ne
      (fullRelated_cover _ witnessChart1_open Q hQ) f hf⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.accepted_pairCell_eq_overlap_sq
statement:
theorem accepted_pairCell_eq_overlap_sq
    (X Y Z : Mat3 K) (hX : HasRealFrameLabels X) (hY : HasRealFrameLabels Y)
    (i j : Fin 3) :
    (labelledLedger (realFrameTauTriple X Y Z)).P i j =
      (overlap X Y i j) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [labelledLedger, realFrameTauTriple, Matrix.cons_val_zero,
    Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.vecHead, Matrix.vecTail]
  rw [hX i, hY j]
  change TauCeti.AlbertAlgebra.trace
      (embed (columnProjector X i) *
        toTau (columnProjector Y j, 0, 0)) = _
  rw [TitsTracePairing.tauTrace_embed_mul_toTau]
  exact trace_columnProjector_mul X Y i j

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.accepted_qCell_eq_overlap_sq
statement:
theorem accepted_qCell_eq_overlap_sq
    (X Y Z : Mat3 K) (hY : HasRealFrameLabels Y) (hZ : HasRealFrameLabels Z)
    (j l : Fin 3) :
    (labelledLedger (realFrameTauTriple X Y Z)).Q j l =
      (overlap Y Z j l) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [labelledLedger, realFrameTauTriple, Matrix.cons_val_zero,
    Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.vecHead, Matrix.vecTail,
    Function.comp_apply, Fin.succ_zero_eq_one]
  rw [hY j, hZ l]
  change TauCeti.AlbertAlgebra.trace
      (embed (columnProjector Y j) *
        toTau (columnProjector Z l, 0, 0)) = _
  rw [TitsTracePairing.tauTrace_embed_mul_toTau]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.accepted_rCell_eq_overlap_sq
statement:
theorem accepted_rCell_eq_overlap_sq
    (X Y Z : Mat3 K) (hZ : HasRealFrameLabels Z) (hX : HasRealFrameLabels X)
    (l i : Fin 3) :
    (labelledLedger (realFrameTauTriple X Y Z)).R l i =
      (overlap Z X l i) ^ 2
proof:
:= by

    Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.vecHead, Matrix.vecTail,
    Function.comp_apply, Fin.succ_zero_eq_one]
  rw [hZ l, hX i]
  change TauCeti.AlbertAlgebra.trace
      (embed (columnProjector Z l) *
        toTau (columnProjector X i, 0, 0)) = _
  rw [TitsTracePairing.tauTrace_embed_mul_toTau]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.accepted_uncenteredCell_eq_overlap_product
statement:
theorem accepted_uncenteredCell_eq_overlap_product
    (X Y Z : Mat3 K)
    (hX : HasRealFrameLabels X) (hY : HasRealFrameLabels Y)
    (hZ : HasRealFrameLabels Z) (i j l : Fin 3) :
    uncenteredCell (labelledLedger (realFrameTauTriple X Y Z)) i j l =
      overlap X Y i j * overlap Y Z j l * overlap Z X l i
proof:
:= by
  rw [uncenteredCell_labelledLedger]
  simp only [realFrameTauTriple, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
    Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.vecHead, Matrix.vecTail, Function.comp_apply,
    Fin.succ_zero_eq_one]
  rw [hX i, hY j, hZ l]
  change TauCeti.AlbertAlgebra.trace (embed (columnProjector X i) *
    (embed (columnProjector Y j) * toTau (columnProjector Z l, 0, 0))) = _
  rw [TitsJointPairing.tauTrace_embed_mul_embed_mul_toTau]
  exact trace_matrixJordan_columnProjectors X Y Z i j l

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.projectorTriple_related_of_acceptedLedger_eq
statement:
theorem projectorTriple_related_of_acceptedLedger_eq
    (X Y Z X' Y' Z' : Mat3 K)
    (hX : IsOrthogonal X) (hY : IsOrthogonal Y) (hZ : IsOrthogonal Z)
    (hX' : IsOrthogonal X') (hY' : IsOrthogonal Y') (hZ' : IsOrthogonal Z')
    (hlabX : HasRealFrameLabels X) (hlabY : HasRealFrameLabels Y)
    (hlabZ : HasRealFrameLabels Z) (hlabX' : HasRealFrameLabels X')
    (hlabY' : HasRealFrameLabels Y') (hlabZ' : HasRealFrameLabels Z')
    (hUnz : ∀ i j, overlap X Y i j ≠ 0)
    (hVnz : ∀ j l, overlap Y Z j l ≠ 0)
    (hWnz : ∀ l i, overlap Z X l i ≠ 0)
    (hledger : labelledLedger (realFrameTauTriple X Y Z) =
      labelledLedger (realFrameTauTriple X' Y' Z')) :
    ∃ q : Mat3 K, IsOrthogonal q ∧
      (∀ i, orthogonalConjugate q (columnProjector X i) = columnProjector X' i) ∧
      (∀ j, orthogonalConjugate q (columnProjector Y j) = columnProjector Y' j) ∧
      (∀ l, orthogonalConjugate q (columnProjector Z l) = columnProjector Z' l)
proof:
:= by
  apply projectorTriple_related_of_equal_overlap_measurements
    X Y Z X' Y' Z' hX hY hZ hX' hY' hZ' hUnz hVnz hWnz
  · intro i j
    rw [← accepted_pairCell_eq_overlap_sq X Y Z hlabX hlabY,
      ← accepted_pairCell_eq_overlap_sq X' Y' Z' hlabX' hlabY']
    exact congrArg (fun L : LabelledLedger K => L.P i j) hledger.symm
  · intro j l
    rw [← accepted_qCell_eq_overlap_sq X Y Z hlabY hlabZ,
      ← accepted_qCell_eq_overlap_sq X' Y' Z' hlabY' hlabZ']
    exact congrArg (fun L : LabelledLedger K => L.Q j l) hledger.symm
  · intro l i
    rw [← accepted_rCell_eq_overlap_sq X Y Z hlabZ hlabX,
      ← accepted_rCell_eq_overlap_sq X' Y' Z' hlabZ' hlabX']
    exact congrArg (fun L : LabelledLedger K => L.R l i) hledger.symm
  · intro i j l
    rw [← accepted_uncenteredCell_eq_overlap_product X' Y' Z'
        hlabX' hlabY' hlabZ',
      ← accepted_uncenteredCell_eq_overlap_product X Y Z hlabX hlabY hlabZ]
    exact uncenteredCell_eq_of_ledger_eq hledger.symm i j l

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticProjectorFrame.first_two_comp_zero_of_sum
statement:
theorem first_two_comp_zero_of_sum (A B C : V →ₗ[K] V)
    (hA : IsIdempotent A) (hB : IsIdempotent B) (hC : IsIdempotent C)
    (hsum : A + B + C = LinearMap.id) : A.comp B = 0 ∧ B.comp A = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hAA : A * A = A := hA
  have hBB : B * B = B := hB
  have hCC : C * C = C := hC
  have hpair : A + B = 1 - C := (eq_sub_iff_add_eq).2 hsum
  have hpairIdem : (A + B) * (A + B) = A + B := by
    rw [hpair]
    noncomm_ring [hCC]
  have hexpand : (A + B) * (A + B) = (A + B) + (A * B + B * A) := by
    noncomm_ring [hAA, hBB]
  have hz : (A + B) + (A * B + B * A) = (A + B) + 0 := by
    rw [← hexpand, hpairIdem, add_zero]
  have hanti : IsJordanOrthogonal A B := add_left_cancel hz
  exact ⟨comp_eq_zero_of_jordan_orthogonal A B hA hB hanti,
    reverse_comp_eq_zero_of_jordan_orthogonal A B hA hB hanti⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticProjectorFrame.comp_zero_of_complete_frame
statement:
theorem comp_zero_of_complete_frame (P : Fin 3 → V →ₗ[K] V)
    (hidem : ∀ i, IsIdempotent (P i))
    (hsum : P 0 + P 1 + P 2 = LinearMap.id) :
    ∀ i j, i ≠ j → (P i).comp (P j) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h01 := first_two_comp_zero_of_sum (P 0) (P 1) (P 2)
    (hidem 0) (hidem 1) (hidem 2) hsum
  have h02 := first_two_comp_zero_of_sum (P 0) (P 2) (P 1)
    (hidem 0) (hidem 2) (hidem 1) (by simpa only [add_right_comm] using hsum)
  have h12 := first_two_comp_zero_of_sum (P 1) (P 2) (P 0)
    (hidem 1) (hidem 2) (hidem 0) (by
      calc
        P 1 + P 2 + P 0 = P 0 + P 1 + P 2 := by abel
        _ = LinearMap.id := hsum)
  intro i j hij
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp_all

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticProjectorFrame.exists_image_hyperbolic_pair
statement:
theorem exists_image_hyperbolic_pair
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V))
    (hright : IsRightNondegenerate omega) (P : V →ₗ[K] V)
    (hP : IsIdempotent P) (hself : IsSelfAdjoint omega P) (hne : P ≠ 0) :
    ∃ u v : V, P u = u ∧ P v = v ∧ omega u v = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hex : ∃ x, P x ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h
    apply hne
    ext x
    exact not_not.mp (fun hx => h ⟨x, hx⟩)
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hex
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hright (P x) hx
  exact ⟨P x, normalizedPartner omega P (P x) y,
    idempotent_apply P hP x, normalizedPartner_mem omega P hP (P x) y,
    normalizedPartner_pairs_one omega P hP hself x y hy⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticProjectorFrame.exists_hyperbolicTriple_of_complete_frame
statement:
theorem exists_hyperbolicTriple_of_complete_frame
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V))
    (hright : IsRightNondegenerate omega) (P : Fin 3 → V →ₗ[K] V)
    (hidem : ∀ i, IsIdempotent (P i))
    (hself : ∀ i, IsSelfAdjoint omega (P i)) (hne : ∀ i, P i ≠ 0)
    (hsum : P 0 + P 1 + P 2 = LinearMap.id) :
    ∃ u v : Fin 3 → V, HyperbolicTriple omega u v ∧
      (∀ i j, P i (u j) = if i = j then u j else 0) ∧
      (∀ i j, P i (v j) = if i = j then v j else 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  choose u v hu hv huv using fun i =>
    exists_image_hyperbolic_pair omega hright (P i) (hidem i) (hself i) (hne i)
  have hcomp := comp_zero_of_complete_frame P hidem hsum
  have horth (i j : Fin 3) (hij : i ≠ j) (x y : V)
      (hx : P i x = x) (hy : P j y = y) : omega x y = 0 := by
    rw [← hx, ← hy]
    exact different_images_orthogonal omega (P i) (P j) (hself i) (hcomp i j hij) x y
  refine ⟨u, v, ⟨huv, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i j hij
    exact horth i j hij (u i) (u j) (hu i) (hu j)
  · intro i j hij
    exact horth i j hij (u i) (v j) (hu i) (hv j)
  · intro i j hij
    exact horth i j hij (v i) (u j) (hv i) (hu j)
  · intro i j hij
    exact horth i j hij (v i) (v j) (hv i) (hv j)
  · intro i j
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j
      simpa using hu i
    · rw [if_neg hij, ← hu j]
      exact LinearMap.congr_fun (hcomp i j hij) (u j)
  · intro i j
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j
      simpa using hv i
    · rw [if_neg hij, ← hv j]
      exact LinearMap.congr_fun (hcomp i j hij) (v j)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.NestedReciprocalField.sigma_base
statement:
@[simp] theorem sigma_base (b : B) : σ B m hm (algebraMap B (Omega B) b) =
    algebraMap B (Omega B) b
proof: := reciprocalHom_base B m hm b

name: AlbertLean.Generic.NestedReciprocalField.sigma_S
statement: @[simp] theorem sigma_S : σ B m hm (S B m) = S B m
proof:
:= by
  simp only [S, map_add, map_div₀, sigma_base, reciprocalEquiv_T]
  rw [div_div_cancel₀ ((map_ne_zero (algebraMap B (Omega B))).mpr hm)]
  ac_rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.NestedReciprocalField.invariantField_fixed
statement:
theorem invariantField_fixed (x : Omega B) (hx : x ∈ invariantField B m) :
    σ B m hm x = x
proof:
:= by
  refine Subfield.closure_induction (p := fun x _ => σ B m hm x = x)
    ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hx
  · rintro x (⟨b, rfl⟩ | hx)
    · exact sigma_base B m hm b
    · simpa only [Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hx] using sigma_S B m hm
  · exact map_one _
  · intro x y _ _ hx hy; simpa only [map_add, hx, hy]
  · intro x _ hx; simpa only [map_neg, hx]
  · intro x _ hx; simpa only [map_inv₀, hx]
  · intro x y _ _ hx hy; simpa only [map_mul, hx, hy]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.NestedReciprocalField.sigma_invariantField_coe
statement:
@[simp] theorem sigma_invariantField_coe (a : invariantField B m) :
    σ B m hm (a : Omega B) = a
proof:
:=
  invariantField_fixed B m hm a a.property

name: AlbertLean.Generic.NestedReciprocalField.T_quadratic
statement:
theorem T_quadratic :
    T B ^ 2 = S B m * T B - algebraMap B (Omega B) m
proof:
:= by
  rw [S]
  field_simp [T_ne_zero B]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.NestedReciprocalField.sigma_T_sub
statement: theorem sigma_T_sub : σ B m hm (T B) = S B m - T B
proof:
:= by
  rw [reciprocalEquiv_T, S]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.NestedReciprocalField.sigma_T_ne_T
statement: theorem sigma_T_ne_T : σ B m hm (T B) ≠ T B
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  rw [reciprocalEquiv_T] at h
  field_simp [T_ne_zero B] at h
  apply branchPolynomial_ne_zero B m
  exact sub_eq_zero.mpr h.symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.NestedReciprocalField.polynomialMap_mem_quadraticSpan
statement:
theorem polynomialMap_mem_quadraticSpan (p : Polynomial B) :
    algebraMap (Polynomial B) (Omega B) p ∈ quadraticSpan B m hm
proof:
:= by
  rw [← evalT_eq_algebraMap B]
  induction p using Polynomial.induction_on' with
  | add p q hp hq => simpa only [map_add] using Subfield.add_mem _ hp hq
  | monomial n b =>
      change (Polynomial.monomial n b).eval₂ (algebraMap B (Omega B)) (T B) ∈ _
      rw [eval₂_monomial]
      apply Subfield.mul_mem
      · exact ⟨⟨algebraMap B (Omega B) b,
          Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inl ⟨b,rfl⟩)⟩, 0, by simp⟩
      · exact (quadraticSpan B m hm).pow_mem
          (show T B ∈ quadraticSpan B m hm from ⟨0,1,by simp⟩) n

name: AlbertLean.Generic.NestedReciprocalField.quadraticSpan_eq_top
statement: theorem quadraticSpan_eq_top : quadraticSpan B m hm = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  apply top_unique
  intro x _
  obtain ⟨p,q,hq,rfl⟩ := IsFractionRing.div_surjective (Polynomial B) x
  apply Subfield.div_mem
  · exact polynomialMap_mem_quadraticSpan B m hm p
  · exact polynomialMap_mem_quadraticSpan B m hm q

name: AlbertLean.Generic.NestedReciprocalField.fixed_iff_mem_invariantField
statement:
theorem fixed_iff_mem_invariantField (x : Omega B) :
    σ B m hm x = x ↔ x ∈ invariantField B m
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨a,b,h⟩ := exists_two_coefficients B m hm x
    have hσ := congrArg (σ B m hm) h
    simp only [map_add, map_mul, sigma_invariantField_coe B m hm,
      sigma_T_sub B m hm, hx] at hσ
    have hb : b = 0 := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      have hz : ((b : Omega B) * (σ B m hm (T B) - T B)) = 0 := by
        rw [sigma_T_sub B m hm]
        linear_combination h - hσ
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hz).resolve_right (sub_ne_zero.mpr
        (sigma_T_ne_T B m hm))
    rw [h, hb]
    simpa using a.property
  · intro hx
    exact invariantField_fixed B m hm x hx

name: AlbertLean.Generic.NestedReciprocalField.invariantField_degree_two
statement:
theorem invariantField_degree_two (hm : m ≠ 0) :
    Module.finrank (invariantField B m) (Omega B) = 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (fixedCoordinatesEquiv B m hm).finrank_eq]
  simp

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.ComplexInvariantField.exists_raw_fraction
statement:
theorem exists_raw_fraction (f : FunctionField k) :
    ∃ a b : CoordinateRing k, rawToField k b ≠ 0 ∧
      f = rawToField k a / rawToField k b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, y, hy, hxy⟩ :=
    IsFractionRing.div_surjective (ReducedCoordinateRing k) f
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective x
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective y
  refine ⟨a, b, ?_, hxy.symm⟩
  change algebraMap (ReducedCoordinateRing k) (FunctionField k)
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk (rawFrameIdeal (R := k)).radical b) ≠ 0
  exact IsFractionRing.to_map_ne_zero_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors hy

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.ComplexInvariantField.agree_at_of_ledger_agreement
statement:
theorem agree_at_of_ledger_agreement
    (f : FunctionField k) (hinv : IsJordanInvariant k f)
    (L : Type u) [Field L]
    (left right : FunctionField k →+* L)
    (hagree : AgreeOnLedgerField k left right) : left f = right f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, hb, hf⟩ := exists_raw_fraction k f
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ, htransport⟩ :=
    embeddings_related_of_ledger_agreement k left right hagree
  rw [hf]
  exact extension_agreement_of_inner_or_transpose
    k left right (agree_scalarMap_comp k left right hagree)
      a b hb (by simpa only [← hf] using hinv) Q hQ htransport

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.ComplexInvariantField.jordanInvariantField_le_ledgerField
statement:
theorem jordanInvariantField_le_ledgerField :
    jordanInvariantField k ≤ ledgerField k
proof:
:= by
  intro f hf
  obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := FieldPointNilpotence.exists_base_of_field_embedding_agreement
    (ledgerField k) (FunctionField k) f (by
      intro L instL left right hbase
      letI : Field L := instL
      apply agree_at_of_ledger_agreement k f hf L left right
      intro x
      exact hbase x)
  rw [← hh]
  change (h : FunctionField k) ∈ ledgerField k
  exact h.property

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.ComplexInvariantField.jordanInvariantField_eq_ledgerField
statement:
theorem jordanInvariantField_eq_ledgerField :
    jordanInvariantField k = ledgerField k
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact jordanInvariantField_le_ledgerField k
  · exact ledgerField_le_jordanInvariantField k

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualLiteralLedgerDictionary.chart_power_diagonal_mem
statement:
theorem chart_power_diagonal_mem (F : Subfield K) (x : ExplicitFrameChart K)
    (hc : CoefficientsIn F x) (hr : ResidualDataIn F x) :
    ∀ i p q, diagLinear i
      (sourceProduct (power (encoderA x) p) (power (encoderB x) q)) ∈ F
proof:
:= by
  rcases hc with ⟨hda, hdb, hr1, hz1, hr2, hz2⟩
  rcases hr with ⟨hM, hroot⟩
  have hq : exteriorQ (matrixM x) ∈ F := exteriorQ_mem F _ hM
  have huv : normalizedUV x.s1 x.s2 x.c1 x.c2 ∈ F := by
    have heq := normalizedUV_exterior_identity x.s1 x.s2 x.c1 x.c2
    change normalizedUV x.s1 x.s2 x.c1 x.c2 = exteriorQ (matrixM x) -
      deltaX x.s1 x.s2 x.c1 x.c2 - deltaStarA x.s1 x.s2 x.c1 x.c2 at heq
    have hh : exteriorQ (matrixM x) -
        (deltaX x.s1 x.s2 x.c1 x.c2 + deltaStarA x.s1 x.s2 x.c1 x.c2) ∈ F :=
      F.sub_mem hq hroot
    rw [heq]
    convert hh using 1 <;> ring
  have hnS1 : nS x.s1 ∈ F := by
    simpa [matrixM, momentMatrix, nS] using hM 0 0
  have hnS2 : nS x.s2 ∈ F := by
    simpa [matrixM, momentMatrix, nS] using hM 1 1
  have hnC1 : nC x.c1 ∈ F := by
    simpa [matrixM, momentMatrix, nC] using hM 2 2
  have hnC2 : nC x.c2 ∈ F := by
    simpa [matrixM, momentMatrix, nC] using hM 3 3
  have hnV1 : nV (vectorA x) ∈ F := by
    simp [nV, vectorA, Pf, BW]
    exact F.mul_mem hr1 hz1
  have hnV2 : nV (vectorB x) ∈ F := by
    simp [nV, vectorB, Pf, BW]
    exact F.mul_mem hr2 hz2
  have hdiagA : ∀ p, DiagIn F (power (encoderA x) p) := by
    intro p i
    fin_cases p <;> fin_cases i <;>
      simp only [power, encoderA, sourceOne, diagLinear_zero, diagLinear_one,
        diagLinear_two, sourceSquare_d1, sourceSquare_d2, sourceSquare_d3,
        Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_two,
        vectorA, nV, nS, nC, BW, Pf, matrixM, momentMatrix] <;>
      aesop (add safe apply [F.add_mem, F.mul_mem, F.pow_mem, F.one_mem,
        F.zero_mem])
  have hdiagB : ∀ q, DiagIn F (power (encoderB x) q) := by
    intro q i
    fin_cases q <;> fin_cases i <;>
      simp only [power, encoderB, sourceOne, diagLinear_zero, diagLinear_one,
        diagLinear_two, sourceSquare_d1, sourceSquare_d2, sourceSquare_d3,
        Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_two,
        vectorB, nV, nS, nC, BW, Pf, matrixM, momentMatrix] <;>
      aesop (add safe apply [F.add_mem, F.mul_mem, F.pow_mem, F.one_mem,
        F.zero_mem])
  have hV : BV (vectorA x) (vectorB x) ∈ F := by
    simp [BV, BW, vectorA, vectorB]
    exact F.add_mem (F.mul_mem hr1 hz2) (F.mul_mem hz1 hr2)
  have hS : BS x.s1 x.s2 ∈ F := by
    change matrixM x 0 1 + matrixM x 1 0 ∈ F
    exact F.add_mem (hM 0 1) (hM 1 0)
  have hC : BC x.c1 x.c2 ∈ F := by
    change matrixM x 2 3 + matrixM x 3 2 ∈ F
    exact F.add_mem (hM 2 3) (hM 3 2)
  have htA1C2 : triality (vectorA x) x.s1 x.c2 ∈ F := by
    rw [show vectorA x = planeVector x.r1 x.z1 by rfl, plane_triality]
    change x.r1 * matrixM x 0 3 + x.z1 * matrixM x 3 0 ∈ F
    exact F.add_mem (F.mul_mem hr1 (hM 0 3)) (F.mul_mem hz1 (hM 3 0))
  have htA2C1 : triality (vectorA x) x.s2 x.c1 ∈ F := by
    rw [show vectorA x = planeVector x.r1 x.z1 by rfl, plane_triality]
    change x.r1 * matrixM x 1 2 + x.z1 * matrixM x 2 1 ∈ F
    exact F.add_mem (F.mul_mem hr1 (hM 1 2)) (F.mul_mem hz1 (hM 2 1))
  have htB1C2 : triality (vectorB x) x.s1 x.c2 ∈ F := by
    rw [show vectorB x = planeVector x.r2 x.z2 by rfl, plane_triality]
    change x.r2 * matrixM x 0 3 + x.z2 * matrixM x 3 0 ∈ F
    exact F.add_mem (F.mul_mem hr2 (hM 0 3)) (F.mul_mem hz2 (hM 3 0))
  have htB2C1 : triality (vectorB x) x.s2 x.c1 ∈ F := by
    rw [show vectorB x = planeVector x.r2 x.z2 by rfl, plane_triality]
    change x.r2 * matrixM x 1 2 + x.z2 * matrixM x 2 1 ∈ F
    exact F.add_mem (F.mul_mem hr2 (hM 1 2)) (F.mul_mem hz2 (hM 2 1))
  have htA2C2 : triality (vectorA x) x.s2 x.c2 ∈ F := by
    rw [show vectorA x = planeVector x.r1 x.z1 by rfl, plane_triality]
    change x.r1 * matrixM x 1 3 + x.z1 * matrixM x 3 1 ∈ F
    exact F.add_mem (F.mul_mem hr1 (hM 1 3)) (F.mul_mem hz1 (hM 3 1))
  have htB1C1 : triality (vectorB x) x.s1 x.c1 ∈ F := by
    rw [show vectorB x = planeVector x.r2 x.z2 by rfl, plane_triality]
    change x.r2 * matrixM x 0 2 + x.z2 * matrixM x 2 0 ∈ F
    exact F.add_mem (F.mul_mem hr2 (hM 0 2)) (F.mul_mem hz2 (hM 2 0))
  have hUC : BC (sourceMuC (vectorA x) x.s1)
      (sourceMuC (vectorB x) x.s2) ∈ F := by
    change BC (sourceMuC (planeVector x.r1 x.z1) x.s1)
      (sourceMuC (planeVector x.r2 x.z2) x.s2) ∈ F
    rw [plane_muC_pairing]
    change x.r1 * x.z2 * matrixM x 0 1 + x.r2 * x.z1 * matrixM x 1 0 ∈ F
    exact F.add_mem (F.mul_mem (F.mul_mem hr1 hz2) (hM 0 1))
      (F.mul_mem (F.mul_mem hr2 hz1) (hM 1 0))
  have hUS : BS (sourceMuS x.c1 (vectorA x))
      (sourceMuS x.c2 (vectorB x)) ∈ F := by
    change BS (sourceMuS x.c1 (planeVector x.r1 x.z1))
      (sourceMuS x.c2 (planeVector x.r2 x.z2)) ∈ F
    rw [plane_muS_pairing]
    change x.r2 * x.z1 * matrixM x 2 3 + x.r1 * x.z2 * matrixM x 3 2 ∈ F
    exact F.add_mem (F.mul_mem (F.mul_mem hr2 hz1) (hM 2 3))
      (F.mul_mem (F.mul_mem hr1 hz2) (hM 3 2))
  have hlVa : x.diagA 1 + x.diagA 2 ∈ F := F.add_mem (hda 1) (hda 2)
  have hlSa : x.diagA 0 + x.diagA 2 ∈ F := F.add_mem (hda 0) (hda 2)
  have hlCa : x.diagA 0 + x.diagA 1 ∈ F := F.add_mem (hda 0) (hda 1)
  have hlVb : x.diagB 1 + x.diagB 2 ∈ F := F.add_mem (hdb 1) (hdb 2)
  have hlSb : x.diagB 0 + x.diagB 2 ∈ F := F.add_mem (hdb 0) (hdb 2)
  have hlCb : x.diagB 0 + x.diagB 1 ∈ F := F.add_mem (hdb 0) (hdb 1)
  have ha2b : SectorIn F (sourceSquare (encoderA x)) (encoderB x) := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [sourceSquare_v, BV_add_left, BV_smul_left, muV_triality]
      simp only [encoderA, encoderB]
      exact F.add_mem (F.mul_mem hlVa hV) htB1C1
    · rw [sourceSquare_s, BS_add_left, BS_smul_left, muS_triality]
      simp only [encoderA, encoderB]
      exact F.add_mem (F.mul_mem hlSa hS) htA2C1
    · rw [sourceSquare_c, BC_add_left, BC_smul_left, muC_triality]
      simp only [encoderA, encoderB]
      exact F.add_mem (F.mul_mem hlCa hC) htA1C2
  have hab2 : SectorIn F (encoderA x) (sourceSquare (encoderB x)) := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [sourceSquare_v, BV_add_right, BV_smul_right]
      simp only [encoderA, encoderB]
      rw [
        BV_symmetric (vectorA x) (normalizedMuV x.s2 x.c2), muV_triality]
      exact F.add_mem (F.mul_mem hlVb hV) htA2C2
    · rw [sourceSquare_s, BS_add_right, BS_smul_right]
      simp only [encoderA, encoderB]
      rw [
        BS_symmetric x.s1 (sourceMuS x.c2 (vectorB x)), muS_triality]
      exact F.add_mem (F.mul_mem hlSb hS) htB1C2
    · rw [sourceSquare_c, BC_add_right, BC_smul_right]
      simp only [encoderA, encoderB]
      rw [
        BC_symmetric x.c1 (sourceMuC (vectorB x) x.s2), muC_triality]
      exact F.add_mem (F.mul_mem hlCb hC) htB2C1
  have ha2b2 : SectorIn F (sourceSquare (encoderA x))
      (sourceSquare (encoderB x)) := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [sourceSquare_v, BV_add_left, BV_add_right, BV_smul_left,
        BV_smul_right, normalizedUV, encoderA, encoderB]
      rw [BV_symmetric (vectorA x) (normalizedMuV x.s2 x.c2),
        muV_triality, muV_triality]
      aesop (add safe apply [F.add_mem, F.mul_mem])
    · simp only [sourceSquare_s, BS_add_left, BS_add_right, BS_smul_left,
        BS_smul_right, encoderA, encoderB]
      rw [BS_symmetric x.s1 (sourceMuS x.c2 (vectorB x)),
        muS_triality, muS_triality]
      aesop (add safe apply [F.add_mem, F.mul_mem])
    · simp only [sourceSquare_c, BC_add_left, BC_add_right, BC_smul_left,
        BC_smul_right, encoderA, encoderB]
      rw [BC_symmetric x.c1 (sourceMuC (vectorB x) x.s2),
        muC_triality, muC_triality]
      aesop (add safe apply [F.add_mem, F.mul_mem])
  have hab : SectorIn F (encoderA x) (encoderB x) := ⟨hV, hS, hC⟩
  have hsector : ∀ p q,
      SectorIn F (power (encoderA x) p) (power (encoderB x) q) := by
    intro p q
    fin_cases p <;> fin_cases q
    all_goals first
      | exact hab | exact hab2 | exact ha2b | exact ha2b2
      | simp [SectorIn, power, sourceOne, BV, BS, BC, BW, evalU]
  intro i p q
  have hpair := hsector p q
  fin_cases i <;> simp only [Fin.isValue, Function.comp_apply]
  · change (sourceProduct (power (encoderA x) p) (power (encoderB x) q)).d1 ∈ F
    rw [sourceProduct_d1]
    exact F.add_mem (F.mul_mem (hdiagA p 0) (hdiagB q 0))
      (F.div_mem (F.add_mem hpair.2.1 hpair.2.2) (natCast_mem F 2))
  · change (sourceProduct (power (encoderA x) p) (power (encoderB x) q)).d2 ∈ F
    rw [sourceProduct_d2]
    exact F.add_mem (F.mul_mem (hdiagA p 1) (hdiagB q 1))
      (F.div_mem (F.add_mem hpair.2.2 hpair.1) (natCast_mem F 2))
  · change (sourceProduct (power (encoderA x) p) (power (encoderB x) q)).d3 ∈ F
    rw [sourceProduct_d3]
    exact F.add_mem (F.mul_mem (hdiagA p 2) (hdiagB q 2))
      (F.div_mem (F.add_mem hpair.1 hpair.2.1) (natCast_mem F 2))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualLiteralLedgerDictionary.ledgerIn_of_chart_data
statement:
theorem ledgerIn_of_chart_data (F : Subfield K) (x : ExplicitFrameChart K)
    (hc : CoefficientsIn F x) (hr : ResidualDataIn F x) :
    LedgerIn F (sourceLedger (encoderA x) (encoderB x))
proof:
:=
  ledgerIn_of_power_diagonal_mem F _ _ (chart_power_diagonal_mem F x hc hr)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualLiteralLedgerDictionary.ledgerField_eq_chartField
statement:
theorem ledgerField_eq_chartField (base : Subfield K) (x : ExplicitFrameChart K)
    (hr1 : x.r1 ∈ base) (hz1 : x.z1 ∈ base)
    (hr2 : x.r2 ∈ base) (hz2 : x.z2 ∈ base)
    (hk : orientation x ≠ 0)
    (hNa : sourceNorm (encoderA x) = 0)
    (hNb : sourceNorm (encoderB x) = 0) :
    ledgerField base (encoderA x) (encoderB x) = chartField base x
proof:
:= by
  let L := ledgerField base (encoderA x) (encoderB x)
  have hInv := residual_moments_mem_ledgerField base x hr1 hz1 hr2 hz2 hk hNa hNb
  have hPow := powers_diag_mem L _ _ (ledgerIn_ledgerField base _ _)
  have hdiagA : ∀ i, x.diagA i ∈ L := by
    intro i
    fin_cases i
    · simpa [L, power, encoderA] using hPow.1 1 0
    · simpa [L, power, encoderA] using hPow.1 1 1
    · simpa [L, power, encoderA] using hPow.1 1 2
  have hdiagB : ∀ i, x.diagB i ∈ L := by
    intro i
    fin_cases i
    · simpa [L, power, encoderB] using hPow.2 1 0
    · simpa [L, power, encoderB] using hPow.2 1 1
    · simpa [L, power, encoderB] using hPow.2 1 2
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply Subfield.closure_le.2
    rintro t (ht | ht)
    · exact Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inl ht)
    · exact (ledgerCells_subset_iff (chartField base x) _ _).2
        (ledgerIn_of_chart_data (chartField base x) x
          ⟨(fun i => Subfield.subset_closure
              (Or.inr (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨i, rfl⟩))))),
           (fun i => Subfield.subset_closure
              (Or.inr (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨i, rfl⟩))))),
           Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inl hr1), Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inl hz1),
           Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inl hr2), Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inl hz2)⟩
          ⟨(fun i j => Subfield.subset_closure
              (Or.inr (Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨(i,j), rfl⟩)))),
           Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inr (Or.inr (by rfl)))⟩) ht
  · apply Subfield.closure_le.2
    rintro t (ht | ht)
    · exact Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inl ht)
    · rcases ht with ((ht | ht) | ht) | ht
      · rcases ht with ⟨i, rfl⟩; exact hdiagA i
      · rcases ht with ⟨i, rfl⟩; exact hdiagB i
      · rcases ht with ⟨⟨i,j⟩, rfl⟩; exact hInv.1 i j
      · rcases ht with rfl; exact hInv.2

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualLiteralLedgerDictionary.kappa_mem_of_lift
statement:
theorem kappa_mem_of_lift (F : Subfield K) (x : ExplicitFrameChart K)
    (hc : CoefficientsIn F x) (hlift : IsKappaLift x) : x.kappa ∈ F
proof:
:= by
  rcases hc with ⟨_, _, hr1, hz1, hr2, hz2⟩
  rw [← hlift]
  exact F.sub_mem (F.mul_mem hr1 hz2) (F.mul_mem hr2 hz1)

proof:
:= by

    MvPolynomial.C ((decode x : Mat6 k) a b)
  rcases a with a | a <;> rcases b with b | b <;>

proof:

  apply Matrix.ext
  intro i j

  exact map_mul MvPolynomial.C a (A i j)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawAutomorphism.product_on_constants
statement:
theorem product_on_constants (x y : Coordinates k) :
    productCoordinate k (MvPolynomial.C ∘ x) (MvPolynomial.C ∘ y) =
      MvPolynomial.C ∘ coordinateJordan x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [productCoordinate, ringMatrix_constants, ringMatrix_constants]
  have hprod :
      (MvPolynomial.C ((2 : k)⁻¹) : CR k) •
        ((MvPolynomial.C : k →+* CR k).mapMatrix (decode x : Mat6 k) *
          (MvPolynomial.C : k →+* CR k).mapMatrix (decode y : Mat6 k) +
         (MvPolynomial.C : k →+* CR k).mapMatrix (decode y : Mat6 k) *
          (MvPolynomial.C : k →+* CR k).mapMatrix (decode x : Mat6 k)) =
      (MvPolynomial.C : k →+* CR k).mapMatrix
        ((2 : k)⁻¹ • ((decode x : Mat6 k) * (decode y : Mat6 k) +
          (decode y : Mat6 k) * (decode x : Mat6 k))) := by
    rw [mapMatrix_constants_smul]
    simp only [map_add, map_mul]
  rw [hprod, matrixCoordinates_constants]
  funext c
  apply congrArg MvPolynomial.C
  change matrixCoordinates
    ((SelfAdjointCarrier.jordan (decode x) (decode y) : Carrier k) : Mat6 k) c =
      coordinateJordan x y c
  exact matrixCoordinates_carrier
    (SelfAdjointCarrier.jordan (decode x) (decode y)) c

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawAutomorphism.extended_map_product
statement:
theorem extended_map_product (g : Aut (K := k)) (x y : Coordinates (CR k)) :
    extendedCoordinateAut k g (productCoordinate k x y) =
      productCoordinate k (extendedCoordinateAut k g x)
        (extendedCoordinateAut k g y)
proof:
:= by
  have hBC : mappedProduct k g = productOfMapped k g := by
    apply bilinear_eq_of_standard_basis
    intro i j
    simp only [mappedProduct, productOfMapped, LinearMap.comp_apply, rawProduct_apply]
    change extendedCoordinateAut k g
        (productCoordinate k (Pi.single i 1) (Pi.single j 1)) =
      productCoordinate k
        (extendedCoordinateAut k g (Pi.single i 1))
        (extendedCoordinateAut k g (Pi.single j 1))
    rw [← show MvPolynomial.C ∘ (Pi.single i 1 : Coordinates k) =
        (Pi.single i 1 : Coordinates (CR k)) by funext q; simp [Pi.single_apply],
      ← show MvPolynomial.C ∘ (Pi.single j 1 : Coordinates k) =
        (Pi.single j 1 : Coordinates (CR k)) by funext q; simp [Pi.single_apply],
      product_on_constants]
    simp only [extendedCoordinateAut_apply]
    rw [extend_on_constants MvPolynomial.C (coordinateAut g).toLinearMap
          (coordinateJordan (Pi.single i (1 : k)) (Pi.single j (1 : k))),
      extend_on_constants MvPolynomial.C (coordinateAut g).toLinearMap
          (Pi.single i (1 : k)),
      extend_on_constants MvPolynomial.C (coordinateAut g).toLinearMap
          (Pi.single j (1 : k)),
      product_on_constants]
    exact congrArg (fun z : Coordinates k => MvPolynomial.C ∘ z)
      (coordinateAut_map_product g (Pi.single i (1 : k)) (Pi.single j (1 : k)))
  change mappedProduct k g x y = productOfMapped k g x y
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun (DFunLike.congr_fun hBC x) y

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericReorientationBase.rationalM_reorient
statement:
theorem rationalM_reorient :
    (rationalM k).map (reorient k).toRingHom = weightedTranspose k (rationalM k)
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  change reorient k (rationalM k i j) = (weight k i)⁻¹ * weight k j * rationalM k j i
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst j
    rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ (weight_ne_zero k i), one_mul]
    fin_cases i <;>
      simp [rationalM, reorient_nA0, reorient_nA2, reorient_nB1, reorient_nB3,
        reorient_PA, reorient_PB, map_div₀]
  · simp only [rationalM, dif_neg hij, dif_neg (Ne.symm hij)]
    exact reorient_off k ⟨(i,j), hij⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericReorientationBase.weightedTranspose_eq
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp [weightedTranspose, Matrix.diagonal_mul, Matrix.mul_diagonal] <;> ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericReorientationBase.weightedTranspose_det
statement:
theorem weightedTranspose_det (M : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) (B k)) :
    Matrix.det (weightedTranspose k M) = Matrix.det M
proof:
:= by
  have hd : Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (weight k i)⁻¹) *
      Matrix.diagonal (weight k) = (1 : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) (B k)) := by
    rw [Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
    have hw : (fun i => (weight k i)⁻¹ * weight k i) = (fun _ : Fin 4 => (1 : B k)) := by
      funext i
      exact inv_mul_cancel₀ (weight_ne_zero k i)
    rw [hw]
    simp
  rw [weightedTranspose_eq, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_transpose]
  calc
    _ = (Matrix.det (Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (weight k i)⁻¹)) *
        Matrix.det (Matrix.diagonal (weight k))) * Matrix.det M := by ring
    _ = Matrix.det M := by rw [← Matrix.det_mul, hd, Matrix.det_one, one_mul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericReorientationBase.reorient_det_rationalM
statement:
@[simp] theorem reorient_det_rationalM :
    reorient k (Matrix.det (rationalM k)) = Matrix.det (rationalM k)
proof:
:= by
  change (reorient k).toRingHom (Matrix.det (rationalM k)) = _
  rw [RingHom.map_det]
  change Matrix.det ((rationalM k).map (reorient k).toRingHom) = _
  rw [rationalM_reorient, weightedTranspose_det]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TitsJointPairing.firstComponent_fromTau_embed_mul
statement:
theorem firstComponent_fromTau_embed_mul (A : Mat3 R) (x : Albert R) :
    (fromTauRaw (embed A * x)).1 = matrixJordan A (fromTauRaw x).1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := (toTau (R := R)).surjective x
  have hinner : embed A * toTau z =
      toTau (polarProduct firstTitsSquare (A, 0, 0) z) := by
    exact (toTau_polarProduct (A, 0, 0) z).symm
  rw [hinner]
  change (fromTauRaw (toTauRaw
      (polarProduct firstTitsSquare (A, 0, 0) z))).1 =
    matrixJordan A (fromTauRaw (toTauRaw z)).1
  rw [fromTauRaw_toTauRaw, fromTauRaw_toTauRaw]
  exact polarProduct_firstComponent A z

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TitsJointPairing.trace_mul_matrixJordan
statement:
theorem trace_mul_matrixJordan (A B C : Mat3 R) :
    Matrix.trace (A * matrixJordan B C) =
      Matrix.trace (matrixJordan A B * C)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [matrixJordan, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul,
    Matrix.trace_smul, mul_add, add_mul, Matrix.trace_add]
  apply congrArg (fun t : R => ⅟(2 : R) • t)
  rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc A B C, ← Matrix.mul_assoc A C B,
    Matrix.trace_mul_cycle A C B]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TitsJointPairing.tauTrace_embed_mul_embed_mul_toTau
statement:
theorem tauTrace_embed_mul_embed_mul_toTau (A B : Mat3 R) (z : FirstTits R) :
    TauCeti.AlbertAlgebra.trace (embed A * (embed B * toTau z)) =
      Matrix.trace (matrixJordan A B * z.1)
proof:
:= by
  have hinner : embed B * toTau z =
      toTau (polarProduct firstTitsSquare (B, 0, 0) z) := by
    exact (toTau_polarProduct (B, 0, 0) z).symm
  rw [hinner, tauTrace_embed_mul_toTau, polarProduct_firstComponent,
    trace_mul_matrixJordan]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TitsJointPairing.two_smul_tauTrace_joint
statement:
theorem two_smul_tauTrace_joint (A B : Mat3 R) (z : FirstTits R) :
    (2 : R) • TauCeti.AlbertAlgebra.trace (embed A * (embed B * toTau z)) =
      Matrix.trace ((A * B + B * A) * z.1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tauTrace_embed_mul_embed_mul_toTau, matrixJordan,
    Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.trace_smul, smul_smul,
    mul_invOf_self, one_smul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TitsJointPairing.firstComponent_eq_of_joint_traces
statement:
theorem firstComponent_eq_of_joint_traces
    (f : Fin 3 → Mat3 K) (z w : FirstTits K)
    (hsum : f 0 + f 1 + f 2 = 1)
    (hsquare : encoder (f 0) (f 2) * encoder (f 0) (f 2) = f 0 + f 2)
    (hdet : Matrix.det
      (grading * encoder (f 0) (f 2) - encoder (f 0) (f 2) * grading) ≠ 0)
    (hjoint : ∀ i j,
      TauCeti.AlbertAlgebra.trace
          (embed (diagonalUnit i) * (embed (f j) * toTau z)) =
        TauCeti.AlbertAlgebra.trace
          (embed (diagonalUnit i) * (embed (f j) * toTau w))) :
    z.1 = w.1
proof:
:= by
  apply eq_of_labelled_probes (f 0) (f 1) (f 2) z.1 w.1 hsum hsquare hdet
  have hp (i j : Fin 3) : labelledProbe (f j) z.1 i = labelledProbe (f j) w.1 i := by
    have h := congrArg (fun t : K => (2 : K) • t) (hjoint i j)
    simpa only [two_smul_tauTrace_joint, labelledProbe] using h
  intro i
  exact ⟨hp i 0, hp i 1, hp i 2⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TitsJointPairing.firstComponent_eq_of_centered_joint_traces
statement:
theorem firstComponent_eq_of_centered_joint_traces
    (f : Fin 3 → Mat3 K) (z w : FirstTits K)
    (offset : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → K)
    (hsum : f 0 + f 1 + f 2 = 1)
    (hsquare : encoder (f 0) (f 2) * encoder (f 0) (f 2) = f 0 + f 2)
    (hdet : Matrix.det
      (grading * encoder (f 0) (f 2) - encoder (f 0) (f 2) * grading) ≠ 0)
    (hjoint : ∀ i j,
      TauCeti.AlbertAlgebra.trace
          (embed (diagonalUnit i) * (embed (f j) * toTau z)) - offset i j =
        TauCeti.AlbertAlgebra.trace
          (embed (diagonalUnit i) * (embed (f j) * toTau w)) - offset i j) :
    z.1 = w.1
proof:
:= by
  apply firstComponent_eq_of_joint_traces f z w hsum hsquare hdet
  intro i j
  exact sub_left_inj.mp (hjoint i j)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericNormalizedFrameChart.insert_equations
statement:
theorem insert_equations (p : OpenParameters K) :
    EquationsVanish (explicitFrameEquationValues (insert p))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [EquationsVanish, explicitFrameEquationValues, insert_matrixM]
  dsimp only [insert, chartWithResidualPair]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp [dA2]
  · simp [moment, spurSumA, m22]
  · have h := div_mul_cancel₀
      (normWeightedA p.toParameters - dA2 p.toParameters * spurSumA p.toParameters)
      p.pivotA_ne
    change m00 p.toParameters * pivotA p.toParameters = _ at h
    simp [pivotA, normWeightedA, rawOffDiag] at h
    simp [moment, m22]
    linear_combination -h
  · simp [dB2]
  · simp [moment, spurSumB, m33]
  · have h := div_mul_cancel₀
      (normWeightedB p.toParameters - dB2 p.toParameters * spurSumB p.toParameters)
      p.pivotB_ne
    change m11 p.toParameters * pivotB p.toParameters = _ at h
    simp [pivotB, normWeightedB, rawOffDiag] at h
    simp [moment, m33]
    linear_combination -h

    (insert p).z1 = p.a ∧ (insert p).r2 = p.b ∧ (insert p).z2 = p.c ∧
    (∀ i j, (h : i ≠ j) → matrixM (insert p) i j = p.offDiag (i,j) h) ∧
    Matrix.det (residualPairOfChart (insert p)).X = p.Delta
proof:

    simp [moment, h]
