name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexPairRoots.roots_eq_or_eq_dual
statement:
theorem roots_eq_or_eq_dual (p q r s x y : K)
    (hA2 : A2 p q r ≠ 0) (hx : x ≠ 0)
    (hQx : pairQuadratic p q r s x = 0)
    (hQy : pairQuadratic p q r s y = 0) :
    y = x ∨ y = dualRoot p q r s x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hyx : y = x
  · exact Or.inl hyx
  · right
    have hfactor : (y-x) * (A2 p q r * (y+x) +
        (p*(1-p-q-r)+(1-p)*(p+q+r+s-1)-q*r)) = 0 := by
      simp only [pairQuadratic, A2] at hQx hQy ⊢
      linear_combination hQy - hQx
    have hlinear : A2 p q r * (y+x) +
        (p*(1-p-q-r)+(1-p)*(p+q+r+s-1)-q*r) = 0 :=
      (mul_eq_zero.mp hfactor).resolve_left (sub_ne_zero.mpr hyx)
    have hproduct : A2 p q r * x * y = A0 p q r s := by
      simp only [pairQuadratic, A2, A0] at hQx hlinear ⊢
      linear_combination x * hlinear - hQx
    unfold dualRoot
    apply (eq_div_iff (mul_ne_zero hA2 hx)).2
    simpa only [mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm] using hproduct

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexPairRoots.dephased_eq_of_overlap_of_d_eq
statement:
theorem dephased_eq_of_overlap_of_d_eq
    (a b c d a' b' c' d' : K)
    (hΔ : delta a b c d ≠ 0) (hΔ' : delta a' b' c' d' ≠ 0)
    (hnu : nu (overlap a b c d 0 0) (overlap a b c d 0 1)
      (overlap a b c d 1 0) (overlap a b c d 1 1) d ≠ 0)
    (hnu' : nu (overlap a' b' c' d' 0 0) (overlap a' b' c' d' 0 1)
      (overlap a' b' c' d' 1 0) (overlap a' b' c' d' 1 1) d' ≠ 0)
    (hover : ∀ i j, overlap a' b' c' d' i j = overlap a b c d i j)
    (hd : d' = d) : dephased a' b' c' d' = dephased a b c d
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ha, hb, hc⟩ := reconstruct_entries a b c d hΔ hnu
  obtain ⟨ha', hb', hc'⟩ := reconstruct_entries a' b' c' d' hΔ' hnu'
  simp only [hover] at ha' hb' hc'
  simp only [hd] at ha' hb' hc'
  have hea : a' = a := ha'.trans ha.symm
  have heb : b' = b := hb'.trans hb.symm
  have hec : c' = c := hc'.trans hc.symm
  simp only [hea, heb, hec, hd]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertSameGaugePairComparison.roots_eq_or_swapped
proof:
:= by
  have hfactor : (x - u) * (x - v) = 0 := by
    calc
      (x - u) * (x - v) = x ^ 2 - (u + v) * x + u * v := by ring
      _ = x ^ 2 - (x + y) * x + x * y := by rw [← hs, ← hp]
      _ = 0 := by ring
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hfactor with hxu | hxv
  · left
    refine ⟨sub_eq_zero.mp hxu, ?_⟩
    calc
      y = (x + y) - x := by ring
      _ = (u + v) - u := by rw [hs, sub_eq_zero.mp hxu]
      _ = v := by ring
  · right
    refine ⟨sub_eq_zero.mp hxv, ?_⟩
    calc
      y = (x + y) - x := by ring
      _ = (u + v) - v := by rw [hs, sub_eq_zero.mp hxv]
      _ = u := by ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertSameGaugePairComparison.same_gauge_detector_pair_eq_or_swapped
statement:
theorem same_gauge_detector_pair_eq_or_swapped
    (q q' : ExplicitFrameChart K)
    (hopen : ResidualOpen (residualPairOfChart q))
    (hopen' : ResidualOpen (residualPairOfChart q'))
    (hledger : sourceLedger (encoderA q) (encoderB q) =
      sourceLedger (encoderA q') (encoderB q'))
    (a b c sigma : K)
    (hq : EquationsVanish (explicitFrameEquationValues q))
    (hq' : EquationsVanish (explicitFrameEquationValues q'))
    (hr1 : q.r1 = 1) (hz1 : q.z1 = a)
    (hr2 : q.r2 = b) (hz2 : q.z2 = c)
    (hr1' : q'.r1 = 1) (hz1' : q'.z1 = a)
    (hr2' : q'.r2 = b) (hz2' : q'.z2 = c)
    (hb : b = (gramV12 q - sigma) / (2*a))
    (hc : c = (gramV12 q + sigma) / 2)
    (hb' : b = (gramV12 q' - sigma) / (2*a))
    (hc' : c = (gramV12 q' + sigma) / 2)
    (hsigma : sigma ≠ 0) (ha : 2*a ≠ 0) :
    (sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1) (encoderA q) (encoderB q) =
        sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1)
          (encoderA q') (encoderB q') ∧
      sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1)
          (encoderA (companion q hopen)) (encoderB (companion q hopen)) =
        sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1)
          (encoderA (companion q' hopen')) (encoderB (companion q' hopen'))) ∨
    (sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1) (encoderA q) (encoderB q) =
        sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1)
          (encoderA (companion q' hopen')) (encoderB (companion q' hopen')) ∧
      sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1)
          (encoderA (companion q hopen)) (encoderB (companion q hopen)) =
        sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1) (encoderA q') (encoderB q'))
proof:
:= by
  have htwo : (2 : K) ≠ 0 := by norm_num
  have hgram_q : c * 2 = gramV12 q + sigma := (eq_div_iff htwo).mp hc
  have hgram_q' : c * 2 = gramV12 q' + sigma := (eq_div_iff htwo).mp hc'
  have hgram : gramV12 q = gramV12 q' := by
    calc
      gramV12 q = c * 2 - sigma := by rw [hgram_q]; ring
      _ = gramV12 q' := by rw [hgram_q']; ring
  have hreconstructed : reconstructedMatrix q a sigma =
      reconstructedMatrix q' a sigma := by
    simp only [reconstructedMatrix, hledger, hgram]
  have hdetectorS : detectorS q a sigma = detectorS q' a sigma := by
    simp only [detectorS, hreconstructed, hledger]
  have hmatrix_q : matrixM q = reconstructedMatrix q a sigma :=
    matrixM_eq_uniform_inverse q a b c sigma hq hr1 hz1 hr2 hz2
      hb hc hsigma ha
  have hmatrix_q' : matrixM q' = reconstructedMatrix q' a sigma :=
    matrixM_eq_uniform_inverse q' a b c sigma hq' hr1' hz1' hr2' hz2'
      hb' hc' hsigma ha
  have hmatrix : matrixM q = matrixM q' :=
    hmatrix_q.trans (hreconstructed.trans hmatrix_q'.symm)
  have hroot_sum :
      delta (residualPairOfChart q) + deltaStar (residualPairOfChart q) =
        delta (residualPairOfChart q') + deltaStar (residualPairOfChart q') := by
    rw [← detectorS_eq_rootSum q a b c sigma hq hr1 hz1 hr2 hz2 hb hc hsigma ha,
      ← detectorS_eq_rootSum q' a b c sigma hq' hr1' hz1' hr2' hz2' hb' hc' hsigma ha]
    exact hdetectorS
  have hroot_product :
      delta (residualPairOfChart q) * deltaStar (residualPairOfChart q) =
        delta (residualPairOfChart q') * deltaStar (residualPairOfChart q') := by
    rw [← matrixM_det_eq_root_product q, ← matrixM_det_eq_root_product q', hmatrix]
  have hroots := roots_eq_or_swapped
    (delta (residualPairOfChart q)) (deltaStar (residualPairOfChart q))
    (delta (residualPairOfChart q')) (deltaStar (residualPairOfChart q'))
    hroot_sum hroot_product
  have hepsilon : actualEpsilon q a b c sigma =
      actualEpsilon q' a b c sigma := by
    simp only [actualEpsilon, reconstructedMatrix, detectorS, hledger, hgram]
  have hbeta : actualBeta q a b c sigma = actualBeta q' a b c sigma := by
    simp only [actualBeta, reconstructedMatrix, detectorS, hledger, hgram]
  have hdet_q := sourceDetector_eq_actualEpsilon_add_actualBeta_mul_delta
    q a b c sigma hq hr1 hz1 hr2 hz2 hb hc hsigma ha
      (matrixM_det_ne_zero q hopen)
  have hdet_q' := sourceDetector_eq_actualEpsilon_add_actualBeta_mul_delta
    q' a b c sigma hq' hr1' hz1' hr2' hz2' hb' hc' hsigma ha
      (matrixM_det_ne_zero q' hopen')
  have hcomp_q_sub := companion_detector_sub q hopen a b c sigma
    hq hr1 hz1 hr2 hz2 hb hc hsigma ha
  have hcomp_q'_sub := companion_detector_sub q' hopen' a b c sigma
    hq' hr1' hz1' hr2' hz2' hb' hc' hsigma ha
  have hcomp_q :
      sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1)
          (encoderA (companion q hopen)) (encoderB (companion q hopen)) =
        actualEpsilon q a b c sigma + actualBeta q a b c sigma *
          deltaStar (residualPairOfChart q) := by
    calc
      _ = sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1) (encoderA q) (encoderB q) +
          actualBeta q a b c sigma *
            (deltaStar (residualPairOfChart q) - delta (residualPairOfChart q)) :=
        by simpa [add_comm] using (sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mp hcomp_q_sub)
      _ = _ := by rw [hdet_q]; ring
  have hcomp_q' :
      sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1)
          (encoderA (companion q' hopen')) (encoderB (companion q' hopen')) =
        actualEpsilon q' a b c sigma + actualBeta q' a b c sigma *
          deltaStar (residualPairOfChart q') := by
    calc
      _ = sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1) (encoderA q') (encoderB q') +
          actualBeta q' a b c sigma *
            (deltaStar (residualPairOfChart q') - delta (residualPairOfChart q')) :=
        by simpa [add_comm] using (sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mp hcomp_q'_sub)
      _ = _ := by rw [hdet_q']; ring
  rcases hroots with hordered | hswapped
  · left
    constructor
    · rw [hdet_q, hdet_q', hepsilon, hbeta, hordered.1]
    · rw [hcomp_q, hcomp_q', hepsilon, hbeta, hordered.2]
  · right
    constructor
    · rw [hdet_q, hcomp_q', hepsilon, hbeta, hswapped.1]
    · rw [hcomp_q, hdet_q', hepsilon, hbeta, hswapped.2]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertInvariantField.scalarMap_mem_base

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertInvariantField.exists_raw_fraction
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a0, b0, hb0, h⟩ :=
    IsFractionRing.div_surjective (RR k) x
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective a0
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective b0
  refine ⟨a, b, ?_, h.symm⟩
  change algebraMap (RR k) (FF k)
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk (rawFrameIdeal (k := k)).radical b) ≠ 0
  exact IsFractionRing.to_map_ne_zero_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors hb0

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertInvariantField.denominator_ne
statement:
private theorem denominator_ne

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertInvariantField.cleared_even
statement:
private theorem cleared_even
    (hb : rawToFunction k b ≠ 0)
    (hinv : ∀ g : ResidualAction.SourceAut (K := k),
      fractionAction k g (rawToFunction k a / rawToFunction k b) =
        rawToFunction k a / rawToFunction k b)
    (p : EvenFactorData E) : Cleared k phi a b p.aut
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Cleared, A, B, EvenFactorData.aut, actualEvenRawAction] using
    reduced_cleared_sourceEven_identity k E phi a b hb hinv
      p.A p.B p.rho p.hA p.hB p.root p.rho_ne

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertInvariantField.sourceAutComp_eq_thenAut
statement:
private theorem sourceAutComp_eq_thenAut
    (g2 g1 : ResidualAction.SourceAut (K := E)) :
    sourceAutComp g2 g1 = thenAut g1 g2
proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertInvariantField.cleared_twoEven
statement:
private theorem cleared_twoEven
    (hb : rawToFunction k b ≠ 0)
    (hinv : ∀ g : ResidualAction.SourceAut (K := k),
      fractionAction k g (rawToFunction k a / rawToFunction k b) =
        rawToFunction k a / rawToFunction k b)
    (w : TwoEvenWord E) : Cleared k phi a b w.aut
proof:
:= by
  have hi := cleared_even k phi a b hb hinv w.inner
  have ho := cleared_even k phi a b hb hinv w.outer
  rw [TwoEvenWord.aut, sourceAutComp_eq_thenAut]
  exact cleared_thenAut E w.inner.aut w.outer.aut
    (A k phi a) (B k phi b) (denominator_ne k phi b hb) hi ho

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertInvariantField.cleared_peirce
statement:
private theorem cleared_peirce
    (hb : rawToFunction k b ≠ 0)
    (hinv : ∀ g : ResidualAction.SourceAut (K := k),
      fractionAction k g (rawToFunction k a / rawToFunction k b) =
        rawToFunction k a / rawToFunction k b)
    (p : JCoord E) (hp : sourceProduct p p = p)
    (ht : sourceTrace p = 1) :
    Cleared k phi a b (SourcePeirceAttachment.sourcePeirceAut p hp)
proof:
:= by
  exact reduced_cleared_sourcePeirce_identity k E phi a b hb hinv p hp ht

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertInvariantField.cleared_mappedSlot
statement:
private theorem cleared_mappedSlot
    {L : Type u} [Field L] [CharZero L]
    (hb : rawToFunction k b ≠ 0)
    (hinv : ∀ g : ResidualAction.SourceAut (K := k),
      fractionAction k g (rawToFunction k a / rawToFunction k b) =
        rawToFunction k a / rawToFunction k b)
    (f : L →+* E) (i : Fin 3) (z : SlotPoint L) :
    Cleared k phi a b (mappedSlotAut f i z)
proof:
:= by
  have hs := cleared_peirce k phi a b hb hinv (diagonalUnit i)
    (SourcePivotCharts.standard_idempotent i)
    ((SourceScheduleRawVanishing.standardFrameLaws (L := E)).trace_one i)
  have hp : sourceProduct (mapSource f (SourcePivotCharts.chart i z.u z.v))
      (mapSource f (SourcePivotCharts.chart i z.u z.v)) =
      mapSource f (SourcePivotCharts.chart i z.u z.v) := by
    rw [← mapSource_product, SourcePivotCharts.chart_idempotent i z.u z.v
      z.denominator_ne]
  have ht : sourceTrace (mapSource f (SourcePivotCharts.chart i z.u z.v)) = 1 := by
    rw [mapSource_trace, SourcePivotCharts.chart_trace i z.u z.v z.denominator_ne,
      map_one]
  have hc := cleared_peirce k phi a b hb hinv _ hp ht
  exact cleared_thenAut E _ _ (A k phi a) (B k phi b)
    (denominator_ne k phi b hb) hs hc

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertInvariantField.cleared_mappedStage
statement:
private theorem cleared_mappedStage
    {L : Type u} [Field L] [CharZero L]
    (hb : rawToFunction k b ≠ 0)
    (hinv : ∀ g : ResidualAction.SourceAut (K := k),
      fractionAction k g (rawToFunction k a / rawToFunction k b) =
        rawToFunction k a / rawToFunction k b)
    (f : L →+* E) (Z : Fin 3 → SlotPoint L) :
    Cleared k phi a b (mappedStageAut f Z)
proof:
:= by
  have h2 := cleared_mappedSlot k phi a b hb hinv f 2 (Z 2)
  have h1 := cleared_mappedSlot k phi a b hb hinv f 1 (Z 1)
  have h0 := cleared_mappedSlot k phi a b hb hinv f 0 (Z 0)
  exact cleared_thenAut E _ _ _ _ (denominator_ne k phi b hb) h2
    (cleared_thenAut E _ _ _ _ (denominator_ne k phi b hb) h1 h0)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertInvariantField.cleared_mappedSchedule
statement:
private theorem cleared_mappedSchedule
    {L : Type u} [Field L] [CharZero L]
    (hb : rawToFunction k b ≠ 0)
    (hinv : ∀ g : ResidualAction.SourceAut (K := k),
      fractionAction k g (rawToFunction k a / rawToFunction k b) =
        rawToFunction k a / rawToFunction k b)
    (f : L →+* E) (Z : Schedule L) :
    Cleared k phi a b (mappedScheduleAut f Z)
proof:
:= by
  have h3 := cleared_mappedStage k phi a b hb hinv f (Z 3)
  have h2 := cleared_mappedStage k phi a b hb hinv f (Z 2)
  have h1 := cleared_mappedStage k phi a b hb hinv f (Z 1)
  have h0 := cleared_mappedStage k phi a b hb hinv f (Z 0)
  exact cleared_thenAut E _ _ _ _ (denominator_ne k phi b hb) h3
    (cleared_thenAut E _ _ _ _ (denominator_ne k phi b hb) h2
      (cleared_thenAut E _ _ _ _ (denominator_ne k phi b hb) h1 h0))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertInvariantField.twoEvenWord_apply

private theorem twoEvenWord_apply (w : TwoEvenWord E) (x : JCoord E) :

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertInvariantField.evenSourceAut_apply_sourceEvenAut
statement:
private theorem evenSourceAut_apply_sourceEvenAut
    (A B : VCoord E) (rho : E)
    (hA : nV A ≠ 0) (hB : nV B ≠ 0)
    (hr : rho ^ 2 = nV A * nV B) (hr0 : rho ≠ 0) (x : JCoord E) :
    (evenSourceAut A B rho hA hB hr hr0).linear x =
      (AlbertLean.Triality.SourceEvenAutomorphism.sourceEvenAut
        A B rho hA hB hr hr0).linear x

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertInvariantField.reflectionSourceAut_apply

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertInvariantField.reflectionWord_factors_apply

      (GenericReflectionGauge.sourceAut a ha).linear x
proof:

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertInvariantField.reflectionWord_apply

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertInvariantField.sourceAut_ext

private theorem sourceAut_ext (g h : ResidualAction.SourceAut (K := E))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertInvariantField.reflectionWord_eq

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertInvariantField.cleared_reflection
statement:
private theorem cleared_reflection
    (hb : rawToFunction k b ≠ 0)
    (hinv : ∀ g : ResidualAction.SourceAut (K := k),
      fractionAction k g (rawToFunction k a / rawToFunction k b) =
        rawToFunction k a / rawToFunction k b)
    (z : E) (hz : z ≠ 0) :
    Cleared k phi a b (GenericReflectionGauge.sourceAut z hz)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← reflectionWord_eq z hz]
  exact cleared_twoEven k phi a b hb hinv (reflectionWord z hz)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertInvariantField.cleared_residual
statement:
private theorem cleared_residual
    (hb : rawToFunction k b ≠ 0)
    (hinv : ∀ g : ResidualAction.SourceAut (K := k),
      fractionAction k g (rawToFunction k a / rawToFunction k b) =
        rawToFunction k a / rawToFunction k b)
    (G : DetOneMatrix E) :
    Cleared k phi a b (ResidualAction.sourceAut G)
proof:
:= by
  exact reduced_cleared_residual_identity k E phi a b hb hinv G

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertInvariantField.cleared_assembled_of_factors
statement:
private theorem cleared_assembled_of_factors
    (Sleft wleft H wright Sright : ResidualAction.SourceAut (K := E))
    (hden : B k phi b ≠ 0)
    (hSL : Cleared k phi a b Sleft) (hwL : Cleared k phi a b wleft)
    (hHC : Cleared k phi a b H) (hwR : Cleared k phi a b wright)
    (hSR : Cleared k phi a b Sright) :
    Cleared k phi a b (assembledAut Sleft wleft H wright Sright)
proof:
:= by
  have hSLi := cleared_inverseSourceAut E Sleft (A k phi a) (B k phi b) hSL
  have hwRi := cleared_inverseSourceAut E wright
    (A k phi a) (B k phi b) hwR
  have h4 := cleared_thenAut E (inverseSourceAut E wright) Sright
    (A k phi a) (B k phi b) hden hwRi hSR
  have h3 := cleared_thenAut E H
    (thenAut (inverseSourceAut E wright) Sright)
    (A k phi a) (B k phi b) hden hHC h4
  have h2 := cleared_thenAut E wleft
    (thenAut H (thenAut (inverseSourceAut E wright) Sright))
    (A k phi a) (B k phi b) hden hwL h3
  have h1 := cleared_thenAut E (inverseSourceAut E Sleft)
    (thenAut wleft
      (thenAut H (thenAut (inverseSourceAut E wright) Sright)))
    (A k phi a) (B k phi b) hden hSLi h2
  exact h1

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertInvariantField.cleared_assembled
statement:
private theorem cleared_assembled
    {L : Type u} [Field L] [CharZero L]
    (hb : rawToFunction k b ≠ 0)
    (hinv : ∀ g : ResidualAction.SourceAut (K := k),
      fractionAction k g (rawToFunction k a / rawToFunction k b) =
        rawToFunction k a / rawToFunction k b)
    (f : ComparisonField k →+* L) (left right : L →+* E)
    (w : TwoEvenWord L) (wleft wright : TwoEvenWord E)
    (Sleft Sright H T : ResidualAction.SourceAut (K := E))
    (hwleft : wleft = mapTwoEvenWord left w)
    (hwright : wright = mapTwoEvenWord right w)
    (hSleft : Sleft = mappedScheduleAut (left.comp f) (firstSchedule k))
    (hSright : Sright = mappedScheduleAut (right.comp f) (firstSchedule k))
    (hT : T = assembledAut Sleft wleft.aut H wright.aut Sright)
    (hH : (∃ G : DetOneMatrix E, H = ResidualAction.sourceAut G) ∨
      (∃ (G : DetOneMatrix E) (z : E) (hz : z ≠ 0),
        H = thenAut (ResidualAction.sourceAut G)
          (GenericReflectionGauge.sourceAut z hz))) :
    Cleared k phi a b T
proof:
:= by
  have hden := denominator_ne k phi b hb
  have hSL : Cleared k phi a b Sleft := by
    rw [hSleft]
    exact cleared_mappedSchedule k phi a b hb hinv (left.comp f) (firstSchedule k)
  have hSR : Cleared k phi a b Sright := by
    rw [hSright]
    exact cleared_mappedSchedule k phi a b hb hinv (right.comp f) (firstSchedule k)
  have hwL : Cleared k phi a b wleft.aut := by
    rw [hwleft]
    exact cleared_twoEven k phi a b hb hinv _
  have hwR : Cleared k phi a b wright.aut := by
    rw [hwright]
    exact cleared_twoEven k phi a b hb hinv _
  have hHC : Cleared k phi a b H := by
    rcases hH with ⟨G, rfl⟩ | ⟨G, z, hz, rfl⟩
    · exact cleared_residual k phi a b hb hinv G
    · exact cleared_thenAut E _ _ _ _ hden
        (cleared_residual k phi a b hb hinv G)
        (cleared_reflection k phi a b hb hinv z hz)
  rw [hT]
  exact cleared_assembled_of_factors k phi a b
    Sleft wleft.aut H wright.aut Sright hden hSL hwL hHC hwR hSR

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertInvariantField.invariant_agreement_of_ledgerDetector_agreement
statement:
theorem invariant_agreement_of_ledgerDetector_agreement
    {K : Type u} [Field K] [CharZero K]
    (phi psi : FF k →+* K)
    (hbase : ∀ z : ledgerDetectorField k, phi z.val = psi z.val)
    (x : FF k) (hx : x ∈ invariantField k) : phi x = psi x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, hb, hxfrac⟩ := exists_raw_fraction k x
  have hinv : ∀ g : ResidualAction.SourceAut (K := k),
      fractionAction k g (rawToFunction k a / rawToFunction k b) =
        rawToFunction k a / rawToFunction k b := by
    rw [← hxfrac]
    exact hx
  obtain ⟨E, iE, cE, j, L, iL, cL, f, sigma, w, q, left, right,
      wleft, wright, Sleft, Sright, H, T, hj, hwleft, hwright,
      hSleft, hSright, hT, hprov, hpoint⟩ :=
    exists_two_point_transporter k phi psi hbase
  letI : Field E := iE
  letI : CharZero E := cE
  letI : Field L := iL
  letI : CharZero L := cL
  have hscalar : originalCoefficientEmbedding k E (j.comp phi) =
      originalCoefficientEmbedding k E (j.comp psi) := by
    ext c
    change j (phi (scalarMap k c)) = j (psi (scalarMap k c))
    exact congrArg j (hbase ⟨_, scalarMap_mem_base k c⟩)
  have hH : (∃ G : DetOneMatrix E, H = ResidualAction.sourceAut G) ∨
      (∃ (G : DetOneMatrix E) (z : E) (hz : z ≠ 0),
        H = thenAut (ResidualAction.sourceAut G)
          (GenericReflectionGauge.sourceAut z hz)) := by
    rcases hprov with ⟨G, hHG, hg, hginv⟩ | ⟨G, hHG, hg, hginv⟩
    · exact Or.inl ⟨G, hHG⟩
    · let z := left (f (nV (comparisonA k).v))
      have hz : z ≠ 0 := by
        simpa only [z, map_zero] using
          left.injective.ne (f.injective.ne (comparison_dephase_open k).1)
      exact Or.inr ⟨G, z, hz, by simpa only [z] using hHG⟩
  have hclear := cleared_assembled k (j.comp phi) a b hb hinv f left right
    w wleft wright Sleft Sright H T hwleft hwright hSleft hSright hT hH
  have hbReduced : reducedInclusion k
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (rawFrameIdeal (k := k)).radical b) ≠ 0 := hb
  have hagree := final_cleared_agreement k E (j.comp phi) (j.comp psi) T
    hscalar hpoint
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk (rawFrameIdeal (k := k)).radical a)
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk (rawFrameIdeal (k := k)).radical b)
    hbReduced hclear
  apply j.injective
  change (j.comp phi) x = (j.comp psi) x
  rw [hxfrac]
  exact hagree

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertInvariantField.invariantField_le_ledgerDetectorField
statement:
theorem invariantField_le_ledgerDetectorField :
    invariantField k ≤ ledgerDetectorField k
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := FieldPointNilpotence.exists_base_of_field_embedding_agreement
    (ledgerDetectorField k) (FF k) x (by
      intro K instK phi psi hbase
      letI : Field K := instK
      letI : CharZero K :=
        FiniteQuadraticRoots.charZero_of_embedding (phi.comp (scalarMap k))
      exact invariant_agreement_of_ledgerDetector_agreement k phi psi hbase x hx)
  rw [← hz]
  exact z.property

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertInvariantField.invariantField_eq_ledgerDetectorField
statement:
theorem invariantField_eq_ledgerDetectorField :
    invariantField k = ledgerDetectorField k
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact invariantField_le_ledgerDetectorField k
  · exact ledgerDetectorField_le_invariantField k

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertInvariantField.invariantField_finrank_eq_two
statement:
theorem invariantField_finrank_eq_two :
    Module.finrank (AlbertRawDetectorExactDegreeTwo.H k)
      (invariantField k) = 2
proof:
:= by
  calc
    Module.finrank (AlbertRawDetectorExactDegreeTwo.H k)
        (invariantField k) =
        Module.finrank (AlbertRawDetectorExactDegreeTwo.H k)
          (ledgerDetectorField k) :=
      (invariantFieldEquivLedgerDetector k).finrank_eq
    _ = 2 := ledgerDetectorField_finrank_eq_two k

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFractionActionUniversalF0.fractionAction_algebraMap_reduced
statement:
@[simp] theorem fractionAction_algebraMap_reduced
    (g : SourceAut (K := k)) (x : ReducedCoordinateRing k) :
    fractionAction k g
        (algebraMap (ReducedCoordinateRing k) (F k) x) =
      algebraMap (ReducedCoordinateRing k) (F k) (reducedAction k g x)
proof:
:=
  IsFractionRing.ringEquivOfRingEquiv_algebraMap (reducedAction k g) x

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFractionActionUniversalF0.fractionAction_universalF0
statement:
theorem fractionAction_universalF0
    (g : SourceAut (K := k)) (r i : Fin 3) :
    (fun c => fractionAction k g (universalF0 k r i c)) =
      linearEquiv (R := F k) g (universalF0 k r i)
proof:
:= by
  funext c
  rw [universalF0, Function.comp_apply, rawToFunction,
    RingHom.comp_apply, fractionAction_algebraMap_reduced]
  change algebraMap (ReducedCoordinateRing k) (F k)
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (rawAction k g (universalVector r i c))) = _
  rw [show rawAction k g (universalVector r i c) =
      transformedUniversalVector k g r i c from
    congrFun (rawAction_universalVector k g r i) c]
  have hn := linearEquiv_natural (R := CoordinateRing k)
    (rawToFunctionAlg k) g (universalVector r i)
  exact congrFun hn c

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.actual_same_ledger_weighted_pair_data
statement:
theorem actual_same_ledger_weighted_pair_data
    (E F E' F' : Fin 3 → Carrier K)
    (hEidem : ∀ i, (E i : Mat6 K) * E i = E i)
    (hEsum : (E 0 : Mat6 K) + E 1 + E 2 = 1)
    (hFidem : ∀ i, (F i : Mat6 K) * F i = F i)
    (hFsum : (F 0 : Mat6 K) + F 1 + F 2 = 1)
    (hEidem' : ∀ i, (E' i : Mat6 K) * E' i = E' i)
    (hEsum' : (E' 0 : Mat6 K) + E' 1 + E' 2 = 1)
    (hFidem' : ∀ i, (F' i : Mat6 K) * F' i = F' i)
    (hFsum' : (F' 0 : Mat6 K) + F' 1 + F' 2 = 1)
    (u v u' v' : Vec6 K) (p : Fin 3 → K)
    (hp : ∀ i, p i = (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u)
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v))
    (hp' : ∀ i, p i = (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E' i : Mat6 K) u')
      (matrixAction (E' i : Mat6 K) v')) (hpne : ∀ i, p i ≠ 0)
    (hFu : ∀ i, matrixAction (F 0 : Mat6 K)
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u) = p i • u)
    (hFv : ∀ i, matrixAction (F 0 : Mat6 K)
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v) = p i • v)
    (hFu' : ∀ i, matrixAction (F' 0 : Mat6 K)
      (matrixAction (E' i : Mat6 K) u') = p i • u')
    (hFv' : ∀ i, matrixAction (F' 0 : Mat6 K)
      (matrixAction (E' i : Mat6 K) v') = p i • v')
    (hledger : ∀ i,
      jordanTrace (K := K) ((E i : Mat6 K) * (F 1 : Mat6 K)) =
      jordanTrace (K := K) ((E' i : Mat6 K) * (F' 1 : Mat6 K))) :
    let L
proof:
:= weightedCoordinateEquiv E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne
    let L' := weightedCoordinateEquiv E' hEidem' hEsum' u' v' p hp' hpne
    let B := fun i j => weightedBlock
      (coordinateConjugate L (matrixAction (F 1 : Mat6 K))) i j
    let C := fun i j => weightedBlock
      (coordinateConjugate L' (matrixAction (F' 1 : Mat6 K))) i j
    ∃ q : Fin 3 → K,
      (∀ i, B i i = scalar2 (q i)) ∧
      (∀ i, C i i = scalar2 (q i)) ∧
      (∀ i, B i 0 + B i 1 + B i 2 = 0) ∧
      (∀ j, p 0 • B 0 j + p 1 • B 1 j + p 2 • B 2 j = 0) ∧
      (∀ i, C i 0 + C i 1 + C i 2 = 0) ∧
      (∀ j, p 0 • C 0 j + p 1 • C 1 j + p 2 • C 2 j = 0) ∧
      (∀ i j, p i • B i j = p j • adj2 (B j i)) ∧
      (∀ i j, p i • C i j = p j • adj2 (C j i)) := by
  dsimp only
  let LB := weightedCoordinateEquiv E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne
  let LC := weightedCoordinateEquiv E' hEidem' hEsum' u' v' p hp' hpne
  let BB := coordinateConjugate LB (matrixAction (F 1 : Mat6 K))
  let CC := coordinateConjugate LC (matrixAction (F' 1 : Mat6 K))
  have hzB := actual_second_projector_weighted_zero_compositions
    E F hEidem hEsum hFidem hFsum u v p hp hpne hFu hFv
  have hzC := actual_second_projector_weighted_zero_compositions
    E' F' hEidem' hEsum' hFidem' hFsum' u' v' p hp' hpne hFu' hFv'
  dsimp only at hzB hzC
  obtain ⟨hrB, hcB⟩ := weighted_block_zero_sums BB p (hpne 0) hzB.1 hzB.2
  obtain ⟨hrC, hcC⟩ := weighted_block_zero_sums CC p (hpne 0) hzC.1 hzC.2
  have hdB := actual_weighted_diagonal_scalar
    E (F 1) hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne
  have hdC := actual_weighted_diagonal_scalar
    E' (F' 1) hEidem' hEsum' u' v' p hp' hpne
  dsimp only at hdB hdC
  choose q hqB using hdB
  choose q' hqC using hdC
  have hqq : q = q' := by
    funext i
    have hB := diagonal_scalar_eq_actual_pair_ledger
      E (F 1) hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne i (q i) (hqB i)
    have hC := diagonal_scalar_eq_actual_pair_ledger
      E' (F' 1) hEidem' hEsum' u' v' p hp' hpne i (q' i) (hqC i)
    calc
      q i = jordanTrace (K := K) ((E i : Mat6 K) * (F 1 : Mat6 K)) := hB
      _ = jordanTrace (K := K) ((E' i : Mat6 K) * (F' 1 : Mat6 K)) := hledger i
      _ = q' i := hC.symm
  subst q'
  refine ⟨q, hqB, hqC, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    ext r s
    simpa [Fin.sum_univ_three] using hrB i r s
  · intro j
    ext r s
    simpa [Fin.sum_univ_three, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] using hcB j r s
  · intro i
    ext r s
    simpa [Fin.sum_univ_three] using hrC i r s
  · intro j
    ext r s
    simpa [Fin.sum_univ_three, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] using hcC j r s
  · exact actual_weighted_block_adjoint E (F 1) hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne
  · exact actual_weighted_block_adjoint E' (F' 1) hEidem' hEsum' u' v' p hp' hpne

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.M3JordanFractionAction.fractionAction_algebraMap_reduced
statement:
@[simp] theorem fractionAction_algebraMap_reduced (g : Aut (K := k))
    (x : ReducedCoordinateRing k) :
    fractionAction k g (algebraMap (ReducedCoordinateRing k) (FunctionField k) x) =
      algebraMap (ReducedCoordinateRing k) (FunctionField k) (reducedAction k g x)
proof:
:=
  IsFractionRing.ringEquivOfRingEquiv_algebraMap (reducedAction k g) x

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.M3JordanFractionAction.fractionAction_scalar
statement:
@[simp] theorem fractionAction_scalar (g : Aut (K := k)) (c : k) :
    fractionAction k g (scalarMap k c) = scalarMap k c
proof:
:= by
  rw [show scalarMap k c = algebraMap (ReducedCoordinateRing k) (FunctionField k)
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (MvPolynomial.C c)) from rfl]
  rw [fractionAction_algebraMap_reduced]
  change algebraMap (ReducedCoordinateRing k) (FunctionField k)
    (reducedActionHom k g (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (MvPolynomial.C c))) = _
  rw [reducedActionHom_scalar]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.M3JordanFractionAction.fractionAction_universalFamily
statement:
theorem fractionAction_universalFamily (g : Aut (K := k)) (r i : Fin 3) :
    (fractionAction k g).toRingHom.mapMatrix (universalFamily k r i) =
      (algebraMap (ReducedCoordinateRing k) (FunctionField k)).mapMatrix
        (transformedFamily k g r i)
proof:
:= by
  ext a b
  rw [universalFamily, RingHom.mapMatrix_apply, RingHom.mapMatrix_apply]
  change fractionAction k g
    (algebraMap (ReducedCoordinateRing k) (FunctionField k)
      (reducedUniversalFamily k r i a b)) = _
  rw [fractionAction_algebraMap_reduced]
  change algebraMap (ReducedCoordinateRing k) (FunctionField k)
    (reducedActionHom k g (reducedUniversalFamily k r i a b)) = _
  rw [reducedActionHom_universalMatrix]
  rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceVectorPairDephaseProvenance.EvenFactorData.aut_diagonalUnit

theorem TwoEvenWord.apply_diagonal

      (z.d1, z.d2, z.d3)
proof:

    (w.inner.aut_apply_diagonal z)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceVectorPairDephaseProvenance.exists_common_field_twoEven
statement:
theorem exists_common_field_twoEven
    (x y : JCoord K) (ha : nV x.v ≠ 0)
    (hGram : 4 * nV x.v * nV y.v - (BV x.v y.v)^2 ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (L : Type u) (_ : Field L) (_ : CharZero L)
      (f : K →+* L) (sigma : L) (w : TwoEvenWord L),
      Function.Injective f ∧
      sigma ^ 2 = f ((BV x.v y.v)^2 - 4 * nV x.v * nV y.v) ∧
      sigma ≠ 0 ∧
      (w.aut.linear (mapSource f x)).v = targetFirst (f (nV x.v)) ∧
      (w.aut.linear (mapSource f y)).v =
        targetSecond (f (nV x.v)) (f (BV x.v y.v)) sigma
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let d := (BV x.v y.v)^2 - 4 * nV x.v * nV y.v
  have hd : d ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    apply hGram
    change (BV x.v y.v)^2 - 4 * nV x.v * nV y.v = 0 at hz
    linear_combination -hz
  obtain ⟨E⟩ := oneRootField_nonempty K d
  letI : CharZero E.Carrier := charZero_of_embedding E.embedding
  let v1 := mapV E.embedding x.v
  let v2 := mapV E.embedding y.v
  have haE : nV v1 ≠ 0 := by
    rw [show nV v1 = E.embedding (nV x.v) from mapV_nV E.embedding x.v]
    exact fun hz => ha (E.embedding.injective (by simpa using hz))
  have hgE : 4 * nV v1 * nV v2 - (BV v1 v2)^2 ≠ 0 := by
    have he : 4 * nV v1 * nV v2 - (BV v1 v2)^2 =
        E.embedding (4 * nV x.v * nV y.v - (BV x.v y.v)^2) := by
      simp only [v1, v2, mapV_nV, mapV_BV, map_sub, map_mul, map_pow,
        map_ofNat]
    rw [he]
    exact fun hz => hGram (E.embedding.injective (by simpa using hz))
  have hsE : E.root ^ 2 = (BV v1 v2)^2 - 4 * nV v1 * nV v2 := by
    simpa only [d, v1, v2, mapV_nV, mapV_BV, map_sub, map_mul, map_pow,
      map_ofNat] using E.root_sq
  obtain ⟨A1, B1, A2, B2, hA1, hB1, hA2, hB2, hv1, hv2⟩ :=
    exists_two_even_pairs_dephasing v1 v2 E.root haE hgE hsE
  let rad : Fin 2 → E.Carrier := ![nV A1 * nV B1, nV A2 * nV B2]
  obtain ⟨F⟩ := rootField_nonempty_of_fintype E.Carrier rad
  letI : CharZero F.Carrier := charZero_of_embedding F.embedding
  let j := F.embedding
  let f := F.embedding.comp E.embedding
  let a1 := mapV j A1
  let b1 := mapV j B1
  let a2 := mapV j A2
  let b2 := mapV j B2
  have nonzero (v : VCoord E.Carrier) (hv : nV v ≠ 0) :
      nV (mapV j v) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [mapV_nV]
    exact fun hz => hv (j.injective (by simpa using hz))
  have ha1 := nonzero A1 hA1
  have hb1 := nonzero B1 hB1
  have ha2 := nonzero A2 hA2
  have hb2 := nonzero B2 hB2
  have hr1 : (F.roots 0)^2 = nV a1 * nV b1 := by
    simpa [a1, b1, j, rad] using F.roots_sq 0
  have hr2 : (F.roots 1)^2 = nV a2 * nV b2 := by
    simpa [a2, b2, j, rad] using F.roots_sq 1
  have rho_nonzero (rho : F.Carrier) (A B : VCoord F.Carrier)
      (hA : nV A ≠ 0) (hB : nV B ≠ 0)
      (hr : rho^2 = nV A * nV B) : rho ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    have hzero : nV A * nV B = 0 := by rw [← hr, hz]; simp
    exact mul_ne_zero hA hB hzero
  have hs : (j E.root)^2 = f d := by
    simpa [j, f] using congrArg F.embedding E.root_sq
  have hs0 : j E.root ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    have he : f d = 0 := by rw [← hs, hz]; simp
    exact hd (f.injective (by simpa using he))
  have hv1F : evenV a2 b2 (evenV a1 b1 (mapSource f x).v) =
      targetFirst (f (nV x.v)) := by
    have H := congrArg (mapV j) hv1
    simp only [mapV_evenV, mapV_targetFirst, mapV_nV, mapV_comp] at H
    rw [mapSource_v]
    simpa [a1, b1, a2, b2, v1, f, j] using H
  have hv2F : evenV a2 b2 (evenV a1 b1 (mapSource f y).v) =
      targetSecond (f (nV x.v)) (f (BV x.v y.v)) (j E.root) := by
    have H := congrArg (mapV j) hv2
    simp only [mapV_evenV, mapV_targetSecond, mapV_nV, mapV_BV, mapV_comp] at H
    rw [mapSource_v]
    simpa [a1, b1, a2, b2, v1, v2, f, j] using H
  let inner : EvenFactorData F.Carrier :=
    ⟨a1, b1, F.roots 0, ha1, hb1, hr1,
      rho_nonzero _ _ _ ha1 hb1 hr1⟩
  let outer : EvenFactorData F.Carrier :=
    ⟨a2, b2, F.roots 1, ha2, hb2, hr2,
      rho_nonzero _ _ _ ha2 hb2 hr2⟩
  let w : TwoEvenWord F.Carrier := ⟨inner, outer⟩
  refine ⟨F.Carrier, inferInstance, inferInstance, f, j E.root, w,
    f.injective, hs, hs0, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change evenV a2 b2 (evenV a1 b1 (mapSource f x).v) = _
    exact hv1F
  · change evenV a2 b2 (evenV a1 b1 (mapSource f y).v) = _
    exact hv2F

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowLabelledProbes.labelledProbe_add
statement:
@[simp] theorem labelledProbe_add (f g A : Mat3 K) (i : Fin 3) :
    labelledProbe (f + g) A i = labelledProbe f A i + labelledProbe g A i
proof:
:= by
  simp [labelledProbe, add_mul, mul_add]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowLabelledProbes.labelledProbe_sub
statement:
@[simp] theorem labelledProbe_sub (f g A : Mat3 K) (i : Fin 3) :
    labelledProbe (f - g) A i = labelledProbe f A i - labelledProbe g A i
proof:
:= by
  simp [labelledProbe, sub_mul, mul_sub, add_mul]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowLabelledProbes.labelledProbe_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem labelledProbe_one (A : Mat3 K) (i : Fin 3) :
    labelledProbe 1 A i = 2 * Matrix.trace (diagonalUnit i * A)
proof:
:= by
  simp [labelledProbe, add_mul]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowLabelledProbes.eq_of_labelled_probes
statement:
theorem eq_of_labelled_probes
    (f0 f1 f2 A B : Mat3 K)
    (hsum : f0 + f1 + f2 = 1)
    (hsquare : encoder f0 f2 * encoder f0 f2 = f0 + f2)
    (hdet : Matrix.det
      (grading * encoder f0 f2 - encoder f0 f2 * grading) ≠ 0)
    (hLabel : ∀ i,
      labelledProbe f0 A i = labelledProbe f0 B i ∧
      labelledProbe f1 A i = labelledProbe f1 B i ∧
      labelledProbe f2 A i = labelledProbe f2 B i) :
    A = B
proof:
:= by
  have hdet' := hdet
  rw [det_grading_commutator] at hdet'
  have hTwo : (2 : K) ≠ 0 := left_ne_zero_of_mul hdet'
  apply eq_of_trace_probes (encoder f0 f2) A B hdet
  · intro i
    apply mul_left_cancel₀ hTwo
    calc
      2 * Matrix.trace (diagonalUnit i * A) =
          labelledProbe (f0 + f1 + f2) A i := by rw [hsum, labelledProbe_one]
      _ = labelledProbe f0 A i + labelledProbe f1 A i + labelledProbe f2 A i := by
        simp only [labelledProbe_add]
      _ = labelledProbe f0 B i + labelledProbe f1 B i + labelledProbe f2 B i := by
        rw [(hLabel i).1, (hLabel i).2.1, (hLabel i).2.2]
      _ = labelledProbe (f0 + f1 + f2) B i := by
        simp only [labelledProbe_add]
      _ = 2 * Matrix.trace (diagonalUnit i * B) := by rw [hsum, labelledProbe_one]
  · intro i
    change labelledProbe (encoder f0 f2) A i = labelledProbe (encoder f0 f2) B i
    simp only [encoder, labelledProbe_sub]
    rw [(hLabel i).1, (hLabel i).2.2]
  · intro i
    change labelledProbe (encoder f0 f2 * encoder f0 f2) A i =
      labelledProbe (encoder f0 f2 * encoder f0 f2) B i
    rw [hsquare]
    simp only [labelledProbe_add]
    rw [(hLabel i).1, (hLabel i).2.2]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowLabelledProbes.encoder_square_of_orthogonal
statement:
theorem encoder_square_of_orthogonal
    (f0 f2 : Mat3 K)
    (h0 : f0 * f0 = f0) (h2 : f2 * f2 = f2)
    (h02 : f0 * f2 = 0) (h20 : f2 * f0 = 0) :
    encoder f0 f2 * encoder f0 f2 = f0 + f2
proof:
:= by
  simp [encoder, sub_mul, mul_sub, h0, h2, h02, h20, add_comm]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowLabelledProbes.eq_of_orthogonal_idempotent_labelled_probes
statement:
theorem eq_of_orthogonal_idempotent_labelled_probes
    (f0 f1 f2 A B : Mat3 K)
    (hsum : f0 + f1 + f2 = 1)
    (h0 : f0 * f0 = f0) (h2 : f2 * f2 = f2)
    (h02 : f0 * f2 = 0) (h20 : f2 * f0 = 0)
    (hdet : Matrix.det
      (grading * encoder f0 f2 - encoder f0 f2 * grading) ≠ 0)
    (hLabel : ∀ i,
      labelledProbe f0 A i = labelledProbe f0 B i ∧
      labelledProbe f1 A i = labelledProbe f1 B i ∧
      labelledProbe f2 A i = labelledProbe f2 B i) :
    A = B
proof:
:= by
  exact eq_of_labelled_probes f0 f1 f2 A B hsum
    (encoder_square_of_orthogonal f0 f2 h0 h2 h02 h20) hdet hLabel

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealInvariantLedger.universalFamily_isRaw

    (RawFramePrimeSquare.genericFrame k (rawFrameIdeal (R := k)).radical)
  exact RawFramePrimeSquare.genericFrame_isRaw k (rawFrameIdeal (R := k)).radical
    Ideal.le_radical

    (hagree : AgreeOnLedgerField k left right)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealInvariantLedger.agree_pairP

theorem agree_pairP

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealInvariantLedger.agree_centeredC0

theorem agree_centeredC0
    (hagree : AgreeOnLedgerField k left right) (i j l : Fin 3) :

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealInvariantLedger.agree_scalarMap_comp
statement:
theorem agree_scalarMap_comp
    (hagree : AgreeOnLedgerField k left right) :
    left.comp (scalarMap k) = right.comp (scalarMap k)
proof:
:= by
  ext c
  exact agree_scalarMap k left right hagree c

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealInvariantLedger.mapLedger_eq_of_agreement
statement:
theorem mapLedger_eq_of_agreement
    (hagree : AgreeOnLedgerField k left right) :
    mapLedger left (universalLedger k) = mapLedger right (universalLedger k)
proof:
:= by
  unfold mapLedger
  rw [LabelledLedger.mk.injEq]
  exact ⟨funext (fun i => funext (agree_pairP k left right hagree i)),
    funext (fun j => funext (agree_pairQ k left right hagree j)),
    funext (fun l => funext (agree_pairR k left right hagree l)),
    funext (fun i => funext (fun j => funext (agree_centeredC0 k left right hagree i j)))⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealInvariantLedger.agreement_of_scalar_and_cells
statement:
theorem agreement_of_scalar_and_cells
    (hbase : ∀ c : k, left (scalarMap k c) = right (scalarMap k c))
    (hcells : mapLedger left (universalLedger k) = mapLedger right (universalLedger k)) :
    AgreeOnLedgerField k left right
proof:
:= by
  have hgen : Set.EqOn left right (Set.range (scalarMap k) ∪ ledgerCells k) := by
    intro x hx
    rcases hx with hx | hx
    · rcases hx with ⟨c, rfl⟩
      exact hbase c
    · rcases hx with hx | hx
      · rcases hx with hx | hx
        · rcases hx with hx | hx
          · rcases hx with ⟨ij, rfl⟩
            exact congrArg (fun ell => ell.P ij.1 ij.2) hcells
          · rcases hx with ⟨jl, rfl⟩
            exact congrArg (fun ell => ell.Q jl.1 jl.2) hcells
        · rcases hx with ⟨li, rfl⟩
          exact congrArg (fun ell => ell.R li.1 li.2) hcells
      · rcases hx with ⟨ijl, rfl⟩
        exact congrArg (fun ell => ell.C0 ijl.1 ijl.2.1 ijl.2.2) hcells
  have hclosure := RingHom.eqOn_field_closure hgen
  intro x
  exact hclosure x.property

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFrameEncoderLaws.encoder_square
statement:
theorem encoder_square (P : Fin 3 → JCoord K) (hP : Laws P) :
    sourceProduct (P 2 - P 0) (P 2 - P 0) = P 2 + P 0
proof:
:= by
  have h02 := hP.orthogonal (i := 0) (j := 2) (by decide)
  have h20 := hP.orthogonal (i := 2) (j := 0) (by decide)
  change sourceProductLinear (P 2 - P 0) (P 2 - P 0) = _
  simp only [map_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply, sourceProductLinear_apply,
    hP.idempotent, h02, h20]
  abel

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFrameEncoderLaws.encoder_cube
statement:
theorem encoder_cube (P : Fin 3 → JCoord K) (hP : Laws P) :
    sourceProduct (P 2 - P 0)
      (sourceProduct (P 2 - P 0) (P 2 - P 0)) = P 2 - P 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [encoder_square P hP]
  have h02 := hP.orthogonal (i := 0) (j := 2) (by decide)
  have h20 := hP.orthogonal (i := 2) (j := 0) (by decide)
  change sourceProductLinear (P 2 - P 0) (P 2 + P 0) = _
  simp only [map_sub, map_add, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.add_apply,
    sourceProductLinear_apply, hP.idempotent, h02, h20]
  abel

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFrameEncoderLaws.encoder_projectors
statement:
theorem encoder_projectors (P : Fin 3 → JCoord K) (hP : Laws P) :
    ∀ i, sourceProjector (P 2 - P 0) i = P i
proof:
:= by
  have hs := hP.sum_one
  intro i
  fin_cases i
  · change (2 : K)⁻¹ • (sourceProduct (P 2 - P 0) (P 2 - P 0) - (P 2 - P 0)) = P 0
    rw [encoder_square P hP]
    module
  · change sourceOne - sourceProduct (P 2 - P 0) (P 2 - P 0) = P 1
    rw [encoder_square P hP]
    linear_combination (norm := module) -hs
  · change (2 : K)⁻¹ • (sourceProduct (P 2 - P 0) (P 2 - P 0) + (P 2 - P 0)) = P 2
    rw [encoder_square P hP]
    module

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFrameEncoderLaws.encoder_fixed_spectrum
statement:
theorem encoder_fixed_spectrum (P : Fin 3 → JCoord K) (hP : Laws P) :
    sourceTrace (P 2 - P 0) = 0 ∧ sourceSpur (P 2 - P 0) = -1 ∧
      sourceNorm (P 2 - P 0) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have ht : sourceTrace (P 2 - P 0) = 0 := by
    change sourceTraceLinear (P 2 - P 0) = 0
    simp only [map_sub, sourceTraceLinear_apply, hP.trace_one, sub_self]
  have ht2 : sourceTrace (sourceProduct (P 2 - P 0) (P 2 - P 0)) = 2 := by
    rw [encoder_square P hP]
    change sourceTraceLinear (P 2 + P 0) = 2
    simp only [map_add, sourceTraceLinear_apply, hP.trace_one]
    norm_num
  have hsp := trace_square (P 2 - P 0)
  rw [ht2, ht] at hsp
  have hs : sourceSpur (P 2 - P 0) = -1 := by linear_combination (1/2 : K) * hsp
  have hn := trace_cube (P 2 - P 0)
  rw [encoder_cube P hP, ht] at hn
  refine ⟨ht, hs, ?_⟩
  linear_combination -(1/3 : K) * hn

name: AlbertLean.Generic.MatrixLedgerReconstruction.thirdFrame_eq_of_matrixLabelledLedger_eq
statement:
theorem thirdFrame_eq_of_matrixLabelledLedger_eq
    (f k l : Fin 3 → Mat3 K)
    (hsum : f 0 + f 1 + f 2 = 1)
    (hsquare : encoder (f 0) (f 2) * encoder (f 0) (f 2) = f 0 + f 2)
    (hdet : Matrix.det
      (grading * encoder (f 0) (f 2) - encoder (f 0) (f 2) * grading) ≠ 0)
    (hE : HasProjectorLabels (embed (grading : Mat3 K))
      (fun i => embed (diagonalUnit i)))
    (hF : HasProjectorLabels (embed (encoder (f 0) (f 2)))
      (fun i => embed (f i)))
    (hK : HasProjectorLabels (embed (encoder (k 0) (k 2)))
      (fun i => embed (k i)))
    (hL : HasProjectorLabels (embed (encoder (l 0) (l 2)))
      (fun i => embed (l i)))
    (hledger : labelledLedger (matrixLedgerTriple f k) =
      labelledLedger (matrixLedgerTriple f l)) :
    k = l
proof:
:= by
  funext q
  apply firstComponent_eq_of_joint_traces f (k q, 0, 0) (l q, 0, 0)
    hsum hsquare hdet
  intro i j
  have hq := congrArg (fun L : LabelledLedger K => L.Q j q) hledger
  have hr := congrArg (fun L : LabelledLedger K => L.R q i) hledger
  have hc := congrArg (fun L : LabelledLedger K => L.C0 i j q) hledger
  simp only [labelledLedger, matrixLedgerTriple, Matrix.cons_val_zero,
    Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.vecHead, Matrix.vecTail,
    Function.comp_apply, Fin.succ_zero_eq_one] at hq hr hc
  rw [hF j, hK q, hL q] at hq
  rw [hE i, hK q, hL q] at hr
  rw [hE i, hF j, hK q, hL q] at hc
  change TauCeti.AlbertAlgebra.trace
      (embed (diagonalUnit i) * (embed (f j) * toTau (k q, 0, 0))) =
    TauCeti.AlbertAlgebra.trace
      (embed (diagonalUnit i) * (embed (f j) * toTau (l q, 0, 0)))
  rw [hq, hr] at hc
  exact sub_left_inj.mp (add_right_cancel hc)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.MatrixLedgerReconstruction.thirdFrame_eq_of_tauFrames
statement:
theorem thirdFrame_eq_of_tauFrames
    (f k l : Fin 3 → Mat3 K)
    (hDiag : TauFrame (fun i => embed (diagonalUnit i : Mat3 K)))
    (hf : TauFrame (fun i => embed (f i)))
    (hk : TauFrame (fun i => embed (k i)))
    (hl : TauFrame (fun i => embed (l i)))
    (hsum : f 0 + f 1 + f 2 = 1)
    (hsquare : encoder (f 0) (f 2) * encoder (f 0) (f 2) = f 0 + f 2)
    (hdet : Matrix.det
      (grading * encoder (f 0) (f 2) - encoder (f 0) (f 2) * grading) ≠ 0)
    (hledger : labelledLedger (matrixLedgerTriple f k) =
      labelledLedger (matrixLedgerTriple f l)) :
    k = l
proof:
:= by
  have hsub (A B : Mat3 K) : embed (A - B) = embed A - embed B := by
    unfold embed
    rw [← map_sub]
    congr 1
    simp
  have hg : (diagonalUnit 2 : Mat3 K) - diagonalUnit 0 = grading := by
    ext i j
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
      norm_num [diagonalUnit, grading, Fin.ext_iff]
  apply thirdFrame_eq_of_matrixLabelledLedger_eq f k l hsum hsquare hdet
      ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hledger
  · simpa only [← hsub, hg] using hasProjectorLabels_of_tauFrame _ hDiag
  · simpa only [encoder, hsub] using hasProjectorLabels_of_tauFrame _ hf
  · simpa only [encoder, hsub] using hasProjectorLabels_of_tauFrame _ hk
  · simpa only [encoder, hsub] using hasProjectorLabels_of_tauFrame _ hl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticProjectorFrame.idempotent_apply
statement:
theorem idempotent_apply (P : V →ₗ[K] V) (hP : IsIdempotent P) (x : V) :
    P (P x) = P x
proof:
:= by
  have h := LinearMap.congr_fun hP x
  exact h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticProjectorFrame.jordan_orthogonal_apply
statement:
theorem jordan_orthogonal_apply (P Q : V →ₗ[K] V)
    (hPQ : IsJordanOrthogonal P Q) (x : V) :
    P (Q x) + Q (P x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := LinearMap.congr_fun hPQ x
  simpa [IsJordanOrthogonal] using h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticProjectorFrame.comp_eq_zero_of_jordan_orthogonal
statement:
theorem comp_eq_zero_of_jordan_orthogonal
    (P Q : V →ₗ[K] V) (hP : IsIdempotent P) (hQ : IsIdempotent Q)
    (hPQ : IsJordanOrthogonal P Q) : P.comp Q = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  have h0 := jordan_orthogonal_apply P Q hPQ x
  have hleft := congrArg P h0
  have hright := jordan_orthogonal_apply P Q hPQ (P x)
  simp only [map_add, map_zero, idempotent_apply P hP] at hleft hright
  have hpqp : P (Q (P x)) = -P (Q x) := by
    exact (eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero).2 (by simpa [add_comm] using hleft)
  have hqp : Q (P x) = -P (Q (P x)) := by
    exact (eq_neg_iff_add_eq_zero).2 (by simpa [add_comm] using hright)
  have heq : Q (P x) = P (Q x) := by rw [hqp, hpqp, neg_neg]
  change P (Q x) = 0
  rw [heq] at h0
  have htwo : (2 : K) • P (Q x) = 0 := by
    simpa [two_smul K] using h0
  exact (smul_eq_zero.mp htwo).resolve_left (by norm_num)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticProjectorFrame.reverse_comp_eq_zero_of_jordan_orthogonal
statement:
theorem reverse_comp_eq_zero_of_jordan_orthogonal
    (P Q : V →ₗ[K] V) (hP : IsIdempotent P) (hQ : IsIdempotent Q)
    (hPQ : IsJordanOrthogonal P Q) : Q.comp P = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hsym : IsJordanOrthogonal Q P := by
    unfold IsJordanOrthogonal at hPQ ⊢
    simpa [add_comm] using hPQ
  exact comp_eq_zero_of_jordan_orthogonal Q P hQ hP hsym

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticProjectorFrame.normalizedPartner_mem
statement:
theorem normalizedPartner_mem
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V)) (P : V →ₗ[K] V)
    (hP : IsIdempotent P) (u y : V) :
    P (normalizedPartner omega P u y) = normalizedPartner omega P u y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [normalizedPartner, map_smul, idempotent_apply P hP y]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticProjectorFrame.normalizedPartner_pairs_one
statement:
theorem normalizedPartner_pairs_one
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V)) (P : V →ₗ[K] V)
    (hP : IsIdempotent P) (hself : IsSelfAdjoint omega P) (x y : V)
    (hpair : omega (P x) y ≠ 0) :
    omega (P x) (normalizedPartner omega P (P x) y) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [normalizedPartner, map_smul, smul_eq_mul,
    ← hself (P x) y, idempotent_apply P hP]
  exact inv_mul_cancel₀ hpair

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticProjectorFrame.different_images_orthogonal
statement:
theorem different_images_orthogonal
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V)) (P Q : V →ₗ[K] V)
    (hself : IsSelfAdjoint omega P) (hcomp : P.comp Q = 0)
    (x y : V) : omega (P x) (Q y) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [hself x (Q y)]
  have h := LinearMap.congr_fun hcomp y
  have hz : P (Q y) = 0 := by simpa using h
  rw [hz, map_zero]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.exists_actual_first_projector_ledger_coordinates
statement:
theorem exists_actual_first_projector_ledger_coordinates
    (E F : Fin 3 → Carrier K)
    (hEidem : ∀ i, (E i : Mat6 K) * E i = E i)
    (hEtrace : ∀ i, jordanTrace (K := K) (E i : Mat6 K) = 1)
    (hEsum : (E 0 : Mat6 K) + E 1 + E 2 = 1)
    (hFidem : ∀ i, (F i : Mat6 K) * F i = F i)
    (hFtrace : ∀ i, jordanTrace (K := K) (F i : Mat6 K) = 1)
    (hFsum : (F 0 : Mat6 K) + F 1 + F 2 = 1) :
    ∃ u v : Vec6 K,
      let p : Fin 3 → K
proof:
:= fun i =>
        jordanTrace (K := K) ((E i : Mat6 K) * (F 0 : Mat6 K))
      (∀ i, p i = (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u)
        (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v)) ∧
      (∀ i, matrixAction (F 0 : Mat6 K)
        (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u) = p i • u) ∧
      (∀ i, matrixAction (F 0 : Mat6 K)
        (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v) = p i • v) := by
  obtain ⟨fu, fv, hfyp, hFfu, hFfv, hspan⟩ :=
    exists_spanning_carrier_frame_eigenbasis F hFidem hFtrace hFsum
  let u : Vec6 K := fu 0
  let v : Vec6 K := fv 0
  have hFu0 : matrixAction (F 0 : Mat6 K) u = u := by
    simpa [u] using hFfu 0 0
  have hFv0 : matrixAction (F 0 : Mat6 K) v = v := by
    simpa [v] using hFfv 0 0
  have huv : (omega (K := K)) u v = 1 := by
    simpa [u, v] using hfyp.pair 0
  have hspan0 : ∀ x, matrixAction (F 0 : Mat6 K) x = x →
      ∃ a b : K, x = a • u + b • v := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨a, b, hab⟩ := hspan x
    refine ⟨a 0, b 0, ?_⟩
    rw [← hx, hab]
    simp only [map_add, map_sum, map_smul, hFfu, hFfv]
    simp [u, v, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  let U : Vec6 K := ∑ j, fu j
  let V : Vec6 K := ∑ j, fv j
  have hFU (i : Fin 3) : matrixAction (F i : Mat6 K) U = fu i := by
    fin_cases i <;> simp [U, hFfu, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  have hFV (i : Fin 3) : matrixAction (F i : Mat6 K) V = fv i := by
    fin_cases i <;> simp [V, hFfv, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  let oneWeight : Fin 3 → K := fun _ => 1
  have honeWeight : ∀ i, oneWeight i =
      (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (F i : Mat6 K) U)
        (matrixAction (F i : Mat6 K) V) := by
    intro i
    rw [hFU, hFV]
    simpa [oneWeight] using (hfyp.pair i).symm
  have honeWeight_ne : ∀ i, oneWeight i ≠ 0 := by
    intro i
    simp [oneWeight]
  let L := weightedCoordinateEquiv F hFidem hFsum U V oneWeight
    honeWeight honeWeight_ne
  have hLleft : L (basisVector (Sum.inl (0 : Fin 3))) = u := by
    change weightedCoordinateLinear F U V
      (basisVector (Sum.inl (0 : Fin 3))) = u
    rw [weightedCoordinateLinear_basis_left, hFU]
  have hLright : matrixAction (F 0 : Mat6 K) V = v := by
    exact hFV 0
  have hover (i : Fin 3) :
      (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u)
          (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v) =
        (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u) v := by
    calc
      _ = (omega (K := K))
          (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K)
            (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u)) v :=
        (carrier_action_selfAdjoint (E i)
          (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u) v).symm
      _ = _ := by
        rw [SymplecticProjectorFrame.idempotent_apply
          (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K))
          (carrier_projector_action_idempotent (E i) (hEidem i))]
  have hweight (i : Fin 3) :
      (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u)
          (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v) =
        jordanTrace (K := K) ((E i : Mat6 K) * (F 0 : Mat6 K)) := by
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := actual_weighted_diagonal_scalar F (E i) hFidem hFsum
      U V oneWeight honeWeight honeWeight_ne 0
    let z := coordinateConjugate L (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K))
      (basisVector (Sum.inl (0 : Fin 3)))
    have h00 := congrFun (congrFun hq 0) 0
    have hz0 : z (Sum.inl (0 : Fin 3)) = q := by
      simpa [z, weightedBlock, weightedPairIndex, scalar2,
        Matrix.one_apply] using h00
    have hLz : weightedCoordinateLinear F U V z =
        matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u := by
      change L z = matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u
      simp [z, coordinateConjugate, hLleft]
    have hextract := (weighted_pairing_extract F hFidem hFsum U V
      oneWeight honeWeight z 0).1
    have hqover :
        (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u) v = q := by
      rw [hLz, hLright, hz0] at hextract
      simpa [oneWeight] using hextract
    have hqtrace := diagonal_scalar_eq_actual_pair_ledger F (E i)
      hFidem hFsum U V oneWeight honeWeight honeWeight_ne 0 q hq
    rw [hover, hqover, hqtrace]
    simp only [jordanTrace]
    rw [Matrix.trace_mul_comm]
  have hscalar (i : Fin 3) :=
    scalar_compression_on_hyperbolic_image (omega (K := K))
      (matrixAction (F 0 : Mat6 K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K))
      (carrier_projector_action_idempotent (F 0) (hFidem 0))
      (carrier_action_selfAdjoint (F 0)) (carrier_action_selfAdjoint (E i))
      u v hFu0 hFv0 huv omega_alternating hspan0
  refine ⟨u, v, ?_⟩
  dsimp only
  refine ⟨fun i => (hweight i).symm, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    rw [← hweight i, hover i]
    exact (hscalar i).1
  · intro i
    rw [← hweight i, hover i]
    exact (hscalar i).2

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.exists_actual_same_pair_ledger_jordanAut
statement:
theorem exists_actual_same_pair_ledger_jordanAut
    (E F E' F' : Fin 3 → Carrier K)
    (hEidem : ∀ i, (E i : Mat6 K) * E i = E i)
    (hEtrace : ∀ i, jordanTrace (K := K) (E i : Mat6 K) = 1)
    (hEsum : (E 0 : Mat6 K) + E 1 + E 2 = 1)
    (hFidem : ∀ i, (F i : Mat6 K) * F i = F i)
    (hFtrace : ∀ i, jordanTrace (K := K) (F i : Mat6 K) = 1)
    (hFsum : (F 0 : Mat6 K) + F 1 + F 2 = 1)
    (hEidem' : ∀ i, (E' i : Mat6 K) * E' i = E' i)
    (hEtrace' : ∀ i, jordanTrace (K := K) (E' i : Mat6 K) = 1)
    (hEsum' : (E' 0 : Mat6 K) + E' 1 + E' 2 = 1)
    (hFidem' : ∀ i, (F' i : Mat6 K) * F' i = F' i)
    (hFtrace' : ∀ i, jordanTrace (K := K) (F' i : Mat6 K) = 1)
    (hFsum' : (F' 0 : Mat6 K) + F' 1 + F' 2 = 1)
    (hledger : ∀ i j,
      jordanTrace (K := K) ((E i : Mat6 K) * (F j : Mat6 K)) =
        jordanTrace (K := K) ((E' i : Mat6 K) * (F' j : Mat6 K)))
    (hpne : ∀ i,
      jordanTrace (K := K) ((E i : Mat6 K) * (F 0 : Mat6 K)) ≠ 0)
    (hp12 :
      jordanTrace (K := K) ((E 1 : Mat6 K) * (F 0 : Mat6 K)) +
        jordanTrace (K := K) ((E 2 : Mat6 K) * (F 0 : Mat6 K)) ≠ 0)
    (hdisc : ∀ (u v : Vec6 K)
      (hp : ∀ i,
        jordanTrace (K := K) ((E i : Mat6 K) * (F 0 : Mat6 K)) =
          (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u)
            (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v)),
      let p : Fin 3 → K := fun i =>
        jordanTrace (K := K) ((E i : Mat6 K) * (F 0 : Mat6 K))
      let L := weightedCoordinateEquiv E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne
      let B := fun i j => weightedBlock (coordinateConjugate L
        (matrixAction (F 1 : Mat6 K))) i j
      trace2 (B 0 1) ^ 2 - 4 * determinant (B 0 1) ≠ 0) :
    ∃ g : ScalarJordanAut.Aut (K := K),
      (∀ i, g.linear (E i) = E' i) ∧ (∀ i, g.linear (F i) = F' i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, v, hp, hFu, hFv⟩ :=
    exists_actual_first_projector_ledger_coordinates E F hEidem hEtrace
      hEsum hFidem hFtrace hFsum
  obtain ⟨u', v', hpRaw', hFuRaw', hFvRaw'⟩ :=
    exists_actual_first_projector_ledger_coordinates E' F' hEidem' hEtrace'
      hEsum' hFidem' hFtrace' hFsum'
  let p : Fin 3 → K := fun i =>
    jordanTrace (K := K) ((E i : Mat6 K) * (F 0 : Mat6 K))
  have hp' : ∀ i, p i =
      (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E' i : Mat6 K) u')
        (matrixAction (E' i : Mat6 K) v') := by
    intro i
    change jordanTrace (K := K) ((E i : Mat6 K) * (F 0 : Mat6 K)) = _
    rw [hledger i 0]
    exact hpRaw' i
  have hFu' : ∀ i, matrixAction (F' 0 : Mat6 K)
      (matrixAction (E' i : Mat6 K) u') = p i • u' := by
    intro i
    change _ = jordanTrace (K := K) ((E i : Mat6 K) * (F 0 : Mat6 K)) • u'
    rw [hledger i 0]
    exact hFuRaw' i
  have hFv' : ∀ i, matrixAction (F' 0 : Mat6 K)
      (matrixAction (E' i : Mat6 K) v') = p i • v' := by
    intro i
    change _ = jordanTrace (K := K) ((E i : Mat6 K) * (F 0 : Mat6 K)) • v'
    rw [hledger i 0]
    exact hFvRaw' i
  apply exists_actual_same_ledger_pair_jordanAut E F E' F'
    hEidem hEsum hFidem hFsum hEidem' hEsum' hFidem' hFsum'
    u v u' v' p hp hp' hpne hFu hFv hFu' hFv'
  · exact fun i => hledger i 1
  · exact hp12
  · exact hdisc u v hp

name: AlbertLean.Generic.CubicAutomorphism.sourceAdjoint_invariant_of_cubic_unit
statement:
theorem sourceAdjoint_invariant_of_cubic_unit
    (g : JCoord K ≃ₗ[K] JCoord K)
    (hOne : g sourceOne = sourceOne)
    (hCubic : ∀ x, sourceNorm (g x) = sourceNorm x) (x : JCoord K) :
    g (sourceAdjoint x) = sourceAdjoint (g x)
proof:
:= by
  exact sourceRecoveryPresentation.map_adjoint g hOne hCubic x

name: AlbertLean.Generic.CubicAutomorphism.sourceCross_invariant_of_cubic_unit
statement:
theorem sourceCross_invariant_of_cubic_unit
    (g : JCoord K ≃ₗ[K] JCoord K)

    (hCubic : ∀ x, sourceNorm (g x) = sourceNorm x) (x y : JCoord K) :

name: AlbertLean.Generic.CubicAutomorphism.sourceProduct_invariant_of_cubic_unit
statement:
theorem sourceProduct_invariant_of_cubic_unit
