name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceIdempotentChart.chart0_adjoint
statement:
theorem chart0_adjoint (u : SCoord K) (v : CCoord K) :
    sourceAdjoint (chart0 u v) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let a := (chart0Denominator u v)⁻¹
  rw [sourceAdjoint_eq_explicit]
  apply JCoord.ext
  · change (a * nC v) * (a * nS u) - nV (a • normalizedMuV u v) = 0
    rw [nV_smul, normalizedMuV_composition]
    ring
  · change a * (a * nS u) - nS (a • u) = 0
    rw [nS_smul]
    ring
  · change a * (a * nC v) - nC (a • v) = 0
    rw [nC_smul]
    ring
  · change normalizedMuV (a • u) (a • v) - a • (a • normalizedMuV u v) = 0
    rw [normalizedMuV_smul]
    module
  · change sourceMuS (a • v) (a • normalizedMuV u v) -
      (a * nC v) • (a • u) = 0
    rw [sourceMuS_smul, sourceMuS_normalizedMuV]
    module
  · change sourceMuC (a • normalizedMuV u v) (a • u) -
      (a * nS u) • (a • v) = 0
    rw [sourceMuC_smul, sourceMuC_normalizedMuV]
    module

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceIdempotentChart.chart0_spur
statement:
theorem chart0_spur (u : SCoord K) (v : CCoord K) :
    sourceSpur (chart0 u v) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sourceSpur, chart0, nV_smul, nS_smul, nC_smul,
    normalizedMuV_composition]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceIdempotentChart.chart0_trace
statement:
theorem chart0_trace (u : SCoord K) (v : CCoord K)
    (hD : chart0Denominator u v ≠ 0) : sourceTrace (chart0 u v) = 1
proof:
:= by
  change (chart0Denominator u v)⁻¹ + (chart0Denominator u v)⁻¹ * nC v +
      (chart0Denominator u v)⁻¹ * nS u = 1
  calc
    _ = (chart0Denominator u v)⁻¹ * chart0Denominator u v := by
      dsimp only [chart0Denominator]
      ring
    _ = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ hD

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceIdempotentChart.chart0_adjoint_trace
statement:
theorem chart0_adjoint_trace (u : SCoord K) (v : CCoord K)
    (hD : chart0Denominator u v ≠ 0) :
    sourceAdjoint (chart0 u v) = 0 ∧ sourceTrace (chart0 u v) = 1
proof:
:=
  ⟨chart0_adjoint u v, chart0_trace u v hD⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceIdempotentChart.chart0_idempotent
statement:
theorem chart0_idempotent (u : SCoord K) (v : CCoord K)
    (hD : chart0Denominator u v ≠ 0) :
    sourceProduct (chart0 u v) (chart0 u v) = chart0 u v
proof:
:= by
  have h := sourceAdjoint_eq_product_square (chart0 u v)
  rw [chart0_adjoint, chart0_trace u v hD, chart0_spur, one_smul,
    zero_smul, add_zero] at h
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp h.symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceIdempotentChart.chart0_d1_ne_zero
statement:
theorem chart0_d1_ne_zero (u : SCoord K) (v : CCoord K)
    (hD : chart0Denominator u v ≠ 0) : (chart0 u v).d1 ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  inv_ne_zero hD

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceIdempotentChart.chart0Denominator_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem chart0Denominator_zero :
    chart0Denominator (0 : SCoord K) (0 : CCoord K) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [chart0Denominator]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceIdempotentChart.chart0_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem chart0_zero :
    chart0 (0 : SCoord K) (0 : CCoord K) = diagonalUnit 0
proof:
:= by
  apply JCoord.ext <;> simp [chart0, diagonalUnit, diagonal]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceIdempotentChart.chart0Denominator_extract
statement:
theorem chart0Denominator_extract (e : JCoord K)
    (hidem : sourceProduct e e = e) (htrace : sourceTrace e = 1)
    (hd : e.d1 ≠ 0) : e.d1 * chart0Denominator (extractS e) (extractC e) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hadj := sourceAdjoint_eq_zero_of_idempotent_trace_one e hidem htrace
  obtain ⟨hS, hC, _, _, _⟩ := adjoint_zero_components e hadj
  change e.d1 * (1 + nS (e.d1⁻¹ • e.s) + nC (e.d1⁻¹ • e.c)) = 1
  rw [nS_smul, nC_smul, hS, hC]
  calc
    _ = e.d1 + e.d2 + e.d3 := by field_simp [hd] <;> ring
    _ = 1 := htrace

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceIdempotentChart.chart0Denominator_extract_ne_zero
statement:
theorem chart0Denominator_extract_ne_zero (e : JCoord K)
    (hidem : sourceProduct e e = e) (htrace : sourceTrace e = 1)
    (hd : e.d1 ≠ 0) : chart0Denominator (extractS e) (extractC e) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hz
  have h := chart0Denominator_extract e hidem htrace hd
  rw [hz, mul_zero] at h
  exact zero_ne_one h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceIdempotentChart.chart0_scale_extract
statement:
theorem chart0_scale_extract (e : JCoord K)
    (hidem : sourceProduct e e = e) (htrace : sourceTrace e = 1)
    (hd : e.d1 ≠ 0) : (chart0Denominator (extractS e) (extractC e))⁻¹ = e.d1
proof:
:= by
  have h := chart0Denominator_extract e hidem htrace hd
  have hD := chart0Denominator_extract_ne_zero e hidem htrace hd
  calc
    _ = (e.d1 * chart0Denominator (extractS e) (extractC e)) *
        (chart0Denominator (extractS e) (extractC e))⁻¹ := by rw [h]; simp
    _ = e.d1 := by rw [mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hD, mul_one]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceIdempotentChart.chart0_reconstruct
statement:
theorem chart0_reconstruct (e : JCoord K)
    (hidem : sourceProduct e e = e) (htrace : sourceTrace e = 1)
    (hd : e.d1 ≠ 0) : chart0 (extractS e) (extractC e) = e
proof:
:= by
  have hadj := sourceAdjoint_eq_zero_of_idempotent_trace_one e hidem htrace
  obtain ⟨hS, hC, hV, _, _⟩ := adjoint_zero_components e hadj
  have ha := chart0_scale_extract e hidem htrace hd
  simp only [chart0, ha]
  apply JCoord.ext
  · rfl
  · change e.d1 * nC (e.d1⁻¹ • e.c) = e.d2
    rw [nC_smul, hC]
    field_simp [hd] <;> ring
  · change e.d1 * nS (e.d1⁻¹ • e.s) = e.d3
    rw [nS_smul, hS]
    field_simp [hd] <;> ring
  · change e.d1 • normalizedMuV (e.d1⁻¹ • e.s) (e.d1⁻¹ • e.c) = e.v
    rw [normalizedMuV_smul, hV]
    simp [smul_smul, mul_assoc, hd]
  · change e.d1 • (e.d1⁻¹ • e.s) = e.s
    simp [smul_smul, hd]
  · change e.d1 • (e.d1⁻¹ • e.c) = e.c
    simp [smul_smul, hd]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceIdempotentChart.chart0_extract
statement:
theorem chart0_extract (u : SCoord K) (v : CCoord K)
    (hD : chart0Denominator u v ≠ 0) :
    extractS (chart0 u v) = u ∧ extractC (chart0 u v) = v
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> simp [extractS, extractC, chart0, smul_smul, hD]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.GLParameterLocalization.denominator_dvd_total
statement:
theorem denominator_dvd_total (r : Fin 3) :
    denominator k r ∣ totalDenominator k
proof:
:=
  Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem (fun s : Fin 3 => denominator k s) (Finset.mem_univ r)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.GLParameterLocalization.localized_denominator_isUnit
statement:
theorem localized_denominator_isUnit (r : Fin 3) :
    IsUnit (algebraMap (Base k) (ParameterRing k) (denominator k r))
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit_iff (x := totalDenominator k)]
  exact ⟨1, by simpa using denominator_dvd_total k r⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.GLParameterLocalization.localizedMatrix_det_isUnit
statement:
theorem localizedMatrix_det_isUnit (r : Fin 3) :
    IsUnit (Matrix.det (localizedMatrix k r))
proof:
:= by
  rw [localizedMatrix, ← RingHom.map_det]
  change IsUnit (algebraMap (Base k) (ParameterRing k) (denominator k r))
  exact localized_denominator_isUnit k r

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.GLParameterLocalization.localizedMatrix_mul_inverse
statement:
theorem localizedMatrix_mul_inverse (r : Fin 3) :
    localizedMatrix k r * localizedInverse k r = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [localizedInverse, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.mul_adjugate, smul_smul,
    Ring.inverse_mul_cancel _ (localizedMatrix_det_isUnit k r), one_smul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.GLParameterLocalization.localizedInverse_mul_matrix
statement:
theorem localizedInverse_mul_matrix (r : Fin 3) :
    localizedInverse k r * localizedMatrix k r = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [localizedInverse, Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.adjugate_mul, smul_smul]
  rw [Ring.inverse_mul_cancel _ (localizedMatrix_det_isUnit k r), one_smul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.GLParameterLocalization.baseEval_parameter
statement:
@[simp] theorem baseEval_parameter (f : k →+* L) (X : Fin 3 → Mat3 L)
    (r a b : Fin 3) : baseEval f X (parameter k r a b) = X r a b
proof:
:= by
  simp [baseEval, parameter]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.GLParameterLocalization.baseEval_genericMatrix
statement:
theorem baseEval_genericMatrix (f : k →+* L) (X : Fin 3 → Mat3 L) (r : Fin 3) :
    (baseEval f X).mapMatrix (genericMatrix k r) = X r
proof:
:= by
  ext a b
  simp [genericMatrix]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.GLParameterLocalization.baseEval_denominator
statement:
theorem baseEval_denominator (f : k →+* L) (X : Fin 3 → Mat3 L) (r : Fin 3) :
    baseEval f X (denominator k r) = Matrix.det (X r)
proof:
:= by
  rw [denominator, RingHom.map_det, baseEval_genericMatrix]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.GLParameterLocalization.baseEval_totalDenominator_ne_zero
statement:
theorem baseEval_totalDenominator_ne_zero (f : k →+* L) (X : Fin 3 → Mat3 L)
    (hX : ∀ r, Matrix.det (X r) ≠ 0) :
    baseEval f X (totalDenominator k) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [totalDenominator, Fin.prod_univ_succ, baseEval_denominator, hX]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.GLParameterLocalization.evalAway_algebraMap
statement:
theorem evalAway_algebraMap (f : k →+* L) (X : Fin 3 → Mat3 L) (hX)
    (p : Base k) :
    evalAway f X hX (algebraMap (Base k) (ParameterRing k) p) = baseEval f X p
proof:
:=
  IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq (totalDenominator k)
    (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (baseEval_totalDenominator_ne_zero f X hX)) p

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.GLParameterLocalization.totalDenominator_ne_zero
statement: theorem totalDenominator_ne_zero : totalDenominator k ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have he := baseEval_totalDenominator_ne_zero (RingHom.id k)
    (fun _ => (1 : Mat3 k)) (fun _ => by simp)
  exact he (by rw [h, map_zero])

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.minor_zero_of_symmetric_idempotent_trace_one
statement:
theorem minor_zero_of_symmetric_idempotent_trace_one
    (P : Mat3 K) (hsymm : Matrix.transpose P = P)
    (hidem : P * P = P) (htrace : Matrix.trace P = 1) :
    ∀ i l j : Fin 3, P i l * P j j = P i j * P j l
proof:
:= by
  have hs01 : P 1 0 = P 0 1 := by
    have h := congrFun (congrFun hsymm 0) 1
    simpa [Matrix.transpose_apply] using h
  have hs02 : P 2 0 = P 0 2 := by
    have h := congrFun (congrFun hsymm 0) 2
    simpa [Matrix.transpose_apply] using h
  have hs12 : P 2 1 = P 1 2 := by
    have h := congrFun (congrFun hsymm 1) 2
    simpa [Matrix.transpose_apply] using h
  have h00 := congrFun (congrFun hidem 0) 0
  have h11 := congrFun (congrFun hidem 1) 1
  have h22 := congrFun (congrFun hidem 2) 2
  have h01 := congrFun (congrFun hidem 0) 1
  have h02 := congrFun (congrFun hidem 0) 2
  have h12 := congrFun (congrFun hidem 1) 2
  simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ, hs01, hs02, hs12]
    at h00 h11 h22 h01 h02 h12
  rw [Matrix.trace_fin_three] at htrace
  have hxy : P 0 0 * P 1 1 = P 0 1 ^ 2 := by
    linear_combination ((P 0 0 + P 1 1 - P 2 2) * htrace - h00 - h11 + h22) / 2
  have hxz : P 0 0 * P 2 2 = P 0 2 ^ 2 := by
    linear_combination ((P 0 0 + P 2 2 - P 1 1) * htrace - h00 - h22 + h11) / 2
  have hyz : P 1 1 * P 2 2 = P 1 2 ^ 2 := by
    linear_combination ((P 1 1 + P 2 2 - P 0 0) * htrace - h11 - h22 + h00) / 2
  have hbc : P 0 2 * P 1 2 = P 0 1 * P 2 2 := by
    linear_combination h01 - P 0 1 * htrace
  have hac : P 0 1 * P 1 2 = P 0 2 * P 1 1 := by
    linear_combination h02 - P 0 2 * htrace
  have hab : P 0 1 * P 0 2 = P 1 2 * P 0 0 := by
    linear_combination h12 - P 1 2 * htrace
  intro i l j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases l <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp_all [pow_two, mul_comm] <;>
    first | exact (mul_comm _ _).trans hxy | exact hbc.symm.trans (mul_comm _ _)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.exists_unit_columnProjector_eq
statement:
theorem exists_unit_columnProjector_eq
    (hsqrt : ∀ x : K, ∃ t : K, t ^ 2 = x) (P : Mat3 K)
    (hsymm : Matrix.transpose P = P)
    (hidem : P * P = P) (htrace : Matrix.trace P = 1) :
    ∃ u : Fin 3 → K,
      (∑ i, u i * u i) = 1 ∧
      (∀ i l, P i l = u i * u l)
proof:
:= by
  have hdiag : ∃ j : Fin 3, P j j ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h
    push_neg at h
    have hz : Matrix.trace P = 0 := by
      rw [Matrix.trace_fin_three, h 0, h 1, h 2]
      ring
    rw [htrace] at hz
    exact one_ne_zero hz
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hdiag
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hsqrt (P j j)
  have ht0 : t ≠ 0 := by
    intro ht0
    apply hj
    simpa [ht0] using ht.symm
  let u : Fin 3 → K := fun i => P i j / t
  have hminor := minor_zero_of_symmetric_idempotent_trace_one P hsymm hidem htrace
  have hfactor : ∀ i l, P i l = u i * u l := by
    intro i l
    have hsymm_lj : P l j = P j l := by
      have h := congrFun (congrFun hsymm j) l
      simpa [Matrix.transpose_apply] using h
    dsimp [u]
    rw [div_mul_div_comm]
    apply (eq_div_iff (mul_ne_zero ht0 ht0)).2
    rw [← pow_two t, ht, hsymm_lj]
    exact hminor i l j
  refine ⟨u, ?_, hfactor⟩
  calc
    (∑ i, u i * u i) = Matrix.trace P := by
      simp [Matrix.trace_fin_three, Fin.sum_univ_succ, hfactor, add_assoc]
    _ = 1 := htrace

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.exists_orthogonal_of_symmetric_primitive_frame
statement:
theorem exists_orthogonal_of_symmetric_primitive_frame
    (hsqrt : ∀ x : K, ∃ t : K, t ^ 2 = x) (P : Fin 3 → Mat3 K)
    (hsymm : ∀ i, Matrix.transpose (P i) = P i)
    (hidem : ∀ i, P i * P i = P i)
    (htrace : ∀ i, Matrix.trace (P i) = 1)
    (hsum : P 0 + P 1 + P 2 = 1) :
    ∃ X : Mat3 K, IsOrthogonal X ∧
      ∀ i, columnProjector X i = P i
proof:
:= by
  choose u huNorm huFactor using fun i =>
    exists_unit_columnProjector_eq hsqrt (P i) (hsymm i) (hidem i) (htrace i)
  let X : Mat3 K := fun r i => u i r
  have hproj : ∀ i, columnProjector X i = P i := by
    intro i
    ext r c
    simp only [columnProjector, X]
    exact (huFactor i r c).symm
  have hmul : X * Matrix.transpose X = 1 := by
    calc
      X * Matrix.transpose X =
          columnProjector X 0 + columnProjector X 1 + columnProjector X 2 := by
        ext r c
        simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, columnProjector,
          Fin.sum_univ_succ, add_assoc]
      _ = P 0 + P 1 + P 2 := by rw [hproj 0, hproj 1, hproj 2]
      _ = 1 := hsum
  refine ⟨X, ⟨?_, hmul⟩, hproj⟩
  exact mul_eq_one_comm.mp hmul

name: AlbertLean.Triality.ParityEvenConjugation.reflectV_injective
statement:
theorem reflectV_injective (a : VCoord K) (ha : nV a ≠ 0) :
    Function.Injective (reflectV a)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y h
  have := congrArg (reflectV a) h
  simpa only [reflectV_involutive a x ha,
    reflectV_involutive a y ha] using this

name: AlbertLean.Triality.ParityEvenConjugation.reflectV_covariant
statement:
theorem reflectV_covariant (a b v : VCoord K) (ha : nV a ≠ 0) :
    reflectV (reflectV a b) (reflectV a v) =
      reflectV a (reflectV b v)
proof:
:= by
  apply reflectV_injective a ha
  rw [reflectV_reflected_conjugate a b (reflectV a v) ha,
    reflectV_involutive a v ha,
    reflectV_involutive a (reflectV b v) ha]

name: AlbertLean.Triality.ParityEvenConjugation.evenV_reflect_covariant
statement:
theorem evenV_reflect_covariant (e c A v : VCoord K)
    (he : nV e ≠ 0) (hc : nV c ≠ 0) :
    reflectV (evenV e c A) (evenV e c v) =
      evenV e c (reflectV A v)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [evenV]
  rw [reflectV_covariant e (reflectV c A) (reflectV c v) he,
    reflectV_covariant c A v hc]

name: AlbertLean.Triality.ParityEvenConjugation.evenV_conjugate
statement:
theorem evenV_conjugate (e c A B v : VCoord K)
    (he : nV e ≠ 0) (hc : nV c ≠ 0) :
    evenV e (reflectV e c)
      (evenV (evenV e c A) (evenV e c B) (evenV e c v)) =
      evenV A B v
proof:
:= by
  rw [evenV_reflected_reverse e c _ he]
  have hcovB := evenV_reflect_covariant e c B v he hc
  have hcovA := evenV_reflect_covariant e c A (reflectV B v) he hc
  simp only [evenV] at hcovB hcovA ⊢
  rw [hcovB, hcovA]
  rw [reflectV_involutive e _ he, reflectV_involutive c _ hc]

name: AlbertLean.Triality.ParityEvenConjugation.clifford_even_conjugate
statement:
theorem clifford_even_conjugate (e c A B : VCoord K)
    (he : nV e = 1) (hc : nV c = 1) :
    (C c * C e) * (C (evenV e c A) * C (evenV e c B)) *
        (C e * C c) = C A * C B
proof:
:= by
  have he0 : nV e ≠ 0 := by simpa [he]
  have hc0 : nV c ≠ 0 := by simpa [hc]
  have hA := C_evenV_intertwine e c A he0 hc0
  have hB := C_evenV_intertwine e c B he0 hc0
  let U := C e * C c
  let V := C c * C e
  change U * C A = C (evenV e c A) * U at hA
  change U * C B = C (evenV e c B) * U at hB
  have hinv : V * U = 1 := by
    change (C c * C e) * (C e * C c) = 1
    calc
      (C c * C e) * (C e * C c) = C c * (C e * C e) * C c := by
        noncomm_ring
      _ = 1 := by
        rw [C_square, he, one_smul, mul_one, C_square, hc, one_smul]
  calc
    (C c * C e) * (C (evenV e c A) * C (evenV e c B)) * (C e * C c) =
        V * C (evenV e c A) * (C (evenV e c B) * U) := by
          dsimp only [U, V]
          noncomm_ring
    _ = V * C (evenV e c A) * (U * C B) := by rw [← hB]
    _ = V * (C (evenV e c A) * U) * C B := by noncomm_ring
    _ = V * (U * C A) * C B := by rw [← hA]
    _ = (V * U) * (C A * C B) := by noncomm_ring
    _ = C A * C B := by rw [hinv, one_mul]

name: AlbertLean.Triality.ParityEvenConjugation.sourceMuS_smul_input
statement:
private theorem sourceMuS_smul_input (v : VCoord K) (a : K) (d : CCoord K) :
    sourceMuS (a • d) v = a • sourceMuS d v
proof:
:= by
  exact (muSLinear v).map_smul a d

name: AlbertLean.Triality.ParityEvenConjugation.sourceMuC_smul_input
statement:
private theorem sourceMuC_smul_input (v : VCoord K) (a : K) (s : SCoord K) :
    sourceMuC v (a • s) = a • sourceMuC v s
proof:
:= by
  exact (muCLinear v).map_smul a s

name: AlbertLean.Triality.ParityEvenConjugation.evenS_conjugate
statement:
theorem evenS_conjugate (e c A B : VCoord K) (rho : K)
    (he : nV e = 1) (hc : nV c = 1) (s : SCoord K) :
    evenS e (reflectV e c) (-1)
      (evenS (evenV e c A) (evenV e c B) rho
        (evenS e c 1 s)) = evenS A B rho s
proof:
:= by
  rw [evenS_reflected_neg_reverse e c 1 (by simpa [he]) (by norm_num)]
  have h := LinearMap.congr_fun (clifford_even_conjugate e c A B he hc) (s, 0)
  have hs := congrArg Prod.fst h
  simp only [Module.End.mul_apply, C_apply] at hs
  simp only [evenS, inv_one, one_smul]
  rw [sourceMuC_smul_input, sourceMuS_smul_input, hs]

name: AlbertLean.Triality.ParityEvenConjugation.evenC_conjugate
statement:
theorem evenC_conjugate (e c A B : VCoord K) (rho : K)
    (he : nV e = 1) (hc : nV c = 1) (d : CCoord K) :
    evenC e (reflectV e c) (-1)
      (evenC (evenV e c A) (evenV e c B) rho
        (evenC e c 1 d)) = evenC A B rho d
proof:
:= by
  rw [evenC_reflected_neg_reverse e c 1 (by simpa [he]) (by norm_num)]
  have h := LinearMap.congr_fun (clifford_even_conjugate e c A B he hc) (0, d)
  have hd := congrArg Prod.snd h
  simp only [Module.End.mul_apply, C_apply] at hd
  simp only [evenC, inv_one, one_smul]
  rw [sourceMuS_smul_input, sourceMuC_smul_input, hd]

name: AlbertLean.Triality.ParityEvenConjugation.sourceEvenAut_linear_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem sourceEvenAut_linear_apply
    (a b : VCoord K) (rho : K)
    (ha : nV a ≠ 0) (hb : nV b ≠ 0)
    (hr : rho ^ 2 = nV a * nV b) (hr0 : rho ≠ 0) (x : JCoord K) :
    (sourceEvenAut a b rho ha hb hr hr0).linear x =
      { d1 := x.d1, d2 := x.d2, d3 := x.d3
        v := evenV a b x.v
        s := evenS a b rho x.s
        c := evenC a b rho x.c }
proof:
:= by
  exact evenJEquiv_apply a b rho ha hb hr hr0 x

name: AlbertLean.Triality.ParityEvenConjugation.sourceEvenAut_conjugate_apply
statement:
theorem sourceEvenAut_conjugate_apply
    (e c A B : VCoord K) (rho : K)
    (he : nV e = 1) (hc : nV c = 1)
    (hA : nV A ≠ 0) (hB : nV B ≠ 0)
    (hr : rho ^ 2 = nV A * nV B) (hr0 : rho ≠ 0)
    (x : JCoord K) :
    let he0 : nV e ≠ 0
proof:
:= by simpa [he]
    let hc0 : nV c ≠ 0 := by simpa [hc]
    let hrc : nV (reflectV e c) ≠ 0 := by
      simpa [nV_reflectV e c he0] using hc0
    let hAc : nV (evenV e c A) ≠ 0 := by
      simpa [nV_evenV e c A he0 hc0] using hA
    let hBc : nV (evenV e c B) ≠ 0 := by
      simpa [nV_evenV e c B he0 hc0] using hB
    let hminus : (-1 : K) ^ 2 = nV e * nV (reflectV e c) := by
      rw [he, one_mul, nV_reflectV e c he0, hc]
      norm_num
    let hone : (1 : K) ^ 2 = nV e * nV c := by rw [he, hc]; norm_num
    let hrcAB : rho ^ 2 = nV (evenV e c A) * nV (evenV e c B) := by
      simpa [nV_evenV e c A he0 hc0, nV_evenV e c B he0 hc0] using hr
    (sourceEvenAut e (reflectV e c) (-1) he0 hrc hminus (by norm_num)).linear
      ((sourceEvenAut (evenV e c A) (evenV e c B) rho hAc hBc hrcAB hr0).linear
        ((sourceEvenAut e c 1 he0 hc0 hone (by norm_num)).linear x)) =
      (sourceEvenAut A B rho hA hB hr hr0).linear x := by
  intro he0 hc0 hrc hAc hBc hminus hone hrcAB
  simp only [sourceEvenAut_linear_apply]
  apply JCoord.ext
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · exact evenV_conjugate e c A B x.v he0 hc0
  · exact evenS_conjugate e c A B rho he hc x.s
  · exact evenC_conjugate e c A B rho he hc x.c

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TitsTracePairing.polarProduct_firstComponent
statement:
theorem polarProduct_firstComponent (A : Mat3 R) (z : FirstTits R) :
    (polarProduct firstTitsSquare (A, 0, 0) z).1 =
      matrixJordan A z.1
proof:
:= by
  rcases z with ⟨D, E, F⟩
  have ht0 : trace3 (0 : Mat3 R) = 0 := by
    rw [trace3_eq_matrixTrace]
    simp
  change ⅟(2 : R) •
      (((A + D) * (A + D) - (0 + E) * (0 + F) +
          trace3 ((0 + E) * (0 + F)) • (1 : Mat3 R)) -
        (A * A - 0 * 0 + trace3 (0 * 0) • (1 : Mat3 R)) -
        (D * D - E * F + trace3 (E * F) • (1 : Mat3 R))) =
    ⅟(2 : R) • (A * D + D * A)
  simp only [zero_add, zero_mul, ht0, zero_smul, sub_zero, add_zero]
  apply congrArg (fun M : Mat3 R => ⅟(2 : R) • M)
  simp only [add_mul, mul_add]
  abel

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TitsTracePairing.polarProduct_firstSummand
statement:
theorem polarProduct_firstSummand (A B : Mat3 R) :
    polarProduct firstTitsSquare (A, 0, 0) (B, 0, 0) =
      (matrixJordan A B, 0, 0)
proof:
:= by
  have ha0 : adjugate3 (0 : Mat3 R) = 0 := by
    rw [adjugate3_eq_matrixAdjugate]
    exact Matrix.adjugate_zero
  apply Prod.ext
  · exact polarProduct_firstComponent A (B, 0, 0)
  · apply Prod.ext <;> simp [polarProduct, firstTitsSquare, ha0]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TitsTracePairing.embed_matrixJordan
statement:
theorem embed_matrixJordan (A B : Mat3 R) :
    embed (matrixJordan A B) = embed A * embed B
proof:
:= by
  rw [embed, embed, embed, ← polarProduct_firstSummand]
  exact toTau_polarProduct (A, 0, 0) (B, 0, 0)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TitsTracePairing.trace_matrixJordan
statement:
theorem trace_matrixJordan (A B : Mat3 R) :
    Matrix.trace (matrixJordan A B) = Matrix.trace (A * B)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [matrixJordan, Matrix.trace_smul, Matrix.trace_add,
    Matrix.trace_mul_comm B A]
  rw [← two_smul R (Matrix.trace (A * B)), smul_smul,
    invOf_mul_self, one_smul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TitsTracePairing.tauTrace_embed_mul_toTau
statement:
theorem tauTrace_embed_mul_toTau (A : Mat3 R) (z : FirstTits R) :
    TauCeti.AlbertAlgebra.trace (embed A * toTau z) =
      Matrix.trace (A * z.1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [embed, ← toTau_polarProduct]
  rw [tauTrace_toTau, polarProduct_firstComponent, trace_matrixJordan]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceScheduleReducedDomain.charZero_of_injective_map

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.realFrameEncoder_eq_primitiveMatrixEncoder
statement:
theorem realFrameEncoder_eq_primitiveMatrixEncoder
    (P : Fin 3 → Mat3 K) (X : Mat3 K)
    (hprojector : ∀ i, columnProjector X i = P i) :
    realFrameEncoder X = primitiveMatrixEncoder P
proof:
:= by
  unfold realFrameEncoder primitiveMatrixEncoder encoder embed
  rw [← map_sub, hprojector 2, hprojector 0]
  apply congrArg toTau
  apply Prod.ext
  · rfl
  · apply Prod.ext <;> simp

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.primitiveMatrixTriple_related_of_acceptedLedger_eq
statement:
theorem primitiveMatrixTriple_related_of_acceptedLedger_eq
    (hsqrt : ∀ x : K, ∃ t : K, t ^ 2 = x)
    (P P' : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Mat3 K)
    (hsymm : ∀ r i, Matrix.transpose (P r i) = P r i)
    (hidem : ∀ r i, P r i * P r i = P r i)
    (htrace : ∀ r i, Matrix.trace (P r i) = 1)
    (hsum : ∀ r, P r 0 + P r 1 + P r 2 = 1)
    (hsymm' : ∀ r i, Matrix.transpose (P' r i) = P' r i)
    (hidem' : ∀ r i, P' r i * P' r i = P' r i)
    (htrace' : ∀ r i, Matrix.trace (P' r i) = 1)
    (hsum' : ∀ r, P' r 0 + P' r 1 + P' r 2 = 1)
    (hnz01 : ∀ i j, Matrix.trace (P 0 i * P 1 j) ≠ 0)
    (hnz12 : ∀ j l, Matrix.trace (P 1 j * P 2 l) ≠ 0)
    (hnz20 : ∀ l i, Matrix.trace (P 2 l * P 0 i) ≠ 0)
    (hledger : labelledLedger (primitiveMatrixTauTriple P) =
      labelledLedger (primitiveMatrixTauTriple P')) :
    ∃ q : Mat3 K, IsOrthogonal q ∧
      ∀ r i, orthogonalConjugate q (P r i) = P' r i
proof:
:= by
  choose X hX hprojector using fun r =>
    exists_orthogonal_of_symmetric_primitive_frame
      hsqrt (P r) (hsymm r) (hidem r) (htrace r) (hsum r)
  choose X' hX' hprojector' using fun r =>
    exists_orthogonal_of_symmetric_primitive_frame
      hsqrt (P' r) (hsymm' r) (hidem' r) (htrace' r) (hsum' r)
  have htriple : realFrameTauTriple (X 0) (X 1) (X 2) =
      primitiveMatrixTauTriple P := by
    funext r
    fin_cases r <;>
      exact realFrameEncoder_eq_primitiveMatrixEncoder _ _ (hprojector _)
  have htriple' : realFrameTauTriple (X' 0) (X' 1) (X' 2) =
      primitiveMatrixTauTriple P' := by
    funext r
    fin_cases r <;>
      exact realFrameEncoder_eq_primitiveMatrixEncoder _ _ (hprojector' _)
  have hover01 : ∀ i j, overlap (X 0) (X 1) i j ≠ 0 := by
    intro i j hover
    apply hnz01 i j
    rw [← hprojector 0 i, ← hprojector 1 j,
      trace_columnProjector_mul, hover]
    norm_num
  have hover12 : ∀ j l, overlap (X 1) (X 2) j l ≠ 0 := by
    intro j l hover
    apply hnz12 j l
    rw [← hprojector 1 j, ← hprojector 2 l,
      trace_columnProjector_mul, hover]
    norm_num
  have hover20 : ∀ l i, overlap (X 2) (X 0) l i ≠ 0 := by
    intro l i hover
    apply hnz20 l i
    rw [← hprojector 2 l, ← hprojector 0 i,
      trace_columnProjector_mul, hover]
    norm_num
  have hledgerX :
      labelledLedger (realFrameTauTriple (X 0) (X 1) (X 2)) =
        labelledLedger (realFrameTauTriple (X' 0) (X' 1) (X' 2)) := by
    rw [htriple, htriple']
    exact hledger
  obtain ⟨q, hq, h0, h1, h2⟩ :=
    projectorTriple_related_of_acceptedLedger_eq_of_orthogonal
      (X 0) (X 1) (X 2) (X' 0) (X' 1) (X' 2)
      (hX 0) (hX 1) (hX 2) (hX' 0) (hX' 1) (hX' 2)
      hover01 hover12 hover20 hledgerX
  refine ⟨q, hq, ?_⟩
  intro r i
  fin_cases r
  · change orthogonalConjugate q (P 0 i) = P' 0 i
    rw [← hprojector 0 i, ← hprojector' 0 i]
    exact h0 i
  · change orthogonalConjugate q (P 1 i) = P' 1 i
    rw [← hprojector 1 i, ← hprojector' 1 i]
    exact h1 i
  · change orthogonalConjugate q (P 2 i) = P' 2 i
    rw [← hprojector 2 i, ← hprojector' 2 i]
    exact h2 i

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RawCompanionSeparation.agreement_of_mem_generated_field
statement:
theorem agreement_of_mem_generated_field
    (i : R →+* F) (hi : Function.Injective i)
    (phi : F →+* K) (e : R →+* K) (S : Set R)
    (hS : ∀ x ∈ S, e x = phi (i x))
    (d : R) (hd : i d ∈ Subfield.closure (i '' S)) :
    e d = phi (i d)
proof:
:= by
  have hc : ∀ x ∈ Subring.closure S, e x = phi (i x) :=
    RingHom.eqOn_set_closure (f := e) (g := phi.comp i) hS
  obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, hab⟩ := Subfield.mem_closure_iff.mp hd
  rw [← i.map_closure] at ha hb
  obtain ⟨ar, har, rfl⟩ := Subring.mem_map.mp ha
  obtain ⟨br, hbr, rfl⟩ := Subring.mem_map.mp hb
  by_cases hb0 : i br = 0
  · have hid : i d = 0 := by simpa only [hb0, div_zero] using hab.symm
    have hd0 : d = 0 := hi (by simpa only [map_zero] using hid)
    simp only [hd0, map_zero]
  · have hmul : i ar = i d * i br := (div_eq_iff hb0).mp hab
    have hraw : ar = d * br := hi (by simpa only [map_mul] using hmul)
    have hphi : phi (i br) ≠ 0 := by
      simpa only [map_zero] using phi.injective.ne hb0
    apply mul_right_cancel₀ hphi
    calc
      e d * phi (i br) = e (d * br) := by rw [map_mul, hc br hbr]
      _ = e ar := congrArg e hraw.symm
      _ = phi (i ar) := hc ar har
      _ = phi (i d) * phi (i br) := by rw [hmul, map_mul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RawCompanionSeparation.not_mem_generated_field_of_companion
statement:
theorem not_mem_generated_field_of_companion
    (i : R →+* F) (hi : Function.Injective i)
    (phi : F →+* K) (e : R →+* K) (S : Set R)
    (hS : ∀ x ∈ S, e x = phi (i x))
    (d : R) (hsep : e d ≠ phi (i d)) :
    i d ∉ Subfield.closure (i '' S)
proof:
:= by
  intro hd
  exact hsep (agreement_of_mem_generated_field i hi phi e S hS d hd)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowProbeSeed.frame_encoder
statement:

proof:
:= by
  have hg : (diagonalUnit 2 : Mat3 K) - diagonalUnit 0 = grading := by
    ext i j
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
      norm_num [diagonalUnit, grading, Fin.ext_iff]
  simp only [encoder, frame, conjugate, ← Matrix.sub_mul, ← Matrix.mul_sub, hg]
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    norm_num [P, Q, grading, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ,
      Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.vecMul_diagonal, Fin.ext_iff]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowProbeSeed.frame_commutator_ne_zero

proof:

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TitsMixedAction.polarProduct_firstLeft
statement:
theorem polarProduct_firstLeft
    (A D E F : Mat3 R) :
    polarProduct firstTitsSquare (A, 0, 0) (D, E, F) =
      (matrixJordan A D,
        ⅟(2 : R) • (trace3 A • E - A * E),
        ⅟(2 : R) • (trace3 A • F - F * A))
proof:
:= by
  have ha0 : adjugate3 (0 : Mat3 R) = 0 := by
    rw [adjugate3_eq_matrixAdjugate]
    exact Matrix.adjugate_zero
  have ht : trace3 (A + D) = trace3 A + trace3 D := by
    simpa only [trace3_eq_matrixTrace] using Matrix.trace_add A D
  apply Prod.ext
  · exact polarProduct_firstComponent A (D, E, F)
  · apply Prod.ext
    · change ⅟(2 : R) •
          ((adjugate3 (0 + F) - (A + D) * (0 + E) + trace3 (A + D) • (0 + E)) -
            (adjugate3 0 - A * 0 + trace3 A • 0) -
            (adjugate3 F - D * E + trace3 D • E)) =
        ⅟(2 : R) • (trace3 A • E - A * E)
      simp only [zero_add]
      rw [ha0, ht]
      simp only [add_mul, mul_zero, smul_zero, sub_zero, zero_add, add_smul]
      congr 1
      abel
    · change ⅟(2 : R) •
          ((adjugate3 (0 + E) - (0 + F) * (A + D) + trace3 (A + D) • (0 + F)) -
            (adjugate3 0 - 0 * A + trace3 A • 0) -
            (adjugate3 E - F * D + trace3 D • F)) =
        ⅟(2 : R) • (trace3 A • F - F * A)
      simp only [zero_add]
      rw [ha0, ht]
      simp only [mul_add, zero_mul, smul_zero, sub_zero, zero_add, add_smul]
      congr 1
      abel

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TitsMixedAction.toTau_mul_firstLeft
statement:
theorem toTau_mul_firstLeft
    (A D E F : Mat3 R) :
    toTau (R := R)
        (matrixJordan A D,
          ⅟(2 : R) • (trace3 A • E - A * E),
          ⅟(2 : R) • (trace3 A • F - F * A)) =
      embed A * toTau (R := R) (D, E, F)
proof:
:= by
  rw [embed, ← toTau_polarProduct, polarProduct_firstLeft]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.PrimitiveOpenWitness.exists_primitive_projector_triple_on_open
statement:
theorem exists_primitive_projector_triple_on_open :
    ∃ P : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Mat3 K,
      (∀ r i, Matrix.transpose (P r i) = P r i) ∧
      (∀ r i, P r i * P r i = P r i) ∧
      (∀ r i, Matrix.trace (P r i) = 1) ∧
      (∀ r, P r 0 + P r 1 + P r 2 = 1) ∧
      (∀ i j, Matrix.trace (P 0 i * P 1 j) ≠ 0) ∧
      (∀ j l, Matrix.trace (P 1 j * P 2 l) ≠ 0) ∧
      (∀ l i, Matrix.trace (P 2 l * P 0 i) ≠ 0)
proof:
:= by
  let B : Fin 3 → Mat3 K := ![X, Y, Z]
  let P : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Mat3 K := fun r i => columnProjector (B r) i
  have hB : ∀ r, IsOrthogonal (B r) := by
    intro r
    fin_cases r
    · exact X_orthogonal
    · exact Y_orthogonal
    · exact Z_orthogonal
  refine ⟨P, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro r i
    exact columnProjector_symmetric (B r) i
  · intro r i
    exact columnProjector_mul_self (B r) (hB r) i
  · intro r i
    exact columnProjector_trace_one (B r) (hB r) i
  · intro r
    exact columnProjector_sum (B r) (hB r)
  · intro i j hzero
    change Matrix.trace
      (columnProjector (X : Mat3 K) i * columnProjector Y j) = 0 at hzero
    apply overlap_XY_ne_zero (K := K) i j
    rw [← sq_eq_zero_iff]
    rw [← trace_columnProjector_mul]
    exact hzero
  · intro j l hzero
    change Matrix.trace
      (columnProjector (Y : Mat3 K) j * columnProjector Z l) = 0 at hzero
    apply overlap_YZ_ne_zero (K := K) j l
    rw [← sq_eq_zero_iff]
    rw [← trace_columnProjector_mul]
    exact hzero
  · intro l i hzero
    change Matrix.trace
      (columnProjector (Z : Mat3 K) l * columnProjector X i) = 0 at hzero
    apply overlap_ZX_ne_zero (K := K) l i
    rw [← sq_eq_zero_iff]
    rw [← trace_columnProjector_mul]
    exact hzero

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericLedgerInvariance.include_fixed
statement:
private theorem include_fixed {z : Base k} (h : reorient k z = z) :
    includeBase k z ∈ nuFixed k
proof:
:= by
  change nu k (includeBase k z) = includeBase k z
  rw [nu_base, h]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericLedgerInvariance.generic_matrix

  rw [GenericNormalizedFrameChart.insert_matrixM]
  change GenericNormalizedFrameChart.moment (fieldParameters k) i j = _
  rw [fieldParameters_moment]
  rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericLedgerInvariance.chart_sector21
statement:
private theorem chart_sector21 (F : Subfield K) (x : ExplicitFrameChart K)
    (hd : ∀ i, x.diagA i ∈ F)
    (hV : BV (vectorA x) (vectorB x) ∈ F)
    (hS : BS x.s1 x.s2 ∈ F) (hC : BC x.c1 x.c2 ∈ F)
    (hB11 : triality (vectorB x) x.s1 x.c1 ∈ F)
    (hA21 : triality (vectorA x) x.s2 x.c1 ∈ F)
    (hA12 : triality (vectorA x) x.s1 x.c2 ∈ F) :
    SectorIn F (sourceSquare (encoderA x)) (encoderB x)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [sourceSquare_v, BV_add_left, BV_smul_left, muV_triality]
    exact F.add_mem (F.mul_mem (F.add_mem (hd 1) (hd 2)) hV) hB11
  · rw [sourceSquare_s, BS_add_left, BS_smul_left, muS_triality]
    exact F.add_mem (F.mul_mem (F.add_mem (hd 0) (hd 2)) hS) hA21
  · rw [sourceSquare_c, BC_add_left, BC_smul_left, muC_triality]
    exact F.add_mem (F.mul_mem (F.add_mem (hd 0) (hd 1)) hC) hA12

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericLedgerInvariance.chart_sector12
statement:
private theorem chart_sector12 (F : Subfield K) (x : ExplicitFrameChart K)
    (hd : ∀ i, x.diagB i ∈ F)
    (hV : BV (vectorA x) (vectorB x) ∈ F)
    (hS : BS x.s1 x.s2 ∈ F) (hC : BC x.c1 x.c2 ∈ F)
    (hA22 : triality (vectorA x) x.s2 x.c2 ∈ F)
    (hB12 : triality (vectorB x) x.s1 x.c2 ∈ F)
    (hB21 : triality (vectorB x) x.s2 x.c1 ∈ F) :
    SectorIn F (encoderA x) (sourceSquare (encoderB x))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [sourceSquare_v, BV_add_right, BV_smul_right]
    simp only [encoderA, encoderB]
    rw [BV_symmetric (vectorA x) (normalizedMuV x.s2 x.c2), muV_triality]
    exact F.add_mem (F.mul_mem (F.add_mem (hd 1) (hd 2)) hV) hA22
  · rw [sourceSquare_s, BS_add_right, BS_smul_right]
    simp only [encoderA, encoderB]
    rw [BS_symmetric x.s1 (sourceMuS x.c2 (vectorB x)), muS_triality]
    exact F.add_mem (F.mul_mem (F.add_mem (hd 0) (hd 2)) hS) hB12
  · rw [sourceSquare_c, BC_add_right, BC_smul_right]
    simp only [encoderA, encoderB]
    rw [BC_symmetric x.c1 (sourceMuC (vectorB x) x.s2), muC_triality]
    exact F.add_mem (F.mul_mem (F.add_mem (hd 0) (hd 1)) hC) hB21

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericLedgerInvariance.diagA_fixed
statement: private theorem diagA_fixed : ∀ i, (genericChart k).diagA i ∈ (nuFixed k)
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  fin_cases i
  · exact include_fixed k (reorient_diag k 0)
  · exact include_fixed k (reorient_diag k 1)
  · change -includeBase k (ι k (diagX k 0)) - includeBase k (ι k (diagX k 1)) ∈ (nuFixed k)
    exact (nuFixed k).sub_mem ((nuFixed k).neg_mem (include_fixed k (reorient_diag k 0)))
      (include_fixed k (reorient_diag k 1))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericLedgerInvariance.diagB_fixed
statement: private theorem diagB_fixed : ∀ i, (genericChart k).diagB i ∈ (nuFixed k)
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  fin_cases i
  · exact include_fixed k (reorient_diag k 2)
  · exact include_fixed k (reorient_diag k 3)
  · change -includeBase k (ι k (diagX k 2)) - includeBase k (ι k (diagX k 3)) ∈ (nuFixed k)
    exact (nuFixed k).sub_mem ((nuFixed k).neg_mem (include_fixed k (reorient_diag k 2)))
      (include_fixed k (reorient_diag k 3))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericLedgerInvariance.gramV_fixed
statement: private theorem gramV_fixed : BV (vectorA (genericChart k)) (vectorB (genericChart k)) ∈ (nuFixed k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [chart_gramV]
  change 1 * includeBase k (ι k (c k)) +
    includeBase k (ι k (a k)) * includeBase k (ι k (b k)) ∈ (nuFixed k)
  rw [one_mul, ← map_mul, ← map_add]
  exact include_fixed k (reorient_vGram k)

statement: private theorem gramS_fixed : BS (genericChart k).s1 (genericChart k).s2 ∈ (nuFixed k)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericLedgerInvariance.crossA_fixed
statement:
private theorem crossA_fixed (i j : Fin 4) (hi : i < 2) (hj : ¬ j < 2) :
    (genericChart k).r1 * matrixM (genericChart k) i j + (genericChart k).z1 * matrixM (genericChart k) j i ∈ (nuFixed k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [generic_matrix, generic_matrix]
  change 1 * includeBase k (rationalM k i j) +
    includeBase k (ι k (a k)) * includeBase k (rationalM k j i) ∈ (nuFixed k)
  rw [one_mul, ← map_mul, ← map_add]
  exact include_fixed k (reorient_trialityA k i j hi hj)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericLedgerInvariance.crossB_fixed
statement:
private theorem crossB_fixed (i j : Fin 4) (hi : i < 2) (hj : ¬ j < 2) :
    (genericChart k).r2 * matrixM (genericChart k) i j + (genericChart k).z2 * matrixM (genericChart k) j i ∈ (nuFixed k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [generic_matrix, generic_matrix]
  change includeBase k (ι k (b k)) * includeBase k (rationalM k i j) +
    includeBase k (ι k (c k)) * includeBase k (rationalM k j i) ∈ (nuFixed k)
  rw [← map_mul, ← map_mul, ← map_add]
  exact include_fixed k (reorient_trialityB k i j hi hj)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericLedgerInvariance.trialityA1C2_fixed
statement: private theorem trialityA1C2_fixed : triality (vectorA (genericChart k)) (genericChart k).s1 (genericChart k).c2 ∈ (nuFixed k)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericLedgerInvariance.UC_fixed
statement:
private theorem UC_fixed : BC (sourceMuC (vectorA (genericChart k)) (genericChart k).s1)
    (sourceMuC (vectorB (genericChart k)) (genericChart k).s2) ∈ (nuFixed k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [chart_UC]
  rw [generic_matrix, generic_matrix]
  change 1 * includeBase k (ι k (c k)) * includeBase k (rationalM k 0 1) +
    includeBase k (ι k (b k)) * includeBase k (ι k (a k)) *
      includeBase k (rationalM k 1 0) ∈ (nuFixed k)
  rw [one_mul, mul_comm (includeBase k (ι k (b k))) (includeBase k (ι k (a k))),
    ← map_mul, ← map_mul, ← map_mul, ← map_add]
  exact include_fixed k (reorient_UC k)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericLedgerInvariance.US_fixed
statement:
private theorem US_fixed : BS (sourceMuS (genericChart k).c1 (vectorA (genericChart k)))
    (sourceMuS (genericChart k).c2 (vectorB (genericChart k))) ∈ (nuFixed k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [chart_US]
  rw [generic_matrix, generic_matrix]
  change includeBase k (ι k (b k)) * includeBase k (ι k (a k)) *
    includeBase k (rationalM k 2 3) + 1 * includeBase k (ι k (c k)) *
      includeBase k (rationalM k 3 2) ∈ (nuFixed k)
  rw [one_mul, mul_comm (includeBase k (ι k (b k))) (includeBase k (ι k (a k)))]
  simpa only [map_add, map_mul] using include_fixed k (reorient_US k)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericLedgerInvariance.UV_fixed
statement: private theorem UV_fixed : normalizedUV (genericChart k).s1 (genericChart k).s2 (genericChart k).c1 (genericChart k).c2 ∈ (nuFixed k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [chart_UV, rootSum_eq_S]
  apply (nuFixed k).sub_mem
  · have hq : exteriorQ (matrixM (genericChart k)) = includeBase k (exteriorQ (rationalM k)) := by
      simp only [exteriorQ, generic_matrix, map_add, map_sub, map_mul]
    rw [hq]
    exact include_fixed k (reorient_exteriorQ k)
  · change nu k (T (Base k) + includeBase k (Matrix.det (rationalM k)) / T (Base k)) =
      T (Base k) + includeBase k (Matrix.det (rationalM k)) / T (Base k)
    simp only [map_add, map_div₀, nu_T, nu_base, reorient_det_rationalM]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericLedgerInvariance.sector21_fixed
proof:
:=
  chart_sector21 (nuFixed k) (genericChart k) (diagA_fixed k)
    (gramV_fixed k) (gramS_fixed k) (gramC_fixed k)
    (trialityB1C1_fixed k) (trialityA2C1_fixed k) (trialityA1C2_fixed k)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericLedgerInvariance.sector12_fixed

:=
  chart_sector12 (nuFixed k) (genericChart k) (diagB_fixed k)
    (gramV_fixed k) (gramS_fixed k) (gramC_fixed k)
    (trialityA2C2_fixed k) (trialityB1C2_fixed k) (trialityB2C1_fixed k)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericLedgerInvariance.ledgerIn_nuFixed
statement:
theorem ledgerIn_nuFixed :
    LedgerIn (nuFixed k) (sourceLedger (encoderA (genericChart k))
      (encoderB (genericChart k)))
proof:
:= by
  exact ledgerIn_of_measurements (nuFixed k)
    (encoderA (genericChart k)) (encoderB (genericChart k))
    (power_diagA_fixed k) (power_diagB_fixed k)
    ⟨gramV_fixed k, gramS_fixed k, gramC_fixed k⟩
    (sector12_fixed k) (sector21_fixed k) (UV_fixed k) (US_fixed k) (UC_fixed k)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericLedgerInvariance.H_le_nuFixed
statement: theorem H_le_nuFixed : H k ≤ nuFixed k
proof:
:= by
  apply Subfield.closure_le.2
  rintro z (hz | hz)
  · have hg : groundBase k ≤ nuFixed k := by
      apply Subfield.closure_le.2
      rintro _ ⟨c,rfl⟩
      exact nu_constant k c
    exact hg hz
  · exact (ledgerCells_subset_iff (nuFixed k) _ _).2 (ledgerIn_nuFixed k) hz

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericLedgerInvariance.deck_fixed_of_mem_H
statement: theorem deck_fixed_of_mem_H {z : FunctionField k} (hz : z ∈ H k) : deck k z = z
proof:
:= by
  have ho : z ∈ orientationLedgerField (groundBase k) (genericChart k) :=
    Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inl hz)
  rw [orientation_eq_invariantField] at ho
  exact (fixed_iff_mem_invariantField (Base k) (Matrix.det (rationalM k))
    (det_rationalM_ne_zero k) z).2 ho

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericLedgerInvariance.tau_fixed_of_mem_H
statement: theorem tau_fixed_of_mem_H {z : FunctionField k} (hz : z ∈ H k) : tau k z = z
proof:
:= by
  rw [tau_apply, show nu k z = z from H_le_nuFixed k hz]
  exact deck_fixed_of_mem_H k hz

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericLedgerInvariance.kappa_not_mem_H
statement: theorem kappa_not_mem_H : kappa k ∉ H k
proof:
:= by
  intro hk
  have h : -kappa k = kappa k := (nu_kappa k).symm.trans (H_le_nuFixed k hk)
  have hz : (2 : FunctionField k) * kappa k = 0 := by linear_combination -h
  exact kappa_ne_zero k ((mul_eq_zero.mp hz).resolve_left (by norm_num))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.coordinate_transport
statement:
theorem coordinate_transport
    (L L' : Vec6 K ≃ₗ[K] Vec6 K) (P Q : Vec6 K →ₗ[K] Vec6 K)
    (S T : Mat2 K)
    (hcoord : (commonPlaneMap S).comp
      ((coordinateConjugate L P).comp (commonPlaneMap T)) = coordinateConjugate L' Q) :
    (L'.toLinearMap.comp ((commonPlaneMap S).comp L.symm.toLinearMap)).comp
      (P.comp (L.toLinearMap.comp
        ((commonPlaneMap T).comp L'.symm.toLinearMap))) = Q
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  change L' ((commonPlaneMap S)
    (L.symm (P (L ((commonPlaneMap T) (L'.symm x)))))) = Q x
  have hx := congrArg L' (LinearMap.congr_fun hcoord (L'.symm x))
  change L' ((commonPlaneMap S)
      (L.symm (P (L ((commonPlaneMap T) (L'.symm x)))))) =
    L' (L'.symm (Q (L' (L'.symm x)))) at hx
  simpa only [L'.apply_symm_apply] using hx

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.diagonalSign_transpose
statement:
theorem diagonalSign_transpose (e : Fin 3 → K) :
    Matrix.transpose (diagonalSign e) = diagonalSign e
proof:
:= by
  exact Matrix.diagonal_transpose e

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.diagonalSign_orthogonal
statement:
theorem diagonalSign_orthogonal (e : Fin 3 → K)
    (he : ∀ i, (e i) ^ 2 = 1) : IsOrthogonal (diagonalSign e)
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> rw [diagonalSign_transpose]
  all_goals
    simp only [diagonalSign, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
    simp only [← pow_two, he, Matrix.diagonal_one]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.gaugeOverlap_apply
statement:
theorem gaugeOverlap_apply (left right : Fin 3 → K) (U : Mat3 K) (i j : Fin 3) :
    gaugeOverlap left right U i j = left i * U i j * right j
proof:
:= by
  simp only [gaugeOverlap, diagonalSign, Matrix.mul_diagonal, Matrix.diagonal_mul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.matrix_gauge_eq_of_entrywise
statement:
theorem matrix_gauge_eq_of_entrywise
    (U U' : Mat3 K) (left right : Fin 3 → K)
    (h : ∀ i j, U' i j = left i * U i j * right j) :
    U' = gaugeOverlap left right U
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  rw [gaugeOverlap_apply]
  exact h i j

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.gaugeOverlap_neg_neg
statement:
theorem gaugeOverlap_neg_neg (left right : Fin 3 → K) (U : Mat3 K) :
    gaugeOverlap (-left) (-right) U = gaugeOverlap left right U
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp [gaugeOverlap_apply]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SeedPairSchedule.seedU_zero
statement: theorem seedU_zero : seedU 0 = pairU
proof:
:= by
  funext a
  rcases a with a | a
  · fin_cases a <;> norm_num [seedU, pairU, R, Matrix.cons_val_two]
  · simp [seedU, pairU]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SeedPairSchedule.seedV_zero
statement: theorem seedV_zero : seedV 0 = pairV
proof:
:= by
  funext a

  · simp [seedV, pairV]
  · fin_cases a <;> norm_num [seedV, pairV, S, Matrix.cons_val_two]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SeedPairSchedule.omega_seedU_seedV
statement:
theorem omega_seedU_seedV (i j : Fin 3) :
    (omega (K := ℚ)) (seedU i) (seedV j) = if i = j then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrFun (congrFun S_mul_R j) i
  simpa [omega, omegaFun, seedU, seedV, Matrix.mul_apply,
    Matrix.one_apply, eq_comm, mul_comm] using h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SeedPairSchedule.omega_seedV_seedU
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrFun (congrFun S_mul_R i) j
  simpa [omega, omegaFun, seedU, seedV, Matrix.mul_apply,
    Matrix.one_apply, mul_comm] using congrArg Neg.neg h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SeedPairSchedule.seed_hyperbolicTriple
statement:
theorem seed_hyperbolicTriple :
    HyperbolicTriple (omega (K := ℚ)) seedU seedV
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    simpa using omega_seedU_seedV i i
  · intro i j hij
    simp [omega, omegaFun, seedU]
  · intro i j hij
    simpa [hij] using omega_seedU_seedV i j
  · intro i j hij
    simpa [hij] using omega_seedV_seedU i j
  · intro i j hij
    simp [omega, omegaFun, seedV]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SeedPairSchedule.A_mul_R
statement: private theorem A_mul_R (i : Fin 3) : A i * R = R * e i
proof:
:= by
  calc
    A i * R = R * e i * (S * R) := by simp only [A, Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = R * e i := by rw [S_mul_R, Matrix.mul_one]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SeedPairSchedule.S_mul_A
statement: private theorem S_mul_A (i : Fin 3) : S * A i = e i * S
proof:
:= by
  calc
    S * A i = (S * R) * e i * S := by simp only [A, Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = e i * S := by rw [S_mul_R, Matrix.one_mul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SeedPairSchedule.R_mul_e_entry
statement:
private theorem R_mul_e_entry (i j a : Fin 3) :
    (R * e i) a j = if i = j then R a j else 0
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> fin_cases a <;>
    norm_num [R, e, diagonalProjector, Matrix.mul_apply,
      Fin.sum_univ_succ, Matrix.one_apply, Matrix.cons_val_two,
      fin3_zero_ne_two, fin3_one_ne_two, fin3_two_ne_zero, fin3_two_ne_one]

statement:

proof:

    norm_num [S, e, diagonalProjector, Matrix.mul_apply,
      Fin.sum_univ_succ, Matrix.one_apply, Matrix.cons_val_two,
      fin3_zero_ne_two, fin3_one_ne_two, fin3_two_ne_zero, fin3_two_ne_one]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SeedPairSchedule.secondFrame_seedU
statement:
theorem secondFrame_seedU (i j : Fin 3) :
    matrixAction (secondFrame i : Mat6 ℚ) (seedU j) =
      if i = j then seedU j else 0
proof:
:= by
  funext a
  rcases a with a | a
  · have haction :
        matrixAction (secondFrame i : Mat6 ℚ) (seedU j) (Sum.inl a) =
          (A i * R) a j := by
      simp [matrixAction, secondFrame, grouped, seedU, hat,
        Matrix.mul_apply, Fintype.sum_sum_type, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
    rw [haction, A_mul_R, R_mul_e_entry]
    by_cases hij : i = j <;> simp [hij, seedU]
  · by_cases hij : i = j <;> fin_cases a <;>
      simp [matrixAction, secondFrame, grouped, seedU, hat,
        Fintype.sum_sum_type, Fin.sum_univ_succ, hij]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SeedPairSchedule.secondFrame_seedV
statement:
theorem secondFrame_seedV (i j : Fin 3) :
    matrixAction (secondFrame i : Mat6 ℚ) (seedV j) =
      if i = j then seedV j else 0
proof:
:= by
  funext a
  rcases a with a | a
  · by_cases hij : i = j <;> fin_cases a <;>
      simp [matrixAction, secondFrame, grouped, seedV, hat,
        Fintype.sum_sum_type, Fin.sum_univ_succ, hij]
  · have haction :
        matrixAction (secondFrame i : Mat6 ℚ) (seedV j) (Sum.inr a) =
          (S * A i) j a := by
      simp [matrixAction, secondFrame, grouped, seedV, hat,
        Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Fintype.sum_sum_type,
        Fin.sum_univ_succ] <;> ring
    rw [haction, S_mul_A, e_mul_S_entry]
    by_cases hij : i = j <;> simp [hij, seedV]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SeedPairSchedule.exists_secondFrame_pair_alignment
statement:
theorem exists_secondFrame_pair_alignment :
    ∃ word : List (Step (K := ℚ) (V := Vec6 ℚ)), word.length = 12 ∧
      (∀ i, ((wordJordanAut word).linear (secondFrame i) : Carrier ℚ) =
        standardCarrierProjector i) ∧
      wordMap omega word pairU = standardE 0 ∧
      wordMap omega word pairV = standardF 0 ∧
      wordMap omega (inverseWord word) (standardE 0) = pairU ∧
      wordMap omega (inverseWord word) (standardF 0) = pairV
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨word, hlen, hu, hv⟩ := exists_fixed_twelve_triple_alignment
    (omega (K := ℚ)) omega_alternating omega_left_nondegenerate
    omega_right_nondegenerate seedU seedV standardE standardF
    seed_hyperbolicTriple standard_hyperbolicTriple
  have hintertwine : ∀ i,
      (wordMap omega word).comp (matrixAction (secondFrame i : Mat6 ℚ)) =
        (standardProjector i).comp (wordMap omega word) :=
    intertwines_of_spanning_target (wordMap omega word)
      (wordMap_injective omega omega_alternating word)
      (fun i => matrixAction (secondFrame i : Mat6 ℚ)) standardProjector
      seedU seedV standardE standardF hu hv secondFrame_seedU secondFrame_seedV
      standardProjector_E standardProjector_F standard_spans
  have hframe : ∀ i,
      ((wordJordanAut word).linear (secondFrame i) : Carrier ℚ) =
        standardCarrierProjector i := by
    intro i
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact word_conjugates_projector word (secondFrame i) i (hintertwine i)
  have hforwardU : wordMap omega word pairU = standardE 0 := by
    rw [← seedU_zero]
    exact hu 0
  have hforwardV : wordMap omega word pairV = standardF 0 := by
    rw [← seedV_zero]
    exact hv 0
  have hinverseU :
      wordMap omega (inverseWord word) (standardE 0) = pairU := by
    apply wordMap_injective omega omega_alternating word
    have hi := LinearMap.congr_fun (inverseWord_right word) (standardE 0)
    simpa only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.id_apply, hforwardU] using hi
  have hinverseV :
      wordMap omega (inverseWord word) (standardF 0) = pairV := by
    apply wordMap_injective omega omega_alternating word
    have hi := LinearMap.congr_fun (inverseWord_right word) (standardF 0)
    simpa only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.id_apply, hforwardV] using hi
  exact ⟨word, hlen, hframe, hforwardU, hforwardV, hinverseU, hinverseV⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SeedPairSchedule.exists_seed_pair_schedule
statement:
theorem exists_seed_pair_schedule :
    ∃ Z : Fin 3 → Fin 12 → (Vec6 ℚ × ℚ),
      (∀ r i c,
        evalSchedule ℚ (RingHom.id ℚ) Z (scheduledPoint ℚ r i c) =
          seedPoint r i c) ∧
      (∀ i, ((wordJordanAut (concreteWord Z 1)).linear (secondFrame i) :
          Carrier ℚ) = standardCarrierProjector i) ∧
      matrixAction
          ((evalSchedule ℚ (RingHom.id ℚ) Z).mapMatrix (forwardMatrix ℚ 1))
          pairU = standardE 0 ∧
      matrixAction
          ((evalSchedule ℚ (RingHom.id ℚ) Z).mapMatrix (forwardMatrix ℚ 1))
          pairV = standardF 0 ∧
      matrixAction
          ((evalSchedule ℚ (RingHom.id ℚ) Z).mapMatrix (inverseMatrix ℚ 1))
          (standardE 0) = pairU ∧
      matrixAction
          ((evalSchedule ℚ (RingHom.id ℚ) Z).mapMatrix (inverseMatrix ℚ 1))
          (standardF 0) = pairV
proof:
:= by
  have hraw := seedPoint_isRaw
  have hactual (r : Fin 3) := actual_frame_laws seedPoint hraw r
  choose word hlen hword using fun r =>
    exists_jordanAut_to_standard_frame (fun i => decode (seedPoint r i))
      (hactual r).1 (hactual r).2.1 (hactual r).2.2
  obtain ⟨special, hspecialLen, hspecialFrame, hforwardU, hforwardV,
      hinverseU, hinverseV⟩ := exists_secondFrame_pair_alignment
  let chosenWord : Fin 3 → List (Step (K := ℚ) (V := Vec6 ℚ)) :=
    fun r => if r = 1 then special else word r
  have hchosenLen (r : Fin 3) : (chosenWord r).length = 12 := by
    by_cases hr : r = 1
    · simp [chosenWord, hr, hspecialLen]
    · simp [chosenWord, hr, hlen]
  have hchosenFrame (r i : Fin 3) :
      ((wordJordanAut (chosenWord r)).linear (seedCarrier r i) : Carrier ℚ) =
        standardCarrierProjector i := by
    by_cases hr : r = 1
    · subst r
      simpa [chosenWord, seedCarrier] using hspecialFrame i
    · simpa [chosenWord, hr, seedPoint, decode_encode] using hword r i
  let Z : Fin 3 → Fin 12 → (Vec6 ℚ × ℚ) :=
    fun r => scheduleOfLengthTwelve (chosenWord r) (hchosenLen r)
  have hconcrete (r : Fin 3) : concreteWord Z r = chosenWord r := by
    change List.ofFn (scheduleOfLengthTwelve (chosenWord r) (hchosenLen r)) =
      chosenWord r
    exact ofFn_scheduleOfLengthTwelve (chosenWord r) (hchosenLen r)
  have hconcreteOne : concreteWord Z 1 = special := by
    rw [hconcrete]
    simp [chosenWord]
  refine ⟨Z, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro r i c
    have hs := congrFun
      (eval_scheduledPoint ℚ (RingHom.id ℚ) Z r i) c
    have hw : (wordJordanAut (concreteWord Z r)).linear.symm
        (standardCarrierProjector i) = decode (seedPoint r i) := by
      apply (wordJordanAut (concreteWord Z r)).linear.injective
      rw [(wordJordanAut (concreteWord Z r)).linear.apply_symm_apply,
        hconcrete]
      simpa only [seedPoint, decode_encode] using (hchosenFrame r i).symm
    rw [hw, encode_decode] at hs
    exact hs
  · simpa only [hconcreteOne] using hspecialFrame
  · rw [eval_forwardMatrix, hconcreteOne]
    unfold wordMatrix
    rw [matrixAction_matrixOfLinear]
    exact hforwardU
  · rw [eval_forwardMatrix, hconcreteOne]
    unfold wordMatrix
    rw [matrixAction_matrixOfLinear]
    exact hforwardV
  · rw [eval_inverseMatrix, hconcreteOne]
    unfold inverseWordMatrix
    rw [matrixAction_matrixOfLinear]
    exact hinverseU
  · rw [eval_inverseMatrix, hconcreteOne]
    unfold inverseWordMatrix
    rw [matrixAction_matrixOfLinear]
    exact hinverseV

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawInvariantFieldLower.rawProduct_eq_product
statement:
private theorem rawProduct_eq_product (x y : RawF0 k) :
    rawProduct k x y = SourceAutExtension.product (k := k) x y
proof:
:=
  SourceRawAutomorphism.raw_product_eq_extension k x y

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawInvariantFieldLower.mapVector_rawProduct
statement:
theorem mapVector_rawProduct (g : SourceAut (K := k))
    (x y : RawF0 k) :
    mapVector k g (rawProduct k x y) =
      rawProduct k (mapVector k g x) (mapVector k g y)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = mapVector k g (SourceAutExtension.product (k := k) x y) :=
      congrArg (mapVector k g) (rawProduct_eq_product k x y)
    _ = SourceAutExtension.product (k := k) (mapVector k g x) (mapVector k g y) :=
      mapVector_product k g x y
    _ = _ := (rawProduct_eq_product k (mapVector k g x) (mapVector k g y)).symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawInvariantFieldLower.rawAction_rawTrace
statement:
theorem rawAction_rawTrace (g : SourceAut (K := k)) (x : RawF0 k) :
    rawAction k g (rawTrace k x) = rawTrace k (mapVector k g x)
proof:
:= by
  simp [rawTrace, mapVector]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawInvariantFieldLower.mapVector_rawEncoder
statement:
theorem mapVector_rawEncoder (g : SourceAut (K := k)) (r : Fin 3) :
    mapVector k g (rawEncoder k r) =
      linearEquiv (R := CoordinateRing k) g (rawEncoder k r)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    mapVector k g (rawEncoder k r) =
        mapVector k g (universalVector r 2) -
          mapVector k g (universalVector r 0) := by
      funext c
      simp only [rawEncoder, mapVector, Pi.sub_apply, map_sub]
    _ = linearEquiv (R := CoordinateRing k) g (universalVector r 2) -
        linearEquiv (R := CoordinateRing k) g (universalVector r 0) := by
      rw [rawAction_universalVector, rawAction_universalVector]
      rfl
    _ = linearEquiv (R := CoordinateRing k) g (rawEncoder k r) :=
      (map_sub (linearEquiv (R := CoordinateRing k) g) _ _).symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawInvariantFieldLower.trace_linear
statement:
private theorem trace_linear (g : SourceAut (K := k)) (x : RawF0 k) :
    rawTrace k (linearEquiv (R := CoordinateRing k) g x) = rawTrace k x
proof:
:= by
  exact linearEquiv_trace g x

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawInvariantFieldLower.product_linear
statement:
private theorem product_linear (g : SourceAut (K := k)) (x y : RawF0 k) :
    rawProduct k (linearEquiv (R := CoordinateRing k) g x)
        (linearEquiv (R := CoordinateRing k) g y) =
      linearEquiv (R := CoordinateRing k) g (rawProduct k x y)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = SourceAutExtension.product (k := k)
        (linearEquiv (R := CoordinateRing k) g x)
        (linearEquiv (R := CoordinateRing k) g y) :=
      rawProduct_eq_product k _ _
    _ = linearEquiv (R := CoordinateRing k) g
        (SourceAutExtension.product (k := k) x y) :=
      (linearEquiv_product g x y).symm
    _ = _ := congrArg (linearEquiv (R := CoordinateRing k) g)
      (rawProduct_eq_product k x y).symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawInvariantFieldLower.rawAction_pairP
statement:
theorem rawAction_pairP (g : SourceAut (K := k)) (i j : Fin 3) :
    rawAction k g (pairP k i j) = pairP k i j
proof:
:= by
  rw [pairP, rawAction_rawTrace, mapVector_rawProduct,
    rawAction_universalVector, rawAction_universalVector]
  simp only [transformedUniversalVector, product_linear, trace_linear]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawInvariantFieldLower.rawAction_centeredTriple
statement:
theorem rawAction_centeredTriple (g : SourceAut (K := k)) (i j l : Fin 3) :
    rawAction k g (centeredTriple k i j l) = centeredTriple k i j l
proof:
:= by
  simp only [centeredTriple, map_add, map_sub, map_mul]
  rw [rawAction_rawTrace, mapVector_rawProduct, mapVector_rawProduct,
    rawAction_universalVector, rawAction_universalVector,
    rawAction_universalVector]
  simp only [transformedUniversalVector, product_linear, trace_linear,
    rawAction_pairP, rawAction_pairQ, rawAction_pairR]
  simp [rawAction]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawInvariantFieldLower.mapVector_rawWord
proof:
:= by
  let A := rawProduct k (rawEncoder k 0)
    (rawProduct k (rawEncoder k 1) (rawEncoder k 2))
  let B := rawProduct k (rawEncoder k 1)
    (rawProduct k (rawEncoder k 0) (rawEncoder k 2))
  have hsub : mapVector k g (A - B) = mapVector k g A - mapVector k g B := by
    funext c
    simp [mapVector]
  rw [show rawWord k = A - B by rfl, hsub]
  simp only [A, B, mapVector_rawProduct, mapVector_rawEncoder,
    product_linear]
  exact ((linearEquiv (R := CoordinateRing k) g).map_sub A B).symm

statement:

    rawAction k g (rawDetector k) = rawDetector k
proof:

  rw [rawDetector, rawAction_rawTrace, mapVector_rawProduct,
    mapVector_rawProduct, mapVector_rawWord]
  rw [product_linear, product_linear, trace_linear]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawInvariantFieldLower.fractionAction_rawToFunction
statement:
theorem fractionAction_rawToFunction (g : SourceAut (K := k))
    (x : CoordinateRing k) :
    fractionAction k g (rawToFunction k x) = rawToFunction k (rawAction k g x)
proof:
:= by
  change fractionAction k g
      (algebraMap (ReducedCoordinateRing k) (F k) (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ x)) =
    algebraMap (ReducedCoordinateRing k) (F k)
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (rawAction k g x))
  rw [fractionAction_algebraMap_reduced]
  rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawInvariantFieldLower.ledgerValue_mem_invariantField
statement:
theorem ledgerValue_mem_invariantField
    (q : Fin 4 × Fin 3 × Fin 3 × Fin 3) : ledgerValue k q ∈ invariantField k
proof:
:= by
  rcases q with ⟨t, i, j, l⟩
  intro g
  rw [ledgerValue, fractionAction_algebraMap_reduced]
  apply congrArg (algebraMap (ReducedCoordinateRing k) (F k))
  change reducedActionHom k g (reducedLedgerCell k _ _ _ _) = _
  fin_cases t <;>
    simp only [reducedLedgerCell, toReduced, reducedActionHom_mk,
      rawAction_pairP, rawAction_pairQ, rawAction_pairR, rawAction_centeredTriple]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawInvariantFieldLower.detectorValue_mem_invariantField
statement: theorem detectorValue_mem_invariantField : detectorValue k ∈ invariantField k
proof:
:= by
  intro g

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawInvariantFieldLower.ledgerDetectorField_le_invariantField
statement:
theorem ledgerDetectorField_le_invariantField :
    ledgerDetectorField k ≤ invariantField k
proof:
:= by
  apply Subfield.closure_le.mpr
  intro x hx
  rcases hx with (hs | hl) | hd
  · obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hs
    exact scalar_mem_invariantField k c
  · obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := hl
    exact ledgerValue_mem_invariantField k q
  · simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hd
    rw [hd]
    exact detectorValue_mem_invariantField k

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.exists_detour_orthogonal_one_pair
statement:
theorem exists_detour_orthogonal_one_pair
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V))
    (halt : ∀ x, omega x x = 0)
    (hleft : IsLeftNondegenerate omega) (hright : IsRightNondegenerate omega)
    (e f x y : V) (hef : omega e f = 1)
    (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0)
    (hex : omega e x = 0) (hfx : omega f x = 0)
    (hye : omega y e = 0) (hyf : omega y f = 0) :
    ∃ z, omega z x ≠ 0 ∧ omega y z ≠ 0 ∧
      omega z e = 0 ∧ omega z f = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨zx, hzx⟩ := hleft x hx
  obtain ⟨zy, hzy⟩ := hright y hy
  let px := projectPair omega e f zx
  let py := projectPair omega e f zy
  have hpxx : omega px x ≠ 0 := by
    rw [projectPair_pairing_right omega e f zx x hex hfx]
    exact hzx
  have hypy : omega y py ≠ 0 := by
    rw [projectPair_pairing_left omega e f zy y hye hyf]
    exact hzy
  obtain ⟨z, hzmem, hzx', hyz'⟩ :=
    common_detour_of_two_witnesses omega x y px py hpxx hypy
  refine ⟨z, hzx', hyz', ?_⟩
  have hpx : omega px e = 0 ∧ omega px f = 0 := by
    dsimp [px]
    exact projectPair_orthogonal omega halt e f zx hef
  have hpy : omega py e = 0 ∧ omega py f = 0 := by
    dsimp [py]
    exact projectPair_orthogonal omega halt e f zy hef
  simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hzmem
  rcases hzmem with rfl | rfl | rfl
  · exact hpx
  · exact hpy
  · constructor <;>
      simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hpx.1, hpx.2, hpy.1, hpy.2,
        zero_add]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.exists_detour_orthogonal_two_pairs
statement:
theorem exists_detour_orthogonal_two_pairs
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V))
    (halt : ∀ x, omega x x = 0)
    (hleft : IsLeftNondegenerate omega) (hright : IsRightNondegenerate omega)
    (e0 f0 e1 f1 x y : V) (hef0 : omega e0 f0 = 1)
    (hef1 : omega e1 f1 = 1) (hx : x ≠ 0) (hy : y ≠ 0)
    (h10e : omega e1 e0 = 0) (h10f : omega f1 e0 = 0)
    (h11e : omega e1 f0 = 0) (h11f : omega f1 f0 = 0)
    (he0x : omega e0 x = 0) (hf0x : omega f0 x = 0)
    (he1x : omega e1 x = 0) (hf1x : omega f1 x = 0)
    (hye0 : omega y e0 = 0) (hyf0 : omega y f0 = 0)
    (hye1 : omega y e1 = 0) (hyf1 : omega y f1 = 0) :
    ∃ z, omega z x ≠ 0 ∧ omega y z ≠ 0 ∧
      omega z e0 = 0 ∧ omega z f0 = 0 ∧
      omega z e1 = 0 ∧ omega z f1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨zx, hzx⟩ := hleft x hx
  obtain ⟨zy, hzy⟩ := hright y hy
  let proj : V → V := fun c =>
    projectPair omega e1 f1 (projectPair omega e0 f0 c)
  have proj_pairing_right (c : V) : omega (proj c) x = omega c x := by
    rw [projectPair_pairing_right omega e1 f1 _ x he1x hf1x,
      projectPair_pairing_right omega e0 f0 c x he0x hf0x]
  have proj_pairing_left (c : V) : omega y (proj c) = omega y c := by
    rw [projectPair_pairing_left omega e1 f1 _ y hye1 hyf1,
      projectPair_pairing_left omega e0 f0 c y hye0 hyf0]
  have proj_orthogonal (c : V) :
      omega (proj c) e0 = 0 ∧ omega (proj c) f0 = 0 ∧
        omega (proj c) e1 = 0 ∧ omega (proj c) f1 = 0 := by
    have hfirst := projectPair_orthogonal omega halt e0 f0 c hef0
    have hsecond := projectPair_orthogonal omega halt e1 f1
      (projectPair omega e0 f0 c) hef1
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, hsecond.1, hsecond.2⟩
    · rw [projectPair_pairing_right omega e1 f1 _ e0 h10e h10f]
      exact hfirst.1
    · rw [projectPair_pairing_right omega e1 f1 _ f0 h11e h11f]
      exact hfirst.2
  have hpxx : omega (proj zx) x ≠ 0 := by rw [proj_pairing_right]; exact hzx
  have hypy : omega y (proj zy) ≠ 0 := by rw [proj_pairing_left]; exact hzy
  obtain ⟨z, hzmem, hzx', hyz'⟩ := common_detour_of_two_witnesses omega x y
    (proj zx) (proj zy) hpxx hypy
  refine ⟨z, hzx', hyz', ?_⟩
  have hpx := proj_orthogonal zx
  have hpy := proj_orthogonal zy
  simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hzmem
  rcases hzmem with rfl | rfl | rfl
  · exact hpx
  · exact hpy
  · constructor
    · simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hpx.1, hpy.1, zero_add]
    constructor
    · simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hpx.2.1, hpy.2.1, zero_add]
    constructor
    · simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hpx.2.2.1, hpy.2.2.1, zero_add]
    · simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hpx.2.2.2, hpy.2.2.2, zero_add]

name: AlbertLean.Triality.ParityEvenMiddleFactor.evenS_middle
statement:
theorem evenS_middle (e A B : VCoord K) (alpha beta rho : K)
    (he : nV e = 1) (hab : alpha * beta = rho)
    (ha0 : alpha ≠ 0) (hb0 : beta ≠ 0) (s : SCoord K) :
    evenS e (reflectV e A) (-alpha)
      (evenS e B beta s) = evenS A B rho s
proof:
:= by
  rw [evenS_reflected_neg_reverse e A alpha (by simpa [he]) ha0]
  simp only [evenS]
  change alpha⁻¹ • muSLinear A
      (muCLinear e (beta⁻¹ • muSLinear e (muCLinear B s))) = _
  rw [(muCLinear e).map_smul]
  simp only [muSLinear_apply, muCLinear_apply]
  rw [sourceMuC_sourceMuS e]
  simp only [he, one_smul]
  change alpha⁻¹ • muSLinear A (beta⁻¹ • muCLinear B s) = _
  rw [(muSLinear A).map_smul]
  simp only [muSLinear_apply]
  simp only [smul_smul]
  have hi : alpha⁻¹ * beta⁻¹ = rho⁻¹ := by
    rw [← mul_inv, hab]
  rw [hi]
  rfl

name: AlbertLean.Triality.ParityEvenMiddleFactor.evenC_middle
statement:
theorem evenC_middle (e A B : VCoord K) (alpha beta rho : K)
    (he : nV e = 1) (hab : alpha * beta = rho)
    (ha0 : alpha ≠ 0) (hb0 : beta ≠ 0) (c : CCoord K) :
    evenC e (reflectV e A) (-alpha)
      (evenC e B beta c) = evenC A B rho c
proof:
:= by
  rw [evenC_reflected_neg_reverse e A alpha (by simpa [he]) ha0]
  simp only [evenC]
  change alpha⁻¹ • muCLinear A
      (muSLinear e (beta⁻¹ • muCLinear e (muSLinear B c))) = _
  rw [(muSLinear e).map_smul]
  simp only [muSLinear_apply, muCLinear_apply]
  rw [sourceMuS_sourceMuC e]
  simp only [he, one_smul]
  change alpha⁻¹ • muCLinear A (beta⁻¹ • muSLinear B c) = _
  rw [(muCLinear A).map_smul]
  simp only [muCLinear_apply]
  simp only [smul_smul]
  have hi : alpha⁻¹ * beta⁻¹ = rho⁻¹ := by
    rw [← mul_inv, hab]
  rw [hi]
  rfl

name: AlbertLean.Triality.ParityEvenMiddleFactor.evenV_middle
statement:
theorem evenV_middle (e A B v : VCoord K) (he0 : nV e ≠ 0) :
    evenV e (reflectV e A) (evenV e B v) = evenV A B v
proof:

  simp only [evenV]

name: AlbertLean.Triality.ParityEvenMiddleFactor.sourceEvenAut_middle_apply
statement:
theorem sourceEvenAut_middle_apply
    (e A B : VCoord K) (alpha beta rho : K)
    (he : nV e = 1)
    (hA : nV A ≠ 0) (hB : nV B ≠ 0)
    (ha : alpha ^ 2 = nV A) (hb : beta ^ 2 = nV B)
    (hab : alpha * beta = rho)
    (ha0 : alpha ≠ 0) (hb0 : beta ≠ 0) (hr0 : rho ≠ 0)
    (x : JCoord K) :
    let he0 : nV e ≠ 0
proof:
:= by simpa [he]
    let hRA : nV (reflectV e A) ≠ 0 := by
      simpa [nV_reflectV e A he0] using hA
    let hneg : (-alpha) ^ 2 = nV e * nV (reflectV e A) := by
      rw [he, one_mul, nV_reflectV e A he0]
      simpa using ha
    let heB : beta ^ 2 = nV e * nV B := by simpa [he] using hb
    let hr : rho ^ 2 = nV A * nV B := by rw [← hab, mul_pow, ha, hb]
    (sourceEvenAut e (reflectV e A) (-alpha) he0 hRA hneg
      (neg_ne_zero.mpr ha0)).linear
        ((sourceEvenAut e B beta he0 hB heB hb0).linear x) =
      (sourceEvenAut A B rho hA hB hr hr0).linear x := by
  intro he0 hRA hneg heB hr
  apply JCoord.ext
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · exact evenV_middle e A B x.v he0
  · exact evenS_middle e A B alpha beta rho he hab ha0 hb0 x.s
  · exact evenC_middle e A B alpha beta rho he hab ha0 hb0 x.c

name: AlbertLean.Generic.BlockTrace.trace_prod_blocks
statement:
theorem trace_prod_blocks (L : M × N →ₗ[K] M × N) :
    LinearMap.trace K (M × N) L =
      LinearMap.trace K M
          ((LinearMap.fst K M N).comp (L.comp (LinearMap.inl K M N))) +
        LinearMap.trace K N
          ((LinearMap.snd K M N).comp (L.comp (LinearMap.inr K M N)))
proof:
:= by
  have hid :
      (LinearMap.inl K M N).comp (LinearMap.fst K M N) +
          (LinearMap.inr K M N).comp (LinearMap.snd K M N) =
        LinearMap.id := by
    ext x <;> simp [LinearMap.inl_apply, LinearMap.inr_apply]
  calc
    LinearMap.trace K (M × N) L =
        LinearMap.trace K (M × N) (LinearMap.id.comp L) := by rfl
    _ = LinearMap.trace K (M × N)
          (((LinearMap.inl K M N).comp (LinearMap.fst K M N) +
            (LinearMap.inr K M N).comp (LinearMap.snd K M N)).comp L) := by
          rw [hid]
    _ = LinearMap.trace K (M × N)
          ((LinearMap.inl K M N).comp
            ((LinearMap.fst K M N).comp L)) +
        LinearMap.trace K (M × N)
          ((LinearMap.inr K M N).comp
            ((LinearMap.snd K M N).comp L)) := by
          rw [LinearMap.add_comp, map_add]
          simp only [LinearMap.comp_assoc]
    _ = _ := by
      rw [LinearMap.trace_comp_comm'
            ((LinearMap.fst K M N).comp L) (LinearMap.inl K M N),
          LinearMap.trace_comp_comm'
            ((LinearMap.snd K M N).comp L) (LinearMap.inr K M N)]
      simp only [LinearMap.comp_assoc]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.BlockTrace.trace_prod_three_blocks
statement:
theorem trace_prod_three_blocks
    {P : Type*} [AddCommGroup P] [Module K P] [FiniteDimensional K P]
    (L : M × (N × P) →ₗ[K] M × (N × P)) :
    LinearMap.trace K (M × (N × P)) L =
      LinearMap.trace K M
          ((LinearMap.fst K M (N × P)).comp
            (L.comp (LinearMap.inl K M (N × P)))) +
        LinearMap.trace K N
          ((LinearMap.fst K N P).comp
            ((LinearMap.snd K M (N × P)).comp
              (L.comp ((LinearMap.inr K M (N × P)).comp
                (LinearMap.inl K N P))))) +
        LinearMap.trace K P
          ((LinearMap.snd K N P).comp
            ((LinearMap.snd K M (N × P)).comp
              (L.comp ((LinearMap.inr K M (N × P)).comp
                (LinearMap.inr K N P)))))
proof:
:= by
  rw [trace_prod_blocks L]
  let L₂ : N × P →ₗ[K] N × P :=
    (LinearMap.snd K M (N × P)).comp
      (L.comp (LinearMap.inr K M (N × P)))
  rw [trace_prod_blocks L₂]
  simp only [L₂, LinearMap.comp_assoc, add_assoc]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TitsFrameEquivalence.firstTitsSharp_eq_square_sub_trace_add
statement:
theorem firstTitsSharp_eq_square_sub_trace_add
    (z : FirstTits K) :
    firstTitsSharp z = firstTitsSquare z - trace3 z.1 • z +
      sourceS z • firstTitsOne
proof:
:= by
  rcases z with ⟨A, B, C⟩
  have hadj3 : adjugate3 A =
      A * A - trace3 A • A + trace3 (adjugate3 A) • 1 := by
    simpa only [trace3_eq_matrixTrace, adjugate3_eq_matrixAdjugate] using
      matrix_adjugate_identity A
  have hS : sourceS (A, B, C) =
      trace3 (adjugate3 A) - trace3 (B * C) := by
    simp [sourceS, firstTitsSharp, trace3]
    ring
  apply Prod.ext
  · change adjugate3 A - B * C =
      (A * A - B * C + trace3 (B * C) • 1) - trace3 A • A +
        sourceS (A, B, C) • 1
    calc
      adjugate3 A - B * C =
          (A * A - trace3 A • A + trace3 (adjugate3 A) • 1) - B * C :=
        congrArg (fun M : Mat3 K => M - B * C) hadj3
      _ = (A * A - B * C + trace3 (B * C) • 1) - trace3 A • A +
          sourceS (A, B, C) • 1 := by rw [hS]; module
  · apply Prod.ext
    · change adjugate3 C - A * B =
        (adjugate3 C - A * B + trace3 A • B) - trace3 A • B +
          sourceS (A, B, C) • (0 : Mat3 K)
      simp only [smul_zero, add_zero]
      module
    · change adjugate3 B - C * A =
        (adjugate3 B - C * A + trace3 A • C) - trace3 A • C +
          sourceS (A, B, C) • (0 : Mat3 K)
      simp only [smul_zero, add_zero]
      module

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TitsFrameEquivalence.firstTitsSharp_eq_zero_of_toTau_idempotent
statement:
theorem firstTitsSharp_eq_zero_of_toTau_idempotent
    (z : FirstTits K) (htrace : trace3 z.1 = 1)
    (hid : toTau z * toTau z = toTau z) : firstTitsSharp z = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hsquare : firstTitsSquare z = z := by
    apply toTau.injective
    rw [toTau_firstTitsSquare, hid]
  have hsharp : firstTitsSharp z = sourceS z • firstTitsOne := by
    rw [firstTitsSharp_eq_square_sub_trace_add, hsquare, htrace]
    simp
  have hSthree : sourceS z = sourceS z + sourceS z + sourceS z := by
    calc
      sourceS z = trace3 (firstTitsSharp z).1 := rfl
      _ = trace3 (sourceS z • (firstTitsOne : FirstTits K)).1 := by rw [hsharp]
      _ = sourceS z + sourceS z + sourceS z := by
        simp [firstTitsOne, trace3]
  have hdouble : sourceS z + sourceS z = 0 := by
    apply add_left_cancel (a := sourceS z)
    simpa only [add_assoc, add_zero] using hSthree.symm
  have hS : sourceS z = 0 := by
    have hm := congrArg (fun q : K => ⅟(2 : K) * q) hdouble
    simpa only [mul_zero, ← two_mul, ← mul_assoc, invOf_mul_self, one_mul] using hm
  rw [hsharp, hS, zero_smul]

theorem sharp_zero_iff_toTau_idempotent

proof:
:=
  ⟨toTau_mul_self_eq_self_of_trace_one_of_sharp_eq_zero z htrace,

statement:
theorem firstTitsSharp_eq_zero_iff_cyclic_adjugates
    (A B C : Mat3 K) :
    firstTitsSharp (A, B, C) = 0 ↔
      adjugate3 A = B * C ∧ adjugate3 C = A * B ∧ adjugate3 B = C * A
proof:
:= by
  simp [firstTitsSharp, sub_eq_zero]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TitsFrameEquivalence.sourceFrame_iff_tauFrame
statement:
theorem sourceFrame_iff_tauFrame (f : Fin 3 → FirstTits K) :
    SourceFrame f ↔ TauFrame (fun i => toTau (f i))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact toTau_sourceFrame f
  · rintro ⟨htrace, hid, hsum, _, _, _⟩
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro i
      rw [trace3_eq_matrixTrace, ← tauTrace_toTau]
      exact htrace i
    · intro i
      exact firstTitsSharp_eq_zero_of_toTau_idempotent
        (f i) (by rw [trace3_eq_matrixTrace, ← tauTrace_toTau]; exact htrace i)
        (hid i)
    · apply toTau.injective
      rw [map_add, map_add, hsum, toTau_firstTitsOne]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TitsFrameEquivalence.sourceFrame_iff_literal_matrix_components
statement:
theorem sourceFrame_iff_literal_matrix_components
    (f : Fin 3 → FirstTits K) :
    SourceFrame f ↔
      (∀ i, Matrix.trace (f i).1 = 1) ∧
      (∀ i,
        (f i).1.adjugate = (f i).2.1 * (f i).2.2 ∧
        (f i).2.2.adjugate = (f i).1 * (f i).2.1 ∧
        (f i).2.1.adjugate = (f i).2.2 * (f i).1) ∧
      ((f 0).1 + (f 1).1 + (f 2).1 = 1) ∧
      ((f 0).2.1 + (f 1).2.1 + (f 2).2.1 = 0) ∧
      ((f 0).2.2 + (f 1).2.2 + (f 2).2.2 = 0)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hf
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro i
      rw [← trace3_eq_matrixTrace]
      exact hf.trace_one i
    · intro i
      rcases (firstTitsSharp_eq_zero_iff_cyclic_adjugates
          (f i).1 (f i).2.1 (f i).2.2).mp (hf.sharp_zero i) with
        ⟨hA, hC, hB⟩
      simpa only [adjugate3_eq_matrixAdjugate] using And.intro hA (And.intro hC hB)
    · exact congrArg Prod.fst hf.sum_one
    · exact congrArg (fun q => q.2.1) hf.sum_one
    · exact congrArg (fun q => q.2.2) hf.sum_one
  · rintro ⟨htrace, hsharp, hA, hB, hC⟩
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro i
      rw [trace3_eq_matrixTrace]
      exact htrace i
    · intro i
      apply (firstTitsSharp_eq_zero_iff_cyclic_adjugates
        (f i).1 (f i).2.1 (f i).2.2).mpr
      simpa only [adjugate3_eq_matrixAdjugate] using hsharp i
    · apply Prod.ext
      · exact hA
      · apply Prod.ext
        · exact hB
        · exact hC
