name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SelfAdjointCarrier.topRight_skew
statement:
theorem topRight_skew {P : Mat6 K} (hP : IsSelfAdjoint P) :
    (topRight P).transpose = -topRight P
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  have h := congrFun (congrFun hP (Sum.inr i)) (Sum.inr j)
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [topRight, symplecticJ, Matrix.mul_apply, Fintype.sum_sum_type,
      Matrix.one_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ, Matrix.transpose_apply] at h ⊢ <;>
    linear_combination h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SelfAdjointCarrier.bottomLeft_skew
statement:
theorem bottomLeft_skew {P : Mat6 K} (hP : IsSelfAdjoint P) :
    (bottomLeft P).transpose = -bottomLeft P
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  have h := congrFun (congrFun hP (Sum.inl i)) (Sum.inl j)
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [bottomLeft, symplecticJ, Matrix.mul_apply, Fintype.sum_sum_type,
      Matrix.one_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ, Matrix.transpose_apply] at h ⊢ <;>
    linear_combination -h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SelfAdjointCarrier.bottomRight_eq_transpose_topLeft
statement:
theorem bottomRight_eq_transpose_topLeft {P : Mat6 K}
    (hP : IsSelfAdjoint P) : bottomRight P = (topLeft P).transpose
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  have h := congrFun (congrFun hP (Sum.inl i)) (Sum.inr j)
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [bottomRight, topLeft, symplecticJ, Matrix.mul_apply,
      Fintype.sum_sum_type, Matrix.one_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ,
      Matrix.transpose_apply] at h ⊢ <;> exact h.symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SelfAdjointCarrier.hat_unhat_of_skew
statement:
theorem hat_unhat_of_skew (B : Mat3 K) (hB : B.transpose = -B) :
    hat (unhat B) = B
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  have hij := congrFun (congrFun hB i) j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
  · simp [unhat, hat, Matrix.transpose_apply] at hij ⊢
    linear_combination (-1 / 2 : K) * hij
  · simp [unhat, hat]
  · simp [unhat, hat]
  · simp [unhat, hat, Matrix.transpose_apply] at hij ⊢
    linear_combination (norm := module) -hij
  · simp [unhat, hat, Matrix.transpose_apply] at hij ⊢
    linear_combination (-1 / 2 : K) * hij
  · simp [unhat, hat]
  · simp [unhat, hat, Matrix.transpose_apply] at hij ⊢
    linear_combination (norm := module) -hij
  · simp [unhat, hat, Matrix.transpose_apply] at hij ⊢
    linear_combination (norm := module) -hij
  · simp [unhat, hat, Matrix.transpose_apply] at hij ⊢
    linear_combination (-1 / 2 : K) * hij

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SelfAdjointCarrier.grouped_extract
statement:
theorem grouped_extract (P : Mat6 K) (hP : IsSelfAdjoint P) :
    grouped (topLeft P) (unhat (topRight P)) (unhat (bottomLeft P)) = P
proof:
:= by
  have hB := hat_unhat_of_skew (topRight P) (topRight_skew hP)
  have hC := hat_unhat_of_skew (bottomLeft P) (bottomLeft_skew hP)
  have hD := bottomRight_eq_transpose_topLeft hP
  ext i j
  rcases i with i | i <;> rcases j with j | j
  · rfl
  · exact congrFun (congrFun hB i) j
  · exact congrFun (congrFun hC i) j
  · exact (congrFun (congrFun hD i) j).symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SelfAdjointCarrier.exists_grouped
statement:
theorem exists_grouped (P : Carrier K) :
    ∃ a u v, (P : Mat6 K) = grouped a u v
proof:
:= by
  have hP : IsSelfAdjoint (P : Mat6 K) := carrier_property P
  exact ⟨topLeft P, unhat (topRight P), unhat (bottomLeft P),
    (grouped_extract (K := K) (P : Mat6 K) hP).symm⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SelfAdjointCarrier.grouped_injective
statement:
theorem grouped_injective
    {a a' : Mat3 K} {u v u' v' : Vec3 K}
    (h : grouped a u v = grouped a' u' v') :
    a = a' ∧ u = u' ∧ v = v'
proof:
:= by
  have ha : a = a' := by
    ext i j
    exact congrFun (congrFun h (Sum.inl i)) (Sum.inl j)
  have huHat : hat u = hat u' := by
    ext i j
    exact congrFun (congrFun h (Sum.inl i)) (Sum.inr j)
  have hvHat : hat v = hat v' := by
    ext i j
    exact congrFun (congrFun h (Sum.inr i)) (Sum.inl j)
  exact ⟨ha, by simpa using congrArg unhat huHat,
    by simpa using congrArg unhat hvHat⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SelfAdjointCarrier.matrixJordan_mem
proof:
:= by
  simp only [IsSelfAdjoint, matrixJordan, Matrix.transpose_smul,
    Matrix.transpose_add, Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.smul_mul,
    Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.mul_add] at hA hB ⊢
  rw [Matrix.mul_assoc B.transpose A.transpose symplecticJ,
    Matrix.mul_assoc A.transpose B.transpose symplecticJ, hA, hB]
  rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc B.transpose symplecticJ A,
    ← Matrix.mul_assoc A.transpose symplecticJ B, hB, hA]
  simp [Matrix.mul_assoc, add_comm]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.exists_four_step_pair
statement:
theorem exists_four_step_pair
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V)) (halt : ∀ x, omega x x = 0)
    (hleft : IsLeftNondegenerate omega) (hright : IsRightNondegenerate omega)
    (x v y f : V) (hxv : omega x v = 1) (hyf : omega y f = 1) :
    ∃ word : List (Step (K := K) (V := V)), word.length = 4 ∧
      wordMap omega word x = y ∧ wordMap omega word v = f
proof:
:= by
  have hx : x ≠ 0 := by intro h; subst x; simpa using hxv
  have hy : y ≠ 0 := by intro h; subst y; simpa using hyf
  obtain ⟨z, hzx, hyz⟩ := exists_common_detour omega hleft hright x y hx hy
  let word := fourStepPairWord omega halt x z y v f hzx hyz
  exact ⟨word, by simp [word, fourStepPairWord],
    fourStepPairWord_source omega halt x z y v f hzx hyz hxv hyf,
    fourStepPairWord_partner omega halt x z y v f hzx hyz hxv hyf⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.exists_fixed_twelve_triple_alignment
statement:
theorem exists_fixed_twelve_triple_alignment
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V)) (halt : ∀ x, omega x x = 0)
    (hleft : IsLeftNondegenerate omega) (hright : IsRightNondegenerate omega)
    (u v e f : Fin 3 → V) (hsrc : HyperbolicTriple omega u v)
    (htgt : HyperbolicTriple omega e f) :
    ∃ word : List (Step (K := K) (V := V)), word.length = 12 ∧
      (∀ i, wordMap omega word (u i) = e i) ∧
      (∀ i, wordMap omega word (v i) = f i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w0, hw0len, hw0u, hw0v⟩ := exists_four_step_pair omega halt hleft hright
    (u 0) (v 0) (e 0) (f 0) (hsrc.pair 0) (htgt.pair 0)
  let u1 := wordMap omega w0 (u 1)
  let v1 := wordMap omega w0 (v 1)
  have hu1v1 : omega u1 v1 = 1 := by
    rw [wordMap_preserves omega halt w0, hsrc.pair]
  have he0u1 : omega (e 0) u1 = 0 := by
    rw [← hw0u, wordMap_preserves omega halt w0]
    exact hsrc.uu 0 1 (by decide)
  have hf0u1 : omega (f 0) u1 = 0 := by
    rw [← hw0v, wordMap_preserves omega halt w0]
    exact hsrc.vu 0 1 (by decide)
  have he0v1 : omega (e 0) v1 = 0 := by
    rw [← hw0u, wordMap_preserves omega halt w0]
    exact hsrc.uv 0 1 (by decide)
  have hf0v1 : omega (f 0) v1 = 0 := by
    rw [← hw0v, wordMap_preserves omega halt w0]
    exact hsrc.vv 0 1 (by decide)
  obtain ⟨w1, hw1len, hw1u, hw1v, hw1e0, hw1f0⟩ :=
    exists_four_step_fixing_one_pair omega halt hleft hright
      (e 0) (f 0) u1 v1 (e 1) (f 1) (htgt.pair 0) hu1v1 (htgt.pair 1)
      he0u1 hf0u1 he0v1 hf0v1
      (htgt.uu 1 0 (by decide)) (htgt.uv 1 0 (by decide))
      (htgt.vu 1 0 (by decide)) (htgt.vv 1 0 (by decide))
  let w10 := w1 ++ w0
  let u2 := wordMap omega w10 (u 2)
  let v2 := wordMap omega w10 (v 2)
  have hw10u0 : wordMap omega w10 (u 0) = e 0 := by
    dsimp only [w10]
    rw [wordMap_append, LinearMap.comp_apply, hw0u, hw1e0]
  have hw10v0 : wordMap omega w10 (v 0) = f 0 := by
    dsimp only [w10]
    rw [wordMap_append, LinearMap.comp_apply, hw0v, hw1f0]
  have hw10u1 : wordMap omega w10 (u 1) = e 1 := by
    dsimp only [w10]
    rw [wordMap_append, LinearMap.comp_apply]
    exact hw1u
  have hw10v1 : wordMap omega w10 (v 1) = f 1 := by
    dsimp only [w10]
    rw [wordMap_append, LinearMap.comp_apply]
    exact hw1v
  have hu2v2 : omega u2 v2 = 1 := by
    rw [wordMap_preserves omega halt w10, hsrc.pair]
  have mapped_u (i : Fin 3) (hi : i ≠ 2) :
      wordMap omega w10 (u i) = e i := by
    fin_cases i
    · exact hw10u0
    · exact hw10u1
    · exact False.elim (hi rfl)
  have mapped_v (i : Fin 3) (hi : i ≠ 2) :
      wordMap omega w10 (v i) = f i := by
    fin_cases i
    · exact hw10v0
    · exact hw10v1
    · exact False.elim (hi rfl)
  have prev_u (i : Fin 3) (hi : i ≠ 2) :
      omega (e i) u2 = 0 ∧ omega (f i) u2 = 0 ∧
      omega (e i) v2 = 0 ∧ omega (f i) v2 = 0 := by
    rw [← mapped_u i hi, ← mapped_v i hi]
    exact ⟨(wordMap_preserves omega halt w10 (u i) (u 2)).trans
        (hsrc.uu i 2 hi),
      (wordMap_preserves omega halt w10 (v i) (u 2)).trans
        (hsrc.vu i 2 hi),
      (wordMap_preserves omega halt w10 (u i) (v 2)).trans
        (hsrc.uv i 2 hi),
      (wordMap_preserves omega halt w10 (v i) (v 2)).trans
        (hsrc.vv i 2 hi)⟩
  obtain ⟨w2, hw2len, hw2u, hw2v, hw2e0, hw2f0, hw2e1, hw2f1⟩ :=
    exists_four_step_fixing_two_pairs omega halt hleft hright
      (e 0) (f 0) (e 1) (f 1) u2 v2 (e 2) (f 2)
      (htgt.pair 0) (htgt.pair 1) hu2v2 (htgt.pair 2)
      (htgt.uu 1 0 (by decide)) (htgt.vu 1 0 (by decide))
      (htgt.uv 1 0 (by decide)) (htgt.vv 1 0 (by decide))
      (prev_u 0 (by decide)).1 (prev_u 0 (by decide)).2.1
      (prev_u 1 (by decide)).1 (prev_u 1 (by decide)).2.1
      (prev_u 0 (by decide)).2.2.1 (prev_u 0 (by decide)).2.2.2
      (prev_u 1 (by decide)).2.2.1 (prev_u 1 (by decide)).2.2.2
      (htgt.uu 2 0 (by decide)) (htgt.uv 2 0 (by decide))
      (htgt.uu 2 1 (by decide)) (htgt.uv 2 1 (by decide))
      (htgt.vu 2 0 (by decide)) (htgt.vv 2 0 (by decide))
      (htgt.vu 2 1 (by decide)) (htgt.vv 2 1 (by decide))
  refine ⟨w2 ++ w10, by simp [w10, hw0len, hw1len, hw2len], ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    fin_cases i
    · change wordMap omega (w2 ++ w10) (u (0 : Fin 3)) = e 0
      rw [wordMap_append, LinearMap.comp_apply, hw10u0, hw2e0]
    · change wordMap omega (w2 ++ w10) (u (1 : Fin 3)) = e 1
      rw [wordMap_append, LinearMap.comp_apply, hw10u1, hw2e1]
    · change wordMap omega (w2 ++ w10) (u (2 : Fin 3)) = e 2
      rw [wordMap_append, LinearMap.comp_apply]
      exact hw2u
  · intro i
    fin_cases i
    · change wordMap omega (w2 ++ w10) (v (0 : Fin 3)) = f 0
      rw [wordMap_append, LinearMap.comp_apply, hw10v0, hw2f0]
    · change wordMap omega (w2 ++ w10) (v (1 : Fin 3)) = f 1
      rw [wordMap_append, LinearMap.comp_apply, hw10v1, hw2f1]
    · change wordMap omega (w2 ++ w10) (v (2 : Fin 3)) = f 2
      rw [wordMap_append, LinearMap.comp_apply]
      exact hw2v

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.UniversalOpen.map_trace3

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.UniversalOpen.rawToField_ne_zero_of_seedEval_ne_zero
statement:
theorem rawToField_ne_zero_of_seedEval_ne_zero
    (p : CoordinateRing k) (hp : seedEval k p ≠ 0) :
    rawToField k p ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hz
  have hq : Ideal.Quotient.mk (rawFrameIdeal (R := k)).radical p = 0 := by
    apply IsFractionRing.injective (ReducedCoordinateRing k) (FunctionField k)
    simpa [rawToField] using hz
  have hrad : p ∈ (rawFrameIdeal (R := k)).radical :=
    Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp hq
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Ideal.mem_radical_iff.mp hrad
  have hzero : seedEval k (p ^ n) = 0 :=
    RingHom.mem_ker.mp (rawFrameIdeal_le_ker_seedEval k hn)
  rw [map_pow] at hzero
  exact (pow_ne_zero n hp) hzero

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.UniversalOpen.universalFamily_isRaw

proof:
:= by

  intro e
  rw [evaluationAlong_universalFamily]
  have hq : Ideal.Quotient.mk (rawFrameIdeal (R := k)).radical
      (equation e) = 0 :=
    Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr
      (Ideal.le_radical (Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self e)))
  change algebraMap (ReducedCoordinateRing k) (FunctionField k)
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk (rawFrameIdeal (R := k)).radical (equation e)) = 0
  rw [hq, map_zero]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.UniversalOpen.map_encoderCommutatorPolynomial
statement:
theorem map_encoderCommutatorPolynomial {S : Type*} [CommRing S]
    (f : CoordinateRing k →+* S) :

      let A
proof:
:= f.mapMatrix (universalMatrix (R := k) 0 2) -

      let B := f.mapMatrix (universalMatrix (R := k) 1 2) -
        f.mapMatrix (universalMatrix (R := k) 1 0)

    let A

name: AlbertLean.Generic.JordanPolarization.polarization_eq_alternating

theorem polarization_eq_alternating
    (μ : V →ₗ[K] V →ₗ[K] V) (a b c y : V) :
    polarization μ a b c y =
      residual μ (a + b + c) y - residual μ (a + b) y -
      residual μ (a + c) y - residual μ (b + c) y +
      residual μ a y + residual μ b y + residual μ c y - residual μ 0 y

statement:
theorem map_normalizedG (f : R →+* S) (Z : Mat4 R) (dInv : R) :
    (normalizedG Z dInv).map f = normalizedG (Z.map f) (f dInv)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [normalizedG, Matrix.map_mul, map_ringX0]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RationalResidualSourceFamily.map_adjugate_apply
proof:
:= by
  exact congrFun (congrFun (f.map_adjugate Z) i) j

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RationalResidualSourceFamily.map_normalizedH
statement:
theorem map_normalizedH (f : R →+* S) (Z : Mat4 R) (d dInv : R) :
    (normalizedH Z d dInv).map f =
      normalizedH (Z.map f) (f d) (f dInv)
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp [normalizedH, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.map_apply,
    map_adjugate_apply, map_ringX0_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    Finset.mul_sum, mul_assoc]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RationalResidualSourceFamily.map_vecAct
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  simp [vecAct, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.map_apply]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RationalResidualSourceFamily.map_covAct
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  simp [covAct, Matrix.vecMul, dotProduct, Matrix.map_apply]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RationalResidualSourceFamily.map_wedge2
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;> simp [wedge2]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RationalResidualSourceFamily.map_vecAct_uBasis
statement:
private theorem map_vecAct_uBasis (f : R →+* S) (G : Mat4 R)
    (j : Fin 4) :
    (fun i => f (vecAct G (uBasis j) i)) =
      vecAct (G.map f) (uBasis j)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = vecAct (G.map f) (fun i => f (uBasis j i)) :=
      map_vecAct f G (uBasis j)
    _ = vecAct (G.map f) (uBasis j) := by
      congr 1
      funext i
      simp [uBasis]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RationalResidualSourceFamily.map_wedge2_vecAct_apply
statement:
private theorem map_wedge2_vecAct_apply (f : R →+* S) (G : Mat4 R)
    (a b : Fin 4) (i : WIdx) :
    f (wedge2 (vecAct G (uBasis a)) (vecAct G (uBasis b)) i) =
      wedge2 (vecAct (G.map f) (uBasis a))
        (vecAct (G.map f) (uBasis b)) i
proof:
:= by
  have h := map_wedge2 f (vecAct G (uBasis a)) (vecAct G (uBasis b))
  rw [map_vecAct_uBasis f G a, map_vecAct_uBasis f G b] at h
  exact congrFun h i

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RationalResidualSourceFamily.map_wedgeAct
statement:
private theorem map_wedgeAct (f : R →+* S) (G : Mat4 R)
    (w : W R) :
    (fun i => f (wedgeAct G w i)) =
      wedgeAct (G.map f) (fun i => f (w i))
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;>
    simp [wedgeAct, map_wedge2_vecAct_apply, smul_eq_mul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RationalResidualSourceFamily.map_ringActStructured
statement:
private theorem map_ringActStructured (f : R →+* S) (G H : Mat4 R)
    (x : JCoord R) :
    mapJ f (ringActStructured G H x) =
      ringActStructured (G.map f) (H.map f) (mapJ f x)
proof:
:= by
  apply JCoord.ext
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · apply VCoord.ext
    · rfl
    · rfl
    · exact map_wedgeAct f G x.v.omega
  · apply SCoord.ext
    · exact map_vecAct f G x.s.p
    · exact map_covAct f H x.s.phi
  · apply CCoord.ext
    · exact map_vecAct f G x.c.q
    · exact map_covAct f H x.c.psi

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RationalResidualSourceFamily.map_unflatten
statement:
private theorem map_unflatten (f : R →+* S) (x : Fin 27 → R) :
    mapJ f (unflatten x) = unflatten (fun c => f (x c))
proof:
:= by
  apply JCoord.ext
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · apply VCoord.ext
    · rfl
    · rfl
    · funext i
      fin_cases i <;> rfl
  · apply SCoord.ext <;> funext i <;> fin_cases i <;> rfl
  · apply CCoord.ext <;> funext i <;> fin_cases i <;> rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RationalResidualSourceFamily.map_flatten
statement:
private theorem map_flatten (f : R →+* S) (x : JCoord R) :
    (fun c => f (flatten x c)) = flatten (mapJ f x)
proof:
:= by
  funext c
  fin_cases c <;> rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RationalResidualSourceFamily.map_circuit
statement:
theorem map_circuit (f : R →+* S) (Z : Mat4 R) (d dInv : R)
    (x : Fin 27 → R) :
    (fun c => f (circuit Z d dInv x c)) =
      circuit (Z.map f) (f d) (f dInv) (fun c => f (x c))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [circuit, map_flatten, map_ringActStructured,
    map_normalizedG, map_normalizedH, map_unflatten]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RationalResidualSourceFamily.ringX0_eq_X0
statement: theorem ringX0_eq_X0 (d : K) : ringX0 d = X0 d
proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RationalResidualSourceFamily.normalizedG_eq_scaledMatrix
statement:
theorem normalizedG_eq_scaledMatrix (Z : Mat4 K) :
    normalizedG Z (Matrix.det Z)⁻¹ =
      SourceRationalDetOneFamily.scaledMatrix Z
proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RationalResidualSourceFamily.normalizedH_eq_scaledMatrixInv
statement:
theorem normalizedH_eq_scaledMatrixInv (Z : Mat4 K)
    (hZ : Matrix.det Z ≠ 0) :
    normalizedH Z (Matrix.det Z) (Matrix.det Z)⁻¹ =
      SourceRationalDetOneFamily.scaledMatrixInv Z
proof:
:= by
  rw [normalizedH, SourceRationalDetOneFamily.scaledMatrixInv,
    ringX0_eq_X0]
  congr 1
  rw [Matrix.inv_def, Ring.inverse_eq_inv]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RationalResidualSourceFamily.circuit_eq_familySourceAut
statement:
theorem circuit_eq_familySourceAut (Z : Mat4 K) (hZ : Matrix.det Z ≠ 0)
    (x : Fin 27 → K) :
    circuit Z (Matrix.det Z) (Matrix.det Z)⁻¹ x =
      structuredEquivK K
        ((SourceRationalDetOneFamily.familySourceAut Z hZ).linear
          ((structuredEquivK K).symm x))
proof:
:= by
  funext c
  change flatten
      (ringActStructured (normalizedG Z (Matrix.det Z)⁻¹)
        (normalizedH Z (Matrix.det Z) (Matrix.det Z)⁻¹) (unflatten x)) c =
    flatten
      (ringActStructured (SourceRationalDetOneFamily.detOneFamily Z hZ).g
        (SourceRationalDetOneFamily.detOneFamily Z hZ).gInv (unflatten x)) c
  rw [show (SourceRationalDetOneFamily.detOneFamily Z hZ).g =
      normalizedG Z (Matrix.det Z)⁻¹ from rfl]
  rw [show (SourceRationalDetOneFamily.detOneFamily Z hZ).gInv =
      normalizedH Z (Matrix.det Z) (Matrix.det Z)⁻¹ by
        exact (normalizedH_eq_scaledMatrixInv Z hZ).symm]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RationalResidualSourceFamily.eval_universalZ_identity
statement:
theorem eval_universalZ_identity :
    (universalZ k).map (identityEval k) = 1
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp [universalZ, identityEval, identityPoint, Matrix.one_apply]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RationalResidualSourceFamily.eval_determinant_identity
statement:
theorem eval_determinant_identity :
    MvPolynomial.eval (identityPoint k) (determinant k) = 1
proof:
:= by
  change identityEval k (determinant k) = 1
  rw [determinant, RingHom.map_det]
  change Matrix.det ((universalZ k).map (identityEval k)) = 1
  rw [eval_universalZ_identity, Matrix.det_one]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RationalResidualSourceFamily.determinant_ne_zero
statement: theorem determinant_ne_zero : determinant k ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have := congrArg (MvPolynomial.eval (identityPoint k)) h
  simpa [eval_determinant_identity] using this

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RationalResidualSourceFamily.charZero_of_injective_map
statement:
private theorem charZero_of_injective_map
    {A L : Type v} [CommRing A] [CharZero A] [Field L]
    (f : A →+* L) (hf : Function.Injective f) : CharZero L where
  cast_injective m n h
proof:
:= Nat.cast_injective (R := A)
    (hf (by simpa only [map_natCast] using h))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RationalResidualSourceFamily.localDet_isUnit
statement: theorem localDet_isUnit : IsUnit (localDet k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [localDet, IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit_iff
    (x := LocalizedGridIdentity.mappedDenominator k
      (RationalSourceFamily.F k) (determinant k))]
  exact ⟨1, by simp⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RationalResidualSourceFamily.localDet_mul_inv
statement: theorem localDet_mul_inv : localDet k * localDetInv k = 1

:=
  Ring.mul_inverse_cancel _ (localDet_isUnit k)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RationalResidualSourceFamily.eval_determinant
statement:
theorem eval_determinant (t : Var → k) :
    MvPolynomial.eval t (determinant k) = Matrix.det (valueZ k t)
proof:
:= by
  change evalHom k t (determinant k) = _
  rw [determinant, RingHom.map_det]
  congr 1
  ext i j
  simp [evalHom, universalZ, valueZ]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RationalResidualSourceFamily.evaluation_localZ
statement:
@[simp] theorem evaluation_localZ (t : Var → k)
    (ht : MvPolynomial.eval t (determinant k) ≠ 0) :
    (localZ k).map (evaluation k t ht) =
      (valueZ k t).map (algebraMap k (RationalSourceFamily.F k))
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp [localZ, universalZ, valueZ, evaluation,
    LocalizedGridIdentity.localizedConstantEval_algebraMap,
    LocalizedGridIdentity.constantEval]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RationalResidualSourceFamily.evaluation_localDet
statement:
@[simp] theorem evaluation_localDet (t : Var → k)
    (ht : MvPolynomial.eval t (determinant k) ≠ 0) :
    evaluation k t ht (localDet k) =
      algebraMap k (RationalSourceFamily.F k)
        (MvPolynomial.eval t (determinant k))
proof:
:= by
  rw [localDet, evaluation,
    LocalizedGridIdentity.localizedConstantEval_algebraMap]
  exact LocalizedGridIdentity.constantEval_mappedDenominator
    k (RationalSourceFamily.F k) (determinant k) t

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RationalResidualSourceFamily.evaluation_localDetInv
statement:
@[simp] theorem evaluation_localDetInv (t : Var → k)
    (ht : MvPolynomial.eval t (determinant k) ≠ 0) :
    evaluation k t ht (localDetInv k) =
      (algebraMap k (RationalSourceFamily.F k)
        (MvPolynomial.eval t (determinant k)))⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hn : algebraMap k (RationalSourceFamily.F k)
      (MvPolynomial.eval t (determinant k)) ≠ 0 :=
    by simpa only [map_zero] using
      (algebraMap k (RationalSourceFamily.F k)).injective.ne ht
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ hn
  have h := congrArg (evaluation k t ht) (localDet_mul_inv k)
  rw [map_mul, map_one, evaluation_localDet] at h
  rw [h, mul_inv_cancel₀ hn]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RationalResidualSourceFamily.linearEquiv_apply_eq_linear
statement:
private theorem linearEquiv_apply_eq_linear
    (g : ResidualAction.SourceAut (K := k))
    (x : Fin 27 → RationalSourceFamily.F k) :
    SourceAutExtension.linearEquiv (R := RationalSourceFamily.F k) g x =
      SourceAutExtension.linear (R := RationalSourceFamily.F k) g x
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RationalResidualSourceFamily.evaluation_single
statement:
private theorem evaluation_single (t : Var → k)
    (ht : MvPolynomial.eval t (determinant k) ≠ 0) (j : Fin 27) :
    (fun c : Fin 27 => evaluation k t ht
      (((Pi.single j (1 : FamilyRing k)) : Fin 27 → FamilyRing k) c)) =
      Pi.single j (1 : RationalSourceFamily.F k)
proof:
:= by
  funext c
  by_cases h : c = j
  · subst c
    simp
  · simp [Pi.single_apply, h]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RationalResidualSourceFamily.eval_matrix_basis
statement:
private theorem eval_matrix_basis (t : Var → k)
    (ht : MvPolynomial.eval t (determinant k) ≠ 0) (j : Fin 27) :
    (fun i => evaluation k t ht (matrix k i j)) =
      SourceAutExtension.linearEquiv (R := RationalSourceFamily.F k)
        (baseAut k t ht) (Pi.single j 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hc := map_circuit (evaluation k t ht) (localZ k) (localDet k)
    (localDetInv k) (Pi.single j 1)
  rw [evaluation_localZ, evaluation_localDet, evaluation_localDetInv] at hc
  have hs := evaluation_single k t ht j
  rw [hs] at hc
  have hb := circuit_eq_familySourceAut (valueZ k t)
    (by simpa only [← eval_determinant k t] using ht) (Pi.single j (1 : k))
  have hn := map_circuit (algebraMap k (RationalSourceFamily.F k))
    (valueZ k t) (Matrix.det (valueZ k t)) (Matrix.det (valueZ k t))⁻¹
    (Pi.single j (1 : k))
  rw [hb] at hn
  have hmapSingle :
      (fun c : Fin 27 => algebraMap k (RationalSourceFamily.F k)
        (((Pi.single j (1 : k)) : Fin 27 → k) c)) =
        (Pi.single j (1 : RationalSourceFamily.F k) :
          Fin 27 → RationalSourceFamily.F k) := by
    exact SourceAutExtension.mapCoord_single
      (k := k) (R := RationalSourceFamily.F k) j
  rw [hmapSingle] at hn
  have he := SourceAutExtension.linearEquiv_on_constants
    (R := RationalSourceFamily.F k) (baseAut k t ht) (Pi.single j (1 : k))
  rw [SourceAutExtension.mapCoord_single] at he
  have hnDet :
      circuit ((valueZ k t).map
          (algebraMap k (RationalSourceFamily.F k)))
        (algebraMap k (RationalSourceFamily.F k)
          (Matrix.det (valueZ k t)))
        (algebraMap k (RationalSourceFamily.F k)
          (Matrix.det (valueZ k t)))⁻¹
        (Pi.single j (1 : RationalSourceFamily.F k)) =
      SourceAutExtension.linearEquiv (R := RationalSourceFamily.F k)
        (baseAut k t ht) (Pi.single j 1) := by
    have hlinear := hn.symm.trans he.symm
    have hdetLinear :
        circuit ((valueZ k t).map
            (algebraMap k (RationalSourceFamily.F k)))
          (algebraMap k (RationalSourceFamily.F k)
            (Matrix.det (valueZ k t)))
          (algebraMap k (RationalSourceFamily.F k)
            (Matrix.det (valueZ k t)))⁻¹
          (Pi.single j (1 : RationalSourceFamily.F k)) =
        SourceAutExtension.linear (R := RationalSourceFamily.F k)
          (baseAut k t ht) (Pi.single j 1) := by
      simpa only [map_inv₀] using hlinear
    have hequiv := (linearEquiv_apply_eq_linear k (baseAut k t ht)
      (Pi.single j (1 : RationalSourceFamily.F k))).symm
    exact hdetLinear.trans hequiv
  have hnEval :
      circuit ((valueZ k t).map
          (algebraMap k (RationalSourceFamily.F k)))
        (algebraMap k (RationalSourceFamily.F k)
          (MvPolynomial.eval t (determinant k)))
        (algebraMap k (RationalSourceFamily.F k)
          (MvPolynomial.eval t (determinant k)))⁻¹
        (Pi.single j (1 : RationalSourceFamily.F k)) =
      SourceAutExtension.linearEquiv (R := RationalSourceFamily.F k)
        (baseAut k t ht) (Pi.single j 1) := by
    simpa only [eval_determinant k t] using hnDet
  simpa only [matrix, localCircuit] using hc.trans hnEval

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RationalResidualSourceFamily.eval_matrix
statement:
theorem eval_matrix (t : Var → k)
    (ht : MvPolynomial.eval t (determinant k) ≠ 0)
    (x : Fin 27 → RationalSourceFamily.F k) :
    ((matrix k).map (evaluation k t ht)).mulVec x =
      SourceAutExtension.linearEquiv (R := RationalSourceFamily.F k)
        (baseAut k t ht) x
proof:
:= by
  have hm : (matrix k).map (evaluation k t ht) =
      LinearMap.toMatrix'
        (SourceAutExtension.linear (R := RationalSourceFamily.F k)
          (baseAut k t ht)) := by
    ext i j
    exact congrFun (eval_matrix_basis k t ht j) i
  rw [hm]
  exact LinearMap.toMatrix'_mulVec _ x

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceCubicTrace.f0Trace_rat
statement: private theorem f0Trace_rat (x : Coord) : f0TraceK x = traceN x
proof:
:=
  (traceN_eq_coords x).symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceCubicTrace.f0One_rat
statement: private theorem f0One_rat : (f0OneK : F0Coord ℚ) = AlbertLean.one
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = mapCoordQK ℚ AlbertLean.one := (mapCoordQK_one (K := ℚ)).symm
    _ = AlbertLean.one := by funext i; simp [mapCoordQK]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceCubicTrace.rational_cubicResidual_zero
statement:
theorem rational_cubicResidual_zero (x : Coord) :
    cubicResidual (f0ProductLinearK (K := ℚ)) f0TraceLinearK f0OneK x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hs := productSpur_eq_spurN x
  have hn := productNorm_eq_cubicNorm x
  simp only [productSpur, productNorm, productTrace_eq_traceN] at hs hn
  have hc := characteristicIdentity x
  rw [← hs, ← hn] at hc
  simp only [cubicResidual, f0ProductLinearK_apply,
    f0ProductK_rat_eq_structuredProduct, f0TraceLinearK_apply,
    f0Trace_rat, f0One_rat]
  linear_combination (norm := module) 6 • hc

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceCubicTrace.cubicResidual_mapCoordQK
statement:
theorem cubicResidual_mapCoordQK (x : Coord) :
    cubicResidual (f0ProductLinearK (K := K)) f0TraceLinearK f0OneK
        (mapCoordQK K x) =
      mapCoordQK K
        (cubicResidual (f0ProductLinearK (K := ℚ)) f0TraceLinearK f0OneK x)
proof:
:= by
  simp [cubicResidual, f0ProductLinearK_apply, f0ProductK_mapCoordQK,
    f0TraceLinearK_apply, f0TraceK_mapCoordQK, mapCoordQK_one,
    mapCoordQK_add, mapCoordQK_sub, mapCoordQK_smul,
    f0ProductK_rat_eq_structuredProduct, f0Trace_rat, f0One_rat, pow_succ]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceCubicTrace.cubicPolar_mapCoordQK
statement:
theorem cubicPolar_mapCoordQK (a b c : Coord) :
    cubicPolar (f0ProductLinearK (K := K)) f0TraceLinearK f0OneK
        (mapCoordQK K a) (mapCoordQK K b) (mapCoordQK K c) =
      mapCoordQK K
        (cubicPolar (f0ProductLinearK (K := ℚ)) f0TraceLinearK f0OneK a b c)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cubicPolar, ← mapCoordQK_add]
  rw [show (0 : F0Coord K) = mapCoordQK K (0 : Coord) from
    (mapCoordQK_zero (K := K)).symm]
  simp only [cubicResidual_mapCoordQK]
  simp only [mapCoordQK_add, mapCoordQK_sub]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceCubicTrace.generic_cubicPolarMap_eq_zero
statement:
theorem generic_cubicPolarMap_eq_zero :
    cubicPolarMap (f0ProductLinearK (K := K)) f0TraceLinearK f0OneK = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Module.Basis.ext_multilinear (fun _ : Fin 3 => Pi.basisFun K (Fin 27))
  intro v
  simp only [cubicPolarMap_apply, MultilinearMap.zero_apply]
  rw [← mapCoordQK_basis (K := K) (v 0), ← mapCoordQK_basis (K := K) (v 1),
    ← mapCoordQK_basis (K := K) (v 2), cubicPolar_mapCoordQK]
  simp [cubicPolar, rational_cubicResidual_zero, mapCoordQK_zero]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceCubicTrace.generic_cubicResidual_zero
statement:
theorem generic_cubicResidual_zero (x : F0Coord K) :
    cubicResidual f0ProductLinearK f0TraceLinearK f0OneK x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg
    (fun F : MultilinearMap K (fun _ : Fin 3 => F0Coord K) (F0Coord K) =>
      F ![x, x, x]) (generic_cubicPolarMap_eq_zero (K := K))
  simp only [cubicPolarMap_apply, MultilinearMap.zero_apply] at h
  change cubicPolar f0ProductLinearK f0TraceLinearK f0OneK x x x = 0 at h
  rw [cubicPolar_diagonal] at h
  exact (smul_eq_zero.mp h).resolve_left (by norm_num)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceCubicTrace.source_cubicResidual_zero
statement:
theorem source_cubicResidual_zero (x : JCoord K) :
    cubicResidual sourceProductLinear sourceTraceLinear sourceOne x = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply (structuredEquivK K).injective
  simpa only [cubicResidual, sourceProductLinear_apply, sourceTraceLinear_apply,
    f0ProductLinearK_apply, f0TraceLinearK_apply, map_add, map_sub, map_smul,
    map_zero, sourceTrace_agrees_with_f0K, GenericStructuredProductAgreesWithF0,
    structuredEquivK_sourceOne] using
    generic_cubicResidual_zero (K := K) (structuredEquivK K x)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.GLFrame.conjugate_mul
statement:
theorem conjugate_mul (X : Mat3 K) (hX : X.det ≠ 0) (A B : Mat3 K) :
    conjugate X (A * B) = conjugate X A * conjugate X B
proof:
:= by
  have hleft := Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul X (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hX)
  simp only [conjugate, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc X⁻¹ X, hleft, Matrix.one_mul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.GLFrame.conjugate_trace
statement:
theorem conjugate_trace (X : Mat3 K) (hX : X.det ≠ 0) (A : Mat3 K) :
    Matrix.trace (conjugate X A) = Matrix.trace A
proof:
:= by
  rw [conjugate, Matrix.trace_mul_cycle,
    Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul X (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hX), Matrix.one_mul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.GLFrame.frameOfInvertible_laws
statement:
theorem frameOfInvertible_laws (X : Mat3 K) (hX : X.det ≠ 0) :
    FrameLaws (frameOfInvertible X)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    change conjugate X (diagonalUnit i) * conjugate X (diagonalUnit i) =
      conjugate X (diagonalUnit i)
    rw [← conjugate_mul X hX,
      FourRowProbeSeed.diagonalUnit_mul]
    simp
  · intro i j hij
    change conjugate X (diagonalUnit i) * conjugate X (diagonalUnit j) = 0
    rw [← conjugate_mul X hX,
      FourRowProbeSeed.diagonalUnit_mul, if_neg hij]
    simp [conjugate]
  · simp only [frameOfInvertible, conjugate, ← Matrix.add_mul, ← Matrix.mul_add]
    rw [FourRowProbeSeed.diagonalUnit_sum, Matrix.mul_one,
      Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv X (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hX)]
  · intro i
    rw [frameOfInvertible, conjugate_trace X hX]
    exact FourRowProbeSeed.diagonalUnit_trace i

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.GLFrame.first_two_mul_zero_of_sum
statement:
theorem first_two_mul_zero_of_sum (A B C : Mat3 K)
    (hA : A * A = A) (hB : B * B = B) (hC : C * C = C)
    (hsum : A + B + C = 1) : A * B = 0 ∧ B * A = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hpair : A + B = 1 - C := (eq_sub_iff_add_eq).2 hsum
  have hpairIdem : (A + B) * (A + B) = A + B := by
    rw [hpair]
    noncomm_ring [hC]
  have hexpand : (A + B) * (A + B) = (A + B) + (A * B + B * A) := by
    noncomm_ring [hA, hB]
  have hz : (A + B) + (A * B + B * A) = (A + B) + 0 := by
    rw [← hexpand, hpairIdem, add_zero]
  have hanti : A * B + B * A = 0 := add_left_cancel hz
  apply Sym3PrimitiveDictionary.jordan_orthogonal_idempotents_mul_zero A B hA hB
  simp only [matrixJordan, hanti, smul_zero]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.GLFrame.rawFrame_laws
statement:
theorem rawFrame_laws (P : Fin 3 → Mat3 K)
    (hidem : ∀ i, P i * P i = P i)
    (hsum : P 0 + P 1 + P 2 = 1)
    (htrace : ∀ i, Matrix.trace (P i) = 1) : FrameLaws P
proof:
:= by
  have h01 := first_two_mul_zero_of_sum (P 0) (P 1) (P 2)
    (hidem 0) (hidem 1) (hidem 2) hsum
  have h02 := first_two_mul_zero_of_sum (P 0) (P 2) (P 1)
    (hidem 0) (hidem 2) (hidem 1) (by simpa only [add_right_comm] using hsum)
  have h12 := first_two_mul_zero_of_sum (P 1) (P 2) (P 0)
    (hidem 1) (hidem 2) (hidem 0) (by
      calc
        P 1 + P 2 + P 0 = P 0 + P 1 + P 2 := by abel
        _ = 1 := hsum)
  refine ⟨hidem, ?_, hsum, htrace⟩
  intro i j hij
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp_all

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.GLFrame.exists_two_sided_frame_basis
statement:
theorem exists_two_sided_frame_basis (P : Fin 3 → Mat3 K) (hP : FrameLaws P) :
    ∃ X Y : Mat3 K, Y * X = 1 ∧ X * Y = 1 ∧
      (∀ i, P i * X = X * diagonalUnit i) ∧
      (∀ i, P i = X * diagonalUnit i * Y)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  choose j hj using fun i =>
    RealPrimitiveFiniteRoots.exists_nonzero_diagonal (P i) (hP.trace_one i)
  let X : Mat3 K := fun r i => P i r (j i)
  let Y : Mat3 K := fun i r => P i (j i) r / P i (j i) (j i)
  have hprod (i l : Fin 3) : P i * P l = if i = l then P i else 0 := by
    by_cases hil : i = l
    · subst l
      simpa using hP.idempotent i
    · simp only [if_neg hil, hP.orthogonal i l hil]
  have hYX : Y * X = 1 := by
    ext i l
    calc
      (Y * X) i l = (P i * P l) (j i) (j l) / P i (j i) (j i) := by
        change (∑ t : Fin 3, (P i (j i) t / P i (j i) (j i)) * P l t (j l)) =
          (∑ t : Fin 3, P i (j i) t * P l t (j l)) / P i (j i) (j i)
        simp [Fin.sum_univ_succ, div_eq_mul_inv] <;> ring
      _ = (1 : Mat3 K) i l := by
        rw [hprod]
        by_cases hil : i = l
        · subst l
          simp [hj i]
        · simp [hil, Matrix.one_apply]
  have hXY : X * Y = 1 := mul_eq_one_comm.mp hYX
  have hPX (i : Fin 3) : P i * X = X * diagonalUnit i := by
    ext r l
    have hc : (P i * X) r l = (P i * P l) r (j l) := rfl
    rw [hc, hprod]
    change (if i = l then P i else 0) r (j l) =
      ∑ t : Fin 3, X r t * diagonalUnit i t l
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases l <;>
      simp [X, diagonalUnit, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  refine ⟨X, Y, hYX, hXY, hPX, ?_⟩
  intro i
  calc
    P i = P i * (X * Y) := by rw [hXY, Matrix.mul_one]
    _ = (P i * X) * Y := (Matrix.mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
    _ = X * diagonalUnit i * Y := by rw [hPX i]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.GLFrame.exists_frameOfInvertible
statement:
theorem exists_frameOfInvertible (P : Fin 3 → Mat3 K) (hP : FrameLaws P) :
    ∃ X : Mat3 K, X.det ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ i, frameOfInvertible X i = P i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨X, Y, hYX, hXY, hPX, hconj⟩ := exists_two_sided_frame_basis P hP
  have hd : X.det * Y.det = 1 := by rw [← Matrix.det_mul, hXY, Matrix.det_one]
  have hX : X.det ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    rw [hzero, zero_mul] at hd
    exact zero_ne_one hd
  have hY : Y = X⁻¹ := by
    calc
      Y = Y * (X * X⁻¹) := by
        rw [Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv X (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hX), Matrix.mul_one]
      _ = (Y * X) * X⁻¹ := (Matrix.mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ = X⁻¹ := by rw [hYX, Matrix.one_mul]
  refine ⟨X, hX, ?_⟩
  intro i
  simpa only [frameOfInvertible, conjugate, hY] using (hconj i).symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.GLFrame.rawFrame_exists_frameOfInvertible
statement:
theorem rawFrame_exists_frameOfInvertible (P : Fin 3 → Mat3 K)
    (hidem : ∀ i, P i * P i = P i)
    (hsum : P 0 + P 1 + P 2 = 1)
    (htrace : ∀ i, Matrix.trace (P i) = 1) :
    ∃ X : Mat3 K, X.det ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ i, frameOfInvertible X i = P i
proof:
:=
  exists_frameOfInvertible P (rawFrame_laws P hidem hsum htrace)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.GLFrame.embedded_tauFrame
statement:
theorem embedded_tauFrame (P : Fin 3 → Mat3 K) (hP : FrameLaws P) :
    TauFrame (fun i => embed (P i))
proof:
:= by
  have hJ (i l : Fin 3) (hil : i ≠ l) : matrixJordan (P i) (P l) = 0 := by
    simp only [matrixJordan, hP.orthogonal i l hil,
      hP.orthogonal l i (Ne.symm hil), add_zero, smul_zero]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    change TauCeti.AlbertAlgebra.trace (toTau (P i, 0, 0)) = 1
    rw [tauTrace_toTau]
    exact hP.trace_one i
  · intro i
    rw [← embed_matrixJordan]
    congr 1
    simp only [matrixJordan, hP.idempotent i, ← two_smul K (P i),
      smul_smul, invOf_mul_self, one_smul]
  · rw [← embed_add_matrix, ← embed_add_matrix, hP.sum_eq_one, embed_one_matrix]
  · rw [← embed_matrixJordan, hJ 0 1 (by decide)]
    simp [embed]
  · rw [← embed_matrixJordan, hJ 0 2 (by decide)]
    simp [embed]
  · rw [← embed_matrixJordan, hJ 1 2 (by decide)]
    simp [embed]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.GLFrame.hasProjectorLabels_of_matrixFrame
statement:
theorem hasProjectorLabels_of_matrixFrame (P : Fin 3 → Mat3 K) (hP : FrameLaws P) :
    HasProjectorLabels (embed (encoder (P 0) (P 2))) (fun i => embed (P i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [encoder, embed_sub_matrix]
  exact hasProjectorLabels_of_tauFrame (fun i => embed (P i)) (embedded_tauFrame P hP)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.GLFrame.frameOfInvertible_hasProjectorLabels
statement:
theorem frameOfInvertible_hasProjectorLabels (X : Mat3 K) (hX : X.det ≠ 0) :
    HasProjectorLabels
      (embed (encoder (frameOfInvertible X 0) (frameOfInvertible X 2)))
      (fun i => embed (frameOfInvertible X i))
proof:
:=
  hasProjectorLabels_of_matrixFrame _ (frameOfInvertible_laws X hX)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourcePrimitiveFrame.trace_cases_of_nonzero
proof:
:= by
  rcases sourceTrace_idempotent_cases e he with h0 | h1 | h2 | h3
  · exact (hne h0).elim
  · exact Or.inl h1
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inl h2)
  · right; right
    rw [h3]
    norm_num [sourceTrace, sourceOne]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourcePrimitiveFrame.primitive_of_laws
statement:
theorem primitive_of_laws (P : Fin 3 → JCoord K)
    (hP : SourceFrameLaws.Laws P) (i : Fin 3) : IsPrimitiveIdempotent (P i)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hP.idempotent i, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro hz
    have ht := hP.trace_one i
    rw [hz] at ht
    norm_num [sourceTrace] at ht
  · intro f g hf hg hfg hsum
    by_cases hf0 : f = 0
    · exact Or.inl hf0
    by_cases hg0 : g = 0
    · exact Or.inr hg0
    exfalso
    have ht : sourceTrace f + sourceTrace g = 1 := by
      have h := congrArg (sourceTraceLinear (K := K)) hsum
      simpa only [map_add, sourceTraceLinear_apply, hP.trace_one i] using h
    rcases trace_cases_of_nonzero f hf hf0 with h1 | h1 | h1 <;>
      rcases trace_cases_of_nonzero g hg hg0 with h2 | h2 | h2 <;>
      norm_num [h1, h2] at ht

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourcePrimitiveFrame.laws_of_primitive_triple
statement:
theorem laws_of_primitive_triple (P : Fin 3 → JCoord K)
    (hP : ∀ i, IsPrimitiveIdempotent (P i))
    (hsum : P 0 + P 1 + P 2 = sourceOne) : SourceFrameLaws.Laws P
proof:
:= by
  have hi : ∀ i, sourceProduct (P i) (P i) = P i := fun i => (hP i).1
  have hn : ∀ i, P i ≠ 0 := fun i => (hP i).2.1
  exact ⟨hi, nonzero_idempotent_triple_trace_one P hi hn hsum, hsum⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourcePrimitiveFrame.primitiveFrame_of_laws
statement:
theorem primitiveFrame_of_laws (P : Fin 3 → JCoord K)
    (hP : SourceFrameLaws.Laws P) : IsPrimitiveFrame P
proof:
:=
  ⟨primitive_of_laws P hP, fun i j hij => hP.orthogonal hij, hP.sum_one⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourcePrimitiveFrame.laws_of_primitiveFrame
statement:
theorem laws_of_primitiveFrame (P : Fin 3 → JCoord K)
    (hP : IsPrimitiveFrame P) : SourceFrameLaws.Laws P
proof:
:=
  laws_of_primitive_triple P hP.1 hP.2.2

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourcePrimitiveFrame.primitiveFrame_iff_laws
statement:
theorem primitiveFrame_iff_laws (P : Fin 3 → JCoord K) :
    IsPrimitiveFrame P ↔ SourceFrameLaws.Laws P
proof:
:=
  ⟨laws_of_primitiveFrame P, primitiveFrame_of_laws P⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualLedgerPower.diagonal_projectors
statement:
theorem diagonal_projectors (i : Fin 3) :
    spectralProjector (diagonal (-1 : K) 0 1) i = diagonalUnit i
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i <;> apply JCoord.ext <;>
    norm_num [spectralProjector, sourceSquare_formula, diagonalUnit, diagonal,
      sourceOne, nS, nC, nV, pf_coordinate, normalizedMuV, muV,
      sourceMuS, sourceMuC, evalU, wedge2, dualWedge2, hodgeStar]

  all_goals first
    | decide
    | (apply VCoord.ext <;> first | rfl | (funext i; cases i <;>
        simp [wedge2, dualWedge2, hodgeStar]))
    | (apply SCoord.ext <;> funext i <;> fin_cases i <;> rfl)
    | (apply CCoord.ext <;> funext i <;> fin_cases i <;> rfl)

proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualLedgerPower.power_pair_mem
statement:
theorem power_pair_mem (F : Subfield K)
    (B : JCoord K →ₗ[K] JCoord K →ₗ[K] K) (a b : JCoord K)
    (h : ∀ j l, B (spectralProjector a j) (spectralProjector b l) ∈ F)
    (p q : Fin 3) : B (power a p) (power b q) ∈ F
proof:
:= by
  rw [power_eq_weighted_projectors a p, power_eq_weighted_projectors b q]
  simp only [map_sum, map_smul, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
    smul_eq_mul]
  apply F.sum_mem
  intro j hj
  apply F.mul_mem (powerWeight_mem F q j)
  apply F.sum_mem
  intro l hl
  exact F.mul_mem (powerWeight_mem F p l) (h l j)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualLedgerPower.rawJoint_mem
statement:
theorem rawJoint_mem (F : Subfield K) (a b : JCoord K)
    (h : LedgerIn F (sourceLedger a b)) (i j l : Fin 3) :
    diagonalProduct i (spectralProjector a j) (spectralProjector b l) ∈ F
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨hP, hQ, hR, hC⟩
  have h3 : (3 : K) ∈ F := natCast_mem F 3
  have h29 : (2 / 9 : K) ∈ F := F.div_mem (natCast_mem F 2) (natCast_mem F 9)
  have hc := hC i j l
  change sourceTraceForm (diagonalUnit i)
    (sourceProduct (spectralProjector a j) (spectralProjector b l)) -
      ((sourceLedger a b).P i j + (sourceLedger a b).Q j l +
        (sourceLedger a b).R l i) / 3 + 2 / 9 ∈ F at hc
  have hh := F.sub_mem
    (F.add_mem hc (F.div_mem (F.add_mem (F.add_mem (hP i j) (hQ j l))
      (hR l i)) h3)) h29
  have heq :
      sourceTraceForm (diagonalUnit i)
        (sourceProduct (spectralProjector a j) (spectralProjector b l)) -
        ((sourceLedger a b).P i j + (sourceLedger a b).Q j l +
          (sourceLedger a b).R l i) / 3 + 2 / 9 +
        ((sourceLedger a b).P i j + (sourceLedger a b).Q j l +
          (sourceLedger a b).R l i) / 3 - 2 / 9 =
      diagonalProduct i (spectralProjector a j) (spectralProjector b l) := by
    rw [diagonal_trace, diagonalProduct_apply]
    ring
  rwa [heq] at hh

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualLedgerPower.power_diagonal_mem
statement:
theorem power_diagonal_mem (F : Subfield K) (a b : JCoord K)
    (h : LedgerIn F (sourceLedger a b)) (i p q : Fin 3) :
    diagLinear i (sourceProduct (power a p) (power b q)) ∈ F
proof:
:=
  power_pair_mem F (diagonalProduct i) a b (rawJoint_mem F a b h i) p q

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3JordanNaturality.linearEquiv_natural
statement:
theorem linearEquiv_natural (f : R →ₐ[k] S)
    (g : Aut (K := k)) (x : Sym3Coord R) :
    mapCoordinates f (linearEquiv R g x) =
      linearEquiv S g (mapCoordinates f x)
proof:
:= by
  funext p
  simp only [mapCoordinates_apply]
  rw [linearEquiv_apply_coordinate, linearEquiv_apply_coordinate]
  simp only [mapCoordinates_apply, map_sum, map_mul, f.commutes]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3JordanNaturality.linearEquiv_symm_natural
statement:
theorem linearEquiv_symm_natural (f : R →ₐ[k] S)
    (g : Aut (K := k)) (x : Sym3Coord R) :
    mapCoordinates f ((linearEquiv R g).symm x) =
      (linearEquiv S g).symm (mapCoordinates f x)
proof:
:= by
  apply (linearEquiv S g).injective
  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  rw [← linearEquiv_natural f g ((linearEquiv R g).symm x)]
  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3JordanNaturality.symmetrize_natural

proof:
:= by

  ext i j

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3JordanNaturality.symCoordinates_natural

        (Pi.basisFun K (Fin 27) i₀) (Pi.basisFun K (Fin 27) i₁)

    ← mapCoordQK_basis (K := K) i₁,

    polarizationMap (f0ProductLinearK (K := K)) = 0

  apply Module.Basis.ext_multilinear
    (fun _ : Fin 4 => Pi.basisFun K (Fin 27))

name: AlbertLean.Comparison.GenericJordanExtension.f0JordanIdentity
statement:
theorem f0JordanIdentity (x y : F0Coord K) :
    f0ProductK (f0ProductK x y) (f0ProductK x x) =
      f0ProductK x (f0ProductK y (f0ProductK x x))
proof:
:= by
  have hp := congrArg
    (fun F : MultilinearMap K (fun _ : Fin 4 => F0Coord K) (F0Coord K) =>
      F ![x, x, x, y]) (f0PolarizationMap_eq_zero (K := K))
  simp only [polarizationMap_apply, MultilinearMap.zero_apply] at hp
  change polarization (f0ProductLinearK (K := K)) x x x y = 0 at hp
  rw [polarization_diagonal] at hp
  have hr : residual (f0ProductLinearK (K := K)) x y = 0 :=
    (smul_eq_zero.mp hp).resolve_left (by norm_num)
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp (by
    simpa only [residual, f0ProductLinearK_apply] using hr)

name: AlbertLean.Comparison.GenericJordanExtension.sourceJordanIdentity
statement:
theorem sourceJordanIdentity (x y : JCoord K) :
    sourceProduct (sourceProduct x y) (sourceProduct x x) =
      sourceProduct x (sourceProduct y (sourceProduct x x))
proof:
:= by
  apply (structuredEquivK K).injective
  calc
    structuredEquivK K
        (sourceProduct (sourceProduct x y) (sourceProduct x x)) =
        f0ProductK (structuredEquivK K (sourceProduct x y))
          (structuredEquivK K (sourceProduct x x)) :=
      GenericStructuredProductAgreesWithF0 _ _
    _ = f0ProductK
          (f0ProductK (structuredEquivK K x) (structuredEquivK K y))
          (f0ProductK (structuredEquivK K x) (structuredEquivK K x)) := by
      rw [GenericStructuredProductAgreesWithF0,
        GenericStructuredProductAgreesWithF0]
    _ = f0ProductK (structuredEquivK K x)
          (f0ProductK (structuredEquivK K y)
            (f0ProductK (structuredEquivK K x) (structuredEquivK K x))) :=
      f0JordanIdentity _ _
    _ = f0ProductK (structuredEquivK K x)
          (structuredEquivK K (sourceProduct y (sourceProduct x x))) := by
      rw [GenericStructuredProductAgreesWithF0,
        GenericStructuredProductAgreesWithF0]
    _ = structuredEquivK K
          (sourceProduct x (sourceProduct y (sourceProduct x x))) :=
      (GenericStructuredProductAgreesWithF0 _ _).symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.GLGridIdentityTransport.algebraMap_eq_scalarMap

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.GLGridIdentityTransport.localizedConstantEval_eq_evalAway
statement:
theorem localizedConstantEval_eq_evalAway
    (t : Var → k) (ht : MvPolynomial.eval t (totalDenominator k) ≠ 0) :
    localizedConstantEval k (F k) (Param k) (totalDenominator k) t ht =
      evalAway (RingHom.id (F k)) (baseMatrices k t)
        (baseMatrices_det_ne_zero k t ht)
proof:
:= by
  apply IsLocalization.ringHom_ext
    (Submonoid.powers (mappedDenominator k (F k) (totalDenominator k)))
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro P
  simp only [RingHom.comp_apply]
  rw [localizedConstantEval_algebraMap, evalAway_algebraMap]
