name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.GLGridIdentityTransport.crossExpression_eq_zero_of_jordanInvariant
statement:
theorem crossExpression_eq_zero_of_jordanInvariant
    (a b : CoordinateRing k) (hb : rawToField k b ≠ 0)
    (hinv : IsJordanInvariant k (rawToField k a / rawToField k b)) :
    crossExpression k a b = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply eq_zero_of_localizedConstantEval_eq_zero k (F k) (Param k)
    (totalDenominator k) (totalDenominator_ne_zero k)
  intro t ht
  rw [localizedConstantEval_eq_evalAway k t ht]
  exact evalAway_crossExpression_eq_zero_of_jordanInvariant k a b hb hinv t ht

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.GLGridIdentityTransport.extensionMatrices_det_ne_zero
statement:
theorem extensionMatrices_det_ne_zero (Q : Mat3 E)
    (hQ : Matrix.det Q ≠ 0) :
    ∀ r, Matrix.det (extensionMatrices Q r) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro r
  fin_cases r
  · simpa [extensionMatrices] using hQ
  · simp [extensionMatrices]
  · simp [extensionMatrices]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.GLGridIdentityTransport.evaluatedAlong_eq_right_comp_rawToField
statement:
theorem evaluatedAlong_eq_right_comp_rawToField
    (left right : F k →+* E)
    (hscalar : left.comp (scalarMap k) = right.comp (scalarMap k))
    (Q : Mat3 E)
    (htransport : ∀ r i,
      Q * left.mapMatrix (universalFamily k r i) * Q⁻¹ =
        right.mapMatrix (universalFamily k r i)) :
    evaluationAlong (left.comp (scalarMap k))
        (fun r i => Q * left.mapMatrix (universalFamily k r i) * Q⁻¹) =
      right.comp (rawToField k)
proof:
:= by
  apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
  · intro c
    have hs := DFunLike.congr_fun hscalar c
    simpa [evaluationAlong, scalarMap] using hs
  · intro q
    cases q with
    | entry r i a b =>
      simp only [evaluationAlong, MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_X', RingHom.comp_apply]
      exact congrFun (congrFun (htransport r i) a) b

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.GLGridIdentityTransport.inner_extension_agreement
statement:
theorem inner_extension_agreement
    (left right : F k →+* E)
    (hscalar : left.comp (scalarMap k) = right.comp (scalarMap k))
    (a b : CoordinateRing k) (hb : rawToField k b ≠ 0)
    (hinv : IsJordanInvariant k (rawToField k a / rawToField k b))
    (Q : Mat3 E) (hQ : Matrix.det Q ≠ 0)
    (htransport : ∀ r i,
      Q * left.mapMatrix (universalFamily k r i) * Q⁻¹ =
        right.mapMatrix (universalFamily k r i)) :
    left (rawToField k a / rawToField k b) =
      right (rawToField k a / rawToField k b)
proof:
:= by
  have hcross0 := crossExpression_eq_zero_of_jordanInvariant k a b hb hinv
  let X := extensionMatrices Q
  let hX := extensionMatrices_det_ne_zero Q hQ
  have hev := congrArg (evalAway left X hX) hcross0
  rw [map_zero, evalAway_crossExpression] at hev
  have hmaps := evaluatedAlong_eq_right_comp_rawToField
    k left right hscalar Q htransport
  have hma := DFunLike.congr_fun hmaps a
  have hmb := DFunLike.congr_fun hmaps b
  have hcross :
      right (rawToField k a) * left (rawToField k b) -
        right (rawToField k b) * left (rawToField k a) = 0 := by
    change evaluationAlong (left.comp (scalarMap k))
        (fun r i => Q * left.mapMatrix (universalFamily k r i) * Q⁻¹) a *
        left (rawToField k b) -
      evaluationAlong (left.comp (scalarMap k))
        (fun r i => Q * left.mapMatrix (universalFamily k r i) * Q⁻¹) b *
        left (rawToField k a) = 0 at hev
    rw [hma, hmb] at hev
    exact hev
  have hlb : left (rawToField k b) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [map_zero] using left.injective.ne hb
  have hrb : right (rawToField k b) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [map_zero] using right.injective.ne hb
  rw [map_div₀, map_div₀]
  apply (div_eq_div_iff hlb hrb).2
  have h := sub_eq_zero.mp hcross
  simpa [mul_comm] using h.symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceCubicTrace.sourceTrace_idempotent_cases
statement:
theorem sourceTrace_idempotent_cases (e : JCoord K)
    (he : sourceProduct e e = e) :
    e = 0 ∨ sourceTrace e = 1 ∨ sourceTrace e = 2 ∨ e = sourceOne
proof:
:= by
  let t := sourceTrace e
  have hR := source_cubicResidual_zero (K := K) e
  have hfactor : ((t - 1) * (t - 2)) • ((3 : K) • e - t • sourceOne) = 0 := by
    simp only [cubicResidual, sourceProductLinear_apply, sourceTraceLinear_apply,
      he] at hR
    dsimp only [t]
    linear_combination (norm := module) hR
  by_cases h1 : t = 1
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inl h1)
  by_cases h2 : t = 2
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl h2))
  have hs : (t - 1) * (t - 2) ≠ 0 :=
    mul_ne_zero (sub_ne_zero.mpr h1) (sub_ne_zero.mpr h2)
  have heScalar : (3 : K) • e = t • sourceOne :=
    sub_eq_zero.mp ((smul_eq_zero.mp hfactor).resolve_left hs)
  have heq : e = (t / 3) • sourceOne := by
    calc
      e = (1 / 3 : K) • ((3 : K) • e) := by module
      _ = (1 / 3 : K) • (t • sourceOne) := by rw [heScalar]
      _ = (t / 3) • sourceOne := by module
  have ht : t = 0 ∨ t = 3 := by
    have hi := he
    rw [heq] at hi
    simp only [sourceProduct_smul_left, sourceProduct_smul_right,
      sourceProduct_one_left, smul_smul] at hi
    have hq : (t / 3)^2 = t / 3 := by
      have hd := congrArg JCoord.d1 hi
      simpa [sourceOne, pow_two] using hd
    have hprod : (t / 3) * (t / 3 - 1) = 0 := by
      rw [mul_sub, mul_one, ← pow_two, hq, sub_self]
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hprod with h | h
    · left
      calc
        t = (t / 3) * 3 := by field_simp
        _ = 0 := by rw [h, zero_mul]
    · right
      have hq1 : t / 3 = 1 := sub_eq_zero.mp h
      calc
        t = (t / 3) * 3 := by field_simp
        _ = 3 := by rw [hq1, one_mul]
  rcases ht with ht | ht
  · exact Or.inl (by rw [heq, ht]; simp)
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (by rw [heq, ht]; simp)))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceCubicTrace.nonzero_idempotent_triple_trace_one
statement:
theorem nonzero_idempotent_triple_trace_one
    (e : Fin 3 → JCoord K) (hidem : ∀ i, sourceProduct (e i) (e i) = e i)
    (hne : ∀ i, e i ≠ 0) (hsum : e 0 + e 1 + e 2 = sourceOne) :
    ∀ i, sourceTrace (e i) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hc (i : Fin 3) : sourceTrace (e i) = 1 ∨
      sourceTrace (e i) = 2 ∨ sourceTrace (e i) = 3 := by
    rcases sourceTrace_idempotent_cases (e i) (hidem i) with h | h | h | h
    · exact False.elim (hne i h)
    · exact Or.inl h
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl h)
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (by rw [h, sourceTrace_one]))
  have ht : sourceTrace (e 0) + sourceTrace (e 1) + sourceTrace (e 2) = 3 := by
    have h := congrArg (sourceTraceLinear (K := K)) hsum
    simpa only [map_add, sourceTraceLinear_apply, sourceTrace_one] using h
  rcases hc 0 with h0 | h0 | h0 <;> rcases hc 1 with h1 | h1 | h1 <;>
    rcases hc 2 with h2 | h2 | h2
  all_goals norm_num [h0, h1, h2] at ht
  intro i
  fin_cases i <;> assumption

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowProbeSeparation.twoByTwo_separates
statement:
theorem twoByTwo_separates {a b c d x y x' y' : K}
    (hdet : a * d - b * c ≠ 0)
    (h₁ : a * x + b * y = a * x' + b * y')
    (h₂ : c * x + d * y = c * x' + d * y') :
    x = x' ∧ y = y'
proof:
:= by
  have hxprod : (a * d - b * c) * (x - x') = 0 := by
    linear_combination d * h₁ - b * h₂
  have hyprod : (a * d - b * c) * (y - y') = 0 := by
    linear_combination a * h₂ - c * h₁
  exact ⟨sub_eq_zero.mp ((mul_eq_zero.mp hxprod).resolve_left hdet),
    sub_eq_zero.mp ((mul_eq_zero.mp hyprod).resolve_left hdet)⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowProbeSeparation.offRow_combo_zero_one
statement:
theorem offRow_combo_zero_one (F A : Mat3 K) :
    offRowMeasurement F A 0 + offRowMeasurement F A 1 -
      offRowMeasurement F A 2 = 2 * pairProbe F A 0 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [offRowMeasurement, rowSymMeasurements, pairProbe, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowProbeSeparation.offRow_combo_zero_two
statement:
theorem offRow_combo_zero_two (F A : Mat3 K) :
    offRowMeasurement F A 0 + offRowMeasurement F A 2 -
      offRowMeasurement F A 1 = 2 * pairProbe F A 0 2
proof:
:= by
  simp [offRowMeasurement, rowSymMeasurements, pairProbe, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowProbeSeparation.offRow_combo_one_two
statement:
theorem offRow_combo_one_two (F A : Mat3 K) :
    offRowMeasurement F A 1 + offRowMeasurement F A 2 -
      offRowMeasurement F A 0 = 2 * pairProbe F A 1 2
proof:
:= by
  simp [offRowMeasurement, rowSymMeasurements, pairProbe, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowProbeSeparation.pairDet_zero_one
statement:
theorem pairDet_zero_one (F : Mat3 K) :
    F 0 1 * (F * F) 1 0 - F 1 0 * (F * F) 0 1 = cycleDifference F
proof:
:= by
  simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ, cycleDifference]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowProbeSeparation.pairDet_zero_two
statement:
theorem pairDet_zero_two (F : Mat3 K) :
    F 0 2 * (F * F) 2 0 - F 2 0 * (F * F) 0 2 = -cycleDifference F
proof:
:= by
  simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ, cycleDifference]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowProbeSeparation.pairDet_one_two
statement:
theorem pairDet_one_two (F : Mat3 K) :
    F 1 2 * (F * F) 2 1 - F 2 1 * (F * F) 1 2 = cycleDifference F
proof:
:= by
  simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ, cycleDifference]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowProbeSeparation.pair_separates
statement:
theorem pair_separates (F A B : Mat3 K) (i k : Fin 3)
    (hdet : F i k * (F * F) k i - F k i * (F * F) i k ≠ 0)
    (h₁ : pairProbe F A i k = pairProbe F B i k)
    (h₂ : pairProbe (F * F) A i k = pairProbe (F * F) B i k) :
    A k i = B k i ∧ A i k = B i k
proof:
:= by
  exact twoByTwo_separates hdet h₁ h₂

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowProbeSeparation.pairProbes_injective
statement:
theorem pairProbes_injective (F A B : Mat3 K)
    (hDelta : cycleDifference F ≠ 0)
    (hDiag : ∀ i, A i i = B i i)
    (hFirst : pairProbe F A 0 1 = pairProbe F B 0 1 ∧
      pairProbe F A 0 2 = pairProbe F B 0 2 ∧ pairProbe F A 1 2 = pairProbe F B 1 2)
    (hSecond : pairProbe (F * F) A 0 1 = pairProbe (F * F) B 0 1 ∧
      pairProbe (F * F) A 0 2 = pairProbe (F * F) B 0 2 ∧
      pairProbe (F * F) A 1 2 = pairProbe (F * F) B 1 2) :
    A = B
proof:
:= by
  have h01 := pair_separates F A B 0 1
    (by rw [pairDet_zero_one]; exact hDelta)
    hFirst.1 hSecond.1
  have h02 := pair_separates F A B 0 2
    (by rw [pairDet_zero_two]; exact neg_ne_zero.mpr hDelta)
    hFirst.2.1 hSecond.2.1
  have h12 := pair_separates F A B 1 2
    (by rw [pairDet_one_two]; exact hDelta)
    hFirst.2.2 hSecond.2.2
  ext i k
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases k
  all_goals simp_all

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowProbeSeparation.offRow_eq_of_row_diag
statement:
private theorem offRow_eq_of_row_diag (F A B : Mat3 K)
    (hDiag : ∀ i, A i i = B i i)
    (hRow : rowSymMeasurements F A = rowSymMeasurements F B) (i : Fin 3) :
    offRowMeasurement F A i = offRowMeasurement F B i
proof:
:= by
  rw [offRowMeasurement, offRowMeasurement, congrFun hRow i, hDiag i]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowProbeSeparation.cancel_two
statement:
private theorem cancel_two {x y : K} (hTwo : (2 : K) ≠ 0)
    (h : 2 * x = 2 * y) : x = y
proof:
:= by
  exact mul_left_cancel₀ hTwo h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowProbeSeparation.rowSymMeasurements_injective
statement:
theorem rowSymMeasurements_injective (F A B : Mat3 K)
    (hTwo : (2 : K) ≠ 0)
    (hDelta : cycleDifference F ≠ 0)
    (hDiag : ∀ i, A i i = B i i)
    (hFirst : rowSymMeasurements F A = rowSymMeasurements F B)
    (hSecond : rowSymMeasurements (F * F) A = rowSymMeasurements (F * F) B) :
    A = B
proof:
:= by
  have hOffFirst : ∀ i, offRowMeasurement F A i = offRowMeasurement F B i :=
    offRow_eq_of_row_diag F A B hDiag hFirst
  have hOffSecond : ∀ i,
      offRowMeasurement (F * F) A i = offRowMeasurement (F * F) B i :=
    offRow_eq_of_row_diag (F * F) A B hDiag hSecond
  have hp01 : pairProbe F A 0 1 = pairProbe F B 0 1 := by
    apply cancel_two hTwo
    rw [← offRow_combo_zero_one F A, ← offRow_combo_zero_one F B]
    simp only [hOffFirst]
  have hp02 : pairProbe F A 0 2 = pairProbe F B 0 2 := by
    apply cancel_two hTwo
    rw [← offRow_combo_zero_two F A, ← offRow_combo_zero_two F B]
    simp only [hOffFirst]
  have hp12 : pairProbe F A 1 2 = pairProbe F B 1 2 := by
    apply cancel_two hTwo
    rw [← offRow_combo_one_two F A, ← offRow_combo_one_two F B]
    simp only [hOffFirst]
  have hp201 : pairProbe (F * F) A 0 1 = pairProbe (F * F) B 0 1 := by
    apply cancel_two hTwo
    rw [← offRow_combo_zero_one (F * F) A,
      ← offRow_combo_zero_one (F * F) B]
    simp only [hOffSecond]
  have hp202 : pairProbe (F * F) A 0 2 = pairProbe (F * F) B 0 2 := by
    apply cancel_two hTwo
    rw [← offRow_combo_zero_two (F * F) A,
      ← offRow_combo_zero_two (F * F) B]
    simp only [hOffSecond]
  have hp212 : pairProbe (F * F) A 1 2 = pairProbe (F * F) B 1 2 := by
    apply cancel_two hTwo
    rw [← offRow_combo_one_two (F * F) A,
      ← offRow_combo_one_two (F * F) B]
    simp only [hOffSecond]
  exact pairProbes_injective F A B hDelta hDiag
    ⟨hp01, hp02, hp12⟩ ⟨hp201, hp202, hp212⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealFrameReducedDomain.exists_prime_field_square
statement:
theorem exists_prime_field_square (p : Ideal (CoordinateRing k)) [p.IsPrime]
    (hraw : rawFrameIdeal (R := k) ≤ p) :
    ∃ (L : Type u) (_ : Field L) (j : CoordinateRing k ⧸ p →+* L),
      Function.Injective j ∧ ∃ e : ParameterRing k →+* L,
        e.comp (psi k) = j.comp (Ideal.Quotient.mk p)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨L, instL, f, x, hden, hj, hX⟩ :=
    RawFramePrimeSquare.exists_extension_and_localized_evaluation k p hraw
  refine ⟨L, instL,
    f.comp (algebraMap (RawFramePrimeSquare.Residue k p)
      (RawFramePrimeSquare.GenericField k p)), hj,
    evalAway (f.comp (RawFramePrimeSquare.coefficientMap k p)) x hden, ?_⟩
  apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
  · intro c
    change evalAway (f.comp (RawFramePrimeSquare.coefficientMap k p)) x hden
      (psi k (MvPolynomial.C c)) = _
    have hc : psi k (MvPolynomial.C c) =
        algebraMap (Base k) (ParameterRing k) (MvPolynomial.C c) := by
      simp [psi, evaluationAlong, RealCayleyParameterDomain.coefficientMap]
    rw [hc, evalAway_algebraMap]
    simp [baseEval, RawFramePrimeSquare.coefficientMap, RawFramePrimeSquare.residueMap]
  · intro q
    cases q with
    | entry r i a b => exact hX r i a b

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealFrameReducedDomain.radical_eq_cayley_kernel
statement:
theorem radical_eq_cayley_kernel :
    (rawFrameIdeal (R := k)).radical = RingHom.ker (psi k)
proof:
:= by
  apply radical_eq_ker_of_prime_field_squares _ _ (rawFrameIdeal_le_ker_psi k)
  intro p hp hraw
  letI : p.IsPrime := hp
  exact exists_prime_field_square k p hraw

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealFrameReducedDomain.rawFrameRadical_isPrime
statement: theorem rawFrameRadical_isPrime : (rawFrameIdeal (R := k)).radical.IsPrime
proof:
:= by
  rw [radical_eq_cayley_kernel]
  exact RingHom.ker_isPrime (psi k)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealFrameReducedDomain.reducedCoordinateRing_isDomain
statement: theorem reducedCoordinateRing_isDomain : IsDomain (ReducedCoordinateRing k)
proof:
:= by
  letI : (rawFrameIdeal (R := k)).radical.IsPrime := rawFrameRadical_isPrime k
  infer_instance

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexNormalizedPairOrbit.eq_diagonal_mul_of_dephase_eq
statement:
theorem eq_diagonal_mul_of_dephase_eq (X Y : Mat3 K)
    (hX : ∀ i j, X i j ≠ 0) (hY : ∀ i j, Y i j ≠ 0)
    (h : dephase Y = dephase X) :
    Y = Matrix.diagonal (leftTransport X Y) * X *
      Matrix.diagonal (rightTransport X Y)
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  have hij := congrFun (congrFun h i) j
  simp only [dephase] at hij
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply]
  simp
  dsimp only [leftTransport, rightTransport]
  field_simp [hX i 0, hX 0 j,
    hY i 0, hY 0 j, hY 0 0, hX 0 0] at hij ⊢
  linear_combination hij

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexNormalizedPairOrbit.leftTransport_ne_zero
statement:
theorem leftTransport_ne_zero (X Y : Mat3 K)
    (hX : ∀ i j, X i j ≠ 0) (hY : ∀ i j, Y i j ≠ 0) (i : Fin 3) :
    leftTransport X Y i ≠ 0
proof: := div_ne_zero (hY i 0) (hX i 0)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexNormalizedPairOrbit.rightTransport_ne_zero
statement:
theorem rightTransport_ne_zero (X Y : Mat3 K)
    (hX : ∀ i j, X i j ≠ 0) (hY : ∀ i j, Y i j ≠ 0) (j : Fin 3) :
    rightTransport X Y j ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  div_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (hY 0 j) (hX 0 0))
    (mul_ne_zero (hY 0 0) (hX 0 j))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexNormalizedPairOrbit.diagonal_inverse
statement:
private theorem diagonal_inverse (d : Fin 3 → K) (hd : ∀ i, d i ≠ 0) :
    (Matrix.diagonal d)⁻¹ = Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (d i)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.inv_eq_left_inv
  ext i j
  by_cases h : i = j
  · subst j; simp [hd]
  · simp [h]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexNormalizedPairOrbit.diagonal_conjugate_diagonalUnit
statement:
theorem diagonal_conjugate_diagonalUnit (d : Fin 3 → K)
    (hd : ∀ i, d i ≠ 0) (i : Fin 3) :
    conjugate (Matrix.diagonal d) (diagonalUnit i) = diagonalUnit i
proof:
:= by
  rw [conjugate, diagonal_inverse d hd]
  ext p q
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases p <;> fin_cases q <;>
    simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply, diagonalUnit, hd, Fin.sum_univ_succ]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexNormalizedPairOrbit.frameOfInvertible_diagonal_mul
statement:
theorem frameOfInvertible_diagonal_mul (X : Mat3 K) (hX : X.det ≠ 0)
    (l r : Fin 3 → K) (hl : ∀ i, l i ≠ 0) (hr : ∀ i, r i ≠ 0)
    (i : Fin 3) :
    frameOfInvertible (Matrix.diagonal l * X * Matrix.diagonal r) i =
      conjugate (Matrix.diagonal l) (frameOfInvertible X i)
proof:
:= by
  have hYX := Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul X (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hX)
  have hrE : Matrix.diagonal r * diagonalUnit i *
      Matrix.diagonal (fun q => (r q)⁻¹) = diagonalUnit i := by
    ext p q
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases p <;> fin_cases q <;>
      simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply, diagonalUnit, hr, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  simp only [frameOfInvertible, conjugate]
  rw [scaled_inverse X X⁻¹ l r hl hr hYX, diagonal_inverse l hl]
  calc
    (Matrix.diagonal l * X * Matrix.diagonal r) * diagonalUnit i *
        (Matrix.diagonal (fun q => (r q)⁻¹) * X⁻¹ *
          Matrix.diagonal (fun q => (l q)⁻¹)) =
      Matrix.diagonal l * (X * (Matrix.diagonal r * diagonalUnit i *
        Matrix.diagonal (fun q => (r q)⁻¹)) * X⁻¹) *
          Matrix.diagonal (fun q => (l q)⁻¹) := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = _ := by rw [hrE]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexNormalizedPairOrbit.frameOfInvertible_inverseTranspose
statement:
theorem frameOfInvertible_inverseTranspose (X : Mat3 K) (hX : X.det ≠ 0)
    (i : Fin 3) :
    frameOfInvertible (Matrix.transpose X⁻¹) i =
      Matrix.transpose (frameOfInvertible X i)
proof:
:= by
  have hu : IsUnit X.det := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hX
  have hinv : (Matrix.transpose X⁻¹)⁻¹ = Matrix.transpose X := by
    rw [← Matrix.transpose_nonsing_inv, Matrix.nonsing_inv_nonsing_inv X hu]
  have hunit : Matrix.transpose (diagonalUnit i : Mat3 K) = diagonalUnit i := by
    ext p q
    simp [diagonalUnit, Matrix.transpose_apply, eq_comm, and_comm]
  rw [frameOfInvertible, conjugate, hinv, frameOfInvertible, conjugate,
    Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_mul, hunit]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexNormalizedPairOrbit.dephase_classification
statement:
theorem dephase_classification (X Y : Mat3 K)
    (hX : X.det ≠ 0) (hY : Y.det ≠ 0)
    (hopen : ∀ i j, overlapOf X i j ≠ 0)
    (hover : ∀ i j, overlapOf Y i j = overlapOf X i j) :
    dephase Y = dephase X ∨
      dephase Y = dephase (Matrix.transpose X⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  have hentryX := (entries_ne_zero_of_overlap_ne_zero X hopen).1
  have hopenY : ∀ i j, overlapOf Y i j ≠ 0 := fun i j => by
    rw [hover i j]
    exact hopen i j
  have hentryY := (entries_ne_zero_of_overlap_ne_zero Y hopenY).1
  let a := dephase X 1 1
  let b := dephase X 1 2
  let c := dephase X 2 1
  let d := dephase X 2 2
  let a' := dephase Y 1 1
  let b' := dephase Y 1 2
  let c' := dephase Y 2 1
  let d' := dephase Y 2 2
  have hcoordX : dephase X = ComplexDephasedPair.dephased a b c d :=
    dephase_eq_dephased X (hentryX 0) (fun i => hentryX i 0)
  have hcoordY : dephase Y = ComplexDephasedPair.dephased a' b' c' d' :=
    dephase_eq_dephased Y (hentryY 0) (fun i => hentryY i 0)
  have hdetX : ComplexDephasedPair.delta a b c d ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← ComplexDephasedPair.det_dephased, ← hcoordX]
    exact det_dephase_ne_zero X hX (hentryX 0) (fun i => hentryX i 0)
  have hdetY : ComplexDephasedPair.delta a' b' c' d' ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← ComplexDephasedPair.det_dephased, ← hcoordY]
    exact det_dephase_ne_zero Y hY (hentryY 0) (fun i => hentryY i 0)
  have hopenCoord : ∀ i j,
      ComplexDephasedPair.overlap a b c d i j ≠ 0 := by
    intro i j
    change overlapOf (ComplexDephasedPair.dephased a b c d) i j ≠ 0
    rw [← hcoordX, overlap_dephase X hentryX hX]
    exact hopen i j
  have hoverCoord : ∀ i j,
      ComplexDephasedPair.overlap a' b' c' d' i j =
        ComplexDephasedPair.overlap a b c d i j := by
    intro i j
    change overlapOf (ComplexDephasedPair.dephased a' b' c' d') i j =
      overlapOf (ComplexDephasedPair.dephased a b c d) i j
    rw [← hcoordY, ← hcoordX, overlap_dephase Y hentryY hY,
      overlap_dephase X hentryX hX]
    exact hover i j
  rcases dephased_pair_matrix_classification a b c d a' b' c' d'
      hdetX hdetY hopenCoord hoverCoord with h | h
  · exact Or.inl (hcoordY.trans (h.trans hcoordX.symm))
  · exact Or.inr (hcoordY.trans (h.trans
      ((congrArg (fun Z : Mat3 K => dephase (Matrix.transpose Z⁻¹)) hcoordX).symm.trans
        (dephase_inverseTranspose_dephase X hentryX hX))))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexNormalizedPairOrbit.normalized_pair_orbit
statement:
theorem normalized_pair_orbit (X Y : Mat3 K)
    (hX : X.det ≠ 0) (hY : Y.det ≠ 0)
    (hopen : ∀ i j, overlapOf X i j ≠ 0)
    (hover : ∀ i j, overlapOf Y i j = overlapOf X i j) :
    ∃ d : Fin 3 → K, (∀ i, d i ≠ 0) ∧
      (∀ i, conjugate (Matrix.diagonal d) (diagonalUnit i) = diagonalUnit i) ∧
      ((∀ i, frameOfInvertible Y i =
          conjugate (Matrix.diagonal d) (frameOfInvertible X i)) ∨
       (∀ i, frameOfInvertible Y i =
          conjugate (Matrix.diagonal d)
            (Matrix.transpose (frameOfInvertible X i))))
proof:
:= by
  have hentryX := (entries_ne_zero_of_overlap_ne_zero X hopen).1
  have hopenY : ∀ i j, overlapOf Y i j ≠ 0 := fun i j => by
    rw [hover i j]
    exact hopen i j
  have hentryY := (entries_ne_zero_of_overlap_ne_zero Y hopenY).1
  rcases dephase_classification X Y hX hY hopen hover with h | h
  · let d := leftTransport X Y
    let c := rightTransport X Y
    have hd : ∀ i, d i ≠ 0 := leftTransport_ne_zero X Y hentryX hentryY
    have hc : ∀ i, c i ≠ 0 := rightTransport_ne_zero X Y hentryX hentryY
    have hYX := eq_diagonal_mul_of_dephase_eq X Y hentryX hentryY h
    refine ⟨d, hd, diagonal_conjugate_diagonalUnit d hd, Or.inl ?_⟩
    intro i
    rw [hYX]
    exact frameOfInvertible_diagonal_mul X hX d c hd hc i
  · let T := Matrix.transpose X⁻¹
    have hentryT : ∀ i j, T i j ≠ 0 :=
      inverseTranspose_entries_ne_zero_of_overlap_ne_zero X hopen
    have hdetT : T.det ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Matrix.det_transpose, Matrix.det_nonsing_inv, Ring.inverse_eq_inv]
      exact inv_ne_zero hX
    let d := leftTransport T Y
    let c := rightTransport T Y
    have hd : ∀ i, d i ≠ 0 := leftTransport_ne_zero T Y hentryT hentryY
    have hc : ∀ i, c i ≠ 0 := rightTransport_ne_zero T Y hentryT hentryY
    have hYT := eq_diagonal_mul_of_dephase_eq T Y hentryT hentryY h
    refine ⟨d, hd, diagonal_conjugate_diagonalUnit d hd, Or.inr ?_⟩
    intro i
    rw [hYT, frameOfInvertible_diagonal_mul T hdetT d c hd hc i,
      frameOfInvertible_inverseTranspose X hX i]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.M3LedgerInvariance.matrixProjector_map
statement:
theorem matrixProjector_map (A : Mat3 F) (i : Fin 3) :
    matrixProjector (e A) i = e (matrixProjector A i)
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i <;>
    dsimp only [matrixProjector, Matrix.cons_val, Fin.reduceFinMk] <;>
    simp only [map_smul, map_sub, map_add, hprod, hone]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.M3LedgerInvariance.trace_mul_map
statement:
theorem trace_mul_map (A B : Mat3 F) :
    Matrix.trace (e A * e B) = Matrix.trace (A * B)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← trace_matrixJordan, ← hprod, htrace, trace_matrixJordan]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.M3LedgerInvariance.trace_left_joint_map
statement:
theorem trace_left_joint_map (A B C : Mat3 F) :
    Matrix.trace (matrixJordan (e A) (e B) * e C) =
      Matrix.trace (matrixJordan A B * C)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← trace_matrixJordan, ← hprod, ← hprod, htrace, trace_matrixJordan]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.M3LedgerInvariance.matrixLedger_invariant
statement:
theorem matrixLedger_invariant (T : Fin 3 → Mat3 F) :
    matrixLedger (fun r => e (T r)) = matrixLedger T
proof:
:= by
  simp only [matrixLedger, matrixProjector_map e hone hprod,
    trace_mul_map e hprod htrace, trace_left_joint_map e hprod htrace]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.M3LedgerInvariance.labelledLedger_embed_invariant
statement:
theorem labelledLedger_embed_invariant (T : Fin 3 → Mat3 F) :
    labelledLedger (fun r => embed (e (T r))) =
      labelledLedger (fun r => embed (T r))
proof:
:= by
  rw [labelledLedger_embed_eq, labelledLedger_embed_eq]
  exact matrixLedger_invariant e hone hprod htrace T

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.M3LedgerInvariance.primitiveLedger_invariant
statement:
theorem primitiveLedger_invariant (P : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Mat3 F) :
    labelledLedger (primitiveMatrixTauTriple (fun r i => e (P r i))) =
      labelledLedger (primitiveMatrixTauTriple P)
proof:
:= by
  rw [primitiveLedger_eq_matrixLedger, primitiveLedger_eq_matrixLedger]
  simpa only [map_sub] using
    matrixLedger_invariant e hone hprod htrace (fun r => P r 2 - P r 0)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.M3LedgerInvariance.labelledLedger_extension_invariant
statement:
theorem labelledLedger_extension_invariant (g : Aut (K := k))
    (T : Fin 3 → Mat3 F) :
    labelledLedger (fun r => embed (linearEquiv (R := F) g (T r))) =
      labelledLedger (fun r => embed (T r))
proof:
:=
  labelledLedger_embed_invariant (linearEquiv (R := F) g)
    (linearEquiv_one g) (linearEquiv_jordan g) (linearEquiv_trace g) T

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.M3LedgerInvariance.primitiveLedger_extension_invariant
statement:
theorem primitiveLedger_extension_invariant (g : Aut (K := k))
    (P : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Mat3 F) :
    labelledLedger (primitiveMatrixTauTriple
      (fun r i => linearEquiv (R := F) g (P r i))) =
      labelledLedger (primitiveMatrixTauTriple P)
proof:
:=
  primitiveLedger_invariant (linearEquiv (R := F) g)
    (linearEquiv_one g) (linearEquiv_jordan g) (linearEquiv_trace g) P

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceTargetTransport.pairTable_map
statement:
theorem pairTable_map
    {V W : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]
    {μ : V →ₗ[K] V →ₗ[K] V} {ν : W →ₗ[K] W →ₗ[K] W}
    (g : V ≃ₗ[K] W) (hprod : ∀ x y, g (μ x y) = ν (g x) (g y))
    {e f c : V} {t : K} (h : PairTable μ e f c t) :
    PairTable ν (g e) (g f) (g c) t
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← hprod, h.ee]
  · rw [← hprod, h.ff]
  · rw [← hprod, h.ef]
  · rw [← hprod, h.ec, map_smul, map_add, map_smul]
  · rw [← hprod, h.fc, map_smul, map_add, map_smul]
  · rw [← hprod, h.cc, map_smul, map_add, map_add, map_smul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceTargetTransport.sourceAut_symm_product
statement:
theorem sourceAut_symm_product (g : SourceAut (K := K)) (x y : JCoord K) :
    g.linear.symm (sourceProduct x y) =
      sourceProduct (g.linear.symm x) (g.linear.symm y)
proof:
:= by
  apply g.linear.injective
  simp only [g.map_product, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceTargetTransport.pairTable_diagonalUnit
statement:
theorem pairTable_diagonalUnit (e : JCoord K) (i : Fin 3)
    (hidem : sourceProduct e e = e) (htrace : sourceTrace e = 1) :
    PairTable sourceProductLinear e (diagonalUnit i)
      (sourceProduct e (diagonalUnit i))
      (sourceTrace (sourceProduct e (diagonalUnit i)))
proof:
:= by
  let g : SourceAut (K := K) := sourceSwapAut 0 i
  let e' := g.linear.symm e
  have he : g.linear e' = e := g.linear.apply_symm_apply e
  have hE : g.linear (diagonalUnit 0) = diagonalUnit i := sourceSwapAut_apply_left 0 i
  have hT (x : JCoord K) : sourceTrace (g.linear x) = sourceTrace x :=
    sourcePermutation_trace (Equiv.swap 0 i) x
  have hide' : sourceProduct e' e' = e' := by
    change sourceProduct (g.linear.symm e) (g.linear.symm e) = g.linear.symm e
    rw [← sourceAut_symm_product, hidem]
  have htrace' : sourceTrace e' = 1 := by
    calc
      _ = sourceTrace (g.linear e') := (hT e').symm
      _ = 1 := by rw [he]; exact htrace
  have hc : g.linear (sourceProduct e' (diagonalUnit 0)) =
      sourceProduct e (diagonalUnit i) := by
    rw [g.map_product, he, hE]
  have ht : e'.d1 = sourceTrace (sourceProduct e (diagonalUnit i)) := by
    calc
      _ = sourceTrace (sourceProduct e' (diagonalUnit 0)) :=
        (sourceTrace_target_zero e').symm
      _ = sourceTrace (g.linear (sourceProduct e' (diagonalUnit 0))) := (hT _).symm
      _ = _ := by rw [hc]
  have h0 := pairTable_of_idempotent_trace_one e' hide' htrace'
  have hm := pairTable_map (μ := sourceProductLinear) (ν := sourceProductLinear)
    g.linear (fun x y => g.map_product x y) h0
  simpa only [he, hE, hc, ht] using hm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceTargetTransport.midpoint_diagonalUnit
statement:
theorem midpoint_diagonalUnit (e : JCoord K) (i : Fin 3) (s : K)
    (hidem : sourceProduct e e = e) (htrace : sourceTrace e = 1)
    (hsquare : s ^ 2 = sourceTrace (sourceProduct e (diagonalUnit i)))
    (hs0 : s ≠ 0) (hsneg : s ≠ -1) :
    let p
proof:
:= midpoint e (diagonalUnit i) (sourceProduct e (diagonalUnit i)) s
    sourceProduct p p = p ∧
      e - (8 : K) • sourceProduct p e +
        (8 : K) • sourceProduct p (sourceProduct p e) = diagonalUnit i := by
  have h := pairTable_diagonalUnit e i hidem htrace
  exact ⟨midpoint_square sourceProductLinear sourceProduct_comm e (diagonalUnit i)
      (sourceProduct e (diagonalUnit i)) (sourceTrace (sourceProduct e (diagonalUnit i)))
      s h hsquare hs0 hsneg,
    midpoint_reflection_apply sourceProductLinear sourceProduct_comm e (diagonalUnit i)
      (sourceProduct e (diagonalUnit i)) (sourceTrace (sourceProduct e (diagonalUnit i)))
      s h hsquare hs0 hsneg⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowFactorization.quadratic_factor_of_right_quadratic
statement:
theorem quadratic_factor_of_right_quadratic
    (r X U V : A) (hrX : r * X = X * r)
    (hquad : X ^ 2 + X * U + V = 0) :
    (r - X) * (r + U + X) = r ^ 2 + r * U + V
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sub_eq_zero]
  calc
    (r - X) * (r + U + X) - (r ^ 2 + r * U + V) =
        -(X ^ 2 + X * U + V) + (r * X - X * r) := by
      simp only [pow_two, mul_add, sub_mul]
      abel
    _ = 0 := by rw [hquad, hrX, neg_zero, sub_self, zero_add]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowFactorization.quadraticMatrix_eq_charmatrix_mul_charmatrix
statement:
theorem quadraticMatrix_eq_charmatrix_mul_charmatrix
    (X U V : Matrix n n R)
    (hquad : X ^ 2 + X * U + V = 0) :
    quadraticMatrix U V =
      Matrix.charmatrix X * Matrix.charmatrix (-U - X)
proof:
:= by
  let z := Matrix.scalar n (Polynomial.X : R[X])
  let cMat : Matrix n n R →+* Matrix n n R[X] :=
    (Polynomial.C : R →+* R[X]).mapMatrix
  have hquadC : cMat X ^ 2 + cMat X * cMat U + cMat V = 0 := by
    calc
      cMat X ^ 2 + cMat X * cMat U + cMat V =
          cMat (X ^ 2 + X * U + V) := by
        simp only [map_add, map_mul, map_pow]
      _ = cMat 0 := congrArg cMat hquad
      _ = 0 := map_zero cMat
  have hzX : z * cMat X = cMat X * z := by
    exact Matrix.scalar_commute _ (fun _ ↦ Commute.all _ _) _
  have hfactor :=
    quadratic_factor_of_right_quadratic z (cMat X) (cMat U) (cMat V) hzX hquadC
  have hcomplement : z + cMat U + cMat X = z - cMat (-U - X) := by
    rw [map_sub, map_neg]
    abel
  change z ^ 2 + z * cMat U + cMat V =
    (z - cMat X) * (z - cMat (-U - X))
  rw [← hcomplement]
  exact hfactor.symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowFactorization.quadraticPolynomial_eq_charpoly_mul
statement:
theorem quadraticPolynomial_eq_charpoly_mul
    (X U V : Matrix n n R)
    (hquad : X ^ 2 + X * U + V = 0) :
    quadraticPolynomial U V = X.charpoly * (-U - X).charpoly
proof:
:= by
  rw [quadraticPolynomial,
    quadraticMatrix_eq_charmatrix_mul_charmatrix X U V hquad,
    Matrix.det_mul]
  rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowFactorization.quadraticPolynomial_eval_zero
statement:
theorem quadraticPolynomial_eval_zero (U V : Matrix n n R) :
    (quadraticPolynomial U V).eval 0 = V.det
proof:
:= by
  rw [quadraticPolynomial, ← Polynomial.coe_evalRingHom, RingHom.map_det]
  apply congrArg Matrix.det
  ext i j
  by_cases hij : i = j <;>
    simp [quadraticMatrix, Matrix.scalar_apply, pow_two,
      Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal, hij]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowFactorization.quadraticPolynomial_eval_neg_one
statement:
theorem quadraticPolynomial_eval_neg_one (U V : Matrix n n R) :
    (quadraticPolynomial U V).eval (-1) = (1 - U + V).det
proof:
:= by
  rw [quadraticPolynomial, ← Polynomial.coe_evalRingHom, RingHom.map_det]
  apply congrArg Matrix.det
  ext i j
  by_cases hij : i = j <;>
    simp [quadraticMatrix, Matrix.scalar_apply, pow_two,
      Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal, sub_eq_add_neg, hij]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowFactorization.charpoly_eval_zero_three
statement:
theorem charpoly_eval_zero_three (M : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) R) :
    M.charpoly.eval 0 = -M.det
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.eval_charpoly]
  have hmatrix : Matrix.scalar (Fin 3) (0 : R) - M = -M := by simp
  rw [hmatrix, Matrix.det_neg]
  simp [pow_succ]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowFactorization.charpoly_eval_neg_one_three
statement:
theorem charpoly_eval_neg_one_three (M : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) R) :
    M.charpoly.eval (-1) = -(1 + M).det
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.eval_charpoly]
  have hmatrix : Matrix.scalar (Fin 3) (-1 : R) - M = -(1 + M) := by
    ext i j
    by_cases hij : i = j <;>
      simp [Matrix.scalar_apply, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm, hij]
  rw [hmatrix, Matrix.det_neg]
  simp [pow_succ]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowFactorization.complementary_charpoly_endpoints
statement:
theorem complementary_charpoly_endpoints
    (X U V : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) K) (c d : K)
    (hquad : X ^ 2 + X * U + V = 0)
    (hc : c ≠ 0) (hd : d ≠ 0)
    (hdetX : X.det = c) (hdetOneX : (1 + X).det = -d)
    (hdetV : V.det = c ^ 2)
    (hdetNegOne : (1 - U + V).det = d ^ 2) :
    let Z
proof:
:= -U - X
    Z.charpoly.eval 0 = -c ∧ Z.charpoly.eval (-1) = d := by
  dsimp only
  have hfactor := quadraticPolynomial_eq_charpoly_mul X U V hquad
  constructor
  · have hzero := congrArg (Polynomial.eval 0) hfactor
    have hprod : c ^ 2 = (-c) * (-U - X).charpoly.eval 0 := by
      simpa [Polynomial.eval_mul, quadraticPolynomial_eval_zero,
        charpoly_eval_zero_three, hdetV, hdetX] using hzero
    apply mul_left_cancel₀ (neg_ne_zero.mpr hc)
    calc
      (-c) * (-U - X).charpoly.eval 0 = c ^ 2 := hprod.symm
      _ = (-c) * (-c) := by simp [pow_two]
  · have hneg := congrArg (Polynomial.eval (-1)) hfactor
    have hprod : d ^ 2 = d * (-U - X).charpoly.eval (-1) := by
      simpa [Polynomial.eval_mul, quadraticPolynomial_eval_neg_one,
        charpoly_eval_neg_one_three, hdetNegOne, hdetOneX] using hneg
    apply mul_left_cancel₀ hd
    calc
      d * (-U - X).charpoly.eval (-1) = d ^ 2 := hprod.symm
      _ = d * d := by rw [pow_two]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFixedFrameSchedule.zeroSlot_aut_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem zeroSlot_aut_apply (i : Fin 3) (x : JCoord K) :
    (SlotPoint.aut i (zeroSlot (K := K))).linear x = x
proof:
:= by
  exact shiftAut_zero_apply i (by simp) x

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFixedFrameSchedule.insertShift_at
statement:
theorem insertShift_at (z : ShiftPoint K) :
    SlotPoint.aut z.pivot (insertShift z z.pivot) = z.aut
proof:
:= by
  simp [insertShift, SlotPoint.aut, ShiftPoint.aut]

  rw [hr, one_mul] at hs

  change y.diagA 0 * y.diagA 1 * y.diagA 2 - y.diagA 0 * (y.r1 * y.z1) -
    y.diagA 1 * matrixM y 0 0 - y.diagA 2 * matrixM y 2 2 +
    y.r1 * matrixM y 0 2 + y.z1 * matrixM y 2 0 = 0 at hn
  rw [hr, one_mul, one_mul] at hn
  simp only [TA, map_add, map_sub, map_mul, chartEval_dA0, chartEval_dA1,
    chartEval_dA2 y heq, chartEval_a,
    chartEval_off y 0 2 (by decide), chartEval_off y 2 0 (by decide)]

    y.r2 * matrixM y 1 3 + y.z2 * matrixM y 3 1 = 0 at hn

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3PrimitiveDictionary.jordan_orthogonal_idempotents_mul_zero
statement:
theorem jordan_orthogonal_idempotents_mul_zero
    (F G : Mat3 K) (hF : F * F = F)
    (hG : G * G = G) (horth : matrixJordan F G = 0) :
    F * G = 0 ∧ G * F = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hsum : F * G + G * F = 0 := by
    have h := congrArg (fun A : Mat3 K => (2 : K) • A) horth
    simpa only [matrixJordan, smul_smul, mul_invOf_self, one_smul, smul_zero] using h
  have hleft : F * G + F * G * F = 0 := by
    have h := congrArg (fun A : Mat3 K => F * A) hsum
    simpa only [mul_add, ← mul_assoc, hF, mul_zero] using h
  have hright : G * F + F * G * F = 0 := by
    have h := congrArg (fun A : Mat3 K => A * F) hsum
    simpa only [add_mul, mul_assoc, hF, zero_mul, add_comm] using h
  have hcomm : F * G = G * F := add_right_cancel (hleft.trans hright.symm)
  have hdouble : F * G + F * G = 0 := by simpa only [← hcomm] using hsum
  have hFG : F * G = 0 := by
    ext i j
    have h := congrFun (congrFun hdouble i) j
    change (F * G) i j + (F * G) i j = 0 at h
    change (F * G) i j = 0
    linear_combination h / 2
  exact ⟨hFG, hcomm.symm.trans hFG⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3PrimitiveDictionary.pivotProjector_properties
statement:
theorem pivotProjector_properties (P : Mat3 K)
    (hsymm : P.transpose = P) (hidem : P * P = P)
    (j : Fin 3) (hj : P j j ≠ 0) :
    let F
proof:
:= pivotProjector P j
    Matrix.transpose F = F ∧ Matrix.trace F = 1 ∧ F * F = F ∧
      P * F = F ∧ F * P = F := by
  let v : Fin 3 → K := fun i => P i j
  have hPv : P *ᵥ v = v := by
    funext i
    exact congrFun (congrFun hidem i) j
  have hvP : v ᵥ* P = v := by
    funext l
    have hs (q : Fin 3) : P q l = P l q := congrFun (congrFun hsymm l) q
    simpa only [Matrix.vecMul, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, hs, mul_comm] using
      congrFun hPv l
  have hvnorm : v ⬝ᵥ v = P j j := by
    have h := congrFun (congrFun hidem j) j
    have hs (q : Fin 3) : P j q = P q j := congrFun (congrFun hsymm q) j
    simpa only [Matrix.mul_apply, dotProduct, v, hs] using h
  have hW : pivotProjector P j = (P j j)⁻¹ • Matrix.vecMulVec v v := by
    ext i l
    simp only [pivotProjector, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, smul_eq_mul,
      v, div_eq_mul_inv]
    ring
  dsimp only
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · ext i l; simp [pivotProjector, mul_comm]
  · rw [hW, Matrix.trace_smul, Matrix.trace_vecMulVec, hvnorm]
    exact inv_mul_cancel₀ hj
  · rw [hW, Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.vecMulVec_mul_vecMulVec,
      hvnorm, Matrix.vecMulVec_smul, smul_smul, smul_smul]
    congr 1
    field_simp [hj]
  · rw [hW, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.mul_vecMulVec, hPv]
  · rw [hW, Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.vecMulVec_mul, hvP]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3PrimitiveDictionary.primitive_idempotent_matrixTrace_eq_one
statement:
theorem primitive_idempotent_matrixTrace_eq_one (e : Sym3Coord K)
    (he : IsJordanPrimitiveIdempotent e) : matrixTrace e = 1
proof:
:= by
  let P := toSymMatrix e
  have hsymm : P.transpose = P := toSymMatrix_symmetric e
  have hidem : P * P = P := by
    have h := congrArg toSymMatrix he.1
    simpa only [P, toSymMatrix_jordan, matrixJordan_self] using h
  have hP0 : P ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply he.2.1
    apply (Function.LeftInverse.injective fromMatrix_toSymMatrix)
    simpa [P] using h
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ :=
    exists_nonzero_diagonal_of_symmetric_idempotent P hsymm hidem hP0
  let F := pivotProjector P j
  let G := P - F
  obtain ⟨hFs, hFt, hFi, hPF, hFP⟩ :=
    pivotProjector_properties P hsymm hidem j hj
  change F.transpose = F at hFs
  change Matrix.trace F = 1 at hFt
  change F * F = F at hFi
  change P * F = F at hPF
  change F * P = F at hFP
  have hGs : G.transpose = G := by simp only [G, Matrix.transpose_sub, hsymm, hFs]
  have hGi : G * G = G := by
    dsimp [G]
    noncomm_ring [hidem, hFi, hPF, hFP]
  have hFG : F * G = 0 := by dsimp [G]; noncomm_ring [hFi, hFP]
  have hGF : G * F = 0 := by dsimp [G]; noncomm_ring [hFi, hPF]
  let f := fromMatrix F
  let g := fromMatrix G
  have hf0 : f ≠ 0 := by
    intro hf
    have : F = 0 := by
      simpa only [f, toSymMatrix_fromMatrix hFs, toSymMatrix_zero] using
        congrArg toSymMatrix hf
    have : Matrix.trace F = 0 := by rw [this]; simp
    exact one_ne_zero (hFt.symm.trans this)
  have hfi : jordan f f = f := by
    apply (Function.LeftInverse.injective fromMatrix_toSymMatrix)
    simp only [f, toSymMatrix_jordan, toSymMatrix_fromMatrix hFs, matrixJordan_self, hFi]
  have hgi : jordan g g = g := by
    apply (Function.LeftInverse.injective fromMatrix_toSymMatrix)
    simp only [g, toSymMatrix_jordan, toSymMatrix_fromMatrix hGs, matrixJordan_self, hGi]
  have hfg : jordan f g = 0 := by
    apply (Function.LeftInverse.injective fromMatrix_toSymMatrix)
    simp only [f, g, toSymMatrix_jordan, toSymMatrix_fromMatrix hFs,
      toSymMatrix_fromMatrix hGs, matrixJordan, hFG, hGF, add_zero, smul_zero, toSymMatrix_zero]
  have hsum : f + g = e := by
    change fromMatrix F + fromMatrix (P - F) = e
    rw [← fromMatrix_add, add_sub_cancel]
    exact fromMatrix_toSymMatrix e

  rcases he.2.2 f g hfi hgi hfg hsum with hf | hg
  · exact (hf0 hf).elim
  · have hG : G = 0 := by
      simpa only [g, toSymMatrix_fromMatrix hGs, toSymMatrix_zero] using
        congrArg toSymMatrix hg
    have hPF' : P = F := sub_eq_zero.mp hG
    rw [← trace_toSymMatrix, show toSymMatrix e = P from rfl, hPF', hFt]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3PrimitiveDictionary.trace_one_idempotent_isPrimitive
statement:
theorem trace_one_idempotent_isPrimitive (e : Sym3Coord K)
    (hidem : jordan e e = e) (htrace : matrixTrace e = 1) :
    IsJordanPrimitiveIdempotent e
proof:
:= by
  let P := toSymMatrix e
  have hsymm : P.transpose = P := toSymMatrix_symmetric e
  have hidemP : P * P = P := by
    have h := congrArg toSymMatrix hidem
    simpa only [P, toSymMatrix_jordan, matrixJordan_self] using h
  have htraceP : Matrix.trace P = 1 := by simpa [P, trace_toSymMatrix] using htrace
  have he0 : e ≠ 0 := by
    intro he
    rw [he, matrixTrace] at htrace
    simpa using htrace
  refine ⟨hidem, he0, ?_⟩
  intro f g hfi hgi hfg hsum
  let F := toSymMatrix f
  let G := toSymMatrix g
  have hFi : F * F = F := by
    have h := congrArg toSymMatrix hfi
    simpa only [F, toSymMatrix_jordan, matrixJordan_self] using h
  have hGi : G * G = G := by
    have h := congrArg toSymMatrix hgi
    simpa only [G, toSymMatrix_jordan, matrixJordan_self] using h
  have horth : matrixJordan F G = 0 := by
    have h := congrArg toSymMatrix hfg
    simpa [F, G, toSymMatrix_jordan] using h
  obtain ⟨hFG, hGF⟩ := jordan_orthogonal_idempotents_mul_zero F G hFi hGi horth
  have hPsum : F + G = P := by
    simpa [F, G, P] using congrArg toSymMatrix hsum
  have hPF : P * F = F := by rw [← hPsum]; noncomm_ring [hFi, hGF]
  have hFP : F * P = F := by rw [← hPsum]; noncomm_ring [hFi, hFG]
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := RealPrimitiveFiniteRoots.exists_nonzero_diagonal P htraceP
  have hfactor := trace_one_pivot_factor P hsymm hidemP htraceP j hj
  have hcorner := corner_scalar P F (fun i => P i j) (P j j) hfactor hPF hFP
  let lam := Matrix.trace F
  change F = lam • P at hcorner
  have hlamM : (lam * lam) • P = lam • P := by
    calc
      (lam * lam) • P = (lam • P) * (lam • P) := by
        rw [Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, smul_smul, hidemP]
      _ = F * F := by rw [← hcorner]
      _ = F := hFi
      _ = lam • P := hcorner
  have hlam : lam ^ 2 = lam := by
    have ht := congrArg Matrix.trace hlamM
    simpa only [Matrix.trace_smul, htraceP, smul_eq_mul, mul_one, pow_two] using ht
  have hlam01 : lam = 0 ∨ lam = 1 := by
    have hz : lam * (lam - 1) = 0 := by
      calc
        lam * (lam - 1) = lam ^ 2 - lam := by ring
        _ = 0 := sub_eq_zero.mpr hlam
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hz with h0 | h1
    · exact Or.inl h0
    · exact Or.inr (sub_eq_zero.mp h1)
  rcases hlam01 with hl0 | hl1
  · left
    have hF0 : F = 0 := by simpa only [hl0, zero_smul] using hcorner
    apply (Function.LeftInverse.injective fromMatrix_toSymMatrix)
    simpa only [F, toSymMatrix_zero] using hF0
  · right
    have hFP' : F = P := by simpa only [hl1, one_smul] using hcorner
    have hsum' : P + G = P + 0 := by simpa only [hFP', add_zero] using hPsum
    have hG0 : G = 0 := add_left_cancel hsum'
    apply (Function.LeftInverse.injective fromMatrix_toSymMatrix)
    simpa only [G, toSymMatrix_zero] using hG0

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3PrimitiveDictionary.primitive_iff_idempotent_and_trace_one
statement:
theorem primitive_iff_idempotent_and_trace_one (e : Sym3Coord K) :
    IsJordanPrimitiveIdempotent e ↔ jordan e e = e ∧ matrixTrace e = 1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h; exact ⟨h.1, primitive_idempotent_matrixTrace_eq_one e h⟩
  · rintro ⟨hi, ht⟩; exact trace_one_idempotent_isPrimitive e hi ht

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3PrimitiveDictionary.primitiveFrame_iff_raw_trace_one_frame
statement:
theorem primitiveFrame_iff_raw_trace_one_frame (e : Fin 3 → Sym3Coord K) :
    IsJordanPrimitiveFrame e ↔
      (∀ i, jordan (e i) (e i) = e i) ∧
      (∀ i, matrixTrace (e i) = 1) ∧
      e 0 + e 1 + e 2 = one
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hprim, horth, hsum⟩
    refine ⟨fun i => (primitive_iff_idempotent_and_trace_one (e i)).mp
      (hprim i) |>.1, ?_, hsum⟩
    intro i
    exact (primitive_iff_idempotent_and_trace_one (e i)).mp (hprim i) |>.2
  · rintro ⟨hidem, htrace, hsum⟩
    refine ⟨fun i => (primitive_iff_idempotent_and_trace_one (e i)).mpr
      ⟨hidem i, htrace i⟩, ?_, hsum⟩
    exact trace_one_coordinate_frame_jordan_zero e hidem htrace hsum

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealConstantAction.constantAction_algebraMap_reduced
statement:
@[simp] theorem constantAction_algebraMap_reduced (Q : Mat3 k)
    (hQTQ : Matrix.transpose Q * Q = 1)
    (hQQT : Q * Matrix.transpose Q = 1) (x : ReducedCoordinateRing k) :
    constantAction k Q hQTQ hQQT
        (algebraMap (ReducedCoordinateRing k) (K k) x) =
      algebraMap (ReducedCoordinateRing k) (K k)
        (reducedAction k Q hQTQ hQQT x)
proof:
:=
  IsFractionRing.ringEquivOfRingEquiv_algebraMap
    (reducedAction k Q hQTQ hQQT) x

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealConstantAction.reducedAction_scalar
statement:
@[simp] theorem reducedAction_scalar (Q : Mat3 k)
    (hQTQ : Matrix.transpose Q * Q = 1)
    (hQQT : Q * Matrix.transpose Q = 1) (c : k) :
    reducedAction k Q hQTQ hQQT
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (rawFrameIdeal (R := k)).radical (MvPolynomial.C c)) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (rawFrameIdeal (R := k)).radical (MvPolynomial.C c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show reducedAction k Q hQTQ hQQT
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (rawFrameIdeal (R := k)).radical (MvPolynomial.C c)) =
      reducedActionHom k Q hQTQ hQQT
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (rawFrameIdeal (R := k)).radical (MvPolynomial.C c)) from rfl]
  rw [reducedActionHom_mk]
  congr 1
  simp [rawAction, evaluationAlong]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealConstantAction.constantAction_scalar
statement:
@[simp] theorem constantAction_scalar (Q : Mat3 k)
    (hQTQ : Matrix.transpose Q * Q = 1)
    (hQQT : Q * Matrix.transpose Q = 1) (c : k) :
    constantAction k Q hQTQ hQQT (scalarMap k c) = scalarMap k c
proof:
:= by
  rw [show scalarMap k c =
      algebraMap (ReducedCoordinateRing k) (K k)
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (rawFrameIdeal (R := k)).radical (MvPolynomial.C c)) from rfl]
  rw [constantAction_algebraMap_reduced, reducedAction_scalar]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealConstantAction.constantAction_universal_generator
statement:
theorem constantAction_universal_generator (Q : Mat3 k)
    (hQTQ : Matrix.transpose Q * Q = 1)
    (hQQT : Q * Matrix.transpose Q = 1) (r i a b : Fin 3) :
    constantAction k Q hQTQ hQQT
        (rawToField k (universalMatrix r i a b)) =
      rawToField k
        (ringConjugate (coefficientMatrix k Q) (universalMatrix r i) a b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show rawToField k (universalMatrix r i a b) =
      algebraMap (ReducedCoordinateRing k) (K k)
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (rawFrameIdeal (R := k)).radical
          (universalMatrix r i a b)) from rfl]
  rw [constantAction_algebraMap_reduced]
  change algebraMap (ReducedCoordinateRing k) (K k)
      (reducedActionHom k Q hQTQ hQQT
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (rawFrameIdeal (R := k)).radical
          (universalMatrix r i a b))) = _
  rw [reducedActionHom_mk, rawAction_universalMatrix]
  rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealConstantAction.constantAction_symm
statement:
theorem constantAction_symm (Q : Mat3 k)
    (hQTQ : Matrix.transpose Q * Q = 1)
    (hQQT : Q * Matrix.transpose Q = 1) :
    (constantAction k Q hQTQ hQQT).symm =
      constantAction k (Matrix.transpose Q)
        (by simpa using hQQT) (by simpa using hQTQ)
proof:
:= by
  have hs : (reducedAction k Q hQTQ hQQT).symm =
      reducedAction k (Matrix.transpose Q)
        (by simpa using hQQT) (by simpa using hQTQ) := by
    apply RingEquiv.ext
    intro x
    rfl
  apply RingEquiv.ext
  intro x
  obtain ⟨a, b, hb, rfl⟩ :=
    IsFractionRing.div_surjective (ReducedCoordinateRing k) x
  simp [constantAction, map_div₀, hs]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealConstantAction.scalar_mem_constantInvariantField
statement:
theorem scalar_mem_constantInvariantField (c : k) :
    scalarMap k c ∈ constantInvariantField k
proof:
:= by
  intro Q hQTQ hQQT
  exact constantAction_scalar k Q hQTQ hQQT c

name: AlbertLean.Generic.DetectorFieldSandwich.subfield_eq_of_deck_moved
statement:
theorem subfield_eq_of_deck_moved (D : Data (k := k) (Ω := Ω))
    (R : Subfield Ω) (hbase : ∀ a : k, algebraMap k Ω a ∈ R)
    (hfixed : R ≤ D.fixedField) (w : Ω) (hw : w ∈ R)
    (hsep : D.delta w ≠ w) : R = D.fixedField
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab⟩ := (D.tau_fixed_iff w).mp (hfixed hw)
  have hb : algebraMap k Ω b ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hsep
    rw [hab, h, zero_mul, add_zero]
    exact D.delta.commutes a
  have hu : D.u = (w - algebraMap k Ω a) / algebraMap k Ω b := by
    apply (eq_div_iff hb).2
    rw [hab]
    ring
  have huR : D.u ∈ R := by
    rw [hu]
    exact R.div_mem (R.sub_mem hw (hbase a)) (hbase b)
  apply le_antisymm hfixed
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨c, d, hcd⟩ := (D.tau_fixed_iff x).mp hx
  rw [hcd]
  exact R.add_mem (hbase c) (R.mul_mem (hbase d) huR)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.DetectorFieldSandwich.detector_generates
statement:
theorem detector_generates (D : Data (k := k) (Ω := Ω))
    (w : Ω) (hw : D.tau w = w) (hsep : D.delta w ≠ w) :
    Subfield.closure (Set.range (algebraMap k Ω) ∪ {w}) = D.fixedField
proof:
:= by
  apply subfield_eq_of_deck_moved D _
  · intro a
    exact Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inl ⟨a, rfl⟩)
  · apply Subfield.closure_le.mpr
    intro x hx
    rcases hx with ⟨a, rfl⟩ | hx
    · exact D.tau.commutes a
    · rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hx]
      exact hw
  · exact Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inr (Set.mem_singleton w))
  · exact hsep

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.ReducedOrthogonalAction.ringConjugate_ringConjugate
statement:
theorem ringConjugate_ringConjugate {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (Q Rm A : Mat3 R) :
    ringConjugate Rm (ringConjugate Q A) = ringConjugate (Rm * Q) A
proof:
:= by
  simp [ringConjugate, Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.ReducedOrthogonalAction.rawAction_coefficientMatrix
statement:
theorem rawAction_coefficientMatrix (Q Rm : Mat3 k) :
    (rawAction k Q).mapMatrix (coefficientMatrix k Rm) = coefficientMatrix k Rm
proof:
:= by
  ext a b
  simp [rawAction, coefficientMatrix, evaluationAlong]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.ReducedOrthogonalAction.rawAction_map_ringConjugate_universal
statement:
theorem rawAction_map_ringConjugate_universal (Q Rm : Mat3 k) (r i : Fin 3) :
    (rawAction k Q).mapMatrix
        (ringConjugate (coefficientMatrix k Rm) (universalMatrix r i)) =
      ringConjugate (coefficientMatrix k Rm)
        (ringConjugate (coefficientMatrix k Q) (universalMatrix r i))
proof:
:= by
  have hm := rawAction_coefficientMatrix k Q Rm
  have hmT : (rawAction k Q).mapMatrix (Matrix.transpose (coefficientMatrix k Rm)) =
      Matrix.transpose (coefficientMatrix k Rm) := by
    funext a b
    exact congrFun (congrFun hm b) a
  have hU : (rawAction k Q).mapMatrix (universalMatrix r i) =
      ringConjugate (coefficientMatrix k Q) (universalMatrix r i) := by
    funext a b
    exact rawAction_universalMatrix k Q r i a b
  simp only [ringConjugate, map_mul, hm, hmT, hU]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.ReducedOrthogonalAction.rawAction_comp
statement:
theorem rawAction_comp (Q Rm : Mat3 k) :
    (rawAction k Q).comp (rawAction k Rm) = rawAction k (Rm * Q)
proof:
:= by
  apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
  · intro c
    simp [rawAction, evaluationAlong]
  · intro x
    cases x with
    | entry r i a b =>
        change rawAction k Q (rawAction k Rm (universalMatrix r i a b)) =
          rawAction k (Rm * Q) (universalMatrix r i a b)
        rw [rawAction_universalMatrix]
        have h := congrFun (congrFun
          (rawAction_map_ringConjugate_universal k Q Rm r i) a) b
        change rawAction k Q
          (ringConjugate (coefficientMatrix k Rm) (universalMatrix r i) a b) =
          ringConjugate (coefficientMatrix k Rm)
            (ringConjugate (coefficientMatrix k Q) (universalMatrix r i)) a b at h
        rw [h, ringConjugate_ringConjugate]
        rw [rawAction_universalMatrix]
        have hm : coefficientMatrix k (Rm * Q) =
            coefficientMatrix k Rm * coefficientMatrix k Q := map_mul _ _ _
        rw [hm]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.ReducedOrthogonalAction.rawAction_one
statement: theorem rawAction_one : rawAction k (1 : Mat3 k) = RingHom.id _
proof:
:= by
  apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
  · intro c
    simp [rawAction, evaluationAlong]
  · intro x
    cases x with
    | entry r i a b =>
        change rawAction k 1 (universalMatrix r i a b) = universalMatrix r i a b
        rw [rawAction_universalMatrix]
        have h1 : coefficientMatrix k 1 = 1 := map_one _
        simp [h1, ringConjugate]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.ReducedOrthogonalAction.rawAction_comp_transpose
statement:
theorem rawAction_comp_transpose (Q : Mat3 k)
    (hQTQ : Matrix.transpose Q * Q = 1) :
    (rawAction k Q).comp (rawAction k (Matrix.transpose Q)) = RingHom.id _
proof:
:= by
  rw [rawAction_comp, hQTQ, rawAction_one]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.ReducedOrthogonalAction.rawAction_transpose_comp
statement:
theorem rawAction_transpose_comp (Q : Mat3 k)
    (hQQT : Q * Matrix.transpose Q = 1) :
    (rawAction k (Matrix.transpose Q)).comp (rawAction k Q) = RingHom.id _
proof:
:= by
  rw [rawAction_comp, hQQT, rawAction_one]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.ReducedOrthogonalAction.radical_stable
statement:
theorem radical_stable (Q : Mat3 k)
    (hQTQ : Matrix.transpose Q * Q = 1) (hQQT : Q * Matrix.transpose Q = 1) :
    (rawFrameIdeal (R := k)).radical ≤
      (rawFrameIdeal (R := k)).radical.comap (rawAction k Q)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := (Ideal.mem_radical_iff.mp hx)
  apply Ideal.mem_radical_iff.mpr
  refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
  rw [← map_pow]
  exact map_rawFrameIdeal_le k Q hQTQ hQQT
    (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (rawAction k Q) hn)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.ReducedOrthogonalAction.reducedActionHom_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem reducedActionHom_mk (Q : Mat3 k)
    (hQTQ : Matrix.transpose Q * Q = 1) (hQQT : Q * Matrix.transpose Q = 1)
    (x : CoordinateRing k) :
    reducedActionHom k Q hQTQ hQQT (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ x) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (rawAction k Q x)
proof:
:= by
  exact Ideal.quotientMap_mk

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericRootAwayTorsionFree.away_isTorsionFree
statement:
theorem away_isTorsionFree
    {A B S : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [CommRing B] [CommRing S]
    [Algebra A B] [Module.IsTorsionFree A B]
    [Algebra B S] [Algebra A S] [IsScalarTower A B S]
    (D : B) [IsLocalization.Away D S] :
    Module.IsTorsionFree A S
proof:
:= by
  apply Module.IsTorsionFree.of_smul_eq_zero
  intro a z haz
  by_cases ha : a = 0
  · exact Or.inl ha
  right
  obtain ⟨n, b, hzb⟩ := IsLocalization.Away.surj D z
  have habmap : algebraMap B S (a • b) = 0 := by
    calc
      algebraMap B S (a • b) = a • algebraMap B S b :=
        map_smul (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom A B S) a b
      _ = a • (z * algebraMap B S D ^ n) := by rw [hzb]
      _ = (a • z) * algebraMap B S D ^ n := (smul_mul_assoc a z _).symm
      _ = 0 := by rw [haz, zero_mul]
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := IsLocalization.Away.exists_of_eq D
    (habmap.trans (map_zero (algebraMap B S)).symm)
  have hab : a • (D ^ m * b) = 0 := by
    simpa only [Algebra.smul_def, mul_zero, mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm]
      using hm
  have hDb : D ^ m * b = 0 :=
    ((Module.isTorsionFree_iff_smul_eq_zero.mp inferInstance)
      a (D ^ m * b) hab).resolve_left ha
  have hb : algebraMap B S b = 0 := by
    apply (IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_pow_isUnit (S := S) D m).mul_left_cancel
    simpa only [← map_pow, ← map_mul, hDb, map_zero, mul_zero]
  apply (IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_pow_isUnit (S := S) D n).mul_left_cancel
  rw [mul_comm (algebraMap B S D ^ n) z, hzb, hb, mul_zero]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericRootAwayTorsionFree.quadraticRootEval_omega
statement:
@[simp] theorem quadraticRootEval_omega (w : B →+* L) (c : B) (r : L)
    (hr : r ^ 2 = w c) :
    quadraticRootEval w c r hr QuadraticAlgebra.omega = r
proof:
:= by
  simp [quadraticRootEval, Algebra.smul_def]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericRootAwayTorsionFree.rootOmega_sq
statement:
theorem rootOmega_sq (c : B) (D : QuadraticRootRing c) :
    rootOmega c D ^ 2 =
      algebraMap (QuadraticRootRing c) (QuadraticRootAway c D)
        (algebraMap B (QuadraticRootRing c) c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rootOmega, pow_two, ← map_mul]
  simpa only [map_zero, zero_mul, add_zero] using congrArg
    (algebraMap (QuadraticRootRing c) (QuadraticRootAway c D))
    (QuadraticAlgebra.omega_mul_omega_eq_algebraMap
      (R := B) (a := c) (b := 0))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericRootAwayTorsionFree.quadraticRootAwayEval_rootOmega
statement:
@[simp] theorem quadraticRootAwayEval_rootOmega
    (w : B →+* L) (c : B) (r : L) (hr : r ^ 2 = w c)
    (D : QuadraticRootRing c) (hD : quadraticRootEval w c r hr D ≠ 0) :
    quadraticRootAwayEval w c r hr D hD (rootOmega c D) = r
proof:
:= by
  rw [rootOmega, quadraticRootAwayEval, IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq]
  exact quadraticRootEval_omega w c r hr

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericRootAwayTorsionFree.quadraticRootAway_nontrivial
statement:
theorem quadraticRootAway_nontrivial
    (w : B →+* L) (c : B) (r : L) (hr : r ^ 2 = w c)
    (D : QuadraticRootRing c) (hD : quadraticRootEval w c r hr D ≠ 0) :
    Nontrivial (QuadraticRootAway c D)
proof:
:=
  (quadraticRootAwayEval w c r hr D hD).domain_nontrivial

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericRootAwayTorsionFree.quadraticRootAway_isTorsionFree
statement:
theorem quadraticRootAway_isTorsionFree
    (w : B →+* L) (c : B) (r : L) (hr : r ^ 2 = w c)
    (D : QuadraticRootRing c) (hD : quadraticRootEval w c r hr D ≠ 0) :
    Module.IsTorsionFree A (QuadraticRootAway c D)
proof:
:= by
  exact away_isTorsionFree D

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.columnProjector_eq_frameOfOrthogonal
statement:
theorem columnProjector_eq_frameOfOrthogonal (X : Mat3 K) (i : Fin 3) :
    columnProjector X i = frameOfOrthogonal X i
proof:
:= by
  ext r c
  fin_cases i <;> simp [columnProjector, frameOfOrthogonal, orthogonalConjugate,
    FourRowProbeTrace.diagonalUnit, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply,
    Fin.sum_univ_succ]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.columnProjector_trace_one
statement:
theorem columnProjector_trace_one (X : Mat3 K) (hX : IsOrthogonal X)
    (i : Fin 3) : Matrix.trace (columnProjector X i) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [columnProjector_eq_frameOfOrthogonal X i]
  unfold frameOfOrthogonal
  rw [orthogonalConjugate_trace X (FourRowProbeTrace.diagonalUnit i) hX]
  simpa [Matrix.one_apply] using FourRowProbeTrace.trace_diagonalUnit
    (1 : Mat3 K) i

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.columnProjector_mul_self
statement:
theorem columnProjector_mul_self (X : Mat3 K) (hX : IsOrthogonal X)
    (i : Fin 3) : columnProjector X i * columnProjector X i =
      columnProjector X i
proof:
:= by
  rw [columnProjector_eq_frameOfOrthogonal,
    frameOfOrthogonal_idempotent X hX]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.columnProjector_sum
statement:
theorem columnProjector_sum (X : Mat3 K) (hX : IsOrthogonal X) :
    columnProjector X 0 + columnProjector X 1 + columnProjector X 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [columnProjector_eq_frameOfOrthogonal] using
    frameOfOrthogonal_sum X hX

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.frameOfOrthogonal_mul_zero_of_ne
statement:
theorem frameOfOrthogonal_mul_zero_of_ne (X : Mat3 K) (hX : IsOrthogonal X)
    (i j : Fin 3) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    frameOfOrthogonal X i * frameOfOrthogonal X j = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold frameOfOrthogonal
  rw [← orthogonalConjugate_mul X _ _ hX]
  have hd : FourRowProbeTrace.diagonalUnit i *
      FourRowProbeTrace.diagonalUnit j = (0 : Mat3 K) := by
    ext r c
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp_all [FourRowProbeTrace.diagonalUnit,
      Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  rw [hd]
  simp [orthogonalConjugate]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.columnProjector_mul_zero_of_ne
statement:
theorem columnProjector_mul_zero_of_ne (X : Mat3 K) (hX : IsOrthogonal X)
    (i j : Fin 3) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    columnProjector X i * columnProjector X j = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [columnProjector_eq_frameOfOrthogonal,
    columnProjector_eq_frameOfOrthogonal]
  exact frameOfOrthogonal_mul_zero_of_ne X hX i j hij

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.embeddedColumnProjectors_tauFrame
statement:
theorem embeddedColumnProjectors_tauFrame (X : Mat3 K) (hX : IsOrthogonal X) :
    TauFrame (fun i => embed (columnProjector X i))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    change TauCeti.AlbertAlgebra.trace (toTau (columnProjector X i, 0, 0)) = 1
    rw [tauTrace_toTau]
    exact columnProjector_trace_one X hX i
  · intro i
    rw [← embed_matrixJordan]
    congr 1
    simp only [matrixJordan, columnProjector_mul_self X hX i,
      ← two_smul K (columnProjector X i), smul_smul, invOf_mul_self, one_smul]
  · unfold embed
    rw [← map_add, ← map_add]
    rw [← TitsLinear.toTau_firstTitsOne]
    apply congrArg toTau
    apply Prod.ext
    · exact columnProjector_sum X hX
    · apply Prod.ext <;> change (0 : Mat3 K) + 0 + 0 = 0 <;> simp
  · rw [← embed_matrixJordan]
    congr 1
    simp [matrixJordan, embed, columnProjector_mul_zero_of_ne X hX 0 1 (by decide),
      columnProjector_mul_zero_of_ne X hX 1 0 (by decide)]
  · rw [← embed_matrixJordan]
    congr 1
    simp [matrixJordan, embed, columnProjector_mul_zero_of_ne X hX 0 2 (by decide),
      columnProjector_mul_zero_of_ne X hX 2 0 (by decide)]
  · rw [← embed_matrixJordan]
    congr 1
    simp [matrixJordan, embed, columnProjector_mul_zero_of_ne X hX 1 2 (by decide),
      columnProjector_mul_zero_of_ne X hX 2 1 (by decide)]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.hasRealFrameLabels_of_orthogonal
statement:
theorem hasRealFrameLabels_of_orthogonal (X : Mat3 K) (hX : IsOrthogonal X) :
    HasRealFrameLabels X
proof:
:= by
  have he : realFrameEncoder X =
      embed (columnProjector X 2) - embed (columnProjector X 0) := by
    unfold realFrameEncoder encoder embed
    rw [← map_sub]
    apply congrArg toTau
    apply Prod.ext
    · rfl
    · apply Prod.ext <;> simp
  unfold HasRealFrameLabels
  rw [he]
  exact hasProjectorLabels_of_tauFrame
    (fun i => embed (columnProjector X i))
    (embeddedColumnProjectors_tauFrame X hX)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.projectorTriple_related_of_acceptedLedger_eq_of_orthogonal
statement:
theorem projectorTriple_related_of_acceptedLedger_eq_of_orthogonal
    (X Y Z X' Y' Z' : Mat3 K)
    (hX : IsOrthogonal X) (hY : IsOrthogonal Y) (hZ : IsOrthogonal Z)
    (hX' : IsOrthogonal X') (hY' : IsOrthogonal Y') (hZ' : IsOrthogonal Z')
    (hUnz : ∀ i j, overlap X Y i j ≠ 0)
    (hVnz : ∀ j l, overlap Y Z j l ≠ 0)
    (hWnz : ∀ l i, overlap Z X l i ≠ 0)
    (hledger : labelledLedger (realFrameTauTriple X Y Z) =
      labelledLedger (realFrameTauTriple X' Y' Z')) :
    ∃ q : Mat3 K, IsOrthogonal q ∧
      (∀ i, orthogonalConjugate q (columnProjector X i) = columnProjector X' i) ∧
      (∀ j, orthogonalConjugate q (columnProjector Y j) = columnProjector Y' j) ∧
      (∀ l, orthogonalConjugate q (columnProjector Z l) = columnProjector Z' l)
proof:
:=
  projectorTriple_related_of_acceptedLedger_eq X Y Z X' Y' Z'
    hX hY hZ hX' hY' hZ'
    (hasRealFrameLabels_of_orthogonal X hX)
    (hasRealFrameLabels_of_orthogonal Y hY)
    (hasRealFrameLabels_of_orthogonal Z hZ)
    (hasRealFrameLabels_of_orthogonal X' hX')
    (hasRealFrameLabels_of_orthogonal Y' hY')
    (hasRealFrameLabels_of_orthogonal Z' hZ')
    hUnz hVnz hWnz hledger

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceEvenAutomorphism.reflectV_add
statement:
theorem reflectV_add (a v w : VCoord K) :
    reflectV a (v + w) = reflectV a v + reflectV a w
proof:
:= by
  rw [reflectV, reflectV, reflectV, BV_add_right]
  module

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceEvenAutomorphism.reflectV_smul
statement:
theorem reflectV_smul (a v : VCoord K) (k : K) :
    reflectV a (k • v) = k • reflectV a v
proof:
:= by
  rw [reflectV, reflectV, BV_smul_right]
  module

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceEvenAutomorphism.BV_reflectV
statement:
theorem BV_reflectV (a v : VCoord K) (ha : nV a ≠ 0) :
    BV a (reflectV a v) = -BV a v
proof:
:= by
  rw [reflectV, sub_eq_add_neg, ← neg_smul, BV_add_right,
    BV_smul_right, BV_self_eq_two_nV]
  field_simp [ha]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceEvenAutomorphism.reflectV_involutive
statement:
theorem reflectV_involutive (a v : VCoord K) (ha : nV a ≠ 0) :
    reflectV a (reflectV a v) = v
proof:
:= by
  rw [reflectV, BV_reflectV a v ha, reflectV]
  field_simp [ha]
  module

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceEvenAutomorphism.evenVLinear_apply

@[simp] theorem evenVLinear_apply (a b v : VCoord K) :

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceEvenAutomorphism.evenSLinear_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem evenSLinear_apply (a b : VCoord K) (rho : K) (s : SCoord K) :
    evenSLinear a b rho s = evenS a b rho s
proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceEvenAutomorphism.evenCLinear_apply

@[simp] theorem evenCLinear_apply (a b : VCoord K) (rho : K) (c : CCoord K) :

proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceEvenAutomorphism.evenJEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem evenJEquiv_apply (a b : VCoord K) (rho : K)
    (ha : nV a ≠ 0) (hb : nV b ≠ 0)
    (hrho : rho ^ 2 = nV a * nV b) (hrho0 : rho ≠ 0) (x : JCoord K) :
    evenJEquiv a b rho ha hb hrho hrho0 x =
      { d1 := x.d1, d2 := x.d2, d3 := x.d3
        v := evenV a b x.v
        s := evenS a b rho x.s
        c := evenC a b rho x.c }
proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceEvenAutomorphism.evenJEquiv_sourceNorm
statement:
theorem evenJEquiv_sourceNorm (a b : VCoord K) (rho : K)
    (ha : nV a ≠ 0) (hb : nV b ≠ 0)
    (hrho : rho ^ 2 = nV a * nV b) (hrho0 : rho ≠ 0) (x : JCoord K) :
    sourceNorm (evenJEquiv a b rho ha hb hrho hrho0 x) = sourceNorm x
proof:
:= by
  rw [evenJEquiv_apply, sourceNorm_formula, sourceNorm_formula,
    nV_evenV a b x.v ha hb, nS_evenS a b rho x.s hrho hrho0,
    nC_evenC a b rho x.c hrho hrho0,
    triality_even a b rho x.v x.s x.c ha hb hrho hrho0]

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceEvenAutomorphism.evenJEquiv_sourceOne
statement:
theorem evenJEquiv_sourceOne (a b : VCoord K) (rho : K)
    (ha : nV a ≠ 0) (hb : nV b ≠ 0)
    (hrho : rho ^ 2 = nV a * nV b) (hrho0 : rho ≠ 0) :
    evenJEquiv a b rho ha hb hrho hrho0 sourceOne = sourceOne
proof:
:= by
  apply JCoord.ext
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · exact (evenVEquiv a b ha hb).map_zero
  · exact (evenSEquiv a b rho hrho hrho0).map_zero
  · exact (evenCEquiv a b rho hrho hrho0).map_zero

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualAction.actS_smul

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualAction.actS_inverse_left

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualAction.actC_inverse_left

:=

  unfold Pf

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualAction.BV_actV
statement:
theorem BV_actV (G : DetOneMatrix K) (v w : VCoord K) :
    BV (actV G v) (actV G w) = BV v w

:= by
  simp only [BV, actV]
  rw [BW_wedgeAct_of_det_one G.g G.det_g]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualAction.nS_actS
statement:
theorem nS_actS (G : DetOneMatrix K) (s : SCoord K) :
    nS (actS G s) = nS s
proof:
:= by

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualAction.BS_actS
statement:
theorem BS_actS (G : DetOneMatrix K) (s t : SCoord K) :
    BS (actS G s) (actS G t) = BS s t
proof:
:= by
  simp only [BS, actS]
  rw [eval_act G, eval_act G]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualAction.nC_actC

theorem nC_actC (G : DetOneMatrix K) (c : CCoord K) :
