theorem BC_actC (G : DetOneMatrix K) (c d : CCoord K) :
    BC (actC G c) (actC G d) = BC c d
proof:
:= by
  simp only [BC, actC]
  rw [eval_act G, eval_act G]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualAction.triality_act
statement:
theorem triality_act (G : DetOneMatrix K)
    (v : VCoord K) (s : SCoord K) (c : CCoord K) :
    triality (actV G v) (actS G s) (actC G c) = triality v s c
proof:
:= by
  simp only [triality, actV, actS, actC]
  rw [eval_act G, eval_act G]
  rw [← wedgeAct_wedge2]
  rw [BW_wedgeAct_of_det_one G.g G.det_g]
  rw [pairW_wedgeAct_dualWedge G.g G.gInv G.gInv_mul_g]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualAction.sourceNorm_act
statement:
theorem sourceNorm_act (G : DetOneMatrix K) (x : JCoord K) :
    sourceNorm (act G x) = sourceNorm x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sourceNorm, act]
  rw [nV_actV G, nS_actS G, nC_actC G, triality_act G]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualAction.sourceOne_act
statement:
@[simp] theorem sourceOne_act (G : DetOneMatrix K) :
    act G (sourceOne : JCoord K) = sourceOne
proof:
:= by
  apply JCoord.ext
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · apply VCoord.ext
    · rfl
    · rfl
    · exact wedgeAct_zero G.g
  · apply SCoord.ext <;> simp [act, actS, sourceOne, vecAct, covAct]
  · apply CCoord.ext <;> simp [act, actC, sourceOne, vecAct, covAct]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualAction.sourceTrace_act
statement:
theorem sourceTrace_act (G : DetOneMatrix K) (x : JCoord K) :
    sourceTrace (act G x) = sourceTrace x
proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualAction.sourceTraceForm_act
statement:
theorem sourceTraceForm_act (G : DetOneMatrix K) (x y : JCoord K) :
    sourceTraceForm (act G x) (act G y) = sourceTraceForm x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [sourceTraceForm_formula, sourceTraceForm_formula]
  simp only [act]
  rw [BV_actV G, BS_actS G, BC_actC G]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualAction.sourcePolar_act
statement:
theorem sourcePolar_act (G : DetOneMatrix K) (x y z : JCoord K) :
    sourcePolar (act G x) (act G y) (act G z) = sourcePolar x y z
proof:
:= by
  have hxyz : sourceNorm (act G x + act G y + act G z) =
      sourceNorm (x + y + z) := by
    rw [← act_add G x y, ← act_add G (x + y) z, sourceNorm_act]
  have hxy : sourceNorm (act G x + act G y) = sourceNorm (x + y) := by
    rw [← act_add G x y, sourceNorm_act]
  have hxz : sourceNorm (act G x + act G z) = sourceNorm (x + z) := by
    rw [← act_add G x z, sourceNorm_act]
  have hyz : sourceNorm (act G y + act G z) = sourceNorm (y + z) := by
    rw [← act_add G y z, sourceNorm_act]
  simp only [sourcePolar, hxyz, hxy, hxz, hyz, sourceNorm_act]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualAction.sourceProduct_act
statement:
theorem sourceProduct_act (G : DetOneMatrix K) (x y : JCoord K) :
    act G (sourceProduct x y) = sourceProduct (act G x) (act G y)
proof:
:= by
  exact sourceProduct_invariant_of_cubic_unit
    (linearEquiv G) (sourceOne_act G) (sourceNorm_act G) x y

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualAction.act_compose
statement:
theorem act_compose (G H : DetOneMatrix K) (x : JCoord K) :
    act (compose G H) x = act G (act H x)
proof:
:= by
  apply JCoord.ext <;>
    simp [act, actV, actS, actC, compose, wedgeAct_mul,
      vecAct, covAct, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.vecMul_vecMul,
      Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualAction.linearEquiv_compose
statement:
theorem linearEquiv_compose (G H : DetOneMatrix K) :
    linearEquiv (compose G H) = (linearEquiv H).trans (linearEquiv G)
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearEquiv.ext
  intro x
  exact act_compose G H x

name: AlbertLean.Generic.DetectorSeparation.clearedA_eq_smul_laurentF
statement:
theorem clearedA_eq_smul_laurentF (F₀ VF : Coord) (t : ℚ)
    (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    clearedA F₀ VF t = t • laurentF F₀ VF t
proof:
:= by
  simp [clearedA, laurentF, smul_add, smul_smul, ht]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.DetectorSeparation.clearedB_eq_smul_laurentK
statement:
theorem clearedB_eq_smul_laurentK (K₀ U V : Coord) (t : ℚ)
    (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    clearedB K₀ U V t = t • laurentK K₀ U V t
proof:
:= by
  simp [clearedB, laurentK, smul_add, smul_smul, ht, pow_two]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.DetectorSeparation.swappedC_eq_smul_laurentF
statement:
theorem swappedC_eq_smul_laurentF (F₀ VF : Coord) (m t : ℚ)
    (hm : m ≠ 0) (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    swappedC F₀ VF m t = m • laurentF F₀ VF (m / t)
proof:
:= by
  have hscalar : m * (m / t)⁻¹ = t := by
    field_simp [hm, ht] <;> ring
  simp only [swappedC, laurentF, smul_add, smul_smul]
  rw [hscalar]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.DetectorSeparation.swappedH_eq_smul_laurentK
statement:
theorem swappedH_eq_smul_laurentK (K₀ U V : Coord) (m t : ℚ)
    (hm : m ≠ 0) (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    swappedH K₀ U V m t =
      (m * t) • laurentK K₀ U V (m / t)
proof:
:= by
  have hU : (m * t) * (m / t) = m ^ 2 := by
    field_simp [hm, ht] <;> ring
  have hV : (m * t) * (m / t)⁻¹ = t ^ 2 := by
    field_simp [hm, ht] <;> ring
  simp only [swappedH, laurentK, smul_add, smul_smul]
  rw [hU, hV]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.DetectorSeparation.detector_clearedAB
statement:
theorem detector_clearedAB (E F₀ VF K₀ U V : Coord) (t : ℚ)
    (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    traceCubeDetector ⟨E, clearedA F₀ VF t, clearedB K₀ U V t⟩ =
      t ^ 6 * traceCubeDetector (laurentTriple E F₀ VF K₀ U V t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [clearedA_eq_smul_laurentF F₀ VF t ht,
    clearedB_eq_smul_laurentK K₀ U V t ht]
  change traceCubeDetector
      ⟨E, t • laurentF F₀ VF t, t • laurentK K₀ U V t⟩ = _
  rw [traceCubeDetector_scaleFK]
  change (t * t) ^ 3 * traceCubeDetector
      (laurentTriple E F₀ VF K₀ U V t) = _
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.DetectorSeparation.detector_swappedCH
statement:
theorem detector_swappedCH (E F₀ VF K₀ U V : Coord) (m t : ℚ)
    (hm : m ≠ 0) (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    traceCubeDetector
        ⟨E, swappedC F₀ VF m t, swappedH K₀ U V m t⟩ =
      m ^ 6 * t ^ 3 *
        traceCubeDetector (laurentTriple E F₀ VF K₀ U V (m / t))
proof:
:= by
  rw [swappedC_eq_smul_laurentF F₀ VF m t hm ht,
    swappedH_eq_smul_laurentK K₀ U V m t hm ht]
  change traceCubeDetector
      ⟨E, m • laurentF F₀ VF (m / t),
        (m * t) • laurentK K₀ U V (m / t)⟩ = _
  rw [traceCubeDetector_scaleFK]
  change (m * (m * t)) ^ 3 *
      traceCubeDetector (laurentTriple E F₀ VF K₀ U V (m / t)) = _
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.DetectorSeparation.detectorDelta_eq
statement:
theorem detectorDelta_eq (E F₀ VF K₀ U V : Coord) (m t : ℚ)
    (hm : m ≠ 0) (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    detectorDelta E F₀ VF K₀ U V m t =
      m ^ 6 * t ^ 6 *
        (traceCubeDetector (laurentTriple E F₀ VF K₀ U V t) -
          traceCubeDetector (laurentTriple E F₀ VF K₀ U V (m / t)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [detectorDelta, detector_clearedAB E F₀ VF K₀ U V t ht,
    detector_swappedCH E F₀ VF K₀ U V m t hm ht]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.DetectorSeparation.detectorDelta_ne_zero_iff
statement:
theorem detectorDelta_ne_zero_iff (E F₀ VF K₀ U V : Coord) (m t : ℚ)
    (hm : m ≠ 0) (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    detectorDelta E F₀ VF K₀ U V m t ≠ 0 ↔
      traceCubeDetector (laurentTriple E F₀ VF K₀ U V t) ≠
        traceCubeDetector (laurentTriple E F₀ VF K₀ U V (m / t))
proof:
:= by
  have hfactor : m ^ 6 * t ^ 6 ≠ 0 :=
    mul_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero 6 hm) (pow_ne_zero 6 ht)
  constructor
  · intro hDelta heq
    apply hDelta
    rw [detectorDelta_eq E F₀ VF K₀ U V m t hm ht, heq, sub_self,
      mul_zero]
  · intro hdet hDelta
    have hmul :
        m ^ 6 * t ^ 6 *
            (traceCubeDetector (laurentTriple E F₀ VF K₀ U V t) -
              traceCubeDetector
                (laurentTriple E F₀ VF K₀ U V (m / t))) = 0 := by
      rw [← detectorDelta_eq E F₀ VF K₀ U V m t hm ht]
      exact hDelta
    have hdiff :
        traceCubeDetector (laurentTriple E F₀ VF K₀ U V t) -
            traceCubeDetector (laurentTriple E F₀ VF K₀ U V (m / t)) = 0 :=
      (mul_eq_zero.mp hmul).resolve_left hfactor
    exact hdet (sub_eq_zero.mp hdiff)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.coordinateConjugate_comp
statement:
theorem coordinateConjugate_comp
    (L : Vec6 K ≃ₗ[K] Vec6 K) (A B : Vec6 K →ₗ[K] Vec6 K) :
    coordinateConjugate L (A.comp B) =
      (coordinateConjugate L A).comp (coordinateConjugate L B)
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  simp [coordinateConjugate, LinearMap.comp_apply]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.coordinateConjugate_zero
statement:
theorem coordinateConjugate_zero
    (L : Vec6 K ≃ₗ[K] Vec6 K) :
    coordinateConjugate L (0 : Vec6 K →ₗ[K] Vec6 K) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  simp [coordinateConjugate]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.coordinateConjugate_first_projector
statement:
theorem coordinateConjugate_first_projector
    (E : Fin 3 → Carrier K) (F0 : Carrier K)
    (hEidem : ∀ i, (E i : Mat6 K) * E i = E i)
    (hEsum : (E 0 : Mat6 K) + E 1 + E 2 = 1)
    (u v : Vec6 K) (p : Fin 3 → K)
    (hp : ∀ i, p i = (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u)
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v)) (hpne : ∀ i, p i ≠ 0)
    (hFu : ∀ i, matrixAction (F0 : Mat6 K)
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u) = p i • u)
    (hFv : ∀ i, matrixAction (F0 : Mat6 K)
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v) = p i • v) :
    coordinateConjugate
      (weightedCoordinateEquiv E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne)
      (matrixAction (F0 : Mat6 K)) = weightedFirstAction p
proof:
:= by
  let L := weightedCoordinateEquiv E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne
  have hinter := first_projector_intertwines_weighted_coordinates
    E F0 hEsum u v p hFu hFv
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  change L.symm (matrixAction (F0 : Mat6 K) (L x)) = weightedFirstAction p x
  have hx := LinearMap.congr_fun hinter x
  change matrixAction (F0 : Mat6 K) (L x) = L (weightedFirstAction p x) at hx
  rw [hx, L.symm_apply_apply]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.actual_second_projector_weighted_zero_compositions
statement:
theorem actual_second_projector_weighted_zero_compositions
    (E F : Fin 3 → Carrier K)
    (hEidem : ∀ i, (E i : Mat6 K) * E i = E i)
    (hEsum : (E 0 : Mat6 K) + E 1 + E 2 = 1)
    (hFidem : ∀ i, (F i : Mat6 K) * F i = F i)
    (hFsum : (F 0 : Mat6 K) + F 1 + F 2 = 1)
    (u v : Vec6 K) (p : Fin 3 → K)
    (hp : ∀ i, p i = (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u)
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v)) (hpne : ∀ i, p i ≠ 0)
    (hFu : ∀ i, matrixAction (F 0 : Mat6 K)
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u) = p i • u)
    (hFv : ∀ i, matrixAction (F 0 : Mat6 K)
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v) = p i • v) :
    let L
proof:
:= weightedCoordinateEquiv E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne
    let B := coordinateConjugate L (matrixAction (F 1 : Mat6 K))
    B.comp (weightedFirstAction p) = 0 ∧
      (weightedFirstAction p).comp B = 0 := by
  let Q : Fin 3 → Vec6 K →ₗ[K] Vec6 K :=
    fun i => matrixAction (K := K) (F i : Mat6 K)
  have hQi : ∀ i, IsIdempotent (Q i) :=
    fun i => carrier_projector_action_idempotent (F i) (hFidem i)
  have hQsum : Q 0 + Q 1 + Q 2 = LinearMap.id :=
    carrier_frame_action_sum F hFsum
  have h10 := comp_zero_of_complete_frame Q hQi hQsum 1 0 (by decide)
  have h01 := comp_zero_of_complete_frame Q hQi hQsum 0 1 (by decide)
  let L := weightedCoordinateEquiv E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne
  have hP := coordinateConjugate_first_projector E (F 0) hEidem hEsum
    u v p hp hpne hFu hFv
  dsimp only
  constructor
  · rw [← hP, ← coordinateConjugate_comp, h10,
      coordinateConjugate_zero]
  · rw [← hP, ← coordinateConjugate_comp, h01,
      coordinateConjugate_zero]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.weighted_block_zero_sums
statement:
theorem weighted_block_zero_sums
    (B : Vec6 K →ₗ[K] Vec6 K) (p : Fin 3 → K) (hp0 : p 0 ≠ 0)
    (hrow : B.comp (weightedFirstAction p) = 0)
    (hcol : (weightedFirstAction p).comp B = 0) :
    (∀ i r s, ∑ j, weightedBlock B i j r s = 0) ∧
      (∀ j r s, ∑ i, p i * weightedBlock B i j r s = 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hfirst (s : Fin 2) :
      weightedFirstAction p (basisVector (weightedPairIndex 0 s)) =
        p 0 • ∑ j : Fin 3, basisVector (weightedPairIndex j s) := by
    funext q
    fin_cases s <;> rcases q with q | q <;> fin_cases q <;>
      simp [weightedFirstAction, weightedPairIndex, basisVector,
        Pi.single_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  constructor
  · intro i r s
    have h := congrFun (LinearMap.congr_fun hrow
      (basisVector (weightedPairIndex 0 s))) (weightedPairIndex i r)
    rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, hfirst, map_smul, map_sum] at h
    simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Finset.sum_apply] at h
    fin_cases r <;> fin_cases s
    all_goals
      simp [LinearMap.comp_apply, weightedFirstAction, weightedBlock,
        weightedPairIndex, basisVector, Pi.single_apply,
        Fin.sum_univ_succ] at h ⊢
      exact h.resolve_left hp0
  · intro j r s
    have h := congrFun (LinearMap.congr_fun hcol
      (basisVector (weightedPairIndex j s))) (weightedPairIndex 0 r)
    fin_cases r <;> fin_cases s
    all_goals
      simpa [LinearMap.comp_apply, weightedFirstAction, weightedBlock,
        weightedPairIndex, basisVector, Pi.single_apply,
        Fin.sum_univ_succ] using h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.weighted_pairing_extract
statement:
theorem weighted_pairing_extract
    (E : Fin 3 → Carrier K)
    (hEidem : ∀ i, (E i : Mat6 K) * E i = E i)
    (hEsum : (E 0 : Mat6 K) + E 1 + E 2 = 1)
    (u v : Vec6 K) (p : Fin 3 → K)
    (hp : ∀ i, p i = (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u)
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v)) (z : Vec6 K) (i : Fin 3) :
    (omega (K := K)) (weightedCoordinateLinear E u v z)
        (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v) = z (Sum.inl i) * p i ∧
      (omega (K := K)) (weightedCoordinateLinear E u v z)
        (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u) = -(z (Sum.inr i) * p i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨huv, huu, hvv⟩ := weighted_pairings E hEidem hEsum u v p hp
  have hrev (j : Fin 3) :
      (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E j : Mat6 K) v)
        (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u) =
        if j = i then -(p j) else 0 := by
    by_cases hji : j = i
    · subst i
      rw [if_pos rfl]
      exact skew_of_alternating (omega (K := K)) omega_alternating _ _ |>.trans
        (by rw [← hp j])
    · rw [if_neg hji]
      exact carrier_frame_images_orthogonal E hEidem hEsum hji v u
  constructor
  · simp [weightedCoordinateLinear, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.sum_apply,
      LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, huv, hvv]
  · simp [weightedCoordinateLinear, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.sum_apply,
      LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, huu, hrev]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.weighted_pairing_extract_reverse
statement:
theorem weighted_pairing_extract_reverse
    (E : Fin 3 → Carrier K)
    (hEidem : ∀ i, (E i : Mat6 K) * E i = E i)
    (hEsum : (E 0 : Mat6 K) + E 1 + E 2 = 1)
    (u v : Vec6 K) (p : Fin 3 → K)
    (hp : ∀ i, p i = (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u)
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v)) (z : Vec6 K) (i : Fin 3) :
    (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u)
        (weightedCoordinateLinear E u v z) = z (Sum.inr i) * p i ∧
      (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v)
        (weightedCoordinateLinear E u v z) = -(z (Sum.inl i) * p i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := weighted_pairing_extract E hEidem hEsum u v p hp z i
  constructor
  · rw [skew_of_alternating (omega (K := K)) omega_alternating]
    linear_combination -h2
  · rw [skew_of_alternating (omega (K := K)) omega_alternating]
    linear_combination -h1

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.actual_weighted_block_adjoint
statement:
theorem actual_weighted_block_adjoint
    (E : Fin 3 → Carrier K) (F1 : Carrier K)
    (hEidem : ∀ i, (E i : Mat6 K) * E i = E i)
    (hEsum : (E 0 : Mat6 K) + E 1 + E 2 = 1)
    (u v : Vec6 K) (p : Fin 3 → K)
    (hp : ∀ i, p i = (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u)
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v)) (hpne : ∀ i, p i ≠ 0) :
    let L
proof:
:= weightedCoordinateEquiv E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne
    let B := coordinateConjugate L (matrixAction (F1 : Mat6 K))
    ∀ i j, p i • weightedBlock B i j = p j • adj2 (weightedBlock B j i) := by
  dsimp only
  let L := weightedCoordinateEquiv E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne
  let B := coordinateConjugate L (matrixAction (F1 : Mat6 K))
  have hinter (z : Vec6 K) :
      weightedCoordinateLinear E u v (B z) =
        matrixAction (F1 : Mat6 K) (weightedCoordinateLinear E u v z) := by
    change L (B z) = matrixAction (F1 : Mat6 K) (L z)
    simp [B, coordinateConjugate]
  intro i j
  ext r s
  fin_cases r <;> fin_cases s
  · have hs := carrier_action_selfAdjoint F1
      (weightedCoordinateLinear E u v (basisVector (weightedPairIndex j 0)))
      (weightedCoordinateLinear E u v (basisVector (weightedPairIndex i 1)))
    rw [← hinter, ← hinter] at hs
    simp only [weightedPairIndex, weightedCoordinateLinear_basis_left,
      weightedCoordinateLinear_basis_right] at hs
    have hl := (weighted_pairing_extract E hEidem hEsum u v p hp
      (B (basisVector (weightedPairIndex j 0))) i).1
    have hr := (weighted_pairing_extract_reverse E hEidem hEsum u v p hp
      (B (basisVector (weightedPairIndex i 1))) j).1
    simp only [weightedPairIndex] at hl hr
    rw [hl, hr] at hs
    change p i * B (basisVector (weightedPairIndex j 0)) (weightedPairIndex i 0) =
      p j * B (basisVector (weightedPairIndex i 1)) (weightedPairIndex j 1)
    simp only [weightedPairIndex]
    linear_combination hs
  · have hs := carrier_action_selfAdjoint F1
      (weightedCoordinateLinear E u v (basisVector (weightedPairIndex j 1)))
      (weightedCoordinateLinear E u v (basisVector (weightedPairIndex i 1)))
    rw [← hinter, ← hinter] at hs
    simp only [weightedPairIndex, weightedCoordinateLinear_basis_left,
      weightedCoordinateLinear_basis_right] at hs
    have hl := (weighted_pairing_extract E hEidem hEsum u v p hp
      (B (basisVector (weightedPairIndex j 1))) i).1
    have hr := (weighted_pairing_extract_reverse E hEidem hEsum u v p hp
      (B (basisVector (weightedPairIndex i 1))) j).2
    simp only [weightedPairIndex] at hl hr
    rw [hl, hr] at hs
    change p i * B (basisVector (weightedPairIndex j 1)) (weightedPairIndex i 0) =
      p j * (-B (basisVector (weightedPairIndex i 1)) (weightedPairIndex j 0))
    simp only [weightedPairIndex]
    linear_combination hs
  · have hs := carrier_action_selfAdjoint F1
      (weightedCoordinateLinear E u v (basisVector (weightedPairIndex j 0)))
      (weightedCoordinateLinear E u v (basisVector (weightedPairIndex i 0)))
    rw [← hinter, ← hinter] at hs
    simp only [weightedPairIndex, weightedCoordinateLinear_basis_left,
      weightedCoordinateLinear_basis_right] at hs
    have hl := (weighted_pairing_extract E hEidem hEsum u v p hp
      (B (basisVector (weightedPairIndex j 0))) i).2
    have hr := (weighted_pairing_extract_reverse E hEidem hEsum u v p hp
      (B (basisVector (weightedPairIndex i 0))) j).1
    simp only [weightedPairIndex] at hl hr
    rw [hl, hr] at hs
    change p i * B (basisVector (weightedPairIndex j 0)) (weightedPairIndex i 1) =
      p j * (-B (basisVector (weightedPairIndex i 0)) (weightedPairIndex j 1))
    simp only [weightedPairIndex]
    linear_combination -hs
  · have hs := carrier_action_selfAdjoint F1
      (weightedCoordinateLinear E u v (basisVector (weightedPairIndex j 1)))
      (weightedCoordinateLinear E u v (basisVector (weightedPairIndex i 0)))
    rw [← hinter, ← hinter] at hs
    simp only [weightedPairIndex, weightedCoordinateLinear_basis_left,
      weightedCoordinateLinear_basis_right] at hs
    have hl := (weighted_pairing_extract E hEidem hEsum u v p hp
      (B (basisVector (weightedPairIndex j 1))) i).2
    have hr := (weighted_pairing_extract_reverse E hEidem hEsum u v p hp
      (B (basisVector (weightedPairIndex i 0))) j).2
    simp only [weightedPairIndex] at hl hr
    rw [hl, hr] at hs
    change p i * B (basisVector (weightedPairIndex j 1)) (weightedPairIndex i 1) =
      p j * B (basisVector (weightedPairIndex i 0)) (weightedPairIndex j 0)
    simp only [weightedPairIndex]
    linear_combination -hs

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.actual_weighted_diagonal_scalar
statement:
theorem actual_weighted_diagonal_scalar
    (E : Fin 3 → Carrier K) (F1 : Carrier K)
    (hEidem : ∀ i, (E i : Mat6 K) * E i = E i)
    (hEsum : (E 0 : Mat6 K) + E 1 + E 2 = 1)
    (u v : Vec6 K) (p : Fin 3 → K)
    (hp : ∀ i, p i = (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u)
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v)) (hpne : ∀ i, p i ≠ 0) :
    let L
proof:
:= weightedCoordinateEquiv E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne
    let B := coordinateConjugate L (matrixAction (F1 : Mat6 K))
    ∀ i, ∃ q : K, weightedBlock B i i = scalar2 q := by
  dsimp only
  intro i
  have h := actual_weighted_block_adjoint E F1 hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne i i
  have hself : weightedBlock
      (coordinateConjugate (weightedCoordinateEquiv E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne)
        (matrixAction (F1 : Mat6 K))) i i =
      adj2 (weightedBlock
        (coordinateConjugate (weightedCoordinateEquiv E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne)
          (matrixAction (F1 : Mat6 K))) i i) :=
    (smul_right_injective _ (hpne i)) h
  refine ⟨weightedBlock
    (coordinateConjugate (weightedCoordinateEquiv E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne)
      (matrixAction (F1 : Mat6 K))) i i 0 0, ?_⟩
  ext r s
  fin_cases r <;> fin_cases s
  · simp [scalar2, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.one_apply]
  · have hrs := congrFun (congrFun hself 0) 1
    simp [adj2, scalar2, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.one_apply] at hrs ⊢
    linear_combination (1 / 2 : K) * hrs
  · have hrs := congrFun (congrFun hself 1) 0
    simp [adj2, scalar2, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.one_apply] at hrs ⊢
    linear_combination (1 / 2 : K) * hrs
  · have hrs := congrFun (congrFun hself 1) 1
    simpa [adj2, scalar2, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.one_apply] using hrs

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SimilitudeWordCoverage.symplecticPart_form
statement:
theorem symplecticPart_form
    (M : Mat6 K) (mu : K) (hmu : mu ≠ 0)
    (hform : M.transpose * symplecticJ * M = mu • symplecticJ) :
    (symplecticPart M mu).transpose * symplecticJ * symplecticPart M mu =
      symplecticJ
proof:
:= by
  have hD :
      (scalarSimilitudeInv mu).transpose * symplecticJ * scalarSimilitudeInv mu =
        mu⁻¹ • symplecticJ := by
    change (scalarSimilitude mu⁻¹).transpose * symplecticJ *
      scalarSimilitude mu⁻¹ = mu⁻¹ • symplecticJ
    exact scalarSimilitude_form mu⁻¹
  calc
    (symplecticPart M mu).transpose * symplecticJ * symplecticPart M mu =
        (scalarSimilitudeInv mu).transpose *
          (M.transpose * symplecticJ * M) * scalarSimilitudeInv mu := by
            simp only [symplecticPart, Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = (scalarSimilitudeInv mu).transpose *
          (mu • symplecticJ) * scalarSimilitudeInv mu := by rw [hform]
    _ = mu • ((scalarSimilitudeInv mu).transpose * symplecticJ *
          scalarSimilitudeInv mu) := by
            simp only [Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul]
    _ = mu • (mu⁻¹ • symplecticJ) := by rw [hD]
    _ = symplecticJ := by simp [smul_smul, hmu]

private theorem symplecticPart_preserves_basis_pair

    (omega (K := K))
        (matrixAction (symplecticPart M mu) (basisVector i))
        (matrixAction (symplecticPart M mu) (basisVector j)) =

    ← symplectic_product_entry, symplecticPart_form M mu hmu hform,
    omega_basisVector]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SimilitudeWordCoverage.symplecticPart_standard_hyperbolicTriple
statement:
theorem symplecticPart_standard_hyperbolicTriple
    (M : Mat6 K) (mu : K) (hmu : mu ≠ 0)
    (hform : M.transpose * symplecticJ * M = mu • symplecticJ) :
    HyperbolicTriple (omega (K := K))
      (fun i => matrixAction (symplecticPart M mu) (standardE i))
      (fun i => matrixAction (symplecticPart M mu) (standardF i))
proof:
:= by
  let hstd := standard_hyperbolicTriple (K := K)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    change (omega (K := K))
      (matrixAction (symplecticPart M mu) (basisVector (Sum.inl i)))
      (matrixAction (symplecticPart M mu) (basisVector (Sum.inr i))) = 1
    rw [symplecticPart_preserves_basis_pair M mu hmu hform]
    simpa only [standardE, standardF] using hstd.pair i
  · intro i j hij
    change (omega (K := K))
      (matrixAction (symplecticPart M mu) (basisVector (Sum.inl i)))
      (matrixAction (symplecticPart M mu) (basisVector (Sum.inl j))) = 0
    rw [symplecticPart_preserves_basis_pair M mu hmu hform]
    simpa only [standardE] using hstd.uu i j hij
  · intro i j hij
    change (omega (K := K))
      (matrixAction (symplecticPart M mu) (basisVector (Sum.inl i)))
      (matrixAction (symplecticPart M mu) (basisVector (Sum.inr j))) = 0
    rw [symplecticPart_preserves_basis_pair M mu hmu hform]
    simpa only [standardE, standardF] using hstd.uv i j hij
  · intro i j hij
    change (omega (K := K))
      (matrixAction (symplecticPart M mu) (basisVector (Sum.inr i)))
      (matrixAction (symplecticPart M mu) (basisVector (Sum.inl j))) = 0
    rw [symplecticPart_preserves_basis_pair M mu hmu hform]
    simpa only [standardE, standardF] using hstd.vu i j hij
  · intro i j hij
    change (omega (K := K))
      (matrixAction (symplecticPart M mu) (basisVector (Sum.inr i)))
      (matrixAction (symplecticPart M mu) (basisVector (Sum.inr j))) = 0
    rw [symplecticPart_preserves_basis_pair M mu hmu hform]
    simpa only [standardF] using hstd.vv i j hij

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SimilitudeWordCoverage.exists_fixed_twelve_scalar_presentation_for_gsp_extension_agreement
statement:
theorem exists_fixed_twelve_scalar_presentation_for_gsp_extension_agreement
    (M N : Mat6 K) (mu : K)
    (hMN : M * N = 1) (hNM : N * M = 1) (hmu : mu ≠ 0)
    (hform : M.transpose * symplecticJ * M = mu • symplecticJ) :
    ∃ schedule : FixedTwelveSchedule (K := K) (V := Vec6 K),
      M = matrixOfLinear (fixedTwelveMap (omega (K := K)) schedule) *
        scalarSimilitude mu
proof:
:= by
  let U := symplecticPart M mu
  have htarget : HyperbolicTriple (omega (K := K))
      (fun i => matrixAction U (standardE i))
      (fun i => matrixAction U (standardF i)) := by
    exact symplecticPart_standard_hyperbolicTriple M mu hmu hform
  obtain ⟨schedule, hsE, hsF⟩ :=
    exists_literal_fixed_twelve_triple_alignment
      (omega (K := K)) omega_alternating omega_left_nondegenerate
      omega_right_nondegenerate
      (standardE (K := K)) (standardF (K := K))
      (fun i => matrixAction U (standardE i))
      (fun i => matrixAction U (standardF i))
      (standard_hyperbolicTriple (K := K)) htarget
  have hmap : fixedTwelveMap (omega (K := K)) schedule = matrixAction U := by
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro x
    obtain ⟨a, b, hx⟩ := standard_spans (K := K) x
    rw [hx]
    simp only [map_add, map_sum, map_smul, hsE, hsF]
  have hword : matrixOfLinear (fixedTwelveMap (omega (K := K)) schedule) = U := by
    apply matrixAction_injective
    rw [matrixAction_matrixOfLinear]
    exact hmap
  refine ⟨schedule, ?_⟩
  rw [hword]
  change M = (M * scalarSimilitudeInv mu) * scalarSimilitude mu
  rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, scalarSimilitude_inv_mul mu hmu, Matrix.mul_one]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertActualPointTransporter.mapEvenFactor_natural
statement:
theorem mapEvenFactor_natural {K L : Type u} [Field K] [CharZero K]
    [Field L] [CharZero L] (f : K →+* L) (p : EvenFactorData K)
    (x : JCoord K) :
    mapSource f (p.aut.linear x) =
      (mapEvenFactor f p).aut.linear (mapSource f x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← RationalEvenFamilyNaturality.mapJ_eq_mapSource,
    ← RationalEvenFamilyNaturality.mapJ_eq_mapSource]
  change RationalEvenFamilyNaturality.mapJ f
      (AlbertLean.Triality.SourceEvenAutomorphism.evenJEquiv p.A p.B p.rho
        p.hA p.hB p.root p.rho_ne x) =
    AlbertLean.Triality.SourceEvenAutomorphism.evenJEquiv
      (SourceVectorCoefficientMap.mapV f p.A)
      (SourceVectorCoefficientMap.mapV f p.B) (f p.rho) _ _ _ _
      (RationalEvenFamilyNaturality.mapJ f x)
  exact
    RationalEvenFamilyNaturality.map_evenJEquiv f p.A p.B p.rho
      p.hA p.hB p.root p.rho_ne x

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertActualPointTransporter.twoEvenWord_aut_apply
statement:
private theorem twoEvenWord_aut_apply {K : Type u} [Field K] [CharZero K]
    (w : TwoEvenWord K) (x : JCoord K) :
    w.aut.linear x = w.outer.aut.linear (w.inner.aut.linear x)
proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertActualPointTransporter.mappedTwoEvenWord_aut_apply
statement:
private theorem mappedTwoEvenWord_aut_apply
    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [CharZero K] [Field L] [CharZero L]
    (f : K →+* L) (w : TwoEvenWord K) (x : JCoord L) :
    (mapTwoEvenWord f w).aut.linear x =
      (mapEvenFactor f w.outer).aut.linear
        ((mapEvenFactor f w.inner).aut.linear x)
proof:
:=
  twoEvenWord_aut_apply (mapTwoEvenWord f w) x

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertActualPointTransporter.mapTwoEvenWord_natural
statement:
theorem mapTwoEvenWord_natural {K L : Type u} [Field K] [CharZero K]
    [Field L] [CharZero L] (f : K →+* L) (w : TwoEvenWord K)
    (x : JCoord K) :
    mapSource f (w.aut.linear x) =
      (mapTwoEvenWord f w).aut.linear (mapSource f x)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    mapSource f (w.aut.linear x) =
        mapSource f (w.outer.aut.linear (w.inner.aut.linear x)) := by
      rw [twoEvenWord_aut_apply]
    _ = (mapEvenFactor f w.outer).aut.linear
        (mapSource f (w.inner.aut.linear x)) :=
      mapEvenFactor_natural f w.outer (w.inner.aut.linear x)
    _ = (mapEvenFactor f w.outer).aut.linear
        ((mapEvenFactor f w.inner).aut.linear (mapSource f x)) := by
      rw [mapEvenFactor_natural]
    _ = (mapTwoEvenWord f w).aut.linear (mapSource f x) := by
      exact (mappedTwoEvenWord_aut_apply f w (mapSource f x)).symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertActualPointTransporter.mappedSlotAut_natural

theorem mappedSlotAut_natural {K L : Type u} [Field K] [CharZero K]

  simp only [mappedSlotAut, thenAut_apply, reflectionAut_apply,
    mapSource_reflection, mapSource_diagonalUnit]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertActualPointTransporter.mappedStageAut_natural
statement:

proof:

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertActualPointTransporter.mappedScheduleAut_natural

theorem mappedScheduleAut_natural {K L : Type u} [Field K] [CharZero K]

    (Z : Schedule K) (x : JCoord K) :

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertActualPointTransporter.inverseSourceAut_after_apply
statement:
private theorem inverseSourceAut_after_apply {K : Type u}
    [Field K] [CharZero K] (g : ResidualAction.SourceAut (K := K))
    (x : JCoord K) :
    (inverseSourceAut K g).linear (g.linear x) = x
proof:
:= by
  change g.linear.symm (g.linear x) = x
  exact g.linear.symm_apply_apply x

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertActualPointTransporter.mappedScheduleAut_inverse_frame
statement:
theorem mappedScheduleAut_inverse_frame {K L : Type u}
    [Field K] [CharZero K] [Field L] [CharZero L]
    (f : K →+* L) (Z : Schedule K) (i : Fin 3) :
    (inverseSourceAut L (mappedScheduleAut f Z)).linear
        (mapSource f (scheduledFrame Z i)) = diagonalUnit i
proof:
:= by
  have hn : mapSource f (scheduledFrame Z i) =
      (mappedScheduleAut f Z).linear (diagonalUnit i) := by
    have h := mappedScheduleAut_natural f Z (diagonalUnit i)
    rw [scheduleAut_apply, mapSource_diagonalUnit] at h
    exact h
  calc
    (inverseSourceAut L (mappedScheduleAut f Z)).linear
        (mapSource f (scheduledFrame Z i)) =
        (inverseSourceAut L (mappedScheduleAut f Z)).linear
          ((mappedScheduleAut f Z).linear (diagonalUnit i)) :=
      congrArg (inverseSourceAut L (mappedScheduleAut f Z)).linear hn
    _ = diagonalUnit i :=
      inverseSourceAut_after_apply (mappedScheduleAut f Z) (diagonalUnit i)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertActualPointTransporter.mappedFirstSchedule_comparison
statement:
theorem mappedFirstSchedule_comparison {L : Type u}
    [Field L] [CharZero L] (f : ComparisonField k →+* L)
    (r i : Fin 3) :
    (mappedScheduleAut f (firstSchedule k)).linear
        (mapSource f (comparisonFrame k r i)) =
      mapSource f
        (scheduledFrame (fieldSchedule k (parameterEmbedding k) r) i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mappedScheduleAut_natural]
  rw [comparisonFrame_apply, comparisonAction_apply]
  exact congrArg (mapSource f)
    ((scheduleAut (firstSchedule k)).linear.apply_symm_apply _)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertActualPointTransporter.mappedFirstSchedule_inverse_comparison
statement:
theorem mappedFirstSchedule_inverse_comparison {L : Type u}
    [Field L] [CharZero L] (f : ComparisonField k →+* L)
    (r i : Fin 3) :
    (inverseSourceAut L (mappedScheduleAut f (firstSchedule k))).linear
        (mapSource f
          (scheduledFrame (fieldSchedule k (parameterEmbedding k) r) i)) =
      mapSource f (comparisonFrame k r i)
proof:
:= by
  have hn := mappedFirstSchedule_comparison k f r i
  calc
    (inverseSourceAut L (mappedScheduleAut f (firstSchedule k))).linear
        (mapSource f
          (scheduledFrame (fieldSchedule k (parameterEmbedding k) r) i)) =
        (inverseSourceAut L (mappedScheduleAut f (firstSchedule k))).linear
          ((mappedScheduleAut f (firstSchedule k)).linear
            (mapSource f (comparisonFrame k r i))) :=
      congrArg
        (inverseSourceAut L (mappedScheduleAut f (firstSchedule k))).linear
        hn.symm
    _ = mapSource f (comparisonFrame k r i) :=
      inverseSourceAut_after_apply _ _

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertActualPointTransporter.chartFrame_laws
statement:
theorem chartFrame_laws {K : Type u} [Field K] [CharZero K]
    (q : ExplicitFrameChart K)
    (hq : EquationsVanish (explicitFrameEquationValues q)) (r : Fin 3) :
    SourceFrameLaws.Laws (chartFrame q r)
proof:
:= by
  have hf := (equationsVanish_iff_source_fixedSpectrum q).1 hq
  fin_cases r
  · change SourceFrameLaws.Laws (chartFrame q 0)
    have hstandard : chartFrame q 0 =
        fun i => diagonalUnit (K := K) i := by
      funext i
      rw [chartFrame, sourceProjector_eq_spectralProjector]
      simpa [residualTriple] using
        (diagonal_projectors (K := K) i)
    rw [hstandard]
    exact standardFrameLaws (L := K)
  · change SourceFrameLaws.Laws (sourceProjector (encoderA q))
    exact projector_laws_of_fixed_spectrum (encoderA q)
      hf.1 hf.2.1 hf.2.2.1
  · change SourceFrameLaws.Laws (sourceProjector (encoderB q))
    exact projector_laws_of_fixed_spectrum (encoderB q)
      hf.2.2.2.1 hf.2.2.2.2.1 hf.2.2.2.2.2

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertActualPointTransporter.chartFrame_encoder
statement:
theorem chartFrame_encoder {K : Type u} [Field K] [CharZero K]
    (q : ExplicitFrameChart K)
    (hq : EquationsVanish (explicitFrameEquationValues q)) (r : Fin 3) :
    chartFrame q r 2 - chartFrame q r 0 =
      residualTriple (encoderA q) (encoderB q) r
proof:
:= by
  change sourceProjector _ 2 - sourceProjector _ 0 = _
  simp [sourceProjector]
  module

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertActualPointTransporter.mappedWord_maps_comparisonFrame
statement:
private theorem mappedWord_maps_comparisonFrame
    {L M : Type u} [Field L] [CharZero L] [Field M] [CharZero M]
    (f : ComparisonField k →+* L) (e : L →+* M)
    (w : TwoEvenWord L) (q : ExplicitFrameChart L)
    (hq : EquationsVanish (explicitFrameEquationValues q))
    (hdiag : ∀ i, w.aut.linear (diagonalUnit i) = diagonalUnit i)
    (hA : encoderA q = w.aut.linear (mapSource f (comparisonA k)))
    (hB : encoderB q = w.aut.linear (mapSource f (comparisonB k))) :
    ∀ r i, (mapTwoEvenWord e w).aut.linear
        (mapSource (e.comp f) (comparisonFrame k r i)) =
      chartFrame (mapChart e q) r i
proof:
:= by
  let qM := mapChart e q
  let wM := mapTwoEvenWord e w
  have hqM : EquationsVanish (explicitFrameEquationValues qM) :=
    equationsVanish_mapChart e q hq
  have hdiagM (i : Fin 3) :
      wM.aut.linear (diagonalUnit i) = diagonalUnit i := by
    have hn := mapTwoEvenWord_natural e w (diagonalUnit i)
    rw [hdiag i, mapSource_diagonalUnit] at hn
    change (mapTwoEvenWord e w).aut.linear (diagonalUnit i) = diagonalUnit i
    exact hn.symm
  have hAM : wM.aut.linear (mapSource (e.comp f) (comparisonA k)) =
      encoderA qM := by
    rw [← mapSource_comp]
    rw [← mapTwoEvenWord_natural]
    rw [← hA, encoderA_mapChart]
  have hBM : wM.aut.linear (mapSource (e.comp f) (comparisonB k)) =
      encoderB qM := by
    rw [← mapSource_comp]
    rw [← mapTwoEvenWord_natural]
    rw [← hB, encoderB_mapChart]
  intro r
  fin_cases r
  · intro i
    change (mapTwoEvenWord e w).aut.linear
        (mapSource (e.comp f) (comparisonFrame k 0 i)) =
      chartFrame (mapChart e q) 0 i
    rw [comparisonFrame_first_standard, mapSource_diagonalUnit, hdiagM]
    simpa [chartFrame, residualTriple,
      sourceProjector_eq_spectralProjector, diagonal_projectors]
  · let P : Fin 3 → JCoord M :=
      fun i => mapSource (e.comp f) (comparisonFrame k 1 i)
    let Q : Fin 3 → JCoord M := chartFrame qM 1
    have hP : SourceFrameLaws.Laws P :=
      mapSource_frameLaws (e.comp f) (comparisonFrame k 1)
        (AlbertScheduleGenericComparison.comparisonFrame_laws k 1)
    have hQ : SourceFrameLaws.Laws Q := chartFrame_laws qM hqM 1
    have henc : wM.aut.linear (P 2 - P 0) = Q 2 - Q 0 := by
      change wM.aut.linear
          (mapSource (e.comp f) (comparisonFrame k 1 2) -
            mapSource (e.comp f) (comparisonFrame k 1 0)) = _
      rw [← mapSource_sub, ← comparisonSources_eq_frame_difference]
      change wM.aut.linear (mapSource (e.comp f) (comparisonA k)) = _
      rw [hAM, chartFrame_encoder qM hqM 1]
      rfl
    exact frame_transport_of_encoder M P Q hP hQ wM.aut henc
  · let P : Fin 3 → JCoord M :=
      fun i => mapSource (e.comp f) (comparisonFrame k 2 i)
    let Q : Fin 3 → JCoord M := chartFrame qM 2
    have hP : SourceFrameLaws.Laws P :=
      mapSource_frameLaws (e.comp f) (comparisonFrame k 2)
        (AlbertScheduleGenericComparison.comparisonFrame_laws k 2)
    have hQ : SourceFrameLaws.Laws Q := chartFrame_laws qM hqM 2
    have henc : wM.aut.linear (P 2 - P 0) = Q 2 - Q 0 := by
      change wM.aut.linear
          (mapSource (e.comp f) (comparisonFrame k 2 2) -
            mapSource (e.comp f) (comparisonFrame k 2 0)) = _
      rw [← mapSource_sub, ← comparisonSources_eq_frame_difference]
      change wM.aut.linear (mapSource (e.comp f) (comparisonB k)) = _
      rw [hBM, chartFrame_encoder qM hqM 2]
      rfl
    exact frame_transport_of_encoder M P Q hP hQ wM.aut henc

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertActualPointTransporter.genericNativePoint_eq_mapped_scheduled
statement:
private theorem genericNativePoint_eq_mapped_scheduled
    {K : Type u} [Field K] [CharZero K]
    (phi : RawFunctionField k →+* K)
    (e : ComparisonField k →+* K)
    (he : phi = e.comp (fractionEmbedding k)) (r i : Fin 3) :
    genericNativePoint k phi r i =
      mapSource e
        (scheduledFrame (fieldSchedule k (parameterEmbedding k) r) i)
proof:
:= by
  apply (structuredEquivK K).injective
  rw [genericNativePoint, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  rw [SourceCoefficientMap.mapSource, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  funext c
  change phi (rawToFunction k (universalVector (k := k) r i c)) = _
  rw [he, RingHom.comp_apply, fractionEmbedding_rawToFunction]
  simp [scheduledFamily, SourceScheduleRawVanishing.fieldF0Family,
    SourceScheduleRawVanishing.fieldNativeFamily,
    AlbertRawSourceDictionary.toF0Family, SourceCoefficientMap.mapF0]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertActualPointTransporter.mapped_sourceLedger_eq
statement:
private theorem mapped_sourceLedger_eq
    {L M : Type u} [Field L] [CharZero L] [Field M] [CharZero M]
    (phi : RawFunctionField k →+* L) (q : ExplicitFrameChart L)
    (halign : ∀ (t : Fin 4) (i j l : Fin 3),
      chartLedgerCell q t i j l = phi (ledgerValue k (t, i, j, l)))
    (left right : L →+* M)
    (hbase : ∀ z : ledgerDetectorField k,
      left (phi z) = right (phi z)) :
    sourceLedger (encoderA (mapChart left q)) (encoderB (mapChart left q)) =
      sourceLedger (encoderA (mapChart right q)) (encoderB (mapChart right q))
proof:
:= by
  rw [sourceLedger_mapChart, sourceLedger_mapChart]
  apply SourceLedger.ext
  · funext i j
    calc
      left ((sourceLedger (encoderA q) (encoderB q)).P i j) =
          left (phi (ledgerValue k (0, i, j, 0))) := congrArg left (halign 0 i j 0)
      _ = right (phi (ledgerValue k (0, i, j, 0))) :=
        hbase ⟨_, ledgerValue_mem_base k _⟩
      _ = right ((sourceLedger (encoderA q) (encoderB q)).P i j) :=
        congrArg right (halign 0 i j 0).symm
  · funext i j
    calc
      left ((sourceLedger (encoderA q) (encoderB q)).Q i j) =
          left (phi (ledgerValue k (1, i, j, 0))) := congrArg left (halign 1 i j 0)
      _ = right (phi (ledgerValue k (1, i, j, 0))) :=
        hbase ⟨_, ledgerValue_mem_base k _⟩
      _ = right ((sourceLedger (encoderA q) (encoderB q)).Q i j) :=
        congrArg right (halign 1 i j 0).symm
  · funext i j
    calc
      left ((sourceLedger (encoderA q) (encoderB q)).R i j) =
          left (phi (ledgerValue k (2, i, j, 0))) := congrArg left (halign 2 i j 0)
      _ = right (phi (ledgerValue k (2, i, j, 0))) :=
        hbase ⟨_, ledgerValue_mem_base k _⟩
      _ = right ((sourceLedger (encoderA q) (encoderB q)).R i j) :=
        congrArg right (halign 2 i j 0).symm
  · funext i j l
    calc
      left ((sourceLedger (encoderA q) (encoderB q)).C0 i j l) =
          left (phi (ledgerValue k (3, i, j, l))) := congrArg left (halign 3 i j l)
      _ = right (phi (ledgerValue k (3, i, j, l))) :=
        hbase ⟨_, ledgerValue_mem_base k _⟩
      _ = right ((sourceLedger (encoderA q) (encoderB q)).C0 i j l) :=
        congrArg right (halign 3 i j l).symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertActualPointTransporter.mapped_gauge_eq
statement:
private theorem mapped_gauge_eq
    {L M : Type u} [Field L] [CharZero L] [Field M] [CharZero M]
    (q : ExplicitFrameChart L)
    (hq : EquationsVanish (explicitFrameEquationValues q))
    (a h sigma : L) (hr1 : q.r1 = 1) (hz1 : q.z1 = a)
    (hr2 : q.r2 = (h - sigma) / (2 * a))
    (hz2 : q.z2 = (h + sigma) / 2)
    (ha : 2 * a ≠ 0) (left right : L →+* M)
    (hledger : sourceLedger (encoderA (mapChart left q))
        (encoderB (mapChart left q)) =
      sourceLedger (encoderA (mapChart right q))
        (encoderB (mapChart right q))) :
    left a = right a ∧ left h = right h
proof:
:= by
  let ql := mapChart left q
  let qr := mapChart right q
  have hf := (equationsVanish_iff_source_fixedSpectrum q).1 hq
  have hfa := recovered_measurements (encoderA ql) (encoderB ql)
    ((equationsVanish_iff_source_fixedSpectrum ql).1
      (equationsVanish_mapChart left q hq)).2.2.1
    ((equationsVanish_iff_source_fixedSpectrum ql).1
      (equationsVanish_mapChart left q hq)).2.2.2.2.2
  have hfr := recovered_measurements (encoderA qr) (encoderB qr)
    ((equationsVanish_iff_source_fixedSpectrum qr).1
      (equationsVanish_mapChart right q hq)).2.2.1
    ((equationsVanish_iff_source_fixedSpectrum qr).1
      (equationsVanish_mapChart right q hq)).2.2.2.2.2
  have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := right_ne_zero_of_mul ha
  have hnva : nV (vectorA q) = a := by
    simp [nV, vectorA, Pf, BW, hr1, hz1]
  have hgram : gramV12 q = h := by
    rw [gramV12, hr1, hz1, hr2, hz2]
    field_simp [ha0]
    ring
  constructor
  · calc
      left a = nV (vectorA ql) := by
        rw [← hnva]
        simp [ql, mapChart, vectorA, nV, Pf, BW]
      _ = nVx (sourceLedger (encoderA ql) (encoderB ql)) := hfa.1.symm
      _ = nVx (sourceLedger (encoderA qr) (encoderB qr)) := by rw [hledger]
      _ = nV (vectorA qr) := hfr.1
      _ = right a := by
        rw [← hnva]
        simp [qr, mapChart, vectorA, nV, Pf, BW]
  · calc
      left h = gramV12 ql := by rw [gramV12_mapChart, hgram]
      _ = BV (vectorA ql) (vectorB ql) := by
        simp [gramV12, BV, vectorA, vectorB, BW]
        ring
      _ = gV (sourceLedger (encoderA ql) (encoderB ql)) 1 1 :=
        hfa.2.2.2.2.2.2.1.symm
      _ = gV (sourceLedger (encoderA qr) (encoderB qr)) 1 1 := by rw [hledger]
      _ = BV (vectorA qr) (vectorB qr) := hfr.2.2.2.2.2.2.1
      _ = gramV12 qr := by
        simp [gramV12, BV, vectorA, vectorB, BW]
        ring
      _ = right h := by rw [gramV12_mapChart, hgram]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertActualPointTransporter.aut_maps_chartFrame
statement:
private theorem aut_maps_chartFrame
    {K : Type u} [Field K] [CharZero K]
    (q q' : ExplicitFrameChart K)
    (hq : EquationsVanish (explicitFrameEquationValues q))
    (hq' : EquationsVanish (explicitFrameEquationValues q'))
    (H : ResidualAction.SourceAut (K := K))
    (hdiag : ∀ d1 d2 d3 : K,
      H.linear (diagonal d1 d2 d3) = diagonal d1 d2 d3)
    (hA : H.linear (encoderA q) = encoderA q')
    (hB : H.linear (encoderB q) = encoderB q') :
    ∀ r i, H.linear (chartFrame q r i) = chartFrame q' r i
proof:
:= by
  intro r
  apply frame_transport_of_encoder K (chartFrame q r) (chartFrame q' r)
    (chartFrame_laws q hq r) (chartFrame_laws q' hq' r) H
  rw [chartFrame_encoder q hq r, chartFrame_encoder q' hq' r]
  fin_cases r
  · exact hdiag (-1) 0 1
  · exact hA
  · exact hB

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertActualPointTransporter.assembledAut_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem assembledAut_apply {K : Type u} [Field K] [CharZero K]
    (Sleft wleft H wright Sright : ResidualAction.SourceAut (K := K))

    (assembledAut Sleft wleft H wright Sright).linear x =
      Sright.linear (wright.linear.symm
        (H.linear (wleft.linear (Sleft.linear.symm x))))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertActualPointTransporter.assembledAut_maps_points
statement:
private theorem assembledAut_maps_points
    {F : Type u} [Field F] [CharZero F]

    (hSl : Sleft.linear xl = x) (hwl : wleft.linear xl = yl)
    (hH : H.linear yl = yr) (hwr : wright.linear xr = yr)
    (hSr : Sright.linear xr = y) :
    (assembledAut Sleft wleft H wright Sright).linear x = y
proof:
:= by

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertActualPointTransporter.baseLinear_eq_of_native
statement:
private theorem baseLinear_eq_of_native
    {F : Type u} [Field F] [CharZero F]
    (g : ResidualAction.SourceAut (K := F)) (x y : Fin 27 → F)
    (h : g.linear ((structuredEquivK F).symm x) =
      (structuredEquivK F).symm y) :
    SourceAutExtension.baseLinear g x = y

:= by

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertActualPointTransporter.exists_two_point_transporter
statement:
theorem exists_two_point_transporter
    {K : Type u} [Field K] [CharZero K]
    (phi psi : RawFunctionField k →+* K)
    (hbase : ∀ z : ledgerDetectorField k, phi z = psi z) :
    ∃ (E : Type u) (_ : Field E) (_ : CharZero E) (j : K →+* E)
      (L : Type u) (_ : Field L) (_ : CharZero L)
      (f : ComparisonField k →+* L) (sigma : L)
      (w : TwoEvenWord L) (q : ExplicitFrameChart L)
      (left right : L →+* E)
      (wleft wright : TwoEvenWord E)
      (Sleft Sright H T : ResidualAction.SourceAut (K := E)),
      Injective j ∧
      wleft = mapTwoEvenWord left w ∧
      wright = mapTwoEvenWord right w ∧
      Sleft = mappedScheduleAut (left.comp f) (firstSchedule k) ∧
      Sright = mappedScheduleAut (right.comp f) (firstSchedule k) ∧
      T = assembledAut Sleft wleft.aut H wright.aut Sright ∧
      ((∃ G : DetOneMatrix E,
          H = ResidualAction.sourceAut G ∧
          G.g = (residualPairOfChart (mapChart right q)).X *
              (residualPairOfChart (mapChart left q)).X⁻¹ ∧
          G.gInv = (residualPairOfChart (mapChart left q)).X *
              (residualPairOfChart (mapChart right q)).X⁻¹) ∨
        (∃ G : DetOneMatrix E,
          H = thenAut (ResidualAction.sourceAut G)
            (GenericReflectionGauge.sourceAut (left (f (nV (comparisonA k).v)))
              (by
                have ha := (comparison_dephase_open k).1
                simpa only [map_zero] using
                  left.injective.ne (f.injective.ne ha))) ∧
          G.g = (residualPairOfChart
                (ReflectionDetectorChart.reflectChart
                  (left (f (nV (comparisonA k).v))) (mapChart right q))).X *
              (residualPairOfChart (mapChart left q)).X⁻¹ ∧
          G.gInv = (residualPairOfChart (mapChart left q)).X *
              (residualPairOfChart
                (ReflectionDetectorChart.reflectChart
                  (left (f (nV (comparisonA k).v))) (mapChart right q))).X⁻¹)) ∧
      ∀ r i, SourceAutExtension.baseLinear T
          (SourceRawScalarTransport.genericPointAlong k E (j.comp phi) r i) =
        SourceRawScalarTransport.genericPointAlong k E (j.comp psi) r i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨L, iL, cL, f, sigma, w, q, hq, hf, hdiag, hdiagFields,
      hA, hB, hkappa, hr1, hz1, hr2, hz2, hsquare, hdetRing,
      hcells, hdetSource, hsigmaSq, hsigma, htwoa, hsep,
      hbeta, hbranch, hopen⟩ :=
    exists_actual_generic_chart_alignment_twoEven k
  letI : Field L := iL
  letI : CharZero L := cL
  let Phi : RawFunctionField k →+* L := actualFractionMap k f
  obtain ⟨M, iM, j0, ell0, hj0, hell0, ham0⟩ :=
    exists_common_field phi Phi
  letI : Field M := iM
  letI : CharZero M :=
    FiniteQuadraticRoots.charZero_of_embedding j0
  obtain ⟨E, iE, m, right, hm, hright, ham1⟩ :=
    exists_common_field (j0.comp psi) Phi
  letI : Field E := iE
  letI : CharZero E :=
    FiniteQuadraticRoots.charZero_of_embedding m
  let j : K →+* E := m.comp j0
  let left : L →+* E := m.comp ell0
  have hphi : j.comp phi = left.comp Phi := by
    calc
      j.comp phi = m.comp (j0.comp phi) := by ext x; rfl
      _ = m.comp (ell0.comp Phi) := by rw [ham0]
      _ = left.comp Phi := by ext x; rfl
  have hpsi : j.comp psi = right.comp Phi := by
    calc
      j.comp psi = m.comp (j0.comp psi) := by ext x; rfl
      _ = right.comp Phi := ham1
  have hbaseTemplate (z : ledgerDetectorField k) :
      left (Phi z) = right (Phi z) := by
    calc
      left (Phi z) = j (phi z) := by
        exact DFunLike.congr_fun hphi (z : RawFunctionField k) |>.symm
      _ = j (psi z) := congrArg j (hbase z)
      _ = right (Phi z) :=
        DFunLike.congr_fun hpsi (z : RawFunctionField k)
  have halign : ∀ (t : Fin 4) (i l s : Fin 3),
      chartLedgerCell q t i l s = Phi (ledgerValue k (t, i, l, s)) := by
    intro t i l s
    have hc := hcells t i l s
    rw [actualReducedMap, reducedEvaluation_ledgerCell] at hc
    exact hc
  let ql := mapChart left q
  let qr := mapChart right q
  have hql : EquationsVanish (explicitFrameEquationValues ql) :=
    equationsVanish_mapChart left q hq
  have hqr : EquationsVanish (explicitFrameEquationValues qr) :=
    equationsVanish_mapChart right q hq
  have hopenl : ResidualOpen (residualPairOfChart ql) :=
    residualOpen_mapChart left q hopen
  have hopenr : ResidualOpen (residualPairOfChart qr) :=
    residualOpen_mapChart right q hopen
  have hledger : sourceLedger (encoderA ql) (encoderB ql) =
      sourceLedger (encoderA qr) (encoderB qr) :=
    mapped_sourceLedger_eq k Phi q halign left right hbaseTemplate
  have hdet : sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1) (encoderA ql) (encoderB ql) =
      sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1) (encoderA qr) (encoderB qr) := by
    calc
      _ = left (sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1)
          (encoderA q) (encoderB q)) := (sourceDetector_mapChart left q).symm
      _ = left (Phi (detectorValue k)) := congrArg left hdetSource.symm
      _ = right (Phi (detectorValue k)) :=
        hbaseTemplate ⟨_, detectorValue_mem_base k⟩
      _ = right (sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1)
          (encoderA q) (encoderB q)) := congrArg right hdetSource
      _ = _ := sourceDetector_mapChart right q
  let aval := f (nV (comparisonA k).v)
  let hval := f (BV (comparisonA k).v (comparisonB k).v)
  have haEval : evalR0 k (actualCoefficientMap k f) q (a k) = aval := by
    calc
      evalR0 k (actualCoefficientMap k f) q (a k) =
          f (comparisonEval k (a k)) :=
        DFunLike.congr_fun hsquare (a k)
      _ = aval := by rw [comparisonEval_a]
  have htwoAval : 2 * aval ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← haEval]
    exact htwoa
  have hgauge := mapped_gauge_eq q hq aval hval sigma hr1 hz1 hr2 hz2
    htwoAval left right hledger
  have ha_lr : left aval = right aval := hgauge.1
  have hh_lr : left hval = right hval := hgauge.2
  have ha0 : f (nV (comparisonA k).v) ≠ 0 := by
    have h := right_ne_zero_of_mul htwoAval
    simpa only [aval] using h
  have hgram : gramV12 q = hval := by
    rw [gramV12, hr1, hz1, hr2, hz2]
    dsimp only [aval, hval]
    field_simp [ha0]
    ring
  have hbetaQ : actualBeta q aval q.r2 q.z2 sigma ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hr2, hz2]
    exact hbeta
  have hcompTemplate := companion_detector_ne q hopen aval q.r2 q.z2 sigma
    hq hr1 hz1 rfl rfl
    (by rw [hr2, hgram]) (by rw [hz2, hgram]) hsigma
    htwoAval hbetaQ hbranch
  have hcompLeft :
      sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1)
          (encoderA (companion ql hopenl)) (encoderB (companion ql hopenl)) ≠
        sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1) (encoderA ql) (encoderB ql) := by
    have hmapped := left.injective.ne hcompTemplate
    rw [companionDetector_mapChart left q hopen,
      sourceDetector_mapChart left q] at hmapped
    exact hmapped
  have hbetaLeft : actualBeta ql (left aval) ql.r2 ql.z2 (left sigma) ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    have hs := companion_detector_sub ql hopenl (left aval) ql.r2 ql.z2
      (left sigma) hql
      (by simp [ql, mapChart, hr1])
      (by simp [ql, mapChart, hz1, aval]) rfl rfl
      (by
        change left q.r2 = (gramV12 ql - left sigma) / (2 * left aval)
        rw [hr2, gramV12_mapChart, hgram, map_div₀, map_sub, map_mul,
          map_ofNat])
      (by
        change left q.z2 = (gramV12 ql + left sigma) / 2
        rw [hz2, gramV12_mapChart, hgram, map_div₀, map_add, map_ofNat])
      (by simpa only [map_zero] using left.injective.ne hsigma)
      (by simpa only [map_mul, map_ofNat, map_zero] using
        left.injective.ne htwoAval)
    rw [hz, zero_mul] at hs
    exact hcompLeft (sub_eq_zero.mp hs)
  have horient := exists_normalized_orientation_transporter ql qr hopenl hopenr
    hledger hdet (left aval) (left hval) (left sigma) (right sigma) hql hqr
    (by simp [ql, mapChart, hr1])
    (by simp [ql, mapChart, hz1, aval])
    (by
      simp [ql, mapChart, hr2, aval, hval]
      rw [map_ofNat])
    (by
      simp [ql, mapChart, hz2, aval, hval]
      rw [map_ofNat])
    (by simp [qr, mapChart, hr1])
    (by change right q.z1 = left aval; rw [hz1, ha_lr])
    (by
      change right q.r2 = (left hval - right sigma) / (2 * left aval)
      rw [hr2, map_div₀, map_sub, map_mul, map_ofNat, ha_lr, hh_lr])
    (by
      change right q.z2 = (left hval + right sigma) / 2
      rw [hz2, map_div₀, map_add, map_ofNat, hh_lr])
    (by simpa only [map_zero] using left.injective.ne hsigma)
    (by simpa only [map_mul, map_ofNat, map_zero] using
      left.injective.ne htwoAval) hbetaLeft
  let wleft := mapTwoEvenWord left w
  let wright := mapTwoEvenWord right w
  let Sleft := mappedScheduleAut (left.comp f) (firstSchedule k)
  let Sright := mappedScheduleAut (right.comp f) (firstSchedule k)
  have hwleft : ∀ r i, wleft.aut.linear
      (mapSource (left.comp f) (comparisonFrame k r i)) = chartFrame ql r i :=
    mappedWord_maps_comparisonFrame k f left w q hq hdiag hA hB
  have hwright : ∀ r i, wright.aut.linear
      (mapSource (right.comp f) (comparisonFrame k r i)) = chartFrame qr r i :=
    mappedWord_maps_comparisonFrame k f right w q hq hdiag hA hB
  rcases horient with hres | href
  · obtain ⟨G, hg, hginv, hdiagG, hAG, hBG⟩ := hres
    let H := ResidualAction.sourceAut G
    let T := assembledAut Sleft wleft.aut H wright.aut Sright
    have hH : ∀ r i, H.linear (chartFrame ql r i) = chartFrame qr r i :=
      aut_maps_chartFrame ql qr hql hqr H hdiagG hAG hBG
    have hnative (r i : Fin 3) :
        T.linear (genericNativePoint k (j.comp phi) r i) =
          genericNativePoint k (j.comp psi) r i := by
      rw [genericNativePoint_eq_mapped_scheduled k (j.comp phi) (left.comp f)
        (by rw [hphi]; rfl)]
      rw [genericNativePoint_eq_mapped_scheduled k (j.comp psi) (right.comp f)
        (by rw [hpsi]; rfl)]
      exact assembledAut_maps_points Sleft wleft.aut H wright.aut Sright
        (mapSource (left.comp f)
          (scheduledFrame (fieldSchedule k (parameterEmbedding k) r) i))
        (mapSource (left.comp f) (comparisonFrame k r i))
        (chartFrame ql r i) (chartFrame qr r i)
        (mapSource (right.comp f) (comparisonFrame k r i))
        (mapSource (right.comp f)
          (scheduledFrame (fieldSchedule k (parameterEmbedding k) r) i))
        (mappedFirstSchedule_comparison k (left.comp f) r i)
        (hwleft r i) (hH r i) (hwright r i)
        (mappedFirstSchedule_comparison k (right.comp f) r i)
    refine ⟨E, iE, inferInstance, j, L, iL, cL, f, sigma, w, q,
      left, right, wleft, wright, Sleft, Sright, H, T, j.injective,
      rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, Or.inl ⟨G, rfl, hg, hginv⟩, ?_⟩
    intro r i
    exact baseLinear_eq_of_native T
      (SourceRawScalarTransport.genericPointAlong k E (j.comp phi) r i)
      (SourceRawScalarTransport.genericPointAlong k E (j.comp psi) r i)
      (hnative r i)
  · obtain ⟨G, hg, hginv, hdiagG, hAG, hBG⟩ := href
    have haLeft : left aval ≠ 0 := by
      simpa only [map_zero] using
        left.injective.ne (right_ne_zero_of_mul htwoAval)
    let R := GenericReflectionGauge.sourceAut (left aval) haLeft
    let H := thenAut (ResidualAction.sourceAut G) R
    have hdiagH : ∀ d1 d2 d3 : E,
        H.linear (diagonal d1 d2 d3) = diagonal d1 d2 d3 := by
      intro d1 d2 d3
      simp only [H, thenAut_apply, hdiagG]
      change GenericReflectionGauge.theta (left aval)
          (diagonal d1 d2 d3) = diagonal d1 d2 d3
      exact ReflectionDetectorChart.theta_diagonal (left aval) d1 d2 d3
    have hH : ∀ r i, H.linear (chartFrame ql r i) = chartFrame qr r i :=
      aut_maps_chartFrame ql qr hql hqr H hdiagH hAG hBG
    let T := assembledAut Sleft wleft.aut H wright.aut Sright
    have hnative (r i : Fin 3) :
        T.linear (genericNativePoint k (j.comp phi) r i) =
          genericNativePoint k (j.comp psi) r i := by
      rw [genericNativePoint_eq_mapped_scheduled k (j.comp phi) (left.comp f)
        (by rw [hphi]; rfl)]
      rw [genericNativePoint_eq_mapped_scheduled k (j.comp psi) (right.comp f)
        (by rw [hpsi]; rfl)]
      exact assembledAut_maps_points Sleft wleft.aut H wright.aut Sright
        (mapSource (left.comp f)
          (scheduledFrame (fieldSchedule k (parameterEmbedding k) r) i))
        (mapSource (left.comp f) (comparisonFrame k r i))
        (chartFrame ql r i) (chartFrame qr r i)
        (mapSource (right.comp f) (comparisonFrame k r i))
        (mapSource (right.comp f)
          (scheduledFrame (fieldSchedule k (parameterEmbedding k) r) i))
        (mappedFirstSchedule_comparison k (left.comp f) r i)
        (hwleft r i) (hH r i) (hwright r i)
        (mappedFirstSchedule_comparison k (right.comp f) r i)
    refine ⟨E, iE, inferInstance, j, L, iL, cL, f, sigma, w, q,
      left, right, wleft, wright, Sleft, Sright, H, T, j.injective,
      rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, Or.inr ⟨G, ?_, hg, hginv⟩, ?_⟩
    · change H = thenAut (ResidualAction.sourceAut G)
          (GenericReflectionGauge.sourceAut (left (f (nV (comparisonA k).v))) _)
      rfl
    · intro r i
      exact baseLinear_eq_of_native T
        (SourceRawScalarTransport.genericPointAlong k E (j.comp phi) r i)
        (SourceRawScalarTransport.genericPointAlong k E (j.comp psi) r i)
        (hnative r i)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ExteriorAction.wedge_decomposition
statement:
theorem wedge_decomposition (w : W K) :
    w = w .i12 • wedge2 (uBasis 0) (uBasis 1) +
      w .i13 • wedge2 (uBasis 0) (uBasis 2) +
      w .i14 • wedge2 (uBasis 0) (uBasis 3) +
      w .i23 • wedge2 (uBasis 1) (uBasis 2) +
      w .i24 • wedge2 (uBasis 1) (uBasis 3) +
      w .i34 • wedge2 (uBasis 2) (uBasis 3)
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;> simp [wedge2, uBasis]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ExteriorAction.wedge_induction
statement:
theorem wedge_induction {P : W K → Prop}
    (hadd : ∀ x y, P x → P y → P (x + y))
    (hsmul : ∀ (a : K) x, P x → P (a • x))
    (hwedge : ∀ p q, P (wedge2 p q)) (w : W K) : P w
proof:
:= by
  rw [wedge_decomposition w]
  repeat' first | apply hadd | apply hsmul | apply hwedge

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ExteriorAction.wedgeAct_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem wedgeAct_zero (g : Mat4 K) : wedgeAct g 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [wedgeAct]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ExteriorAction.wedgeAct_add
statement:
theorem wedgeAct_add (g : Mat4 K) (w v : W K) :
    wedgeAct g (w + v) = wedgeAct g w + wedgeAct g v
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  simp [wedgeAct, add_smul]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ExteriorAction.wedgeAct_smul
statement:
theorem wedgeAct_smul (g : Mat4 K) (a : K) (w : W K) :
    wedgeAct g (a • w) = a • wedgeAct g w
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  simp [wedgeAct]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ExteriorAction.wedgeAct_wedge2
statement:
theorem wedgeAct_wedge2 (g : Mat4 K) (p q : U K) :
    wedgeAct g (wedge2 p q) = wedge2 (vecAct g p) (vecAct g q)
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;>
    simp [wedgeAct, wedge2, vecAct, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct,
      Fin.sum_univ_succ, uBasis] <;> ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ExteriorAction.vecAct_one
statement: @[simp] theorem vecAct_one (p : U K) : vecAct (1 : Mat4 K) p = p
proof:
:= by
  simp [vecAct]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ExteriorAction.vecAct_mul
statement:
theorem vecAct_mul (g h : Mat4 K) (p : U K) :
    vecAct g (vecAct h p) = vecAct (g * h) p
proof:
:= by
  exact Matrix.mulVec_mulVec p g h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ExteriorAction.wedgeAct_mul
statement:
theorem wedgeAct_mul (g h : Mat4 K) (w : W K) :
    wedgeAct g (wedgeAct h w) = wedgeAct (g * h) w
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => arg 2; unfold wedgeAct
  simp only [wedgeAct_add, wedgeAct_smul, wedgeAct_wedge2, vecAct_mul]
  rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ExteriorAction.wedgeAct_one
statement: @[simp] theorem wedgeAct_one (w : W K) : wedgeAct (1 : Mat4 K) w = w
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [wedgeAct, vecAct_one] using (wedge_decomposition w).symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ExteriorAction.wedgeAct_inverse
statement:
theorem wedgeAct_inverse (g h : Mat4 K) (hhg : h * g = 1) (w : W K) :
    wedgeAct h (wedgeAct g w) = w
proof:
:= by
  rw [wedgeAct_mul, hhg, wedgeAct_one]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ExteriorAction.BW_wedge2_eq_det
statement:
theorem BW_wedge2_eq_det (p q r s : U K) :
    BW (wedge2 p q) (wedge2 r s) = Matrix.det (fourColumns p q r s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.det_succ_row_zero]
  simp [fourColumns, Matrix.transpose, Matrix.det_fin_three, Matrix.submatrix,
    Fin.sum_univ_succ, Fin.succAbove, BW, wedge2] <;> ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ExteriorAction.fourColumns_vecAct
statement:
theorem fourColumns_vecAct (g : Mat4 K) (p q r s : U K) :
    fourColumns (vecAct g p) (vecAct g q) (vecAct g r) (vecAct g s) =
      g * fourColumns p q r s
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  fin_cases j <;>
    simp [fourColumns, Matrix.transpose, vecAct, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.mulVec,
      dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_succ]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ExteriorAction.BW_wedgeAct_wedges
statement:
theorem BW_wedgeAct_wedges (g : Mat4 K) (p q r s : U K) :
    BW (wedgeAct g (wedge2 p q)) (wedgeAct g (wedge2 r s)) =
      Matrix.det g * BW (wedge2 p q) (wedge2 r s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [wedgeAct_wedge2, wedgeAct_wedge2, BW_wedge2_eq_det,
    fourColumns_vecAct, Matrix.det_mul, BW_wedge2_eq_det]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ExteriorAction.BW_wedgeAct
statement:
theorem BW_wedgeAct (g : Mat4 K) (w v : W K) :
    BW (wedgeAct g w) (wedgeAct g v) = Matrix.det g * BW w v
proof:
:= by
  have hw : ∀ w : W K, ∀ v : W K,
      BW (wedgeAct g w) (wedgeAct g v) = Matrix.det g * BW w v := by
    intro w
    apply wedge_induction (P := fun w => ∀ v : W K,
      BW (wedgeAct g w) (wedgeAct g v) = Matrix.det g * BW w v)
    · intro x y hx hy v
      simp only [wedgeAct_add, BW_add_left, hx, hy, mul_add]
    · intro a x hx v
      simp only [wedgeAct_smul, BW_smul_left, hx]
      ring
    · intro p q v
      apply wedge_induction (P := fun v =>
        BW (wedgeAct g (wedge2 p q)) (wedgeAct g v) =
          Matrix.det g * BW (wedge2 p q) v)
      · intro x y hx hy
        simp only [wedgeAct_add, BW_add_right, hx, hy, mul_add]
      · intro a x hx
        simp only [wedgeAct_smul, BW_smul_right, hx]
        ring
      · intro r s
        exact BW_wedgeAct_wedges g p q r s
  exact hw w v

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ExteriorAction.BW_wedgeAct_of_det_one
statement:
theorem BW_wedgeAct_of_det_one (g : Mat4 K) (hg : Matrix.det g = 1)
    (w v : W K) : BW (wedgeAct g w) (wedgeAct g v) = BW w v
proof:
:= by
  rw [BW_wedgeAct, hg, one_mul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ExteriorAction.evalU_covAct_vecAct
statement:
theorem evalU_covAct_vecAct (g h : Mat4 K) (hhg : h * g = 1)
    (phi : Udual K) (p : U K) : evalU (covAct h phi) (vecAct g p) = evalU phi p
proof:
:= by
  have eval_dot (a : Udual K) (b : U K) : evalU a b = dotProduct a b := by
    simp [evalU, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_succ] <;> ring
  rw [eval_dot, eval_dot]
  change dotProduct (Matrix.vecMul phi h) (g.mulVec p) = dotProduct phi p
  rw [Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, Matrix.vecMul_vecMul, hhg, Matrix.vecMul_one]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ExteriorAction.pairW_add_left
statement:
theorem pairW_add_left (w v : W K) (zeta : Wdual K) :
    pairW (w + v) zeta = pairW w zeta + pairW v zeta
proof:
:= by
  simp [pairW]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ExteriorAction.pairW_smul_left
statement:
theorem pairW_smul_left (a : K) (w : W K) (zeta : Wdual K) :
    pairW (a • w) zeta = a * pairW w zeta
proof:
:= by
  simp [pairW]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ExteriorAction.pairW_wedgeAct_dualWedge
statement:
theorem pairW_wedgeAct_dualWedge (g h : Mat4 K) (hhg : h * g = 1)
    (w : W K) (phi psi : Udual K) :
    pairW (wedgeAct g w) (dualWedge2 (covAct h phi) (covAct h psi)) =
      pairW w (dualWedge2 phi psi)
proof:
:= by
  apply wedge_induction (P := fun w =>
    pairW (wedgeAct g w) (dualWedge2 (covAct h phi) (covAct h psi)) =
      pairW w (dualWedge2 phi psi))
  · intro x y hx hy
    simp only [wedgeAct_add, pairW_add_left, hx, hy]
  · intro a x hx
    simp only [wedgeAct_smul, pairW_smul_left, hx]
  · intro p q
    rw [wedgeAct_wedge2, wedge_dual_pairing, wedge_dual_pairing,
      evalU_covAct_vecAct g h hhg, evalU_covAct_vecAct g h hhg,
      evalU_covAct_vecAct g h hhg, evalU_covAct_vecAct g h hhg]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceRawIdealPreservation.idempotenceResidual_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem idempotenceResidual_apply (r i : Fin 3) (c : Fin 27) :
    idempotenceResidual k r i c = equation (.idempotence r i c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [idempotenceResidual, Pi.sub_apply, ← raw_product_eq_extension]
  rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceRawIdealPreservation.extension_one_eq_unitCoordinate
statement:
theorem extension_one_eq_unitCoordinate (c : Fin 27) :
    SourceAutExtension.one (k := k) (R := CoordinateRing k) c =
      unitCoordinate c
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases c <;> simp [SourceAutExtension.one, unitCoordinate, f0OneK]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceRawIdealPreservation.sumResidual_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem sumResidual_apply (r : Fin 3) (c : Fin 27) :
    sumResidual k r c = equation (.sumOne r c)
proof:
:= by
  simp [sumResidual, equation, extension_one_eq_unitCoordinate]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceRawIdealPreservation.linearEquiv_mem_rawFrameIdeal
statement:
theorem linearEquiv_mem_rawFrameIdeal (g : SourceAut (K := k))
    (x : Fin 27 → CoordinateRing k)
    (hx : ∀ c, x c ∈ rawFrameIdeal (k := k)) (c : Fin 27) :
    linearEquiv (R := CoordinateRing k) g x c ∈ rawFrameIdeal (k := k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [linearEquiv_apply_coordinate]
  apply (rawFrameIdeal (k := k)).sum_mem
  intro i hi
  simpa [mul_comm] using
    (rawFrameIdeal (k := k)).mul_mem_left
      (algebraMap k (CoordinateRing k) (baseLinear g (Pi.single i 1) c)) (hx i)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceRawIdealPreservation.rawAction_idempotence_mem
statement:
theorem rawAction_idempotence_mem (g : SourceAut (K := k))
    (r i : Fin 3) (c : Fin 27) :
    rawAction k g (equation (.idempotence r i c)) ∈ rawFrameIdeal (k := k)
proof:
:= by
  have hprod := mapVector_product k g (universalVector r i) (universalVector r i)
  have hU := rawAction_universalVector k g r i
  have hres : mapVector k g (idempotenceResidual k r i) =
      linearEquiv (R := CoordinateRing k) g (idempotenceResidual k r i) := by
    calc
      mapVector k g (idempotenceResidual k r i) =
          mapVector k g (product (k := k) (universalVector r i)
            (universalVector r i)) - mapVector k g (universalVector r i) := by
        rw [idempotenceResidual]
        funext d
        simp only [mapVector, Pi.sub_apply, map_sub]
      _ = product (k := k) (transformedUniversalVector k g r i)
          (transformedUniversalVector k g r i) -
            transformedUniversalVector k g r i := by rw [hprod, hU]
      _ = linearEquiv (R := CoordinateRing k) g
          (product (k := k) (universalVector r i) (universalVector r i)) -
            linearEquiv (R := CoordinateRing k) g (universalVector r i) := by
        rw [linearEquiv_product, transformedUniversalVector]
      _ = linearEquiv (R := CoordinateRing k) g
          (idempotenceResidual k r i) := by
        rw [idempotenceResidual, map_sub]
  have hc := congrFun hres c
  rw [mapVector, idempotenceResidual_apply] at hc
  rw [hc]
  exact linearEquiv_mem_rawFrameIdeal k g (idempotenceResidual k r i)
      (fun d => by
        rw [idempotenceResidual_apply]
        exact Ideal.subset_span
          (Set.mem_range_self (EquationIndex.idempotence r i d))) c

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceRawIdealPreservation.rawAction_traceOne_eq
statement:
theorem rawAction_traceOne_eq (g : SourceAut (K := k)) (r i : Fin 3) :
    rawAction k g (equation (.traceOne r i)) = equation (.traceOne r i)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [equation, map_sub, map_add, map_one]
  rw [show rawAction k g (universalVector r i 0) = transformedUniversalVector k g r i 0
      from congrFun (rawAction_universalVector k g r i) 0,
    show rawAction k g (universalVector r i 1) = transformedUniversalVector k g r i 1
      from congrFun (rawAction_universalVector k g r i) 1,
    show rawAction k g (universalVector r i 2) = transformedUniversalVector k g r i 2
      from congrFun (rawAction_universalVector k g r i) 2]
  change trace (transformedUniversalVector k g r i) - 1 =
    trace (universalVector r i) - 1
  rw [transformedUniversalVector, linearEquiv_trace]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceRawIdealPreservation.rawAction_sumOne_mem
statement:
theorem rawAction_sumOne_mem (g : SourceAut (K := k))
    (r : Fin 3) (c : Fin 27) :
    rawAction k g (equation (.sumOne r c)) ∈ rawFrameIdeal (k := k)
proof:
:= by
  have hres : mapVector k g (sumResidual k r) =
      linearEquiv (R := CoordinateRing k) g (sumResidual k r) := by
    have hone : mapVector k g
        (SourceAutExtension.one (k := k) (R := CoordinateRing k)) =
          SourceAutExtension.one (k := k) (R := CoordinateRing k) := by
      funext d
      simp [mapVector, SourceAutExtension.one, rawAction]
    calc
      mapVector k g (sumResidual k r) =
          (∑ i : Fin 3, mapVector k g (universalVector r i)) -
            mapVector k g
              (SourceAutExtension.one (k := k) (R := CoordinateRing k)) := by
        rw [sumResidual]
        funext d
        simp only [mapVector, Pi.sub_apply, Finset.sum_apply, map_sub, map_sum]
      _ = (∑ i : Fin 3, transformedUniversalVector k g r i) -
          SourceAutExtension.one (k := k) (R := CoordinateRing k) := by
        rw [hone]
        simp_rw [rawAction_universalVector]
      _ = linearEquiv (R := CoordinateRing k) g
          ((∑ i : Fin 3, universalVector r i) -
            SourceAutExtension.one (k := k) (R := CoordinateRing k)) := by
        simp only [transformedUniversalVector, map_sub, map_sum, linearEquiv_one]
      _ = linearEquiv (R := CoordinateRing k) g (sumResidual k r) := rfl
  have hc := congrFun hres c
  rw [mapVector, sumResidual_apply] at hc
  rw [hc]
  exact linearEquiv_mem_rawFrameIdeal k g (sumResidual k r)
    (fun d => by
      rw [sumResidual_apply]
      exact Ideal.subset_span
        (Set.mem_range_self (EquationIndex.sumOne r d))) c

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceRawIdealPreservation.rawAction_equation_mem
statement:
theorem rawAction_equation_mem (g : SourceAut (K := k)) (q : EquationIndex) :
    rawAction k g (equation q) ∈ rawFrameIdeal (k := k)
proof:
:= by
  cases q with
  | idempotence r i c => exact rawAction_idempotence_mem k g r i c
  | traceOne r i =>
      rw [rawAction_traceOne_eq]
      exact Ideal.subset_span
        (Set.mem_range_self (EquationIndex.traceOne r i))
  | sumOne r c => exact rawAction_sumOne_mem k g r c

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceRawIdealPreservation.rawAction_maps_rawFrameIdeal
statement:
theorem rawAction_maps_rawFrameIdeal (g : SourceAut (K := k)) :
    Ideal.map (rawAction k g) (rawFrameIdeal (k := k)) ≤ rawFrameIdeal (k := k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
  apply Ideal.span_le.2
  intro x hx
  rcases hx with ⟨q, rfl⟩
  exact rawAction_equation_mem k g q

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceRawIdealPreservation.rawAction_radical_stable
statement:
theorem rawAction_radical_stable (g : SourceAut (K := k)) :
    (rawFrameIdeal (k := k)).radical ≤
      (rawFrameIdeal (k := k)).radical.comap (rawAction k g)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Ideal.mem_radical_iff.mp hx
  apply Ideal.mem_radical_iff.mpr
  refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
  rw [← map_pow]
  exact rawAction_maps_rawFrameIdeal k g
    (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (rawAction k g) hn)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericFieldChart.baseParameters_moment
statement: theorem baseParameters_moment : moment (baseParameters k) = rationalM k
proof:
:= by
  have ha := PA_ne_zero k
  have hb := PB_ne_zero k
  have hea : ι k (PA k) = ι k (diagX k 0) + ι k (diagX k 1) * 2 := by
    simp [PA, GenericDeterminantOpen.dA2, GenericDeterminantOpen.dA0,
      GenericDeterminantOpen.dA1]
    ring
  have heb : ι k (PB k) = ι k (diagX k 2) + ι k (diagX k 3) * 2 := by
    simp [PB, GenericDeterminantOpen.dB2, GenericDeterminantOpen.dB0,
      GenericDeterminantOpen.dB1]
    ring
  rw [hea] at ha
  rw [heb] at hb
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [moment, rationalM, baseParameters, m00, m11, m22, m33,
      normWeightedA, normWeightedB, spurSumA, spurSumB, pivotA, pivotB,
      GenericNormalizedFrameChart.dA2, GenericNormalizedFrameChart.dB2,
      rawOffDiag, nA0, nA2, nB1, nB3, TA, TB, SA, SB,
      GenericDeterminantOpen.dA2, GenericDeterminantOpen.dB2,
      GenericDeterminantOpen.dA0, GenericDeterminantOpen.dA1,
      GenericDeterminantOpen.dB0, GenericDeterminantOpen.dB1,
      GenericDeterminantOpen.a, GenericDeterminantOpen.b,
      GenericDeterminantOpen.c, off, PA, PB, PA_ne_zero, PB_ne_zero] <;>
    ring_nf <;> field_simp [ha, hb] <;> ring
