name: AlbertLean.Triality.ParityChartFiniteMover.eval_pivotPolynomial
statement:
@[simp] theorem eval_pivotPolynomial (A : VCoord K) (t : K) :
    (pivotPolynomial A).eval t = pivotValue A t
proof:
:= by
  simp [pivotPolynomial, pivotValue]

name: AlbertLean.Triality.ParityChartFiniteMover.pivotPolynomial_ne_zero
statement:
theorem pivotPolynomial_ne_zero (A : VCoord K) (hA : nV A ≠ 0) :
    pivotPolynomial A ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hr := congrArg (fun p : K[X] => p.coeff 7) h
  have hz := congrArg (fun p : K[X] => p.coeff 0) h
  have h12 := congrArg (fun p : K[X] => p.coeff 6) h
  have h13 := congrArg (fun p : K[X] => p.coeff 5) h
  have h14 := congrArg (fun p : K[X] => p.coeff 4) h
  have h23 := congrArg (fun p : K[X] => p.coeff 3) h
  have h24 := congrArg (fun p : K[X] => p.coeff 2) h
  have h34 := congrArg (fun p : K[X] => p.coeff 1) h
  simp [pivotPolynomial] at hr hz h12 h13 h14 h23 h24 h34
  have hzero : A = 0 := by
    apply VCoord.ext
    · exact hr
    · exact hz
    · funext i
      fin_cases i
      · exact h12
      · exact h13
      · exact h14
      · exact h23
      · exact h24
      · exact h34
  apply hA
  rw [hzero]
  simp [nV, pf_coordinate]

name: AlbertLean.Triality.ParityChartFiniteMover.natDegree_pivotPolynomial_le
statement:
theorem natDegree_pivotPolynomial_le (A : VCoord K) :
    (pivotPolynomial A).natDegree ≤ 7
proof:
:= by
  apply natDegree_le_iff_coeff_eq_zero.mpr
  intro n hn
  have h0 : n ≠ 0 := by omega
  have h1 : n ≠ 1 := by omega
  have h2 : n ≠ 2 := by omega
  have h3 : n ≠ 3 := by omega
  have h4 : n ≠ 4 := by omega
  have h5 : n ≠ 5 := by omega
  have h6 : n ≠ 6 := by omega
  have h7 : n ≠ 7 := by omega
  simp [pivotPolynomial, coeff_C, coeff_X, coeff_X_pow,
    h0, h1, Ne.symm h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, h7]

name: AlbertLean.Triality.ParityChartFiniteMover.natDegree_pivotPolynomial_mul_le
statement:
theorem natDegree_pivotPolynomial_mul_le (A B : VCoord K) :
    (pivotPolynomial A * pivotPolynomial B).natDegree ≤ 14
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (pivotPolynomial A * pivotPolynomial B).natDegree ≤
        (pivotPolynomial A).natDegree + (pivotPolynomial B).natDegree :=
      natDegree_mul_le
    _ ≤ 14 := Nat.add_le_add (natDegree_pivotPolynomial_le A)
      (natDegree_pivotPolynomial_le B)

name: AlbertLean.Triality.ParityChartFiniteMover.exists_fin15_move_centers
statement:
theorem exists_fin15_move_centers (A B : VCoord K)
    (hA : nV A ≠ 0) (hB : nV B ≠ 0) :
    ∃ t : Fin 15,
      (evenV parityVector (movingCenter (t.val : K)) A).r ≠ 0 ∧
      (evenV parityVector (movingCenter (t.val : K)) B).r ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let p := pivotPolynomial A * pivotPolynomial B
  have hp : p ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero (pivotPolynomial_ne_zero A hA)
    (pivotPolynomial_ne_zero B hB)
  by_contra hall
  push Not at hall
  have hroots : ∀ t : Fin 15, p.eval (t.val : K) = 0 := by
    intro t
    by_cases hAt : (evenV parityVector (movingCenter (t.val : K)) A).r = 0
    · rw [moved_r, ← eval_pivotPolynomial] at hAt
      simp [p, hAt]
    · have hBt := hall t hAt
      rw [moved_r, ← eval_pivotPolynomial] at hBt
      simp [p, hBt]
  let S : Finset K := Finset.univ.image (fun t : Fin 15 => (t.val : K))
  have hScard : S.card = 15 := by
    have hi : Set.InjOn (fun t : Fin 15 => (t.val : K)) (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 15)) := by
      intro i _ j _ hij
      apply Fin.ext
      exact Nat.cast_injective hij
    simpa [S] using Finset.card_image_iff.mpr hi
  have hsubset : S ⊆ p.roots.toFinset := by
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨t, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hz
    simpa only [Multiset.mem_toFinset] using
      (Polynomial.mem_roots hp).mpr (hroots t)
  have hcard : 15 ≤ p.roots.toFinset.card := by
    rw [← hScard]
    exact Finset.card_le_card hsubset
  have hdeg : p.natDegree ≤ 14 := natDegree_pivotPolynomial_mul_le A B
  have hbound : p.roots.toFinset.card ≤ p.natDegree :=
    (Multiset.toFinset_card_le p.roots).trans (Polynomial.card_roots' p)
  omega

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.CyclicBlockNormalizer.cyclic_intertwines
statement:
theorem cyclic_intertwines (X : Mat2 K) :
    X * cyclicBasis X = cyclicBasis X * companion X
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [cyclicBasis, companion, matrix, trace2, determinant,
      Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two] <;> ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.CyclicBlockNormalizer.cyclic_mul_inv
statement:
theorem cyclic_mul_inv (X : Mat2 K) (h : X 0 1 ≠ 0) :
    cyclicBasis X * cyclicBasisInv X = 1
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [cyclicBasis, cyclicBasisInv, matrix, Matrix.mul_apply,
      Fin.sum_univ_two, h] <;> field_simp <;> ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.CyclicBlockNormalizer.cyclic_inv_mul
statement:
theorem cyclic_inv_mul (X : Mat2 K) (h : X 0 1 ≠ 0) :
    cyclicBasisInv X * cyclicBasis X = 1
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [cyclicBasis, cyclicBasisInv, matrix, Matrix.mul_apply,
      Fin.sum_univ_two, h] <;> field_simp <;> ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.CyclicBlockNormalizer.rational_intertwiner
statement:
theorem rational_intertwiner (X Y : Mat2 K)
    (hx : X 0 1 ≠ 0) (hy : Y 0 1 ≠ 0)
    (ht : trace2 X = trace2 Y) (hd : determinant X = determinant Y) :
    let T
proof:
:= cyclicBasis X * cyclicBasisInv Y
    let S := cyclicBasis Y * cyclicBasisInv X
    T * S = 1 ∧ S * T = 1 ∧ X * T = T * Y := by
  have hc : companion X = companion Y := by simp only [companion, ht, hd]
  have hi : companion Y * cyclicBasisInv Y = cyclicBasisInv Y * Y := by
    calc
      companion Y * cyclicBasisInv Y =
          (cyclicBasisInv Y * cyclicBasis Y) * companion Y * cyclicBasisInv Y := by
            rw [cyclic_inv_mul Y hy, one_mul]
      _ = cyclicBasisInv Y * (cyclicBasis Y * companion Y) * cyclicBasisInv Y := by
        simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = cyclicBasisInv Y * (Y * cyclicBasis Y) * cyclicBasisInv Y := by
        rw [← cyclic_intertwines]
      _ = cyclicBasisInv Y * Y := by
        simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc, cyclic_mul_inv Y hy, Matrix.mul_one]
  dsimp only
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · calc
      _ = cyclicBasis X * (cyclicBasisInv Y * cyclicBasis Y) * cyclicBasisInv X := by
        simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = 1 := by rw [cyclic_inv_mul Y hy, Matrix.mul_one, cyclic_mul_inv X hx]
  · calc
      _ = cyclicBasis Y * (cyclicBasisInv X * cyclicBasis X) * cyclicBasisInv Y := by
        simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = 1 := by rw [cyclic_inv_mul X hx, Matrix.mul_one, cyclic_mul_inv Y hy]
  · calc
      _ = (X * cyclicBasis X) * cyclicBasisInv Y := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = (cyclicBasis X * companion Y) * cyclicBasisInv Y := by rw [cyclic_intertwines, hc]
      _ = cyclicBasis X * (cyclicBasisInv Y * Y) := by rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, hi]
      _ = _ := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ScheduleReducedDomain.charZero_of_injective_map
statement:
private theorem charZero_of_injective_map

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ScheduleReducedDomain.inverse_map_jordan
statement:
theorem inverse_map_jordan (g : Aut (K := k)) (A B : SelfAdjointCarrier.Carrier k) :
    g.linear.symm (SelfAdjointCarrier.jordan A B) =
      SelfAdjointCarrier.jordan (g.linear.symm A) (g.linear.symm B)
proof:
:= by
  apply g.linear.injective
  rw [g.linear.apply_symm_apply, g.map_jordan,
    g.linear.apply_symm_apply, g.linear.apply_symm_apply]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ScheduleReducedDomain.inverse_map_one
statement:

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ScheduleReducedDomain.inverse_standard_isRaw
statement:
theorem inverse_standard_isRaw (g : Aut (K := k)) :
    IsRawFrameFamily (fun _ i => encode (g.linear.symm (standardCarrierProjector i)))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro r i
    apply decode_injective
    rw [decode_coordinateJordan]
    simp only [decode_encode]
    rw [← inverse_map_jordan]
    congr 1
    apply Subtype.ext
    ext a b
    rcases a with a | a <;> rcases b with b | b <;>
      fin_cases a <;> fin_cases b <;> fin_cases i <;>
      simp [standardCarrierProjector, diagonalProjector,
        SelfAdjointCarrier.jordan, GroupedBridge.matrixJordan,
        GroupedBridge.grouped, ScalarFibre.hat, Matrix.mul_apply,
        Fintype.sum_sum_type, Fin.sum_univ_succ] <;> norm_num
  · intro r i
    rw [← jordanTrace_decode]
    rw [decode_encode]
    rw [← jordanTrace_invariant g (g.linear.symm (standardCarrierProjector i)),
      g.linear.apply_symm_apply]
    fin_cases i <;>
      simp [ProjectorBlockBridge.jordanTrace, standardCarrierProjector,
        diagonalProjector, GroupedBridge.grouped, Matrix.trace,
        Fintype.sum_sum_type, Fin.sum_univ_succ] <;> norm_num
  · intro r c
    have hs : ∑ i : Fin 3, g.linear.symm (standardCarrierProjector i) =
        SelfAdjointCarrier.one := by
      rw [← map_sum, ← inverse_map_one]
      congr 1
      apply Subtype.ext
      ext a b
      rcases a with a | a <;> rcases b with b | b <;>
        fin_cases a <;> fin_cases b <;>
        simp [standardCarrierProjector, diagonalProjector,
          GroupedBridge.grouped, ScalarFibre.hat, SelfAdjointCarrier.one,
          Fin.sum_univ_succ, Matrix.one_apply]
    calc
      (∑ i : Fin 3, encode (g.linear.symm (standardCarrierProjector i)) c) =
          encode (∑ i : Fin 3, g.linear.symm (standardCarrierProjector i)) c := by
            exact congrFun (map_sum (encodeLinear (K := k))
              (fun i : Fin 3 => g.linear.symm (standardCarrierProjector i)) Finset.univ) c |>.symm
      _ = encode (SelfAdjointCarrier.one : Carrier k) c := by rw [hs]
      _ = _ := RawFrameIdeal.encode_one c

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ScheduleReducedDomain.genericPoint_isRaw
statement:
theorem genericPoint_isRaw (p : Ideal (CoordinateRing k)) [p.IsPrime]
    (hraw : rawFrameIdeal k ≤ p) : IsRawFrameFamily (genericPoint k p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← equations_vanishAlong_iff k (coefficientMap k p)]
  have heq : evaluationAlong k (coefficientMap k p) (genericPoint k p) =
      residueMap k p := by
    apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
    · intro a
      simp only [evaluationAlong, MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_C]
      rfl
    · intro q
      rcases q with ⟨r, i, c⟩
      simp only [evaluationAlong, MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_X']
      rfl
  intro q
  rw [heq]
  change algebraMap (Residue k p) (GenericField k p)
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk p (equation k q)) = 0
  rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr
    (hraw (Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self q))), map_zero]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ScheduleReducedDomain.exists_prime_schedule_square
statement:
theorem exists_prime_schedule_square
    (p : Ideal (CoordinateRing k)) [p.IsPrime]
    (hraw : rawFrameIdeal k ≤ p) :
    ∃ (L : Type u) (_ : Field L) (j : Residue k p →+* L),
      Function.Injective j ∧ ∃ e : ParameterRing k →+* L,
        e.comp (scheduleRawMap k) = j.comp (Ideal.Quotient.mk p)
proof:
:= by
  have hP := genericPoint_isRaw k p hraw
  have hactual (r : Fin 3) := actual_frame_laws (genericPoint k p) hP r
  choose word hlen hword using fun r =>
    exists_jordanAut_to_standard_frame (fun i => decode (genericPoint k p r i))
      (hactual r).1 (hactual r).2.1 (hactual r).2.2
  let Z : Fin 3 → Fin 12 → (Vec6 (GenericField k p) × GenericField k p) :=
    fun r => scheduleOfLengthTwelve (word r) (hlen r)
  let e : ParameterRing k →+* GenericField k p := evalSchedule k (coefficientMap k p) Z
  let j : Residue k p →+* GenericField k p := algebraMap _ _
  refine ⟨GenericField k p, inferInstance, j, IsFractionRing.injective _ _, e, ?_⟩
  apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
  · intro a
    simp [e, j, evalSchedule, coefficientMap, residueMap, scheduleRawMap]
  · intro q
    rcases q with ⟨r,i,c⟩
    simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, scheduleRawMap_X]
    have hs := congrFun (eval_scheduledPoint k (coefficientMap k p) Z r i) c
    have hw : (wordJordanAut (concreteWord Z r)).linear.symm
        (standardCarrierProjector i) = decode (genericPoint k p r i) := by
      apply (wordJordanAut (concreteWord Z r)).linear.injective
      rw [(wordJordanAut (concreteWord Z r)).linear.apply_symm_apply]
      rw [show concreteWord Z r = word r by
        change List.ofFn (scheduleOfLengthTwelve (word r) (hlen r)) = word r
        exact ofFn_scheduleOfLengthTwelve (word r) (hlen r)]
      exact (hword r i).symm
    rw [hw, encode_decode] at hs
    simpa [e, j, residueMap, genericPoint] using hs

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ScheduleReducedDomain.rawFrameIdeal_le_scheduleKernel
statement:
theorem rawFrameIdeal_le_scheduleKernel :
    rawFrameIdeal k ≤ RingHom.ker (scheduleRawMap k)
proof:
:= by
  let F := FractionRing (ParameterRing k)
  letI : Field F := inferInstance
  let inc : ParameterRing k →+* F := algebraMap _ _
  let coeff : k →+* F := inc.comp (algebraMap k (ParameterRing k))
  letI : CharZero F := charZero_of_injective_map coeff coeff.injective
  let Z : Fin 3 → Fin 12 → (Vec6 F × F) := fun r s =>
    (fun i => inc (direction k r s i), inc (coefficient k r s))
  have heval : evalSchedule k coeff Z = inc := by
    apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
    · intro a
      simp [evalSchedule, coeff]
    · intro q
      rcases q with ⟨r,s,c⟩
      rcases c with c | c <;> simp [evalSchedule, Z, direction, coefficient, inc]
  let P : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Coordinates F := fun r i =>
    encode ((wordJordanAut (concreteWord Z r)).linear.symm
      (standardCarrierProjector i))
  have hP : IsRawFrameFamily P := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro r i
      exact (inverse_standard_isRaw F
        (wordJordanAut (concreteWord Z r))).idempotent 0 i
    · intro r i
      exact (inverse_standard_isRaw F
        (wordJordanAut (concreteWord Z r))).trace_one 0 i
    · intro r c
      exact (inverse_standard_isRaw F
        (wordJordanAut (concreteWord Z r))).sum_one 0 c
  have hideal : rawFrameIdeal k ≤ RingHom.ker (evaluationAlong k coeff P) :=
    (rawFrameIdeal_le_ker_iff k coeff P).2 hP
  have hcomp : inc.comp (scheduleRawMap k) = evaluationAlong k coeff P := by
    apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
    · intro a
      simp [RingHom.comp_apply, scheduleRawMap, evaluationAlong, coeff]
    · intro q
      rcases q with ⟨r,i,c⟩
      simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, scheduleRawMap_X,
        evaluationAlong, MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_X']
      have hs := congrFun (eval_scheduledPoint k coeff Z r i) c
      rw [heval] at hs
      exact hs
  intro x hx
  apply RingHom.mem_ker.mpr
  apply (IsFractionRing.injective (ParameterRing k) F)
  rw [map_zero]
  have hx0 := RingHom.mem_ker.mp (hideal hx)
  rw [← DFunLike.congr_fun hcomp x] at hx0
  exact hx0

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ScheduleReducedDomain.radical_eq_scheduleKernel
statement:

    (rawFrameIdeal k).radical = RingHom.ker (scheduleRawMap k)

    (rawFrameIdeal_le_scheduleKernel k)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ScheduleReducedDomain.rawFrameRadical_isPrime

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuadraticDetectorAffine.theta_sq
statement:
theorem theta_sq (s m : R) :
    theta s m ^ 2 =
      algebraMap R (DetectorQuadratic s m) s * theta s m -
        algebraMap R (DetectorQuadratic s m) m
proof:
:= by
  simpa [theta, pow_two, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm, add_left_comm,
    add_assoc] using
    (QuadraticAlgebra.omega_mul_omega_eq_algebraMap
      (R := R) (a := -m) (b := s))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuadraticDetectorAffine.theta_mul_thetaInv
statement:
theorem theta_mul_thetaInv (s m mInv : R) (hm : m * mInv = 1) :
    theta s m * thetaInv s m mInv = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hs := theta_sq (R := R) s m
  calc
    theta s m * thetaInv s m mInv =
        (theta s m * algebraMap R (DetectorQuadratic s m) s -
          theta s m ^ 2) * algebraMap R (DetectorQuadratic s m) mInv := by
      rw [thetaInv]
      ring
    _ = algebraMap R (DetectorQuadratic s m) m *
        algebraMap R (DetectorQuadratic s m) mInv := by rw [hs]; ring
    _ = 1 := by rw [← map_mul, hm, map_one]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuadraticDetectorAffine.value_eq_epsilon_add_beta_theta
statement:
theorem value_eq_epsilon_add_beta_theta
    (dA dB : Fin 3 → R) (a b c : R)
    (M : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) R) (s m mInv : R) :
    value dA dB a b c M s m mInv =
      algebraMap R (DetectorQuadratic s m)
          (epsilon dA dB a b c M s m mInv) +
        algebraMap R (DetectorQuadratic s m)
          (beta dA dB a b c M s m mInv) * theta s m
proof:
:= by
  symm
  simpa [epsilon, beta, theta, Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one] using
    QuadraticAlgebra.re_smul_add_im_smul
      (value dA dB a b c M s m mInv)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuadraticDetectorAffine.evalAt_theta
statement:
@[simp] theorem evalAt_theta (f : R →+* K) (s m : R) (Delta : K)
    (hDelta : Delta ^ 2 = f s * Delta - f m) :
    evalAt f s m Delta hDelta (theta s m) = Delta
proof:
:= by
  simp [evalAt, theta, Algebra.smul_def]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuadraticDetectorAffine.evalAt_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp] theorem evalAt_algebraMap (f : R →+* K) (s m : R) (Delta : K)
    (hDelta : Delta ^ 2 = f s * Delta - f m) (x : R) :
    evalAt f s m Delta hDelta
      (algebraMap R (DetectorQuadratic s m) x) = f x
proof:
:= by
  simp [evalAt, RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuadraticDetectorAffine.evalAt_thetaInv
statement:
theorem evalAt_thetaInv (f : R →+* K) (s m mInv : R)
    (hm : m * mInv = 1) (Delta : K)
    (hDelta : Delta ^ 2 = f s * Delta - f m) :
    evalAt f s m Delta hDelta (thetaInv s m mInv) = Delta⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hfm : f m ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have := congrArg f hm
    simp [h] at this
  have hDelta0 : Delta ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hfm
    have hd : (0 : K) = -f m := by simpa [h] using hDelta
    exact neg_eq_zero.mp hd.symm
  let e := evalAt f s m Delta hDelta
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ hDelta0
  have hu := congrArg e (theta_mul_thetaInv (R := R) s m mInv hm)
  rw [map_mul, map_one, evalAt_theta] at hu
  rw [hu, mul_inv_cancel₀ hDelta0]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuadraticDetectorAffine.normalized_eq_epsilon_add_beta_mul
statement:
theorem normalized_eq_epsilon_add_beta_mul
    (dA dB : Fin 3 → R) (a b c : R)
    (M : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) R) (s m mInv : R)
    (hm : m * mInv = 1) (f : R →+* K) (Delta : K)
    (hDelta : Delta ^ 2 = f s * Delta - f m) :
    normalized (fun i => f (dA i)) (fun i => f (dB i))
        1 (f a) (f b) (f c) (M.map f) Delta Delta⁻¹ =
      f (epsilon dA dB a b c M s m mInv) +
        f (beta dA dB a b c M s m mInv) * Delta
proof:
:= by
  let e := evalAt f s m Delta hDelta
  have hv := congrArg e
    (value_eq_epsilon_add_beta_theta dA dB a b c M s m mInv)
  have hn := map_normalized e
    (fun i => algebraMap R (DetectorQuadratic s m) (dA i))
    (fun i => algebraMap R (DetectorQuadratic s m) (dB i))
    1 (algebraMap R (DetectorQuadratic s m) a)
    (algebraMap R (DetectorQuadratic s m) b)
    (algebraMap R (DetectorQuadratic s m) c)
    (M.map (algebraMap R (DetectorQuadratic s m)))
    (theta s m) (thetaInv s m mInv)
  rw [value, hn] at hv
  simpa [e, evalAt_algebraMap, evalAt_theta,
    evalAt_thetaInv f s m mInv hm Delta hDelta,
    Matrix.map_map, Function.comp_def] using hv

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceNormalizationOpenWitness.moment_parameters
statement:
theorem moment_parameters : moment (parameters K) =
    Matrix.diagonal ![-(1/2 : K), -1, -(1/2 : K), -1]
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    norm_num [moment, parameters, m00, m11, m22, m33,
      normWeightedA, normWeightedB, spurSumA, spurSumB,
      pivotA, pivotB, dA2, dB2, rawOffDiag, Matrix.diagonal]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceNormalizationOpenWitness.determinant_moment
statement: theorem determinant_moment : Matrix.det (moment (parameters K)) = (1/4 : K)
proof:
:= by
  rw [moment_parameters, Matrix.det_diagonal]
  norm_num [Fin.prod_univ_succ]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceNormalizationOpenWitness.fixed_difference_values
statement:
theorem fixed_difference_values :
    nV (targetFirst (1 : K)) = 1 ∧
    nV (targetRemainder (1 : K) 3 1) = -(1/4 : K) ∧
    (differenceB1 (1 : K)).r = -2 ∧
    nV (differenceB1 (1 : K)) = 4 ∧
    (differenceB2 (1 : K) 3 1).r = 1 ∧
    nV (differenceB2 (1 : K) 3 1) = -1
proof:
:= by
  rw [targetFirst_norm, targetRemainder_norm 1 3 1 (by norm_num),
    differenceB1_r, differenceB1_norm,
    differenceB2_r 1 3 1 (by norm_num),
    differenceB2_norm 1 3 1 (by norm_num)]
  norm_num

name: AlbertLean.Generic.UniformMomentActualSpecialization.actualDetectorQuadraticMap_im
statement:
private theorem actualDetectorQuadraticMap_im
    (f : A →+* B) (s m : A)
    (z : QuadraticDetectorAffine.DetectorQuadratic s m) :
    (actualDetectorQuadraticMap f s m z).im = f z.im
proof:
:= by
  have homega : actualDetectorQuadraticMap f s m
      (QuadraticAlgebra.omega :
        QuadraticDetectorAffine.DetectorQuadratic s m) =
      (QuadraticAlgebra.omega :
        QuadraticDetectorAffine.DetectorQuadratic (f s) (f m)) :=
    actualDetectorQuadraticMap_theta f s m
  conv_lhs =>
    rw [← QuadraticAlgebra.re_smul_add_im_smul z]
  simp [Algebra.smul_def, homega]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.UniformMomentActualSpecialization.actualDetectorQuadraticMap_value

private theorem actualDetectorQuadraticMap_value
    (f : A →+* B) (dA dB : Fin 3 → A) (a b c : A)

    actualDetectorQuadraticMap f s m
        (QuadraticDetectorAffine.value dA dB a b c M s m mInv) =
      QuadraticDetectorAffine.value (fun i => f (dA i))
        (fun i => f (dB i)) (f a) (f b) (f c) (M.map f)
        (f s) (f m) (f mInv)
proof:
:= by
  unfold QuadraticDetectorAffine.value
  rw [NormalizedDetectorCircuit.map_normalized]
  simp [Matrix.map_map, Function.comp_def]

        (fun i => f (dB i)) (f a) (f b) (f c) (M.map f)
        (f s) (f m) (f mInv)

    (hsigma : sigma ^ 2 = evalR0 k f q (discr k)) (x : Local k) :

name: AlbertLean.Generic.UniformMomentActualSpecialization.evalLocal_norm_eq_evalQ_mul_evalQ_neg
statement:
theorem evalLocal_norm_eq_evalQ_mul_evalQ_neg
    (f : k →+* L) (q : ExplicitFrameChart L)
    (hB : evalR0 k f q (B0 k) ≠ 0) (sigma : L)
    (hsigma2 : sigma ^ 2 = evalR0 k f q (discr k)) (z : Q k) :
    evalLocal k f q hB (QuadraticAlgebra.norm z) =
      evalQ k f q hB sigma hsigma2 z *
        evalQ k f q hB (-sigma) (by simpa [pow_two] using hsigma2) z
proof:
:= by
  let ep := evalQ k f q hB sigma hsigma2
  let em := evalQ k f q hB (-sigma) (by simpa [pow_two] using hsigma2)
  have hep : ep z =
      evalLocal k f q hB z.re + evalLocal k f q hB z.im * sigma := by
    rw [← QuadraticAlgebra.re_smul_add_im_smul z]
    simp [Algebra.smul_def, ep, evalQ_algebraMap, evalQ_omega]
  have hem : em z =
      evalLocal k f q hB z.re - evalLocal k f q hB z.im * sigma := by
    rw [← QuadraticAlgebra.re_smul_add_im_smul z]
    simp [Algebra.smul_def, em, evalQ_algebraMap, evalQ_omega,
      sub_eq_add_neg]
  change evalLocal k f q hB (QuadraticAlgebra.norm z) = ep z * em z
  rw [hep, hem, QuadraticAlgebra.norm_def]
  simp only [map_sub, map_add, map_mul, map_pow, map_zero, evalLocal_loc]
  rw [← hsigma2]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.UniformMomentActualSpecialization.actual_nVx_eq
proof:
:= by
  have hfixed := (equationsVanish_iff_source_fixedSpectrum q).1 hq
  have hm := recovered_measurements (encoderA q) (encoderB q)
    hfixed.2.2.1 hfixed.2.2.2.2.2
  calc
    nVx (actualLedger q) = q.z1 := by
      change nVx (sourceLedger (encoderA q) (encoderB q)) = q.z1
      rw [hm.1]
      simp [encoderA, vectorA, AlbertLean.Triality.CoordinateTensor.nV,
        AlbertLean.Triality.ExteriorSix.Pf,
        AlbertLean.Triality.ExteriorSix.BW, hr]
    _ = a := hz1

name: AlbertLean.Generic.UniformMomentActualSpecialization.actual_gV_eq
proof:
:= by
  have hfixed := (equationsVanish_iff_source_fixedSpectrum q).1 hq
  have hm := recovered_measurements (encoderA q) (encoderB q)
    hfixed.2.2.1 hfixed.2.2.2.2.2
  change gV (sourceLedger (encoderA q) (encoderB q)) 1 1 = gramV12 q
  rw [hm.2.2.2.2.2.2.1]
  simp [gramV12, encoderA, encoderB, vectorA, vectorB,
    AlbertLean.Triality.CoordinateTensor.BV,
    AlbertLean.Triality.ExteriorSix.BW]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.UniformMomentActualSpecialization.evalLocal_aInv
statement:
private theorem evalLocal_aInv (f : k →+* L) (q : ExplicitFrameChart L)
    (hB : evalR0 k f q (B0 k) ≠ 0) (a : L)
    (haEval : evalR0 k f q (UniformMomentFiniteAlgebra.a k) = a) :
    evalLocal k f q hB (aInv k) = a⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (evalLocal k f q hB) (a_mul_aInv k)
  simp only [map_mul, map_one, evalLocal_loc, haEval] at h
  exact (inv_eq_of_mul_eq_one_right h).symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.UniformMomentActualSpecialization.evalLocal_twoInv
statement:
private theorem evalLocal_twoInv (f : k →+* L) (q : ExplicitFrameChart L)
    (hB : evalR0 k f q (B0 k) ≠ 0) :
    evalLocal k f q hB ((algebraMap k (Local k)) (2 : k)⁻¹) =
      (2 : L)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  change ((evalLocal k f q hB).comp (algebraMap k (Local k)))
    ((2 : k)⁻¹) = (2 : L)⁻¹
  simp only [map_inv₀, map_ofNat]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.UniformMomentActualSpecialization.evalQ_sigmaInv
statement:
private theorem evalQ_sigmaInv (f : k →+* L) (q : ExplicitFrameChart L)
    (hB : evalR0 k f q (B0 k) ≠ 0) (sigma : L)
    (hsigma2 : sigma ^ 2 = evalR0 k f q (discr k)) :
    evalQ k f q hB sigma hsigma2 (sigmaInv k) = sigma⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (evalQ k f q hB sigma hsigma2)
    (sigma_mul_sigmaInv k)
  simp only [map_mul, map_one, evalQ_omega] at h
  exact (inv_eq_of_mul_eq_one_right h).symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.UniformMomentActualSpecialization.evalQ_scaleUnit
statement:
private theorem evalQ_scaleUnit (f : k →+* L) (q : ExplicitFrameChart L)
    (hB : evalR0 k f q (B0 k) ≠ 0) (a sigma : L)
    (hsigma2 : sigma ^ 2 = evalR0 k f q (discr k))
    (haEval : evalR0 k f q (UniformMomentFiniteAlgebra.a k) = a) :
    evalQ k f q hB sigma hsigma2 (scaleUnit k : Q k) =
      (2 * a * sigma)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  simp [scaleUnit, twoUnit, twoBaseUnit, aUnit, evalQ_algebraMap,
    sigmaUnit, evalLocal_aInv k f q hB a haEval,
    evalLocal_twoInv k f q hB,
    evalQ_sigmaInv k f q hB sigma hsigma2, map_inv₀]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.UniformMomentActualSpecialization.evalQ_moment
statement:
theorem evalQ_moment (f : k →+* L) (q : ExplicitFrameChart L)
    (hB : evalR0 k f q (B0 k) ≠ 0) (a b c sigma : L)
    (hq : EquationsVanish (explicitFrameEquationValues q))
    (hr : q.r1 = 1) (hz1 : q.z1 = a) (hr2 : q.r2 = b) (hz2 : q.z2 = c)
    (hb : b = (gramV12 q - sigma) / (2*a))
    (hc : c = (gramV12 q + sigma) / 2)
    (hsigma2 : sigma ^ 2 = evalR0 k f q (discr k))
    (hsigma : sigma ≠ 0) (ha : 2*a ≠ 0) :
    (moment k).map (evalQ k f q hB sigma hsigma2) = matrixM q
proof:
:= by
  let ep := evalQ k f q hB sigma hsigma2
  let phi := ep.comp (qmap k)
  have hrec := matrixM_eq_uniform_inverse q a b c sigma
    hq hr hz1 hr2 hz2 hb hc hsigma ha
  have haEval : evalR0 k f q (UniformMomentFiniteAlgebra.a k) = a :=
    (evalR0_a k f q).trans (actual_nVx_eq q a hq hr hz1)
  have hhEval : evalR0 k f q (h k) = gramV12 q :=
    (evalR0_h k f q).trans (actual_gV_eq q hq)
  have hcomp : phi.comp (algebraMap (R0 k) (Q0 k)) = evalR0 k f q := by
    apply RingHom.ext
    intro x
    simp [phi, ep, qmap, QuadraticNormTransport.map_eq,
      evalQ_algebraMap, evalLocal_loc]
  have hrat : phi.comp (algebraMap ℚ (Q0 k)) = algebraMap ℚ L :=
    Subsingleton.elim _ _
  have hledger :
      mapLedger phi
          (mapLedger (algebraMap (R0 k) (Q0 k)) (universalLedger k)) =
        actualLedger q := by
    rw [mapLedger_comp, hcomp, evalR0_universalLedger]
  have hA : phi (algebraMap (R0 k) (Q0 k)
      (UniformMomentFiniteAlgebra.a k)) = a := by
    change (phi.comp (algebraMap (R0 k) (Q0 k)))
      (UniformMomentFiniteAlgebra.a k) = a
    rw [hcomp, haEval]
  have hH : phi (algebraMap (R0 k) (Q0 k) (h k)) = gramV12 q := by
    change (phi.comp (algebraMap (R0 k) (Q0 k))) (h k) = gramV12 q
    rw [hcomp, hhEval]
  have hSigma : phi (QuadraticAlgebra.omega : Q0 k) = sigma := by
    simp [phi, ep, qmap, QuadraticNormTransport.map_eq, evalQ_omega]
  have hN : (N k).map ep =
      uniformN (actualLedger q) a (gramV12 q) sigma := by
    rw [N, Matrix.map_map]
    change (N0 k).map phi = _
    rw [N0, map_uniformN phi hrat, hledger, hA, hH, hSigma]
  have hmapMoment : (UniformMomentFiniteAlgebra.moment k).map ep =
      ep (scaleUnit k : Q k) •
      (N k).map ep := by
    ext i j
    simp only [UniformMomentFiniteAlgebra.moment, Matrix.map_apply,
      Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, map_mul]
  rw [hmapMoment,
    evalQ_scaleUnit k f q hB a sigma hsigma2 haEval, hN]
  exact hrec.symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.UniformMomentActualSpecialization.eval_betaOpen_ne_zero
statement:
theorem eval_betaOpen_ne_zero (f : k →+* L) (q : ExplicitFrameChart L)
    (hopen : evalR0 k f q (betaOpen k) ≠ 0) :
    evalR0 k f q (B0 k) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hB
  apply hopen
  rw [betaOpen, map_mul, hB, zero_mul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.UniformMomentActualSpecialization.evalLocal_betaNorm_ne_zero
statement:
theorem evalLocal_betaNorm_ne_zero (f : k →+* L) (q : ExplicitFrameChart L)
    (hopen : evalR0 k f q (betaOpen k) ≠ 0) :
    evalLocal k f q (eval_betaOpen_ne_zero k f q hopen) (betaNorm k) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  let s := IsLocalization.Away.sec (B0 k) (betaNorm k)
  have hopen' : evalR0 k f q (B0 k) *
      evalR0 k f q (betaNumerator k) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa [betaOpen] using hopen
  have hn : evalR0 k f q s.1 ≠ 0 := by
    simpa [s, betaNumerator] using (mul_ne_zero_iff.mp hopen').2
  have hs : betaNorm k * algebraMap (R0 k) (Local k) ((B0 k) ^ s.2) =
      algebraMap (R0 k) (Local k) s.1 := IsLocalization.Away.sec_spec (B0 k) (betaNorm k)
  have hm := congrArg (evalLocal k f q (eval_betaOpen_ne_zero k f q hopen)) hs
  intro hz
  rw [map_mul, hz, zero_mul] at hm
  apply hn
  rw [← evalLocal_loc k f q (eval_betaOpen_ne_zero k f q hopen)]
  exact hm.symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.UniformMomentActualSpecialization.evalQ_beta_ne_zero
statement:
theorem evalQ_beta_ne_zero (f : k →+* L) (q : ExplicitFrameChart L)
    (hopen : evalR0 k f q (betaOpen k) ≠ 0) (sigma : L)
    (hsigma2 : sigma ^ 2 = evalR0 k f q (discr k)) :
    evalQ k f q (eval_betaOpen_ne_zero k f q hopen) sigma hsigma2
      (UniformMomentGenericQuadraticEval.beta k) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  let hB := eval_betaOpen_ne_zero k f q hopen
  let ep := evalQ k f q hB sigma hsigma2
  let em := evalQ k f q hB (-sigma) (by simpa [pow_two] using hsigma2)
  have hn := evalLocal_betaNorm_ne_zero k f q hopen
  have hprod : ep (UniformMomentGenericQuadraticEval.beta k) *
      em (UniformMomentGenericQuadraticEval.beta k) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← evalLocal_norm_eq_evalQ_mul_evalQ_neg k f q hB sigma hsigma2
      (UniformMomentGenericQuadraticEval.beta k)]
    simpa only [betaNorm] using hn
  exact (mul_ne_zero_iff.mp hprod).1

name: AlbertLean.Generic.UniformMomentActualSpecialization.evalQ_beta_eq_actualBeta
statement:
theorem evalQ_beta_eq_actualBeta (f : k →+* L) (q : ExplicitFrameChart L)
    (hopen : evalR0 k f q (betaOpen k) ≠ 0) (a b c sigma : L)
    (hq : EquationsVanish (explicitFrameEquationValues q))
    (hr : q.r1 = 1) (hz1 : q.z1 = a) (hr2 : q.r2 = b) (hz2 : q.z2 = c)
    (hb : b = (gramV12 q - sigma) / (2*a))
    (hc : c = (gramV12 q + sigma) / 2)
    (hsigma2 : sigma ^ 2 = evalR0 k f q (discr k))
    (hsigma : sigma ≠ 0) (ha : 2*a ≠ 0) :
    evalQ k f q (eval_betaOpen_ne_zero k f q hopen) sigma hsigma2
        (UniformMomentGenericQuadraticEval.beta k) =
      UniformMomentActualDetector.actualBeta q a b c sigma
proof:
:= by
  let hB := eval_betaOpen_ne_zero k f q hopen
  let ep := evalQ k f q hB sigma hsigma2
  change ep (UniformMomentGenericQuadraticEval.beta k) =
    UniformMomentActualDetector.actualBeta q a b c sigma
  have hrat := evalR0_preserves_rat k f q
  have haEval : evalR0 k f q (UniformMomentFiniteAlgebra.a k) = a :=
    (evalR0_a k f q).trans (actual_nVx_eq q a hq hr hz1)
  have hhEval : evalR0 k f q (UniformMomentFiniteAlgebra.h k) =
      gramV12 q := (evalR0_h k f q).trans (actual_gV_eq q hq)
  have hdA (i : Fin 3) : ep
      (UniformMomentGenericQuadraticEval.finiteDiagA k i) =
        D (actualLedger q) i 1 := by
    simp only [UniformMomentGenericQuadraticEval.finiteDiagA,
      ep, evalQ_algebraMap, evalLocal_loc]
    rw [actual_map_D (evalR0 k f q) hrat, evalR0_universalLedger]
  have hdB (i : Fin 3) : ep
      (UniformMomentGenericQuadraticEval.finiteDiagB k i) =
        E (actualLedger q) i 1 := by
    simp only [UniformMomentGenericQuadraticEval.finiteDiagB,
      ep, evalQ_algebraMap, evalLocal_loc]
    rw [actual_map_E (evalR0 k f q) hrat, evalR0_universalLedger]
  have hA : ep (algebraMap (Local k) (Q k)
      (loc k (UniformMomentFiniteAlgebra.a k))) = a := by
    simp only [ep, evalQ_algebraMap, evalLocal_loc]
    exact haEval
  have hH : ep (UniformMomentGenericQuadraticEval.finiteH k) =
      gramV12 q := by
    simp only [UniformMomentGenericQuadraticEval.finiteH, ep,
      evalQ_algebraMap, evalLocal_loc]
    exact hhEval
  have hTwoAInv : ep
      (UniformMomentGenericQuadraticEval.finiteTwoAInv k) =
        (2 * a)⁻¹ := by
    simp [UniformMomentGenericQuadraticEval.finiteTwoAInv,
      twoUnit, twoBaseUnit, aUnit, ep, evalQ_algebraMap,
      evalLocal_aInv k f q hB a haEval,
      evalLocal_twoInv k f q hB, map_inv₀]
  have hTwoInv : ep (UniformMomentGenericQuadraticEval.finiteTwoInv k) =
      (2 : L)⁻¹ := by
    simp [UniformMomentGenericQuadraticEval.finiteTwoInv,
      twoUnit, twoBaseUnit, ep, evalQ_algebraMap,
      evalLocal_twoInv k f q hB, map_inv₀]
  have hBval : ep (UniformMomentGenericQuadraticEval.finiteB k) = b := by
    rw [UniformMomentGenericQuadraticEval.finiteB, map_mul, map_sub,
      hH, show ep (UniformMomentGenericQuadraticEval.finiteSigma k) =
        sigma by exact evalQ_omega k f q hB sigma hsigma2, hTwoAInv]
    simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv] using hb.symm
  have hCval : ep (UniformMomentGenericQuadraticEval.finiteC k) = c := by
    rw [UniformMomentGenericQuadraticEval.finiteC, map_mul, map_add,
      hH, show ep (UniformMomentGenericQuadraticEval.finiteSigma k) =
        sigma by exact evalQ_omega k f q hB sigma hsigma2, hTwoInv]
    simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv] using hc.symm
  have hmoment : (moment k).map ep = matrixM q :=
    evalQ_moment k f q hB a b c sigma hq hr hz1 hr2 hz2 hb hc
      hsigma2 hsigma ha
  have hrec : matrixM q =
      UniformMomentActualDetector.reconstructedMatrix q a sigma := by
    exact matrixM_eq_uniform_inverse q a b c sigma
      hq hr hz1 hr2 hz2 hb hc hsigma ha
  have hS : ep (UniformMomentGenericQuadraticEval.finiteS k) =
      UniformMomentActualDetector.detectorS q a sigma := by
    change ep
        ((moment k 2 0 * moment k 1 3 + moment k 3 1 * moment k 0 2 +
          moment k 1 0 * moment k 3 2 - moment k 1 2 * moment k 3 0 +
          moment k 0 1 * moment k 2 3 - moment k 0 3 * moment k 2 1) -
          algebraMap (Local k) (Q k) (loc k (uV (universalLedger k)))) = _
    simp only [map_sub, map_add, map_mul, ep, evalQ_algebraMap,
      evalLocal_loc, evalR0_uV]
    change AlbertLean.Residual.TrialitySquares.exteriorQ ((moment k).map ep) -
        uV (actualLedger q) = _
    rw [hmoment, UniformMomentActualDetector.detectorS, ← hrec]
    rfl
  have hdet : ep (Matrix.det (moment k)) = Matrix.det (matrixM q) := by
    calc
      _ = Matrix.det ((moment k).map ep) :=
        RingHom.map_det ep (moment k)
      _ = _ := congrArg Matrix.det hmoment
  have hdetInv : ep (momentDetInv k) = (Matrix.det (matrixM q))⁻¹ := by
    have hu := congrArg ep (momentDet_mul_inv k)
    rw [map_mul, map_one, hdet] at hu
    exact (inv_eq_of_mul_eq_one_right hu).symm
  unfold UniformMomentGenericQuadraticEval.beta
  unfold UniformMomentFiniteAlgebra.detectorBeta
  unfold UniformMomentActualDetector.actualBeta
  rw [actual_map_detectorBeta]
  rw [show (fun i => ep
        (UniformMomentGenericQuadraticEval.finiteDiagA k i)) =
      fun i => D (actualLedger q) i 1 from funext hdA]
  rw [show (fun i => ep
        (UniformMomentGenericQuadraticEval.finiteDiagB k i)) =
      fun i => E (actualLedger q) i 1 from funext hdB]
  rw [hA, hBval, hCval, hmoment, hS, hdet, hdetInv, hrec]
  rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.UniformMomentActualSpecialization.actualBeta_ne_zero
statement:
theorem actualBeta_ne_zero (f : k →+* L) (q : ExplicitFrameChart L)
    (hopen : evalR0 k f q (betaOpen k) ≠ 0) (a b c sigma : L)
    (hq : EquationsVanish (explicitFrameEquationValues q))
    (hr : q.r1 = 1) (hz1 : q.z1 = a) (hr2 : q.r2 = b) (hz2 : q.z2 = c)
    (hb : b = (gramV12 q - sigma) / (2*a))
    (hc : c = (gramV12 q + sigma) / 2)
    (hsigma2 : sigma ^ 2 = evalR0 k f q (discr k))
    (hsigma : sigma ≠ 0) (ha : 2*a ≠ 0) :
    UniformMomentActualDetector.actualBeta q a b c sigma ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← evalQ_beta_eq_actualBeta k f q hopen a b c sigma hq hr hz1 hr2 hz2
    hb hc hsigma2 hsigma ha]
  exact evalQ_beta_ne_zero k f q hopen sigma hsigma2

name: AlbertLean.Generic.UniformMomentActualSpecialization.detector_affine_actual
statement:
theorem detector_affine_actual (q : ExplicitFrameChart L) (a b c sigma : L)
    (hq : EquationsVanish (explicitFrameEquationValues q))
    (hr : q.r1 = 1) (hz1 : q.z1 = a) (hr2 : q.r2 = b) (hz2 : q.z2 = c)
    (hb : b = (gramV12 q - sigma) / (2*a))
    (hc : c = (gramV12 q + sigma) / 2)
    (hsigma : sigma ≠ 0) (ha : 2*a ≠ 0)
    (hdet : Matrix.det (matrixM q) ≠ 0) :
    GenericTauDetector.sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1)
        (encoderA q) (encoderB q) =
      UniformMomentActualDetector.actualEpsilon q a b c sigma +
        UniformMomentActualDetector.actualBeta q a b c sigma *
          AlbertLean.Residual.SL4PairAction.delta (residualPairOfChart q)
proof:
:=
  UniformMomentActualDetector.sourceDetector_eq_actualEpsilon_add_actualBeta_mul_delta
    q a b c sigma hq hr hz1 hr2 hz2 hb hc hsigma ha hdet

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertActualCompanion.matrixM_eq_moment
statement:
private theorem matrixM_eq_moment (x : ExplicitFrameChart K) :
    matrixM x = moment (residualPairOfChart x)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [matrixM, residualPairOfChart, moment] using
    (momentMatrix_eq_AMatrix_mul_XMatrix x.s1 x.s2 x.c1 x.c2)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertActualCompanion.equationValues_reinsert_of_moment_eq
statement:
theorem equationValues_reinsert_of_moment_eq
    (x : ExplicitFrameChart K) (Q : ResidualPair K)
    (hQ : moment Q = moment (residualPairOfChart x)) :
    explicitFrameEquationValues (chartWithResidualPair x Q) =
      explicitFrameEquationValues x
proof:
:= by
  have hM : matrixM (chartWithResidualPair x Q) = matrixM x := by
    calc
      matrixM (chartWithResidualPair x Q) =
          moment (residualPairOfChart (chartWithResidualPair x Q)) :=
        matrixM_eq_moment _
      _ = moment Q := by rw [residualPairOfChart_chartWithResidualPair]
      _ = moment (residualPairOfChart x) := hQ
      _ = matrixM x := (matrixM_eq_moment x).symm
  have hdiagA : (chartWithResidualPair x Q).diagA = x.diagA := rfl
  have hdiagB : (chartWithResidualPair x Q).diagB = x.diagB := rfl
  have hr1 : (chartWithResidualPair x Q).r1 = x.r1 := rfl
  have hz1 : (chartWithResidualPair x Q).z1 = x.z1 := rfl
  have hr2 : (chartWithResidualPair x Q).r2 = x.r2 := rfl
  have hz2 : (chartWithResidualPair x Q).z2 = x.z2 := rfl
  apply FrameEquationValues.ext <;>
    simp only [explicitFrameEquationValues, hdiagA, hdiagB,
      hr1, hz1, hr2, hz2, hM]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertActualCompanion.sourceLedger_eq_of_power_diagonal_eq
statement:
theorem sourceLedger_eq_of_power_diagonal_eq (a b a' b' : JCoord K)
    (h : ∀ i p q, diagLinear i (sourceProduct (power a p) (power b q)) =
      diagLinear i (sourceProduct (power a' p) (power b' q))) :
    sourceLedger a b = sourceLedger a' b'
proof:
:= by
  have hraw (i j l : Fin 3) :
      diagonalProduct i (spectralProjector a j) (spectralProjector b l) =
        diagonalProduct i (spectralProjector a' j) (spectralProjector b' l) := by
    rw [projector_eq_weighted_powers a j, projector_eq_weighted_powers b l,
      projector_eq_weighted_powers a' j, projector_eq_weighted_powers b' l]
    simp only [map_sum, map_smul, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
      smul_eq_mul, diagonalProduct_apply]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro p hp
    apply congrArg (fun z => projectorWeight l p * z)
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro q hq
    rw [h i q p]
  have hdiagA (i j : Fin 3) :
      diagLinear i (spectralProjector a j) =
        diagLinear i (spectralProjector a' j) := by
    rw [projector_eq_weighted_powers a j, projector_eq_weighted_powers a' j]
    simp only [map_sum, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro p hp
    have hp0 := h i p 0
    simp only [power, Matrix.cons_val_zero, sourceProduct_one_right] at hp0
    change diagLinear i (power a p) = diagLinear i (power a' p) at hp0
    rw [hp0]
  have hdiagB (i l : Fin 3) :
      diagLinear i (spectralProjector b l) =
        diagLinear i (spectralProjector b' l) := by
    rw [projector_eq_weighted_powers b l, projector_eq_weighted_powers b' l]
    simp only [map_sum, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro q hq
    have h0q := h i 0 q
    simp only [power, Matrix.cons_val_zero, sourceProduct_one_left] at h0q
    change diagLinear i (power b q) = diagLinear i (power b' q) at h0q
    rw [h0q]
  apply SourceLedger.ext
  · funext i j
    simp only [sourceLedger, diagonal_trace]
    exact hdiagA i j
  · funext j l
    simp only [sourceLedger, traceForm_eq_sum_diagonalProduct]
    rw [hraw 0 j l, hraw 1 j l, hraw 2 j l]
  · funext l i
    simp only [sourceLedger, sourceTraceForm_symmetric, diagonal_trace]
    exact hdiagB i l
  · funext i j l
    simp only [sourceLedger, diagonal_trace, diagonalProduct_apply]
    have hraw' := hraw i j l
    simp only [diagonalProduct_apply] at hraw'
    rw [sourceTraceForm_symmetric (spectralProjector b l) (diagonalUnit i),
      sourceTraceForm_symmetric (spectralProjector b' l) (diagonalUnit i)]
    simp only [diagonal_trace]
    rw [hraw', hdiagA i j, hdiagB i l]
    have hQ : sourceTraceForm (spectralProjector a j) (spectralProjector b l) =
        sourceTraceForm (spectralProjector a' j) (spectralProjector b' l) := by
      rw [traceForm_eq_sum_diagonalProduct,
        traceForm_eq_sum_diagonalProduct,
        hraw 0 j l, hraw 1 j l, hraw 2 j l]
    rw [hQ]

statement:

    normalizedUV x.s1 x.s2 x.c1 x.c2 = exteriorQ (matrixM x) -
      (deltaX x.s1 x.s2 x.c1 x.c2 +
        deltaStarA x.s1 x.s2 x.c1 x.c2)
proof:
:= by
  have h := normalizedUV_exterior_identity x.s1 x.s2 x.c1 x.c2
  change normalizedUV x.s1 x.s2 x.c1 x.c2 = exteriorQ (matrixM x) -
    deltaX x.s1 x.s2 x.c1 x.c2 - deltaStarA x.s1 x.s2 x.c1 x.c2 at h
  rw [h]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertActualCompanion.power_diagonal_eq_of_chart_data
statement:
private theorem power_diagonal_eq_of_chart_data
    (x y : ExplicitFrameChart K)
    (hda : ∀ i, y.diagA i = x.diagA i)
    (hdb : ∀ i, y.diagB i = x.diagB i)
    (hr1 : y.r1 = x.r1) (hz1 : y.z1 = x.z1)
    (hr2 : y.r2 = x.r2) (hz2 : y.z2 = x.z2)
    (hM : matrixM y = matrixM x)
    (hroot : deltaX y.s1 y.s2 y.c1 y.c2 +
        deltaStarA y.s1 y.s2 y.c1 y.c2 =
      deltaX x.s1 x.s2 x.c1 x.c2 + deltaStarA x.s1 x.s2 x.c1 x.c2) :
    ∀ i p q, diagLinear i
        (sourceProduct (power (encoderA y) p) (power (encoderB y) q)) =
      diagLinear i
        (sourceProduct (power (encoderA x) p) (power (encoderB x) q))
proof:
:= by
  have hMij (i j : Fin 4) : matrixM y i j = matrixM x i j :=
    congrFun (congrFun hM i) j
  have hnS1 : nS y.s1 = nS x.s1 := by
    rw [chart_normS1 y, chart_normS1 x, hMij 0 0]
  have hnS2 : nS y.s2 = nS x.s2 := by
    rw [chart_normS2 y, chart_normS2 x, hMij 1 1]
  have hnC1 : nC y.c1 = nC x.c1 := by
    rw [chart_normC1 y, chart_normC1 x, hMij 2 2]
  have hnC2 : nC y.c2 = nC x.c2 := by
    rw [chart_normC2 y, chart_normC2 x, hMij 3 3]
  have hnVA : nV (vectorA y) = nV (vectorA x) := by
    rw [chart_normVA y, chart_normVA x, hr1, hz1]
  have hnVB : nV (vectorB y) = nV (vectorB x) := by
    rw [chart_normVB y, chart_normVB x, hr2, hz2]
  have hV : BV (vectorA y) (vectorB y) =
      BV (vectorA x) (vectorB x) := by
    rw [chart_gramV y, chart_gramV x, hr1, hz1, hr2, hz2]
  have hS : BS y.s1 y.s2 = BS x.s1 x.s2 := by
    rw [chart_gramS y, chart_gramS x, hMij 0 1, hMij 1 0]
  have hC : BC y.c1 y.c2 = BC x.c1 x.c2 := by
    rw [chart_gramC y, chart_gramC x, hMij 2 3, hMij 3 2]
  have htA1C2 : triality (vectorA y) y.s1 y.c2 =
      triality (vectorA x) x.s1 x.c2 := by
    rw [chart_trialityA1C2 y, chart_trialityA1C2 x,
      hr1, hz1, hMij 0 3, hMij 3 0]
  have htA2C1 : triality (vectorA y) y.s2 y.c1 =
      triality (vectorA x) x.s2 x.c1 := by
    rw [chart_trialityA2C1 y, chart_trialityA2C1 x,
      hr1, hz1, hMij 1 2, hMij 2 1]
  have htA2C2 : triality (vectorA y) y.s2 y.c2 =
      triality (vectorA x) x.s2 x.c2 := by
    rw [chart_trialityA2C2 y, chart_trialityA2C2 x,
      hr1, hz1, hMij 1 3, hMij 3 1]
  have htB1C2 : triality (vectorB y) y.s1 y.c2 =
      triality (vectorB x) x.s1 x.c2 := by
    rw [chart_trialityB1C2 y, chart_trialityB1C2 x,
      hr2, hz2, hMij 0 3, hMij 3 0]
  have htB2C1 : triality (vectorB y) y.s2 y.c1 =
      triality (vectorB x) x.s2 x.c1 := by
    rw [chart_trialityB2C1 y, chart_trialityB2C1 x,
      hr2, hz2, hMij 1 2, hMij 2 1]
  have htB1C1 : triality (vectorB y) y.s1 y.c1 =
      triality (vectorB x) x.s1 x.c1 := by
    rw [chart_trialityB1C1 y, chart_trialityB1C1 x,
      hr2, hz2, hMij 0 2, hMij 2 0]
  have hUC : BC (sourceMuC (vectorA y) y.s1)
      (sourceMuC (vectorB y) y.s2) =
      BC (sourceMuC (vectorA x) x.s1) (sourceMuC (vectorB x) x.s2) := by
    rw [chart_UC y, chart_UC x, hr1, hz1, hr2, hz2,
      hMij 0 1, hMij 1 0]
  have hUS : BS (sourceMuS y.c1 (vectorA y))
      (sourceMuS y.c2 (vectorB y)) =
      BS (sourceMuS x.c1 (vectorA x)) (sourceMuS x.c2 (vectorB x)) := by
    rw [chart_US y, chart_US x, hr1, hz1, hr2, hz2,
      hMij 2 3, hMij 3 2]
  have hUV : normalizedUV y.s1 y.s2 y.c1 y.c2 =
      normalizedUV x.s1 x.s2 x.c1 x.c2 := by
    rw [chart_UV y, chart_UV x, hM, hroot]
  have hdiagA : ∀ p i,
      diagLinear i (power (encoderA y) p) =
        diagLinear i (power (encoderA x) p) := by
    intro p i
    fin_cases p <;> fin_cases i <;>
      simp only [fin3_mk_zero_eq_zero, fin3_mk_one_eq_one, fin3_mk_two_eq_two] <;>
      simp only [power, encoderA, sourceOne, diagLinear_zero, diagLinear_one,
        diagLinear_two, sourceSquare_d1, sourceSquare_d2, sourceSquare_d3,
        Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_two,
        Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.tail_cons] <;>
      simp only [hda, hnS1, hnC1, hnVA]
  have hdiagB : ∀ q i,
      diagLinear i (power (encoderB y) q) =
        diagLinear i (power (encoderB x) q) := by
    intro q i
    fin_cases q <;> fin_cases i <;>
      simp only [fin3_mk_zero_eq_zero, fin3_mk_one_eq_one, fin3_mk_two_eq_two] <;>
      simp only [power, encoderB, sourceOne, diagLinear_zero, diagLinear_one,
        diagLinear_two, sourceSquare_d1, sourceSquare_d2, sourceSquare_d3,
        Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_two,
        Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.tail_cons] <;>
      simp only [hdb, hnS2, hnC2, hnVB]
  have hV21 : BV (normalizedMuV y.s1 y.c1) (vectorB y) =
      BV (normalizedMuV x.s1 x.c1) (vectorB x) := by
    rw [muV_triality, muV_triality, htB1C1]
  have hS21 : BS (sourceMuS y.c1 (vectorA y)) y.s2 =
      BS (sourceMuS x.c1 (vectorA x)) x.s2 := by
    rw [muS_triality, muS_triality, htA2C1]
  have hC21 : BC (sourceMuC (vectorA y) y.s1) y.c2 =
      BC (sourceMuC (vectorA x) x.s1) x.c2 := by
    rw [muC_triality, muC_triality, htA1C2]
  have hV12 : BV (vectorA y) (normalizedMuV y.s2 y.c2) =
      BV (vectorA x) (normalizedMuV x.s2 x.c2) := by
    rw [BV_symmetric (vectorA y) (normalizedMuV y.s2 y.c2),
      BV_symmetric (vectorA x) (normalizedMuV x.s2 x.c2),
      muV_triality, muV_triality, htA2C2]
  have hS12 : BS y.s1 (sourceMuS y.c2 (vectorB y)) =
      BS x.s1 (sourceMuS x.c2 (vectorB x)) := by
    rw [BS_symmetric y.s1 (sourceMuS y.c2 (vectorB y)),
      BS_symmetric x.s1 (sourceMuS x.c2 (vectorB x)),
      muS_triality, muS_triality, htB1C2]
  have hC12 : BC y.c1 (sourceMuC (vectorB y) y.s2) =
      BC x.c1 (sourceMuC (vectorB x) x.s2) := by
    rw [BC_symmetric y.c1 (sourceMuC (vectorB y) y.s2),
      BC_symmetric x.c1 (sourceMuC (vectorB x) x.s2),
      muC_triality, muC_triality, htB2C1]
  have hUVraw : BV (normalizedMuV y.s1 y.c1) (normalizedMuV y.s2 y.c2) =
      BV (normalizedMuV x.s1 x.c1) (normalizedMuV x.s2 x.c2) := hUV
  have h11 :
      BV (encoderA y).v (encoderB y).v = BV (encoderA x).v (encoderB x).v ∧
      BS (encoderA y).s (encoderB y).s = BS (encoderA x).s (encoderB x).s ∧
      BC (encoderA y).c (encoderB y).c = BC (encoderA x).c (encoderB x).c := by
    simpa only [encoderA, encoderB] using And.intro hV (And.intro hS hC)
  have h21 :
      BV (sourceSquare (encoderA y)).v (encoderB y).v =
          BV (sourceSquare (encoderA x)).v (encoderB x).v ∧
      BS (sourceSquare (encoderA y)).s (encoderB y).s =
          BS (sourceSquare (encoderA x)).s (encoderB x).s ∧
      BC (sourceSquare (encoderA y)).c (encoderB y).c =
          BC (sourceSquare (encoderA x)).c (encoderB x).c := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [sourceSquare_v, BV_add_left, BV_smul_left, encoderA, encoderB]
      rw [hda 1, hda 2, hV, hV21]
    · simp only [sourceSquare_s, BS_add_left, BS_smul_left, encoderA, encoderB]
      rw [hda 0, hda 2, hS, hS21]
    · simp only [sourceSquare_c, BC_add_left, BC_smul_left, encoderA, encoderB]
      rw [hda 0, hda 1, hC, hC21]
  have h12 :
      BV (encoderA y).v (sourceSquare (encoderB y)).v =
          BV (encoderA x).v (sourceSquare (encoderB x)).v ∧
      BS (encoderA y).s (sourceSquare (encoderB y)).s =
          BS (encoderA x).s (sourceSquare (encoderB x)).s ∧
      BC (encoderA y).c (sourceSquare (encoderB y)).c =
          BC (encoderA x).c (sourceSquare (encoderB x)).c := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [sourceSquare_v, BV_add_right, BV_smul_right, encoderA, encoderB]
      rw [hdb 1, hdb 2, hV, hV12]
    · simp only [sourceSquare_s, BS_add_right, BS_smul_right, encoderA, encoderB]
      rw [hdb 0, hdb 2, hS, hS12]
    · simp only [sourceSquare_c, BC_add_right, BC_smul_right, encoderA, encoderB]
      rw [hdb 0, hdb 1, hC, hC12]
  have h22 :
      BV (sourceSquare (encoderA y)).v (sourceSquare (encoderB y)).v =
          BV (sourceSquare (encoderA x)).v (sourceSquare (encoderB x)).v ∧
      BS (sourceSquare (encoderA y)).s (sourceSquare (encoderB y)).s =
          BS (sourceSquare (encoderA x)).s (sourceSquare (encoderB x)).s ∧
      BC (sourceSquare (encoderA y)).c (sourceSquare (encoderB y)).c =
          BC (sourceSquare (encoderA x)).c (sourceSquare (encoderB x)).c := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [sourceSquare_v, BV_add_left, BV_add_right, BV_smul_left,
        BV_smul_right, encoderA, encoderB]
      simp only [hda, hdb, hV, hV12, hV21, hUVraw]
    · simp only [sourceSquare_s, BS_add_left, BS_add_right, BS_smul_left,
        BS_smul_right, encoderA, encoderB]
      simp only [hda, hdb, hS, hS12, hS21, hUS]
    · simp only [sourceSquare_c, BC_add_left, BC_add_right, BC_smul_left,
        BC_smul_right, encoderA, encoderB]
      simp only [hda, hdb, hC, hC12, hC21, hUC]
  have hsector : ∀ p q,
      BV (power (encoderA y) p).v (power (encoderB y) q).v =
          BV (power (encoderA x) p).v (power (encoderB x) q).v ∧
      BS (power (encoderA y) p).s (power (encoderB y) q).s =
          BS (power (encoderA x) p).s (power (encoderB x) q).s ∧
      BC (power (encoderA y) p).c (power (encoderB y) q).c =
          BC (power (encoderA x) p).c (power (encoderB x) q).c := by
    intro p q
    fin_cases p <;> fin_cases q
    all_goals first
      | exact h11 | exact h12 | exact h21 | exact h22
      | simp [power, sourceOne, BV, BS, BC, BW, evalU]
  intro i p q
  have hs := hsector p q
  fin_cases i
  · simp only [fin3_mk_zero_eq_zero, diagLinear_zero, sourceProduct_d1]
    rw [show (power (encoderA y) p).d1 = (power (encoderA x) p).d1 from hdiagA p 0,
      show (power (encoderB y) q).d1 = (power (encoderB x) q).d1 from hdiagB q 0,
      hs.2.1, hs.2.2]
  · simp only [fin3_mk_one_eq_one, diagLinear_one, sourceProduct_d2]
    rw [show (power (encoderA y) p).d2 = (power (encoderA x) p).d2 from hdiagA p 1,
      show (power (encoderB y) q).d2 = (power (encoderB x) q).d2 from hdiagB q 1,
      hs.2.2, hs.1]
  · simp only [fin3_mk_two_eq_two, diagLinear_two, sourceProduct_d3]
    rw [show (power (encoderA y) p).d3 = (power (encoderA x) p).d3 from hdiagA p 2,
      show (power (encoderB y) q).d3 = (power (encoderB x) q).d3 from hdiagB q 2,
      hs.1, hs.2.1]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertActualCompanion.power_diagonal_reinsert_of_sameResidualBase
statement:
theorem power_diagonal_reinsert_of_sameResidualBase
    (x : ExplicitFrameChart K) (Q : ResidualPair K)
    (hQ : sameResidualBase (residualPairOfChart x) Q) (i p q : Fin 3) :
    diagLinear i
        (sourceProduct (power (encoderA (chartWithResidualPair x Q)) p)
          (power (encoderB (chartWithResidualPair x Q)) q)) =
      diagLinear i
        (sourceProduct (power (encoderA x) p) (power (encoderB x) q))
proof:
:= by
  have hM : matrixM (chartWithResidualPair x Q) = matrixM x := by
    rw [matrixM_eq_moment, residualPairOfChart_chartWithResidualPair, matrixM_eq_moment]
    simpa only [baseMoment] using hQ.1
  have hroot :
      deltaX (chartWithResidualPair x Q).s1 (chartWithResidualPair x Q).s2
          (chartWithResidualPair x Q).c1 (chartWithResidualPair x Q).c2 +
        deltaStarA (chartWithResidualPair x Q).s1 (chartWithResidualPair x Q).s2
          (chartWithResidualPair x Q).c1 (chartWithResidualPair x Q).c2 =
      deltaX x.s1 x.s2 x.c1 x.c2 + deltaStarA x.s1 x.s2 x.c1 x.c2 := by
    simp only [deltaX_eq_det_XMatrix, deltaStarA_eq_det_AMatrix]
    change delta (residualPairOfChart (chartWithResidualPair x Q)) +
        deltaStar (residualPairOfChart (chartWithResidualPair x Q)) =
      delta (residualPairOfChart x) + deltaStar (residualPairOfChart x)
    rw [residualPairOfChart_chartWithResidualPair]
    exact hQ.2
  exact power_diagonal_eq_of_chart_data x (chartWithResidualPair x Q)
    (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl) rfl rfl rfl rfl hM hroot i p q

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertActualCompanion.companion_equations_and_sourceLedger
statement:
theorem companion_equations_and_sourceLedger
    (x : ExplicitFrameChart K)
    (hx : ResidualOpen (residualPairOfChart x)) :
    explicitFrameEquationValues (companion x hx) =
        explicitFrameEquationValues x ∧
      sourceLedger (encoderA (companion x hx)) (encoderB (companion x hx)) =
        sourceLedger (encoderA x) (encoderB x)
proof:
:= by
  let Q := rootSwappedRepresentative (residualPairOfChart x) hx
  have hbase : sameResidualBase (residualPairOfChart x) Q :=
    ⟨by simpa [Q, baseMoment] using
        (rootSwappedRepresentative_baseMoment (residualPairOfChart x) hx),
      by simpa [Q] using
        (rootSwappedRepresentative_baseRootSum (residualPairOfChart x) hx)⟩
  constructor
  · exact equationValues_reinsert_of_moment_eq x Q hbase.1
  · apply sourceLedger_eq_of_power_diagonal_eq
    intro i p q
    exact power_diagonal_reinsert_of_sameResidualBase x Q hbase i p q

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedBlockEquations.scaled_block_equations
statement:
theorem scaled_block_equations (B : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Mat2 K)
    (p q : Fin 3 → K)
    (hd : ∀ i, B i i = q i • (1 : Mat2 K))
    (hr : ∀ i, B i 0 + B i 1 + B i 2 = 0)
    (hc : ∀ j, p 0 • B 0 j + p 1 • B 1 j + p 2 • B 2 j = 0) :
    B 0 2 = -q 0 • (1 : Mat2 K) - B 0 1 ∧
    p 2 • B 2 1 = -p 0 • B 0 1 - (p 1 * q 1) • (1 : Mat2 K) ∧
    p 2 • B 2 0 = p 0 • B 0 1 + (p 1 * q 1 - p 2 * q 2) • (1 : Mat2 K) ∧
    p 1 • B 1 0 = -p 0 • B 0 1 +
      (-p 0 * q 0 - p 1 * q 1 + p 2 * q 2) • (1 : Mat2 K) ∧
    p 1 • B 1 2 = p 0 • B 0 1 +
      (p 0 * q 0 - p 2 * q 2) • (1 : Mat2 K)
proof:
:= by
  have h02 := hr 0
  rw [hd 0] at h02
  have h21 := hc 1
  rw [hd 1] at h21
  have h20 := hr 2
  rw [hd 2] at h20
  have h10 := hc 0
  rw [hd 0] at h10
  have h12 := hr 1
  rw [hd 1] at h12
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · linear_combination (norm := module) h02
  · linear_combination (norm := module) h21
  · linear_combination (norm := module) p 2 • h20 - h21
  · linear_combination (norm := module) h10 - p 2 • h20 + h21
  · linear_combination (norm := module) p 1 • h12 - h10 + p 2 • h20 - h21

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedBlockEquations.blocks_eq_of_pivot_eq
statement:
theorem blocks_eq_of_pivot_eq (B C : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Mat2 K)
    (p q : Fin 3 → K) (hp1 : p 1 ≠ 0) (hp2 : p 2 ≠ 0)
    (hdB : ∀ i, B i i = q i • (1 : Mat2 K))
    (hrB : ∀ i, B i 0 + B i 1 + B i 2 = 0)
    (hcB : ∀ j, p 0 • B 0 j + p 1 • B 1 j + p 2 • B 2 j = 0)
    (hdC : ∀ i, C i i = q i • (1 : Mat2 K))
    (hrC : ∀ i, C i 0 + C i 1 + C i 2 = 0)
    (hcC : ∀ j, p 0 • C 0 j + p 1 • C 1 j + p 2 • C 2 j = 0)
    (hX : B 0 1 = C 0 1) : B = C
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hb02, hb21, hb20, hb10, hb12⟩ := scaled_block_equations B p q hdB hrB hcB
  obtain ⟨hc02, hc21, hc20, hc10, hc12⟩ := scaled_block_equations C p q hdC hrC hcC
  rw [hX] at hb02 hb21 hb20 hb10 hb12
  have h02 : B 0 2 = C 0 2 := hb02.trans hc02.symm
  have cancel1 {X Y : Mat2 K} (h : p 1 • X = p 1 • Y) : X = Y := by
    exact (smul_right_injective _ hp1) h
  have cancel2 {X Y : Mat2 K} (h : p 2 • X = p 2 • Y) : X = Y := by
    exact (smul_right_injective _ hp2) h
  have h21 := cancel2 (hb21.trans hc21.symm)
  have h20 := cancel2 (hb20.trans hc20.symm)
  have h10 := cancel1 (hb10.trans hc10.symm)
  have h12 := cancel1 (hb12.trans hc12.symm)
  funext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
  · exact (hdB 0).trans (hdC 0).symm
  · exact hX
  · exact h02
  · exact h10
  · exact (hdB 1).trans (hdC 1).symm
  · exact h12
  · exact h20
  · exact h21
  · exact (hdB 2).trans (hdC 2).symm

proof:

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertActualCompanionDetector.companion_detector_sub
statement:
theorem companion_detector_sub (q : ExplicitFrameChart K)
    (hx : ResidualOpen (residualPairOfChart q)) (a b c sigma : K)
    (hq : EquationsVanish (explicitFrameEquationValues q))
    (hr : q.r1 = 1) (hz1 : q.z1 = a) (hr2 : q.r2 = b) (hz2 : q.z2 = c)
    (hb : b = (gramV12 q - sigma) / (2*a))
    (hc : c = (gramV12 q + sigma) / 2)
    (hsigma : sigma ≠ 0) (ha : 2*a ≠ 0) :
    sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1)
        (encoderA (companion q hx)) (encoderB (companion q hx)) -
      sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1) (encoderA q) (encoderB q) =
      actualBeta q a b c sigma *
        (deltaStar (residualPairOfChart q) - delta (residualPairOfChart q))
proof:
:= by
  have hq' : EquationsVanish (explicitFrameEquationValues (companion q hx)) := by
    rw [(companion_equations_and_sourceLedger q hx).1]
    exact hq
  have hdet : Matrix.det (matrixM q) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [matrixM_eq_moment, moment, Matrix.det_mul]
    exact mul_ne_zero hx.2 hx.1
  have hdet' : Matrix.det (matrixM (companion q hx)) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [companion_matrixM]
    exact hdet
  have hgram : gramV12 (companion q hx) = gramV12 q := rfl
  have hfirst := sourceDetector_eq_actualEpsilon_add_actualBeta_mul_delta
    q a b c sigma hq hr hz1 hr2 hz2 hb hc hsigma ha hdet
  have hsecond := sourceDetector_eq_actualEpsilon_add_actualBeta_mul_delta
    (companion q hx) a b c sigma hq' hr hz1 hr2 hz2
    (by simpa only [hgram] using hb) (by simpa only [hgram] using hc)
    hsigma ha hdet'
  have hcoeff := companion_coefficients q hx a b c sigma
  rw [hsecond, hfirst, hcoeff.1, hcoeff.2]
  simp only [companion, residualPairOfChart_chartWithResidualPair,
    rootSwappedRepresentative_delta]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertActualCompanionDetector.companion_detector_ne
statement:
theorem companion_detector_ne (q : ExplicitFrameChart K)
    (hx : ResidualOpen (residualPairOfChart q)) (a b c sigma : K)
    (hq : EquationsVanish (explicitFrameEquationValues q))
    (hr : q.r1 = 1) (hz1 : q.z1 = a) (hr2 : q.r2 = b) (hz2 : q.z2 = c)
    (hb : b = (gramV12 q - sigma) / (2*a))
    (hc : c = (gramV12 q + sigma) / 2)
    (hsigma : sigma ≠ 0) (ha : 2*a ≠ 0)
    (hbeta : actualBeta q a b c sigma ≠ 0)
    (hbranch : delta (residualPairOfChart q) ≠ deltaStar (residualPairOfChart q)) :
    sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1)
        (encoderA (companion q hx)) (encoderB (companion q hx)) ≠
      sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1) (encoderA q) (encoderB q)
proof:
:= by
  intro heq
  have h := companion_detector_sub q hx a b c sigma
    hq hr hz1 hr2 hz2 hb hc hsigma ha
  rw [heq, sub_self] at h
  exact mul_ne_zero hbeta (sub_ne_zero.mpr hbranch.symm) h.symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.UniformMomentBetaOpen.tau_genericEvalLocal
statement:
theorem tau_genericEvalLocal (x : Local k) :
    tau k (genericEvalLocal k x) = genericEvalLocal k x
proof:
:= by
  have hlocal : (tau k).toRingHom.comp (genericEvalLocal k) =
      genericEvalLocal k := by
    apply IsLocalization.ringHom_ext (Submonoid.powers (B0 k))
    apply RingHom.ext
    intro p
    simp only [RingHom.comp_apply]
    calc
      tau k (genericEvalLocal k (algebraMap (R0 k) (Local k) p)) =
          tau k (ledgerEval k p) :=
        congrArg (tau k) (genericEvalLocal_loc k p)
      _ = ledgerEval k p := by
        simpa only [RingHom.comp_apply, RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe,
          RingHom.coe_coe] using
          DFunLike.congr_fun (tau_comp_ledgerEval k) p
      _ = genericEvalLocal k (algebraMap (R0 k) (Local k) p) :=
        (genericEvalLocal_loc k p).symm
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun hlocal x

name: AlbertLean.Generic.UniformMomentBetaOpen.genericEvalLocal_betaNorm
statement:
theorem genericEvalLocal_betaNorm :
    genericEvalLocal k (betaNorm k) =
      evalQ k (beta k) * tau k (evalQ k (beta k))
proof:
:= by
  have heval : evalQ k (beta k) =
      genericEvalLocal k (beta k).re +
        genericEvalLocal k (beta k).im * kappa k := by
    rw [← QuadraticAlgebra.re_smul_add_im_smul (beta k)]
    simp [Algebra.smul_def, evalQ_algebraMap, evalQ_omega]
  have htau : tau k (evalQ k (beta k)) =
      genericEvalLocal k (beta k).re -
        genericEvalLocal k (beta k).im * kappa k := by
    rw [heval]
    simp [tau_genericEvalLocal, tau_kappa, sub_eq_add_neg]
  rw [htau, heval, betaNorm, QuadraticAlgebra.norm_def]
  simp only [map_sub, map_add, map_mul, map_pow, map_zero,
    genericEvalLocal_loc, ledgerEval_discr_eq_kappa_sq]
  ring

    (fixedParityAut D s hr hs).linear =
      (sourceEvenAut parityVector D s (by simp)
        (by rw [← hsq]; exact pow_ne_zero 2 hs)
        (by simpa using hsq) hs).linear
proof:
:= by

  exact familyAut_linear_eq_fixed_center parityVector D s (by simp)
    (by rw [← hsq]; exact pow_ne_zero 2 hs) hr (by simpa using hsq) hs

name: AlbertLean.Triality.ParityEvenFourFactor.four_fixedParity_apply
statement:
theorem four_fixedParity_apply
    (A B c : VCoord K) (rho alpha beta : K)
    (hc : nV c = 1)
    (hA : nV A ≠ 0) (hB : nV B ≠ 0)
    (hr : rho ^ 2 = nV A * nV B) (hr0 : rho ≠ 0)
    (ha : alpha ^ 2 = nV A) (ha0 : alpha ≠ 0)
    (hb : beta ^ 2 = nV B) (hb0 : beta ≠ 0)
    (hab : alpha * beta = rho)
    (hcr : c.r ≠ 0)
    (hAr : (evenV parityVector c A).r ≠ 0)
    (hBr : (evenV parityVector c B).r ≠ 0)
    (x : JCoord K) :
    let A'
proof:
:= evenV parityVector c A
    let B' := evenV parityVector c B
    let D0 := reflectV parityVector c
    let D1 := reflectV parityVector A'
    let F0 := fixedParityAut D0 (-1) (by simpa [D0] using hcr) (by norm_num)
    let F1 := fixedParityAut D1 (-alpha) (by simpa [D1] using hAr)
      (neg_ne_zero.mpr ha0)
    let F2 := fixedParityAut B' beta hBr hb0
    let F3 := fixedParityAut c 1 hcr (by norm_num)
    (sourceEvenAut A B rho hA hB hr hr0).linear x =
      F0.linear (F1.linear (F2.linear (F3.linear x))) := by
  intro A' B' D0 D1 F0 F1 F2 F3
  have he : nV (parityVector : VCoord K) = 1 := nV_parityVector
  have he0 : nV (parityVector : VCoord K) ≠ 0 := by simp
  have hc0 : nV c ≠ 0 := by rw [hc]; exact one_ne_zero
  have hA'n : nV A' ≠ 0 := by simpa [A', nV_evenV _ _ _ he0 hc0] using hA
  have hB'n : nV B' ≠ 0 := by simpa [B', nV_evenV _ _ _ he0 hc0] using hB
  have ha' : alpha ^ 2 = nV A' := by simpa [A', nV_evenV _ _ _ he0 hc0] using ha
  have hb' : beta ^ 2 = nV B' := by simpa [B', nV_evenV _ _ _ he0 hc0] using hb
  have hD0r : D0.r ≠ 0 := by simpa [D0] using hcr
  have hD1r : D1.r ≠ 0 := by simpa [D1] using hAr
  have hconj := sourceEvenAut_conjugate_apply parityVector c A B rho he hc
    hA hB hr hr0 x
  dsimp only at hconj
  rw [← hconj]
  have hmid := sourceEvenAut_middle_apply parityVector A' B' alpha beta rho he
    hA'n hB'n ha' hb' hab ha0 hb0 hr0
      ((sourceEvenAut parityVector c 1 (by simp) hc0
        (by simpa [hc]) (by norm_num)).linear x)
  dsimp only at hmid
  rw [← hmid]
  have hF0 (y : JCoord K) :
      F0.linear y =
        (sourceEvenAut parityVector D0 (-1) (by simp)
          (by simpa [D0, nV_reflectV _ _ he0] using hc0)
          (by simp [D0, nV_reflectV _ _ he0, hc]) (by norm_num)).linear y :=
    congrArg (fun L => L y) (fixedParityAut_linear_eq D0 (-1) hD0r
      (by norm_num) (by simp [D0, nV_reflectV _ _ he0, hc]))
  have hF1 (y : JCoord K) :
      F1.linear y =
        (sourceEvenAut parityVector D1 (-alpha) (by simp)
          (by simpa [D1, nV_reflectV _ _ he0] using hA'n)
          (by simpa [D1, nV_reflectV _ _ he0] using ha')
          (neg_ne_zero.mpr ha0)).linear y :=
    congrArg (fun L => L y) (fixedParityAut_linear_eq D1 (-alpha) hD1r
      (neg_ne_zero.mpr ha0) (by simpa [D1, nV_reflectV _ _ he0] using ha'))
  have hF2 (y : JCoord K) :
      F2.linear y =
        (sourceEvenAut parityVector B' beta (by simp) hB'n
          (by simpa using hb') hb0).linear y :=
    congrArg (fun L => L y) (fixedParityAut_linear_eq B' beta hBr hb0 hb')
  have hF3 (y : JCoord K) :
      F3.linear y =
        (sourceEvenAut parityVector c 1 (by simp) hc0
          (by simpa [hc]) (by norm_num)).linear y :=
    congrArg (fun L => L y) (fixedParityAut_linear_eq c 1 hcr
      (by norm_num) (by simpa [hc]))
  rw [← hF0, ← hF1, ← hF2, ← hF3]

name: AlbertLean.Triality.ParityEvenFourFactor.four_fixedParity_factorization
statement:
theorem four_fixedParity_factorization
    (A B c : VCoord K) (rho alpha beta : K)
    (hc : nV c = 1)
    (hA : nV A ≠ 0) (hB : nV B ≠ 0)
    (hr : rho ^ 2 = nV A * nV B) (hr0 : rho ≠ 0)
    (ha : alpha ^ 2 = nV A) (ha0 : alpha ≠ 0)
    (hb : beta ^ 2 = nV B) (hb0 : beta ≠ 0)
    (hab : alpha * beta = rho)
    (hcr : c.r ≠ 0)
    (hAr : (evenV parityVector c A).r ≠ 0)
    (hBr : (evenV parityVector c B).r ≠ 0) :
    Nonempty (FourFixedParityFactorization A B rho hA hB hr hr0)
proof:
:= by
  let A' := evenV parityVector c A
  let B' := evenV parityVector c B
  let D : Fin 4 → VCoord K := ![
    reflectV parityVector c, reflectV parityVector A', B', c]
  let s : Fin 4 → K := ![-1, -alpha, beta, 1]
  have hDr : ∀ i, (D i).r ≠ 0 := by
    intro i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [D, A', B', hcr, hAr, hBr]
  have hs : ∀ i, s i ≠ 0 := by
    intro i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [s, ha0, hb0]
  let F := fun i => fixedParityAut (D i) (s i) (hDr i) (hs i)
  refine ⟨{
    r := fun i => (D i).r
    w := fun i => (D i).omega
    s := s
    r_ne := hDr
    s_ne := hs
    factor := F
    factor_eq := by
      intro i
      dsimp only [F]
      unfold fixedParityAut
      rfl

    action := ?_ }⟩
  intro x
  have hD0 : (reflectV parityVector c).r ≠ 0 := by simpa using hcr
  have hD1 : (reflectV parityVector A').r ≠ 0 := by simpa [A'] using hAr
  have hm1 : (-1 : K) ≠ 0 := by norm_num
  have hma : -alpha ≠ 0 := neg_ne_zero.mpr ha0
  have h1 : (1 : K) ≠ 0 := one_ne_zero
  let G0 := fixedParityAut (reflectV parityVector c) (-1) hD0 hm1
  let G1 := fixedParityAut (reflectV parityVector A') (-alpha) hD1 hma
  let G2 := fixedParityAut B' beta (by simpa [B'] using hBr) hb0
  let G3 := fixedParityAut c 1 hcr h1
  have hfour :
      (sourceEvenAut A B rho hA hB hr hr0).linear x =
        G0.linear (G1.linear (G2.linear (G3.linear x))) := by
    simpa only [G0, G1, G2, G3, A', B'] using
      four_fixedParity_apply A B c rho alpha beta hc hA hB hr hr0
        ha ha0 hb hb0 hab hcr hAr hBr x
  have hF0 : F 0 = G0 := by dsimp [F, D, s, G0]
  have hF1 : F 1 = G1 := by dsimp [F, D, s, G1, A']
  have hF2 : F 2 = G2 := by dsimp [F, D, s, G2, B']
  have hF3 : F 3 = G3 := by dsimp [F, D, s, G3]
  calc
    _ = G0.linear (G1.linear (G2.linear (G3.linear x))) := hfour
    _ = (F 0).linear (G1.linear (G2.linear (G3.linear x))) := by rw [hF0]
    _ = (F 0).linear ((F 1).linear (G2.linear (G3.linear x))) := by rw [hF1]
    _ = (F 0).linear ((F 1).linear ((F 2).linear (G3.linear x))) := by rw [hF2]
    _ = (F 0).linear ((F 1).linear ((F 2).linear ((F 3).linear x))) := by rw [hF3]

name: AlbertLean.Triality.ParityEvenFourFactor.exists_oneRoot_four_fixedParity
statement:
theorem exists_oneRoot_four_fixedParity
    (A B : VCoord K) (rho : K)
    (hA : nV A ≠ 0) (hB : nV B ≠ 0)
    (hr : rho ^ 2 = nV A * nV B) (hr0 : rho ≠ 0) :
    ∃ R : OneRootField K (nV A),
      ∃ _ : CharZero R.Carrier,
      Nonempty (FourFixedParityFactorization (mapV R.embedding A) (mapV R.embedding B)
        (R.embedding rho) (by simpa using R.embedding.injective.ne_iff.mpr hA)
        (by simpa using R.embedding.injective.ne_iff.mpr hB)
        (by simpa using congrArg R.embedding hr)
        (by simpa only [map_zero] using R.embedding.injective.ne_iff.mpr hr0))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, hAt, hBt⟩ := exists_fin15_move_centers A B hA hB
  obtain ⟨R⟩ := oneRootField_nonempty K (nV A)
  letI : CharZero R.Carrier := charZero_of_embedding R.embedding
  let Ae := mapV R.embedding A
  let Be := mapV R.embedding B
  let c := movingCenter (R.embedding (t.val : K))
  let A' := evenV parityVector c Ae
  let B' := evenV parityVector c Be
  let alpha := R.root
  let beta := R.embedding rho / alpha
  have ha : alpha ^ 2 = nV Ae := by simpa [Ae] using R.root_sq
  have ha0 : alpha ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    apply R.embedding.injective.ne_iff.mpr hA
    rw [← R.root_sq, show R.root = alpha from rfl, hz]
    norm_num
  have hab : alpha * beta = R.embedding rho := by
    dsimp [beta]
    field_simp [ha0]
  have hb : beta ^ 2 = nV Be := by
    dsimp [beta]
    rw [div_pow, show alpha ^ 2 = R.embedding (nV A) from R.root_sq,
      ← map_pow, hr, map_mul]
    rw [show nV Be = R.embedding (nV B) by simp [Be]]
    have hEA : R.embedding (nV A) ≠ 0 := by
      simpa only [map_zero] using R.embedding.injective.ne_iff.mpr hA
    calc
      R.embedding (nV A) * R.embedding (nV B) / R.embedding (nV A) =
          R.embedding (nV B) * R.embedding (nV A) / R.embedding (nV A) := by
            rw [mul_comm]
      _ = R.embedding (nV B) := mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ hEA
  have hb0 : beta ≠ 0 := by
    apply div_ne_zero
    · simpa only [map_zero] using R.embedding.injective.ne_iff.mpr hr0
    · exact ha0
  have hmc : mapV R.embedding (movingCenter (t.val : K)) = c := by
    rw [mapV_movingCenter]
  have hAr : A'.r ≠ 0 := by
    have hmap :
        mapV R.embedding (evenV parityVector (movingCenter (t.val : K)) A) = A' := by
      rw [mapV_evenV, mapV_parityVector, hmc]
    rw [← hmap]
    change R.embedding ((evenV parityVector (movingCenter (t.val : K)) A).r) ≠ 0
    simpa only [map_zero] using R.embedding.injective.ne_iff.mpr hAt
  have hBr : B'.r ≠ 0 := by
    have hmap :
        mapV R.embedding (evenV parityVector (movingCenter (t.val : K)) B) = B' := by
      rw [mapV_evenV, mapV_parityVector, hmc]
    rw [← hmap]
    change R.embedding ((evenV parityVector (movingCenter (t.val : K)) B).r) ≠ 0
    simpa only [map_zero] using R.embedding.injective.ne_iff.mpr hBt
  have hAe : nV Ae ≠ 0 := by simpa [Ae] using R.embedding.injective.ne_iff.mpr hA
  have hBe : nV Be ≠ 0 := by simpa [Be] using R.embedding.injective.ne_iff.mpr hB
  have hre : (R.embedding rho) ^ 2 = nV Ae * nV Be := by
    simpa [Ae, Be] using congrArg R.embedding hr
  have hre0 : R.embedding rho ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [map_zero] using R.embedding.injective.ne_iff.mpr hr0
  have hcR : c.r ≠ 0 := by simp [c]
  refine ⟨R, inferInstance, ?_⟩
  exact four_fixedParity_factorization Ae Be c (R.embedding rho) alpha beta
    (movingCenter_norm _) hAe hBe hre hre0 ha ha0 hb hb0 hab hcR hAr hBr

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3LedgerInvariance.matrix_of_sub
statement:
private theorem matrix_of_sub (x y : Sym3Coord F) :
    toSymMatrix (x - y) = toSymMatrix x - toSymMatrix y
proof:
:=
  toSymMatrixLinear.map_sub x y

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3LedgerInvariance.trace_coordinate_pair
statement:
theorem trace_coordinate_pair (x y : Sym3Coord F) :
    Matrix.trace (toSymMatrix x * toSymMatrix y) = matrixTrace (jordan x y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← trace_matrixJordan, ← toSymMatrix_jordan, trace_toSymMatrix]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3LedgerInvariance.trace_coordinate_joint
statement:
theorem trace_coordinate_joint (x y z : Sym3Coord F) :
    Matrix.trace (matrixJordan (toSymMatrix x) (toSymMatrix y) * toSymMatrix z) =
      matrixTrace (jordan (jordan x y) z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← toSymMatrix_jordan, trace_coordinate_pair]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3LedgerInvariance.toSymMatrix_coordinateProjector
statement:
theorem toSymMatrix_coordinateProjector (x : Sym3Coord F) (i : Fin 3) :
    toSymMatrix (coordinateProjector x i) = matrixProjector (toSymMatrix x) i
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i <;>
    dsimp only [coordinateProjector, matrixProjector, Matrix.cons_val, Fin.reduceFinMk] <;>
    simp only [toSymMatrix_smul, matrix_of_sub, toSymMatrix_add,
      Sym3JordanCoordinates.toSymMatrix_one, toSymMatrix_jordan]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3LedgerInvariance.matrixLedger_eq_coordinateLedger
statement:
theorem matrixLedger_eq_coordinateLedger (T : Fin 3 → Sym3Coord F) :
    matrixLedger (fun r => toSymMatrix (T r)) = coordinateLedger T
proof:
:= by
  simp only [matrixLedger, coordinateLedger, ← toSymMatrix_coordinateProjector,
    trace_coordinate_pair, trace_coordinate_joint]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3LedgerInvariance.coordinateProjector_map
statement:
theorem coordinateProjector_map (x : Sym3Coord F) (i : Fin 3) :
    coordinateProjector (e x) i = e (coordinateProjector x i)
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i <;>
    dsimp only [coordinateProjector, Matrix.cons_val, Fin.reduceFinMk] <;>
    simp only [map_smul, map_sub, map_add, hprod, hone]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3LedgerInvariance.coordinateLedger_invariant
statement:
theorem coordinateLedger_invariant (T : Fin 3 → Sym3Coord F) :
    coordinateLedger (fun r => e (T r)) = coordinateLedger T
proof:
:= by
  simp only [coordinateLedger, coordinateProjector_map e hone hprod,
    ← hprod, htrace]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3LedgerInvariance.matrixLedger_invariant
statement:
theorem matrixLedger_invariant (T : Fin 3 → Sym3Coord F) :
    matrixLedger (fun r => toSymMatrix (e (T r))) =
      matrixLedger (fun r => toSymMatrix (T r))
proof:
:= by
  rw [matrixLedger_eq_coordinateLedger, matrixLedger_eq_coordinateLedger]
  exact coordinateLedger_invariant e hone hprod htrace T

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3LedgerInvariance.labelledLedger_invariant
statement:
theorem labelledLedger_invariant (T : Fin 3 → Sym3Coord F) :
    labelledLedger (fun r => embed (toSymMatrix (e (T r)))) =
      labelledLedger (fun r => embed (toSymMatrix (T r)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [labelledLedger_embed_eq, labelledLedger_embed_eq]
  exact matrixLedger_invariant e hone hprod htrace T

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3LedgerInvariance.primitiveLedger_invariant
statement:
theorem primitiveLedger_invariant (P : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Sym3Coord F) :
    labelledLedger (primitiveMatrixTauTriple (fun r i => toSymMatrix (e (P r i)))) =
      labelledLedger (primitiveMatrixTauTriple (fun r i => toSymMatrix (P r i)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [primitiveLedger_eq_matrixLedger, primitiveLedger_eq_matrixLedger]
  simpa only [map_sub, matrix_of_sub] using
    matrixLedger_invariant e hone hprod htrace (fun r => P r 2 - P r 0)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3LedgerInvariance.labelledLedger_extension_invariant
statement:
theorem labelledLedger_extension_invariant (g : Aut (K := k))
    (T : Fin 3 → Sym3Coord F) :
    labelledLedger (fun r => embed (toSymMatrix (Sym3JordanExtension.linearEquiv F g (T r)))) =
      labelledLedger (fun r => embed (toSymMatrix (T r)))
proof:
:=
  labelledLedger_invariant (Sym3JordanExtension.linearEquiv F g)
    (Sym3JordanExtension.linearEquiv_one F g) (Sym3JordanExtension.linearEquiv_jordan F g)
    (Sym3JordanExtension.linearEquiv_matrixTrace F g) T

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3LedgerInvariance.primitiveLedger_extension_invariant
statement:
theorem primitiveLedger_extension_invariant (g : Aut (K := k))
    (P : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Sym3Coord F) :
    labelledLedger (primitiveMatrixTauTriple
      (fun r i => toSymMatrix (Sym3JordanExtension.linearEquiv F g (P r i)))) =
      labelledLedger (primitiveMatrixTauTriple (fun r i => toSymMatrix (P r i)))
proof:
:=
  primitiveLedger_invariant (Sym3JordanExtension.linearEquiv F g)
    (Sym3JordanExtension.linearEquiv_one F g) (Sym3JordanExtension.linearEquiv_jordan F g)
    (Sym3JordanExtension.linearEquiv_matrixTrace F g) P

name: AlbertLean.Generic.UniformMomentGenericEvaluation.map_uniformN
statement:
theorem map_uniformN (f : A →+* B)
    (hf : f.comp (algebraMap ℚ A) = algebraMap ℚ B)
    (L : SourceLedger A) (a h sigma : A) :
    (uniformN L a h sigma).map f =
      uniformN (mapLedger f L) (f a) (f h) (f sigma)
proof:
:= by
  have hf2 : f (2 : A) = (2 : B) := map_natCast f 2
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [uniformN, hf2, map_nSx f hf, map_nSy f hf, map_nCx f hf,
      map_nCy f hf, map_gS f hf, map_gC f hf, map_t111 f hf,
      map_t211 f hf, map_t121 f hf, map_t112 f hf, map_t122 f hf,
      map_t212 f hf, map_t221 f hf, map_t222 f hf, map_uS f hf,
      map_uC f hf]
