name: AlbertLean.Generic.UniformMomentGenericEvaluation.evalQ0_omega
statement:
@[simp] theorem evalQ0_omega (r : FunctionField k)
    (hr : r ^ 2 = ledgerEval k (discr k)) :
    evalQ0 k r hr (QuadraticAlgebra.omega : Q0 k) = r
proof:
:= by
  simp [evalQ0, Algebra.smul_def]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.UniformMomentGenericEvaluation.evalQ0_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp] theorem evalQ0_algebraMap (r : FunctionField k)
    (hr : r ^ 2 = ledgerEval k (discr k)) (x : R0 k) :
    evalQ0 k r hr (algebraMap (R0 k) (Q0 k) x) = ledgerEval k x
proof:
:= by
  simp [evalQ0, RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.UniformMomentGenericEvaluation.ledgerEval_norm_eq_evalQ0_mul_evalQ0_neg
statement:
theorem ledgerEval_norm_eq_evalQ0_mul_evalQ0_neg
    (r : FunctionField k)
    (hr : r ^ 2 = ledgerEval k (discr k))
    (hrneg : (-r) ^ 2 = ledgerEval k (discr k)) (z : Q0 k) :
    ledgerEval k (QuadraticAlgebra.norm z) =
      evalQ0 k r hr z * evalQ0 k (-r) hrneg z
proof:
:= by
  let ep := evalQ0 k r hr
  let em := evalQ0 k (-r) hrneg
  have hep : ep z = ledgerEval k z.re + ledgerEval k z.im * r := by
    rw [← QuadraticAlgebra.re_smul_add_im_smul z]
    simp [Algebra.smul_def, ep, evalQ0_algebraMap, evalQ0_omega]
  have hem : em z = ledgerEval k z.re - ledgerEval k z.im * r := by
    rw [← QuadraticAlgebra.re_smul_add_im_smul z]
    simp [Algebra.smul_def, em, evalQ0_algebraMap, evalQ0_omega,
      sub_eq_add_neg]
  change ledgerEval k (QuadraticAlgebra.norm z) = ep z * em z
  rw [hep, hem, QuadraticAlgebra.norm_def]
  simp only [map_sub, map_add, map_mul, map_pow, map_zero]
  rw [← hr]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.UniformMomentGenericEvaluation.evalQ0_N0
statement:
theorem evalQ0_N0 (r : FunctionField k)
    (hr : r ^ 2 = ledgerEval k (discr k)) :
    (N0 k).map (evalQ0 k r hr) =
      uniformN (genericLedger k) (ledgerEval k (a k))
        (ledgerEval k (h k)) r
proof:
:= by
  have hQ : (evalQ0 k r hr).comp (algebraMap ℚ (Q0 k)) =
      algebraMap ℚ (FunctionField k) := by
    ext q
    simp [evalQ0_algebraMap, ledgerEval]
  have hL :
      mapLedger (evalQ0 k r hr)
          (mapLedger (algebraMap (R0 k) (Q0 k)) (universalLedger k)) =
        genericLedger k := by
    calc
      _ = mapLedger (ledgerEval k) (universalLedger k) := by
        ext <;> simp [mapLedger, evalQ0_algebraMap]
      _ = genericLedger k := ledgerEval_universal k
  rw [N0, map_uniformN (evalQ0 k r hr) hQ, hL]
  simp

name: AlbertLean.Generic.UniformMomentGenericEvaluation.ledgerEval_eta_eq_det_plus_mul_det_minus
statement:
theorem ledgerEval_eta_eq_det_plus_mul_det_minus
    (hplus : (kappa k) ^ 2 = ledgerEval k (discr k))
    (hminus : (-kappa k) ^ 2 = ledgerEval k (discr k)) :
    ledgerEval k (UniformMomentFiniteAlgebra.eta k) =
      Matrix.det ((N0 k).map (evalQ0 k (kappa k) hplus)) *
      Matrix.det ((N0 k).map (evalQ0 k (-kappa k) hminus))
proof:
:= by
  rw [UniformMomentFiniteAlgebra.eta,
    ledgerEval_norm_eq_evalQ0_mul_evalQ0_neg k (kappa k)
      hplus hminus (Matrix.det (N0 k))]
  have hp : evalQ0 k (kappa k) hplus (Matrix.det (N0 k)) =
      Matrix.det ((N0 k).map (evalQ0 k (kappa k) hplus)) :=
    RingHom.map_det (evalQ0 k (kappa k) hplus) (N0 k)
  have hm : evalQ0 k (-kappa k) hminus (Matrix.det (N0 k)) =
      Matrix.det ((N0 k).map (evalQ0 k (-kappa k) hminus)) :=
    RingHom.map_det (evalQ0 k (-kappa k) hminus) (N0 k)
  rw [hp, hm]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.CayleyFrameCoverage.skew_isSkew
statement: @[simp] theorem skew_isSkew (a b c : K) : IsSkew (skew a b c)
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [IsSkew, skew, Matrix.transpose_apply]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.CayleyFrameCoverage.skew_coordinates
statement:
theorem skew_coordinates {A : Mat3 K} (hA : IsSkew A) :
    skew (A 0 1) (A 0 2) (A 1 2) = A
proof:
:= by
  have h := hA
  unfold IsSkew at h
  ext i j
  have hij := congrFun (congrFun h i) j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [skew, Matrix.transpose_apply] at hij ⊢ <;>
      first | exact hij.symm | linear_combination -hij | linear_combination -hij / 2

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.CayleyFrameCoverage.exists_cayley_projector_frame
statement:
theorem exists_cayley_projector_frame
    (hsqrt : ∀ x : K, ∃ t : K, t ^ 2 = x)
    (P : Fin 3 → Mat3 K)
    (hsymm : ∀ i, Matrix.transpose (P i) = P i)
    (hidem : ∀ i, P i * P i = P i)
    (htrace : ∀ i, Matrix.trace (P i) = 1)
    (hsum : P 0 + P 1 + P 2 = 1) :
    ∃ a b c : K,
      Matrix.det (1 + skew a b c) ≠ 0 ∧
      IsOrthogonal (cayley (skew a b c)) ∧
      ∀ i, columnProjector (cayley (skew a b c)) i = P i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨X, hX, hXP⟩ :=
    exists_orthogonal_of_symmetric_primitive_frame
      hsqrt P hsymm hidem htrace hsum
  obtain ⟨B, hB, hBX, hBden⟩ :=
    exists_orthogonal_same_projectors_det_one_add_ne_zero X hX
  let A := cayley B
  have hAskew : IsSkew A := cayley_skew_of_orthogonal hB hBden
  have hAden : Matrix.det (1 + A) ≠ 0 :=
    det_one_add_cayley_ne_zero hBden
  have hrecover : cayley A = B := cayley_cayley hBden
  have hcoords : skew (A 0 1) (A 0 2) (A 1 2) = A :=
    skew_coordinates hAskew
  refine ⟨A 0 1, A 0 2, A 1 2, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [hcoords] using hAden
  · rw [hcoords, hrecover]
    exact hB
  · intro i
    rw [hcoords, hrecover, hBX i, hXP i]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.CyclicContractions.sourceMuS_normalizedMuV
statement:

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3PrimitiveDictionary.trace_one_ne_zero
statement:
theorem trace_one_ne_zero (P : Mat3 K) (htrace : Matrix.trace P = 1) :
    P ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hP
  rw [hP] at htrace
  simpa using htrace

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3PrimitiveDictionary.raw_trace_one_frame_mul_zero
statement:
theorem raw_trace_one_frame_mul_zero
    (P : Fin 3 → Mat3 K)
    (hsymm : ∀ i, Matrix.transpose (P i) = P i)
    (hidem : ∀ i, P i * P i = P i)
    (htrace : ∀ i, Matrix.trace (P i) = 1)
    (hsum : P 0 + P 1 + P 2 = 1) :
    ∀ i j, i ≠ j → P i * P j = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨L, instL, f, a, b, c, hden, horth, hproj⟩ :=
    exists_common_extension_cayley_parameters
      (rho := Unit) (fun _ i => P i)
      (fun _ => hsymm) (fun _ => hidem) (fun _ => htrace) (fun _ => hsum)
  letI : Field L := instL
  letI : CharZero L := FiniteQuadraticRoots.charZero_of_embedding f
  letI : Invertible (2 : L) := invertibleOfNonzero (by norm_num)
  intro i j hij
  apply Matrix.ext
  intro r s
  apply f.injective
  change f ((P i * P j) r s) = f (0 : K)
  rw [map_zero]
  change (f.mapMatrix (P i * P j)) r s = 0
  rw [map_mul]
  rw [← hproj Unit.unit i, ← hproj Unit.unit j]
  rw [columnProjector_mul_zero_of_ne _ (horth Unit.unit) i j hij]
  rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3PrimitiveDictionary.trace_one_coordinate_frame_jordan_zero
statement:
theorem trace_one_coordinate_frame_jordan_zero
    (e : Fin 3 → Sym3Coord K)
    (hidem : ∀ i, jordan (e i) (e i) = e i)
    (htrace : ∀ i, matrixTrace (e i) = 1)
    (hsum : e 0 + e 1 + e 2 = one) :
    ∀ i j, i ≠ j → jordan (e i) (e j) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hsymm : ∀ i, Matrix.transpose (toSymMatrix (e i)) = toSymMatrix (e i) :=
    fun i => toSymMatrix_symmetric (e i)
  have hidemM : ∀ i, toSymMatrix (e i) * toSymMatrix (e i) =
      toSymMatrix (e i) := by
    intro i
    have h := congrArg toSymMatrix (hidem i)
    simpa only [toSymMatrix_jordan, Sym3JordanFrameTransport.matrixJordan_self] using h
  have htraceM : ∀ i, Matrix.trace (toSymMatrix (e i)) = 1 := by
    intro i
    rw [trace_toSymMatrix, htrace i]
  have hsumM : toSymMatrix (e 0) + toSymMatrix (e 1) + toSymMatrix (e 2) = 1 := by
    have h := congrArg toSymMatrix hsum
    simpa only [toSymMatrix_add, Sym3JordanCoordinates.toSymMatrix_one] using h
  intro i j hij
  have hm := raw_trace_one_frame_mul_zero (fun q => toSymMatrix (e q))
    hsymm hidemM htraceM hsumM i j hij
  have hm' := raw_trace_one_frame_mul_zero (fun q => toSymMatrix (e q))
    hsymm hidemM htraceM hsumM j i (Ne.symm hij)
  apply (Function.LeftInverse.injective fromMatrix_toSymMatrix)
  rw [toSymMatrix_jordan]
  simp only [matrixJordan, hm, hm', add_zero, smul_zero, toSymMatrix_zero]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.M3JordanReducedAction.reducedUniversalFamily_isRaw
statement:
theorem reducedUniversalFamily_isRaw :
    IsRawFrameFamily (reducedUniversalFamily k)
proof:
:= by
  let q := Ideal.Quotient.mk (rawFrameIdeal (R := k)).radical
  have heval : evaluationAlong (q.comp MvPolynomial.C) (reducedUniversalFamily k) = q := by
    apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
    · intro c; simp [evaluationAlong, q]
    · intro x
      cases x with
      | entry r i a b => simp [reducedUniversalFamily, q, evaluationAlong, universalMatrix]
  apply (equations_vanishAlong_iff (q.comp MvPolynomial.C)
    (reducedUniversalFamily k)).1
  intro e
  rw [heval]
  exact Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr
    (Ideal.le_radical (Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self e)))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.M3JordanReducedAction.matrixJordan_self
statement:
private theorem matrixJordan_self {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [Invertible (2 : R)]
    (A : Mat3 R) : matrixJordan A A = A * A
proof:
:= by
  rw [matrixJordan, ← two_smul R (A * A), ← smul_assoc,
    smul_eq_mul, invOf_mul_self, one_smul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.M3JordanReducedAction.linearEquiv_mapMatrix
statement:
theorem linearEquiv_mapMatrix
    {R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [Algebra k R] [Algebra k S] [Invertible (2 : R)] [Invertible (2 : S)]
    (f : R →ₐ[k] S) (g : Aut (K := k)) (A : Mat3 R) :
    f.toRingHom.mapMatrix (linearEquiv (R := R) g A) =
      linearEquiv (R := S) g (f.toRingHom.mapMatrix A)
proof:
:= by
  apply coordEquiv.injective
  change (f ∘ coordLinearEquiv (R := R) g (coordEquiv A)) =
    coordLinearEquiv (R := S) g (f ∘ coordEquiv A)
  exact coordLinearEquiv_natural f g (coordEquiv A)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.M3JordanReducedAction.linearEquiv_symm_mapMatrix
statement:
theorem linearEquiv_symm_mapMatrix
    {R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [Algebra k R] [Algebra k S] [Invertible (2 : R)] [Invertible (2 : S)]
    (f : R →ₐ[k] S) (g : Aut (K := k)) (A : Mat3 R) :
    f.toRingHom.mapMatrix ((linearEquiv (R := R) g).symm A) =
      (linearEquiv (R := S) g).symm (f.toRingHom.mapMatrix A)
proof:
:= by
  apply (linearEquiv (R := S) g).injective
  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, ← linearEquiv_mapMatrix]
  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.M3JordanReducedAction.transformedFamily_isRaw
statement:
theorem transformedFamily_isRaw (g : Aut (K := k)) :
    IsRawFrameFamily (transformedFamily k g)
proof:
:= by
  let G := linearEquiv (R := ReducedCoordinateRing k) g
  have hP := reducedUniversalFamily_isRaw k
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro r i
    have h := linearEquiv_jordan (R := ReducedCoordinateRing k) g
      (reducedUniversalFamily k r i) (reducedUniversalFamily k r i)
    rw [matrixJordan_self, matrixJordan_self, hP.idempotent r i] at h
    exact h.symm
  · intro r i
    exact linearEquiv_trace (R := ReducedCoordinateRing k) g _ |>.trans (hP.trace_one r i)
  · intro r
    change ∑ i : Fin 3, G (reducedUniversalFamily k r i) = 1
    rw [← map_sum G, hP.sum_one r]
    exact linearEquiv_one (R := ReducedCoordinateRing k) g

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.M3JordanReducedAction.rawFrameIdeal_le_ker_rawToReduced
statement:
theorem rawFrameIdeal_le_ker_rawToReduced (g : Aut (K := k)) :
    rawFrameIdeal (R := k) ≤ RingHom.ker (rawToReduced k g)
proof:
:= by
  have h := (equations_vanishAlong_iff
    ((Ideal.Quotient.mk (rawFrameIdeal (R := k)).radical).comp MvPolynomial.C)
    (transformedFamily k g)).2 (transformedFamily_isRaw k g)
  exact Ideal.span_le.2 (fun p hp => by
    rcases hp with ⟨e, rfl⟩
    exact RingHom.mem_ker.mpr (h e))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.M3JordanReducedAction.radical_le_ker_rawToReduced
statement:
theorem radical_le_ker_rawToReduced (g : Aut (K := k)) :
    (rawFrameIdeal (R := k)).radical ≤ RingHom.ker (rawToReduced k g)
proof:
:=
  (RingHom.ker_isPrime (rawToReduced k g)).radical_le_iff.mpr
    (rawFrameIdeal_le_ker_rawToReduced k g)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.M3JordanReducedAction.inverse_one
statement:
theorem inverse_one (g : Aut (K := k)) :
    (linearEquiv (R := ReducedCoordinateRing k) g).symm (1 : Mat3 _) = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply (linearEquiv (R := ReducedCoordinateRing k) g).injective

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.M3JordanReducedAction.inverse_jordan
statement:
theorem inverse_jordan (g : Aut (K := k)) (A B : Mat3 (ReducedCoordinateRing k)) :
    (linearEquiv (R := ReducedCoordinateRing k) g).symm (matrixJordan A B) =
      matrixJordan ((linearEquiv (R := ReducedCoordinateRing k) g).symm A)
        ((linearEquiv (R := ReducedCoordinateRing k) g).symm B)
proof:
:= by
  apply (linearEquiv (R := ReducedCoordinateRing k) g).injective
  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, linearEquiv_jordan,
    LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.M3JordanReducedAction.inverse_trace
statement:
theorem inverse_trace (g : Aut (K := k)) (A : Mat3 (ReducedCoordinateRing k)) :
    Matrix.trace ((linearEquiv (R := ReducedCoordinateRing k) g).symm A) =
      Matrix.trace A
proof:
:= by
  have h := linearEquiv_trace (R := ReducedCoordinateRing k) g
    ((linearEquiv (R := ReducedCoordinateRing k) g).symm A)
  simpa only [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using h.symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.M3JordanReducedAction.inverseTransformedFamily_isRaw
statement:
theorem inverseTransformedFamily_isRaw (g : Aut (K := k)) :
    IsRawFrameFamily (inverseTransformedFamily k g)
proof:
:= by
  let G := (linearEquiv (R := ReducedCoordinateRing k) g).symm
  have hP := reducedUniversalFamily_isRaw k
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro r i
    have h := inverse_jordan (k := k) g
      (reducedUniversalFamily k r i) (reducedUniversalFamily k r i)
    rw [matrixJordan_self, matrixJordan_self, hP.idempotent r i] at h
    exact h.symm
  · intro r i
    exact inverse_trace (k := k) g _ |>.trans (hP.trace_one r i)
  · intro r
    change ∑ i : Fin 3, G (reducedUniversalFamily k r i) = 1
    rw [← map_sum G, hP.sum_one r]
    exact inverse_one k g

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.M3JordanReducedAction.rawFrameIdeal_le_ker_rawToReducedInverse

    ((Ideal.Quotient.mk (rawFrameIdeal (R := k)).radical).comp MvPolynomial.C)
    (inverseTransformedFamily k g)).2 (inverseTransformedFamily_isRaw k g)

    exact RingHom.mem_ker.mpr (h e))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.M3JordanReducedAction.radical_le_ker_rawToReducedInverse

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.M3JordanReducedAction.reducedInverseHom_universalMatrix
statement:
@[simp] theorem reducedInverseHom_universalMatrix (g : Aut (K := k))
    (r i a b : Fin 3) :
    reducedInverseHom k g (reducedUniversalFamily k r i a b) =
      inverseTransformedFamily k g r i a b

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.M3JordanReducedAction.reducedInverseHom_scalar
statement:
@[simp] theorem reducedInverseHom_scalar (g : Aut (K := k)) (c : k) :
    reducedInverseHom k g (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (MvPolynomial.C c)) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (MvPolynomial.C c)
proof:
:= by
  simp [reducedInverseHom, rawToReducedInverse, evaluationAlong]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.M3JordanReducedAction.reducedInverse_map_transformedFamily
statement:
theorem reducedInverse_map_transformedFamily (g : Aut (K := k)) (r i : Fin 3) :
    (reducedInverseHom k g).mapMatrix (transformedFamily k g r i) =
      reducedUniversalFamily k r i
proof:
:= by
  have hU : (reducedInverseHom k g).mapMatrix (reducedUniversalFamily k r i) =
      inverseTransformedFamily k g r i := by
    ext a b; exact reducedInverseHom_universalMatrix k g r i a b
  calc
    _ = linearEquiv (R := ReducedCoordinateRing k) g
        ((reducedInverseHom k g).mapMatrix (reducedUniversalFamily k r i)) :=
      linearEquiv_mapMatrix k (reducedInverseAlgHom k g) g _
    _ = _ := by rw [hU, inverseTransformedFamily, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.M3JordanReducedAction.reducedAction_map_inverseTransformedFamily
statement:
theorem reducedAction_map_inverseTransformedFamily (g : Aut (K := k)) (r i : Fin 3) :
    (reducedActionHom k g).mapMatrix (inverseTransformedFamily k g r i) =
      reducedUniversalFamily k r i
proof:
:= by
  have hU : (reducedActionHom k g).mapMatrix (reducedUniversalFamily k r i) =
      transformedFamily k g r i := by
    ext a b; exact reducedActionHom_universalMatrix k g r i a b
  calc
    _ = (linearEquiv (R := ReducedCoordinateRing k) g).symm
        ((reducedActionHom k g).mapMatrix (reducedUniversalFamily k r i)) :=
      linearEquiv_symm_mapMatrix k (reducedActionAlgHom k g) g _
    _ = _ := by rw [hU, transformedFamily, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.M3JordanReducedAction.reducedInverse_comp_action
statement:
theorem reducedInverse_comp_action (g : Aut (K := k)) :
    (reducedInverseHom k g).comp (reducedActionHom k g) = RingHom.id _
proof:
:= by
  apply Ideal.Quotient.ringHom_ext
  apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
  · intro c; simp
  · intro x
    cases x with
    | entry r i a b =>
      change reducedInverseHom k g (reducedActionHom k g
        (reducedUniversalFamily k r i a b)) = reducedUniversalFamily k r i a b
      rw [reducedActionHom_universalMatrix]
      exact congrFun (congrFun (reducedInverse_map_transformedFamily k g r i) a) b

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.M3JordanReducedAction.reducedAction_comp_inverse
statement:
theorem reducedAction_comp_inverse (g : Aut (K := k)) :
    (reducedActionHom k g).comp (reducedInverseHom k g) = RingHom.id _
proof:
:= by
  apply Ideal.Quotient.ringHom_ext
  apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
  · intro c; simp
  · intro x
    cases x with
    | entry r i a b =>
      change reducedActionHom k g (reducedInverseHom k g
        (reducedUniversalFamily k r i a b)) = reducedUniversalFamily k r i a b
      rw [reducedInverseHom_universalMatrix]
      exact congrFun (congrFun (reducedAction_map_inverseTransformedFamily k g r i) a) b

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FibreLedger.right_of_cover_of_detector_ne
statement:
theorem right_of_cover_of_detector_ne {X₀ X₁ Y : WitnessTriple}
    (hdet : traceCubeDetector X₀ ≠ traceCubeDetector Y)
    (hcover : FullRelated X₀ Y ∨ FullRelated X₁ Y) :
    FullRelated X₁ Y
proof:
:= by
  rcases hcover with h | h
  · exact (hdet h.traceCubeDetector_eq).elim
  · exact h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FibreLedger.ledger_eq_of_cover
statement:
theorem ledger_eq_of_cover {X₀ X₁ Y : WitnessTriple}
    (hroot : ledger X₁ = ledger X₀)
    (hcover : FullRelated X₀ Y ∨ FullRelated X₁ Y) :
    ledger Y = ledger X₀
proof:
:= by
  rcases hcover with h | h
  · exact h.ledger_eq.symm
  · exact h.ledger_eq.symm.trans hroot

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FibreLedger.root_ledger_eq_of_separating_witness
statement:
theorem root_ledger_eq_of_separating_witness {X₀ X₁ Y : WitnessTriple}
    (hdet : traceCubeDetector X₀ ≠ traceCubeDetector Y)
    (hledger : ledger X₀ = ledger Y)
    (hcover : FullRelated X₀ Y ∨ FullRelated X₁ Y) :
    ledger X₁ = ledger X₀
proof:
:= by
  exact (right_of_cover_of_detector_ne hdet hcover).ledger_eq.trans hledger.symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FibreLedger.fibre_ledger_eq_of_separating_witness
statement:
theorem fibre_ledger_eq_of_separating_witness (x : ExplicitFrameChart ℚ)
    (hx : ResidualOpen (residualPairOfChart x))
    (W : ResidualPair ℚ) (hW : InFibre x W)
    (hdet : traceCubeDetector (chartWitnessTriple x) ≠
      traceCubeDetector (fibreTriple x W))
    (hledger : ledger (chartWitnessTriple x) = ledger (fibreTriple x W))
    (Q : ResidualPair ℚ) (hQ : InFibre x Q) :
    ledger (fibreTriple x Q) = ledger (chartWitnessTriple x)
proof:
:= by
  apply ledger_eq_of_cover
  · exact root_ledger_eq_of_separating_witness hdet hledger
      (fullRelated_cover x hx W hW)
  · exact fullRelated_cover x hx Q hQ

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FibreLedger.witnessCharts_ledger_eq
statement:
theorem witnessCharts_ledger_eq :
    ledger (chartWitnessTriple witnessChart1) =
      ledger (chartWitnessTriple witnessChartM)
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartWitnessTriple_witnessChart1, chartWitnessTriple_witnessChartM]
  exact witnessSameLedger

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FibreLedger.witness_rootSwap_fullRelated_witnessM
statement:
theorem witness_rootSwap_fullRelated_witnessM :
    FullRelated
      (chartWitnessTriple (rootSwappedChart witnessChart1 witnessChart1_open))
      (chartWitnessTriple witnessChartM)
proof:
:= by
  apply right_of_cover_of_detector_ne witnessCharts_detector_ne
  simpa only [fibreTriple_witnessM] using
    (fullRelated_cover witnessChart1 witnessChart1_open
      (residualPairOfChart witnessChartM) witnessM_inFibre)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FibreLedger.witness_rootSwap_ledger_eq
statement:
theorem witness_rootSwap_ledger_eq :
    ledger
        (chartWitnessTriple
          (rootSwappedChart witnessChart1 witnessChart1_open)) =
      ledger (chartWitnessTriple witnessChart1)
proof:
:= by
  exact witness_rootSwap_fullRelated_witnessM.ledger_eq.trans
    witnessCharts_ledger_eq.symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FibreLedger.witness_fibre_ledger_eq_original
statement:
theorem witness_fibre_ledger_eq_original (Q : ResidualPair ℚ)
    (hQ : InFibre witnessChart1 Q) :
    ledger (fibreTriple witnessChart1 Q) = ledger witnessTheta1
proof:
:= by
  calc
    ledger (fibreTriple witnessChart1 Q) =
        ledger (chartWitnessTriple witnessChart1) :=
      ledger_eq_of_cover witness_rootSwap_ledger_eq
        (fullRelated_cover witnessChart1 witnessChart1_open Q hQ)
    _ = ledger witnessTheta1 := by rw [chartWitnessTriple_witnessChart1]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FibreLedger.witness_fibre_lawful_same_original_ledger
statement:
theorem witness_fibre_lawful_same_original_ledger (Q : ResidualPair ℚ)
    (hQ : InFibre witnessChart1 Q) :
    LawfulFrameTriple (fibreTriple witnessChart1 Q) ∧
      ledger (fibreTriple witnessChart1 Q) = ledger witnessTheta1
proof:
:=
  ⟨lawful_of_inFibre witnessChart1 witnessChart1_lawful Q hQ,
    witness_fibre_ledger_eq_original Q hQ⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericMeasurementSymmetry.reorient_entry
statement:
theorem reorient_entry (i j : Fin 4) :
    reorient k (rationalM k i j) =
      (weight k i)⁻¹ * weight k j * rationalM k j i
proof:
:=
  congrArg (fun M : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) (B k) => M i j) (rationalM_reorient k)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericMeasurementSymmetry.reorient_diagonal
statement:
@[simp] theorem reorient_diagonal (i : Fin 4) :
    reorient k (rationalM k i i) = rationalM k i i
proof:
:= by
  rw [reorient_entry, inv_mul_cancel₀ (weight_ne_zero k i), one_mul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericMeasurementSymmetry.reorient_bc
statement:
@[simp] theorem reorient_bc :
    reorient k (ι k (b k) * ι k (c k)) = ι k (b k) * ι k (c k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_mul, reorient_b, reorient_c]
  field_simp [base_a_ne_zero k]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericMeasurementSymmetry.reorient_vGram
statement:
@[simp] theorem reorient_vGram :
    reorient k (ι k (c k) + ι k (a k) * ι k (b k)) =
      ι k (c k) + ι k (a k) * ι k (b k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_add, map_mul, reorient_c, reorient_a, reorient_b]
  field_simp [base_a_ne_zero k]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericMeasurementSymmetry.reorient_sGram
statement:
@[simp] theorem reorient_sGram :
    reorient k (rationalM k 0 1 + rationalM k 1 0) =
      rationalM k 0 1 + rationalM k 1 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [map_add, reorient_entry, weight]
  norm_num [Fin.lt_def]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericMeasurementSymmetry.reorient_cGram
statement:
@[simp] theorem reorient_cGram :
    reorient k (rationalM k 2 3 + rationalM k 3 2) =
      rationalM k 2 3 + rationalM k 3 2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [map_add, reorient_entry, weight]
  norm_num [Fin.lt_def]
  field_simp [base_a_ne_zero k]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericMeasurementSymmetry.reorient_trialityA
statement:
theorem reorient_trialityA (i j : Fin 4) (hi : i < 2) (hj : ¬ j < 2) :
    reorient k (rationalM k i j + ι k (a k) * rationalM k j i) =
      rationalM k i j + ι k (a k) * rationalM k j i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [map_add, map_mul, reorient_a, reorient_entry,
    weight, if_pos hi, if_neg hj, inv_one, one_mul, mul_one]
  field_simp [base_a_ne_zero k]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericMeasurementSymmetry.reorient_trialityB
statement:
theorem reorient_trialityB (i j : Fin 4) (hi : i < 2) (hj : ¬ j < 2) :
    reorient k (ι k (b k) * rationalM k i j + ι k (c k) * rationalM k j i) =
      ι k (b k) * rationalM k i j + ι k (c k) * rationalM k j i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [map_add, map_mul, reorient_b, reorient_c, reorient_entry,
    weight, if_pos hi, if_neg hj, inv_one, one_mul, mul_one]
  field_simp [base_a_ne_zero k]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericMeasurementSymmetry.reorient_UC
statement:
@[simp] theorem reorient_UC :
    reorient k (ι k (c k) * rationalM k 0 1 +
      ι k (a k) * ι k (b k) * rationalM k 1 0) =
    ι k (c k) * rationalM k 0 1 + ι k (a k) * ι k (b k) * rationalM k 1 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [map_add, map_mul, reorient_a, reorient_b, reorient_c,
    reorient_entry, weight]
  norm_num [Fin.lt_def]
  field_simp [base_a_ne_zero k]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericMeasurementSymmetry.reorient_US
statement:
@[simp] theorem reorient_US :
    reorient k (ι k (a k) * ι k (b k) * rationalM k 2 3 +
      ι k (c k) * rationalM k 3 2) =
    ι k (a k) * ι k (b k) * rationalM k 2 3 + ι k (c k) * rationalM k 3 2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [map_add, map_mul, reorient_a, reorient_b, reorient_c,
    reorient_entry, weight]
  norm_num [Fin.lt_def]
  field_simp [base_a_ne_zero k]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericMeasurementSymmetry.weightedTranspose_exteriorQ
statement:
theorem weightedTranspose_exteriorQ (M : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) (B k)) :
    exteriorQ (weightedTranspose k M) = exteriorQ M
proof:
:= by
  simp only [exteriorQ, weightedTranspose, weight]
  norm_num [Fin.lt_def]
  field_simp [base_a_ne_zero k]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericMeasurementSymmetry.reorient_exteriorQ
statement:
@[simp] theorem reorient_exteriorQ :
    reorient k (exteriorQ (rationalM k)) = exteriorQ (rationalM k)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = exteriorQ (weightedTranspose k (rationalM k)) := by
      simp only [exteriorQ, map_add, map_sub, map_mul, reorient_entry, weightedTranspose]
    _ = _ := weightedTranspose_exteriorQ k _

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.exists_four_step_fixing_one_pair
statement:
theorem exists_four_step_fixing_one_pair
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V)) (halt : ∀ x, omega x x = 0)
    (hleft : IsLeftNondegenerate omega) (hright : IsRightNondegenerate omega)
    (e0 f0 x v y f : V) (he0f0 : omega e0 f0 = 1)
    (hxv : omega x v = 1) (hyf : omega y f = 1)
    (he0x : omega e0 x = 0) (hf0x : omega f0 x = 0)
    (he0v : omega e0 v = 0) (hf0v : omega f0 v = 0)
    (hye0 : omega y e0 = 0) (hyf0 : omega y f0 = 0)
    (hfe0 : omega f e0 = 0) (hff0 : omega f f0 = 0) :
    ∃ word : List (Step (K := K) (V := V)), word.length = 4 ∧
      wordMap omega word x = y ∧ wordMap omega word v = f ∧
      wordMap omega word e0 = e0 ∧ wordMap omega word f0 = f0
proof:
:= by
  have hx : x ≠ 0 := by intro h; subst x; simpa using hxv
  have hy : y ≠ 0 := by intro h; subst y; simpa using hyf
  obtain ⟨z, hzx, hyz, hze0, hzf0⟩ := exists_detour_orthogonal_one_pair
    omega halt hleft hright e0 f0 x y he0f0 hx hy he0x hf0x hye0 hyf0
  let word := fourStepPairWord omega halt x z y v f hzx hyz
  refine ⟨word, by simp [word, fourStepPairWord],
    fourStepPairWord_source omega halt x z y v f hzx hyz hxv hyf,
    fourStepPairWord_partner omega halt x z y v f hzx hyz hxv hyf, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply fourStepPairWord_fixes omega halt x z y v f e0 hzx hyz
    · exact (skew_of_alternating omega halt x e0).trans (by rw [he0x]; simp)
    · exact hze0
    · exact hye0
    · exact (skew_of_alternating omega halt v e0).trans (by rw [he0v]; simp)
    · exact hfe0
  · apply fourStepPairWord_fixes omega halt x z y v f f0 hzx hyz
    · exact (skew_of_alternating omega halt x f0).trans (by rw [hf0x]; simp)
    · exact hzf0
    · exact hyf0
    · exact (skew_of_alternating omega halt v f0).trans (by rw [hf0v]; simp)
    · exact hff0

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.exists_four_step_fixing_two_pairs
statement:
theorem exists_four_step_fixing_two_pairs
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V)) (halt : ∀ x, omega x x = 0)
    (hleft : IsLeftNondegenerate omega) (hright : IsRightNondegenerate omega)
    (e0 f0 e1 f1 x v y f : V)
    (he0f0 : omega e0 f0 = 1) (he1f1 : omega e1 f1 = 1)
    (hxv : omega x v = 1) (hyf : omega y f = 1)
    (he1e0 : omega e1 e0 = 0) (hf1e0 : omega f1 e0 = 0)
    (he1f0 : omega e1 f0 = 0) (hf1f0 : omega f1 f0 = 0)
    (he0x : omega e0 x = 0) (hf0x : omega f0 x = 0)
    (he1x : omega e1 x = 0) (hf1x : omega f1 x = 0)
    (he0v : omega e0 v = 0) (hf0v : omega f0 v = 0)
    (he1v : omega e1 v = 0) (hf1v : omega f1 v = 0)
    (hye0 : omega y e0 = 0) (hyf0 : omega y f0 = 0)
    (hye1 : omega y e1 = 0) (hyf1 : omega y f1 = 0)
    (hfe0 : omega f e0 = 0) (hff0 : omega f f0 = 0)
    (hfe1 : omega f e1 = 0) (hff1 : omega f f1 = 0) :
    ∃ word : List (Step (K := K) (V := V)), word.length = 4 ∧
      wordMap omega word x = y ∧ wordMap omega word v = f ∧
      wordMap omega word e0 = e0 ∧ wordMap omega word f0 = f0 ∧
      wordMap omega word e1 = e1 ∧ wordMap omega word f1 = f1
proof:
:= by
  have hx : x ≠ 0 := by intro h; subst x; simpa using hxv
  have hy : y ≠ 0 := by intro h; subst y; simpa using hyf
  obtain ⟨z, hzx, hyz, hze0, hzf0, hze1, hzf1⟩ :=
    exists_detour_orthogonal_two_pairs omega halt hleft hright
      e0 f0 e1 f1 x y he0f0 he1f1 hx hy he1e0 hf1e0 he1f0 hf1f0
      he0x hf0x he1x hf1x hye0 hyf0 hye1 hyf1
  let word := fourStepPairWord omega halt x z y v f hzx hyz
  refine ⟨word, by simp [word, fourStepPairWord],
    fourStepPairWord_source omega halt x z y v f hzx hyz hxv hyf,
    fourStepPairWord_partner omega halt x z y v f hzx hyz hxv hyf,
    ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact fourStepPairWord_fixes omega halt x z y v f e0 hzx hyz
      ((skew_of_alternating omega halt x e0).trans (by rw [he0x]; simp))
      hze0 hye0
      ((skew_of_alternating omega halt v e0).trans (by rw [he0v]; simp)) hfe0
  · exact fourStepPairWord_fixes omega halt x z y v f f0 hzx hyz
      ((skew_of_alternating omega halt x f0).trans (by rw [hf0x]; simp))
      hzf0 hyf0
      ((skew_of_alternating omega halt v f0).trans (by rw [hf0v]; simp)) hff0
  · exact fourStepPairWord_fixes omega halt x z y v f e1 hzx hyz
      ((skew_of_alternating omega halt x e1).trans (by rw [he1x]; simp))
      hze1 hye1
      ((skew_of_alternating omega halt v e1).trans (by rw [he1v]; simp)) hfe1
  · exact fourStepPairWord_fixes omega halt x z y v f f1 hzx hyz
      ((skew_of_alternating omega halt x f1).trans (by rw [hf1x]; simp))
      hzf1 hyf1
      ((skew_of_alternating omega halt v f1).trans (by rw [hf1v]; simp)) hff1

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.ComplexTransposeTransport.fractionAction_transpose_universalFamily
statement:
theorem fractionAction_transpose_universalFamily (r i : Fin 3) :
    (fractionAction k (transposeAut (k := k))).toRingHom.mapMatrix
        (universalFamily k r i) =
      Matrix.transpose (universalFamily k r i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [LedgerInvariantField.fractionAction_universalFamily_extended]
  exact extension_transposeAut (k := k) (R := F k) (universalFamily k r i)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.ComplexTransposeTransport.transposePrecompose_scalar
statement:
theorem transposePrecompose_scalar (left : F k →+* E) :
    (transposePrecompose k left).comp (scalarMap k) = left.comp (scalarMap k)
proof:
:= by
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro c
  change left (fractionAction k (transposeAut (k := k)) (scalarMap k c)) =
    left (scalarMap k c)
  rw [fractionAction_scalar]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.ComplexTransposeTransport.transposePrecompose_universalFamily
statement:
theorem transposePrecompose_universalFamily (left : F k →+* E) (r i : Fin 3) :
    (transposePrecompose k left).mapMatrix (universalFamily k r i) =
      Matrix.transpose (left.mapMatrix (universalFamily k r i))
proof:
:= by
  ext a b
  have h := congrFun (congrFun
    (fractionAction_transpose_universalFamily k r i) a) b
  change left (fractionAction k (transposeAut (k := k))
      (universalFamily k r i a b)) = left (universalFamily k r i b a)
  exact congrArg left h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.ComplexTransposeTransport.extension_agreement_of_inner_or_transpose
statement:
theorem extension_agreement_of_inner_or_transpose
    (left right : F k →+* E)
    (hscalar : left.comp (scalarMap k) = right.comp (scalarMap k))
    (a b : CoordinateRing k) (hb : rawToField k b ≠ 0)
    (hinv : IsJordanInvariant k (rawToField k a / rawToField k b))
    (Q : Mat3 E) (hQ : Matrix.det Q ≠ 0)
    (htransport :
      (∀ r i, Q * left.mapMatrix (universalFamily k r i) * Q⁻¹ =
        right.mapMatrix (universalFamily k r i)) ∨
      (∀ r i, Q * Matrix.transpose (left.mapMatrix (universalFamily k r i)) * Q⁻¹ =
        right.mapMatrix (universalFamily k r i))) :
    left (rawToField k a / rawToField k b) =
      right (rawToField k a / rawToField k b)
proof:
:= by
  rcases htransport with hinner | htranspose
  · exact inner_extension_agreement k left right hscalar a b hb hinv Q hQ hinner
  · let leftT := transposePrecompose k left
    have hscalarT : leftT.comp (scalarMap k) = right.comp (scalarMap k) := by
      rw [show leftT.comp (scalarMap k) = left.comp (scalarMap k) from
        transposePrecompose_scalar k left, hscalar]
    have htransportT : ∀ r i,
        Q * leftT.mapMatrix (universalFamily k r i) * Q⁻¹ =
          right.mapMatrix (universalFamily k r i) := by
      intro r i
      rw [show leftT.mapMatrix (universalFamily k r i) =
        Matrix.transpose (left.mapMatrix (universalFamily k r i)) from
          transposePrecompose_universalFamily k left r i]
      exact htranspose r i
    have hagree := inner_extension_agreement k leftT right hscalarT a b hb hinv Q hQ htransportT
    have hfix := hinv (transposeAut (k := k))
    calc
      left (rawToField k a / rawToField k b) =
          left (fractionAction k (transposeAut (k := k))
            (rawToField k a / rawToField k b)) := congrArg left hfix.symm
      _ = leftT (rawToField k a / rawToField k b) := rfl
      _ = right (rawToField k a / rawToField k b) := hagree

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ProjectorBlockBridge.trace_grouped
statement:
theorem trace_grouped (a : Mat3 K) (u v : Vec3 K) :
    Matrix.trace (grouped a u v) = 2 * Matrix.trace a
proof:
:= by
  simp [Matrix.trace, grouped, Fintype.sum_sum_type, Fin.sum_univ_succ,
    Matrix.transpose_apply]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ProjectorBlockBridge.jordanTrace_grouped
statement:
@[simp] theorem jordanTrace_grouped (a : Mat3 K) (u v : Vec3 K) :
    jordanTrace (grouped a u v) = Matrix.trace a
proof:
:= by
  rw [jordanTrace, trace_grouped]
  field_simp

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ProjectorBlockBridge.top_left_projector_equation
statement:
theorem top_left_projector_equation
    (a : Mat3 K) (u v : Vec3 K)
    (hidem : grouped a u v * grouped a u v = grouped a u v) :
    a * a - a = -(hat u * hat v)
proof:
:= by
  apply sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mpr
  ext i j
  have h := congrFun (congrFun hidem (Sum.inl i)) (Sum.inl j)
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [grouped, Matrix.mul_apply, Fintype.sum_sum_type,
      Fin.sum_univ_succ] at h ⊢ <;> linear_combination h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ProjectorBlockBridge.grouped_trace_one
statement:
theorem grouped_trace_one
    (a : Mat3 K) (u v : Vec3 K)
    (htrace : jordanTrace (grouped a u v) = 1) : Matrix.trace a = 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa using htrace

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ProjectorBlockBridge.adjugate_of_actual_projector
statement:
theorem adjugate_of_actual_projector
    (P : Carrier K) (a : Mat3 K) (u v : Vec3 K)
    (hP : (P : Mat6 K) = grouped a u v)
    (hidem : (P : Mat6 K) * P = P)
    (htrace : jordanTrace (K := K) (P : Mat6 K) = 1) :
    Matrix.adjugate a = -outer v u
proof:
:= by
  apply adjugate_of_projector_trace_one a u v
  · apply top_left_projector_equation a u v
    simpa [hP] using hidem
  · apply grouped_trace_one a u v
    simpa [hP] using htrace

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ProjectorBlockBridge.same_a_actual_projector_fibre
statement:
theorem same_a_actual_projector_fibre
    (P P' : Carrier K) (a : Mat3 K) (u v u' v' : Vec3 K)
    (hP : (P : Mat6 K) = grouped a u v)
    (hP' : (P' : Mat6 K) = grouped a u' v')
    (hidem : (P : Mat6 K) * P = P)
    (hidem' : (P' : Mat6 K) * P' = P')
    (htrace : jordanTrace (K := K) (P : Mat6 K) = 1)
    (hadj : Matrix.adjugate a ≠ 0) :
    ∃ t : K, t ≠ 0 ∧ u' = t • u ∧ v' = t⁻¹ • v
proof:
:= by
  apply same_a_scalar_fibre a u v u' v'
  · apply top_left_projector_equation a u v
    simpa [hP] using hidem
  · apply top_left_projector_equation a u' v'
    simpa [hP'] using hidem'
  · apply grouped_trace_one a u v
    simpa [hP] using htrace
  · exact hadj

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowMatrix.cube_eq_of_right_quadratic
statement:
theorem cube_eq_of_right_quadratic (X U V : R)
    (hquad : X ^ 2 + X * U + V = 0) :
    X ^ 3 = X * (U ^ 2 - V) + V * U
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sub_eq_zero]
  calc
    X ^ 3 - (X * (U ^ 2 - V) + V * U) =
        X * (X ^ 2 + X * U + V) - (X ^ 2 + X * U + V) * U := by
      simp only [pow_three, pow_two, mul_add, add_mul, mul_sub, mul_assoc]
      abel
    _ = 0 := by rw [hquad, mul_zero, zero_mul, sub_self]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowMatrix.mul_reconstruction_of_right_quadratic
statement:
theorem mul_reconstruction_of_right_quadratic
    (X U V t u v : R)
    (hquad : X ^ 2 + X * U + V = 0)
    (hcubic : X ^ 3 - t * X ^ 2 + u * X - v = 0)
    (ht : t * X = X * t) (hu : u * X = X * u) :
    X * (U ^ 2 - V + t * U + u) = v - V * U - t * V
proof:
:= by
  have hcube := cube_eq_of_right_quadratic X U V hquad
  have htsq : t * X ^ 2 = X * t * X := by
    rw [pow_two, ← mul_assoc, ht]
  have htU : t * (X * U) = X * (t * U) := by
    rw [← mul_assoc, ht, mul_assoc]
  rw [← sub_eq_zero]
  calc
    X * (U ^ 2 - V + t * U + u) - (v - V * U - t * V) =
        (X ^ 3 - t * X ^ 2 + u * X - v) +
          t * (X ^ 2 + X * U + V) := by
      rw [hcube]
      simp only [mul_add, mul_sub]
      rw [htsq, htU, hu]
      simp only [mul_assoc]
      abel
    _ = 0 := by rw [hcubic, hquad, mul_zero, add_zero]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowMatrix.reconstruction_of_right_quadratic
statement:
theorem reconstruction_of_right_quadratic
    (X U V t u v : R)
    (hquad : X ^ 2 + X * U + V = 0)
    (hcubic : X ^ 3 - t * X ^ 2 + u * X - v = 0)
    (ht : t * X = X * t) (hu : u * X = X * u)
    [Invertible (U ^ 2 - V + t * U + u)] :
    X = (v - V * U - t * V) * ⅟(U ^ 2 - V + t * U + u)
proof:
:= by
  let E := U ^ 2 - V + t * U + u
  have hmul : X * E = v - V * U - t * V := by
    simpa [E] using
      mul_reconstruction_of_right_quadratic X U V t u v hquad hcubic ht hu
  calc
    X = X * E * ⅟E := by rw [mul_assoc, mul_invOf_self, mul_one]
    _ = (v - V * U - t * V) * ⅟E := by rw [hmul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowMatrix.sylvester_conjugate_eq_add_invOf
statement:
theorem sylvester_conjugate_eq_add_invOf
    (X U L : R) [Invertible L]
    (hsylvester : (-U - X) * L - L * X = 1) :
    ⅟L * (-U - X) * L = X + ⅟L
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sub_eq_zero]
  calc
    ⅟L * (-U - X) * L - (X + ⅟L) =
        ⅟L * (((-U - X) * L - L * X) - 1) := by
      simp only [mul_sub, ← mul_assoc, invOf_mul_self, one_mul, mul_one]
      abel
    _ = 0 := by rw [hsylvester, sub_self, mul_zero]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowMatrix.sylvester_invOf_relation
statement:
theorem sylvester_invOf_relation
    (X U L : R) [Invertible L]
    (hsylvester : (-U - X) * L - L * X = 1) :
    X * ⅟L + ⅟L * X + ⅟L * U + ⅟L * ⅟L = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hsylvester' : (-U - X) * L = L * X + 1 :=
    (sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mp hsylvester).trans (add_comm 1 (L * X))
  have hright : -U - X = L * X * ⅟L + ⅟L := by
    calc
      -U - X = (-U - X) * (L * ⅟L) := by rw [mul_invOf_self, mul_one]
      _ = ((-U - X) * L) * ⅟L := by rw [mul_assoc]
      _ = (L * X + 1) * ⅟L := by rw [hsylvester']
      _ = L * X * ⅟L + ⅟L := by rw [add_mul, one_mul]
  have hleft : ⅟L * (-U - X) = X * ⅟L + ⅟L * ⅟L := by
    calc
      ⅟L * (-U - X) = ⅟L * (L * X * ⅟L + ⅟L) := by rw [hright]
      _ = X * ⅟L + ⅟L * ⅟L := by
        simp only [mul_add, ← mul_assoc, invOf_mul_self, one_mul]
  calc
    X * ⅟L + ⅟L * X + ⅟L * U + ⅟L * ⅟L =
        (X * ⅟L + ⅟L * ⅟L) - ⅟L * (-U - X) := by
      simp only [mul_sub, mul_neg]
      abel
    _ = 0 := by rw [hleft, sub_self]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowMatrix.sylvester_branch_right_quadratic
statement:
theorem sylvester_branch_right_quadratic
    (X U V L : R) [Invertible L]
    (hquad : X ^ 2 + X * U + V = 0)
    (hsylvester : (-U - X) * L - L * X = 1) :
    let Y
proof:
:= ⅟L * (-U - X) * L
    Y ^ 2 + Y * U + V = 0 := by
  dsimp only
  rw [sylvester_conjugate_eq_add_invOf X U L hsylvester]
  have hinv := sylvester_invOf_relation X U L hsylvester
  calc
    (X + ⅟L) ^ 2 + (X + ⅟L) * U + V =
        (X ^ 2 + X * U + V) +
          (X * ⅟L + ⅟L * X + ⅟L * U + ⅟L * ⅟L) := by
      simp only [pow_two, add_mul, mul_add]
      abel
    _ = 0 := by rw [hquad, hinv, add_zero]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowMatrix.sylvester_branch_eq_add_invOf
statement:
theorem sylvester_branch_eq_add_invOf
    (X U L : R) [Invertible L]
    (hsylvester : (-U - X) * L - L * X = 1) :
    ⅟L * (-U - X) * L = X + ⅟L
proof:
:=
  sylvester_conjugate_eq_add_invOf X U L hsylvester

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowMatrix.matrix_mul_reconstruction_of_right_quadratic
statement:
theorem matrix_mul_reconstruction_of_right_quadratic
    (X U V : Matrix n n K) (t u v : K)
    (hquad : X ^ 2 + X * U + V = 0)
    (hcubic : X ^ 3 - t • X ^ 2 + u • X - v • 1 = 0) :
    X * (U ^ 2 - V + t • U + u • 1) =
      v • 1 - V * U - t • V
proof:
:= by
  have ht : (t • (1 : Matrix n n K)) * X = X * (t • 1) := by
    rw [Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.mul_one]
  have hu : (u • (1 : Matrix n n K)) * X = X * (u • 1) := by
    rw [Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.mul_one]
  simpa [Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_smul] using
    mul_reconstruction_of_right_quadratic
      X U V (t • (1 : Matrix n n K)) (u • 1) (v • 1)
      hquad (by simpa [Matrix.smul_mul] using hcubic) ht hu

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowMatrix.matrix_reconstruction_of_right_quadratic
statement:
theorem matrix_reconstruction_of_right_quadratic
    (X U V : Matrix n n K) (t u v : K)
    (hquad : X ^ 2 + X * U + V = 0)
    (hcubic : X ^ 3 - t • X ^ 2 + u • X - v • 1 = 0)
    [Invertible (U ^ 2 - V + t • U + u • 1)] :
    X = (v • 1 - V * U - t • V) *
      ⅟(U ^ 2 - V + t • U + u • 1)
proof:
:= by
  let E := U ^ 2 - V + t • U + u • (1 : Matrix n n K)
  have hmul : X * E = v • 1 - V * U - t • V := by
    simpa [E] using
      matrix_mul_reconstruction_of_right_quadratic X U V t u v hquad hcubic
  calc
    X = X * E * ⅟E := by rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, mul_invOf_self, Matrix.mul_one]
    _ = (v • 1 - V * U - t • V) * ⅟E := by rw [hmul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowMatrix.trace_invOf_mul_mul
statement:
theorem trace_invOf_mul_mul
    (Z L : Matrix n n K) [Invertible L] :
    Matrix.trace (⅟L * Z * L) = Matrix.trace Z
proof:
:= by
  calc
    Matrix.trace (⅟L * Z * L) = Matrix.trace (L * (⅟L * Z)) :=
      Matrix.trace_mul_comm _ _
    _ = Matrix.trace Z := by
      rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, mul_invOf_self, Matrix.one_mul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowMatrix.trace_sylvester_branch
statement:
theorem trace_sylvester_branch
    (X U L : Matrix n n K) [Invertible L] :
    Matrix.trace (⅟L * (-U - X) * L) =
      -Matrix.trace U - Matrix.trace X
proof:
:= by
  rw [trace_invOf_mul_mul]
  simp

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowMatrix.sylvester_branch_package
statement:
theorem sylvester_branch_package
    (X U V L : Matrix n n K) [Invertible L]
    (hquad : X ^ 2 + X * U + V = 0)
    (hsylvester : (-U - X) * L - L * X = 1) :
    let Y
proof:
:= ⅟L * (-U - X) * L
    (Y ^ 2 + Y * U + V = 0) ∧
      (Y = X + ⅟L) ∧
      (Matrix.trace Y = -Matrix.trace U - Matrix.trace X) := by
  dsimp only
  exact ⟨sylvester_branch_right_quadratic X U V L hquad hsylvester,
    sylvester_branch_eq_add_invOf X U L hsylvester,
    trace_sylvester_branch X U L⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceRawAutomorphismEquiv.inverseSourceAut_linearEquiv
statement:
theorem inverseSourceAut_linearEquiv (g : SourceAut (K := k)) :
    linearEquiv (R := CoordinateRing k) (inverseSourceAut k g) =
      (linearEquiv (R := CoordinateRing k) g).symm
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearEquiv.ext
  intro x
  change inverseLinear (R := CoordinateRing k) g x = _
  rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceRawAutomorphismEquiv.rawAction_comp_inverse
statement:
theorem rawAction_comp_inverse (g : SourceAut (K := k)) :
    (rawAction k g).comp (rawAction k (inverseSourceAut k g)) = RingHom.id _
proof:
:= by
  apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
  · intro a
    simp [rawAction]
  · intro q
    cases q with
    | entry r i c =>
      simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.id_apply]
      change rawAction k g
          (rawAction k (inverseSourceAut k g) (universalVector r i c)) =
        universalVector r i c
      rw [show rawAction k (inverseSourceAut k g) (universalVector r i c) =
          transformedUniversalVector k (inverseSourceAut k g) r i c from
        congrFun (rawAction_universalVector k (inverseSourceAut k g) r i) c]
      have h := mapVector_linearEquiv k g (inverseSourceAut k g) (universalVector r i)
      rw [inverseSourceAut_linearEquiv] at h
      have hc := congrFun h c
      rw [rawAction_universalVector, transformedUniversalVector,
        LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply] at hc
      exact hc

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceRawAutomorphismEquiv.rawAction_inverse_comp
statement:
theorem rawAction_inverse_comp (g : SourceAut (K := k)) :
    (rawAction k (inverseSourceAut k g)).comp (rawAction k g) = RingHom.id _
proof:
:= by
  apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
  · intro a
    simp [rawAction]
  · intro q
    cases q with
    | entry r i c =>
      simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.id_apply]
      change rawAction k (inverseSourceAut k g)
          (rawAction k g (universalVector r i c)) = universalVector r i c
      rw [show rawAction k g (universalVector r i c) =
          transformedUniversalVector k g r i c from
        congrFun (rawAction_universalVector k g r i) c]
      have h := mapVector_linearEquiv k (inverseSourceAut k g) g (universalVector r i)
      rw [rawAction_universalVector, transformedUniversalVector,
        inverseSourceAut_linearEquiv, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at h
      have hc := congrFun h c
      change rawAction k (inverseSourceAut k g)
          (transformedUniversalVector k g r i c) = universalVector r i c at hc
      exact hc

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceRawAutomorphismEquiv.rawRingEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem rawRingEquiv_apply (g : SourceAut (K := k)) (x : CoordinateRing k) :
    rawRingEquiv k g x = rawAction k g x
proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceMidpointTransport.scalar_midpoint_reflection
statement:
private theorem scalar_midpoint_reflection
    {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    (μ : V →ₗ[K] V →ₗ[K] V) (hcomm : ∀ x y, μ x y = μ y x)
    (e f c : V) (t s : K) (h : ScalarMidpoint.PairTable μ e f c t)
    (hsquare : s ^ 2 = t) (hs0 : s ≠ 0) (hsneg : s ≠ -1) :
    PeircePolynomial.reflection μ (ScalarMidpoint.midpoint e f c s) e = f
proof:
:=
  ScalarMidpoint.midpoint_reflection_apply μ hcomm e f c t s h hsquare hs0 hsneg

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceMidpointTransport.sourceMidpoint_square
statement:
theorem sourceMidpoint_square
    (e : JCoord K)
    (hidem : sourceProduct e e = e)
    (htrace : sourceTrace e = 1)
    (s : K) (hsquare : s ^ 2 = e.d1)
    (hs0 : s ≠ 0) (hsneg : s ≠ -1) :
    sourceProduct (sourceMidpoint e s) (sourceMidpoint e s) =
      sourceMidpoint e s
proof:
:= by
  simpa [sourceMidpoint] using
    (ScalarMidpoint.midpoint_square sourceProductLinear sourceProduct_comm
      e (diagonalUnit 0) (sourceProduct e (diagonalUnit 0)) e.d1 s
      (StandardTargetPairTable.pairTable_of_idempotent_trace_one e hidem htrace)
      hsquare hs0 hsneg)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceMidpointTransport.sourceMidpointAut_apply_e
statement:
theorem sourceMidpointAut_apply_e
    (e : JCoord K)
    (hidem : sourceProduct e e = e)
    (htrace : sourceTrace e = 1)
    (s : K) (hsquare : s ^ 2 = e.d1)
    (hs0 : s ≠ 0) (hsneg : s ≠ -1) :
    (sourceMidpointAut e hidem htrace s hsquare hs0 hsneg).linear e =
      diagonalUnit 0
proof:
:= by
  change SourcePeirceAttachment.sourcePeirceLinearEquiv
      (sourceMidpoint e s)
      (sourceMidpoint_square e hidem htrace s hsquare hs0 hsneg) e = _
  rw [SourcePeirceAttachment.sourcePeirceLinearEquiv_apply]
  change PeircePolynomial.reflection sourceProductLinear (sourceMidpoint e s) e = _
  exact scalar_midpoint_reflection sourceProductLinear sourceProduct_comm
      e (diagonalUnit 0) (sourceProduct e (diagonalUnit 0)) e.d1 s
      (StandardTargetPairTable.pairTable_of_idempotent_trace_one e hidem htrace)
      hsquare hs0 hsneg

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceMidpointTransport.sourceMidpointAut_trace
statement:
theorem sourceMidpointAut_trace
    (e : JCoord K)
    (hidem : sourceProduct e e = e)
    (htrace : sourceTrace e = 1)
    (s : K) (hsquare : s ^ 2 = e.d1)
    (hs0 : s ≠ 0) (hsneg : s ≠ -1)
    (x : JCoord K) :
    sourceTrace
        ((sourceMidpointAut e hidem htrace s hsquare hs0 hsneg).linear x) =
      sourceTrace x
proof:
:= by
  change sourceTrace
      (SourcePeirceAttachment.sourcePeirceLinearEquiv
        (sourceMidpoint e s)
        (sourceMidpoint_square e hidem htrace s hsquare hs0 hsneg) x) = _
  rw [SourcePeirceAttachment.sourcePeirceLinearEquiv_apply]
  simpa [SourcePeirceAttachment.sourcePeirceReflection] using
    (AlbertLean.Comparison.GenericTraceAssociativity.sourceTrace_reflection
      (sourceMidpoint e s) x
      (sourceMidpoint_square e hidem htrace s hsquare hs0 hsneg))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceMidpointTransport.sourceMidpointAut_fixed_of_product_eq_zero
statement:
theorem sourceMidpointAut_fixed_of_product_eq_zero
    (e : JCoord K)
    (hidem : sourceProduct e e = e)
    (htrace : sourceTrace e = 1)
    (s : K) (hsquare : s ^ 2 = e.d1)
    (hs0 : s ≠ 0) (hsneg : s ≠ -1)
    (z : JCoord K) (hz : sourceProduct (sourceMidpoint e s) z = 0) :
    (sourceMidpointAut e hidem htrace s hsquare hs0 hsneg).linear z = z
proof:
:= by
  change SourcePeirceAttachment.sourcePeirceLinearEquiv
      (sourceMidpoint e s)
      (sourceMidpoint_square e hidem htrace s hsquare hs0 hsneg) z = z
  rw [SourcePeirceAttachment.sourcePeirceLinearEquiv_apply]
  rw [SourcePeirceAttachment.sourcePeirceReflection_formula, hz]
  have hzero : sourceProduct (sourceMidpoint e s) (0 : JCoord K) = 0 :=
    map_zero (sourceProductLinear (sourceMidpoint e s))
  rw [hzero]
  module

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FiniteQuadraticRoots.oneRootField_nonempty
statement:
theorem oneRootField_nonempty (K : Type u) [Field K] (c : K) :
    Nonempty (OneRootField K c)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hc : IsSquare c
  · obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hc
    exact ⟨{
      Carrier := K
      embedding := RingHom.id K
      root := r
      root_sq := by simpa only [pow_two, RingHom.id_apply] using hr.symm }⟩
  · letI : Fact (¬ IsSquare c) := ⟨hc⟩
    refine ⟨{
      Carrier := QuadraticAlgebra K c 0
      embedding := algebraMap K (QuadraticAlgebra K c 0)
      root := QuadraticAlgebra.omega
      root_sq := ?_ }⟩
    simpa only [pow_two, map_zero, zero_mul, add_zero] using
      (QuadraticAlgebra.omega_mul_omega_eq_algebraMap
        (R := K) (a := c) (b := 0))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FiniteQuadraticRoots.rootField_nonempty
statement:
theorem rootField_nonempty : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ (K : Type u) [Field K]
    (c : Fin n → K), Nonempty (RootField K c)
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      intro K _ c
      exact ⟨{
        Carrier := K
        embedding := RingHom.id K
        roots := Fin.elim0
        roots_sq := fun i => Fin.elim0 i }⟩
  | succ n ih =>
      intro K _ c
      obtain ⟨E⟩ := oneRootField_nonempty K (c 0)
      obtain ⟨F⟩ := ih E.Carrier (fun i => E.embedding (c i.succ))
      refine ⟨{
        Carrier := F.Carrier
        embedding := F.embedding.comp E.embedding
        roots := Fin.cases (F.embedding E.root) F.roots
        roots_sq := ?_ }⟩
      intro i
      refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
      · simpa only [Fin.cases_zero, RingHom.comp_apply, map_pow] using
          congrArg F.embedding E.root_sq
      · simpa only [Fin.cases_succ, RingHom.comp_apply] using F.roots_sq j

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FiniteQuadraticRoots.rootField_nonempty_of_fintype
statement:
theorem rootField_nonempty_of_fintype (K : Type u) [Field K]
    {ι : Type v} [Fintype ι] (c : ι → K) : Nonempty (RootField K c)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let e := Fintype.equivFin ι
  obtain ⟨F⟩ := rootField_nonempty (Fintype.card ι) K (fun i => c (e.symm i))
  refine ⟨{
    Carrier := F.Carrier
    embedding := F.embedding
    roots := fun i => F.roots (e i)
    roots_sq := ?_ }⟩
  intro i
  simpa only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply] using F.roots_sq (e i)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FiniteQuadraticRoots.charZero_of_embedding
statement:
theorem charZero_of_embedding {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Field L] [CharZero K]
    (f : K →+* L) : CharZero L where
  cast_injective m n h
proof:
:= Nat.cast_injective (R := K) (f.injective (by
    simpa only [map_natCast] using h))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.UniformMomentFiniteAlgebra.a_mul_aInv
statement: theorem a_mul_aInv : loc k (a k) * aInv k = 1
proof:
:= by
  calc
    loc k (a k) * aInv k =
        loc k (a k * (discr k * eta k)) * invB0 k := by
      simp only [aInv, map_mul, mul_assoc]
    _ = loc k (B0 k) * invB0 k := by
      exact congrArg (fun x : R0 k => loc k x * invB0 k) (by
        simp only [B0, mul_assoc])
    _ = 1 := IsLocalization.Away.mul_invSelf (B0 k)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.UniformMomentFiniteAlgebra.discr_mul_discrInv
statement: theorem discr_mul_discrInv : loc k (discr k) * discrInv k = 1
proof:
:= by
  calc
    loc k (discr k) * discrInv k =
        loc k (discr k * (a k * eta k)) * invB0 k := by
      simp only [discrInv, map_mul, mul_assoc]
    _ = loc k (B0 k) * invB0 k := by
      exact congrArg (fun x : R0 k => loc k x * invB0 k) (by
        simp only [B0]
        ring)
    _ = 1 := IsLocalization.Away.mul_invSelf (B0 k)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.UniformMomentFiniteAlgebra.eta_mul_etaInv
statement: theorem eta_mul_etaInv : loc k (eta k) * etaInv k = 1
proof:
:= by
  calc
    loc k (eta k) * etaInv k =
        loc k (eta k * (a k * discr k)) * invB0 k := by
      simp only [etaInv, map_mul, mul_assoc]
    _ = loc k (B0 k) * invB0 k := by
      exact congrArg (fun x : R0 k => loc k x * invB0 k) (by
        simp only [B0]
        ring)
    _ = 1 := IsLocalization.Away.mul_invSelf (B0 k)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.UniformMomentFiniteAlgebra.sigma_mul_sigmaInv
statement:
theorem sigma_mul_sigmaInv :
    (QuadraticAlgebra.omega : Q k) * sigmaInv k = 1
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = algebraMap (Local k) (Q k) (discrInv k) *
        ((QuadraticAlgebra.omega : Q k) * QuadraticAlgebra.omega) := by
      rw [sigmaInv]
      ring
    _ = algebraMap (Local k) (Q k) (discrInv k) *
        algebraMap (Local k) (Q k) (loc k (discr k)) := by
      simp only [QuadraticAlgebra.omega_mul_omega_eq_algebraMap,
        map_zero, zero_mul, add_zero]
    _ = 1 := by
      rw [← map_mul, mul_comm, discr_mul_discrInv, map_one]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.UniformMomentFiniteAlgebra.norm_det_N
statement:
theorem norm_det_N :
    QuadraticAlgebra.norm (Matrix.det (N k)) = loc k (eta k)
proof:

  change QuadraticAlgebra.norm (Matrix.det ((qmap k).mapMatrix (N0 k))) = _
  rw [← RingHom.map_det]
  exact QuadraticNormTransport.norm_map (loc k) (discr k) (Matrix.det (N0 k))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.UniformMomentFiniteAlgebra.det_N_isUnit
statement: theorem det_N_isUnit : IsUnit (Matrix.det (N k))
proof:
:= by

  refine ⟨⟨loc k (eta k), etaInv k, eta_mul_etaInv k, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
  rw [mul_comm, eta_mul_etaInv]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.UniformMomentFiniteAlgebra.momentDet_mul_inv

name: AlbertLean.Generic.UniformMomentFiniteAlgebra.detector_affine
statement:
theorem detector_affine
    {K : Type*} [Field K] [CharZero K]
    (dA dB : Fin 3 → Q k) (b c s : Q k) (f : Q k →+* K) (Delta : K)
    (hDelta : Delta ^ 2 = f s * Delta - f (Matrix.det (moment k))) :
    NormalizedDetectorCircuit.normalized
        (fun i => f (dA i)) (fun i => f (dB i)) 1
        (f (algebraMap (Local k) (Q k) (loc k (a k)))) (f b) (f c)
        ((moment k).map f) Delta Delta⁻¹ =
      f (detectorEpsilon k dA dB b c s) +
        f (detectorBeta k dA dB b c s) * Delta
proof:
:= by
  exact QuadraticDetectorAffine.normalized_eq_epsilon_add_beta_mul
    dA dB (algebraMap (Local k) (Q k) (loc k (a k))) b c
    (moment k) s (Matrix.det (moment k)) (momentDetInv k)
    (momentDet_mul_inv k) f Delta hDelta

proof:

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawDetectorNonmembership.actualReducedMap_scalar
statement:
private theorem actualReducedMap_scalar
    (f : AlbertScheduleGenericChartAlignment.E k →+* L)
    (q : ExplicitFrameChart L)
    (hq : EquationsVanish (explicitFrameEquationValues q)) (c : k) :
    actualReducedMap k f q hq (reducedScalar k c) =
      actualFractionMap k f (scalarMap k c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [actualReducedMap, reducedScalar, reducedEvaluation_mk]
  change chartEvaluation k (actualCoefficientMap k f) q (MvPolynomial.C c) =
    f (fractionEmbedding k (scalarMap k c))
  have hscalar : fractionEmbedding k (scalarMap k c) =
      algebraMap k (AlbertScheduleGenericChartAlignment.E k) c :=
    DFunLike.congr_fun (fractionEmbedding_scalarMap k) c
  rw [hscalar]
  simp [chartEvaluation, evaluationAlong, actualCoefficientMap]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawDetectorNonmembership.detectorValue_not_mem_originalRawLedgerField
statement:
theorem detectorValue_not_mem_originalRawLedgerField :
    detectorValue k ∉ originalRawLedgerField k
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨L, iL, cL, f, sigma, g, q, hq, hf, hdiag, hdiagFields,
      hA, hB, hkappa, hr, hz1, hr2, hz2, hsquare, hdetectorRing,
      hledgerCells, hdetectorSource, hsigmaEval, hsigma0, htwoaEval,
      hseparationOpen, hbeta, hroots, hopen⟩ :=
    exists_actual_generic_chart_alignment k
  letI : Field L := iL
  letI : CharZero L := cL
  let coeff := actualCoefficientMap k f
  let aval := f (nV (comparisonA k).v)
  let hval := f (BV (comparisonA k).v (comparisonB k).v)
  let bval := (hval - sigma) / (2 * aval)
  let cval := (hval + sigma) / 2
  have haEval : evalR0 k coeff q (a k) = aval := by
    calc
      evalR0 k coeff q (a k) = f (comparisonEval k (a k)) := by
        exact DFunLike.congr_fun hsquare (a k)
      _ = aval := by rw [comparisonEval_a]
  have htwoa : 2 * aval ≠ 0 := by
    rw [haEval] at htwoaEval
    exact htwoaEval
  have haval : aval ≠ 0 := right_ne_zero_of_mul htwoa
  dsimp only [aval] at haval
  have hgram : gramV12 q = hval := by
    rw [gramV12, hr, hz1, hr2, hz2]
    dsimp only [aval, hval, bval, cval]
    field_simp [haval]
    ring
  have hb : bval = (gramV12 q - sigma) / (2 * aval) := by
    rw [hgram]
  have hc : cval = (gramV12 q + sigma) / 2 := by
    rw [hgram]
  have hdetectors :
      sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1)
          (encoderA (companion q hopen)) (encoderB (companion q hopen)) ≠
        sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1) (encoderA q) (encoderB q) := by
    exact companion_detector_ne q hopen aval bval cval sigma
      hq hr hz1 hr2 hz2 hb hc hsigma0 htwoa hbeta hroots
  let hqComp := companion_equations q hq hopen
  let phi : RawFunctionField k →+* L := actualFractionMap k f
  let e : ReducedCoordinateRing k →+* L :=
    actualReducedMap k f (companion q hopen) hqComp
  have hgenerators : ∀ x ∈ reducedLedgerGenerators k,
      e x = phi (reducedInclusion k x) := by
    intro x hx
    rcases hx with ⟨c, rfl⟩ | ⟨cell, rfl⟩
    · dsimp only [e, phi]
      change actualReducedMap k f (companion q hopen) hqComp
          (reducedScalar k c) = actualFractionMap k f (scalarMap k c)
      exact actualReducedMap_scalar k f (companion q hopen) hqComp c
    · rcases cell with ⟨t, i, j, l⟩
      dsimp only [e, phi]
      calc
        actualReducedMap k f (companion q hopen) hqComp
            (reducedLedgerCell k t i j l) =
            actualReducedMap k f q hq (reducedLedgerCell k t i j l) := by
          simpa [actualReducedMap, coeff, hqComp] using
            (companion_reducedEvaluation_ledger k coeff q hq hopen t i j l)
        _ = actualFractionMap k f
            (AlbertRawInvariantFieldLower.ledgerValue k (t, i, j, l)) :=
          hledgerCells t i j l
        _ = actualFractionMap k f
            (reducedInclusion k (reducedLedgerCell k t i j l)) := by
          rfl
  have heComp : e (reducedDetector k) =
      sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1)
        (encoderA (companion q hopen)) (encoderB (companion q hopen)) := by
    dsimp only [e]
    change chartEvaluation k coeff (companion q hopen) (rawDetector k) = _
    exact chartEvaluation_detector k coeff (companion q hopen)
  have hphiOriginal : phi (reducedInclusion k (reducedDetector k)) =
      sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1) (encoderA q) (encoderB q) := by
    dsimp only [phi]
    change actualFractionMap k f (detectorValue k) = _
    exact hdetectorSource
  have hsepReduced : e (reducedDetector k) ≠
      phi (reducedInclusion k (reducedDetector k)) := by
    intro heq
    apply hdetectors
    calc
      sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1)
          (encoderA (companion q hopen)) (encoderB (companion q hopen)) =
          e (reducedDetector k) := heComp.symm
      _ = phi (reducedInclusion k (reducedDetector k)) := heq
      _ = sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1)
          (encoderA q) (encoderB q) := hphiOriginal
  have hnot := not_mem_generated_field_of_companion
    (reducedInclusion k) (reducedInclusion_injective k) phi e
    (reducedLedgerGenerators k) hgenerators (reducedDetector k) hsepReduced
  rw [reducedInclusion_image_generators] at hnot
  change SourceFractionActionUniversalF0.rawToFunction k (rawDetector k) ∉
    Subfield.closure (Set.range (scalarMap k) ∪
      Set.range (AlbertRawInvariantFieldLower.ledgerValue k)) at hnot
  change SourceFractionActionUniversalF0.rawToFunction k (rawDetector k) ∉
    Subfield.closure (Set.range (scalarMap k) ∪
      Set.range (AlbertRawInvariantFieldLower.ledgerValue k))
  exact hnot

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.GLSubstitution.evalAway_parameterScalar
statement:
@[simp] theorem evalAway_parameterScalar (j : F k →+* E)
    (X : Fin 3 → Mat3 E) (hX : ∀ r, Matrix.det (X r) ≠ 0)
    (y : F k) :
    evalAway j X hX (parameterScalar k y) = j y
proof:
:= by
  change evalAway j X hX
    (algebraMap (Base (F k)) (Param k) (MvPolynomial.C y)) = _
  rw [evalAway_algebraMap]
  simp [baseEval]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.GLSubstitution.evalAway_conjugatedFamily
statement:
theorem evalAway_conjugatedFamily (j : F k →+* E)
    (X : Fin 3 → Mat3 E) (hX : ∀ r, Matrix.det (X r) ≠ 0)
    (r i : Fin 3) :
    (evalAway j X hX).mapMatrix (conjugatedFamily k r i) =
      X 0 * j.mapMatrix (universalFamily k r i) * (X 0)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [conjugatedFamily, map_mul, map_mul, evalAway_localizedMatrix,
    evalAway_localizedInverse]
  congr 2
  ext a b
  exact evalAway_parameterScalar k j X hX (universalFamily k r i a b)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.GLSubstitution.evalAway_comp_substitution
statement:
theorem evalAway_comp_substitution (j : F k →+* E)
    (X : Fin 3 → Mat3 E) (hX : ∀ r, Matrix.det (X r) ≠ 0) :
    (evalAway j X hX).comp (substitution k) =
      evaluationAlong (j.comp (scalarMap k))
        (fun r i => X 0 * j.mapMatrix (universalFamily k r i) * (X 0)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
  · intro c
    simp [substitution, evaluationAlong, evalAway_parameterScalar]
  · intro q
    cases q with
    | entry r i a b =>
      simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, substitution, evaluationAlong,
        MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_X']
      exact congrFun (congrFun (evalAway_conjugatedFamily k j X hX r i) a) b

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.GLSubstitution.evalAway_substitution
statement:
theorem evalAway_substitution (j : F k →+* E)
    (X : Fin 3 → Mat3 E) (hX : ∀ r, Matrix.det (X r) ≠ 0)
    (p : CoordinateRing k) :
    evalAway j X hX (substitution k p) =
      evaluationAlong (j.comp (scalarMap k))
        (fun r i => X 0 * j.mapMatrix (universalFamily k r i) * (X 0)⁻¹) p
proof:
:=
  DFunLike.congr_fun (evalAway_comp_substitution k j X hX) p

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.GLSubstitution.evalAway_crossExpression
statement:
theorem evalAway_crossExpression (j : F k →+* E)
    (X : Fin 3 → Mat3 E) (hX : ∀ r, Matrix.det (X r) ≠ 0)
    (a b : CoordinateRing k) :
    evalAway j X hX (crossExpression k a b) =
      evaluationAlong (j.comp (scalarMap k))
          (fun r i => X 0 * j.mapMatrix (universalFamily k r i) * (X 0)⁻¹) a *
        j (rawToField k b) -
      evaluationAlong (j.comp (scalarMap k))
          (fun r i => X 0 * j.mapMatrix (universalFamily k r i) * (X 0)⁻¹) b *
        j (rawToField k a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [crossExpression, map_sub, map_mul, map_mul,
    evalAway_substitution, evalAway_substitution,
    evalAway_parameterScalar, evalAway_parameterScalar]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.StandardTargetAdjoint.sourceSpur_eq_zero_of_idempotent_trace_one

name: AlbertLean.Generic.StandardTargetAdjoint.sourceProduct_diagonal
statement:
theorem sourceProduct_diagonal (e : JCoord K) (a b d : K) :
    sourceProduct e (diagonal a b d) =
      { d1 := a * e.d1, d2 := b * e.d2, d3 := d * e.d3,
        v := ((b + d) / 2) • e.v,
        s := ((a + d) / 2) • e.s,
        c := ((a + b) / 2) • e.c }
proof:
:= by
  apply JCoord.ext
  · simp [sourceProduct_d1, diagonal, BS, BC, evalU]; ring
  · simp [sourceProduct_d2, diagonal, BV, BC, BW, evalU]; ring
  · simp [sourceProduct_d3, diagonal, BV, BS, BW, evalU]; ring
  · rw [sourceProduct_v_polarization]
    simp [sourceSquare_v, diagonal] <;> module
  · rw [sourceProduct_s_polarization]
    simp [sourceSquare_s, diagonal] <;> module
  · rw [sourceProduct_c_polarization]
    simp [sourceSquare_c, diagonal] <;> module

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualAction.f0LinearEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem f0LinearEquiv_apply (G : DetOneMatrix ℚ) (x : Coord) :
    f0LinearEquiv G x = structuredEquiv (act G (structuredEquiv.symm x))
proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualAction.f0LinearEquiv_one
statement:
theorem f0LinearEquiv_one (G : DetOneMatrix ℚ) :
    f0LinearEquiv G AlbertLean.one = AlbertLean.one
proof:
:= by
  have hsource : structuredEquiv.symm AlbertLean.one =
      (sourceOne : JCoord ℚ) := by
    apply structuredEquiv.injective
    rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, structuredEquiv_sourceOne]
  rw [f0LinearEquiv_apply, hsource, sourceOne_act, structuredEquiv_sourceOne]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualAction.f0LinearEquiv_product
statement:
theorem f0LinearEquiv_product (G : DetOneMatrix ℚ) (x y : Coord) :
    f0LinearEquiv G (AlbertLean.structuredProduct x y) =
      AlbertLean.structuredProduct (f0LinearEquiv G x) (f0LinearEquiv G y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := structuredEquiv.surjective x
  obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := structuredEquiv.surjective y
  have huv := StructuredSourceProductAgreesWithF0 u v
  change structuredEquiv (sourceProduct u v) =
    AlbertLean.structuredProduct (structuredEquiv u) (structuredEquiv v) at huv
  calc
    f0LinearEquiv G
        (AlbertLean.structuredProduct (structuredEquiv u) (structuredEquiv v)) =
        structuredEquiv (act G (sourceProduct u v)) := by
          rw [← huv, f0LinearEquiv_apply, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
    _ = structuredEquiv (sourceProduct (act G u) (act G v)) := by
          rw [sourceProduct_act]
    _ = AlbertLean.structuredProduct
          (structuredEquiv (act G u)) (structuredEquiv (act G v)) := by
          exact StructuredSourceProductAgreesWithF0 (act G u) (act G v)
    _ = AlbertLean.structuredProduct
          (f0LinearEquiv G (structuredEquiv u))
          (f0LinearEquiv G (structuredEquiv v)) := by
          rw [f0LinearEquiv_apply, f0LinearEquiv_apply,
            LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualAction.f0LinearEquiv_compose
statement:
theorem f0LinearEquiv_compose (G H : DetOneMatrix ℚ) :
    f0LinearEquiv (compose G H) =
      (f0LinearEquiv H).trans (f0LinearEquiv G)
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearEquiv.ext
  intro x
  change structuredEquiv (act (compose G H) (structuredEquiv.symm x)) =
    structuredEquiv
      (act G (structuredEquiv.symm
        (structuredEquiv (act H (structuredEquiv.symm x)))))
  rw [act_compose, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualAction.jordanAut_compose_apply
statement:
theorem jordanAut_compose_apply (G H : DetOneMatrix ℚ) (x : Coord) :
    jordanAut (compose G H) x = jordanAut G (jordanAut H x)
proof:
:= by
  change f0LinearEquiv (compose G H) x =
    f0LinearEquiv G (f0LinearEquiv H x)
  have h := congrArg (fun e : Coord ≃ₗ[ℚ] Coord => e x)
    (f0LinearEquiv_compose G H)
  exact h
