name: AlbertLean.Generic.SignRootAdjoin.closure_eq_span
statement:
theorem closure_eq_span :
    Subfield.closure ((H : Set K) ∪ {t}) = span H s hfix t hsq hneg
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply Subfield.closure_le.2
    rintro z (hz | rfl)
    · exact ⟨⟨z,hz⟩,0,by simp⟩
    · exact ⟨0,1,by simp⟩
  · rintro z ⟨a,b,rfl⟩
    apply Subfield.add_mem
    · exact Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inl a.property)
    · exact Subfield.mul_mem _ (Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inl b.property))
        (Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inr rfl))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SignRootAdjoin.exists_coefficients
statement:
theorem exists_coefficients {z : K} (hz : z ∈ Subfield.closure ((H : Set K) ∪ {t})) :
    ∃ a b : H, z = (a : K) + (b : K) * t
proof:
:= by
  rw [closure_eq_span H s hfix t hsq hneg] at hz
  exact hz

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SignRootAdjoin.fixed_iff_mem_base
statement:
theorem fixed_iff_mem_base [CharZero K] (ht : t ≠ 0) {z : K}
    (hz : z ∈ Subfield.closure ((H : Set K) ∪ {t})) : s z = z ↔ z ∈ H
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hsz
    obtain ⟨a,b,he⟩ := exists_coefficients H s hfix t hsq hneg hz
    have hs := congrArg s he
    simp only [map_add, map_mul, map_coe H s hfix, hneg, hsz] at hs
    have hb : (b : K) = 0 := by
      have hh : (2 : K) * ((b : K) * t) = 0 := by linear_combination hs - he
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp ((mul_eq_zero.mp hh).resolve_left (by norm_num))).resolve_right ht
    rw [he,hb,zero_mul,add_zero]
    exact a.property
  · exact hfix z

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TitsSquare.invOf_two_smul_add_self
statement:
private theorem invOf_two_smul_add_self
    {V : Type*} [AddCommMonoid V] [Module R V] (v : V) :
    ⅟(2 : R) • (v + v) = v
proof:
:= by
  rw [← two_smul R v, smul_smul, invOf_mul_self, one_smul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TitsSquare.square_offDiag
statement:
private theorem square_offDiag (x : Albert R) (i : Fin 3) :
    (x * x).offDiag i =
      (x.diag (i + 1) + x.diag (i + 2)) • x.offDiag i +
        TauCeti.Octonion.conj (x.offDiag (i + 1) * x.offDiag (i + 2))
proof:
:= by
  rw [TauCeti.AlbertAlgebra.mul_offDiag,
    invOf_two_smul_add_self, invOf_two_smul_add_self]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TitsSquare.matrix_sub_apply
statement:
private theorem matrix_sub_apply (M N : Mat3 R) (i j : Fin 3) :
    (M - N) i j = M i j - N i j
proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TitsSquare.toTau_firstTitsSquare
statement:
theorem toTau_firstTitsSquare (z : FirstTits R) :
    toTau (R := R) (firstTitsSquare z) = toTau z * toTau z
proof:
:= by
  rcases z with ⟨A, B, C⟩
  apply TauCeti.AlbertAlgebra.ext
  · funext i
    fin_cases i <;>
      simp [toTau, toTauRaw, firstTitsSquare, trace3, adjugate3,
        TauCeti.AlbertAlgebra.mul_diag,
        QuadraticMap.associated_eq_self_apply,
        TauCeti.Octonion.norm_def, Matrix.mul_apply,
        Fin.sum_univ_succ, dotProduct] <;> ring
  · funext i
    rw [square_offDiag]
    fin_cases i
    all_goals apply TauCeti.Octonion.ext
    all_goals try (funext j; fin_cases j)
    all_goals
      simp [toTau, toTauRaw, firstTitsSquare, trace3, adjugate3,
        matrix_sub_apply, Matrix.mul_apply, Pi.add_apply, Pi.neg_apply, Pi.smul_apply,
        Fin.sum_univ_succ, dotProduct] <;> ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TitsSquare.map_polarProduct
statement:
theorem map_polarProduct
    (square : FirstTits R → FirstTits R)
    (hSquare : ∀ z, toTau (R := R) (square z) = toTau z * toTau z)
    (x y : FirstTits R) :
    toTau (R := R) (polarProduct square x y) = toTau x * toTau y
proof:
:= by
  rw [polarProduct, map_smul, map_sub, map_sub, hSquare, hSquare, hSquare]
  simp only [map_add]
  have hcross :
      (toTau x + toTau y) * (toTau x + toTau y) - toTau x * toTau x -
          toTau y * toTau y =
        toTau x * toTau y + toTau x * toTau y := by
    simp only [add_mul, mul_add]
    rw [mul_comm (toTau y) (toTau x)]
    abel
  rw [hcross, invOf_two_smul_add_self]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TitsSquare.toTau_polarProduct
statement:
theorem toTau_polarProduct (x y : FirstTits R) :
    toTau (R := R) (polarProduct firstTitsSquare x y) =
      toTau x * toTau y
proof:
:=
  map_polarProduct firstTitsSquare toTau_firstTitsSquare x y

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawFrameIdeal.evaluationAlong_universalVector
statement:
@[simp] theorem evaluationAlong_universalVector
    (f : k →+* L) (P : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → F0Coord L)
    (r i : Fin 3) (c : Fin 27) :
    evaluationAlong f P (universalVector r i c) = P r i c
proof:
:= by
  simp [evaluationAlong, universalVector]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawFrameIdeal.evaluationAlong_productCoordinate
statement:
@[simp] theorem evaluationAlong_productCoordinate
    (f : k →+* L) (P : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → F0Coord L)
    (x y : F0Coord (CoordinateRing k)) (c : Fin 27) :
    evaluationAlong f P (productCoordinate x y c) =
      ∑ a : Fin 27, ∑ b : Fin 27,
        evaluationAlong f P (x a) * evaluationAlong f P (y b) *
          tensorCoeffK a b c
proof:
:= by
  simp [productCoordinate, tensorCoeffK, evaluationAlong]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawFrameIdeal.equations_vanishAlong_iff
statement:
theorem equations_vanishAlong_iff
    (f : k →+* L) (P : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → F0Coord L) :
    (∀ q, evaluationAlong f P (equation q) = 0) ↔ IsRawFrameFamily P
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro r i
      funext c
      simpa [equation, f0ProductK, sub_eq_zero] using
        h (.idempotence r i c)
    · intro r i
      simpa [equation, f0TraceK, sub_eq_zero] using h (.traceOne r i)
    · intro r
      funext c
      have hc := h (.sumOne r c)
      fin_cases c <;>
        simpa [equation, unitCoordinate, f0OneK, sub_eq_zero,
          Finset.sum_apply] using hc
  · intro h q
    cases q with
    | idempotence r i c =>
        have hc := congrFun (h.idempotent r i) c
        simpa [equation, f0ProductK, sub_eq_zero] using hc
    | traceOne r i =>
        simpa [equation, f0TraceK, sub_eq_zero] using h.trace_one r i
    | sumOne r c =>
        have hc := congrFun (h.sum_one r) c
        fin_cases c <;>
          simpa [equation, unitCoordinate, f0OneK, sub_eq_zero,
            Finset.sum_apply] using hc

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawFrameIdeal.rawFrameIdeal_le_ker_iff
statement:
theorem rawFrameIdeal_le_ker_iff
    (f : k →+* L) (P : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → F0Coord L) :
    rawFrameIdeal (k := k) ≤ RingHom.ker (evaluationAlong f P) ↔
      IsRawFrameFamily P
proof:
:= by
  rw [← equations_vanishAlong_iff f P]
  constructor
  · intro h q
    exact RingHom.mem_ker.mp (h (Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self q)))
  · intro h
    exact Ideal.span_le.2 (fun p hp => by
      rcases hp with ⟨q, rfl⟩
      exact RingHom.mem_ker.mpr (h q))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FixedParityFamilyFieldSubstitution.charZero_of_injective_map
statement:
private theorem charZero_of_injective_map
    {R L : Type u} [CommRing R] [CharZero R] [Field L]
    (f : R →+* L) (hf : Function.Injective f) : CharZero L where
  cast_injective m n h
proof:
:= Nat.cast_injective (R := R)
    (hf (by simpa only [map_natCast] using h))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FixedParityFamilyFieldSubstitution.recovery_source_linear
statement:
private theorem recovery_source_linear
    {K : Type u} [Field K] [CharZero K]
    (g : CubicAutomorphism.RecoveryPresentation.Aut
      (StructuredAdjoint.sourceRecoveryData (K := K))) :
    (recoveryAutToSourceAut g).linear = g.linear
proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FixedParityFamilyFieldSubstitution.fixedParitySourceAut_linear
statement:
private theorem fixedParitySourceAut_linear
    {K : Type u} [Field K] [CharZero K]
    (r : K) (w : W K) (rho : K) (hr : r ≠ 0) (hp : rho ≠ 0) :
    (fixedParitySourceAut K r w rho hr hp).linear =
      (familyAut parityVector (by simp) r w rho hr hp).linear
proof:
:=
  recovery_source_linear _

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FixedParityFamilyFieldSubstitution.fixedParitySourceAut_natural
statement:
private theorem fixedParitySourceAut_natural
    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [CharZero K] [Field L] [CharZero L]
    (f : K →+* L) (r : K) (w : W K) (rho : K)
    (hr : r ≠ 0) (hp : rho ≠ 0) (x : JCoord K) :
    AlbertLean.Generic.SourceCoefficientMap.mapSource f
        ((fixedParitySourceAut K r w rho hr hp).linear x) =
      (fixedParitySourceAut L (f r)
        (AlbertLean.Triality.RationalEvenFamilyNaturality.mapW f w) (f rho)
        (by simpa only [map_zero] using f.injective.ne hr)
        (by simpa only [map_zero] using f.injective.ne hp)).linear
        (AlbertLean.Generic.SourceCoefficientMap.mapSource f x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [fixedParitySourceAut_linear, fixedParitySourceAut_linear]
  have hparity :
      AlbertLean.Triality.RationalEvenFamilyNaturality.mapV f
          (parityVector : VCoord K) = (parityVector : VCoord L) := by
    apply VCoord.ext
    · simp [AlbertLean.Triality.RationalEvenFamilyNaturality.mapV, parityVector]
    · simp [AlbertLean.Triality.RationalEvenFamilyNaturality.mapV, parityVector]
    · funext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [AlbertLean.Triality.RationalEvenFamilyNaturality.mapV,
        AlbertLean.Triality.RationalEvenFamilyNaturality.mapW, parityVector,
        ExteriorSix.wBasis]
  have hn := familyAut_natural f (parityVector : VCoord K) (by simp)
    r w rho hr hp x
  simpa only [hparity] using hn

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FixedParityFamilyFieldSubstitution.baseLinear_structured
statement:
private theorem baseLinear_structured
    {K : Type u} [Field K] [CharZero K]
    (g : ResidualAction.SourceAut (K := K)) (x : JCoord K) :
    SourceAutExtension.baseLinear (k := K) g (structuredEquivK K x) =
      structuredEquivK K (g.linear x)
proof:
:= by
  change structuredEquivK K
    (g.linear ((structuredEquivK K).symm (structuredEquivK K x))) = _
  rw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FixedParityFamilyFieldSubstitution.extended_linear_of_natural
statement:
private theorem extended_linear_of_natural
    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [CharZero K] [Field L] [CharZero L]
    [Algebra K L] [Invertible (2 : L)]
    (gK : ResidualAction.SourceAut (K := K))
    (gL : ResidualAction.SourceAut (K := L))
    (hn : ∀ x : JCoord K,
      AlbertLean.Generic.SourceCoefficientMap.mapSource (algebraMap K L)
          (gK.linear x) =
        gL.linear
          (AlbertLean.Generic.SourceCoefficientMap.mapSource (algebraMap K L) x)) :
    (SourceAutExtension.linearEquiv (R := L) gK).toLinearMap =
      SourceAutExtension.baseLinear (k := L) gL
proof:
:= by
  apply (Pi.basisFun L (Fin 27)).ext
  intro c
  simp only [Pi.basisFun_apply]
  rw [← SourceAutExtension.mapCoord_single (k := K) (R := L) c]
  change SourceAutExtension.linear (R := L) gK
      (SourceAutExtension.mapCoord (algebraMap K L) (Pi.single c 1)) = _
  rw [SourceAutExtension.linearEquiv_on_constants]
  let x := (structuredEquivK K).symm (Pi.single c 1)
  change (algebraMap K L) ∘ structuredEquivK K (gK.linear x) = _
  have hmap (y : JCoord K) :
      structuredEquivK L
          (AlbertLean.Generic.SourceCoefficientMap.mapSource (algebraMap K L) y) =
        (algebraMap K L) ∘ structuredEquivK K y := by
    exact LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply (structuredEquivK L) _
  rw [← hmap (gK.linear x)]
  refine (congrArg (structuredEquivK L) (hn x)).trans ?_
  have hx :
      structuredEquivK L
          (AlbertLean.Generic.SourceCoefficientMap.mapSource (algebraMap K L) x) =
        SourceAutExtension.mapCoord (algebraMap K L) (Pi.single c 1) := by
    rw [hmap]
    rw [show structuredEquivK K x = Pi.single c 1 from
      LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply _ _]
    rfl
  rw [← hx, baseLinear_structured]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FixedParityFamilyFieldSubstitution.extended_family_linear
statement:
theorem extended_family_linear
    (r : k) (w : W k) (rho : k) (hr : r ≠ 0) (hp : rho ≠ 0) :
    (SourceAutExtension.linearEquiv (R := F k)
        (fixedParitySourceAut k r w rho hr hp)).toLinearMap =
      SourceAutExtension.baseLinear (k := F k)
        (fixedParitySourceAut (F k) (algebraMap k (F k) r)
          (AlbertLean.Triality.RationalEvenFamilyNaturality.mapW
            (algebraMap k (F k)) w) (algebraMap k (F k) rho)
          (by simpa only [map_zero] using (algebraMap k (F k)).injective.ne hr)
          (by simpa only [map_zero] using (algebraMap k (F k)).injective.ne hp))
proof:
:= by
  apply extended_linear_of_natural
  intro x
  exact fixedParitySourceAut_natural (algebraMap k (F k)) r w rho hr hp x

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FixedParityFamilyFieldSubstitution.familySubstitution_eq_fractionAction
statement:
theorem familySubstitution_eq_fractionAction
    (r : k) (w : W k) (rho : k) (hr : r ≠ 0) (hp : rho ≠ 0) :
    familySubstitution k r w rho hr hp =
      (fractionAction k (fixedParitySourceAut k r w rho hr hp)).toRingHom.comp
        (rawToFunction k)
proof:
:= by
  apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
  · intro a
    simp only [familySubstitution, MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_C, RingHom.comp_apply]
    rw [rawToFunction, RingHom.comp_apply]
    change _ = fractionAction k (fixedParitySourceAut k r w rho hr hp)
      (algebraMap (SourceScheduleReducedDomain.ReducedCoordinateRing k) (F k)
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (MvPolynomial.C a)))
    rw [fractionAction_algebraMap_reduced]
    congr 1
    change Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (MvPolynomial.C a) =
      SourceReducedRawAutomorphism.reducedActionHom k _
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (MvPolynomial.C a))
    rw [SourceReducedRawAutomorphism.reducedActionHom_mk]
    congr 1
    simp [SourceRawAutomorphism.rawAction]
  · intro q
    cases q with
    | entry a i c =>
      simp only [familySubstitution, MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_X', RingHom.comp_apply]
      have hf := familyF0_eq_sourceEvenAut
        (A := (parityVector : VCoord (F k))) (by simp)
        (algebraMap k (F k) r)
        (RationalEvenRingAction.mapW (algebraMap k (F k)) w)
        (algebraMap k (F k) rho)
        (by simpa only [map_zero] using (algebraMap k (F k)).injective.ne hr)
        (by simpa only [map_zero] using (algebraMap k (F k)).injective.ne hp)
        ((structuredEquivK (F k)).symm (universalF0 k a i))
      rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at hf
      have hfc := congrFun hf c
      have htwoF :
          (RationalEvenRingAction.instInvertibleOfNat_albertLean :
            Invertible (2 : F k)) = functionTwo k := Subsingleton.elim _ _
      rw [htwoF] at hfc
      let gF := fixedParitySourceAut (F k) (algebraMap k (F k) r)
        (AlbertLean.Triality.RationalEvenFamilyNaturality.mapW
          (algebraMap k (F k)) w) (algebraMap k (F k) rho)
        (by simpa only [map_zero] using (algebraMap k (F k)).injective.ne hr)
        (by simpa only [map_zero] using (algebraMap k (F k)).injective.ne hp)
      have hbase :
          familyF0 (parityVector : VCoord (F k)) 1 1
              (algebraMap k (F k) r)
              (RationalEvenRingAction.mapW (algebraMap k (F k)) w)
              (algebraMap k (F k) rho) ((algebraMap k (F k) r)⁻¹)
              ((algebraMap k (F k) rho)⁻¹) (universalF0 k a i) c =
            SourceAutExtension.baseLinear (k := F k) gF
              (universalF0 k a i) c := by
        simp only [nV_parityVector, inv_one] at hfc
        change familyF0 (parityVector : VCoord (F k)) 1 1
              (algebraMap k (F k) r)
              (RationalEvenRingAction.mapW (algebraMap k (F k)) w)
              (algebraMap k (F k) rho) ((algebraMap k (F k) r)⁻¹)
              ((algebraMap k (F k) rho)⁻¹) (universalF0 k a i) c = _ at hfc
        exact hfc
      have he := LinearMap.congr_fun
        (extended_family_linear k r w rho hr hp) (universalF0 k a i)
      have hec := congrFun he c
      have ha := fractionAction_universalF0 k
        (fixedParitySourceAut k r w rho hr hp) a i
      have hc := congrFun ha c
      calc
        _ = SourceAutExtension.baseLinear (k := F k) gF
              (universalF0 k a i) c := by simpa only [map_inv₀] using hbase
        _ = SourceAutExtension.linearEquiv (R := F k)
              (fixedParitySourceAut k r w rho hr hp) (universalF0 k a i) c := hec.symm
        _ = fractionAction k (fixedParitySourceAut k r w rho hr hp)
              (universalF0 k a i c) := hc.symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealCayleySignCover.signs_sq
statement: @[simp] theorem signs_sq (s : Fin 4) (i : Fin 3) : (signs (K := K) s i) ^ 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases s <;> fin_cases i <;> simp [signs]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealCayleySignCover.signMatrix_det
statement: @[simp] theorem signMatrix_det (s : Fin 4) : Matrix.det (signMatrix (K := K) s) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [signMatrix, Matrix.det_diagonal]
  fin_cases s <;> simp [signs, Fin.prod_univ_succ]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealCayleySignCover.signMatrix_orthogonal
statement: theorem signMatrix_orthogonal (s : Fin 4) : IsOrthogonal (signMatrix (K := K) s)
proof:
:= by
  change IsOrthogonal (diagonalSign (signs (K := K) s))
  exact diagonalSign_orthogonal (signs (K := K) s) (signs_sq (K := K) s)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealCayleySignCover.sum_det_one_add_mul_sign
statement:
theorem sum_det_one_add_mul_sign (Q : Mat3 K) :
    (∑ s : Fin 4, Matrix.det (1 + Q * signMatrix s)) = 4 * (1 + Matrix.det Q)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_four]
  simp [signMatrix, signs, Matrix.det_fin_three, Matrix.mul_apply,
    Matrix.mul_diagonal, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealCayleySignCover.exists_sign_denominator_ne_zero
statement:
theorem exists_sign_denominator_ne_zero (Q : Mat3 K) (hdet : Matrix.det Q = 1) :
    ∃ s : Fin 4, Matrix.det (1 + Q * signMatrix s) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  push_neg at h
  have hsum := sum_det_one_add_mul_sign Q
  simp only [h, Finset.sum_const_zero] at hsum
  rw [hdet] at hsum
  norm_num at hsum

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealCayleySignCover.mul_sign_orthogonal
statement:
theorem mul_sign_orthogonal (Q : Mat3 K) (hQ : IsOrthogonal Q) (s : Fin 4) :
    IsOrthogonal (Q * signMatrix s)
proof:
:= by
  have hD := signMatrix_orthogonal (K := K) s
  have ht : Matrix.transpose (Q * signMatrix s) * (Q * signMatrix s) = 1 := by
    simp only [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc (Matrix.transpose Q) Q (signMatrix s),
      hQ.transpose_mul, Matrix.one_mul, hD.transpose_mul]
  exact ⟨ht, mul_eq_one_comm.mp ht⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealCayleySignCover.columnProjector_mul_sign
statement:
theorem columnProjector_mul_sign (Q : Mat3 K) (s : Fin 4) (i : Fin 3) :
    columnProjector (Q * signMatrix s) i = columnProjector Q i
proof:
:= by
  ext r c
  simp only [columnProjector, signMatrix, Matrix.mul_diagonal]
  calc
    (Q r i * signs s i) * (Q c i * signs s i) =
        (Q r i * Q c i) * (signs (K := K) s i) ^ 2 := by ring
    _ = Q r i * Q c i := by rw [signs_sq, mul_one]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealCayleySignCover.neg_orthogonal
statement: theorem neg_orthogonal (X : Mat3 K) (hX : IsOrthogonal X) : IsOrthogonal (-X)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · simpa [Matrix.transpose_neg] using hX.transpose_mul
  · simpa [Matrix.transpose_neg] using hX.mul_transpose

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealCayleySignCover.columnProjector_neg
statement:
theorem columnProjector_neg (X : Mat3 K) (i : Fin 3) :
    columnProjector (-X) i = columnProjector X i
proof:
:= by
  ext r c
  simp [columnProjector]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealCayleySignCover.orthogonal_det_eq_one_or_neg_one
statement:
theorem orthogonal_det_eq_one_or_neg_one (X : Mat3 K) (hX : IsOrthogonal X) :
    Matrix.det X = 1 ∨ Matrix.det X = -1
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg Matrix.det hX.transpose_mul
  rw [Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_transpose, Matrix.det_one] at h
  exact sq_eq_one_iff.mp (by simpa [pow_two] using h)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealCayleySignCover.cover_det_one
statement:
private theorem cover_det_one (Q : Mat3 K) (hQ : IsOrthogonal Q)
    (hdet : Matrix.det Q = 1) :
    ∃ B : Mat3 K, IsOrthogonal B ∧
      (∀ i, columnProjector B i = columnProjector Q i) ∧
      Matrix.det (1 + B) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := exists_sign_denominator_ne_zero Q hdet
  exact ⟨Q * signMatrix s, mul_sign_orthogonal Q hQ s,
    columnProjector_mul_sign Q s, hs⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealCayleySignCover.exists_orthogonal_same_projectors_det_one_add_ne_zero
statement:
theorem exists_orthogonal_same_projectors_det_one_add_ne_zero
    (X : Mat3 K) (hX : IsOrthogonal X) :
    ∃ B : Mat3 K, IsOrthogonal B ∧
      (∀ i, columnProjector B i = columnProjector X i) ∧
      Matrix.det (1 + B) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases orthogonal_det_eq_one_or_neg_one X hX with hdet | hdet
  · exact cover_det_one X hX hdet
  · have hnegdet : Matrix.det (-X) = 1 := by
      rw [Matrix.det_neg, hdet]
      norm_num
    obtain ⟨B, hB, hproj, hden⟩ := cover_det_one (-X) (neg_orthogonal X hX) hnegdet
    exact ⟨B, hB, fun i => (hproj i).trans (columnProjector_neg X i), hden⟩

    (P : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Coordinates K) :

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.TransvectionWordTransport.wordReducedAction_mk
statement:
theorem wordReducedAction_mk
    (word : List (Step (K := K) (V := Vec6 K)))
    (x : CoordinateRing K) :
    wordReducedAction K word
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (rawFrameIdeal K).radical x) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (rawFrameIdeal K).radical (wordRawAction K word x)
proof:
:= by
  induction word generalizing x with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons step word ih =>
      change wordReducedAction K word
          (reducedAction K (singletonAut K step)
            (Ideal.Quotient.mk (rawFrameIdeal K).radical x)) =
        Ideal.Quotient.mk (rawFrameIdeal K).radical
          (wordRawAction K word (rawAction K (singletonAut K step) x))
      rw [show reducedAction K (singletonAut K step)
            (Ideal.Quotient.mk (rawFrameIdeal K).radical x) =
          Ideal.Quotient.mk (rawFrameIdeal K).radical
            (rawAction K (singletonAut K step) x) from rfl]
      exact ih (rawAction K (singletonAut K step) x)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.TransvectionWordTransport.evaluationAlong_wordRawAction
statement:
theorem evaluationAlong_wordRawAction
    (word : List (Step (K := K) (V := Vec6 K)))
    (P : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Coordinates K) :
    (evaluationAlong K (RingHom.id K) P).comp (wordRawAction K word) =
      evaluationAlong K (RingHom.id K) (wordActedPoint K word P)
proof:
:= by
  induction word generalizing P with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons step word ih =>
      calc
        (evaluationAlong K (RingHom.id K) P).comp
            (wordRawAction K (step :: word)) =
          ((evaluationAlong K (RingHom.id K) P).comp
            (wordRawAction K word)).comp
              (rawAction K (singletonAut K step)) := rfl
        _ = (evaluationAlong K (RingHom.id K)
              (wordActedPoint K word P)).comp
                (rawAction K (singletonAut K step)) := by rw [ih]
        _ = evaluationAlong K (RingHom.id K)
              (actedPoint K (singletonAut K step)
                (wordActedPoint K word P)) :=
          evaluationAlong_rawAction K (singletonAut K step)
            (wordActedPoint K word P)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.TransvectionWordTransport.polynomial_word_endpoint_square
statement:
theorem polynomial_word_endpoint_square
    (φ ψ : FF k →+* K)
    (word : List (Step (K := K) (V := Vec6 K)))
    (hscalar : originalCoefficientEmbedding k K φ =
      originalCoefficientEmbedding k K ψ)
    (hpoint : wordActedPoint K word (genericPointAlong k K φ) =
      genericPointAlong k K ψ) :
    (polynomialEvaluation k K φ).comp
        ((wordRawAction K word).comp
          (polynomialCoefficientMap k K
            (originalCoefficientEmbedding k K φ))) =
      ψ.comp (rawToFunction k)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (polynomialEvaluation k K φ).comp
        ((wordRawAction K word).comp
          (polynomialCoefficientMap k K
            (originalCoefficientEmbedding k K φ))) =
      ((polynomialEvaluation k K φ).comp
        (wordRawAction K word)).comp
          (polynomialCoefficientMap k K
            (originalCoefficientEmbedding k K φ)) := rfl
    _ = (evaluationAlong K (RingHom.id K)
          (wordActedPoint K word (genericPointAlong k K φ))).comp
        (polynomialCoefficientMap k K
          (originalCoefficientEmbedding k K φ)) := by
            rw [show polynomialEvaluation k K φ =
                evaluationAlong K (RingHom.id K)
                  (genericPointAlong k K φ) from rfl,
              evaluationAlong_wordRawAction]
    _ = (evaluationAlong K (RingHom.id K)
          (genericPointAlong k K ψ)).comp
        (polynomialCoefficientMap k K
          (originalCoefficientEmbedding k K φ)) := by rw [hpoint]
    _ = (evaluationAlong K (RingHom.id K)
          (genericPointAlong k K ψ)).comp
        (polynomialCoefficientMap k K
          (originalCoefficientEmbedding k K ψ)) := by rw [hscalar]
    _ = ψ.comp (rawToFunction k) :=
      polynomial_evaluation_square k K ψ

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.TransvectionWordTransport.reduced_word_evaluation_square
statement:
theorem reduced_word_evaluation_square
    (φ ψ : FF k →+* K)
    (word : List (Step (K := K) (V := Vec6 K)))
    (hscalar : originalCoefficientEmbedding k K φ =
      originalCoefficientEmbedding k K ψ)
    (hpoint : wordActedPoint K word (genericPointAlong k K φ) =
      genericPointAlong k K ψ) :
    ((evaluation k K φ).comp (wordReducedAction K word).toRingHom).comp
        (reducedCoefficientMap k K φ) =
      ψ.comp (reducedInclusion k)
proof:
:= by
  apply Ideal.Quotient.ringHom_ext
  apply DFunLike.ext _ _
  intro x
  simp only [RingHom.comp_apply]
  change evaluation k K φ
      (wordReducedAction K word
        (reducedCoefficientMap k K φ
          (Ideal.Quotient.mk (rawFrameIdeal k).radical x))) = _
  rw [reducedCoefficientMap, reducedCoefficientMapOf_mk,
    wordReducedAction_mk, evaluation_mk]
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun
    (polynomial_word_endpoint_square k K φ ψ word hscalar hpoint) x

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.TransvectionWordTransport.transvectionWord_clearedInvariant_extension
statement:
theorem transvectionWord_clearedInvariant_extension
    (φ : FF k →+* K)
    (a b : CoordinateRing k) (hb : rawToFunction k b ≠ 0)
    (hinv : ∀ g : ScalarJordanAut.Aut (K := k),
      fractionAction k g (rawToFunction k a / rawToFunction k b) =
        rawToFunction k a / rawToFunction k b)
    (word : List (Step (K := K) (V := Vec6 K))) :
    let A
proof:
:= reducedCoefficientMap k K φ
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (rawFrameIdeal k).radical a)
    let B := reducedCoefficientMap k K φ
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (rawFrameIdeal k).radical b)
    let T := wordReducedAction K word
    T A * B = A * T B := by
  dsimp only
  have hbR : reducedInclusion k
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (rawFrameIdeal k).radical b) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa [rawToFunction] using hb
  have hB : reducedCoefficientMap k K φ
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (rawFrameIdeal k).radical b) ≠ 0 :=
    reducedCoefficientMap_ne_zero k K φ _ hbR
  induction word with
  | nil => simp [wordReducedAction]
  | cons step word ih =>
      rcases step with ⟨d, t⟩
      exact ratio_fixed_comp
        (reducedCoefficientMap k K φ
          (Ideal.Quotient.mk (rawFrameIdeal k).radical a))
        (reducedCoefficientMap k K φ
          (Ideal.Quotient.mk (rawFrameIdeal k).radical b))
        hB
        (wordReducedAction K word)
        (reducedAction K (singletonAut K (d, t)))
        ih
        (oneTransvection_clearedInvariant_extension
          k K φ a b hb hinv d t)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.TransvectionWordTransport.transvectionWord_actualEndpointCross
statement:
theorem transvectionWord_actualEndpointCross
    (φ : FF k →+* K)
    (a b : CoordinateRing k) (hb : rawToFunction k b ≠ 0)
    (hinv : ∀ g : ScalarJordanAut.Aut (K := k),
      fractionAction k g (rawToFunction k a / rawToFunction k b) =
        rawToFunction k a / rawToFunction k b)
    (word : List (Step (K := K) (V := Vec6 K))) :
    let A
proof:
:= reducedCoefficientMap k K φ
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (rawFrameIdeal k).radical a)
    let B := reducedCoefficientMap k K φ
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (rawFrameIdeal k).radical b)
    let T := wordReducedAction K word
    evaluation k K φ (T A) * φ (rawToFunction k b) =
      φ (rawToFunction k a) * evaluation k K φ (T B) := by
  dsimp only
  have hclear := transvectionWord_clearedInvariant_extension
    k K φ a b hb hinv word
  have h := congrArg (evaluation k K φ) hclear
  simp only [map_mul] at h
  have ha := DFunLike.congr_fun (reduced_evaluation_square k K φ)
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk (rawFrameIdeal k).radical a)
  have hb' := DFunLike.congr_fun (reduced_evaluation_square k K φ)
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk (rawFrameIdeal k).radical b)
  simp only [RingHom.comp_apply] at ha hb'
  rw [ha, hb'] at h
  simpa [rawToFunction] using h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.TransvectionWordTransport.transvectionWord_finalPoint_agreement
statement:
theorem transvectionWord_finalPoint_agreement
    (φ ψ : FF k →+* K)
    (word : List (Step (K := K) (V := Vec6 K)))
    (hscalar : originalCoefficientEmbedding k K φ =
      originalCoefficientEmbedding k K ψ)
    (hpoint : wordActedPoint K word (genericPointAlong k K φ) =
      genericPointAlong k K ψ)
    (a b : CoordinateRing k) (hb : rawToFunction k b ≠ 0)
    (hinv : ∀ g : ScalarJordanAut.Aut (K := k),
      fractionAction k g (rawToFunction k a / rawToFunction k b) =
        rawToFunction k a / rawToFunction k b) :
    φ (rawToFunction k a / rawToFunction k b) =
      ψ (rawToFunction k a / rawToFunction k b)
proof:
:= by
  let A := Ideal.Quotient.mk (rawFrameIdeal k).radical a
  let B := Ideal.Quotient.mk (rawFrameIdeal k).radical b
  let T := wordReducedAction K word
  have hbR : reducedInclusion k B ≠ 0 := by
    simpa [B, rawToFunction] using hb
  have hclear :
      T (reducedCoefficientMap k K φ A) *
          reducedCoefficientMap k K φ B =
        reducedCoefficientMap k K φ A *
          T (reducedCoefficientMap k K φ B) := by
    simpa [T, A, B] using
      transvectionWord_clearedInvariant_extension
        k K φ a b hb hinv word
  have hright :
      ((evaluation k K φ).comp T.toRingHom).comp
          (reducedCoefficientMap k K φ) =
        ψ.comp (reducedInclusion k) := by
    simpa [T] using reduced_word_evaluation_square
      k K φ ψ word hscalar hpoint
  have hagree := agreement_of_generic_cleared_transport
    (reducedInclusion k) (reducedCoefficientMap k K φ)
    (evaluation k K φ) φ ψ T
    (reduced_evaluation_square k K φ) hright A B hbR hclear
  simpa [A, B, rawToFunction] using hagree

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexPairPolynomial.reconstructed_determinant_numerator
statement:
theorem reconstructed_determinant_numerator (p q r s d : K) :
    (s * d - nu p q r s d) * (d - 1) * nu p q r s d -
      (d * nu p q r s d + q * d * (d - 1) - nu p q r s d) *
        (d * nu p q r s d + r * d * (d - 1) - nu p q r s d) -
      d * (d - 1) * nu p q r s d =
        -(d * (d - 1)) * pairQuadratic p q r s d
proof:
:= by
  unfold nu pairQuadratic
  ring

proof:
:= by
  apply (eq_div_iff hQ.1.1).mpr
  change Matrix.det Q.A * Matrix.det Q.X = witnessScale
  rw [← Matrix.det_mul]
  change Matrix.det (moment Q) = witnessScale

name: AlbertLean.Generic.CoordinateDomain.coordinateTriple_normalForm
statement:
theorem coordinateTriple_normalForm (Q : ResidualPair ℚ)
    (hQ : FixedMomentPair Q) :
    FullRelated (parameterTriple (delta Q) hQ.1.1) (coordinateTriple Q)
proof:
:= by
  have hrel : Related
      (residualPairOfChart (parameterChart (delta Q) hQ.1.1)) Q := by
    rw [parameterChart_residualPair]
    apply (related_iff_same_moment_delta _ _
      ((parameterResidualPair_open (delta Q) hQ.1.1).1) hQ.1.1).mpr
    exact ⟨(parameterResidualPair_moment _ _).trans hQ.2.symm,
      parameterResidualPair_delta _ _⟩
  simpa only [parameterTriple, coordinateTriple, fibreTriple,
    parameterChart, chartWithResidualPair_reinsert] using
    fullRelated_of_related (parameterChart (delta Q) hQ.1.1) Q hrel

name: AlbertLean.Generic.CoordinateDomain.coordinateTriple_lawful
statement:
theorem coordinateTriple_lawful (Q : ResidualPair ℚ)
    (hQ : FixedMomentPair Q) : LawfulFrameTriple (coordinateTriple Q)
proof:
:= by
  rcases coordinateTriple_normalForm Q hQ with ⟨g, hg⟩
  exact (lawfulFrameTriple_iff_of_transports g _ _ hg).mpr
    (parameterTriple_lawful (delta Q) hQ.1.1)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.CoordinateDomain.coordinateTriple_ledger_normalForm
statement:
theorem coordinateTriple_ledger_normalForm (Q : ResidualPair ℚ)
    (hQ : FixedMomentPair Q) :
    ledger (coordinateTriple Q) = ledger (parameterTriple (delta Q) hQ.1.1)
proof:
:=
  (coordinateTriple_normalForm Q hQ).ledger_eq.symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.CoordinateDomain.coordinateTriple_detector_normalForm
statement:
theorem coordinateTriple_detector_normalForm (Q : ResidualPair ℚ)
    (hQ : FixedMomentPair Q) :
    traceCubeDetector (coordinateTriple Q) =
      traceCubeDetector (parameterTriple (delta Q) hQ.1.1)
proof:
:=
  (coordinateTriple_normalForm Q hQ).traceCubeDetector_eq.symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.PeircePolynomial.reflection_reflection
statement:
theorem reflection_reflection
    (μ : A →ₗ[K] A →ₗ[K] A) (p : A)
    (hcubic : ∀ x,
      (2 : K) • μ p (μ p (μ p x)) -
        (3 : K) • μ p (μ p x) + μ p x = 0)
    (x : A) : reflection μ p (reflection μ p x) = x
proof:
:= by
  have h3 := hcubic x
  have h4 := hcubic (μ p x)
  dsimp only [reflection]
  simp only [map_add, map_sub, map_smul]
  linear_combination (norm := module)
    (-16 : K) • h3 + (32 : K) • h4

name: AlbertLean.Generic.PeircePolynomial.reflection_one
statement:
theorem reflection_one
    (μ : A →ₗ[K] A →ₗ[K] A) (one p : A)
    (hone : μ p one = p) (hidem : μ p p = p) :
    reflection μ p one = one
proof:
:= by
  simp [reflection, hone, hidem]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.uncenteredCell_labelledLedger
statement:
theorem uncenteredCell_labelledLedger (T : Fin 3 → Albert K) (i j l : Fin 3) :
    uncenteredCell (labelledLedger T) i j l =
      TauCeti.AlbertAlgebra.trace
        (tauProjector (T 0) i *
          (tauProjector (T 1) j * tauProjector (T 2) l))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [uncenteredCell, labelledLedger]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.uncenteredCell_eq_of_ledger_eq
statement:
theorem uncenteredCell_eq_of_ledger_eq
    {L M : LabelledLedger K} (h : L = M) (i j l : Fin 3) :
    uncenteredCell L i j l = uncenteredCell M i j l
proof:
:= by
  rw [h]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.rawJoint_eq_of_labelledLedger_eq
statement:
theorem rawJoint_eq_of_labelledLedger_eq
    (T W : Fin 3 → Albert K) (h : labelledLedger T = labelledLedger W)
    (i j l : Fin 3) :
    TauCeti.AlbertAlgebra.trace
        (tauProjector (T 0) i *
          (tauProjector (T 1) j * tauProjector (T 2) l)) =
      TauCeti.AlbertAlgebra.trace
        (tauProjector (W 0) i *
          (tauProjector (W 1) j * tauProjector (W 2) l))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← uncenteredCell_labelledLedger T,
    ← uncenteredCell_labelledLedger W]
  exact uncenteredCell_eq_of_ledger_eq h i j l

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowFrameSeed.root_cube
statement: theorem root_cube (z : K) (hz : z ^ 2 + z + 1 = 0) : z ^ 3 = 1
proof:
:= by
  linear_combination (z - 1) * hz

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowFrameSeed.root_square_equation
statement:
theorem root_square_equation (z : K) (hz : z ^ 2 + z + 1 = 0) :
    (z ^ 2) ^ 2 + z ^ 2 + 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  linear_combination (z ^ 2 - z + 1) * hz

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowFrameSeed.a_det_ne_zero
statement: theorem a_det_ne_zero : (a : Mat3 K).det ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [a, Matrix.det_smul]
  norm_num

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowFrameSeed.first_components_sum
statement: theorem first_components_sum : (a : Mat3 K) + a + a = 1
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [a]
  module

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowFrameSeed.first_component_trace
statement: theorem first_component_trace : Matrix.trace (a : Mat3 K) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [a, Matrix.trace_smul, Matrix.trace_one]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowFrameSeed.component_parameters
statement:
theorem component_parameters :
    componentU (a : Mat3 K) a a = 1 ∧ componentV (a : Mat3 K) a = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hadj : (a : Mat3 K).adjugate.det ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Matrix.det_adjugate]
    exact pow_ne_zero 2 a_det_ne_zero
  constructor <;>
    simp only [componentU, componentV, FourRowFrameReduction.frameU,
      FourRowFrameReduction.frameV, add_sub_cancel_right,
      Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hadj)]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowFrameSeed.seed_goodSolution
statement:
theorem seed_goodSolution (z : K) (hz : z ^ 2 + z + 1 = 0) :
    GoodSolution (1 : Mat3 K) 1 1 1 (X z)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hm : (X z) ^ 2 + X z * 1 + 1 = (z ^ 2 + z + 1) • (1 : Mat3 K) := by
      simp only [X, pow_two, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, mul_one, one_mul,
        smul_smul, add_smul, one_smul]
    rw [hm, hz, zero_smul]
  · rw [X, Matrix.det_smul]
    simpa only [Fintype.card_fin, Matrix.det_one, mul_one] using root_cube z hz
  · have hm : (1 : Mat3 K) + X z = (1 + z) • 1 := by simp [X, add_smul]
    rw [hm, Matrix.det_smul]
    simp only [Fintype.card_fin, Matrix.det_one, mul_one]
    linear_combination (z + 2) * hz
  · have hden : reconstructionDenominator (1 : Mat3 K) 1 1 1 (Matrix.trace (X z)) =
        (-3 : K) • 1 := by
      simp only [reconstructionDenominator, one_pow, sub_self, zero_add]
      module
    rw [hden, Matrix.det_smul]
    norm_num

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowFrameSeed.seed_componentSolution
statement:
theorem seed_componentSolution (z : K) (hz : z ^ 2 + z + 1 = 0) :
    ComponentSolution a a a (X z)
proof:
:= by
  apply FourRowComponentEquivalence.components_of_goodSolution
    a a a (X z) a_det_ne_zero a_det_ne_zero a_det_ne_zero
  rw [component_parameters.1, component_parameters.2, div_self a_det_ne_zero]
  exact seed_goodSolution z hz

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowFrameSeed.seed_matrices_distinct
statement:
theorem seed_matrices_distinct (z : K) (hz : z ^ 2 + z + 1 = 0) :
    X z ≠ X (z ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have heq : z = z ^ 2 := by
    simpa [X] using congrFun (congrFun h 0) 0
  have hprod : z * (z - 1) = 0 := by
    calc
      z * (z - 1) = z ^ 2 - z := by ring
      _ = 0 := sub_eq_zero.mpr heq.symm
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hprod with hz0 | hsub
  · rw [hz0] at hz
    norm_num at hz
  · rw [sub_eq_zero.mp hsub] at hz
    norm_num at hz

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowFrameSeed.componentSolution_iff
statement:
theorem componentSolution_iff (z : K) (hz : z ^ 2 + z + 1 = 0) (W : Mat3 K) :
    ComponentSolution a a a W ↔ W = X z ∨ W = X (z ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hx := seed_componentSolution z hz
  have hy := seed_componentSolution (z ^ 2) (root_square_equation z hz)
  constructor
  · intro hw
    rcases three_componentSolutions_pairwise_eq a a a
        a_det_ne_zero a_det_ne_zero a_det_ne_zero W (X z) (X (z ^ 2)) hw hx hy
        with h | h | h
    · exact Or.inl h
    · exact Or.inr h
    · exact (seed_matrices_distinct z hz h).elim
  · rintro (rfl | rfl)
    · exact hx
    · exact hy

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceAutInvariants.tauConjugate_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem tauConjugate_apply (g : SourceAut (K := K)) (x : JCoord K) :
    tauConjugate g (sourceTauEquiv x) = sourceTauEquiv (g.linear x)
proof:
:= by
  simp [tauConjugate]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceAutInvariants.tauConjugate_one
statement: theorem tauConjugate_one (g : SourceAut (K := K)) : tauConjugate g 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sourceTauEquiv_one, tauConjugate_apply, g.map_one, sourceTauEquiv_one]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceAutInvariants.tauConjugate_mul
statement:
theorem tauConjugate_mul (g : SourceAut (K := K)) (x y : Albert K) :
    tauConjugate g (x * y) = tauConjugate g x * tauConjugate g y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := sourceTauEquiv.surjective x
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := sourceTauEquiv.surjective y
  rw [← sourceTauEquiv_product, tauConjugate_apply, g.map_product,
    sourceTauEquiv_product, tauConjugate_apply, tauConjugate_apply]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceAutInvariants.sourceTrace_invariant
statement:
theorem sourceTrace_invariant (g : SourceAut (K := K)) (x : JCoord K) :
    sourceTrace (g.linear x) = sourceTrace x
proof:
:= by
  have h := TauIntrinsicTrace.tauTrace_invariant (tauConjugate g)
    (tauConjugate_mul g) (sourceTauEquiv x)
  simpa only [tauConjugate_apply, sourceTauEquiv_trace] using h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceAutInvariants.frameLaws_map
statement:
theorem frameLaws_map (g : SourceAut (K := K)) (P : Fin 3 → JCoord K)
    (hP : SourceFrameLaws.Laws P) : SourceFrameLaws.Laws (g.linear ∘ P)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    change sourceProduct (g.linear (P i)) (g.linear (P i)) = g.linear (P i)
    rw [← g.map_product, hP.idempotent]
  · intro i
    exact (sourceTrace_invariant g (P i)).trans (hP.trace_one i)
  · change g.linear (P 0) + g.linear (P 1) + g.linear (P 2) = sourceOne
    rw [← map_add, ← map_add, hP.sum_one, g.map_one]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceAutInvariants.sourceLabelledLedger_invariant
statement:
theorem sourceLabelledLedger_invariant (g : SourceAut (K := K))
    (T : Fin 3 → JCoord K) :
    sourceLabelledLedger (g.linear ∘ T) = sourceLabelledLedger T
proof:
:= by
  rw [← labelledLedger_mapTriple, ← labelledLedger_mapTriple]
  have hm : mapTriple (g.linear ∘ T) = tauConjugate g ∘ mapTriple T := by
    funext i
    exact (tauConjugate_apply g (T i)).symm
  rw [hm]
  exact TauLedgerInvariance.labelledLedger_invariant (tauConjugate g)
    (tauConjugate_one g) (tauConjugate_mul g) (mapTriple T)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceAutInvariants.sourceDetector_invariant
statement:
theorem sourceDetector_invariant (g : SourceAut (K := K)) (x y z : JCoord K) :
    sourceDetector (g.linear x) (g.linear y) (g.linear z) = sourceDetector x y z
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← tauDetector_sourceTauEquiv, ← tauConjugate_apply g]
  exact TauLedgerInvariance.detector_invariant (tauConjugate g)
    (tauConjugate_mul g) (sourceTauEquiv x) (sourceTauEquiv y) (sourceTauEquiv z)

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceCliffordReflection.cliffordEnd_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem cliffordEnd_apply (v : VCoord K) (w : W K) :
    cliffordEnd v w = (sourceMuS w.2 v, sourceMuC v w.1)
proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceCliffordReflection.C_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem C_apply (v : VCoord K) (w : W K) :
    C v w = (sourceMuS w.2 v, sourceMuC v w.1)
proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceCliffordReflection.C_square
statement:
theorem C_square (v : VCoord K) :
    C v * C v = nV v • (1 : Module.End K (W K))
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro w
  apply Prod.ext
  · exact sourceMuS_sourceMuC v w.1
  · exact sourceMuC_sourceMuS v w.2

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceCliffordReflection.C_polar
statement:
theorem C_polar (v w : VCoord K) :
    C v * C w + C w * C v = BV v w • (1 : Module.End K (W K))
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  apply Prod.ext
  · simpa [add_comm] using sourceMuS_sourceMuC_polar v w x.1
  · exact sourceMuC_sourceMuS_polar v w x.2

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceCliffordReflection.C_sandwich
statement:
theorem C_sandwich (a v : VCoord K) :
    C a * C v * C a = BV a v • C a - nV a • C v
proof:
:= by
  have hp := congrArg (fun E : Module.End K (W K) => E * C a) (C_polar a v)
  simp only [add_mul, mul_assoc, C_square, mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc,
    mul_one, one_mul] at hp
  simpa only [mul_assoc] using (eq_sub_of_add_eq hp)

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceCliffordReflection.C_reflection
statement:
theorem C_reflection (a v : VCoord K) (ha : nV a ≠ 0) :
    -(nV a)⁻¹ • (C a * C v * C a) =
      C (v - (BV a v / nV a) • a)
proof:
:= by
  have hn : -(nV a)⁻¹ * nV a = -1 := by simp [ha]
  have hb : -(nV a)⁻¹ * BV a v = -(BV a v / nV a) := by
    rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
    ring
  rw [C_sandwich, map_sub, map_smul, smul_sub, smul_smul, smul_smul, hn, hb]
  simp only [neg_smul, one_smul, sub_neg_eq_add]
  abel

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.exists_actual_same_ledger_pair_block_conjugator
statement:
theorem exists_actual_same_ledger_pair_block_conjugator
    (E F E' F' : Fin 3 → Carrier K)
    (hEidem : ∀ i, (E i : Mat6 K) * E i = E i)
    (hEsum : (E 0 : Mat6 K) + E 1 + E 2 = 1)
    (hFidem : ∀ i, (F i : Mat6 K) * F i = F i)
    (hFsum : (F 0 : Mat6 K) + F 1 + F 2 = 1)
    (hEidem' : ∀ i, (E' i : Mat6 K) * E' i = E' i)
    (hEsum' : (E' 0 : Mat6 K) + E' 1 + E' 2 = 1)
    (hFidem' : ∀ i, (F' i : Mat6 K) * F' i = F' i)
    (hFsum' : (F' 0 : Mat6 K) + F' 1 + F' 2 = 1)
    (u v u' v' : Vec6 K) (p : Fin 3 → K)
    (hp : ∀ i, p i = (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u)
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v))
    (hp' : ∀ i, p i = (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E' i : Mat6 K) u')
      (matrixAction (E' i : Mat6 K) v')) (hpne : ∀ i, p i ≠ 0)
    (hFu : ∀ i, matrixAction (F 0 : Mat6 K) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u) = p i • u)
    (hFv : ∀ i, matrixAction (F 0 : Mat6 K) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v) = p i • v)
    (hFu' : ∀ i, matrixAction (F' 0 : Mat6 K) (matrixAction (E' i : Mat6 K) u') = p i • u')
    (hFv' : ∀ i, matrixAction (F' 0 : Mat6 K) (matrixAction (E' i : Mat6 K) v') = p i • v')
    (hledger : ∀ i, jordanTrace (K := K) ((E i : Mat6 K) * (F 1 : Mat6 K)) =
      jordanTrace (K := K) ((E' i : Mat6 K) * (F' 1 : Mat6 K)))
    (hp12 : p 1 + p 2 ≠ 0)
    (hdisc : let L := weightedCoordinateEquiv E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne
      let B := fun i j => weightedBlock (coordinateConjugate L
        (matrixAction (F 1 : Mat6 K))) i j
      trace2 (B 0 1) ^ 2 - 4 * determinant (B 0 1) ≠ 0) :
    let L
proof:
:= weightedCoordinateEquiv E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne
    let L' := weightedCoordinateEquiv E' hEidem' hEsum' u' v' p hp' hpne
    let B := fun i j => weightedBlock (coordinateConjugate L (matrixAction (F 1 : Mat6 K))) i j
    let C := fun i j => weightedBlock (coordinateConjugate L' (matrixAction (F' 1 : Mat6 K))) i j
    ∃ T S : Mat2 K, T * S = 1 ∧ S * T = 1 ∧ ∀ i j, B i j = T * C i j * S := by
  dsimp only at hdisc ⊢
  obtain ⟨q, hdB, hdC, hrB, hcB, hrC, hcC, hsB, hsC⟩ :=
    actual_same_ledger_weighted_pair_data E F E' F' hEidem hEsum hFidem hFsum
      hEidem' hEsum' hFidem' hFsum' u v u' v' p hp hp' hpne
      hFu hFv hFu' hFv' hledger
  dsimp only at hdB hdC hrB hcB hrC hcC hsB hsC
  have hiB := actual_weighted_pivot_idempotent E (F 1) hEidem hEsum
    u v p hp hpne (hFidem 1)
  have hiC := actual_weighted_pivot_idempotent E' (F' 1) hEidem' hEsum'
    u' v' p hp' hpne (hFidem' 1)
  dsimp only at hiB hiC
  exact exists_pair_conjugator_of_actual_weighted_data _ _ p q hpne hp12
    hdB hdC hrB hcB hrC hcC hsB hsC hiB hiC hdisc

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SymplecticMatrixBridge.omega_alternating
statement: theorem omega_alternating (x : Vec6 K) : (omega (K := K)) x x = 0
proof:
:= by
  change omegaFun x x = 0
  simp [omegaFun, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SymplecticMatrixBridge.omega_basis_pair
statement:
theorem omega_basis_pair (i : Fin 3) :
    (omega (K := K)) (basisVector (Sum.inl i))
      (basisVector (Sum.inr i)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change omegaFun (basisVector (Sum.inl i)) (basisVector (Sum.inr i)) = 1
  fin_cases i <;> simp [omegaFun, basisVector, Fin.sum_univ_succ]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SymplecticMatrixBridge.omega_left_nondegenerate
statement: theorem omega_left_nondegenerate : IsLeftNondegenerate (omega (K := K))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro x hx
  have hex : ∃ i, x i ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h
    apply hx
    funext i
    exact not_not.mp (fun hi => h ⟨i, hi⟩)
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hex
  rcases i with i | i
  · refine ⟨basisVector (Sum.inr i), ?_⟩
    change omegaFun (basisVector (Sum.inr i)) x ≠ 0
    fin_cases i <;>
      simpa [omegaFun, basisVector, Fin.sum_univ_succ] using neg_ne_zero.mpr hi
  · refine ⟨basisVector (Sum.inl i), ?_⟩
    change omegaFun (basisVector (Sum.inl i)) x ≠ 0
    fin_cases i <;> simpa [omegaFun, basisVector, Fin.sum_univ_succ] using hi

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SymplecticMatrixBridge.omega_right_nondegenerate
statement: theorem omega_right_nondegenerate : IsRightNondegenerate (omega (K := K))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro x hx
  have hex : ∃ i, x i ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h
    apply hx
    funext i
    exact not_not.mp (fun hi => h ⟨i, hi⟩)
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hex
  rcases i with i | i
  · refine ⟨basisVector (Sum.inr i), ?_⟩
    change omegaFun x (basisVector (Sum.inr i)) ≠ 0
    fin_cases i <;> simpa [omegaFun, basisVector, Fin.sum_univ_succ] using hi
  · refine ⟨basisVector (Sum.inl i), ?_⟩
    change omegaFun x (basisVector (Sum.inl i)) ≠ 0
    fin_cases i <;>
      simpa [omegaFun, basisVector, Fin.sum_univ_succ] using neg_ne_zero.mpr hi

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SymplecticMatrixBridge.matrixAction_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem matrixAction_apply (P : Mat6 K) (x : Vec6 K) (i : Ix6) :
    matrixAction P x i = ∑ j, P i j * x j
proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SymplecticMatrixBridge.matrixAction_mul
statement:
theorem matrixAction_mul (P Q : Mat6 K) :
    matrixAction (P * Q) = (matrixAction P).comp (matrixAction Q)
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  funext i
  simp only [matrixAction_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, Matrix.mul_apply]
  simp_rw [Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k _
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SymplecticMatrixBridge.matrixAction_add
statement:
theorem matrixAction_add (P Q : Mat6 K) :
    matrixAction (P + Q) = matrixAction P + matrixAction Q
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  funext i
  simp [matrixAction, Finset.sum_add_distrib, add_mul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SymplecticMatrixBridge.matrixAction_one
statement: theorem matrixAction_one : matrixAction (1 : Mat6 K) = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  funext i
  classical
  simp [matrixAction, Matrix.one_apply]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SymplecticMatrixBridge.matrixAction_zero
statement: theorem matrixAction_zero : matrixAction (0 : Mat6 K) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  funext i
  simp [matrixAction]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SymplecticMatrixBridge.matrixAction_injective
statement: theorem matrixAction_injective : Function.Injective (matrixAction (K := K))
proof:
:= by
  intro P Q h
  ext i j
  have hcol := LinearMap.congr_fun h (basisVector j)
  have hij := congrFun hcol i
  rcases j with j | j <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simpa [matrixAction, basisVector, Fintype.sum_sum_type,
      Fin.sum_univ_succ] using hij

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SymplecticMatrixBridge.carrier_action_selfAdjoint
statement:
theorem carrier_action_selfAdjoint (P : Carrier K) :
    SymplecticProjectorFrame.IsSelfAdjoint (omega (K := K))
      (matrixAction (K := K) (P : Mat6 K))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, u, v, hP⟩ := exists_grouped P
  intro x y
  rw [hP]
  simp [omega, omegaFun, matrixAction, grouped, Fintype.sum_sum_type,
    Fin.sum_univ_succ, ScalarFibre.hat]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SymplecticMatrixBridge.carrier_projector_action_idempotent
statement:
theorem carrier_projector_action_idempotent (P : Carrier K)
    (hP : (P : Mat6 K) * P = P) :
    SymplecticProjectorFrame.IsIdempotent
      (matrixAction (K := K) (P : Mat6 K))
proof:
:= by
  change (matrixAction (K := K) (P : Mat6 K)).comp
    (matrixAction (K := K) (P : Mat6 K)) = matrixAction (K := K) (P : Mat6 K)
  rw [← matrixAction_mul]
  exact congrArg (matrixAction (K := K)) hP

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SymplecticMatrixBridge.carrier_frame_action_sum
statement:
theorem carrier_frame_action_sum
    (P : Fin 3 → Carrier K)
    (hsum : (P 0 : Mat6 K) + P 1 + P 2 = 1) :
    matrixAction (K := K) (P 0 : Mat6 K) +
        matrixAction (K := K) (P 1 : Mat6 K) +
        matrixAction (K := K) (P 2 : Mat6 K) =
      LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (matrixAction (K := K)) hsum
  rw [matrixAction_add, matrixAction_add, matrixAction_one] at h
  exact h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SymplecticMatrixBridge.carrier_action_ne_zero_of_trace_one
statement:
theorem carrier_action_ne_zero_of_trace_one (P : Carrier K)
    (htrace : jordanTrace (K := K) (P : Mat6 K) = 1) :
    matrixAction (K := K) (P : Mat6 K) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  have hPzero : (P : Mat6 K) = 0 := by
    apply matrixAction_injective
    rw [hzero, matrixAction_zero]
  rw [hPzero] at htrace
  simp [jordanTrace, Matrix.trace] at htrace

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GenericRawEmbedding.evalSchedule_rootSchedule_over_k
statement:
theorem evalSchedule_rootSchedule_over_k :
    evalSchedule k (rootCoefficientMap k) (rootSchedule k) =
      rootParameterMap k
proof:
:= by
  apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
  · intro a
    simp [evalSchedule, rootCoefficientMap]
  · intro q
    rcases q with ⟨r, s, c⟩
    rcases c with i | u
    · simp only [evalSchedule, MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_X', rootSchedule]
      change rootPEval k (direction ℚ r s i) =
        rootParameterMap k (direction k r s i)
      rw [← coefficientMap_direction k r s i,
        rootParameterMap_coefficientMap]
    · simp only [evalSchedule, MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_X', rootSchedule]
      change rootPEval k (coefficient ℚ r s) =
        rootParameterMap k (coefficient k r s)
      rw [← coefficientMap_coefficient k r s,
        rootParameterMap_coefficientMap]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GenericRawEmbedding.reducedToParameters_injective

    Function.Injective (reducedToParameters k)
proof:

  intro x y hxy
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective x
  obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective y
  change scheduleRawMap k p = scheduleRawMap k q at hxy
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  apply Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr
  rw [radical_eq_scheduleKernel]
  change scheduleRawMap k (p - q) = 0
  simpa only [map_sub, sub_eq_zero] using hxy

      rootCoefficientMap]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceChartDiagonalReadback.omitted_diagonal
statement:
theorem omitted_diagonal (q : ExplicitFrameChart K)
    (hq : EquationsVanish (explicitFrameEquationValues q)) :
    dA2 (parameters q) = q.diagA 2 ∧ dB2 (parameters q) = q.diagB 2
proof:
:= by
  rcases hq with ⟨hTA, _, _, hTB, _, _⟩
  change q.diagA 0 + q.diagA 1 + q.diagA 2 = 0 at hTA
  change q.diagB 0 + q.diagB 1 + q.diagB 2 = 0 at hTB
  constructor
  · change -q.diagA 0 - q.diagA 1 = q.diagA 2
    linear_combination -hTA
  · change -q.diagB 0 - q.diagB 1 = q.diagB 2
    linear_combination -hTB

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceChartDiagonalReadback.solve_diagonal_pair
statement:
theorem solve_diagonal_pair (d₁ d₂ S N x y : K)
    (hp : d₁ - d₂ ≠ 0) (hS : x + y = S)
    (hN : d₁ * x + d₂ * y = N) :
    (N - d₂ * S) / (d₁ - d₂) = x ∧
      S - (N - d₂ * S) / (d₁ - d₂) = y
proof:
:= by
  have hx : (N - d₂ * S) / (d₁ - d₂) = x := by
    apply (div_eq_iff hp).2
    linear_combination -hN + d₂ * hS
  refine ⟨hx, ?_⟩
  rw [hx]
  linear_combination -hS

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceChartDiagonalReadback.actual_diagonal_systems
statement:
theorem actual_diagonal_systems (q : ExplicitFrameChart K)
    (hr : q.r1 = 1)
    (hq : EquationsVanish (explicitFrameEquationValues q)) :
    matrixM q 0 0 + matrixM q 2 2 = spurSumA (parameters q) ∧
    q.diagA 1 * matrixM q 0 0 + q.diagA 2 * matrixM q 2 2 =
      normWeightedA (parameters q) ∧
    matrixM q 1 1 + matrixM q 3 3 = spurSumB (parameters q) ∧
    q.diagB 1 * matrixM q 1 1 + q.diagB 2 * matrixM q 3 3 =
      normWeightedB (parameters q)
proof:
:= by
  have hdiag := omitted_diagonal q hq
  rcases hq with ⟨_, hSA, hNA, _, hSB, hNB⟩
  simp only [explicitFrameEquationValues, hr, one_mul] at hSA hNA hSB hNB
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [spurSumA, hdiag.1]
    change matrixM q 0 0 + matrixM q 2 2 =
      q.diagA 0 * q.diagA 1 + q.diagA 0 * q.diagA 2 +
        q.diagA 1 * q.diagA 2 - q.z1 + 1
    linear_combination -hSA
  · rw [normWeightedA, hdiag.1]
    simp [rawOffDiag, parameters]
    linear_combination -hNA
  · rw [spurSumB, hdiag.2]
    change matrixM q 1 1 + matrixM q 3 3 =
      q.diagB 0 * q.diagB 1 + q.diagB 0 * q.diagB 2 +
        q.diagB 1 * q.diagB 2 - q.r2 * q.z2 + 1
    linear_combination -hSB
  · rw [normWeightedB, hdiag.2]
    simp [rawOffDiag, parameters]
    linear_combination -hNB

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3JordanFrameTransport.matrixJordan_self
statement: theorem matrixJordan_self (A : Mat3 R) : matrixJordan A A = A * A
proof:
:= by
  rw [matrixJordan, ← two_smul R (A * A), smul_smul,
    invOf_mul_self, one_smul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3JordanFrameTransport.isRawPrimitiveFrameFamily_transport
statement:
theorem isRawPrimitiveFrameFamily_transport
    (g : Sym3Coord R →ₗ[R] Sym3Coord R)
    (hgJordan : ∀ x y, g (jordan x y) = jordan (g x) (g y))
    (hgOne : g one = one)
    (hgTrace : ∀ x, matrixTrace (g x) = matrixTrace x)
    (P : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Mat3 R)
    (hP : IsRawPrimitiveFrameFamily P) :
    IsRawPrimitiveFrameFamily (transportFamily g P)
proof:
:= by
  have hinjective : Function.Injective (toSymMatrix : Sym3Coord R → Mat3 R) := by
    intro x y hxy
    rw [← fromMatrix_toSymMatrix x, ← fromMatrix_toSymMatrix y, hxy]
  have hPsymm (r i : Fin 3) : Matrix.transpose (P r i) = P r i := by
    ext a b
    exact hP.symmetric r i b a
  have hread (r i : Fin 3) :
      toSymMatrix (symCoordinates (P r i)) = P r i := by
    rw [toSymMatrix_symCoordinates, symmetrize_eq_self (hPsymm r i)]
  have hcoordIdem (r i : Fin 3) :
      jordan (symCoordinates (P r i)) (symCoordinates (P r i)) =
        symCoordinates (P r i) := by
    apply hinjective
    simp only [toSymMatrix_jordan, hread, matrixJordan_self, hP.idempotent]
  have hcoordSum (r : Fin 3) :
      ∑ i : Fin 3, symCoordinates (P r i) = one := by
    apply hinjective
    calc
      toSymMatrix (∑ i : Fin 3, symCoordinates (P r i)) =
          ∑ i : Fin 3, toSymMatrix (symCoordinates (P r i)) := by
            rw [← toSymMatrixLinear_apply, map_sum]
            rfl
      _ = ∑ i : Fin 3, P r i := by simp only [hread]
      _ = 1 := hP.sum_one r
      _ = toSymMatrix one := Sym3JordanCoordinates.toSymMatrix_one.symm
  constructor
  · intro r i a b
    have h := toSymMatrix_symmetric (g (symCoordinates (P r i)))
    exact congrFun (congrFun h b) a
  · intro r i
    let x := symCoordinates (P r i)
    let A := toSymMatrix (g x)
    have hj : jordan (g x) (g x) = g x := by
      rw [← hgJordan, hcoordIdem]
    have hmj : matrixJordan A A = A := by
      rw [← toSymMatrix_jordan]
      exact congrArg toSymMatrix hj
    change A * A = A
    rw [← matrixJordan_self]
    exact hmj
  · intro r i
    rw [transportFamily, trace_toSymMatrix, hgTrace,
      ← trace_toSymMatrix, hread, hP.trace_one]
  · intro r
    calc
      ∑ i : Fin 3, transportFamily g P r i =
          ∑ i : Fin 3, toSymMatrix (g (symCoordinates (P r i))) := rfl
      _ = toSymMatrix (∑ i : Fin 3, g (symCoordinates (P r i))) := by
        rw [← toSymMatrixLinear_apply, map_sum]
        rfl
      _ = toSymMatrix (g (∑ i : Fin 3, symCoordinates (P r i))) := by
        rw [map_sum]
      _ = toSymMatrix (g one) := by rw [hcoordSum]
      _ = toSymMatrix one := by rw [hgOne]
      _ = 1 := Sym3JordanCoordinates.toSymMatrix_one

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3JordanFrameTransport.isRawPrimitiveFrameFamily_transport_equiv
statement:
theorem isRawPrimitiveFrameFamily_transport_equiv
    (g : Sym3Coord R ≃ₗ[R] Sym3Coord R)
    (hgJordan : ∀ x y, g (jordan x y) = jordan (g x) (g y))
    (hgOne : g one = one)
    (hgTrace : ∀ x, matrixTrace (g x) = matrixTrace x)
    (P : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Mat3 R)
    (hP : IsRawPrimitiveFrameFamily P) :
    IsRawPrimitiveFrameFamily (transportFamily g.toLinearMap P)
proof:
:=
  isRawPrimitiveFrameFamily_transport g.toLinearMap hgJordan hgOne hgTrace P hP

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualPowerMeasurements.SectorIn.symm
statement:
theorem SectorIn.symm (F : Subfield K) (x y : JCoord K)
    (h : SectorIn F x y) : SectorIn F y x
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [SectorIn, BV_symmetric y.v x.v, BS_symmetric y.s x.s,
    BC_symmetric y.c x.c] using h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualPowerMeasurements.sector_pairings_mem
statement:
theorem sector_pairings_mem (F : Subfield K) (x y : JCoord K)
    (hx : DiagIn F x) (hy : DiagIn F y)
    (hxy : DiagIn F (sourceProduct x y)) : SectorIn F x y
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : (2 : K) ∈ F := natCast_mem F 2
  have pairSum (i : Fin 3) :
      2 * diagLinear i (sourceProduct x y) -
        2 * (diagLinear i x * diagLinear i y) ∈ F :=
    F.sub_mem (F.mul_mem h2 (hxy i)) (F.mul_mem h2 (F.mul_mem (hx i) (hy i)))
  have hVS : BV x.v y.v + BS x.s y.s ∈ F := by
    convert pairSum 2 using 1
    simp only [diagLinear_zero, diagLinear_one, diagLinear_two, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.cons_val_one,
      Matrix.cons_val_zero, sourceProduct_d3]
    ring
  have hSC : BS x.s y.s + BC x.c y.c ∈ F := by
    convert pairSum 0 using 1
    simp only [diagLinear_zero, diagLinear_one, diagLinear_two, Matrix.cons_val_zero, sourceProduct_d1]
    ring
  have hCV : BC x.c y.c + BV x.v y.v ∈ F := by
    convert pairSum 1 using 1
    simp only [diagLinear_zero, diagLinear_one, diagLinear_two, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_zero, sourceProduct_d2]
    ring
  exact triple_mem_of_pair_sums F _ _ _ hVS hSC hCV

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualPowerMeasurements.norms_mem
statement:
theorem norms_mem (F : Subfield K) (x : JCoord K)
    (hx : DiagIn F x) (hx2 : DiagIn F (sourceSquare x)) :
    nV x.v ∈ F ∧ nS x.s ∈ F ∧ nC x.c ∈ F
proof:
:= by
  have pairSum (i : Fin 3) :
      diagLinear i (sourceSquare x) - diagLinear i x ^ 2 ∈ F :=
    F.sub_mem (hx2 i) (F.pow_mem (hx i) 2)
  have hVS : nV x.v + nS x.s ∈ F := by
    convert pairSum 2 using 1
    simp [diagLinear, sourceSquare_d3]
    <;> ring
  have hSC : nS x.s + nC x.c ∈ F := by
    convert pairSum 0 using 1
    simp [diagLinear, sourceSquare_d1]
    <;> ring
  have hCV : nC x.c + nV x.v ∈ F := by
    convert pairSum 1 using 1
    simp [diagLinear, sourceSquare_d2]
    <;> ring
  exact triple_mem_of_pair_sums F _ _ _ hVS hSC hCV

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualPowerMeasurements.powers_diag_mem
statement:
theorem powers_diag_mem (F : Subfield K) (a b : JCoord K)
    (h : LedgerIn F (sourceLedger a b)) :
    (∀ p, DiagIn F (power a p)) ∧ (∀ q, DiagIn F (power b q))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro p i
    simpa only [power, Matrix.cons_val_zero, sourceProduct_one_right] using
      power_diagonal_mem F a b h i p 0
  · intro q i
    simpa only [power, Matrix.cons_val_zero, sourceProduct_one_left] using
      power_diagonal_mem F a b h i 0 q

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualPowerMeasurements.power_sectors_mem
statement:
theorem power_sectors_mem (F : Subfield K) (a b : JCoord K)
    (h : LedgerIn F (sourceLedger a b)) (p q : Fin 3) :
    SectorIn F (power a p) (power b q)
proof:
:=
  sector_pairings_mem F _ _ ((powers_diag_mem F a b h).1 p)
    ((powers_diag_mem F a b h).2 q)
    (fun i => power_diagonal_mem F a b h i p q)
