name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualPowerMeasurements.mixed_trialities_mem
statement:
theorem mixed_trialities_mem (F : Subfield K) (x y : JCoord K)
    (hx : DiagIn F x) (hxy : SectorIn F x y)
    (hx2y : SectorIn F (sourceSquare x) y) :
    triality y.v x.s x.c ∈ F ∧ triality x.v y.s x.c ∈ F ∧
      triality x.v x.s y.c ∈ F
proof:
:= by
  have hv := hx2y.1
  rw [sourceSquare_v, BV_add_left, BV_smul_left, muV_triality] at hv
  have hs := hx2y.2.1
  rw [sourceSquare_s, BS_add_left, BS_smul_left, muS_triality] at hs
  have hc := hx2y.2.2
  rw [sourceSquare_c, BC_add_left, BC_smul_left, muC_triality] at hc
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [diagLinear_zero, diagLinear_one, diagLinear_two, add_sub_cancel_left] using
      F.sub_mem hv (F.mul_mem (F.add_mem (hx 1) (hx 2)) hxy.1)
  · simpa only [diagLinear_zero, diagLinear_one, diagLinear_two, add_sub_cancel_left] using
      F.sub_mem hs (F.mul_mem (F.add_mem (hx 0) (hx 2)) hxy.2.1)
  · simpa only [diagLinear_zero, diagLinear_one, diagLinear_two, add_sub_cancel_left] using
      F.sub_mem hc (F.mul_mem (F.add_mem (hx 0) (hx 1)) hxy.2.2)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualPowerMeasurements.single_triality_mem
statement:
theorem single_triality_mem (F : Subfield K) (x : JCoord K)
    (hx : DiagIn F x) (hn : nV x.v ∈ F ∧ nS x.s ∈ F ∧ nC x.c ∈ F)
    (hN : sourceNorm x = 0) : triality x.v x.s x.c ∈ F
proof:
:= by
  have hformula : triality x.v x.s x.c =
      x.d1 * nV x.v + x.d2 * nS x.s + x.d3 * nC x.c -
        x.d1 * x.d2 * x.d3 := by
    dsimp only [sourceNorm] at hN
    linear_combination hN
  rw [hformula]
  exact F.sub_mem
    (F.add_mem (F.add_mem (F.mul_mem (hx 0) hn.1)
      (F.mul_mem (hx 1) hn.2.1)) (F.mul_mem (hx 2) hn.2.2))
    (F.mul_mem (F.mul_mem (hx 0) (hx 1)) (hx 2))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualPowerMeasurements.all_trialities_mem
statement:
theorem all_trialities_mem (F : Subfield K) (a b : JCoord K)
    (h : LedgerIn F (sourceLedger a b))
    (hNa : sourceNorm a = 0) (hNb : sourceNorm b = 0) :
    ∀ i j l : Fin 2, triality (![a.v, b.v] i) (![a.s, b.s] j)
      (![a.c, b.c] l) ∈ F
proof:
:= by
  have hd := powers_diag_mem F a b h
  have ha : DiagIn F a := hd.1 1
  have hb : DiagIn F b := hd.2 1
  have hab : SectorIn F a b := power_sectors_mem F a b h 1 1
  have hab3 := mixed_trialities_mem F a b ha hab (power_sectors_mem F a b h 2 1)
  have hba3 := mixed_trialities_mem F b a hb (SectorIn.symm F a b hab)
    (SectorIn.symm F a (sourceSquare b) (power_sectors_mem F a b h 1 2))
  have haa := single_triality_mem F a ha (norms_mem F a ha (hd.1 2)) hNa
  have hbb := single_triality_mem F b hb (norms_mem F b hb (hd.2 2)) hNb
  intro i j l
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> fin_cases l
  all_goals first
    | exact haa | exact hbb
    | exact hab3.1 | exact hab3.2.1 | exact hab3.2.2
    | exact hba3.1 | exact hba3.2.1 | exact hba3.2.2

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualPowerMeasurements.uV_centered
statement:
theorem uV_centered (a b : JCoord K) :
    normalizedUV a.s b.s a.c b.c =
      BV (sourceSquare a).v (sourceSquare b).v -
      lV a * BV a.v (sourceSquare b).v -
      lV b * BV (sourceSquare a).v b.v + lV a * lV b * BV a.v b.v
proof:
:= by
  simp only [normalizedUV, sourceSquare_v, BV_add_left, BV_add_right,
    BV_smul_left, BV_smul_right, lV]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualPowerMeasurements.uS_centered
statement:
theorem uS_centered (a b : JCoord K) :
    BS (sourceMuS a.c a.v) (sourceMuS b.c b.v) =
      BS (sourceSquare a).s (sourceSquare b).s -
      lS a * BS a.s (sourceSquare b).s -
      lS b * BS (sourceSquare a).s b.s + lS a * lS b * BS a.s b.s
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sourceSquare_s, BS_add_left, BS_add_right,
    BS_smul_left, BS_smul_right, lS]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualPowerMeasurements.uC_centered
statement:
theorem uC_centered (a b : JCoord K) :
    BC (sourceMuC a.v a.s) (sourceMuC b.v b.s) =
      BC (sourceSquare a).c (sourceSquare b).c -
      lC a * BC a.c (sourceSquare b).c -
      lC b * BC (sourceSquare a).c b.c + lC a * lC b * BC a.c b.c
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sourceSquare_c, BC_add_left, BC_add_right,
    BC_smul_left, BC_smul_right, lC]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualPowerMeasurements.centered_mem
statement:
theorem centered_mem (F : Subfield K) (la lb g11 g12 g21 g22 : K)
    (hla : la ∈ F) (hlb : lb ∈ F) (h11 : g11 ∈ F)
    (h12 : g12 ∈ F) (h21 : g21 ∈ F) (h22 : g22 ∈ F) :
    g22 - la * g12 - lb * g21 + la * lb * g11 ∈ F
proof:
:=
  F.add_mem (F.sub_mem (F.sub_mem h22 (F.mul_mem hla h12)) (F.mul_mem hlb h21))
    (F.mul_mem (F.mul_mem hla hlb) h11)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualPowerMeasurements.all_U_mem
statement:
theorem all_U_mem (F : Subfield K) (a b : JCoord K)
    (h : LedgerIn F (sourceLedger a b)) :
    normalizedUV a.s b.s a.c b.c ∈ F ∧
      BS (sourceMuS a.c a.v) (sourceMuS b.c b.v) ∈ F ∧
      BC (sourceMuC a.v a.s) (sourceMuC b.v b.s) ∈ F
proof:
:= by
  have hd := powers_diag_mem F a b h
  have ha : DiagIn F a := hd.1 1
  have hb : DiagIn F b := hd.2 1
  have h11 : SectorIn F a b := power_sectors_mem F a b h 1 1
  have h12 : SectorIn F a (sourceSquare b) := power_sectors_mem F a b h 1 2
  have h21 : SectorIn F (sourceSquare a) b := power_sectors_mem F a b h 2 1
  have h22 : SectorIn F (sourceSquare a) (sourceSquare b) := power_sectors_mem F a b h 2 2
  rw [uV_centered, uS_centered, uC_centered]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact centered_mem F _ _ _ _ _ _ (F.add_mem (ha 1) (ha 2))
      (F.add_mem (hb 1) (hb 2)) h11.1 h12.1 h21.1 h22.1
  · exact centered_mem F _ _ _ _ _ _ (F.add_mem (ha 0) (ha 2))
      (F.add_mem (hb 0) (hb 2)) h11.2.1 h12.2.1 h21.2.1 h22.2.1
  · exact centered_mem F _ _ _ _ _ _ (F.add_mem (ha 0) (ha 1))
      (F.add_mem (hb 0) (hb 1)) h11.2.2 h12.2.2 h21.2.2 h22.2.2

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SimilitudeConjugation.left_form
statement:
theorem left_form (hMN : M * N = 1)
    (hform : M.transpose * symplecticJ * M = c • symplecticJ) :
    M.transpose * symplecticJ = c • (symplecticJ * N)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    M.transpose * symplecticJ = M.transpose * symplecticJ * (M * N) := by
      rw [hMN, Matrix.mul_one]
    _ = (M.transpose * symplecticJ * M) * N := by
      simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = (c • symplecticJ) * N := by rw [hform]
    _ = c • (symplecticJ * N) := by rw [Matrix.smul_mul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SimilitudeConjugation.scaled_right_form
statement:
theorem scaled_right_form (hMN : M * N = 1)
    (hform : M.transpose * symplecticJ * M = c • symplecticJ) :
    c • (N.transpose * symplecticJ) = symplecticJ * M
proof:
:= by
  calc
    c • (N.transpose * symplecticJ) = N.transpose * (c • symplecticJ) := by
      rw [Matrix.mul_smul]
    _ = N.transpose * (M.transpose * symplecticJ * M) := by rw [hform]
    _ = (M * N).transpose * symplecticJ * M := by
      simp only [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = symplecticJ * M := by rw [hMN, Matrix.transpose_one, Matrix.one_mul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SimilitudeConjugation.inverse_form
statement:
theorem inverse_form (hMN : M * N = 1) (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (hform : M.transpose * symplecticJ * M = c • symplecticJ) :
    N.transpose * symplecticJ * N = c⁻¹ • symplecticJ
proof:
:= by
  have hr := congrArg (fun A : Mat6 K => A * N)
    (scaled_right_form M N c hMN hform)
  have hscaled : c • (N.transpose * symplecticJ * N) = symplecticJ := by
    simpa only [Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc, hMN, Matrix.mul_one] using hr
  calc
    N.transpose * symplecticJ * N = (1 : K) • (N.transpose * symplecticJ * N) := by simp
    _ = (c⁻¹ * c) • (N.transpose * symplecticJ * N) := by rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ hc]
    _ = c⁻¹ • (c • (N.transpose * symplecticJ * N)) := by rw [smul_smul]
    _ = c⁻¹ • symplecticJ := by rw [hscaled]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SimilitudeConjugation.conjugate_mem
statement:
theorem conjugate_mem (hMN : M * N = 1)
    (hform : M.transpose * symplecticJ * M = c • symplecticJ)
    (P : Carrier K) : IsSelfAdjoint (M * (P : Mat6 K) * N)
proof:
:= by
  have hl := left_form M N c hMN hform
  have hr := scaled_right_form M N c hMN hform
  change (M * (P : Mat6 K) * N).transpose * symplecticJ =
    symplecticJ * (M * (P : Mat6 K) * N)
  rw [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_mul]
  calc
    N.transpose * ((P : Mat6 K).transpose * M.transpose) * symplecticJ =
        N.transpose * (P : Mat6 K).transpose *
          (M.transpose * symplecticJ) := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = N.transpose * (P : Mat6 K).transpose *
          (c • (symplecticJ * N)) := by rw [hl]
    _ = c • (N.transpose * ((P : Mat6 K).transpose * symplecticJ) * N) := by
      simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul]
    _ = c • (N.transpose * (symplecticJ * (P : Mat6 K)) * N) := by
      rw [carrier_property P]
    _ = (c • (N.transpose * symplecticJ)) * (P : Mat6 K) * N := by
      simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.smul_mul]
    _ = symplecticJ * M * (P : Mat6 K) * N := by rw [hr]
    _ = symplecticJ * (M * (P : Mat6 K) * N) := by
      simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SimilitudeConjugation.conjugateLinear_coe
statement:
@[simp] theorem conjugateLinear_coe (hMN : M * N = 1)
    (hform : M.transpose * symplecticJ * M = c • symplecticJ) (P : Carrier K) :
    ((conjugateLinear M N c hMN hform P : Carrier K) : Mat6 K) = M * P * N
proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealCayleyExtensionCoverage.exists_common_extension_cayley_parameters
statement:
theorem exists_common_extension_cayley_parameters
    {rho : Type v} [Fintype rho]
    (P : rho → Fin 3 → Mat3 K)
    (hsymm : ∀ r i, Matrix.transpose (P r i) = P r i)
    (hidem : ∀ r i, P r i * P r i = P r i)
    (htrace : ∀ r i, Matrix.trace (P r i) = 1)
    (hsum : ∀ r, P r 0 + P r 1 + P r 2 = 1) :
    ∃ (L : Type u) (_ : Field L) (f : K →+* L)
      (a b c : rho → L),
      (∀ r, Matrix.det (1 + skew (a r) (b r) (c r)) ≠ 0) ∧
      (∀ r, IsOrthogonal (cayley (skew (a r) (b r) (c r)))) ∧
      (∀ r i, columnProjector (cayley (skew (a r) (b r) (c r))) i =
        f.mapMatrix (P r i))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  choose pivot hpivot using fun r i => exists_nonzero_diagonal (P r i) (htrace r i)
  let q : rho × Fin 3 → K := fun x => P x.1 x.2 (pivot x.1 x.2) (pivot x.1 x.2)
  obtain ⟨F⟩ := rootField_nonempty_of_fintype K q
  letI : CharZero F.Carrier := charZero_of_embedding F.embedding
  let PE : rho → Fin 3 → Mat3 F.Carrier :=
    fun r i => F.embedding.mapMatrix (P r i)
  have hsymmE : ∀ r i, Matrix.transpose (PE r i) = PE r i := by
    intro r i
    ext x y
    change F.embedding (P r i y x) = F.embedding (P r i x y)
    exact congrArg F.embedding (congrFun (congrFun (hsymm r i) x) y)
  have hidemE : ∀ r i, PE r i * PE r i = PE r i := by
    intro r i
    calc
      PE r i * PE r i = F.embedding.mapMatrix (P r i * P r i) := by
        exact (map_mul F.embedding.mapMatrix (P r i) (P r i)).symm
      _ = PE r i := by rw [hidem r i]
  have htraceE : ∀ r i, Matrix.trace (PE r i) = 1 := by
    intro r i
    change Matrix.trace ((P r i).map F.embedding) = 1
    rw [← AddMonoidHom.map_trace, htrace r i, map_one]
  have hsumE : ∀ r, PE r 0 + PE r 1 + PE r 2 = 1 := by
    intro r
    calc
      PE r 0 + PE r 1 + PE r 2 =
          F.embedding.mapMatrix (P r 0 + P r 1 + P r 2) := by
        simp only [PE, map_add]
      _ = 1 := by rw [hsum r, map_one]
  have hrootE : ∀ r i, ∃ j : Fin 3, ∃ t : F.Carrier,
      PE r i j j ≠ 0 ∧ t ^ 2 = PE r i j j := by
    intro r i
    refine ⟨pivot r i, F.roots (r, i), ?_, ?_⟩
    · change F.embedding (P r i (pivot r i) (pivot r i)) ≠ 0
      intro hz
      exact hpivot r i (F.embedding.injective (by simpa only [map_zero] using hz))
    · change F.roots (r, i) ^ 2 = F.embedding (q (r, i))
      exact F.roots_sq (r, i)
  choose X hX hXP using fun r =>
    exists_orthogonal_of_symmetric_primitive_frame_finite_roots
      (PE r) (hsymmE r) (hidemE r) (htraceE r) (hsumE r) (hrootE r)
  choose B hB hBX hBden using fun r =>
    exists_orthogonal_same_projectors_det_one_add_ne_zero (X r) (hX r)
  let A : rho → Mat3 F.Carrier := fun r => cayley (B r)
  have hAskew : ∀ r, IsSkew (A r) := fun r =>
    cayley_skew_of_orthogonal (hB r) (hBden r)
  have hcoords : ∀ r, skew (A r 0 1) (A r 0 2) (A r 1 2) = A r :=
    fun r => skew_coordinates (hAskew r)
  refine ⟨F.Carrier, F.instField, F.embedding,
    fun r => A r 0 1, fun r => A r 0 2, fun r => A r 1 2, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro r
    rw [hcoords r]
    exact det_one_add_cayley_ne_zero (hBden r)
  · intro r
    rw [hcoords r, cayley_cayley (hBden r)]
    exact hB r
  · intro r i
    rw [hcoords r, cayley_cayley (hBden r), hBX r i, hXP r i]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ProductDiagonal.sourceSquare_add
statement:
theorem sourceSquare_add (x y : JCoord K) :
    sourceSquare (x + y) =
      sourceSquare x + sourceSquare y + (2 : K) • sourceProduct x y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sourceSquare, sourceProduct_add_left, sourceProduct_add_right,
    sourceProduct_comm y x, two_smul]
  abel

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ProductDiagonal.sourceProduct_d1
statement:
theorem sourceProduct_d1 (x y : JCoord K) :
    (sourceProduct x y).d1 = x.d1 * y.d1 +
      (BS x.s y.s + BC x.c y.c) / 2
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg JCoord.d1 (sourceSquare_add x y)
  simp only [add_d1, smul_d1, smul_eq_mul, sourceSquare_d1,
    add_s, add_c, nS_add, nC_add] at h
  linear_combination -(1 / 2 : K) * h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ProductDiagonal.sourceProduct_d2
statement:
theorem sourceProduct_d2 (x y : JCoord K) :
    (sourceProduct x y).d2 = x.d2 * y.d2 +
      (BC x.c y.c + BV x.v y.v) / 2
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg JCoord.d2 (sourceSquare_add x y)
  simp only [add_d2, smul_d2, smul_eq_mul, sourceSquare_d2,
    add_c, add_v, nC_add, nV_add] at h
  linear_combination -(1 / 2 : K) * h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ProductDiagonal.sourceProduct_d3
statement:
theorem sourceProduct_d3 (x y : JCoord K) :
    (sourceProduct x y).d3 = x.d3 * y.d3 +
      (BV x.v y.v + BS x.s y.s) / 2
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg JCoord.d3 (sourceSquare_add x y)
  simp only [add_d3, smul_d3, smul_eq_mul, sourceSquare_d3,
    add_v, add_s, nV_add, nS_add] at h
  linear_combination -(1 / 2 : K) * h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ProductDiagonal.sourceTraceForm_diagonal_left
statement:
theorem sourceTraceForm_diagonal_left (a b c : K) (x : JCoord K) :
    sourceTraceForm (diagonal a b c) x =
      a * x.d1 + b * x.d2 + c * x.d3
proof:
:= by
  simp [sourceTraceForm_formula, diagonal]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3JordanTrace.trace_leftMul
statement:
theorem trace_leftMul (x : Sym3Coord K) :
    LinearMap.trace K (Sym3Coord K) (leftMul x) = 2 * matrixTrace x
proof:
:= by
  rw [LinearMap.trace_eq_matrix_trace K (Pi.basisFun K (Fin 6))]
  simp [Matrix.trace, leftMul, jordan, fromMatrix, matrixTrace,
    Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  simp only [TitsTracePairing.matrixJordan, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.mul_apply]
  simp [toSymMatrix, Pi.single_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ,
    Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.vecHead, Matrix.vecTail]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3JordanTrace.leftMul_conj
statement:
private theorem leftMul_conj (g : Aut (K := K)) (x : Sym3Coord K) :
    leftMul (g x) = g.linear.conj (leftMul x)
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro y
  change jordan (g x) y = g.linear (jordan x (g.linear.symm y))
  rw [g.map_jordan]
  simp

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3JordanTrace.matrixTrace_invariant
statement:
theorem matrixTrace_invariant (g : Aut (K := K)) (x : Sym3Coord K) :
    matrixTrace (g x) = matrixTrace x
proof:
:= by
  have h := LinearMap.trace_conj' (leftMul x) g.linear
  rw [← leftMul_conj g x, trace_leftMul, trace_leftMul] at h
  exact (mul_left_cancel₀ (by norm_num : (2 : K) ≠ 0)) h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.DetectorPolynomial.pEval_pProd
statement:
theorem pEval_pProd (t : ℚ) (x y : PCoord) :
    pEval t (pProd x y) =
      structuredProduct (pEval t x) (pEval t y)
proof:
:= by
  funext k
  rw [structuredProduct_eq_tensor]
  simp only [pEval, pProd, AlbertLean.Generated.tensorProduct,
    Polynomial.eval_finsetSum, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.DetectorPolynomial.pEval_sub
statement:
theorem pEval_sub (t : ℚ) (x y : PCoord) :
    pEval t (x - y) = pEval t x - pEval t y
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  simp [pEval]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.DetectorPolynomial.pEval_pConst
statement:
theorem pEval_pConst (t : ℚ) (x : Coord) :
    pEval t (pConst x) = x
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  change (C (x i)).eval t = x i
  exact Polynomial.eval_C

name: AlbertLean.Generic.DetectorPolynomial.eval_pTrace
statement:
theorem eval_pTrace (t : ℚ) (x : PCoord) :
    (pTrace x).eval t = traceN (pEval t x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [traceN_eq_coords]
  simp only [pTrace, pEval, Polynomial.eval_add]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.DetectorPolynomial.pEval_pW0
statement:
theorem pEval_pW0 (t : ℚ) (E F K : PCoord) :
    pEval t (pW0 E F K) =
      W0 ⟨pEval t E, pEval t F, pEval t K⟩
proof:
:= by
  calc
    pEval t (pW0 E F K) =
        pEval t (pProd E (pProd F K)) -
          pEval t (pProd F (pProd E K)) := by
      rw [pW0, pEval_sub]
    _ = structuredProduct (pEval t E)
          (structuredProduct (pEval t F) (pEval t K)) -
        structuredProduct (pEval t F)
          (structuredProduct (pEval t E) (pEval t K)) := by
      rw [pEval_pProd, pEval_pProd, pEval_pProd, pEval_pProd]
    _ = W0 ⟨pEval t E, pEval t F, pEval t K⟩ := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.DetectorPolynomial.eval_pDetector
statement:
theorem eval_pDetector (t : ℚ) (E F K : PCoord) :
    (pDetector E F K).eval t =
      traceCubeDetector ⟨pEval t E, pEval t F, pEval t K⟩
proof:
:= by
  simp only [pDetector]
  rw [eval_pTrace, pEval_pProd, pEval_pProd]
  simp only [pEval_pW0]
  exact traceN_structuredProduct_eq_traceForm
    (W0 ⟨pEval t E, pEval t F, pEval t K⟩)
    (structuredProduct
      (W0 ⟨pEval t E, pEval t F, pEval t K⟩)
      (W0 ⟨pEval t E, pEval t F, pEval t K⟩))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.CommutatorGeometry.commutator_skewAdjoint
statement:
theorem commutator_skewAdjoint
    (B : V →ₗ[R] V →ₗ[R] R) (A C : V →ₗ[R] V)
    (hA : ∀ u v, B (A u) v = B u (A v))
    (hC : ∀ u v, B (C u) v = B u (C v)) (u v : V) :
    B ((A.comp C - C.comp A) u) v =
      -B u ((A.comp C - C.comp A) v)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, map_sub]
  rw [hA (C u) v, hC u (A v), hC (A u) v, hA u (C v)]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.CommutatorGeometry.tracePairing_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem tracePairing_apply (x y : Coord) :
    tracePairing x y = traceForm x y
proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.CommutatorGeometry.leftMultiplication_selfAdjoint
statement:
theorem leftMultiplication_selfAdjoint (x z w : Coord) :
    traceForm (structuredProduct x z) w =
      traceForm z (structuredProduct x w)
proof:
:= by
  rw [productCommutative x z, traceFormAssociative]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.CommutatorGeometry.innerCommutator_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem innerCommutator_apply (x y z : Coord) :
    innerCommutator x y z =
      structuredProduct x (structuredProduct y z) -
        structuredProduct y (structuredProduct x z)
proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.CommutatorGeometry.innerCommutator_skewAdjoint
statement:
theorem innerCommutator_skewAdjoint (x y z w : Coord) :
    traceForm (innerCommutator x y z) w =
      -traceForm z (innerCommutator x y w)
proof:
:= by
  exact commutator_skewAdjoint tracePairing
    (leftMulLinear productQBilinear x) (leftMulLinear productQBilinear y)
    (leftMultiplication_selfAdjoint x) (leftMultiplication_selfAdjoint y) z w

name: AlbertLean.Generic.CommutatorGeometry.innerCommutator_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem innerCommutator_one (x y : Coord) :
    innerCommutator x y one = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [innerCommutator_apply, (unitLaw y).2, (unitLaw x).2,
    productCommutative x y, sub_self]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.CommutatorGeometry.traceN_innerCommutator
statement:
theorem traceN_innerCommutator (x y z : Coord) :
    traceN (innerCommutator x y z) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := innerCommutator_skewAdjoint x y z one
  rw [innerCommutator_one, traceForm_symmetric _ one,
    traceForm_one_eq_traceN] at h
  have hz : traceForm z 0 = 0 := (tracePairingRight z).map_zero
  rw [hz, neg_zero] at h
  exact h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.CommutatorGeometry.traceForm_self_innerCommutator
statement:
theorem traceForm_self_innerCommutator (x y z : Coord) :
    traceForm z (innerCommutator x y z) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := innerCommutator_skewAdjoint x y z z
  rw [traceForm_symmetric (innerCommutator x y z) z] at h
  linarith

name: AlbertLean.Generic.CommutatorGeometry.W0_eq_innerCommutator
statement:
theorem W0_eq_innerCommutator (X : WitnessTriple) :
    W0 X = innerCommutator X.cE X.cF X.cK
proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.CommutatorGeometry.detectorFactorThree_unconditional
statement:
theorem detectorFactorThree_unconditional (X : WitnessTriple) :
    traceCubeDetector X = 3 * cubicNormDetector X
proof:
:= by
  apply detectorFactorThree X
  rw [W0_eq_innerCommutator]
  exact traceN_innerCommutator X.cE X.cF X.cK

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ReflectionCompanionDetector.det_Li_mul_det_Di
statement:
private theorem det_Li_mul_det_Di (a : K) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    Matrix.det (Li a) * Matrix.det (Di a) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [Li, Di, Matrix.det_diagonal, Fin.prod_univ_succ]
  calc
    a⁻¹ * a⁻¹ * (a * a) = (a⁻¹ * a) * (a⁻¹ * a) := by ring
    _ = 1 := by rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ ha]; simp

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ReflectionCompanionDetector.deltaStar_reflect
statement:
private theorem deltaStar_reflect (a : K) (ha : a ≠ 0) (P : ResidualPair K) :
    deltaStar (reflect a P) = delta P
proof:
:= by
  simp only [deltaStar, reflect, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_transpose]
  calc
    Matrix.det (Li a) * Matrix.det P.X * Matrix.det (Di a) =
        (Matrix.det (Li a) * Matrix.det (Di a)) * Matrix.det P.X := by ring
    _ = Matrix.det P.X := by rw [det_Li_mul_det_Di a ha, one_mul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ReflectionCompanionDetector.residualOpen_reflect
statement:
private theorem residualOpen_reflect (a : K) (ha : a ≠ 0) (P : ResidualPair K)
    (hP : ResidualOpen P) : ResidualOpen (reflect a P)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [delta_reflect a ha]
    simpa only [deltaStar] using hP.2
  · rw [deltaStar_reflect a ha]
    exact hP.1

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ReflectionCompanionDetector.residualOpen_reflectChart
statement:
theorem residualOpen_reflectChart (a : K) (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (q : ExplicitFrameChart K) (hopen : ResidualOpen (residualPairOfChart q)) :
    ResidualOpen (residualPairOfChart (reflectChart a q))
proof:
:= by
  rw [residualPair_reflectChart a ha]
  exact residualOpen_reflect a ha (residualPairOfChart q) hopen

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ReflectionCompanionDetector.rootSwap_reflect_related
statement:
private theorem rootSwap_reflect_related (a : K) (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (P : ResidualPair K) (hP : ResidualOpen P) :
    Related
      (rootSwappedRepresentative (reflect a P)
        (residualOpen_reflect a ha P hP))
      (reflect a (rootSwappedRepresentative P hP))
proof:
:= by
  let R := reflect a P
  let S := rootSwappedRepresentative P hP
  let hR : ResidualOpen R := residualOpen_reflect a ha P hP
  have hS : ResidualOpen S := rootSwappedRepresentative_open P hP
  have hS_moment : moment S = moment P := by
    simpa only [S, baseMoment] using rootSwappedRepresentative_baseMoment P hP
  have hRS : ResidualOpen (rootSwappedRepresentative R hR) :=
    rootSwappedRepresentative_open R hR
  have hT : ResidualOpen (reflect a S) := residualOpen_reflect a ha S hS
  apply (related_iff_same_moment_delta _ _ hRS.1 hT.1).2
  constructor
  · calc
      moment (rootSwappedRepresentative R hR) = moment R := by
        simpa only [baseMoment] using rootSwappedRepresentative_baseMoment R hR
      _ = Li a * (moment P).transpose * L a := moment_reflect a ha P
      _ = Li a * (moment S).transpose * L a := by
        rw [hS_moment]
      _ = moment (reflect a S) := (moment_reflect a ha S).symm
  · calc
      delta (rootSwappedRepresentative R hR) = deltaStar R :=
        rootSwappedRepresentative_delta R hR
      _ = delta P := deltaStar_reflect a ha P
      _ = deltaStar S := (rootSwappedRepresentative_deltaStar P hP).symm
      _ = delta (reflect a S) := by
        simpa only [deltaStar] using (delta_reflect a ha S).symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ReflectionCompanionDetector.detector_eq_of_related_retained
statement:
private theorem detector_eq_of_related_retained
    (x y : ExplicitFrameChart K)
    (hdelta : delta (residualPairOfChart x) ≠ 0)
    (hrelated : Related (residualPairOfChart x) (residualPairOfChart y))
    (hdiagA : x.diagA = y.diagA) (hdiagB : x.diagB = y.diagB)
    (hr1 : x.r1 = y.r1) (hz1 : x.z1 = y.z1)
    (hr2 : x.r2 = y.r2) (hz2 : x.z2 = y.z2) :
    sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1) (encoderA x) (encoderB x) =
      sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1) (encoderA y) (encoderB y)
proof:
:= by
  have hinv := related_preserves_invariants hrelated
  have hdelta' : delta (residualPairOfChart y) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← hinv.2.1]
    exact hdelta
  rw [sourceDetector_eq_normalized x hdelta,
    sourceDetector_eq_normalized y hdelta', hdiagA, hdiagB, hr1, hz1, hr2, hz2,
    hinv.1, hinv.2.1]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ReflectionCompanionDetector.companion_detector_reflectChart
statement:
theorem companion_detector_reflectChart (a : K) (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (q : ExplicitFrameChart K) (hopen : ResidualOpen (residualPairOfChart q)) :
    sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1)
        (encoderA (companion (reflectChart a q)
          (residualOpen_reflectChart a ha q hopen)))
        (encoderB (companion (reflectChart a q)
          (residualOpen_reflectChart a ha q hopen))) =
      sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1)
        (encoderA (companion q hopen)) (encoderB (companion q hopen))
proof:
:= by
  let hreflect : ResidualOpen (reflect a (residualPairOfChart q)) :=
    residualOpen_reflect a ha (residualPairOfChart q) hopen
  let hreflectChart : ResidualOpen (residualPairOfChart (reflectChart a q)) :=
    residualOpen_reflectChart a ha q hopen
  let hleft : ResidualOpen
      (rootSwappedRepresentative (reflect a (residualPairOfChart q)) hreflect) :=
    rootSwappedRepresentative_open _ hreflect
  have hleftPair :
      residualPairOfChart (companion (reflectChart a q) hreflectChart) =
        rootSwappedRepresentative (reflect a (residualPairOfChart q)) hreflect := by
    simp only [companion, residualPairOfChart_chartWithResidualPair,
      residualPair_reflectChart a ha]
  have hrightPair :
      residualPairOfChart (reflectChart a (companion q hopen)) =
        reflect a (rootSwappedRepresentative (residualPairOfChart q) hopen) := by
    rw [residualPair_reflectChart a ha]
    simp only [companion, residualPairOfChart_chartWithResidualPair]
  have hleftDelta :
      delta (residualPairOfChart (companion (reflectChart a q) hreflectChart)) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hleftPair]
    exact hleft.1
  have hrelated : Related
      (residualPairOfChart (companion (reflectChart a q) hreflectChart))
      (residualPairOfChart (reflectChart a (companion q hopen))) := by
    rw [hleftPair, hrightPair]
    exact rootSwap_reflect_related a ha (residualPairOfChart q) hopen
  have htransport := detector_eq_of_related_retained
    (companion (reflectChart a q) hreflectChart) (reflectChart a (companion q hopen))
    hleftDelta hrelated rfl rfl rfl rfl rfl rfl
  calc
    _ = sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1)
        (encoderA (reflectChart a (companion q hopen)))
        (encoderB (reflectChart a (companion q hopen))) := htransport
    _ = _ := detector_reflectChart a ha (companion q hopen)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ReflectionCompanionDetector.detector_pair_reflectChart
statement:
theorem detector_pair_reflectChart (a : K) (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (q : ExplicitFrameChart K) (hopen : ResidualOpen (residualPairOfChart q)) :
    sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1)
        (encoderA (reflectChart a q)) (encoderB (reflectChart a q)) =
      sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1) (encoderA q) (encoderB q) ∧
    sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1)
        (encoderA (companion (reflectChart a q)
          (residualOpen_reflectChart a ha q hopen)))
        (encoderB (companion (reflectChart a q)
          (residualOpen_reflectChart a ha q hopen))) =
      sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1)
        (encoderA (companion q hopen)) (encoderB (companion q hopen))
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨detector_reflectChart a ha q,
    companion_detector_reflectChart a ha q hopen⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericReflectionGauge.thetaV_add
statement:
theorem thetaV_add (a : K) (v w : VCoord K) :
    thetaV a (v + w) = thetaV a v + thetaV a w
proof:
:= by
  apply VCoord.ext
  · simp [thetaV, add_div]
  · simp [thetaV, mul_add]
  · funext i
    cases i <;> simp [thetaV, add_div, mul_add, add_comm]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericReflectionGauge.thetaS_add
statement:
theorem thetaS_add (a : K) (s t : SCoord K) :
    thetaS a (s + t) = thetaS a s + thetaS a t
proof:
:= by
  apply SCoord.ext <;> funext i <;> fin_cases i <;>
    simp [thetaS, add_div, mul_add]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericReflectionGauge.thetaC_add
statement:
theorem thetaC_add (a : K) (c d : CCoord K) :

proof:
:= by
  apply CCoord.ext <;> funext i <;> fin_cases i <;>
    simp [thetaC, add_div, mul_add]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericReflectionGauge.thetaV_smul
statement:
theorem thetaV_smul (a b : K) (v : VCoord K) :
    thetaV a (b • v) = b • thetaV a v
proof:
:= by
  apply VCoord.ext
  · simp [thetaV, smul_eq_mul, mul_div_assoc]
  · simp [thetaV, smul_eq_mul, mul_left_comm]
  · funext i
    cases i <;> simp [thetaV, smul_eq_mul, mul_div_assoc, mul_left_comm]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericReflectionGauge.thetaS_smul
statement:
theorem thetaS_smul (a b : K) (s : SCoord K) :
    thetaS a (b • s) = b • thetaS a s
proof:
:= by
  apply SCoord.ext <;> funext i <;> fin_cases i <;>
    simp [thetaS, smul_eq_mul, mul_div_assoc, mul_left_comm]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericReflectionGauge.thetaC_smul
statement:
theorem thetaC_smul (a b : K) (c : CCoord K) :
    thetaC a (b • c) = b • thetaC a c
proof:
:= by
  apply CCoord.ext <;> funext i <;> fin_cases i <;>
    simp [thetaC, smul_eq_mul, mul_div_assoc, mul_left_comm]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericReflectionGauge.theta_add
statement:
theorem theta_add (a : K) (x y : JCoord K) :
    theta a (x + y) = theta a x + theta a y
proof:
:= by
  apply JCoord.ext <;> simp [theta, thetaV_add, thetaS_add, thetaC_add]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericReflectionGauge.theta_smul
statement:
theorem theta_smul (a b : K) (x : JCoord K) :
    theta a (b • x) = b • theta a x
proof:
:= by
  apply JCoord.ext <;> simp [theta, thetaV_smul, thetaS_smul, thetaC_smul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericReflectionGauge.thetaV_involutive
statement:
theorem thetaV_involutive (a : K) (ha : a ≠ 0) (v : VCoord K) :
    thetaV a (thetaV a v) = v
proof:
:= by
  apply VCoord.ext
  · simp [thetaV, ha] <;> field_simp
  · simp [thetaV, ha] <;> field_simp
  · funext i
    cases i <;> simp [thetaV, ha] <;> field_simp

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericReflectionGauge.thetaS_involutive
statement:
theorem thetaS_involutive (a : K) (ha : a ≠ 0) (s : SCoord K) :
    thetaS a (thetaS a s) = s
proof:
:= by
  apply SCoord.ext <;> funext i <;> fin_cases i <;> simp [thetaS, ha] <;> field_simp

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericReflectionGauge.thetaC_involutive
statement:
theorem thetaC_involutive (a : K) (ha : a ≠ 0) (c : CCoord K) :
    thetaC a (thetaC a c) = c
proof:
:= by
  apply CCoord.ext <;> funext i <;> fin_cases i <;> simp [thetaC, ha] <;> field_simp

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericReflectionGauge.theta_involutive
statement:
theorem theta_involutive (a : K) (ha : a ≠ 0) (x : JCoord K) :
    theta a (theta a x) = x
proof:
:= by
  exact JCoord.ext rfl rfl rfl (thetaV_involutive a ha x.v)
    (thetaS_involutive a ha x.s) (thetaC_involutive a ha x.c)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericReflectionGauge.linearEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem linearEquiv_apply (a : K) (ha : a ≠ 0) (x : JCoord K) :
    linearEquiv a ha x = theta a x
proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericReflectionGauge.nV_thetaV
statement:
theorem nV_thetaV (a : K) (ha : a ≠ 0) (v : VCoord K) :
    nV (thetaV a v) = nV v
proof:
:= by
  simp only [nV, pf_coordinate, thetaV]
  field_simp [ha] <;> ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericReflectionGauge.nS_thetaS
statement:
theorem nS_thetaS (a : K) (ha : a ≠ 0) (s : SCoord K) :
    nS (thetaS a s) = nS s
proof:
:= by
  simp [nS, evalU, thetaS]
  field_simp [ha] <;> ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericReflectionGauge.nC_thetaC
statement:
theorem nC_thetaC (a : K) (ha : a ≠ 0) (c : CCoord K) :
    nC (thetaC a c) = nC c
proof:
:= by
  simp [nC, evalU, thetaC]
  field_simp [ha] <;> ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericReflectionGauge.scalar_first_theta
statement:
theorem scalar_first_theta (a : K) (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (v : VCoord K) (s : SCoord K) (c : CCoord K) :
    (thetaV a v).r * evalU (thetaS a s).phi (thetaC a c).q =
      v.z * evalU c.psi s.p
proof:
:= by
  simp [thetaV, thetaS, thetaC, evalU]
  field_simp [ha] <;> ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericReflectionGauge.scalar_second_theta
statement:
theorem scalar_second_theta (a : K) (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (v : VCoord K) (s : SCoord K) (c : CCoord K) :
    (thetaV a v).z * evalU (thetaC a c).psi (thetaS a s).p =
      v.r * evalU s.phi c.q
proof:
:= by
  have h := scalar_first_theta a ha (thetaV a v) (thetaS a s) (thetaC a c)
  simpa only [thetaV_involutive a ha, thetaS_involutive a ha,
    thetaC_involutive a ha] using h.symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericReflectionGauge.BW_theta
statement:
theorem BW_theta (a : K) (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (v : VCoord K) (s : SCoord K) (c : CCoord K) :
    BW (thetaV a v).omega (wedge2 (thetaS a s).p (thetaC a c).q) =
      pairW v.omega (dualWedge2 s.phi c.psi)
proof:
:= by
  simp [thetaV, thetaS, thetaC, BW, wedge2, pairW, dualWedge2]
  field_simp [ha] <;> ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericReflectionGauge.pairW_theta
statement:
theorem pairW_theta (a : K) (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (v : VCoord K) (s : SCoord K) (c : CCoord K) :
    pairW (thetaV a v).omega (dualWedge2 (thetaS a s).phi (thetaC a c).psi) =
      BW v.omega (wedge2 s.p c.q)
proof:
:= by
  have h := BW_theta a ha (thetaV a v) (thetaS a s) (thetaC a c)
  simpa only [thetaV_involutive a ha, thetaS_involutive a ha,
    thetaC_involutive a ha] using h.symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericReflectionGauge.triality_theta
statement:
theorem triality_theta (a : K) (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (v : VCoord K) (s : SCoord K) (c : CCoord K) :
    triality (thetaV a v) (thetaS a s) (thetaC a c) = triality v s c
proof:
:= by
  simp only [triality, scalar_first_theta a ha, scalar_second_theta a ha,
    BW_theta a ha, pairW_theta a ha]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericReflectionGauge.sourceNorm_theta
statement:
theorem sourceNorm_theta (a : K) (ha : a ≠ 0) (x : JCoord K) :
    sourceNorm (theta a x) = sourceNorm x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sourceNorm, theta, nV_thetaV a ha, nS_thetaS a ha,
    nC_thetaC a ha, triality_theta a ha]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericReflectionGauge.sourceOne_theta
statement:
@[simp] theorem sourceOne_theta (a : K) :
    theta a (sourceOne : JCoord K) = sourceOne
proof:
:= by
  apply JCoord.ext
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · apply VCoord.ext
    · simp [theta, thetaV, sourceOne]
    · simp [theta, thetaV, sourceOne]
    · funext i
      cases i <;> simp [theta, thetaV, sourceOne]
  · apply SCoord.ext <;> funext i <;> fin_cases i <;>
      simp [theta, thetaS, sourceOne]
  · apply CCoord.ext <;> funext i <;> fin_cases i <;>
      simp [theta, thetaC, sourceOne]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericReflectionGauge.sourceTrace_theta
statement:
theorem sourceTrace_theta (a : K) (x : JCoord K) :
    sourceTrace (theta a x) = sourceTrace x
proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericReflectionGauge.sourceProduct_theta
statement:
theorem sourceProduct_theta (a : K) (ha : a ≠ 0) (x y : JCoord K) :
    theta a (sourceProduct x y) = sourceProduct (theta a x) (theta a y)
proof:
:= by
  exact CubicAutomorphism.sourceProduct_invariant_of_cubic_unit
    (linearEquiv a ha) (sourceOne_theta a) (sourceNorm_theta a ha) x y

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertActualChartMapNaturality.encoderA_mapChart
statement:
theorem encoderA_mapChart (f : K →+* L) (q : ExplicitFrameChart K) :
    encoderA (mapChart f q) = mapSource f (encoderA q)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mapJ_eq_mapSource]
  apply JCoord.ext
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · apply VCoord.ext
    · rfl
    · rfl
    · funext i
      simp [mapChart, encoderA, vectorA,
        AlbertLean.Triality.RationalEvenFamilyNaturality.mapJ,
        AlbertLean.Triality.RationalEvenFamilyNaturality.mapV,
        AlbertLean.Triality.RationalEvenFamilyNaturality.mapW]
  · rfl
  · rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertActualChartMapNaturality.encoderB_mapChart
statement:
theorem encoderB_mapChart (f : K →+* L) (q : ExplicitFrameChart K) :
    encoderB (mapChart f q) = mapSource f (encoderB q)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mapJ_eq_mapSource]
  apply JCoord.ext
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · apply VCoord.ext
    · rfl
    · rfl
    · funext i
      simp [mapChart, encoderB, vectorB,
        AlbertLean.Triality.RationalEvenFamilyNaturality.mapJ,
        AlbertLean.Triality.RationalEvenFamilyNaturality.mapV,
        AlbertLean.Triality.RationalEvenFamilyNaturality.mapW]
  · rfl
  · rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertActualChartMapNaturality.residualPairOfChart_mapChart
statement:
theorem residualPairOfChart_mapChart (f : K →+* L)
    (q : ExplicitFrameChart K) :
    residualPairOfChart (mapChart f q) =
      mapResidualPair f (residualPairOfChart q)
proof:
:= by
  apply ResidualPair.ext <;> funext i j <;> fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertActualChartMapNaturality.moment_mapResidualPair
statement:
theorem moment_mapResidualPair (f : K →+* L) (P : ResidualPair K) :
    moment (mapResidualPair f P) = f.mapMatrix (moment P)
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp [AlbertLean.Residual.SL4PairAction.moment, mapResidualPair, Matrix.mul_apply, map_sum, map_mul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertActualChartMapNaturality.delta_mapResidualPair
statement:
theorem delta_mapResidualPair (f : K →+* L) (P : ResidualPair K) :
    delta (mapResidualPair f P) = f (delta P)
proof:
:= by
  exact (RingHom.map_det f P.X).symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertActualChartMapNaturality.deltaStar_mapResidualPair
statement:
theorem deltaStar_mapResidualPair (f : K →+* L) (P : ResidualPair K) :
    deltaStar (mapResidualPair f P) = f (deltaStar P)
proof:
:= by
  exact (RingHom.map_det f P.A).symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertActualChartMapNaturality.residualOpen_mapChart
statement:
theorem residualOpen_mapChart (f : K →+* L) (q : ExplicitFrameChart K)
    (hq : ResidualOpen (residualPairOfChart q)) :
    ResidualOpen (residualPairOfChart (mapChart f q))
proof:
:= by
  rw [residualPairOfChart_mapChart]
  constructor
  · rw [delta_mapResidualPair]
    simpa only [map_zero] using f.injective.ne hq.1
  · rw [deltaStar_mapResidualPair]
    simpa only [map_zero] using f.injective.ne hq.2

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertActualChartMapNaturality.mapSource_standard
statement:
private theorem mapSource_standard (f : K →+* L) :
    mapSource f (diagonal (-1) 0 1) = diagonal (-1) 0 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [show diagonal (-1 : K) 0 1 =
      diagonalUnit 2 - diagonalUnit 0 by
    apply JCoord.ext <;> simp [diagonalUnit, diagonal]]
  rw [mapSource_sub, mapSource_diagonalUnit, mapSource_diagonalUnit]
  apply JCoord.ext <;> simp [diagonalUnit, diagonal]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertActualChartMapNaturality.map_spectralProjector
statement:
private theorem map_spectralProjector (f : K →+* L)
    (x : JCoord K) (i : Fin 3) :
    mapSource f (spectralProjector x i) =
      spectralProjector (mapSource f x) i
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i <;>
    simp [spectralProjector, sourceSquare, mapSource_smul, mapSource_sub,
      mapSource_add, mapSource_one, mapSource_product, map_inv₀, map_ofNat]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertActualChartMapNaturality.map_sourceTraceForm
proof:
:= by
  calc
    f (sourceTraceForm x y) = f (sourceTrace (sourceProduct x y)) :=
      congrArg f (GenericTauLedger.sourceTrace_product_eq_traceForm x y).symm
    _ = sourceTrace (mapSource f (sourceProduct x y)) :=
      (mapSource_trace f (sourceProduct x y)).symm
    _ = sourceTrace (sourceProduct (mapSource f x) (mapSource f y)) := by
      rw [mapSource_product]
    _ = sourceTraceForm (mapSource f x) (mapSource f y) :=
      GenericTauLedger.sourceTrace_product_eq_traceForm _ _

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertActualChartMapNaturality.sourceLedger_mapSource

  · funext l i

statement:
private theorem detector_eq_of_retained_moment_delta
    (x y : ExplicitFrameChart L)
    (hx : delta (residualPairOfChart x) ≠ 0)
    (hy : delta (residualPairOfChart y) ≠ 0)
    (hdiagA : x.diagA = y.diagA) (hdiagB : x.diagB = y.diagB)
    (hr1 : x.r1 = y.r1) (hz1 : x.z1 = y.z1)
    (hr2 : x.r2 = y.r2) (hz2 : x.z2 = y.z2)
    (hmoment : moment (residualPairOfChart x) =
      moment (residualPairOfChart y))
    (hdelta : delta (residualPairOfChart x) =
      delta (residualPairOfChart y)) :
    sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1) (encoderA x) (encoderB x) =
      sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1) (encoderA y) (encoderB y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sourceDetector_eq_normalized x hx, sourceDetector_eq_normalized y hy,
    hdiagA, hdiagB, hr1, hz1, hr2, hz2, hmoment, hdelta]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertActualChartMapNaturality.companionDetector_mapChart
statement:
theorem companionDetector_mapChart (f : K →+* L) (q : ExplicitFrameChart K)
    (hq : ResidualOpen (residualPairOfChart q)) :
    f (sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1)
        (encoderA (companion q hq)) (encoderB (companion q hq))) =
      sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1)
        (encoderA (companion (mapChart f q) (residualOpen_mapChart f q hq)))
        (encoderB (companion (mapChart f q)
          (residualOpen_mapChart f q hq)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [sourceDetector_mapChart]
  let x := mapChart f (companion q hq)
  let y := companion (mapChart f q) (residualOpen_mapChart f q hq)
  have hxopen := residualOpen_mapChart f (companion q hq) (companion_open q hq)
  have hyopen : ResidualOpen (residualPairOfChart y) := companion_open _ _
  apply detector_eq_of_retained_moment_delta x y hxopen.1 hyopen.1
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · dsimp only [x, y, companion]
    calc
      moment (residualPairOfChart (mapChart f (companion q hq))) =
          f.mapMatrix (moment (residualPairOfChart (companion q hq))) := by
        rw [residualPairOfChart_mapChart, moment_mapResidualPair]
      _ = f.mapMatrix (moment (residualPairOfChart q)) := by
        rw [moment_companion q hq]
      _ = moment (residualPairOfChart (mapChart f q)) := by
        rw [residualPairOfChart_mapChart, moment_mapResidualPair]
      _ = moment (residualPairOfChart
          (companion (mapChart f q) (residualOpen_mapChart f q hq))) :=
        (moment_companion (mapChart f q) (residualOpen_mapChart f q hq)).symm
  · dsimp only [x, y, companion]
    calc
      delta (residualPairOfChart (mapChart f (companion q hq))) =
          f (delta (residualPairOfChart (companion q hq))) := by
        rw [residualPairOfChart_mapChart, delta_mapResidualPair]
      _ = f (deltaStar (residualPairOfChart q)) := by
        rw [delta_companion q hq]
      _ = deltaStar (residualPairOfChart (mapChart f q)) := by
        rw [residualPairOfChart_mapChart, deltaStar_mapResidualPair]
      _ = delta (residualPairOfChart
          (companion (mapChart f q) (residualOpen_mapChart f q hq))) :=
        (delta_companion (mapChart f q) (residualOpen_mapChart f q hq)).symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.PeirceJordan.polarization_zero
statement:
theorem polarization_zero
    (hJordan : ∀ x y, residual μ x y = 0) (a b c y : A) :
    polarization μ a b c y = 0
proof:
:=
  polarization_eq_zero_of_residual_eq_zero μ hJordan a b c y

name: AlbertLean.Generic.PeirceJordan.peirce_operator_cubic
statement:
theorem peirce_operator_cubic
    (hJordan : ∀ x y, residual μ x y = 0)
    (p : A) (hp : μ p p = p) (x : A) :
    (2 : K) • μ p (μ p (μ p x)) -
      (3 : K) • μ p (μ p x) + μ p x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hP := polarization_zero μ hJordan p p x p
  dsimp only [polarization, term] at hP
  simp only [hp] at hP
  simp only [hcomm] at hP
  linear_combination (norm := module) (-1 / 2 : K) • hP

name: AlbertLean.Generic.PeirceJordan.reflection_square_certificate
statement:
theorem reflection_square_certificate
    (p : A) (hp : μ p p = p) (x : A) :
    reflection μ p (μ x x) - μ (reflection μ p x) (reflection μ p x) =
        (8 : K) • polarization μ p p (μ p x) x -
        (8 : K) • polarization μ p p x (μ p x) -
        (16 : K) • polarization μ p p (μ p x) (μ p x) -
        (4 : K) • polarization μ p x x p +
        (16 : K) • polarization μ p p x (μ p (μ p x)) -
        (8 : K) • μ x (polarization μ p p x p) +
        (16 : K) • μ (μ p x) (polarization μ p p x p)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [reflection, polarization, term]
  simp only [map_add, map_sub, map_smul, LinearMap.add_apply,
    LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, hp]
  simp only [hcomm]
  module

name: AlbertLean.Generic.PeirceJordan.reflection_square
statement:
theorem reflection_square
    (hJordan : ∀ x y, residual μ x y = 0)
    (p : A) (hp : μ p p = p) (x : A) :
    reflection μ p (μ x x) = μ (reflection μ p x) (reflection μ p x)
proof:
:= by
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  rw [reflection_square_certificate μ hcomm p hp x]
  simp only [polarization_zero μ hJordan, smul_zero, sub_zero, add_zero,
    map_zero]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.PeirceJordan.reflection_add
statement:
theorem reflection_add (p x y : A) :
    reflection μ p (x + y) = reflection μ p x + reflection μ p y
proof:
:= by
  simp [reflection, map_add]
  module

name: AlbertLean.Generic.PeirceJordan.reflection_smul
statement:
theorem reflection_smul (p x : A) (c : K) :
    reflection μ p (c • x) = c • reflection μ p x
proof:
:= by
  simp [reflection, map_smul]
  module

name: AlbertLean.Generic.PeirceJordan.reflection_mul
statement:
theorem reflection_mul
    (hJordan : ∀ x y, residual μ x y = 0)
    (p : A) (hp : μ p p = p) (x y : A) :
    reflection μ p (μ x y) = μ (reflection μ p x) (reflection μ p y)
proof:
:= by
  have hxy := reflection_square μ hcomm hJordan p hp (x + y)
  have hx := reflection_square μ hcomm hJordan p hp x
  have hy := reflection_square μ hcomm hJordan p hp y
  simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, reflection_add μ,
    hcomm y x, hcomm (reflection μ p y) (reflection μ p x)] at hxy
  linear_combination (norm := module)
    (1 / 2 : K) • hxy - (1 / 2 : K) • hx - (1 / 2 : K) • hy

name: AlbertLean.Generic.PeirceJordan.reflectionEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem reflectionEquiv_apply
    (hJordan : ∀ x y, residual μ x y = 0)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceSchedulePrimeSquare.genericSourcePoint_laws
statement:
theorem genericSourcePoint_laws (hraw : rawFrameIdeal (k := k) ≤ p) :
    ∀ r, Laws (genericSourcePoint k p r)
proof:
:= by
  apply (sourceFrameFamily_iff_f0Raw (genericSourcePoint k p)).2
  have heq : toF0Family (genericSourcePoint k p) = genericPoint k p := by
    funext r i
    exact LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply (structuredEquivK (GenericField k p))
      (genericPoint k p r i)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceSchedulePrimeSquare.exists_prime_schedule_square
statement:
theorem exists_prime_schedule_square (hraw : rawFrameIdeal (k := k) ≤ p) :
    ∃ (L : Type u) (_ : Field L) (j : A k ⧸ p →+* L),
      Function.Injective j ∧ ∃ specialize : ParameterRing k →+* L,
        specialize.comp (scheduleRawMap k) = j.comp (Ideal.Quotient.mk p)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨L, hL, hL0, f, Z, hf, hZ⟩ :=
    common_field_fixed_schedules (genericSourcePoint k p)
      (genericSourcePoint_laws k p hraw)
  letI : Field L := hL
  letI : CharZero L := hL0
  let coeff : k →+* L := f.comp (coefficientMap k p)
  letI : Algebra k L := coeff.toAlgebra
  let specialize : ParameterRing k →+* L := evalAway k Z
  let j : Residue k p →+* L :=
    f.comp (algebraMap (Residue k p) (GenericField k p))
  refine ⟨L, hL, j, hf.comp (IsFractionRing.injective _ _), specialize, ?_⟩
  apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
  · intro a
    simp only [RingHom.comp_apply]
    rw [scheduleRawMap_C]
    have hc := (evalAwayAlg k Z).commutes a
    change evalAway k Z (algebraMap k (ParameterRing k) a) = coeff a at hc
    rw [hc]
    simp [coeff, coefficientMap, residueMap, j]
  · intro q
    cases q with
    | entry r i c =>
      simp only [RingHom.comp_apply]
      rw [scheduleRawMap_X]
      have hs := congrFun (evalAway_scheduledPoint k Z r i) c
      rw [hZ r i] at hs
      have hcoord : structuredEquivK L
          (mapSource f (genericSourcePoint k p r i)) c =
          f (residueMap k p (MvPolynomial.X (.entry r i c))) := by
        rw [mapSource, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, genericSourcePoint,
          LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
        rfl
      rw [hcoord] at hs
      simpa [specialize, j, residueMap] using hs

name: AlbertLean.Generic.UniformMomentActualBranchSpecialization.evalQ_finiteS_eq_detectorS
statement:
theorem evalQ_finiteS_eq_detectorS (f : k →+* L) (q : ExplicitFrameChart L)
    (hB : evalR0 k f q (B0 k) ≠ 0) (a b c sigma : L)
    (hq : EquationsVanish (explicitFrameEquationValues q))
    (hr : q.r1 = 1) (hz1 : q.z1 = a) (hr2 : q.r2 = b) (hz2 : q.z2 = c)
    (hb : b = (gramV12 q - sigma) / (2*a))
    (hc : c = (gramV12 q + sigma) / 2)
    (hsigma2 : sigma ^ 2 = evalR0 k f q (discr k))
    (hsigma : sigma ≠ 0) (ha : 2*a ≠ 0) :
    UniformMomentActualSpecialization.evalQ k f q hB sigma hsigma2 (finiteS k) =
      detectorS q a sigma
proof:
:= by
  let ep := UniformMomentActualSpecialization.evalQ k f q hB sigma hsigma2
  have hmoment : (UniformMomentFiniteAlgebra.moment k).map ep =
      reconstructedMatrix q a sigma := by
    calc
      _ = matrixM q := evalQ_moment k f q hB a b c sigma hq hr hz1 hr2 hz2
        hb hc hsigma2 hsigma ha
      _ = _ := matrixM_eq_uniform_inverse q a b c sigma hq hr hz1 hr2 hz2
        hb hc hsigma ha
  change ep
      ((UniformMomentFiniteAlgebra.moment k 2 0 * UniformMomentFiniteAlgebra.moment k 1 3 +
        UniformMomentFiniteAlgebra.moment k 3 1 * UniformMomentFiniteAlgebra.moment k 0 2 +
        UniformMomentFiniteAlgebra.moment k 1 0 * UniformMomentFiniteAlgebra.moment k 3 2 -
        UniformMomentFiniteAlgebra.moment k 1 2 * UniformMomentFiniteAlgebra.moment k 3 0 +
        UniformMomentFiniteAlgebra.moment k 0 1 * UniformMomentFiniteAlgebra.moment k 2 3 -
        UniformMomentFiniteAlgebra.moment k 0 3 * UniformMomentFiniteAlgebra.moment k 2 1) -
        algebraMap (Local k) (Q k) (loc k
          (UniformLedgerMeasurements.uV (universalLedger k)))) = _
  simp only [map_sub, map_add, map_mul, ep,
    UniformMomentActualSpecialization.evalQ_algebraMap,
    UniformMomentActualSpecialization.evalLocal_loc, UniformMomentActualSpecialization.evalR0_uV]
  change AlbertLean.Residual.TrialitySquares.exteriorQ
      ((UniformMomentFiniteAlgebra.moment k).map ep) -
      UniformLedgerMeasurements.uV (actualLedger q) = _
  rw [hmoment, detectorS]
  rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.UniformMomentActualBranchSpecialization.detectorS_eq_rootSum
statement:
theorem detectorS_eq_rootSum (q : ExplicitFrameChart L) (a b c sigma : L)
    (hq : EquationsVanish (explicitFrameEquationValues q))
    (hr : q.r1 = 1) (hz1 : q.z1 = a) (hr2 : q.r2 = b) (hz2 : q.z2 = c)
    (hb : b = (gramV12 q - sigma) / (2*a))
    (hc : c = (gramV12 q + sigma) / 2)
    (hsigma : sigma ≠ 0) (ha : 2*a ≠ 0) :
    detectorS q a sigma =
      delta (residualPairOfChart q) + deltaStar (residualPairOfChart q)
proof:
:= by
  have hM : matrixM q = reconstructedMatrix q a sigma :=
    matrixM_eq_uniform_inverse q a b c sigma hq hr hz1 hr2 hz2
      hb hc hsigma ha
  have hDelta_eq : delta (residualPairOfChart q) =
      deltaX q.s1 q.s2 q.c1 q.c2 :=
    (deltaX_eq_det_XMatrix q.s1 q.s2 q.c1 q.c2).symm
  have hfixed := (equationsVanish_iff_source_fixedSpectrum q).1 hq
  have hm := recovered_measurements (encoderA q) (encoderB q)
    hfixed.2.2.1 hfixed.2.2.2.2.2
  rcases hm with ⟨hnVx, hnSx, hnCx, hnVy, hnSy, hnCy, hgV, hgS, hgC,
    ht111, ht211, ht121, ht112, ht122, ht212, ht221, ht222, huV, huS, huC⟩
  have hs : detectorS q a sigma =
      delta (residualPairOfChart q) + deltaStarA q.s1 q.s2 q.c1 q.c2 := by
    rw [detectorS, ← hM, huV]
    rw [normalizedUV_exterior_identity, hDelta_eq]
    dsimp only [matrixM, encoderA, encoderB]
    ring
  calc
    _ = delta (residualPairOfChart q) +
        deltaStarA q.s1 q.s2 q.c1 q.c2 := hs
    _ = delta (residualPairOfChart q) +
        deltaStar (residualPairOfChart q) := by
      simp only [deltaStarA_eq_det_AMatrix]
      rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.UniformMomentActualBranchSpecialization.evalQ_finiteS_eq_rootSum
statement:
theorem evalQ_finiteS_eq_rootSum (f : k →+* L) (q : ExplicitFrameChart L)
    (hB : evalR0 k f q (B0 k) ≠ 0) (a b c sigma : L)
    (hq : EquationsVanish (explicitFrameEquationValues q))
    (hr : q.r1 = 1) (hz1 : q.z1 = a) (hr2 : q.r2 = b) (hz2 : q.z2 = c)
    (hb : b = (gramV12 q - sigma) / (2*a))
    (hc : c = (gramV12 q + sigma) / 2)
    (hsigma2 : sigma ^ 2 = evalR0 k f q (discr k))
    (hsigma : sigma ≠ 0) (ha : 2*a ≠ 0) :
    UniformMomentActualSpecialization.evalQ k f q hB sigma hsigma2 (finiteS k) =
      delta (residualPairOfChart q) + deltaStar (residualPairOfChart q)
proof:
:= by
  rw [evalQ_finiteS_eq_detectorS k f q hB a b c sigma hq hr hz1 hr2 hz2
    hb hc hsigma2 hsigma ha]
  exact detectorS_eq_rootSum q a b c sigma hq hr hz1 hr2 hz2 hb hc hsigma ha

name: AlbertLean.Generic.UniformMomentActualBranchSpecialization.evalQ_branchElement_eq_rootDifference_sq
statement:
theorem evalQ_branchElement_eq_rootDifference_sq
    (f : k →+* L) (q : ExplicitFrameChart L)
    (hB : evalR0 k f q (B0 k) ≠ 0) (a b c sigma : L)
    (hq : EquationsVanish (explicitFrameEquationValues q))
    (hr : q.r1 = 1) (hz1 : q.z1 = a) (hr2 : q.r2 = b) (hz2 : q.z2 = c)
    (hb : b = (gramV12 q - sigma) / (2*a))
    (hc : c = (gramV12 q + sigma) / 2)
    (hsigma2 : sigma ^ 2 = evalR0 k f q (discr k))
    (hsigma : sigma ≠ 0) (ha : 2*a ≠ 0) :
    UniformMomentActualSpecialization.evalQ k f q hB sigma hsigma2
        (branchElement k) =
      (delta (residualPairOfChart q) - deltaStar (residualPairOfChart q)) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let ep := UniformMomentActualSpecialization.evalQ k f q hB sigma hsigma2
  have hfiniteS : ep (finiteS k) =
      delta (residualPairOfChart q) + deltaStar (residualPairOfChart q) :=
    evalQ_finiteS_eq_rootSum k f q hB a b c sigma hq hr hz1 hr2 hz2
      hb hc hsigma2 hsigma ha
  have hmoment : (UniformMomentFiniteAlgebra.moment k).map ep = matrixM q :=
    evalQ_moment k f q hB a b c sigma hq hr hz1 hr2 hz2
      hb hc hsigma2 hsigma ha
  have hdet : ep (Matrix.det (UniformMomentFiniteAlgebra.moment k)) =
      Matrix.det (matrixM q) := by
    calc
      _ = Matrix.det ((UniformMomentFiniteAlgebra.moment k).map ep) :=
        RingHom.map_det ep (UniformMomentFiniteAlgebra.moment k)
      _ = _ := congrArg Matrix.det hmoment
  have hdetRoots : Matrix.det (matrixM q) =
      delta (residualPairOfChart q) * deltaStar (residualPairOfChart q) := by
    rw [matrixM, det_momentMatrix_eq_deltaX_mul_deltaStarA]
    simp only [deltaX_eq_det_XMatrix, deltaStarA_eq_det_AMatrix]
    rfl
  have hfour : ep (4 : Q k) = (4 : L) := map_ofNat ep 4
  change ep (branchElement k) = _
  simp only [branchElement, map_sub, map_pow, map_mul]
  rw [hfour, hfiniteS, hdet, hdetRoots]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.UniformMomentActualBranchSpecialization.eval_betaOpen_ne_zero_of_separationOpen
statement:
theorem eval_betaOpen_ne_zero_of_separationOpen
    (f : k →+* L) (q : ExplicitFrameChart L)
    (hopen : evalR0 k f q (separationOpen k) ≠ 0) :
    evalR0 k f q (betaOpen k) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hz
  apply hopen
  rw [separationOpen, map_mul, hz, zero_mul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.UniformMomentActualBranchSpecialization.eval_branchNumerator_ne_zero_of_separationOpen
statement:
theorem eval_branchNumerator_ne_zero_of_separationOpen
    (f : k →+* L) (q : ExplicitFrameChart L)
    (hopen : evalR0 k f q (separationOpen k) ≠ 0) :
    evalR0 k f q (branchNumerator k) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hprod : evalR0 k f q (betaOpen k) *
      evalR0 k f q (branchNumerator k) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [separationOpen, map_mul] using hopen
  exact (mul_ne_zero_iff.mp hprod).2

name: AlbertLean.Generic.UniformMomentActualBranchSpecialization.evalLocal_branchNorm_ne_zero_of_separationOpen
statement:
theorem evalLocal_branchNorm_ne_zero_of_separationOpen
    (f : k →+* L) (q : ExplicitFrameChart L)
    (hopen : evalR0 k f q (separationOpen k) ≠ 0) :
    evalLocal k f q
        (eval_betaOpen_ne_zero k f q
          (eval_betaOpen_ne_zero_of_separationOpen k f q hopen))
        (branchNorm k) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  let hbeta := eval_betaOpen_ne_zero_of_separationOpen k f q hopen
  let hB := eval_betaOpen_ne_zero k f q hbeta
  let s := IsLocalization.Away.sec (B0 k) (branchNorm k)
  have hn : evalR0 k f q s.1 ≠ 0 := by
    simpa [s, branchNumerator] using
      eval_branchNumerator_ne_zero_of_separationOpen k f q hopen
  have hs : branchNorm k * algebraMap (R0 k) (Local k) ((B0 k) ^ s.2) =
      algebraMap (R0 k) (Local k) s.1 :=
    IsLocalization.Away.sec_spec (B0 k) (branchNorm k)
  have hm := congrArg (evalLocal k f q hB) hs
  change evalLocal k f q hB (branchNorm k) ≠ 0
  intro hz
  rw [map_mul, hz, zero_mul] at hm
  apply hn
  rw [← evalLocal_loc k f q hB]
  exact hm.symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.UniformMomentActualBranchSpecialization.evalQ_branchElement_ne_zero_of_separationOpen
statement:
theorem evalQ_branchElement_ne_zero_of_separationOpen
    (f : k →+* L) (q : ExplicitFrameChart L)
    (hopen : evalR0 k f q (separationOpen k) ≠ 0) (sigma : L)
    (hsigma2 : sigma ^ 2 = evalR0 k f q (discr k)) :
    UniformMomentActualSpecialization.evalQ k f q
        (eval_betaOpen_ne_zero k f q
          (eval_betaOpen_ne_zero_of_separationOpen k f q hopen))
        sigma hsigma2 (branchElement k) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  let hbeta := eval_betaOpen_ne_zero_of_separationOpen k f q hopen
  let hB := eval_betaOpen_ne_zero k f q hbeta
  let ep := UniformMomentActualSpecialization.evalQ k f q hB sigma hsigma2
  let em := UniformMomentActualSpecialization.evalQ k f q hB (-sigma)
    (by simpa [pow_two] using hsigma2)
  have hn := evalLocal_branchNorm_ne_zero_of_separationOpen k f q hopen
  have hprod : ep (branchElement k) * em (branchElement k) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← UniformMomentActualSpecialization.evalLocal_norm_eq_evalQ_mul_evalQ_neg
      k f q hB sigma hsigma2 (branchElement k)]
    simpa only [branchNorm] using hn
  change ep (branchElement k) ≠ 0
  exact (mul_ne_zero_iff.mp hprod).1

name: AlbertLean.Generic.UniformMomentActualBranchSpecialization.actualBeta_ne_zero_of_separationOpen
statement:
theorem actualBeta_ne_zero_of_separationOpen
    (f : k →+* L) (q : ExplicitFrameChart L)
    (hopen : evalR0 k f q (separationOpen k) ≠ 0) (a b c sigma : L)
    (hq : EquationsVanish (explicitFrameEquationValues q))
    (hr : q.r1 = 1) (hz1 : q.z1 = a) (hr2 : q.r2 = b) (hz2 : q.z2 = c)
    (hb : b = (gramV12 q - sigma) / (2*a))
    (hc : c = (gramV12 q + sigma) / 2)
    (hsigma2 : sigma ^ 2 = evalR0 k f q (discr k))
    (hsigma : sigma ≠ 0) (ha : 2*a ≠ 0) :
    actualBeta q a b c sigma ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  exact actualBeta_ne_zero k f q
    (eval_betaOpen_ne_zero_of_separationOpen k f q hopen)
    a b c sigma hq hr hz1 hr2 hz2 hb hc hsigma2 hsigma ha

name: AlbertLean.Generic.UniformMomentActualBranchSpecialization.actualRoots_ne_of_separationOpen
statement:
theorem actualRoots_ne_of_separationOpen
    (f : k →+* L) (q : ExplicitFrameChart L)
    (hopen : evalR0 k f q (separationOpen k) ≠ 0) (a b c sigma : L)
    (hq : EquationsVanish (explicitFrameEquationValues q))
    (hr : q.r1 = 1) (hz1 : q.z1 = a) (hr2 : q.r2 = b) (hz2 : q.z2 = c)
    (hb : b = (gramV12 q - sigma) / (2*a))
    (hc : c = (gramV12 q + sigma) / 2)
    (hsigma2 : sigma ^ 2 = evalR0 k f q (discr k))
    (hsigma : sigma ≠ 0) (ha : 2*a ≠ 0) :
    delta (residualPairOfChart q) ≠ deltaStar (residualPairOfChart q)
proof:
:= by
  let hbeta := eval_betaOpen_ne_zero_of_separationOpen k f q hopen
  let hB := eval_betaOpen_ne_zero k f q hbeta
  let ep := UniformMomentActualSpecialization.evalQ k f q hB sigma hsigma2
  have heval : ep (branchElement k) =
      (delta (residualPairOfChart q) - deltaStar (residualPairOfChart q)) ^ 2 :=
    evalQ_branchElement_eq_rootDifference_sq k f q hB a b c sigma
      hq hr hz1 hr2 hz2 hb hc hsigma2 hsigma ha
  have hbranch : ep (branchElement k) ≠ 0 :=
    evalQ_branchElement_ne_zero_of_separationOpen
      k f q hopen sigma hsigma2
  have hsquare :
      (delta (residualPairOfChart q) - deltaStar (residualPairOfChart q)) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← heval]
    exact hbranch
  apply sub_ne_zero.mp
  intro hz
  apply hsquare
  simp [hz]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.UniformMomentActualBranchSpecialization.actualBeta_ne_zero_and_roots_ne
statement:
theorem actualBeta_ne_zero_and_roots_ne
    (f : k →+* L) (q : ExplicitFrameChart L)
    (hopen : evalR0 k f q (separationOpen k) ≠ 0) (a b c sigma : L)
    (hq : EquationsVanish (explicitFrameEquationValues q))
    (hr : q.r1 = 1) (hz1 : q.z1 = a) (hr2 : q.r2 = b) (hz2 : q.z2 = c)
    (hb : b = (gramV12 q - sigma) / (2*a))
    (hc : c = (gramV12 q + sigma) / 2)
    (hsigma2 : sigma ^ 2 = evalR0 k f q (discr k))
    (hsigma : sigma ≠ 0) (ha : 2*a ≠ 0) :
    actualBeta q a b c sigma ≠ 0 ∧
      delta (residualPairOfChart q) ≠ deltaStar (residualPairOfChart q)
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨actualBeta_ne_zero_of_separationOpen k f q hopen a b c sigma
      hq hr hz1 hr2 hz2 hb hc hsigma2 hsigma ha,
    actualRoots_ne_of_separationOpen k f q hopen a b c sigma
      hq hr hz1 hr2 hz2 hb hc hsigma2 hsigma ha⟩

statement:

    {x : ExplicitFrameChart K} {Q : ResidualPair K}
    (h : SourceAutRelated x Q) :
    ∃ G : DetOneMatrix K,
      residualPairOfChart (actChart G x) = Q ∧
      (∀ d1 d2 d3 : K,
        (ResidualAction.sourceAut G).linear (diagonal d1 d2 d3) =
          diagonal d1 d2 d3) ∧
      (ResidualAction.sourceAut G).linear (encoderA x) =
        encoderA (actChart G x) ∧

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ChartBridge.sourceAutRelated_iff_related
statement:
theorem sourceAutRelated_iff_related
    (x : ExplicitFrameChart K) (Q : ResidualPair K) :
    SourceAutRelated x Q ↔ Related (residualPairOfChart x) Q
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨G, hG, _, _, _⟩
    exact ⟨G, (residualPairOfChart_actChart G x).symm.trans hG⟩
  · rintro ⟨G, hG⟩
    refine ⟨G, (residualPairOfChart_actChart G x).trans hG,
      sourceAut_diagonal G, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact (encoderA_actChart G x).symm
    · exact (encoderB_actChart G x).symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ChartBridge.ChartResidualBaseSourceAutClassification
statement:
theorem ChartResidualBaseSourceAutClassification
    (x : ExplicitFrameChart K)
    (hP : ResidualOpen (residualPairOfChart x))
    (hbranch : delta (residualPairOfChart x) ≠
      deltaStar (residualPairOfChart x)) :
    let P
proof:
:= residualPairOfChart x
    let Pswap := rootSwappedRepresentative P hP
    let xswap := chartWithResidualPair x Pswap
    residualPairOfChart xswap = Pswap ∧
      ∀ Q : ResidualPair K, ResidualOpen Q →
        (sameResidualBase P Q ↔
          SourceAutRelated x Q ∨ SourceAutRelated xswap Q) ∧
        ¬ (SourceAutRelated x Q ∧ SourceAutRelated xswap Q) := by
  dsimp only
  let P := residualPairOfChart x
  let Pswap := rootSwappedRepresentative P hP
  let xswap := chartWithResidualPair x Pswap
  have hxswap : residualPairOfChart xswap = Pswap := by
    simp [xswap]
  refine ⟨hxswap, ?_⟩
  intro Q hQ
  constructor
  · rw [sourceAutRelated_iff_related,
      sourceAutRelated_iff_related, hxswap]
    exact sameResidualBase_iff_related_or_swapped P hP Q hQ
  · rintro ⟨hx, hxs⟩
    apply related_families_disjoint P hP hbranch Q
    constructor
    · exact (sourceAutRelated_iff_related x Q).mp hx
    · change Related Pswap Q
      rw [← hxswap]
      exact (sourceAutRelated_iff_related xswap Q).mp hxs

name: AlbertLean.Generic.PeirceReflectionFamily.directCircuit_natural
statement:
theorem directCircuit_natural
    {S : Type w} [CommRing S] [Algebra k S] [Invertible (2 : S)]
    (f : R →ₐ[k] S) (i : Fin 3) (a : R) (u : SCoord R) (v : CCoord R)
    (x : Fin 27 → R) :
    (f ∘ directCircuit (k := k) i a u v x) =
      directCircuit (k := k) i (f a) (mapS f.toRingHom u)
        (mapC f.toRingHom v) (f ∘ x)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra ℚ R :=
    ((algebraMap k R).comp (algebraMap ℚ k)).toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra ℚ S :=
    ((algebraMap k S).comp (algebraMap ℚ k)).toAlgebra
  have hq : f.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap ℚ R) = algebraMap ℚ S := by
    ext q
    simp
  change mapF0Ring f.toRingHom
      (ringReflection (directCenter (k := k) i a u v) x) = _
  rw [map_ringReflection f.toRingHom hq]
  congr 1
  rw [directCenter, directCenter]
  have hpivot : (f.toRingHom ∘ pivotMap (k := k) i
      (flatten (chartWithScale a u v))) =
      pivotMap (k := k) i
        (f.toRingHom ∘ flatten (chartWithScale a u v)) := by
    simpa only [AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe, AlgHom.coe_toRingHom] using
      pivotMap_natural (f := f) i (flatten (chartWithScale a u v))
  exact hpivot.trans (congrArg (pivotMap (k := k) i)
    (map_flatten_chartWithScale f a u v))

    (g : ResidualAction.SourceAut (K := k)) (z : JCoord k) :

      structuredEquivK k (g.linear z)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.PeirceReflectionFamily.directCircuit_eq_baseLinear
statement:
theorem directCircuit_eq_baseLinear
    (i : Fin 3) (u : SCoord k) (v : CCoord k)
    (hD : chart0Denominator u v ≠ 0) (x : Fin 27 → k) :
    directCircuit (k := k) i (chart0Denominator u v)⁻¹ u v x =
      SourceAutExtension.baseLinear
        (sourcePeirceAut (chart i u v) (chart_idempotent i u v hD)) x
proof:
:= by
  let y : JCoord k := (structuredEquivK k).symm x
  have hx : structuredEquivK k y = x := LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply _ x
  have hc : directCenter (k := k) i (chart0Denominator u v)⁻¹ u v =
      structuredEquivK k (chart i u v) := by
    rw [directCenter, chartWithScale_field, flatten_field,
      pivotMap_field_native]
    rfl
  have hdirect : directCircuit (k := k) i
      (chart0Denominator u v)⁻¹ u v x =
      ringReflection (directCenter (k := k) i
        (chart0Denominator u v)⁻¹ u v) x := by
    funext c
    simp [directCircuit, ringReflection, ringProduct]
  rw [hdirect, hc]
  rw [← hx, ringReflection_eq_source, baseLinear_structured]
  simp only [sourcePeirceAut, sourcePeirceLinearEquiv_apply]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.PeirceReflectionFamily.charZero_of_injective_map
statement:
private theorem charZero_of_injective_map
    {A L : Type u} [CommRing A] [CharZero A] [Field L]
    (f : A →+* L) (hf : Function.Injective f) : CharZero L where
  cast_injective m n h
proof:
:= Nat.cast_injective (R := A)
    (hf (by simpa only [map_natCast] using h))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.PeirceReflectionFamily.reflectionLinear_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem reflectionLinear_apply (p x : Fin 27 → FamilyRing k) :
    reflectionLinear k p x = ringReflection p x
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.PeirceReflectionFamily.matrix_entry
statement:
theorem matrix_entry (i : Fin 3) (row column : Fin 27) :
    matrix k i row column =
      directCircuit (k := k) i (denominatorInverse k) (familyU k) (familyV k)
        (Pi.single column 1) row
proof:
:= by
  change familyLinear k i (Pi.single column 1) row = _
  rw [familyLinear, reflectionLinear_apply, familyCenter]
  rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.PeirceReflectionFamily.baseAut_twice
statement:
theorem baseAut_twice (i : Fin 3) (t : Param → k)
    (ht : MvPolynomial.eval t (denominator k) ≠ 0) (x : JCoord k) :
    (baseAut k i t ht).linear ((baseAut k i t ht).linear x) = x
proof:
:= by
  let p := chart i (valueU k t) (valueV k t)
  let hp := chart_idempotent i (valueU k t) (valueV k t)
    (legalDenominator k t ht)
  have hinv (y : JCoord k) :
      (sourcePeirceLinearEquiv p hp).symm y = sourcePeirceReflection p y := rfl
  have h := (sourcePeirceLinearEquiv p hp).symm_apply_apply x
  simpa only [baseAut, sourcePeirceAut, p, hp, hinv,
    sourcePeirceLinearEquiv_apply] using h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.PeirceReflectionFamily.evaluation_parameter
statement:
@[simp] theorem evaluation_parameter (t : Param → k)
    (ht : MvPolynomial.eval t (denominator k) ≠ 0) (q : Param) :
    evaluation k t ht (parameter k q) = algebraMap k (RationalSourceFamily.F k) (t q)
proof:
:= by
  simp [evaluation, parameter,
    LocalizedGridIdentity.localizedConstantEval_algebraMap,
    LocalizedGridIdentity.constantEval]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.PeirceReflectionFamily.evaluation_denominatorInverse
statement:
theorem evaluation_denominatorInverse (t : Param → k)
    (ht : MvPolynomial.eval t (denominator k) ≠ 0) :
    evaluation k t ht (denominatorInverse k) =
      algebraMap k (RationalSourceFamily.F k)
        (MvPolynomial.eval t (denominator k))⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  let ev := evaluation k t ht
  let d := LocalizedGridIdentity.mappedDenominator k (RationalSourceFamily.F k)
    (denominator k)
  have hm := congrArg ev (IsLocalization.Away.mul_invSelf d)
  have hd : ev (algebraMap (MvPolynomial Param (RationalSourceFamily.F k))
      (FamilyRing k) d) =
      algebraMap k (RationalSourceFamily.F k)
        (MvPolynomial.eval t (denominator k)) := by
    change LocalizedGridIdentity.localizedConstantEval k
      (RationalSourceFamily.F k) (FamilyRing k) (denominator k) t ht
        (algebraMap (MvPolynomial Param (RationalSourceFamily.F k))
          (FamilyRing k) d) = _
    rw [LocalizedGridIdentity.localizedConstantEval_algebraMap]
    exact LocalizedGridIdentity.constantEval_mappedDenominator
      k (RationalSourceFamily.F k) (denominator k) t
  have hn : algebraMap k (RationalSourceFamily.F k)
      (MvPolynomial.eval t (denominator k)) ≠ 0 :=
    by simpa only [map_zero] using
      (algebraMap k (RationalSourceFamily.F k)).injective.ne ht
  change ev (IsLocalization.Away.invSelf d) = _
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ hn
  calc
    algebraMap k (RationalSourceFamily.F k)
          (MvPolynomial.eval t (denominator k)) *
        ev (IsLocalization.Away.invSelf d) = 1 := by
      rw [← hd]
      simpa only [map_mul, map_one] using hm
    _ = algebraMap k (RationalSourceFamily.F k)
          (MvPolynomial.eval t (denominator k)) *
        (algebraMap k (RationalSourceFamily.F k)
          (MvPolynomial.eval t (denominator k)))⁻¹ :=
      (mul_inv_cancel₀ hn).symm
    _ = algebraMap k (RationalSourceFamily.F k)
          (MvPolynomial.eval t (denominator k)) *
        algebraMap k (RationalSourceFamily.F k)
          ((MvPolynomial.eval t (denominator k))⁻¹) := by
      rw [map_inv₀]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.PeirceReflectionFamily.evaluation_familyU
statement:
private theorem evaluation_familyU (t : Param → k)
    (ht : MvPolynomial.eval t (denominator k) ≠ 0) :
    mapS (evaluation k t ht) (familyU k) =
      mapS (algebraMap k (RationalSourceFamily.F k)) (valueU k t)
proof:
:= by
  apply SCoord.ext <;> funext j <;>
    simp [mapS, familyU, valueU, evaluation_parameter]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.PeirceReflectionFamily.evaluation_familyV
statement:
private theorem evaluation_familyV (t : Param → k)
    (ht : MvPolynomial.eval t (denominator k) ≠ 0) :
    mapC (evaluation k t ht) (familyV k) =
      mapC (algebraMap k (RationalSourceFamily.F k)) (valueV k t)
proof:
:= by
  apply CCoord.ext <;> funext j <;>
    simp [mapC, familyV, valueV, evaluation_parameter]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.PeirceReflectionFamily.evaluation_single
statement:
private theorem evaluation_single (t : Param → k)
    (ht : MvPolynomial.eval t (denominator k) ≠ 0) (j : Fin 27) :
    (evaluation k t ht) ∘ (Pi.single j (1 : FamilyRing k)) =
      Pi.single j (1 : RationalSourceFamily.F k)
proof:
:= by
  funext c
  by_cases h : c = j
  · subst c; simp
  · simp [Pi.single_apply, h]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.PeirceReflectionFamily.eval_familyLinear_single
statement:
private theorem eval_familyLinear_single (i : Fin 3) (t : Param → k)
    (ht : MvPolynomial.eval t (denominator k) ≠ 0) (j : Fin 27) :
    (evaluation k t ht) ∘ familyLinear k i (Pi.single j 1) =
      SourceAutExtension.linearEquiv (R := RationalSourceFamily.F k)
        (baseAut k i t ht) (Pi.single j 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [familyLinear, reflectionLinear_apply, familyCenter]
  change (evaluation k t ht) ∘ directCircuit (k := k) i
      (denominatorInverse k) (familyU k) (familyV k)
        (Pi.single j 1) = _
  rw [linearEquiv_apply_eq_linear]
  have hfam := directCircuit_natural
    (f := evaluationAlgHom k t ht) i (denominatorInverse k)
      (familyU k) (familyV k) (Pi.single j 1)
  change (evaluation k t ht) ∘ directCircuit (k := k) i
      (denominatorInverse k) (familyU k) (familyV k) (Pi.single j 1) =
    directCircuit (k := k) i (evaluation k t ht (denominatorInverse k))
      (mapS (evaluation k t ht) (familyU k))
      (mapC (evaluation k t ht) (familyV k))
      ((evaluation k t ht) ∘ Pi.single j 1) at hfam
  rw [evaluation_denominatorInverse, eval_denominator,
    evaluation_familyU, evaluation_familyV, evaluation_single] at hfam
  rw [map_inv₀] at hfam
  have hbase := directCircuit_natural
    (f := IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k k (RationalSourceFamily.F k)) i
      (chart0Denominator (valueU k t) (valueV k t))⁻¹
      (valueU k t) (valueV k t) (Pi.single j 1)
  change (algebraMap k (RationalSourceFamily.F k)) ∘
      directCircuit (k := k) i
        (chart0Denominator (valueU k t) (valueV k t))⁻¹
        (valueU k t) (valueV k t) (Pi.single j 1) =
    directCircuit (k := k) i
      (algebraMap k (RationalSourceFamily.F k)
        ((chart0Denominator (valueU k t) (valueV k t))⁻¹))
      (mapS (algebraMap k (RationalSourceFamily.F k)) (valueU k t))
      (mapC (algebraMap k (RationalSourceFamily.F k)) (valueV k t))
      ((algebraMap k (RationalSourceFamily.F k)) ∘ Pi.single j 1) at hbase
  have hsingle :
      (algebraMap k (RationalSourceFamily.F k)) ∘ (Pi.single j (1 : k)) =
        Pi.single j (1 : RationalSourceFamily.F k) := by
    funext c
    by_cases h : c = j
    · subst c; simp
    · simp [Pi.single_apply, h]
  rw [map_inv₀, hsingle] at hbase
  have hfield := directCircuit_eq_baseLinear (k := k) i
    (valueU k t) (valueV k t) (legalDenominator k t ht) (Pi.single j 1)
  rw [hfield] at hbase
  have hext := SourceAutExtension.linearEquiv_on_constants
    (R := RationalSourceFamily.F k) (baseAut k i t ht) (Pi.single j 1)
  rw [SourceAutExtension.mapCoord_single] at hext
  exact hfam.trans (hbase.symm.trans hext.symm)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.PeirceReflectionFamily.eval_matrix
statement:
theorem eval_matrix (i : Fin 3) (t : Param → k)
    (ht : MvPolynomial.eval t (denominator k) ≠ 0)
    (x : Fin 27 → RationalSourceFamily.F k) :
    ((matrix k i).map (evaluation k t ht)).mulVec x =
      SourceAutExtension.linearEquiv (R := RationalSourceFamily.F k)
        (baseAut k i t ht) x
proof:
:= by
  have hmat : (matrix k i).map (evaluation k t ht) =
      LinearMap.toMatrix'
        (SourceAutExtension.linear (R := RationalSourceFamily.F k)
          (baseAut k i t ht)) := by
    ext c j
    change evaluation k t ht (familyLinear k i (Pi.single j 1) c) =
      SourceAutExtension.linearEquiv (R := RationalSourceFamily.F k)
        (baseAut k i t ht) (Pi.single j 1) c
    exact congrFun (eval_familyLinear_single k i t ht j) c
  rw [hmat]
  exact LinearMap.toMatrix'_mulVec _ x

name: AlbertLean.Generic.PeirceReflectionFamily.valueU_encode

name: AlbertLean.Generic.PeirceReflectionFamily.valueV_encode

name: AlbertLean.Generic.PeirceReflectionFamily.covers_traceOne_idempotent
statement:
theorem covers_traceOne_idempotent (e : JCoord k)
    (he : sourceProduct e e = e) (hT : sourceTrace e = 1) :
    ∃ (i : Fin 3) (t : Param → k)
        (ht : MvPolynomial.eval t (denominator k) ≠ 0),
      (stage k i).baseAut t ht = sourcePeirceAut e he
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, u, v, hD, hchart⟩ := exists_pivot_chart e he hT
  subst e
  refine ⟨i, encode k u v, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [eval_denominator, valueU_encode, valueV_encode] using hD
  · simp only [stage, baseAut, valueU_encode, valueV_encode]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealLedgerNaturality.embed_add_matrix
statement: theorem embed_add_matrix (A B : Mat3 K) : embed (A + B) = embed A + embed B

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealLedgerNaturality.embed_matrixProjector
statement:
theorem embed_matrixProjector (A : Mat3 K) (i : Fin 3) :
    embed (matrixProjector A i) = tauProjector (embed A) i
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i <;>
    simp [matrixProjector, tauProjector, embed_smul_matrix,
      embed_sub_matrix, embed_add_matrix, embed_one_matrix, embed_matrixJordan,
      Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.vecHead, Matrix.vecTail]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealLedgerNaturality.tauProjector_embed
statement:
theorem tauProjector_embed (A : Mat3 K) (i : Fin 3) :
    tauProjector (embed A) i = embed (matrixProjector A i)

:=
  (embed_matrixProjector A i).symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealLedgerNaturality.trace_embed_pair
statement:
theorem trace_embed_pair (A B : Mat3 K) :
    TauCeti.AlbertAlgebra.trace (embed A * embed B) = Matrix.trace (A * B)
proof:
:=
  tauTrace_embed_mul_toTau A (B, 0, 0)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealLedgerNaturality.trace_embed_joint
statement:
theorem trace_embed_joint (A B C : Mat3 K) :
    TauCeti.AlbertAlgebra.trace (embed A * (embed B * embed C)) =
      Matrix.trace (matrixJordan A B * C)
proof:
:=
  tauTrace_embed_mul_embed_mul_toTau A B (C, 0, 0)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealLedgerNaturality.labelledLedger_embed_eq
statement:

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealLedgerNaturality.mapMatrix_smul
statement:
theorem mapMatrix_smul (f : K →+* L) (c : K) (A : Mat3 K) :
    f.mapMatrix (c • A) = f c • f.mapMatrix A
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  change f (c * A i j) = f c * f (A i j)
  exact map_mul f c (A i j)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealLedgerNaturality.mapMatrix_matrixJordan
statement:
theorem mapMatrix_matrixJordan (f : K →+* L) (A B : Mat3 K) :
    f.mapMatrix (matrixJordan A B) = matrixJordan (f.mapMatrix A) (f.mapMatrix B)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [matrixJordan, invOf_eq_inv, mapMatrix_smul, map_add, map_mul,
    map_inv₀, map_ofNat]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealLedgerNaturality.mapMatrix_matrixProjector
statement:
theorem mapMatrix_matrixProjector (f : K →+* L) (A : Mat3 K) (i : Fin 3) :
    f.mapMatrix (matrixProjector A i) = matrixProjector (f.mapMatrix A) i
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i <;>
    dsimp only [matrixProjector, Matrix.cons_val, Fin.reduceFinMk] <;>
    simp only [mapMatrix_smul, map_sub, map_add, map_one, map_inv₀, map_ofNat,
      mapMatrix_matrixJordan]

theorem mapMatrix_trace (f : K →+* L) (A : Mat3 K) :
