name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealLedgerNaturality.matrixLedger_map
statement:
theorem matrixLedger_map (f : K →+* L) (T : Fin 3 → Mat3 K) :
    matrixLedger (fun r => f.mapMatrix (T r)) = mapLedgerValues f (matrixLedger T)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [matrixLedger, mapLedgerValues, mapMatrix_trace, map_add, map_sub,
    map_div₀, map_ofNat, map_mul, mapMatrix_matrixProjector, mapMatrix_matrixJordan]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealLedgerNaturality.primitiveLedger_eq_matrixLedger
statement:
theorem primitiveLedger_eq_matrixLedger (P : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Mat3 K) :
    labelledLedger (primitiveMatrixTauTriple P) =
      matrixLedger (fun r => P r 2 - P r 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hT : primitiveMatrixTauTriple P = fun r => embed (P r 2 - P r 0) := by
    funext r
    exact (embed_sub_matrix (P r 2) (P r 0)).symm
  rw [hT, labelledLedger_embed_eq]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealLedgerNaturality.primitiveLedger_map
statement:
theorem primitiveLedger_map (f : K →+* L) (P : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Mat3 K) :
    labelledLedger (primitiveMatrixTauTriple (fun r i => f.mapMatrix (P r i))) =
      mapLedgerValues f (labelledLedger (primitiveMatrixTauTriple P))
proof:
:= by
  rw [primitiveLedger_eq_matrixLedger, primitiveLedger_eq_matrixLedger]
  simpa only [map_sub] using matrixLedger_map f (fun r => P r 2 - P r 0)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertScheduleGenericDephase.fractionEmbedding_comp_rawLedgerSubstitution
statement:
theorem fractionEmbedding_comp_rawLedgerSubstitution :
    ((fractionEmbedding k).comp (rawToFunction k)).comp
        (rawLedgerSubstitution k) = comparisonEval k
proof:
:= by
  apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
  · intro c
    simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, rawLedgerSubstitution,
      MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_C]
    rw [show comparisonEval k (MvPolynomial.C c) =
        algebraMap k (E k) c by simp [comparisonEval]]
    change fractionEmbedding k (scalarMap k c) = algebraMap k (E k) c
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun (fractionEmbedding_scalarMap k) c
  · intro x
    simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, rawLedgerSubstitution_X, comparisonEval_X]
    rcases x with ⟨i,j⟩ | x
    · change fractionEmbedding k (ledgerValue k (0, i, j, 0)) =
        (comparisonLedger k).P i j
      exact (comparison_ledger_P k i j).symm
    · rcases x with ⟨j,l⟩ | x
      · change fractionEmbedding k (ledgerValue k (1, j, l, 0)) =
          (comparisonLedger k).Q j l
        exact (comparison_ledger_Q k j l).symm
      · rcases x with ⟨l,i⟩ | ⟨i,j,l⟩
        · change fractionEmbedding k (ledgerValue k (2, l, i, 0)) =
            (comparisonLedger k).R l i
          exact (comparison_ledger_R k l i).symm
        · change fractionEmbedding k (ledgerValue k (3, i, j, l)) =
            (comparisonLedger k).C0 i j l
          exact (comparison_ledger_C0 k i j l).symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertScheduleGenericDephase.fractionEmbedding_fractionBetaOpen
statement:
theorem fractionEmbedding_fractionBetaOpen :
    fractionEmbedding k (fractionBetaOpen k) =
      comparisonEval k (UniformMomentBetaOpen.betaOpen k)
proof:
:= by
  change fractionEmbedding k (rawToFunction k (rawBetaOpen k)) = _
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun (fractionEmbedding_comp_rawLedgerSubstitution k)
    (UniformMomentBetaOpen.betaOpen k)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertScheduleGenericDephase.comparison_fixedSpectrum
statement:
theorem comparison_fixedSpectrum :
    sourceTrace (comparisonA k) = 0 ∧
      sourceSpur (comparisonA k) = -1 ∧
      sourceNorm (comparisonA k) = 0 ∧
      sourceTrace (comparisonB k) = 0 ∧
      sourceSpur (comparisonB k) = -1 ∧
      sourceNorm (comparisonB k) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hA := encoder_fixed_spectrum (comparisonFrame k 1)
    (AlbertScheduleGenericComparison.comparisonFrame_laws k 1)
  have hB := encoder_fixed_spectrum (comparisonFrame k 2)
    (AlbertScheduleGenericComparison.comparisonFrame_laws k 2)
  have hAeq : comparisonFrame k 1 2 - comparisonFrame k 1 0 =
      comparisonA k := by
    change comparisonFrame k 1 2 - comparisonFrame k 1 0 =
      comparisonSources k 1
    exact (comparisonSources_eq_frame_difference k 1).symm
  have hBeq : comparisonFrame k 2 2 - comparisonFrame k 2 0 =
      comparisonB k := by
    change comparisonFrame k 2 2 - comparisonFrame k 2 0 =
      comparisonSources k 2
    exact (comparisonSources_eq_frame_difference k 2).symm
  have hA' : sourceTrace (comparisonA k) = 0 ∧
      sourceSpur (comparisonA k) = -1 ∧
      sourceNorm (comparisonA k) = 0 := by
    simpa only [hAeq] using hA
  have hB' : sourceTrace (comparisonB k) = 0 ∧
      sourceSpur (comparisonB k) = -1 ∧
      sourceNorm (comparisonB k) = 0 := by
    simpa only [hBeq] using hB
  exact ⟨hA'.1, hA'.2.1, hA'.2.2, hB'.1, hB'.2.1, hB'.2.2⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertScheduleGenericDephase.comparisonEval_a
statement:
theorem comparisonEval_a :
    comparisonEval k (a k) = nV (comparisonA k).v
proof:
:= by
  have hm := recovered_measurements (comparisonA k) (comparisonB k)
    (comparison_fixedSpectrum k).2.2.1
    (comparison_fixedSpectrum k).2.2.2.2.2
  calc
    comparisonEval k (a k) =
        nVx (mapLedger (comparisonEval k) (universalLedger k)) := by
      exact map_nVx' (comparisonEval k) (comparisonEval_rat k)
        (universalLedger k)
    _ = nVx (comparisonLedger k) := by rw [comparisonEval_universalLedger]
    _ = nV (comparisonA k).v := hm.1

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertScheduleGenericDephase.comparisonEval_h
statement:
theorem comparisonEval_h :
    comparisonEval k (h k) = BV (comparisonA k).v (comparisonB k).v
proof:
:= by
  have hm := recovered_measurements (comparisonA k) (comparisonB k)
    (comparison_fixedSpectrum k).2.2.1
    (comparison_fixedSpectrum k).2.2.2.2.2
  calc
    comparisonEval k (h k) =
        gV (mapLedger (comparisonEval k) (universalLedger k)) 1 1 := by
      exact map_gV' (comparisonEval k) (comparisonEval_rat k)
        (universalLedger k) 1 1
    _ = gV (comparisonLedger k) 1 1 := by rw [comparisonEval_universalLedger]
    _ = BV (comparisonA k).v (comparisonB k).v :=
      hm.2.2.2.2.2.2.1

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertScheduleGenericDephase.comparisonEval_nVy
statement:
theorem comparisonEval_nVy :
    comparisonEval k (nVy (universalLedger k)) = nV (comparisonB k).v
proof:
:= by
  have hm := recovered_measurements (comparisonA k) (comparisonB k)
    (comparison_fixedSpectrum k).2.2.1
    (comparison_fixedSpectrum k).2.2.2.2.2
  calc
    comparisonEval k (nVy (universalLedger k)) =
        nVy (mapLedger (comparisonEval k) (universalLedger k)) := by
      exact map_nVy' (comparisonEval k) (comparisonEval_rat k)
        (universalLedger k)
    _ = nVy (comparisonLedger k) := by rw [comparisonEval_universalLedger]
    _ = nV (comparisonB k).v := hm.2.2.2.1

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertScheduleGenericDephase.comparisonEval_discr
statement:
theorem comparisonEval_discr :
    comparisonEval k (discr k) =
      (BV (comparisonA k).v (comparisonB k).v) ^ 2 -
        4 * nV (comparisonA k).v * nV (comparisonB k).v
proof:
:= by
  simp only [discr, map_sub, map_pow, map_mul, map_ofNat,
    comparisonEval_h, comparisonEval_a, comparisonEval_nVy]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertScheduleGenericDephase.comparison_dephase_open
statement:
theorem comparison_dephase_open :
    nV (comparisonA k).v ≠ 0 ∧
      4 * nV (comparisonA k).v * nV (comparisonB k).v -
        (BV (comparisonA k).v (comparisonB k).v) ^ 2 ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hopenRaw : fractionEmbedding k (fractionBetaOpen k) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [map_zero] using
      (fractionEmbedding_injective k).ne (fractionBetaOpen_ne_zero k)
  have hopen : comparisonEval k (UniformMomentBetaOpen.betaOpen k) ≠ 0 := by
    rwa [fractionEmbedding_fractionBetaOpen] at hopenRaw
  have hB0 : comparisonEval k (B0 k) ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    apply hopen
    rw [UniformMomentBetaOpen.betaOpen, map_mul, hz]
    exact zero_mul _
  have ha : comparisonEval k (a k) ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    apply hB0
    rw [B0, map_mul, map_mul, hz, zero_mul]
    exact zero_mul _
  have hd : comparisonEval k (discr k) ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    apply hB0
    rw [B0, map_mul, map_mul, hz, mul_zero, zero_mul]
  rw [comparisonEval_a] at ha
  rw [comparisonEval_discr] at hd
  exact ⟨ha, by simpa only [neg_sub] using neg_ne_zero.mpr hd⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertScheduleGenericDephase.twoEven_public_facts
statement:
private theorem twoEven_public_facts
    {K : Type u} [Field K] [CharZero K] (w : TwoEvenWord K) :
    (∀ i, w.aut.linear (diagonalUnit i) = diagonalUnit i) ∧
      (∀ z : JCoord K,
        ((w.aut.linear z).d1, (w.aut.linear z).d2, (w.aut.linear z).d3) =
          (z.d1, z.d2, z.d3))
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨w.fixes_diagonalUnit, w.apply_diagonal⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertScheduleGenericDephase.mapped_action_fixedSpectrum
statement:
private theorem mapped_action_fixedSpectrum
    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [CharZero K] [Field L] [CharZero L]
    (f : K →+* L) (g : SourceAut (K := L)) (x y : JCoord K)
    (hTx : sourceTrace x = 0) (hSx : sourceSpur x = -1)
    (hNx : sourceNorm x = 0) (hTy : sourceTrace y = 0)
    (hSy : sourceSpur y = -1) (hNy : sourceNorm y = 0) :
    let X
proof:
:= g.linear (mapSource f x)
    let Y := g.linear (mapSource f y)
    sourceTrace X = 0 ∧ sourceSpur X = -1 ∧ sourceNorm X = 0 ∧
      sourceTrace Y = 0 ∧ sourceSpur Y = -1 ∧ sourceNorm Y = 0 := by
  dsimp only
  simp only [SourceAutInvariants.sourceTrace_invariant, mapSource_trace,
    sourceSpur_invariant, sourceSpur_mapSource,
    sourceNorm_invariant, sourceNorm_mapSource,
    hTx, hSx, hNx, hTy, hSy, hNy, map_zero, map_neg, map_one,
    and_self]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertScheduleGenericDephase.readback_public_facts
statement:
private theorem readback_public_facts
    {K : Type u} [Field K] [CharZero K]
    (X Y : JCoord K) (sigma a h : K) (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (hx : X.v = targetFirst a) (hy : Y.v = targetSecond a h sigma)
    (hfixed : sourceTrace X = 0 ∧ sourceSpur X = -1 ∧
      sourceNorm X = 0 ∧ sourceTrace Y = 0 ∧
      sourceSpur Y = -1 ∧ sourceNorm Y = 0) :
    let q
proof:
:= readback X Y sigma
    encoderA q = X ∧ encoderB q = Y ∧ IsKappaLift q ∧
      EquationsVanish (explicitFrameEquationValues q) ∧
      q.r1 = 1 ∧ q.z1 = a ∧
      q.r2 = (h - sigma) / (2 * a) ∧ q.z2 = (h + sigma) / 2 := by
  dsimp only
  have hr := readback_spec X Y sigma a h ha hx hy
    hfixed.1 hfixed.2.1 hfixed.2.2.1 hfixed.2.2.2.1
    hfixed.2.2.2.2.1 hfixed.2.2.2.2.2
  refine ⟨hr.1, hr.2.1, hr.2.2.1, hr.2.2.2, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change X.v.r = 1
    rw [hx]
    rfl
  · change X.v.z = a
    rw [hx]
    rfl
  · change Y.v.r = (h - sigma) / (2 * a)
    rw [hy]
    rfl
  · change Y.v.z = (h + sigma) / 2
    rw [hy]
    rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertScheduleGenericDephase.exists_finite_dephase_readback_twoEven
statement:
private theorem exists_finite_dephase_readback_twoEven
    {K : Type u} [Field K] [CharZero K] (x y : JCoord K)
    (ha : nV x.v ≠ 0)
    (hGram : 4 * nV x.v * nV y.v - (BV x.v y.v) ^ 2 ≠ 0)
    (hTx : sourceTrace x = 0) (hSx : sourceSpur x = -1)
    (hNx : sourceNorm x = 0) (hTy : sourceTrace y = 0)
    (hSy : sourceSpur y = -1) (hNy : sourceNorm y = 0) :
    ∃ (L : Type u) (_ : Field L) (_ : CharZero L)
      (f : K →+* L) (sigma : L) (w : TwoEvenWord L)
      (q : ExplicitFrameChart L),
      Function.Injective f ∧
      sigma ^ 2 = f ((BV x.v y.v) ^ 2 - 4 * nV x.v * nV y.v) ∧
      sigma ≠ 0 ∧
      (∀ i, w.aut.linear (diagonalUnit i) = diagonalUnit i) ∧
      (∀ z : JCoord L,
        ((w.aut.linear z).d1, (w.aut.linear z).d2, (w.aut.linear z).d3) =
          (z.d1, z.d2, z.d3)) ∧
      encoderA q = w.aut.linear (mapSource f x) ∧
      encoderB q = w.aut.linear (mapSource f y) ∧
      IsKappaLift q ∧
      EquationsVanish (explicitFrameEquationValues q) ∧
      q.r1 = 1 ∧
      q.z1 = f (nV x.v) ∧
      q.r2 = (f (BV x.v y.v) - sigma) / (2 * f (nV x.v)) ∧
      q.z2 = (f (BV x.v y.v) + sigma) / 2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨L, iL, cL, f, sigma, w, hf, hsigma, hsigma0, hx, hy⟩ :=
    exists_common_field_twoEven x y ha hGram
  letI : Field L := iL
  letI : CharZero L := cL
  let X := w.aut.linear (mapSource f x)
  let Y := w.aut.linear (mapSource f y)
  let q := readback X Y sigma
  have hfa : f (nV x.v) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [map_zero] using hf.ne ha
  have hw := twoEven_public_facts w
  have hfixed := mapped_action_fixedSpectrum f w.aut x y
    hTx hSx hNx hTy hSy hNy
  have hread := readback_public_facts X Y sigma (f (nV x.v))
    (f (BV x.v y.v)) hfa hx hy hfixed
  refine ⟨L, iL, cL, f, sigma, w, q, hf, hsigma, hsigma0,
    hw.1, hw.2, hread.1, hread.2.1, hread.2.2.1, hread.2.2.2.1,
    ?_, ?_, hread.2.2.2.2.2.2.1, hread.2.2.2.2.2.2.2⟩
  · exact hread.2.2.2.2.1
  · exact hread.2.2.2.2.2.1

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertScheduleGenericDephase.exists_actual_finite_dephase_readback_twoEven
statement:
theorem exists_actual_finite_dephase_readback_twoEven :
    ∃ (L : Type u) (_ : Field L) (_ : CharZero L)
      (f : E k →+* L) (sigma : L) (w : TwoEvenWord L)
      (q : ExplicitFrameChart L),
      Function.Injective f ∧
      sigma ^ 2 = f ((BV (comparisonA k).v (comparisonB k).v) ^ 2 -
        4 * nV (comparisonA k).v * nV (comparisonB k).v) ∧
      sigma ≠ 0 ∧
      (∀ i, w.aut.linear (diagonalUnit i) = diagonalUnit i) ∧
      (∀ z : JCoord L,
        ((w.aut.linear z).d1, (w.aut.linear z).d2, (w.aut.linear z).d3) =
          (z.d1, z.d2, z.d3)) ∧
      encoderA q = w.aut.linear (mapSource f (comparisonA k)) ∧
      encoderB q = w.aut.linear (mapSource f (comparisonB k)) ∧
      IsKappaLift q ∧
      EquationsVanish (explicitFrameEquationValues q) ∧
      q.r1 = 1 ∧
      q.z1 = f (nV (comparisonA k).v) ∧
      q.r2 = (f (BV (comparisonA k).v (comparisonB k).v) - sigma) /
        (2 * f (nV (comparisonA k).v)) ∧
      q.z2 = (f (BV (comparisonA k).v (comparisonB k).v) + sigma) / 2
proof:
:= by
  have ha : nV (comparisonA k).v ≠ 0 := (comparison_dephase_open k).1
  have hGram : 4 * nV (comparisonA k).v * nV (comparisonB k).v -
      (BV (comparisonA k).v (comparisonB k).v) ^ 2 ≠ 0 :=
    (comparison_dephase_open k).2
  have hTx : sourceTrace (comparisonA k) = 0 := (comparison_fixedSpectrum k).1
  have hSx : sourceSpur (comparisonA k) = -1 := (comparison_fixedSpectrum k).2.1
  have hNx : sourceNorm (comparisonA k) = 0 := (comparison_fixedSpectrum k).2.2.1
  have hTy : sourceTrace (comparisonB k) = 0 :=
    (comparison_fixedSpectrum k).2.2.2.1
  have hSy : sourceSpur (comparisonB k) = -1 :=
    (comparison_fixedSpectrum k).2.2.2.2.1
  have hNy : sourceNorm (comparisonB k) = 0 :=
    (comparison_fixedSpectrum k).2.2.2.2.2
  exact exists_finite_dephase_readback_twoEven
    (comparisonA k) (comparisonB k) ha hGram hTx hSx hNx hTy hSy hNy

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertScheduleGenericDephase.exists_actual_finite_dephase_readback
statement:
theorem exists_actual_finite_dephase_readback :
    ∃ (L : Type u) (_ : Field L) (_ : CharZero L)
      (f : E k →+* L) (sigma : L) (g : SourceAut (K := L))
      (q : ExplicitFrameChart L),
      Function.Injective f ∧
      sigma ^ 2 = f ((BV (comparisonA k).v (comparisonB k).v) ^ 2 -
        4 * nV (comparisonA k).v * nV (comparisonB k).v) ∧
      sigma ≠ 0 ∧
      (∀ i, g.linear (diagonalUnit i) = diagonalUnit i) ∧
      (∀ z : JCoord L,
        ((g.linear z).d1, (g.linear z).d2, (g.linear z).d3) =
          (z.d1, z.d2, z.d3)) ∧
      encoderA q = g.linear (mapSource f (comparisonA k)) ∧
      encoderB q = g.linear (mapSource f (comparisonB k)) ∧
      IsKappaLift q ∧
      EquationsVanish (explicitFrameEquationValues q) ∧
      q.r1 = 1 ∧
      q.z1 = f (nV (comparisonA k).v) ∧
      q.r2 = (f (BV (comparisonA k).v (comparisonB k).v) - sigma) /
        (2 * f (nV (comparisonA k).v)) ∧
      q.z2 = (f (BV (comparisonA k).v (comparisonB k).v) + sigma) / 2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨L, iL, cL, f, sigma, w, q, hf, hsigma, hsigma0, hdiag,
    hdiagFields, hA, hB, hkappa, hequations, hr1, hz1, hr2, hz2⟩ :=
    exists_actual_finite_dephase_readback_twoEven k
  exact ⟨L, iL, cL, f, sigma, w.aut, q, hf, hsigma, hsigma0, hdiag,
    hdiagFields, hA, hB, hkappa, hequations, hr1, hz1, hr2, hz2⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericCommonFixedField.kappa_square_mem_H
statement: theorem kappa_square_mem_H : kappa k ^ 2 ∈ H k
proof:
:= by
  let x := genericChart k
  have hl : LedgerIn (H k) (sourceLedger (encoderA x) (encoderB x)) :=
    ledgerIn_ledgerField (groundBase k) _ _
  have hd := powers_diag_mem (H k) _ _ hl
  have ha := norms_mem (H k) (encoderA x) (hd.1 1) (hd.1 2)
  have hb := norms_mem (H k) (encoderB x) (hd.2 1) (hd.2 2)
  have hg : BV (vectorA x) (vectorB x) ∈ H k :=
    (power_sectors_mem (H k) _ _ hl 1 1).1
  have he : kappa k ^ 2 = BV (vectorA x) (vectorB x) ^ 2 -
      4 * nV (vectorA x) * nV (vectorB x) := by
    rw [kappa_eq_orientation]
    change orientation x ^ 2 = _
    simp [orientation, BV, BW, vectorA, vectorB, nV, Pf]
    ring
  rw [he]
  exact (H k).sub_mem ((H k).pow_mem hg 2)
    ((H k).mul_mem ((H k).mul_mem (natCast_mem (H k) 4) ha.1) hb.1)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericCommonFixedField.orientation_adjoin_eq_invariant
statement:

    Subfield.closure (((H k : Subfield (FunctionField k)) : Set (FunctionField k)) ∪

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericCommonFixedField.joint_fixed_iff
statement:
theorem joint_fixed_iff (z : FunctionField k) :
    (tau k z = z ∧ deck k z = z) ↔ z ∈ H k
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨ht,hd⟩
    have hz : z ∈ Subfield.closure ((H k : Set (FunctionField k)) ∪ {kappa k}) := by
      rw [orientation_adjoin_eq_invariant]
      exact (fixed_iff_mem_invariantField (Base k) (Matrix.det (rationalM k))
        (det_rationalM_ne_zero k) z).1 hd
    have hn : nu k z = z := by
      apply (deck k).injective
      change tau k z = deck k z
      rw [ht,hd]
    exact (SignRootAdjoin.fixed_iff_mem_base (H k) (nu k)
      (fun _ h => H_le_nuFixed k h) (kappa k) (kappa_square_mem_H k)
      (nu_kappa k) (kappa_ne_zero k) hz).1 hn
  · intro hz
    exact ⟨tau_fixed_of_mem_H k hz,deck_fixed_of_mem_H k hz⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TensorDifferenceDescent.exists_annihilator_derivative_ne_zero
statement:
theorem exists_annihilator_derivative_ne_zero (a : K)
    (h : ∃ p : Polynomial H, p ≠ 0 ∧ Polynomial.aeval a p = 0) :
    ∃ p : Polynomial H, p ≠ 0 ∧ Polynomial.aeval a p = 0 ∧
      Polynomial.aeval a p.derivative ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let P : ℕ → Prop := fun n =>
    ∃ p : Polynomial H, p ≠ 0 ∧ Polynomial.aeval a p = 0 ∧ p.natDegree = n
  have hn : ∃ n, P n := by
    obtain ⟨p, hp0, hp⟩ := h
    exact ⟨p.natDegree, p, hp0, hp, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨p, hp0, hpa, hpdeg⟩ := Nat.find_spec hn
  have hpdeg0 : p.natDegree ≠ 0 := by
    intro hdeg
    have hpC : p = Polynomial.C (p.coeff 0) :=
      Polynomial.eq_C_of_natDegree_eq_zero hdeg
    have hcmap : algebraMap H K (p.coeff 0) = 0 := by
      have hr := hpa
      rw [hpC, Polynomial.aeval_C] at hr
      exact hr
    have hc : p.coeff 0 = 0 := (algebraMap H K).injective (by simpa using hcmap)
    apply hp0
    rw [hpC, hc, Polynomial.C_0]
  refine ⟨p, hp0, hpa, ?_⟩
  intro hpder
  have hpder0 : p.derivative ≠ 0 :=
    Polynomial.derivative_ne_zero.mpr hpdeg0
  have hlt0 : p.derivative.natDegree < p.natDegree :=
    Polynomial.natDegree_derivative_lt hpdeg0
  have hlt : p.derivative.natDegree < Nat.find hn := by
    simpa [hpdeg] using hlt0
  exact (Nat.find_min hn hlt)
    ⟨p.derivative, hpder0, hpder, rfl⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TensorDifferenceDescent.difference_eq_zero_of_annihilator_of_isNilpotent
statement:
theorem difference_eq_zero_of_annihilator_of_isNilpotent
    (a : K) (p : Polynomial H)
    (hpa : Polynomial.aeval a p = 0)
    (hpder : Polynomial.aeval a p.derivative ≠ 0)
    (hz : IsNilpotent (difference H K a)) :
    difference H K a = 0
proof:
:= by
  let q : Polynomial (TensorSquare H K) := p.map (algebraMap H (TensorSquare H K))
  let x : TensorSquare H K := right H K a
  let z : TensorSquare H K := difference H K a
  have hq_x : q.eval x = 0 := by
    change (p.map _).eval ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight :
      K →ₐ[H] TensorSquare H K) a) = 0
    rw [Polynomial.eval_map_algebraMap, Polynomial.aeval_algHom_apply, hpa, map_zero]
  have hxz : x + z = left H K a := by
    simp [x, z, difference]
  have hq_xz : q.eval (x + z) = 0 := by
    rw [hxz]
    change (p.map _).eval ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft (S := H) :
      K →ₐ[H] TensorSquare H K) a) = 0
    rw [Polynomial.eval_map_algebraMap, Polynomial.aeval_algHom_apply, hpa, map_zero]
  have hdu : IsUnit (q.derivative.eval x) := by
    have huK : IsUnit (Polynomial.aeval a p.derivative) :=
      isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hpder
    have huT := huK.map (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight :
      K →ₐ[H] TensorSquare H K)
    change IsUnit ((p.map _).derivative.eval ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight :
      K →ₐ[H] TensorSquare H K) a))
    rw [Polynomial.derivative_map, Polynomial.eval_map_algebraMap,
      Polynomial.aeval_algHom_apply]
    exact huT
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ : ∃ r : Polynomial (TensorSquare H K),
      q = (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C x) * r :=
    Polynomial.dvd_iff_isRoot.mpr (Polynomial.IsRoot.def.mpr hq_x)
  have hr_deriv : r.eval x = q.derivative.eval x := by
    have h := congrArg (fun s : Polynomial (TensorSquare H K) => s.derivative.eval x) hr
    simpa [Polynomial.derivative_mul] using h.symm
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Polynomial.sub_dvd_eval_sub (x + z) x r
  have hr_add : r.eval (x + z) = r.eval x + z * c := by
    have hc' : r.eval (x + z) - r.eval x = z * c := by
      simpa [add_sub_cancel_left] using hc
    simpa [add_comm] using sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mp hc'
  have hzc : IsNilpotent (z * c) :=
    (Commute.all z c).isNilpotent_mul_right hz
  have hfactor : IsUnit (r.eval (x + z)) := by
    rw [hr_add, hr_deriv]
    exact hzc.isUnit_add_left_of_commute hdu (Commute.all _ _)
  have hprod : z * r.eval (x + z) = 0 := by
    have h := congrArg (fun s : Polynomial (TensorSquare H K) => s.eval (x + z)) hr
    rw [hq_xz, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_sub,
      Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_C] at h
    simpa using h.symm
  exact hfactor.mul_right_injective (by simpa [mul_comm] using hprod)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TensorDifferenceDescent.exists_base_of_contraction
statement:
theorem exists_base_of_contraction
    (a : K) (ell : K →ₗ[H] H) (pi : TensorSquare H K →ₗ[H] K)
    (hleft : pi (left H K a) = a)
    (hright : pi (right H K a) = algebraMap H K (ell a))
    (hz : difference H K a = 0) :
    ∃ h : H, algebraMap H K h = a
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨ell a, ?_⟩
  have := congrArg pi hz
  simp only [difference, map_sub, map_zero, sub_eq_zero, hleft, hright] at this
  exact this.symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TensorDifferenceDescent.exists_base_of_difference_isNilpotent
statement:
theorem exists_base_of_difference_isNilpotent (a : K)
    (hz : IsNilpotent (difference H K a)) :
    ∃ h : H, algebraMap H K h = a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hz
  obtain ⟨p, hpmonic, hpa⟩ :=
    exists_monic_annihilator_of_tensorDifference_pow_eq_zero H K a n hn
  obtain ⟨q, hq0, hqa, hqder⟩ :=
    exists_annihilator_derivative_ne_zero H K a
      ⟨p, hpmonic.ne_zero, hpa⟩
  apply exists_base_of_contraction H K a (scalarRetraction H K) (contractRight H K)
  · simp [left]
  · simp [right, Algebra.smul_def]
  · exact difference_eq_zero_of_annihilator_of_isNilpotent H K a q hqa hqder ⟨n, hn⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericDetectorTauParameters.tau_moment

    (ambientMoment k).map (tau k) = reflectedMoment k
proof:

  ext i j
  change tau k (includeBase k (rationalM k i j)) = _
  rw [tau_base]
  have h := congrFun (congrFun (rationalM_reorient k) i) j
  change reorient k (rationalM k i j) =
    (weight k i)⁻¹ * weight k j * rationalM k j i at h

    fieldScheduleUnapply k e r (structuredEquivK L x) =
      structuredEquivK L
        ((scheduleAut (fieldSchedule k e r)).linear.symm x)
proof:
:= by
  apply_fun (fieldScheduleFormula k e r)
  · rw [fieldScheduleFormula_unapply]
    simp only [fieldScheduleFormula, fieldStageFormula]

      fieldSlotShift_native, fieldSlotShift_native, fieldSlotShift_native,
      fieldSlotShift_native, fieldSlotShift_native, fieldSlotShift_native,
      fieldSlotShift_native, fieldSlotShift_native, fieldSlotShift_native]
    change structuredEquivK L x = structuredEquivK L
      (applySchedule (fieldSchedule k e r)
        ((scheduleAut (fieldSchedule k e r)).linear.symm x))
    rw [← scheduleAut_apply]
    simp
  · intro a b hab
    rw [← fieldScheduleUnapply_apply k e r a,
      ← fieldScheduleUnapply_apply k e r b, hab]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowProbeTrace.trace_diagonalUnit
statement:
theorem trace_diagonalUnit (A : Mat3 K) (i : Fin 3) :
    Matrix.trace (diagonalUnit i * A) = A i i
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i <;>
    simp [Matrix.trace_fin_three, Matrix.mul_apply, diagonalUnit, Fin.sum_univ_succ]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowProbeTrace.trace_symmetricProbe
statement:
theorem trace_symmetricProbe (F A : Mat3 K) (i : Fin 3) :
    Matrix.trace ((diagonalUnit i * F + F * diagonalUnit i) * A) =
      rowSymMeasurements F A i
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i <;>
    simp [Matrix.trace_fin_three, Matrix.mul_apply, diagonalUnit,
      rowSymMeasurements, Fin.sum_univ_succ] <;> ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowProbeTrace.det_grading_commutator
statement:
theorem det_grading_commutator (F : Mat3 K) :
    Matrix.det (grading * F - F * grading) = 2 * cycleDifference F
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.det_fin_three]
  simp [grading, cycleDifference, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowProbeTrace.eq_of_trace_probes
statement:
theorem eq_of_trace_probes (F A B : Mat3 K)
    (hdet : Matrix.det (grading * F - F * grading) ≠ 0)
    (hDiag : ∀ i, Matrix.trace (diagonalUnit i * A) = Matrix.trace (diagonalUnit i * B))
    (hFirst : ∀ i,
      Matrix.trace ((diagonalUnit i * F + F * diagonalUnit i) * A) =
        Matrix.trace ((diagonalUnit i * F + F * diagonalUnit i) * B))
    (hSecond : ∀ i,
      Matrix.trace ((diagonalUnit i * (F * F) + (F * F) * diagonalUnit i) * A) =
        Matrix.trace ((diagonalUnit i * (F * F) + (F * F) * diagonalUnit i) * B)) :
    A = B
proof:
:= by
  rw [det_grading_commutator] at hdet
  apply rowSymMeasurements_injective F A B
    (left_ne_zero_of_mul hdet) (right_ne_zero_of_mul hdet)
  · intro i
    simpa only [trace_diagonalUnit] using hDiag i
  · funext i
    simpa only [trace_symmetricProbe] using hFirst i
  · funext i
    simpa only [trace_symmetricProbe] using hSecond i

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowAdjoint.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left
statement:
theorem eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left
    (M X Y : Mat3 K) (hM : M.det ≠ 0) (h : M * X = M * Y) : X = Y
proof:
:= by
  calc
    X = M⁻¹ * (M * X) := by
      rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc,
        Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul M (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hM), Matrix.one_mul]
    _ = M⁻¹ * (M * Y) := by rw [h]
    _ = Y := by
      rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc,
        Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul M (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hM), Matrix.one_mul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowAdjoint.det_nonsing_inv_mul_adjugate
statement:
theorem det_nonsing_inv_mul_adjugate
    (a b : Mat3 K) (hb : b.det ≠ 0) (hdet : b.det = a.det) :
    (b⁻¹ * a.adjugate).det = a.det
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_nonsing_inv, Matrix.det_adjugate]
  rw [← hdet]
  simp only [Ring.inverse_eq_inv]
  field_simp [hb]
  norm_num

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowAdjoint.adjugate_eq_mul_parametrized
statement:
theorem adjugate_eq_mul_parametrized
    (a b : Mat3 K) (hb : b.det ≠ 0) :
    a.adjugate = b * (b⁻¹ * a.adjugate)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc,
    Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv b (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hb), Matrix.one_mul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowAdjoint.adjugate_b_eq_parametrized_mul_a
statement:
theorem adjugate_b_eq_parametrized_mul_a
    (a b : Mat3 K) (hb : b.det ≠ 0) (hdet : b.det = a.det) :
    b.adjugate = (b⁻¹ * a.adjugate) * a
proof:
:= by
  apply eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left b _ _ hb
  calc
    b * b.adjugate = b.det • (1 : Mat3 K) := Matrix.mul_adjugate b
    _ = a.det • (1 : Mat3 K) := by rw [hdet]
    _ = a.adjugate * a := (Matrix.adjugate_mul a).symm
    _ = b * ((b⁻¹ * a.adjugate) * a) := by
      rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Matrix.mul_assoc,
        Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv b (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hb), Matrix.one_mul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowAdjoint.adjugate_parametrized_eq_mul
statement:
theorem adjugate_parametrized_eq_mul
    (a b : Mat3 K) (hb : b.det ≠ 0) (hdet : b.det = a.det) :
    (b⁻¹ * a.adjugate).adjugate = a * b
proof:
:= by
  let c : Mat3 K := b⁻¹ * a.adjugate
  have hdetc : c.det = a.det := by
    exact det_nonsing_inv_mul_adjugate a b hb hdet
  have ha : a.det ≠ 0 := by rw [← hdet]; exact hb
  have hc : c.det ≠ 0 := by rw [hdetc]; exact ha
  apply eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left c _ _ hc
  calc
    c * c.adjugate = c.det • (1 : Mat3 K) := Matrix.mul_adjugate c
    _ = a.det • (1 : Mat3 K) := by rw [hdetc]
    _ = b.det • (1 : Mat3 K) := by rw [hdet]
    _ = b.adjugate * b := (Matrix.adjugate_mul b).symm
    _ = (c * a) * b := by
      rw [← adjugate_b_eq_parametrized_mul_a a b hb hdet]
    _ = c * (a * b) := by rw [Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowAdjoint.parametrized_adjugate_equations
statement:
theorem parametrized_adjugate_equations
    (a b : Mat3 K) (hb : b.det ≠ 0) (hdet : b.det = a.det) :
    let c
proof:
:= b⁻¹ * a.adjugate
    a.adjugate = b * c ∧ c.adjugate = a * b ∧ b.adjugate = c * a := by
  dsimp only
  exact ⟨adjugate_eq_mul_parametrized a b hb,
    adjugate_parametrized_eq_mul a b hb hdet,
    adjugate_b_eq_parametrized_mul_a a b hb hdet⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowAdjoint.eq_nonsing_inv_mul_adjugate_of_adjugate_eq_mul
statement:
theorem eq_nonsing_inv_mul_adjugate_of_adjugate_eq_mul
    (a b c : Mat3 K) (hb : b.det ≠ 0) (h : a.adjugate = b * c) :
    c = b⁻¹ * a.adjugate
proof:
:= by
  calc
    c = b⁻¹ * (b * c) := by
      rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc,
        Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul b (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hb), Matrix.one_mul]
    _ = b⁻¹ * a.adjugate := by rw [← h]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowAdjoint.det_eq_of_adjugate_equations
statement:
theorem det_eq_of_adjugate_equations
    (a b c : Mat3 K) (ha : a.adjugate = b * c)
    (hb : b.adjugate = c * a) : b.det = a.det
proof:
:= by
  have hm : a.det • (1 : Mat3 K) = b.det • (1 : Mat3 K) := by
    calc
      a.det • (1 : Mat3 K) = a.adjugate * a := (Matrix.adjugate_mul a).symm
      _ = (b * c) * a := by rw [ha]
      _ = b * (c * a) := by rw [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = b * b.adjugate := by rw [← hb]
      _ = b.det • (1 : Mat3 K) := Matrix.mul_adjugate b
  have hentry := congrFun (congrFun hm 0) 0
  simpa using hentry.symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowAdjoint.parametrized_iff_adjugate_equations
statement:
theorem parametrized_iff_adjugate_equations
    (a b c : Mat3 K) (hb : b.det ≠ 0) :
    (b.det = a.det ∧ c = b⁻¹ * a.adjugate) ↔
      (a.adjugate = b * c ∧ c.adjugate = a * b ∧ b.adjugate = c * a)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hdet, rfl⟩
    exact parametrized_adjugate_equations a b hb hdet
  · rintro ⟨ha, hc, hbAdj⟩
    have hdet := det_eq_of_adjugate_equations a b c ha hbAdj
    exact ⟨hdet, eq_nonsing_inv_mul_adjugate_of_adjugate_eq_mul a b c hb ha⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealOrthogonalCayleyDecomposition.signMatrix_mul_self
statement:
theorem signMatrix_mul_self (s : Fin 4) :
    signMatrix (K := E) s * signMatrix s = 1
proof:
:= by

    (signMatrix_orthogonal (K := E) s).transpose_mul

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealOrthogonalCayleyDecomposition.decomposition_det_one
statement:
private theorem decomposition_det_one (Q : Mat3 E) (hQ : IsOrthogonal Q)
    (hdet : Matrix.det Q = 1) :
    ∃ (s : Fin 4) (a b c : E),
      Matrix.det (1 + skew a b c) ≠ 0 ∧
      IsOrthogonal (cayley (skew a b c)) ∧
      Q = cayley (skew a b c) * signMatrix s
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := exists_sign_denominator_ne_zero Q hdet
  let B := Q * signMatrix (K := E) s
  have hB : IsOrthogonal B := mul_sign_orthogonal Q hQ s
  have hBden : Matrix.det (1 + B) ≠ 0 := hs
  let A := cayley B
  have hskew : IsSkew A := cayley_skew_of_orthogonal hB hBden
  have hcoords : skew (A 0 1) (A 0 2) (A 1 2) = A := skew_coordinates hskew
  have hrecover : cayley A = B := cayley_cayley hBden
  refine ⟨s, A 0 1, A 0 2, A 1 2, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hcoords]
    exact det_one_add_cayley_ne_zero hBden
  · rw [hcoords, hrecover]
    exact hB
  · rw [hcoords, hrecover]
    simp only [B, Matrix.mul_assoc, signMatrix_mul_self, Matrix.mul_one]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealOrthogonalCayleyDecomposition.exists_cayley_mul_sign_or_neg
statement:
theorem exists_cayley_mul_sign_or_neg (Q : Mat3 E) (hQ : IsOrthogonal Q) :
    ∃ (s : Fin 4) (a b c : E),
      Matrix.det (1 + skew a b c) ≠ 0 ∧
      IsOrthogonal (cayley (skew a b c)) ∧
      (Q = cayley (skew a b c) * signMatrix s ∨
        Q = -(cayley (skew a b c) * signMatrix s))
proof:
:= by
  rcases orthogonal_det_eq_one_or_neg_one Q hQ with hdet | hdet
  · obtain ⟨s, a, b, c, hden, hC, hEq⟩ := decomposition_det_one Q hQ hdet
    exact ⟨s, a, b, c, hden, hC, Or.inl hEq⟩
  · have hnegdet : Matrix.det (-Q) = 1 := by
      rw [Matrix.det_neg, hdet]
      norm_num
    obtain ⟨s, a, b, c, hden, hC, hEq⟩ :=
      decomposition_det_one (-Q) (neg_orthogonal Q hQ) hnegdet
    refine ⟨s, a, b, c, hden, hC, Or.inr ?_⟩
    simpa only [neg_neg] using congrArg Neg.neg hEq

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealOrthogonalCayleyDecomposition.ringConjugate_neg
statement:
theorem ringConjugate_neg (Q A : Mat3 E) :
    ringConjugate (-Q) A = ringConjugate Q A
proof:
:= by
  simp [ringConjugate, Matrix.transpose_neg]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealOrthogonalCayleyDecomposition.ringConjugate_product
statement:
theorem ringConjugate_product (C S A : Mat3 E) :
    ringConjugate (C * S) A = ringConjugate C (ringConjugate S A)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ringConjugate, Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealOrthogonalCayleyDecomposition.exists_cayley_sign_conjugation
statement:
theorem exists_cayley_sign_conjugation (Q : Mat3 E) (hQ : IsOrthogonal Q) :
    ∃ (s : Fin 4) (a b c : E),
      Matrix.det (1 + skew a b c) ≠ 0 ∧
      IsOrthogonal (cayley (skew a b c)) ∧
      ∀ A : Mat3 E, ringConjugate Q A =
        ringConjugate (cayley (skew a b c)) (ringConjugate (signMatrix s) A)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, a, b, c, hden, hC, hEq⟩ := exists_cayley_mul_sign_or_neg Q hQ
  refine ⟨s, a, b, c, hden, hC, ?_⟩
  intro A
  rcases hEq with hEq | hEq
  · rw [hEq, ringConjugate_product]
  · rw [hEq, ringConjugate_neg, ringConjugate_product]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealOrthogonalCayleyDecomposition.signs_map
statement:
theorem signs_map (j : k →+* E) (s : Fin 4) (i : Fin 3) :
    j (signs (K := k) s i) = signs (K := E) s i
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases s <;> fin_cases i <;> simp [signs]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealOrthogonalCayleyDecomposition.signMatrix_map
statement:
theorem signMatrix_map (j : k →+* E) (s : Fin 4) :
    j.mapMatrix (signMatrix (K := k) s) = signMatrix (K := E) s
proof:
:= by
  change (Matrix.diagonal (signs (K := k) s)).map j =
    Matrix.diagonal (signs (K := E) s)
  rw [Matrix.diagonal_map (map_zero j)]
  congr 1
  funext i
  exact signs_map j s i

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealOrthogonalCayleyDecomposition.exists_cayley_constant_sign_conjugation
statement:
theorem exists_cayley_constant_sign_conjugation (j : k →+* E)
    (Q : Mat3 E) (hQ : IsOrthogonal Q) :
    ∃ (s : Fin 4) (a b c : E),
      IsOrthogonal (signMatrix (K := k) s) ∧
      Matrix.det (1 + skew a b c) ≠ 0 ∧
      IsOrthogonal (cayley (skew a b c)) ∧
      ∀ A : Mat3 E, ringConjugate Q A =
        ringConjugate (cayley (skew a b c))
          (ringConjugate (j.mapMatrix (signMatrix (K := k) s)) A)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, a, b, c, hden, hC, hconj⟩ := exists_cayley_sign_conjugation Q hQ
  refine ⟨s, a, b, c, signMatrix_orthogonal s, hden, hC, ?_⟩
  intro A
  rw [signMatrix_map]
  exact hconj A

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericBaseLocalization.baseNonzeroImages_le_nonZeroDivisors
statement:
private theorem baseNonzeroImages_le_nonZeroDivisors :
    baseNonzeroImages A B ≤ nonZeroDivisors B
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
  rw [mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_right]
  intro b hab
  have hs : a • b = 0 := by
    simpa only [Algebra.smul_def, mul_comm] using hab
  exact (smul_eq_zero.mp hs).resolve_left
    (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mp ha)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericBaseLocalization.algebraMap_injective
statement:
theorem algebraMap_injective : Function.Injective
    (algebraMap B (GenericBaseRing A B))
proof:
:=
  IsLocalization.injective (GenericBaseRing A B)
    (baseNonzeroImages_le_nonZeroDivisors A B)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericBaseLocalization.coefficientMap_injective
statement: theorem coefficientMap_injective : Function.Injective (coefficientMap A B)

:=
  (algebraMap_injective A B).comp

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericBaseLocalization.fractionMap_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp] theorem fractionMap_algebraMap (a : A) :
    fractionMap A B (algebraMap A (FractionRing A) a) = coefficientMap A B a

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericBaseLocalization.fractionMap_injective
statement: theorem fractionMap_injective : Function.Injective (fractionMap A B)

  RingHom.injective (fractionMap A B)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SymplecticConjugation.left_form_of_symplectic_inverse
statement:
theorem left_form_of_symplectic_inverse
    (M N : Mat6 K) (hMN : M * N = 1)
    (hform : M.transpose * symplecticJ * M = symplecticJ) :
    M.transpose * symplecticJ = symplecticJ * N
proof:
:= by
  calc
    M.transpose * symplecticJ =
        M.transpose * symplecticJ * (M * N) := by rw [hMN, Matrix.mul_one]
    _ = (M.transpose * symplecticJ * M) * N := by
      simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = symplecticJ * N := by rw [hform]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SymplecticConjugation.right_form_of_symplectic_inverse
statement:
theorem right_form_of_symplectic_inverse
    (M N : Mat6 K) (hMN : M * N = 1)
    (hform : M.transpose * symplecticJ * M = symplecticJ) :
    N.transpose * symplecticJ = symplecticJ * M
proof:
:= by
  calc
    N.transpose * symplecticJ =
        N.transpose * (M.transpose * symplecticJ * M) := by rw [hform]
    _ = (M * N).transpose * symplecticJ * M := by
      simp only [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = symplecticJ * M := by rw [hMN, Matrix.transpose_one, Matrix.one_mul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SymplecticConjugation.inverse_is_symplectic
statement:
theorem inverse_is_symplectic
    (M N : Mat6 K) (hMN : M * N = 1) (hNM : N * M = 1)
    (hform : M.transpose * symplecticJ * M = symplecticJ) :
    N.transpose * symplecticJ * N = symplecticJ
proof:
:= by
  rw [right_form_of_symplectic_inverse M N hMN hform, Matrix.mul_assoc, hMN,
    Matrix.mul_one]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SymplecticConjugation.conjugate_mem
statement:
theorem conjugate_mem
    (M N : Mat6 K) (hMN : M * N = 1)
    (hform : M.transpose * symplecticJ * M = symplecticJ)
    (P : Carrier K) : IsSelfAdjoint (M * (P : Mat6 K) * N)
proof:
:= by
  have hleft := left_form_of_symplectic_inverse M N hMN hform
  have hright := right_form_of_symplectic_inverse M N hMN hform
  change (M * (P : Mat6 K) * N).transpose * symplecticJ =
    symplecticJ * (M * (P : Mat6 K) * N)
  rw [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_mul]
  calc
    N.transpose * ((P : Mat6 K).transpose * M.transpose) * symplecticJ =
        N.transpose * (P : Mat6 K).transpose *
          (M.transpose * symplecticJ) := by
      simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = N.transpose * (P : Mat6 K).transpose * (symplecticJ * N) := by
      rw [hleft]
    _ = N.transpose * ((P : Mat6 K).transpose * symplecticJ) * N := by
      simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = N.transpose * (symplecticJ * (P : Mat6 K)) * N := by
      rw [carrier_property P]
    _ = (N.transpose * symplecticJ) * (P : Mat6 K) * N := by
      simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = symplecticJ * M * (P : Mat6 K) * N := by rw [hright]
    _ = symplecticJ * (M * (P : Mat6 K) * N) := by
      simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SymplecticConjugation.conjugateLinear_coe
statement:
@[simp] theorem conjugateLinear_coe
    (M N : Mat6 K) (hMN : M * N = 1)
    (hform : M.transpose * symplecticJ * M = symplecticJ) (P : Carrier K) :
    ((conjugateLinear M N hMN hform P : Carrier K) : Mat6 K) = M * P * N
proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SymplecticConjugation.conjugate_map_one
statement:
theorem conjugate_map_one
    (M N : Mat6 K) (hMN : M * N = 1) : M * (1 : Mat6 K) * N = 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa using hMN

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.SymplecticConjugation.conjugate_map_jordan
statement:
theorem conjugate_map_jordan
    (M N : Mat6 K) (hNM : N * M = 1) (A B : Mat6 K) :
    M * matrixJordan A B * N =
      matrixJordan (M * A * N) (M * B * N)
proof:
:= by
  have hmul (X Y : Mat6 K) :
      M * (X * Y) * N = (M * X * N) * (M * Y * N) := by
    symm
    calc
      (M * X * N) * (M * Y * N) = M * X * (N * M) * Y * N := by
        simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = M * X * 1 * Y * N := by rw [hNM]
      _ = M * (X * Y) * N := by simp [Matrix.mul_assoc]
  simp only [matrixJordan, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul]
  rw [Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.add_mul, hmul A B, hmul B A]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.PeirceRawTransport.directCircuit_natural_ringHom
statement:
private theorem directCircuit_natural_ringHom
    {R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    [Algebra k R] [Algebra k S]
    [Invertible (2 : R)] [Invertible (2 : S)]
    (ev : R →+* S)
    (hcomm : ∀ a : k, ev (algebraMap k R a) = algebraMap k S a)
    (i : Fin 3) (a : R) (u : SCoord R) (v : CCoord R)
    (x : Fin 27 → R) :
    (ev ∘ PeirceReflectionFamily.directCircuit (k := k) i a u v x) =
      PeirceReflectionFamily.directCircuit (k := k) i (ev a)
        (PeirceReflectionFamily.mapS ev u)
        (PeirceReflectionFamily.mapC ev v) (ev ∘ x)
proof:
:= by
  let evA : R →ₐ[k] S := { ev with commutes' := hcomm }
  have h := PeirceReflectionFamily.directCircuit_natural
    (f := evA) i a u v x
  funext c
  exact congrFun h c

name: AlbertLean.Generic.PeirceRawTransport.eval_mapped_peirceDenominator
statement:
private theorem eval_mapped_peirceDenominator
    (theta : FF k →+* FF K) (t : PVar → K) :
    MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom theta (peircePoint K t)
        (LocalizedGridIdentity.mappedDenominator k (FF k)
          (PeirceReflectionFamily.denominator k)) =
      algebraMap K (FF K)
        (MvPolynomial.eval t (PeirceReflectionFamily.denominator K))
proof:
:= by
  simp [LocalizedGridIdentity.mappedDenominator,
    PeirceReflectionFamily.denominator,
    PeirceReflectionFamily.polynomialU, PeirceReflectionFamily.polynomialV,
    peircePoint,
    SourceRingChartZero.chartDenominator, nS, nC, evalU,
    MvPolynomial.map_eval, Function.comp_def, map_add, map_mul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.PeirceRawTransport.peirceDenominator_unit
statement:
private theorem peirceDenominator_unit
    (theta : FF k →+* FF K) (t : PVar → K)
    (ht : MvPolynomial.eval t (PeirceReflectionFamily.denominator K) ≠ 0) :
    IsUnit (MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom theta (peircePoint K t)
      (LocalizedGridIdentity.mappedDenominator k (FF k)
        (PeirceReflectionFamily.denominator k)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [eval_mapped_peirceDenominator k K theta t]
  apply isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr
  simpa only [map_zero] using (algebraMap K (FF K)).injective.ne ht

name: AlbertLean.Generic.PeirceRawTransport.peirceEval_algebraMap
statement:
private theorem peirceEval_algebraMap
    (theta : FF k →+* FF K) (t : PVar → K)
    (ht : MvPolynomial.eval t (PeirceReflectionFamily.denominator K) ≠ 0)
    (p : MvPolynomial PVar (FF k)) :
    peirceEval k K theta t ht
        (algebraMap (MvPolynomial PVar (FF k))
          (PeirceReflectionFamily.FamilyRing k) p) =
      MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom theta (peircePoint K t) p
proof:
:= by
  exact IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq
    (LocalizedGridIdentity.mappedDenominator k (FF k)
      (PeirceReflectionFamily.denominator k))
    (peirceDenominator_unit k K theta t ht) p

name: AlbertLean.Generic.PeirceRawTransport.peirceEval_coefficient
statement:
private theorem peirceEval_coefficient
    (theta : FF k →+* FF K) (t : PVar → K)
    (ht : MvPolynomial.eval t (PeirceReflectionFamily.denominator K) ≠ 0)
    (x : FF k) :
    peirceEval k K theta t ht
        (PeirceReflectionFamily.coefficientEmbedding k x) = theta x
proof:
:= by
  simp [peirceEval, PeirceReflectionFamily.coefficientEmbedding,
    RationalSourceFamily.coefficientEmbedding,
    LocalizedGridIdentity.extensionEval, IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.PeirceRawTransport.peirceEval_genericCoefficient
statement:
private theorem peirceEval_genericCoefficient
    (theta : FF k →+* FF K) (t : PVar → K)
    (ht : MvPolynomial.eval t (PeirceReflectionFamily.denominator K) ≠ 0)
    (x : FF k) :
    peirceEval k K theta t ht
        (RationalSourceFamily.coefficientEmbedding k x) = theta x
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [PeirceReflectionFamily.coefficientEmbedding] using
    peirceEval_coefficient k K theta t ht x

name: AlbertLean.Generic.PeirceRawTransport.fractionCoefficientEmbedding_base
statement:
private theorem fractionCoefficientEmbedding_base
    (phi : FF k →+* K) (a : k) :
    SourceEvenRawTransport.fractionCoefficientEmbedding k K phi
        (algebraMap k (FF k) a) =
      algebraMap K (FF K)
        (SourceRawScalarTransport.originalCoefficientEmbedding k K phi a)
proof:
:= by
  change SourceEvenRawTransport.fractionCoefficientEmbedding k K phi
      (SourceRawScalarTransport.rawToFunction k (MvPolynomial.C a)) = _
  rw [SourceEvenRawTransport.fractionCoefficientEmbedding_raw]
  simp only [SourceRawScalarTransport.reducedCoefficientMap,
    SourceRawScalarTransport.reducedCoefficientMapOf_mk,
    SourceRawScalarTransport.polynomialCoefficientMap_C]
  change algebraMap (RR K) (FF K)
      (algebraMap K (RR K)
        (SourceRawScalarTransport.originalCoefficientEmbedding k K phi a)) = _
  exact IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply K (RR K) (FF K) _

name: AlbertLean.Generic.PeirceRawTransport.peirceEval_parameter
statement:
private theorem peirceEval_parameter
    (theta : FF k →+* FF K) (t : PVar → K)
    (ht : MvPolynomial.eval t (PeirceReflectionFamily.denominator K) ≠ 0)
    (q : PVar) :
    peirceEval k K theta t ht (PeirceReflectionFamily.parameter k q) =
      algebraMap K (FF K) (t q)
proof:
:= by
  simp [peirceEval, PeirceReflectionFamily.parameter,
    LocalizedGridIdentity.extensionEval, IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq,
    peircePoint]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.PeirceRawTransport.peirceEval_denominatorInverse
statement:
private theorem peirceEval_denominatorInverse
    (theta : FF k →+* FF K) (t : PVar → K)
    (ht : MvPolynomial.eval t (PeirceReflectionFamily.denominator K) ≠ 0) :
    peirceEval k K theta t ht
        (PeirceReflectionFamily.denominatorInverse k) =
      (algebraMap K (FF K)
        (MvPolynomial.eval t (PeirceReflectionFamily.denominator K)))⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  let ev := peirceEval k K theta t ht
  let d := LocalizedGridIdentity.mappedDenominator k (FF k)
    (PeirceReflectionFamily.denominator k)
  have hm := congrArg ev (IsLocalization.Away.mul_invSelf d)
  have hd : ev (algebraMap (MvPolynomial PVar (FF k))
      (PeirceReflectionFamily.FamilyRing k) d) =
      algebraMap K (FF K)
        (MvPolynomial.eval t (PeirceReflectionFamily.denominator K)) := by
    rw [show ev (algebraMap (MvPolynomial PVar (FF k))
        (PeirceReflectionFamily.FamilyRing k) d) =
      MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom theta (peircePoint K t) d by
        exact peirceEval_algebraMap k K theta t ht d]
    exact eval_mapped_peirceDenominator k K theta t
  have hd0 : algebraMap K (FF K)
      (MvPolynomial.eval t (PeirceReflectionFamily.denominator K)) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [map_zero] using (algebraMap K (FF K)).injective.ne ht
  change ev (IsLocalization.Away.invSelf d) = _
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ hd0
  calc
    algebraMap K (FF K)
          (MvPolynomial.eval t (PeirceReflectionFamily.denominator K)) *
        ev (IsLocalization.Away.invSelf d) = 1 := by
      rw [← hd]
      simpa only [map_mul, map_one] using hm
    _ = algebraMap K (FF K)
          (MvPolynomial.eval t (PeirceReflectionFamily.denominator K)) *
        (algebraMap K (FF K)
          (MvPolynomial.eval t (PeirceReflectionFamily.denominator K)))⁻¹ :=
      (mul_inv_cancel₀ hd0).symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.PeirceRawTransport.peirceEval_familyU
statement:
private theorem peirceEval_familyU
    (theta : FF k →+* FF K) (t : PVar → K)
    (ht : MvPolynomial.eval t (PeirceReflectionFamily.denominator K) ≠ 0) :
    PeirceReflectionFamily.mapS (peirceEval k K theta t ht)
        (PeirceReflectionFamily.familyU k) =
      PeirceReflectionFamily.mapS (algebraMap K (FF K))
        (PeirceReflectionFamily.valueU K t)
proof:
:= by
  apply SCoord.ext <;> funext j <;>
    simp [PeirceReflectionFamily.mapS, PeirceReflectionFamily.familyU,
      PeirceReflectionFamily.valueU, peirceEval_parameter]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.PeirceRawTransport.peirceEval_familyV
statement:
private theorem peirceEval_familyV
    (theta : FF k →+* FF K) (t : PVar → K)
    (ht : MvPolynomial.eval t (PeirceReflectionFamily.denominator K) ≠ 0) :
    PeirceReflectionFamily.mapC (peirceEval k K theta t ht)
        (PeirceReflectionFamily.familyV k) =
      PeirceReflectionFamily.mapC (algebraMap K (FF K))
        (PeirceReflectionFamily.valueV K t)
proof:
:= by
  apply CCoord.ext <;> funext j <;>
    simp [PeirceReflectionFamily.mapC, PeirceReflectionFamily.familyV,
