name: AlbertLean.Generic.PeirceRawTransport.peirceEval_single
statement:
private theorem peirceEval_single
    (theta : FF k →+* FF K) (t : PVar → K)
    (ht : MvPolynomial.eval t (PeirceReflectionFamily.denominator K) ≠ 0)
    (j : Fin 27) :
    (peirceEval k K theta t ht) ∘
        (Pi.single j (1 : PeirceReflectionFamily.FamilyRing k)) =
      Pi.single j (1 : FF K)
proof:
:= by
  funext c
  by_cases h : c = j <;> simp [Pi.single_apply, h]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.PeirceRawTransport.baseLinear_structured_extension
statement:
private theorem baseLinear_structured_extension
    {L : Type*} [Field L] [CharZero L]
    (g : SourceAut (K := L)) (z : JCoord L) :
    SourceAutExtension.baseLinear g (structuredEquivK L z) =
      structuredEquivK L (g.linear z)
proof:
:= by
  change structuredEquivK L
      (g.linear ((structuredEquivK L).symm (structuredEquivK L z))) = _
  rw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.PeirceRawTransport.directCircuit_eq_baseLinear_extension
statement:
private theorem directCircuit_eq_baseLinear_extension
    {L : Type*} [Field L] [CharZero L] [Algebra k L]
    [Invertible (2 : L)] (i : Fin 3) (u : SCoord L) (v : CCoord L)
    (hD : SourceIdempotentChart.chart0Denominator u v ≠ 0)
    (x : Fin 27 → L) :
    PeirceReflectionFamily.directCircuit (k := k) i
        (SourceIdempotentChart.chart0Denominator u v)⁻¹ u v x =
      SourceAutExtension.baseLinear
        (sourcePeirceAut (SourcePivotCharts.chart i u v)
          (SourcePivotCharts.chart_idempotent i u v hD)) x
proof:
:= by
  let y : JCoord L := (structuredEquivK L).symm x
  have hx : structuredEquivK L y = x := LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply _ x
  have hc : PeirceReflectionFamily.directCenter (k := k) i
      (SourceIdempotentChart.chart0Denominator u v)⁻¹ u v =
      structuredEquivK L (SourcePivotCharts.chart i u v) := by
    rw [PeirceReflectionFamily.directCenter,
      SourceRingChartZero.chartWithScale_field,
      SourceRingChartZero.flatten_field,
      PeirceReflectionFamily.pivotMap_field_native]
    rfl
  have hdirect : PeirceReflectionFamily.directCircuit (k := k) i
      (SourceIdempotentChart.chart0Denominator u v)⁻¹ u v x =
      SourceRingReflectionFormula.ringReflection
        (PeirceReflectionFamily.directCenter (k := k) i
          (SourceIdempotentChart.chart0Denominator u v)⁻¹ u v) x := by
    funext c
    simp [PeirceReflectionFamily.directCircuit,
      SourceRingReflectionFormula.ringReflection,
      SourceRingReflectionFormula.ringProduct]
  rw [hdirect, hc]
  rw [← hx, SourceRingReflectionFormula.ringReflection_eq_source,
    baseLinear_structured_extension]
  simp only [sourcePeirceAut, sourcePeirceLinearEquiv_apply]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.PeirceRawTransport.peirceEval_matrix_basis
statement:
private theorem peirceEval_matrix_basis
    (phi : FF k →+* K) (i : Fin 3) (t : PVar → K)
    (ht : MvPolynomial.eval t (PeirceReflectionFamily.denominator K) ≠ 0)
    (j : Fin 27) :
    (fun c => peirceEval k K
      (SourceEvenRawTransport.fractionCoefficientEmbedding k K phi) t ht
      (PeirceReflectionFamily.matrix k i c j)) =
      SourceAutExtension.baseLinear (mappedPeirceAut K i t ht)
        (Pi.single j 1)
proof:
:= by
  let theta := SourceEvenRawTransport.fractionCoefficientEmbedding k K phi
  let iK : K →+* FF K := algebraMap K (FF K)
  let kK := SourceRawScalarTransport.originalCoefficientEmbedding k K phi
  letI : Algebra k (FF K) := (iK.comp kK).toAlgebra
  let ev := peirceEval k K theta t ht
  have hcomm (a : k) :
      ev (algebraMap k (PeirceReflectionFamily.FamilyRing k) a) =
        algebraMap k (FF K) a := by
    change ev (PeirceReflectionFamily.coefficientEmbedding k
      (algebraMap k (FF k) a)) = _
    rw [peirceEval_coefficient]
    exact fractionCoefficientEmbedding_base k K phi a
  have hfam' := directCircuit_natural_ringHom k ev hcomm i
    (PeirceReflectionFamily.denominatorInverse k)
    (PeirceReflectionFamily.familyU k) (PeirceReflectionFamily.familyV k)
    (Pi.single j 1)
  dsimp only [ev] at hfam'
  rw [peirceEval_denominatorInverse k K theta t ht,
    peirceEval_familyU k K theta t ht,
    peirceEval_familyV k K theta t ht,
    peirceEval_single k K theta t ht] at hfam'
  let u := PeirceReflectionFamily.mapS iK (PeirceReflectionFamily.valueU K t)
  let v := PeirceReflectionFamily.mapC iK (PeirceReflectionFamily.valueV K t)
  have hden : iK (MvPolynomial.eval t
      (PeirceReflectionFamily.denominator K)) =
      SourceIdempotentChart.chart0Denominator u v := by
    rw [PeirceReflectionFamily.eval_denominator]
    simp [u, v, iK, PeirceReflectionFamily.mapS,
      PeirceReflectionFamily.mapC, PeirceReflectionFamily.valueU,
      PeirceReflectionFamily.valueV, SourceIdempotentChart.chart0Denominator,
      nS, nC, evalU]
  rw [hden] at hfam'
  have hD : SourceIdempotentChart.chart0Denominator u v ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← hden]
    simpa only [map_zero] using iK.injective.ne ht
  have hbase := directCircuit_eq_baseLinear_extension (k := k) i u v hD
    (Pi.single j (1 : FF K))
  funext c
  rw [PeirceReflectionFamily.matrix_entry]
  simpa only [theta, iK, u, v, mappedPeirceAut,
    Function.comp_apply] using congrFun (hfam'.trans hbase) c

name: AlbertLean.Generic.PeirceRawTransport.matrix_mulVec_eq_of_columns
statement:
private theorem matrix_mulVec_eq_of_columns
    {F : Type*} [Field F]
    (M : Matrix (Fin 27) (Fin 27) F)
    (g : (Fin 27 → F) →ₗ[F] (Fin 27 → F))
    (h : ∀ j, (fun c => M c j) = g (Pi.single j 1))
    (x : Fin 27 → F) : M.mulVec x = g x
proof:
:= by
  have hm : M = LinearMap.toMatrix' g := by
    ext c j
    exact congrFun (h j) c
  rw [hm]
  exact LinearMap.toMatrix'_mulVec _ x

name: AlbertLean.Generic.PeirceRawTransport.peirceEval_matrix
statement:
private theorem peirceEval_matrix
    (phi : FF k →+* K) (i : Fin 3) (t : PVar → K)
    (ht : MvPolynomial.eval t (PeirceReflectionFamily.denominator K) ≠ 0)
    (x : Fin 27 → FF K) :
    ((PeirceReflectionFamily.matrix k i).map
      (peirceEval k K
        (SourceEvenRawTransport.fractionCoefficientEmbedding k K phi) t ht)).mulVec x =
      SourceAutExtension.baseLinear (mappedPeirceAut K i t ht) x
proof:
:= by
  apply matrix_mulVec_eq_of_columns
  intro j
  simpa only [Matrix.map_apply] using
    peirceEval_matrix_basis k K phi i t ht j

name: AlbertLean.Generic.PeirceRawTransport.peirceEval_substitution
statement:
private theorem peirceEval_substitution
    (phi : FF k →+* K) (i : Fin 3) (t : PVar → K)
    (ht : MvPolynomial.eval t (PeirceReflectionFamily.denominator K) ≠ 0) :
    (peirceEval k K
      (SourceEvenRawTransport.fractionCoefficientEmbedding k K phi) t ht).comp
        (RationalSourceFamily.substitution k (peirceWord k i)) =
      SourceEvenRawTransport.genericSourceSubstitution k
        (SourceEvenRawTransport.fractionCoefficientEmbedding k K phi)
        (mappedPeirceAut K i t ht)
proof:
:= by
  apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
  · intro a
    simpa only [RingHom.comp_apply, RationalSourceFamily.substitution,
      MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_C,
      SourceEvenRawTransport.genericSourceSubstitution,
      peirceWord] using
        peirceEval_genericCoefficient k K
          (SourceEvenRawTransport.fractionCoefficientEmbedding k K phi)
          t ht (algebraMap k (FF k) a)
  · intro q
    cases q with
    | entry r m c =>
      simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, RationalSourceFamily.substitution,
        SourceEvenRawTransport.genericSourceSubstitution,
        MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_X']
      have hm := congrFun (peirceEval_matrix k K phi i t ht
        (fun d => SourceEvenRawTransport.fractionCoefficientEmbedding k K phi
          (SourceFractionActionUniversalF0.universalF0 k r m d))) c
      simpa [RingHom.comp_apply, RationalSourceFamily.substitution,
        MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_X',
        SourceEvenRawTransport.genericSourceSubstitution,
        peirceWord, RationalSourceFamily.CertifiedWord.stages,
        PeirceReflectionFamily.stage,
        PeirceReflectionFamily.coefficientEmbedding,
        RationalSourceFamily.applyWord, RationalSourceFamily.wordMatrix,
        Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct,
        peirceEval_genericCoefficient k K] using hm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.PeirceRawTransport.peirce_natural
statement:
private theorem peirce_natural
    (i : Fin 3) (t : PVar → K)
    (ht : MvPolynomial.eval t (PeirceReflectionFamily.denominator K) ≠ 0) :
    ∀ x : JCoord K,
      SourceCoefficientMap.mapSource (algebraMap K (FF K))
          ((PeirceReflectionFamily.baseAut K i t ht).linear x) =
        (mappedPeirceAut K i t ht).linear
          (SourceCoefficientMap.mapSource (algebraMap K (FF K)) x)
proof:
:= by
  let iK : K →+* FF K := algebraMap K (FF K)
  let u := PeirceReflectionFamily.valueU K t
  let v := PeirceReflectionFamily.valueV K t
  have hchart0F : (iK ∘ structuredEquivK K
      (SourceIdempotentChart.chart0 u v)) =
      structuredEquivK (FF K) (SourceIdempotentChart.chart0
        (PeirceReflectionFamily.mapS iK u)
        (PeirceReflectionFamily.mapC iK v)) := by
    let fK : K →ₐ[K] FF K := IsScalarTower.toAlgHom K K (FF K)
    have hden : iK (SourceIdempotentChart.chart0Denominator u v) =
        SourceIdempotentChart.chart0Denominator
          (PeirceReflectionFamily.mapS iK u)
          (PeirceReflectionFamily.mapC iK v) := by
      simp [SourceIdempotentChart.chart0Denominator,
        PeirceReflectionFamily.mapS, PeirceReflectionFamily.mapC,
        nS, nC, evalU, map_add, map_mul]
    have hm := PeirceReflectionFamily.map_flatten_chartWithScale
      (k := K) (f := fK)
      (SourceIdempotentChart.chart0Denominator u v)⁻¹ u v
    change (iK ∘ SourceRingChartZero.flatten
        (SourceRingChartZero.chartWithScale
          (SourceIdempotentChart.chart0Denominator u v)⁻¹ u v)) =
      SourceRingChartZero.flatten
        (SourceRingChartZero.chartWithScale
          (iK ((SourceIdempotentChart.chart0Denominator u v)⁻¹))
          (PeirceReflectionFamily.mapS iK u)
          (PeirceReflectionFamily.mapC iK v)) at hm
    rw [SourceRingChartZero.chartWithScale_field] at hm
    rw [map_inv₀, hden, SourceRingChartZero.chartWithScale_field] at hm
    rw [SourceRingChartZero.flatten_field,
      SourceRingChartZero.flatten_field] at hm
    simpa only [fK, iK, AlgHom.toRingHom_eq_coe,
      AlgHom.coe_toRingHom] using hm
  have hcenter : SourceCoefficientMap.mapSource iK
      (SourcePivotCharts.chart i u v) =
      SourcePivotCharts.chart i
        (PeirceReflectionFamily.mapS iK u)
        (PeirceReflectionFamily.mapC iK v) := by
    apply (structuredEquivK (FF K)).injective
    simp only [SourceCoefficientMap.mapSource,
      LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, SourceCoefficientMap.mapF0]
    rw [SourcePivotCharts.chart, SourcePivotCharts.chart,
      ← PeirceReflectionFamily.pivotMap_field_native (k := K),
      ← PeirceReflectionFamily.pivotMap_field_native (k := K)]
    calc
      iK ∘ PeirceReflectionFamily.pivotMap (k := K) i
          (structuredEquivK K (SourceIdempotentChart.chart0 u v)) =
        PeirceReflectionFamily.pivotMap (k := K) i
          (iK ∘ structuredEquivK K
            (SourceIdempotentChart.chart0 u v)) := by
          exact PeirceReflectionFamily.pivotMap_natural
            (f := IsScalarTower.toAlgHom K K (FF K)) i _
      _ = _ := congrArg (PeirceReflectionFamily.pivotMap (k := K) i) hchart0F
  intro x
  rw [PeirceReflectionFamily.baseAut]
  change SourceCoefficientMap.mapSource iK
      (sourcePeirceReflection
        (SourcePivotCharts.chart i u v) x) = _
  rw [SourceCoefficientMap.mapSource_reflection]
  rw [hcenter]
  simp only [mappedPeirceAut, iK, u, v, sourcePeirceAut,
    sourcePeirceLinearEquiv_apply]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.PeirceRawTransport.reduced_cleared_peirce_chart
statement:
private theorem reduced_cleared_peirce_chart
    (phi : FF k →+* K)
    (a b : CR k) (hb : SourceRawScalarTransport.rawToFunction k b ≠ 0)
    (hinv : ∀ g : SourceAut (K := k),
      fractionAction k g
          (SourceRawScalarTransport.rawToFunction k a /
            SourceRawScalarTransport.rawToFunction k b) =
        SourceRawScalarTransport.rawToFunction k a /
          SourceRawScalarTransport.rawToFunction k b)
    (i : Fin 3) (t : PVar → K)
    (ht : MvPolynomial.eval t (PeirceReflectionFamily.denominator K) ≠ 0) :
    reducedAction K (PeirceReflectionFamily.baseAut K i t ht)
        (reducedCoefficientMap k K phi (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ a)) *
      reducedCoefficientMap k K phi (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ b) =
    reducedCoefficientMap k K phi (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ a) *
      reducedAction K (PeirceReflectionFamily.baseAut K i t ht)
        (reducedCoefficientMap k K phi (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ b))
proof:
:= by
  let theta := SourceEvenRawTransport.fractionCoefficientEmbedding k K phi
  let ev := peirceEval k K theta t ht
  let gK := PeirceReflectionFamily.baseAut K i t ht
  let gL := mappedPeirceAut K i t ht
  have hgrid := RationalSourceFamily.word_grid_cleared_identity k
    (peirceWord k i) a b hb hinv
  have hclear := congrArg ev hgrid
  rw [map_sub, map_mul, map_mul, map_zero, sub_eq_zero] at hclear
  have hsub := peirceEval_substitution k K phi i t ht
  have hsa := DFunLike.congr_fun hsub a
  have hsb := DFunLike.congr_fun hsub b
  simp only [RingHom.comp_apply] at hsa hsb
  have hca :
      peirceEval k K theta t ht
          (RationalSourceFamily.coefficientEmbedding k
            (SourceFractionActionUniversalF0.rawToFunction k a)) =
        theta (SourceFractionActionUniversalF0.rawToFunction k a) := by
    exact peirceEval_genericCoefficient k K theta t ht
      (SourceFractionActionUniversalF0.rawToFunction k a)
  have hcb :
      peirceEval k K theta t ht
          (RationalSourceFamily.coefficientEmbedding k
            (SourceFractionActionUniversalF0.rawToFunction k b)) =
        theta (SourceFractionActionUniversalF0.rawToFunction k b) := by
    exact peirceEval_genericCoefficient k K theta t ht
      (SourceFractionActionUniversalF0.rawToFunction k b)
  change ev (RationalSourceFamily.substitution k (peirceWord k i) a) *
      ev (RationalSourceFamily.coefficientEmbedding k
        (SourceFractionActionUniversalF0.rawToFunction k b)) =
    ev (RationalSourceFamily.coefficientEmbedding k
      (SourceFractionActionUniversalF0.rawToFunction k a)) *
      ev (RationalSourceFamily.substitution k (peirceWord k i) b) at hclear
  dsimp only [ev] at hclear
  rw [hsa, hsb, hca, hcb] at hclear
  have hn : ∀ x : JCoord K,
      SourceCoefficientMap.mapSource (algebraMap K (FF K)) (gK.linear x) =
        gL.linear (SourceCoefficientMap.mapSource (algebraMap K (FF K)) x) := by
    simpa only [gK, gL] using peirce_natural K i t ht
  have hsquare := SourceEvenRawTransport.genericSourceSubstitution_eq_actual
    k K phi (RingHom.id (FF K)) (fun _ => rfl) gK gL hn
  simp only [RingHom.id_comp] at hsquare
  have hga := DFunLike.congr_fun hsquare a
  have hgb := DFunLike.congr_fun hsquare b
  have hbase (p : CR k) :
      theta (SourceFractionActionUniversalF0.rawToFunction k p) =
      algebraMap (RR K) (FF K)
        (reducedCoefficientMap k K phi (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ p)) := by
    exact SourceEvenRawTransport.fractionCoefficientEmbedding_raw k K phi p
  rw [hga, hgb, hbase a, hbase b] at hclear
  apply IsFractionRing.injective (RR K) (FF K)
  simpa only [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.id_apply, map_mul,
    RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingEquiv.coe_toRingHom,
    gK, gL] using hclear

name: AlbertLean.Generic.PeirceRawTransport.reduced_cleared_sourcePeirce_identity
statement:
theorem reduced_cleared_sourcePeirce_identity
    (phi : FF k →+* K)
    (a b : CR k) (hb : SourceRawScalarTransport.rawToFunction k b ≠ 0)
    (hinv : ∀ g : SourceAut (K := k),
      fractionAction k g
          (SourceRawScalarTransport.rawToFunction k a /
            SourceRawScalarTransport.rawToFunction k b) =
        SourceRawScalarTransport.rawToFunction k a /
          SourceRawScalarTransport.rawToFunction k b)
    (e : JCoord K) (he : sourceProduct e e = e)
    (hT : sourceTrace e = 1) :
    reducedAction K (sourcePeirceAut e he)
        (reducedCoefficientMap k K phi (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ a)) *
      reducedCoefficientMap k K phi (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ b) =
    reducedCoefficientMap k K phi (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ a) *
      reducedAction K (sourcePeirceAut e he)
        (reducedCoefficientMap k K phi (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ b))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, t, ht, hbase⟩ := PeirceReflectionFamily.covers_traceOne_idempotent
    K e he hT
  have hbase' : PeirceReflectionFamily.baseAut K i t ht =
      sourcePeirceAut e he := by
    simpa only [PeirceReflectionFamily.stage] using hbase
  have hchart := reduced_cleared_peirce_chart
    k K phi a b hb hinv i t ht
  rw [hbase'] at hchart
  exact hchart

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3JordanReducedAction.reducedUniversalFamily_isRaw
statement:
theorem reducedUniversalFamily_isRaw :
    IsRawPrimitiveFrameFamily (reducedUniversalFamily k)
proof:
:= by
  let q := Ideal.Quotient.mk (rawFrameIdeal (R := k)).radical
  have heval : evaluationAlong (q.comp MvPolynomial.C) (reducedUniversalFamily k) = q := by
    apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
    · intro c; simp [evaluationAlong, q]
    · intro x
      cases x with
      | entry r i a b => simp [reducedUniversalFamily, q, evaluationAlong, universalMatrix]
  apply (equations_vanishAlong_iff (q.comp MvPolynomial.C)
    (reducedUniversalFamily k)).1
  intro e
  rw [heval]
  exact Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr
    (Ideal.le_radical (Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self e)))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3JordanReducedAction.transformedFamily_isRaw
statement:
theorem transformedFamily_isRaw (g : Aut (K := k)) :
    IsRawPrimitiveFrameFamily (transformedFamily k g)
proof:
:=
  isRawPrimitiveFrameFamily_transport_equiv
    (linearEquiv (ReducedCoordinateRing k) g)
    (linearEquiv_jordan _ g) (linearEquiv_one _ g)
    (linearEquiv_matrixTrace _ g) _ (reducedUniversalFamily_isRaw k)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3JordanReducedAction.rawFrameIdeal_le_ker_rawToReduced
statement:
theorem rawFrameIdeal_le_ker_rawToReduced (g : Aut (K := k)) :
    rawFrameIdeal (R := k) ≤ RingHom.ker (rawToReduced k g)
proof:
:= by
  have h := (equations_vanishAlong_iff
    ((Ideal.Quotient.mk (rawFrameIdeal (R := k)).radical).comp MvPolynomial.C)
    (transformedFamily k g)).2 (transformedFamily_isRaw k g)
  exact Ideal.span_le.2 (fun p hp => by
    rcases hp with ⟨e, rfl⟩
    exact RingHom.mem_ker.mpr (h e))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3JordanReducedAction.radical_le_ker_rawToReduced
statement:
theorem radical_le_ker_rawToReduced (g : Aut (K := k)) :
    (rawFrameIdeal (R := k)).radical ≤ RingHom.ker (rawToReduced k g)
proof:
:=
  (RingHom.ker_isPrime (rawToReduced k g)).radical_le_iff.mpr
    (rawFrameIdeal_le_ker_rawToReduced k g)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3JordanReducedAction.reducedActionHom_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem reducedActionHom_mk (g : Aut (K := k)) (x : CoordinateRing k) :
    reducedActionHom k g (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ x) = rawToReduced k g x
proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3JordanReducedAction.reducedActionHom_universalMatrix
statement:
@[simp] theorem reducedActionHom_universalMatrix (g : Aut (K := k))
    (r i a b : Fin 3) :
    reducedActionHom k g (reducedUniversalFamily k r i a b) =
      transformedFamily k g r i a b
proof:
:= by
  simp [reducedUniversalFamily, rawToReduced, transformedFamily]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3JordanReducedAction.inverseTransformedFamily_isRaw
statement:
theorem inverseTransformedFamily_isRaw (g : Aut (K := k)) :
    IsRawPrimitiveFrameFamily (inverseTransformedFamily k g)
proof:
:=
  isRawPrimitiveFrameFamily_transport_equiv
    (linearEquiv (ReducedCoordinateRing k) g).symm
    (inverse_jordan _ g) (inverse_one _ g) (inverse_matrixTrace _ g)
    _ (reducedUniversalFamily_isRaw k)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3JordanReducedAction.radical_le_ker_rawToReducedInverse
statement:
theorem radical_le_ker_rawToReducedInverse (g : Aut (K := k)) :
    (rawFrameIdeal (R := k)).radical ≤ RingHom.ker (rawToReducedInverse k g)
proof:
:= by
  apply (RingHom.ker_isPrime (rawToReducedInverse k g)).radical_le_iff.mpr
  have h := (equations_vanishAlong_iff
    ((Ideal.Quotient.mk (rawFrameIdeal (R := k)).radical).comp MvPolynomial.C)
    (inverseTransformedFamily k g)).2 (inverseTransformedFamily_isRaw k g)
  exact Ideal.span_le.2 (fun p hp => by
    rcases hp with ⟨e, rfl⟩
    exact RingHom.mem_ker.mpr (h e))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3JordanReducedAction.reducedInverseHom_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem reducedInverseHom_mk (g : Aut (K := k)) (x : CoordinateRing k) :
    reducedInverseHom k g (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ x) = rawToReducedInverse k g x
proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3JordanReducedAction.reducedInverseHom_universalMatrix
statement:
@[simp] theorem reducedInverseHom_universalMatrix (g : Aut (K := k))
    (r i a b : Fin 3) :
    reducedInverseHom k g (reducedUniversalFamily k r i a b) =
      inverseTransformedFamily k g r i a b
proof:
:= by
  simp [reducedUniversalFamily, rawToReducedInverse, inverseTransformedFamily]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3JordanReducedAction.reducedActionHom_scalar
statement:
@[simp] theorem reducedActionHom_scalar (g : Aut (K := k)) (c : k) :
    reducedActionHom k g
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (MvPolynomial.C c)) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (MvPolynomial.C c)
proof:
:= by
  simp [rawToReduced, evaluationAlong]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3JordanReducedAction.reducedInverseHom_scalar
statement:
@[simp] theorem reducedInverseHom_scalar (g : Aut (K := k)) (c : k) :
    reducedInverseHom k g
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (MvPolynomial.C c)) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (MvPolynomial.C c)
proof:
:= by
  simp [rawToReducedInverse, evaluationAlong]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3JordanReducedAction.reducedInverse_map_transformedFamily
statement:
theorem reducedInverse_map_transformedFamily (g : Aut (K := k)) (r i : Fin 3) :
    (reducedInverseHom k g).mapMatrix (transformedFamily k g r i) =
      reducedUniversalFamily k r i
proof:
:= by
  let U := reducedUniversalFamily k r i
  have hUsymm : Matrix.transpose U = U := by
    ext a b
    exact (reducedUniversalFamily_isRaw k).symmetric r i b a
  change (reducedInverseAlgHom k g).toRingHom.mapMatrix
    (toSymMatrix (linearEquiv (ReducedCoordinateRing k) g (symCoordinates U))) = U
  rw [toSymMatrix_linearEquiv_natural (reducedInverseAlgHom k g)]
  rw [← symCoordinates_natural (reducedInverseAlgHom k g)]
  have hUmap : (reducedInverseHom k g).mapMatrix U =
      inverseTransformedFamily k g r i := by
    ext a b
    exact reducedInverseHom_universalMatrix k g r i a b
  change toSymMatrix (linearEquiv (ReducedCoordinateRing k) g
    (symCoordinates ((reducedInverseHom k g).mapMatrix U))) = U
  rw [hUmap, inverseTransformedFamily, transportFamily,
    symCoordinates_toSymMatrix]
  change toSymMatrix ((linearEquiv (ReducedCoordinateRing k) g)
    ((linearEquiv (ReducedCoordinateRing k) g).symm (symCoordinates U))) = U
  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  rw [toSymMatrix_symCoordinates, symmetrize_eq_self hUsymm]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3JordanReducedAction.reducedAction_map_inverseTransformedFamily
statement:
theorem reducedAction_map_inverseTransformedFamily (g : Aut (K := k)) (r i : Fin 3) :
    (reducedActionHom k g).mapMatrix (inverseTransformedFamily k g r i) =
      reducedUniversalFamily k r i
proof:
:= by
  let U := reducedUniversalFamily k r i
  have hUsymm : Matrix.transpose U = U := by
    ext a b
    exact (reducedUniversalFamily_isRaw k).symmetric r i b a
  change (reducedActionAlgHom k g).toRingHom.mapMatrix
    (toSymMatrix ((linearEquiv (ReducedCoordinateRing k) g).symm (symCoordinates U))) = U
  rw [toSymMatrix_linearEquiv_symm_natural (reducedActionAlgHom k g)]
  rw [← symCoordinates_natural (reducedActionAlgHom k g)]
  have hUmap : (reducedActionHom k g).mapMatrix U = transformedFamily k g r i := by
    ext a b
    exact reducedActionHom_universalMatrix k g r i a b
  change toSymMatrix ((linearEquiv (ReducedCoordinateRing k) g).symm
    (symCoordinates ((reducedActionHom k g).mapMatrix U))) = U
  rw [hUmap, transformedFamily, transportFamily,
    symCoordinates_toSymMatrix]
  change toSymMatrix ((linearEquiv (ReducedCoordinateRing k) g).symm
    ((linearEquiv (ReducedCoordinateRing k) g) (symCoordinates U))) = U
  rw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  rw [toSymMatrix_symCoordinates, symmetrize_eq_self hUsymm]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3JordanReducedAction.reducedInverse_comp_action
statement:
theorem reducedInverse_comp_action (g : Aut (K := k)) :
    (reducedInverseHom k g).comp (reducedActionHom k g) = RingHom.id _
proof:
:= by
  apply Ideal.Quotient.ringHom_ext
  apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
  · intro c
    simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.id_apply, reducedActionHom_scalar, reducedInverseHom_scalar]
  · intro x
    cases x with
    | entry r i a b =>
        change reducedInverseHom k g (reducedActionHom k g
          (reducedUniversalFamily k r i a b)) = reducedUniversalFamily k r i a b
        rw [reducedActionHom_universalMatrix]
        exact congrFun (congrFun (reducedInverse_map_transformedFamily k g r i) a) b

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3JordanReducedAction.reducedAction_comp_inverse
statement:
theorem reducedAction_comp_inverse (g : Aut (K := k)) :
    (reducedActionHom k g).comp (reducedInverseHom k g) = RingHom.id _
proof:
:= by
  apply Ideal.Quotient.ringHom_ext
  apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
  · intro c
    simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.id_apply, reducedActionHom_scalar, reducedInverseHom_scalar]
  · intro x
    cases x with
    | entry r i a b =>
        change reducedActionHom k g (reducedInverseHom k g
          (reducedUniversalFamily k r i a b)) = reducedUniversalFamily k r i a b
        rw [reducedInverseHom_universalMatrix]
        exact congrFun (congrFun (reducedAction_map_inverseTransformedFamily k g r i) a) b

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.TwoTransvectionFinalPoint.transformedUniversal_expansion
statement:
private theorem transformedUniversal_expansion
    (g : ScalarJordanAut.Aut (K := K)) (r i : Fin 3) (c : Index) :
    transformedUniversal K g r i c =
      ∑ d : Index, universalPoint K r i d *
        MvPolynomial.C
          (coordinateAut g
            (Pi.single d (1 : K) : Coordinates K) c)
proof:
:= by
  change (∑ d : Index,
      MvPolynomial.C
          (coordinateAut g
            (Pi.single d (1 : K) : Coordinates K) c) *
        universalPoint K r i d) = _
  simp only [mul_comm]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.TwoTransvectionFinalPoint.coordinateAut_linear_expansion
statement:
private theorem coordinateAut_linear_expansion
    (g : ScalarJordanAut.Aut (K := K)) (x : Coordinates K) (c : Index) :
    (∑ d : Index, x d *
      coordinateAut g (Pi.single d (1 : K) : Coordinates K) c) =
        coordinateAut g x c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hx : x = ∑ d : Index,
      x d • (Pi.single d (1 : K) : Coordinates K) := by
    funext q
    simp [Pi.single_apply]
  calc
    (∑ d : Index, x d *
      coordinateAut g (Pi.single d (1 : K) : Coordinates K) c) =
        coordinateAut g
          (∑ d : Index,
            x d • (Pi.single d (1 : K) : Coordinates K)) c := by
              simp only [map_sum, map_smul, Finset.sum_apply,
                Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    _ = coordinateAut g x c := by rw [← hx]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.TwoTransvectionFinalPoint.evaluationAlong_transformedUniversal
statement:
private theorem evaluationAlong_transformedUniversal
    (g : ScalarJordanAut.Aut (K := K))
    (P : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Coordinates K)
    (r i : Fin 3) (c : Index) :
    evaluationAlong K (RingHom.id K) P
        (transformedUniversal K g r i c) =
      coordinateAut g (P r i) c
proof:
:= by
  rw [transformedUniversal_expansion, map_sum]
  simp only [map_mul, evaluationAlong_universalPoint]
  simp only [evaluationAlong, MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_C, RingHom.id_apply]
  exact coordinateAut_linear_expansion K g (P r i) c

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.TwoTransvectionFinalPoint.evaluationAlong_rawAction
statement:
theorem evaluationAlong_rawAction
    (g : ScalarJordanAut.Aut (K := K))
    (P : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Coordinates K) :
    (evaluationAlong K (RingHom.id K) P).comp (rawAction K g) =
      evaluationAlong K (RingHom.id K) (actedPoint K g P)
proof:
:= by
  apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
  · intro a
    simp [evaluationAlong, rawAction]
  · intro q
    rcases q with ⟨r, i, c⟩
    simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, rawAction_X]
    rw [evaluationAlong_transformedUniversal]
    simp only [evaluationAlong, MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_X', actedPoint]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.TwoTransvectionFinalPoint.ringHom_comp_assoc
statement:
private theorem ringHom_comp_assoc
    {R S T U : Type*}
    [Semiring R] [Semiring S] [Semiring T] [Semiring U]
    (f : T →+* U) (g : S →+* T) (h : R →+* S) :
    f.comp (g.comp h) = (f.comp g).comp h
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.TwoTransvectionFinalPoint.polynomialEvaluation_twoActions
statement:
theorem polynomialEvaluation_twoActions
    (φ : FF k →+* K)
    (g₁ g₂ : ScalarJordanAut.Aut (K := K)) :
    (polynomialEvaluation k K φ).comp
        ((rawAction K g₁).comp (rawAction K g₂)) =
      evaluationAlong K (RingHom.id K)
        (actedPoint K g₂
          (actedPoint K g₁ (genericPointAlong k K φ)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [show polynomialEvaluation k K φ =
      evaluationAlong K (RingHom.id K) (genericPointAlong k K φ) from rfl,
    ringHom_comp_assoc]
  have h₁ := congrArg
    (fun e : CoordinateRing K →+* K => e.comp (rawAction K g₂))
    (evaluationAlong_rawAction K g₁ (genericPointAlong k K φ))
  exact h₁.trans
    (evaluationAlong_rawAction K g₂
      (actedPoint K g₁ (genericPointAlong k K φ)))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.TwoTransvectionFinalPoint.polynomial_twoAction_endpoint_square
statement:
theorem polynomial_twoAction_endpoint_square
    (φ ψ : FF k →+* K)
    (g₁ g₂ : ScalarJordanAut.Aut (K := K))
    (hscalar : originalCoefficientEmbedding k K φ =
      originalCoefficientEmbedding k K ψ)
    (hpoint : actedPoint K g₂
        (actedPoint K g₁ (genericPointAlong k K φ)) =
      genericPointAlong k K ψ) :
    (polynomialEvaluation k K φ).comp
        ((rawAction K g₁).comp
          ((rawAction K g₂).comp
            (polynomialCoefficientMap k K
              (originalCoefficientEmbedding k K φ)))) =
      ψ.comp (rawToFunction k)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (polynomialEvaluation k K φ).comp
        ((rawAction K g₁).comp
          ((rawAction K g₂).comp
            (polynomialCoefficientMap k K
              (originalCoefficientEmbedding k K φ)))) =
      ((polynomialEvaluation k K φ).comp
        ((rawAction K g₁).comp (rawAction K g₂))).comp
          (polynomialCoefficientMap k K
            (originalCoefficientEmbedding k K φ)) := rfl
    _ = (evaluationAlong K (RingHom.id K)
          (actedPoint K g₂
            (actedPoint K g₁ (genericPointAlong k K φ)))).comp
        (polynomialCoefficientMap k K
          (originalCoefficientEmbedding k K φ)) := by
            rw [polynomialEvaluation_twoActions]
    _ = (evaluationAlong K (RingHom.id K)
          (genericPointAlong k K ψ)).comp
        (polynomialCoefficientMap k K
          (originalCoefficientEmbedding k K φ)) := by rw [hpoint]
    _ = (evaluationAlong K (RingHom.id K)
          (genericPointAlong k K ψ)).comp
        (polynomialCoefficientMap k K
          (originalCoefficientEmbedding k K ψ)) := by rw [hscalar]
    _ = ψ.comp (rawToFunction k) :=
      polynomial_evaluation_square k K ψ

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.TwoTransvectionFinalPoint.twoReducedAction_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem twoReducedAction_apply
    (g₁ g₂ : ScalarJordanAut.Aut (K := K)) (x : RR K) :
    twoReducedAction K g₁ g₂ x =
      reducedAction K g₁ (reducedAction K g₂ x)
proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.TwoTransvectionFinalPoint.reducedAction_mk
statement:
private theorem reducedAction_mk
    (g : ScalarJordanAut.Aut (K := K)) (x : CoordinateRing K) :
    reducedAction K g (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ x) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (rawAction K g x)
proof:
:= by
  change reducedActionHom K g (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ x) = _
  exact reducedActionHom_mk K g x

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.TwoTransvectionFinalPoint.reduced_twoAction_evaluation_square
statement:
theorem reduced_twoAction_evaluation_square
    (φ ψ : FF k →+* K)
    (g₁ g₂ : ScalarJordanAut.Aut (K := K))
    (hscalar : originalCoefficientEmbedding k K φ =
      originalCoefficientEmbedding k K ψ)
    (hpoint : actedPoint K g₂
        (actedPoint K g₁ (genericPointAlong k K φ)) =
      genericPointAlong k K ψ) :
    ((evaluation k K φ).comp (twoReducedAction K g₁ g₂).toRingHom).comp
        (reducedCoefficientMap k K φ) =
      ψ.comp (reducedInclusion k)
proof:
:= by
  apply Ideal.Quotient.ringHom_ext
  apply DFunLike.ext _ _
  intro x
  simp only [RingHom.comp_apply]
  rw [reducedCoefficientMap, reducedCoefficientMapOf_mk]
  change evaluation k K φ
      (twoReducedAction K g₁ g₂
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk _
          (polynomialCoefficientMap k K
            (originalCoefficientEmbedding k K φ) x))) = _
  rw [twoReducedAction_apply, reducedAction_mk, reducedAction_mk,
    evaluation_mk]
  change polynomialEvaluation k K φ
      (rawAction K g₁
        (rawAction K g₂
          (polynomialCoefficientMap k K
            (originalCoefficientEmbedding k K φ) x))) =
    ψ (rawToFunction k x)
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun
    (polynomial_twoAction_endpoint_square k K φ ψ g₁ g₂ hscalar hpoint) x

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.TwoTransvectionFinalPoint.twoTransvections_finalPoint_agreement
statement:
theorem twoTransvections_finalPoint_agreement
    (φ ψ : FF k →+* K)
    (d₁ d₂ : Vec6 K) (t₁ t₂ : K)
    (hscalar : originalCoefficientEmbedding k K φ =
      originalCoefficientEmbedding k K ψ)
    (hpoint : actedPoint K (wordJordanAut [(d₂, t₂)])
        (actedPoint K (wordJordanAut [(d₁, t₁)])
          (genericPointAlong k K φ)) =
      genericPointAlong k K ψ)
    (a b : CoordinateRing k) (hb : rawToFunction k b ≠ 0)
    (hinv : ∀ g : ScalarJordanAut.Aut (K := k),
      fractionAction k g (rawToFunction k a / rawToFunction k b) =
        rawToFunction k a / rawToFunction k b) :
    φ (rawToFunction k a / rawToFunction k b) =
      ψ (rawToFunction k a / rawToFunction k b)
proof:
:= by
  let g₁ := wordJordanAut [(d₁, t₁)]
  let g₂ := wordJordanAut [(d₂, t₂)]
  let A := Ideal.Quotient.mk (rawFrameIdeal k).radical a
  let B := Ideal.Quotient.mk (rawFrameIdeal k).radical b
  let T := twoReducedAction K g₁ g₂
  have hbR : reducedInclusion k B ≠ 0 := by
    simpa [B, rawToFunction] using hb
  have hclear' := twoTransvections_clearedInvariant_extension
    k K φ a b hb hinv d₁ d₂ t₁ t₂
  have hclear :
      T (reducedCoefficientMap k K φ A) *
          reducedCoefficientMap k K φ B =
        reducedCoefficientMap k K φ A *
          T (reducedCoefficientMap k K φ B) := by
    simpa [T, twoReducedAction, g₁, g₂, A, B] using hclear'
  have hright :
      ((evaluation k K φ).comp T.toRingHom).comp
          (reducedCoefficientMap k K φ) =
        ψ.comp (reducedInclusion k) := by
    simpa [T, g₁, g₂] using
      reduced_twoAction_evaluation_square k K φ ψ
        (wordJordanAut [(d₁, t₁)]) (wordJordanAut [(d₂, t₂)])
        hscalar hpoint
  have hagree := agreement_of_generic_cleared_transport
    (reducedInclusion k) (reducedCoefficientMap k K φ)
    (evaluation k K φ) φ ψ T
    (reduced_evaluation_square k K φ) hright A B hbR hclear
  simpa [A, B, rawToFunction] using hagree

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3JordanExtension.linearMap_comp_inverse
statement:
theorem linearMap_comp_inverse (g : Aut (K := k)) :
    (linearMap R g).comp (inverseLinearMap R g) = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3JordanExtension.inverse_comp_linearMap
statement:
theorem inverse_comp_linearMap (g : Aut (K := k)) :

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3JordanExtension.linearEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem linearEquiv_apply (g : Aut (K := k)) (x : Sym3Coord R) :
    linearEquiv R g x = linearMap R g x
proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3JordanExtension.linearEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem linearEquiv_symm_apply (g : Aut (K := k)) (x : Sym3Coord R) :
    (linearEquiv R g).symm x = inverseLinearMap R g x
proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3JordanExtension.linearEquiv_apply_coordinate
statement:
theorem linearEquiv_apply_coordinate (g : Aut (K := k)) (x : Sym3Coord R)
    (p : Fin 6) :
    linearEquiv R g x p =
      ∑ q : Fin 6, x q * algebraMap k R (g (Pi.single q 1) p)
proof:
:= by
  change (∑ q : Fin 6, algebraMap k R (g (Pi.single q 1) p) * x q) = _
  simp only [mul_comm]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3JordanExtension.linearMap_on_constants
statement:
theorem linearMap_on_constants (g : Aut (K := k)) (x : Sym3Coord k) :
    linearMap R g (coordinateMap (algebraMap k R) x) =
      coordinateMap (algebraMap k R) (g x)
proof:
:=
  FiniteCoordinateExtension.extend_on_constants (algebraMap k R) g.linear.toLinearMap x

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3JordanExtension.linearMap_one
statement:
theorem linearMap_one (g : Aut (K := k)) :
    linearMap R g (one : Sym3Coord R) = one
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coordinateMap_one (algebraMap k R), linearMap_on_constants,
    g.map_one, coordinateMap_one]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3JordanExtension.linearMap_jordan
statement:
theorem linearMap_jordan (g : Aut (K := k)) (x y : Sym3Coord R) :
    linearMap R g (jordan x y) = jordan (linearMap R g x) (linearMap R g y)
proof:
:= by
  have hbilin :
      (jordanBilin (R := R)).compr₂ (linearMap R g) =
        (jordanBilin (R := R)).compl₁₂ (linearMap R g) (linearMap R g) := by
    apply FiniteCoordinateExtension.bilinear_eq_of_standard_basis
    intro p q
    change linearMap R g (jordan (Pi.single p 1) (Pi.single q 1)) =
      jordan (linearMap R g (Pi.single p 1)) (linearMap R g (Pi.single q 1))
    rw [← coordinateMap_single_one (algebraMap k R) p,
      ← coordinateMap_single_one (algebraMap k R) q,
      ← coordinateMap_jordan, linearMap_on_constants, g.map_jordan,
      coordinateMap_jordan, linearMap_on_constants, linearMap_on_constants]
  exact congrArg (fun B : Sym3Coord R →ₗ[R] Sym3Coord R →ₗ[R] Sym3Coord R => B x y) hbilin

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3JordanExtension.linearMap_matrixTrace
statement:
theorem linearMap_matrixTrace (g : Aut (K := k)) (x : Sym3Coord R) :
    matrixTrace (linearMap R g x) = matrixTrace x
proof:
:= by
  have hlinear :
      (matrixTraceLinear (R := R)).comp (linearMap R g) = matrixTraceLinear := by
    apply (Pi.basisFun R (Fin 6)).ext
    intro q
    simp only [Pi.basisFun_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, matrixTraceLinear_apply]
    change matrixTrace (linearMap R g (Pi.single q 1)) = matrixTrace (Pi.single q 1)
    rw [← coordinateMap_single_one (algebraMap k R) q,
      linearMap_on_constants, matrixTrace_coordinateMap,
      matrixTrace_invariant, matrixTrace_coordinateMap]
  exact congrArg (fun T : Sym3Coord R →ₗ[R] R => T x) hlinear

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3JordanExtension.linearEquiv_one
statement:
theorem linearEquiv_one (g : Aut (K := k)) :
    linearEquiv R g (one : Sym3Coord R) = one
proof: := linearMap_one R g

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3JordanExtension.linearEquiv_jordan
statement:
theorem linearEquiv_jordan (g : Aut (K := k)) (x y : Sym3Coord R) :
    linearEquiv R g (jordan x y) = jordan (linearEquiv R g x) (linearEquiv R g y)
proof:
:=
  linearMap_jordan R g x y

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3JordanExtension.linearEquiv_matrixTrace
statement:
theorem linearEquiv_matrixTrace (g : Aut (K := k)) (x : Sym3Coord R) :

proof: := linearMap_matrixTrace R g x

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3JordanExtension.inverse_one
statement:
theorem inverse_one (g : Aut (K := k)) :
    (linearEquiv R g).symm (one : Sym3Coord R) = one
proof:
:= by
  apply (linearEquiv R g).injective
  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, linearEquiv_one]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3JordanExtension.inverse_jordan
statement:
theorem inverse_jordan (g : Aut (K := k)) (x y : Sym3Coord R) :
    (linearEquiv R g).symm (jordan x y) =
      jordan ((linearEquiv R g).symm x) ((linearEquiv R g).symm y)
proof:
:= by
  apply (linearEquiv R g).injective
  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, linearEquiv_jordan,
    LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3JordanExtension.inverse_matrixTrace
statement:
theorem inverse_matrixTrace (g : Aut (K := k)) (x : Sym3Coord R) :
    matrixTrace ((linearEquiv R g).symm x) = matrixTrace x
proof:
:= by
  have h := linearEquiv_matrixTrace R g ((linearEquiv R g).symm x)
  simpa only [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] using h.symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFramePivotNormalization.good_root_of_square
statement:
theorem good_root_of_square (t s : K) (ht : t ≠ 0) (hsquare : s ^ 2 = t) :
    ∃ r : K, r ^ 2 = t ∧ r ≠ 0 ∧ r ≠ -1
proof:
:= by
  have hs0 : s ≠ 0 := by
    intro hs
    apply ht
    rw [← hsquare, hs]
    simp
  by_cases hneg : s = -1
  · refine ⟨-s, by simpa using hsquare, neg_ne_zero.mpr hs0, ?_⟩
    rw [hneg]
    norm_num
  · exact ⟨s, hsquare, hs0, hneg⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFramePivotNormalization.normalize_first_of_pivot
statement:
theorem normalize_first_of_pivot (e : JCoord K) (i : Fin 3) (s : K)
    (he : sourceProduct e e = e) (hT : sourceTrace e = 1)
    (hsquare : s ^ 2 = sourceTrace (sourceProduct e (diagonalUnit i)))
    (hs0 : s ≠ 0) (hsneg : s ≠ -1) :
    ∃ (p q : JCoord K) (hp : sourceProduct p p = p) (hq : sourceProduct q q = q),
      sourceTrace p = 1 ∧ sourceTrace q = 1 ∧
      (thenAut (sourcePeirceAut p hp) (sourcePeirceAut q hq)).linear e = diagonalUnit 0
proof:
:= by
  let p := ScalarMidpoint.midpoint e (diagonalUnit i) (sourceProduct e (diagonalUnit i)) s
  have hm := midpointAt_properties e i s he hT hsquare hs0 hsneg
  have hp : sourceProduct p p = p := hm.1
  have hpT : sourceTrace p = 1 := hm.2.1
  have hpe : sourcePeirceReflection p e = diagonalUnit i := hm.2.2
  refine ⟨p, swapCenter i 0, hp, swapCenter_idempotent i 0,
    hpT, swapCenter_trace i 0, ?_⟩
  simp only [thenAut_apply, reflectionAut_apply, hpe, swapCenter_reflection,
    Equiv.swap_apply_left]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFramePivotNormalization.normalize_second_of_pivot
statement:
theorem normalize_second_of_pivot (e : JCoord K) (i : Fin 3) (s : K)
    (he : sourceProduct e e = e) (hT : sourceTrace e = 1)
    (hzero : sourceProduct e (diagonalUnit 0) = 0) (hi0 : i ≠ 0)
    (hsquare : s ^ 2 = sourceTrace (sourceProduct e (diagonalUnit i)))
    (hs0 : s ≠ 0) (hsneg : s ≠ -1) :
    ∃ (p q : JCoord K) (hp : sourceProduct p p = p) (hq : sourceProduct q q = q),
      sourceTrace p = 1 ∧ sourceTrace q = 1 ∧
      (thenAut (sourcePeirceAut p hp) (sourcePeirceAut q hq)).linear (diagonalUnit 0) =
        diagonalUnit 0 ∧
      (thenAut (sourcePeirceAut p hp) (sourcePeirceAut q hq)).linear e = diagonalUnit 1
proof:
:= by
  let p := ScalarMidpoint.midpoint e (diagonalUnit i) (sourceProduct e (diagonalUnit i)) s
  have hm := midpointAt_properties e i s he hT hsquare hs0 hsneg
  have hp : sourceProduct p p = p := hm.1
  have hpT : sourceTrace p = 1 := hm.2.1
  have hpe : sourcePeirceReflection p e = diagonalUnit i := hm.2.2
  have hp0 : sourcePeirceReflection p (diagonalUnit 0) = diagonalUnit 0 :=
    reflection_fixed_of_product_zero p (diagonalUnit 0) (midpoint_stays_zero e hzero i hi0 s)
  refine ⟨p, swapCenter i 1, hp, swapCenter_idempotent i 1,
    hpT, swapCenter_trace i 1, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [thenAut_apply, reflectionAut_apply, hp0, swapCenter_reflection]
    rw [Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne (Ne.symm hi0) (by decide)]
  · simp only [thenAut_apply, reflectionAut_apply, hpe, swapCenter_reflection,
      Equiv.swap_apply_left]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.LawfulChart.chartWithResidualPair_reinsert

    (x : ExplicitFrameChart ℚ) (P Q : ResidualPair ℚ) :

name: AlbertLean.Generic.LawfulChart.explicitFrameEquationValues_chartWithResidualPair_of_moment_eq
statement:
theorem explicitFrameEquationValues_chartWithResidualPair_of_moment_eq
    (x : ExplicitFrameChart ℚ) (Q : ResidualPair ℚ)
    (hQ : moment Q = moment (residualPairOfChart x)) :
    explicitFrameEquationValues (chartWithResidualPair x Q) =
      explicitFrameEquationValues x
proof:
:= by
  have hM : matrixM (chartWithResidualPair x Q) = matrixM x := by
    calc
      matrixM (chartWithResidualPair x Q) =
          moment (residualPairOfChart (chartWithResidualPair x Q)) :=
        matrixM_eq_moment_residualPairOfChart _
      _ = moment Q := by rw [residualPairOfChart_chartWithResidualPair]
      _ = moment (residualPairOfChart x) := hQ
      _ = matrixM x := (matrixM_eq_moment_residualPairOfChart x).symm
  have hdiagA : (chartWithResidualPair x Q).diagA = x.diagA := rfl
  have hdiagB : (chartWithResidualPair x Q).diagB = x.diagB := rfl
  have hr1 : (chartWithResidualPair x Q).r1 = x.r1 := rfl
  have hz1 : (chartWithResidualPair x Q).z1 = x.z1 := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RawPrimitiveFrameIdeal.equations_vanishAlong_iff
statement:
theorem equations_vanishAlong_iff (f : R →+* S)
    (P : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Mat3 S) :
    (∀ q, evaluationAlong f P (equation q) = 0) ↔
      IsRawPrimitiveFrameFamily P
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro r i a b
      simpa [equation, sub_eq_zero] using h (.symmetry r i a b)
    · intro r i
      ext a b
      simpa [equation, Matrix.mul_apply, sub_eq_zero] using
        h (.idempotence r i a b)
    · intro r i
      simpa [equation, Matrix.trace, sub_eq_zero] using h (.traceOne r i)
    · intro r
      ext a b
      simpa [equation, Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.one_apply, sub_eq_zero] using h (.sumOne r a b)
  · intro h q
    cases q with
    | symmetry r i a b => simp [equation, h.symmetric r i a b]
    | idempotence r i a b =>
        have hij := congrFun (congrFun (h.idempotent r i) a) b
        simpa [equation, Matrix.mul_apply, sub_eq_zero] using hij
    | traceOne r i => simpa [equation, Matrix.trace, sub_eq_zero] using h.trace_one r i
    | sumOne r a b =>
        have hij := congrFun (congrFun (h.sum_one r) a) b
        simpa [equation, Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.one_apply, sub_eq_zero] using hij

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RawPrimitiveFrameIdeal.rawFrameIdeal_le_ker_iff
statement:
theorem rawFrameIdeal_le_ker_iff (P : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Mat3 S) :
    rawFrameIdeal (R := R) ≤ RingHom.ker (evaluation (R := R) P).toRingHom ↔
      IsRawPrimitiveFrameFamily P
proof:
:= by
  rw [← equations_vanish_iff (R := R) P]
  constructor
  · intro h q
    exact (RingHom.mem_ker.mp (h (Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self q))))
  · intro h
    refine Ideal.span_le.2 ?_
    rintro p ⟨q, rfl⟩
    exact RingHom.mem_ker.mpr (h q)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceRingReflectionFormula.map_ringProduct
statement:
theorem map_ringProduct {S : Type v} [CommRing S] [Algebra ℚ S]
    (f : R →+* S) (hf : f.comp (algebraMap ℚ R) = algebraMap ℚ S)
    (x y : F0Ring R) :
    mapF0Ring f (ringProduct x y) =
      ringProduct (mapF0Ring f x) (mapF0Ring f y)
proof:
:= by
  funext c
  have hc (q : ℚ) : f (algebraMap ℚ R q) = algebraMap ℚ S q :=
    DFunLike.congr_fun hf q
  simp [mapF0Ring, ringProduct, map_sum, map_mul, hc]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceRingReflectionFormula.map_ringReflection
statement:
theorem map_ringReflection {S : Type v} [CommRing S] [Algebra ℚ S]
    (f : R →+* S) (hf : f.comp (algebraMap ℚ R) = algebraMap ℚ S)
    (p x : F0Ring R) :
    mapF0Ring f (ringReflection p x) =
      ringReflection (mapF0Ring f p) (mapF0Ring f x)
proof:
:= by
  funext c
  have hpx := congrFun (map_ringProduct f hf p x) c
  have hppx := congrFun (map_ringProduct f hf p (ringProduct p x)) c
  have hpx' := map_ringProduct f hf p x
  rw [hpx'] at hppx
  dsimp only [mapF0Ring] at hpx hppx
  simp only [ringReflection, mapF0Ring, Pi.add_apply, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply,
    smul_eq_mul, map_add, map_sub, map_mul, map_ofNat, hpx, hppx]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3ActionAttachment.ringEquiv_ext_scalar_universal
statement:
theorem ringEquiv_ext_scalar_universal
    (f g : FunctionField k ≃+* FunctionField k)
    (hscalar : ∀ c : k, f (scalarMap k c) = g (scalarMap k c))
    (hentry : ∀ r i a b : Fin 3,
      f (universalFamily k r i a b) = g (universalFamily k r i a b)) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  have hpoly : f.toRingHom.comp (rawToField k) = g.toRingHom.comp (rawToField k) := by
    apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
    · intro c
      exact hscalar c
    · intro z
      cases z with
      | entry r i a b => exact hentry r i a b
  have hraw (p : CoordinateRing k) : f (rawToField k p) = g (rawToField k p) :=
    congrArg (fun h : CoordinateRing k →+* FunctionField k => h p) hpoly
  apply RingEquiv.ext
  intro x
  obtain ⟨a, b, _hb, hx⟩ := RealOrthogonalExtensionAgreement.exists_raw_fraction k x
  rw [hx, map_div₀, map_div₀, hraw a, hraw b]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3ActionAttachment.fractionAction_orthogonalAut
