theorem fractionAction_orthogonalAut (Q : Mat3 k) (hQ : IsOrthogonal Q) :
    fractionAction k (orthogonalAut Q hQ) =
      constantAction k Q hQ.transpose_mul hQ.mul_transpose
proof:
:= by
  apply ringEquiv_ext_scalar_universal k
  · intro c
    rw [fractionAction_scalar, constantAction_scalar]
  · intro r i a b
    have hmatrix :
        (fractionAction k (orthogonalAut Q hQ)).toRingHom.mapMatrix (universalFamily k r i) =
          (constantAction k Q hQ.transpose_mul hQ.mul_transpose).toRingHom.mapMatrix
            (universalFamily k r i) := by
      rw [fractionAction_universalFamily_coordinates,
        extension_orthogonal_symCoordinates,
        symmetrize_eq_self (universalFamily_symmetric k r i),
        RealLedgerInvariant.constantAction_universalFamily] <;> rfl
    exact congrFun (congrFun hmatrix a) b

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowComponents.determinant_ratios
statement:
theorem determinant_ratios (a0 a1 a2 X : Mat3 K) (ha0 : a0.det ≠ 0)
    (hX : ComponentSolution a0 a1 a2 X) :
    X.det = a1.det / a0.det ∧ (1 + X).det = -(a2.det / a0.det)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · apply (eq_div_iff ha0).2
    simpa only [Matrix.det_mul] using hX.det_b1
  · have hn : -(1 + X).det = a2.det / a0.det := by
      apply (eq_div_iff ha0).2
      have hb := hX.det_b2
      rw [Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_neg] at hb
      norm_num at hb
      simpa only [neg_mul] using hb
    exact neg_eq_iff_eq_neg.mp hn

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowComponents.goodSolution_of_components
statement:
theorem goodSolution_of_components
    (a0 a1 a2 X : Mat3 K)
    (ha0 : a0.det ≠ 0) (ha1 : a1.det ≠ 0) (ha2 : a2.det ≠ 0)
    (hX : ComponentSolution a0 a1 a2 X) :
    GoodSolution (componentU a0 a1 a2) (componentV a0 a1)
      (a1.det / a0.det) (a2.det / a0.det) X
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hdetX, hdetOne⟩ := determinant_ratios a0 a1 a2 X ha0 hX
  have hnX : X.det ≠ 0 := by rw [hdetX]; exact div_ne_zero ha1 ha0
  have hnOne : (1 + X).det ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hdetOne]; exact neg_ne_zero.mpr (div_ne_zero ha2 ha0)
  have hnA0 : a0.adjugate.det ≠ 0 := by
    have h : a0.adjugate.det = a0.det ^ 2 := by simpa using Matrix.det_adjugate a0
    rw [h]
    exact pow_ne_zero 2 ha0
  refine ⟨?_, hdetX, hdetOne, hX.denominator_det_ne_zero⟩
  exact right_quadratic_of_normalized_cslots
    a0 a0 (X * a0) (-(1 + X) * a0) X a0.adjugate a1.adjugate a2.adjugate
    rfl rfl rfl ha0 (by rw [hX.det_b1]; exact ha1)
    (by rw [hX.det_b2]; exact ha2) hnX hnOne hnA0 hX.inverse_adjugate_sum

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowComponents.eq_of_components_of_trace_eq
statement:
theorem eq_of_components_of_trace_eq
    (a0 a1 a2 : Mat3 K)
    (ha0 : a0.det ≠ 0) (ha1 : a1.det ≠ 0) (ha2 : a2.det ≠ 0)
    {X Y : Mat3 K} (hX : ComponentSolution a0 a1 a2 X)
    (hY : ComponentSolution a0 a1 a2 Y)
    (ht : Matrix.trace X = Matrix.trace Y) : X = Y
proof:
:= by
  exact eq_of_goodSolution_of_trace_eq _ _ _ _
    (goodSolution_of_components a0 a1 a2 X ha0 ha1 ha2 hX)
    (goodSolution_of_components a0 a1 a2 Y ha0 ha1 ha2 hY) ht

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowComponents.three_componentSolutions_pairwise_eq
statement:
theorem three_componentSolutions_pairwise_eq
    (a0 a1 a2 : Mat3 K)
    (ha0 : a0.det ≠ 0) (ha1 : a1.det ≠ 0) (ha2 : a2.det ≠ 0)
    (X Y Z : Mat3 K)
    (hX : ComponentSolution a0 a1 a2 X)
    (hY : ComponentSolution a0 a1 a2 Y)
    (hZ : ComponentSolution a0 a1 a2 Z) :
    X = Y ∨ X = Z ∨ Y = Z
proof:
:= by
  have hparams := FourRowFrameDeterminants.adjugate_normalized_endpoint_determinants
    a0 a1 a2 ha0
  exact three_goodSolutions_pairwise_eq
    (componentU a0 a1 a2) (componentV a0 a1) (a1.det / a0.det) (a2.det / a0.det)
    (div_ne_zero ha1 ha0) (div_ne_zero ha2 ha0) hparams.1 hparams.2 X Y Z
    (goodSolution_of_components a0 a1 a2 X ha0 ha1 ha2 hX)
    (goodSolution_of_components a0 a1 a2 Y ha0 ha1 ha2 hY)
    (goodSolution_of_components a0 a1 a2 Z ha0 ha1 ha2 hZ)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualRawTransport.eval_mapped_determinant
statement:
private theorem eval_mapped_determinant
    (theta : FF k →+* FF K)
    (G : AlbertLean.Residual.SL4PairAction.DetOneMatrix K) :
    MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom theta (residualPoint K G)
        (LocalizedGridIdentity.mappedDenominator k (FF k)
          (RationalResidualSourceFamily.determinant k)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hmap :
      MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom theta (residualPoint K G)
          (LocalizedGridIdentity.mappedDenominator k (FF k)
            (RationalResidualSourceFamily.determinant k)) =
        MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom
          (theta.comp (algebraMap k (FF k))) (residualPoint K G)
            (RationalResidualSourceFamily.determinant k) := by
    simp [LocalizedGridIdentity.mappedDenominator,
      MvPolynomial.map_eval, Function.comp_def]
  rw [hmap, RationalResidualSourceFamily.determinant, RingHom.map_det]
  have hmatrix :
      (MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom
          (theta.comp (algebraMap k (FF k)))
          (residualPoint K G)).mapMatrix
            (RationalResidualSourceFamily.universalZ k) =
        (algebraMap K (FF K)).mapMatrix G.g := by
    ext i j
    simp [RationalResidualSourceFamily.universalZ, residualPoint]
  rw [hmatrix, ← RingHom.map_det, G.det_g, map_one]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualRawTransport.residual_denominator_unit
statement:
private theorem residual_denominator_unit
    (theta : FF k →+* FF K)
    (G : AlbertLean.Residual.SL4PairAction.DetOneMatrix K) :
    IsUnit (MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom theta (residualPoint K G)
      (LocalizedGridIdentity.mappedDenominator k (FF k)
        (RationalResidualSourceFamily.determinant k)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [eval_mapped_determinant k K theta G]
  exact isUnit_one

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualRawTransport.residualEval_coefficient
statement:
private theorem residualEval_coefficient
    (theta : FF k →+* FF K)
    (G : AlbertLean.Residual.SL4PairAction.DetOneMatrix K) (x : FF k) :
    residualEval k K theta G
        (RationalResidualSourceFamily.coefficientEmbedding k x) = theta x
proof:
:= by
  simp [residualEval, RationalResidualSourceFamily.coefficientEmbedding,
    RationalSourceFamily.coefficientEmbedding,
    LocalizedGridIdentity.extensionEval, IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualRawTransport.residualEval_genericCoefficient
statement:
private theorem residualEval_genericCoefficient
    (theta : FF k →+* FF K)
    (G : AlbertLean.Residual.SL4PairAction.DetOneMatrix K) (x : FF k) :
    residualEval k K theta G
        (RationalSourceFamily.coefficientEmbedding k x) = theta x
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [RationalResidualSourceFamily.coefficientEmbedding] using
    residualEval_coefficient k K theta G x

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualRawTransport.residualEval_localZ
statement:
private theorem residualEval_localZ
    (theta : FF k →+* FF K)
    (G : AlbertLean.Residual.SL4PairAction.DetOneMatrix K) :
    (RationalResidualSourceFamily.localZ k).map (residualEval k K theta G) =
      G.g.map (algebraMap K (FF K))
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp [RationalResidualSourceFamily.localZ,
    RationalResidualSourceFamily.universalZ, residualEval, residualPoint,
    LocalizedGridIdentity.extensionEval, IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualRawTransport.residualEval_localDet
statement:
private theorem residualEval_localDet
    (theta : FF k →+* FF K)
    (G : AlbertLean.Residual.SL4PairAction.DetOneMatrix K) :
    residualEval k K theta G (RationalResidualSourceFamily.localDet k) = 1
proof:
:= by
  change
    LocalizedGridIdentity.extensionEval k (FF k)
      (RationalResidualSourceFamily.FamilyRing k)
      (RationalResidualSourceFamily.determinant k) theta (residualPoint K G)
      (residual_denominator_unit k K theta G)
      (algebraMap
        (MvPolynomial RVar (FF k))
        (RationalResidualSourceFamily.FamilyRing k)
        (LocalizedGridIdentity.mappedDenominator k (FF k)
          (RationalResidualSourceFamily.determinant k))) = 1
  rw [show
      LocalizedGridIdentity.extensionEval k (FF k)
          (RationalResidualSourceFamily.FamilyRing k)
          (RationalResidualSourceFamily.determinant k) theta
          (residualPoint K G) (residual_denominator_unit k K theta G)
          (algebraMap
            (MvPolynomial RVar (FF k))
            (RationalResidualSourceFamily.FamilyRing k)
            (LocalizedGridIdentity.mappedDenominator k (FF k)
              (RationalResidualSourceFamily.determinant k))) =
        MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom theta (residualPoint K G)
          (LocalizedGridIdentity.mappedDenominator k (FF k)
            (RationalResidualSourceFamily.determinant k)) by
      exact IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq _ _ _]
  exact eval_mapped_determinant k K theta G

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualRawTransport.residualEval_localDetInv
statement:
private theorem residualEval_localDetInv
    (theta : FF k →+* FF K)
    (G : AlbertLean.Residual.SL4PairAction.DetOneMatrix K) :
    residualEval k K theta G
        (RationalResidualSourceFamily.localDetInv k) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (residualEval k K theta G)
    (RationalResidualSourceFamily.localDet_mul_inv k)
  rw [map_mul, map_one, residualEval_localDet k K theta G, one_mul] at h
  exact h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualRawTransport.residualEval_single
statement:
private theorem residualEval_single
    (theta : FF k →+* FF K)
    (G : AlbertLean.Residual.SL4PairAction.DetOneMatrix K) (j : Fin 27) :
    (fun c : Fin 27 => residualEval k K theta G
      (((Pi.single j (1 : RationalResidualSourceFamily.FamilyRing k)) :
        Fin 27 → RationalResidualSourceFamily.FamilyRing k) c)) =
        Pi.single j (1 : FF K)
proof:
:= by
  funext c
  by_cases h : c = j <;> simp [Pi.single_apply, h]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualRawTransport.mapped_det_one
statement:
private theorem mapped_det_one
    (G : AlbertLean.Residual.SL4PairAction.DetOneMatrix K) :
    Matrix.det (G.g.map (algebraMap K (FF K))) = 1
proof:
:= by
  change Matrix.det ((algebraMap K (FF K)).mapMatrix G.g) = 1
  rw [← RingHom.map_det, G.det_g, map_one]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualRawTransport.residualEval_matrix_basis
statement:
private theorem residualEval_matrix_basis
    (theta : FF k →+* FF K)
    (G : AlbertLean.Residual.SL4PairAction.DetOneMatrix K) (j : Fin 27) :
    (fun i => residualEval k K theta G
      (RationalResidualSourceFamily.matrix k i j)) =
      SourceAutExtension.baseLinear
        (SourceRationalDetOneFamily.familySourceAut
          (G.g.map (algebraMap K (FF K)))
          (by simpa [mapped_det_one K G]))
        (Pi.single j 1)
proof:
:= by
  let ev := residualEval k K theta G
  let Z := G.g.map (algebraMap K (FF K))
  have hZ : Matrix.det Z ≠ 0 := by
    simpa [Z, mapped_det_one K G]
  have hc := RationalResidualSourceFamily.map_circuit ev
    (RationalResidualSourceFamily.localZ k)
    (RationalResidualSourceFamily.localDet k)
    (RationalResidualSourceFamily.localDetInv k)
    (Pi.single j 1)
  rw [residualEval_localZ k K theta G,
    residualEval_localDet k K theta G,
    residualEval_localDetInv k K theta G,
    residualEval_single k K theta G j] at hc
  have hb := RationalResidualSourceFamily.circuit_eq_familySourceAut Z hZ
    (Pi.single j (1 : FF K))
  have hdetZ : Matrix.det Z = 1 := by
    simpa only [Z] using mapped_det_one K G
  have hbOne :
      RationalResidualSourceFamily.circuit Z 1 1
          (Pi.single j (1 : FF K)) =
        structuredEquivK (FF K)
          ((SourceRationalDetOneFamily.familySourceAut Z hZ).linear
            ((structuredEquivK (FF K)).symm
              (Pi.single j (1 : FF K)))) := by
    simpa only [hdetZ, inv_one] using hb
  simpa [ev, Z, RationalResidualSourceFamily.matrix,
    RationalResidualSourceFamily.localCircuit,
    SourceAutExtension.baseLinear] using hc.trans hbOne

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualRawTransport.residualEval_matrix
statement:
private theorem residualEval_matrix
    (theta : FF k →+* FF K)
    (G : AlbertLean.Residual.SL4PairAction.DetOneMatrix K)
    (x : Fin 27 → FF K) :
    ((RationalResidualSourceFamily.matrix k).map
      (residualEval k K theta G)).mulVec x =
      SourceAutExtension.baseLinear
        (SourceRationalDetOneFamily.familySourceAut
          (G.g.map (algebraMap K (FF K)))
          (by simpa [mapped_det_one K G])) x
proof:
:= by
  have hm :
      (RationalResidualSourceFamily.matrix k).map
          (residualEval k K theta G) =
        LinearMap.toMatrix'
          (SourceAutExtension.baseLinear
            (SourceRationalDetOneFamily.familySourceAut
              (G.g.map (algebraMap K (FF K)))
              (by simpa [mapped_det_one K G]))) := by
    ext i j
    exact congrFun (residualEval_matrix_basis k K theta G j) i
  rw [hm]
  exact LinearMap.toMatrix'_mulVec _ x

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualRawTransport.residualEval_substitution
statement:
private theorem residualEval_substitution
    (theta : FF k →+* FF K)
    (G : AlbertLean.Residual.SL4PairAction.DetOneMatrix K) :
    (residualEval k K theta G).comp
        (RationalSourceFamily.substitution k (residualWord k)) =
      SourceEvenRawTransport.genericSourceSubstitution k theta
        (SourceRationalDetOneFamily.familySourceAut
          (G.g.map (algebraMap K (FF K)))
          (by simpa [mapped_det_one K G]))
proof:
:= by
  apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
  · intro a
    simpa only [RingHom.comp_apply, RationalSourceFamily.substitution,
      MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_C,
      SourceEvenRawTransport.genericSourceSubstitution,
      RationalResidualSourceFamily.coefficientEmbedding] using
        residualEval_genericCoefficient k K theta G (algebraMap k (FF k) a)
  · intro q
    cases q with
    | entry r i c =>
      have hm := congrFun (residualEval_matrix k K theta G
        (fun d => theta
          (SourceFractionActionUniversalF0.universalF0 k r i d))) c
      simpa [RingHom.comp_apply, RationalSourceFamily.substitution,
        MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_X',
        SourceEvenRawTransport.genericSourceSubstitution,
        RationalResidualSourceFamily.stage,
        RationalResidualSourceFamily.coefficientEmbedding,
        residualWord, RationalSourceFamily.CertifiedWord.stages,
        RationalSourceFamily.applyWord, RationalSourceFamily.wordMatrix,
        Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct,
        residualEval_genericCoefficient k K theta G] using hm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualRawTransport.residual_natural
statement:
private theorem residual_natural
    (G : AlbertLean.Residual.SL4PairAction.DetOneMatrix K) :
    let iK : K →+* FF K
proof:
:= algebraMap K (FF K)
    let gL := SourceRationalDetOneFamily.familySourceAut (G.g.map iK)
      (by rw [mapped_det_one K G]; exact one_ne_zero)
    ∀ x : JCoord K,
      SourceCoefficientMap.mapSource iK ((ResidualAction.sourceAut G).linear x) =
        gL.linear (SourceCoefficientMap.mapSource iK x) := by
  dsimp only
  intro x
  let iK : K →+* FF K := algebraMap K (FF K)
  let Z := G.g.map iK
  have hG : Matrix.det G.g ≠ 0 := by simpa [G.det_g]
  have hZ : Matrix.det Z ≠ 0 := by
    rw [show Matrix.det Z = 1 by
      simpa only [Z] using mapped_det_one K G]
    exact one_ne_zero
  let y := structuredEquivK K x
  have hbase := RationalResidualSourceFamily.circuit_eq_familySourceAut
    G.g hG y
  rw [SourceRationalDetOneFamily.familySourceAut_surjective G] at hbase
  rw [G.det_g] at hbase
  simp only [inv_one] at hbase
  have hmap := RationalResidualSourceFamily.map_circuit iK G.g 1 1 y
  have hmap' :
      (fun c => iK (RationalResidualSourceFamily.circuit G.g 1 1 y c)) =
        RationalResidualSourceFamily.circuit Z 1 1 (fun c => iK (y c)) := by
    simpa only [map_one, Z] using hmap
  have htarget := RationalResidualSourceFamily.circuit_eq_familySourceAut
    Z hZ (fun c => iK (y c))
  have hdetZ : Matrix.det Z = 1 := by
    simpa only [Z] using mapped_det_one K G
  have htargetOne :
      RationalResidualSourceFamily.circuit Z 1 1
          (fun c => iK (y c)) =
        structuredEquivK (FF K)
          ((SourceRationalDetOneFamily.familySourceAut Z hZ).linear
            ((structuredEquivK (FF K)).symm (fun c => iK (y c)))) := by
    simpa only [hdetZ, inv_one] using htarget
  apply (structuredEquivK (FF K)).injective
  simp only [SourceCoefficientMap.mapSource, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply,
    SourceCoefficientMap.mapF0]
  change (fun c => iK (structuredEquivK K ((ResidualAction.sourceAut G).linear x) c)) =
    structuredEquivK (FF K)
      ((SourceRationalDetOneFamily.familySourceAut Z hZ).linear
        ((structuredEquivK (FF K)).symm (fun c => iK (y c))))
  exact (congrArg (fun z => fun c => iK (z c)) hbase).symm.trans
    (hmap'.trans htargetOne)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualRawTransport.reduced_cleared_residual_identity
statement:
theorem reduced_cleared_residual_identity
    (phi : FF k →+* K)
    (a b : CR k) (hb : rawToFunction k b ≠ 0)
    (hinv : ∀ g : ResidualAction.SourceAut (K := k),
      fractionAction k g (rawToFunction k a / rawToFunction k b) =
        rawToFunction k a / rawToFunction k b)
    (G : AlbertLean.Residual.SL4PairAction.DetOneMatrix K) :
    reducedAction K (ResidualAction.sourceAut G)
        (reducedCoefficientMap k K phi (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ a)) *
      reducedCoefficientMap k K phi (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ b) =
    reducedCoefficientMap k K phi (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ a) *
      reducedAction K (ResidualAction.sourceAut G)
        (reducedCoefficientMap k K phi (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ b))
proof:
:= by
  let theta := SourceEvenRawTransport.fractionCoefficientEmbedding k K phi
  let iK : K →+* FF K := algebraMap K (FF K)
  let Z := G.g.map iK
  have hZ : Matrix.det Z ≠ 0 := by
    rw [show Matrix.det Z = 1 by
      simpa only [Z] using mapped_det_one K G]
    exact one_ne_zero
  let gL := SourceRationalDetOneFamily.familySourceAut Z hZ
  let ev := residualEval k K theta G
  have hgrid := RationalSourceFamily.word_grid_cleared_identity k
    (residualWord k) a b hb hinv
  have hclear := congrArg ev hgrid
  rw [map_sub, map_mul, map_mul, map_zero, sub_eq_zero] at hclear
  have hsub := residualEval_substitution k K theta G
  have hsa := DFunLike.congr_fun hsub a
  have hsb := DFunLike.congr_fun hsub b
  simp only [RingHom.comp_apply] at hsa hsb
  have hca :
      residualEval k K theta G
          (RationalSourceFamily.coefficientEmbedding k
            (SourceFractionActionUniversalF0.rawToFunction k a)) =
        theta (SourceFractionActionUniversalF0.rawToFunction k a) :=
    residualEval_genericCoefficient k K theta G
      (SourceFractionActionUniversalF0.rawToFunction k a)
  have hcb :
      residualEval k K theta G
          (RationalSourceFamily.coefficientEmbedding k
            (SourceFractionActionUniversalF0.rawToFunction k b)) =
        theta (SourceFractionActionUniversalF0.rawToFunction k b) :=
    residualEval_genericCoefficient k K theta G
      (SourceFractionActionUniversalF0.rawToFunction k b)
  change ev (RationalSourceFamily.substitution k (residualWord k) a) *
      ev (RationalSourceFamily.coefficientEmbedding k
        (SourceFractionActionUniversalF0.rawToFunction k b)) =
      ev (RationalSourceFamily.coefficientEmbedding k
      (SourceFractionActionUniversalF0.rawToFunction k a)) *
      ev (RationalSourceFamily.substitution k (residualWord k) b) at hclear
  dsimp only [ev] at hclear
  rw [hsa, hsb, hca, hcb] at hclear
  have hn : ∀ x : JCoord K,
      SourceCoefficientMap.mapSource (algebraMap K (FF K))
          ((ResidualAction.sourceAut G).linear x) =
        gL.linear
          (SourceCoefficientMap.mapSource (algebraMap K (FF K)) x) := by
    simpa only [gL, Z, iK] using residual_natural K G
  have hsquare := SourceEvenRawTransport.genericSourceSubstitution_eq_actual
    k K phi (RingHom.id (FF K)) (fun _ => rfl)
    (ResidualAction.sourceAut G) gL hn
  simp only [RingHom.id_comp] at hsquare
  have hga := DFunLike.congr_fun hsquare a
  have hgb := DFunLike.congr_fun hsquare b
  have hbase (p : CR k) :
      theta (SourceFractionActionUniversalF0.rawToFunction k p) =
      algebraMap (RR K) (FF K)
        (reducedCoefficientMap k K phi (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ p)) := by
    exact SourceEvenRawTransport.fractionCoefficientEmbedding_raw k K phi p
  rw [hga, hgb, hbase a, hbase b] at hclear
  apply IsFractionRing.injective (RR K) (FF K)
  simpa only [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.id_apply, map_mul,
    RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingEquiv.coe_toRingHom] using hclear

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.ThreeFrameCayleyLocalization.denominator_dvd_total
statement:
theorem denominator_dvd_total (r : Fin 3) :
    denominator k r ∣ totalDenominator k
proof:
:= by
  exact Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem (fun s : Fin 3 => denominator k s) (Finset.mem_univ r)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.ThreeFrameCayleyLocalization.localized_denominator_isUnit
statement:
theorem localized_denominator_isUnit (r : Fin 3) :
    IsUnit (algebraMap (Base k) (ParameterRing k) (denominator k r))
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit_iff (x := totalDenominator k)]
  exact ⟨1, by simpa using denominator_dvd_total k r⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.ThreeFrameCayleyLocalization.baseEval_parameter
statement:
@[simp] theorem baseEval_parameter (f : k →+* L)
    (x : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → L) (r q : Fin 3) :
    baseEval f x (parameter k r q) = x r q
proof:
:= by
  simp [baseEval, parameter]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.ThreeFrameCayleyLocalization.baseEval_skewPoly
statement:
theorem baseEval_skewPoly (f : k →+* L)
    (x : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → L) (r : Fin 3) :
    (baseEval f x).mapMatrix (skewPoly k r) =
      AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.CayleyFrameCoverage.skew (x r 0) (x r 1) (x r 2)
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [skewPoly,
    AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.CayleyFrameCoverage.skew, baseEval_parameter]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.ThreeFrameCayleyLocalization.baseEval_denominator
statement:
theorem baseEval_denominator (f : k →+* L)
    (x : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → L) (r : Fin 3) :
    baseEval f x (denominator k r) =
      Matrix.det (1 + AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.CayleyFrameCoverage.skew
        (x r 0) (x r 1) (x r 2))
proof:
:= by
  rw [denominator, RingHom.map_det]
  rw [map_add, map_one, baseEval_skewPoly]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.ThreeFrameCayleyLocalization.baseEval_totalDenominator_ne_zero
statement:
theorem baseEval_totalDenominator_ne_zero
    (f : k →+* L) (x : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → L)
    (hden : ∀ r, Matrix.det (1 +
      AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.CayleyFrameCoverage.skew
        (x r 0) (x r 1) (x r 2)) ≠ 0) :
    baseEval f x (totalDenominator k) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [totalDenominator, Fin.prod_univ_succ, baseEval_denominator, hden]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.ThreeFrameCayleyLocalization.evalAway_algebraMap
statement:
theorem evalAway_algebraMap (f : k →+* L) (x : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → L)
    (hden) (p : Base k) :
    evalAway f x hden (algebraMap (Base k) (ParameterRing k) p) = baseEval f x p
proof:
:= by
  exact IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq (totalDenominator k)
    (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (baseEval_totalDenominator_ne_zero f x hden)) p

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.sign_ne_zero
statement: theorem sign_ne_zero {x : K} (hx : x ^ 2 = 1) : x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  rw [h, zero_pow (by decide : 2 ≠ 0)] at hx
  exact zero_ne_one hx

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.sign_mul_self
statement: theorem sign_mul_self {x : K} (hx : x ^ 2 = 1) : x * x = 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [pow_two] using hx

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.sign_cocycle_factorization
statement:
theorem sign_cocycle_factorization
    (s t r : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → K)
    (hs : ∀ i j, (s i j) ^ 2 = 1)
    (ht : ∀ j l, (t j l) ^ 2 = 1)
    (hr : ∀ l i, (r l i) ^ 2 = 1)
    (htriangle : ∀ i j l, s i j * t j l * r l i = 1) :
    ∃ epsilon eta zeta : Fin 3 → K,
      (∀ i, (epsilon i) ^ 2 = 1) ∧
      (∀ j, (eta j) ^ 2 = 1) ∧
      (∀ l, (zeta l) ^ 2 = 1) ∧
      (∀ i j, s i j = epsilon i * eta j) ∧
      (∀ j l, t j l = eta j * zeta l) ∧
      (∀ l i, r l i = zeta l * epsilon i)
proof:
:= by
  let epsilon : Fin 3 → K := fun i => s i 0
  let eta : Fin 3 → K := fun j => s 0 0 * s 0 j
  let zeta : Fin 3 → K := fun l => t 0 l
  refine ⟨epsilon, eta, zeta, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    exact hs i 0
  · intro j
    simp only [eta, mul_pow, hs, one_mul]
  · intro l
    exact ht 0 l
  · intro i j
    have h1 := htriangle i j 0
    have h2 := htriangle i 0 0
    have h3 := htriangle 0 j 0
    have h4 := htriangle 0 0 0
    have hij : s i j * t j 0 = s i 0 * t 0 0 := by
      apply mul_right_cancel₀ (sign_ne_zero (hr 0 i))
      rw [h1, h2]
    have h0j : s 0 j * t j 0 = s 0 0 * t 0 0 := by
      apply mul_right_cancel₀ (sign_ne_zero (hr 0 0))
      rw [h3, h4]
    dsimp only [epsilon, eta]
    apply mul_right_cancel₀ (sign_ne_zero (ht j 0))
    rw [hij]
    symm
    calc
      s i 0 * (s 0 0 * s 0 j) * t j 0 =
          s i 0 * s 0 0 * (s 0 j * t j 0) := by ring
      _ = s i 0 * s 0 0 * (s 0 0 * t 0 0) := by rw [h0j]
      _ = s i 0 * t 0 0 := by
        linear_combination s i 0 * t 0 0 * (hs 0 0)
  · intro j l
    have h1 := htriangle 0 j l
    have h2 := htriangle 0 0 l
    have hjl : s 0 j * t j l = s 0 0 * t 0 l := by
      apply mul_right_cancel₀ (sign_ne_zero (hr l 0))
      rw [h1, h2]
    dsimp only [eta, zeta]
    apply mul_left_cancel₀ (sign_ne_zero (hs 0 j))
    rw [hjl]
    symm
    calc
      s 0 j * (s 0 0 * s 0 j * t 0 l) =
          s 0 0 * (s 0 j * s 0 j) * t 0 l := by ring
      _ = s 0 0 * t 0 l := by rw [sign_mul_self (hs 0 j), mul_one]
  · intro l i
    have h := htriangle i 0 l
    have hsi0 := sign_mul_self (hs i 0)
    have ht0l := sign_mul_self (ht 0 l)
    dsimp only [zeta, epsilon]
    calc
      r l i = 1 * r l i := by rw [one_mul]
      _ = ((s i 0 * s i 0) * (t 0 l * t 0 l)) * r l i := by
        simp only [hsi0, ht0l, one_mul]
      _ = t 0 l * s i 0 * (s i 0 * t 0 l * r l i) := by ring
      _ = t 0 l * s i 0 := by rw [h, mul_one]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.overlap_triples_gauge_related
statement:
theorem overlap_triples_gauge_related
    (U V W U' V' W' : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → K)
    (hUnz : ∀ i j, U i j ≠ 0) (hVnz : ∀ j l, V j l ≠ 0)
    (hWnz : ∀ l i, W l i ≠ 0)
    (hUsq : ∀ i j, (U' i j) ^ 2 = (U i j) ^ 2)
    (hVsq : ∀ j l, (V' j l) ^ 2 = (V j l) ^ 2)
    (hWsq : ∀ l i, (W' l i) ^ 2 = (W l i) ^ 2)
    (hC : ∀ i j l, U' i j * V' j l * W' l i =
      U i j * V j l * W l i) :
    ∃ epsilon eta zeta : Fin 3 → K,
      (∀ i, (epsilon i) ^ 2 = 1) ∧
      (∀ j, (eta j) ^ 2 = 1) ∧
      (∀ l, (zeta l) ^ 2 = 1) ∧
      (∀ i j, U' i j = epsilon i * U i j * eta j) ∧
      (∀ j l, V' j l = eta j * V j l * zeta l) ∧
      (∀ l i, W' l i = zeta l * W l i * epsilon i)
proof:
:= by
  let s : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → K := fun i j => U' i j / U i j
  let t : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → K := fun j l => V' j l / V j l
  let r : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → K := fun l i => W' l i / W l i
  have hs : ∀ i j, (s i j) ^ 2 = 1 := by
    intro i j
    dsimp only [s]
    rw [div_pow, hUsq i j, div_self (pow_ne_zero 2 (hUnz i j))]
  have ht : ∀ j l, (t j l) ^ 2 = 1 := by
    intro j l
    dsimp only [t]
    rw [div_pow, hVsq j l, div_self (pow_ne_zero 2 (hVnz j l))]
  have hr : ∀ l i, (r l i) ^ 2 = 1 := by
    intro l i
    dsimp only [r]
    rw [div_pow, hWsq l i, div_self (pow_ne_zero 2 (hWnz l i))]
  have htriangle : ∀ i j l, s i j * t j l * r l i = 1 := by
    intro i j l
    dsimp only [s, t, r]
    field_simp [hUnz i j, hVnz j l, hWnz l i]
    exact hC i j l
  rcases sign_cocycle_factorization s t r hs ht hr htriangle with
    ⟨epsilon, eta, zeta, he, hn, hz, hsFac, htFac, hrFac⟩
  refine ⟨epsilon, eta, zeta, he, hn, hz, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i j
    have h := hsFac i j
    dsimp only [s] at h
    field_simp [hUnz i j] at h
    calc
      U' i j = U i j * epsilon i * eta j := h
      _ = epsilon i * U i j * eta j := by ring
  · intro j l
    have h := htFac j l
    dsimp only [t] at h
    field_simp [hVnz j l] at h
    calc
      V' j l = V j l * eta j * zeta l := h
      _ = eta j * V j l * zeta l := by ring
  · intro l i
    have h := hrFac l i
    dsimp only [r] at h
    field_simp [hWnz l i] at h
    calc
      W' l i = W l i * zeta l * epsilon i := h
      _ = zeta l * W l i * epsilon i := by ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.operatorTrace_matrixAction
statement:
theorem operatorTrace_matrixAction (A : Mat6 K) :
    LinearMap.trace K (Vec6 K) (matrixAction A) = Matrix.trace A
proof:
:= by
  rw [LinearMap.trace_eq_matrix_trace K (Pi.basisFun K Ix6)]
  simp [Matrix.trace, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply', matrixAction, basisVector,
    Pi.single_apply, Fintype.sum_sum_type, Fin.sum_univ_succ]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.trace_standardProjector_comp
statement:
theorem trace_standardProjector_comp (B : Vec6 K →ₗ[K] Vec6 K) (i : Fin 3) :
    LinearMap.trace K (Vec6 K) ((standardProjector i).comp B) =
      weightedBlock B i i 0 0 + weightedBlock B i i 1 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [LinearMap.trace_eq_matrix_trace K (Pi.basisFun K Ix6)]
  fin_cases i <;>
    simp [Matrix.trace, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply', LinearMap.comp_apply,
      standardProjector, coordinateLabel, weightedBlock, weightedPairIndex,
      basisVector, Pi.single_apply, Fintype.sum_sum_type, Fin.sum_univ_succ]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.first_frame_intertwines_weighted_coordinates
statement:
theorem first_frame_intertwines_weighted_coordinates
    (E : Fin 3 → Carrier K)
    (hEidem : ∀ i, (E i : Mat6 K) * E i = E i)
    (hEsum : (E 0 : Mat6 K) + E 1 + E 2 = 1)
    (u v : Vec6 K) (i : Fin 3) :
    (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K)).comp (weightedCoordinateLinear E u v) =
      (weightedCoordinateLinear E u v).comp (standardProjector i)
proof:
:= by
  let Q : Fin 3 → Vec6 K →ₗ[K] Vec6 K :=
    fun j => matrixAction (K := K) (E j : Mat6 K)
  have hQi : ∀ j, IsIdempotent (Q j) :=
    fun j => carrier_projector_action_idempotent (E j) (hEidem j)
  have hQsum : Q 0 + Q 1 + Q 2 = LinearMap.id :=
    carrier_frame_action_sum E hEsum
  have hcomp := comp_zero_of_complete_frame Q hQi hQsum
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro z
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply]
  change Q i
      ((∑ j, z (Sum.inl j) • Q j u) +
        ∑ j, z (Sum.inr j) • Q j v) =
    (∑ j, (standardProjector i z) (Sum.inl j) • Q j u) +
      ∑ j, (standardProjector i z) (Sum.inr j) • Q j v
  rw [map_add, map_sum, map_sum]
  simp only [map_smul]
  apply congrArg₂ (· + ·)
  · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j
      rw [idempotent_apply (Q i) (hQi i)]
      simp [standardProjector, coordinateLabel]
    · rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply, hcomp i j hij]
      simp [standardProjector, coordinateLabel, hij, Ne.symm hij]
  · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j
      rw [idempotent_apply (Q i) (hQi i)]
      simp [standardProjector, coordinateLabel]
    · rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply, hcomp i j hij]
      simp [standardProjector, coordinateLabel, hij, Ne.symm hij]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.coordinateConjugate_first_frame
statement:
theorem coordinateConjugate_first_frame
    (E : Fin 3 → Carrier K)
    (hEidem : ∀ i, (E i : Mat6 K) * E i = E i)
    (hEsum : (E 0 : Mat6 K) + E 1 + E 2 = 1)
    (u v : Vec6 K) (p : Fin 3 → K)
    (hp : ∀ i, p i = (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u)
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v)) (hpne : ∀ i, p i ≠ 0) (i : Fin 3) :
    coordinateConjugate
      (weightedCoordinateEquiv E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne)
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K)) = standardProjector i
proof:
:= by
  let L := weightedCoordinateEquiv E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne
  have hinter := first_frame_intertwines_weighted_coordinates E hEidem hEsum u v i
  have hL : L.toLinearMap = weightedCoordinateLinear E u v := by
    rfl
  change L.symm.toLinearMap.comp
      ((matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K)).comp L.toLinearMap) = standardProjector i
  rw [hL, hinter]
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro z
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply]
  rw [← hL]
  exact L.symm_apply_apply _

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.diagonal_scalar_eq_actual_pair_ledger
statement:
theorem diagonal_scalar_eq_actual_pair_ledger
    (E : Fin 3 → Carrier K) (F1 : Carrier K)
    (hEidem : ∀ i, (E i : Mat6 K) * E i = E i)
    (hEsum : (E 0 : Mat6 K) + E 1 + E 2 = 1)
    (u v : Vec6 K) (p : Fin 3 → K)
    (hp : ∀ i, p i = (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u)
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v)) (hpne : ∀ i, p i ≠ 0)
    (i : Fin 3) (q : K)
    (hq : weightedBlock
      (coordinateConjugate (weightedCoordinateEquiv E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne)
        (matrixAction (F1 : Mat6 K))) i i = scalar2 q) :
    q = jordanTrace (K := K) ((E i : Mat6 K) * (F1 : Mat6 K))
proof:
:= by
  let L := weightedCoordinateEquiv E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne
  let B := coordinateConjugate L (matrixAction (F1 : Mat6 K))
  have hEi := coordinateConjugate_first_frame E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne i
  have hprod : coordinateConjugate L
      (matrixAction ((E i : Mat6 K) * (F1 : Mat6 K))) =
      (standardProjector i).comp B := by
    rw [matrixAction_mul, coordinateConjugate_comp, hEi]
  have htrace : Matrix.trace ((E i : Mat6 K) * (F1 : Mat6 K)) = 2 * q := by
    rw [← operatorTrace_matrixAction, ← LinearMap.trace_conj'
      (matrixAction ((E i : Mat6 K) * (F1 : Mat6 K))) L.symm]
    change LinearMap.trace K (Vec6 K)
      (coordinateConjugate L
        (matrixAction ((E i : Mat6 K) * (F1 : Mat6 K)))) = _
    rw [hprod, trace_standardProjector_comp]
    have h00 := congrFun (congrFun hq 0) 0
    have h11 := congrFun (congrFun hq 1) 1
    simp [scalar2, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.one_apply] at h00 h11
    linear_combination h00 + h11
  rw [jordanTrace, htrace]
  field_simp

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowFrameDeterminants.normalized_endpoint_determinants
statement:
theorem normalized_endpoint_determinants
    (A0 A1 A2 A0i U V : Mat3 K) (c d : K)
    (hA0i : A0 * A0i = 1)
    (hU : U = (A0 + A1 - A2) * A0i)
    (hV : V = A1 * A0i)
    (hdetA1 : A1.det = c ^ 2 * A0.det)
    (hdetA2 : A2.det = d ^ 2 * A0.det) :
    V.det = c ^ 2 ∧ (1 - U + V).det = d ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hdetA0i : A0.det * A0i.det = 1 := by
    simpa only [Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_one] using congrArg Matrix.det hA0i
  have hnegOneMatrix : 1 - U + V = A2 * A0i := by
    rw [hU, hV, ← hA0i]
    simp only [add_mul, sub_mul]
    abel
  constructor
  · rw [hV, Matrix.det_mul, hdetA1]
    calc
      c ^ 2 * A0.det * A0i.det = c ^ 2 * (A0.det * A0i.det) := by ring
      _ = c ^ 2 := by rw [hdetA0i, mul_one]
  · rw [hnegOneMatrix, Matrix.det_mul, hdetA2]
    calc
      d ^ 2 * A0.det * A0i.det = d ^ 2 * (A0.det * A0i.det) := by ring
      _ = d ^ 2 := by rw [hdetA0i, mul_one]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowFrameDeterminants.normalized_endpoint_determinants_nonsing_inv
statement:
theorem normalized_endpoint_determinants_nonsing_inv
    (A0 A1 A2 U V : Mat3 K) (c d : K)
    (hA0 : IsUnit A0.det)
    (hU : U = (A0 + A1 - A2) * A0⁻¹)
    (hV : V = A1 * A0⁻¹)
    (hdetA1 : A1.det = c ^ 2 * A0.det)
    (hdetA2 : A2.det = d ^ 2 * A0.det) :
    V.det = c ^ 2 ∧ (1 - U + V).det = d ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  apply normalized_endpoint_determinants A0 A1 A2 A0⁻¹ U V c d
  · exact Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv A0 hA0
  · exact hU
  · exact hV
  · exact hdetA1
  · exact hdetA2

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowFrameDeterminants.adjugate_normalized_endpoint_determinants
statement:
theorem adjugate_normalized_endpoint_determinants
    (a0 a1 a2 : Mat3 K) (ha0 : a0.det ≠ 0) :
    let A0
proof:
:= Matrix.adjugate a0
    let A1 := Matrix.adjugate a1
    let A2 := Matrix.adjugate a2
    let c := a1.det / a0.det
    let d := a2.det / a0.det
    let U := (A0 + A1 - A2) * A0⁻¹
    let V := A1 * A0⁻¹
    V.det = c ^ 2 ∧ (1 - U + V).det = d ^ 2 := by
  dsimp only
  have hadj (a : Mat3 K) : (Matrix.adjugate a).det = a.det ^ 2 := by
    simpa using Matrix.det_adjugate a
  have hA0det : (Matrix.adjugate a0).det ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hadj]
    exact pow_ne_zero 2 ha0
  apply normalized_endpoint_determinants_nonsing_inv
      (Matrix.adjugate a0) (Matrix.adjugate a1) (Matrix.adjugate a2)
      ((Matrix.adjugate a0 + Matrix.adjugate a1 - Matrix.adjugate a2) *
        (Matrix.adjugate a0)⁻¹)
      (Matrix.adjugate a1 * (Matrix.adjugate a0)⁻¹)
      (a1.det / a0.det) (a2.det / a0.det)
  · exact isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hA0det
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · rw [hadj, hadj]
    field_simp [ha0]
  · rw [hadj, hadj]
    field_simp [ha0]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.CommonSplitBasis.eigenCoefficients_intertwines
statement:
theorem eigenCoefficients_intertwines (X : Mat2 K) (sigma d : K)
    (hroot : sigma ^ 2 = trace2 X ^ 2 - 4 * determinant X) :
    companion X * eigenCoefficients X sigma d =
      eigenCoefficients X sigma d * eigenvalues X sigma
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hp, hm⟩ := characteristic_roots X sigma hroot
  have hsum : lambdaPlus X sigma + lambdaMinus X sigma = trace2 X := by
    dsimp [lambdaPlus, lambdaMinus]
    ring
  have hprod : lambdaPlus X sigma * lambdaMinus X sigma = determinant X := by
    linear_combination -hp + lambdaPlus X sigma * hsum
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [companion, eigenCoefficients, eigenvalues, matrix, Matrix.mul_apply,
      Fin.sum_univ_two, div_eq_mul_inv] <;>
    simp only [← hprod, ← hsum] <;> ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.CommonSplitBasis.eigenCoefficients_det
statement:
theorem eigenCoefficients_det (X : Mat2 K) (sigma d : K)
    (hs : sigma ≠ 0) (hd : d ≠ 0) :
    determinant (eigenCoefficients X sigma d) = d⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  simp [determinant, eigenCoefficients, matrix, lambdaPlus, lambdaMinus]
  field_simp [hs, hd]
  <;> ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.CommonSplitBasis.cyclicSplitBasis_det
statement:
theorem cyclicSplitBasis_det (X : Mat2 K) (sigma : K) (v : Vec2 K)
    (hs : sigma ≠ 0) (hv : cyclicDet X v ≠ 0) :
    determinant (cyclicSplitBasis X sigma v) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hdet : determinant (cyclicBasisAt X v) = cyclicDet X v := rfl
  rw [cyclicSplitBasis, determinant_eq_det, Matrix.det_mul,
    ← determinant_eq_det, ← determinant_eq_det, hdet,
    eigenCoefficients_det X sigma (cyclicDet X v) hs hv, mul_inv_cancel₀ hv]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.CommonSplitBasis.cyclicSplitBasis_intertwines
statement:
theorem cyclicSplitBasis_intertwines (X : Mat2 K) (sigma : K) (v : Vec2 K)
    (hroot : sigma ^ 2 = trace2 X ^ 2 - 4 * determinant X) :
    X * cyclicSplitBasis X sigma v =
      cyclicSplitBasis X sigma v * eigenvalues X sigma
proof:
:= by
  rw [cyclicSplitBasis, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, cyclicBasisAt_intertwines,
    Matrix.mul_assoc, eigenCoefficients_intertwines X sigma _ hroot]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.CommonSplitBasis.inverseSL_mul
statement:
theorem inverseSL_mul (H : Mat2 K) (hH : determinant H = 1) :
    inverseSL H * H = 1
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [determinant] at hH
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [inverseSL, matrix, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two,
      Matrix.one_apply]
  all_goals ring_nf at hH ⊢ <;> exact hH

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.CommonSplitBasis.mul_inverseSL
statement:
theorem mul_inverseSL (H : Mat2 K) (hH : determinant H = 1) :
    H * inverseSL H = 1
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [determinant] at hH
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [inverseSL, matrix, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two,
      Matrix.one_apply]
  all_goals ring_nf at hH ⊢ <;> exact hH

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.CommonSplitBasis.exists_ordered_sl2_split
statement:
theorem exists_ordered_sl2_split (X : Mat2 K) (sigma : K)
    (hs : sigma ≠ 0)
    (hroot : sigma ^ 2 = trace2 X ^ 2 - 4 * determinant X) :
    ∃ H S : Mat2 K,
      determinant H = 1 ∧ H * S = 1 ∧ S * H = 1 ∧
      S * X * H = eigenvalues X sigma
proof:
:= by
  have hd : trace2 X ^ 2 - 4 * determinant X ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← hroot]
    exact pow_ne_zero 2 hs
  obtain ⟨v, _, hv⟩ := exists_three_cyclic X (nonscalar_of_discriminant_ne_zero X hd)
  let H := cyclicSplitBasis X sigma v
  have hH : determinant H = 1 := cyclicSplitBasis_det X sigma v hs hv
  have hi : inverseSL H * H = 1 := inverseSL_mul H hH
  refine ⟨H, inverseSL H, hH, mul_inverseSL H hH, hi, ?_⟩
  rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, cyclicSplitBasis_intertwines X sigma v hroot,
    ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hi, Matrix.one_mul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.CommonSplitBasis.all_blocks_killed
statement:
theorem all_blocks_killed
    (B : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Mat2 K) (p q : Fin 3 → K)
    (hp1 : p 1 ≠ 0) (hp2 : p 2 ≠ 0)
    (hd : ∀ i, B i i = q i • (1 : Mat2 K))
    (hr : ∀ i, B i 0 + B i 1 + B i 2 = 0)
    (hc : ∀ j, p 0 • B 0 j + p 1 • B 1 j + p 2 • B 2 j = 0)
    (ell : Mat2 K →ₗ[K] K) (hI : ell 1 = 0) (hX : ell (B 0 1) = 0) :
    ∀ i j, ell (B i j) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h02, h21, h20, h10, h12⟩ := scaled_block_equations B p q hd hr hc
  have d (i : Fin 3) : ell (B i i) = 0 := by simp [hd i, hI]
  have z02 : ell (B 0 2) = 0 := by simp [h02, hI, hX]
  have cancel (t : K) (ht : t ≠ 0) (Y : Mat2 K) (he : ell (t • Y) = 0) :
      ell Y = 0 := by
    simpa only [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, mul_eq_zero, ht, false_or] using he
  have z21 : ell (B 2 1) = 0 := cancel _ hp2 _ (by simp [h21, hI, hX])
  have z20 : ell (B 2 0) = 0 := cancel _ hp2 _ (by simp [h20, hI, hX])
  have z10 : ell (B 1 0) = 0 := cancel _ hp1 _ (by simp [h10, hI, hX])
  have z12 : ell (B 1 2) = 0 := cancel _ hp1 _ (by simp [h12, hI, hX])
  intro i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
  · exact d 0
  · exact hX
  · exact z02
  · exact z10
  · exact d 1
  · exact z12
  · exact z20
  · exact z21
  · exact d 2

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.CommonSplitBasis.all_blocks_diagonal
statement:
theorem all_blocks_diagonal
    (B : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Mat2 K) (p q : Fin 3 → K)
    (hp1 : p 1 ≠ 0) (hp2 : p 2 ≠ 0)
    (hd : ∀ i, B i i = q i • (1 : Mat2 K))
    (hr : ∀ i, B i 0 + B i 1 + B i 2 = 0)
    (hc : ∀ j, p 0 • B 0 j + p 1 • B 1 j + p 2 • B 2 j = 0)
    (H S : Mat2 K) (hSH : S * H = 1) (sigma : K)
    (hX : S * B 0 1 * H = eigenvalues (B 0 1) sigma) :
    ∀ i j, (S * B i j * H) 0 1 = 0 ∧ (S * B i j * H) 1 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  have zero_entry (r s : Fin 2) (hrs : r ≠ s) :
      ∀ i j, (S * B i j * H) r s = 0 := by
    apply all_blocks_killed B p q hp1 hp2 hd hr hc (conjugateEntry S H r s)
    · simp [conjugateEntry, hSH, Matrix.one_apply, hrs]
    · fin_cases r <;> fin_cases s <;>
        simp [conjugateEntry, hX, eigenvalues, matrix] at hrs ⊢
  exact fun i j => ⟨zero_entry 0 1 (by decide) i j,
    zero_entry 1 0 (by decide) i j⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.CommonSplitBasis.planeScale_comp
statement:
theorem planeScale_comp (t s : Fin 3 → K) (h : ∀ i, t i * s i = 1) :
    (planeScale t).comp (planeScale s) = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  ext x a
  rcases a with i | i <;> simp [planeScale, ← mul_assoc, h]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.CommonSplitBasis.planeScale_weighted_form
statement:
theorem planeScale_weighted_form (p : Fin 3 → K) (hp : ∀ i, p i ≠ 0)
    (x y : Vec6 K) :
    weightedOmega p (planeScale (fun i => (p i)⁻¹) x)
      (planeScale (fun i => (p i)⁻¹) y) = (omega (K := K)) x y
proof:
:= by
  change (∑ i, p i * (x (Sum.inl i) * ((p i)⁻¹ * y (Sum.inr i)) -
    ((p i)⁻¹ * x (Sum.inr i)) * y (Sum.inl i))) =
    ∑ i, (x (Sum.inl i) * y (Sum.inr i) - x (Sum.inr i) * y (Sum.inl i))
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  field_simp [hp i]
  <;> ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.CommonSplitBasis.split_inverse
statement:
theorem split_inverse (L : Vec6 K ≃ₗ[K] Vec6 K) (p : Fin 3 → K)
    (hp : ∀ i, p i ≠ 0) (H S : Mat2 K) (hHS : H * S = 1) (hSH : S * H = 1) :
    (splitForward L p H).comp (splitBackward L p S) = LinearMap.id ∧
    (splitBackward L p S).comp (splitForward L p H) = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  have hpp := planeScale_comp (fun i => (p i)⁻¹) p
    (fun i => inv_mul_cancel₀ (hp i))
  have hpp' := planeScale_comp p (fun i => (p i)⁻¹)
    (fun i => mul_inv_cancel₀ (hp i))
  have hh := commonPlaneMap_comp H S hHS
  have hh' := commonPlaneMap_comp S H hSH
  constructor
  · apply LinearMap.ext
    intro x
    have hz := LinearMap.congr_fun hpp (commonPlaneMap S (L.symm x))
    have hw := LinearMap.congr_fun hh (L.symm x)
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.id_apply] at hz hw
    change L (commonPlaneMap H
      (planeScale (fun i => (p i)⁻¹) (planeScale p (commonPlaneMap S (L.symm x))))) = x
    rw [hz, hw, L.apply_symm_apply]
  · apply LinearMap.ext
    intro x
    have hz := LinearMap.congr_fun hpp' x
    have hw := LinearMap.congr_fun hh' (planeScale (fun i => (p i)⁻¹) x)
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.id_apply] at hz hw
    change planeScale p (commonPlaneMap S
      (L.symm (L (commonPlaneMap H (planeScale (fun i => (p i)⁻¹) x))))) = x
    rw [L.symm_apply_apply, hw, hz]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.CommonSplitBasis.splitForward_symplectic
statement:
theorem splitForward_symplectic
    (E : Fin 3 → Carrier K)
    (hEidem : ∀ i, (E i : Mat6 K) * E i = E i)
    (hEsum : (E 0 : Mat6 K) + E 1 + E 2 = 1)
    (u v : Vec6 K) (p : Fin 3 → K)
    (hp : ∀ i, p i = (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u)
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v)) (hpne : ∀ i, p i ≠ 0)
    (H : Mat2 K) (hH : determinant H = 1) :
    let L
proof:
:= weightedCoordinateEquiv E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne
    let Q := matrixOfLinear (splitForward L p H)
    Q.transpose * symplecticJ * Q = symplecticJ := by
  dsimp only
  let L := weightedCoordinateEquiv E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne
  have hform (x y : Vec6 K) :
      (omega (K := K)) (splitForward L p H x) (splitForward L p H y) =
        (omega (K := K)) x y := by
    change (omega (K := K)) (weightedCoordinateLinear E u v
      (commonPlaneMap H (planeScale (fun i => (p i)⁻¹) x)))
      (weightedCoordinateLinear E u v
      (commonPlaneMap H (planeScale (fun i => (p i)⁻¹) y))) = _
    rw [weightedCoordinate_form E hEidem hEsum u v p hp, commonPlaneMap_form]
    change determinant H * _ = _
    rw [hH, one_mul, planeScale_weighted_form p hpne]
  ext i j
  rw [symplectic_product_entry]
  rw [← matrixAction_basisVector _ i, ← matrixAction_basisVector _ j,
    matrixAction_matrixOfLinear, hform, omega_basisVector]

name: AlbertLean.Comparison.RationalSourceJordan.sourceJordanIdentity_rat
statement:
theorem sourceJordanIdentity_rat (x y : JCoord ℚ) :
    sourceProduct (sourceProduct x y) (sourceProduct x x) =
      sourceProduct x (sourceProduct y (sourceProduct x x))
proof:
:= by
  apply structuredEquiv.injective
  calc
    structuredEquiv
        (sourceProduct (sourceProduct x y) (sourceProduct x x)) =
        structuredProduct (structuredEquiv (sourceProduct x y))
          (structuredEquiv (sourceProduct x x)) :=
      StructuredSourceProductAgreesWithF0 _ _
    _ = structuredProduct
          (structuredProduct (structuredEquiv x) (structuredEquiv y))
          (structuredProduct (structuredEquiv x) (structuredEquiv x)) := by
      rw [StructuredSourceProductAgreesWithF0,
        StructuredSourceProductAgreesWithF0]
    _ = structuredProduct (structuredEquiv x)
          (structuredProduct (structuredEquiv y)
            (structuredProduct (structuredEquiv x) (structuredEquiv x))) :=
      AlbertLean.jordanIdentity (structuredEquiv x) (structuredEquiv y)
    _ = structuredProduct (structuredEquiv x)
          (structuredEquiv (sourceProduct y (sourceProduct x x))) := by
      rw [StructuredSourceProductAgreesWithF0,
        StructuredSourceProductAgreesWithF0]
    _ = structuredEquiv
          (sourceProduct x (sourceProduct y (sourceProduct x x))) :=
      (StructuredSourceProductAgreesWithF0 _ _).symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.UniformMomentReconstruction.uniformN_eq_smul_of_measurements
statement:
private theorem uniformN_eq_smul_of_measurements
    (L : SourceLedger K) (m : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) K)
    (a b c sigma h : K)
    (h00 : nSx L = m 0 0) (h11 : nSy L = m 1 1)
    (h22 : nCx L = m 2 2) (h33 : nCy L = m 3 3)
    (hS : gS L 1 1 = m 0 1 + m 1 0)
    (hC : gC L 1 1 = m 2 3 + m 3 2)
    (hUC : uC L = c * m 0 1 + a*b * m 1 0)
    (hUS : uS L = a*b * m 2 3 + c * m 3 2)
    (hT111 : t111 L = m 0 2 + a * m 2 0)
    (hT211 : t211 L = b * m 0 2 + c * m 2 0)
    (hT112 : t112 L = m 0 3 + a * m 3 0)
    (hT212 : t212 L = b * m 0 3 + c * m 3 0)
    (hT121 : t121 L = m 1 2 + a * m 2 1)
    (hT221 : t221 L = b * m 1 2 + c * m 2 1)
    (hT122 : t122 L = m 1 3 + a * m 3 1)
    (hT222 : t222 L = b * m 1 3 + c * m 3 1)
    (hsum : h = c + a*b) (hc : c = sigma + a*b) :
    uniformN L a h sigma = (2*a*sigma) • m
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.ext
  intro i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
  · change 2*a*sigma*nSx L = (2*a*sigma) * m 0 0
    simp only [h00, h11, h22, h33, hS, hC, hUC, hUS,
      hT111, hT211, hT112, hT212, hT121, hT221, hT122, hT222, hsum, hc] <;> ring
  · change 2*a*uC L-a*(h-sigma)*gS L 1 1 = (2*a*sigma) * m 0 1
    simp only [h00, h11, h22, h33, hS, hC, hUC, hUS,
      hT111, hT211, hT112, hT212, hT121, hT221, hT122, hT222, hsum, hc] <;> ring
  · change a*(h+sigma)*t111 L-2*a^2*t211 L = (2*a*sigma) * m 0 2
    simp only [h00, h11, h22, h33, hS, hC, hUC, hUS,
      hT111, hT211, hT112, hT212, hT121, hT221, hT122, hT222, hsum, hc] <;> ring
  · change a*(h+sigma)*t112 L-2*a^2*t212 L = (2*a*sigma) * m 0 3
    simp only [h00, h11, h22, h33, hS, hC, hUC, hUS,
      hT111, hT211, hT112, hT212, hT121, hT221, hT122, hT222, hsum, hc] <;> ring
  · change a*(h+sigma)*gS L 1 1-2*a*uC L = (2*a*sigma) * m 1 0
    simp only [h00, h11, h22, h33, hS, hC, hUC, hUS,
      hT111, hT211, hT112, hT212, hT121, hT221, hT122, hT222, hsum, hc] <;> ring
  · change 2*a*sigma*nSy L = (2*a*sigma) * m 1 1
    simp only [h00, h11, h22, h33, hS, hC, hUC, hUS,
      hT111, hT211, hT112, hT212, hT121, hT221, hT122, hT222, hsum, hc] <;> ring
  · change a*(h+sigma)*t121 L-2*a^2*t221 L = (2*a*sigma) * m 1 2
    simp only [h00, h11, h22, h33, hS, hC, hUC, hUS,
      hT111, hT211, hT112, hT212, hT121, hT221, hT122, hT222, hsum, hc] <;> ring
  · change a*(h+sigma)*t122 L-2*a^2*t222 L = (2*a*sigma) * m 1 3
    simp only [h00, h11, h22, h33, hS, hC, hUC, hUS,
      hT111, hT211, hT112, hT212, hT121, hT221, hT122, hT222, hsum, hc] <;> ring
  · change 2*a*t211 L-(h-sigma)*t111 L = (2*a*sigma) * m 2 0
    simp only [h00, h11, h22, h33, hS, hC, hUC, hUS,
      hT111, hT211, hT112, hT212, hT121, hT221, hT122, hT222, hsum, hc] <;> ring
  · change 2*a*t221 L-(h-sigma)*t121 L = (2*a*sigma) * m 2 1
    simp only [h00, h11, h22, h33, hS, hC, hUC, hUS,
      hT111, hT211, hT112, hT212, hT121, hT221, hT122, hT222, hsum, hc] <;> ring
  · change 2*a*sigma*nCx L = (2*a*sigma) * m 2 2
    simp only [h00, h11, h22, h33, hS, hC, hUC, hUS,
      hT111, hT211, hT112, hT212, hT121, hT221, hT122, hT222, hsum, hc] <;> ring
  · change a*(h+sigma)*gC L 1 1-2*a*uS L = (2*a*sigma) * m 2 3
    simp only [h00, h11, h22, h33, hS, hC, hUC, hUS,
      hT111, hT211, hT112, hT212, hT121, hT221, hT122, hT222, hsum, hc] <;> ring
  · change 2*a*t212 L-(h-sigma)*t112 L = (2*a*sigma) * m 3 0
    simp only [h00, h11, h22, h33, hS, hC, hUC, hUS,
      hT111, hT211, hT112, hT212, hT121, hT221, hT122, hT222, hsum, hc] <;> ring
  · change 2*a*t222 L-(h-sigma)*t122 L = (2*a*sigma) * m 3 1
    simp only [h00, h11, h22, h33, hS, hC, hUC, hUS,
      hT111, hT211, hT112, hT212, hT121, hT221, hT122, hT222, hsum, hc] <;> ring
  · change 2*a*uS L-a*(h-sigma)*gC L 1 1 = (2*a*sigma) * m 3 2
    simp only [h00, h11, h22, h33, hS, hC, hUC, hUS,
      hT111, hT211, hT112, hT212, hT121, hT221, hT122, hT222, hsum, hc] <;> ring
  · change 2*a*sigma*nCy L = (2*a*sigma) * m 3 3
    simp only [h00, h11, h22, h33, hS, hC, hUC, hUS,
      hT111, hT211, hT112, hT212, hT121, hT221, hT122, hT222, hsum, hc] <;> ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.UniformMomentReconstruction.inverse_of_cleared
statement:
private theorem inverse_of_cleared
    (m n : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) K) (z : K) (hz : z ≠ 0)
    (hn : n = z • m) : m = z⁻¹ • n
proof:
:= by
  rw [hn, ← mul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hz, one_smul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.UniformMomentReconstruction.matrixM_eq_uniform_inverse
statement:
theorem matrixM_eq_uniform_inverse (q : ExplicitFrameChart K) (a b c sigma : K)
    (hq : EquationsVanish (explicitFrameEquationValues q))
    (hr1 : q.r1 = 1) (hz1 : q.z1 = a) (hr2 : q.r2 = b) (hz2 : q.z2 = c)
    (hb : b = (gramV12 q - sigma) / (2*a))
    (hc : c = (gramV12 q + sigma) / 2)
    (hsigma : sigma ≠ 0) (ha : 2*a ≠ 0) :
    matrixM q = (2*a*sigma)⁻¹ •
      uniformN (sourceLedger (encoderA q) (encoderB q)) a (gramV12 q) sigma
proof:
:= by
  have hfixed := (equationsVanish_iff_source_fixedSpectrum q).1 hq
  have hm := recovered_measurements (encoderA q) (encoderB q) hfixed.2.2.1 hfixed.2.2.2.2.2
  rcases hm with ⟨hnVx, hnSx, hnCx, hnVy, hnSy, hnCy, hgV, hgS, hgC,
    ht111, ht211, ht121, ht112, ht122, ht212, ht221, ht222, huV, huS, huC⟩
  have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    exact ha (by rw [hz, mul_zero])
  have hab : a * b = (gramV12 q - sigma) / 2 := by
    rw [hb]
    field_simp [ha0] <;> ring
  have hdet : c - a*b = sigma := by rw [hc, hab]; ring
  have hc' : c = sigma + a*b := by linear_combination hdet
  have hsum : gramV12 q = c + a*b := by
    simp only [gramV12, hr1, hz1, hr2, hz2, one_mul]
    ring
  let L := sourceLedger (encoderA q) (encoderB q)
  have h00 : nSx L = matrixM q 0 0 := by simpa [L, encoderA, matrixM, momentMatrix, nS, nC] using hnSx
  have h11 : nSy L = matrixM q 1 1 := by simpa [L, encoderB, matrixM, momentMatrix, nS, nC] using hnSy
  have h22 : nCx L = matrixM q 2 2 := by simpa [L, encoderA, matrixM, momentMatrix, nS, nC] using hnCx
  have h33 : nCy L = matrixM q 3 3 := by simpa [L, encoderB, matrixM, momentMatrix, nS, nC] using hnCy
  have hS : gS L 1 1 = matrixM q 0 1 + matrixM q 1 0 := by
    simpa [L, encoderA, encoderB, matrixM, momentMatrix, BS, BC] using hgS
  have hC : gC L 1 1 = matrixM q 2 3 + matrixM q 3 2 := by
    simpa [L, encoderA, encoderB, matrixM, momentMatrix, BS, BC] using hgC
  have hVA : (encoderA q).v = planeVector 1 a := by
    apply VCoord.ext <;> simp [encoderA, vectorA, planeVector, hr1, hz1]
  have hVB : (encoderB q).v = planeVector b c := by
    apply VCoord.ext <;> simp [encoderB, vectorB, planeVector, hr2, hz2]
  have hUC : uC L = c * matrixM q 0 1 + a*b * matrixM q 1 0 := by
    change uC (sourceLedger (encoderA q) (encoderB q)) = _
    rw [huC, hVA, hVB, plane_muC_pairing]
    simp [encoderA, encoderB, matrixM, momentMatrix, one_mul,
      mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm]
  have hUS : uS L = a*b * matrixM q 2 3 + c * matrixM q 3 2 := by
    change uS (sourceLedger (encoderA q) (encoderB q)) = _
    rw [huS, hVA, hVB, plane_muS_pairing]
    simp [encoderA, encoderB, matrixM, momentMatrix, one_mul,
      mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm]
  have hT111 : t111 L = matrixM q 0 2 + a * matrixM q 2 0 := by
    change t111 (sourceLedger (encoderA q) (encoderB q)) = _
    rw [ht111, hVA, plane_triality]
    simp [encoderA, encoderB, matrixM, momentMatrix]
  have hT211 : t211 L = b * matrixM q 0 2 + c * matrixM q 2 0 := by
    change t211 (sourceLedger (encoderA q) (encoderB q)) = _
    rw [ht211, hVB, plane_triality]
    simp [encoderA, encoderB, matrixM, momentMatrix]
  have hT112 : t112 L = matrixM q 0 3 + a * matrixM q 3 0 := by
    change t112 (sourceLedger (encoderA q) (encoderB q)) = _
    rw [ht112, hVA, plane_triality]
    simp [encoderA, encoderB, matrixM, momentMatrix]
  have hT212 : t212 L = b * matrixM q 0 3 + c * matrixM q 3 0 := by
    change t212 (sourceLedger (encoderA q) (encoderB q)) = _
    rw [ht212, hVB, plane_triality]
    simp [encoderA, encoderB, matrixM, momentMatrix]
  have hT121 : t121 L = matrixM q 1 2 + a * matrixM q 2 1 := by
    change t121 (sourceLedger (encoderA q) (encoderB q)) = _
    rw [ht121, hVA, plane_triality]
    simp [encoderA, encoderB, matrixM, momentMatrix]
  have hT221 : t221 L = b * matrixM q 1 2 + c * matrixM q 2 1 := by
    change t221 (sourceLedger (encoderA q) (encoderB q)) = _
    rw [ht221, hVB, plane_triality]
    simp [encoderA, encoderB, matrixM, momentMatrix]
  have hT122 : t122 L = matrixM q 1 3 + a * matrixM q 3 1 := by
    change t122 (sourceLedger (encoderA q) (encoderB q)) = _
    rw [ht122, hVA, plane_triality]
    simp [encoderA, encoderB, matrixM, momentMatrix]
  have hT222 : t222 L = b * matrixM q 1 3 + c * matrixM q 3 1 := by
    change t222 (sourceLedger (encoderA q) (encoderB q)) = _
    rw [ht222, hVB, plane_triality]
    simp [encoderA, encoderB, matrixM, momentMatrix]
  have hcleared := uniformN_eq_smul_of_measurements L (matrixM q)
    a b c sigma (gramV12 q) h00 h11 h22 h33 hS hC hUC hUS
    hT111 hT211 hT112 hT212 hT121 hT221 hT122 hT222 hsum hc'
  exact inverse_of_cleared (matrixM q)
    (uniformN L a (gramV12 q) sigma) (2*a*sigma)
    (mul_ne_zero ha hsigma) hcleared

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ParameterRootArithmetic.reciprocal_sum_eq_iff
statement:
theorem reciprocal_sum_eq_iff (m t u : K) (ht : t ≠ 0) (hu : u ≠ 0) :
    t + m / t = u + m / u ↔ u = t ∨ u = m / t
proof:
:= by
  have hfactor : (u - t) * (u - m / t) =
      u * (u + m / u - (t + m / t)) := by
    field_simp [ht, hu] <;> ring
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hz : u + m / u - (t + m / t) = 0 := sub_eq_zero.mpr h.symm
    have hp : (u - t) * (u - m / t) = 0 := by
      rw [hfactor, hz, mul_zero]
    simpa only [mul_eq_zero, sub_eq_zero] using hp
  · intro h
    have hp : (u - t) * (u - m / t) = 0 := by
      rcases h with h | h <;> simp [h]
    have hz := (mul_eq_zero.mp (hfactor.symm.trans hp)).resolve_left hu
    exact (sub_eq_zero.mp hz).symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ParameterRootArithmetic.reciprocal_involutive

proof:

  field_simp [hm, ht]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ParameterRootArithmetic.reciprocal_sum_swap
statement:
theorem reciprocal_sum_swap (m t : K) (hm : m ≠ 0) (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    m / t + m / (m / t) = t + m / t
proof:
:= by
  rw [reciprocal_involutive m t hm ht, add_comm]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceScheduleLocalizationEval.evalAwayAlg_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem evalAwayAlg_apply (Z : Fin 3 → Schedule L) (x : ParameterRing k) :
    evalAwayAlg k Z x = evalAway k Z x
proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceScheduleLocalizationEval.evalAway_fieldSchedule
statement:
theorem evalAway_fieldSchedule (Z : Fin 3 → Schedule L) (r : Fin 3) :
    fieldSchedule k (evalAwayAlg k Z) r = Z r
proof:
:= by
  funext s p
  apply slotPoint_ext
  · apply SCoord.ext <;> funext i <;> simp [fieldSchedule, fieldSlot, mapS,
      localU, evalAwayAlg_apply, evalAway_localParameter, slotCoordinate]
  · apply CCoord.ext <;> funext i <;> simp [fieldSchedule, fieldSlot, mapC,
      localV, evalAwayAlg_apply, evalAway_localParameter, slotCoordinate]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceScheduleLocalizationEval.evalAway_scheduledPoint
statement:
theorem evalAway_scheduledPoint (Z : Fin 3 → Schedule L) (r i : Fin 3) :
    (fun c => evalAway k Z (SourceLocalizedScheduleFormula.scheduledPoint k r i c)) =
      structuredEquivK L (scheduledFrame (Z r) i)
proof:
:= by
  have h := map_scheduledPoint_eq_fieldSchedule k (evalAwayAlg k Z) r i
  rw [evalAway_fieldSchedule] at h
  exact h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealCayleySubstitution.evalAway_parameterScalar
statement:
@[simp] theorem evalAway_parameterScalar (j : F k →+* E)
    (x : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → E) (hden) (y : F k) :
    evalAway j x hden (parameterScalar k y) = j y
proof:
:= by
  change evalAway j x hden
    (algebraMap (Base (F k)) (Param k) (MvPolynomial.C y)) = j y
  rw [evalAway_algebraMap]
  simp [baseEval]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealCayleySubstitution.map_ringConjugate
statement:
theorem map_ringConjugate {R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (f : R →+* S) (Q A : Mat3 R) :
    f.mapMatrix (ringConjugate Q A) =
      ringConjugate (f.mapMatrix Q) (f.mapMatrix A)
proof:
:= by
  simp [ringConjugate, Matrix.transpose_map]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealCayleySubstitution.evalAway_embeddedUniversalFamily
statement:
theorem evalAway_embeddedUniversalFamily (j : F k →+* E)
    (x : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → E) (hden) (r i : Fin 3) :
    (evalAway j x hden).mapMatrix (embeddedUniversalFamily k r i) =
      j.mapMatrix (universalFamily k r i)
proof:
:= by
  ext a b
  exact evalAway_parameterScalar k j x hden (universalFamily k r i a b)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealCayleySubstitution.evalAway_cayleyConjugatedFamily
statement:
theorem evalAway_cayleyConjugatedFamily (j : F k →+* E)
    (x : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → E) (hden) (r i : Fin 3) :
    (evalAway j x hden).mapMatrix (cayleyConjugatedFamily k r i) =
      evaluatedConjugatedFamily k j x r i
proof:
:= by
  rw [cayleyConjugatedFamily, map_ringConjugate,
    evalAway_localizedCayley, evalAway_embeddedUniversalFamily]
  rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealCayleySubstitution.evalAway_comp_substitution
statement:
theorem evalAway_comp_substitution (j : F k →+* E)
    (x : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → E) (hden) :
    (evalAway j x hden).comp (substitution k) =
      evaluationAlong (j.comp (scalarMap k))
        (evaluatedConjugatedFamily k j x)
proof:
:= by
  apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
  · intro c
    simp [substitution, evaluationAlong, evalAway_parameterScalar]
  · intro q
    cases q with
    | entry r i a b =>
        simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, substitution, evaluationAlong,
          MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_X']
        change evalAway j x hden (cayleyConjugatedFamily k r i a b) =
          evaluatedConjugatedFamily k j x r i a b
        exact congrFun (congrFun
          (evalAway_cayleyConjugatedFamily k j x hden r i) a) b

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealCayleySubstitution.evalAway_substitution
statement:
theorem evalAway_substitution (j : F k →+* E)
    (x : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → E) (hden) (p : CoordinateRing k) :
    evalAway j x hden (substitution k p) =
      evaluationAlong (j.comp (scalarMap k))
        (evaluatedConjugatedFamily k j x) p
proof:
:=
  DFunLike.congr_fun (evalAway_comp_substitution k j x hden) p

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealCayleySubstitution.evalAway_crossExpression
statement:
theorem evalAway_crossExpression (j : F k →+* E)
    (x : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → E) (hden) (a b : CoordinateRing k) :
    evalAway j x hden (crossExpression k a b) =
      evaluationAlong (j.comp (scalarMap k))
          (evaluatedConjugatedFamily k j x) a * j (rawToField k b) -
        evaluationAlong (j.comp (scalarMap k))
          (evaluatedConjugatedFamily k j x) b * j (rawToField k a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [crossExpression, map_sub, map_mul, map_mul,
    evalAway_substitution, evalAway_substitution,
    evalAway_parameterScalar, evalAway_parameterScalar]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceCubicTrace.cubicPolar_eq_cubicSymPolar
statement:
theorem cubicPolar_eq_cubicSymPolar {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    (μ : V →ₗ[K] V →ₗ[K] V) (T : V →ₗ[K] K) (one a b c : V) :
    cubicPolar μ T one a b c = cubicSymPolar μ T one a b c
proof:
:= by
  simp [cubicPolar, cubicResidual, cubicSymPolar, cubicTrilinearTerm,
    map_add, smul_add, add_smul]
  module

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceCubicTrace.cubicPolarMap_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem cubicPolarMap_apply {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    (μ : V →ₗ[K] V →ₗ[K] V) (T : V →ₗ[K] K) (one : V)
    (v : Fin 3 → V) :
    cubicPolarMap μ T one v = cubicPolar μ T one (v 0) (v 1) (v 2)
proof:
:= by
  exact (cubicPolar_eq_cubicSymPolar μ T one (v 0) (v 1) (v 2)).symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceCubicTrace.cubicPolar_diagonal
statement:
theorem cubicPolar_diagonal {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    (μ : V →ₗ[K] V →ₗ[K] V) (T : V →ₗ[K] K) (one x : V) :
    cubicPolar μ T one x x x = (6 : K) • cubicResidual μ T one x
proof:
:= by
  rw [cubicPolar_eq_cubicSymPolar]
  simp [cubicSymPolar, cubicTrilinearTerm, cubicResidual]
  module

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.linear_apply_eq_sum_basis
statement:
theorem linear_apply_eq_sum_basis (A : Vec6 K →ₗ[K] Vec6 K) (x : Vec6 K) :
    A x = (∑ i, x (Sum.inl i) • A (basisVector (Sum.inl i))) +
      ∑ i, x (Sum.inr i) • A (basisVector (Sum.inr i))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, hx⟩ := standard_spans (K := K) x
  have ha : a = fun i => x (Sum.inl i) := by
    funext i
    have hi := congrFun hx (Sum.inl i)
    fin_cases i <;>
      simpa [standardE, standardF, basisVector, Pi.single_apply,
        Fin.sum_univ_succ] using hi.symm
  have hb : b = fun i => x (Sum.inr i) := by
    funext i
    have hi := congrFun hx (Sum.inr i)
    fin_cases i <;>
      simpa [standardE, standardF, basisVector, Pi.single_apply,
        Fin.sum_univ_succ] using hi.symm
  subst a
  subst b
  calc
    A x = A ((∑ i, x (Sum.inl i) • standardE i) +
        ∑ i, x (Sum.inr i) • standardF i) := congrArg A hx
    _ = _ := by simp only [map_add, map_sum, map_smul, standardE, standardF]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.weightedBlock_comp
statement:
theorem weightedBlock_comp (A B : Vec6 K →ₗ[K] Vec6 K) (i l : Fin 3) :
    weightedBlock (A.comp B) i l =
      ∑ j, weightedBlock A i j * weightedBlock B j l
proof:
:= by
  ext r s
  have h := congrFun (linear_apply_eq_sum_basis A
    (B (basisVector (weightedPairIndex l s)))) (weightedPairIndex i r)
  fin_cases r <;> fin_cases s <;>
    simp [weightedBlock, weightedPairIndex, LinearMap.comp_apply,
      Finset.sum_apply, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, Fin.sum_univ_three,
      Finset.sum_add_distrib,
      LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
      smul_eq_mul] at h ⊢ <;> linear_combination h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.actual_weighted_block_idempotent
statement:
theorem actual_weighted_block_idempotent
    (E : Fin 3 → Carrier K) (F1 : Carrier K)
    (hEidem : ∀ i, (E i : Mat6 K) * E i = E i)
    (hEsum : (E 0 : Mat6 K) + E 1 + E 2 = 1)
    (u v : Vec6 K) (p : Fin 3 → K)
    (hp : ∀ i, p i = (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u)
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v)) (hpne : ∀ i, p i ≠ 0)
    (hFidem : (F1 : Mat6 K) * F1 = F1) :
    let L
proof:
:= weightedCoordinateEquiv E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne
    let B := coordinateConjugate L (matrixAction (F1 : Mat6 K))
    ∀ i l, (∑ j, weightedBlock B i j * weightedBlock B j l) =
      weightedBlock B i l := by
  dsimp only
  let L := weightedCoordinateEquiv E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne
  let B := coordinateConjugate L (matrixAction (F1 : Mat6 K))
  have hact : (matrixAction (F1 : Mat6 K)).comp
      (matrixAction (F1 : Mat6 K)) = matrixAction (F1 : Mat6 K) := by
    rw [← matrixAction_mul]
    exact congrArg (matrixAction (K := K)) hFidem
  have hB : B.comp B = B := by
    rw [← coordinateConjugate_comp, hact]
  intro i l
  rw [← weightedBlock_comp B B i l, hB]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.actual_weighted_pivot_idempotent
statement:
theorem actual_weighted_pivot_idempotent
    (E : Fin 3 → Carrier K) (F1 : Carrier K)
    (hEidem : ∀ i, (E i : Mat6 K) * E i = E i)
    (hEsum : (E 0 : Mat6 K) + E 1 + E 2 = 1)
    (u v : Vec6 K) (p : Fin 3 → K)
    (hp : ∀ i, p i = (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u)
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v)) (hpne : ∀ i, p i ≠ 0)
    (hFidem : (F1 : Mat6 K) * F1 = F1) :
    let L
proof:
:= weightedCoordinateEquiv E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne
    let B := fun i j => weightedBlock
      (coordinateConjugate L (matrixAction (F1 : Mat6 K))) i j
    B 0 0 * B 0 0 + B 0 1 * B 1 0 + B 0 2 * B 2 0 = B 0 0 := by
  dsimp only
  have h := actual_weighted_block_idempotent E F1 hEidem hEsum
    u v p hp hpne hFidem 0 0
  simpa [Fin.sum_univ_three] using h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowFrameReduction.weighted_cslot_implies_anchored_equation
statement:
theorem weighted_cslot_implies_anchored_equation
    (X Xi Yi A0 A1 A2 : R)
    (hXXi : X * Xi = 1) (hOneYi : (1 + X) * Yi = 1)
    (hc : A0 + Xi * A1 - Yi * A2 = 0) :
    X ^ 2 * A0 + X * (A0 + A1 - A2) + A1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hXOneXi : X * (1 + X) * Xi = 1 + X := by
    calc
      X * (1 + X) * Xi = (X + X * X) * Xi := by rw [mul_add, mul_one]
      _ = X * Xi + X * X * Xi := by rw [add_mul]
      _ = X * Xi + X * (X * Xi) := by rw [mul_assoc]
      _ = 1 + X := by rw [hXXi, mul_one]
  have hXOneYi : X * (1 + X) * Yi = X := by
    rw [mul_assoc, hOneYi, mul_one]
  have hm := congrArg (fun Z : R => X * (1 + X) * Z) hc
  simp only [mul_zero] at hm
  calc
    X ^ 2 * A0 + X * (A0 + A1 - A2) + A1 =
        (X * (1 + X)) * A0 + (1 + X) * A1 - X * A2 := by
      simp only [pow_two, mul_add, add_mul, mul_sub, sub_mul, mul_one, one_mul, mul_assoc]
      abel
    _ = (X * (1 + X)) * A0 +
          (X * (1 + X) * Xi) * A1 -
          (X * (1 + X) * Yi) * A2 := by rw [hXOneXi, hXOneYi]
    _ = X * (1 + X) * (A0 + Xi * A1 - Yi * A2) := by
      simp only [mul_sub, mul_add, mul_assoc]
    _ = 0 := hm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowFrameReduction.anchored_equation_implies_right_quadratic
statement:
theorem anchored_equation_implies_right_quadratic
    (X A0 A0i A1 A2 : R)
    (hA0i : A0 * A0i = 1)
    (hanchored : X ^ 2 * A0 + X * (A0 + A1 - A2) + A1 = 0) :
    X ^ 2 + X * ((A0 + A1 - A2) * A0i) + A1 * A0i = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hm := congrArg (fun Z : R => Z * A0i) hanchored
  simp only [zero_mul] at hm
  calc
    X ^ 2 + X * ((A0 + A1 - A2) * A0i) + A1 * A0i =
        (X ^ 2 * A0 + X * (A0 + A1 - A2) + A1) * A0i := by
      simp only [add_mul, mul_assoc, hA0i, mul_one]
    _ = 0 := hm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowFrameReduction.normalized_cslot_equation_of_sum
statement:
theorem normalized_cslot_equation_of_sum
    (a0 b0 b1 b2 X A0 A1 A2 : Mat3 K)
    (hb0 : b0 = a0)
    (hb1 : b1 = X * a0)
    (hb2 : b2 = -(1 + X) * a0)
    (hb0ne : b0.det ≠ 0)
    (hb1ne : b1.det ≠ 0) (hb2ne : b2.det ≠ 0)
    (hX : X.det ≠ 0) (hOneX : (1 + X).det ≠ 0)
    (hc : cslotSum b0 b1 b2 A0 A1 A2 = 0) :
    A0 + X⁻¹ * A1 - (1 + X)⁻¹ * A2 = 0
proof:
:= by
  subst b0
  have ha0b0 : a0 * a0⁻¹ = 1 :=
    Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv a0 (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hb0ne)
  have ha0b1 : a0 * b1⁻¹ = X⁻¹ := by
    calc
      a0 * b1⁻¹ = X⁻¹ * (X * a0 * b1⁻¹) := by
        simp only [← Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul X
          (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hX), Matrix.one_mul]
      _ = X⁻¹ * (b1 * b1⁻¹) := by rw [hb1]
      _ = X⁻¹ := by
        rw [Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv b1 (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hb1ne),
          Matrix.mul_one]
  have ha0b2 : a0 * b2⁻¹ = -(1 + X)⁻¹ := by
    have hb2product : -((1 + X) * (a0 * b2⁻¹)) = 1 := by
      calc
        -((1 + X) * (a0 * b2⁻¹)) = b2 * b2⁻¹ := by
          rw [hb2]
          simp only [neg_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]
        _ = 1 := Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv b2 (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hb2ne)
    have hproduct : (1 + X) * (a0 * b2⁻¹) = -1 := by
      calc
        (1 + X) * (a0 * b2⁻¹) = -(-((1 + X) * (a0 * b2⁻¹))) := by simp
        _ = -1 := by rw [hb2product]
    calc
      a0 * b2⁻¹ = (1 + X)⁻¹ * ((1 + X) * (a0 * b2⁻¹)) := by
        rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul (1 + X)
          (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hOneX), Matrix.one_mul]
      _ = -(1 + X)⁻¹ := by rw [hproduct]; simp
  have hm := congrArg (fun Z : Mat3 K => a0 * Z) hc
  simp only [cslotSum, mul_zero, mul_add, ← Matrix.mul_assoc] at hm
  rw [ha0b0, ha0b1, ha0b2, Matrix.one_mul, neg_mul] at hm
  simpa only [sub_eq_add_neg, neg_neg] using hm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowFrameReduction.right_quadratic_of_normalized_cslots
statement:
theorem right_quadratic_of_normalized_cslots
    (a0 b0 b1 b2 X A0 A1 A2 : Mat3 K)
    (hb0 : b0 = a0)
    (hb1 : b1 = X * a0)
    (hb2 : b2 = -(1 + X) * a0)
    (hb0ne : b0.det ≠ 0)
    (hb1ne : b1.det ≠ 0) (hb2ne : b2.det ≠ 0)
    (hX : X.det ≠ 0) (hOneX : (1 + X).det ≠ 0)
    (hA0 : A0.det ≠ 0)
    (hc : cslotSum b0 b1 b2 A0 A1 A2 = 0) :
    X ^ 2 + X * frameU A0 A1 A2 + frameV A0 A1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hnormalized := normalized_cslot_equation_of_sum
    a0 b0 b1 b2 X A0 A1 A2 hb0 hb1 hb2 hb0ne hb1ne hb2ne hX hOneX hc
  have hanchored := weighted_cslot_implies_anchored_equation
    X X⁻¹ (1 + X)⁻¹ A0 A1 A2
    (Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv X (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hX))
    (Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv (1 + X) (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hOneX))
    hnormalized
  simpa only [frameU, frameV] using
    anchored_equation_implies_right_quadratic X A0 A0⁻¹ A1 A2
      (Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv A0 (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hA0)) hanchored
