name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.FieldPointComparison.agree_of_mem
statement:
theorem agree_of_mem (h : AgreeOnLedgerField k left right)
    {x : FunctionField k} (hx : x ∈ ledgerField k) : left x = right x
proof: := h ⟨x,hx⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.FieldPointComparison.agree_scalarMap_comp
statement:
theorem agree_scalarMap_comp (h : AgreeOnLedgerField k left right) :
    left.comp (scalarMap k) = right.comp (scalarMap k)
proof:
:= by
  ext c
  exact agree_of_mem k left right h (scalarMap_mem_ledgerField k c)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.FieldPointComparison.mapLedger_eq_of_agreement
statement:
theorem mapLedger_eq_of_agreement (h : AgreeOnLedgerField k left right) :
    mapLedgerValues left (universalLedger k) = mapLedgerValues right (universalLedger k)
proof:
:= by
  unfold mapLedgerValues
  rw [LabelledLedger.mk.injEq]
  exact ⟨funext (fun i => funext (fun j =>
      agree_of_mem k left right h (pairP_mem_ledgerField k i j))),
    funext (fun j => funext (fun l =>
      agree_of_mem k left right h (pairQ_mem_ledgerField k j l))),
    funext (fun l => funext (fun i =>
      agree_of_mem k left right h (pairR_mem_ledgerField k l i))),
    funext (fun i => funext (fun j => funext (fun l =>
      agree_of_mem k left right h (centeredC0_mem_ledgerField k i j l))))⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.FieldPointComparison.isRaw_mapMatrix
statement:
theorem isRaw_mapMatrix {E : Type*} [Field E] (f : E →+* L)
    (P : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Mat3 E) (hP : IsRawFrameFamily P) :
    IsRawFrameFamily (fun r i => f.mapMatrix (P r i)) where
  idempotent r i
proof:
:= by
    rw [← map_mul]
    exact congrArg f.mapMatrix (hP.idempotent r i)
  trace_one r i := by
    change Matrix.trace ((P r i).map f) = 1
    rw [← AddMonoidHom.map_trace f, hP.trace_one, map_one]
  sum_one r := by
    simpa only [map_sum, map_one] using congrArg f.mapMatrix (hP.sum_one r)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.FieldPointComparison.mapped_firstPairTrace_ne_zero
statement:
theorem mapped_firstPairTrace_ne_zero (f : FunctionField k →+* L)
    [CharZero L] (i j : Fin 3) :
    Matrix.trace (f.mapMatrix (universalFamily k 0 i) *
      f.mapMatrix (universalFamily k 1 j)) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hz
  apply universal_firstPairTrace_ne_zero k i j
  apply f.injective
  rw [map_zero, mapMatrix_trace, map_mul]
  exact hz

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.FieldPointComparison.mapped_encoderCommutator_ne_zero
statement:
theorem mapped_encoderCommutator_ne_zero (f : FunctionField k →+* L) :
    let A
proof:
:= f.mapMatrix (universalFamily k 0 2) - f.mapMatrix (universalFamily k 0 0)
    let B := f.mapMatrix (universalFamily k 1 2) - f.mapMatrix (universalFamily k 1 0)
    Matrix.det (A*B-B*A) ≠ 0 := by
  dsimp only
  intro hz
  apply universal_encoderCommutator_ne_zero k
  apply f.injective
  rw [map_zero]
  simpa only [RingHom.map_det, map_sub, map_mul] using hz

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.FieldPointComparison.embeddings_related_of_ledger_agreement
statement:
theorem embeddings_related_of_ledger_agreement
    (hagree : AgreeOnLedgerField k left right) :
    ∃ Q : Mat3 L, Q.det ≠ 0 ∧
      ((∀ r i, conjugate Q (left.mapMatrix (universalFamily k r i)) =
          right.mapMatrix (universalFamily k r i)) ∨
       (∀ r i, conjugate Q (Matrix.transpose (left.mapMatrix (universalFamily k r i))) =
          right.mapMatrix (universalFamily k r i)))
proof:
:= by
  letI : CharZero L := {
    cast_injective := fun m n h => Nat.cast_injective (R := FunctionField k)
      (left.injective (by simpa only [map_natCast] using h)) }
  letI : Invertible (2 : L) := invertibleOfNonzero (by norm_num)
  let A := fun r i => left.mapMatrix (universalFamily k r i)
  let B := fun r i => right.mapMatrix (universalFamily k r i)
  have hAr := isRaw_mapMatrix left (universalFamily k) (universalFamily_isRaw k)
  have hBr := isRaw_mapMatrix right (universalFamily k) (universalFamily_isRaw k)
  have hA : ∀ r, FrameLaws (A r) := by
    intro r
    exact rawFrame_laws _ (hAr.idempotent r)
      (by simpa [A, Fin.sum_univ_succ, add_assoc] using hAr.sum_one r) (hAr.trace_one r)
  have hB : ∀ r, FrameLaws (B r) := by
    intro r
    exact rawFrame_laws _ (hBr.idempotent r)
      (by simpa [B, Fin.sum_univ_succ, add_assoc] using hBr.sum_one r) (hBr.trace_one r)
  obtain ⟨X0, hX0, hAX0⟩ := exists_frameOfInvertible (A 0) (hA 0)
  obtain ⟨X1, hX1, hAX1⟩ := exists_frameOfInvertible (A 1) (hA 1)
  obtain ⟨Y0, hY0, hBY0⟩ := exists_frameOfInvertible (B 0) (hB 0)
  obtain ⟨Y1, hY1, hBY1⟩ := exists_frameOfInvertible (B 1) (hB 1)
  have hAX0' : A 0 = frameOfInvertible X0 := funext (fun i => (hAX0 i).symm)
  have hAX1' : A 1 = frameOfInvertible X1 := funext (fun i => (hAX1 i).symm)
  have hBY0' : B 0 = frameOfInvertible Y0 := funext (fun i => (hBY0 i).symm)
  have hBY1' : B 1 = frameOfInvertible Y1 := funext (fun i => (hBY1 i).symm)
  have hopen : ∀ i j, overlapOf (X0⁻¹*X1) i j ≠ 0 := by
    intro i j
    rw [relative_overlap_eq_pair_trace X0 X1 hX0, hAX0 i, hAX1 j]
    exact mapped_firstPairTrace_ne_zero k left i j
  have hdet : Matrix.det
      (FourRowProbeTrace.grading * FourRowLabelledProbes.encoder
        (normalizeBy Y0 B 1 0) (normalizeBy Y0 B 1 2) -
       FourRowLabelledProbes.encoder (normalizeBy Y0 B 1 0) (normalizeBy Y0 B 1 2) *
        FourRowProbeTrace.grading) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [normalized_encoderCommutator_det B Y0 hY0 hBY0']
    exact mapped_encoderCommutator_ne_zero k right
  have hled : labelledLedger (primitiveMatrixTauTriple A) =
      labelledLedger (primitiveMatrixTauTriple B) := by
    have hleft := primitiveLedger_map left (universalFamily k)
    have hright := primitiveLedger_map right (universalFamily k)
    exact hleft.trans ((mapLedger_eq_of_agreement k left right hagree).trans hright.symm)
  exact triple_orbit_explicit_of_bases A B hA hB X0 X1 Y0 Y1
    hX0 hX1 hY0 hY1 hAX0' hAX1' hBY0' hBY1' hopen hdet hled

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualDetectorTransport.sourceDetector_chartWithResidualPair
statement:
theorem sourceDetector_chartWithResidualPair
    (x : ExplicitFrameChart K) (Q : ResidualPair K)
    (hx : delta (residualPairOfChart x) ≠ 0)
    (hQ : delta Q ≠ 0)
    (hmoment : moment (residualPairOfChart x) = moment Q)
    (hdelta : delta (residualPairOfChart x) = delta Q) :
    sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1) (encoderA x) (encoderB x) =
      sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1)
        (encoderA (chartWithResidualPair x Q))
        (encoderB (chartWithResidualPair x Q))
proof:
:= by
  have hrelated : Related (residualPairOfChart x) Q :=
    (related_iff_same_moment_delta _ _ hx hQ).2 ⟨hmoment, hdelta⟩
  have hsource : SourceAutRelated x Q :=
    (sourceAutRelated_iff_related x Q).2 hrelated
  rcases hsource with ⟨G, hresidual, hdiagonal, hA, hB⟩
  have hreinsert : chartWithResidualPair x Q = actChart G x := by
    rw [← hresidual]
    apply ExplicitFrameChart.ext <;> rfl
  have hinvariant := sourceDetector_map
    (ResidualAction.sourceAut G).linear
    (ResidualAction.sourceAut G).map_product
    (ResidualAction.sourceTrace_act G)
    (diagonal (-1) 0 1) (encoderA x) (encoderB x)
  change sourceDetector ((ResidualAction.sourceAut G).linear (diagonal (-1) 0 1))
    ((ResidualAction.sourceAut G).linear (encoderA x))
    ((ResidualAction.sourceAut G).linear (encoderB x)) = _ at hinvariant
  have hbase := hdiagonal (-1) 0 1
  rw [hbase, hA, hB] at hinvariant
  rw [hreinsert]
  exact hinvariant.symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualDetectorTransport.sourceDetector_eq_normalized
statement:
theorem sourceDetector_eq_normalized
    (x : ExplicitFrameChart K)
    (hx : delta (residualPairOfChart x) ≠ 0) :
    sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1) (encoderA x) (encoderB x) =
      normalized x.diagA x.diagB x.r1 x.z1 x.r2 x.z2
        (moment (residualPairOfChart x))
        (delta (residualPairOfChart x))
        (delta (residualPairOfChart x))⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  let P := residualPairOfChart x
  let Q : ResidualPair K :=
    ⟨moment P * RationalChartCircuit.diagonal (delta P)⁻¹,
      RationalChartCircuit.diagonal (delta P)⟩
  have hQeq : normalizedPair P = Q := by
    rfl
  have hrelated : Related P Q := by
    refine ⟨normalizingDetOneMatrix P hx, ?_⟩
    exact (act_normalizingDetOneMatrix P hx).trans hQeq
  have hinvariants := related_preserves_invariants hrelated
  have hQ : delta Q ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← hinvariants.2.1]
    exact hx
  calc
    sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1) (encoderA x) (encoderB x) =
        sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1)
          (encoderA (chartWithResidualPair x Q))
          (encoderB (chartWithResidualPair x Q)) :=
      sourceDetector_chartWithResidualPair x Q hx hQ
        hinvariants.1 hinvariants.2.1
    _ = normalized x.diagA x.diagB x.r1 x.z1 x.r2 x.z2
          (moment P) (delta P) (delta P)⁻¹ := by
      exact (normalized_source x (moment P) (delta P) (delta P)⁻¹).symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealCayleyGridIdentity.totalDenominator_ne_zero
statement: theorem totalDenominator_ne_zero : totalDenominator k ≠ 0
proof:
:= by

    ext i j
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [skew]
  have hzero : ∀ r : Fin 3,
      Matrix.det (1 + skew (0 : k) 0 0) ≠ 0 := by
    intro r

    exact one_ne_zero

    (RingHom.id k) (fun _ _ => 0) hzero

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealCayleyGridIdentity.localizedConstantEval_eq_evalAway

theorem localizedConstantEval_eq_evalAway
    (t : Var → k) (ht : MvPolynomial.eval t (totalDenominator k) ≠ 0) :
    localizedConstantEval k (F k) (Param k) (totalDenominator k) t ht =
      evalAway (RingHom.id (F k))
        (basePoint k (fun r q => t (r, q)))
        (basePoint_denominator_ne_zero k (fun r q => t (r, q))
          (by simpa using ht))
proof:

      (mappedDenominator k (F k) (totalDenominator k)))

  rw [evalAway_algebraMap]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealCayleyGridIdentity.crossExpression_eq_zero_of_constantInvariant

theorem crossExpression_eq_zero_of_constantInvariant
    (a b : CoordinateRing k) (hb : rawToField k b ≠ 0)
    (hinv : IsConstantInvariant k (rawToField k a / rawToField k b)) :
    crossExpression k a b = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply eq_zero_of_localizedConstantEval_eq_zero
    k (F k) (Param k) (totalDenominator k) (totalDenominator_ne_zero k)
  intro t ht
  rw [localizedConstantEval_eq_evalAway k t ht]
  exact evalAway_crossExpression_eq_zero_of_constantInvariant
    k a b hb hinv (fun r q => t (r, q)) (by simpa using ht)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ActualTripleGSp.similitude_form_mul
statement:
private theorem similitude_form_mul
    (X Y : Mat6 K) (a b : K)
    (hX : X.transpose * symplecticJ * X = a • symplecticJ)
    (hY : Y.transpose * symplecticJ * Y = b • symplecticJ) :
    (X * Y).transpose * symplecticJ * (X * Y) =
      (a * b) • symplecticJ
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.transpose_mul]
  calc
    Y.transpose * X.transpose * symplecticJ * (X * Y) =
        Y.transpose * (X.transpose * symplecticJ * X) * Y := by
          simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = Y.transpose * (a • symplecticJ) * Y := by rw [hX]
    _ = a • (Y.transpose * symplecticJ * Y) := by
      simp only [Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = a • (b • symplecticJ) := by rw [hY]
    _ = (a * b) • symplecticJ := by rw [smul_smul]

      Fintype.sum_sum_type, Fin.sum_univ_succ]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ActualTripleGSp.carrier_frame_mul_zero
statement:
private theorem carrier_frame_mul_zero
    (P : Fin 3 → Carrier K)
    (hidem : ∀ i, (P i : Mat6 K) * P i = P i)
    (hsum : (P 0 : Mat6 K) + P 1 + P 2 = 1)
    (i j : Fin 3) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    (P i : Mat6 K) * P j = 0
proof:
:= by
  let T : Fin 3 → Vec6 K →ₗ[K] Vec6 K :=
    fun l => matrixAction (P l : Mat6 K)
  have hTi : ∀ l, IsIdempotent (T l) :=
    fun l => carrier_projector_action_idempotent (P l) (hidem l)
  have hTsum : T 0 + T 1 + T 2 = LinearMap.id :=
    carrier_frame_action_sum P hsum
  have hz := comp_zero_of_complete_frame T hTi hTsum i j hij
  apply matrixAction_injective
  rw [matrixAction_mul, matrixAction_zero]
  exact hz

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ActualTripleGSp.actual_carrierLedger_eq_of_map
statement:
theorem actual_carrierLedger_eq_of_map
    (g h : Aut (K := K))
    (E F P E' F' P' : Fin 3 → Carrier K)
    (hledger : ActualSplitThirdFrameAut.carrierLedger E F P =
      ActualSplitThirdFrameAut.carrierLedger E' F' P') :
    ActualSplitThirdFrameAut.carrierLedger
        (CarrierLedgerInvariance.mapFrame g E)
        (CarrierLedgerInvariance.mapFrame g F)
        (CarrierLedgerInvariance.mapFrame g P) =
      ActualSplitThirdFrameAut.carrierLedger
        (CarrierLedgerInvariance.mapFrame h E')
        (CarrierLedgerInvariance.mapFrame h F')
        (CarrierLedgerInvariance.mapFrame h P')
proof:
:= by
  apply toInvariantLedger_injective
  simp only [toInvariantLedger_carrierLedger]
  apply CarrierLedgerInvariance.carrierLedger_eq_of_map
  exact congrArg toInvariantLedger hledger

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ActualTripleGSp.exists_actual_triple_gsp_of_one_splitter
statement:
theorem exists_actual_triple_gsp_of_one_splitter
    (E F P E' F' P' : Fin 3 → Carrier K)
    (hEidem : ∀ i, (E i : Mat6 K) * E i = E i)
    (hEtrace : ∀ i, jordanTrace (K := K) (E i : Mat6 K) = 1)
    (hEsum : (E 0 : Mat6 K) + E 1 + E 2 = 1)
    (hFidem : ∀ i, (F i : Mat6 K) * F i = F i)
    (hFtrace : ∀ i, jordanTrace (K := K) (F i : Mat6 K) = 1)
    (hFsum : (F 0 : Mat6 K) + F 1 + F 2 = 1)
    (hPidem : ∀ i, (P i : Mat6 K) * P i = P i)
    (hPtrace : ∀ i, jordanTrace (K := K) (P i : Mat6 K) = 1)
    (hPsum : (P 0 : Mat6 K) + P 1 + P 2 = 1)
    (hEidem' : ∀ i, (E' i : Mat6 K) * E' i = E' i)
    (hEtrace' : ∀ i, jordanTrace (K := K) (E' i : Mat6 K) = 1)
    (hEsum' : (E' 0 : Mat6 K) + E' 1 + E' 2 = 1)
    (hFidem' : ∀ i, (F' i : Mat6 K) * F' i = F' i)
    (hFtrace' : ∀ i, jordanTrace (K := K) (F' i : Mat6 K) = 1)
    (hFsum' : (F' 0 : Mat6 K) + F' 1 + F' 2 = 1)
    (hPidem' : ∀ i, (P' i : Mat6 K) * P' i = P' i)
    (hPtrace' : ∀ i, jordanTrace (K := K) (P' i : Mat6 K) = 1)
    (hPsum' : (P' 0 : Mat6 K) + P' 1 + P' 2 = 1)
    (hledger : ActualSplitThirdFrameAut.carrierLedger E F P =
      ActualSplitThirdFrameAut.carrierLedger E' F' P')
    (u v : Vec6 K) (p : Fin 3 → K)
    (hp : ∀ i, p i = (omega (K := K))
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v))
    (hpne : ∀ i, p i ≠ 0)
    (hFu : ∀ i, matrixAction (F 0 : Mat6 K)
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u) = p i • u)
    (hFv : ∀ i, matrixAction (F 0 : Mat6 K)
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v) = p i • v)
    (hpLedger : ∀ i, p i = jordanTrace (K := K)
      ((E i : Mat6 K) * (F 0 : Mat6 K)))
    (hp12 : p 1 + p 2 ≠ 0)
    (hdisc : let L := weightedCoordinateEquiv E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne
      let C := fun i j => weightedBlock (coordinateConjugate L
        (matrixAction (F 1 : Mat6 K))) i j
      trace2 (C 0 1) ^ 2 - 4 * determinant (C 0 1) ≠ 0)
    (Q N : Mat6 K)
    (hQN : Q * N = 1) (hNQ : N * Q = 1)
    (hQform : Q.transpose * symplecticJ * Q = symplecticJ)
    (f : Fin 3 → Mat3 K)
    (hEsplit : ∀ i, N * (E i : Mat6 K) * Q =
      grouped (diagonalUnit i) 0 0)
    (hFsplit : ∀ i, N * (F i : Mat6 K) * Q = grouped (f i) 0 0)
    (hprobeOpen : Matrix.det
      (grading * encoder (f 0) (f 2) - encoder (f 0) (f 2) * grading) ≠ 0)
    (hadj : ∀ l, Matrix.adjugate
      (topLeft (N * (P l : Mat6 K) * Q)) ≠ 0)
    (hrankTwo :
      let su := fun l => unhat (topRight (N * (P l : Mat6 K) * Q))
      let sv := fun l => unhat (bottomLeft (N * (P l : Mat6 K) * Q))
      (∃ r s, su 0 r * su 1 s - su 0 s * su 1 r ≠ 0) ∨
      (∃ r s, sv 0 r * sv 1 s - sv 0 s * sv 1 r ≠ 0)) :
    ∃ A B : Mat6 K, ∃ nu t : K, ∃ M MInv : Mat6 K, ∃ mu : K,
      A * B = 1 ∧ B * A = 1 ∧ nu ≠ 0 ∧
      A.transpose * symplecticJ * A = nu • symplecticJ ∧ t ≠ 0 ∧
      M = A * Q * scalarSimilitude t * N ∧
      MInv = Q * scalarSimilitudeInv t * N * B ∧ mu = nu * t ∧
      M * MInv = 1 ∧ MInv * M = 1 ∧ mu ≠ 0 ∧
      M.transpose * symplecticJ * M = mu • symplecticJ ∧
      (∀ i, M * (E i : Mat6 K) * MInv = (E' i : Mat6 K)) ∧
      (∀ i, M * (F i : Mat6 K) * MInv = (F' i : Mat6 K)) ∧
      (∀ i, M * (P i : Mat6 K) * MInv = (P' i : Mat6 K))
proof:
:= by
  have hpairEF (i j : Fin 3) :
      jordanTrace (K := K) ((E i : Mat6 K) * (F j : Mat6 K)) =
        jordanTrace (K := K) ((E' i : Mat6 K) * (F' j : Mat6 K)) := by
    have h := congrArg
      (fun L : ActualSplitThirdFrameAut.CarrierLedger K => L.pairEF i j)
      hledger
    simpa only [ActualSplitThirdFrameAut.carrierLedger] using h
  obtain ⟨u', v', hpRaw', hFuRaw', hFvRaw'⟩ :=
    exists_actual_first_projector_ledger_coordinates E' F'
      hEidem' hEtrace' hEsum' hFidem' hFtrace' hFsum'
  have hp' : ∀ i, p i = (omega (K := K))
      (matrixAction (E' i : Mat6 K) u')
      (matrixAction (E' i : Mat6 K) v') := by
    intro i
    rw [hpLedger i, hpairEF i 0]
    exact hpRaw' i
  have hFu' : ∀ i, matrixAction (F' 0 : Mat6 K)
      (matrixAction (E' i : Mat6 K) u') = p i • u' := by
    intro i
    rw [hpLedger i, hpairEF i 0]
    exact hFuRaw' i
  have hFv' : ∀ i, matrixAction (F' 0 : Mat6 K)
      (matrixAction (E' i : Mat6 K) v') = p i • v' := by
    intro i
    rw [hpLedger i, hpairEF i 0]
    exact hFvRaw' i
  obtain ⟨g, A, B, nu, hAB, hBA, hnu, hAform,
      hgCarrier, hgE, hgF⟩ :=
    exists_actual_same_ledger_pair_jordanAut_provenance
      E F E' F' hEidem hEsum hFidem hFsum
      hEidem' hEsum' hFidem' hFsum'
      u v u' v' p hp hp' hpne hFu hFv hFu' hFv'
      (fun i => hpairEF i 1) hp12 hdisc
  have hBform : B.transpose * symplecticJ * B = nu⁻¹ • symplecticJ :=
    inverse_form A B nu hAB hnu hAform
  have hNform : N.transpose * symplecticJ * N = symplecticJ := by
    simpa using inverse_form Q N (1 : K) hQN one_ne_zero
      (by simpa using hQform)
  let NB : Mat6 K := N * B
  let AQ : Mat6 K := A * Q
  have hNBAQ : NB * AQ = 1 := by
    change (N * B) * (A * Q) = 1
    calc
      (N * B) * (A * Q) = N * (B * A) * Q := by
        simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = N * 1 * Q := by rw [hBA]
      _ = 1 := by simpa using hNQ
  have hAQNB : AQ * NB = 1 := by
    change (A * Q) * (N * B) = 1
    calc
      (A * Q) * (N * B) = A * (Q * N) * B := by
        simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = A * 1 * B := by rw [hQN]
      _ = 1 := by simpa using hAB
  have hNBform : NB.transpose * symplecticJ * NB = nu⁻¹ • symplecticJ := by
    simpa only [NB, one_mul] using
      similitude_form_mul N B (1 : K) nu⁻¹
        (by simpa using hNform) hBform
  let gL : Aut (K := K) :=
    jordanAut N Q 1 hNQ hQN one_ne_zero (by simpa using hNform)
  let gR : Aut (K := K) :=
    jordanAut NB AQ nu⁻¹ hNBAQ hAQNB (inv_ne_zero hnu) hNBform
  let EL := CarrierLedgerInvariance.mapFrame gL E
  let FL := CarrierLedgerInvariance.mapFrame gL F
  let PL := CarrierLedgerInvariance.mapFrame gL P
  let ER := CarrierLedgerInvariance.mapFrame gR E'
  let FR := CarrierLedgerInvariance.mapFrame gR F'
  let PR := CarrierLedgerInvariance.mapFrame gR P'
  have hbackE (i : Fin 3) :
      B * (E' i : Mat6 K) * A = (E i : Mat6 K) := by
    have hfwd : A * (E i : Mat6 K) * B = (E' i : Mat6 K) := by
      calc
        A * (E i : Mat6 K) * B =
            ((g.linear (E i) : Carrier K) : Mat6 K) := (hgCarrier (E i)).symm
        _ = (E' i : Mat6 K) := congrArg Subtype.val (hgE i)
    calc
      B * (E' i : Mat6 K) * A = B * (A * (E i : Mat6 K) * B) * A := by
        rw [hfwd]
      _ = (B * A) * (E i : Mat6 K) * (B * A) := by
        simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = (E i : Mat6 K) := by rw [hBA]; simp
  have hbackF (i : Fin 3) :
      B * (F' i : Mat6 K) * A = (F i : Mat6 K) := by
    have hfwd : A * (F i : Mat6 K) * B = (F' i : Mat6 K) := by
      calc
        A * (F i : Mat6 K) * B =
            ((g.linear (F i) : Carrier K) : Mat6 K) := (hgCarrier (F i)).symm
        _ = (F' i : Mat6 K) := congrArg Subtype.val (hgF i)
    calc
      B * (F' i : Mat6 K) * A = B * (A * (F i : Mat6 K) * B) * A := by
        rw [hfwd]
      _ = (B * A) * (F i : Mat6 K) * (B * A) := by
        simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = (F i : Mat6 K) := by rw [hBA]; simp
  have hEL (i : Fin 3) :
      (EL i : Mat6 K) = grouped (diagonalUnit i) 0 0 := by
    change N * (E i : Mat6 K) * Q = _
    exact hEsplit i
  have hER (i : Fin 3) :
      (ER i : Mat6 K) = grouped (diagonalUnit i) 0 0 := by
    change (N * B) * (E' i : Mat6 K) * (A * Q) = _
    calc
      (N * B) * (E' i : Mat6 K) * (A * Q) =
          N * (B * (E' i : Mat6 K) * A) * Q := by
            simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = N * (E i : Mat6 K) * Q := by rw [hbackE]
      _ = _ := hEsplit i
  have hFL (i : Fin 3) : (FL i : Mat6 K) = grouped (f i) 0 0 := by
    change N * (F i : Mat6 K) * Q = _
    exact hFsplit i
  have hFR (i : Fin 3) : (FR i : Mat6 K) = grouped (f i) 0 0 := by
    change (N * B) * (F' i : Mat6 K) * (A * Q) = _
    calc
      (N * B) * (F' i : Mat6 K) * (A * Q) =
          N * (B * (F' i : Mat6 K) * A) * Q := by
            simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = N * (F i : Mat6 K) * Q := by rw [hbackF]
      _ = _ := hFsplit i
  let a : Fin 3 → Mat3 K := fun i => topLeft (PL i : Mat6 K)
  let su : Fin 3 → Vec3 K := fun i => unhat (topRight (PL i : Mat6 K))
  let sv : Fin 3 → Vec3 K := fun i => unhat (bottomLeft (PL i : Mat6 K))
  let a' : Fin 3 → Mat3 K := fun i => topLeft (PR i : Mat6 K)
  let su' : Fin 3 → Vec3 K := fun i => unhat (topRight (PR i : Mat6 K))
  let sv' : Fin 3 → Vec3 K := fun i => unhat (bottomLeft (PR i : Mat6 K))
  have hPL (i : Fin 3) :
      (PL i : Mat6 K) = grouped (a i) (su i) (sv i) := by
    exact (grouped_extract (PL i : Mat6 K) (carrier_property (PL i))).symm
  have hPR (i : Fin 3) :
      (PR i : Mat6 K) = grouped (a' i) (su' i) (sv' i) := by
    exact (grouped_extract (PR i : Mat6 K) (carrier_property (PR i))).symm
  have hPLidem : ∀ i, (PL i : Mat6 K) * PL i = PL i := by
    intro i
    change (N * (P i : Mat6 K) * Q) * (N * (P i : Mat6 K) * Q) =
      N * (P i : Mat6 K) * Q
    calc
      _ = N * (P i : Mat6 K) * (Q * N) * (P i : Mat6 K) * Q := by
        simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = N * ((P i : Mat6 K) * P i) * Q := by
        rw [hQN]
        simp only [Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = _ := by rw [hPidem]
  have hPRidem : ∀ i, (PR i : Mat6 K) * PR i = PR i := by
    intro i
    change (NB * (P' i : Mat6 K) * AQ) *
      (NB * (P' i : Mat6 K) * AQ) = NB * (P' i : Mat6 K) * AQ
    calc
      _ = NB * (P' i : Mat6 K) * (AQ * NB) * (P' i : Mat6 K) * AQ := by
        simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = NB * ((P' i : Mat6 K) * P' i) * AQ := by
        rw [hAQNB]
        simp only [Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = _ := by rw [hPidem']
  have hPLtrace : ∀ i, jordanTrace (K := K) (PL i : Mat6 K) = 1 := by
    intro i
    calc
      jordanTrace (K := K) (PL i : Mat6 K) =
          jordanTrace (K := K) (P i : Mat6 K) :=
        jordanTrace_invariant gL (P i)
      _ = 1 := hPtrace i
  have hPRtrace : ∀ i, jordanTrace (K := K) (PR i : Mat6 K) = 1 := by
    intro i
    calc
      jordanTrace (K := K) (PR i : Mat6 K) =
          jordanTrace (K := K) (P' i : Mat6 K) :=
        jordanTrace_invariant gR (P' i)
      _ = 1 := hPtrace' i
  have hPLsum : (PL 0 : Mat6 K) + PL 1 + PL 2 = 1 := by
    have hsCarrier : P 0 + P 1 + P 2 = (SelfAdjointCarrier.one : Carrier K) := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact hPsum
    have hs := congrArg gL.linear hsCarrier
    simp only [map_add, gL.map_one] at hs
    have hv := congrArg Subtype.val hs
    change ((gL.linear (P 0) : Carrier K) : Mat6 K) +
      ((gL.linear (P 1) : Carrier K) : Mat6 K) +
      ((gL.linear (P 2) : Carrier K) : Mat6 K) = 1 at hv
    simpa only [PL, CarrierLedgerInvariance.mapFrame] using hv
  have hPRsum : (PR 0 : Mat6 K) + PR 1 + PR 2 = 1 := by
    have hsCarrier : P' 0 + P' 1 + P' 2 = (SelfAdjointCarrier.one : Carrier K) := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact hPsum'
    have hs := congrArg gR.linear hsCarrier
    simp only [map_add, gR.map_one] at hs
    have hv := congrArg Subtype.val hs
    change ((gR.linear (P' 0) : Carrier K) : Mat6 K) +
      ((gR.linear (P' 1) : Carrier K) : Mat6 K) +
      ((gR.linear (P' 2) : Carrier K) : Mat6 K) = 1 at hv
    simpa only [PR, CarrierLedgerInvariance.mapFrame] using hv
  have hfsum : f 0 + f 1 + f 2 = 1 := by
    have hs : N * (F 0 : Mat6 K) * Q + N * (F 1 : Mat6 K) * Q +
        N * (F 2 : Mat6 K) * Q = 1 := by
      rw [← Matrix.add_mul, ← Matrix.mul_add, ← Matrix.add_mul,
        ← Matrix.mul_add, hFsum, Matrix.mul_one, hNQ]
    rw [hFsplit 0, hFsplit 1, hFsplit 2] at hs
    have ht := congrArg topLeft hs
    ext i j
    simpa [topLeft, grouped, Matrix.one_apply] using
      congrFun (congrFun ht i) j
  have split_product (i j : Fin 3) (hz : (F i : Mat6 K) * F j = 0) :
      f i * f j = 0 := by
    have hs : (N * (F i : Mat6 K) * Q) *
        (N * (F j : Mat6 K) * Q) = 0 := by
      calc
        _ = N * (F i : Mat6 K) * (Q * N) * (F j : Mat6 K) * Q := by
          simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
        _ = N * ((F i : Mat6 K) * F j) * Q := by
          rw [hQN]
          simp only [Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.mul_assoc]
        _ = 0 := by rw [hz]; simp
    rw [hFsplit i, hFsplit j] at hs
    calc
      f i * f j = topLeft (grouped (f i) 0 0 * grouped (f j) 0 0) :=
        (topLeft_grouped_zero_mul (f i) (f j)).symm
      _ = topLeft 0 := congrArg topLeft hs
      _ = 0 := rfl
  have split_idempotent (i : Fin 3) : f i * f i = f i := by
    have hs : (N * (F i : Mat6 K) * Q) *
        (N * (F i : Mat6 K) * Q) = N * (F i : Mat6 K) * Q := by
      calc
        _ = N * (F i : Mat6 K) * (Q * N) * (F i : Mat6 K) * Q := by
          simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
        _ = N * ((F i : Mat6 K) * F i) * Q := by
          rw [hQN]
          simp only [Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.mul_assoc]
        _ = _ := by rw [hFidem]
    rw [hFsplit i] at hs
    calc
      f i * f i = topLeft (grouped (f i) 0 0 * grouped (f i) 0 0) :=
        (topLeft_grouped_zero_mul (f i) (f i)).symm
      _ = topLeft (grouped (f i) 0 0) := congrArg topLeft hs
      _ = f i := rfl
  have hf0 : f 0 * f 0 = f 0 := split_idempotent 0
  have hf2 : f 2 * f 2 = f 2 := split_idempotent 2
  have hf02 : f 0 * f 2 = 0 :=
    split_product 0 2 (carrier_frame_mul_zero F hFidem hFsum 0 2 (by decide))
  have hf20 : f 2 * f 0 = 0 :=
    split_product 2 0 (carrier_frame_mul_zero F hFidem hFsum 2 0 (by decide))
  have hsplitLedger : ActualSplitThirdFrameAut.carrierLedger EL FL PL =
      ActualSplitThirdFrameAut.carrierLedger ER FR PR := by
    exact actual_carrierLedger_eq_of_map gL gR E F P E' F' P' hledger
  have hadj' : ∀ l, Matrix.adjugate (a l) ≠ 0 := by
    intro l
    change Matrix.adjugate (topLeft (N * (P l : Mat6 K) * Q)) ≠ 0
    exact hadj l
  have hrankTwo' :
      (∃ r s, su 0 r * su 1 s - su 0 s * su 1 r ≠ 0) ∨
      (∃ r s, sv 0 r * sv 1 s - sv 0 s * sv 1 r ≠ 0) := by
    change
      (∃ r s,
        unhat (topRight (N * (P 0 : Mat6 K) * Q)) r *
            unhat (topRight (N * (P 1 : Mat6 K) * Q)) s -
          unhat (topRight (N * (P 0 : Mat6 K) * Q)) s *
            unhat (topRight (N * (P 1 : Mat6 K) * Q)) r ≠ 0) ∨
      (∃ r s,
        unhat (bottomLeft (N * (P 0 : Mat6 K) * Q)) r *
            unhat (bottomLeft (N * (P 1 : Mat6 K) * Q)) s -
          unhat (bottomLeft (N * (P 0 : Mat6 K) * Q)) s *
            unhat (bottomLeft (N * (P 1 : Mat6 K) * Q)) r ≠ 0)
    exact hrankTwo
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hDDinv, hDinvD, hDform, hDE, hDF, hDP⟩ :=
    exists_split_actual_three_frame_scalar_provenance_of_same_ledger
      EL FL PL ER FR PR f a a' su sv su' sv'
      hEL hER hFL hFR hPL hPR hPLidem hPRidem hPLtrace hPRtrace
      hPLsum hPRsum hfsum hf0 hf2 hf02 hf20 hprobeOpen
      hadj' hrankTwo' hsplitLedger
  let D : Mat6 K := scalarSimilitude t
  let Dinv : Mat6 K := scalarSimilitudeInv t
  let M : Mat6 K := A * Q * D * N
  let MInv : Mat6 K := Q * Dinv * N * B
  let mu : K := nu * t
  have hMMInv : M * MInv = 1 := by
    change (A * Q * D * N) * (Q * Dinv * N * B) = 1
    calc
      _ = A * Q * D * (N * Q) * Dinv * N * B := by
        simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = A * Q * (D * Dinv) * N * B := by
        rw [hNQ]
        simp only [Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = A * (Q * N) * B := by
        rw [hDDinv]
        simp only [Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = 1 := by rw [hQN]; simpa using hAB
  have hMInvM : MInv * M = 1 := by
    change (Q * Dinv * N * B) * (A * Q * D * N) = 1
    calc
      _ = Q * Dinv * N * (B * A) * Q * D * N := by
        simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = Q * Dinv * (N * Q) * D * N := by
        rw [hBA]
        simp only [Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = Q * (Dinv * D) * N := by
        rw [hNQ]
        simp only [Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = 1 := by rw [hDinvD]; simpa using hQN
  have hAQform : (A * Q).transpose * symplecticJ * (A * Q) =
      nu • symplecticJ := by
    simpa only [mul_one] using similitude_form_mul A Q nu (1 : K)
      hAform (by simpa using hQform)
  have hAQDform : (A * Q * D).transpose * symplecticJ * (A * Q * D) =
      (nu * t) • symplecticJ := by
    exact similitude_form_mul (A * Q) D nu t hAQform (by simpa [D] using hDform)
  have hMform : M.transpose * symplecticJ * M = mu • symplecticJ := by
    simpa only [M, mu, mul_one] using
      similitude_form_mul (A * Q * D) N (nu * t) (1 : K)
        hAQDform (by simpa using hNform)
  have hcancel : A * Q * N * B = 1 := by
    calc
      A * Q * N * B = A * (Q * N) * B := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = 1 := by rw [hQN]; simpa using hAB
  have final_of_split {X X' : Carrier K}
      (hDX : D * (N * (X : Mat6 K) * Q) * Dinv =
        (N * B) * (X' : Mat6 K) * (A * Q)) :
      M * (X : Mat6 K) * MInv = (X' : Mat6 K) := by
    change (A * Q * D * N) * (X : Mat6 K) *
      (Q * Dinv * N * B) = (X' : Mat6 K)
    calc
      _ = A * Q * (D * (N * (X : Mat6 K) * Q) * Dinv) * N * B := by
        simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = A * Q * ((N * B) * (X' : Mat6 K) * (A * Q)) * N * B := by
        rw [hDX]
      _ = (A * Q * N * B) * (X' : Mat6 K) * (A * Q * N * B) := by
        simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = (X' : Mat6 K) := by rw [hcancel]; simp
  have hME : ∀ i, M * (E i : Mat6 K) * MInv = (E' i : Mat6 K) := by
    intro i
    apply final_of_split
    have hs := hDE i
    change D * (N * (E i : Mat6 K) * Q) * Dinv =
      (N * B) * (E' i : Mat6 K) * (A * Q) at hs
    exact hs
  have hMF : ∀ i, M * (F i : Mat6 K) * MInv = (F' i : Mat6 K) := by
    intro i
    apply final_of_split
    have hs := hDF i
    change D * (N * (F i : Mat6 K) * Q) * Dinv =
      (N * B) * (F' i : Mat6 K) * (A * Q) at hs
    exact hs
  have hMP : ∀ i, M * (P i : Mat6 K) * MInv = (P' i : Mat6 K) := by
    intro i
    apply final_of_split
    have hs := hDP i
    change D * (N * (P i : Mat6 K) * Q) * Dinv =
      (N * B) * (P' i : Mat6 K) * (A * Q) at hs
    exact hs
  exact ⟨A, B, nu, t, M, MInv, mu, hAB, hBA, hnu, hAform, ht,
    rfl, rfl, rfl, hMMInv, hMInvM, mul_ne_zero hnu ht, hMform,
    hME, hMF, hMP⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealConstantGrid.denominator_ne_zero_of_total_ne_zero
statement:
theorem denominator_ne_zero_of_total_ne_zero
    (t : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → k)
    (ht : MvPolynomial.eval (fun q => t q.1 q.2) (totalDenominator k) ≠ 0)
    (r : Fin 3) :
    Matrix.det (1 + skew (t r 0) (t r 1) (t r 2)) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hevalDen : MvPolynomial.eval (fun q => t q.1 q.2) (denominator k r) =
      Matrix.det (1 + skew (t r 0) (t r 1) (t r 2)) := by
    simpa [baseEval] using
      baseEval_denominator (RingHom.id k) t r
  intro hr
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := denominator_dvd_total k r
  apply ht
  rw [hc, MvPolynomial.eval_mul, hevalDen, hr, zero_mul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealConstantGrid.basePoint_denominator_ne_zero
statement:
theorem basePoint_denominator_ne_zero
    (t : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → k)
    (ht : MvPolynomial.eval (fun q => t q.1 q.2) (totalDenominator k) ≠ 0)
    (r : Fin 3) :
    Matrix.det (1 + skew
      (basePoint k t r 0) (basePoint k t r 1) (basePoint k t r 2)) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := denominator_ne_zero_of_total_ne_zero k t ht r
  intro hz
  apply h
  apply (scalarMap k).injective
  rw [map_zero]
  rw [RingHom.map_det]
  have hmatrix : (scalarMap k).mapMatrix
      (1 + skew (t r 0) (t r 1) (t r 2)) =
      1 + skew (basePoint k t r 0) (basePoint k t r 1)
        (basePoint k t r 2) := by
    ext i j
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [skew, basePoint]
  rw [hmatrix, hz]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealConstantGrid.baseCayley_orthogonal
statement:
theorem baseCayley_orthogonal
    (t : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → k)
    (ht : MvPolynomial.eval (fun q => t q.1 q.2) (totalDenominator k) ≠ 0) :
    IsOrthogonal (baseCayley k t)
proof:
:=
  cayley_orthogonal (skew_isSkew _ _ _)
    (denominator_ne_zero_of_total_ne_zero k t ht 0)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealConstantGrid.scalarMap_baseCayley
statement:
theorem scalarMap_baseCayley
    (t : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → k)
    (ht : MvPolynomial.eval (fun q => t q.1 q.2) (totalDenominator k) ≠ 0) :
    (scalarMap k).mapMatrix (baseCayley k t) =
      cayley (skew (basePoint k t 0 0) (basePoint k t 0 1) (basePoint k t 0 2))
proof:
:= by
  let A := skew (t 0 0) (t 0 1) (t 0 2)
  have hA : (scalarMap k).mapMatrix A =
      skew (basePoint k t 0 0) (basePoint k t 0 1) (basePoint k t 0 2) := by
    ext i j
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [A, skew, basePoint]
  change (scalarMap k).mapMatrix ((1 - A) * (1 + A)⁻¹) = _
  have hunit : IsUnit (Matrix.det (1 + A)) :=
    isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (denominator_ne_zero_of_total_ne_zero k t ht 0)
  rw [map_mul, ThreeFrameCayleyLocalization.map_matrix_inv_of_isUnit
      (scalarMap k) (1 + A) hunit,
    map_sub, map_one, map_add, map_one, hA]
  rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealConstantGrid.specialized_substitution_eq_constantAction
statement:
theorem specialized_substitution_eq_constantAction
    (t : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → k)
    (ht : MvPolynomial.eval (fun q => t q.1 q.2) (totalDenominator k) ≠ 0)
    (p : CoordinateRing k) :
    evaluationAlong (scalarMap k)
        (evaluatedConjugatedFamily k (RingHom.id (F k)) (basePoint k t)) p =
      constantAction k (baseCayley k t)
        (baseCayley_orthogonal k t ht).transpose_mul
        (baseCayley_orthogonal k t ht).mul_transpose (rawToField k p)
proof:
:= by
  let Q := baseCayley k t
  let hQ := baseCayley_orthogonal k t ht
  have hhom :
      evaluationAlong (scalarMap k)
          (evaluatedConjugatedFamily k (RingHom.id (F k)) (basePoint k t)) =
        (constantAction k Q hQ.transpose_mul hQ.mul_transpose).toRingHom.comp
          (rawToField k) := by
    apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
    · intro c
      simp only [evaluationAlong, MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_C, RingHom.comp_apply]
      change scalarMap k c =
        constantAction k Q hQ.transpose_mul hQ.mul_transpose (scalarMap k c)
      exact (constantAction_scalar k Q hQ.transpose_mul hQ.mul_transpose c).symm
    · intro e
      cases e with
      | entry r i a b =>
          simp only [evaluationAlong, MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_X', RingHom.comp_apply]
          change evaluatedConjugatedFamily k (RingHom.id (F k))
            (basePoint k t) r i a b =
            constantAction k Q hQ.transpose_mul hQ.mul_transpose
              (universalFamily k r i a b)
          have hgen := congrFun (congrFun
            (RealLedgerInvariant.constantAction_universalFamily k Q
              hQ.transpose_mul hQ.mul_transpose r i) a) b
          rw [show evaluatedConjugatedFamily k (RingHom.id (F k))
              (basePoint k t) r i a b =
              ringConjugate ((scalarMap k).mapMatrix Q)
                (universalFamily k r i) a b from by
            unfold evaluatedConjugatedFamily
            rw [← scalarMap_baseCayley k t ht]
            rfl]
          exact hgen.symm
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun hhom p

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealConstantGrid.evalAway_crossExpression_eq_zero_of_constantInvariant
statement:
theorem evalAway_crossExpression_eq_zero_of_constantInvariant
    (a b : CoordinateRing k) (hb : rawToField k b ≠ 0)
    (hinv : IsConstantInvariant k (rawToField k a / rawToField k b))
    (t : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → k)
    (ht : MvPolynomial.eval (fun q => t q.1 q.2) (totalDenominator k) ≠ 0) :
    evalAway (RingHom.id (F k)) (basePoint k t)
      (basePoint_denominator_ne_zero k t ht) (crossExpression k a b) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let Q := baseCayley k t
  let hQ := baseCayley_orthogonal k t ht
  have hi := hinv Q hQ.transpose_mul hQ.mul_transpose
  have hbn : constantAction k Q hQ.transpose_mul hQ.mul_transpose
      (rawToField k b) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [map_zero] using
      (constantAction k Q hQ.transpose_mul hQ.mul_transpose).injective.ne hb
  have hcross :
      constantAction k Q hQ.transpose_mul hQ.mul_transpose (rawToField k a) *
          rawToField k b -
        constantAction k Q hQ.transpose_mul hQ.mul_transpose (rawToField k b) *
          rawToField k a = 0 := by
    have hdiv :
        constantAction k Q hQ.transpose_mul hQ.mul_transpose (rawToField k a) /
            constantAction k Q hQ.transpose_mul hQ.mul_transpose (rawToField k b) =
          rawToField k a / rawToField k b := by simpa using hi
    apply sub_eq_zero.mpr
    simpa only [mul_comm] using (div_eq_div_iff hbn hb).mp hdiv
  rw [evalAway_crossExpression]
  simp only [RingHom.id_comp, RingHom.id_apply]
  rw [specialized_substitution_eq_constantAction k t ht a,
    specialized_substitution_eq_constantAction k t ht b]
  exact hcross

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealPrimitiveFiniteRoots.exists_nonzero_diagonal
statement:
theorem exists_nonzero_diagonal (P : Mat3 K) (htrace : Matrix.trace P = 1) :
    ∃ j : Fin 3, P j j ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  push_neg at h
  have hz : Matrix.trace P = 0 := by
    rw [Matrix.trace_fin_three, h 0, h 1, h 2]
    ring
  rw [htrace] at hz
  exact one_ne_zero hz

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealPrimitiveFiniteRoots.exists_unit_columnProjector_eq_of_pivot
statement:
theorem exists_unit_columnProjector_eq_of_pivot
    (P : Mat3 K) (hsymm : Matrix.transpose P = P)
    (hidem : P * P = P) (htrace : Matrix.trace P = 1)
    (j : Fin 3) (hj : P j j ≠ 0) (t : K) (ht : t ^ 2 = P j j) :
    ∃ u : Fin 3 → K,
      (∑ i, u i * u i) = 1 ∧
      (∀ i l, P i l = u i * u l)
proof:
:= by
  have ht0 : t ≠ 0 := by
    intro ht0
    apply hj
    simpa [ht0] using ht.symm
  let u : Fin 3 → K := fun i => P i j / t
  have hminor :=
    minor_zero_of_symmetric_idempotent_trace_one P hsymm hidem htrace
  have hfactor : ∀ i l, P i l = u i * u l := by
    intro i l
    have hsymm_lj : P l j = P j l := by
      have h := congrFun (congrFun hsymm j) l
      simpa [Matrix.transpose_apply] using h
    dsimp [u]
    rw [div_mul_div_comm]
    apply (eq_div_iff (mul_ne_zero ht0 ht0)).2
    rw [← pow_two t, ht, hsymm_lj]
    exact hminor i l j
  refine ⟨u, ?_, hfactor⟩
  calc
    (∑ i, u i * u i) = Matrix.trace P := by
      simp [Matrix.trace_fin_three, Fin.sum_univ_succ, hfactor, add_assoc]
    _ = 1 := htrace

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealPrimitiveFiniteRoots.exists_orthogonal_of_symmetric_primitive_frame_finite_roots
statement:
theorem exists_orthogonal_of_symmetric_primitive_frame_finite_roots
    (P : Fin 3 → Mat3 K)
    (hsymm : ∀ i, Matrix.transpose (P i) = P i)
    (hidem : ∀ i, P i * P i = P i)
    (htrace : ∀ i, Matrix.trace (P i) = 1)
    (hsum : P 0 + P 1 + P 2 = 1)
    (hroot : ∀ i, ∃ j : Fin 3, ∃ t : K,
      P i j j ≠ 0 ∧ t ^ 2 = P i j j) :
    ∃ X : Mat3 K, IsOrthogonal X ∧
      ∀ i, columnProjector X i = P i
proof:
:= by
  choose j t hj ht using hroot
  choose u huNorm huFactor using fun i =>
    exists_unit_columnProjector_eq_of_pivot (P i) (hsymm i) (hidem i)
      (htrace i) (j i) (hj i) (t i) (ht i)
  let X : Mat3 K := fun r i => u i r
  have hproj : ∀ i, columnProjector X i = P i := by
    intro i
    ext r c
    simp only [columnProjector, X]
    exact (huFactor i r c).symm
  have hmul : X * Matrix.transpose X = 1 := by
    calc
      X * Matrix.transpose X =
          columnProjector X 0 + columnProjector X 1 + columnProjector X 2 := by
        ext r c
        simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, columnProjector,
          Fin.sum_univ_succ, add_assoc]
      _ = P 0 + P 1 + P 2 := by rw [hproj 0, hproj 1, hproj 2]
      _ = 1 := hsum
  refine ⟨X, ⟨?_, hmul⟩, hproj⟩
  exact mul_eq_one_comm.mp hmul

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RootWordCoverage.central_rescale_conjugation
statement:
theorem central_rescale_conjugation (M N X : Mat6 K) (r : K) (hr : r ≠ 0) :
    (r⁻¹ • M) * X * (r • N) = M * X * N
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, smul_smul]
  simp [hr]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RootWordCoverage.normalized_form
statement:
private theorem normalized_form (M : Mat6 K) (mu r : K) (hr : r ≠ 0)
    (hsq : r ^ 2 = mu)
    (hform : M.transpose * symplecticJ * M = mu • symplecticJ) :
    (r⁻¹ • M).transpose * symplecticJ * (r⁻¹ • M) = symplecticJ
proof:
:= by
  have hscale : (r⁻¹ * r⁻¹) * mu = 1 := by
    rw [← hsq, pow_two]
    field_simp [hr]
  simp only [Matrix.transpose_smul, Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, smul_smul]
  rw [hform, smul_smul, hscale, one_smul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RootWordCoverage.exists_twelve_word_of_multiplier_root
statement:
theorem exists_twelve_word_of_multiplier_root
    (M N : Mat6 K) (mu r : K)
    (hMN : M * N = 1) (hNM : N * M = 1) (hr : r ≠ 0)
    (hsq : r ^ 2 = mu)
    (hform : M.transpose * symplecticJ * M = mu • symplecticJ) :
    ∃ word : List (Step (K := K) (V := Vec6 K)), word.length = 12 ∧
      ∀ X : Mat6 K, wordMatrix word * X * inverseWordMatrix word = M * X * N
proof:
:= by
  let A : Mat6 K := r⁻¹ • M
  let B : Mat6 K := r • N
  have hAB : A * B = 1 := by
    simp [A, B, Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, smul_smul, hMN, hr]
  have hBA : B * A = 1 := by
    simp [A, B, Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, smul_smul, hNM, hr]
  have hA : A.transpose * symplecticJ * A = (1 : K) • symplecticJ := by
    simpa only [A, one_smul] using normalized_form M mu r hr hsq hform
  obtain ⟨schedule, hs⟩ :=
    exists_fixed_twelve_scalar_presentation_for_gsp_extension_agreement
      A B 1 hAB hBA one_ne_zero hA
  let word := List.ofFn schedule
  have hw : wordMatrix word = A := by
    simpa only [scalarSimilitude_one, Matrix.mul_one, word, wordMatrix,
      fixedTwelveMap] using hs.symm
  have hwi : inverseWordMatrix word = B := by
    calc
      inverseWordMatrix word = inverseWordMatrix word * 1 := (Matrix.mul_one _).symm
      _ = inverseWordMatrix word * (A * B) := by rw [hAB]
      _ = (inverseWordMatrix word * A) * B := (Matrix.mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ = B := by rw [← hw, inverse_mul_wordMatrix, Matrix.one_mul]
  refine ⟨word, by exact List.length_ofFn, ?_⟩
  intro X
  rw [hw, hwi]
  exact central_rescale_conjugation M N X r hr

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RootWordCoverage.map_symplecticJ
statement:
private theorem map_symplecticJ
    {L : Type u} [Field L] [CharZero L] (f : K →+* L) :
    f.mapMatrix (symplecticJ : Mat6 K) = symplecticJ
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  rcases i with i | i <;> rcases j with j | j <;>
    simp [symplecticJ, Matrix.one_apply]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RootWordCoverage.map_similitude_form
statement:
private theorem map_similitude_form
    {L : Type u} [Field L] [CharZero L] (f : K →+* L)
    (M : Mat6 K) (mu : K)
    (hform : M.transpose * symplecticJ * M = mu • symplecticJ) :
    (f.mapMatrix M).transpose * symplecticJ * f.mapMatrix M =
      f mu • symplecticJ
proof:
:= by
  have ht : f.mapMatrix M.transpose = (f.mapMatrix M).transpose := rfl
  have hs : f.mapMatrix (mu • (symplecticJ : Mat6 K)) =
      f mu • f.mapMatrix (symplecticJ : Mat6 K) := by
    ext i j
    exact f.map_mul mu (symplecticJ i j)
  have h := congrArg f.mapMatrix hform
  simp only [map_mul, ht, hs, map_symplecticJ] at h
  exact h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RootWordCoverage.exists_twelve_word_after_root
statement:
theorem exists_twelve_word_after_root
    (M N : Mat6 K) (mu : K)
    (hMN : M * N = 1) (hNM : N * M = 1) (hmu : mu ≠ 0)
    (hform : M.transpose * symplecticJ * M = mu • symplecticJ) :
    ∃ R : OneRootField K mu, ∃ _ : CharZero R.Carrier,
      ∃ word : List (Step (K := R.Carrier) (V := Vec6 R.Carrier)),
        word.length = 12 ∧ ∀ X : Mat6 R.Carrier,
          wordMatrix word * X * inverseWordMatrix word =
            R.embedding.mapMatrix M * X * R.embedding.mapMatrix N
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R⟩ := oneRootField_nonempty K mu
  letI : CharZero R.Carrier := charZero_of_embedding R.embedding
  have hr : R.root ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    have hzero : R.embedding mu = 0 := by simpa [hz] using R.root_sq.symm
    exact hmu (R.embedding.injective (hzero.trans R.embedding.map_zero.symm))
  have hMN' : R.embedding.mapMatrix M * R.embedding.mapMatrix N = 1 := by
    rw [← map_mul, hMN, map_one]
  have hNM' : R.embedding.mapMatrix N * R.embedding.mapMatrix M = 1 := by
    rw [← map_mul, hNM, map_one]
  obtain ⟨word, hlen, hword⟩ := exists_twelve_word_of_multiplier_root
    (R.embedding.mapMatrix M) (R.embedding.mapMatrix N) (R.embedding mu) R.root
    hMN' hNM' hr R.root_sq (map_similitude_form R.embedding M mu hform)
  exact ⟨R, inferInstance, word, hlen, hword⟩

proof:

    structuredEquiv (diagonal d1 d2 d3)

    jordanAut G (f0EncoderB x) = f0EncoderB (actChart G x)
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨jordanAut_f0Diagonal G,
    jordanAut_encoderA_actChart G x, jordanAut_encoderB_actChart G x⟩

name: CompactOneBit.polar_basis_sum
statement:
theorem polar_basis_sum (x y : Coord) :
    (∑ j : Fin 27, (polar x x (Pi.single j 1) / 2) * y j) =
      polar x x y / 2
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (∑ j : Fin 27, (polar x x (Pi.single j 1) / 2) * y j) =
        ∑ j : Fin 27,
          y j * polarRightLinear x x ((Pi.basisFun ℚ (Fin 27)) j) / 2 := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      simp only [Pi.basisFun_apply, polarRightLinear_apply]
      ring
    _ = polarRightLinear x x
          (∑ j : Fin 27, y j • (Pi.basisFun ℚ (Fin 27)) j) / 2 := by
      simp only [map_sum, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, div_eq_mul_inv,
        Finset.sum_mul]
    _ = polar x x y / 2 := by
      have hy : (∑ j : Fin 27, y j • (Pi.basisFun ℚ (Fin 27)) j) = y := by
        simpa only [Pi.basisFun_repr] using
          (Pi.basisFun ℚ (Fin 27)).sum_repr y
      rw [hy]
      rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.WitnessChart.witnessCharts_moment_eq
statement:
theorem witnessCharts_moment_eq :
    moment (residualPairOfChart witnessChartM) =
      moment (residualPairOfChart witnessChart1)
proof:
:= by
  unfold moment
  rw [witnessChart1_X, witnessChartM_X, witnessChart1_A, witnessChartM_A,
    Matrix.mul_one]
  ext i j
  simp only [Matrix.mul_diagonal]
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    norm_num [witnessAM, witnessA1, witnessScale]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.WitnessChart.witnessChartM_deltaStar
statement:
theorem witnessChartM_deltaStar :
    deltaStar (residualPairOfChart witnessChartM) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg Matrix.det witnessCharts_moment_eq
  simp only [moment, Matrix.det_mul] at h
  change deltaStar (residualPairOfChart witnessChartM) *
      delta (residualPairOfChart witnessChartM) =
    deltaStar (residualPairOfChart witnessChart1) *
      delta (residualPairOfChart witnessChart1) at h
  rw [witnessChart1_delta, witnessChart1_deltaStar, witnessChartM_delta] at h
  norm_num [witnessScale] at h
  linarith

name: AlbertLean.Generic.WitnessChart.witnessChart1_open
statement: theorem witnessChart1_open : ResidualOpen (residualPairOfChart witnessChart1)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [witnessChart1_delta]
    norm_num
  · rw [witnessChart1_deltaStar]
    norm_num [witnessScale]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.WitnessChart.witnessChartM_open
statement: theorem witnessChartM_open : ResidualOpen (residualPairOfChart witnessChartM)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [witnessChartM_delta]
    norm_num [witnessScale]
  · rw [witnessChartM_deltaStar]
    norm_num

name: AlbertLean.Generic.WitnessChart.witnessChart1_branch
statement:
theorem witnessChart1_branch :
    delta (residualPairOfChart witnessChart1) ≠
      deltaStar (residualPairOfChart witnessChart1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [witnessChart1_delta, witnessChart1_deltaStar]
  norm_num [witnessScale]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.WitnessChart.witnessCharts_sameResidualBase
statement:
theorem witnessCharts_sameResidualBase :
    sameResidualBase (residualPairOfChart witnessChart1)
      (residualPairOfChart witnessChartM)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact witnessCharts_moment_eq
  · change delta (residualPairOfChart witnessChartM) +
        deltaStar (residualPairOfChart witnessChartM) =
      delta (residualPairOfChart witnessChart1) +
        deltaStar (residualPairOfChart witnessChart1)
    rw [witnessChart1_delta, witnessChart1_deltaStar,
      witnessChartM_delta, witnessChartM_deltaStar]
    exact add_comm _ _

name: AlbertLean.Generic.WitnessChart.witnessCharts_detector_ne
statement:
theorem witnessCharts_detector_ne :
    traceCubeDetector (chartWitnessTriple witnessChart1) ≠
      traceCubeDetector (chartWitnessTriple witnessChartM)
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartWitnessTriple_witnessChart1, chartWitnessTriple_witnessChartM]
  exact witnessDetectorValues.2.2

name: AlbertLean.Generic.WitnessChart.lawful_residual_fibre_detector_separated_nonempty
statement:
theorem lawful_residual_fibre_detector_separated_nonempty :
    ∃ x y : ExplicitFrameChart ℚ,
      LawfulFrameTriple (chartWitnessTriple x) ∧
      LawfulFrameTriple (chartWitnessTriple y) ∧
      ResidualOpen (residualPairOfChart x) ∧
      ResidualOpen (residualPairOfChart y) ∧
      sameResidualBase (residualPairOfChart x) (residualPairOfChart y) ∧
      y = chartWithResidualPair x (residualPairOfChart y) ∧
      traceCubeDetector (chartWitnessTriple x) ≠
        traceCubeDetector (chartWitnessTriple y)
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨witnessChart1, witnessChartM, witnessChart1_lawful, witnessChartM_lawful,
    witnessChart1_open, witnessChartM_open, witnessCharts_sameResidualBase,
    witnessChartM_eq_reinsert, witnessCharts_detector_ne⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawFiniteOpen.rawLedgerSubstitution_X
statement:
@[simp] theorem rawLedgerSubstitution_X (v : LedgerVar) :

proof:

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawFiniteOpen.chartEvaluation_rawLedgerAssignment
statement:
theorem chartEvaluation_rawLedgerAssignment (v : LedgerVar) :
    chartEvaluation k (rawLedgerAssignment k v) = ledgerAssignment k v
proof:
:= by
  have h0 := chartEvaluation_rawLabelledLedger k
  have h1 := labelledLedger_mapTriple (chartSourceTriple k)
  have h2 := sourceLabelledLedger_residual
    (encoderA (GenericFieldChart.genericChart k))
    (encoderB (GenericFieldChart.genericChart k))
  have h :
      { P := fun i j => chartEvaluation k (pairP k i j)
        Q := fun j l => chartEvaluation k (pairQ k j l)
        R := fun l i => chartEvaluation k (pairR k l i)
        C0 := fun i j l => chartEvaluation k (centeredTriple k i j l) } =
      copySourceLedger (genericLedger k) := by
    calc
      _ = labelledLedger (mapTriple (chartSourceTriple k)) := h0
      _ = sourceLabelledLedger (chartSourceTriple k) := h1
      _ = copySourceLedger (genericLedger k) := by
        simpa [chartSourceTriple, genericLedger] using h2
  rcases v with ⟨i,j⟩ | v
  · simpa [rawLedgerAssignment, ledgerAssignment, copySourceLedger] using
      congrFun (congrFun (congrArg LabelledLedger.P h) i) j
  · rcases v with ⟨j,l⟩ | v
    · simpa [rawLedgerAssignment, ledgerAssignment, copySourceLedger] using
        congrFun (congrFun (congrArg LabelledLedger.Q h) j) l
    · rcases v with ⟨l,i⟩ | ⟨i,j,l⟩
      · simpa [rawLedgerAssignment, ledgerAssignment, copySourceLedger] using
          congrFun (congrFun (congrArg LabelledLedger.R h) l) i
      · simpa [rawLedgerAssignment, ledgerAssignment, copySourceLedger] using
          congrFun (congrFun (congrFun
            (congrArg LabelledLedger.C0 h) i) j) l

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawFiniteOpen.chartEvaluation_comp_rawLedgerSubstitution
statement:
theorem chartEvaluation_comp_rawLedgerSubstitution :
    (chartEvaluation k).comp (rawLedgerSubstitution k) = ledgerEval k
proof:
:= by
  apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
  · intro a
    simp [rawLedgerSubstitution, chartEvaluation, evaluationAlong, ledgerEval]
  · intro v
    simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, rawLedgerSubstitution_X, ledgerEval_X]
    exact chartEvaluation_rawLedgerAssignment k v

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawFiniteOpen.chartEvaluation_rawBetaOpen_ne_zero

    chartEvaluation k (rawBetaOpen k) ≠ 0

      ledgerEval k (betaOpen k) := by
    simpa only [RingHom.comp_apply] using DFunLike.congr_fun
      (chartEvaluation_comp_rawLedgerSubstitution k) (betaOpen k)
  change chartEvaluation k (rawLedgerSubstitution k (betaOpen k)) ≠ 0
  rw [h]
  exact ledgerEval_betaOpen_ne_zero k

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawFiniteOpen.reducedBetaOpen_ne_zero

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawFiniteOpen.fractionBetaOpen_ne_zero

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedBlockConjugacy.all_blocks_conjugate
statement:
theorem all_blocks_conjugate (B C : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Mat2 K)
    (p q : Fin 3 → K) (hp1 : p 1 ≠ 0) (hp2 : p 2 ≠ 0)
    (hdB : ∀ i, B i i = q i • (1 : Mat2 K))
    (hrB : ∀ i, B i 0 + B i 1 + B i 2 = 0)
    (hcB : ∀ j, p 0 • B 0 j + p 1 • B 1 j + p 2 • B 2 j = 0)
    (hdC : ∀ i, C i i = q i • (1 : Mat2 K))
    (hrC : ∀ i, C i 0 + C i 1 + C i 2 = 0)
    (hcC : ∀ j, p 0 • C 0 j + p 1 • C 1 j + p 2 • C 2 j = 0)
    (T S : Mat2 K) (hTS : T * S = 1)
    (hX : B 0 1 * T = T * C 0 1) :
    ∀ i j, B i j = T * C i j * S
proof:
:= by
  let D : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Mat2 K := fun i j => T * C i j * S
  have hdiag (i : Fin 3) : D i i = q i • (1 : Mat2 K) := by
    simp only [D, hdC, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_one, hTS]
  have hrow (i : Fin 3) : D i 0 + D i 1 + D i 2 = 0 := by
    change T * C i 0 * S + T * C i 1 * S + T * C i 2 * S = 0
    rw [← Matrix.add_mul, ← Matrix.add_mul, ← Matrix.mul_add, ← Matrix.mul_add,
      hrC, Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.zero_mul]
  have hcol (j : Fin 3) : p 0 • D 0 j + p 1 • D 1 j + p 2 • D 2 j = 0 := by
    change p 0 • (T * C 0 j * S) + p 1 • (T * C 1 j * S) +
      p 2 • (T * C 2 j * S) = 0
    have h := congrArg (fun X : Mat2 K => T * X * S) (hcC j)
    simpa only [Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul,
      Matrix.mul_zero, Matrix.zero_mul] using h
  have hpivot : B 0 1 = D 0 1 := by
    change B 0 1 = T * C 0 1 * S
    calc
      B 0 1 = (B 0 1 * T) * S := by rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, hTS, Matrix.mul_one]
      _ = T * C 0 1 * S := by rw [hX]
  have h := blocks_eq_of_pivot_eq B D p q hp1 hp2 hdB hrB hcB hdiag hrow hcol hpivot
  intro i j
  exact congrFun (congrFun h i) j

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedBlockConjugacy.exists_common_conjugator
statement:
theorem exists_common_conjugator (B C : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Mat2 K)
    (p q : Fin 3 → K) (hp1 : p 1 ≠ 0) (hp2 : p 2 ≠ 0)
    (hdB : ∀ i, B i i = q i • (1 : Mat2 K))
    (hrB : ∀ i, B i 0 + B i 1 + B i 2 = 0)
    (hcB : ∀ j, p 0 • B 0 j + p 1 • B 1 j + p 2 • B 2 j = 0)
    (hdC : ∀ i, C i i = q i • (1 : Mat2 K))
    (hrC : ∀ i, C i 0 + C i 1 + C i 2 = 0)
    (hcC : ∀ j, p 0 • C 0 j + p 1 • C 1 j + p 2 • C 2 j = 0)
    (hB : B 0 1 0 1 ≠ 0) (hC : C 0 1 0 1 ≠ 0)
    (ht : trace2 (B 0 1) = trace2 (C 0 1))
    (hd : determinant (B 0 1) = determinant (C 0 1)) :
    ∃ T S : Mat2 K, T * S = 1 ∧ S * T = 1 ∧
      ∀ i j, B i j = T * C i j * S
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hTS, hST, hX⟩ := rational_intertwiner (B 0 1) (C 0 1) hB hC ht hd
  exact ⟨_, _, hTS, hST,
    all_blocks_conjugate B C p q hp1 hp2 hdB hrB hcB hdC hrC hcC _ _ hTS hX⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TwoCopyCoefficientDescent.sumAlgEquiv_firstCopy
statement:
private theorem sumAlgEquiv_firstCopy (p : MvPolynomial ι k) :
    sumAlgEquiv k ι ι (firstCopy p) = map (C : k →+* MvPolynomial ι k) p
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun f => f p) (sumAlgEquiv_comp_rename_inl (R := k)
    (S₁ := ι) (S₂ := ι))
  change sumAlgEquiv k ι ι (rename Sum.inl p) =
    map (C : k →+* MvPolynomial ι k) p at h
  exact h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TwoCopyCoefficientDescent.sumAlgEquiv_secondCopy
statement:
private theorem sumAlgEquiv_secondCopy (p : MvPolynomial ι k) :
    sumAlgEquiv k ι ι (secondCopy p) = C p
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun f => f p) (sumAlgEquiv_comp_rename_inr (R := k)
    (S₁ := ι) (S₂ := ι))
  change sumAlgEquiv k ι ι (rename Sum.inr p) = C p at h
  exact h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TwoCopyCoefficientDescent.proportional_of_two_copy_cross_mul
statement:
theorem proportional_of_two_copy_cross_mul
    (A B : MvPolynomial ι k) (α : ι →₀ ℕ) (hBα : B.coeff α ≠ 0)
    (hcross : firstCopy A * secondCopy B = secondCopy A * firstCopy B) :
    A = C (A.coeff α / B.coeff α) * B
proof:
:= by
  have hcoeff := congrArg
    (fun p : MvPolynomial (ι ⊕ ι) k => (sumAlgEquiv k ι ι p).coeff α) hcross
  have hproportional : C (A.coeff α) * B = C (B.coeff α) * A := by
    simpa only [map_mul, sumAlgEquiv_firstCopy, sumAlgEquiv_secondCopy,
      coeff_C_mul, coeff_map, RingHom.coe_coe, mul_comm] using hcoeff
  apply (mul_left_cancel₀ (C_ne_zero.mpr hBα))
  calc
    C (B.coeff α) * A = C (A.coeff α) * B := hproportional.symm
    _ = C (B.coeff α) * (C (A.coeff α / B.coeff α) * B) := by
      rw [← mul_assoc, ← C_mul]
      congr 2
      rw [mul_comm, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hBα]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TwoCopyCoefficientDescent.fraction_eq_coefficient_ratio
statement:
theorem fraction_eq_coefficient_ratio
    (A B : MvPolynomial ι k) (α : ι →₀ ℕ) (hBα : B.coeff α ≠ 0)
    (hcross : firstCopy A * secondCopy B = secondCopy A * firstCopy B) :
    algebraMap (MvPolynomial ι k) (FractionRing (MvPolynomial ι k)) A /
        algebraMap (MvPolynomial ι k) (FractionRing (MvPolynomial ι k)) B =
      algebraMap k (FractionRing (MvPolynomial ι k)) (A.coeff α / B.coeff α)
proof:
:= by
  have hAB := proportional_of_two_copy_cross_mul A B α hBα hcross
  have hB : B ≠ 0 := fun hzero => hBα (by simp [hzero])
  have hmapB : algebraMap (MvPolynomial ι k)
      (FractionRing (MvPolynomial ι k)) B ≠ 0 :=
    by simpa only [map_zero] using
      (IsFractionRing.injective (MvPolynomial ι k)
        (FractionRing (MvPolynomial ι k))).ne hB
  calc
    algebraMap (MvPolynomial ι k) (FractionRing (MvPolynomial ι k)) A /
          algebraMap (MvPolynomial ι k) (FractionRing (MvPolynomial ι k)) B =
        algebraMap (MvPolynomial ι k) (FractionRing (MvPolynomial ι k))
            (C (A.coeff α / B.coeff α) * B) /
          algebraMap (MvPolynomial ι k) (FractionRing (MvPolynomial ι k)) B := by
      exact congrArg
        (fun P => algebraMap (MvPolynomial ι k) (FractionRing (MvPolynomial ι k)) P /
          algebraMap (MvPolynomial ι k) (FractionRing (MvPolynomial ι k)) B) hAB
    _ = algebraMap (MvPolynomial ι k) (FractionRing (MvPolynomial ι k))
        (C (A.coeff α / B.coeff α)) := by
      rw [map_mul, mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ hmapB]
    _ = algebraMap k (FractionRing (MvPolynomial ι k))
        (A.coeff α / B.coeff α) := by
      rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k (MvPolynomial ι k), MvPolynomial.algebraMap_eq]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexDephasedPair.det_dephased
statement:

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexDephasedPair.cofactor_mul
statement:

    cofactorInverseNumerator a b c d * dephased a b c d =
      delta a b c d • (1 : Mat3 K)
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [cofactorInverseNumerator, dephased, delta, Matrix.mul_apply,
      Fin.sum_univ_succ] <;> ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexDephasedPair.dephased_mul_cofactor
statement:
theorem dephased_mul_cofactor (a b c d : K) :
    dephased a b c d * cofactorInverseNumerator a b c d =
      delta a b c d • (1 : Mat3 K)
proof:
:= by
  ext i j

      Fin.sum_univ_succ] <;> ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexDephasedPair.dephased_inv_eq
statement:
theorem dephased_inv_eq (a b c d : K) (hΔ : delta a b c d ≠ 0) :
    (dephased a b c d)⁻¹ =
      (delta a b c d)⁻¹ • cofactorInverseNumerator a b c d
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.inv_eq_left_inv
  rw [Matrix.smul_mul, cofactor_mul, smul_smul]
  simp [hΔ]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexDephasedPair.overlap_table
statement:
theorem overlap_table (a b c d : K) (hΔ : delta a b c d ≠ 0) :
    (fun i j => overlap a b c d i j) =
      !![(a*d-b*c)/delta a b c d,
          (b-d)/delta a b c d, (c-a)/delta a b c d;
         (c-d)/delta a b c d,
          a*(d-1)/delta a b c d, b*(1-c)/delta a b c d;
         (b-a)/delta a b c d,
          c*(1-b)/delta a b c d, d*(a-1)/delta a b c d]
proof:
:= by
  funext i j
  unfold overlap
  rw [dephased_inv_eq a b c d hΔ]
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [dephased, cofactorInverseNumerator, div_eq_mul_inv] <;> ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexDephasedPair.nu_mul_delta
statement:
theorem nu_mul_delta (a b c d : K) (hΔ : delta a b c d ≠ 0) :
    let p
proof:
:= overlap a b c d 0 0
    let q := overlap a b c d 0 1
    let r := overlap a b c d 1 0
    let s := overlap a b c d 1 1
    nu p q r s d * delta a b c d = d * (d - 1) := by
  rw [show overlap a b c d 0 0 = (a*d-b*c)/delta a b c d by
        simpa using congrFun (congrFun (overlap_table a b c d hΔ) 0) 0,
      show overlap a b c d 0 1 = (b-d)/delta a b c d by
        simpa using congrFun (congrFun (overlap_table a b c d hΔ) 0) 1,
      show overlap a b c d 1 0 = (c-d)/delta a b c d by
        simpa using congrFun (congrFun (overlap_table a b c d hΔ) 1) 0,
      show overlap a b c d 1 1 = a*(d-1)/delta a b c d by
        simpa using congrFun (congrFun (overlap_table a b c d hΔ) 1) 1]
  unfold nu
  field_simp
  unfold delta
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexDephasedPair.pairQuadratic_root
statement:
theorem pairQuadratic_root (a b c d : K) (hΔ : delta a b c d ≠ 0) :
    pairQuadratic (overlap a b c d 0 0) (overlap a b c d 0 1)
      (overlap a b c d 1 0) (overlap a b c d 1 1) d = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [show overlap a b c d 0 0 = (a*d-b*c)/delta a b c d by
        simpa using congrFun (congrFun (overlap_table a b c d hΔ) 0) 0,
      show overlap a b c d 0 1 = (b-d)/delta a b c d by
        simpa using congrFun (congrFun (overlap_table a b c d hΔ) 0) 1,
      show overlap a b c d 1 0 = (c-d)/delta a b c d by
        simpa using congrFun (congrFun (overlap_table a b c d hΔ) 1) 0,
      show overlap a b c d 1 1 = a*(d-1)/delta a b c d by
        simpa using congrFun (congrFun (overlap_table a b c d hΔ) 1) 1]
  unfold pairQuadratic
  field_simp
  unfold delta
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexDephasedPair.reconstruct_entries
statement:
theorem reconstruct_entries (a b c d : K) (hΔ : delta a b c d ≠ 0)
    (hnu : nu (overlap a b c d 0 0) (overlap a b c d 0 1)
      (overlap a b c d 1 0) (overlap a b c d 1 1) d ≠ 0) :
    let p
proof:
:= overlap a b c d 0 0
    let q := overlap a b c d 0 1
    let r := overlap a b c d 1 0
    let s := overlap a b c d 1 1
    let χ := d * (d - 1) / nu p q r s d
    a = s * d / nu p q r s d ∧ b = d + q * χ ∧ c = d + r * χ := by
  have hnΔ := nu_mul_delta a b c d hΔ
  have hχ : d * (d - 1) /
      nu (overlap a b c d 0 0) (overlap a b c d 0 1)
        (overlap a b c d 1 0) (overlap a b c d 1 1) d =
      delta a b c d := by
    apply (div_eq_iff hnu).2
    simpa [mul_comm] using hnΔ.symm
  dsimp only
  rw [hχ]
  have ht := overlap_table a b c d hΔ
  have hs : overlap a b c d 1 1 = a * (d - 1) / delta a b c d := by
    simpa using congrFun (congrFun ht 1) 1
  have hq : overlap a b c d 0 1 = (b - d) / delta a b c d := by
    simpa using congrFun (congrFun ht 0) 1
  have hr : overlap a b c d 1 0 = (c - d) / delta a b c d := by
    simpa using congrFun (congrFun ht 1) 0
  constructor
  · apply (eq_div_iff hnu).2
    apply mul_right_cancel₀ hΔ
    rw [mul_assoc a, hnΔ, hs]
    field_simp
  · constructor
    · rw [hq, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hΔ]
      ring
    · rw [hr, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hΔ]
      ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawBranchOpen.evalQ_branchElement_oriented
statement:
private theorem evalQ_branchElement_oriented :
    evalQ k (branchElement k) =
      (deltaX (genericChart k).s1 (genericChart k).s2
          (genericChart k).c1 (genericChart k).c2 -
        deltaStarA (genericChart k).s1 (genericChart k).s2
          (genericChart k).c1 (genericChart k).c2) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hfiniteS := evalQ_finiteS k
  have hmoment :
      (UniformMomentFiniteAlgebra.moment k).map (evalQ k) =
        AlbertLean.Residual.FrameIdeal.matrixM (genericChart k) :=
    evalQ_moment_eq_matrixM k
  have hdet :
      evalQ k (Matrix.det (UniformMomentFiniteAlgebra.moment k)) =
        Matrix.det (AlbertLean.Residual.FrameIdeal.matrixM (genericChart k)) := by
    calc
      _ = Matrix.det ((UniformMomentFiniteAlgebra.moment k).map (evalQ k)) :=
        RingHom.map_det (evalQ k) (UniformMomentFiniteAlgebra.moment k)
      _ = _ := congrArg Matrix.det hmoment
  have hfour : evalQ k (4 : Q k) = (4 : FunctionField k) :=
    map_ofNat (evalQ k) 4
  simp only [branchElement, map_sub, map_pow, map_mul]
  rw [hfour, hfiniteS, hdet, AlbertLean.Residual.FrameIdeal.matrixM,
    det_momentMatrix_eq_deltaX_mul_deltaStarA]
  ring

  have hparams : (genericOpen k).toParameters = fieldParameters k := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertRawBranchOpen.genericEvalLocal_norm
statement:
theorem genericEvalLocal_norm (z : Q k) :
    genericEvalLocal k (QuadraticAlgebra.norm z) =
      evalQ k z * tau k (evalQ k z)
proof:
:= by
  have heval : evalQ k z =
      genericEvalLocal k z.re + genericEvalLocal k z.im * kappa k := by
    rw [← QuadraticAlgebra.re_smul_add_im_smul z]
    simp [Algebra.smul_def, evalQ_algebraMap, evalQ_omega]
  have htau : tau k (evalQ k z) =
      genericEvalLocal k z.re - genericEvalLocal k z.im * kappa k := by
    rw [heval]
    simp [tau_genericEvalLocal, tau_kappa, sub_eq_add_neg]
  rw [htau, heval, QuadraticAlgebra.norm_def]
  simp only [map_sub, map_add, map_mul, map_pow, map_zero,
    genericEvalLocal_loc, ledgerEval_discr_eq_kappa_sq]
  ring
