name: AlbertLean.Generic.TitsLabelledLedger.hasProjectorLabels_of_tauFrame
statement:
theorem hasProjectorLabels_of_tauFrame (f : Fin 3 → Albert K)
    (hf : TauFrame f) : HasProjectorLabels (f 2 - f 0) f
proof:
:= by
  rcases hf with ⟨_, hid, hsum, h01, h02, h12⟩
  have htwo : ∀ x : Albert K, x + x = 0 → x = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    have h := congrArg (fun y : Albert K => ⅟(2 : K) • y) hx
    simpa only [← two_smul K x, smul_zero, smul_smul,
      invOf_mul_self, one_smul] using h
  rcases FrameEncoder.encoder_identities (f 0) (f 1) (f 2)
      (fun x y => mul_comm x y) htwo (hid 0) (hid 1) (hid 2) hsum with
    ⟨_, _, hm, hmid, hp⟩
  rcases FrameEncoder.literal_projectors (K := K) (f 0) (f 1) (f 2) (f 2 - f 0)
      (by norm_num) hm hmid hp with ⟨h0, h1, h2⟩
  intro i
  fin_cases i <;> assumption

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TitsLabelledLedger.first_components_eq_of_labelledLedger_eq
statement:
theorem first_components_eq_of_labelledLedger_eq
    {a d : Fin 3 → Mat3 K} (f : Fin 3 → Mat3 K)
    (S : RawSystem a) (T : RawSystem d)
    (hsum : f 0 + f 1 + f 2 = 1)
    (hsquare : encoder (f 0) (f 2) * encoder (f 0) (f 2) = f 0 + f 2)
    (hdet : Matrix.det
      (grading * encoder (f 0) (f 2) - encoder (f 0) (f 2) * grading) ≠ 0)
    (hE : HasProjectorLabels (embed (grading : Mat3 K)) (fun i => embed (diagonalUnit i)))
    (hF : HasProjectorLabels (embed (encoder (f 0) (f 2))) (fun i => embed (f i)))
    (hS : HasProjectorLabels (rawFrame S 2 - rawFrame S 0) (rawFrame S))
    (hT : HasProjectorLabels (rawFrame T 2 - rawFrame T 0) (rawFrame T))
    (hledger : labelledLedger (ledgerTriple f S) = labelledLedger (ledgerTriple f T)) :
    a = d
proof:
:= by
  funext l
  apply firstComponent_eq_of_joint_traces f (a l, S.b l, S.c l)
    (d l, T.b l, T.c l) hsum hsquare hdet
  intro i j
  have hq := congrArg (fun L : LabelledLedger K => L.Q j l) hledger
  have hr := congrArg (fun L : LabelledLedger K => L.R l i) hledger
  have hc := congrArg (fun L : LabelledLedger K => L.C0 i j l) hledger
  simp only [labelledLedger, ledgerTriple, Matrix.cons_val_zero,
    Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.vecHead, Matrix.vecTail,
    Function.comp_apply, Fin.succ_zero_eq_one] at hq hr hc
  rw [hF j, hS l, hT l] at hq
  rw [hE i, hS l, hT l] at hr
  rw [hE i, hF j, hS l, hT l] at hc
  change TauCeti.AlbertAlgebra.trace
      (embed (diagonalUnit i) * (embed (f j) * rawFrame S l)) =
    TauCeti.AlbertAlgebra.trace
      (embed (diagonalUnit i) * (embed (f j) * rawFrame T l))
  rw [hq, hr] at hc
  exact sub_left_inj.mp (add_right_cancel hc)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TitsLabelledLedger.three_labelledLedgers_related_pair
statement:
theorem three_labelledLedgers_related_pair
    {a d e : Fin 3 → Mat3 K} (f : Fin 3 → Mat3 K)
    (S : RawSystem a) (T : RawSystem d) (W : RawSystem e)
    (hsum : f 0 + f 1 + f 2 = 1)
    (hsquare : encoder (f 0) (f 2) * encoder (f 0) (f 2) = f 0 + f 2)
    (hdet : Matrix.det
      (grading * encoder (f 0) (f 2) - encoder (f 0) (f 2) * grading) ≠ 0)
    (hE : HasProjectorLabels (embed (grading : Mat3 K)) (fun i => embed (diagonalUnit i)))
    (hF : HasProjectorLabels (embed (encoder (f 0) (f 2))) (fun i => embed (f i)))
    (hSlab : HasProjectorLabels (rawFrame S 2 - rawFrame S 0) (rawFrame S))
    (hTlab : HasProjectorLabels (rawFrame T 2 - rawFrame T 0) (rawFrame T))
    (hWlab : HasProjectorLabels (rawFrame W 2 - rawFrame W 0) (rawFrame W))
    (hST : labelledLedger (ledgerTriple f S) = labelledLedger (ledgerTriple f T))
    (hSW : labelledLedger (ledgerTriple f S) = labelledLedger (ledgerTriple f W))
    (hS : OnReconstructionOpen S) (hT : OnReconstructionOpen T)
    (hW : OnReconstructionOpen W) :
    RelatedFixingFirst (rawFrame S) (rawFrame T) ∨
    RelatedFixingFirst (rawFrame S) (rawFrame W) ∨
    RelatedFixingFirst (rawFrame T) (rawFrame W)
proof:
:= by
  have haT := first_components_eq_of_labelledLedger_eq f S T hsum hsquare hdet
    hE hF hSlab hTlab hST
  have haW := first_components_eq_of_labelledLedger_eq f S W hsum hsquare hdet
    hE hF hSlab hWlab hSW
  subst d
  subst e
  exact three_rawTriples_related_pair S T W hS hT hW

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ScalarFibre.two_column_coefficients_zero
statement:
theorem two_column_coefficients_zero
    (x y : Vec3 K) (p q : Fin 3) (α β : K)
    (hminor : x p * y q - x q * y p ≠ 0)
    (hp : α * x p + β * y p = 0)
    (hq : α * x q + β * y q = 0) :
    α = 0 ∧ β = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hα : α * (x p * y q - x q * y p) = 0 := by
    linear_combination y q * hp - y p * hq
  have hβ : β * (x p * y q - x q * y p) = 0 := by
    linear_combination x p * hq - x q * hp
  exact ⟨(mul_eq_zero.mp hα).resolve_right hminor,
    (mul_eq_zero.mp hβ).resolve_right hminor⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ScalarFibre.three_scalars_eq_of_minor
statement:
theorem three_scalars_eq_of_minor
    (u : Fin 3 → Vec3 K) (t : Fin 3 → K) (p q : Fin 3)
    (hsum : ThreeSumZero u)
    (hscaled : ThreeScaledSumZero t u)
    (hminor : u 0 p * u 1 q - u 0 q * u 1 p ≠ 0) :
    t 0 = t 1 ∧ t 1 = t 2
proof:
:= by
  have hp : (t 0 - t 2) * u 0 p + (t 1 - t 2) * u 1 p = 0 := by
    linear_combination hscaled p - t 2 * hsum p
  have hq : (t 0 - t 2) * u 0 q + (t 1 - t 2) * u 1 q = 0 := by
    linear_combination hscaled q - t 2 * hsum q
  obtain ⟨h0, h1⟩ :=
    two_column_coefficients_zero (u 0) (u 1) p q
      (t 0 - t 2) (t 1 - t 2) hminor hp hq
  constructor
  · exact (sub_eq_zero.mp h0).trans (sub_eq_zero.mp h1).symm
  · exact sub_eq_zero.mp h1

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ScalarFibre.common_frame_scalar_fibre
statement:
theorem common_frame_scalar_fibre
    (a : Fin 3 → Mat3 K)
    (u v u' v' : Fin 3 → Vec3 K)
    (hblock : ∀ i, a i * a i - a i = -(hat (u i) * hat (v i)))
    (hblock' : ∀ i, a i * a i - a i = -(hat (u' i) * hat (v' i)))
    (htrace : ∀ i, Matrix.trace (a i) = 1)
    (hadj : ∀ i, Matrix.adjugate (a i) ≠ 0)
    (hsumu : ThreeSumZero u) (hsumu' : ThreeSumZero u')
    (hsumv : ThreeSumZero v) (hsumv' : ThreeSumZero v')
    (hrankTwo :
      (∃ p q, u 0 p * u 1 q - u 0 q * u 1 p ≠ 0) ∨
      (∃ p q, v 0 p * v 1 q - v 0 q * v 1 p ≠ 0)) :
    ∃ t : K, t ≠ 0 ∧
      (∀ i, u' i = t • u i) ∧ (∀ i, v' i = t⁻¹ • v i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  choose t ht hu hv using fun i =>
    same_a_scalar_fibre (a i) (u i) (v i) (u' i) (v' i)
      (hblock i) (hblock' i) (htrace i) (hadj i)
  have htu : ThreeScaledSumZero t u := by
    intro j
    have h := hsumu' j
    simpa [hu] using h
  have htv : ThreeScaledSumZero (fun i => (t i)⁻¹) v := by
    intro j
    have h := hsumv' j
    simpa [hv] using h
  have hcommon : t 0 = t 1 ∧ t 1 = t 2 := by
    rcases hrankTwo with ⟨p, q, hminor⟩ | ⟨p, q, hminor⟩
    · exact three_scalars_eq_of_minor u t p q hsumu htu hminor
    · obtain ⟨h01, h12⟩ :=
        three_scalars_eq_of_minor v (fun i => (t i)⁻¹) p q hsumv htv hminor
      exact ⟨inv_injective h01, inv_injective h12⟩
  refine ⟨t 0, ht 0, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    fin_cases i
    · exact hu 0
    · simpa [hcommon.1] using hu 1
    · simpa [hcommon.1, hcommon.2] using hu 2
  · intro i
    fin_cases i
    · exact hv 0
    · simpa [hcommon.1] using hv 1
    · simpa [hcommon.1, hcommon.2] using hv 2

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceAutExtension.linear_comp_inverse
statement:
theorem linear_comp_inverse (g : SourceAut (K := k)) :
    (linear (R := R) g).comp (inverseLinear (R := R) g) = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  have hc : (baseLinear g).comp (baseInverseLinear g) = LinearMap.id := by
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro x
    change structuredEquivK k
      (g.linear ((structuredEquivK k).symm
        (structuredEquivK k
          (g.linear.symm ((structuredEquivK k).symm x))))) = x
    rw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply,
      LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  rw [linear, inverseLinear, ← FiniteIndexExtension.extend_comp, hc]
  exact FiniteIndexExtension.extend_id (ι := Fin 27) (algebraMap k R)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceAutExtension.inverse_comp_linear
statement:
theorem inverse_comp_linear (g : SourceAut (K := k)) :
    (inverseLinear (R := R) g).comp (linear (R := R) g) = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  have hc : (baseInverseLinear g).comp (baseLinear g) = LinearMap.id := by
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro x
    change structuredEquivK k
      (g.linear.symm ((structuredEquivK k).symm
        (structuredEquivK k
          (g.linear ((structuredEquivK k).symm x))))) = x
    rw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply,
      LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  rw [linear, inverseLinear, ← FiniteIndexExtension.extend_comp, hc]
  exact FiniteIndexExtension.extend_id (ι := Fin 27) (algebraMap k R)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceAutExtension.linearEquiv_apply_coordinate
statement:
theorem linearEquiv_apply_coordinate (g : SourceAut (K := k))
    (x : Coord R) (c : Fin 27) :
    linearEquiv (R := R) g x c =
      ∑ i : Fin 27, x i * algebraMap k R (baseLinear g (Pi.single i 1) c)
proof:
:= by
  change (∑ i : Fin 27,
    algebraMap k R (baseLinear g (Pi.single i 1) c) * x i) = _
  simp only [mul_comm]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceAutExtension.linearEquiv_on_constants
statement:
theorem linearEquiv_on_constants (g : SourceAut (K := k)) (x : Coord k) :
    linear (R := R) g (mapCoord (algebraMap k R) x) =
      mapCoord (algebraMap k R) (baseLinear g x)
proof:
:=
  FiniteIndexExtension.extend_on_constants (algebraMap k R) (baseLinear g) x

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceAutExtension.mapCoord_single
statement:
theorem mapCoord_single (i : Fin 27) :
    mapCoord (algebraMap k R) (Pi.single i 1) = Pi.single i 1
proof:
:= by
  funext j
  by_cases h : j = i
  · subst j; simp [mapCoord]
  · simp [mapCoord, Pi.single_apply, h]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceAutExtension.product_map
statement:
private theorem product_map (x y : Coord k) :
    product (k := k) (R := R) (mapCoord (algebraMap k R) x)
        (mapCoord (algebraMap k R) y) =
      mapCoord (algebraMap k R) (f0ProductK x y)
proof:
:= by
  funext c
  simp only [product, mapCoord, Function.comp_apply, f0ProductK, map_sum, map_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceAutExtension.baseLinear_product
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨sx, rfl⟩ := (structuredEquivK k).surjective x
  obtain ⟨sy, rfl⟩ := (structuredEquivK k).surjective y
  simp only [baseLinear, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe,
    LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  rw [← GenericStructuredProductAgreesWithF0,
    LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply, g.map_product,
    GenericStructuredProductAgreesWithF0]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceAutExtension.linearEquiv_product
statement:
theorem linearEquiv_product (g : SourceAut (K := k)) (x y : Coord R) :
    linearEquiv (R := R) g (product (k := k) x y) =
      product (k := k) (linearEquiv (R := R) g x)
        (linearEquiv (R := R) g y)
proof:
:= by
  have hbilin :
      (productBilin (k := k) (R := R)).compr₂ (linear (R := R) g) =
        (productBilin (k := k) (R := R)).compl₁₂ (linear (R := R) g)
          (linear (R := R) g) := by
    apply FiniteIndexExtension.bilinear_eq_of_standard_basis
    intro i j
    change linear (R := R) g
        (product (k := k) (Pi.single i 1) (Pi.single j 1)) =
      product (k := k) (linear (R := R) g (Pi.single i 1))
        (linear (R := R) g (Pi.single j 1))
    have h := congrArg (mapCoord (algebraMap k R))
      (baseLinear_product g (Pi.single i 1) (Pi.single j 1))
    simpa only [← linearEquiv_on_constants, ← product_map, mapCoord_single] using h
  exact congrArg (fun B : Coord R →ₗ[R] Coord R →ₗ[R] Coord R => B x y) hbilin

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceAutExtension.linearEquiv_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem linearEquiv_one (g : SourceAut (K := k)) :
    linearEquiv (R := R) g (one (k := k)) = one (k := k)
proof:
:= by
  change linear (R := R) g (mapCoord (algebraMap k R) f0OneK) = _
  rw [linearEquiv_on_constants]
  have hb : baseLinear g f0OneK = f0OneK := by
    rw [← structuredEquivK_sourceOne]
    change structuredEquivK k
      (g.linear ((structuredEquivK k).symm (structuredEquivK k sourceOne))) =
        structuredEquivK k sourceOne
    rw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply, g.map_one]
  rw [hb]
  rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceAutExtension.linearEquiv_trace
statement:
theorem linearEquiv_trace (g : SourceAut (K := k)) (x : Coord R) :
    trace (linearEquiv (R := R) g x) = trace x
proof:
:= by
  have ht (z : Coord k) :
      trace (mapCoord (algebraMap k R) z) = algebraMap k R (f0TraceK z) := by
    simp [trace, f0TraceK, mapCoord]
  have hmaps : trace.comp (linear (R := R) g) = trace := by
    apply (Pi.basisFun R (Fin 27)).ext
    intro i
    simp only [Pi.basisFun_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply]
    rw [← mapCoord_single (k := k) (R := R) i, linearEquiv_on_constants, ht, ht]
    apply congrArg (algebraMap k R)
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := (structuredEquivK k).surjective (Pi.single i 1)
    rw [← hz]
    change f0TraceK (structuredEquivK k
      (g.linear ((structuredEquivK k).symm (structuredEquivK k z)))) =
        f0TraceK (structuredEquivK k z)
    rw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
    rw [← sourceTrace_agrees_with_f0K, ← sourceTrace_agrees_with_f0K]
    exact sourceTrace_invariant g z
  exact congrArg (fun T : Coord R →ₗ[R] R => T x) hmaps

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceAutExtension.linearEquiv_natural
statement:
theorem linearEquiv_natural
    {S : Type w} [CommRing S] [Algebra k S] [Invertible (2 : S)]
    (f : R →ₐ[k] S) (g : SourceAut (K := k)) (x : Coord R) :
    (f ∘ linearEquiv (R := R) g x) =
      linearEquiv (R := S) g (f ∘ x)
proof:
:= by
  funext c
  change f (linearEquiv (R := R) g x c) =
    linearEquiv (R := S) g (f ∘ x) c
  rw [linearEquiv_apply_coordinate, linearEquiv_apply_coordinate]
  simp only [map_sum, map_mul, f.commutes, Function.comp_apply]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.DetectorScaling.scaleWitnessTriple_cE
statement:
@[simp] theorem scaleWitnessTriple_cE (a b c : ℚ) (X : WitnessTriple) :
    (scaleWitnessTriple a b c X).cE = a • X.cE
proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.DetectorScaling.scaleWitnessTriple_cF
statement:
@[simp] theorem scaleWitnessTriple_cF (a b c : ℚ) (X : WitnessTriple) :
    (scaleWitnessTriple a b c X).cF = b • X.cF
proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.DetectorScaling.scaleWitnessTriple_cK
statement:
@[simp] theorem scaleWitnessTriple_cK (a b c : ℚ) (X : WitnessTriple) :
    (scaleWitnessTriple a b c X).cK = c • X.cK
proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.DetectorScaling.W0_scaleWitnessTriple
statement:
theorem W0_scaleWitnessTriple (a b c : ℚ) (X : WitnessTriple) :
    W0 (scaleWitnessTriple a b c X) = (a * b * c) • W0 X
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ :
      structuredProduct (a • X.cE)
          (structuredProduct (b • X.cF) (c • X.cK)) =
        (a * b * c) •
          structuredProduct X.cE (structuredProduct X.cF X.cK) := by
    simp only [productQBilinear.2.1, productQBilinear.2.2.2, smul_smul]
    congr 1
    ring
  have h₂ :
      structuredProduct (b • X.cF)
          (structuredProduct (a • X.cE) (c • X.cK)) =
        (a * b * c) •
          structuredProduct X.cF (structuredProduct X.cE X.cK) := by
    simp only [productQBilinear.2.1, productQBilinear.2.2.2, smul_smul]
    congr 1
    ring
  change
    structuredProduct (a • X.cE)
          (structuredProduct (b • X.cF) (c • X.cK)) -
        structuredProduct (b • X.cF)
          (structuredProduct (a • X.cE) (c • X.cK)) =
      (a * b * c) •
        (structuredProduct X.cE (structuredProduct X.cF X.cK) -
          structuredProduct X.cF (structuredProduct X.cE X.cK))
  rw [h₁, h₂, smul_sub]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.DetectorScaling.traceForm_smul_smul
statement:
theorem traceForm_smul_smul (a b : ℚ) (x y : Coord) :
    traceForm (a • x) (b • y) = a * b * traceForm x y
proof:
:= by
  calc
    traceForm (a • x) (b • y) =
        traceN (structuredProduct (a • x) (b • y)) :=
      (traceN_structuredProduct_eq_traceForm (a • x) (b • y)).symm
    _ = traceN ((a * b) • structuredProduct x y) := by
      rw [productQBilinear.2.1, productQBilinear.2.2.2, smul_smul]
    _ = a * b * traceForm x y := by
      rw [traceN_smul, traceN_structuredProduct_eq_traceForm]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.DetectorScaling.traceCubeDetector_scaleWitnessTriple
statement:
theorem traceCubeDetector_scaleWitnessTriple (a b c : ℚ)
    (X : WitnessTriple) :
    traceCubeDetector (scaleWitnessTriple a b c X) =
      (a * b * c) ^ 3 * traceCubeDetector X
proof:
:= by
  calc
    traceCubeDetector (scaleWitnessTriple a b c X) =
        traceForm ((a * b * c) • W0 X)
          (structuredProduct ((a * b * c) • W0 X)
            ((a * b * c) • W0 X)) := by
      simp only [traceCubeDetector, W0_scaleWitnessTriple]
    _ = traceForm ((a * b * c) • W0 X)
          (((a * b * c) * (a * b * c)) •
            structuredProduct (W0 X) (W0 X)) := by
      rw [productQBilinear.2.1, productQBilinear.2.2.2, smul_smul]
    _ = (a * b * c) ^ 3 * traceCubeDetector X := by
      rw [traceForm_smul_smul]
      simp only [traceCubeDetector]
      ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.DetectorScaling.traceCubeDetector_scaleFK
statement:
theorem traceCubeDetector_scaleFK (a b : ℚ) (E F K : Coord) :
    traceCubeDetector ⟨E, a • F, b • K⟩ =
      (a * b) ^ 3 * traceCubeDetector ⟨E, F, K⟩
proof:
:= by
  simpa [scaleWitnessTriple] using
    traceCubeDetector_scaleWitnessTriple 1 a b (⟨E, F, K⟩ : WitnessTriple)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFrameFiniteRoots.mapSource_idempotent
statement:
theorem mapSource_idempotent (f : K →+* L) (p : JCoord K)
    (hp : sourceProduct p p = p) :
    sourceProduct (mapSource f p) (mapSource f p) = mapSource f p
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mapSource_product, hp]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFrameFiniteRoots.mapSource_overlap
statement:
theorem mapSource_overlap (f : K →+* L) (e : JCoord K) (i : Fin 3) :
    sourceTrace (sourceProduct (mapSource f e) (diagonalUnit i)) =
      f (sourceTrace (sourceProduct e (diagonalUnit i)))
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = sourceTrace (sourceProduct (mapSource f e)
        (mapSource f (diagonalUnit i))) := by rw [mapSource_diagonalUnit]
    _ = _ := by rw [← mapSource_product, mapSource_trace]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFrameFiniteRoots.mapSource_two_reflections
statement:
theorem mapSource_two_reflections (f : K →+* L) (p q x : JCoord K)
    (hp : sourceProduct p p = p) (hq : sourceProduct q q = q) :
    mapSource f ((thenAut (sourcePeirceAut p hp) (sourcePeirceAut q hq)).linear x) =
      (thenAut
        (sourcePeirceAut (mapSource f p) (mapSource_idempotent f p hp))
        (sourcePeirceAut (mapSource f q) (mapSource_idempotent f q hq))).linear
          (mapSource f x)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [thenAut_apply, reflectionAut_apply, mapSource_reflection]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFrameFiniteRoots.common_field_four_reflections
statement:
theorem common_field_four_reflections
    (P : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → JCoord K) (hP : ∀ a, SourceFrameLaws.Laws (P a)) :
    ∃ (L : Type u) (_ : Field L) (_ : CharZero L) (f : K →+* L)
      (p q r s : Fin 3 → JCoord L)
      (hp : ∀ a, sourceProduct (p a) (p a) = p a)
      (hq : ∀ a, sourceProduct (q a) (q a) = q a)
      (hr : ∀ a, sourceProduct (r a) (r a) = r a)
      (hs : ∀ a, sourceProduct (s a) (s a) = s a),
      Function.Injective f ∧
      (∀ a, sourceTrace (p a) = 1 ∧ sourceTrace (q a) = 1 ∧
        sourceTrace (r a) = 1 ∧ sourceTrace (s a) = 1) ∧
      ∀ a i, (fourReflectionAut (p a) (q a) (r a) (s a)
        (hp a) (hq a) (hr a) (hs a)).linear (mapSource f (P a i)) = diagonalUnit i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  choose i hi using fun a => exists_first_pivot (P a 0) ((hP a).trace_one 0)
  let t : Fin 3 → K := fun a => sourceTrace (sourceProduct (P a 0) (diagonalUnit (i a)))
  obtain ⟨E⟩ := rootField_nonempty_of_fintype K t
  letI : CharZero E.Carrier := charZero_of_embedding E.embedding
  let P1 : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → JCoord E.Carrier :=
    fun a j => mapSource E.embedding (P a j)
  have hP1 (a : Fin 3) : SourceFrameLaws.Laws (P1 a) :=
    mapSource_frameLaws E.embedding (P a) (hP a)
  have hroot1 (a : Fin 3) : ∃ z : E.Carrier,
      z ^ 2 = sourceTrace (sourceProduct (P1 a 0) (diagonalUnit (i a))) ∧
      z ≠ 0 ∧ z ≠ -1 := by
    have ht : E.embedding (t a) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      apply hi a
      exact E.embedding.injective (by simpa only [map_zero] using h)
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hz0, hzneg⟩ :=
      good_root_of_square _ _ ht (E.roots_sq a)
    refine ⟨z, ?_, hz0, hzneg⟩
    simpa only [P1, mapSource_overlap, t] using hz
  choose z hz hz0 hzneg using hroot1
  choose p q hp hq hpT hqT hfirst using fun a =>
    normalize_first_of_pivot (P1 a 0) (i a) (z a)
      ((hP1 a).idempotent 0) ((hP1 a).trace_one 0) (hz a) (hz0 a) (hzneg a)
  let A (a : Fin 3) := thenAut (sourcePeirceAut (p a) (hp a))
    (sourcePeirceAut (q a) (hq a))
  let Q : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → JCoord E.Carrier := fun a j => (A a).linear (P1 a j)
  have hAT (a : Fin 3) (x : JCoord E.Carrier) :
      sourceTrace ((A a).linear x) = sourceTrace x :=
    thenAut_trace _ _ (reflectionAut_trace (p a) (hp a))
      (reflectionAut_trace (q a) (hq a)) x
  have hQ (a : Fin 3) : SourceFrameLaws.Laws (Q a) :=
    map_laws (A a) (hAT a) (P1 a) (hP1 a)
  have hQ0 (a : Fin 3) : Q a 0 = diagonalUnit 0 := hfirst a
  have hQzero (a : Fin 3) : sourceProduct (Q a 1) (diagonalUnit 0) = 0 := by
    rw [← hQ0 a]
    exact (hQ a).orthogonal (by decide : (1 : Fin 3) ≠ 0)
  
  choose j hj0 hj using fun a =>
    exists_second_pivot (Q a 1) ((hQ a).trace_one 1) (hQzero a)
  let t2 : Fin 3 → E.Carrier :=
    fun a => sourceTrace (sourceProduct (Q a 1) (diagonalUnit (j a)))
  obtain ⟨F⟩ := rootField_nonempty_of_fintype E.Carrier t2
  letI : CharZero F.Carrier := charZero_of_embedding F.embedding
  let Q2 : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → JCoord F.Carrier :=
    fun a b => mapSource F.embedding (Q a b)
  have hQ2 (a : Fin 3) : SourceFrameLaws.Laws (Q2 a) :=
    mapSource_frameLaws F.embedding (Q a) (hQ a)
  have hQ20 (a : Fin 3) : Q2 a 0 = diagonalUnit 0 := by
    simp only [Q2, hQ0, mapSource_diagonalUnit]
  have hQ2zero (a : Fin 3) : sourceProduct (Q2 a 1) (diagonalUnit 0) = 0 := by
    rw [← hQ20 a]
    exact (hQ2 a).orthogonal (by decide : (1 : Fin 3) ≠ 0)
  have hroot2 (a : Fin 3) : ∃ z : F.Carrier,
      z ^ 2 = sourceTrace (sourceProduct (Q2 a 1) (diagonalUnit (j a))) ∧
      z ≠ 0 ∧ z ≠ -1 := by
    have ht : F.embedding (t2 a) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      apply hj a
      exact F.embedding.injective (by simpa only [map_zero] using h)
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hz0, hzneg⟩ :=
      good_root_of_square _ _ ht (F.roots_sq a)
    refine ⟨z, ?_, hz0, hzneg⟩
    simpa only [Q2, mapSource_overlap, t2] using hz
  choose w hw hw0 hwneg using hroot2
  choose r s hr hs hrT hsT hfix hsecond using fun a =>
    normalize_second_of_pivot (Q2 a 1) (j a) (w a)
      ((hQ2 a).idempotent 1) ((hQ2 a).trace_one 1) (hQ2zero a) (hj0 a)
      (hw a) (hw0 a) (hwneg a)
  
  let p2 : Fin 3 → JCoord F.Carrier := fun a => mapSource F.embedding (p a)
  let q2 : Fin 3 → JCoord F.Carrier := fun a => mapSource F.embedding (q a)
  have hp2 (a : Fin 3) : sourceProduct (p2 a) (p2 a) = p2 a :=
    mapSource_idempotent F.embedding (p a) (hp a)
  have hq2 (a : Fin 3) : sourceProduct (q2 a) (q2 a) = q2 a :=
    mapSource_idempotent F.embedding (q a) (hq a)
  have hp2T (a : Fin 3) : sourceTrace (p2 a) = 1 := by
    simp only [p2, mapSource_trace, hpT, map_one]
  have hq2T (a : Fin 3) : sourceTrace (q2 a) = 1 := by
    simp only [q2, mapSource_trace, hqT, map_one]
  let f : K →+* F.Carrier := F.embedding.comp E.embedding
  let P2 : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → JCoord F.Carrier := fun a b => mapSource f (P a b)
  have hP2 (a : Fin 3) : SourceFrameLaws.Laws (P2 a) :=
    mapSource_frameLaws f (P a) (hP a)
  let A2 (a : Fin 3) := thenAut (sourcePeirceAut (p2 a) (hp2 a))
    (sourcePeirceAut (q2 a) (hq2 a))
  have hA2 (a b : Fin 3) : (A2 a).linear (P2 a b) = Q2 a b := by
    have h := mapSource_two_reflections F.embedding (p a) (q a) (P1 a b) (hp a) (hq a)
    simpa only [Q2, Q, A, A2, p2, q2, P2, P1, f, mapSource_comp] using h.symm
  let G (a : Fin 3) := fourReflectionAut (p2 a) (q2 a) (r a) (s a)
    (hp2 a) (hq2 a) (hr a) (hs a)
  have hG0 (a : Fin 3) : (G a).linear (P2 a 0) = diagonalUnit 0 := by
    dsimp only [G]
    rw [fourReflectionAut_apply]
    change (thenAut (sourcePeirceAut (r a) (hr a))
      (sourcePeirceAut (s a) (hs a))).linear ((A2 a).linear (P2 a 0)) = _
    rw [hA2, hQ20]
    exact hfix a
  have hG1 (a : Fin 3) : (G a).linear (P2 a 1) = diagonalUnit 1 := by
    dsimp only [G]
    rw [fourReflectionAut_apply]
    change (thenAut (sourcePeirceAut (r a) (hr a))
      (sourcePeirceAut (s a) (hs a))).linear ((A2 a).linear (P2 a 1)) = _
    rw [hA2]
    exact hsecond a
  have hG2 (a : Fin 3) : (G a).linear (P2 a 2) = diagonalUnit 2 := by
    have hsum := congrArg (G a).linear (hP2 a).sum_one
    simp only [map_add, (G a).map_one, hG0, hG1] at hsum
    exact add_left_cancel (hsum.trans diagonalUnit_sum.symm)
  refine ⟨F.Carrier, inferInstance, inferInstance, f, p2, q2, r, s,
    hp2, hq2, hr, hs, f.injective, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro a
    exact ⟨hp2T a, hq2T a, hrT a, hsT a⟩
  · intro a b
    change (G a).linear (P2 a b) = diagonalUnit b
    fin_cases b
    · exact hG0 a
    · exact hG1 a
    · exact hG2 a

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WordMatrixConnection.matrixAction_matrixOfLinear
statement:
theorem matrixAction_matrixOfLinear (L : Vec6 K →ₗ[K] Vec6 K) :
    matrixAction (matrixOfLinear L) = L
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  obtain ⟨a, b, hx⟩ := standard_spans x
  rw [hx]
  simp only [map_add, map_sum, map_smul]
  congr 1 <;> apply Finset.sum_congr rfl <;> intro i _
  · congr 1
    ext p
    simp [matrixAction, matrixOfLinear, standardE, basisVector,
      Pi.single_apply]
  · congr 1
    ext p
    simp [matrixAction, matrixOfLinear, standardF, basisVector,
      Pi.single_apply]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WordMatrixConnection.inverseWord_left
statement:
theorem inverseWord_left
    (word : List (Step (K := K) (V := Vec6 K))) :
    (wordMap omega (inverseWord word)).comp (wordMap omega word) = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  induction word with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons step word ih =>
      rcases step with ⟨d, t⟩
      simp only [inverseWord, List.reverse_cons, List.map_append, List.map_singleton,
        wordMap_append, wordMap]
      apply LinearMap.ext
      intro x
      simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.id_apply]
      have hcancel := LinearMap.congr_fun
        (map_neg_comp omega omega_alternating d t) (wordMap omega word x)
      simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.id_apply] at hcancel
      rw [hcancel]
      exact LinearMap.congr_fun ih x

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WordMatrixConnection.inverseWord_involutive
statement:
private theorem inverseWord_involutive
    (word : List (Step (K := K) (V := Vec6 K))) :
    inverseWord (inverseWord word) = word
proof:
:= by
  simp [inverseWord, Function.comp_def]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WordMatrixConnection.inverseWord_right
statement:
theorem inverseWord_right
    (word : List (Step (K := K) (V := Vec6 K))) :
    (wordMap omega word).comp (wordMap omega (inverseWord word)) = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  have h := inverseWord_left (inverseWord word)
  rw [inverseWord_involutive] at h
  exact h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WordMatrixConnection.wordMatrix_mul_inverse
statement:
theorem wordMatrix_mul_inverse (word : List (Step (K := K) (V := Vec6 K))) :
    wordMatrix word * inverseWordMatrix word = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply matrixAction_injective
  unfold wordMatrix inverseWordMatrix
  rw [matrixAction_mul, matrixAction_matrixOfLinear, matrixAction_matrixOfLinear,
    inverseWord_right, matrixAction_one]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WordMatrixConnection.inverse_mul_wordMatrix
statement:
theorem inverse_mul_wordMatrix (word : List (Step (K := K) (V := Vec6 K))) :
    inverseWordMatrix word * wordMatrix word = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply matrixAction_injective
  unfold wordMatrix inverseWordMatrix
  rw [matrixAction_mul, matrixAction_matrixOfLinear, matrixAction_matrixOfLinear,
    inverseWord_left, matrixAction_one]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WordMatrixConnection.matrixAction_basisVector
statement:
theorem matrixAction_basisVector (M : Mat6 K) (j : Ix6) :
    matrixAction (K := K) M (basisVector (K := K) j) = fun i => M i j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  funext i
  rcases j with j | j <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [matrixAction, basisVector, Pi.single_apply,
      Fintype.sum_sum_type, Fin.sum_univ_succ]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WordMatrixConnection.symplectic_product_entry
statement:
theorem symplectic_product_entry (M : Mat6 K) (i j : Ix6) :
    ((M.transpose * (symplecticJ : Mat6 K) * M) : Mat6 K) i j =
      (omega (K := K)) (fun r => M r i) (fun r => M r j)
proof:
:= by
  simp [omega, omegaFun, symplecticJ, Matrix.mul_apply,
    Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.one_apply, Fintype.sum_sum_type, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WordMatrixConnection.omega_basisVector
statement:
theorem omega_basisVector (i j : Ix6) :
    (omega (K := K)) (basisVector (K := K) i) (basisVector (K := K) j) =
      symplecticJ i j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases i with i | i <;> rcases j with j | j <;>
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [omega, omegaFun, symplecticJ, basisVector, Pi.single_apply,
      Fin.sum_univ_succ, Matrix.one_apply]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WordMatrixConnection.matrix_symplectic_of_action_preserves
statement:
theorem matrix_symplectic_of_action_preserves
    (M : Mat6 K)
    (hpres : ∀ x y : Vec6 K,
      (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (K := K) M x) (matrixAction (K := K) M y) =
        (omega (K := K)) x y) :
    M.transpose * symplecticJ * M = symplecticJ
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  rw [symplectic_product_entry]
  rw [← matrixAction_basisVector M i, ← matrixAction_basisVector M j]
  rw [hpres]
  exact omega_basisVector i j

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WordMatrixConnection.wordMatrix_symplectic
statement:
theorem wordMatrix_symplectic (word : List (Step (K := K) (V := Vec6 K))) :
    (wordMatrix word).transpose * symplecticJ * wordMatrix word = symplecticJ
proof:
:= by
  apply matrix_symplectic_of_action_preserves
  intro x y
  unfold wordMatrix
  rw [matrixAction_matrixOfLinear]
  exact wordMap_preserves (omega (K := K)) omega_alternating word x y

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceVectorReflectionTransport.nV_neg
statement: theorem nV_neg (v : VCoord K) : nV (-v) = nV v
proof:
:= by
  rw [← neg_one_smul K v, nV_smul]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceVectorReflectionTransport.BV_neg_left
statement: theorem BV_neg_left (v w : VCoord K) : BV (-v) w = -BV v w
proof:
:= by
  rw [← neg_one_smul K v, BV_smul_left]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceVectorReflectionTransport.BV_neg_right
statement: theorem BV_neg_right (v w : VCoord K) : BV v (-w) = -BV v w
proof:
:= by
  rw [BV_symmetric, BV_neg_left, BV_symmetric w v]

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceVectorReflectionTransport.nV_sub
statement:
theorem nV_sub (v w : VCoord K) :
    nV (v - w) = nV v + nV w - BV v w
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, nV_add, nV_neg, BV_neg_right]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceVectorReflectionTransport.difference_pairing
statement:
theorem difference_pairing (x y : VCoord K) (hn : nV x = nV y) :
    BV (x - y) x = nV (x - y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [nV_sub, sub_eq_add_neg, BV_add_left, BV_neg_left,
    BV_symmetric y x, ← hn, BV_self_eq_two_nV]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceVectorReflectionTransport.reflect_difference
statement:
theorem reflect_difference (x y : VCoord K) (hn : nV x = nV y)
    (hd : nV (x - y) ≠ 0) :
    reflectV (x - y) x = y
proof:
:= by
  rw [reflectV, difference_pairing x y hn, div_self hd]
  module

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceVectorReflectionTransport.sum_pairing
statement:
theorem sum_pairing (x y : VCoord K) (hn : nV x = nV y)
    (hd : nV (x - y) = 0) :
    BV (x + y) x = nV (x + y)
proof:
:= by
  have hxy : BV x y = 2 * nV x := by
    have h := nV_sub x y
    rw [hd, ← hn] at h
    linear_combination h
  rw [nV_add, BV_add_left, BV_self_eq_two_nV, BV_symmetric y x, hxy, hn]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceVectorReflectionTransport.nV_sum_eq_four
statement:
theorem nV_sum_eq_four (x y : VCoord K) (hn : nV x = nV y)
    (hd : nV (x - y) = 0) :
    nV (x + y) = 4 * nV x
proof:
:= by
  have hxy : BV x y = 2 * nV x := by
    have h := nV_sub x y
    rw [hd, ← hn] at h
    linear_combination h
  rw [nV_add, ← hn, hxy]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceVectorReflectionTransport.reflect_sum
statement:
theorem reflect_sum (x y : VCoord K) (hn : nV x = nV y)
    (hd : nV (x - y) = 0) (hs : nV (x + y) ≠ 0) :
    reflectV (x + y) x = -y
proof:
:= by
  rw [reflectV, sum_pairing x y hn hd, div_self hs]
  module

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceVectorReflectionTransport.reflect_neg_self
statement:
theorem reflect_neg_self (y : VCoord K) (hy : nV y ≠ 0) :
    reflectV y (-y) = y
proof:
:= by
  have hcoef : BV y (-y) / nV y = (-2 : K) := by
    rw [BV_neg_right, BV_self_eq_two_nV]
    field_simp [hy]
  rw [reflectV, hcoef]
  module

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceVectorReflectionTransport.exists_reflection_transport
statement:
theorem exists_reflection_transport (x y : VCoord K)
    (hn : nV x = nV y) (hx : nV x ≠ 0) :
    (∃ a, nV a ≠ 0 ∧ reflectV a x = y) ∨
      (∃ a b, nV a ≠ 0 ∧ nV b ≠ 0 ∧ reflectV b (reflectV a x) = y)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hd : nV (x - y) = 0
  · have hy : nV y ≠ 0 := by
      intro hy0
      apply hx
      rw [hn, hy0]
    have hs : nV (x + y) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [nV_sum_eq_four x y hn hd]
      exact mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) hx
    right
    refine ⟨x + y, y, hs, hy, ?_⟩
    rw [reflect_sum x y hn hd hs, reflect_neg_self y hy]
  · left
    exact ⟨x - y, hd, reflect_difference x y hn hd⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexMatrixDephasing.dephase_eq_diagonal_mul
statement:
theorem dephase_eq_diagonal_mul (X : Mat3 K) :
    dephase X = Matrix.diagonal (leftScale X) * X * Matrix.diagonal (rightScale X)
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp [dephase, leftScale, rightScale, Matrix.mul_apply,
    Matrix.diagonal_apply, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexMatrixDephasing.dephase_first_row
statement:
theorem dephase_first_row (X : Mat3 K) (h00 : X 0 0 ≠ 0)
    (hrow : ∀ j, X 0 j ≠ 0) (j : Fin 3) : dephase X 0 j = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [dephase, h00, hrow j]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexMatrixDephasing.dephase_first_col
statement:
theorem dephase_first_col (X : Mat3 K) (h00 : X 0 0 ≠ 0)

proof:

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexMatrixDephasing.scaled_inverse
statement:
theorem scaled_inverse
    (X Y : Mat3 K) (l r : Fin 3 → K)
    (hl : ∀ i, l i ≠ 0) (hr : ∀ i, r i ≠ 0)
    (hYX : Y * X = 1) :
    (Matrix.diagonal l * X * Matrix.diagonal r)⁻¹ =
      Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (r i)⁻¹) * Y *
        Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (l i)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  have hL : Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (l i)⁻¹) * Matrix.diagonal l =
      (1 : Mat3 K) := by
    ext i j
    by_cases h : i = j
    · subst j; simp [hl]
    · simp [Matrix.diagonal_apply, h]
  have hR : Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (r i)⁻¹) * Matrix.diagonal r =
      (1 : Mat3 K) := by
    ext i j
    by_cases h : i = j
    · subst j; simp [hr]
    · simp [Matrix.diagonal_apply, h]
  apply Matrix.inv_eq_left_inv
  calc
    (Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (r i)⁻¹) * Y * Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (l i)⁻¹)) *
        (Matrix.diagonal l * X * Matrix.diagonal r) =
      Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (r i)⁻¹) *
        (Y * (Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (l i)⁻¹) * Matrix.diagonal l) * X) *
          Matrix.diagonal r := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = 1 := by rw [hL, Matrix.mul_one, hYX, Matrix.mul_one, hR]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexMatrixDephasing.overlap_diagonal_scale
statement:
theorem overlap_diagonal_scale
    (X : Mat3 K) (l r : Fin 3 → K)
    (hl : ∀ i, l i ≠ 0) (hr : ∀ i, r i ≠ 0)
    (hdet : Matrix.det X ≠ 0) (i j : Fin 3) :
    overlapOf (Matrix.diagonal l * X * Matrix.diagonal r) i j = overlapOf X i j
proof:
:= by
  have hYX := Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul X (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hdet)
  rw [overlapOf, overlapOf,
    scaled_inverse X X⁻¹ l r hl hr hYX]
  simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply]
  field_simp [hl i, hr j]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexMatrixDephasing.overlap_dephase
statement:
theorem overlap_dephase (X : Mat3 K)
    (hentries : ∀ i j, X i j ≠ 0) (hdet : Matrix.det X ≠ 0) (i j : Fin 3) :
    overlapOf (dephase X) i j = overlapOf X i j
proof:
:= by
  rw [dephase_eq_diagonal_mul]
  apply overlap_diagonal_scale
  · intro q
    exact div_ne_zero (hentries 0 0) (hentries q 0)
  · intro q
    exact inv_ne_zero (hentries 0 q)
  · exact hdet

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexMatrixDephasing.overlap_inverseTranspose
statement:
theorem overlap_inverseTranspose (X : Mat3 K)
    (hdet : Matrix.det X ≠ 0) (i j : Fin 3) :
    overlapOf (Matrix.transpose X⁻¹) i j = overlapOf X i j
proof:
:= by
  have hu : IsUnit (Matrix.det X) := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hdet
  have hi : (Matrix.transpose X⁻¹)⁻¹ = Matrix.transpose X := by
    rw [← Matrix.transpose_nonsing_inv, Matrix.nonsing_inv_nonsing_inv X hu]
  simp only [overlapOf, hi, Matrix.transpose_apply]
  exact mul_comm _ _

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexMatrixDephasing.entries_ne_zero_of_overlap_ne_zero
statement:
theorem entries_ne_zero_of_overlap_ne_zero (X : Mat3 K)
    (hopen : ∀ i j, overlapOf X i j ≠ 0) :
    (∀ i j, X i j ≠ 0) ∧ (∀ i j, X⁻¹ j i ≠ 0)
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> intro i j
  · exact (mul_ne_zero_iff.mp (hopen i j)).1
  · exact (mul_ne_zero_iff.mp (hopen i j)).2

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexMatrixDephasing.inverseTranspose_entries_ne_zero_of_overlap_ne_zero
statement:
theorem inverseTranspose_entries_ne_zero_of_overlap_ne_zero (X : Mat3 K)
    (hopen : ∀ i j, overlapOf X i j ≠ 0) :
    ∀ i j, Matrix.transpose X⁻¹ i j ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro i j
  exact (entries_ne_zero_of_overlap_ne_zero X hopen).2 i j

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ParameterLedger.structuredEquiv_sourceSquare
statement:
theorem structuredEquiv_sourceSquare (z : JCoord ℚ) :
    structuredEquiv (sourceSquare z) =

proof:
:= by

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ParameterLedger.structuredEquiv_sourceProjector
statement:
theorem structuredEquiv_sourceProjector (z : JCoord ℚ) (i : Fin 3) :
    structuredEquiv (sourceProjector z i) = projector (structuredEquiv z) i
proof:
:= by
  rw [sourceProjector, sourceCombo, map_add, map_add, map_smul, map_smul,
    map_smul, structuredEquiv_sourceOne, structuredEquiv_sourceSquare]
  fin_cases i
  · change (0 : ℚ) • one + (-1 / 2 : ℚ) • structuredEquiv z +
        (1 / 2 : ℚ) •
          structuredProduct (structuredEquiv z) (structuredEquiv z) =
      (2 : ℚ)⁻¹ •
        (structuredProduct (structuredEquiv z) (structuredEquiv z) -
          structuredEquiv z)
    module
  · change (1 : ℚ) • one + (0 : ℚ) • structuredEquiv z +
        (-1 : ℚ) •
          structuredProduct (structuredEquiv z) (structuredEquiv z) =
      one - structuredProduct (structuredEquiv z) (structuredEquiv z)
    module
  · change (0 : ℚ) • one + (1 / 2 : ℚ) • structuredEquiv z +
        (1 / 2 : ℚ) •
          structuredProduct (structuredEquiv z) (structuredEquiv z) =
      (2 : ℚ)⁻¹ •
        (structuredProduct (structuredEquiv z) (structuredEquiv z) +
          structuredEquiv z)
    module
