name: AlbertLean.Generic.ParameterLedger.sourceProjector_s_pair_reinsert
statement:
private theorem sourceProjector_s_pair_reinsert
    (x : ExplicitFrameChart ℚ) (Q : ResidualPair ℚ)
    (hM : moment Q = moment (residualPairOfChart x)) (j l : Fin 3) :
    BS (sourceProjector (encoderA (chartWithResidualPair x Q)) j).s
        (sourceProjector (encoderB (chartWithResidualPair x Q)) l).s =
      BS (sourceProjector (encoderA x) j).s
        (sourceProjector (encoderB x) l).s
proof:
:= by
  have hmomentMatrix :
      momentMatrix (chartWithResidualPair x Q).s1
          (chartWithResidualPair x Q).s2 (chartWithResidualPair x Q).c1
          (chartWithResidualPair x Q).c2 =
        momentMatrix x.s1 x.s2 x.c1 x.c2 := by
    change matrixM (chartWithResidualPair x Q) = matrixM x
    exact matrixM_reinsert_of_moment_eq x Q hM
  rw [sourceProjector_encoderA_s, sourceProjector_encoderB_s, mixedS_pair,
    sourceProjector_encoderA_s, sourceProjector_encoderB_s, mixedS_pair,
    hmomentMatrix]
  simp only [sWeight, encoderA, encoderB, chartWithResidualPair]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ParameterLedger.sourceProjector_c_pair_reinsert
statement:
private theorem sourceProjector_c_pair_reinsert
    (x : ExplicitFrameChart ℚ) (Q : ResidualPair ℚ)
    (hM : moment Q = moment (residualPairOfChart x)) (j l : Fin 3) :
    BC (sourceProjector (encoderA (chartWithResidualPair x Q)) j).c
        (sourceProjector (encoderB (chartWithResidualPair x Q)) l).c =
      BC (sourceProjector (encoderA x) j).c
        (sourceProjector (encoderB x) l).c
proof:
:= by
  have hmomentMatrix :
      momentMatrix (chartWithResidualPair x Q).s1
          (chartWithResidualPair x Q).s2 (chartWithResidualPair x Q).c1
          (chartWithResidualPair x Q).c2 =
        momentMatrix x.s1 x.s2 x.c1 x.c2 := by
    change matrixM (chartWithResidualPair x Q) = matrixM x
    exact matrixM_reinsert_of_moment_eq x Q hM
  rw [sourceProjector_encoderA_c, sourceProjector_encoderB_c, mixedC_pair,
    sourceProjector_encoderA_c, sourceProjector_encoderB_c, mixedC_pair,
    hmomentMatrix]
  simp only [cWeight, encoderA, encoderB, chartWithResidualPair]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ParameterLedger.sourceProjector_v_pair_reinsert
statement:
private theorem sourceProjector_v_pair_reinsert
    (x : ExplicitFrameChart ℚ) (Q : ResidualPair ℚ)
    (hM : moment Q = moment (residualPairOfChart x)) (j l : Fin 3) :
    BV (sourceProjector (encoderA (chartWithResidualPair x Q)) j).v
        (sourceProjector (encoderB (chartWithResidualPair x Q)) l).v =
      BV (sourceProjector (encoderA x) j).v
          (sourceProjector (encoderB x) l).v +
        projectorSquareCoeff j * projectorSquareCoeff l *
          (baseRootSum (residualPairOfChart x) - baseRootSum Q)
proof:
:= by
  have hmomentMatrix :
      momentMatrix (chartWithResidualPair x Q).s1
          (chartWithResidualPair x Q).s2 (chartWithResidualPair x Q).c1
          (chartWithResidualPair x Q).c2 =
        momentMatrix x.s1 x.s2 x.c1 x.c2 := by
    change matrixM (chartWithResidualPair x Q) = matrixM x
    exact matrixM_reinsert_of_moment_eq x Q hM
  rw [sourceProjector_encoderA_v, sourceProjector_encoderB_v,
    mixedV_pair (h1 := rfl) (h2 := rfl),
    sourceProjector_encoderA_v, sourceProjector_encoderB_v,
    mixedV_pair (h1 := rfl) (h2 := rfl),
    hmomentMatrix,
    chart_deltaX, chart_deltaStarA,
    residualPairOfChart_chartWithResidualPair,
    chart_deltaX, chart_deltaStarA]
  simp only [baseRootSum]
  simp only [vWeight, encoderA, encoderB, vectorA, vectorB,
    chartWithResidualPair]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ParameterLedger.sourceProjector_pairing_reinsert
statement:
theorem sourceProjector_pairing_reinsert (x : ExplicitFrameChart ℚ)
    (Q : ResidualPair ℚ)
    (hM : moment Q = moment (residualPairOfChart x)) (j l : Fin 3) :
    sourceTraceForm
        (sourceProjector (encoderA (chartWithResidualPair x Q)) j)
        (sourceProjector (encoderB (chartWithResidualPair x Q)) l) =
      sourceTraceForm (sourceProjector (encoderA x) j)
          (sourceProjector (encoderB x) l) +
        projectorSquareCoeff j * projectorSquareCoeff l *
          (baseRootSum (residualPairOfChart x) - baseRootSum Q)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sourceTraceForm_formula, sourceTraceForm_formula]
  have hA := sourceProjector_encoderA_diagonal_reinsert x Q hM j
  have hB := sourceProjector_encoderB_diagonal_reinsert x Q hM l
  rw [hA.1, hA.2.1, hA.2.2, hB.1, hB.2.1, hB.2.2,
    sourceProjector_s_pair_reinsert x Q hM j l,
    sourceProjector_c_pair_reinsert x Q hM j l,
    sourceProjector_v_pair_reinsert x Q hM j l]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ParameterLedger.ledger_Q_eq_source
statement:
private theorem ledger_Q_eq_source (x : ExplicitFrameChart ℚ) (j l : Fin 3) :
    (ledger (chartWitnessTriple x)).Q j l =
      sourceTraceForm (sourceProjector (encoderA x) j)
        (sourceProjector (encoderB x) l)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sourceTraceForm_agrees_with_f0,
    structuredEquiv_sourceProjector, structuredEquiv_sourceProjector]
  rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ParameterLedger.ledger_Q_reinsert
statement:
theorem ledger_Q_reinsert (x : ExplicitFrameChart ℚ) (Q : ResidualPair ℚ)
    (hM : moment Q = moment (residualPairOfChart x)) (j l : Fin 3) :
    (ledger (chartWitnessTriple (chartWithResidualPair x Q))).Q j l =
      (ledger (chartWitnessTriple x)).Q j l +
        projectorSquareCoeff j * projectorSquareCoeff l *
          (baseRootSum (residualPairOfChart x) - baseRootSum Q)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ledger_Q_eq_source, ledger_Q_eq_source]
  exact sourceProjector_pairing_reinsert x Q hM j l

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ParameterLedger.ledger_P_reinsert
statement:
theorem ledger_P_reinsert (x : ExplicitFrameChart ℚ) (Q : ResidualPair ℚ)
    (hM : moment Q = moment (residualPairOfChart x)) :
    (ledger (chartWitnessTriple (chartWithResidualPair x Q))).P =
      (ledger (chartWitnessTriple x)).P
proof:
:= by
  funext i j
  change traceForm (projector chartBaseEncoder i)
      (projector (structuredEquiv
        (encoderA (chartWithResidualPair x Q))) j) =
    traceForm (projector chartBaseEncoder i)
      (projector (structuredEquiv (encoderA x)) j)
  rw [chartBaseEncoder_eq_theta1E,
    traceForm_projector_theta1E_left, traceForm_projector_theta1E_left,
    ← structuredEquiv_sourceProjector, ← structuredEquiv_sourceProjector]
  have h := sourceProjector_encoderA_diagonal_reinsert x Q hM j
  fin_cases i
  · exact h.1
  · exact h.2.1
  · exact h.2.2

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ParameterLedger.ledger_R_reinsert
statement:
theorem ledger_R_reinsert (x : ExplicitFrameChart ℚ) (Q : ResidualPair ℚ)
    (hM : moment Q = moment (residualPairOfChart x)) :
    (ledger (chartWitnessTriple (chartWithResidualPair x Q))).R =
      (ledger (chartWitnessTriple x)).R
proof:
:= by
  funext l i
  change traceForm
      (projector (structuredEquiv
        (encoderB (chartWithResidualPair x Q))) l)
      (projector chartBaseEncoder i) =
    traceForm (projector (structuredEquiv (encoderB x)) l)
      (projector chartBaseEncoder i)
  rw [chartBaseEncoder_eq_theta1E,
    traceForm_projector_theta1E_right, traceForm_projector_theta1E_right,
    ← structuredEquiv_sourceProjector, ← structuredEquiv_sourceProjector]
  have h := sourceProjector_encoderB_diagonal_reinsert x Q hM l
  fin_cases i
  · exact h.1
  · exact h.2.1
  · exact h.2.2

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ParameterLedger.sourceProduct_projectors_d1_reinsert
statement:
private theorem sourceProduct_projectors_d1_reinsert
    (x : ExplicitFrameChart ℚ) (Q : ResidualPair ℚ)
    (hM : moment Q = moment (residualPairOfChart x)) (j l : Fin 3) :
    (sourceProduct
        (sourceProjector (encoderA (chartWithResidualPair x Q)) j)
        (sourceProjector (encoderB (chartWithResidualPair x Q)) l)).d1 =
      (sourceProduct (sourceProjector (encoderA x) j)
        (sourceProjector (encoderB x) l)).d1
proof:
:= by
  rw [sourceProduct_d1, sourceProduct_d1]
  have hA := sourceProjector_encoderA_diagonal_reinsert x Q hM j
  have hB := sourceProjector_encoderB_diagonal_reinsert x Q hM l
  rw [hA.1, hB.1, sourceProjector_s_pair_reinsert x Q hM j l,
    sourceProjector_c_pair_reinsert x Q hM j l]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ParameterLedger.sourceProduct_projectors_d2_reinsert
statement:
private theorem sourceProduct_projectors_d2_reinsert
    (x : ExplicitFrameChart ℚ) (Q : ResidualPair ℚ)
    (hM : moment Q = moment (residualPairOfChart x)) (j l : Fin 3) :
    (sourceProduct
        (sourceProjector (encoderA (chartWithResidualPair x Q)) j)
        (sourceProjector (encoderB (chartWithResidualPair x Q)) l)).d2 =
      (sourceProduct (sourceProjector (encoderA x) j)
          (sourceProjector (encoderB x) l)).d2 +
        (1 / 2 : ℚ) * projectorSquareCoeff j * projectorSquareCoeff l *
          (baseRootSum (residualPairOfChart x) - baseRootSum Q)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sourceProduct_d2, sourceProduct_d2]
  have hA := sourceProjector_encoderA_diagonal_reinsert x Q hM j
  have hB := sourceProjector_encoderB_diagonal_reinsert x Q hM l
  rw [hA.2.1, hB.2.1, sourceProjector_c_pair_reinsert x Q hM j l,
    sourceProjector_v_pair_reinsert x Q hM j l]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ParameterLedger.sourceProduct_projectors_d3_reinsert
statement:
private theorem sourceProduct_projectors_d3_reinsert
    (x : ExplicitFrameChart ℚ) (Q : ResidualPair ℚ)
    (hM : moment Q = moment (residualPairOfChart x)) (j l : Fin 3) :
    (sourceProduct
        (sourceProjector (encoderA (chartWithResidualPair x Q)) j)
        (sourceProjector (encoderB (chartWithResidualPair x Q)) l)).d3 =
      (sourceProduct (sourceProjector (encoderA x) j)
          (sourceProjector (encoderB x) l)).d3 +
        (1 / 2 : ℚ) * projectorSquareCoeff j * projectorSquareCoeff l *
          (baseRootSum (residualPairOfChart x) - baseRootSum Q)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sourceProduct_d3, sourceProduct_d3]
  have hA := sourceProjector_encoderA_diagonal_reinsert x Q hM j
  have hB := sourceProjector_encoderB_diagonal_reinsert x Q hM l
  rw [hA.2.2, hB.2.2, sourceProjector_v_pair_reinsert x Q hM j l,
    sourceProjector_s_pair_reinsert x Q hM j l]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ParameterLedger.sourceProduct_projectors_diagonal_reinsert
statement:
private theorem sourceProduct_projectors_diagonal_reinsert
    (x : ExplicitFrameChart ℚ) (Q : ResidualPair ℚ)
    (hM : moment Q = moment (residualPairOfChart x)) (i j l : Fin 3) :
    sourceDiagonal
        (sourceProduct
          (sourceProjector (encoderA (chartWithResidualPair x Q)) j)
          (sourceProjector (encoderB (chartWithResidualPair x Q)) l)) i =
      sourceDiagonal
          (sourceProduct (sourceProjector (encoderA x) j)
            (sourceProjector (encoderB x) l)) i +
        rawJointCoeff i * projectorSquareCoeff j * projectorSquareCoeff l *
          (baseRootSum (residualPairOfChart x) - baseRootSum Q)
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i
  · simpa [sourceDiagonal, rawJointCoeff] using
      sourceProduct_projectors_d1_reinsert x Q hM j l
  · simpa [sourceDiagonal, rawJointCoeff] using
      sourceProduct_projectors_d2_reinsert x Q hM j l
  · simpa [sourceDiagonal, rawJointCoeff] using
      sourceProduct_projectors_d3_reinsert x Q hM j l

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ParameterLedger.rawJoint_eq_sourceDiagonal
statement:
private theorem rawJoint_eq_sourceDiagonal (x : ExplicitFrameChart ℚ)
    (i j l : Fin 3) :
    traceForm (projector chartBaseEncoder i)
        (structuredProduct (projector (f0EncoderA x) j)
          (projector (f0EncoderB x) l)) =
      sourceDiagonal
        (sourceProduct (sourceProjector (encoderA x) j)
          (sourceProjector (encoderB x) l)) i
proof:
:= by
  have hprod := StructuredSourceProductAgreesWithF0
    (sourceProjector (encoderA x) j) (sourceProjector (encoderB x) l)
  change traceForm (projector chartBaseEncoder i)
      (structuredProduct
        (projector (structuredEquiv (encoderA x)) j)
        (projector (structuredEquiv (encoderB x)) l)) = _
  rw [← structuredEquiv_sourceProjector, ← structuredEquiv_sourceProjector,
    ← hprod, chartBaseEncoder_eq_theta1E,
    traceForm_projector_theta1E_left]
  fin_cases i <;> rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ParameterLedger.rawJoint_reinsert
statement:
private theorem rawJoint_reinsert (x : ExplicitFrameChart ℚ)
    (Q : ResidualPair ℚ)
    (hM : moment Q = moment (residualPairOfChart x)) (i j l : Fin 3) :
    traceForm (projector chartBaseEncoder i)
        (structuredProduct
          (projector (f0EncoderA (chartWithResidualPair x Q)) j)
          (projector (f0EncoderB (chartWithResidualPair x Q)) l)) =
      traceForm (projector chartBaseEncoder i)
          (structuredProduct (projector (f0EncoderA x) j)
            (projector (f0EncoderB x) l)) +
        rawJointCoeff i * projectorSquareCoeff j * projectorSquareCoeff l *
          (baseRootSum (residualPairOfChart x) - baseRootSum Q)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rawJoint_eq_sourceDiagonal, rawJoint_eq_sourceDiagonal]
  exact sourceProduct_projectors_diagonal_reinsert x Q hM i j l

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ParameterLedger.ledger_C0_reinsert
statement:
theorem ledger_C0_reinsert (x : ExplicitFrameChart ℚ) (Q : ResidualPair ℚ)
    (hM : moment Q = moment (residualPairOfChart x)) (i j l : Fin 3) :
    (ledger (chartWitnessTriple (chartWithResidualPair x Q))).C0 i j l =
      (ledger (chartWitnessTriple x)).C0 i j l +
        centeredJointCoeff i * projectorSquareCoeff j *
          projectorSquareCoeff l *
            (baseRootSum (residualPairOfChart x) - baseRootSum Q)
proof:
:= by
  have hP := congrFun (congrFun (ledger_P_reinsert x Q hM) i) j
  have hR := congrFun (congrFun (ledger_R_reinsert x Q hM) l) i
  have hQ := ledger_Q_reinsert x Q hM j l
  have hC0 :
      (ledger (chartWitnessTriple x)).C0 i j l =
        traceForm (projector chartBaseEncoder i)
            (structuredProduct (projector (f0EncoderA x) j)
              (projector (f0EncoderB x) l)) -
          ((ledger (chartWitnessTriple x)).P i j +
            (ledger (chartWitnessTriple x)).Q j l +
            (ledger (chartWitnessTriple x)).R l i) / 3 +
          2 / 9 := by
    rfl
  change
    traceForm (projector chartBaseEncoder i)
        (structuredProduct
          (projector (f0EncoderA (chartWithResidualPair x Q)) j)
          (projector (f0EncoderB (chartWithResidualPair x Q)) l)) -
        ((ledger (chartWitnessTriple (chartWithResidualPair x Q))).P i j +
          (ledger (chartWitnessTriple (chartWithResidualPair x Q))).Q j l +
          (ledger (chartWitnessTriple (chartWithResidualPair x Q))).R l i) / 3 +
        2 / 9 = _
  rw [rawJoint_reinsert x Q hM i j l, hP, hQ, hR, hC0]
  simp only [centeredJointCoeff]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ParameterLedger.ledger_reinsert_eq_shiftLedger
statement:
theorem ledger_reinsert_eq_shiftLedger (x : ExplicitFrameChart ℚ)
    (Q : ResidualPair ℚ)
    (hM : moment Q = moment (residualPairOfChart x)) :
    ledger (chartWitnessTriple (chartWithResidualPair x Q)) =
      shiftLedger (ledger (chartWitnessTriple x))
        (baseRootSum (residualPairOfChart x) - baseRootSum Q)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [shiftLedger, ledger]
  rw [Ledger.mk.injEq]
  refine ⟨ledger_P_reinsert x Q hM, ?_, ledger_R_reinsert x Q hM, ?_⟩
  · funext j l
    exact ledger_Q_reinsert x Q hM j l
  · funext i j l
    exact ledger_C0_reinsert x Q hM i j l

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ParameterLedger.parameterRootSum_reciprocal
statement:
theorem parameterRootSum_reciprocal (t : ℚ) (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    parameterRootSum (witnessScale / t) = parameterRootSum t
proof:
:= by
  have h := (parameterResidualPair_reciprocal_sameBase t ht).2
  simpa only [parameterResidualPair_baseRootSum, parameterRootSum] using h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ParameterLedger.parameter_Q_affine
statement:
theorem parameter_Q_affine (t : ℚ) (ht : t ≠ 0) (j l : Fin 3) :
    (ledger (parameterTriple t ht)).Q j l =
      (ledger (parameterTriple 1 one_ne_zero)).Q j l +
        projectorSquareCoeff j * projectorSquareCoeff l *
          ((1 + witnessScale) - parameterRootSum t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [parameterTriple, parameterChart]
  rw [ledger_Q_reinsert witnessChart1 (parameterResidualPair t ht)]
  · rw [parameterTriple_one]
    simp [parameterRootSum, baseRootSum, witnessChart1_delta,
      witnessChart1_deltaStar]
  · exact parameterResidualPair_moment t ht

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ParameterLedger.parameter_ledger_affine
statement:
theorem parameter_ledger_affine (t : ℚ) (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    ledger (parameterTriple t ht) =
      shiftLedger (ledger (parameterTriple 1 one_ne_zero))
        ((1 + witnessScale) - parameterRootSum t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [parameterTriple, parameterChart,
    ledger_reinsert_eq_shiftLedger witnessChart1 (parameterResidualPair t ht)]
  · rw [parameterTriple_one]
    simp [parameterRootSum, baseRootSum, witnessChart1_delta,
      witnessChart1_deltaStar]
  · exact parameterResidualPair_moment t ht

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ParameterLedger.parameterLedger_one_eq_witnessScale
statement:
theorem parameterLedger_one_eq_witnessScale :
    ledger (parameterTriple 1 one_ne_zero) =
      ledger (parameterTriple witnessScale witnessScale_ne_zero)
proof:
:= by
  rw [parameterTriple_one, parameterTriple_witnessScale]
  exact witnessCharts_ledger_eq

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ParameterLedger.parameter_rootSumLedgerLaw
statement: theorem parameter_rootSumLedgerLaw : RootSumLedgerLaw
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun s => shiftLedger (ledger (parameterTriple 1 one_ne_zero))
    ((1 + witnessScale) - s), ?_⟩
  intro t ht
  exact parameter_ledger_affine t ht

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ParameterLedger.ledger_eq_reciprocal_of_rootSumLedgerLaw
statement:
theorem ledger_eq_reciprocal_of_rootSumLedgerLaw
    (hLaw : RootSumLedgerLaw) (t : ℚ) (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    ledger
        (parameterTriple (witnessScale / t)
          (reciprocalParameter_ne_zero t ht)) =
      ledger (parameterTriple t ht)
proof:
:= by
  rcases hLaw with ⟨L, hL⟩
  rw [hL, hL, parameterRootSum_reciprocal t ht]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ParameterLedger.parameter_ledger_reciprocal
statement:
theorem parameter_ledger_reciprocal (t : ℚ) (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    ledger
        (parameterTriple (witnessScale / t)
          (reciprocalParameter_ne_zero t ht)) =
      ledger (parameterTriple t ht)
proof:
:=
  ledger_eq_reciprocal_of_rootSumLedgerLaw parameter_rootSumLedgerLaw t ht

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ParameterLedger.parameter_Q11_affine
statement: theorem parameter_Q11_affine : Q11AffineLaw
proof:
:= by
  intro t ht
  rw [parameter_Q_affine t ht 1 1]
  simp [q11AffineValue, projectorSquareCoeff]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ParameterLedger.parameter_ledger_eq_iff
statement:
theorem parameter_ledger_eq_iff (t u : ℚ) (ht : t ≠ 0) (hu : u ≠ 0) :
    ledger (parameterTriple t ht) = ledger (parameterTriple u hu) ↔
      parameterRootSum t = parameterRootSum u
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hQ := congrArg (fun L : Ledger => L.Q 1 1) h
    rw [parameter_Q_affine t ht 1 1, parameter_Q_affine u hu 1 1] at hQ
    simp [projectorSquareCoeff] at hQ
    linarith
  · intro h
    rw [parameter_ledger_affine t ht, parameter_ledger_affine u hu, h]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ParameterLedger.q11AffineValue_one
statement:
theorem q11AffineValue_one :
    (ledger (parameterTriple 1 one_ne_zero)).Q 1 1 = q11AffineValue 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [q11AffineValue, parameterRootSum]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ParameterLedger.q11AffineValue_witnessScale
statement:
theorem q11AffineValue_witnessScale :
    (ledger (parameterTriple witnessScale witnessScale_ne_zero)).Q 1 1 =
      q11AffineValue witnessScale
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun L : Ledger => L.Q 1 1)
    parameterLedger_one_eq_witnessScale
  rw [← h]
  simp [q11AffineValue, parameterRootSum, witnessScale_ne_zero]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ParameterLedger.parameterRootSum_eq_of_Q11AffineLaw
statement:
theorem parameterRootSum_eq_of_Q11AffineLaw
    (hLaw : Q11AffineLaw) (t : ℚ) (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    parameterRootSum t =
      1 + witnessScale +
        (ledger (parameterTriple 1 one_ne_zero)).Q 1 1 -
          (ledger (parameterTriple t ht)).Q 1 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [hLaw t ht]
  simp only [q11AffineValue]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ParameterLedger.parameterRootSum_eq_Q11
statement:
theorem parameterRootSum_eq_Q11 (t : ℚ) (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    parameterRootSum t =
      1 + witnessScale +
        (ledger (parameterTriple 1 one_ne_zero)).Q 1 1 -
          (ledger (parameterTriple t ht)).Q 1 1
proof:
:=
  parameterRootSum_eq_of_Q11AffineLaw parameter_Q11_affine t ht

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TitsDiagonalBlocks.polarProduct_secondBlock
statement:
theorem polarProduct_secondBlock (A B C E : Mat3 K) :
    (polarProduct firstTitsSquare (A, B, C) (0, E, 0)).2.1 =
      ⅟(2 : K) • (trace3 A • E - A * E)
proof:
:= by
  have ha0 : adjugate3 (0 : Mat3 K) = 0 := by
    rw [adjugate3_eq_matrixAdjugate]
    exact Matrix.adjugate_zero
  have ht : trace3 (A + 0) = trace3 A := by simp
  change ⅟(2 : K) •
      ((adjugate3 (C + 0) - (A + 0) * (B + E) +
          trace3 (A + 0) • (B + E)) -
        (adjugate3 C - A * B + trace3 A • B) -
        (adjugate3 0 - 0 * E + trace3 0 • E)) = _
  have hz : trace3 (0 : Mat3 K) = 0 := by simp [trace3, Matrix.zero_apply]
  rw [ha0, ht, hz]
  simp only [add_zero, add_mul, mul_add, zero_mul,
    zero_add, zero_smul, sub_zero, smul_add]
  congr 1
  abel

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TitsDiagonalBlocks.polarProduct_thirdBlock
statement:
theorem polarProduct_thirdBlock (A B C F : Mat3 K) :
    (polarProduct firstTitsSquare (A, B, C) (0, 0, F)).2.2 =
      ⅟(2 : K) • (trace3 A • F - F * A)
proof:
:= by
  have ha0 : adjugate3 (0 : Mat3 K) = 0 := by
    rw [adjugate3_eq_matrixAdjugate]
    exact Matrix.adjugate_zero
  have ht : trace3 (A + 0) = trace3 A := by simp
  change ⅟(2 : K) •
      ((adjugate3 (B + 0) - (C + F) * (A + 0) +
          trace3 (A + 0) • (C + F)) -
        (adjugate3 B - C * A + trace3 A • C) -
        (adjugate3 0 - F * 0 + trace3 0 • F)) = _
  have hz : trace3 (0 : Mat3 K) = 0 := by simp [trace3, Matrix.zero_apply]
  rw [ha0, ht, hz]
  simp only [add_zero, add_mul, mul_add, mul_zero,
    zero_add, zero_smul, sub_zero, smul_add]
  congr 1
  abel

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TitsDiagonalBlocks.polarProduct_firstBlock
statement:
theorem polarProduct_firstBlock (A B C D : Mat3 K) :
    (polarProduct firstTitsSquare (A, B, C) (D, 0, 0)).1 =
      matrixJordan A D
proof:
:= by
  have hcomm : polarProduct firstTitsSquare (A, B, C) (D, 0, 0) =
      polarProduct firstTitsSquare (D, 0, 0) (A, B, C) := by
    simp only [polarProduct, add_comm]
    congr 1
    abel
  rw [hcomm]
  simpa only [matrixJordan, add_comm] using
    polarProduct_firstComponent D (A, B, C)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericFieldSymmetries.nu_base
statement:
@[simp] theorem nu_base (b : Base k) :
    nu k (includeBase k b) = includeBase k (reorient k b)
proof:
:=
  fieldEquiv_base _ _ b

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericFieldSymmetries.nu_T
statement: @[simp] theorem nu_T : nu k (T (Base k)) = T (Base k)
proof: := fieldEquiv_T _ _

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericFieldSymmetries.nu_twice
statement: @[simp] theorem nu_twice (z : FunctionField k) : nu k (nu k z) = z
proof:
:=
  fieldEquiv_twice _ _ z

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericFieldSymmetries.nu_constant
statement:
@[simp] theorem nu_constant (z : k) :
    nu k (algebraMap k (FunctionField k) z) = algebraMap k (FunctionField k) z
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k (Base k) (FunctionField k)]
  change nu k (includeBase k (algebraMap k (Base k) z)) = _
  rw [nu_base, reorient_constant]
  rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericFieldSymmetries.nu_commutes_deck
statement: theorem nu_commutes_deck : Function.Commute (nu k) (deck k)
proof:
:=
  fieldEquiv_commutes_reciprocal (reorient k) (reorient_twice k)
    (Matrix.det (rationalM k)) (det_rationalM_ne_zero k) (reorient_det_rationalM k)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericFieldSymmetries.tau_apply
statement: theorem tau_apply (z : FunctionField k) : tau k z = deck k (nu k z)
proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericFieldSymmetries.deck_twice
statement: @[simp] theorem deck_twice (z : FunctionField k) : deck k (deck k z) = z
proof:
:=
  (deck k).left_inv z

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericFieldSymmetries.tau_twice
statement: @[simp] theorem tau_twice (z : FunctionField k) : tau k (tau k z) = z
proof:
:= by
  simp only [tau_apply]
  rw [nu_commutes_deck, nu_twice, deck_twice]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericFieldSymmetries.tau_commutes_deck
statement: theorem tau_commutes_deck : Function.Commute (tau k) (deck k)
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  simp only [tau_apply]
  rw [nu_commutes_deck]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericFieldSymmetries.kappa_eq_orientation
statement:
theorem kappa_eq_orientation :
    kappa k = AlbertLean.Residual.FrameIdeal.orientation (genericChart k)
proof:
:= by
  change includeBase k (ι k (c k) - ι k (a k) * ι k (b k)) =
    1 * includeBase k (ι k (c k)) - includeBase k (ι k (b k)) *
      includeBase k (ι k (a k))
  simp only [map_sub, map_mul, one_mul]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericFieldSymmetries.kappa_ne_zero
statement: theorem kappa_ne_zero : kappa k ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [kappa_eq_orientation]
  exact generic_orientation_ne k

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericFieldSymmetries.eta_ne_zero
statement: theorem eta_ne_zero : eta k ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply branchPolynomial_ne_zero (Base k) (Matrix.det (rationalM k))
  have ht := T_ne_zero (Base k)
  have he : T (Base k) = includeBase k (Matrix.det (rationalM k)) / T (Base k) :=
    sub_eq_zero.mp h
  have hh := (eq_div_iff ht).mp he
  simpa only [pow_two, sub_eq_zero, includeBase] using hh

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericFieldSymmetries.nu_kappa
statement: @[simp] theorem nu_kappa : nu k (kappa k) = -kappa k
proof:
:= by
  rw [kappa, nu_base, reorient_orientation, map_neg]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericFieldSymmetries.deck_kappa
statement: @[simp] theorem deck_kappa : deck k (kappa k) = kappa k
proof: := deck_base k _

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericFieldSymmetries.nu_eta
statement: @[simp] theorem nu_eta : nu k (eta k) = eta k
proof:
:= by
  simp only [eta, map_sub, map_div₀, nu_T, nu_base, reorient_det_rationalM]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericFieldSymmetries.deck_eta
statement: @[simp] theorem deck_eta : deck k (eta k) = -eta k
proof:
:= by
  have hm : includeBase k (Matrix.det (rationalM k)) ≠ 0 :=
    (map_ne_zero (includeBase k)).mpr (det_rationalM_ne_zero k)
  have ht : deck k (T (Base k)) =
      includeBase k (Matrix.det (rationalM k)) / T (Base k) := deck_Delta k
  simp only [eta, map_sub, map_div₀, ht, deck_base]
  rw [div_div_cancel₀ hm]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericFieldSymmetries.tau_kappa
statement: @[simp] theorem tau_kappa : tau k (kappa k) = -kappa k
proof:
:= by
  rw [tau_apply, nu_kappa, map_neg, deck_kappa]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericFieldSymmetries.tau_eta
statement: @[simp] theorem tau_eta : tau k (eta k) = -eta k
proof:
:= by
  rw [tau_apply, nu_eta, deck_eta]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericFieldSymmetries.tau_constant
statement:
@[simp] theorem tau_constant (z : k) :
    tau k (algebraMap k (FunctionField k) z) = algebraMap k (FunctionField k) z
proof:
:= by
  rw [tau_apply, nu_constant, IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k (Base k) (FunctionField k)]
  exact deck_base k _

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexDephaseTransposeBridge.dephase_diagonal_scale
statement:
theorem dephase_diagonal_scale (X : Mat3 K) (l r : Fin 3 → K)
    (hl : ∀ i, l i ≠ 0) (hr : ∀ j, r j ≠ 0) :
    dephase (Matrix.diagonal l * X * Matrix.diagonal r) = dephase X
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp only [dephase, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply]
  simp
  field_simp [hl 0, hl i, hr 0, hr j]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexDephaseTransposeBridge.transpose_diagonal
statement:
private theorem transpose_diagonal (d : Fin 3 → K) :
    Matrix.transpose (Matrix.diagonal d) = Matrix.diagonal d
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  by_cases h : i = j
  · subst j; simp
  · simp [Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.diagonal_apply, h, Ne.symm h]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexDephaseTransposeBridge.inverseTranspose_dephase_eq_diagonal_scale
statement:
theorem inverseTranspose_dephase_eq_diagonal_scale (X : Mat3 K)
    (hentries : ∀ i j, X i j ≠ 0) (hdet : Matrix.det X ≠ 0) :
    Matrix.transpose (dephase X)⁻¹ =
      Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (leftScale X i)⁻¹) *
        Matrix.transpose X⁻¹ *
          Matrix.diagonal (fun j => (rightScale X j)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  have hl : ∀ i, leftScale X i ≠ 0 := fun i =>
    div_ne_zero (hentries 0 0) (hentries i 0)
  have hr : ∀ j, rightScale X j ≠ 0 := fun j =>
    inv_ne_zero (hentries 0 j)
  have hYX : X⁻¹ * X = 1 :=
    Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul X (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hdet)
  rw [dephase_eq_diagonal_mul,
    scaled_inverse X X⁻¹ (leftScale X) (rightScale X) hl hr hYX]
  simp only [Matrix.transpose_mul]
  rw [transpose_diagonal, transpose_diagonal]
  simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexDephaseTransposeBridge.dephase_inverseTranspose_dephase
statement:
theorem dephase_inverseTranspose_dephase (X : Mat3 K)
    (hentries : ∀ i j, X i j ≠ 0) (hdet : Matrix.det X ≠ 0) :
    dephase (Matrix.transpose (dephase X)⁻¹) =
      dephase (Matrix.transpose X⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  rw [inverseTranspose_dephase_eq_diagonal_scale X hentries hdet]
  apply dephase_diagonal_scale
  · intro i
    exact inv_ne_zero (div_ne_zero (hentries 0 0) (hentries i 0))
  · intro j
    exact inv_ne_zero (inv_ne_zero (hentries 0 j))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.MeasurementLedgerConverse.power_diagonals_of_norms
statement:
theorem power_diagonals_of_norms (F : Subfield K) (a : JCoord K)
    (ha : DiagIn F a) (hv : nV a.v ∈ F) (hs : nS a.s ∈ F) (hc : nC a.c ∈ F) :
    ∀ p, DiagIn F (power a p)
proof:
:= by
  intro p
  fin_cases p
  · intro i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [power, sourceOne, diagLinear]
  · exact ha
  · intro i
    fin_cases i
    · change (sourceSquare a).d1 ∈ F
      rw [sourceSquare_d1]
      exact F.add_mem (F.add_mem (F.pow_mem (ha 0) 2) hs) hc
    · change (sourceSquare a).d2 ∈ F
      rw [sourceSquare_d2]
      exact F.add_mem (F.add_mem (F.pow_mem (ha 1) 2) hc) hv
    · change (sourceSquare a).d3 ∈ F
      rw [sourceSquare_d3]
      exact F.add_mem (F.add_mem (F.pow_mem (ha 2) 2) hv) hs

name: AlbertLean.Generic.MeasurementLedgerConverse.uncentered_mem
statement:
theorem uncentered_mem (F : Subfield K) (la lb g11 g12 g21 g22 : K)
    (hla : la ∈ F) (hlb : lb ∈ F) (h11 : g11 ∈ F)
    (h12 : g12 ∈ F) (h21 : g21 ∈ F)
    (hU : g22 - la * g12 - lb * g21 + la * lb * g11 ∈ F) : g22 ∈ F
proof:
:= by
  have h := F.sub_mem
    (F.add_mem (F.add_mem hU (F.mul_mem hla h12)) (F.mul_mem hlb h21))
    (F.mul_mem (F.mul_mem hla hlb) h11)
  convert h using 1 <;> ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.MeasurementLedgerConverse.square_sectors_mem
statement:
theorem square_sectors_mem (F : Subfield K) (a b : JCoord K)
    (ha : DiagIn F a) (hb : DiagIn F b)
    (h11 : SectorIn F a b)
    (h12 : SectorIn F a (sourceSquare b))
    (h21 : SectorIn F (sourceSquare a) b)
    (hUV : normalizedUV a.s b.s a.c b.c ∈ F)
    (hUS : BS (sourceMuS a.c a.v) (sourceMuS b.c b.v) ∈ F)
    (hUC : BC (sourceMuC a.v a.s) (sourceMuC b.v b.s) ∈ F) :
    SectorIn F (sourceSquare a) (sourceSquare b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [uV_centered] at hUV
  rw [uS_centered] at hUS
  rw [uC_centered] at hUC
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact uncentered_mem F _ _ _ _ _ _ (F.add_mem (ha 1) (ha 2))
      (F.add_mem (hb 1) (hb 2)) h11.1 h12.1 h21.1 hUV
  · exact uncentered_mem F _ _ _ _ _ _ (F.add_mem (ha 0) (ha 2))
      (F.add_mem (hb 0) (hb 2)) h11.2.1 h12.2.1 h21.2.1 hUS
  · exact uncentered_mem F _ _ _ _ _ _ (F.add_mem (ha 0) (ha 1))
      (F.add_mem (hb 0) (hb 1)) h11.2.2 h12.2.2 h21.2.2 hUC

name: AlbertLean.Generic.MeasurementLedgerConverse.ledgerIn_of_measurements
statement:
theorem ledgerIn_of_measurements (F : Subfield K) (a b : JCoord K)
    (ha : ∀ p, DiagIn F (power a p)) (hb : ∀ p, DiagIn F (power b p))
    (h11 : SectorIn F a b)
    (h12 : SectorIn F a (sourceSquare b))
    (h21 : SectorIn F (sourceSquare a) b)
    (hUV : normalizedUV a.s b.s a.c b.c ∈ F)
    (hUS : BS (sourceMuS a.c a.v) (sourceMuS b.c b.v) ∈ F)
    (hUC : BC (sourceMuC a.v a.s) (sourceMuC b.v b.s) ∈ F) :
    LedgerIn F (sourceLedger a b)
proof:
:= by
  have h22 := square_sectors_mem F a b (ha 1) (hb 1) h11 h12 h21 hUV hUS hUC
  have hs : ∀ p q, SectorIn F (power a p) (power b q) := by
    intro p q
    fin_cases p <;> fin_cases q
    all_goals first
      | exact h11 | exact h12 | exact h21 | exact h22
      | simp [SectorIn, power, sourceOne, BV, BS, BC, BW, evalU]
  apply ledgerIn_of_power_diagonal_mem
  intro i p q
  have hpair := hs p q
  fin_cases i
  · change (sourceProduct (power a p) (power b q)).d1 ∈ F
    rw [sourceProduct_d1]
    exact F.add_mem (F.mul_mem (ha p 0) (hb q 0))
      (F.div_mem (F.add_mem hpair.2.1 hpair.2.2) (natCast_mem F 2))
  · change (sourceProduct (power a p) (power b q)).d2 ∈ F
    rw [sourceProduct_d2]
    exact F.add_mem (F.mul_mem (ha p 1) (hb q 1))
      (F.div_mem (F.add_mem hpair.2.2 hpair.1) (natCast_mem F 2))
  · change (sourceProduct (power a p) (power b q)).d3 ∈ F
    rw [sourceProduct_d3]
    exact F.add_mem (F.mul_mem (ha p 2) (hb q 2))
      (F.div_mem (F.add_mem hpair.1 hpair.2.1) (natCast_mem F 2))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.orthogonalConjugate_symmetric
statement:
theorem orthogonalConjugate_symmetric (q A : Mat3 K)
    (hA : Matrix.transpose A = A) :
    Matrix.transpose (orthogonalConjugate q A) = orthogonalConjugate q A
proof:
:= by
  simp only [orthogonalConjugate, Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_transpose,
    hA, Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.orthogonalConjugate_mul
statement:
theorem orthogonalConjugate_mul (q A B : Mat3 K) (hq : IsOrthogonal q) :
    orthogonalConjugate q (A * B) =
      orthogonalConjugate q A * orthogonalConjugate q B
proof:
:= by
  simp only [orthogonalConjugate, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc (Matrix.transpose q) q (B * Matrix.transpose q), hq.transpose_mul,
    Matrix.one_mul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.orthogonalConjugate_one
statement:
theorem orthogonalConjugate_one (q : Mat3 K) (hq : IsOrthogonal q) :
    orthogonalConjugate q 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [orthogonalConjugate, hq.mul_transpose]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.orthogonalConjugate_add
statement:
theorem orthogonalConjugate_add (q A B : Mat3 K) :
    orthogonalConjugate q (A + B) =
      orthogonalConjugate q A + orthogonalConjugate q B
proof:
:= by
  simp [orthogonalConjugate, Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.add_mul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.orthogonalConjugate_trace
statement:
theorem orthogonalConjugate_trace (q A : Mat3 K) (hq : IsOrthogonal q) :
    Matrix.trace (orthogonalConjugate q A) = Matrix.trace A
proof:
:= by
  calc
    Matrix.trace (q * A * Matrix.transpose q) =
        Matrix.trace (Matrix.transpose q * (q * A)) := Matrix.trace_mul_comm _ _
    _ = Matrix.trace A := by rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, hq.transpose_mul, Matrix.one_mul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.frameOfOrthogonal_symmetric
statement:
theorem frameOfOrthogonal_symmetric (q : Mat3 K) (i : Fin 3) :
    Matrix.transpose (frameOfOrthogonal q i) = frameOfOrthogonal q i
proof:
:= by
  apply orthogonalConjugate_symmetric
  ext r c
  simp [diagonalUnit, Matrix.transpose_apply, and_comm]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.frameOfOrthogonal_idempotent
statement:
theorem frameOfOrthogonal_idempotent (q : Mat3 K) (hq : IsOrthogonal q)
    (i : Fin 3) : frameOfOrthogonal q i * frameOfOrthogonal q i =
      frameOfOrthogonal q i
proof:
:= by
  unfold frameOfOrthogonal
  rw [← orthogonalConjugate_mul q _ _ hq]
  congr 1
  ext r c
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases r <;> fin_cases c <;>
    simp [diagonalUnit, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.frameOfOrthogonal_sum
statement:
theorem frameOfOrthogonal_sum (q : Mat3 K) (hq : IsOrthogonal q) :
    frameOfOrthogonal q 0 + frameOfOrthogonal q 1 + frameOfOrthogonal q 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold frameOfOrthogonal
  rw [← orthogonalConjugate_add, ← orthogonalConjugate_add,
    show diagonalUnit 0 + diagonalUnit 1 + diagonalUnit 2 = (1 : Mat3 K) by
      ext r c
      fin_cases r <;> fin_cases c <;> simp [diagonalUnit]]
  exact orthogonalConjugate_one q hq

name: AlbertLean.Generic.PairedReflectionDescent.coefficients_of_paired_reflection
statement:
theorem coefficients_of_paired_reflection
    (ep bp em bm s t u : K) (htu : t ≠ u) (hs : s = t + u)
    (hfirst : ep + bp * t = em + bm * u)
    (hsecond : ep + bp * u = em + bm * t) :
    bm = -bp ∧ em = ep + bp * s
proof:
:= by
  have hprod : (bp + bm) * (t - u) = 0 := by
    linear_combination hfirst - hsecond
  have hsum : bp + bm = 0 :=
    (mul_eq_zero.mp hprod).resolve_right (sub_ne_zero.mpr htu)
  constructor
  · linear_combination hsum
  · rw [hs]
    linear_combination -hfirst - u * hsum

name: AlbertLean.Generic.PairedReflectionDescent.symmetric_coefficients_equal
statement:
theorem symmetric_coefficients_equal
    (ep bp em bm s m : K)
    (hb : bm = -bp) (he : em = ep + bp * s) :
    2 * em + bm * s = 2 * ep + bp * s ∧
      em ^ 2 + em * bm * s + bm ^ 2 * m =
        ep ^ 2 + ep * bp * s + bp ^ 2 * m
proof:
:= by
  rw [hb, he]
  constructor <;> ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.PairedReflectionDescent.affine_root_quadratic
statement:
theorem affine_root_quadratic
    (e b s m t u : K) (hs : s = t + u) (hm : m = t * u) :
    (e + b * t) ^ 2 - (2 * e + b * s) * (e + b * t) +
      (e ^ 2 + e * b * s + b ^ 2 * m) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [hs, hm]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.PairedReflectionDescent.orientationEval_apply
statement:
theorem orientationEval_apply (i : H →+* K) (D : H) (sigma : K)
    (hsigma : sigma ^ 2 = i D) (z : QuadraticAlgebra H D 0) :
    orientationEval i D sigma hsigma z = i z.re + i z.im * sigma
proof:
:= by
  change i z.re * 1 + i z.im * sigma = _
  rw [mul_one]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.PairedReflectionDescent.im_eq_zero_of_opposite_evaluations
statement:
theorem im_eq_zero_of_opposite_evaluations
    (i : H →+* K) (D : H) (sigma : K)
    (hsigma : sigma ^ 2 = i D) (hsigma0 : sigma ≠ 0)
    (z : QuadraticAlgebra H D 0)
    (heq : orientationEval i D sigma hsigma z =
      orientationEval i D (-sigma) (by simpa using hsigma) z) :
    z.im = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [orientationEval_apply, orientationEval_apply] at heq
  have hz : ((2 : K) * sigma) * i z.im = 0 := by
    linear_combination heq
  have hi : i z.im = 0 :=
    (mul_eq_zero.mp hz).resolve_left
      (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) hsigma0)
  apply i.injective
  simpa using hi

name: AlbertLean.Generic.PairedReflectionDescent.eq_base_of_opposite_evaluations
statement:
theorem eq_base_of_opposite_evaluations
    (i : H →+* K) (D : H) (sigma : K)
    (hsigma : sigma ^ 2 = i D) (hsigma0 : sigma ≠ 0)
    (z : QuadraticAlgebra H D 0)
    (heq : orientationEval i D sigma hsigma z =
      orientationEval i D (-sigma) (by simpa using hsigma) z) :
    z = algebraMap H (QuadraticAlgebra H D 0) z.re ∧
      orientationEval i D sigma hsigma z = i z.re
proof:
:= by
  have him := im_eq_zero_of_opposite_evaluations i D sigma hsigma hsigma0 z heq
  constructor
  · apply QuadraticAlgebra.ext <;> simp [him]
  · rw [orientationEval_apply, him, map_zero, zero_mul, add_zero]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.PairedReflectionDescent.symmetric_coefficients_descend
statement:
theorem symmetric_coefficients_descend
    (i : H →+* K) (D : H) (sigma : K)
    (hsigma : sigma ^ 2 = i D) (hsigma0 : sigma ≠ 0)
    (e b s m : QuadraticAlgebra H D 0)
    (hb : orientationEval i D (-sigma) (by simpa using hsigma) b =
      -orientationEval i D sigma hsigma b)
    (he : orientationEval i D (-sigma) (by simpa using hsigma) e =
      orientationEval i D sigma hsigma e +
        orientationEval i D sigma hsigma b * orientationEval i D sigma hsigma s)
    (hs : orientationEval i D (-sigma) (by simpa using hsigma) s =
      orientationEval i D sigma hsigma s)
    (hm : orientationEval i D (-sigma) (by simpa using hsigma) m =
      orientationEval i D sigma hsigma m) :
    (2 * e + b * s).im = 0 ∧
      (e ^ 2 + e * b * s + b ^ 2 * m).im = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · apply im_eq_zero_of_opposite_evaluations i D sigma hsigma hsigma0
    simp only [map_add, map_mul, map_ofNat, hb, he, hs]
    ring
  · apply im_eq_zero_of_opposite_evaluations i D sigma hsigma hsigma0
    simp only [map_add, map_mul, map_pow, hb, he, hs, hm]
    ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.PairedReflectionDescent.sourceDetector_eq_reflected_affine
statement:
theorem sourceDetector_eq_reflected_affine
    (a : K) (ha : a ≠ 0) (q : ExplicitFrameChart K)
    (hr : q.r1 = 1) (hz : q.z1 = a)
    (hm : determinantProduct q ≠ 0) :
    sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1) (encoderA q) (encoderB q) =
      QuadraticDetectorAffine.epsilon q.diagA q.diagB a (q.z2 / a) (a * q.r2)
          (reflectedMoment a q) (determinantSum q)
          (determinantProduct q) (determinantProduct q)⁻¹ +
        QuadraticDetectorAffine.beta q.diagA q.diagB a (q.z2 / a) (a * q.r2)
          (reflectedMoment a q) (determinantSum q)
          (determinantProduct q) (determinantProduct q)⁻¹ *
            deltaStar (residualPairOfChart q)
proof:
:= by
  have hprod : determinantProduct q =
      deltaStar (residualPairOfChart q) * delta (residualPairOfChart q) := by
    simp only [determinantProduct, moment, Matrix.det_mul, deltaStar, delta]
  have hA : Matrix.det (residualPairOfChart q).A ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    apply hm
    rw [hprod]
    change Matrix.det (residualPairOfChart q).A * _ = 0
    rw [hzero, zero_mul]
  have hquad : deltaStar (residualPairOfChart q) ^ 2 =
      determinantSum q * deltaStar (residualPairOfChart q) - determinantProduct q := by
    rw [determinantSum, hprod]
    ring
  have href := detector_eq_reflected_normalized a ha q hA
  rw [hr, hz, div_self ha, mul_one] at href
  have haff := QuadraticDetectorAffine.normalized_eq_epsilon_add_beta_mul
    q.diagA q.diagB a (q.z2 / a) (a * q.r2)
    (reflectedMoment a q) (determinantSum q)
    (determinantProduct q) (determinantProduct q)⁻¹
    (mul_inv_cancel₀ hm) (RingHom.id K)
    (deltaStar (residualPairOfChart q)) hquad
  exact href.trans (by simpa [reflectedMoment, deltaStar] using haff)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.NonzeroFrame.orthogonal_of_idempotents_sum
statement:
theorem orthogonal_of_idempotents_sum (P : Fin 3 → Mat3 K)
    (hi : ∀ i, P i * P i = P i) (hs : P 0 + P 1 + P 2 = 1) :
    ∀ i j, i ≠ j → P i * P j = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h01 := first_two_mul_zero_of_sum (P 0) (P 1) (P 2)
    (hi 0) (hi 1) (hi 2) hs
  have h02 := first_two_mul_zero_of_sum (P 0) (P 2) (P 1)
    (hi 0) (hi 2) (hi 1) (by simpa only [add_right_comm] using hs)
  have h12 := first_two_mul_zero_of_sum (P 1) (P 2) (P 0)
    (hi 1) (hi 2) (hi 0) (by
      calc
        P 1 + P 2 + P 0 = P 0 + P 1 + P 2 := by abel
        _ = 1 := hs)
  intro i j hij
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp_all

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.NonzeroFrame.exists_nonzero_entry
statement:
theorem exists_nonzero_entry (P : Mat3 K) (hP : P ≠ 0) :
    ∃ r c : Fin 3, P r c ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  push_neg at h
  apply hP
  ext r c
  exact h r c

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.NonzeroFrame.exists_two_sided_basis
statement:
theorem exists_two_sided_basis (P : Fin 3 → Mat3 K)
    (hi : ∀ i, P i * P i = P i) (hn : ∀ i, P i ≠ 0)
    (hs : P 0 + P 1 + P 2 = 1) :
    ∃ X Y : Mat3 K, Y * X = 1 ∧ X * Y = 1 ∧
      (∀ i, P i * X = X * diagonalUnit i) ∧
      (∀ i, P i = X * diagonalUnit i * Y)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have ho := orthogonal_of_idempotents_sum P hi hs
  choose k j hkj using fun i => exists_nonzero_entry (P i) (hn i)
  let X : Mat3 K := fun r i => P i r (j i)
  let Y : Mat3 K := fun i r => P i (k i) r / P i (k i) (j i)
  have hprod (i l : Fin 3) : P i * P l = if i = l then P i else 0 := by
    by_cases hil : i = l
    · subst l
      simpa using hi i
    · simp only [if_neg hil, ho i l hil]
  have hYX : Y * X = 1 := by
    ext i l
    calc
      (Y * X) i l = (P i * P l) (k i) (j l) / P i (k i) (j i) := by
        change (∑ t : Fin 3, (P i (k i) t / P i (k i) (j i)) * P l t (j l)) =
          (∑ t : Fin 3, P i (k i) t * P l t (j l)) / P i (k i) (j i)
        simp [Fin.sum_univ_succ, div_eq_mul_inv] <;> ring
      _ = (1 : Mat3 K) i l := by
        rw [hprod]
        by_cases hil : i = l
        · subst l
          simp [hkj i]
        · simp [hil, Matrix.one_apply]
  have hXY : X * Y = 1 := mul_eq_one_comm.mp hYX
  have hPX (i : Fin 3) : P i * X = X * diagonalUnit i := by
    ext r l
    have hc : (P i * X) r l = (P i * P l) r (j l) := rfl
    rw [hc, hprod]
    change (if i = l then P i else 0) r (j l) =
      ∑ t : Fin 3, X r t * diagonalUnit i t l
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases l <;>
      simp [X, diagonalUnit, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  refine ⟨X, Y, hYX, hXY, hPX, ?_⟩
  intro i
  calc
    P i = P i * (X * Y) := by rw [hXY, Matrix.mul_one]
    _ = (P i * X) * Y := (Matrix.mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
    _ = X * diagonalUnit i * Y := by rw [hPX i]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.NonzeroFrame.trace_one_of_nonzero_idempotents_sum
statement:
theorem trace_one_of_nonzero_idempotents_sum (P : Fin 3 → Mat3 K)
    (hi : ∀ i, P i * P i = P i) (hn : ∀ i, P i ≠ 0)
    (hs : P 0 + P 1 + P 2 = 1) : ∀ i, Matrix.trace (P i) = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨X, Y, hYX, hXY, hPX, hP⟩ := exists_two_sided_basis P hi hn hs
  intro i
  rw [hP i, Matrix.trace_mul_cycle, hYX, Matrix.one_mul]
  exact FourRowProbeSeed.diagonalUnit_trace i

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.NonzeroFrame.frameLaws_of_nonzero_idempotents_sum
statement:
theorem frameLaws_of_nonzero_idempotents_sum (P : Fin 3 → Mat3 K)
    (hi : ∀ i, P i * P i = P i) (hn : ∀ i, P i ≠ 0)
    (hs : P 0 + P 1 + P 2 = 1) : FrameLaws P
proof:
:=
  ⟨hi, orthogonal_of_idempotents_sum P hi hs, hs,
    trace_one_of_nonzero_idempotents_sum P hi hn hs⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.RawFramePrimeSquare.residueMap_eq_evaluationAlong
statement:
theorem residueMap_eq_evaluationAlong :
    residueMap k p = evaluationAlong (coefficientMap k p) (genericFrame k p)
proof:
:= by
  apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
  · intro c; simp [evaluationAlong, coefficientMap]
  · intro x
    cases x with
    | entry r i a b => simp [residueMap, coefficientMap, genericFrame,
        evaluationAlong, universalMatrix]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.RawFramePrimeSquare.genericFrame_isRaw
statement:
theorem genericFrame_isRaw (hraw : rawFrameIdeal (R := k) ≤ p) :
    IsRawFrameFamily (genericFrame k p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← equations_vanishAlong_iff (coefficientMap k p),
    ← residueMap_eq_evaluationAlong]
  intro q
  simp [residueMap, Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr
    (hraw (Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self q)))]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.RawFramePrimeSquare.exists_localized_evaluation
statement:
theorem exists_localized_evaluation (hraw : rawFrameIdeal (R := k) ≤ p) :
    ∃ (X : Fin 3 → Mat3 (GenericField k p))
      (hdet : ∀ r, Matrix.det (X r) ≠ 0),
      ∀ r i a b,
        evalAway (coefficientMap k p) X hdet
            (psi k (MvPolynomial.X (.entry r i a b))) =
          residueMap k p (MvPolynomial.X (.entry r i a b))
proof:
:= by
  letI : CharZero (GenericField k p) :=
    AlbertLean.Generic.FiniteQuadraticRoots.charZero_of_embedding (coefficientMap k p)
  have hP := genericFrame_isRaw k p hraw
  have hsum (r : Fin 3) : genericFrame k p r 0 + genericFrame k p r 1 +
      genericFrame k p r 2 = 1 := by
    simpa [Fin.sum_univ_succ, add_assoc] using hP.sum_one r
  choose X hdet hX using fun r => rawFrame_exists_frameOfInvertible
    (genericFrame k p r) (hP.idempotent r) (hsum r) (hP.trace_one r)
  refine ⟨X, hdet, ?_⟩
  intro r i a b
  simp only [psi, evaluationAlong, MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_X']
  change (evalAway (coefficientMap k p) X hdet).mapMatrix
    (localizedProjector k r i) a b = _
  rw [evalAway_localizedProjector]
  exact congrFun (congrFun (hX r i) a) b

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourcePermutationExtension.sourcePermutation_f0_normal_form
statement:
private theorem sourcePermutation_f0_normal_form
    {F : Type*} [Field F] [CharZero F]
    (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) (x : Fin 27 → F) :
    structuredEquivK F
        (sourcePermutation σ ((structuredEquivK F).symm x)) =
      firstTitsToF0Raw (firstTitsPerm σ (f0ToFirstTitsRaw x))
proof:
:= by
  apply (f0FirstTitsEquiv (K := F)).injective
  change sourceFirstTitsEquiv
      (sourcePermutation σ ((structuredEquivK F).symm x)) = _
  rw [sourcePermutation_transport]
  change firstTitsPerm σ
      (F0FirstTitsLinear.f0FirstTitsEquiv
        (structuredEquivK F ((structuredEquivK F).symm x))) =
    F0FirstTitsLinear.f0FirstTitsEquiv
      ((F0FirstTitsLinear.f0FirstTitsEquiv (K := F)).symm
        (firstTitsPerm σ (F0FirstTitsLinear.f0FirstTitsEquiv x)))
  simp only [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourcePermutationExtension.ringSwap01_eq_native
statement:
theorem ringSwap01_eq_native
    {L : Type*} [Field L] [CharZero L] [Algebra k L]
    [Invertible (2 : L)] :
    ringSwap01 (k := k) (R := L) =
      nativePermutation (L := L) (Equiv.swap 0 1)
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearEquiv.ext
  have hmaps :
      (ringSwap01 (k := k) (R := L)).toLinearMap =
        (nativePermutation (L := L) (Equiv.swap 0 1)).toLinearMap := by
    apply (Pi.basisFun L (Fin 27)).ext
    intro i
    simp only [Pi.basisFun_apply]
    rw [← mapCoord_single (k := k) (R := L) i]
    change SourceAutExtension.linear (R := L)
      (sourcePermutationAut (K := k) (Equiv.swap 0 1))
        (mapCoord (algebraMap k L) (Pi.single i 1)) = _
    rw [linearEquiv_on_constants]
    change mapCoord (algebraMap k L)
        (structuredEquivK k
          (sourcePermutation (Equiv.swap 0 1)
            ((structuredEquivK k).symm (Pi.single i 1)))) = _
    exact swap01_f0_natural (k := k) (L := L) (Pi.single i 1)
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun hmaps

name: AlbertLean.Generic.MatrixOperatorTrace.trace_mulLeft_fin_three
statement:
theorem trace_mulLeft_fin_three (A : Mat3 K) :
    LinearMap.trace K (Mat3 K) (matrixMulLeft A) =
      3 * Matrix.trace A
proof:
:= by
  rw [LinearMap.trace_eq_matrix_trace K (Matrix.stdBasis K (Fin 3) (Fin 3))]
  have repr_apply (X : Mat3 K) (i j : Fin 3) :
      (Matrix.stdBasis K (Fin 3) (Fin 3)).repr X (i, j) = X i j := rfl
  simp only [Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag_apply, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply', matrixMulLeft,
    repr_apply, ← Finset.univ_product_univ, Finset.sum_product]
  simp [Matrix.stdBasis_eq_single, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ,
    Matrix.single_apply]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.MatrixOperatorTrace.trace_mulRight_fin_three
statement:
theorem trace_mulRight_fin_three (A : Mat3 K) :
    LinearMap.trace K (Mat3 K) (matrixMulRight A) =
      3 * Matrix.trace A
proof:
:= by
  rw [LinearMap.trace_eq_matrix_trace K (Matrix.stdBasis K (Fin 3) (Fin 3))]
  have repr_apply (X : Mat3 K) (i j : Fin 3) :
      (Matrix.stdBasis K (Fin 3) (Fin 3)).repr X (i, j) = X i j := rfl
  simp only [Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag_apply, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply', matrixMulRight,
    repr_apply, ← Finset.univ_product_univ, Finset.sum_product]
  simp [Matrix.stdBasis_eq_single, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ,
    Matrix.single_apply]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.MatrixOperatorTrace.trace_sourceLeftMul
statement:
theorem trace_sourceLeftMul (A B C : Mat3 K) :
    LinearMap.trace K (FirstTits K) (sourceLeftMul (A, B, C)) =
      9 * trace3 A
proof:
:= by
  rw [trace_prod_three_blocks]
  have h₁ :
      (LinearMap.fst K (Mat3 K) (Mat3 K × Mat3 K)).comp
          ((sourceLeftMul (A, B, C)).comp
            (LinearMap.inl K (Mat3 K) (Mat3 K × Mat3 K))) =
        ⅟(2 : K) •
          (matrixMulLeft A + matrixMulRight A) := by
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro D
    change (polarProduct firstTitsSquare (A, B, C) (D, 0, 0)).1 = _
    rw [polarProduct_firstBlock]
    rfl
  have h₂ :
      (LinearMap.fst K (Mat3 K) (Mat3 K)).comp
          ((LinearMap.snd K (Mat3 K) (Mat3 K × Mat3 K)).comp
            ((sourceLeftMul (A, B, C)).comp
              ((LinearMap.inr K (Mat3 K) (Mat3 K × Mat3 K)).comp
                (LinearMap.inl K (Mat3 K) (Mat3 K))))) =
        ⅟(2 : K) •
          (trace3 A • LinearMap.id - matrixMulLeft A) := by
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro E
    change (polarProduct firstTitsSquare (A, B, C) (0, E, 0)).2.1 = _
    rw [polarProduct_secondBlock]
    rfl
  have h₃ :
      (LinearMap.snd K (Mat3 K) (Mat3 K)).comp
          ((LinearMap.snd K (Mat3 K) (Mat3 K × Mat3 K)).comp
            ((sourceLeftMul (A, B, C)).comp
              ((LinearMap.inr K (Mat3 K) (Mat3 K × Mat3 K)).comp
                (LinearMap.inr K (Mat3 K) (Mat3 K))))) =
        ⅟(2 : K) •
          (trace3 A • LinearMap.id - matrixMulRight A) := by
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro F
    change (polarProduct firstTitsSquare (A, B, C) (0, 0, F)).2.2 = _
    rw [polarProduct_thirdBlock]
    rfl
  rw [h₁, h₂, h₃]
  simp only [map_smul, map_add, map_sub,
    LinearMap.trace_id, trace_mulLeft_fin_three, trace_mulRight_fin_three,
    trace3_eq_matrixTrace]
  norm_num [Module.finrank_matrix, Module.finrank_self, invOf_eq_inv] <;> ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.OneTransvectionTransport.eval₂Hom_neg
statement:

statement:

    {R T : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing T]
    (f : R →+* T)
    (A : Matrix Ix6 Ix6 R) (c : Index) :
    f (matrixCoordinates A c) = matrixCoordinates (f.mapMatrix A) c
proof:
:= by
  rcases c with ⟨a, b⟩ | c
  · rfl
  · rcases c with c | c <;> fin_cases c <;> simp [matrixCoordinates]

statement:
private theorem map_three_matrix_coordinates
    {R T : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing T]
    (f : R →+* T) (A B C : Matrix Ix6 Ix6 R) (c : Index) :
    f (matrixCoordinates (A * B * C) c) =
      matrixCoordinates (f.mapMatrix A * f.mapMatrix B * f.mapMatrix C) c
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_matrixCoordinates, map_mul, map_mul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.OneTransvectionTransport.map_ringMatrix_basis
statement:
private theorem map_ringMatrix_basis
    {L T : Type*} [CommRing L] [CommRing T]
    (coeffMap : L →+* T) (d : Index) :
    coeffMap.mapMatrix (ringMatrix (Pi.single d (1 : L))) =
      ringMatrix (Pi.single d (1 : T))
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.ext
  intro i j
  change coeffMap (ringMatrix (Pi.single d (1 : L)) i j) =
    ringMatrix (Pi.single d (1 : T)) i j
  rcases i with i | i <;> rcases j with j | j <;>
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [ringMatrix, ringHat, Matrix.fromBlocks, Matrix.transpose,
      Pi.single_apply]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.OneTransvectionTransport.map_conjugation_coefficient
statement:
private theorem map_conjugation_coefficient
    {R L T : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing L] [CommRing T]
    (f : R →+* T) (g : L →+* T)
    (A B : Matrix Ix6 Ix6 R) (A' B' : Matrix Ix6 Ix6 L)
    (q c : Index)
    (hA : f.mapMatrix A = g.mapMatrix A')
    (hB : f.mapMatrix B = g.mapMatrix B') :
    f (matrixCoordinates (A * ringMatrix (Pi.single q (1 : R)) * B) c) =
      g (matrixCoordinates (A' * ringMatrix (Pi.single q (1 : L)) * B') c)
proof:
:= by
  have hbasis : f.mapMatrix (ringMatrix (Pi.single q (1 : R))) =
      g.mapMatrix (ringMatrix (Pi.single q (1 : L))) :=
    (map_ringMatrix_basis (L := R) (T := T) f q).trans
      (map_ringMatrix_basis (L := L) (T := T) g q).symm
  calc
    _ = matrixCoordinates
        (f.mapMatrix A * f.mapMatrix (ringMatrix (Pi.single q (1 : R))) *
          f.mapMatrix B) c :=
      map_three_matrix_coordinates (R := R) (T := T) f A
        (ringMatrix (Pi.single q (1 : R))) B c
    _ = matrixCoordinates
        (g.mapMatrix A' * g.mapMatrix (ringMatrix (Pi.single q (1 : L))) *
          g.mapMatrix B') c := by rw [hA, hbasis, hB]
    _ = _ :=
      (map_three_matrix_coordinates (R := L) (T := T) g A'
        (ringMatrix (Pi.single q (1 : L))) B' c).symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.OneTransvectionTransport.wordMatrix_singleton_entry
statement:
private theorem wordMatrix_singleton_entry
    {L : Type*} [Field L] [CharZero L]
    (d : Vec6 L) (t : L) (i j : Ix6) :
    wordMatrix [(d, t)] i j =
      (if i = j then 1 else 0) + t *
        (match j with
          | Sum.inl q => -d (Sum.inr q)
          | Sum.inr q => d (Sum.inl q)) * d i
proof:
:= by
  change map (omega (K := L)) d t (basisVector j) i = _
  rw [map_apply]
  change basisVector j i +
      (t * (omega (K := L)) d (basisVector j)) * d i = _
  rw [PolynomialFrameSchedule.basisVector_apply_eq,
    PolynomialFrameSchedule.omega_basis_eq_column]
  rcases j with j | j <;> rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.OneTransvectionTransport.inverseWordMatrix_singleton_entry
statement:
private theorem inverseWordMatrix_singleton_entry
    {L : Type*} [Field L] [CharZero L]
    (d : Vec6 L) (t : L) (i j : Ix6) :
    inverseWordMatrix [(d, t)] i j =
      (if i = j then 1 else 0) + (-t) *
        (match j with
          | Sum.inl q => -d (Sum.inr q)
          | Sum.inr q => d (Sum.inl q)) * d i
proof:
:= by
  change wordMatrix [(d, -t)] i j = _
  exact wordMatrix_singleton_entry d (-t) i j

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.OneTransvectionTransport.eval_familyForwardMatrix
statement:
private theorem eval_familyForwardMatrix
    {L : Type*} [Field L] [CharZero L]
    (coeffMap : L →+* S) (η : RR k →+* S) (d : Vec6 L) (t : L) :
    (familyEvaluation k η (coeffMap ∘ d) (coeffMap t)).mapMatrix
        (familyForwardMatrix k) =
      coeffMap.mapMatrix (wordMatrix [(d, t)])
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.ext
  intro i j
  change familyEvaluation k η (coeffMap ∘ d) (coeffMap t)
      (familyForwardMatrix k i j) = coeffMap (wordMatrix [(d, t)] i j)
  rw [wordMatrix_singleton_entry d t]
  rcases j with j | j <;>
    simp [familyEvaluation, familyForwardMatrix, familyCoefficient,
      familyDirection, familyOmegaColumn, Function.comp_apply,
      eval₂Hom_neg, MvPolynomial.eval₂_X] <;>
    split_ifs <;> simp_all <;> ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.OneTransvectionTransport.eval_familyInverseMatrix
statement:
private theorem eval_familyInverseMatrix
    {L : Type*} [Field L] [CharZero L]
    (coeffMap : L →+* S) (η : RR k →+* S) (d : Vec6 L) (t : L) :
    (familyEvaluation k η (coeffMap ∘ d) (coeffMap t)).mapMatrix
        (familyInverseMatrix k) =
      coeffMap.mapMatrix (inverseWordMatrix [(d, t)])
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.ext
  intro i j
  change familyEvaluation k η (coeffMap ∘ d) (coeffMap t)
      (familyInverseMatrix k i j) = coeffMap (inverseWordMatrix [(d, t)] i j)
  rw [inverseWordMatrix_singleton_entry d t]
  rcases j with j | j <;>
    simp [familyEvaluation, familyInverseMatrix, familyCoefficient,
      familyDirection, familyOmegaColumn, Function.comp_apply,
      eval₂Hom_neg, MvPolynomial.eval₂_X] <;>
    split_ifs <;> simp_all <;> ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.OneTransvectionTransport.coordinateAut_singleton_basis
statement:
private theorem coordinateAut_singleton_basis
    {L : Type*} [Field L] [CharZero L]
    (d : Vec6 L) (t : L) (q c : Index) :
    coordinateAut (wordJordanAut [(d, t)]) (Pi.single q 1) c =
      matrixCoordinates
        (wordMatrix [(d, t)] * ringMatrix (Pi.single q (1 : L)) *
          inverseWordMatrix [(d, t)]) c
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordinateAut_apply]
  rw [← matrixCoordinates_carrier]
  rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.OneTransvectionTransport.eval_familyActionCoefficient
statement:
private theorem eval_familyActionCoefficient
    {L : Type*} [Field L] [CharZero L]
    (coeffMap : L →+* S) (η : RR k →+* S) (d : Vec6 L) (t : L)
    (q c : Index) :
    familyEvaluation k η (coeffMap ∘ d) (coeffMap t)
        (familyActionCoefficient k q c) =
      coeffMap (coordinateAut (wordJordanAut [(d, t)]) (Pi.single q 1) c)
proof:
:= by
  exact (map_conjugation_coefficient
    (R := FamilyRing k) (L := L) (T := S)
    (familyEvaluation k η (coeffMap ∘ d) (coeffMap t)) coeffMap
    (familyForwardMatrix k) (familyInverseMatrix k)
    (wordMatrix [(d, t)]) (inverseWordMatrix [(d, t)]) q c
    (eval_familyForwardMatrix (k := k) coeffMap η d t)
    (eval_familyInverseMatrix (k := k) coeffMap η d t)).trans
      (congrArg coeffMap (coordinateAut_singleton_basis d t q c).symm)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.OneTransvectionTransport.transformedUniversal_expansion
statement:
private theorem transformedUniversal_expansion
    {L : Type*} [Field L] [CharZero L]
    (g : ScalarJordanAut.Aut (K := L)) (r i : Fin 3) (c : Index) :
    transformedUniversal L g r i c =
      ∑ d : Index, universalPoint L r i d *
        MvPolynomial.C (coordinateAut g (Pi.single d 1) c)
proof:
:= by
  change (∑ d : Index,
      MvPolynomial.C (coordinateAut g (Pi.single d 1) c) *
        universalPoint L r i d) = _
  simp only [mul_comm]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.OneTransvectionTransport.familyRawAction_base_specialization
statement:
private theorem familyRawAction_base_specialization
    (d : Vec6 k) (t : k) :
    (familyEvaluation k (RingHom.id (RR k))
        (scalarToReduced k ∘ d) (scalarToReduced k t)).comp
        (familyRawAction k) =
      (reducedActionHom k (wordJordanAut [(d, t)])).comp
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (rawFrameIdeal k).radical)
proof:
:= by
  apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
  · intro a
    simp [familyEvaluation, familyRawAction, scalarToReduced, rawAction]
  · intro q
    rcases q with ⟨r, i, c⟩
    have hC (x : RR k) :
        familyEvaluation k (RingHom.id (RR k))
            (scalarToReduced k ∘ d) (scalarToReduced k t)
            (MvPolynomial.C x) = x := by
      simp [familyEvaluation]
    simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, familyRawAction,
      MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_X', reducedActionHom_mk, rawAction_X]
    rw [familyPoint, map_sum]
    simp only [map_mul]
    simp_rw [hC,
      eval_familyActionCoefficient k (scalarToReduced k)
        (RingHom.id (RR k)) d t]
    rw [transformedUniversal_expansion]
    simp [scalarToReduced, universalPoint]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.OneTransvectionTransport.fractionAction_reducedInclusion
statement:
private theorem fractionAction_reducedInclusion
    (g : ScalarJordanAut.Aut (K := k)) (x : RR k) :
    fractionAction k g (reducedInclusion k x) =
      reducedInclusion k (reducedAction k g x)
proof:
:= by
  exact IsFractionRing.ringEquivOfRingEquiv_algebraMap (reducedAction k g) x

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.OneTransvectionTransport.cleared_of_ordinary_invariance
statement:
private theorem cleared_of_ordinary_invariance
    (a b : CoordinateRing k) (hb : rawToFunction k b ≠ 0)
    (hinv : ∀ g : ScalarJordanAut.Aut (K := k),
      fractionAction k g (rawToFunction k a / rawToFunction k b) =
        rawToFunction k a / rawToFunction k b)
    (g : ScalarJordanAut.Aut (K := k)) :
    reducedAction k g (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ a) * Ideal.Quotient.mk _ b =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk _ a * reducedAction k g (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ b)
proof:
:= by
  apply (IsFractionRing.injective (RR k) (FF k))
  simp only [map_mul]
  have h := hinv g
  rw [map_div₀] at h
  simp only [rawToFunction, RingHom.comp_apply,
    fractionAction_reducedInclusion] at h
  have hbR : Ideal.Quotient.mk (rawFrameIdeal k).radical b ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    apply hb
    change reducedInclusion k (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ b) = 0
    rw [hzero, map_zero]
  have hgbR : reducedAction k g (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ b) ≠ 0 :=
    (reducedAction k g).injective.ne hbR
  have hgb : reducedInclusion k (reducedAction k g (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ b)) ≠ 0 := by
    have hgb' := (IsFractionRing.injective (RR k) (FF k)).ne hgbR
    simpa only [reducedInclusion, map_zero] using hgb'
  exact (div_eq_div_iff hgb hb).mp h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.OneTransvectionTransport.eq_zero_of_injective_grid
statement:
private theorem eq_zero_of_injective_grid
    {D : Type*} [CommRing D] [IsDomain D]
    {σ : Type*} (ι : k →+* D) (hι : Function.Injective ι)
    (P : MvPolynomial σ D)
    (hP : ∀ z : σ → k,
      MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom (RingHom.id D) (ι ∘ z) P = 0) :
    P = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply MvPolynomial.funext_set
    (fun _ : σ => Set.range ι)
    (fun _ => Set.infinite_range_of_injective hι)
  intro x hx
  choose z hz using fun i => hx i (Set.mem_univ i)
  have hzx : ι ∘ z = x := funext hz
  rw [← hzx]
  change MvPolynomial.eval (ι ∘ z) P = 0
  exact hP z

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.OneTransvectionTransport.familyCross_eq_zero
statement:
theorem familyCross_eq_zero
    (a b : CoordinateRing k) (hb : rawToFunction k b ≠ 0)
    (hinv : ∀ g : ScalarJordanAut.Aut (K := k),
      fractionAction k g (rawToFunction k a / rawToFunction k b) =
        rawToFunction k a / rawToFunction k b) :
    familyCross k a b = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply eq_zero_of_injective_grid k (scalarToReduced k)
    (scalarToReduced k).injective
  intro z
  let d : Vec6 k := fun i => z (Sum.inl i)
  let t : k := z (Sum.inr ())
  have hs := DFunLike.congr_fun
    (familyRawAction_base_specialization k d t)
  simp only [RingHom.comp_apply] at hs
  have hsa :
      familyEvaluation k (RingHom.id (RR k))
          (scalarToReduced k ∘ d) (scalarToReduced k t)
          (familyRawAction k a) =
        reducedAction k (wordJordanAut [(d, t)])
          (Ideal.Quotient.mk (rawFrameIdeal k).radical a) := hs a
  have hsb :
      familyEvaluation k (RingHom.id (RR k))
          (scalarToReduced k ∘ d) (scalarToReduced k t)
          (familyRawAction k b) =
        reducedAction k (wordJordanAut [(d, t)])
          (Ideal.Quotient.mk (rawFrameIdeal k).radical b) := hs b
  have hc := cleared_of_ordinary_invariance k a b hb hinv
    (wordJordanAut [(d, t)])
  have hassign : (scalarToReduced k ∘ z) = fun q => match q with
      | Sum.inl i => scalarToReduced k (d i)
      | Sum.inr _ => scalarToReduced k t := by
    funext q
    rcases q with i | u
    · rfl
    · rcases u with ⟨⟩
      rfl
  rw [hassign]
  change familyEvaluation k (RingHom.id (RR k))
      (scalarToReduced k ∘ d) (scalarToReduced k t) (familyCross k a b) = 0
  have hC (x : RR k) :
      familyEvaluation k (RingHom.id (RR k))
          (scalarToReduced k ∘ d) (scalarToReduced k t)
          (MvPolynomial.C x) = x := by
    simp [familyEvaluation]
  simp only [familyCross, map_sub, map_mul, map_zero]
  rw [hsa, hsb, hC, hC]
  exact sub_eq_zero.mpr hc

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.OneTransvectionTransport.familyRawAction_extension_specialization
statement:
private theorem familyRawAction_extension_specialization
    (d : Vec6 K) (t : K) :
    (familyEvaluation k (reducedCoefficientMap k K φ)
        (scalarToReduced K ∘ d) (scalarToReduced K t)).comp
        (familyRawAction k) =
      (reducedActionHom K (wordJordanAut [(d, t)])).comp
        ((reducedCoefficientMap k K φ).comp
          (Ideal.Quotient.mk (rawFrameIdeal k).radical))
proof:
:= by
  apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
  · intro a
    simp [familyEvaluation, familyRawAction, scalarToReduced,
      reducedCoefficientMap, reducedCoefficientMapOf, rawAction,
      originalCoefficientEmbedding]
  · intro q
    rcases q with ⟨r, i, c⟩
    have hC (x : RR k) :
        familyEvaluation k (reducedCoefficientMap k K φ)
            (scalarToReduced K ∘ d) (scalarToReduced K t)
            (MvPolynomial.C x) = reducedCoefficientMap k K φ x := by
      simp [familyEvaluation]
    simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, familyRawAction,
      MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_X']
    rw [familyPoint, map_sum]
    simp only [map_mul]
    simp_rw [hC,
      eval_familyActionCoefficient k (scalarToReduced K)
        (reducedCoefficientMap k K φ) d t]
    have hcoeff : reducedCoefficientMap k K φ =
        reducedCoefficientMapOf k K
          (originalCoefficientEmbedding k K φ) := rfl
    rw [hcoeff, reducedCoefficientMapOf_mk, reducedActionHom_mk,
      polynomialCoefficientMap_X, rawAction_X,
      transformedUniversal_expansion]
    simp [polynomialCoefficientMap, scalarToReduced, universalPoint]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.OneTransvectionTransport.oneTransvection_clearedInvariant_extension
statement:
theorem oneTransvection_clearedInvariant_extension
    (a b : CoordinateRing k) (hb : rawToFunction k b ≠ 0)
    (hinv : ∀ g : ScalarJordanAut.Aut (K := k),
      fractionAction k g (rawToFunction k a / rawToFunction k b) =
        rawToFunction k a / rawToFunction k b)
    (d : Vec6 K) (t : K) :
    let T
proof:
:= reducedAction K (wordJordanAut [(d, t)])
    T (reducedCoefficientMap k K φ (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ a)) *
        reducedCoefficientMap k K φ (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ b) =
      reducedCoefficientMap k K φ (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ a) *
        T (reducedCoefficientMap k K φ (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ b)) := by
  dsimp only
  have hzero := familyCross_eq_zero k a b hb hinv
  let ev : FamilyRing k →+* RR K :=
    familyEvaluation k (reducedCoefficientMap k K φ)
      (scalarToReduced K ∘ d) (scalarToReduced K t)
  have heval := congrArg ev hzero
  have hs := DFunLike.congr_fun
    (familyRawAction_extension_specialization k K φ d t)
  simp only [RingHom.comp_apply] at hs
  have hsa : ev (familyRawAction k a) =
      reducedAction K (wordJordanAut [(d, t)])
        (reducedCoefficientMap k K φ (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ a)) := hs a
  have hsb : ev (familyRawAction k b) =
      reducedAction K (wordJordanAut [(d, t)])
        (reducedCoefficientMap k K φ (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ b)) := hs b
  have hC (x : RR k) : ev (MvPolynomial.C x) =
      reducedCoefficientMap k K φ x := by
    simp [ev, familyEvaluation]
  simp only [familyCross, map_sub, map_mul, map_zero] at heval
  rw [hsa, hsb, hC, hC] at heval
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp heval

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ReciprocalDetectorGenerator.moved_generates
statement:
theorem moved_generates (d : Omega B) (hd : σ B m hm d ≠ d) :
    Subfield.closure ((invariantField B m : Set (Omega B)) ∪ {d}) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  let D := Subfield.closure ((invariantField B m : Set (Omega B)) ∪ {d})
  have base_mem (x : invariantField B m) : (x : Omega B) ∈ D :=
    Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inl x.property)
  have dmem : d ∈ D := Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inr rfl)
  obtain ⟨a,b,h⟩ := exists_two_coefficients B m hm d
  have hb : (b : Omega B) ≠ 0 := by
    intro hb
    have ha : d = (a : Omega B) := by simpa only [hb, zero_mul, add_zero] using h
    apply hd
    rw [ha]
    exact invariantField_fixed B m hm _ a.property
  have ht : T B = (d - (a : Omega B)) / (b : Omega B) := by
    rw [h]
    field_simp [hb] <;> ring
  have tmem : T B ∈ D := by
    rw [ht]
    exact D.div_mem (D.sub_mem dmem (base_mem a)) (base_mem b)
  apply top_unique
  intro z _
  obtain ⟨a,b,hz⟩ := exists_two_coefficients B m hm z
  change z ∈ D
  rw [hz]
  exact D.add_mem (base_mem a) (D.mul_mem (base_mem b) tmem)

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceVectorPairDephase.evenV_eq_of_centers
statement:
theorem evenV_eq_of_centers (e x y : VCoord K)
    (he : nV e ≠ 0) (hxy : nV x = nV y) (hx : nV x ≠ 0)
    (hey : BV e y = 0) :
    ∃ A B : VCoord K,
      nV A ≠ 0 ∧ nV B ≠ 0 ∧ evenV A B x = y
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hd : nV (x - y) = 0
  · have hy : nV y ≠ 0 := by simpa only [← hxy] using hx
    have hs : nV (x + y) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [nV_sum_eq_four x y hxy hd]
      exact mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) hx
    refine ⟨y, x + y, hy, hs, ?_⟩
    rw [evenV, reflect_sum x y hxy hd hs, reflect_neg_self y hy]
  · refine ⟨e, x - y, he, hd, ?_⟩
    rw [evenV, reflect_difference x y hxy hd,
      reflectV_eq_of_orthogonal e y hey]

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceVectorPairDephase.evenV_eq_fixing
statement:
theorem evenV_eq_fixing (e f x y : VCoord K)
    (he : nV e ≠ 0) (hxy : nV x = nV y) (hx : nV x ≠ 0)
    (hey : BV e y = 0) (hfe : BV f e = 0)
    (hfx : BV f x = 0) (hfy : BV f y = 0) :
    ∃ A B : VCoord K,
      nV A ≠ 0 ∧ nV B ≠ 0 ∧ BV f A = 0 ∧ BV f B = 0 ∧
      evenV A B x = y ∧ evenV A B f = f
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hd : nV (x - y) = 0
  · have hy : nV y ≠ 0 := by simpa only [← hxy] using hx
    have hs : nV (x + y) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [nV_sum_eq_four x y hxy hd]
      exact mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) hx
    refine ⟨y, x + y, hy, hs, hfy, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [BV_add_right, hfx, hfy, add_zero]
    · rw [evenV, reflect_sum x y hxy hd hs, reflect_neg_self y hy]
    · rw [evenV, reflectV_eq_of_orthogonal (x + y) f,
        reflectV_eq_of_orthogonal y f]
      · rw [BV_symmetric, hfy]
      · rw [BV_symmetric, BV_add_right, hfx, hfy, add_zero]
  · refine ⟨e, x - y, he, hd, hfe, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [sub_eq_add_neg, BV_add_right, BV_neg_right, hfx, hfy]
      simp
    · rw [evenV, reflect_difference x y hxy hd,
        reflectV_eq_of_orthogonal e y hey]
    · rw [evenV, reflectV_eq_of_orthogonal (x - y) f,
        reflectV_eq_of_orthogonal e f]
      · rw [BV_symmetric, hfe]
      · rw [BV_symmetric, sub_eq_add_neg, BV_add_right, BV_neg_right,
          hfx, hfy]
        simp

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TitsLinear.fromTauRaw_toTauRaw
statement:
@[simp] theorem fromTauRaw_toTauRaw [AddCommGroup R] (z : FirstTits R) :
    fromTauRaw (toTauRaw z) = z
proof:
:= by
  rcases z with ⟨A, B, C⟩
  apply Prod.ext
  · ext i j
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> rfl
  · apply Prod.ext
    · ext i j
      fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [fromTauRaw, toTauRaw]
    · ext i j
      fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TitsLinear.toTauRaw_fromTauRaw

    toTauRaw (fromTauRaw x) = x
proof:
:= by
  apply TauCeti.AlbertAlgebra.ext
  · funext i
    fin_cases i <;> rfl
  · funext i
    fin_cases i <;> apply TauCeti.Octonion.ext <;>
      simp [fromTauRaw, toTauRaw]
    all_goals
      funext j
      fin_cases j <;> simp [fromTauRaw, toTauRaw]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GenericSplitterAttachment.coefficientMap_injective
statement: theorem coefficientMap_injective : Function.Injective (coefficientMap k)
proof:
:=
  MvPolynomial.map_injective (algebraMap ℚ k) (algebraMap ℚ k).injective

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GenericSplitterAttachment.rootBaseMap_norm_eq_orientations
statement:
theorem rootBaseMap_norm_eq_orientations (z : Q) :
    rootBaseMap k (QuadraticAlgebra.norm z) =
      rootQEval k z * rootQEvalNeg k z
proof:
:= by
  have hp : rootQEval k z =
      rootBaseMap k z.re + rootBaseMap k z.im * rootSigma k := by
    simp [rootQEval, Algebra.smul_def, RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra]
  have hm : rootQEvalNeg k z =
      rootBaseMap k z.re - rootBaseMap k z.im * rootSigma k := by
    simp [rootQEvalNeg, Algebra.smul_def, RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra,
      sub_eq_add_neg]
  rw [hp, hm, QuadraticAlgebra.norm_def]
  simp only [map_sub, map_add, map_mul, map_pow, map_zero]
  rw [← rootSigma_sq k]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GenericSplitterAttachment.rootDiagnostics_ne
statement:
theorem rootDiagnostics_ne :
    rootQEval k diagnostic ≠ 0 ∧ rootQEvalNeg k diagnostic ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hnorm : rootBaseMap k diagnosticNorm ≠ 0 :=
    by simpa only [map_zero] using
      (rootBaseMap_injective k).ne diagnosticNorm_ne
  have hprod : rootQEval k diagnostic * rootQEvalNeg k diagnostic ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← rootBaseMap_norm_eq_orientations]
    exact hnorm
  exact ⟨fun h => hprod (by rw [h, zero_mul]),
    fun h => hprod (by rw [h, mul_zero])⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GenericSplitterAttachment.actual_generic_scalar_extension_data

    genericBaseMap k diagnosticOpen ≠ 0 ∧
    genericWEval k discr ≠ 0 ∧
    genericWEval k cyclic ≠ 0 ∧
    Function.Injective (genericLocalEval k) ∧
    rootSigma k ≠ 0 ∧
    rootSigma k ^ 2 = rootBaseMap k (lloc discr) ∧
    rootQEval k diagnostic ≠ 0 ∧ rootQEvalNeg k diagnostic ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨coefficientMap_injective k, genericBaseMap_injective k,
    genericBaseMap_diagnosticOpen_ne k, genericWEval_discr_ne k,
    genericWEval_cyclic_ne k, genericLocalEval_injective k, rootSigma_ne k,
    rootSigma_sq k, (rootDiagnostics_ne k).1, (rootDiagnostics_ne k).2⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedBlockEquations.mul_adj
statement: theorem mul_adj (X : Mat2 K) : X * adj X = determinant X • (1 : Mat2 K)
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [adj, matrix, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, determinant] <;> ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedBlockEquations.weighted_product
statement:
theorem weighted_product (p q : K) (X Y : Mat2 K)
    (h : p • Y = q • adj X) :
    p • (X * Y) = (q * determinant X) • (1 : Mat2 K)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    p • (X * Y) = X * (p • Y) := (mul_smul_comm p X Y).symm
    _ = X * (q • adj X) := by rw [h]
    _ = q • (X * adj X) := mul_smul_comm q X (adj X)
    _ = (q * determinant X) • (1 : Mat2 K) := by rw [mul_adj, smul_smul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedBlockEquations.pivot_trace_relation
statement:
theorem pivot_trace_relation (B : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Mat2 K) (p q : Fin 3 → K)
    (hd : ∀ i, B i i = q i • (1 : Mat2 K))
    (hr : ∀ i, B i 0 + B i 1 + B i 2 = 0)
    (hc : ∀ j, p 0 • B 0 j + p 1 • B 1 j + p 2 • B 2 j = 0)
    (hs : p 1 • B 1 0 = p 0 • adj (B 0 1)) :
    p 0 * trace2 (B 0 1) = -p 0 * q 0 - p 1 * q 1 + p 2 * q 2
proof:
:= by
  have hb := (scaled_block_equations B p q hd hr hc).2.2.2.1
  have hb00 := congrArg (fun X : Mat2 K => X 0 0) hb
  have hs00 := congrArg (fun X : Mat2 K => X 0 0) hs
  simp [adj, matrix, Matrix.one_apply, smul_eq_mul] at hb00 hs00
  dsimp [trace2]
  linear_combination hb00 - hs00

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedBlockEquations.pivot_determinant_relation
statement:
theorem pivot_determinant_relation (B : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Mat2 K) (p q : Fin 3 → K)
    (hd : ∀ i, B i i = q i • (1 : Mat2 K))
    (hr : ∀ i, B i 0 + B i 1 + B i 2 = 0)
    (hc : ∀ j, p 0 • B 0 j + p 1 • B 1 j + p 2 • B 2 j = 0)
    (hs1 : p 1 • B 1 0 = p 0 • adj (B 0 1))
    (hs2 : p 2 • B 2 0 = p 0 • adj (B 0 2))
    (hi : B 0 0 * B 0 0 + B 0 1 * B 1 0 + B 0 2 * B 2 0 = B 0 0) :
    p 0 * (p 1 + p 2) * determinant (B 0 1) =
      p 1 * p 2 * (q 0 - q 0 ^ 2) -
        p 0 * p 1 * (q 0 ^ 2 + q 0 * trace2 (B 0 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hw1 := weighted_product (p 1) (p 0) (B 0 1) (B 1 0) hs1
  have hw2 := weighted_product (p 2) (p 0) (B 0 2) (B 2 0) hs2
  have h01 : B 0 2 = affine (-q 0) (-1) (B 0 1) := by
    rw [(scaled_block_equations B p q hd hr hc).1]
    simp [affine, sub_eq_add_neg]
  have hdet : determinant (B 0 2) =
      q 0 ^ 2 + q 0 * trace2 (B 0 1) + determinant (B 0 1) := by
    rw [h01, determinant_affine]
    ring
  have hm := congrArg (fun X : Mat2 K => X 0 0) hi
  have h1 := congrArg (fun X : Mat2 K => X 0 0) hw1
  have h2 := congrArg (fun X : Mat2 K => X 0 0) hw2
  rw [hd 0] at hm
  simp only [Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.one_apply,
    ite_true, smul_eq_mul, mul_one, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm,
    one_mul, smul_smul] at hm h1 h2
  rw [hdet] at h2
  linear_combination p 1 * p 2 * hm - p 2 * h1 - p 1 * h2
