  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [ha]

name: AlbertLean.Residual.ResidualPairReflection.L_mul_Li
statement: theorem L_mul_Li (a : K) (ha : a ≠ 0) : L a * Li a = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [L, Li, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [ha]

name: AlbertLean.Residual.ResidualPairReflection.Li_mul_L
statement: theorem Li_mul_L (a : K) (ha : a ≠ 0) : Li a * L a = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Li, L, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [ha]

name: AlbertLean.Residual.ResidualPairReflection.moment_reflect
statement:
theorem moment_reflect (a : K) (ha : a ≠ 0) (P : ResidualPair K) :
    moment (reflect a P) = Li a * (moment P).transpose * L a
proof:
:= by
  simp only [moment, reflect, Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc (Di a) (D a), Di_mul_D a ha, Matrix.one_mul]

name: AlbertLean.Residual.ResidualPairReflection.moment_reflect_apply
statement:
theorem moment_reflect_apply (a : K) (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (P : ResidualPair K) (i j : Fin 4) :
    moment (reflect a P) i j =
      (reflectionWeight a i)⁻¹ * reflectionWeight a j * moment P j i
proof:
:= by
  rw [moment_reflect a ha, Li_transpose_mul_L_apply]

name: AlbertLean.Residual.ResidualPairReflection.det_D_mul_det_L
statement:
private theorem det_D_mul_det_L (a : K) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    Matrix.det (D a) * Matrix.det (L a) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [D, L, Matrix.det_diagonal, Fin.prod_univ_succ]
  calc
    a⁻¹ * a⁻¹ * (a * a) = (a⁻¹ * a) * (a⁻¹ * a) := by ring
    _ = 1 := by rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ ha]; simp

name: AlbertLean.Residual.ResidualPairReflection.delta_reflect
statement:
theorem delta_reflect (a : K) (ha : a ≠ 0) (P : ResidualPair K) :
    delta (reflect a P) = Matrix.det P.A
proof:
:= by
  simp only [delta, reflect, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_transpose]
  calc
    Matrix.det (D a) * Matrix.det P.A * Matrix.det (L a) =
        (Matrix.det (D a) * Matrix.det (L a)) * Matrix.det P.A := by ring
    _ = Matrix.det P.A := by rw [det_D_mul_det_L a ha, one_mul]

name: AlbertLean.Residual.ResidualPairReflection.deltaStar_normalizedPair
statement:
theorem deltaStar_normalizedPair (P : ResidualPair K) (hP : delta P ≠ 0) :
    deltaStar (normalizedPair P) = Matrix.det (moment P) / delta P
proof:
:= by
  simp only [deltaStar, normalizedPair, Matrix.det_mul, det_X0Inv,
    div_eq_mul_inv]

name: AlbertLean.Residual.ResidualPairReflection.delta_reflect_normalizedPair
statement:
theorem delta_reflect_normalizedPair (a : K) (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (P : ResidualPair K) (hP : delta P ≠ 0) :
    delta (reflect a (normalizedPair P)) =
      Matrix.det (moment P) / delta P
proof:
:= by
  rw [delta_reflect a ha]
  exact deltaStar_normalizedPair P hP

name: AlbertLean.Generic.UniformMomentActualDetector.sourceDetector_eq_actualEpsilon_add_actualBeta_mul_delta
statement:
theorem sourceDetector_eq_actualEpsilon_add_actualBeta_mul_delta
    (q : ExplicitFrameChart K) (a b c sigma : K)
    (hq : EquationsVanish (explicitFrameEquationValues q))
    (hr1 : q.r1 = 1) (hz1 : q.z1 = a) (hr2 : q.r2 = b) (hz2 : q.z2 = c)
    (hb : b = (gramV12 q - sigma) / (2*a))
    (hc : c = (gramV12 q + sigma) / 2)
    (hsigma : sigma ≠ 0) (ha : 2*a ≠ 0)
    (hdet : Matrix.det (matrixM q) ≠ 0) :
    sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1) (encoderA q) (encoderB q) =
      actualEpsilon q a b c sigma + actualBeta q a b c sigma *
        delta (residualPairOfChart q)
proof:
:= by
  let L := sourceLedger (encoderA q) (encoderB q)
  let Delta := delta (residualPairOfChart q)
  have hM : matrixM q = reconstructedMatrix q a sigma := by
    exact matrixM_eq_uniform_inverse q a b c sigma hq hr1 hz1 hr2 hz2 hb hc hsigma ha
  have hDelta_eq : Delta = deltaX q.s1 q.s2 q.c1 q.c2 := by
    exact (deltaX_eq_det_XMatrix q.s1 q.s2 q.c1 q.c2).symm
  have hDelta : Delta ≠ 0 := by
    intro hd
    apply hdet
    rw [matrixM, det_momentMatrix_eq_deltaX_mul_deltaStarA]
    rw [hDelta_eq] at hd
    rw [hd, zero_mul]
  have hfixed := (equationsVanish_iff_source_fixedSpectrum q).1 hq
  have hm := recovered_measurements (encoderA q) (encoderB q)
    hfixed.2.2.1 hfixed.2.2.2.2.2
  rcases hm with ⟨hnVx, hnSx, hnCx, hnVy, hnSy, hnCy, hgV, hgS, hgC,
    ht111, ht211, ht121, ht112, ht122, ht212, ht221, ht222, huV, huS, huC⟩
  have hs : detectorS q a sigma =
      Delta + deltaStarA q.s1 q.s2 q.c1 q.c2 := by
    rw [detectorS, ← hM, huV]
    rw [normalizedUV_exterior_identity, hDelta_eq]
    dsimp only [matrixM, encoderA, encoderB]
    ring
  have hquad : Delta ^ 2 = detectorS q a sigma * Delta -
      Matrix.det (reconstructedMatrix q a sigma) := by
    rw [hs, ← hM, matrixM, det_momentMatrix_eq_deltaX_mul_deltaStarA]
    rw [hDelta_eq]
    ring
  have hdiagA (i : Fin 3) : D L i 1 = q.diagA i := by
    fin_cases i <;> simp [L, D, H_sourceLedger, power, encoderA, diagLinear]
  have hdiagB (i : Fin 3) : E L i 1 = q.diagB i := by
    fin_cases i <;> simp [L, E, H_sourceLedger, power, encoderB, diagLinear]
  have hnorm := QuadraticDetectorAffine.normalized_eq_epsilon_add_beta_mul
    (fun i => D L i 1) (fun i => E L i 1) a b c
    (reconstructedMatrix q a sigma) (detectorS q a sigma)
    (Matrix.det (reconstructedMatrix q a sigma))
    (Matrix.det (reconstructedMatrix q a sigma))⁻¹
    (by rw [← hM]; exact mul_inv_cancel₀ hdet) (RingHom.id K) Delta hquad
  have hmoment : moment (residualPairOfChart q) = reconstructedMatrix q a sigma := by
    calc
      _ = matrixM q := by
        simpa only [residualPairOfChart, moment, matrixM] using
          (momentMatrix_eq_AMatrix_mul_XMatrix q.s1 q.s2 q.c1 q.c2).symm
      _ = _ := hM
  change NormalizedDetectorCircuit.normalized
      (fun i => D L i 1) (fun i => E L i 1) 1 a b c
      (reconstructedMatrix q a sigma) Delta Delta⁻¹ =
    actualEpsilon q a b c sigma + actualBeta q a b c sigma * Delta at hnorm
  have hdA : (fun i => D L i 1) = q.diagA := funext hdiagA
  have hdB : (fun i => E L i 1) = q.diagB := funext hdiagB
  rw [hdA, hdB] at hnorm
  have hsource := sourceDetector_eq_normalized q hDelta
  rw [hr1, hz1, hr2, hz2, hmoment] at hsource
  exact hsource.trans hnorm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.exists_actual_same_ledger_pair_jordanAut
statement:
theorem exists_actual_same_ledger_pair_jordanAut
    (E F E' F' : Fin 3 → Carrier K)
    (hEidem : ∀ i, (E i : Mat6 K) * E i = E i)
    (hEsum : (E 0 : Mat6 K) + E 1 + E 2 = 1)
    (hFidem : ∀ i, (F i : Mat6 K) * F i = F i)
    (hFsum : (F 0 : Mat6 K) + F 1 + F 2 = 1)
    (hEidem' : ∀ i, (E' i : Mat6 K) * E' i = E' i)
    (hEsum' : (E' 0 : Mat6 K) + E' 1 + E' 2 = 1)
    (hFidem' : ∀ i, (F' i : Mat6 K) * F' i = F' i)
    (hFsum' : (F' 0 : Mat6 K) + F' 1 + F' 2 = 1)
    (u v u' v' : Vec6 K) (p : Fin 3 → K)
    (hp : ∀ i, p i = (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u)
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v))
    (hp' : ∀ i, p i = (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E' i : Mat6 K) u')
      (matrixAction (E' i : Mat6 K) v')) (hpne : ∀ i, p i ≠ 0)
    (hFu : ∀ i, matrixAction (F 0 : Mat6 K) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u) = p i • u)
    (hFv : ∀ i, matrixAction (F 0 : Mat6 K) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v) = p i • v)
    (hFu' : ∀ i, matrixAction (F' 0 : Mat6 K) (matrixAction (E' i : Mat6 K) u') = p i • u')
    (hFv' : ∀ i, matrixAction (F' 0 : Mat6 K) (matrixAction (E' i : Mat6 K) v') = p i • v')
    (hledger : ∀ i, jordanTrace (K := K) ((E i : Mat6 K) * (F 1 : Mat6 K)) =
      jordanTrace (K := K) ((E' i : Mat6 K) * (F' 1 : Mat6 K)))
    (hp12 : p 1 + p 2 ≠ 0)
    (hdisc : let L := weightedCoordinateEquiv E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne
      let B := fun i j => weightedBlock (coordinateConjugate L
        (matrixAction (F 1 : Mat6 K))) i j
      trace2 (B 0 1) ^ 2 - 4 * determinant (B 0 1) ≠ 0) :
    ∃ g : ScalarJordanAut.Aut (K := K),
      (∀ i, g.linear (E i) = E' i) ∧ (∀ i, g.linear (F i) = F' i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨T, S, hTS, hST, hblocks⟩ :=
    exists_actual_same_ledger_pair_block_conjugator E F E' F'
      hEidem hEsum hFidem hFsum hEidem' hEsum' hFidem' hFsum'
      u v u' v' p hp hp' hpne hFu hFv hFu' hFv' hledger hp12 hdisc
  have hdet : det2 S ≠ 0 := by
    change determinant S ≠ 0
    have hdetprod : determinant S * determinant T = 1 := by
      rw [determinant_eq_det, determinant_eq_det, ← Matrix.det_mul, hST,
        Matrix.det_one]
    intro hzero
    rw [hzero, zero_mul] at hdetprod
    exact zero_ne_one hdetprod
  let L := weightedCoordinateEquiv E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne
  let L' := weightedCoordinateEquiv E' hEidem' hEsum' u' v' p hp' hpne
  let B := coordinateConjugate L (matrixAction (F 1 : Mat6 K))
  let C := coordinateConjugate L' (matrixAction (F' 1 : Mat6 K))
  let g := commonPlaneJordanAut E E' hEidem hEsum hEidem' hEsum'
    u v u' v' p hp hp' hpne S T hST hTS hdet
  have hmap_of_coordinate_conjugacy (P Q : Carrier K)
      (hcoord : (commonPlaneMap S).comp
        ((coordinateConjugate L (matrixAction (P : Mat6 K))).comp
          (commonPlaneMap T)) =
        coordinateConjugate L' (matrixAction (Q : Mat6 K))) :
      g.linear P = Q := by
    dsimp only [g]
    apply commonPlaneJordanAut_maps_of_action E E' hEidem hEsum
      hEidem' hEsum' u v u' v' p hp hp' hpne S T hST hTS hdet P Q
    simpa only [commonPlaneForward, commonPlaneBackward, L, L'] using
      coordinate_transport L L' (matrixAction (P : Mat6 K))
        (matrixAction (Q : Mat6 K)) S T hcoord
  have hEcoord (i : Fin 3) :
      (commonPlaneMap S).comp
        ((coordinateConjugate L (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K))).comp
          (commonPlaneMap T)) =
        coordinateConjugate L' (matrixAction (E' i : Mat6 K)) := by
    rw [coordinateConjugate_first_frame E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne i,
      coordinateConjugate_first_frame E' hEidem' hEsum' u' v' p hp' hpne i,
      ← LinearMap.comp_assoc, commonPlaneMap_comm_standardProjector S i,
      LinearMap.comp_assoc, commonPlaneMap_comp S T hST]
    simp
  have hF0coord :
      (commonPlaneMap S).comp
        ((coordinateConjugate L (matrixAction (F 0 : Mat6 K))).comp
          (commonPlaneMap T)) =
        coordinateConjugate L' (matrixAction (F' 0 : Mat6 K)) := by
    rw [coordinateConjugate_first_projector E (F 0) hEidem hEsum
        u v p hp hpne hFu hFv,
      coordinateConjugate_first_projector E' (F' 0) hEidem' hEsum'
        u' v' p hp' hpne hFu' hFv',
      ← LinearMap.comp_assoc, commonPlaneMap_comm_weightedFirst S p,
      LinearMap.comp_assoc, commonPlaneMap_comp S T hST]
    simp
  have hF1coord :
      (commonPlaneMap S).comp
        ((coordinateConjugate L (matrixAction (F 1 : Mat6 K))).comp
          (commonPlaneMap T)) =
        coordinateConjugate L' (matrixAction (F' 1 : Mat6 K)) := by
    exact commonPlane_conjugates_operator_of_blocks B C T S hTS hST
      (by intro i j; exact hblocks i j)
  have hgE : ∀ i, g.linear (E i) = E' i := fun i =>
    hmap_of_coordinate_conjugacy (E i) (E' i) (hEcoord i)
  have hgF0 : g.linear (F 0) = F' 0 :=
    hmap_of_coordinate_conjugacy (F 0) (F' 0) hF0coord
  have hgF1 : g.linear (F 1) = F' 1 :=
    hmap_of_coordinate_conjugacy (F 1) (F' 1) hF1coord
  have hFsumCarrier : F 0 + F 1 + F 2 = (SelfAdjointCarrier.one : Carrier K) := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact hFsum
  have hFsumCarrier' : F' 0 + F' 1 + F' 2 = (SelfAdjointCarrier.one : Carrier K) := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact hFsum'
  have hgF2 : g.linear (F 2) = F' 2 := by
    have hsum := congrArg g.linear hFsumCarrier
    simp only [map_add, g.map_one, hgF0, hgF1] at hsum
    exact add_left_cancel (hsum.trans hFsumCarrier'.symm)
  refine ⟨g, hgE, ?_⟩
  intro i
  fin_cases i
  · exact hgF0
  · exact hgF1
  · exact hgF2

name: AlbertLean.JordanAut.id_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem id_apply (x : Coord) : id x = x
proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.JordanAut.comp_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem comp_apply (g h : JordanAut) (x : Coord) :
    comp g h x = g (h x)
proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.JordanAut.inv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem inv_apply (g : JordanAut) (x : Coord) :
    inv g x = g.toLinearEquiv.symm x
proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.JordanAut.inv_apply_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem inv_apply_apply (g : JordanAut) (x : Coord) :
    inv g (g x) = x
proof: := g.toLinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply x

name: AlbertLean.JordanAut.apply_inv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem apply_inv_apply (g : JordanAut) (x : Coord) :
    g (inv g x) = x
proof: := g.toLinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply x

name: AlbertLean.JordanAut.map_projector
statement:
theorem map_projector (g : JordanAut) (c : Coord) (i : Fin 3) :
    g (projector c i) = projector (g c) i
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i
  · change g.toLinearEquiv ((2 : ℚ)⁻¹ •
        (structuredProduct c c - c)) =
      (2 : ℚ)⁻¹ •
        (structuredProduct (g.toLinearEquiv c) (g.toLinearEquiv c) -
          g.toLinearEquiv c)
    rw [map_smul, map_sub, g.map_circle]
  · change g.toLinearEquiv (one - structuredProduct c c) =
      one - structuredProduct (g.toLinearEquiv c) (g.toLinearEquiv c)
    rw [map_sub, g.map_one, g.map_circle]
  · change g.toLinearEquiv ((2 : ℚ)⁻¹ •
        (structuredProduct c c + c)) =
      (2 : ℚ)⁻¹ •
        (structuredProduct (g.toLinearEquiv c) (g.toLinearEquiv c) +
          g.toLinearEquiv c)
    rw [map_smul, map_add, g.map_circle]

name: AlbertLean.Transports.refl
statement: theorem refl (X : WitnessTriple) : Transports JordanAut.id X X
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

name: AlbertLean.Transports.comp
proof:
:= by
  rcases hXY with ⟨hXE, hXF, hXK⟩
  rcases hYZ with ⟨hYE, hYF, hYK⟩
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change g (h X.cE) = Z.cE
    rw [hXE, hYE]
  · change g (h X.cF) = Z.cF
    rw [hXF, hYF]
  · change g (h X.cK) = Z.cK
    rw [hXK, hYK]

name: AlbertLean.Transports.inv
statement:
theorem inv {g : JordanAut} {X Y : WitnessTriple}
    (h : Transports g X Y) : Transports (JordanAut.inv g) Y X
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨hE, hF, hK⟩
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← hE]
    exact JordanAut.inv_apply_apply g X.cE
  · rw [← hF]
    exact JordanAut.inv_apply_apply g X.cF
  · rw [← hK]
    exact JordanAut.inv_apply_apply g X.cK

name: AlbertLean.FullRelated.refl
statement: theorem refl (X : WitnessTriple) : FullRelated X X
proof:
:=
  ⟨JordanAut.id, Transports.refl X⟩

name: AlbertLean.FullRelated.symm
statement:
theorem symm {X Y : WitnessTriple} (h : FullRelated X Y) :
    FullRelated Y X
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨g, hg⟩
  exact ⟨JordanAut.inv g, hg.inv⟩

name: AlbertLean.FullRelated.trans
proof:
:= by
  rcases hXY with ⟨h, hh⟩
  rcases hYZ with ⟨g, hg⟩
  exact ⟨JordanAut.comp g h, hh.comp hg⟩

name: AlbertLean.fullRelated_equivalence
statement: theorem fullRelated_equivalence : Equivalence FullRelated
proof:
:=
  ⟨FullRelated.refl, FullRelated.symm, FullRelated.trans⟩

name: AlbertLean.map_encoder_of_transports
statement:
theorem map_encoder_of_transports (g : JordanAut) (X Y : WitnessTriple)
    (h : Transports g X Y) (r : Fin 3) :
    g (encoder X r) = encoder Y r
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨hE, hF, hK⟩
  fin_cases r
  · change g.toLinearEquiv X.cE = Y.cE
    exact hE
  · change g.toLinearEquiv X.cF = Y.cF
    exact hF
  · change g.toLinearEquiv X.cK = Y.cK
    exact hK

name: AlbertLean.map_projector_of_transports
statement:
theorem map_projector_of_transports (g : JordanAut) (X Y : WitnessTriple)
    (h : Transports g X Y) (r i : Fin 3) :
    g (projector (encoder X r) i) = projector (encoder Y r) i
proof:
:= by
  rw [JordanAut.map_projector, map_encoder_of_transports g X Y h r]

name: AlbertLean.productTrace_invariant
statement:
theorem productTrace_invariant (g : JordanAut) (x : Coord) :
    productTrace (g x) = productTrace x
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [productTrace_eq_traceN] using traceN_invariant g x

name: AlbertLean.spurN_invariant
statement:
theorem spurN_invariant (g : JordanAut) (x : Coord) :
    spurN (g x) = spurN x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← productSpur_eq_spurN, ← productSpur_eq_spurN]
  simp only [productSpur, ← g.map_circle, productTrace_invariant]

name: AlbertLean.cubicNorm_invariant
statement:
theorem cubicNorm_invariant (g : JordanAut) (x : Coord) :
    cubicNorm (g x) = cubicNorm x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← productNorm_eq_cubicNorm, ← productNorm_eq_cubicNorm]
  simp only [productNorm, ← g.map_circle, productTrace_invariant]

name: AlbertLean.lawfulEncoder_iff
statement:
theorem lawfulEncoder_iff (g : JordanAut) (c : Coord) :
    LawfulEncoder (g c) ↔ LawfulEncoder c
proof:
:= by
  simp only [LawfulEncoder, traceN_invariant, spurN_invariant,
    cubicNorm_invariant]

name: AlbertLean.lawfulFrame_iff
statement:
theorem lawfulFrame_iff (g : JordanAut) (c : Coord) :
    LawfulFrame (g c) ↔ LawfulFrame c
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact lawfulFrame_of_lawfulEncoder c ((lawfulEncoder_iff g c).mp h.1)
  · intro h
    exact lawfulFrame_of_lawfulEncoder (g c)
      ((lawfulEncoder_iff g c).mpr h.1)

name: AlbertLean.lawfulFrameTriple_iff_of_transports
statement:
theorem lawfulFrameTriple_iff_of_transports
    (g : JordanAut) (X Y : WitnessTriple) (h : Transports g X Y) :
    LawfulFrameTriple Y ↔ LawfulFrameTriple X
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hY r
    have hr : LawfulFrame (g (encoder X r)) := by
      rw [map_encoder_of_transports g X Y h r]
      exact hY r
    exact (lawfulFrame_iff g (encoder X r)).mp hr
  · intro hX r
    have hr := (lawfulFrame_iff g (encoder X r)).mpr (hX r)
    rwa [map_encoder_of_transports g X Y h r] at hr

name: AlbertLean.projectorPairing_invariant
statement:
theorem projectorPairing_invariant (g : JordanAut)
    (c d : Coord) (i j : Fin 3) :
    traceForm (projector (g c) i) (projector (g d) j) =
      traceForm (projector c i) (projector d j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← JordanAut.map_projector, ← JordanAut.map_projector,
    traceForm_invariant]

name: AlbertLean.projectorJoint_invariant
statement:
theorem projectorJoint_invariant (g : JordanAut)
    (a b c : Coord) (i j l : Fin 3) :
    traceForm (projector (g a) i)
        (structuredProduct (projector (g b) j) (projector (g c) l)) =
      traceForm (projector a i)
        (structuredProduct (projector b j) (projector c l))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← JordanAut.map_projector, ← JordanAut.map_projector,
    ← JordanAut.map_projector, ← g.map_circle, traceForm_invariant]

name: AlbertLean.ledger_invariant
statement:
theorem ledger_invariant (g : JordanAut) (X Y : WitnessTriple)
    (h : Transports g X Y) : ledger Y = ledger X
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨hE, hF, hK⟩
  simp only [ledger]
  rw [Ledger.mk.injEq]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · funext i j
    change traceForm (projector Y.cE i) (projector Y.cF j) =
      traceForm (projector X.cE i) (projector X.cF j)
    rw [← hE, ← hF]
    exact projectorPairing_invariant g X.cE X.cF i j
  · funext j l
    change traceForm (projector Y.cF j) (projector Y.cK l) =
      traceForm (projector X.cF j) (projector X.cK l)
    rw [← hF, ← hK]
    exact projectorPairing_invariant g X.cF X.cK j l
  · funext l i
    change traceForm (projector Y.cK l) (projector Y.cE i) =
      traceForm (projector X.cK l) (projector X.cE i)
    rw [← hK, ← hE]
    exact projectorPairing_invariant g X.cK X.cE l i
  · funext i j l
    change
      traceForm (projector Y.cE i)
          (structuredProduct (projector Y.cF j) (projector Y.cK l)) -
            (traceForm (projector Y.cE i) (projector Y.cF j) +
              traceForm (projector Y.cF j) (projector Y.cK l) +
              traceForm (projector Y.cK l) (projector Y.cE i)) / 3 + 2 / 9 =
        traceForm (projector X.cE i)
          (structuredProduct (projector X.cF j) (projector X.cK l)) -
            (traceForm (projector X.cE i) (projector X.cF j) +
              traceForm (projector X.cF j) (projector X.cK l) +
              traceForm (projector X.cK l) (projector X.cE i)) / 3 + 2 / 9
    rw [← hE, ← hF, ← hK, projectorJoint_invariant,
      projectorPairing_invariant, projectorPairing_invariant,
      projectorPairing_invariant]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ParameterSeparation.admissible_rootSum_image_infinite
statement:
theorem admissible_rootSum_image_infinite :
    Set.Infinite
      ((fun t : ℚ => t + witnessScale / t) '' {t | Admissible t})
proof:
:= by
  intro himage
  apply admissible_infinite
  apply Set.Finite.of_finite_fibers
    (fun t : ℚ => t + witnessScale / t) himage
  intro _ hy
  rcases hy with ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
  refine ((Set.finite_singleton (witnessScale / t)).insert t).subset ?_
  intro u hu
  have ht_admissible : Admissible t := ht
  have hu_admissible : Admissible u := hu.1
  have heq :
      t + witnessScale / t = u + witnessScale / u := by
    have h := hu.2
    simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at h
    exact h.symm
  have hpair : u = t ∨ u = witnessScale / t :=
    (reciprocal_sum_eq_iff witnessScale t u ht_admissible.1
      hu_admissible.1).mp heq
  rcases hpair with hpair | hpair <;> simp [hpair]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.scalar_compression_on_hyperbolic_image
statement:
theorem scalar_compression_on_hyperbolic_image
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V))
    (F E : V →ₗ[K] V) (hFidem : IsIdempotent F)
    (hFself : IsSelfAdjoint omega F) (hEself : IsSelfAdjoint omega E)
    (u v : V) (hFu : F u = u) (hFv : F v = v)
    (huv : omega u v = 1) (halt : ∀ x, omega x x = 0)
    (hspan : ∀ x, F x = x → ∃ a b : K, x = a • u + b • v) :
    let p
proof:
:= omega (E u) v
    F (E u) = p • u ∧ F (E v) = p • v := by
  let T : V →ₗ[K] V := F.comp E
  have hTfixed (x : V) : F (T x) = T x := by
    change F (F (E x)) = F (E x)
    exact idempotent_apply F hFidem (E x)
  have hTself {x y : V} (hx : F x = x) (hy : F y = y) :
      omega (T x) y = omega x (T y) := by
    change omega (F (E x)) y = omega x (F (E y))
    calc
      omega (F (E x)) y = omega (E x) (F y) := hFself (E x) y
      _ = omega (E x) y := by rw [hy]
      _ = omega x (E y) := hEself x y
      _ = omega (F x) (E y) := by rw [hx]
      _ = omega x (F (E y)) := hFself x (E y)
  obtain ⟨a, b, hTu⟩ := hspan (T u) (hTfixed u)
  obtain ⟨c, d, hTv⟩ := hspan (T v) (hTfixed v)
  have hvuu : omega v u = -1 := by
    have hzero := halt (u + v)
    simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, huv, halt] at hzero
    linear_combination hzero
  have hb : b = 0 := by
    have hs := hTself hFu hFu
    rw [hTu] at hs
    simp only [map_add, map_smul, LinearMap.add_apply,
      LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, halt, huv, hvuu] at hs
    linear_combination (-1 / 2 : K) * hs
  have hc : c = 0 := by
    have hs := hTself hFv hFv
    rw [hTv] at hs
    simp only [map_add, map_smul, LinearMap.add_apply,
      LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, halt, huv, hvuu] at hs
    linear_combination (1 / 2 : K) * hs
  have had : a = d := by
    have hs := hTself hFu hFv
    rw [hTu, hTv, hb, hc] at hs
    simp only [map_add, map_smul, LinearMap.add_apply,
      LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, huv, halt, zero_smul, add_zero,
      zero_add] at hs
    simpa using hs
  have ha : a = omega (E u) v := by
    have hs : omega (T u) v = omega (E u) v := by
      change omega (F (E u)) v = omega (E u) v
      rw [hFself, hFv]
    rw [hTu, hb] at hs
    simpa [huv] using hs
  dsimp only
  constructor
  · change T u = omega (E u) v • u
    simpa [hb, ha] using hTu
  · change T v = omega (E u) v • v
    simpa [hc, ← had, ha] using hTv

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.exists_actual_weighted_first_projector_coordinates
statement:
theorem exists_actual_weighted_first_projector_coordinates
    (E F : Fin 3 → Carrier K)
    (hEidem : ∀ i, (E i : Mat6 K) * E i = E i)
    (hEtrace : ∀ i, jordanTrace (K := K) (E i : Mat6 K) = 1)
    (hEsum : (E 0 : Mat6 K) + E 1 + E 2 = 1)
    (hFidem : ∀ i, (F i : Mat6 K) * F i = F i)
    (hFtrace : ∀ i, jordanTrace (K := K) (F i : Mat6 K) = 1)
    (hFsum : (F 0 : Mat6 K) + F 1 + F 2 = 1) :
    ∃ u v : Vec6 K,
      matrixAction (F 0 : Mat6 K) u = u ∧
      matrixAction (F 0 : Mat6 K) v = v ∧ (omega (K := K)) u v = 1 ∧
      let p : Fin 3 → K
proof:
:= fun i => (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u)
        (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v)
      (∀ i, matrixAction (F 0 : Mat6 K)
          (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u) = p i • u) ∧
      (∀ i, matrixAction (F 0 : Mat6 K)
          (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v) = p i • v) ∧
      (∀ i, (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u)
          (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v) = p i) := by
  obtain ⟨fu, fv, hfyp, hFfu, hFfv, hFspan⟩ :=
    first_projector_image_spanned F hFidem hFtrace hFsum
  have hfu0 : matrixAction (F 0 : Mat6 K) (fu 0) = fu 0 := by
    simpa using hFfu 0 0
  have hfv0 : matrixAction (F 0 : Mat6 K) (fv 0) = fv 0 := by
    simpa using hFfv 0 0
  refine ⟨fu 0, fv 0, hfu0, hfv0, hfyp.pair 0, ?_⟩
  dsimp only
  have himage : ∀ x, matrixAction (F 0 : Mat6 K) x = x →
      ∃ a b : K, x = a • fu 0 + b • fv 0 := hFspan
  have hscalar (i : Fin 3) :=
    scalar_compression_on_hyperbolic_image (omega (K := K))
      (matrixAction (F 0 : Mat6 K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K))
      (carrier_projector_action_idempotent (F 0) (hFidem 0))
      (carrier_action_selfAdjoint (F 0)) (carrier_action_selfAdjoint (E i))
      (fu 0) (fv 0) hfu0 hfv0
      (hfyp.pair 0) omega_alternating himage
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, fun i => rfl⟩
  · intro i
    have hi := (hscalar i).1
    have hover : (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) (fu 0))
        (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) (fv 0)) =
        (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) (fu 0)) (fv 0) := by
      calc
        _ = (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K)
              (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) (fu 0))) (fv 0) :=
          (carrier_action_selfAdjoint (E i)
            (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) (fu 0)) (fv 0)).symm
        _ = _ := by
          rw [idempotent_apply (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K))
            (carrier_projector_action_idempotent (E i) (hEidem i))]
    simpa only [hover] using hi
  · intro i
    have hi := (hscalar i).2
    have hover : (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) (fu 0))
        (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) (fv 0)) =
        (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) (fu 0)) (fv 0) := by
      calc
        _ = (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K)
              (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) (fu 0))) (fv 0) :=
          (carrier_action_selfAdjoint (E i)
            (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) (fu 0)) (fv 0)).symm
        _ = _ := by
          rw [idempotent_apply (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K))
            (carrier_projector_action_idempotent (E i) (hEidem i))]
    simpa only [hover] using hi

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawLedger.extended_apply_coordinate
statement:
private theorem extended_apply_coordinate (g : Aut (K := k))
    (x : Coordinates (CR k)) (c : Index) :
    extendedCoordinateAut k g x c =
      ∑ d : Index, x d * MvPolynomial.C
        (coordinateAut g (Pi.single d 1) c)
proof:
:= by
  change (∑ d : Index,
      MvPolynomial.C (coordinateAut g (Pi.single d 1) c) * x d) = _
  simp only [mul_comm]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawLedger.coordinateAut_trace_basis
statement:
private theorem coordinateAut_trace_basis (g : Aut (K := k)) (d : Index) :
    (∑ a : Fin 3, coordinateAut g
      (Pi.single d (1 : k) : Coordinates k) (Sum.inl (a,a))) =
      ∑ a : Fin 3,
        (Pi.single d (1 : k) : Coordinates k) (Sum.inl (a,a))
proof:
:= by
  have ht := jordanTrace_invariant g
    (decode (Pi.single d (1 : k) : Coordinates k))
  rw [coordinateAut_apply]
  rw [← jordanTrace_decode, ← jordanTrace_decode]
  simpa only [decode_encode] using ht

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawLedger.constant_coordinate_trace
statement:
private theorem constant_coordinate_trace (g : Aut (K := k)) (d : Index) :
    (∑ a : Fin 3,
      MvPolynomial.C (coordinateAut g
        (Pi.single d (1 : k) : Coordinates k) (Sum.inl (a,a))) : CR k) =
      ∑ a : Fin 3, MvPolynomial.C
        ((Pi.single d (1 : k) : Coordinates k) (Sum.inl (a,a)))
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [map_sum] using
    congrArg (fun z : k => (MvPolynomial.C z : CR k))
      (coordinateAut_trace_basis k g d)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawLedger.single_coordinate_expansion
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [Pi.single_apply]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawLedger.extended_trace
proof:
:= by
  unfold traceCoordinate
  calc
    (∑ a : Fin 3, extendedCoordinateAut k g x (Sum.inl (a,a))) =
        ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ d : Index, x d *
          MvPolynomial.C (coordinateAut g
            (Pi.single d (1 : k) : Coordinates k) (Sum.inl (a,a))) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro a ha
      exact extended_apply_coordinate k g x (Sum.inl (a,a))
    _ = ∑ d : Index, x d * (∑ a : Fin 3,
          MvPolynomial.C (coordinateAut g
            (Pi.single d (1 : k) : Coordinates k) (Sum.inl (a,a)))) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro d hd
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ = ∑ d : Index, x d * (∑ a : Fin 3,
          MvPolynomial.C
            ((Pi.single d (1 : k) : Coordinates k) (Sum.inl (a,a)))) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro d hd
      rw [constant_coordinate_trace k g d]
    _ = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ d : Index, x d *
          MvPolynomial.C
            ((Pi.single d (1 : k) : Coordinates k) (Sum.inl (a,a))) := by
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro d hd
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ = ∑ a : Fin 3, x (Sum.inl (a,a)) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro a ha
      exact single_coordinate_expansion k x (Sum.inl (a,a))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawLedger.rawAction_rawPairTrace
proof:
:= by
  rw [rawPairTrace, rawAction_traceCoordinate, mapCoordinates_product,
    mapCoordinates_universal, mapCoordinates_universal]
  change traceCoordinate k
      (productCoordinate k
        (extendedCoordinateAut k g (universalPoint k r i))
        (extendedCoordinateAut k g (universalPoint k s j))) = _
  rw [← extended_map_product, extended_trace]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawLedger.rawAction_rawJointTrace
proof:
:= by

    mapCoordinates_product, mapCoordinates_universal,
    mapCoordinates_universal, mapCoordinates_universal]
  change traceCoordinate k
      (productCoordinate k
        (extendedCoordinateAut k g (universalPoint k 0 i))
        (productCoordinate k
          (extendedCoordinateAut k g (universalPoint k 1 j))
          (extendedCoordinateAut k g (universalPoint k 2 l)))) = _
  rw [← extended_map_product,
    ← extended_map_product, extended_trace]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawLedger.rawAction_rawCentered

:= by

    rawAction_rawPairTrace, rawAction_rawPairTrace]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawLedger.rawAction_rawLedgerCell
proof:
:= by
  rcases q with ⟨i,j⟩ | q
  · exact rawAction_rawPairTrace k g 0 i 1 j
  · rcases q with ⟨j,l⟩ | q
    · exact rawAction_rawPairTrace k g 1 j 2 l
    · rcases q with ⟨l,i⟩ | ⟨i,j,l⟩
      · exact rawAction_rawPairTrace k g 2 l 0 i
      · exact rawAction_rawCentered k g i j l

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawLedger.fractionAction_rawToFunction
statement:
theorem fractionAction_rawToFunction (g : Aut (K := k)) (x : CR k) :

proof:

      (algebraMap (RR k) (FF k) (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ x)) =
    algebraMap (RR k) (FF k)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawLedger.genericPointAlong_isRaw
statement:
private theorem genericPointAlong_isRaw (K : Type u) [Field K] [CharZero K]
    (φ : FF k →+* K) : IsRawFrameFamily (genericPointAlong k K φ)
proof:
:= by
  apply (rawFrameIdeal_le_ker_iff (k := K) (RingHom.id K)
    (genericPointAlong k K φ)).1
  change rawFrameIdeal K ≤ RingHom.ker (polynomialEvaluation k K φ)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawLedger.genericCarrierAlong_laws
statement:
theorem genericCarrierAlong_laws (K : Type u) [Field K] [CharZero K]
    (φ : FF k →+* K) (r : Fin 3) :
    (∀ i, ((genericCarrierAlong k K φ r i : Carrier K) : Mat6 K) *
        genericCarrierAlong k K φ r i = genericCarrierAlong k K φ r i) ∧
    (∀ i, jordanTrace (K := K)
        ((genericCarrierAlong k K φ r i : Carrier K) : Mat6 K) = 1) ∧
    ((genericCarrierAlong k K φ r 0 : Carrier K) : Mat6 K) +
        genericCarrierAlong k K φ r 1 + genericCarrierAlong k K φ r 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [genericCarrierAlong] using
    (actual_frame_laws (genericPointAlong k K φ)
      (genericPointAlong_isRaw k K φ) r)

statement:
private theorem genericEvaluation_eq (K : Type u) [Field K] [CharZero K]
    (φ : FF k →+* K) :
    genericEvaluation k K φ = φ.comp (rawToFunction k)
proof:
:= by
  apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
  · intro c
    simp [genericEvaluation, originalCoefficientEmbedding, evaluationAlong]
  · intro q
    rcases q with ⟨r,i,c⟩
    simp [genericEvaluation, genericPointAlong, evaluationAlong, universalPoint]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawLedger.map_ringMatrix
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.ext
  intro a b
  change e (ringMatrix x a b) = ringMatrix (e ∘ x) a b
  rcases a with a | a <;> rcases b with b | b <;>
    fin_cases a <;> fin_cases b <;>
    simp [ringMatrix, ringHat, Matrix.fromBlocks, Matrix.transpose,
      Function.comp_apply]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawLedger.map_productCoordinate
statement:
private theorem map_productCoordinate (e : CR k →+* K)
    (x y : Coordinates (CR k)) (c : Index) :
    e (productCoordinate k x y c) =
      coordinateJordan (e ∘ x) (e ∘ y) c
proof:
:= by
  rw [productCoordinate, RawFrameIdeal.map_matrixCoordinates]
  simp only [RawFrameIdeal.mapMatrix_smul, map_add, map_mul,
    map_ringMatrix]
  rw [show e (MvPolynomial.C ((2 : k)⁻¹) : CR k) = (2 : K)⁻¹ by
    change (e.comp MvPolynomial.C) ((2 : k)⁻¹) = (2 : K)⁻¹
    simp only [map_inv₀, map_ofNat]]
  change matrixCoordinates
      ((SelfAdjointCarrier.jordan (decode (e ∘ x))
        (decode (e ∘ y)) : Carrier K) : Mat6 K) c = _
  exact matrixCoordinates_carrier
    (SelfAdjointCarrier.jordan (decode (e ∘ x)) (decode (e ∘ y))) c

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawLedger.genericEvaluation_universal

private theorem genericEvaluation_universal (K : Type u) [Field K] [CharZero K]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawLedger.genericEvaluation_product
statement:
private theorem genericEvaluation_product (K : Type u) [Field K] [CharZero K]
    (φ : FF k →+* K) (x y : Coordinates (CR k)) :
    genericEvaluation k K φ ∘ productCoordinate k x y =
      coordinateJordan (genericEvaluation k K φ ∘ x)
        (genericEvaluation k K φ ∘ y)
proof:
:= by
  funext c
  exact map_productCoordinate k (genericEvaluation k K φ) x y c

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawLedger.genericEvaluation_rawPairTrace
statement:
private theorem genericEvaluation_rawPairTrace
    (K : Type u) [Field K] [CharZero K] (φ : FF k →+* K)
    (r i s j : Fin 3) :
    genericEvaluation k K φ (rawPairTrace k r i s j) =
      pairTrace (genericCarrierAlong k K φ r i)
        (genericCarrierAlong k K φ s j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rawPairTrace, traceCoordinate, map_sum]
  simp_rw [map_productCoordinate]
  rw [← jordanTrace_decode]
  rw [genericEvaluation_universal, genericEvaluation_universal,
    decode_coordinateJordan]
  exact (pairTrace_eq_jordanTrace_jordan _ _).symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawLedger.genericEvaluation_rawJointTrace
statement:
private theorem genericEvaluation_rawJointTrace
    (K : Type u) [Field K] [CharZero K] (φ : FF k →+* K)
    (i j l : Fin 3) :
    genericEvaluation k K φ (rawJointTrace k i j l) =
      jointTrace (genericCarrierAlong k K φ 0 i)
        (genericCarrierAlong k K φ 1 j)
        (genericCarrierAlong k K φ 2 l)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rawJointTrace, traceCoordinate, map_sum]
  simp_rw [map_productCoordinate]
  rw [genericEvaluation_product,
    genericEvaluation_universal, genericEvaluation_universal,
    genericEvaluation_universal]
  rw [← jordanTrace_decode, decode_coordinateJordan, decode_coordinateJordan]
  rw [jointTrace, pairTrace_eq_jordanTrace_jordan]
  rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawLedger.genericLedgerCellAlong
statement:
theorem genericLedgerCellAlong (K : Type u) [Field K] [CharZero K]
    (φ : FF k →+* K) (q : LedgerIndex) :
    φ (ledgerCell k q) =
      actualLedgerCell (genericCarrierLedgerAlong k K φ) q
proof:
:= by
  rw [ledgerCell]
  change (φ.comp (rawToFunction k)) (rawLedgerCell k q) = _
  rw [← DFunLike.congr_fun (genericEvaluation_eq k K φ)
    (rawLedgerCell k q)]
  rcases q with ⟨i,j⟩ | q
  · simpa [rawLedgerCell, genericCarrierLedgerAlong, actualLedgerCell,
      ActualSplitThirdFrameAut.carrierLedger, pairTrace] using
      genericEvaluation_rawPairTrace k K φ 0 i 1 j
  · rcases q with ⟨j,l⟩ | q
    · simpa [rawLedgerCell, genericCarrierLedgerAlong, actualLedgerCell,
        ActualSplitThirdFrameAut.carrierLedger, pairTrace] using
        genericEvaluation_rawPairTrace k K φ 1 j 2 l
    · rcases q with ⟨l,i⟩ | ⟨i,j,l⟩
      · simpa [rawLedgerCell, genericCarrierLedgerAlong, actualLedgerCell,
          ActualSplitThirdFrameAut.carrierLedger, pairTrace] using
          genericEvaluation_rawPairTrace k K φ 2 l 0 i
      · have hthree : genericEvaluation k K φ
            (MvPolynomial.C ((3 : k)⁻¹) : CR k) = (3 : K)⁻¹ := by
          change ((genericEvaluation k K φ).comp MvPolynomial.C)
            ((3 : k)⁻¹) = (3 : K)⁻¹
          simp only [map_inv₀, map_ofNat]
        have htwoNine : genericEvaluation k K φ
            (MvPolynomial.C ((2 : k) / 9) : CR k) = (2 : K) / 9 := by
          change ((genericEvaluation k K φ).comp MvPolynomial.C)
            ((2 : k) / 9) = (2 : K) / 9
          simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, map_mul, map_inv₀, map_ofNat]
        simp only [rawLedgerCell, rawCentered, map_add, map_sub, map_mul]
        rw [hthree, htwoNine]
        rw [genericEvaluation_rawJointTrace,
          genericEvaluation_rawPairTrace, genericEvaluation_rawPairTrace,
          genericEvaluation_rawPairTrace]
        simp only [genericCarrierLedgerAlong, actualLedgerCell,
          ActualSplitThirdFrameAut.carrierLedger, jointTrace, pairTrace,
          SelfAdjointCarrier.coe_jordan]
        ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawLedger.genericData_agreement
statement:
theorem genericData_agreement (K : Type u) [Field K] [CharZero K]
    (φ ψ : FF k →+* K)
    (hscalar : ∀ c, φ (scalarMap k c) = ψ (scalarMap k c))
    (hledger : ∀ q, φ (ledgerCell k q) = ψ (ledgerCell k q)) :
    originalCoefficientEmbedding k K φ =
        originalCoefficientEmbedding k K ψ ∧
      genericCarrierLedgerAlong k K φ =
        genericCarrierLedgerAlong k K ψ
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · ext c
    simpa only [originalCoefficientEmbedding, scalarMap,
      RingHom.comp_apply] using hscalar c
  · have hcell (q : LedgerIndex) :
        actualLedgerCell (genericCarrierLedgerAlong k K φ) q =
          actualLedgerCell (genericCarrierLedgerAlong k K ψ) q :=
      (genericLedgerCellAlong k K φ q).symm.trans
        ((hledger q).trans (genericLedgerCellAlong k K ψ q))
    let Lφ := genericCarrierLedgerAlong k K φ
    let Lψ := genericCarrierLedgerAlong k K ψ
    have hEF : Lφ.pairEF = Lψ.pairEF := by
      funext i j
      simpa only [Lφ, Lψ, actualLedgerCell] using hcell (Sum.inl (i,j))
    have hFP : Lφ.pairFP = Lψ.pairFP := by
      funext j l
      simpa only [Lφ, Lψ, actualLedgerCell] using
        hcell (Sum.inr (Sum.inl (j,l)))
    have hPE : Lφ.pairPE = Lψ.pairPE := by
      funext l i
      simpa only [Lφ, Lψ, actualLedgerCell] using
        hcell (Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inl (l,i))))
    have hcentered : Lφ.centered = Lψ.centered := by
      funext i j l
      simpa only [Lφ, Lψ, actualLedgerCell] using
        hcell (Sum.inr (Sum.inr (Sum.inr (i,j,l))))
    have hext : ∀ (A B : ActualSplitThirdFrameAut.CarrierLedger K),
        A.pairEF = B.pairEF → A.pairFP = B.pairFP →
        A.pairPE = B.pairPE → A.centered = B.centered → A = B := by
      rintro ⟨ae, af, ap, ac⟩ ⟨be, bf, bp, bc⟩ h1 h2 h3 h4
      cases h1
      cases h2
      cases h3
      cases h4
      rfl
    exact hext Lφ Lψ hEF hFP hPE hcentered

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TauLedgerInvariance.projector_map
statement:
theorem projector_map (g : Albert K ≃ₗ[K] Albert K)
    (hunit : g 1 = 1) (hmul : ∀ x y, g (x * y) = g x * g y)
    (x : Albert K) (i : Fin 3) :
    g (tauProjector x i) = tauProjector (g x) i
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i
  · change g ((2 : K)⁻¹ • (x * x - x)) = (2 : K)⁻¹ • (g x * g x - g x)
    rw [map_smul, map_sub, hmul]
  · change g (1 - x * x) = 1 - g x * g x
    rw [map_sub, hunit, hmul]
  · change g ((2 : K)⁻¹ • (x * x + x)) = (2 : K)⁻¹ • (g x * g x + g x)
    rw [map_smul, map_add, hmul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TauLedgerInvariance.labelledLedger_invariant
statement:
theorem labelledLedger_invariant (g : Albert K ≃ₗ[K] Albert K)
    (hunit : g 1 = 1) (hmul : ∀ x y, g (x * y) = g x * g y)
    (T : Fin 3 → Albert K) : labelledLedger (g ∘ T) = labelledLedger T
proof:
:= by
  simp only [labelledLedger, Function.comp_apply, ← projector_map g hunit hmul,
    ← hmul, tauTrace_invariant g hmul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TauLedgerInvariance.word_map
statement:
theorem word_map (g : Albert K ≃ₗ[K] Albert K)
    (hmul : ∀ x y, g (x * y) = g x * g y) (x y z : Albert K) :
    word (g x) (g y) (g z) = g (word x y z)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [word, map_sub, hmul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TauLedgerInvariance.detector_invariant
statement:
theorem detector_invariant (g : Albert K ≃ₗ[K] Albert K)
    (hmul : ∀ x y, g (x * y) = g x * g y) (x y z : Albert K) :
    detector (g x) (g y) (g z) = detector x y z
proof:
:= by
  simp only [detector, word_map g hmul, tauTrace_cube_invariant g hmul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GSpFinalAgreement.map_ringMatrix_of_coordinates
statement:
theorem map_ringMatrix_of_coordinates
    {K : Type v} {E : Type w} [Field K] [CharZero K]
    [Field E] [CharZero E] (j : K →+* E) (x : Coordinates K) :
    j.mapMatrix (ringMatrix x) = ringMatrix (j ∘ x)
proof:
:= by
  ext a b
  change j (ringMatrix x a b) = ringMatrix (j ∘ x) a b
  rcases a with a | a <;> rcases b with b | b <;>
    fin_cases a <;> fin_cases b <;>
    simp [ringMatrix, ringHat, Matrix.fromBlocks, Matrix.transpose,
      Function.comp_apply]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GSpFinalAgreement.matrixCoordinates_ringMatrix
statement:
theorem matrixCoordinates_ringMatrix
    {K : Type v} [Field K] [CharZero K] (x : Coordinates K) :
    matrixCoordinates (ringMatrix x) = x
proof:
:= by
  funext c
  rcases c with ⟨a, b⟩ | c
  · rfl
  · rcases c with c | c <;> fin_cases c <;>
      simp [matrixCoordinates, ringMatrix, ringHat, Matrix.fromBlocks]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GSpFinalAgreement.ringMatrix_injective
statement:
theorem ringMatrix_injective
    {K : Type v} [Field K] [CharZero K] :
    Function.Injective (ringMatrix : Coordinates K → Mat6 K)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y h
  have := congrArg matrixCoordinates h
  simpa only [matrixCoordinates_ringMatrix] using this

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GSpFinalAgreement.map_ringMatrix_genericPointAlong
statement:
theorem map_ringMatrix_genericPointAlong
    {K : Type v} {E : Type w} [Field K] [CharZero K]
    [Field E] [CharZero E] (j : K →+* E) (phi : FF k →+* K)
    (r i : Fin 3) :
    j.mapMatrix (ringMatrix (genericPointAlong k K phi r i)) =
      ringMatrix (genericPointAlong k E (j.comp phi) r i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_ringMatrix_of_coordinates]
  apply congrArg ringMatrix
  funext c
  rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GSpFinalAgreement.originalCoefficientEmbedding_comp
statement:
theorem originalCoefficientEmbedding_comp
    {K : Type v} {E : Type w} [Field K] [CharZero K]
    [Field E] [CharZero E] (j : K →+* E) (phi : FF k →+* K) :
    originalCoefficientEmbedding k E (j.comp phi) =
      j.comp (originalCoefficientEmbedding k K phi)
proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GSpFinalAgreement.wordMatrix_nil
statement:
private theorem wordMatrix_nil
    {K : Type v} [Field K] [CharZero K] :
    wordMatrix ([] : List (Step (K := K) (V := Vec6 K))) = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply matrixAction_injective
  unfold wordMatrix
  rw [matrixAction_matrixOfLinear, matrixAction_one]
  rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GSpFinalAgreement.inverseWordMatrix_nil
statement:
private theorem inverseWordMatrix_nil
    {K : Type v} [Field K] [CharZero K] :
    inverseWordMatrix ([] : List (Step (K := K) (V := Vec6 K))) = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply matrixAction_injective
  unfold inverseWordMatrix
  rw [matrixAction_matrixOfLinear, matrixAction_one]
  rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GSpFinalAgreement.wordMatrix_cons
statement:
private theorem wordMatrix_cons
    {K : Type v} [Field K] [CharZero K]
    (step : Step (K := K) (V := Vec6 K))
    (word : List (Step (K := K) (V := Vec6 K))) :
    wordMatrix (step :: word) = wordMatrix [step] * wordMatrix word
proof:
:= by
  rcases step with ⟨d, t⟩
  apply matrixAction_injective
  unfold wordMatrix
  rw [matrixAction_mul, matrixAction_matrixOfLinear,
    matrixAction_matrixOfLinear, matrixAction_matrixOfLinear]
  rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GSpFinalAgreement.inverseWordMatrix_cons
statement:
private theorem inverseWordMatrix_cons
    {K : Type v} [Field K] [CharZero K]
    (step : Step (K := K) (V := Vec6 K))
    (word : List (Step (K := K) (V := Vec6 K))) :
    inverseWordMatrix (step :: word) =
      inverseWordMatrix word * inverseWordMatrix [step]
proof:
:= by
  rcases step with ⟨d, t⟩
  apply matrixAction_injective
  unfold inverseWordMatrix
  rw [matrixAction_mul, matrixAction_matrixOfLinear,
    matrixAction_matrixOfLinear, matrixAction_matrixOfLinear]
  simp only [inverseWord, List.reverse_cons, List.map_append,
    List.map_singleton, List.reverse_nil, List.map_nil, wordMap_append,
    wordMap_nil, LinearMap.comp_id, LinearMap.id_comp]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GSpFinalAgreement.ringMatrix_actedPoint_singleton
statement:
theorem ringMatrix_actedPoint_singleton
    {K : Type v} [Field K] [CharZero K]
    (step : Step (K := K) (V := Vec6 K))
    (P : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Coordinates K) (r i : Fin 3) :
    ringMatrix (actedPoint K (singletonAut K step) P r i) =
      wordMatrix [step] * ringMatrix (P r i) * inverseWordMatrix [step]
proof:
:= by
  change ringMatrix (coordinateAut (singletonAut K step) (P r i)) = _
  change ((decode (coordinateAut (singletonAut K step) (P r i)) :
    Carrier K) : Mat6 K) = _
  rw [coordinateAut_apply, decode_encode]
  rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GSpFinalAgreement.ringMatrix_wordActedPoint
statement:
theorem ringMatrix_wordActedPoint
    {K : Type v} [Field K] [CharZero K]
    (word : List (Step (K := K) (V := Vec6 K)))
    (P : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Coordinates K) (r i : Fin 3) :
    ringMatrix (wordActedPoint K word P r i) =
      wordMatrix word * ringMatrix (P r i) * inverseWordMatrix word
proof:
:= by
  induction word with
  | nil =>
      rw [wordMatrix_nil, inverseWordMatrix_nil]
      simp [wordActedPoint]
  | cons step word ih =>
      change ringMatrix
          (actedPoint K (singletonAut K step) (wordActedPoint K word P) r i) = _
      rw [ringMatrix_actedPoint_singleton, ih, wordMatrix_cons step word,
        inverseWordMatrix_cons step word]
      simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GSpFinalAgreement.map_full_point_conjugacy
statement:
theorem map_full_point_conjugacy
    {K : Type v} {E : Type w} [Field K] [CharZero K]
    [Field E] [CharZero E] (j : K →+* E) (phi psi : FF k →+* K)
    (M N : Mat6 K)
    (hpoint : ∀ r i,
      M * ringMatrix (genericPointAlong k K phi r i) * N =
        ringMatrix (genericPointAlong k K psi r i)) (r i : Fin 3) :
    j.mapMatrix M *
        ringMatrix (genericPointAlong k E (j.comp phi) r i) *
          j.mapMatrix N =
      ringMatrix (genericPointAlong k E (j.comp psi) r i)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg j.mapMatrix (hpoint r i)
  simp only [map_mul] at h
  rw [map_ringMatrix_genericPointAlong,
    map_ringMatrix_genericPointAlong] at h
  exact h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GSpFinalAgreement.GSp_finalPoint_agreement
statement:
theorem GSp_finalPoint_agreement
    {K : Type v} [Field K] [CharZero K]
    (phi psi : FF k →+* K)
    (M N : Mat6 K) (mu : K)
    (hMN : M * N = 1) (hNM : N * M = 1) (hmu : mu ≠ 0)
    (hform : M.transpose * symplecticJ * M = mu • symplecticJ)
    (hscalar : originalCoefficientEmbedding k K phi =
      originalCoefficientEmbedding k K psi)
    (hpoint : ∀ r i,
      M * ringMatrix (genericPointAlong k K phi r i) * N =
        ringMatrix (genericPointAlong k K psi r i))
    (a b : CoordinateRing k) (hb : rawToFunction k b ≠ 0)
    (hinv : ∀ g : ScalarJordanAut.Aut (K := k),
      fractionAction k g (rawToFunction k a / rawToFunction k b) =
        rawToFunction k a / rawToFunction k b) :
    phi (rawToFunction k a / rawToFunction k b) =
      psi (rawToFunction k a / rawToFunction k b)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R, instR, word, _hlen, hword⟩ :=
    exists_twelve_word_after_root M N mu hMN hNM hmu hform
  letI : CharZero R.Carrier := instR
  have hscalarR :
      originalCoefficientEmbedding k R.Carrier (R.embedding.comp phi) =
        originalCoefficientEmbedding k R.Carrier (R.embedding.comp psi) := by
    rw [originalCoefficientEmbedding_comp, originalCoefficientEmbedding_comp]
    exact congrArg (fun f : k →+* K => R.embedding.comp f) hscalar
  have hpointR :
      wordActedPoint R.Carrier word
          (genericPointAlong k R.Carrier (R.embedding.comp phi)) =
        genericPointAlong k R.Carrier (R.embedding.comp psi) := by
    funext r i
    apply ringMatrix_injective
    rw [ringMatrix_wordActedPoint]
    calc
      wordMatrix word *
            ringMatrix (genericPointAlong k R.Carrier
              (R.embedding.comp phi) r i) *
          inverseWordMatrix word =
        R.embedding.mapMatrix M *
            ringMatrix (genericPointAlong k R.Carrier
              (R.embedding.comp phi) r i) *
          R.embedding.mapMatrix N := hword _
      _ = ringMatrix (genericPointAlong k R.Carrier
          (R.embedding.comp psi) r i) :=
        map_full_point_conjugacy k R.embedding phi psi M N hpoint r i
  have hagree := transvectionWord_finalPoint_agreement
    k R.Carrier (R.embedding.comp phi) (R.embedding.comp psi) word
    hscalarR hpointR a b hb hinv
  apply R.embedding.injective
  simpa only [RingHom.comp_apply] using hagree

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawIdealPreservation.rawAction_C
statement:
@[simp] theorem rawAction_C (g : Aut (K := k)) (a : k) :
    rawAction k g (MvPolynomial.C a) = MvPolynomial.C a
proof: := by simp [rawAction]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawIdealPreservation.mapCoordinates_universal
statement:
@[simp] theorem mapCoordinates_universal (g : Aut (K := k)) (r i : Fin 3) :
    mapCoordinates k g (universalPoint k r i) = transformedUniversal k g r i
proof:
:= by
  funext c
  simp [mapCoordinates, transformedUniversal, universalPoint, rawAction]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawIdealPreservation.map_ringMatrix
statement:
private theorem map_ringMatrix (g : Aut (K := k)) (x : Coordinates (CR k)) :
    (rawAction k g).mapMatrix (ringMatrix x) = ringMatrix (mapCoordinates k g x)
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.ext
  intro a b
  change rawAction k g (ringMatrix x a b) = ringMatrix (mapCoordinates k g x) a b
  rcases a with a | a <;> rcases b with b | b <;>
    fin_cases a <;> fin_cases b <;>
    simp [ringMatrix, ringHat, Matrix.fromBlocks, Matrix.transpose,
      mapCoordinates, Function.comp_apply]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawIdealPreservation.map_matrixCoordinates
statement:
private theorem map_matrixCoordinates (g : Aut (K := k))
    (A : Matrix (Sum (Fin 3) (Fin 3)) (Sum (Fin 3) (Fin 3)) (CR k)) :
    mapCoordinates k g (matrixCoordinates A) =
      matrixCoordinates ((rawAction k g).mapMatrix A)
proof:
:= by
  funext c
  rcases c with ⟨a,b⟩ | c
  · rfl
  · rcases c with c | c <;> fin_cases c <;>
      simp [mapCoordinates, matrixCoordinates]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawIdealPreservation.mapMatrix_smul
statement:
private theorem mapMatrix_smul (g : Aut (K := k)) (a : CR k)
    (A : Matrix (Sum (Fin 3) (Fin 3)) (Sum (Fin 3) (Fin 3)) (CR k)) :
    (rawAction k g).mapMatrix (a • A) =
      rawAction k g a • (rawAction k g).mapMatrix A
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.ext
  intro i j
  change rawAction k g (a * A i j) = rawAction k g a * rawAction k g (A i j)
  exact map_mul (rawAction k g) a (A i j)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawIdealPreservation.mapCoordinates_product
statement:
theorem mapCoordinates_product (g : Aut (K := k)) (x y : Coordinates (CR k)) :
    mapCoordinates k g (productCoordinate k x y) =
      productCoordinate k (mapCoordinates k g x) (mapCoordinates k g y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [productCoordinate, map_matrixCoordinates]
  simp only [mapMatrix_smul, map_add, map_mul, map_ringMatrix, rawAction_C]
  rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawIdealPreservation.extended_apply_coordinate
statement:
private theorem extended_apply_coordinate (g : Aut (K := k))
    (x : Coordinates (CR k)) (c : Index) :
    extendedCoordinateAut k g x c =
      ∑ d : Index, x d * MvPolynomial.C
        (coordinateAut g (Pi.single d 1) c)
proof:
:= by
  change (∑ d : Index,
      MvPolynomial.C (coordinateAut g (Pi.single d 1) c) * x d) = _
  simp only [mul_comm]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawIdealPreservation.extended_mem_rawIdeal
statement:
private theorem extended_mem_rawIdeal (g : Aut (K := k))
    (x : Coordinates (CR k))
    (hx : ∀ c, x c ∈ rawFrameIdeal k) (c : Index) :
    extendedCoordinateAut k g x c ∈ rawFrameIdeal k
proof:
:= by
  rw [extended_apply_coordinate]
  apply (rawFrameIdeal k).sum_mem
  intro d hd
  exact (rawFrameIdeal k).mul_mem_right _ (hx d)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawIdealPreservation.idempotenceResidual_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem idempotenceResidual_apply (r i : Fin 3) (c : Index) :
    idempotenceResidual k r i c = equation k (.idempotence r i c)
proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawIdealPreservation.sumResidual_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem sumResidual_apply (r : Fin 3) (c : Index) :
    sumResidual k r c = equation k (.sumOne r c)
proof:
:= by
  simp [sumResidual, equation, Finset.sum_apply]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawIdealPreservation.extended_unit
statement:
private theorem extended_unit (g : Aut (K := k)) :
    extendedCoordinateAut k g (unitCoordinate k) = unitCoordinate k
proof:
:= by
  have hconst : unitCoordinate k = MvPolynomial.C ∘
      (encode (SelfAdjointCarrier.one : SelfAdjointCarrier.Carrier k)) := by
    funext c
    rw [Function.comp_apply, RawFrameIdeal.encode_one]
    rcases c with ⟨a,b⟩ | c
    · by_cases h : a = b <;> simp [unitCoordinate, h]
    · simp [unitCoordinate]
  rw [hconst]
  change extend MvPolynomial.C (coordinateAut g).toLinearMap
      (MvPolynomial.C ∘ encode SelfAdjointCarrier.one) = _
  rw [extend_on_constants]
  funext c
  apply congrArg MvPolynomial.C
  change coordinateAut g (encode SelfAdjointCarrier.one) c =
    encode SelfAdjointCarrier.one c
  rw [coordinateAut_apply, decode_encode, g.map_one]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawIdealPreservation.coordinateAut_trace_basis
statement:
private theorem coordinateAut_trace_basis (g : Aut (K := k)) (d : Index) :
    (∑ a : Fin 3, coordinateAut g
      (Pi.single d (1 : k) : Coordinates k) (Sum.inl (a,a))) =
      ∑ a : Fin 3,
        (Pi.single d (1 : k) : Coordinates k) (Sum.inl (a,a))
proof:
:= by
  have ht := jordanTrace_invariant g
    (decode (Pi.single d (1 : k) : Coordinates k))
  rw [coordinateAut_apply]
  rw [← jordanTrace_decode, ← jordanTrace_decode]
  simpa only [decode_encode] using ht

        (Pi.single d (1 : k) : Coordinates k) (Sum.inl (a,a))) : CR k) =
      ∑ a : Fin 3, MvPolynomial.C
        ((Pi.single d (1 : k) : Coordinates k) (Sum.inl (a,a)))
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [map_sum] using
    congrArg (fun z : k => (MvPolynomial.C z : CR k))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawIdealPreservation.single_coordinate_expansion
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [Pi.single_apply]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawIdealPreservation.extended_trace
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (∑ a : Fin 3, extendedCoordinateAut k g x (Sum.inl (a,a))) =
        ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ d : Index, x d *
          MvPolynomial.C (coordinateAut g
            (Pi.single d (1 : k) : Coordinates k) (Sum.inl (a,a))) := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro a ha
            exact extended_apply_coordinate k g x (Sum.inl (a,a))
    _ = ∑ d : Index, x d * (∑ a : Fin 3,
          MvPolynomial.C (coordinateAut g
            (Pi.single d (1 : k) : Coordinates k) (Sum.inl (a,a)))) := by
            rw [Finset.sum_comm]
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro d hd
            rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ = ∑ d : Index, x d * (∑ a : Fin 3,
          MvPolynomial.C
            ((Pi.single d (1 : k) : Coordinates k) (Sum.inl (a,a)))) := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro d hd
            rw [constant_coordinate_trace k g d]
    _ = ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ d : Index, x d *
          MvPolynomial.C
            ((Pi.single d (1 : k) : Coordinates k) (Sum.inl (a,a))) := by
            rw [Finset.sum_comm]
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro d hd
            rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    _ = ∑ a : Fin 3, x (Sum.inl (a,a)) := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro a ha
            exact single_coordinate_expansion k x (Sum.inl (a,a))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawIdealPreservation.rawAction_idempotence_mem
proof:
:= by
  have hres : mapCoordinates k g (idempotenceResidual k r i) =
      extendedCoordinateAut k g (idempotenceResidual k r i) := by
    rw [idempotenceResidual]
    calc
      mapCoordinates k g
          (productCoordinate k (universalPoint k r i) (universalPoint k r i) -
            universalPoint k r i) =
        mapCoordinates k g
            (productCoordinate k (universalPoint k r i) (universalPoint k r i)) -
          mapCoordinates k g (universalPoint k r i) := by
            funext d
            simp only [mapCoordinates, Pi.sub_apply, map_sub]
      _ = productCoordinate k
            (mapCoordinates k g (universalPoint k r i))
            (mapCoordinates k g (universalPoint k r i)) -
          mapCoordinates k g (universalPoint k r i) := by
            rw [mapCoordinates_product]
      _ = productCoordinate k
            (extendedCoordinateAut k g (universalPoint k r i))
            (extendedCoordinateAut k g (universalPoint k r i)) -
          extendedCoordinateAut k g (universalPoint k r i) := by
            rw [mapCoordinates_universal]
            rfl
      _ = extendedCoordinateAut k g
            (productCoordinate k (universalPoint k r i) (universalPoint k r i)) -
          extendedCoordinateAut k g (universalPoint k r i) := by
            rw [extended_map_product]
      _ = extendedCoordinateAut k g
          (productCoordinate k (universalPoint k r i) (universalPoint k r i) -
            universalPoint k r i) := by
            rw [map_sub]
  rw [← idempotenceResidual_apply]
  rw [show rawAction k g (idempotenceResidual k r i c) =
      mapCoordinates k g (idempotenceResidual k r i) c from rfl]
  rw [congrFun hres c]
  exact extended_mem_rawIdeal k g _ (fun d =>
    Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self (EquationIndex.idempotence r i d))) c

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawIdealPreservation.rawAction_sumOne_mem
proof:
:= by
  have hres : mapCoordinates k g (sumResidual k r) =
      extendedCoordinateAut k g (sumResidual k r) := by
    rw [sumResidual]
    have hmapUnit : mapCoordinates k g (unitCoordinate k) = unitCoordinate k := by
      funext d
      rcases d with ⟨a,b⟩ | d
      · by_cases h : a = b <;> simp [mapCoordinates, unitCoordinate, h]
      · simp [mapCoordinates, unitCoordinate]
    have hpoint (j : Fin 3) :
        mapCoordinates k g (universalPoint k r j) =
          extendedCoordinateAut k g (universalPoint k r j) := by
      simpa only [transformedUniversal] using mapCoordinates_universal k g r j
    calc
      mapCoordinates k g ((∑ j : Fin 3, universalPoint k r j) - unitCoordinate k) =
          (∑ j : Fin 3, mapCoordinates k g (universalPoint k r j)) -
            mapCoordinates k g (unitCoordinate k) := by
        funext d
        simp only [mapCoordinates, Pi.sub_apply, Finset.sum_apply, map_sub, map_sum]
      _ = (∑ j : Fin 3, extendedCoordinateAut k g (universalPoint k r j)) -
          extendedCoordinateAut k g (unitCoordinate k) := by
        rw [hmapUnit, extended_unit]
        apply congrArg (fun y => y - unitCoordinate k)
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j hj
        exact hpoint j
      _ = extendedCoordinateAut k g
          ((∑ j : Fin 3, universalPoint k r j) - unitCoordinate k) := by
        rw [map_sub, map_sum]
  rw [← sumResidual_apply]
  rw [show rawAction k g (sumResidual k r c) =
      mapCoordinates k g (sumResidual k r) c from rfl]
  rw [congrFun hres c]
  exact extended_mem_rawIdeal k g _ (fun d =>
    Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self (EquationIndex.sumOne r d))) c

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawIdealPreservation.rawAction_traceOne_mem
statement:
private theorem rawAction_traceOne_mem (g : Aut (K := k)) (r i : Fin 3) :
    rawAction k g (equation k (.traceOne r i)) ∈ rawFrameIdeal k
proof:
:= by
  simp only [equation, traceCoordinate, map_sub, map_sum, map_one]
  simp_rw [show ∀ a : Fin 3,
      rawAction k g (universalPoint k r i (Sum.inl (a,a))) =
        transformedUniversal k g r i (Sum.inl (a,a)) by
      intro a; exact congrFun (mapCoordinates_universal k g r i) (Sum.inl (a,a))]
  rw [transformedUniversal, extended_trace]
  exact Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self (EquationIndex.traceOne r i))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawIdealPreservation.rawAction_equation_mem
statement:
theorem rawAction_equation_mem (g : Aut (K := k)) (q : EquationIndex) :
    rawAction k g (equation k q) ∈ rawFrameIdeal k
proof:
:= by
  cases q with
  | idempotence r i c => exact rawAction_idempotence_mem k g r i c
  | traceOne r i => exact rawAction_traceOne_mem k g r i
  | sumOne r c => exact rawAction_sumOne_mem k g r c

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawIdealPreservation.rawAction_maps_rawFrameIdeal
statement:
theorem rawAction_maps_rawFrameIdeal (g : Aut (K := k)) :
    Ideal.map (rawAction k g) (rawFrameIdeal k) ≤ rawFrameIdeal k
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
  apply Ideal.span_le.2
  rintro x ⟨q, rfl⟩
  exact rawAction_equation_mem k g q

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawIdealPreservation.rawAction_radical_stable
statement:
theorem rawAction_radical_stable (g : Aut (K := k)) :
    (rawFrameIdeal k).radical ≤ (rawFrameIdeal k).radical.comap (rawAction k g)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Ideal.mem_radical_iff.mp hx
  apply Ideal.mem_radical_iff.mpr
  refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
  rw [← map_pow]
  exact rawAction_maps_rawFrameIdeal k g
    (Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (rawAction k g) hn)

      ![SecondStatement.E, SecondStatement.F0 + t⁻¹ • SecondStatement.FInv,
        SecondStatement.K0 + t • SecondStatement.KPos + t⁻¹ • SecondStatement.KInv]

  rw [normalizedTriple_eq_mapTriple t ht, statementE_eq_toAlbert_theta1E,
    F0_eq, FInv_eq, K0_eq, KPos_eq, KInv_eq]

  · exact congrArg SecondStatement.toAlbert (parameterTriple_cE t ht)
  · change SecondStatement.toAlbert (parameterTriple t ht).cF =
      SecondStatement.toAlbert parameterFConst +
        t⁻¹ • SecondStatement.toAlbert parameterFInv
    rw [parameterTriple_cF, toAlbert_add, toAlbert_smul]
  · change SecondStatement.toAlbert (parameterTriple t ht).cK =
      SecondStatement.toAlbert parameterKConst +
          t • SecondStatement.toAlbert parameterKPos +

statement:
theorem eval_stages {σ : Type w} {D : MvPolynomial σ k}
    (head : Stage k σ D) (rest : List (Stage k σ D))
    (t : σ → k) (ht : MvPolynomial.eval t D ≠ 0) (x : Fin 27 → F k) :
    ((wordMatrix k (head :: rest)).map
      (localizedConstantEval k (F k) (WordRing k σ D) D t ht)).mulVec x =
      SourceAutExtension.linearEquiv (R := F k)
        (stagesAut k head rest t ht) x
proof:
:= by
  induction rest generalizing head x with
  | nil =>
      simp only [wordMatrix, Matrix.mul_one, stagesAut]
      exact head.eval_matrix t ht x
  | cons next rest ih =>
      rw [wordMatrix, Matrix.map_mul, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
      rw [ih next]
      rw [head.eval_matrix]
      exact (extended_comp_apply k _ _ x).symm

    (t : σ → k) (ht : MvPolynomial.eval t W.denominator ≠ 0) (x : F k) :
    localizedConstantEval k (F k) (WordRing k σ W.denominator)

proof:

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RationalSourceFamily.localizedEval_substitution
statement:
theorem localizedEval_substitution
    (t : σ → k) (ht : MvPolynomial.eval t W.denominator ≠ 0) :
    (localizedConstantEval k (F k) (WordRing k σ W.denominator)
        W.denominator t ht).comp (substitution k W) =
      (fractionAction k (CertifiedWord.baseWordAut k W t ht)).toRingHom.comp
        (rawToFunction k)
proof:
:= by
  apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
  · intro a
    simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, substitution, MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_C]
    rw [localizedEval_coefficient]
    rw [rawToFunction, RingHom.comp_apply]
    change _ = fractionAction k (CertifiedWord.baseWordAut k W t ht)
      (algebraMap (ReducedCoordinateRing k) (F k)
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (MvPolynomial.C a)))
    rw [fractionAction_algebraMap_reduced]
    apply congrArg (algebraMap (ReducedCoordinateRing k) (F k))
    change Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (MvPolynomial.C a) =
      SourceReducedRawAutomorphism.reducedActionHom k _
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (MvPolynomial.C a))
    rw [SourceReducedRawAutomorphism.reducedActionHom_mk]
    simp [SourceRawAutomorphism.rawAction]
  · intro q
    cases q with
    | entry r i c =>
      simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, substitution, MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_X']
      change _ = fractionAction k (CertifiedWord.baseWordAut k W t ht) (universalF0 k r i c)
      have h := congrFun (CertifiedWord.eval_word k W t ht (universalF0 k r i)) c
      calc
        _ = SourceAutExtension.linearEquiv (R := F k)
            (CertifiedWord.baseWordAut k W t ht) (universalF0 k r i) c := by
          simpa [applyWord, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct,
            coefficientEmbedding, localizedConstantEval_algebraMap,
            LocalizedGridIdentity.constantEval] using h
        _ = fractionAction k (CertifiedWord.baseWordAut k W t ht)
            (universalF0 k r i c) :=
          (congrFun (fractionAction_universalF0 k
            (CertifiedWord.baseWordAut k W t ht) r i) c).symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RationalSourceFamily.word_grid_cleared_identity
statement:
theorem word_grid_cleared_identity
    (a b : CoordinateRing k) (hb : rawToFunction k b ≠ 0)
    (hinv : ∀ g : ResidualAction.SourceAut (K := k),
      fractionAction k g (rawToFunction k a / rawToFunction k b) =
        rawToFunction k a / rawToFunction k b) :
    substitution k W a * coefficientEmbedding k (rawToFunction k b) -
      coefficientEmbedding k (rawToFunction k a) * substitution k W b = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply eq_zero_of_localizedConstantEval_eq_zero k (F k)
    (WordRing k σ W.denominator) W.denominator W.denominator_ne_zero
  intro t ht
  let g := CertifiedWord.baseWordAut k W t ht
  have hs := localizedEval_substitution k W t ht
  have hsa := DFunLike.congr_fun hs a
  have hsb := DFunLike.congr_fun hs b
  have hi := hinv g
  have hgb : fractionAction k g (rawToFunction k b) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [map_zero] using (fractionAction k g).injective.ne hb
  have hcross :
      fractionAction k g (rawToFunction k a) * rawToFunction k b =
        rawToFunction k a * fractionAction k g (rawToFunction k b) := by
    apply (div_eq_div_iff hgb hb).mp
    simpa only [map_div₀] using hi
  simp only [map_sub, map_mul]
  change
    (((localizedConstantEval k (F k) (WordRing k σ W.denominator)
      W.denominator t ht).comp (substitution k W)) a) *
        localizedConstantEval k (F k) (WordRing k σ W.denominator)
          W.denominator t ht (coefficientEmbedding k (rawToFunction k b)) -
      localizedConstantEval k (F k) (WordRing k σ W.denominator)
          W.denominator t ht (coefficientEmbedding k (rawToFunction k a)) *
        (((localizedConstantEval k (F k) (WordRing k σ W.denominator)
          W.denominator t ht).comp (substitution k W)) b) = 0
  rw [hsa, hsb]
  rw [localizedEval_coefficient, localizedEval_coefficient]
  change fractionAction k g (rawToFunction k a) * rawToFunction k b -
    rawToFunction k a * fractionAction k g (rawToFunction k b) = 0
  rw [hcross, sub_self]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RationalSourceFamily.extensionEval_coefficient
statement:
private theorem extensionEval_coefficient
    (φ : F k →+* E) (p : σ → E)
    (hD : IsUnit (MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom φ p
      (LocalizedGridIdentity.mappedDenominator k (F k) W.denominator)))
    (x : F k) :
    extensionEval k (F k) (WordRing k σ W.denominator) W.denominator
        φ p hD (coefficientEmbedding k x) = φ x
proof:
:= by
  simp [coefficientEmbedding, extensionEval, IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RationalSourceFamily.two_embeddings_invariant_agreement
statement:
theorem two_embeddings_invariant_agreement
    (a b : CoordinateRing k) (hb : rawToFunction k b ≠ 0)
    (hinv : ∀ g : ResidualAction.SourceAut (K := k),
      fractionAction k g (rawToFunction k a / rawToFunction k b) =
        rawToFunction k a / rawToFunction k b)
    (φ ψ : F k →+* E) (p : σ → E)
    (hD : IsUnit (MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom φ p
      (LocalizedGridIdentity.mappedDenominator k (F k) W.denominator)))
    (hcoordinates :
      (extensionEval k (F k) (WordRing k σ W.denominator) W.denominator
        φ p hD).comp (substitution k W) = ψ.comp (rawToFunction k)) :
    φ (rawToFunction k a / rawToFunction k b) =
      ψ (rawToFunction k a / rawToFunction k b)
proof:
:= by
  let ev := extensionEval k (F k) (WordRing k σ W.denominator)
    W.denominator φ p hD
  have hz := congrArg ev (word_grid_cleared_identity k W a b hb hinv)
  have ha := DFunLike.congr_fun hcoordinates a
  have hb' := DFunLike.congr_fun hcoordinates b
  rw [map_sub, map_mul, map_mul, map_zero, sub_eq_zero] at hz
  change
    ((ev.comp (substitution k W)) a) *
        ev (coefficientEmbedding k (rawToFunction k b)) =
      ev (coefficientEmbedding k (rawToFunction k a)) *
        ((ev.comp (substitution k W)) b) at hz
  rw [ha, hb'] at hz
  rw [extensionEval_coefficient k W φ p hD,
    extensionEval_coefficient k W φ p hD] at hz
  have hφb : φ (rawToFunction k b) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [map_zero] using φ.injective.ne hb
  have hψb : ψ (rawToFunction k b) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [map_zero] using ψ.injective.ne hb
  rw [map_div₀, map_div₀]
  apply (div_eq_div_iff hφb hψb).2
  exact hz.symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFixedDifferenceInverseWitness.doubledCenter_norm_ne
statement:
theorem doubledCenter_norm_ne (t : VCoord K) (ht : nV t ≠ 0) :
    nV (doubledCenter t) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [doubledCenter, nV_smul]
  exact mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) ht

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFixedDifferenceInverseWitness.reflect_doubled_neg
statement:
theorem reflect_doubled_neg (t : VCoord K) (ht : nV t ≠ 0) :
    reflectV (doubledCenter t) (-t) = t
proof:
:= by
  have hd : -t - t = doubledCenter t := by unfold doubledCenter; module
  have hn : nV (-t - t) ≠ 0 := by rw [hd]; exact doubledCenter_norm_ne t ht
  simpa only [hd] using reflect_difference (-t) t (nV_neg t) hn

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFixedDifferenceInverseWitness.reflect_doubled_self
statement:
theorem reflect_doubled_self (t : VCoord K) (ht : nV t ≠ 0) :
    reflectV (doubledCenter t) t = -t
proof:
:= by
  have h := SourceEvenAutomorphism.reflectV_involutive
    (doubledCenter t) (-t) (doubledCenter_norm_ne t ht)
  rw [reflect_doubled_neg t ht] at h
  exact h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFixedDifferenceInverseWitness.even_doubled_self
statement:
theorem even_doubled_self (e t : VCoord K) (ht : nV t ≠ 0)
    (het : BV e t = 0) : evenV e (doubledCenter t) t = -t
proof:
:= by
  rw [evenV, reflect_doubled_self t ht]
  apply reflectV_eq_of_orthogonal
  rw [BV_neg_right, het, neg_zero]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFixedDifferenceInverseWitness.even_doubled_orthogonal
statement:
theorem even_doubled_orthogonal (e t q : VCoord K)
    (heq : BV e q = 0) (htq : BV t q = 0) :
    evenV e (doubledCenter t) q = q
proof:
:= by
  rw [evenV, reflectV_eq_of_orthogonal (doubledCenter t) q]
  · exact reflectV_eq_of_orthogonal e q heq
  · rw [doubledCenter, BV_smul_left, htq, mul_zero]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFixedDifferenceInverseWitness.two_even_negates_span
statement:
theorem two_even_negates_span (e t q : VCoord K)
    (ht : nV t ≠ 0) (hq : nV q ≠ 0)
    (het : BV e t = 0) (heq : BV e q = 0) (htq : BV t q = 0)
    (b c : K) :
    evenV e (doubledCenter q)
      (evenV e (doubledCenter t) (b • t + c • q)) = -(b • t + c • q)
proof:
:= by
  have hqt : BV q t = 0 := by rw [BV_symmetric]; exact htq
  have h1t := even_doubled_self e t ht het
  have h1q := even_doubled_orthogonal e t q heq htq
  have h2t := even_doubled_orthogonal e q t het hqt
  have h2q := even_doubled_self e q hq heq
  simp only [SourceVectorPairDephase.evenV_add,
    SourceVectorPairDephase.evenV_smul, h1t, h1q]
  have hneg : evenV e (doubledCenter q) (-t) = -t := by
    simpa only [neg_one_smul, h2t] using
      SourceVectorPairDephase.evenV_smul e (doubledCenter q) t (-1)
  rw [hneg, h2q]
  module

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFixedDifferenceInverseWitness.first_stage_negative_second
statement:
theorem first_stage_negative_second (e t q : VCoord K)
    (ht : nV t ≠ 0) (het : BV e t = 0) (heq : BV e q = 0)
    (htq : BV t q = 0) (beta : K) :
    evenV e (doubledCenter t) (-(beta • t + q)) = beta • t - q
proof:
:= by
  have h1t := even_doubled_self e t ht het
  have h1q := even_doubled_orthogonal e t q heq htq
  have harg : -(beta • t + q) = (-beta) • t + (-1 : K) • q := by module
  rw [harg, SourceVectorPairDephase.evenV_add,
    SourceVectorPairDephase.evenV_smul, SourceVectorPairDephase.evenV_smul,
    h1t, h1q]
  module

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFixedDifferenceInverseWitness.second_algorithmic_difference
statement:
theorem second_algorithmic_difference (e t q : VCoord K)
    (ht : nV t ≠ 0) (het : BV e t = 0) (heq : BV e q = 0)
    (htq : BV t q = 0) (beta : K) :
    orthogonalRemainder t
      (evenV e (doubledCenter t) (-(beta • t + q))) - q = doubledCenter q
proof:
:= by
  rw [first_stage_negative_second e t q ht het heq htq beta]
  have hproj : projectionCoeff t (beta • t - q) = beta := by
    rw [projectionCoeff, sub_eq_add_neg, BV_add_right,
      BV_smul_right, BV_neg_right, htq, BV_self_eq_two_nV]
    field_simp [ht]
    ring
  rw [orthogonalRemainder, hproj, doubledCenter]
  module

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFixedDifferenceInverseWitness.inverse_pair_of_v_intertwining
statement:
private theorem inverse_pair_of_v_intertwining
    (g1 g2 : JCoord K ≃ₗ[K] JCoord K) (T : VCoord K ≃ₗ[K] VCoord K)
    (hTv : ∀ z, (g2 (g1 z)).v = T z.v)
    (x y : JCoord K) (u v : VCoord K)
    (hTu : T u = x.v) (hTv' : T v = y.v) :
    ∃ X Y : JCoord K,
      X.v = u ∧ Y.v = v ∧ g2 (g1 X) = x ∧ g2 (g1 Y) = y
proof:
:= by
  let G := g1.trans g2
  let X := G.symm x
  let Y := G.symm y
  have hX : g2 (g1 X) = x := G.apply_symm_apply x
  have hY : g2 (g1 Y) = y := G.apply_symm_apply y
  refine ⟨X, Y, ?_, ?_, hX, hY⟩
  · apply T.injective
    rw [← hTv X, hX, hTu]
  · apply T.injective
    rw [← hTv Y, hY, hTv']

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFixedDifferenceInverseWitness.full_source_inverse_witness
statement:
theorem full_source_inverse_witness
    (e t q : VCoord K) (rho1 rho2 beta : K)
    (he : nV e ≠ 0) (ht : nV t ≠ 0) (hq : nV q ≠ 0)
    (het : BV e t = 0) (heq : BV e q = 0) (htq : BV t q = 0)
    (hr1 : rho1 ^ 2 = nV e * nV (doubledCenter t)) (hr10 : rho1 ≠ 0)
    (hr2 : rho2 ^ 2 = nV e * nV (doubledCenter q)) (hr20 : rho2 ≠ 0)
    (x y : JCoord K) (hx : x.v = t) (hy : y.v = beta • t + q) :
    let g1
proof:
:= sourceEvenAut e (doubledCenter t) rho1 he
      (doubledCenter_norm_ne t ht) hr1 hr10
    let g2 := sourceEvenAut e (doubledCenter q) rho2 he
      (doubledCenter_norm_ne q hq) hr2 hr20
    ∃ X Y : JCoord K,
      X.v = -t ∧ Y.v = -(beta • t + q) ∧
      g2.linear (g1.linear X) = x ∧ g2.linear (g1.linear Y) = y := by
  intro g1 g2
  let T := (evenVEquiv e (doubledCenter t) he (doubledCenter_norm_ne t ht)).trans
    (evenVEquiv e (doubledCenter q) he (doubledCenter_norm_ne q hq))
  have hTv (z : JCoord K) : (g2.linear (g1.linear z)).v = T z.v := rfl
  have hTnegT : T (-t) = t := by
    change evenV e (doubledCenter q) (evenV e (doubledCenter t) (-t)) = t
    have h := two_even_negates_span e t q ht hq het heq htq (-1) 0
    simpa only [zero_smul, add_zero, neg_one_smul, neg_neg] using h
  have hTnegY : T (-(beta • t + q)) = beta • t + q := by
    change evenV e (doubledCenter q)
      (evenV e (doubledCenter t) (-(beta • t + q))) = beta • t + q
    have h := two_even_negates_span e t q ht hq het heq htq (-beta) (-1)
    simpa only [neg_smul, neg_one_smul, one_smul, ← neg_add, neg_neg] using h
  exact inverse_pair_of_v_intertwining g1.linear g2.linear T hTv x y
    (-t) (-(beta • t + q)) (hTnegT.trans hx.symm) (hTnegY.trans hy.symm)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FixedParityInvariantTransport.charZero_of_injective_map
statement:
private theorem charZero_of_injective_map
    {A L : Type u} [CommRing A] [CharZero A] [Field L]
    (f : A →+* L) (hf : Function.Injective f) : CharZero L where
  cast_injective m n h
proof:
:= Nat.cast_injective (R := A)
    (hf (by simpa only [map_natCast] using h))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FixedParityInvariantTransport.map_parityVectorRing
statement:
private theorem map_parityVectorRing
    {L : Type*} [Field L] [CharZero L]
    (f : FamilyRing k →+* L) :
    mapV f (parityVectorRing k) = (parityVector : VCoord L)
proof:
:= by
  apply VCoord.ext
  · simp [parityVectorRing, RationalEvenRingAction.mapV,
      SourceVectorPairDephase.parityVector]
  · simp [parityVectorRing, RationalEvenRingAction.mapV,
      SourceVectorPairDephase.parityVector]
  · funext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [parityVectorRing, RationalEvenRingAction.mapV,
      RationalEvenRingAction.mapW, SourceVectorPairDephase.parityVector,
      ExteriorSix.wBasis]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FixedParityInvariantTransport.r_dvd_denominator
statement:
private theorem r_dvd_denominator :

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FixedParityInvariantTransport.localized_r_isUnit
statement: theorem localized_r_isUnit : IsUnit (parameter k .r)
proof:
:= by
