name: AlbertLean.Generic.FixedParityInvariantTransport.denominator_ne_zero
statement: private theorem denominator_ne_zero : denominator k ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [denominator]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FixedParityInvariantTransport.localizedEval_parameter
statement:
private theorem localizedEval_parameter
    (t : EvenVar → k) (ht : MvPolynomial.eval t (denominator k) ≠ 0)
    (q : EvenVar) :
    localizedConstantEval k (F k) (FamilyRing k) (denominator k) t ht
        (parameter k q) = algebraMap k (F k) (t q)
proof:
:= by
  simp [parameter, localizedConstantEval_algebraMap,
    LocalizedGridIdentity.constantEval]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FixedParityInvariantTransport.localizedEval_rInverse
statement:
private theorem localizedEval_rInverse
    (t : EvenVar → k) (ht : MvPolynomial.eval t (denominator k) ≠ 0) :
    localizedConstantEval k (F k) (FamilyRing k) (denominator k) t ht
        (rInverse k) = algebraMap k (F k) (t .r)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  let ev := localizedConstantEval k (F k) (FamilyRing k)
    (denominator k) t ht
  have hr : t .r ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply ht
    simp [denominator, h]
  have her : algebraMap k (F k) (t .r) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [map_zero] using (algebraMap k (F k)).injective.ne hr
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ her
  have h := congrArg ev (r_mul_rInverse k)
  rw [map_mul, map_one, localizedEval_parameter k t ht] at h
  calc
    algebraMap k (F k) (t .r) * ev (rInverse k) = 1 := h
    _ = algebraMap k (F k) (t .r) * (algebraMap k (F k) (t .r))⁻¹ :=
      (mul_inv_cancel₀ her).symm
    _ = algebraMap k (F k) (t .r) * algebraMap k (F k) ((t .r)⁻¹) := by
      rw [map_inv₀]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FixedParityInvariantTransport.localizedEval_rhoInverse
statement:
private theorem localizedEval_rhoInverse
    (t : EvenVar → k) (ht : MvPolynomial.eval t (denominator k) ≠ 0) :
    localizedConstantEval k (F k) (FamilyRing k) (denominator k) t ht
        (rhoInverse k) = algebraMap k (F k) (t .rho)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  let ev := localizedConstantEval k (F k) (FamilyRing k)
    (denominator k) t ht
  have hp : t .rho ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply ht
    simp [denominator, h]
  have hep : algebraMap k (F k) (t .rho) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [map_zero] using (algebraMap k (F k)).injective.ne hp
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ hep
  have h := congrArg ev (rho_mul_rhoInverse k)
  rw [map_mul, map_one, localizedEval_parameter k t ht] at h
  calc
    algebraMap k (F k) (t .rho) * ev (rhoInverse k) = 1 := h
    _ = algebraMap k (F k) (t .rho) * (algebraMap k (F k) (t .rho))⁻¹ :=
      (mul_inv_cancel₀ hep).symm
    _ = algebraMap k (F k) (t .rho) * algebraMap k (F k) ((t .rho)⁻¹) := by
      rw [map_inv₀]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FixedParityInvariantTransport.localizedEval_familySubstitution
statement:
theorem localizedEval_familySubstitution
    (t : EvenVar → k) (ht : MvPolynomial.eval t (denominator k) ≠ 0) :
    (localizedConstantEval k (F k) (FamilyRing k) (denominator k) t ht).comp
        (familySubstitution k) =
      FixedParityFamilyFieldSubstitution.familySubstitution k
        (t .r) (fun i => t (.omega i)) (t .rho)
        (by intro h; apply ht; simp [denominator, h])
        (by intro h; apply ht; simp [denominator, h])
proof:
:= by
  apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
  · intro c
    have hraw : rawToFunction k (MvPolynomial.C c) = algebraMap k (F k) c := by
      change (rawToFunctionAlg k) (algebraMap k (CoordinateRing k) c) = _
      exact (rawToFunctionAlg k).commutes c
    simpa [familySubstitution,
      FixedParityFamilyFieldSubstitution.familySubstitution,
      coefficientEmbedding, localizedConstantEval_algebraMap,
      LocalizedGridIdentity.constantEval] using hraw.symm
  · intro q
    cases q with
    | entry a i c =>
      simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, familySubstitution,
        MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_X']
      have hm := congrFun (map_familyF0
        (localizedConstantEval k (F k) (FamilyRing k) (denominator k) t ht)
        (parityVectorRing k) 1 1
        (parameter k .r) (omegaParameter k) (parameter k .rho)
        (rInverse k) (rhoInverse k)
        (mapF0 (coefficientEmbedding k) (universalF0 k a i))) c
      let ev := localizedConstantEval k (F k) (FamilyRing k) (denominator k) t ht
      have hparity := map_parityVectorRing k ev
      have homega : mapW ev (omegaParameter k) =
          fun j => algebraMap k (F k) (t (.omega j)) := by
        funext j
        exact localizedEval_parameter k t ht (.omega j)
      have huniversal : mapF0 ev
          (mapF0 (coefficientEmbedding k) (universalF0 k a i)) =
          universalF0 k a i := by
        funext j
        simp [mapF0, coefficientEmbedding, ev,
          localizedConstantEval_algebraMap, LocalizedGridIdentity.constantEval]
      rw [hparity, homega, huniversal] at hm
      simpa [universalFamily,
        FixedParityFamilyFieldSubstitution.familySubstitution,
        FixedParityFamilyFieldSubstitution.F, Function.comp_def,
        mapF0, mapV, mapW, omegaParameter, parameter, coefficientEmbedding,
        localizedConstantEval_algebraMap, LocalizedGridIdentity.constantEval,
        localizedEval_rInverse k t ht, localizedEval_rhoInverse k t ht,
        map_inv₀] using hm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FixedParityInvariantTransport.localizedEval_coefficient
statement:
private theorem localizedEval_coefficient
    (t : EvenVar → k) (ht : MvPolynomial.eval t (denominator k) ≠ 0)
    (x : F k) :
    localizedConstantEval k (F k) (FamilyRing k) (denominator k) t ht
        (coefficientEmbedding k x) = x
proof:
:= by
  simp [coefficientEmbedding, localizedConstantEval_algebraMap,
    LocalizedGridIdentity.constantEval]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FixedParityInvariantTransport.cleared_family_identity
statement:
theorem cleared_family_identity
    (a b : CoordinateRing k) (hb : rawToFunction k b ≠ 0)
    (hinv : IsSourceInvariant k
      (rawToFunction k a / rawToFunction k b)) :
    familySubstitution k a * coefficientEmbedding k (rawToFunction k b) -
      coefficientEmbedding k (rawToFunction k a) * familySubstitution k b = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply eq_zero_of_localizedConstantEval_eq_zero k (F k) (FamilyRing k)
    (denominator k) (denominator_ne_zero k)
  intro t ht
  have hr : t .r ≠ 0 := by intro h; apply ht; simp [denominator, h]
  have hp : t .rho ≠ 0 := by intro h; apply ht; simp [denominator, h]
  let g := FixedParityFamilyFieldSubstitution.fixedParitySourceAut k
    (t .r) (fun i => t (.omega i)) (t .rho) hr hp
  have hs := localizedEval_familySubstitution k t ht
  have hsa := DFunLike.congr_fun hs a
  have hsb := DFunLike.congr_fun hs b
  have hactual := familySubstitution_eq_fractionAction k
    (t .r) (fun i => t (.omega i)) (t .rho) hr hp
  have haa := DFunLike.congr_fun hactual a
  have hab := DFunLike.congr_fun hactual b
  have hi := hinv g
  have hgb : fractionAction k g (rawToFunction k b) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [map_zero] using (fractionAction k g).injective.ne hb
  have hcross :
      fractionAction k g (rawToFunction k a) * rawToFunction k b =
        rawToFunction k a * fractionAction k g (rawToFunction k b) := by
    apply (div_eq_div_iff hgb hb).mp
    simpa only [map_div₀] using hi
  simp only [map_sub, map_mul]
  have hsa' : localizedConstantEval k (F k) (FamilyRing k) (denominator k) t ht
      (familySubstitution k a) =
      FixedParityFamilyFieldSubstitution.familySubstitution k
        (t .r) (fun i => t (.omega i)) (t .rho) hr hp a := by
    simpa only [RingHom.comp_apply] using hsa
  have hsb' : localizedConstantEval k (F k) (FamilyRing k) (denominator k) t ht
      (familySubstitution k b) =
      FixedParityFamilyFieldSubstitution.familySubstitution k
        (t .r) (fun i => t (.omega i)) (t .rho) hr hp b := by
    simpa only [RingHom.comp_apply] using hsb
  rw [hsa', hsb']
  rw [localizedEval_coefficient k t ht, localizedEval_coefficient k t ht]
  have haa' :
      FixedParityFamilyFieldSubstitution.familySubstitution k
        (t .r) (fun i => t (.omega i)) (t .rho) hr hp a =
      fractionAction k g (rawToFunction k a) := by
    simpa only [RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe,
      RingHom.comp_apply, g] using haa
  have hab' :
      FixedParityFamilyFieldSubstitution.familySubstitution k
        (t .r) (fun i => t (.omega i)) (t .rho) hr hp b =
      fractionAction k g (rawToFunction k b) := by
    simpa only [RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe,
      RingHom.comp_apply, g] using hab
  rw [haa', hab', hcross, sub_self]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FixedParityInvariantTransport.extension_denominator_unit
statement:
private theorem extension_denominator_unit (φ : F k →+* E)
    (r : E) (w : W E) (rho : E) (hr : r ≠ 0) (hp : rho ≠ 0) :
    IsUnit (MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom φ (extensionPoint r w rho)
      (mappedDenominator k))
proof:
:= by
  apply isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr
  simp [mappedDenominator, denominator, extensionPoint, hr, hp,
    LocalizedGridIdentity.mappedDenominator]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FixedParityInvariantTransport.extensionEval_parameter
statement:
private theorem extensionEval_parameter
    (φ : F k →+* E) (r : E) (w : W E) (rho : E)
    (hr : r ≠ 0) (hp : rho ≠ 0) (q : EvenVar) :
    extensionEval k (F k) (FamilyRing k) (denominator k) φ
      (extensionPoint r w rho) (extension_denominator_unit k φ r w rho hr hp)
      (parameter k q) = extensionPoint r w rho q
proof:
:= by
  simp [parameter, extensionEval, IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq,
    extensionPoint]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FixedParityInvariantTransport.extensionEval_coefficient
statement:
private theorem extensionEval_coefficient
    (φ : F k →+* E) (r : E) (w : W E) (rho : E)
    (hr : r ≠ 0) (hp : rho ≠ 0) (x : F k) :
    extensionEval k (F k) (FamilyRing k) (denominator k) φ
      (extensionPoint r w rho) (extension_denominator_unit k φ r w rho hr hp)
      (coefficientEmbedding k x) = φ x
proof:
:= by
  simp [coefficientEmbedding, extensionEval, IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FixedParityInvariantTransport.extensionEval_rInverse
statement:
private theorem extensionEval_rInverse
    (φ : F k →+* E) (r : E) (w : W E) (rho : E)
    (hr : r ≠ 0) (hp : rho ≠ 0) :
    extensionEval k (F k) (FamilyRing k) (denominator k) φ
      (extensionPoint r w rho) (extension_denominator_unit k φ r w rho hr hp)
      (rInverse k) = r⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  let ev := extensionEval k (F k) (FamilyRing k) (denominator k) φ
    (extensionPoint r w rho) (extension_denominator_unit k φ r w rho hr hp)
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ hr
  have h := congrArg ev (r_mul_rInverse k)
  rw [map_mul, map_one, extensionEval_parameter k φ r w rho hr hp] at h
  have h' : r * ev (rInverse k) = 1 := by
    simpa only [extensionPoint] using h
  calc
    r * ev (rInverse k) = 1 := h'
    _ = r * r⁻¹ := (mul_inv_cancel₀ hr).symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FixedParityInvariantTransport.extensionEval_rhoInverse
statement:
private theorem extensionEval_rhoInverse
    (φ : F k →+* E) (r : E) (w : W E) (rho : E)

proof:

    (extensionPoint r w rho) (extension_denominator_unit k φ r w rho hr hp)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FixedParityInvariantTransport.extensionEval_familySubstitution
statement:
private theorem extensionEval_familySubstitution
    (φ : F k →+* E) (r : E) (w : W E) (rho : E)
    (hr : r ≠ 0) (hp : rho ≠ 0) :
    (extensionEval k (F k) (FamilyRing k) (denominator k) φ
      (extensionPoint r w rho) (extension_denominator_unit k φ r w rho hr hp)).comp
        (familySubstitution k) =
      extensionFamilySubstitution k φ r w rho hr hp
proof:
:= by
  apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
  · intro c
    simp [familySubstitution, extensionFamilySubstitution, coefficientEmbedding,
      extensionEval, IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq]
  · intro q
    cases q with
    | entry a i c =>
      simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, familySubstitution,
        extensionFamilySubstitution, MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_X']
      have hm := congrFun (map_familyF0
        (extensionEval k (F k) (FamilyRing k) (denominator k) φ
          (extensionPoint r w rho) (extension_denominator_unit k φ r w rho hr hp))
        (parityVectorRing k) 1 1
        (parameter k .r) (omegaParameter k) (parameter k .rho)
        (rInverse k) (rhoInverse k)
        (mapF0 (coefficientEmbedding k) (universalF0 k a i))) c
      let ev := extensionEval k (F k) (FamilyRing k) (denominator k) φ
        (extensionPoint r w rho) (extension_denominator_unit k φ r w rho hr hp)
      have hev : ev = extensionEval k (F k) (FamilyRing k) (denominator k) φ
          (extensionPoint r w rho) (extension_denominator_unit k φ r w rho hr hp) := rfl
      have hparity := map_parityVectorRing k ev
      have homega : mapW ev (omegaParameter k) = w := by
        funext j
        change ev (parameter k (.omega j)) = w j
        rw [hev]
        simpa [extensionPoint] using
          (extensionEval_parameter k φ r w rho hr hp (.omega j))
      have huniversal : mapF0 ev
          (mapF0 (coefficientEmbedding k) (universalF0 k a i)) =
          mapF0 φ (universalF0 k a i) := by
        funext j
        change ev (coefficientEmbedding k (universalF0 k a i j)) =
          φ (universalF0 k a i j)
        rw [hev]
        exact extensionEval_coefficient k φ r w rho hr hp (universalF0 k a i j)
      have hri : ev (rInverse k) = r⁻¹ := by
        rw [hev]
        exact extensionEval_rInverse k φ r w rho hr hp
      have hrhoi : ev (rhoInverse k) = rho⁻¹ := by
        rw [hev]
        exact extensionEval_rhoInverse k φ r w rho hr hp
      rw [hparity, homega, huniversal, hri, hrhoi] at hm
      simpa [universalFamily,
        FixedParityFamilyFieldSubstitution.familySubstitution,
        mapF0, mapV, mapW, omegaParameter, parameter, coefficientEmbedding,
        extensionPoint, extensionEval, IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq, map_inv₀] using hm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FixedParityInvariantTransport.extension_cleared_family_identity
statement:
theorem extension_cleared_family_identity
    (a b : CoordinateRing k) (hb : rawToFunction k b ≠ 0)
    (hinv : IsSourceInvariant k
      (rawToFunction k a / rawToFunction k b))
    (φ : F k →+* E) (r : E) (w : W E) (rho : E)
    (hr : r ≠ 0) (hp : rho ≠ 0) :
    extensionFamilySubstitution k φ r w rho hr hp a * φ (rawToFunction k b) =
      φ (rawToFunction k a) * extensionFamilySubstitution k φ r w rho hr hp b
proof:
:= by
  let ev := extensionEval k (F k) (FamilyRing k) (denominator k) φ
    (extensionPoint r w rho) (extension_denominator_unit k φ r w rho hr hp)
  have hz := congrArg ev (cleared_family_identity k a b hb hinv)
  have hs := extensionEval_familySubstitution k φ r w rho hr hp
  have hsa := DFunLike.congr_fun hs a
  have hsb := DFunLike.congr_fun hs b
  rw [map_sub, map_mul, map_mul, map_zero, sub_eq_zero] at hz
  have hsa' : ev (familySubstitution k a) =
      extensionFamilySubstitution k φ r w rho hr hp a := by
    simpa only [RingHom.comp_apply] using hsa
  have hsb' : ev (familySubstitution k b) =
      extensionFamilySubstitution k φ r w rho hr hp b := by
    simpa only [RingHom.comp_apply] using hsb
  rw [hsa', hsb'] at hz
  rw [extensionEval_coefficient k φ r w rho hr hp,
    extensionEval_coefficient k φ r w rho hr hp] at hz
  exact hz

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealFiniteLedgerOrbit.mapped_pairTrace_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem mapped_pairTrace_ne_zero
    {E : Type u} [Field E] [CharZero E] (j : L →+* E)
    (A B : Mat3 L) (h : Matrix.trace (A * B) ≠ 0) :
    Matrix.trace (j.mapMatrix A * j.mapMatrix B) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have heq : j (Matrix.trace (A * B)) =
      Matrix.trace (j.mapMatrix A * j.mapMatrix B) := by
    rw [mapMatrix_trace, map_mul]
  intro hz
  apply h
  apply j.injective
  simpa only [map_zero, heq] using hz

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealFiniteLedgerOrbit.exists_extension_orthogonal_of_acceptedLedger_eq
statement:
theorem exists_extension_orthogonal_of_acceptedLedger_eq
    (P P' : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Mat3 L)
    (hP : IsRawPrimitiveFrameFamily P)
    (hP' : IsRawPrimitiveFrameFamily P')
    (hnz01 : ∀ i j, Matrix.trace (P 0 i * P 1 j) ≠ 0)
    (hnz12 : ∀ j l, Matrix.trace (P 1 j * P 2 l) ≠ 0)
    (hnz20 : ∀ l i, Matrix.trace (P 2 l * P 0 i) ≠ 0)
    (hledger : labelledLedger (primitiveMatrixTauTriple P) =
      labelledLedger (primitiveMatrixTauTriple P')) :
    ∃ (E : Type u) (_ : Field E) (j : L →+* E) (Q : Mat3 E),
      IsOrthogonal Q ∧ ∀ r i,
        orthogonalConjugate Q (j.mapMatrix (P r i)) = j.mapMatrix (P' r i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let F : (Fin 2 × Fin 3) → Fin 3 → Mat3 L :=
    fun r => if r.1 = 0 then P r.2 else P' r.2
  have hF : ∀ s : Fin 2, IsRawPrimitiveFrameFamily (fun r i => F (s, r) i) := by
    intro s
    fin_cases s
    · simpa [F] using hP
    · simpa [F] using hP'
  have hsF : ∀ r i, Matrix.transpose (F r i) = F r i := by
    intro r i
    ext a b
    exact (hF r.1).symmetric r.2 i b a
  have hiF : ∀ r i, F r i * F r i = F r i := by
    intro r i
    exact (hF r.1).idempotent r.2 i
  have htF : ∀ r i, Matrix.trace (F r i) = 1 := by
    intro r i
    exact (hF r.1).trace_one r.2 i
  have huF : ∀ r, F r 0 + F r 1 + F r 2 = 1 := by
    intro r
    simpa [Fin.sum_univ_succ, add_assoc] using (hF r.1).sum_one r.2
  obtain ⟨E, instE, j, a, b, c, _hden, hB, hproj⟩ :=
    exists_common_extension_cayley_parameters F hsF hiF htF huF
  letI : Field E := instE
  letI : CharZero E := AlbertLean.Generic.FiniteQuadraticRoots.charZero_of_embedding j
  letI : Invertible (2 : E) := invertibleOfNonzero (by norm_num)
  let B : (Fin 2 × Fin 3) → Mat3 E :=
    fun r => cayley (skew (a r) (b r) (c r))
  let X : Fin 3 → Mat3 E := fun r => B (0, r)
  let X' : Fin 3 → Mat3 E := fun r => B (1, r)
  let PE : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Mat3 E := fun r i => j.mapMatrix (P r i)
  let PE' : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Mat3 E := fun r i => j.mapMatrix (P' r i)
  have hX : ∀ r, IsOrthogonal (X r) := fun r => hB (0, r)
  have hX' : ∀ r, IsOrthogonal (X' r) := fun r => hB (1, r)
  have hprojector : ∀ r i, columnProjector (X r) i = PE r i := by
    intro r i
    simpa [X, B, PE, F] using hproj (0, r) i
  have hprojector' : ∀ r i, columnProjector (X' r) i = PE' r i := by
    intro r i
    simpa [X', B, PE', F] using hproj (1, r) i
  have hnz01E : ∀ i j, Matrix.trace (PE 0 i * PE 1 j) ≠ 0 := by
    intro i q
    exact mapped_pairTrace_ne_zero j _ _ (hnz01 i q)
  have hnz12E : ∀ i j, Matrix.trace (PE 1 i * PE 2 j) ≠ 0 := by
    intro i q
    exact mapped_pairTrace_ne_zero j _ _ (hnz12 i q)
  have hnz20E : ∀ i j, Matrix.trace (PE 2 i * PE 0 j) ≠ 0 := by
    intro i q
    exact mapped_pairTrace_ne_zero j _ _ (hnz20 i q)
  have hledgerE : labelledLedger (primitiveMatrixTauTriple PE) =
      labelledLedger (primitiveMatrixTauTriple PE') := by
    simpa only [PE, PE', primitiveLedger_map] using
      congrArg (mapLedgerValues j) hledger
  have htriple : realFrameTauTriple (X 0) (X 1) (X 2) =
      primitiveMatrixTauTriple PE := by
    funext r
    fin_cases r <;>
      exact realFrameEncoder_eq_primitiveMatrixEncoder _ _ (hprojector _)
  have htriple' : realFrameTauTriple (X' 0) (X' 1) (X' 2) =
      primitiveMatrixTauTriple PE' := by
    funext r
    fin_cases r <;>
      exact realFrameEncoder_eq_primitiveMatrixEncoder _ _ (hprojector' _)
  have hover01 : ∀ i q, overlap (X 0) (X 1) i q ≠ 0 := by
    intro i q hover
    apply hnz01E i q
    rw [← hprojector 0 i, ← hprojector 1 q, trace_columnProjector_mul, hover]
    norm_num
  have hover12 : ∀ q l, overlap (X 1) (X 2) q l ≠ 0 := by
    intro q l hover
    apply hnz12E q l
    rw [← hprojector 1 q, ← hprojector 2 l, trace_columnProjector_mul, hover]
    norm_num
  have hover20 : ∀ l i, overlap (X 2) (X 0) l i ≠ 0 := by
    intro l i hover
    apply hnz20E l i
    rw [← hprojector 2 l, ← hprojector 0 i, trace_columnProjector_mul, hover]
    norm_num
  have hledgerX : labelledLedger (realFrameTauTriple (X 0) (X 1) (X 2)) =
      labelledLedger (realFrameTauTriple (X' 0) (X' 1) (X' 2)) := by
    rw [htriple, htriple']
    exact hledgerE
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ, h0, h1, h2⟩ :=
    projectorTriple_related_of_acceptedLedger_eq_of_orthogonal
      (X 0) (X 1) (X 2) (X' 0) (X' 1) (X' 2)
      (hX 0) (hX 1) (hX 2) (hX' 0) (hX' 1) (hX' 2)
      hover01 hover12 hover20 hledgerX
  refine ⟨E, instE, j, Q, hQ, ?_⟩
  intro r i
  change orthogonalConjugate Q (PE r i) = PE' r i
  fin_cases r
  · change orthogonalConjugate Q (PE 0 i) = PE' 0 i
    rw [← hprojector 0 i, ← hprojector' 0 i]
    exact h0 i
  · change orthogonalConjugate Q (PE 1 i) = PE' 1 i
    rw [← hprojector 1 i, ← hprojector' 1 i]
    exact h1 i
  · change orthogonalConjugate Q (PE 2 i) = PE' 2 i
    rw [← hprojector 2 i, ← hprojector' 2 i]
    exact h2 i

      NonvanishingSeed.seedCarrier r i
proof:
:= by

    (ActualFrameJordanAut.standardCarrierProjector i)
  have hs := eval_scheduledPoint ℚ (RingHom.id ℚ) seedPairSchedule r i

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.FiniteQuadraticDiagnostic.weight_mul_weightInv
statement:
theorem weight_mul_weightInv (i : Fin 3) :
    wloc (weight i) * weightInv i = 1
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i
  · calc
      wloc (weight 0) * weightInv 0 =
          wloc (weight 0 * (weight 1 * weight 2)) * invWeightOpen := by
        simp only [weightInv, map_mul, mul_assoc]
      _ = wloc weightOpen * invWeightOpen := by
        simp only [weightOpen, mul_assoc]
      _ = 1 := IsLocalization.Away.mul_invSelf weightOpen

  · calc
      wloc (weight 1) * weightInv 1 =
          wloc (weight 1 * (weight 0 * weight 2)) * invWeightOpen := by
        simp only [weightInv, map_mul, mul_assoc]
      _ = wloc weightOpen * invWeightOpen := by
        rw [show weight 1 * (weight 0 * weight 2) = weightOpen by
          simp only [weightOpen]
          ring]
      _ = 1 := IsLocalization.Away.mul_invSelf weightOpen

  · calc
      wloc (weight 2) * weightInv 2 =
          wloc (weight 2 * (weight 0 * weight 1)) * invWeightOpen := by
        simp only [weightInv, map_mul, mul_assoc]
      _ = wloc weightOpen * invWeightOpen := by
        rw [show weight 2 * (weight 0 * weight 1) = weightOpen by
          simp only [weightOpen]
          ring]
      _ = 1 := IsLocalization.Away.mul_invSelf weightOpen

statement:
theorem seedEvalW_weightInv (i : Fin 3) :

:= by

  simp only [map_mul, map_one, seedEvalW_wloc, seedEval_weight] at h

    (NonvanishingSeed.seedCarrier r i : Matrix Ix Ix ℚ) a b

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.FiniteQuadraticDiagnostic.seedEvalW_firstBlockAction
statement:
theorem seedEvalW_firstBlockAction (z : Ix → W) :
    mapVec seedEvalW (wFirstBlockAction z) =
      matrixAction (NonvanishingSeed.secondFrame 1 : Matrix Ix Ix ℚ)
        (mapVec seedEvalW z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [wFirstBlockAction, mapVec_apply6]
  rw [show mapMat seedEvalW (wFrame 1 1) =
      (NonvanishingSeed.secondFrame 1 : Matrix Ix Ix ℚ) by
    simpa only [mapMat, NonvanishingSeed.seedCarrier] using
      seedEvalW_wFrame 1 1]
  rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.FiniteQuadraticDiagnostic.seedEvalW_pivot
statement:
theorem seedEvalW_pivot :
    seedEvalW.mapMatrix pivot = actualPivot
proof:
:= by
  ext r s
  have hmap := congrFun
    (map_coordinateConjugateFormula seedEvalW wEu wEv weightInv
      wFirstBlockAction
      (matrixAction (NonvanishingSeed.secondFrame 1 : Matrix Ix Ix ℚ))
      seedEvalW_firstBlockAction (basis6 (pairIndex 1 s)))
    (pairIndex 0 r)
  have hEu : (fun i => mapVec seedEvalW (wEu i)) =
      fun i => matrixAction (NonvanishingSeed.firstFrame i : Matrix Ix Ix ℚ)
        NonvanishingSeed.pairU := funext fun i => seedEvalW_wEu i
  have hEv : (fun i => mapVec seedEvalW (wEv i)) =
      fun i => matrixAction (NonvanishingSeed.firstFrame i : Matrix Ix Ix ℚ)
        NonvanishingSeed.pairV := funext fun i => seedEvalW_wEv i
  have hpInv : (fun i => seedEvalW (weightInv i)) =
      fun i => (NonvanishingSeed.p i)⁻¹ := funext fun i => seedEvalW_weightInv i
  rw [hEu, hEv, hpInv, mapVec_basis6,
    basis6_eq_basisVector] at hmap
  have hactual := WeightedInverseCoordinates.pivotBlock_entry_eq_formula
    NonvanishingSeed.firstFrame NonvanishingSeed.firstFrame_idempotent
    NonvanishingSeed.firstFrame_sum NonvanishingSeed.pairU
    NonvanishingSeed.pairV NonvanishingSeed.p
    NonvanishingSeed.p_eq_weighted seed_weight_ne
    (NonvanishingSeed.secondFrame 1) r s
  change actualPivot r s = coordinateConjugateFormula
      (fun i => matrixAction
        (NonvanishingSeed.firstFrame i : Matrix Ix Ix ℚ) NonvanishingSeed.pairU)
      (fun i => matrixAction
        (NonvanishingSeed.firstFrame i : Matrix Ix Ix ℚ) NonvanishingSeed.pairV)
      (fun i => (NonvanishingSeed.p i)⁻¹)
      (matrixAction (NonvanishingSeed.secondFrame 1 : Matrix Ix Ix ℚ))
      (SymplecticMatrixBridge.basisVector (pairIndex 1 s))
      (pairIndex 0 r) at hactual
  change seedEvalW (pivot r s) = actualPivot r s
  exact hmap.trans hactual.symm

    f.mapMatrix (cyclicBasis X v) =
      cyclicBasis (f.mapMatrix X) (fun i => f (v i))
proof:

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.FiniteQuadraticDiagnostic.seedEvalW_discr
statement: theorem seedEvalW_discr : seedEvalW discr = 1
proof:
:= by

    seedEvalW_pivot]
  change BlockEigenbasis.trace2 actualPivot ^ 2 -
      4 * BlockEigenbasis.determinant actualPivot = 1
  rw [actualPivot_eq_pivot]
  exact NonvanishingSeed.pivot_discriminant

      DeterministicSeedCertificate.w := by

    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [mapVec, cyclicVector]
  rw [hv]
  change NonscalarBlockNormalizer.cyclicDet actualPivot
      DeterministicSeedCertificate.w = 1
  exact seed_cyclicDet

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.FiniteQuadraticDiagnostic.discr_mul_discrInv
statement: theorem discr_mul_discrInv : lloc discr * discrInv = 1
proof:
:= by
  calc
    lloc discr * discrInv = lloc (discr * cyclic) * invSecondaryOpen := by
      simp only [discrInv, map_mul, mul_assoc]
    _ = lloc secondaryOpen * invSecondaryOpen := rfl
    _ = 1 := IsLocalization.Away.mul_invSelf secondaryOpen

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.FiniteQuadraticDiagnostic.cyclic_mul_cyclicInv
statement: theorem cyclic_mul_cyclicInv : lloc cyclic * cyclicInv = 1
proof:
:= by
  calc
    lloc cyclic * cyclicInv = lloc (cyclic * discr) * invSecondaryOpen := by
      simp only [cyclicInv, map_mul, mul_assoc]
    _ = lloc secondaryOpen * invSecondaryOpen := by
      rw [show cyclic * discr = secondaryOpen by
        simp only [secondaryOpen]
        ring]
    _ = 1 := IsLocalization.Away.mul_invSelf secondaryOpen

statement:
theorem actualL_apply_eq_formula (z : Ix → ℚ) :
    DeterministicSeedCertificate.actualL z =
      weightedForwardFormula
        (fun i => matrixAction
          (NonvanishingSeed.firstFrame i : Matrix Ix Ix ℚ) NonvanishingSeed.pairU)
        (fun i => matrixAction
          (NonvanishingSeed.firstFrame i : Matrix Ix Ix ℚ) NonvanishingSeed.pairV) z
proof:
:= by
  change WeightedProjectorGauge.weightedCoordinateLinear NonvanishingSeed.firstFrame
      NonvanishingSeed.pairU NonvanishingSeed.pairV z = _
  funext q
  change
    ((∑ i, z (Sum.inl i) • matrixAction
        (NonvanishingSeed.firstFrame i : Matrix Ix Ix ℚ) NonvanishingSeed.pairU) +
      ∑ i, z (Sum.inr i) • matrixAction
        (NonvanishingSeed.firstFrame i : Matrix Ix Ix ℚ) NonvanishingSeed.pairV) q = _
  simp only [weightedForwardFormula, Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.add_apply, smul_eq_mul]

    (weightedCoordinateEquiv_symm_eq_formula
      NonvanishingSeed.firstFrame NonvanishingSeed.firstFrame_idempotent
      NonvanishingSeed.firstFrame_sum NonvanishingSeed.pairU
      NonvanishingSeed.pairV NonvanishingSeed.p NonvanishingSeed.p_eq_weighted

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.FiniteQuadraticDiagnostic.sec_numerator_eval_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem sec_numerator_eval_ne_zero
    {A F : Type*} [CommRing A] [Field F] (B : A)
    (z : Localization.Away B) (e : A →+* F) (eB : e B ≠ 0)
    (ez : IsLocalization.Away.lift B (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr eB) z ≠ 0) :
    e (IsLocalization.Away.sec B z).1 ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  let ev : Localization.Away B →+* F :=
    IsLocalization.Away.lift B (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr eB)
  let t := IsLocalization.Away.sec B z
  have ht : z * algebraMap A (Localization.Away B) (B ^ t.2) =
      algebraMap A (Localization.Away B) t.1 :=
    IsLocalization.Away.sec_spec B z
  have hev := congrArg ev ht
  have hz : ev z ≠ 0 := by simpa [ev] using ez
  change e t.1 ≠ 0
  rw [map_mul, IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq, IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq,
    map_pow] at hev
  rw [← hev]
  exact mul_ne_zero hz (pow_ne_zero _ eB)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.weightedCoordinate_form
statement:
theorem weightedCoordinate_form
    (E : Fin 3 → Carrier K)
    (hEidem : ∀ i, (E i : Mat6 K) * E i = E i)
    (hEsum : (E 0 : Mat6 K) + E 1 + E 2 = 1)
    (u v : Vec6 K) (p : Fin 3 → K)
    (hp : ∀ i, p i = (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u)
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v)) (x y : Vec6 K) :
    (omega (K := K)) (weightedCoordinateLinear E u v x)
      (weightedCoordinateLinear E u v y) = weightedOmega p x y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨huv, huu, hvv⟩ := weighted_pairings E hEidem hEsum u v p hp
  have hrev (i j : Fin 3) :
      (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v)
        (matrixAction (E j : Mat6 K) u) =
        if i = j then -(p i) else 0 := by
    rw [skew_of_alternating (omega (K := K)) omega_alternating]
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst j
      simp [huv]
    · simp [huv, hij, Ne.symm hij]
  simp [weightedCoordinateLinear, weightedOmega, LinearMap.add_apply,
    LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, huv, huu, hvv, hrev]
  rw [← sub_eq_add_neg, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.commonPlaneMap_form
statement:
theorem commonPlaneMap_form (p : Fin 3 → K)
    (T : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) K) (x y : Vec6 K) :
    weightedOmega p (commonPlaneMap T x) (commonPlaneMap T y) =
      det2 T * weightedOmega p x y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [weightedOmega, commonPlaneMap, det2]
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  change p i *
      ((T 0 0 * x (Sum.inl i) + T 0 1 * x (Sum.inr i)) *
          (T 1 0 * y (Sum.inl i) + T 1 1 * y (Sum.inr i)) -
        (T 1 0 * x (Sum.inl i) + T 1 1 * x (Sum.inr i)) *
          (T 0 0 * y (Sum.inl i) + T 0 1 * y (Sum.inr i))) = _
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.commonPlaneMap_comp
statement:
theorem commonPlaneMap_comp (T S : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) K)
    (hTS : T * S = 1) :
    (commonPlaneMap T).comp (commonPlaneMap S) = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  funext q
  rcases q with i | i
  ·
    have h00 := congrFun (congrFun hTS 0) 0
    have h01 := congrFun (congrFun hTS 0) 1
    have h10 := congrFun (congrFun hTS 1) 0
    have h11 := congrFun (congrFun hTS 1) 1
    simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ, Matrix.one_apply,
      commonPlaneMap, LinearMap.comp_apply] at h00 h01 h10 h11 ⊢
    linear_combination x (Sum.inl i) * h00 + x (Sum.inr i) * h01
  ·
    have h00 := congrFun (congrFun hTS 0) 0
    have h01 := congrFun (congrFun hTS 0) 1
    have h10 := congrFun (congrFun hTS 1) 0
    have h11 := congrFun (congrFun hTS 1) 1
    simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ, Matrix.one_apply,
      commonPlaneMap, LinearMap.comp_apply] at h00 h01 h10 h11 ⊢
    linear_combination x (Sum.inl i) * h10 + x (Sum.inr i) * h11

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertScheduleGenericChartAlignment.mapSource_standard
statement:
private theorem mapSource_standard (f : A →+* B) :

proof:

      diagonalUnit 2 - diagonalUnit 0 by
    apply JCoord.ext <;> simp [diagonalUnit, diagonal]]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertScheduleGenericChartAlignment.map_spectralProjector
statement:
private theorem map_spectralProjector (f : A →+* B)
    (x : JCoord A) (i : Fin 3) :

      spectralProjector (mapSource f x) i
proof:

      mapSource_add, mapSource_one, mapSource_product, map_inv₀, map_ofNat]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertScheduleGenericChartAlignment.map_sourceTraceForm
proof:
:= by
  calc
    f (sourceTraceForm x y) =
        f (sourceTrace (sourceProduct x y)) :=
      congrArg f (sourceTrace_product_eq_traceForm x y).symm
    _ = sourceTrace (mapSource f (sourceProduct x y)) :=
      (mapSource_trace f (sourceProduct x y)).symm
    _ = sourceTrace
        (sourceProduct (mapSource f x) (mapSource f y)) := by
      rw [mapSource_product]
    _ = sourceTraceForm (mapSource f x) (mapSource f y) :=
      sourceTrace_product_eq_traceForm _ _

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertScheduleGenericChartAlignment.map_sourceLedger
proof:
:= by

  · funext i j

    rw [map_sourceTraceForm, mapSource_diagonalUnit,
      map_spectralProjector]
  · funext j l
    simp only [mapLedger, sourceLedger]
    rw [map_sourceTraceForm, map_spectralProjector,
      map_spectralProjector]
  · funext l i
    simp only [mapLedger, sourceLedger]
    rw [map_sourceTraceForm, map_spectralProjector,
      mapSource_diagonalUnit]
  · funext i j l
    simp only [mapLedger, sourceLedger, map_sub, map_add, map_div₀,

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertScheduleGenericChartAlignment.sourceAut_standard
statement:

    (hdiag : ∀ i, g.linear (diagonalUnit i) = diagonalUnit i) :

proof:

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertScheduleGenericChartAlignment.actualLedger_eq_mapped
statement:
private theorem actualLedger_eq_mapped
    (hdiag : ∀ i, g.linear (diagonalUnit i) = diagonalUnit i)
    (hA : encoderA q = g.linear (mapSource f (comparisonA k)))
    (hB : encoderB q = g.linear (mapSource f (comparisonB k))) :
    actualLedger q = mapLedger f (comparisonLedger k)
proof:
:= by
  have htriple :
      residualTriple (encoderA q) (encoderB q) =
        g.linear ∘ residualTriple
          (mapSource f (comparisonA k)) (mapSource f (comparisonB k)) := by
    funext r
    fin_cases r
    · exact (sourceAut_standard g hdiag).symm
    · exact hA
    · exact hB
  have hlabel := sourceLabelledLedger_invariant g
    (residualTriple (mapSource f (comparisonA k))
      (mapSource f (comparisonB k)))
  rw [← htriple, sourceLabelledLedger_residual,
    sourceLabelledLedger_residual] at hlabel
  change sourceLedger (encoderA q) (encoderB q) = _
  calc
    sourceLedger (encoderA q) (encoderB q) =
        sourceLedger (mapSource f (comparisonA k))
          (mapSource f (comparisonB k)) :=
      copySourceLedger_injective hlabel
    _ = mapLedger f (comparisonLedger k) := by
      exact (map_sourceLedger f (comparisonA k) (comparisonB k)).symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertScheduleGenericChartAlignment.evalR0_comparison_square
statement:
theorem evalR0_comparison_square
    (hdiag : ∀ i, g.linear (diagonalUnit i) = diagonalUnit i)
    (hA : encoderA q = g.linear (mapSource f (comparisonA k)))
    (hB : encoderB q = g.linear (mapSource f (comparisonB k))) :
    evalR0 k (actualCoefficientMap k f) q =
      f.comp (comparisonEval k)
proof:
:= by
  have hledger := actualLedger_eq_mapped k f g q hdiag hA hB
  apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
  · intro c
    simp [evalR0, actualCoefficientMap, comparisonEval]
  · intro x
    simp only [evalR0_X, RingHom.comp_apply, comparisonEval_X]
    rcases x with ⟨i,j⟩ | x
    · change (actualLedger q).P i j = f ((comparisonLedger k).P i j)
      exact congrFun (congrFun (congrArg SourceLedger.P hledger) i) j
    · rcases x with ⟨j,l⟩ | x
      · change (actualLedger q).Q j l = f ((comparisonLedger k).Q j l)
        exact congrFun (congrFun (congrArg SourceLedger.Q hledger) j) l
      · rcases x with ⟨l,i⟩ | ⟨i,j,l⟩
        · change (actualLedger q).R l i = f ((comparisonLedger k).R l i)
          exact congrFun (congrFun (congrArg SourceLedger.R hledger) l) i
        · change (actualLedger q).C0 i j l =
            f ((comparisonLedger k).C0 i j l)
          exact congrFun (congrFun (congrFun
            (congrArg SourceLedger.C0 hledger) i) j) l

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertScheduleGenericChartAlignment.actualRingMap_detector
statement:
theorem actualRingMap_detector
    (hdiag : ∀ i, g.linear (diagonalUnit i) = diagonalUnit i)
    (hA : encoderA q = g.linear (mapSource f (comparisonA k)))
    (hB : encoderB q = g.linear (mapSource f (comparisonB k))) :
    actualRingMap k f q (rawDetector k) =
      actualFractionMap k f (detectorValue k)
proof:
:= by
  have hinv := sourceDetector_invariant g
    (diagonal (-1) 0 1) (mapSource f (comparisonA k))
      (mapSource f (comparisonB k))
  calc
    actualRingMap k f q (rawDetector k) =
        sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1) (encoderA q) (encoderB q) :=
      chartEvaluation_detector k (actualCoefficientMap k f) q
    _ = sourceDetector (g.linear (diagonal (-1) 0 1))
          (g.linear (mapSource f (comparisonA k)))
          (g.linear (mapSource f (comparisonB k))) := by
      rw [sourceAut_standard g hdiag, hA, hB]
    _ = sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1)
          (mapSource f (comparisonA k))
          (mapSource f (comparisonB k)) := hinv
    _ = f (sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1)
          (comparisonA k) (comparisonB k)) := by
      rw [← mapSource_standard f]
      exact (map_sourceDetector f (diagonal (-1) 0 1)
        (comparisonA k) (comparisonB k)).symm
    _ = f (fractionEmbedding k (detectorValue k)) := by
      rw [comparison_detector]
    _ = actualFractionMap k f (detectorValue k) := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertScheduleGenericChartAlignment.actualDetector_alignment
statement:
theorem actualDetector_alignment
    (hdiag : ∀ i, g.linear (diagonalUnit i) = diagonalUnit i)
    (hA : encoderA q = g.linear (mapSource f (comparisonA k)))
    (hB : encoderB q = g.linear (mapSource f (comparisonB k))) :
    actualFractionMap k f (detectorValue k) =
      sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1) (encoderA q) (encoderB q)
proof:
:= by
  exact (actualRingMap_detector k f g q hdiag hA hB).symm.trans
    (chartEvaluation_detector k (actualCoefficientMap k f) q)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertScheduleGenericChartAlignment.actualReducedMap_ledgerCell
statement:
theorem actualReducedMap_ledgerCell
    (hdiag : ∀ i, g.linear (diagonalUnit i) = diagonalUnit i)
    (hA : encoderA q = g.linear (mapSource f (comparisonA k)))
    (hB : encoderB q = g.linear (mapSource f (comparisonB k)))
    (hq : EquationsVanish (explicitFrameEquationValues q))
    (t : Fin 4) (i j l : Fin 3) :
    actualReducedMap k f q hq (reducedLedgerCell k t i j l) =
      actualFractionMap k f
        (AlbertRawInvariantFieldLower.ledgerValue k (t, i, j, l))
proof:
:= by
  rw [actualReducedMap, reducedEvaluation_ledgerCell]
  have hledger := actualLedger_eq_mapped k f g q hdiag hA hB
  fin_cases t
  · change (actualLedger q).P i j =
      f (fractionEmbedding k
        (AlbertRawInvariantFieldLower.ledgerValue k (0, i, j, 0)))
    calc
      (actualLedger q).P i j = f ((comparisonLedger k).P i j) :=
        congrFun (congrFun (congrArg SourceLedger.P hledger) i) j
      _ = f (fractionEmbedding k
          (AlbertRawInvariantFieldLower.ledgerValue k (0, i, j, 0))) := by
        rw [comparison_ledger_P]
  · change (actualLedger q).Q i j =
      f (fractionEmbedding k
        (AlbertRawInvariantFieldLower.ledgerValue k (1, i, j, 0)))
    calc
      (actualLedger q).Q i j = f ((comparisonLedger k).Q i j) :=
        congrFun (congrFun (congrArg SourceLedger.Q hledger) i) j
      _ = f (fractionEmbedding k
          (AlbertRawInvariantFieldLower.ledgerValue k (1, i, j, 0))) := by
        rw [comparison_ledger_Q]
  · change (actualLedger q).R i j =
      f (fractionEmbedding k
        (AlbertRawInvariantFieldLower.ledgerValue k (2, i, j, 0)))
    calc
      (actualLedger q).R i j = f ((comparisonLedger k).R i j) :=
        congrFun (congrFun (congrArg SourceLedger.R hledger) i) j
      _ = f (fractionEmbedding k
          (AlbertRawInvariantFieldLower.ledgerValue k (2, i, j, 0))) := by
        rw [comparison_ledger_R]
  · change (actualLedger q).C0 i j l =
      f (fractionEmbedding k
        (AlbertRawInvariantFieldLower.ledgerValue k (3, i, j, l)))
    calc
      (actualLedger q).C0 i j l = f ((comparisonLedger k).C0 i j l) :=
        congrFun (congrFun (congrFun
          (congrArg SourceLedger.C0 hledger) i) j) l
      _ = f (fractionEmbedding k
          (AlbertRawInvariantFieldLower.ledgerValue k (3, i, j, l))) := by
        rw [comparison_ledger_C0]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertScheduleGenericChartAlignment.actualReducedMap_detector
statement:
theorem actualReducedMap_detector
    (hdiag : ∀ i, g.linear (diagonalUnit i) = diagonalUnit i)
    (hA : encoderA q = g.linear (mapSource f (comparisonA k)))
    (hB : encoderB q = g.linear (mapSource f (comparisonB k)))
    (hq : EquationsVanish (explicitFrameEquationValues q)) :
    actualReducedMap k f q hq (reducedDetector k) =
      actualFractionMap k f (detectorValue k)
proof:
:= by
  change actualRingMap k f q (rawDetector k) = _
  exact actualRingMap_detector k f g q hdiag hA hB

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertScheduleGenericChartAlignment.evalR0_separationOpen_ne_zero
statement:
theorem evalR0_separationOpen_ne_zero
    (hf : Injective f)
    (hsquare : evalR0 k (actualCoefficientMap k f) q =
      f.comp (comparisonEval k)) :
    evalR0 k (actualCoefficientMap k f) q (separationOpen k) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hraw : rawToFunction k (rawSeparationOpen k) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa [rawToFunction, fractionSeparationOpen, reducedSeparationOpen] using
      (fractionSeparationOpen_ne_zero k)
  have hE : fractionEmbedding k (rawToFunction k (rawSeparationOpen k)) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [map_zero] using (fractionEmbedding_injective k).ne hraw
  have hsubst := DFunLike.congr_fun
    (fractionEmbedding_comp_rawLedgerSubstitution k) (separationOpen k)
  have hcomparison : comparisonEval k (separationOpen k) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← hsubst]
    exact hE
  have hmapped : f (comparisonEval k (separationOpen k)) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [map_zero] using hf.ne hcomparison
  rw [DFunLike.congr_fun hsquare (separationOpen k), RingHom.comp_apply]
  exact hmapped

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertScheduleGenericChartAlignment.exists_actual_generic_chart_alignment_twoEven
statement:
theorem exists_actual_generic_chart_alignment_twoEven :
    ∃ (L : Type u) (_ : Field L) (_ : CharZero L)
      (f : E k →+* L) (sigma : L) (w : TwoEvenWord L)
      (q : ExplicitFrameChart L)
      (hq : EquationsVanish (explicitFrameEquationValues q)),
      Injective f ∧
      (∀ i, w.aut.linear (diagonalUnit i) = diagonalUnit i) ∧
      (∀ z : JCoord L,
        ((w.aut.linear z).d1, (w.aut.linear z).d2, (w.aut.linear z).d3) =
          (z.d1, z.d2, z.d3)) ∧
      encoderA q = w.aut.linear (mapSource f (comparisonA k)) ∧
      encoderB q = w.aut.linear (mapSource f (comparisonB k)) ∧
      IsKappaLift q ∧
      q.r1 = 1 ∧
      q.z1 = f (nV (comparisonA k).v) ∧
      q.r2 = (f (BV (comparisonA k).v (comparisonB k).v) - sigma) /
        (2 * f (nV (comparisonA k).v)) ∧
      q.z2 = (f (BV (comparisonA k).v (comparisonB k).v) + sigma) / 2 ∧
      evalR0 k (actualCoefficientMap k f) q = f.comp (comparisonEval k) ∧
      actualRingMap k f q (rawDetector k) =
        actualFractionMap k f (detectorValue k) ∧
      (∀ (t : Fin 4) (i j l : Fin 3),
        actualReducedMap k f q hq
            (reducedLedgerCell k t i j l) =
          actualFractionMap k f
            (AlbertRawInvariantFieldLower.ledgerValue k (t, i, j, l))) ∧
      actualFractionMap k f (detectorValue k) =
        sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1) (encoderA q) (encoderB q) ∧
      sigma ^ 2 = evalR0 k (actualCoefficientMap k f) q (discr k) ∧
      sigma ≠ 0 ∧
      2 * evalR0 k (actualCoefficientMap k f) q (a k) ≠ 0 ∧
      evalR0 k (actualCoefficientMap k f) q (separationOpen k) ≠ 0 ∧
      UniformMomentActualDetector.actualBeta q
        (f (nV (comparisonA k).v))
        ((f (BV (comparisonA k).v (comparisonB k).v) - sigma) /
          (2 * f (nV (comparisonA k).v)))
        ((f (BV (comparisonA k).v (comparisonB k).v) + sigma) / 2)
        sigma ≠ 0 ∧
      delta (residualPairOfChart q) ≠ deltaStar (residualPairOfChart q) ∧
      ResidualOpen (residualPairOfChart q)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨L, iL, cL, f, sigma, w, q, hf, hsigmaRaw, hsigma0,
      hdiag, hdiagFields, hA, hB, hkappa, hq, hr, hz1, hr2, hz2⟩ :=
    exists_actual_finite_dephase_readback_twoEven k
  letI : Field L := iL
  letI : CharZero L := cL
  let coeff := actualCoefficientMap k f
  have hsquare : evalR0 k coeff q = f.comp (comparisonEval k) :=
    evalR0_comparison_square k f w.aut q hdiag hA hB
  have hdetector : actualRingMap k f q (rawDetector k) =
      actualFractionMap k f (detectorValue k) :=
    actualRingMap_detector k f w.aut q hdiag hA hB
  have hledgerCells : ∀ (t : Fin 4) (i j l : Fin 3),
      actualReducedMap k f q hq (reducedLedgerCell k t i j l) =
        actualFractionMap k f
          (AlbertRawInvariantFieldLower.ledgerValue k (t, i, j, l)) :=
    actualReducedMap_ledgerCell k f w.aut q hdiag hA hB hq
  have hdetectorSource : actualFractionMap k f (detectorValue k) =
      sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1) (encoderA q) (encoderB q) :=
    actualDetector_alignment k f w.aut q hdiag hA hB
  have hsigmaEval : sigma ^ 2 = evalR0 k coeff q (discr k) := by
    calc
      sigma ^ 2 = f ((BV (comparisonA k).v (comparisonB k).v) ^ 2 -
          4 * nV (comparisonA k).v * nV (comparisonB k).v) := hsigmaRaw
      _ = f (comparisonEval k (discr k)) := by
        rw [comparisonEval_discr]
      _ = evalR0 k coeff q (discr k) := by
        simpa only [RingHom.comp_apply] using
          (DFunLike.congr_fun hsquare (discr k)).symm
  have ha0 : f (nV (comparisonA k).v) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [map_zero] using hf.ne (comparison_dephase_open k).1
  have htwoa : 2 * f (nV (comparisonA k).v) ≠ 0 :=
    mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) ha0
  have haEval : evalR0 k coeff q (a k) =
      f (nV (comparisonA k).v) := by
    calc
      evalR0 k coeff q (a k) = f (comparisonEval k (a k)) := by
        exact DFunLike.congr_fun hsquare (a k)
      _ = f (nV (comparisonA k).v) := by rw [comparisonEval_a]
  have htwoaEval : 2 * evalR0 k coeff q (a k) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [haEval]
    exact htwoa
  have hsep : evalR0 k coeff q (separationOpen k) ≠ 0 :=
    evalR0_separationOpen_ne_zero k f q hf hsquare
  let aval := f (nV (comparisonA k).v)
  let hval := f (BV (comparisonA k).v (comparisonB k).v)
  let bval := (hval - sigma) / (2 * aval)
  let cval := (hval + sigma) / 2
  have hgram : gramV12 q = hval := by
    rw [gramV12, hr, hz1, hr2, hz2]
    dsimp only [aval, hval, bval, cval]
    field_simp [htwoa]
    ring
  have hbval : bval = (gramV12 q - sigma) / (2 * aval) := by
    rw [hgram]
  have hcval : cval = (gramV12 q + sigma) / 2 := by
    rw [hgram]
  have hbetaRoots :
      UniformMomentActualDetector.actualBeta q aval bval cval sigma ≠ 0 ∧
        delta (residualPairOfChart q) ≠ deltaStar (residualPairOfChart q) :=
    actualBeta_ne_zero_and_roots_ne k coeff q hsep aval bval cval sigma
      hq hr hz1 hr2 hz2 hbval hcval hsigmaEval hsigma0 htwoa
  have hbeta : evalR0 k coeff q (UniformMomentBetaOpen.betaOpen k) ≠ 0 := by
    have hm := hsep
    rw [separationOpen, map_mul] at hm
    exact (mul_ne_zero_iff.mp hm).1
  let hB0 := eval_betaOpen_ne_zero k coeff q hbeta
  let ep := evalQ k coeff q hB0 sigma hsigmaEval
  have hmoment : (moment k).map ep = matrixM q :=
    evalQ_moment k coeff q hB0 aval bval cval sigma hq hr hz1 hr2 hz2
      hbval hcval hsigmaEval hsigma0 htwoa
  have hunit := congrArg ep (momentDet_mul_inv k)
  have hdetQ : ep (Matrix.det (moment k)) ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    rw [map_mul, hz, zero_mul, map_one] at hunit
    exact zero_ne_one hunit
  have hdetMapped : Matrix.det ((moment k).map ep) ≠ 0 := by
    change Matrix.det (ep.mapMatrix (moment k)) ≠ 0
    simpa only [RingHom.map_det] using hdetQ
  have hdetChart : Matrix.det (matrixM q) ≠ 0 := by
    rwa [hmoment] at hdetMapped
  have hdetRoots : Matrix.det (matrixM q) =
      delta (residualPairOfChart q) * deltaStar (residualPairOfChart q) := by
    rw [matrixM, det_momentMatrix_eq_deltaX_mul_deltaStarA]
    simp only [deltaX_eq_det_XMatrix, deltaStarA_eq_det_AMatrix]
    rfl
  have hopen : ResidualOpen (residualPairOfChart q) := by
    have hp : delta (residualPairOfChart q) *
        deltaStar (residualPairOfChart q) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [← hdetRoots]
      exact hdetChart
    exact mul_ne_zero_iff.mp hp
  refine ⟨L, iL, cL, f, sigma, w, q, hq, hf, hdiag, hdiagFields,
    hA, hB, hkappa, hr, hz1, hr2, hz2, hsquare, hdetector,
    hledgerCells, hdetectorSource, hsigmaEval, hsigma0, htwoaEval, hsep,
    hbetaRoots.1, hbetaRoots.2, hopen⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertScheduleGenericChartAlignment.exists_actual_generic_chart_alignment
statement:
theorem exists_actual_generic_chart_alignment :
    ∃ (L : Type u) (_ : Field L) (_ : CharZero L)
      (f : E k →+* L) (sigma : L) (g : SourceAut (K := L))
      (q : ExplicitFrameChart L)
      (hq : EquationsVanish (explicitFrameEquationValues q)),
      Injective f ∧
      (∀ i, g.linear (diagonalUnit i) = diagonalUnit i) ∧
      (∀ z : JCoord L,
        ((g.linear z).d1, (g.linear z).d2, (g.linear z).d3) =
          (z.d1, z.d2, z.d3)) ∧
      encoderA q = g.linear (mapSource f (comparisonA k)) ∧
      encoderB q = g.linear (mapSource f (comparisonB k)) ∧
      IsKappaLift q ∧
      q.r1 = 1 ∧
      q.z1 = f (nV (comparisonA k).v) ∧
      q.r2 = (f (BV (comparisonA k).v (comparisonB k).v) - sigma) /
        (2 * f (nV (comparisonA k).v)) ∧
      q.z2 = (f (BV (comparisonA k).v (comparisonB k).v) + sigma) / 2 ∧
      evalR0 k (actualCoefficientMap k f) q = f.comp (comparisonEval k) ∧
      actualRingMap k f q (rawDetector k) =
        actualFractionMap k f (detectorValue k) ∧
      (∀ (t : Fin 4) (i j l : Fin 3),
        actualReducedMap k f q hq
            (reducedLedgerCell k t i j l) =
          actualFractionMap k f
            (AlbertRawInvariantFieldLower.ledgerValue k (t, i, j, l))) ∧
      actualFractionMap k f (detectorValue k) =
        sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1) (encoderA q) (encoderB q) ∧
      sigma ^ 2 = evalR0 k (actualCoefficientMap k f) q (discr k) ∧
      sigma ≠ 0 ∧
      2 * evalR0 k (actualCoefficientMap k f) q (a k) ≠ 0 ∧
      evalR0 k (actualCoefficientMap k f) q (separationOpen k) ≠ 0 ∧
      UniformMomentActualDetector.actualBeta q
        (f (nV (comparisonA k).v))
        ((f (BV (comparisonA k).v (comparisonB k).v) - sigma) /
          (2 * f (nV (comparisonA k).v)))
        ((f (BV (comparisonA k).v (comparisonB k).v) + sigma) / 2)
        sigma ≠ 0 ∧
      delta (residualPairOfChart q) ≠ deltaStar (residualPairOfChart q) ∧
      ResidualOpen (residualPairOfChart q)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨L, iL, cL, f, sigma, w, q, hq, hrest⟩ :=
    exists_actual_generic_chart_alignment_twoEven k
  exact ⟨L, iL, cL, f, sigma, w.aut, q, hq, hrest⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFixedSpectrumTransport.sourceSpur_invariant
statement:
theorem sourceSpur_invariant (g : SourceAut (K := K)) (x : JCoord K) :
    sourceSpur (g.linear x) = sourceSpur x
proof:
:= by
  have hg := trace_square (g.linear x)
  have hx := trace_square x
  rw [← g.map_product, sourceTrace_invariant g, sourceTrace_invariant g] at hg
  have htwo : (2 : K) ≠ 0 := by norm_num
  apply (mul_left_cancel₀ htwo)
  linear_combination hg - hx

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFixedSpectrumTransport.sourceNorm_invariant
statement:
theorem sourceNorm_invariant (g : SourceAut (K := K)) (x : JCoord K) :
    sourceNorm (g.linear x) = sourceNorm x
proof:
:= by
  have hg := trace_cube (g.linear x)
  have hx := trace_cube x
  rw [← g.map_product x x,
    ← g.map_product x (sourceProduct x x),
    sourceTrace_invariant g, sourceTrace_invariant g,
    sourceSpur_invariant g] at hg
  have hthree : (3 : K) ≠ 0 := by norm_num
  apply (mul_left_cancel₀ hthree)
  linear_combination hx - hg

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFixedSpectrumTransport.sourceSpur_mapSource
statement:
theorem sourceSpur_mapSource (f : K →+* L) (x : JCoord K) :
    sourceSpur (mapSource f x) = f (sourceSpur x)
proof:
:= by
  have hm := trace_square (mapSource f x)
  have hx := congrArg f (trace_square x)
  rw [← mapSource_product, mapSource_trace, mapSource_trace] at hm
  simp only [map_sub, map_mul, map_pow, map_ofNat] at hx
  have htwo : (2 : L) ≠ 0 := by norm_num
  apply (mul_left_cancel₀ htwo)
  linear_combination hm - hx

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFixedSpectrumTransport.sourceNorm_mapSource
statement:
theorem sourceNorm_mapSource (f : K →+* L) (x : JCoord K) :
    sourceNorm (mapSource f x) = f (sourceNorm x)
proof:
:= by
  have hm := trace_cube (mapSource f x)
  have hx := congrArg f (trace_cube x)
  rw [← mapSource_product f x x,
    ← mapSource_product f x (sourceProduct x x),
    mapSource_trace, mapSource_trace, sourceSpur_mapSource] at hm
  simp only [map_add, map_sub, map_mul, map_pow, map_ofNat] at hx
  have hthree : (3 : L) ≠ 0 := by norm_num
  apply (mul_left_cancel₀ hthree)
  linear_combination hx - hm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericLedgerFixedField.gauge_mem_a
statement: theorem gauge_mem_a : (genericChart k).z1 ∈ gaugeBase k
proof:
:= by
  apply Subfield.subset_closure
  change includeBase k (ι k (GenericDeterminantOpen.a k)) ∈ gaugeGenerators k
  exact Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericLedgerFixedField.gauge_mem_b
statement: theorem gauge_mem_b : (genericChart k).r2 ∈ gaugeBase k
proof:
:= by
  apply Subfield.subset_closure
  change includeBase k (ι k (GenericDeterminantOpen.b k)) ∈ gaugeGenerators k
  exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericLedgerFixedField.gauge_mem_c
statement: theorem gauge_mem_c : (genericChart k).z2 ∈ gaugeBase k
proof:
:= by

  exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr rfl))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericLedgerFixedField.generic_orientation_ne
statement: theorem generic_orientation_ne : orientation (genericChart k) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  change orientation (GenericNormalizedFrameChart.insert (genericOpen k)) ≠ 0
  rw [insert_orientation]
  have hbridge :
      (fieldParameters k).c - (fieldParameters k).a * (fieldParameters k).b =
        includeBase k (ι k (GenericDeterminantOpen.c k -
          GenericDeterminantOpen.a k * GenericDeterminantOpen.b k)) := by
    simp only [fieldParameters, baseParameters, map_sub, map_mul]
  change (fieldParameters k).c - (fieldParameters k).a * (fieldParameters k).b ≠ 0
  rw [hbridge]
  apply (map_ne_zero (includeBase k)).mpr
  intro hι
  have h : GenericDeterminantOpen.c k - GenericDeterminantOpen.a k *
      GenericDeterminantOpen.b k = 0 := by
    apply iota_injective k
    simpa using hι
  have hh := congrArg (witnessEval k) h
  simp [GenericDeterminantOpen.a, GenericDeterminantOpen.b,
    GenericDeterminantOpen.c, gaugeX, GenericDeterminantOpen.x,
    witnessEval, witnessValue] at hh
  norm_num at hh

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericLedgerFixedField.rootSum_eq_S
statement:
theorem rootSum_eq_S :
    deltaX (genericChart k).s1 (genericChart k).s2
        (genericChart k).c1 (genericChart k).c2 +
      deltaStarA (genericChart k).s1 (genericChart k).s2
        (genericChart k).c1 (genericChart k).c2 =
      S (Base k) (Matrix.det (rationalM k))
proof:
:= by
  change deltaX (GenericNormalizedFrameChart.insert (genericOpen k)).s1 (GenericNormalizedFrameChart.insert (genericOpen k)).s2
      (GenericNormalizedFrameChart.insert (genericOpen k)).c1 (GenericNormalizedFrameChart.insert (genericOpen k)).c2 +
    deltaStarA (GenericNormalizedFrameChart.insert (genericOpen k)).s1 (GenericNormalizedFrameChart.insert (genericOpen k)).s2
      (GenericNormalizedFrameChart.insert (genericOpen k)).c1 (GenericNormalizedFrameChart.insert (genericOpen k)).c2 = _
  rw [deltaX_eq_det_XMatrix, deltaStarA_eq_det_AMatrix]
  change Matrix.det (residualPairOfChart (GenericNormalizedFrameChart.insert (genericOpen k))).X +
    Matrix.det (residualPairOfChart (GenericNormalizedFrameChart.insert (genericOpen k))).A = _
  rw [insert_residualPair]
  change Matrix.det (X0 (fieldParameters k).Delta) +
    Matrix.det (moment (fieldParameters k) * X0Inv (fieldParameters k).Delta) = _
  rw [det_X0, Matrix.det_mul, det_X0Inv, fieldParameters_detMoment]
  rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericLedgerFixedField.ledger_eq_chart
statement:
theorem ledger_eq_chart :
    ledgerField (gaugeBase k) (encoderA (genericChart k))
        (encoderB (genericChart k)) = chartField (gaugeBase k) (genericChart k)
proof:
:= by
  apply ledgerField_eq_chartField
  · exact (gaugeBase k).one_mem
  · exact gauge_mem_a k
  · exact gauge_mem_b k
  · exact gauge_mem_c k
  · exact generic_orientation_ne k
  · exact (genericChart_source_fixedSpectrum k).2.2.1
  · exact (genericChart_source_fixedSpectrum k).2.2.2.2.2

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericLedgerFixedField.chart_base
statement:
private theorem chart_base {z : FunctionField k} (hz : z ∈ gaugeBase k) :
    z ∈ chartField (gaugeBase k) (genericChart k)
proof:
:=
  Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inl hz)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericLedgerFixedField.chart_diagA
statement:
private theorem chart_diagA (i : Fin 3) :
    (genericChart k).diagA i ∈ chartField (gaugeBase k) (genericChart k)
proof:
:=
  Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inr (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨i,rfl⟩))))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericLedgerFixedField.chart_diagB
statement:
private theorem chart_diagB (i : Fin 3) :
    (genericChart k).diagB i ∈ chartField (gaugeBase k) (genericChart k)

:=
