name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericLedgerFixedField.chart_matrix
statement:
private theorem chart_matrix (i j : Fin 4) :
    matrixM (genericChart k) i j ∈ chartField (gaugeBase k) (genericChart k)
proof:
:=
  Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inr (Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨(i,j),rfl⟩)))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericLedgerFixedField.generic_matrix
statement:
private theorem generic_matrix (i j : Fin 4) :
    matrixM (genericChart k) i j = includeBase k (rationalM k i j)
proof:
:= by
  change matrixM (GenericNormalizedFrameChart.insert (genericOpen k)) i j = _
  rw [insert_matrixM]
  change moment (fieldParameters k) i j = _
  rw [fieldParameters_moment]
  rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericLedgerFixedField.include_constant
statement:
private theorem include_constant (z : k) :
    includeBase k (ι k (MvPolynomial.C z)) = algebraMap k (FunctionField k) z
proof:
:= by
  change algebraMap (Base k) (FunctionField k)
    (algebraMap (BasePolynomial k) (Base k) (algebraMap k (BasePolynomial k) z)) = _
  rw [← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k (BasePolynomial k) (Base k),
    ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k (Base k) (FunctionField k)]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericLedgerFixedField.baseVariable_mem_chartField
statement:
theorem baseVariable_mem_chartField (v : BaseVar) :
    includeBase k (ι k (MvPolynomial.X v)) ∈
      chartField (gaugeBase k) (genericChart k)
proof:
:= by
  rcases v with i | (i | ⟨⟨i,j⟩,h⟩)
  · fin_cases i
    · exact chart_diagA k 0
    · exact chart_diagA k 1
    · exact chart_diagB k 0
    · exact chart_diagB k 1
  · fin_cases i
    · exact chart_base k (gauge_mem_a k)
    · exact chart_base k (gauge_mem_b k)
    · exact chart_base k (gauge_mem_c k)
  · have hh := chart_matrix k i j
    rw [generic_matrix] at hh
    simpa only [rationalM, dif_neg h, offX, x] using hh

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericLedgerFixedField.polynomial_mem_chartField
statement:
theorem polynomial_mem_chartField (p : BasePolynomial k) :
    includeBase k (ι k p) ∈ chartField (gaugeBase k) (genericChart k)
proof:
:= by
  induction p using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
  | C a =>
      rw [include_constant]
      exact chart_base k (Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inl ⟨a,rfl⟩))
  | add p q hp hq =>
      simpa only [map_add] using
        (chartField (gaugeBase k) (genericChart k)).add_mem hp hq
  | mul_X p v hp =>
      simpa only [map_mul] using
        (chartField (gaugeBase k) (genericChart k)).mul_mem hp
          (baseVariable_mem_chartField k v)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericLedgerFixedField.base_mem_chartField
statement:
theorem base_mem_chartField (b : Base k) :
    includeBase k b ∈ chartField (gaugeBase k) (genericChart k)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p,q,hq,rfl⟩ := IsFractionRing.div_surjective (BasePolynomial k) b
  rw [map_div₀]
  exact Subfield.div_mem _ (polynomial_mem_chartField k p)
    (polynomial_mem_chartField k q)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericLedgerFixedField.invariant_base
statement:
private theorem invariant_base (b : Base k) :
    includeBase k b ∈ invariantField (Base k) (Matrix.det (rationalM k))
proof:
:=
  Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inl ⟨b,rfl⟩)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericLedgerFixedField.gauge_le_invariant
statement:
private theorem gauge_le_invariant :
    gaugeBase k ≤ invariantField (Base k) (Matrix.det (rationalM k))
proof:
:= by
  apply Subfield.closure_le.2
  change gaugeGenerators k ⊆ _
  rintro z (⟨z,rfl⟩ | hz)
  · rw [← include_constant]
    exact invariant_base k _
  · rcases hz with rfl | rfl | rfl <;> exact invariant_base k _

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericLedgerFixedField.chart_eq_invariant
statement:
theorem chart_eq_invariant :
    chartField (gaugeBase k) (genericChart k) =
      invariantField (Base k) (Matrix.det (rationalM k))
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply Subfield.closure_le.2
    change (gaugeBase k : Set (FunctionField k)) ∪ chartCells (genericChart k) ⊆ _
    rintro z (hz | hz)
    · exact gauge_le_invariant k hz
    · rcases hz with ((⟨i,rfl⟩ | ⟨i,rfl⟩) | ⟨⟨i,j⟩,rfl⟩) | hz
      · fin_cases i
        · exact invariant_base k _
        · exact invariant_base k _
        · change -includeBase k _ - includeBase k _ ∈ _
          exact Subfield.sub_mem _ (Subfield.neg_mem _ (invariant_base k _))
            (invariant_base k _)
      · fin_cases i
        · exact invariant_base k _
        · exact invariant_base k _
        · change -includeBase k _ - includeBase k _ ∈ _
          exact Subfield.sub_mem _ (Subfield.neg_mem _ (invariant_base k _))
            (invariant_base k _)
      · change matrixM (genericChart k) i j ∈ _
        rw [generic_matrix]
        exact invariant_base k _
      · rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hz, rootSum_eq_S]
        exact Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inr rfl)
  · apply Subfield.closure_le.2
    change Set.range (algebraMap (Base k) (FunctionField k)) ∪
      {S (Base k) (Matrix.det (rationalM k))} ⊆ _
    rintro z (⟨b,rfl⟩ | hz)
    · exact base_mem_chartField k b
    · rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hz, ← rootSum_eq_S]
      exact Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inr (Or.inr rfl))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericLedgerFixedField.generic_ledgerField_eq_invariantField
statement:
theorem generic_ledgerField_eq_invariantField :
    ledgerField (gaugeBase k) (encoderA (genericChart k))
        (encoderB (genericChart k)) =
      invariantField (Base k) (Matrix.det (rationalM k))
proof:
:= by
  rw [ledger_eq_chart, chart_eq_invariant]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericLedgerFixedField.generic_ledgerField_degree_two
statement:
theorem generic_ledgerField_degree_two :
    Module.finrank
      (ledgerField (gaugeBase k) (encoderA (genericChart k))
        (encoderB (genericChart k))) (FunctionField k) = 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [generic_ledgerField_eq_invariantField]
  exact invariantField_degree_two (Base k) (Matrix.det (rationalM k))
    (det_rationalM_ne_zero k)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualLedgerMomentField.projector_eq_weighted_powers
statement:
theorem projector_eq_weighted_powers (a : JCoord K) (j : Fin 3) :
    spectralProjector a j = ∑ p, projectorWeight (K := K) j p • power a p
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases j <;>
    simp [projectorWeight, spectralProjector, power, Fin.sum_univ_succ] <;> module

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualLedgerMomentField.projectorWeight_mem
statement:
theorem projectorWeight_mem (F : Subfield K) (j p : Fin 3) :
    projectorWeight j p ∈ F
proof:
:= by
  have hh : (1 / 2 : K) ∈ F := F.div_mem F.one_mem (natCast_mem F 2)
  fin_cases j <;> fin_cases p <;>
    simp only [projectorWeight, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
      Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.vecHead, Matrix.vecTail, Function.comp_apply,
      Fin.succ_zero_eq_one]
  all_goals first
    | exact F.zero_mem
    | exact F.one_mem
    | exact hh
    | exact F.neg_mem hh
    | exact F.neg_mem F.one_mem

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualLedgerMomentField.projector_linear_mem
statement:
theorem projector_linear_mem (F : Subfield K) (B : JCoord K →ₗ[K] K)
    (a : JCoord K) (h : ∀ p, B (power a p) ∈ F) (j : Fin 3) :
    B (spectralProjector a j) ∈ F
proof:
:= by
  rw [projector_eq_weighted_powers]
  simp only [map_sum, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  exact F.sum_mem fun p _ => F.mul_mem (projectorWeight_mem F j p) (h p)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualLedgerMomentField.projector_pair_mem
statement:
theorem projector_pair_mem (F : Subfield K)
    (B : JCoord K →ₗ[K] JCoord K →ₗ[K] K) (a b : JCoord K)
    (h : ∀ p q, B (power a p) (power b q) ∈ F) (j l : Fin 3) :
    B (spectralProjector a j) (spectralProjector b l) ∈ F
proof:
:= by
  rw [projector_eq_weighted_powers a j, projector_eq_weighted_powers b l]
  simp only [map_sum, map_smul, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  apply F.sum_mem
  intro p hp
  apply F.mul_mem (projectorWeight_mem F l p)
  apply F.sum_mem
  intro q hq
  exact F.mul_mem (projectorWeight_mem F j q) (h q p)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualLedgerMomentField.traceForm_eq_sum_diagonalProduct
statement:
theorem traceForm_eq_sum_diagonalProduct (x y : JCoord K) :
    sourceTraceForm x y = diagonalProduct 0 x y + diagonalProduct 1 x y +
      diagonalProduct 2 x y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [diagonalProduct_apply, diagLinear_zero, diagLinear_one, diagLinear_two, Matrix.cons_val_zero,
    Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_two, sourceProduct_d1,
    sourceProduct_d2, sourceProduct_d3, sourceTraceForm_formula]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualLedgerMomentField.ledgerIn_of_power_diagonal_mem
statement:
theorem ledgerIn_of_power_diagonal_mem (F : Subfield K) (a b : JCoord K)
    (h : ∀ i p q, diagLinear i (sourceProduct (power a p) (power b q)) ∈ F) :
    LedgerIn F (sourceLedger a b)
proof:
:= by
  have ha (i p : Fin 3) : diagLinear i (power a p) ∈ F := by
    simpa only [power, Matrix.cons_val_zero, sourceProduct_one_right] using h i p 0
  have hb (i q : Fin 3) : diagLinear i (power b q) ∈ F := by
    simpa only [power, Matrix.cons_val_zero, sourceProduct_one_left] using h i 0 q
  have hraw (i j l : Fin 3) :
      diagonalProduct i (spectralProjector a j) (spectralProjector b l) ∈ F :=
    projector_pair_mem F (diagonalProduct i) a b (h i) j l
  have hP (i j : Fin 3) : (sourceLedger a b).P i j ∈ F := by
    change sourceTraceForm (diagonalUnit i) (spectralProjector a j) ∈ F
    rw [diagonal_trace]
    exact projector_linear_mem F (diagLinear i) a (ha i) j
  have hR (l i : Fin 3) : (sourceLedger a b).R l i ∈ F := by
    change sourceTraceForm (spectralProjector b l) (diagonalUnit i) ∈ F
    rw [sourceTraceForm_symmetric, diagonal_trace]
    exact projector_linear_mem F (diagLinear i) b (hb i) l
  have hQ (j l : Fin 3) : (sourceLedger a b).Q j l ∈ F := by
    change sourceTraceForm (spectralProjector a j) (spectralProjector b l) ∈ F
    rw [traceForm_eq_sum_diagonalProduct]
    exact F.add_mem (F.add_mem (hraw 0 j l) (hraw 1 j l)) (hraw 2 j l)
  refine ⟨hP, hQ, hR, ?_⟩
  intro i j l
  change sourceTraceForm (diagonalUnit i)
    (sourceProduct (spectralProjector a j) (spectralProjector b l)) -
      ((sourceLedger a b).P i j + (sourceLedger a b).Q j l +
        (sourceLedger a b).R l i) / 3 + 2 / 9 ∈ F
  rw [diagonal_trace]
  exact F.add_mem (F.sub_mem (hraw i j l)
    (F.div_mem (F.add_mem (F.add_mem (hP i j) (hQ j l)) (hR l i))
      (natCast_mem F 3))) (F.div_mem (natCast_mem F 2) (natCast_mem F 9))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualLedgerMomentField.ledgerCells_subset_iff
statement:
theorem ledgerCells_subset_iff (F : Subfield K) (a b : JCoord K) :
    ledgerCells a b ⊆ F ↔ LedgerIn F (sourceLedger a b)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨fun i j => h (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨(i,j), rfl⟩))),
      fun j l => h (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨(j,l), rfl⟩))),
      fun l i => h (Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨(l,i), rfl⟩)),
      fun i j l => h (Or.inr ⟨(i,j,l), rfl⟩)⟩
  · rintro ⟨hP, hQ, hR, hC⟩ x (((hx | hx) | hx) | hx)
    · rcases hx with ⟨⟨i,j⟩, rfl⟩; exact hP i j
    · rcases hx with ⟨⟨j,l⟩, rfl⟩; exact hQ j l
    · rcases hx with ⟨⟨l,i⟩, rfl⟩; exact hR l i
    · rcases hx with ⟨⟨i,j,l⟩, rfl⟩; exact hC i j l

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualLedgerMomentField.ledgerIn_ledgerField
statement:
theorem ledgerIn_ledgerField (base : Subfield K) (a b : JCoord K) :
    LedgerIn (ledgerField base a b) (sourceLedger a b)
proof:
:=
  (ledgerCells_subset_iff _ a b).1 (fun _ hx => Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inr hx))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualLedgerMomentField.ledgerField_eq_powerField
statement:
theorem ledgerField_eq_powerField (base : Subfield K) (a b : JCoord K) :
    ledgerField base a b = powerField base a b
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply Subfield.closure_le.2
    intro x hx
    rcases hx with hx | hx
    · exact Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inl hx)
    · apply (ledgerCells_subset_iff _ a b).2
        (ledgerIn_of_power_diagonal_mem _ a b ?_) hx
      intro i p q
      exact Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inr ⟨(i,p,q), rfl⟩)
  · apply Subfield.closure_le.2
    rintro x (hx | ⟨⟨i,p,q⟩, rfl⟩)
    · exact Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inl hx)
    · exact power_diagonal_mem _ a b (ledgerIn_ledgerField base a b) i p q

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualLedgerMomentField.residual_moments_mem_ledgerField
statement:
theorem residual_moments_mem_ledgerField (base : Subfield K) (x : ExplicitFrameChart K)
    (hr1 : x.r1 ∈ base) (hz1 : x.z1 ∈ base)
    (hr2 : x.r2 ∈ base) (hz2 : x.z2 ∈ base)
    (hk : orientation x ≠ 0)
    (hNa : sourceNorm (encoderA x) = 0) (hNb : sourceNorm (encoderB x) = 0) :
    (∀ i j, matrixM x i j ∈ ledgerField base (encoderA x) (encoderB x)) ∧
      deltaX x.s1 x.s2 x.c1 x.c2 + deltaStarA x.s1 x.s2 x.c1 x.c2 ∈
        ledgerField base (encoderA x) (encoderB x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := ledgerField base (encoderA x) (encoderB x)
  have hbase : ∀ t, t ∈ base → t ∈ F :=
    fun _ ht => Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inl ht)
  have hL : LedgerIn F (sourceLedger (encoderA x) (encoderB x)) :=
    ledgerIn_ledgerField base _ _
  have hd := powers_diag_mem F _ _ hL
  have hna := norms_mem F (encoderA x) (hd.1 1) (hd.1 2)
  have hnb := norms_mem F (encoderB x) (hd.2 1) (hd.2 2)
  have hgram : SectorIn F (encoderA x) (encoderB x) := power_sectors_mem F _ _ hL 1 1
  have ht := all_trialities_mem F _ _ hL hNa hNb
  have hu := all_U_mem F _ _ hL
  have hUC : x.r1 * x.z2 * matrixM x 0 1 + x.r2 * x.z1 * matrixM x 1 0 ∈ F := by
    have hh : BC (sourceMuC (planeVector x.r1 x.z1) x.s1)
      (sourceMuC (planeVector x.r2 x.z2) x.s2) ∈ F := hu.2.2
    rw [plane_muC_pairing] at hh
    exact hh
  have hUS : x.r2 * x.z1 * matrixM x 2 3 + x.r1 * x.z2 * matrixM x 3 2 ∈ F := by
    have hh : BS (sourceMuS x.c1 (planeVector x.r1 x.z1))
      (sourceMuS x.c2 (planeVector x.r2 x.z2)) ∈ F := hu.2.1
    rw [plane_muS_pairing] at hh
    exact hh
  have cross : ∀ i j, (i = 0 ∨ i = 1) → (j = 2 ∨ j = 3) →
      (x.r1 * matrixM x i j + x.z1 * matrixM x j i ∈ F) ∧
      (x.r2 * matrixM x i j + x.z2 * matrixM x j i ∈ F) := by
    intro i j hi hj
    rcases hi with rfl | rfl <;> rcases hj with rfl | rfl
    all_goals constructor
    all_goals first
      | simpa [encoderA, encoderB, vectorA, vectorB, matrixM, momentMatrix,
          triality, BW, pairW] using ht 0 0 0
      | simpa [encoderA, encoderB, vectorA, vectorB, matrixM, momentMatrix,
          triality, BW, pairW] using ht 1 0 0
      | simpa [encoderA, encoderB, vectorA, vectorB, matrixM, momentMatrix,
          triality, BW, pairW] using ht 0 0 1
      | simpa [encoderA, encoderB, vectorA, vectorB, matrixM, momentMatrix,
          triality, BW, pairW] using ht 1 0 1
      | simpa [encoderA, encoderB, vectorA, vectorB, matrixM, momentMatrix,
          triality, BW, pairW] using ht 0 1 0
      | simpa [encoderA, encoderB, vectorA, vectorB, matrixM, momentMatrix,
          triality, BW, pairW] using ht 1 1 0
      | simpa [encoderA, encoderB, vectorA, vectorB, matrixM, momentMatrix,
          triality, BW, pairW] using ht 0 1 1
      | simpa [encoderA, encoderB, vectorA, vectorB, matrixM, momentMatrix,
          triality, BW, pairW] using ht 1 1 1
  have hM : ∀ i j, matrixM x i j ∈ F := by
    apply matrix_entries_mem F (matrixM x) x.r1 x.z1 x.r2 x.z2
      (hbase _ hr1) (hbase _ hz1) (hbase _ hr2) (hbase _ hz2) hk
    · intro i
      fin_cases i
      · exact hna.2.1
      · exact hnb.2.1
      · exact hna.2.2
      · exact hnb.2.2
    · exact hgram.2.1
    · exact hgram.2.2
    · exact hUC
    · exact hUS
    · exact cross
  exact ⟨hM, determinant_sum_mem F x.s1 x.s2 x.c1 x.c2 hM hu.1⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FullOrbitFibre.fullRelated_of_related
statement:
theorem fullRelated_of_related (x : ExplicitFrameChart ℚ) (Q : ResidualPair ℚ)
    (h : Related (residualPairOfChart x) Q) :
    FullRelated (chartWitnessTriple x) (fibreTriple x Q)
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨G, hG⟩
  have heq : chartWithResidualPair x Q = actChart G x := by
    rw [← hG, ← residualPairOfChart_actChart]
    change chartWithResidualPair (actChart G x)
      (residualPairOfChart (actChart G x)) = actChart G x
    exact chartWithResidualPair_self _
  refine ⟨ResidualAction.jordanAut G, ?_⟩
  unfold fibreTriple
  rw [heq]
  exact jordanAut_chartWitnessTriple_actChart G x

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FullOrbitFibre.fullRelated_cover
statement:
theorem fullRelated_cover (x : ExplicitFrameChart ℚ)
    (hx : ResidualOpen (residualPairOfChart x)) (Q : ResidualPair ℚ)
    (hQ : InFibre x Q) :
    FullRelated (chartWitnessTriple x) (fibreTriple x Q) ∨
      FullRelated (chartWitnessTriple (rootSwappedChart x hx)) (fibreTriple x Q)
proof:
:= by
  rcases (sameResidualBase_iff_related_or_swapped
    (residualPairOfChart x) hx Q hQ.1).mp hQ.2 with h | h
  · exact Or.inl (fullRelated_of_related x Q h)
  · apply Or.inr
    have hs : Related (residualPairOfChart (rootSwappedChart x hx)) Q := by
      simpa [rootSwappedChart] using h
    simpa [fibreTriple, rootSwappedChart] using
      fullRelated_of_related (rootSwappedChart x hx) Q hs

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FullOrbitFibre.original_inFibre
statement:
theorem original_inFibre (x : ExplicitFrameChart ℚ)
    (hx : ResidualOpen (residualPairOfChart x)) :
    InFibre x (residualPairOfChart x)
proof: := ⟨hx, rfl, rfl⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FullOrbitFibre.swapped_inFibre
statement:
theorem swapped_inFibre (x : ExplicitFrameChart ℚ)
    (hx : ResidualOpen (residualPairOfChart x)) :
    InFibre x (rootSwappedRepresentative (residualPairOfChart x) hx)
proof:
:=
  ⟨rootSwappedRepresentative_open _ hx,
    rootSwappedRepresentative_baseMoment _ hx,
    rootSwappedRepresentative_baseRootSum _ hx⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FullOrbitFibre.lawful_of_inFibre
statement:
theorem lawful_of_inFibre (x : ExplicitFrameChart ℚ)
    (hx : LawfulFrameTriple (chartWitnessTriple x)) (Q : ResidualPair ℚ)
    (hQ : InFibre x Q) : LawfulFrameTriple (fibreTriple x Q)
proof:
:=
  (lawfulFrameTriple_chartWithResidualPair_iff_of_sameResidualBase x Q hQ.2).mpr hx

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FullOrbitFibre.fullRelated_iff_detector_of_cover
statement:
theorem fullRelated_iff_detector_of_cover {X₀ X₁ Y Z : WitnessTriple}
    (hsep : traceCubeDetector X₀ ≠ traceCubeDetector X₁)
    (hY : FullRelated X₀ Y ∨ FullRelated X₁ Y)
    (hZ : FullRelated X₀ Z ∨ FullRelated X₁ Z) :
    FullRelated Y Z ↔ traceCubeDetector Y = traceCubeDetector Z
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact FullRelated.traceCubeDetector_eq
  · intro heq
    rcases hY with hY | hY <;> rcases hZ with hZ | hZ
    · exact hY.symm.trans hZ
    · exact (hsep (hY.traceCubeDetector_eq.trans
        (heq.trans hZ.traceCubeDetector_eq.symm))).elim
    · exact (hsep (hZ.traceCubeDetector_eq.trans
        (heq.symm.trans hY.traceCubeDetector_eq.symm))).elim
    · exact hY.symm.trans hZ

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FullOrbitFibre.fullRelated_iff_detector
statement:
theorem fullRelated_iff_detector (x : ExplicitFrameChart ℚ)
    (hx : ResidualOpen (residualPairOfChart x))
    (hsep : traceCubeDetector (chartWitnessTriple x) ≠
      traceCubeDetector (chartWitnessTriple (rootSwappedChart x hx)))
    (Q R : ResidualPair ℚ) (hQ : InFibre x Q) (hR : InFibre x R) :
    FullRelated (fibreTriple x Q) (fibreTriple x R) ↔
      traceCubeDetector (fibreTriple x Q) = traceCubeDetector (fibreTriple x R)
proof:
:=
  fullRelated_iff_detector_of_cover hsep
    (fullRelated_cover x hx Q hQ) (fullRelated_cover x hx R hR)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FullOrbitFibre.representative_separation_of_witness
statement:
theorem representative_separation_of_witness (x : ExplicitFrameChart ℚ)
    (hx : ResidualOpen (residualPairOfChart x)) (Q : ResidualPair ℚ)
    (hQ : InFibre x Q)
    (hsep : traceCubeDetector (chartWitnessTriple x) ≠
      traceCubeDetector (fibreTriple x Q)) :
    traceCubeDetector (chartWitnessTriple x) ≠
      traceCubeDetector (chartWitnessTriple (rootSwappedChart x hx))
proof:
:= by
  rcases fullRelated_cover x hx Q hQ with h | h
  · exact (hsep h.traceCubeDetector_eq).elim
  · intro heq
    exact hsep (heq.trans h.traceCubeDetector_eq)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FullOrbitFibre.detectorBit_zero_or_one
statement:
theorem detectorBit_zero_or_one {X₀ X₁ Y : WitnessTriple}
    (hsep : traceCubeDetector X₀ ≠ traceCubeDetector X₁)
    (hY : FullRelated X₀ Y ∨ FullRelated X₁ Y) :
    detectorBit X₀ X₁ Y = 0 ∨ detectorBit X₀ X₁ Y = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hd : traceCubeDetector X₁ - traceCubeDetector X₀ ≠ 0 :=
    sub_ne_zero.mpr hsep.symm
  rcases hY with h | h
  · left
    simp [detectorBit, ← h.traceCubeDetector_eq]
  · right
    simp [detectorBit, ← h.traceCubeDetector_eq, hd]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FullOrbitFibre.invariant_affine_in_detector
statement:
theorem invariant_affine_in_detector {X₀ X₁ Y : WitnessTriple}
    (hsep : traceCubeDetector X₀ ≠ traceCubeDetector X₁)
    (hY : FullRelated X₀ Y ∨ FullRelated X₁ Y)
    (f : WitnessTriple → ℚ)
    (hf : ∀ {U V}, FullRelated U V → f U = f V) :
    f Y = f X₀ + (f X₁ - f X₀) * detectorBit X₀ X₁ Y
proof:
:= by
  have hd : traceCubeDetector X₁ - traceCubeDetector X₀ ≠ 0 :=
    sub_ne_zero.mpr hsep.symm
  rcases hY with h | h
  · simp [detectorBit, ← h.traceCubeDetector_eq, ← hf h]
  · simp [detectorBit, ← h.traceCubeDetector_eq, ← hf h, hd]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FullOrbitFibre.lawfulFibre_two_full_classes
statement:
theorem lawfulFibre_two_full_classes (x : ExplicitFrameChart ℚ)
    (hx : ResidualOpen (residualPairOfChart x))
    (hlaw : LawfulFrameTriple (chartWitnessTriple x))
    (hsep : traceCubeDetector (chartWitnessTriple x) ≠
      traceCubeDetector (chartWitnessTriple (rootSwappedChart x hx))) :
    InFibre x (residualPairOfChart x) ∧
    InFibre x (rootSwappedRepresentative (residualPairOfChart x) hx) ∧
    ¬ FullRelated (chartWitnessTriple x)
      (chartWitnessTriple (rootSwappedChart x hx)) ∧
    (∀ Q, InFibre x Q → LawfulFrameTriple (fibreTriple x Q) ∧
      (FullRelated (chartWitnessTriple x) (fibreTriple x Q) ∨
       FullRelated (chartWitnessTriple (rootSwappedChart x hx)) (fibreTriple x Q))) ∧
    (∀ Q R, InFibre x Q → InFibre x R →
      (FullRelated (fibreTriple x Q) (fibreTriple x R) ↔
       traceCubeDetector (fibreTriple x Q) = traceCubeDetector (fibreTriple x R)))
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨original_inFibre x hx, swapped_inFibre x hx,
    not_fullRelated_of_traceCubeDetector_ne hsep,
    fun Q hQ => ⟨lawful_of_inFibre x hlaw Q hQ, fullRelated_cover x hx Q hQ⟩,
    fun Q R hQ hR => fullRelated_iff_detector x hx hsep Q R hQ hR⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.OpenGridIdentity.eq_zero_of_eval_algebraMap_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_eval_algebraMap_eq_zero
    (P : MvPolynomial σ K)
    (hP : ∀ a : σ → k,
      MvPolynomial.eval ((algebraMap k K) ∘ a) P = 0) :
    P = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply MvPolynomial.funext_set
    (fun _ : σ => Set.range (algebraMap k K))
    (fun _ => Set.infinite_range_of_injective (algebraMap k K).injective)
  intro x hx
  choose a ha using fun i => hx i (Set.mem_univ i)
  have hxa : (algebraMap k K) ∘ a = x := funext ha
  rw [← hxa]
  simpa using hP a

name: AlbertLean.Generic.OpenGridIdentity.eq_zero_of_eval_algebraMap_eq_zero_of_denominator_ne_zero
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_eval_algebraMap_eq_zero_of_denominator_ne_zero
    (D : MvPolynomial σ k) (P : MvPolynomial σ K) (hD : D ≠ 0)
    (hP : ∀ a : σ → k, MvPolynomial.eval a D ≠ 0 →
      MvPolynomial.eval ((algebraMap k K) ∘ a) P = 0) :
    P = 0
proof:
:= by
  let f : k →+* K := algebraMap k K
  have hproduct : MvPolynomial.map f D * P = 0 := by
    apply eq_zero_of_eval_algebraMap_eq_zero (k := k)
    intro a
    rw [MvPolynomial.eval_mul]
    by_cases hDa : MvPolynomial.eval a D = 0
    · have hmapDa :
          MvPolynomial.eval (f ∘ a) (MvPolynomial.map f D) = 0 := by
        rw [← MvPolynomial.map_eval, hDa, map_zero]
      rw [hmapDa, zero_mul]
    · rw [hP a hDa, mul_zero]
  have hmapD : MvPolynomial.map f D ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hD
    apply MvPolynomial.map_injective f f.injective
    simpa only [map_zero] using h
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hproduct).resolve_left hmapD

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceCharacteristicIdentity.trace_square
statement:
theorem trace_square (x : JCoord K) :
    sourceTrace (sourceProduct x x) = (sourceTrace x)^2 - 2 * sourceSpur x
proof:
:= by
  rw [sourceTrace_product_eq_traceForm, sourceTraceForm, sourceSpurPolar_diagonal]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceCharacteristicIdentity.trace_adjoint_product
statement:
theorem trace_adjoint_product (x : JCoord K) :
    sourceTrace (sourceProduct (sourceAdjoint x) x) = 3 * sourceNorm x
proof:
:= by
  rw [sourceTrace_product_eq_traceForm, sourceAdjoint_characterization,
    sourcePolar_diagonal]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceCharacteristicIdentity.trace_cube
statement:
theorem trace_cube (x : JCoord K) :
    sourceTrace (sourceProduct x (sourceProduct x x)) =
      (sourceTrace x)^3 - 3 * sourceTrace x * sourceSpur x + 3 * sourceNorm x
proof:
:= by
  have h := trace_adjoint_product x
  rw [sourceAdjoint_eq_product_square] at h
  change sourceTraceLinear
    (sourceProductLinear
      (sourceProduct x x - sourceTrace x • x + sourceSpur x • sourceOne) x) = _ at h
  simp only [map_add, map_sub, map_smul, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.sub_apply,
    LinearMap.smul_apply, sourceProductLinear_apply, sourceTraceLinear_apply,
    sourceProduct_one_left, smul_eq_mul] at h
  rw [sourceProduct_comm (sourceProduct x x) x, trace_square] at h
  linear_combination h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceCharacteristicIdentity.characteristic_identity
statement:
theorem characteristic_identity (x : JCoord K) :
    sourceProduct x (sourceProduct x x) - sourceTrace x • sourceProduct x x +
      sourceSpur x • x - sourceNorm x • sourceOne = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := source_cubicResidual_zero x
  simp only [cubicResidual, sourceProductLinear_apply, sourceTraceLinear_apply,
    trace_square, trace_cube] at h
  linear_combination (norm := module) (1 / 6 : K) • h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceCharacteristicIdentity.cubic_of_fixed_spectrum
statement:
theorem cubic_of_fixed_spectrum (x : JCoord K)
    (hT : sourceTrace x = 0) (hS : sourceSpur x = -1) (hN : sourceNorm x = 0) :
    sourceProduct x (sourceProduct x x) = x
proof:
:= by
  have h := characteristic_identity x
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  simpa only [hT, hS, hN, zero_smul, sub_zero, neg_one_smul, sub_eq_add_neg, neg_zero, add_zero] using h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertSameGaugeTransporter.matrixM_eq_moment
statement:
private theorem matrixM_eq_moment (q : ExplicitFrameChart K) :
    matrixM q = moment (residualPairOfChart q)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [matrixM, residualPairOfChart, moment] using
    momentMatrix_eq_AMatrix_mul_XMatrix q.s1 q.s2 q.c1 q.c2

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertSameGaugeTransporter.diagonals_of_ledger
statement:
private theorem diagonals_of_ledger (q q' : ExplicitFrameChart K)
    (h : sourceLedger (encoderA q) (encoderB q) =
      sourceLedger (encoderA q') (encoderB q')) :
    q.diagA = q'.diagA ∧ q.diagB = q'.diagB
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · funext i
    have hd := congrArg (fun L : SourceLedger K => D L i 1) h
    fin_cases i <;>
      simpa [D, H_sourceLedger, power, encoderA, diagLinear] using hd
  · funext i
    have hd := congrArg (fun L : SourceLedger K => E L i 1) h
    fin_cases i <;>
      simpa [E, H_sourceLedger, power, encoderB, diagLinear] using hd

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertSameGaugeTransporter.encoders_of_residual
statement:
private theorem encoders_of_residual (q q' : ExplicitFrameChart K)
    (h : residualPairOfChart q = residualPairOfChart q')
    (hA : q.diagA = q'.diagA) (hB : q.diagB = q'.diagB)
    (hr1 : q.r1 = q'.r1) (hz1 : q.z1 = q'.z1)
    (hr2 : q.r2 = q'.r2) (hz2 : q.z2 = q'.z2) :
    encoderA q = encoderA q' ∧ encoderB q = encoderB q'
proof:
:= by
  have hX (i j : Fin 4) := congrArg (fun P : ResidualPair K => P.X i j) h
  have hC (i j : Fin 4) := congrArg (fun P : ResidualPair K => P.A i j) h
  have hs1 : q.s1 = q'.s1 := by
    apply SCoord.ext
    · funext i; exact hX i 0
    · funext i; exact hC 0 i
  have hs2 : q.s2 = q'.s2 := by
    apply SCoord.ext
    · funext i; exact hX i 1
    · funext i; exact hC 1 i
  have hc1 : q.c1 = q'.c1 := by
    apply CCoord.ext
    · funext i; exact hX i 2
    · funext i; exact hC 2 i
  have hc2 : q.c2 = q'.c2 := by
    apply CCoord.ext
    · funext i; exact hX i 3
    · funext i; exact hC 3 i
  constructor
  · simp only [encoderA, vectorA, hA, hr1, hz1, hs1, hc1]
  · simp only [encoderB, vectorB, hB, hr2, hz2, hs2, hc2]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertSameGaugeTransporter.same_gauge_transporter
statement:
theorem same_gauge_transporter
    (q q' : ExplicitFrameChart K)
    (hopen : ResidualOpen (residualPairOfChart q))
    (hopen' : ResidualOpen (residualPairOfChart q'))
    (hledger : sourceLedger (encoderA q) (encoderB q) =
      sourceLedger (encoderA q') (encoderB q'))
    (hdetector : sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1) (encoderA q) (encoderB q) =
      sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1) (encoderA q') (encoderB q'))
    (a b c sigma : K)
    (hq : EquationsVanish (explicitFrameEquationValues q))
    (hq' : EquationsVanish (explicitFrameEquationValues q'))
    (hr1 : q.r1 = 1) (hz1 : q.z1 = a)
    (hr2 : q.r2 = b) (hz2 : q.z2 = c)
    (hr1' : q'.r1 = 1) (hz1' : q'.z1 = a)
    (hr2' : q'.r2 = b) (hz2' : q'.z2 = c)
    (hb : b = (gramV12 q - sigma) / (2*a))
    (hc : c = (gramV12 q + sigma) / 2)
    (hsigma : sigma ≠ 0) (ha : 2*a ≠ 0)
    (hbeta : actualBeta q a b c sigma ≠ 0) :
    ∃ G : DetOneMatrix K,
      G.g = (residualPairOfChart q').X * (residualPairOfChart q).X⁻¹ ∧
      G.gInv = (residualPairOfChart q).X * (residualPairOfChart q').X⁻¹ ∧
      (∀ d1 d2 d3 : K, (ResidualAction.sourceAut G).linear
        (diagonal d1 d2 d3) = diagonal d1 d2 d3) ∧
      (ResidualAction.sourceAut G).linear (encoderA q) = encoderA q' ∧
      (ResidualAction.sourceAut G).linear (encoderB q) = encoderB q'
proof:
:= by
  have hgram : gramV12 q = gramV12 q' := by
    simp only [gramV12, hr1, hz1, hr2, hz2, hr1', hz1', hr2', hz2']
  have hb' : b = (gramV12 q' - sigma) / (2*a) := by rw [← hgram]; exact hb
  have hc' : c = (gramV12 q' + sigma) / 2 := by rw [← hgram]; exact hc
  have hmatrix_q := matrixM_eq_uniform_inverse q a b c sigma
    hq hr1 hz1 hr2 hz2 hb hc hsigma ha
  have hmatrix_q' := matrixM_eq_uniform_inverse q' a b c sigma
    hq' hr1' hz1' hr2' hz2' hb' hc' hsigma ha
  have hreconstructed : reconstructedMatrix q a sigma =
      reconstructedMatrix q' a sigma := by
    simp only [reconstructedMatrix, hledger, hgram]
  have hmatrix : matrixM q = matrixM q' :=
    hmatrix_q.trans (hreconstructed.trans hmatrix_q'.symm)
  have hepsilon : actualEpsilon q a b c sigma = actualEpsilon q' a b c sigma := by
    simp only [actualEpsilon, reconstructedMatrix, detectorS, hledger, hgram]
  have hbetaeq : actualBeta q a b c sigma = actualBeta q' a b c sigma := by
    simp only [actualBeta, reconstructedMatrix, detectorS, hledger, hgram]
  have hdet : Matrix.det (matrixM q) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [matrixM_eq_moment, moment, Matrix.det_mul]
    exact mul_ne_zero hopen.2 hopen.1
  have hdet' : Matrix.det (matrixM q') ≠ 0 := by rw [← hmatrix]; exact hdet
  have hd := sourceDetector_eq_actualEpsilon_add_actualBeta_mul_delta
    q a b c sigma hq hr1 hz1 hr2 hz2 hb hc hsigma ha hdet
  have hd' := sourceDetector_eq_actualEpsilon_add_actualBeta_mul_delta
    q' a b c sigma hq' hr1' hz1' hr2' hz2' hb' hc' hsigma ha hdet'
  have hDelta : delta (residualPairOfChart q) = delta (residualPairOfChart q') := by
    rw [hd, hd', ← hepsilon, ← hbetaeq] at hdetector
    exact mul_left_cancel₀ hbeta (add_left_cancel hdetector)
  have hM : moment (residualPairOfChart q) = moment (residualPairOfChart q') := by
    rw [← matrixM_eq_moment, ← matrixM_eq_moment]
    exact hmatrix
  let G := transitionDetOneMatrix (residualPairOfChart q) (residualPairOfChart q')
    hopen.1 hopen'.1 hM hDelta
  have hres : residualPairOfChart (actChart G q) = residualPairOfChart q' :=
    (residualPairOfChart_actChart G q).trans
      (act_transitionDetOneMatrix _ _ hopen.1 hopen'.1 hM hDelta)
  have hdiags := diagonals_of_ledger q q' hledger
  have henc := encoders_of_residual (actChart G q) q' hres hdiags.1 hdiags.2
    (hr1.trans hr1'.symm) (hz1.trans hz1'.symm)
    (hr2.trans hr2'.symm) (hz2.trans hz2'.symm)
  refine ⟨G, rfl, rfl, sourceAut_diagonal G, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change ResidualAction.act G (encoderA q) = encoderA q'
    exact (encoderA_actChart G q).symm.trans henc.1
  · change ResidualAction.act G (encoderB q) = encoderB q'
    exact (encoderB_actChart G q).symm.trans henc.2

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertSameGaugeTransporter.restore_reflected_target
statement:
theorem restore_reflected_target (q q' : ExplicitFrameChart K)
    (a : K) (ha : a ≠ 0) (G : DetOneMatrix K)
    (hA : (ResidualAction.sourceAut G).linear (encoderA q) =
      encoderA (reflectChart a q'))
    (hB : (ResidualAction.sourceAut G).linear (encoderB q) =
      encoderB (reflectChart a q')) :
    (GenericReflectionGauge.sourceAut a ha).linear
        ((ResidualAction.sourceAut G).linear (encoderA q)) = encoderA q' ∧
    (GenericReflectionGauge.sourceAut a ha).linear
        ((ResidualAction.sourceAut G).linear (encoderB q)) = encoderB q'
proof:
:= by
  rw [hA, hB, encoderA_reflectChart, encoderB_reflectChart]
  constructor
  · exact GenericReflectionGauge.theta_involutive a ha (encoderA q')
  · exact GenericReflectionGauge.theta_involutive a ha (encoderB q')

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.PolynomialFrameSchedule.basisVector_apply_eq
statement:
theorem basisVector_apply_eq (a b : Ix6) :
    basisVector (K := L) b a = if a = b then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases a with a | a <;> rcases b with b | b <;>
    fin_cases a <;> fin_cases b <;> simp [basisVector, Pi.single_apply]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.PolynomialFrameSchedule.omega_basis_eq_column
statement:
theorem omega_basis_eq_column (d : Vec6 L) (b : Ix6) :
    (omega (K := L)) d (basisVector (K := L) b) =
      match b with
      | Sum.inl i => -d (Sum.inr i)
      | Sum.inr i => d (Sum.inl i)
proof:
:= by
  rcases b with b | b <;> fin_cases b <;>
    simp [omega, omegaFun, basisVector, Pi.single_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.PolynomialFrameSchedule.eval_direction
statement:
@[simp] theorem eval_direction (f : k →+* L)
    (Z : Fin 3 → Fin 12 → (Vec6 L × L)) (r : Fin 3) (s : Fin 12) (a : Ix6) :
    evalSchedule k f Z (direction k r s a) = (Z r s).1 a
proof:
:= by
  simp [evalSchedule, direction]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.PolynomialFrameSchedule.eval_coefficient
statement:
@[simp] theorem eval_coefficient (f : k →+* L)
    (Z : Fin 3 → Fin 12 → (Vec6 L × L)) (r : Fin 3) (s : Fin 12) :
    evalSchedule k f Z (coefficient k r s) = (Z r s).2
proof:
:= by
  simp [evalSchedule, coefficient]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.PolynomialFrameSchedule.eval_omegaColumn
statement:
theorem eval_omegaColumn (f : k →+* L)
    (Z : Fin 3 → Fin 12 → (Vec6 L × L)) (r : Fin 3) (s : Fin 12) (b : Ix6) :
    evalSchedule k f Z (omegaColumn k (direction k r s) b) =
      match b with
      | Sum.inl i => -(Z r s).1 (Sum.inr i)
      | Sum.inr i => (Z r s).1 (Sum.inl i)
proof:
:= by
  rcases b with b | b <;> simp [omegaColumn, eval_direction]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.PolynomialFrameSchedule.eval_transvectionMatrix
statement:
theorem eval_transvectionMatrix (f : k →+* L)
    (Z : Fin 3 → Fin 12 → (Vec6 L × L))
    (r : Fin 3) (s : Fin 12) :
    (evalSchedule k f Z).mapMatrix
        (transvectionMatrix k (direction k r s) (coefficient k r s)) =
      matrixOfLinear (map omega (Z r s).1 (Z r s).2)
proof:
:= by
  ext a b
  classical
  change evalSchedule k f Z
      ((if a = b then 1 else 0) + coefficient k r s *
        omegaColumn k (direction k r s) b * direction k r s a) =
    basisVector (K := L) b a +
      (Z r s).2 * (omega (K := L)) (Z r s).1 (basisVector (K := L) b) *
        (Z r s).1 a
  rw [map_add, map_mul, map_mul, eval_coefficient, eval_omegaColumn,
    eval_direction, basisVector_apply_eq, omega_basis_eq_column]
  simp

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.PolynomialFrameSchedule.eval_neg_transvectionMatrix
statement:
theorem eval_neg_transvectionMatrix (f : k →+* L)
    (Z : Fin 3 → Fin 12 → (Vec6 L × L))
    (r : Fin 3) (s : Fin 12) :
    (evalSchedule k f Z).mapMatrix
        (transvectionMatrix k (direction k r s) (-coefficient k r s)) =
      matrixOfLinear (map omega (Z r s).1 (-(Z r s).2))
proof:
:= by
  ext a b
  classical
  change evalSchedule k f Z
      ((if a = b then 1 else 0) + (-coefficient k r s) *
        omegaColumn k (direction k r s) b * direction k r s a) =
    basisVector (K := L) b a +
      (-(Z r s).2) * (omega (K := L)) (Z r s).1 (basisVector (K := L) b) *
        (Z r s).1 a
  rw [map_add, map_mul, map_mul, map_neg, eval_coefficient, eval_omegaColumn,
    eval_direction, basisVector_apply_eq, omega_basis_eq_column]
  split_ifs <;> simp <;> ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.PolynomialFrameSchedule.map_matrixWord
statement:
theorem map_matrixWord (f : ParameterRing k →+* L) (word : List (Mat6R k)) :
    f.mapMatrix (matrixWord (k := k) word) =
      (word.map f.mapMatrix).prod
proof:
:= by
  induction word with
  | nil => simp [matrixWord]
  | cons A word ih => simp [matrixWord, ih, map_mul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.PolynomialFrameSchedule.matrixOfLinear_comp
statement:
theorem matrixOfLinear_comp (A B : Vec6 L →ₗ[L] Vec6 L) :
    matrixOfLinear (A.comp B) = matrixOfLinear A * matrixOfLinear B
proof:
:= by
  apply matrixAction_injective
  rw [matrixAction_matrixOfLinear, matrixAction_mul,
    matrixAction_matrixOfLinear, matrixAction_matrixOfLinear]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.PolynomialFrameSchedule.wordMatrix_eq_prod
statement:
theorem wordMatrix_eq_prod (word : List (Step (K := L) (V := Vec6 L))) :
    wordMatrix word =
      (word.map (fun z => matrixOfLinear (map omega z.1 z.2))).prod
proof:
:= by
  induction word with
  | nil =>
      change matrixOfLinear (wordMap (omega (K := L)) []) = 1
      apply matrixAction_injective
      rw [matrixAction_matrixOfLinear, matrixAction_one]
      exact wordMap_nil (omega (K := L))
  | cons z word ih =>
      rcases z with ⟨d,t⟩
      change matrixOfLinear (wordMap (omega (K := L)) word) = _ at ih
      rw [wordMatrix, wordMap, matrixOfLinear_comp, List.map_cons, List.prod_cons,
        ih]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.PolynomialFrameSchedule.eval_forwardMatrix
statement:
theorem eval_forwardMatrix (f : k →+* L)
    (Z : Fin 3 → Fin 12 → (Vec6 L × L)) (r : Fin 3) :
    (evalSchedule k f Z).mapMatrix (forwardMatrix k r) =
      wordMatrix (concreteWord Z r)
proof:
:= by
  rw [forwardMatrix, map_matrixWord, wordMatrix_eq_prod]
  apply congrArg List.prod
  simp only [forwardMatrices, concreteWord, List.map_ofFn]
  apply congrArg (fun h : Fin 12 → Mat6 L => List.ofFn h)
  funext s
  exact eval_transvectionMatrix k f Z r s

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.PolynomialFrameSchedule.eval_inverseMatrix
statement:
theorem eval_inverseMatrix (f : k →+* L)
    (Z : Fin 3 → Fin 12 → (Vec6 L × L)) (r : Fin 3) :
    (evalSchedule k f Z).mapMatrix (inverseMatrix k r) =
      inverseWordMatrix (concreteWord Z r)
proof:
:= by
  rw [inverseMatrix, map_matrixWord]
  change _ = wordMatrix (inverseWord (concreteWord Z r))
  rw [wordMatrix_eq_prod]
  apply congrArg List.prod
  simp only [inverseMatrices, inverseWord, concreteWord, List.map_reverse, List.map_map,
    List.map_ofFn]
  congr 1
  apply congrArg (fun h : Fin 12 → Mat6 L => List.ofFn h)
  funext s
  exact eval_neg_transvectionMatrix k f Z r s

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.PolynomialFrameSchedule.map_schedule_matrixCoordinates
statement:
theorem map_schedule_matrixCoordinates (f : ParameterRing k →+* L)
    (A : Mat6R k) (c : Index) :
    f (matrixCoordinates A c) = matrixCoordinates (f.mapMatrix A) c
proof:
:= by
  rcases c with ⟨a,b⟩ | c
  · rfl
  · rcases c with c | c <;> fin_cases c <;> simp [matrixCoordinates]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.PolynomialFrameSchedule.eval_standardMatrix
statement:
theorem eval_standardMatrix (f : ParameterRing k →+* L) (i : Fin 3) :
    f.mapMatrix (standardMatrix k i) =
      ((standardCarrierProjector (K := L) i : Carrier L) : Mat6 L)
proof:
:= by
  ext a b
  rcases a with a | a <;> rcases b with b | b <;>
    fin_cases a <;> fin_cases b <;> fin_cases i <;>
    simp [standardMatrix, standardCarrierProjector, diagonalProjector,
      grouped, hat, coordinateLabel]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.PolynomialFrameSchedule.eval_scheduledPoint
statement:
theorem eval_scheduledPoint (f : k →+* L)
    (Z : Fin 3 → Fin 12 → (Vec6 L × L))
    (r i : Fin 3) :
    (fun c => evalSchedule k f Z (scheduledPoint k r i c)) =
      encode ((wordJordanAut (concreteWord Z r)).linear.symm
        (standardCarrierProjector i))
proof:
:= by
  funext c
  rw [scheduledPoint, map_schedule_matrixCoordinates]
  rw [map_mul, map_mul, eval_inverseMatrix, eval_standardMatrix,
    eval_forwardMatrix]
  let Q := (wordJordanAut (concreteWord Z r)).linear.symm
    (standardCarrierProjector i)
  have hQ : (Q : Mat6 L) =
      inverseWordMatrix (concreteWord Z r) *
        (standardCarrierProjector i : Carrier L) *
        wordMatrix (concreteWord Z r) := rfl
  rw [← hQ, matrixCoordinates_carrier]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.InvariantPointAgreement.exists_raw_fraction
statement:
theorem exists_raw_fraction (f : FF k) :
    ∃ a b : CoordinateRing k, rawToFunction k b ≠ 0 ∧
      f = rawToFunction k a / rawToFunction k b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, y, hy, hxy⟩ := IsFractionRing.div_surjective (RR k) f
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective x
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective y
  refine ⟨a, b, ?_, hxy.symm⟩
  change algebraMap (RR k) (FF k)
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk (rawFrameIdeal k).radical b) ≠ 0
  exact IsFractionRing.to_map_ne_zero_of_mem_nonZeroDivisors hy

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.InvariantPointAgreement.invariant_agreement_of_GSp
statement:
theorem invariant_agreement_of_GSp
    {K : Type v} [Field K] [CharZero K]
    (phi psi : FF k →+* K)
    (M N : Mat6 K) (mu : K)
    (hMN : M * N = 1) (hNM : N * M = 1) (hmu : mu ≠ 0)
    (hform : M.transpose * symplecticJ * M = mu • symplecticJ)
    (hscalar : originalCoefficientEmbedding k K phi =
      originalCoefficientEmbedding k K psi)
    (hpoint : ∀ r i,
      M * ringMatrix (genericPointAlong k K phi r i) * N =
        ringMatrix (genericPointAlong k K psi r i))
    (f : FF k) (hf : f ∈ ordinaryInvariantField k) :
    phi f = psi f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, hb, hrep⟩ := exists_raw_fraction k f
  rw [hrep]
  apply GSpFinalAgreement.GSp_finalPoint_agreement k phi psi M N mu
    hMN hNM hmu hform hscalar hpoint a b hb
  change ∀ g : ScalarJordanAut.Aut (K := k), fractionAction k g f = f at hf
  simpa only [← hrep] using hf

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.InvariantPointAgreement.invariant_agreement_of_GSp_after_embedding
statement:
theorem invariant_agreement_of_GSp_after_embedding
    {K : Type v} {L : Type w} [Field K] [CharZero K]
    [Field L] [CharZero L]
    (phi psi : FF k →+* K) (j : K →+* L)
    (M N : Mat6 L) (mu : L)
    (hMN : M * N = 1) (hNM : N * M = 1) (hmu : mu ≠ 0)
    (hform : M.transpose * symplecticJ * M = mu • symplecticJ)
    (hscalar : originalCoefficientEmbedding k K phi =
      originalCoefficientEmbedding k K psi)
    (hpoint : ∀ r i,
      M * ringMatrix (genericPointAlong k L (j.comp phi) r i) * N =
        ringMatrix (genericPointAlong k L (j.comp psi) r i))
    (f : FF k) (hf : f ∈ ordinaryInvariantField k) :
    phi f = psi f
proof:
:= by
  apply j.injective
  have hs : originalCoefficientEmbedding k L (j.comp phi) =
      originalCoefficientEmbedding k L (j.comp psi) := by
    rw [GSpFinalAgreement.originalCoefficientEmbedding_comp,
      GSpFinalAgreement.originalCoefficientEmbedding_comp]
    exact congrArg (fun c : k →+* K => j.comp c) hscalar
  exact invariant_agreement_of_GSp k (j.comp phi) (j.comp psi)
    M N mu hMN hNM hmu hform hs hpoint f hf

name: AlbertLean.Generic.UniformMomentGenericQuadraticEval.evalQ_comp_qmap

proof:

name: AlbertLean.Generic.UniformMomentGenericQuadraticEval.deck_evalQ
statement: theorem deck_evalQ (z : Q k) : deck k (evalQ k z) = evalQ k z
proof:
:= by
  rw [← QuadraticAlgebra.re_smul_add_im_smul z]
  simp only [map_add, map_smul, Algebra.smul_def, evalQ_algebraMap,
    evalQ_omega, map_mul, map_one, deck_kappa]
  have hbase (x : Local k) : deck k (genericEvalLocal k x) = genericEvalLocal k x := by
    have hledger : (deck k).toRingHom.comp (ledgerEval k) = ledgerEval k := by
      apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
      · intro c
        simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, ledgerEval, MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_C]
        rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k (Base k) (FunctionField k)]
        exact deck_base k _
      · intro v
        simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, ledgerEval_X]
        apply AlbertLean.Generic.GenericLedgerInvariance.deck_fixed_of_mem_H k
        apply Subfield.subset_closure
        right
        cases v with
        | inl ij => exact Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨ij, rfl⟩))
        | inr v =>
          cases v with
          | inl jl => exact Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨jl, rfl⟩))
          | inr v =>
            cases v with
            | inl li => exact Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨li, rfl⟩)
            | inr ijl => exact Or.inr ⟨ijl, rfl⟩
    have hlocal : (deck k).toRingHom.comp (genericEvalLocal k) =
        genericEvalLocal k := by
      apply IsLocalization.ringHom_ext (Submonoid.powers (B0 k))
      apply RingHom.ext
      intro p
      change deck k (genericEvalLocal k (loc k p)) =
        genericEvalLocal k (loc k p)
      simpa only [genericEvalLocal_loc, RingHom.comp_apply,
        RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe] using
          DFunLike.congr_fun hledger p
    exact DFunLike.congr_fun hlocal x
  rw [hbase, hbase]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.UniformMomentGenericQuadraticEval.generic_nVx_eq_z1
statement:
private theorem generic_nVx_eq_z1 :
    nVx (genericLedger k) = (genericChart k).z1
proof:
:= by
  let q := genericChart k
  have hf := genericChart_source_fixedSpectrum k
  have hm := recovered_measurements (encoderA q) (encoderB q)
    hf.2.2.1 hf.2.2.2.2.2

name: AlbertLean.Generic.UniformMomentGenericQuadraticEval.evalQ_moment_eq_matrixM
statement:
theorem evalQ_moment_eq_matrixM :
    (moment k).map (evalQ k) = matrixM (genericChart k)
proof:
:= by
  let q := genericChart k
  let L := genericLedger k
  let av := nVx L
  have hf := genericChart_source_fixedSpectrum k
  have hm := recovered_measurements (encoderA q) (encoderB q)
    hf.2.2.1 hf.2.2.2.2.2
  rcases hm with ⟨hnVx, hnSx, hnCx, hnVy, hnSy, hnCy, hgV, hgS, hgC,
    ht111, ht211, ht121, ht112, ht122, ht212, ht221, ht222, huV, huS, huC⟩
  have hqr : q.r1 = 1 := by
    simpa only [q] using
      AlbertLean.Generic.GenericOrientationAttachment.generic_r1 k
  have hqz : q.z1 ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [q] using
      AlbertLean.Generic.GenericOrientationAttachment.generic_z1_ne k
  have hav : av = q.z1 := by
    change nVx (sourceLedger (encoderA q) (encoderB q)) = q.z1
    rw [hnVx]
    simp [encoderA, vectorA, AlbertLean.Triality.CoordinateTensor.nV,
      AlbertLean.Triality.ExteriorSix.Pf, AlbertLean.Triality.ExteriorSix.BW,
      hqr]
  have hh : gV L 1 1 = gramV12 q := by
    change gV (sourceLedger (encoderA q) (encoderB q)) 1 1 = gramV12 q
    rw [hgV]
    simp [gramV12, encoderA, encoderB, vectorA, vectorB,
      AlbertLean.Triality.CoordinateTensor.BV,
      AlbertLean.Triality.ExteriorSix.BW]
    ring
  have ho : orientation q = kappa k := (kappa_eq_orientation k).symm
  have hb : q.r2 = (gramV12 q - kappa k) / (2*av) := by
    rw [← ho, gramV12, orientation, hav]
    field_simp [hqz]
    ring
  have hc : q.z2 = (gramV12 q + kappa k) / 2 := by
    rw [← ho, gramV12, orientation]
    rw [hqr]
    ring
  have hq : EquationsVanish (explicitFrameEquationValues q) :=
    (equationsVanish_iff_source_fixedSpectrum q).2 hf
  have hrec := UniformMomentReconstruction.matrixM_eq_uniform_inverse
    q av q.r2 q.z2 (kappa k)
    hq hqr hav.symm rfl rfl hb hc
    (kappa_ne_zero k)
    (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num)
      (by rw [hav]; exact hqz))
  have hmapMoment : (moment k).map (evalQ k) =
      evalQ k (scaleUnit k : Q k) • (N k).map (evalQ k) := by
    ext i j
    simp only [moment, Matrix.map_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
      map_mul]
  have hL : genericLedger k =
      sourceLedger (encoderA q) (encoderB q) := rfl
  rw [← hL] at hrec
  rw [hmapMoment, evalQ_scaleUnit, evalQ_N, evalPlus_N0]
  simpa [L, av, hh] using hrec.symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.UniformMomentGenericQuadraticEval.genericValue_eq_epsilon_add_beta_mul_Delta
statement:
theorem genericValue_eq_epsilon_add_beta_mul_Delta :
    genericValue k = evalQ k (epsilon k) + evalQ k (beta k) * T (Base k)
proof:
:= by
  have hdelta :
      deltaX (genericChart k).s1 (genericChart k).s2
          (genericChart k).c1 (genericChart k).c2 = T (Base k) := by
    rw [deltaX_eq_det_XMatrix]
    change Matrix.det
      (AlbertLean.Generic.ChartBridge.residualPairOfChart (genericChart k)).X = _
    rw [genericChart, GenericNormalizedFrameChart.insert_residualPair]
    change Matrix.det
      (AlbertLean.Residual.NormalizedOrbitSection.X0 (T (Base k))) = _
    exact AlbertLean.Residual.NormalizedOrbitSection.det_X0 _
  have hquad : T (Base k) ^ 2 = evalQ k (finiteS k) * T (Base k) -
      evalQ k (Matrix.det (moment k)) := by
    rw [evalQ_finiteS]
    have hmap : evalQ k (Matrix.det (moment k)) =
        Matrix.det ((evalQ k).mapMatrix (moment k)) :=
      RingHom.map_det (evalQ k) (moment k)
    rw [hmap]
    have hmoment : (evalQ k).mapMatrix (moment k) =
        matrixM (genericChart k) := by
      ext i j
      change evalQ k (moment k i j) = matrixM (genericChart k) i j
      exact congrFun (congrFun (evalQ_moment_eq_matrixM k) i) j
    rw [hmoment,
      matrixM, det_momentMatrix_eq_deltaX_mul_deltaStarA]
    rw [hdelta]
    ring
  have h := detector_affine k (finiteDiagA k) (finiteDiagB k)
    (finiteB k) (finiteC k) (finiteS k) (evalQ k) (T (Base k)) hquad
  rw [GenericDetectorFamily.genericValue_eq_family]
  unfold GenericDetectorFamily.family
  have hdA : (fun i => ambientCoefficient k
      (GenericDetectorFamily.diagonalA k i)) =
      fun i => evalQ k (finiteDiagA k i) := by
    funext i
    rw [evalQ_finiteDiagA]
    fin_cases i <;>
      simp [GenericDetectorFamily.diagonalA, ambientCoefficient,
        GenericDeterminantOpen.dA2, genericChart,
        GenericNormalizedFrameChart.insert, ChartBridge.chartWithResidualPair,
        GenericNormalizedFrameChart.dA2, genericOpen, fieldParameters,
        baseParameters]
  have hdB : (fun i => ambientCoefficient k
      (GenericDetectorFamily.diagonalB k i)) =
      fun i => evalQ k (finiteDiagB k i) := by
    funext i
    rw [evalQ_finiteDiagB]
    fin_cases i <;>
      simp [GenericDetectorFamily.diagonalB, ambientCoefficient,
        GenericDeterminantOpen.dB2, genericChart,
        GenericNormalizedFrameChart.insert, ChartBridge.chartWithResidualPair,
        GenericNormalizedFrameChart.dB2, genericOpen, fieldParameters,
        baseParameters]
  have ha : ambientCoefficient k (GenericDeterminantOpen.a k) =
      evalQ k (algebraMap (Local k) (Q k) (loc k (a k))) := by
    rw [evalQ_algebraMap, genericEvalLocal_loc, ledgerEval_a,
      generic_nVx_eq_z1]
    rfl
  have hb : ambientCoefficient k (GenericDeterminantOpen.b k) =
      evalQ k (finiteB k) := by
    rw [evalQ_finiteB]
    rfl
  have hc : ambientCoefficient k (GenericDeterminantOpen.c k) =
      evalQ k (finiteC k) := by
    rw [evalQ_finiteC]
    rfl
  have hM : (GenericDeterminantOpen.rationalM k).map (includeBase k) =
      (moment k).map (evalQ k) := by
    rw [evalQ_moment_eq_matrixM]
    change ambientMoment k = matrixM (genericChart k)
    rw [genericChart, GenericNormalizedFrameChart.insert_matrixM]
    have hparams : (genericOpen k).toParameters = fieldParameters k := rfl
    rw [hparams, fieldParameters_moment]
    rfl
  rw [hdA, hdB, ha, hb, hc, hM]
  simpa only [epsilon, beta] using h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ThreeIdempotents.pairwise_mul_eq_zero_of_sum_eq_one
statement:
theorem pairwise_mul_eq_zero_of_sum_eq_one
    (e0 e1 e2 : A)
    (hcomm : ∀ x y : A, x * y = y * x)
    (htwo : ∀ x : A, x + x = 0 → x = 0)
    (h0 : e0 * e0 = e0) (h1 : e1 * e1 = e1) (h2 : e2 * e2 = e2)
    (hsum : e0 + e1 + e2 = 1) :
    e0 * e1 = 0 ∧ e0 * e2 = 0 ∧ e1 * e2 = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hr0 := congrArg (fun y : A => e0 * y) hsum
  have hr1 := congrArg (fun y : A => e1 * y) hsum
  have hr2 := congrArg (fun y : A => e2 * y) hsum
  have hpq : e0 * e1 + e0 * e2 = 0 := by
    simp only [mul_add, mul_one, h0] at hr0
    calc
      e0 * e1 + e0 * e2 = (e0 + e0 * e1 + e0 * e2) - e0 := by abel
      _ = 0 := by rw [hr0, sub_self]
  have hpr : e0 * e1 + e1 * e2 = 0 := by
    simp only [mul_add, mul_one, h1, hcomm e1 e0] at hr1
    calc
      e0 * e1 + e1 * e2 = (e0 * e1 + e1 + e1 * e2) - e1 := by abel
      _ = 0 := by rw [hr1, sub_self]
  have hqr : e0 * e2 + e1 * e2 = 0 := by
    simp only [mul_add, mul_one, h2, hcomm e2 e0, hcomm e2 e1] at hr2
    calc
      e0 * e2 + e1 * e2 = (e0 * e2 + e1 * e2 + e2) - e2 := by abel
      _ = 0 := by rw [hr2, sub_self]
  have hp2 : e0 * e1 + e0 * e1 = 0 := by
    calc
      e0 * e1 + e0 * e1 =
          (e0 * e1 + e0 * e2) + (e0 * e1 + e1 * e2) -
            (e0 * e2 + e1 * e2) := by abel
      _ = 0 := by rw [hpq, hpr, hqr]; simp
  have hp : e0 * e1 = 0 := htwo _ hp2
  have hq : e0 * e2 = 0 := by
    rw [hp, zero_add] at hpq
    exact hpq
  have hr : e1 * e2 = 0 := by
    rw [hp, zero_add] at hpr
    exact hpr
  exact ⟨hp, hq, hr⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ThreeIdempotents.scalar_coefficient_eq_zero_of_adjoint_eq_zero
statement:
theorem scalar_coefficient_eq_zero_of_adjoint_eq_zero
    (trace scalar : A → K) (sharp : A → A) (x : A)
    (trace_sharp : trace (sharp x) = scalar x)
    (trace_zero : trace 0 = 0)
    (hsharp : sharp x = 0) : scalar x = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [hsharp, trace_zero] at trace_sharp
  exact trace_sharp.symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ThreeIdempotents.mul_self_eq_self_of_adjoint_eq_zero
statement:
theorem mul_self_eq_self_of_adjoint_eq_zero
    (trace scalar : A → K) (sharp : A → A) (x : A)
    (adjoint_identity :
      sharp x = x * x - trace x • x + scalar x • (1 : A))
    (trace_sharp : trace (sharp x) = scalar x)
    (trace_zero : trace 0 = 0)
    (htrace : trace x = 1)
    (hsharp : sharp x = 0) : x * x = x
proof:
:= by
  have hscalar : scalar x = 0 :=
    scalar_coefficient_eq_zero_of_adjoint_eq_zero
      trace scalar sharp x trace_sharp trace_zero hsharp
  rw [hsharp, htrace, hscalar] at adjoint_identity
  have hdiff : x * x - x = 0 := by simpa using adjoint_identity.symm
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp hdiff

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ThreeIdempotents.adjoint_eq_zero_iff_mul_self_eq_self
statement:
theorem adjoint_eq_zero_iff_mul_self_eq_self
    (trace scalar : A → K) (sharp : A → A) (x : A)
    (adjoint_identity : sharp x = x * x - trace x • x + scalar x • (1 : A))
    (trace_sharp : trace (sharp x) = scalar x) (trace_zero : trace 0 = 0)
    (trace_smul_one : ∀ k : K, trace (k • (1 : A)) = k + k + k)
    (htwo : ∀ k : K, k + k = 0 → k = 0) (htrace : trace x = 1) :
    sharp x = 0 ↔ x * x = x
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact mul_self_eq_self_of_adjoint_eq_zero trace scalar sharp x
      adjoint_identity trace_sharp trace_zero htrace
  · intro hid
    have hs : sharp x = scalar x • (1 : A) := by
      simpa only [hid, htrace, one_smul, sub_self, zero_add] using adjoint_identity
    have ht : scalar x + scalar x + scalar x = scalar x := by
      simpa only [hs, trace_smul_one] using trace_sharp
    have hdouble : scalar x + scalar x = 0 := by
      calc
        scalar x + scalar x = (scalar x + scalar x + scalar x) - scalar x := by abel
        _ = 0 := by rw [ht, sub_self]
    rw [hs, htwo _ hdouble, zero_smul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericDetectorLocalization.PA_mul_inversePA
statement: @[simp] theorem PA_mul_inversePA : coefficient k (PA k) * inversePA k = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply factor_mul_inverse
  change Polynomial.C (PA k) * (Polynomial.C (PB k * Matrix.det (N k)) * Polynomial.X) = denominator k
  simp only [denominator, map_mul]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericDetectorLocalization.PB_mul_inversePB

@[simp] theorem detN_mul_inverseDetN :

proof:
:= by

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericDetectorLocalization.inversePA_mul_PA
statement: @[simp] theorem inversePA_mul_PA : inversePA k * coefficient k (PA k) = 1

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericDetectorLocalization.inversePB_mul_PB

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericDetectorLocalization.inverseRoot_mul_root

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericDetectorLocalization.inverseDetN_mul_detN

@[simp] theorem inverseDetN_mul_detN :

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericDetectorLocalization.map_inverse
statement:
private theorem map_inverse {D E : Type*} [CommRing D] [Field E]
    (f : D →+* E) {x y : D} (hxy : x * y = 1) : f y = (f x)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have h : f x * f y = 1 := by rw [← map_mul, hxy, map_one]
  have hx : f x ≠ 0 := by
    intro hx
    rw [hx, zero_mul] at h
    exact zero_ne_one h
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ hx
  rw [h, mul_inv_cancel₀ hx]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericDetectorLocalization.j_inversePA
statement:
@[simp] theorem j_inversePA :
    j k (inversePA k) = (includeBase k (ι k (PA k)))⁻¹

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericDetectorLocalization.evalPolynomial_X

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericDetectorLocalization.evalPolynomial_denominator_unit

statement:
theorem ambient_ne_zero_of_evaluation_ne_zero {z : LocalRing k}
    (hz : evaluation k e t hPA hPB hDetN ht z ≠ 0) : j k z ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hjz
  have hz0 : z = 0 := j_injective k (by simpa only [map_zero] using hjz)
  apply hz
  rw [hz0, map_zero]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.NestedReciprocalField.polynomialMap_injective
statement:
theorem polynomialMap_injective :
    Function.Injective (algebraMap (Polynomial B) (Omega B))
proof:
:=
  IsFractionRing.injective (Polynomial B) (Omega B)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.NestedReciprocalField.T_ne_zero
statement: theorem T_ne_zero : T B ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply Polynomial.X_ne_zero (R := B)
  apply polynomialMap_injective B
  simpa only [map_zero, T] using h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.NestedReciprocalField.polynomialMap_C
statement:
@[simp] theorem polynomialMap_C (b : B) :
    algebraMap (Polynomial B) (Omega B) (Polynomial.C b) =
      algebraMap B (Omega B) b
proof:
:=
  (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply B (Polynomial B) (Omega B) b).symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.NestedReciprocalField.branchPolynomial_ne_zero
statement:
theorem branchPolynomial_ne_zero (m : B) :
    T B ^ 2 - algebraMap B (Omega B) m ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hp : (Polynomial.X ^ 2 - Polynomial.C m : Polynomial B) = 0 := by
    apply (polynomialMap_injective B)
    rw [map_zero]
    simpa only [map_sub, map_pow, polynomialMap_C, T] using h
  have hc := congrArg (fun p : Polynomial B => p.coeff 2) hp
  simpa using hc

name: AlbertLean.Generic.NestedReciprocalField.evalT_eq_algebraMap
statement:
theorem evalT_eq_algebraMap :
    Polynomial.eval₂RingHom (algebraMap B (Omega B)) (T B) =
      algebraMap (Polynomial B) (Omega B)
proof:
:= by
  ext <;> simp [T]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.NestedReciprocalField.evalInvT_injective
statement:
theorem evalInvT_injective : Function.Injective
    (Polynomial.eval₂RingHom (algebraMap B (Omega B)) (T B)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  intro p q hpq
  suffices p - q = 0 by exact sub_eq_zero.mp this
  apply Polynomial.reverse_eq_zero.mp
  apply (polynomialMap_injective B)
  rw [map_zero]
  rw [← evalT_eq_algebraMap B]
  letI : Invertible ((T B)⁻¹) := invertibleOfNonzero (inv_ne_zero (T_ne_zero B))
  have hz : Polynomial.eval₂ (algebraMap B (Omega B)) ((T B)⁻¹) (p - q) = 0 := by
    change (Polynomial.eval₂RingHom (algebraMap B (Omega B)) ((T B)⁻¹)) (p-q) = 0
    rw [map_sub, hpq, sub_self]
  have hrev := (Polynomial.eval₂_reverse_eq_zero_iff
    (algebraMap B (Omega B)) ((T B)⁻¹) (p - q)).2 hz
  change Polynomial.eval₂ (algebraMap B (Omega B)) (T B) (p - q).reverse = 0
  simpa only [invOf_eq_inv, inv_inv] using hrev

name: AlbertLean.Generic.NestedReciprocalField.scale_injective
statement:
theorem scale_injective (m : B) (hm : m ≠ 0) :
    Function.Injective (scale B m)
proof:
:= by
  intro p q hpq
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  apply (Polynomial.comp_C_mul_X_eq_zero_iff
    (p := p - q) (mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mpr hm)).mp
  change (p - q).comp (Polynomial.C m * Polynomial.X) = 0
  rw [Polynomial.sub_comp]
  change scale B m p - scale B m q = 0
  exact sub_eq_zero.mpr hpq

name: AlbertLean.Generic.NestedReciprocalField.numeratorMap_eq
statement:
theorem numeratorMap_eq (m : B) : numeratorMap B m =
    (Polynomial.eval₂RingHom (algebraMap B (Omega B)) (T B)⁻¹).comp
      (scale B m)
proof:
:= by
  ext
  · simp [numeratorMap, scale]
  · simp [numeratorMap, scale, div_eq_mul_inv]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.NestedReciprocalField.numeratorMap_injective
statement:
theorem numeratorMap_injective (m : B) (hm : m ≠ 0) :
    Function.Injective (numeratorMap B m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [numeratorMap_eq]
  exact (evalInvT_injective B).comp (scale_injective B m hm)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.NestedReciprocalField.reciprocalHom_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp] theorem reciprocalHom_algebraMap (m : B) (hm : m ≠ 0)
    (p : Polynomial B) :
    reciprocalHom B m hm (algebraMap (Polynomial B) (Omega B) p) =
      numeratorMap B m p
proof:
:= by
  exact IsFractionRing.lift_algebraMap _ _

name: AlbertLean.Generic.NestedReciprocalField.reciprocalHom_base
statement:
@[simp] theorem reciprocalHom_base (m : B) (hm : m ≠ 0) (b : B) :
    reciprocalHom B m hm (algebraMap B (Omega B) b) =
      algebraMap B (Omega B) b
proof:
:= by
  rw [← polynomialMap_C B b, reciprocalHom_algebraMap]
  simp [numeratorMap]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.NestedReciprocalField.reciprocalHom_T
statement:
@[simp] theorem reciprocalHom_T (m : B) (hm : m ≠ 0) :
    reciprocalHom B m hm (T B) = algebraMap B (Omega B) m / T B
proof:
:= by
  simp [T, numeratorMap]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.NestedReciprocalField.reciprocalHom_involutive
statement:
theorem reciprocalHom_involutive (m : B) (hm : m ≠ 0) :
    (reciprocalHom B m hm).comp (reciprocalHom B m hm) = RingHom.id _
proof:
:= by
  apply IsFractionRing.ringHom_ext (A := Polynomial B)
  have h : ((reciprocalHom B m hm).comp (reciprocalHom B m hm)).comp
      (algebraMap (Polynomial B) (Omega B)) =
      algebraMap (Polynomial B) (Omega B) := by
    ext b
    · simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, polynomialMap_C, reciprocalHom_base]
    · change reciprocalHom B m hm (reciprocalHom B m hm (T B)) = T B
      rw [reciprocalHom_T, map_div₀, reciprocalHom_base, reciprocalHom_T]
      exact div_div_cancel₀ ((map_ne_zero (algebraMap B (Omega B))).mpr hm)
  intro p
  exact RingHom.congr_fun h p

name: AlbertLean.Generic.NestedReciprocalField.reciprocalEquiv_T
statement:
@[simp] theorem reciprocalEquiv_T (m : B) (hm : m ≠ 0) :
    reciprocalEquiv B m hm (T B) = algebraMap B (Omega B) m / T B
proof:
:=
  reciprocalHom_T B m hm

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceVectorPairDephase.evenSourceAut_apply_v
statement:
@[simp] theorem evenSourceAut_apply_v (A B : VCoord K) (rho : K)
    (hA : nV A ≠ 0) (hB : nV B ≠ 0)
    (hrho : rho ^ 2 = nV A * nV B) (hrho0 : rho ≠ 0) (x : JCoord K) :

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceVectorPairDephase.evenSourceAut_apply_diagonal
statement:
@[simp] theorem evenSourceAut_apply_diagonal (A B : VCoord K) (rho : K)

    (hrho : rho ^ 2 = nV A * nV B) (hrho0 : rho ≠ 0) (x : JCoord K) :
    (((evenSourceAut A B rho hA hB hrho hrho0).linear x).d1,

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealCayleyExtensionAgreement.extensionPoint_denominator_ne_zero
statement:
theorem extensionPoint_denominator_ne_zero (c : Fin 3 → E)
    (hden : Matrix.det (1 + skew (c 0) (c 1) (c 2)) ≠ 0) :
    ∀ r, Matrix.det (1 + skew
      (extensionPoint c r 0) (extensionPoint c r 1)
      (extensionPoint c r 2)) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hz : skew (0 : E) 0 0 = 0 := by
    ext i j
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [skew]
  intro r
  fin_cases r
  · simpa [extensionPoint] using hden
  · simp [extensionPoint, hz]
  · simp [extensionPoint, hz]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealCayleyExtensionAgreement.evaluatedAlong_eq_right_comp_rawToField
statement:
theorem evaluatedAlong_eq_right_comp_rawToField
    (left right : FunctionField k →+* E)
    (hscalar : left.comp (scalarMap k) = right.comp (scalarMap k))
    (c : Fin 3 → E)
    (htransport : ∀ r i,
      ringConjugate (cayley (skew (c 0) (c 1) (c 2)))
          (left.mapMatrix (universalFamily k r i)) =
        right.mapMatrix (universalFamily k r i)) :
    evaluationAlong (left.comp (scalarMap k))
        (evaluatedConjugatedFamily k left (extensionPoint c)) =
      right.comp (rawToField k)
proof:
:= by
  apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
  · intro x
    have hs := DFunLike.congr_fun hscalar x
    simpa [evaluationAlong, scalarMap] using hs
  · intro q
    cases q with
    | entry r i a b =>
        simp only [evaluationAlong, MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_X', RingHom.comp_apply]
        change evaluatedConjugatedFamily k left (extensionPoint c) r i a b =
          right (rawToField k (universalMatrix r i a b))
        have h := congrFun (congrFun (htransport r i) a) b
        simpa [evaluatedConjugatedFamily, extensionPoint, universalFamily] using h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealCayleyExtensionAgreement.cayley_extension_agreement
statement:
theorem cayley_extension_agreement
    (left right : FunctionField k →+* E)
    (hscalar : left.comp (scalarMap k) = right.comp (scalarMap k))
    (a b : CoordinateRing k) (hb : rawToField k b ≠ 0)
    (hinv : IsConstantInvariant k (rawToField k a / rawToField k b))
    (c : Fin 3 → E)
    (hden : Matrix.det (1 + skew (c 0) (c 1) (c 2)) ≠ 0)
    (htransport : ∀ r i,
      ringConjugate (cayley (skew (c 0) (c 1) (c 2)))
          (left.mapMatrix (universalFamily k r i)) =
        right.mapMatrix (universalFamily k r i)) :
    left (rawToField k a / rawToField k b) =
      right (rawToField k a / rawToField k b)
proof:
:= by
  have hcross0 := crossExpression_eq_zero_of_constantInvariant k a b hb hinv
  let x := extensionPoint c
  let hxden := extensionPoint_denominator_ne_zero c hden
  have hev := congrArg (evalAway left x hxden) hcross0
  rw [map_zero, evalAway_crossExpression] at hev
  have hmaps := evaluatedAlong_eq_right_comp_rawToField
    k left right hscalar c htransport
  have hma := DFunLike.congr_fun hmaps a
  have hmb := DFunLike.congr_fun hmaps b
  have hcross :
      right (rawToField k a) * left (rawToField k b) -
        right (rawToField k b) * left (rawToField k a) = 0 := by
    simpa [x, hma, hmb] using hev
  have hlb : left (rawToField k b) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [map_zero] using left.injective.ne hb
  have hrb : right (rawToField k b) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [map_zero] using right.injective.ne hb
  rw [map_div₀, map_div₀]
  apply (div_eq_div_iff hlb hrb).2
  have := sub_eq_zero.mp hcross
  simpa [mul_comm] using this.symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericTauLedger.f0FirstTitsEquiv_one
statement:
theorem f0FirstTitsEquiv_one :

:= by

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericTauLedger.sourceTauEquiv_one

proof:

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericTauLedger.labelledLedger_mapTriple
statement:
theorem labelledLedger_mapTriple (T : Fin 3 → JCoord K) :
    labelledLedger (mapTriple T) = sourceLabelledLedger T
proof:
:= by
  rw [LabelledLedger.mk.injEq]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · funext i j
    simp only [labelledLedger, sourceLabelledLedger, mapTriple]
    rw [← sourceTauEquiv_projector, ← sourceTauEquiv_projector,
      ← sourceTauEquiv_product, sourceTauEquiv_trace]
  · funext j l
    simp only [labelledLedger, sourceLabelledLedger, mapTriple]
    rw [← sourceTauEquiv_projector, ← sourceTauEquiv_projector,
      ← sourceTauEquiv_product, sourceTauEquiv_trace]
  · funext l i
    simp only [labelledLedger, sourceLabelledLedger, mapTriple]
    rw [← sourceTauEquiv_projector, ← sourceTauEquiv_projector,
      ← sourceTauEquiv_product, sourceTauEquiv_trace]
  · funext i j l
    simp only [labelledLedger, sourceLabelledLedger, mapTriple]
    simp_rw [← sourceTauEquiv_projector]
    rw [← sourceTauEquiv_product, ← sourceTauEquiv_product,
      sourceTauEquiv_trace]
    simp_rw [← sourceTauEquiv_product, sourceTauEquiv_trace]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericTauLedger.sourceProjector_eq_spectralProjector
