name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericTauLedger.sourceLabelledLedger_residual
statement:
theorem sourceLabelledLedger_residual (a b : JCoord K) :
    sourceLabelledLedger (residualTriple a b) =
      copySourceLedger (sourceLedger a b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [LabelledLedger.mk.injEq]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · funext i j
    change sourceTrace
        (sourceProduct (sourceProjector (diagonal (-1) 0 1) i)
          (sourceProjector a j)) =
      sourceTraceForm (diagonalUnit i) (spectralProjector a j)
    rw [sourceProjector_eq_spectralProjector,
      sourceProjector_eq_spectralProjector, diagonal_projectors,
      sourceTrace_product_eq_traceForm]
  · funext j l
    change sourceTrace (sourceProduct (sourceProjector a j)
        (sourceProjector b l)) =
      sourceTraceForm (spectralProjector a j) (spectralProjector b l)
    rw [sourceProjector_eq_spectralProjector,
      sourceProjector_eq_spectralProjector, sourceTrace_product_eq_traceForm]
  · funext l i
    change sourceTrace (sourceProduct (sourceProjector b l)
        (sourceProjector (diagonal (-1) 0 1) i)) =
      sourceTraceForm (spectralProjector b l) (diagonalUnit i)
    rw [sourceProjector_eq_spectralProjector,
      sourceProjector_eq_spectralProjector, diagonal_projectors,
      sourceTrace_product_eq_traceForm]
  · funext i j l
    simp only [sourceLabelledLedger, residualTriple, copySourceLedger,
      sourceLedger, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
      Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.vecHead, Matrix.vecTail,
      Function.comp_apply, Fin.succ_zero_eq_one]
    simp_rw [sourceProjector_eq_spectralProjector]
    rw [diagonal_projectors]
    simp_rw [sourceTrace_product_eq_traceForm]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowNormalization.anchor_properties
statement:
theorem anchor_properties (a0 b0 : Mat3 K)
    (ha0 : a0.det ≠ 0) (hb0 : b0.det = a0.det) :
    (anchor a0 b0).det = 1 ∧ b0 * anchor a0 b0 = a0 ∧
      (a0⁻¹ * b0) * anchor a0 b0 = 1 ∧
      anchor a0 b0 * (a0⁻¹ * b0) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hb : IsUnit b0.det := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (hb0 ▸ ha0)
  have ha : IsUnit a0.det := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr ha0
  dsimp only [anchor]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Matrix.det_mul, ← hb0]
    exact Matrix.det_nonsing_inv_mul_det b0 hb
  · rw [← mul_assoc, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv b0 hb, one_mul]
  · rw [mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc b0, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv b0 hb,
      one_mul, Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul a0 ha]
  · rw [mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc a0, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv a0 ha,
      one_mul, Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul b0 hb]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowNormalization.anchor_unique
statement:
theorem anchor_unique (a0 b0 h : Mat3 K) (hb0 : b0.det ≠ 0)
    (hh : b0 * h = a0) : h = anchor a0 b0
proof:
:= by
  have hm := congrArg (fun Z : Mat3 K => b0⁻¹ * Z) hh
  simpa only [anchor, ← mul_assoc,
    Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul b0 (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hb0), one_mul] using hm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowNormalization.inverse_after_right_change
statement:
theorem inverse_after_right_change (b g h : Mat3 K)
    (hb : b.det ≠ 0) (hgh : g * h = 1) :
    (b * h)⁻¹ = g * b⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.inv_eq_left_inv
  rw [mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc b⁻¹,
    Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul b (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hb), one_mul, hgh]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowNormalization.cslotSum_right_change
statement:
theorem cslotSum_right_change
    (b0 b1 b2 A0 A1 A2 g h : Mat3 K)
    (hb0 : b0.det ≠ 0) (hb1 : b1.det ≠ 0) (hb2 : b2.det ≠ 0)
    (hgh : g * h = 1) :
    cslotSum (b0 * h) (b1 * h) (b2 * h) A0 A1 A2 =
      g * cslotSum b0 b1 b2 A0 A1 A2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cslotSum, inverse_after_right_change b0 g h hb0 hgh,
    inverse_after_right_change b1 g h hb1 hgh,
    inverse_after_right_change b2 g h hb2 hgh, mul_add, mul_assoc]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowNormalization.normalized_second_components
statement:
theorem normalized_second_components
    (a0 b0 b1 b2 : Mat3 K) (ha0 : a0.det ≠ 0)
    (hb0 : b0.det = a0.det) (hsum : b0 + b1 + b2 = 0) :
    b0 * anchor a0 b0 = a0 ∧
      b1 * anchor a0 b0 = normalizedX a0 b0 b1 * a0 ∧
      b2 * anchor a0 b0 = -(1 + normalizedX a0 b0 b1) * a0
proof:
:= by
  have h0 := (anchor_properties a0 b0 ha0 hb0).2.1
  have h1 : b1 * anchor a0 b0 = normalizedX a0 b0 b1 * a0 := by
    dsimp only [normalizedX]
    rw [mul_assoc, Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul a0 (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr ha0), mul_one]
  refine ⟨h0, h1, ?_⟩
  have hs := congrArg (fun Z : Mat3 K => Z * anchor a0 b0) hsum
  simp only [add_mul, zero_mul, h0, h1] at hs
  have ht : b2 * anchor a0 b0 = -(a0 + normalizedX a0 b0 b1 * a0) := by
    apply eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left
    simpa only [add_comm] using hs
  simpa only [neg_mul, add_mul, one_mul] using ht

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowNormalization.componentSolution_of_raw
statement:
theorem componentSolution_of_raw
    (a0 a1 a2 b0 b1 b2 : Mat3 K)
    (ha0 : a0.det ≠ 0) (ha1 : a1.det ≠ 0) (ha2 : a2.det ≠ 0)
    (hb0 : b0.det = a0.det) (hb1 : b1.det = a1.det) (hb2 : b2.det = a2.det)
    (hbsum : b0 + b1 + b2 = 0)
    (hcsum : cslotSum b0 b1 b2 a0.adjugate a1.adjugate a2.adjugate = 0)
    (hden : (reconstructionDenominator (componentU a0 a1 a2) (componentV a0 a1)
      (a1.det / a0.det) (a2.det / a0.det) (Matrix.trace (normalizedX a0 b0 b1))).det ≠ 0) :
    ComponentSolution a0 a1 a2 (normalizedX a0 b0 b1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hd, _, hgh, _⟩ := anchor_properties a0 b0 ha0 hb0
  obtain ⟨h0, h1, h2⟩ := normalized_second_components a0 b0 b1 b2 ha0 hb0 hbsum
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, hden⟩
  · rw [← h1, Matrix.det_mul, hd, mul_one, hb1]
  · rw [← h2, Matrix.det_mul, hd, mul_one, hb2]
  · have ht := cslotSum_right_change b0 b1 b2 a0.adjugate a1.adjugate a2.adjugate
      (a0⁻¹ * b0) (anchor a0 b0) (hb0 ▸ ha0) (hb1 ▸ ha1) (hb2 ▸ ha2) hgh
    rw [h0, h1, h2, hcsum, mul_zero] at ht
    exact ht

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawScalarTransport.polynomialCoefficientMap_C
statement:
@[simp] theorem polynomialCoefficientMap_C (κ : k →+* K) (a : k) :
    polynomialCoefficientMap k K κ (MvPolynomial.C a) = MvPolynomial.C (κ a)
proof:
:= by
  simp [polynomialCoefficientMap]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawScalarTransport.polynomialCoefficientMap_X
statement:
@[simp] theorem polynomialCoefficientMap_X (κ : k →+* K)
    (q : RawCoordinate) :
    polynomialCoefficientMap k K κ (MvPolynomial.X q) = MvPolynomial.X q
proof:
:= by
  simp [polynomialCoefficientMap]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawScalarTransport.map_ringMatrix
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.ext
  intro a b
  change polynomialCoefficientMap k K κ (ringMatrix x a b) =
    ringMatrix (polynomialCoefficientMap k K κ ∘ x) a b
  rcases a with a | a <;> rcases b with b | b <;>
    fin_cases a <;> fin_cases b <;>
    simp [ringMatrix, ringHat, Matrix.fromBlocks, Matrix.transpose,
      Function.comp_apply]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawScalarTransport.map_matrixCoordinates
statement:
private theorem map_matrixCoordinates (κ : k →+* K)
    (A : Matrix (Sum (Fin 3) (Fin 3)) (Sum (Fin 3) (Fin 3)) (CR k))
    (c : Index) :
    polynomialCoefficientMap k K κ (matrixCoordinates A c) =
      matrixCoordinates ((polynomialCoefficientMap k K κ).mapMatrix A) c
proof:
:= by
  rcases c with ⟨a, b⟩ | c
  · rfl
  · rcases c with c | c <;> fin_cases c <;>
      simp [matrixCoordinates]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawScalarTransport.mapMatrix_smul
statement:
private theorem mapMatrix_smul (κ : k →+* K) (a : CR k)
    (A : Matrix (Sum (Fin 3) (Fin 3)) (Sum (Fin 3) (Fin 3)) (CR k)) :
    (polynomialCoefficientMap k K κ).mapMatrix (a • A) =
      polynomialCoefficientMap k K κ a •
        (polynomialCoefficientMap k K κ).mapMatrix A
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.ext
  intro i j
  change polynomialCoefficientMap k K κ (a * A i j) =
    polynomialCoefficientMap k K κ a * polynomialCoefficientMap k K κ (A i j)
  exact map_mul (polynomialCoefficientMap k K κ) a (A i j)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawScalarTransport.map_productCoordinate
statement:
private theorem map_productCoordinate (κ : k →+* K)
    (x y : Coordinates (CR k)) (c : Index) :
    polynomialCoefficientMap k K κ (productCoordinate k x y c) =
      productCoordinate K
        (polynomialCoefficientMap k K κ ∘ x)
        (polynomialCoefficientMap k K κ ∘ y) c
proof:
:= by
  rw [productCoordinate, productCoordinate, map_matrixCoordinates]
  simp only [mapMatrix_smul, map_add, map_mul, map_ringMatrix]
  rw [show polynomialCoefficientMap k K κ
      (MvPolynomial.C ((2 : k)⁻¹) : CR k) =
        (MvPolynomial.C ((2 : K)⁻¹) : CR K) by
      simp only [polynomialCoefficientMap_C, map_inv₀, map_ofNat]]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawScalarTransport.polynomialCoefficientMap_universalPoint
statement:
@[simp] theorem polynomialCoefficientMap_universalPoint
    (κ : k →+* K) (r i : Fin 3) (c : Index) :
    polynomialCoefficientMap k K κ (universalPoint k r i c) =
      universalPoint K r i c
proof:
:= by
  simp [polynomialCoefficientMap, universalPoint]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawScalarTransport.polynomialCoefficientMap_equation
statement:
theorem polynomialCoefficientMap_equation (κ : k →+* K)
    (q : EquationIndex) :
    polynomialCoefficientMap k K κ (equation k q) = equation K q
proof:
:= by
  cases q with
  | idempotence r i c =>
      simp only [equation, map_sub, map_productCoordinate,
        polynomialCoefficientMap_universalPoint]
      have hpoint :
          polynomialCoefficientMap k K κ ∘ universalPoint k r i =
            universalPoint K r i := by
        funext d
        exact polynomialCoefficientMap_universalPoint k K κ r i d
      rw [hpoint]
  | traceOne r i =>
      simp [equation, traceCoordinate, polynomialCoefficientMap_universalPoint]
  | sumOne r c =>
      rcases c with ⟨a, b⟩ | c
      · simp [equation, unitCoordinate,
          polynomialCoefficientMap_universalPoint]
      · simp [equation, unitCoordinate,
          polynomialCoefficientMap_universalPoint]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawScalarTransport.rawFrameIdeal_le_comap
statement:
theorem rawFrameIdeal_le_comap (κ : k →+* K) :
    rawFrameIdeal k ≤
      (rawFrameIdeal K).comap (polynomialCoefficientMap k K κ)
proof:
:= by
  apply Ideal.span_le.2
  rintro x ⟨q, rfl⟩
  change polynomialCoefficientMap k K κ (equation k q) ∈ rawFrameIdeal K
  rw [polynomialCoefficientMap_equation]
  exact Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self q)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawScalarTransport.rawFrameRadical_le_comap
statement:
theorem rawFrameRadical_le_comap (κ : k →+* K) :
    (rawFrameIdeal k).radical ≤
      (rawFrameIdeal K).radical.comap (polynomialCoefficientMap k K κ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.comap_radical]
  exact Ideal.radical_mono (rawFrameIdeal_le_comap k K κ)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawScalarTransport.reducedCoefficientMapOf_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem reducedCoefficientMapOf_mk (κ : k →+* K) (x : CR k) :
    reducedCoefficientMapOf k K κ (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ x) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (polynomialCoefficientMap k K κ x)
proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawScalarTransport.rawToFunction_eq_zero_of_mem
statement:
theorem rawToFunction_eq_zero_of_mem (x : CR k)
    (hx : x ∈ (rawFrameIdeal k).radical) : rawToFunction k x = 0
proof:
:= by
  change algebraMap (RR k) (FF k) (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ x) = 0
  rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr hx, map_zero]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawScalarTransport.polynomial_evaluation_square
statement:
theorem polynomial_evaluation_square :
    (polynomialEvaluation k K φ).comp
        (polynomialCoefficientMap k K (originalCoefficientEmbedding k K φ)) =
      φ.comp (rawToFunction k)
proof:
:= by
  apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
  · intro a
    simp [polynomialEvaluation, polynomialCoefficientMap,
      originalCoefficientEmbedding, evaluationAlong]
  · intro q
    rcases q with ⟨r, i, c⟩
    simp [polynomialEvaluation, polynomialCoefficientMap, genericPointAlong,
      evaluationAlong, universalPoint]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawScalarTransport.rawFrameIdeal_le_evaluationKer
statement:
theorem rawFrameIdeal_le_evaluationKer :
    rawFrameIdeal K ≤ RingHom.ker (polynomialEvaluation k K φ)
proof:
:= by
  apply Ideal.span_le.2
  rintro x ⟨q, rfl⟩
  apply RingHom.mem_ker.mpr
  rw [← polynomialCoefficientMap_equation k K
    (originalCoefficientEmbedding k K φ) q]
  change
    ((polynomialEvaluation k K φ).comp
      (polynomialCoefficientMap k K (originalCoefficientEmbedding k K φ)))
        (equation k q) = 0
  rw [DFunLike.congr_fun (polynomial_evaluation_square k K φ) (equation k q)]
  rw [RingHom.comp_apply]
  rw [rawToFunction_eq_zero_of_mem k (equation k q)
    (Ideal.le_radical (Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self q))), map_zero]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawScalarTransport.rawFrameRadical_le_evaluationKer
statement:
theorem rawFrameRadical_le_evaluationKer :
    (rawFrameIdeal K).radical ≤
      RingHom.ker (polynomialEvaluation k K φ)
proof:
:= by
  exact ((RingHom.ker_isPrime (polynomialEvaluation k K φ)).isRadical.radical_le_iff).2
    (rawFrameIdeal_le_evaluationKer k K φ)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawScalarTransport.evaluation_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem evaluation_mk (x : CR K) :
    evaluation k K φ (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ x) = polynomialEvaluation k K φ x
proof:
:=
  Ideal.Quotient.lift_mk _ _ _

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawScalarTransport.reduced_evaluation_square
statement:
theorem reduced_evaluation_square :
    (evaluation k K φ).comp (reducedCoefficientMap k K φ) =
      φ.comp (reducedInclusion k)
proof:
:= by
  apply Ideal.Quotient.ringHom_ext
  apply DFunLike.ext _ _
  intro x
  simp only [RingHom.comp_apply]
  rw [reducedCoefficientMap, reducedCoefficientMapOf_mk, evaluation_mk]
  change polynomialEvaluation k K φ
      (polynomialCoefficientMap k K (originalCoefficientEmbedding k K φ) x) =
    φ (rawToFunction k x)
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun (polynomial_evaluation_square k K φ) x

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawScalarTransport.reducedCoefficientMap_injective
statement:
theorem reducedCoefficientMap_injective :
    Function.Injective (reducedCoefficientMap k K φ)
proof:
:= by
  exact injective_of_evaluation_square
    (reducedInclusion k) (IsFractionRing.injective _ _)
    (reducedCoefficientMap k K φ) (evaluation k K φ) φ
    (reduced_evaluation_square k K φ)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawScalarTransport.reducedCoefficientMap_ne_zero
statement:
theorem reducedCoefficientMap_ne_zero (b : RR k)
    (hb : reducedInclusion k b ≠ 0) :
    reducedCoefficientMap k K φ b ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hb0 : b ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hb
    rw [h, map_zero]
  simpa only [map_zero] using (reducedCoefficientMap_injective k K φ).ne hb0

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawScalarTransport.evaluation_reducedCoefficientMap_ne_zero
statement:
theorem evaluation_reducedCoefficientMap_ne_zero (b : RR k)
    (hb : reducedInclusion k b ≠ 0) :
    evaluation k K φ (reducedCoefficientMap k K φ b) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  change ((evaluation k K φ).comp (reducedCoefficientMap k K φ)) b ≠ 0
  rw [DFunLike.congr_fun (reduced_evaluation_square k K φ) b]
  rw [RingHom.comp_apply]
  simpa only [map_zero] using φ.injective.ne hb

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.M3JordanSubgroup.conjugationLinear_comp_inverse
statement:
theorem conjugationLinear_comp_inverse (Q : Mat3 k) (hQ : Matrix.det Q ≠ 0) :
    (conjugationLinear Q).comp (conjugationLinear Q⁻¹) = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro A
  change Q * (Q⁻¹ * A * (Q⁻¹)⁻¹) * Q⁻¹ = A
  calc
    Q * (Q⁻¹ * A * (Q⁻¹)⁻¹) * Q⁻¹ =
        (Q * Q⁻¹) * A * ((Q⁻¹)⁻¹ * Q⁻¹) := by
          simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = (Q * Q⁻¹) * A * (Q * Q⁻¹) := by
      rw [Matrix.nonsing_inv_nonsing_inv Q (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hQ)]
    _ = A := by
      rw [Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv Q (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hQ)]
      simp

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.M3JordanSubgroup.conjugationLinear_inverse_comp
statement:
theorem conjugationLinear_inverse_comp (Q : Mat3 k) (hQ : Matrix.det Q ≠ 0) :
    (conjugationLinear Q⁻¹).comp (conjugationLinear Q) = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro A
  change Q⁻¹ * (Q * A * Q⁻¹) * (Q⁻¹)⁻¹ = A
  calc
    Q⁻¹ * (Q * A * Q⁻¹) * (Q⁻¹)⁻¹ =
        (Q⁻¹ * Q) * A * (Q⁻¹ * (Q⁻¹)⁻¹) := by
          simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = (Q⁻¹ * Q) * A * (Q⁻¹ * Q) := by
      rw [Matrix.nonsing_inv_nonsing_inv Q (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hQ)]
    _ = A := by
      rw [Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul Q (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hQ)]
      simp

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.M3JordanSubgroup.conjugationEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem conjugationEquiv_apply (Q : Mat3 k) (hQ : Matrix.det Q ≠ 0)
    (A : Mat3 k) : conjugationEquiv Q hQ A = Q * A * Q⁻¹
proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.M3JordanSubgroup.transposeLinearEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem transposeLinearEquiv_apply (A : Mat3 k) :
    transposeLinearEquiv A = A.transpose
proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.M3JordanSubgroup.baseCoordLinear_glAut_single
statement:
theorem baseCoordLinear_glAut_single (Q : Mat3 k) (hQ : Q.det ≠ 0)
    (a b i j : Fin 3) :
    baseCoordLinear (glAut Q hQ) (Pi.single (a,b) 1) (i,j) =
      Q i a * Q⁻¹ b j
proof:
:= by
  change ((Q * (coordEquiv (R := k)).symm (Pi.single (a,b) (1 : k)) * Q⁻¹) : Mat3 k) i j = _
  simp [Matrix.mul_apply, coordEquiv_symm_apply, Pi.single_apply, Prod.mk.injEq, ite_and]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.M3JordanSubgroup.baseCoordLinear_transpose_single
statement:
theorem baseCoordLinear_transpose_single (a b i j : Fin 3) :
    baseCoordLinear (transposeAut (k := k)) (Pi.single (a,b) 1) (i,j) =
      (Pi.single (a,b) (1 : k) : Coord k) (j,i)
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.M3JordanSubgroup.extension_glAut
statement:
theorem extension_glAut (Q : Mat3 k) (hQ : Matrix.det Q ≠ 0) (A : Mat3 R) :
    linearEquiv (R := R) (glAut Q hQ) A =
      (algebraMap k R).mapMatrix Q * A * (algebraMap k R).mapMatrix Q⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.ext
  intro i j
  change coordLinearEquiv (R := R) (glAut Q hQ) (coordEquiv A) (i,j) = _
  rw [coordLinearEquiv_apply_coordinate]
  change (∑ q : Ix, A q.1 q.2 * algebraMap k R
      (baseCoordLinear (glAut Q hQ) (Pi.single q 1) (i,j))) =
    ∑ b : Fin 3, (∑ a : Fin 3,
      algebraMap k R (Q i a) * A a b) * algebraMap k R (Q⁻¹ b j)
  simp_rw [show ∀ q : Ix,
      baseCoordLinear (glAut Q hQ) (Pi.single q 1) (i,j) =
        Q i q.1 * Q⁻¹ q.2 j by
    rintro ⟨a,b⟩
    exact baseCoordLinear_glAut_single Q hQ a b i j]
  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type, Finset.sum_comm]
  simp only [map_mul, Finset.sum_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro b _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a _
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.M3JordanSubgroup.extension_transposeAut
statement:
theorem extension_transposeAut (A : Mat3 R) :
    linearEquiv (R := R) (transposeAut (k := k)) A = A.transpose
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.ext
  intro i j
  change coordLinearEquiv (R := R) (transposeAut (k := k)) (coordEquiv A) (i,j) = _
  rw [coordLinearEquiv_apply_coordinate]
  change (∑ q : Ix, A q.1 q.2 * algebraMap k R
      (baseCoordLinear (transposeAut (k := k)) (Pi.single q 1) (i,j))) = A j i
  simp_rw [show ∀ q : Ix,
      baseCoordLinear (transposeAut (k := k)) (Pi.single q 1) (i,j) =
        (Pi.single q (1 : k) : Coord k) (j,i) by
    rintro ⟨a,b⟩
    exact baseCoordLinear_transpose_single a b i j]
  simp [Pi.single_apply]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FixedDifferenceRingStages.mapV_sub
statement:
private theorem mapV_sub {S : Type v} [CommRing S] (f : R →+* S)
    (x y : VCoord R) : mapV f (x - y) = mapV f x - mapV f y
proof:
:= by
  apply VCoord.ext
  · exact map_sub f x.r y.r
  · exact map_sub f x.z y.z
  · funext i
    exact map_sub f (x.omega i) (y.omega i)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FixedDifferenceRingStages.mapV_smul
statement:
private theorem mapV_smul {S : Type v} [CommRing S] (f : R →+* S)
    (c : R) (x : VCoord R) : mapV f (c • x) = f c • mapV f x
proof:
:= by
  apply VCoord.ext
  · exact map_mul f c x.r
  · exact map_mul f c x.z
  · funext i
    exact map_mul f c (x.omega i)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FixedDifferenceRingStages.map_ringBV
statement:
private theorem map_ringBV {S : Type v} [CommRing S] (f : R →+* S)
    (x y : VCoord R) : f (ringBV x y) = ringBV (mapV f x) (mapV f y)
proof:
:= by
  simp [ringBV, mapV, BW]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FixedDifferenceRingStages.map_ringReflectV
statement:
private theorem map_ringReflectV {S : Type v} [CommRing S]
    [Algebra ℚ S] [Invertible (2 : S)] (f : R →+* S)
    (c : VCoord R) (nInv : R) (x : VCoord R) :
    mapV f (ringReflectV c nInv x) =
      ringReflectV (mapV f c) (f nInv) (mapV f x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ringReflectV, ringReflectV, mapV_sub, mapV_smul, map_mul, map_ringBV]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FixedDifferenceRingStages.map_plane
statement:
private theorem map_plane {S : Type v} [CommRing S] (f : R →+* S)
    (r z : R) : mapV f (plane r z) = plane (f r) (f z)
proof:
:= by
  apply VCoord.ext
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · funext i
    simp [mapV, plane]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FixedDifferenceRingStages.map_parity
statement:
private theorem map_parity {S : Type v} [CommRing S] (f : R →+* S) :
    mapV f (parity : VCoord R) = (parity : VCoord S)
proof:
:= by
  apply VCoord.ext
  · simp [mapV, parity]
  · simp [mapV, parity]
  · funext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [mapV, parity, wBasis]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FixedDifferenceRingStages.map_targetT
statement:
private theorem map_targetT {S : Type v} [CommRing S] (f : R →+* S) (a : R) :
    mapV f (targetT a) = targetT (f a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [targetT, targetT, map_plane, map_one]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FixedDifferenceRingStages.map_beta
proof:
:= by
  simp [beta]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FixedDifferenceRingStages.map_targetZ
statement:
private theorem map_targetZ {S : Type v} [CommRing S] (f : R →+* S)
    (twoInv aInv a h sigma : R) :
    mapV f (targetZ twoInv aInv a h sigma) =
      targetZ (f twoInv) (f aInv) (f a) (f h) (f sigma)
proof:
:= by

  simp

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FixedDifferenceRingStages.map_targetQ
statement:
private theorem map_targetQ {S : Type v} [CommRing S] (f : R →+* S)
    (twoInv aInv a h sigma : R) :
    mapV f (targetQ twoInv aInv a h sigma) =
      targetQ (f twoInv) (f aInv) (f a) (f h) (f sigma)
proof:

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FixedDifferenceRingStages.map_firstCenter
proof:
:= by
  rw [firstCenter, firstCenter, mapV_sub, map_targetT]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FixedDifferenceRingStages.map_stageOneVector
statement:
private theorem map_stageOneVector {S : Type v} [CommRing S]
    [Algebra ℚ S] [Invertible (2 : S)] (f : R →+* S)
    (v1 v2 : VCoord R) (a n1Inv : R) :
    mapV f (stageOneVector v1 v2 a n1Inv) =
      stageOneVector (mapV f v1) (mapV f v2) (f a) (f n1Inv)
proof:
:= by
  rw [stageOneVector, stageOneVector, map_ringReflectV, map_ringReflectV,
    map_parity, map_firstCenter, map_one]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FixedDifferenceRingStages.map_secondCenter
statement:
theorem map_secondCenter {S : Type v} [CommRing S] [Algebra ℚ S]
    [Invertible (2 : S)] (f : R →+* S)
    (v1 v2 : VCoord R) (twoInv aInv a h sigma n1Inv : R) :
    mapV f (secondCenter v1 v2 twoInv aInv a h sigma n1Inv) =
      secondCenter (mapV f v1) (mapV f v2) (f twoInv) (f aInv)
        (f a) (f h) (f sigma) (f n1Inv)
proof:
:= by
  rw [secondCenter, secondCenter, mapV_sub, secondRemainder, secondRemainder,
    mapV_sub, mapV_smul, map_stageOneVector, map_beta, map_targetT,
    map_targetQ]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FixedDifferenceRingStages.targetZ_field
statement:
private theorem targetZ_field (a h sigma : K) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    targetZ (2 : K)⁻¹ a⁻¹ a h sigma = targetSecond a h sigma
proof:
:= by
  apply VCoord.ext
  · simp [targetZ, targetSecond, targetB, targetC, plane, planeVector]
    field_simp [ha] <;> ring
  · simp [targetZ, targetSecond, targetB, targetC, plane, planeVector]
    field_simp <;> ring
  · funext i
    simp [targetZ, targetSecond, targetB, targetC, plane, planeVector]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FixedDifferenceRingStages.targets_field
statement:
theorem targets_field (a h sigma : K) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    targetT a = targetFirst a ∧
    targetZ (2 : K)⁻¹ a⁻¹ a h sigma = targetSecond a h sigma ∧
    targetQ (2 : K)⁻¹ a⁻¹ a h sigma = targetRemainder a h sigma
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rfl
  constructor
  · exact targetZ_field a h sigma ha
  · rw [targetQ, targetRemainder, targetZ_field a h sigma ha]
    have hc : beta (2 : K)⁻¹ a⁻¹ h = h / (2 * a) := by
      unfold beta
      field_simp [ha] <;> ring
    rw [hc]
    rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FixedDifferenceRingStages.stageOneVector_field
statement:
theorem stageOneVector_field (v1 v2 : VCoord K) (a : K)
    (hB1 : nV (firstCenter v1 a) ≠ 0) :
    stageOneVector v1 v2 a (nV (firstCenter v1 a))⁻¹ =
      evenV parityVector (firstCenter v1 a) v2
proof:
:= by
  unfold stageOneVector
  have hp : (nV (parityVector : VCoord K))⁻¹ = 1 := by simp
  change ringReflectV parityVector 1
      (ringReflectV (firstCenter v1 a) (nV (firstCenter v1 a))⁻¹ v2) = _
  rw [← hp, ringReflectV_eq, ringReflectV_eq, evenV]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FixedDifferenceRingStages.secondCenter_field
statement:
theorem secondCenter_field (v1 v2 : VCoord K) (a h sigma : K)
    (ha : a ≠ 0) (hB1 : nV (firstCenter v1 a) ≠ 0)
    (hpair : BV (targetFirst a)
      (evenV parityVector (firstCenter v1 a) v2) = h) :
    secondCenter v1 v2 (2 : K)⁻¹ a⁻¹ a h sigma
        (nV (firstCenter v1 a))⁻¹ =
      orthogonalRemainder (targetFirst a)
          (evenV parityVector (firstCenter v1 a) v2) -
        targetRemainder a h sigma
proof:
:= by
  rw [secondCenter, secondRemainder, stageOneVector_field v1 v2 a hB1]
  obtain ⟨ht, _, hq⟩ := targets_field a h sigma ha
  rw [ht, hq, orthogonalRemainder]
  congr 1
  simp [projectionCoeff, beta, targetFirst_norm, hpair]
  field_simp [ha] <;> ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceVectorPairFiniteDephase.evenSourceAut_diagonalUnit
statement:
theorem evenSourceAut_diagonalUnit (A B : VCoord K) (rho : K)
    (hA : nV A ≠ 0) (hB : nV B ≠ 0)
    (hr : rho^2 = nV A*nV B) (hr0 : rho ≠ 0) (i : Fin 3) :
    (evenSourceAut A B rho hA hB hr hr0).linear (diagonalUnit i) =
      diagonalUnit i
proof:
:= by
  change evenJEquiv A B rho hA hB hr hr0 (diagonalUnit i) = diagonalUnit i
  rw [evenJEquiv_apply]
  apply JCoord.ext
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · exact (evenVEquiv A B hA hB).map_zero
  · exact (evenSEquiv A B rho hr hr0).map_zero
  · exact (evenCEquiv A B rho hr hr0).map_zero

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceVectorPairFiniteDephase.sourceAutComp_fix_diagonalUnit
statement:
private theorem sourceAutComp_fix_diagonalUnit
    (g2 g1 : ResidualAction.SourceAut (K := K))
    (h1 : ∀ i, g1.linear (diagonalUnit i) = diagonalUnit i)
    (h2 : ∀ i, g2.linear (diagonalUnit i) = diagonalUnit i) :
    ∀ i, (sourceAutComp g2 g1).linear (diagonalUnit i) = diagonalUnit i
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  change g2.linear (g1.linear (diagonalUnit i)) = diagonalUnit i
  rw [h1 i, h2 i]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceVectorPairFiniteDephase.sourceAutComp_even_diagonal
statement:
private theorem sourceAutComp_even_diagonal
    (A1 B1 A2 B2 : VCoord K) (rho1 rho2 : K)
    (hA1 : nV A1 ≠ 0) (hB1 : nV B1 ≠ 0)
    (hr1 : rho1 ^ 2 = nV A1 * nV B1) (hrho1 : rho1 ≠ 0)
    (hA2 : nV A2 ≠ 0) (hB2 : nV B2 ≠ 0)
    (hr2 : rho2 ^ 2 = nV A2 * nV B2) (hrho2 : rho2 ≠ 0)
    (z : JCoord K) :
    let g1
proof:
:= evenSourceAut A1 B1 rho1 hA1 hB1 hr1 hrho1
    let g2 := evenSourceAut A2 B2 rho2 hA2 hB2 hr2 hrho2
    (((sourceAutComp g2 g1).linear z).d1,
      ((sourceAutComp g2 g1).linear z).d2,
      ((sourceAutComp g2 g1).linear z).d3) = (z.d1, z.d2, z.d3) := by
  dsimp only
  have h1 := evenSourceAut_apply_diagonal A1 B1 rho1 hA1 hB1 hr1 hrho1 z
  have h2 := evenSourceAut_apply_diagonal A2 B2 rho2 hA2 hB2 hr2 hrho2
    ((evenSourceAut A1 B1 rho1 hA1 hB1 hr1 hrho1).linear z)
  exact h2.trans h1

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceVectorPairFiniteDephase.exists_two_even_sourceAut
statement:
private theorem exists_two_even_sourceAut
    (x y : JCoord K) (t1 t2 : VCoord K)
    (A1 B1 A2 B2 : VCoord K) (rho1 rho2 : K)
    (hA1 : nV A1 ≠ 0) (hB1 : nV B1 ≠ 0)
    (hr1 : rho1 ^ 2 = nV A1 * nV B1) (hrho1 : rho1 ≠ 0)
    (hA2 : nV A2 ≠ 0) (hB2 : nV B2 ≠ 0)
    (hr2 : rho2 ^ 2 = nV A2 * nV B2) (hrho2 : rho2 ≠ 0)
    (hx : evenV A2 B2 (evenV A1 B1 x.v) = t1)
    (hy : evenV A2 B2 (evenV A1 B1 y.v) = t2) :
    ∃ g : ResidualAction.SourceAut (K := K),
      (∀ i, g.linear (diagonalUnit i) = diagonalUnit i) ∧
      (∀ z : JCoord K,
        ((g.linear z).d1, (g.linear z).d2, (g.linear z).d3) =
          (z.d1, z.d2, z.d3)) ∧
      (g.linear x).v = t1 ∧ (g.linear y).v = t2
proof:
:= by
  let g1 := evenSourceAut A1 B1 rho1 hA1 hB1 hr1 hrho1
  let g2 := evenSourceAut A2 B2 rho2 hA2 hB2 hr2 hrho2
  let g := sourceAutComp g2 g1
  refine ⟨g, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact sourceAutComp_fix_diagonalUnit g2 g1
      (evenSourceAut_diagonalUnit _ _ _ _ _ _ _)
      (evenSourceAut_diagonalUnit _ _ _ _ _ _ _)
  · intro z
    exact sourceAutComp_even_diagonal A1 B1 A2 B2 rho1 rho2
      hA1 hB1 hr1 hrho1 hA2 hB2 hr2 hrho2 z
  · change evenV A2 B2 (evenV A1 B1 x.v) = t1
    exact hx
  · change evenV A2 B2 (evenV A1 B1 y.v) = t2
    exact hy

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceVectorPairFiniteDephase.exists_common_field_sourceAut
statement:
theorem exists_common_field_sourceAut
    (x y : JCoord K) (ha : nV x.v ≠ 0)
    (hGram : 4*nV x.v*nV y.v - (BV x.v y.v)^2 ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (L : Type u) (_ : Field L) (_ : CharZero L)
      (f : K →+* L) (sigma : L) (g : ResidualAction.SourceAut (K := L)),
      Function.Injective f ∧
      sigma ^ 2 = f ((BV x.v y.v)^2 - 4*nV x.v*nV y.v) ∧
      sigma ≠ 0 ∧
      (∀ i, g.linear (diagonalUnit i) = diagonalUnit i) ∧
      (∀ z : JCoord L,
        ((g.linear z).d1,(g.linear z).d2,(g.linear z).d3) = (z.d1,z.d2,z.d3)) ∧
      (g.linear (mapSource f x)).v = targetFirst (f (nV x.v)) ∧
      (g.linear (mapSource f y)).v =
        targetSecond (f (nV x.v)) (f (BV x.v y.v)) sigma
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let d := (BV x.v y.v)^2 - 4*nV x.v*nV y.v
  have hd : d ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    apply hGram
    change (BV x.v y.v)^2 - 4*nV x.v*nV y.v = 0 at hz
    linear_combination -hz
  obtain ⟨E⟩ := oneRootField_nonempty K d
  letI : CharZero E.Carrier := charZero_of_embedding E.embedding
  let v1 := mapV E.embedding x.v
  let v2 := mapV E.embedding y.v
  have haE : nV v1 ≠ 0 := by
    rw [show nV v1 = E.embedding (nV x.v) from mapV_nV E.embedding x.v]
    exact fun hz => ha (E.embedding.injective (by simpa using hz))
  have hgE : 4*nV v1*nV v2 - (BV v1 v2)^2 ≠ 0 := by
    have he : 4*nV v1*nV v2 - (BV v1 v2)^2 =
        E.embedding (4*nV x.v*nV y.v - (BV x.v y.v)^2) := by
      simp only [v1, v2, mapV_nV, mapV_BV, map_sub, map_mul, map_pow,
        map_ofNat]
    rw [he]
    exact fun hz => hGram (E.embedding.injective (by simpa using hz))
  have hsE : E.root ^ 2 = (BV v1 v2)^2 - 4*nV v1*nV v2 := by
    simpa only [d, v1, v2, mapV_nV, mapV_BV, map_sub, map_mul, map_pow,
      map_ofNat] using E.root_sq
  obtain ⟨A1,B1,A2,B2,hA1,hB1,hA2,hB2,hv1,hv2⟩ :=
    exists_two_even_pairs_dephasing v1 v2 E.root haE hgE hsE
  let rad : Fin 2 → E.Carrier := ![nV A1*nV B1, nV A2*nV B2]
  obtain ⟨F⟩ := rootField_nonempty_of_fintype E.Carrier rad
  letI : CharZero F.Carrier := charZero_of_embedding F.embedding
  let j := F.embedding
  let f := F.embedding.comp E.embedding
  let a1 := mapV j A1
  let b1 := mapV j B1
  let a2 := mapV j A2
  let b2 := mapV j B2
  have nonzero (v : VCoord E.Carrier) (hv : nV v ≠ 0) :
      nV (mapV j v) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [mapV_nV]
    exact fun hz => hv (j.injective (by simpa using hz))
  have ha1 := nonzero A1 hA1
  have hb1 := nonzero B1 hB1
  have ha2 := nonzero A2 hA2
  have hb2 := nonzero B2 hB2
  have hr1 : (F.roots 0)^2 = nV a1*nV b1 := by
    simpa [a1,b1,j,rad] using F.roots_sq 0
  have hr2 : (F.roots 1)^2 = nV a2*nV b2 := by
    simpa [a2,b2,j,rad] using F.roots_sq 1
  have rho_nonzero (rho : F.Carrier) (A B : VCoord F.Carrier)
      (hA : nV A ≠ 0) (hB : nV B ≠ 0)
      (hr : rho^2 = nV A*nV B) : rho ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    have hzero : nV A*nV B = 0 := by rw [← hr,hz]; simp
    exact mul_ne_zero hA hB hzero
  have hs : (j E.root)^2 = f d := by
    simpa [j,f] using congrArg F.embedding E.root_sq
  have hs0 : j E.root ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    have he : f d = 0 := by rw [← hs,hz]; simp
    exact hd (f.injective (by simpa using he))
  have hv1F : evenV a2 b2 (evenV a1 b1 (mapSource f x).v) =
      targetFirst (f (nV x.v)) := by
    have H := congrArg (mapV j) hv1
    simp only [mapV_evenV, mapV_targetFirst, mapV_nV, mapV_comp] at H
    rw [mapSource_v]
    simpa [a1, b1, a2, b2, v1, f, j] using H
  have hv2F : evenV a2 b2 (evenV a1 b1 (mapSource f y).v) =
      targetSecond (f (nV x.v)) (f (BV x.v y.v)) (j E.root) := by
    have H := congrArg (mapV j) hv2
    simp only [mapV_evenV, mapV_targetSecond, mapV_nV, mapV_BV, mapV_comp] at H
    rw [mapSource_v]
    simpa [a1, b1, a2, b2, v1, v2, f, j] using H
  obtain ⟨g, hdiag, hdiagAll, hxF, hyF⟩ := exists_two_even_sourceAut
    (mapSource f x) (mapSource f y)
    (targetFirst (f (nV x.v)))
    (targetSecond (f (nV x.v)) (f (BV x.v y.v)) (j E.root))
    a1 b1 a2 b2 (F.roots 0) (F.roots 1)
    ha1 hb1 hr1 (rho_nonzero _ _ _ ha1 hb1 hr1)
    ha2 hb2 hr2 (rho_nonzero _ _ _ ha2 hb2 hr2) hv1F hv2F
  refine ⟨F.Carrier,inferInstance,inferInstance,f,j E.root,g,
    f.injective,hs,hs0,hdiag,hdiagAll,hxF,hyF⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GenericOpenAttachment.rootWeight_eq_actual_pair_ledger
statement:
theorem rootWeight_eq_actual_pair_ledger (i : Fin 3) :
    rootWeight k i = ProjectorBlockBridge.jordanTrace (K := Root k)
      ((rootCarrier k 0 i : Mat6 (Root k)) *
        (rootCarrier k 1 0 : Mat6 (Root k)))
proof:
:= by
  have hcoord := coordinateConjugate_first_projector
    (fun j => rootCarrier k 0 j) (rootCarrier k 1 0)
    (rootCarrier_laws k 0).1 (rootCarrier_laws k 0).2.2
    (rootPairU k) (rootPairV k) (rootWeight k)
    (rootWeight_eq_pairing k) (rootWeight_ne k)
    (rootFirst_compresses_left k) (rootFirst_compresses_right k)
  have hblock :
      weightedBlock
          (coordinateConjugate
            (weightedCoordinateEquiv (fun j => rootCarrier k 0 j)
              (rootCarrier_laws k 0).1 (rootCarrier_laws k 0).2.2
              (rootPairU k) (rootPairV k) (rootWeight k)
              (rootWeight_eq_pairing k) (rootWeight_ne k))
            (matrixAction (rootCarrier k 1 0 : Mat6 (Root k)))) i i =
        WeightedProjectorGauge.scalar2 (rootWeight k i) := by
    rw [hcoord]
    ext r s
    fin_cases r <;> fin_cases s <;>
      simp [weightedBlock, weightedPairIndex, weightedFirstAction,
        basisVector, Pi.single_apply, WeightedProjectorGauge.scalar2,
        Matrix.one_apply]
  exact diagonal_scalar_eq_actual_pair_ledger
    (fun j => rootCarrier k 0 j) (rootCarrier k 1 0)
    (rootCarrier_laws k 0).1 (rootCarrier_laws k 0).2.2
    (rootPairU k) (rootPairV k) (rootWeight k)
    (rootWeight_eq_pairing k) (rootWeight_ne k) i (rootWeight k i) hblock

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GenericOpenAttachment.rootQ_symplectic

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GenericOpenAttachment.rootSplitFrame_grouped
statement:
theorem rootSplitFrame_grouped (r i : Fin 3) :
    rootSplitFrame k r i = grouped
      (topLeft (rootSplitFrame k r i))
      (unhat (topRight (rootSplitFrame k r i)))
      (unhat (bottomLeft (rootSplitFrame k r i)))
proof:
:= by
  have hmem := SimilitudeConjugation.conjugate_mem
    (rootN k) (rootQ k) (1 : Root k) (rootNQ k)
    (by simpa using rootN_symplectic k) (rootCarrier k r i)
  exact (grouped_extract (rootSplitFrame k r i) hmem).symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GenericOpenAttachment.rootSplitFirst_standard

      (AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowProbeTrace.diagonalUnit i) 0 0
proof:

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GenericOpenAttachment.rootSplitSecond_grouped
statement:
theorem rootSplitSecond_grouped (j : Fin 3) :
    rootSplitFrame k 1 j = grouped (rootSplitSecondA k j) 0 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hQN, hNQ, hQ, hE, hF⟩ :=
    exists_actual_generic_common_splitter k
  have ha : rootSplitSecondA k j = f j := by
    change topLeft (rootSplitFrame k 1 j) = f j
    rw [show rootSplitFrame k 1 j = grouped (f j) 0 0 by
      simpa only [rootSplitFrame] using hF j]
    rfl
  rw [show rootSplitFrame k 1 j = grouped (f j) 0 0 by
    simpa only [rootSplitFrame] using hF j, ha]

theorem rootQEval_splitFrame (r i : Fin 3) :

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GenericOpenAttachment.rootQEval_splitSecondA
statement:

proof:
:= by

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GenericOpenAttachment.rootQEval_splitThirdA

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GenericOpenAttachment.rootQEval_splitEncoder
statement:
theorem rootQEval_splitEncoder :

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GenericOpenAttachment.rootQEval_chosenMinor
statement:

    rootQEval k FiniteQuadraticDiagnostic.chosenMinor = rootChosenMinor k
proof:
:= by

  have h0 := rootQEval_splitThirdU k 0
  have h1 := rootQEval_splitThirdU k 1
  rw [congrFun h0 0, congrFun h0 1, congrFun h1 0, congrFun h1 1]
  rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GenericOpenAttachment.map_adjugate_entry_root
statement:
private theorem map_adjugate_entry_root
    (M : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) FiniteQuadraticDiagnostic.Q) (i j : Fin 3) :
    rootQEval k (Matrix.adjugate M i j) =
      Matrix.adjugate ((rootQEval k).mapMatrix M) i j
proof:
:= by
  exact congrFun (congrFun (RingHom.map_adjugate (rootQEval k) M) i) j

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GenericOpenAttachment.rootQEval_diagnostic
statement:
theorem rootQEval_diagnostic :
    rootQEval k FiniteQuadraticDiagnostic.diagnostic =
      Matrix.det
          (rootGrading k * rootSplitEncoder k -
            rootSplitEncoder k * rootGrading k) *
        Matrix.adjugate (rootSplitThirdA k 0) 2 2 *
        Matrix.adjugate (rootSplitThirdA k 1) 2 2 *
        Matrix.adjugate (rootSplitThirdA k 2) 1 1 *
        rootChosenMinor k
proof:
:= by
  rw [FiniteQuadraticDiagnostic.diagnostic, map_mul, map_mul, map_mul, map_mul,
    RingHom.map_det]
  rw [map_sub, map_mul, map_mul, rootQEval_grading,
    rootQEval_splitEncoder]
  rw [show rootQEval k (Matrix.adjugate (FiniteQuadraticDiagnostic.splitThirdA 0) 2 2) =
      Matrix.adjugate (rootSplitThirdA k 0) 2 2 by
      rw [map_adjugate_entry_root, rootQEval_splitThirdA]]
  rw [show rootQEval k (Matrix.adjugate (FiniteQuadraticDiagnostic.splitThirdA 1) 2 2) =
      Matrix.adjugate (rootSplitThirdA k 1) 2 2 by
      rw [map_adjugate_entry_root, rootQEval_splitThirdA]]
  rw [show rootQEval k (Matrix.adjugate (FiniteQuadraticDiagnostic.splitThirdA 2) 1 1) =
      Matrix.adjugate (rootSplitThirdA k 2) 1 1 by
      rw [map_adjugate_entry_root, rootQEval_splitThirdA]]
  rw [rootQEval_chosenMinor]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GenericOpenAttachment.root_left_diagnostic_entries_ne
statement:
theorem root_left_diagnostic_entries_ne :
    Matrix.det
        (rootGrading k * rootSplitEncoder k -
          rootSplitEncoder k * rootGrading k) ≠ 0 ∧
    Matrix.adjugate (rootSplitThirdA k 0) 2 2 ≠ 0 ∧
    Matrix.adjugate (rootSplitThirdA k 1) 2 2 ≠ 0 ∧
    Matrix.adjugate (rootSplitThirdA k 2) 1 1 ≠ 0 ∧
    rootChosenMinor k ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := (rootDiagnostics_ne k).1
  rw [rootQEval_diagnostic] at h
  have h4 := left_ne_zero_of_mul h
  have hm := right_ne_zero_of_mul h
  have h3 := left_ne_zero_of_mul h4
  have ha2 := right_ne_zero_of_mul h4
  have h2 := left_ne_zero_of_mul h3
  have ha1 := right_ne_zero_of_mul h3
  have hd := left_ne_zero_of_mul h2
  have ha0 := right_ne_zero_of_mul h2
  exact ⟨hd, ha0, ha1, ha2, hm⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GenericOpenAttachment.root_left_template_opens
statement:
theorem root_left_template_opens :
    let f
proof:
:= rootSplitSecondA k
    let a := rootSplitThirdA k
    let u := rootSplitThirdU k
    Matrix.det
        (AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowProbeTrace.grading *
            AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowLabelledProbes.encoder (f 0) (f 2) -
          AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowLabelledProbes.encoder (f 0) (f 2) *
            AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowProbeTrace.grading) ≠ 0 ∧
      (∀ l, Matrix.adjugate (a l) ≠ 0) ∧
      (∃ p q, u 0 p * u 1 q - u 0 q * u 1 p ≠ 0) := by
  dsimp only
  obtain ⟨hd, ha0, ha1, ha2, hm⟩ := root_left_diagnostic_entries_ne k
  have matrix_ne_of_entry_ne {M : ScalarFibre.Mat3 (Root k)}
      {i j : Fin 3} (hij : M i j ≠ 0) : M ≠ 0 := by
    intro hM
    apply hij
    simpa only [Matrix.zero_apply] using
      congrArg (fun (N : ScalarFibre.Mat3 (Root k)) => N i j) hM
  have hA0 : Matrix.adjugate (rootSplitThirdA k 0) ≠ 0 :=
    matrix_ne_of_entry_ne ha0
  have hA1 : Matrix.adjugate (rootSplitThirdA k 1) ≠ 0 :=
    matrix_ne_of_entry_ne ha1
  have hA2 : Matrix.adjugate (rootSplitThirdA k 2) ≠ 0 :=
    matrix_ne_of_entry_ne ha2
  have hadj : ∀ l, Matrix.adjugate (rootSplitThirdA k l) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Fin.forall_fin_succ]
    refine ⟨hA0, ?_⟩
    rw [Fin.forall_fin_succ]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa only [Fin.succ_zero_eq_one] using hA1
    rw [Fin.forall_fin_succ]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa only [Fin.succ_zero_eq_one, Fin.succ_one_eq_two] using hA2
    intro i
    exact Fin.elim0 i
  refine ⟨?_, hadj, ⟨0, 1, ?_⟩⟩
  · simpa only [rootGrading, rootSplitEncoder,
      AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowLabelledProbes.encoder] using hd
  · simpa only [rootChosenMinor, mul_comm] using hm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.NonvanishingSeed.A_mul
statement:
theorem A_mul (i j : Fin 3) :
    A i * A j = if i = j then A i else 0
proof:
:= by
  calc
    A i * A j = R * e i * (S * R) * e j * S := by
      simp only [A, Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = R * (e i * e j) * S := by
      rw [S_mul_R]
      simp only [Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = if i = j then A i else 0 := by
      rw [e_mul]
      split_ifs <;> simp [A]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.NonvanishingSeed.A_sum

proof:
:= by

      simp only [A, Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.add_mul]
    _ = 1 := by rw [e_sum, Matrix.mul_one, R_mul_S]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.NonvanishingSeed.thirdFrame_laws
statement:
theorem thirdFrame_laws :
    (∀ i, (thirdFrame i : Mat6 ℚ) * thirdFrame i = thirdFrame i) ∧
    (∀ i, jordanTrace (thirdFrame i : Mat6 ℚ) = 1) ∧
    ((thirdFrame 0 : Mat6 ℚ) + thirdFrame 1 + thirdFrame 2 = 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hraw : IsRawFrameFamily
      (fun _ i => encode (thirdFrame i)) := by
    convert (inverse_standard_isRaw ℚ thirdAut) using 1
    ext r i c
    change encode (thirdFrame i) c =
      encode (thirdAut.linear.symm (standardCarrierProjector i)) c
    rfl
  simpa only [decode_encode] using
    (actual_frame_laws (fun _ i => encode (thirdFrame i)) hraw 0)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.NonvanishingSeed.seedPoint_isRaw
statement: theorem seedPoint_isRaw : IsRawFrameFamily seedPoint
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro r i
    change coordinateJordan (encode (seedCarrier r i))
      (encode (seedCarrier r i)) = encode (seedCarrier r i)
    apply decode_injective
    rw [decode_coordinateJordan, decode_encode]
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [coe_jordan]
    fin_cases r
    · change matrixJordan (firstFrame i : Mat6 ℚ) (firstFrame i) = firstFrame i
      rw [matrixJordan_self₆, firstFrame_idempotent]
    · change matrixJordan (secondFrame i : Mat6 ℚ) (secondFrame i) = secondFrame i
      rw [matrixJordan_self₆, secondFrame_idempotent]
    · change matrixJordan (thirdFrame i : Mat6 ℚ) (thirdFrame i) = thirdFrame i
      rw [matrixJordan_self₆, thirdFrame_laws.1]
  · intro r i
    change (∑ a : Fin 3, encode (seedCarrier r i) (Sum.inl (a, a))) = 1
    rw [← jordanTrace_decode, decode_encode]
    fin_cases r
    · exact firstFrame_trace i
    · exact secondFrame_trace i
    · exact thirdFrame_laws.2.1 i
  · intro r c
    have hs : (seedCarrier r 0 : Mat6 ℚ) + seedCarrier r 1 +
        seedCarrier r 2 = 1 := by
      fin_cases r
      · exact firstFrame_sum
      · exact secondFrame_sum
      · exact thirdFrame_laws.2.2
    have hsCarrier : seedCarrier r 0 + seedCarrier r 1 + seedCarrier r 2 =
        SelfAdjointCarrier.one := Subtype.ext hs
    have hsSum : (∑ i : Fin 3, seedCarrier r i) =
        SelfAdjointCarrier.one := by
      simpa [Fin.sum_univ_succ, add_assoc] using hsCarrier
    calc
      (∑ i : Fin 3, seedPoint r i c) =
          encode (∑ i : Fin 3, seedCarrier r i) c := by
            exact congrFun (map_sum (encodeLinear (K := ℚ))
              (fun i : Fin 3 => seedCarrier r i) Finset.univ) c |>.symm
      _ = encode (SelfAdjointCarrier.one : Carrier ℚ) c := by
        rw [hsSum]
      _ = _ := encode_one c

proof:

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.NonvanishingSeed.simultaneous_nonzero
statement:
theorem simultaneous_nonzero :
    p 0 * p 1 * p 2 * (p 1 + p 2) ≠ 0 ∧
    trace2 pivot ^ 2 - 4 * determinant pivot ≠ 0 ∧
    Matrix.det (grading * frameEncoder - frameEncoder * grading) ≠ 0 ∧
    Matrix.adjugate (thirdA 0) ≠ 0 ∧
    Matrix.adjugate (thirdA 1) ≠ 0 ∧
    Matrix.adjugate (thirdA 2) ≠ 0 ∧
    thirdU 0 0 * thirdU 1 1 - thirdU 1 0 * thirdU 0 1 ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨by rw [p_product]; norm_num,
    by rw [pivot_discriminant]; norm_num,
    by rw [frameEncoder_commutator_det]; norm_num, ?_, ?_, ?_,
    by rw [third_rank_minor]; norm_num⟩
  · intro h
    have := congrFun (congrFun h 2) 2
    rw [third_adjugate_values.1] at this
    norm_num at this
  · intro h
    have := congrFun (congrFun h 2) 2
    rw [third_adjugate_values.2.1] at this
    norm_num at this
  · intro h
    have := congrFun (congrFun h 1) 1
    rw [third_adjugate_values.2.2] at this
    norm_num at this

proof:

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericDetectorTauInvariance.tau_generic_detector
statement: theorem tau_generic_detector : tau k (genericValue k) = genericValue k
proof:
:= by
  have hA : Matrix.det (residualPairOfChart (genericChart k)).A ≠ 0 := by
    rw [generic_residual_detA]
    exact div_ne_zero (ambientMoment_det_ne_zero k) (T_ne_zero (Base k))
  have h := detector_eq_reflected_normalized (ambientCoefficient k (a k))
    (ambient_a_ne_zero k) (genericChart k) hA
  rw [generic_residual_moment, generic_residual_detA, ← reflectedMoment_eq,
    generic_diagonalA, generic_diagonalB] at h
  change genericValue k = _ at h
  have hr : (genericChart k).r1 = 1 := rfl
  have hz : (genericChart k).z1 = ambientCoefficient k (a k) := rfl
  have hb : (genericChart k).r2 = ambientCoefficient k (b k) := rfl
  have hc : (genericChart k).z2 = ambientCoefficient k (c k) := rfl
  rw [hr, hz, hb, hc, div_self (ambient_a_ne_zero k), mul_one] at h
  rw [tau_genericValue_eq_normalized]
  simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm] using h.symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.M3JordanAut.trace_leftMul
statement:
theorem trace_leftMul (A : Mat3 K) :
    LinearMap.trace K (Mat3 K) (leftMul A) = 3 * Matrix.trace A
proof:
:= by
  rw [LinearMap.trace_eq_matrix_trace K (Matrix.stdBasis K (Fin 3) (Fin 3))]
  have repr_apply (X : Mat3 K) (i j : Fin 3) :
      (Matrix.stdBasis K (Fin 3) (Fin 3)).repr X (i, j) = X i j := rfl
  simp only [Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag_apply, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply', leftMul,
    repr_apply, ← Finset.univ_product_univ, Finset.sum_product]
  simp [Matrix.stdBasis_eq_single, matrixJordan, Matrix.mul_apply,
    Matrix.single_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ, invOf_eq_inv]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.M3JordanAut.leftMul_conj
statement:
private theorem leftMul_conj (g : Aut (K := K)) (A : Mat3 K) :
    leftMul (g A) = g.linear.conj (leftMul A)
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro X
  change matrixJordan (g A) X = g.linear (matrixJordan A (g.linear.symm X))
  rw [g.map_jordan]
  simp

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.M3JordanAut.trace_invariant
statement:
theorem trace_invariant (g : Aut (K := K)) (A : Mat3 K) :
    Matrix.trace (g A) = Matrix.trace A
proof:
:= by
  have h := LinearMap.trace_conj' (leftMul A) g.linear
  rw [← leftMul_conj g A, trace_leftMul, trace_leftMul] at h
  exact (mul_left_cancel₀ (by norm_num : (3 : K) ≠ 0)) h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFiniteFrameSchedule.schedule_of_four_reflection_normalizer
statement:
theorem schedule_of_four_reflection_normalizer
    (P : Fin 3 → JCoord K) (p q r s : JCoord K)
    (hp : sourceProduct p p = p) (hq : sourceProduct q q = q)
    (hr : sourceProduct r r = r) (hs : sourceProduct s s = s)
    (hpT : sourceTrace p = 1) (hqT : sourceTrace q = 1)
    (hrT : sourceTrace r = 1) (hsT : sourceTrace s = 1)
    (hN : ∀ i, (fourReflectionAut p q r s hp hq hr hs).linear (P i) = diagonalUnit i) :
    ∃ Z : Schedule K, ∀ i, scheduledFrame Z i = P i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := four_reflections_on_seed p q r s hp hq hr hs hpT hqT hrT hsT
  refine ⟨scheduleOfFour z, ?_⟩
  intro i
  rw [scheduledFrame, applySchedule_scheduleOfFour, ← hz i,
    ← hN i, fourReflectionAut_formula]
  rw [reflection_twice s hs, reflection_twice r hr,
    reflection_twice q hq, reflection_twice p hp]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFiniteFrameSchedule.common_field_fixed_schedules
statement:
theorem common_field_fixed_schedules
    (P : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → JCoord K) (hP : ∀ a, SourceFrameLaws.Laws (P a)) :
    ∃ (L : Type u) (_ : Field L) (_ : CharZero L) (f : K →+* L)
      (Z : Fin 3 → Schedule L),
      Function.Injective f ∧
      ∀ a i, scheduledFrame (Z a) i = mapSource f (P a i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨L, hL, hL0, f, p, q, r, s, hp, hq, hr, hs, hf, hT, hN⟩ :=
    common_field_four_reflections P hP
  letI : Field L := hL
  letI : CharZero L := hL0
  have hschedule (a : Fin 3) : ∃ Z : Schedule L,
      ∀ i, scheduledFrame Z i = mapSource f (P a i) := by
    obtain ⟨hpT, hqT, hrT, hsT⟩ := hT a
    exact schedule_of_four_reflection_normalizer (fun i => mapSource f (P a i))
      (p a) (q a) (r a) (s a) (hp a) (hq a) (hr a) (hs a)
      hpT hqT hrT hsT (hN a)
  choose Z hZ using hschedule
  exact ⟨L, hL, hL0, f, Z, hf, hZ⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowExample.goodSolution_iff
statement:
theorem goodSolution_iff (W : Mat3) :
    GoodSolution U V c d W ↔ W = X ∨ W = Y
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hW
    rcases three_goodSolutions_pairwise_eq U V c d c_ne_zero d_ne_zero
      V_det one_sub_U_add_V_det X Y W X_good Y_good hW with hXY | hXW | hYW
    · exact False.elim (X_ne_Y hXY)
    · exact Or.inl hXW.symm
    · exact Or.inr hYW.symm
  · rintro (rfl | rfl)
    · exact X_good
    · exact Y_good

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ActualSplitThirdFrameProvenance.exists_scalar_provenance_of_labelled_probes
statement:
private theorem exists_scalar_provenance_of_labelled_probes
    (E F P E' F' P' : Fin 3 → Carrier K)
    (f a a' : Fin 3 → Mat3 K)
    (u v u' v' : Fin 3 → Vec3 K)
    (hE : ∀ i, (E i : Mat6 K) = grouped (diagonalUnit i) 0 0)
    (hE' : ∀ i, (E' i : Mat6 K) = grouped (diagonalUnit i) 0 0)
    (hF : ∀ i, (F i : Mat6 K) = grouped (f i) 0 0)
    (hF' : ∀ i, (F' i : Mat6 K) = grouped (f i) 0 0)
    (hP : ∀ i, (P i : Mat6 K) = grouped (a i) (u i) (v i))
    (hP' : ∀ i, (P' i : Mat6 K) = grouped (a' i) (u' i) (v' i))
    (hPidem : ∀ i, (P i : Mat6 K) * P i = P i)
    (hPidem' : ∀ i, (P' i : Mat6 K) * P' i = P' i)
    (hPtrace : ∀ i, jordanTrace (K := K) (P i : Mat6 K) = 1)
    (hPtrace' : ∀ i, jordanTrace (K := K) (P' i : Mat6 K) = 1)
    (hPsum : (P 0 : Mat6 K) + P 1 + P 2 = 1)
    (hPsum' : (P' 0 : Mat6 K) + P' 1 + P' 2 = 1)
    (hfsum : f 0 + f 1 + f 2 = 1)
    (hf0 : f 0 * f 0 = f 0) (hf2 : f 2 * f 2 = f 2)
    (hf02 : f 0 * f 2 = 0) (hf20 : f 2 * f 0 = 0)
    (hprobeOpen : Matrix.det
      (grading * encoder (f 0) (f 2) - encoder (f 0) (f 2) * grading) ≠ 0)
    (hLabel : ∀ l i,
      labelledProbe (f 0) (a l) i = labelledProbe (f 0) (a' l) i ∧
      labelledProbe (f 1) (a l) i = labelledProbe (f 1) (a' l) i ∧
      labelledProbe (f 2) (a l) i = labelledProbe (f 2) (a' l) i)
    (hadj : ∀ l, Matrix.adjugate (a l) ≠ 0)
    (hrankTwo :
      (∃ p q, u 0 p * u 1 q - u 0 q * u 1 p ≠ 0) ∨
      (∃ p q, v 0 p * v 1 q - v 0 q * v 1 p ≠ 0)) :
    ∃ t : K, ∃ ht : t ≠ 0,
      scalarSimilitude t * scalarSimilitudeInv t = 1 ∧
      scalarSimilitudeInv t * scalarSimilitude t = 1 ∧
      (scalarSimilitude t).transpose * symplecticJ * scalarSimilitude t =
        t • symplecticJ ∧
      (∀ i, scalarSimilitude t * (E i : Mat6 K) * scalarSimilitudeInv t =
        (E' i : Mat6 K)) ∧
      (∀ i, scalarSimilitude t * (F i : Mat6 K) * scalarSimilitudeInv t =
        (F' i : Mat6 K)) ∧
      (∀ i, scalarSimilitude t * (P i : Mat6 K) * scalarSimilitudeInv t =
        (P' i : Mat6 K))
proof:
:= by
  have ha : ∀ l, a l = a' l := by
    intro l
    exact eq_of_orthogonal_idempotent_labelled_probes
      (f 0) (f 1) (f 2) (a l) (a' l)
      hfsum hf0 hf2 hf02 hf20 hprobeOpen (hLabel l)
  have hPcommon' : ∀ i, (P' i : Mat6 K) = grouped (a i) (u' i) (v' i) := by
    intro i
    rw [ha i]
    exact hP' i
  have hblock : ∀ i,
      a i * a i - a i = -(hat (u i) * hat (v i)) := by
    intro i
    apply top_left_projector_equation
    simpa [hP i] using hPidem i
  have hblock' : ∀ i,
      a i * a i - a i = -(hat (u' i) * hat (v' i)) := by
    intro i
    apply top_left_projector_equation
    simpa [hPcommon' i] using hPidem' i
  have htrace : ∀ i, Matrix.trace (a i) = 1 := by
    intro i
    apply grouped_trace_one (a i) (u i) (v i)
    simpa [hP i] using hPtrace i
  obtain ⟨hsumu, hsumv⟩ := grouped_frame_threeSumZero P a u v hP hPsum
  obtain ⟨hsumu', hsumv'⟩ :=
    grouped_frame_threeSumZero P' a u' v' hPcommon' hPsum'
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hu, hv⟩ := common_frame_scalar_fibre
    a u v u' v' hblock hblock' htrace hadj
      hsumu hsumu' hsumv hsumv' hrankTwo
  refine ⟨t, ht, scalarSimilitude_mul_inv t ht,
    scalarSimilitude_inv_mul t ht, scalarSimilitude_form t, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    rw [hE i, hE' i,
      scalarSimilitude_conjugates_grouped t ht (diagonalUnit i) 0 0]
    simp
  · intro i
    rw [hF i, hF' i,
      scalarSimilitude_conjugates_grouped t ht (f i) 0 0]
    simp
  · intro i
    rw [hP i, hPcommon' i,
      scalarSimilitude_conjugates_grouped t ht (a i) (u i) (v i),
      hu i, hv i]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ActualSplitThirdFrameProvenance.exists_split_actual_three_frame_scalar_provenance_of_same_ledger
statement:
theorem exists_split_actual_three_frame_scalar_provenance_of_same_ledger
    (E F P E' F' P' : Fin 3 → Carrier K)
    (f a a' : Fin 3 → Mat3 K)
    (u v u' v' : Fin 3 → Vec3 K)
    (hE : ∀ i, (E i : Mat6 K) = grouped (diagonalUnit i) 0 0)
    (hE' : ∀ i, (E' i : Mat6 K) = grouped (diagonalUnit i) 0 0)
    (hF : ∀ i, (F i : Mat6 K) = grouped (f i) 0 0)
    (hF' : ∀ i, (F' i : Mat6 K) = grouped (f i) 0 0)
    (hP : ∀ i, (P i : Mat6 K) = grouped (a i) (u i) (v i))
    (hP' : ∀ i, (P' i : Mat6 K) = grouped (a' i) (u' i) (v' i))
    (hPidem : ∀ i, (P i : Mat6 K) * P i = P i)
    (hPidem' : ∀ i, (P' i : Mat6 K) * P' i = P' i)
    (hPtrace : ∀ i, jordanTrace (K := K) (P i : Mat6 K) = 1)
    (hPtrace' : ∀ i, jordanTrace (K := K) (P' i : Mat6 K) = 1)
    (hPsum : (P 0 : Mat6 K) + P 1 + P 2 = 1)
    (hPsum' : (P' 0 : Mat6 K) + P' 1 + P' 2 = 1)
    (hfsum : f 0 + f 1 + f 2 = 1)
    (hf0 : f 0 * f 0 = f 0) (hf2 : f 2 * f 2 = f 2)
    (hf02 : f 0 * f 2 = 0) (hf20 : f 2 * f 0 = 0)
    (hprobeOpen : Matrix.det
      (grading * encoder (f 0) (f 2) - encoder (f 0) (f 2) * grading) ≠ 0)
    (hadj : ∀ l, Matrix.adjugate (a l) ≠ 0)
    (hrankTwo :
      (∃ p q, u 0 p * u 1 q - u 0 q * u 1 p ≠ 0) ∨
      (∃ p q, v 0 p * v 1 q - v 0 q * v 1 p ≠ 0))
    (hledger : carrierLedger E F P = carrierLedger E' F' P') :
    ∃ t : K, ∃ ht : t ≠ 0,
      scalarSimilitude t * scalarSimilitudeInv t = 1 ∧
      scalarSimilitudeInv t * scalarSimilitude t = 1 ∧
      (scalarSimilitude t).transpose * symplecticJ * scalarSimilitude t =
        t • symplecticJ ∧
      (∀ i, scalarSimilitude t * (E i : Mat6 K) * scalarSimilitudeInv t =
        (E' i : Mat6 K)) ∧
      (∀ i, scalarSimilitude t * (F i : Mat6 K) * scalarSimilitudeInv t =
        (F' i : Mat6 K)) ∧
      (∀ i, scalarSimilitude t * (P i : Mat6 K) * scalarSimilitudeInv t =
        (P' i : Mat6 K))
proof:
:= by
  have hLabel : ∀ l i,
      labelledProbe (f 0) (a l) i = labelledProbe (f 0) (a' l) i ∧
      labelledProbe (f 1) (a l) i = labelledProbe (f 1) (a' l) i ∧
      labelledProbe (f 2) (a l) i = labelledProbe (f 2) (a' l) i := by
    intro l i
    have hcell (j : Fin 3) :
        uncenteredCell (carrierLedger E F P) i j l =
          uncenteredCell (carrierLedger E' F' P') i j l :=
      congrArg (fun L : CarrierLedger K => uncenteredCell L i j l) hledger
    have hjoint (j : Fin 3) :
        jordanTrace (K := K)
            ((E i : Mat6 K) * matrixJordan (F j : Mat6 K) (P l : Mat6 K)) =
          jordanTrace (K := K)
            ((E' i : Mat6 K) * matrixJordan (F' j : Mat6 K) (P' l : Mat6 K)) := by
      simpa using hcell j
    have hprobe (j : Fin 3) :
        labelledProbe (f j) (a l) i = labelledProbe (f j) (a' l) i := by
      rw [labelledProbe_eq_two_split_joint (f j) (a l) (u l) (v l) i,
        labelledProbe_eq_two_split_joint (f j) (a' l) (u' l) (v' l) i]
      exact congrArg (fun x : K => 2 * x)
        (by simpa [hE i, hE' i, hF j, hF' j, hP l, hP' l] using hjoint j)
    exact ⟨hprobe 0, hprobe 1, hprobe 2⟩
  exact exists_scalar_provenance_of_labelled_probes
    E F P E' F' P' f a a' u v u' v'
    hE hE' hF hF' hP hP' hPidem hPidem' hPtrace hPtrace'
    hPsum hPsum' hfsum hf0 hf2 hf02 hf20 hprobeOpen hLabel hadj hrankTwo

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ActualSplitThirdFrameProvenance.exists_split_actual_three_frame_jordanAut_from_scalar_provenance
statement:
theorem exists_split_actual_three_frame_jordanAut_from_scalar_provenance
    (E F P E' F' P' : Fin 3 → Carrier K)
    (f a a' : Fin 3 → Mat3 K)
    (u v u' v' : Fin 3 → Vec3 K)
    (hE : ∀ i, (E i : Mat6 K) = grouped (diagonalUnit i) 0 0)
    (hE' : ∀ i, (E' i : Mat6 K) = grouped (diagonalUnit i) 0 0)
    (hF : ∀ i, (F i : Mat6 K) = grouped (f i) 0 0)
    (hF' : ∀ i, (F' i : Mat6 K) = grouped (f i) 0 0)
    (hP : ∀ i, (P i : Mat6 K) = grouped (a i) (u i) (v i))
    (hP' : ∀ i, (P' i : Mat6 K) = grouped (a' i) (u' i) (v' i))
    (hPidem : ∀ i, (P i : Mat6 K) * P i = P i)
    (hPidem' : ∀ i, (P' i : Mat6 K) * P' i = P' i)
    (hPtrace : ∀ i, jordanTrace (K := K) (P i : Mat6 K) = 1)
    (hPtrace' : ∀ i, jordanTrace (K := K) (P' i : Mat6 K) = 1)
    (hPsum : (P 0 : Mat6 K) + P 1 + P 2 = 1)
    (hPsum' : (P' 0 : Mat6 K) + P' 1 + P' 2 = 1)
    (hfsum : f 0 + f 1 + f 2 = 1)
    (hf0 : f 0 * f 0 = f 0) (hf2 : f 2 * f 2 = f 2)
    (hf02 : f 0 * f 2 = 0) (hf20 : f 2 * f 0 = 0)
    (hprobeOpen : Matrix.det
      (grading * encoder (f 0) (f 2) - encoder (f 0) (f 2) * grading) ≠ 0)
    (hadj : ∀ l, Matrix.adjugate (a l) ≠ 0)
    (hrankTwo :
      (∃ p q, u 0 p * u 1 q - u 0 q * u 1 p ≠ 0) ∨
      (∃ p q, v 0 p * v 1 q - v 0 q * v 1 p ≠ 0))
    (hledger : carrierLedger E F P = carrierLedger E' F' P') :
    ∃ g : Aut (K := K),
      (∀ i, g.linear (E i) = E' i) ∧
      (∀ i, g.linear (F i) = F' i) ∧
      (∀ i, g.linear (P i) = P' i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht, _hMN, _hNM, _hform, hEc, hFc, hPc⟩ :=
    exists_split_actual_three_frame_scalar_provenance_of_same_ledger
      E F P E' F' P' f a a' u v u' v'
      hE hE' hF hF' hP hP' hPidem hPidem' hPtrace hPtrace'
      hPsum hPsum' hfsum hf0 hf2 hf02 hf20 hprobeOpen hadj hrankTwo hledger
  refine ⟨scalarAut t ht, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    apply Subtype.ext
    change scalarSimilitude t * (E i : Mat6 K) * scalarSimilitudeInv t =
      (E' i : Mat6 K)
    exact hEc i
  · intro i
    apply Subtype.ext
    change scalarSimilitude t * (F i : Mat6 K) * scalarSimilitudeInv t =
      (F' i : Mat6 K)
    exact hFc i
  · intro i
    apply Subtype.ext
    change scalarSimilitude t * (P i : Mat6 K) * scalarSimilitudeInv t =
      (P' i : Mat6 K)
    exact hPc i

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ParameterFamily.parameterResidualPair_A
statement:
theorem parameterResidualPair_A (t : ℚ) (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    (parameterResidualPair t ht).A = parameterMoment *
      AlbertLean.Residual.NormalizedOrbitSection.X0Inv t
proof:
:= by
  have hAX : (parameterResidualPair t ht).A *
      AlbertLean.Residual.NormalizedOrbitSection.X0 t = parameterMoment := by
    rw [← parameterResidualPair_X]
    exact parameterResidualPair_moment t ht
  calc
    (parameterResidualPair t ht).A =
        (parameterResidualPair t ht).A * 1 := (Matrix.mul_one _).symm
    _ = (parameterResidualPair t ht).A *
        (AlbertLean.Residual.NormalizedOrbitSection.X0 t *
          AlbertLean.Residual.NormalizedOrbitSection.X0Inv t) := by
      rw [AlbertLean.Residual.NormalizedOrbitSection.X0_mul_X0Inv t ht]
    _ = ((parameterResidualPair t ht).A *
          AlbertLean.Residual.NormalizedOrbitSection.X0 t) *
        AlbertLean.Residual.NormalizedOrbitSection.X0Inv t := by
      rw [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = parameterMoment *
        AlbertLean.Residual.NormalizedOrbitSection.X0Inv t := by rw [hAX]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ParameterFamily.parameterResidualPair_A_mul_diagonal

theorem parameterResidualPair_A_mul_diagonal (t : ℚ) (ht : t ≠ 0)

      parameterMoment i j
proof:

    (parameterResidualPair_moment t ht)
  rw [moment, parameterResidualPair_X] at h
  fin_cases j <;>
    simpa [AlbertLean.Residual.NormalizedOrbitSection.X0, Matrix.mul_apply,
      Fin.sum_univ_succ] using h

theorem parameterResidualPair_rootSwapped (t : ℚ) (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    rootSwappedRepresentative (parameterResidualPair t ht)
        (parameterResidualPair_open t ht) =
      parameterResidualPair (witnessScale / t)
        (reciprocalParameter_ne_zero t ht)
proof:
:= by
  let s := parameterSection t ht
  have hs : AlbertLean.Residual.NormalizedRootSwap.rootSwap s =
      parameterSection (witnessScale / t)
        (reciprocalParameter_ne_zero t ht) := by
    apply AlbertLean.Residual.NormalizedRootSwap.NormalizedResidualSection.ext
    · rfl
    · simp [s, parameterSection,
        AlbertLean.Residual.NormalizedRootSwap.DeltaStar,
        parameterMoment_det]
  unfold rootSwappedRepresentative parameterResidualPair
  rw [section_residual_roundtrip]
  exact congrArg residualPairOfSection hs

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ParameterFamily.parameterResidualPair_eq_of_moment_X
statement:
theorem parameterResidualPair_eq_of_moment_X (t : ℚ) (ht : t ≠ 0)
    (P : ResidualPair ℚ) (hM : moment P = parameterMoment)
    (hX : P.X = AlbertLean.Residual.NormalizedOrbitSection.X0 t) :
    parameterResidualPair t ht = P
proof:
:= by
  apply ResidualPair.ext
  · rw [parameterResidualPair_A]
    calc
      parameterMoment * AlbertLean.Residual.NormalizedOrbitSection.X0Inv t =
          moment P * AlbertLean.Residual.NormalizedOrbitSection.X0Inv t := by
        rw [hM]
      _ = (P.A * P.X) *
          AlbertLean.Residual.NormalizedOrbitSection.X0Inv t := rfl
      _ = P.A * (P.X *
          AlbertLean.Residual.NormalizedOrbitSection.X0Inv t) := by
        rw [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = P.A * 1 := by
        rw [hX,
          AlbertLean.Residual.NormalizedOrbitSection.X0_mul_X0Inv t ht]
      _ = P.A := Matrix.mul_one _
  · exact (parameterResidualPair_X t ht).trans hX.symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericNormalizationFieldPoint.exists_generic_normalization_field_point
statement:
theorem exists_generic_normalization_field_point
    (w : B →+* L) (D : B) (hD : w D ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (E : Type u) (_ : Field E) (j : FractionRing A →+* E),
      Function.Injective j ∧
      ∃ f : B →+* E, f D ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ a : A,
        f (algebraMap A B a) = j (algebraMap A (FractionRing A) a)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨E, hE, g, hg⟩ := exists_field_point_of_injective_witness
    (algebraMap B (GenericBaseRing A B)) (algebraMap_injective A B) w D hD
  letI : Field E := hE
  let j : FractionRing A →+* E := g.comp (fractionMap A B)
  let f : B →+* E := g.comp (algebraMap B (GenericBaseRing A B))
  refine ⟨E, hE, j, RingHom.injective j, f, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact hg
  · intro a
    simp [f, j, coefficientMap, fractionMap_algebraMap]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.UniformMomentGenericOpen.ledgerEval_discr_eq_kappa_sq
statement:
theorem ledgerEval_discr_eq_kappa_sq :
    ledgerEval k (discr k) = kappa k ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let q := genericChart k
  have hfour : ledgerEval k (4 : R0 k) = (4 : FunctionField k) :=
    map_ofNat (ledgerEval k) 4
  have hf := genericChart_source_fixedSpectrum k
  have hm := recovered_measurements (encoderA q) (encoderB q) hf.2.2.1 hf.2.2.2.2.2
  rcases hm with ⟨hnVx, hnSx, hnCx, hnVy, hnSy, hnCy, hgV, hgS, hgC,
    ht111, ht211, ht121, ht112, ht122, ht212, ht221, ht222, huV, huS, huC⟩
  rw [discr, map_sub, map_pow, map_mul, map_mul, hfour, ledgerEval_a,
    ledgerEval_h, ledgerEval_nVy]
  change gV (sourceLedger (encoderA q) (encoderB q)) 1 1 ^ 2 -
    4 * nVx (sourceLedger (encoderA q) (encoderB q)) *
      nVy (sourceLedger (encoderA q) (encoderB q)) = kappa k ^ 2
  rw [hnVx, hnVy, hgV]
  rw [kappa_eq_orientation, orientation_sq]
  simp [q, gramV11, gramV12, gramV22, encoderA, encoderB, vectorA, vectorB,
    AlbertLean.Triality.CoordinateTensor.nV,
    AlbertLean.Triality.CoordinateTensor.BV,
    AlbertLean.Triality.ExteriorSix.Pf,
    AlbertLean.Triality.ExteriorSix.BW]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.UniformMomentGenericOpen.evalPlus_N0

    uniformN (genericLedger k) (nVx (genericLedger k))
      (gV (genericLedger k) 1 1) (kappa k)
proof:
:= by

      (by simpa [pow_two] using ledgerEval_discr_eq_kappa_sq k |>.symm)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.UniformMomentGenericOpen.det_evalPlus_N0_ne_zero
statement:
theorem det_evalPlus_N0_ne_zero :
    Matrix.det ((N0 k).map (evalPlus k)) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  let q := genericChart k
  let L := genericLedger k
  let av := nVx L
  have hf := genericChart_source_fixedSpectrum k
  have hm := recovered_measurements (encoderA q) (encoderB q) hf.2.2.1 hf.2.2.2.2.2
  rcases hm with ⟨hnVx, hnSx, hnCx, hnVy, hnSy, hnCy, hgV, hgS, hgC,
    ht111, ht211, ht121, ht112, ht122, ht212, ht221, ht222, huV, huS, huC⟩
  have hqr : q.r1 = 1 := by simpa only [q] using generic_r1 k
  have hqz : q.z1 ≠ 0 := by simpa only [q] using generic_z1_ne k
  have hav : av = q.z1 := by
    change nVx (sourceLedger (encoderA q) (encoderB q)) = q.z1
    rw [hnVx]
    simp [encoderA, vectorA, AlbertLean.Triality.CoordinateTensor.nV,
      AlbertLean.Triality.ExteriorSix.Pf,
      AlbertLean.Triality.ExteriorSix.BW, hqr]
  have hh : gV L 1 1 = gramV12 q := by
    change gV (sourceLedger (encoderA q) (encoderB q)) 1 1 = gramV12 q
    rw [hgV]
    simp [gramV12, encoderA, encoderB, vectorA, vectorB,
      AlbertLean.Triality.CoordinateTensor.BV,
      AlbertLean.Triality.ExteriorSix.BW]
    ring
  have ho : orientation q = kappa k := (kappa_eq_orientation k).symm
  have hb : q.r2 = (gramV12 q - kappa k) / (2*av) := by
    rw [← ho, gramV12, orientation, hav]
    field_simp [hqz] <;> ring
  have hc : q.z2 = (gramV12 q + kappa k) / 2 := by
    rw [← ho, gramV12, orientation]
    rw [hqr]
    ring
  have hq : EquationsVanish (explicitFrameEquationValues q) :=
    (equationsVanish_iff_source_fixedSpectrum q).2 hf
  have hrec := matrixM_eq_uniform_inverse q av q.r2 q.z2 (kappa k)
    hq hqr hav.symm rfl rfl hb hc (kappa_ne_zero k)
    (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) (by rw [hav]; exact hqz))
  have hL : L = sourceLedger (encoderA q) (encoderB q) := rfl
  have hscale : uniformN L av (gV L 1 1) (kappa k) =
      (2*av*kappa k) • matrixM q := by
    rw [← hL, ← hh] at hrec
    have hz : 2 * av * kappa k ≠ 0 :=
      mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) (by rw [hav]; exact hqz))
        (kappa_ne_zero k)
    rw [hrec, ← mul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hz, one_smul]
  rw [evalPlus_N0, hscale, Matrix.det_smul]
  have hMq : matrixM q = ambientMoment k := by
    calc
      _ = AlbertLean.Residual.SL4PairAction.moment
          (AlbertLean.Generic.ChartBridge.residualPairOfChart q) := by
        simpa [matrixM, AlbertLean.Generic.ChartBridge.residualPairOfChart,
          AlbertLean.Residual.SL4PairAction.moment] using
            (AlbertLean.Residual.ResidualMatrices.momentMatrix_eq_AMatrix_mul_XMatrix
              q.s1 q.s2 q.c1 q.c2)
      _ = ambientMoment k := by
        simpa only [q] using
          AlbertLean.Generic.GenericDetectorTauInvariance.generic_residual_moment k
  exact mul_ne_zero
    (pow_ne_zero _ (mul_ne_zero
      (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) (by rw [hav]; exact hqz))
      (kappa_ne_zero k))) (by
        rw [hMq]
        exact ambientMoment_det_ne_zero k)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.UniformMomentGenericOpen.tau_ledgerAssignment
statement:
theorem tau_ledgerAssignment (v : LedgerVar) :
    tau k (ledgerAssignment k v) = ledgerAssignment k v
proof:
:= by
  apply tau_fixed_of_mem_H k
  apply Subfield.subset_closure
  right
  cases v with
  | inl ij => exact Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨ij, rfl⟩))
  | inr v =>
    cases v with
    | inl jl => exact Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨jl, rfl⟩))
    | inr v =>
      cases v with
      | inl li => exact Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨li, rfl⟩)
      | inr ijl => exact Or.inr ⟨ijl, rfl⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.UniformMomentGenericOpen.tau_comp_ledgerEval
statement:
theorem tau_comp_ledgerEval :
    (tau k).toRingHom.comp (ledgerEval k) = ledgerEval k
proof:
:= by
  apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
  · intro c
    simp [ledgerEval, tau_constant]
  · intro v
    simp [ledgerEval_X, tau_ledgerAssignment]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.UniformMomentGenericOpen.evalMinus_eq_tau_comp_evalPlus
statement:
theorem evalMinus_eq_tau_comp_evalPlus :
    evalMinus k = (tau k).toRingHom.comp (evalPlus k)
proof:
:= by
  apply RingHom.ext
  intro z
  have hcre := congrArg (fun f : R0 k →+* FunctionField k => f z.re)
    (tau_comp_ledgerEval k)
  have hcim := congrArg (fun f : R0 k →+* FunctionField k => f z.im)
    (tau_comp_ledgerEval k)
  rw [← QuadraticAlgebra.re_smul_add_im_smul z]
  simp only [map_add, map_smul, Algebra.smul_def, RingHom.comp_apply,
    evalMinus, evalPlus, evalQ0_algebraMap, evalQ0_omega, map_mul, map_neg,
    map_one]
  simp only [RingHom.comp_apply] at hcre hcim
  have hk : (tau k).toRingHom (kappa k) = -kappa k := tau_kappa k
  rw [hcre, hcim, hk]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.UniformMomentGenericOpen.evalMinus_N0_eq_tau_map_evalPlus
statement:
theorem evalMinus_N0_eq_tau_map_evalPlus :
    (N0 k).map (evalMinus k) =
      ((N0 k).map (evalPlus k)).map (tau k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [evalMinus_eq_tau_comp_evalPlus, Matrix.map_map]
  rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.UniformMomentGenericOpen.det_evalMinus_N0_ne_zero
statement:
theorem det_evalMinus_N0_ne_zero :
    Matrix.det ((N0 k).map (evalMinus k)) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [evalMinus_N0_eq_tau_map_evalPlus]
  intro hz
  change Matrix.det ((tau k).toRingHom.mapMatrix
    ((N0 k).map (evalPlus k))) = 0 at hz
  rw [← RingHom.map_det] at hz
  apply det_evalPlus_N0_ne_zero k
  apply (tau k).toRingHom.injective
  exact hz.trans (map_zero (tau k).toRingHom).symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.UniformMomentGenericOpen.ledgerEval_B0_ne_zero_of_det_orientations
statement:
theorem ledgerEval_B0_ne_zero_of_det_orientations
    (hplus : Matrix.det ((N0 k).map (evalPlus k)) ≠ 0)
    (hminus : Matrix.det ((N0 k).map (evalMinus k)) ≠ 0) :
    ledgerEval k (B0 k) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [B0, map_mul, map_mul, ledgerEval_a, ledgerEval_discr_eq_kappa_sq,
    ledgerEval_eta_eq_det_plus_mul_det_minus k
      (ledgerEval_discr_eq_kappa_sq k).symm
      (by simpa [pow_two] using ledgerEval_discr_eq_kappa_sq k |>.symm)]
  exact mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero
    (by
      have hf := genericChart_source_fixedSpectrum k
      have hm := recovered_measurements (encoderA (genericChart k))
        (encoderB (genericChart k)) hf.2.2.1 hf.2.2.2.2.2
      have hr : (genericChart k).r1 = 1 := generic_r1 k
      have hn : nVx (sourceLedger (encoderA (genericChart k))
          (encoderB (genericChart k))) = (genericChart k).z1 := by
        rw [hm.1]
        simp [encoderA, vectorA, AlbertLean.Triality.CoordinateTensor.nV,
          AlbertLean.Triality.ExteriorSix.Pf,
          AlbertLean.Triality.ExteriorSix.BW, hr]
      change nVx (sourceLedger (encoderA (genericChart k))
        (encoderB (genericChart k))) ≠ 0
      rw [hn]
      exact generic_z1_ne k)
    (pow_ne_zero 2 (kappa_ne_zero k))) (mul_ne_zero hplus hminus)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.UniformMomentGenericOpen.ledgerEval_B0_ne_zero
statement: theorem ledgerEval_B0_ne_zero : ledgerEval k (B0 k) ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  ledgerEval_B0_ne_zero_of_det_orientations k
    (det_evalPlus_N0_ne_zero k) (det_evalMinus_N0_ne_zero k)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RationalEvenRingAction.ringNV_centerB
statement:
theorem ringNV_centerB (alpha alphaInv r : R) (omega : W R)
    (rho rInv : R) (ha : alpha * alphaInv = 1) (hr : r * rInv = 1) :
    ringNV (centerB alphaInv r omega rho rInv) = rho ^ 2 * alphaInv
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ringNV, centerB]
  calc
    r * ((rho ^ 2 * alphaInv - Pf omega) * rInv) + Pf omega =
        (rho ^ 2 * alphaInv - Pf omega) * (r * rInv) + Pf omega := by ring
    _ = rho ^ 2 * alphaInv := by rw [hr]; ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RationalEvenRingAction.centerB_inverseNorm
statement:
theorem centerB_inverseNorm (alpha alphaInv r : R) (omega : W R)
    (rho rInv rhoInv : R) (ha : alpha * alphaInv = 1)
    (hr : r * rInv = 1) (hp : rho * rhoInv = 1) :
    ringNV (centerB alphaInv r omega rho rInv) * (alpha * rhoInv ^ 2) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [ringNV_centerB alpha alphaInv r omega rho rInv ha hr]
  calc
    rho ^ 2 * alphaInv * (alpha * rhoInv ^ 2) =
        (alpha * alphaInv) * (rho * rhoInv) ^ 2 := by ring
    _ = 1 := by rw [ha, hp]; norm_num

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RationalEvenRingAction.ofF0_toF0
statement: @[simp] theorem ofF0_toF0 (x : JCoord R) : ofF0 (toF0 x) = x
proof:
:= by
  apply JCoord.ext
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · apply VCoord.ext <;> first | rfl | (funext i; fin_cases i <;> rfl)
  · apply SCoord.ext <;> funext i <;> fin_cases i <;> rfl
  · apply CCoord.ext <;> funext i <;> fin_cases i <;> rfl
