name: AlbertLean.Generic.RationalEvenRingAction.map_centerB
statement:
private theorem map_centerB {S : Type*} [CommRing S] [Algebra ℚ S]
    [Invertible (2 : S)]
    (f : R →+* S) (alphaInv r : R) (omega : W R) (rho rInv : R) :
    mapV f (centerB alphaInv r omega rho rInv) =
      centerB (f alphaInv) (f r) (mapW f omega) (f rho) (f rInv)
proof:
:= by
  apply VCoord.ext
  · rfl
  · change f ((rho ^ 2 * alphaInv - Pf omega) * rInv) =
      (f rho ^ 2 * f alphaInv - Pf (mapW f omega)) * f rInv
    have hPf : f (Pf omega) = Pf (mapW f omega) := by
      rw [pf_coordinate, pf_coordinate]
      simp only [mapW, Function.comp_apply, map_add, map_sub, map_mul]
    rw [map_mul, map_sub, map_mul, map_pow]
    rw [hPf]
  · rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RationalEvenRingAction.map_ringBV
statement:
private theorem map_ringBV {S : Type*} [CommRing S]
    (f : R →+* S) (a x : VCoord R) :
    f (ringBV a x) = ringBV (mapV f a) (mapV f x)
proof:
:= by
  simp [ringBV, mapV, mapW, BW]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RationalEvenRingAction.mapV_sub
statement:
private theorem mapV_sub {S : Type*} [CommRing S]
    (f : R →+* S) (x y : VCoord R) :
    mapV f (x - y) = mapV f x - mapV f y
proof:
:= by
  apply VCoord.ext
  · exact f.map_sub x.r y.r
  · exact f.map_sub x.z y.z
  · funext i
    exact f.map_sub (x.omega i) (y.omega i)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RationalEvenRingAction.mapV_smul
statement:
private theorem mapV_smul {S : Type*} [CommRing S]
    (f : R →+* S) (a : R) (x : VCoord R) :
    mapV f (a • x) = f a • mapV f x
proof:
:= by
  apply VCoord.ext
  · simp [mapV]
  · simp [mapV]
  · funext i
    simp [mapV, mapW]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RationalEvenRingAction.map_ringReflectV
statement:
private theorem map_ringReflectV {S : Type*} [CommRing S]
    (f : R →+* S) (a : VCoord R) (nInv : R) (x : VCoord R) :
    mapV f (ringReflectV a nInv x) =
      ringReflectV (mapV f a) (f nInv) (mapV f x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ringReflectV, ringReflectV, mapV_sub, mapV_smul, map_mul,
    map_ringBV]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RationalEvenRingAction.map_ringMuS
statement:
private theorem map_ringMuS {S : Type*} [CommRing S]
    (f : R →+* S) (c : CCoord R) (v : VCoord R) :
    mapS f (ringMuS c v) = ringMuS (mapC f c) (mapV f v)
proof:
:= by
  apply SCoord.ext <;> funext i <;> fin_cases i <;>
    simp [ringMuS, mapS, mapC, mapV, mapW]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RationalEvenRingAction.map_ringMuC
statement:
private theorem map_ringMuC {S : Type*} [CommRing S]
    (f : R →+* S) (v : VCoord R) (s : SCoord R) :
    mapC f (ringMuC v s) = ringMuC (mapV f v) (mapS f s)
proof:
:= by
  apply CCoord.ext <;> funext i <;> fin_cases i <;>
    simp [ringMuC, mapS, mapC, mapV, mapW]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RationalEvenRingAction.mapS_smul
statement:
private theorem mapS_smul {S : Type*} [CommRing S]
    (f : R →+* S) (a : R) (s : SCoord R) :
    mapS f (a • s) = f a • mapS f s
proof:
:= by
  apply SCoord.ext <;> funext i <;> simp [mapS]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RationalEvenRingAction.mapC_smul
statement:
private theorem mapC_smul {S : Type*} [CommRing S]
    (f : R →+* S) (a : R) (c : CCoord R) :
    mapC f (a • c) = f a • mapC f c
proof:
:= by
  apply CCoord.ext <;> funext i <;> simp [mapC]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RationalEvenRingAction.map_familyJ
statement:
private theorem map_familyJ {S : Type*} [CommRing S] [Algebra ℚ S]
    [Invertible (2 : S)]
    (f : R →+* S) (A : VCoord R) (alpha alphaInv r : R) (omega : W R)
    (rho rInv rhoInv : R) (x : JCoord R) :
    mapJ f (familyJ A alpha alphaInv r omega rho rInv rhoInv x) =
      familyJ (mapV f A) (f alpha) (f alphaInv) (f r) (mapW f omega)
        (f rho) (f rInv) (f rhoInv) (mapJ f x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [familyJ, familyJ]
  apply JCoord.ext
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · simp only [mapJ]
    rw [map_ringReflectV, map_ringReflectV, map_centerB, map_mul, map_pow]
  · simp only [mapJ]
    rw [mapS_smul, map_ringMuS, map_ringMuC, map_centerB]
  · simp only [mapJ]
    rw [mapC_smul, map_ringMuC, map_ringMuS, map_centerB]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RationalEvenRingAction.map_toF0
statement:
private theorem map_toF0 {S : Type*} [CommRing S]
    (f : R →+* S) (x : JCoord R) :
    mapF0 f (toF0 x) = toF0 (mapJ f x)
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;> rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RationalEvenRingAction.map_ofF0
statement:
private theorem map_ofF0 {S : Type*} [CommRing S]
    (f : R →+* S) (x : F0Ring R) :
    mapJ f (ofF0 x) = ofF0 (mapF0 f x)
proof:
:= by
  apply JCoord.ext
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · apply VCoord.ext <;> first | rfl | (funext i; fin_cases i <;> rfl)
  · apply SCoord.ext <;> funext i <;> fin_cases i <;> rfl
  · apply CCoord.ext <;> funext i <;> fin_cases i <;> rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RationalEvenRingAction.map_familyF0
statement:
theorem map_familyF0 {S : Type*} [CommRing S] [Algebra ℚ S] [Invertible (2 : S)]
    (f : R →+* S) (A : VCoord R) (alpha alphaInv r : R) (omega : W R)
    (rho rInv rhoInv : R) (x : F0Ring R) :
    mapF0 f (familyF0 A alpha alphaInv r omega rho rInv rhoInv x) =
      familyF0 (mapV f A) (f alpha) (f alphaInv) (f r) (mapW f omega)
        (f rho) (f rInv) (f rhoInv) (mapF0 f x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [familyF0, familyF0, map_toF0, map_familyJ, map_ofF0]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RationalEvenRingAction.map_twoFamilyF0
statement:
theorem map_twoFamilyF0 {S : Type*} [CommRing S] [Algebra ℚ S]
    [Invertible (2 : S)] (f : R →+* S)
    (A₁ A₂ : VCoord R)
    (alpha₁ alphaInv₁ r₁ : R) (omega₁ : W R) (rho₁ rInv₁ rhoInv₁ : R)
    (alpha₂ alphaInv₂ r₂ : R) (omega₂ : W R) (rho₂ rInv₂ rhoInv₂ : R)
    (x : F0Ring R) :
    mapF0 f
        (familyF0 A₂ alpha₂ alphaInv₂ r₂ omega₂ rho₂ rInv₂ rhoInv₂
          (familyF0 A₁ alpha₁ alphaInv₁ r₁ omega₁ rho₁ rInv₁ rhoInv₁ x)) =
      familyF0 (mapV f A₂) (f alpha₂) (f alphaInv₂) (f r₂) (mapW f omega₂)
        (f rho₂) (f rInv₂) (f rhoInv₂)
        (familyF0 (mapV f A₁) (f alpha₁) (f alphaInv₁) (f r₁) (mapW f omega₁)
          (f rho₁) (f rInv₁) (f rhoInv₁) (mapF0 f x))
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_familyF0, map_familyF0]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RationalEvenRingAction.ringNV_eq_nV
statement: theorem ringNV_eq_nV (v : VCoord K) : ringNV v = nV v
proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RationalEvenRingAction.ringBV_eq_BV
statement: theorem ringBV_eq_BV (v w : VCoord K) : ringBV v w = BV v w
proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RationalEvenRingAction.ringMuS_eq
statement: theorem ringMuS_eq (c : CCoord K) (v : VCoord K) : ringMuS c v = sourceMuS c v
proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RationalEvenRingAction.ringMuC_eq
statement: theorem ringMuC_eq (v : VCoord K) (s : SCoord K) : ringMuC v s = sourceMuC v s
proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RationalEvenRingAction.ringReflectV_eq
statement:
theorem ringReflectV_eq (a v : VCoord K) :
    ringReflectV a (nV a)⁻¹ v = reflectV a v
proof:
:= by
  simp [ringReflectV, reflectV, ringBV_eq_BV, div_eq_mul_inv]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RationalEvenRingAction.centerB_eq_center
statement:
theorem centerB_eq_center (alpha r : K) (omega : W K) (rho : K) :
    centerB alpha⁻¹ r omega rho r⁻¹ = center alpha r omega rho
proof:
:= by
  apply VCoord.ext
  · rfl
  · simp [centerB, center, div_eq_mul_inv]
  · rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RationalEvenRingAction.familyF0_eq_sourceEvenAut
statement:
theorem familyF0_eq_sourceEvenAut
    (A : VCoord K) (hA : nV A ≠ 0)
    (r : K) (omega : W K) (rho : K) (hr : r ≠ 0) (hp : rho ≠ 0)
    (x : JCoord K) :
    familyF0 A (nV A) (nV A)⁻¹ r omega rho r⁻¹ rho⁻¹
        (structuredEquivK K x) =
      structuredEquivK K ((familyAut A hA r omega rho hr hp).linear x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [familyF0]
  have hdecode : ofF0 (structuredEquivK K x) = x := by
    change ofF0 (toF0 x) = x
    exact ofF0_toF0 x
  rw [hdecode]
  have hB : nV (center (nV A) r omega rho) ≠ 0 :=
    norm_center_ne_zero (nV A) r omega rho hA hr hp
  have hinv : nV A * rho⁻¹ ^ 2 =
      (nV (center (nV A) r omega rho))⁻¹ := by
    apply (mul_left_cancel₀ hB)
    rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hB]
    have hprod := centerB_inverseNorm (nV A) (nV A)⁻¹ r omega rho r⁻¹ rho⁻¹
      (mul_inv_cancel₀ hA) (mul_inv_cancel₀ hr) (mul_inv_cancel₀ hp)
    simpa only [ringNV_eq_nV, centerB_eq_center] using hprod
  have hJ : familyJ A (nV A) (nV A)⁻¹ r omega rho r⁻¹ rho⁻¹ x =
      evenJEquiv A (center (nV A) r omega rho) rho hA hB
        (center_root (nV A) r omega rho hA hr) hp x := by
    rw [evenJEquiv_apply]
    apply JCoord.ext
    · rfl
    · rfl
    · rfl
    · change ringReflectV A (nV A)⁻¹
          (ringReflectV (centerB (nV A)⁻¹ r omega rho r⁻¹)
            (nV A * rho⁻¹ ^ 2) x.v) = _
      rw [centerB_eq_center, hinv, ringReflectV_eq, ringReflectV_eq] <;> rfl
    · change rho⁻¹ • ringMuS
          (ringMuC (centerB (nV A)⁻¹ r omega rho r⁻¹) x.s) A = _
      rw [centerB_eq_center, ringMuS_eq, ringMuC_eq] <;> rfl
    · change rho⁻¹ • ringMuC A
          (ringMuS x.c (centerB (nV A)⁻¹ r omega rho r⁻¹)) = _
      rw [centerB_eq_center, ringMuS_eq, ringMuC_eq] <;> rfl
  rw [hJ] <;> rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourFixedParityInvariantTransport.map_parityVectorRing
statement:
private theorem map_parityVectorRing
    {L : Type*} [Field L] [CharZero L]
    (f : FamilyRing k →+* L) :
    mapV f (parityVectorRing k) =
      (SourceVectorPairDephase.parityVector : VCoord L)
proof:
:= by
  apply VCoord.ext
  · simp [parityVectorRing, RationalEvenRingAction.mapV,
      SourceVectorPairDephase.parityVector]
  · simp [parityVectorRing, RationalEvenRingAction.mapV,
      SourceVectorPairDephase.parityVector]
  · funext j
    fin_cases j <;> simp [parityVectorRing, RationalEvenRingAction.mapV,
      RationalEvenRingAction.mapW, SourceVectorPairDephase.parityVector,
      ExteriorSix.wBasis]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourFixedParityInvariantTransport.stageDenominator_dvd
statement:
theorem stageDenominator_dvd (i : Fin 4) :
    stageDenominator k i ∣ denominator k
proof:
:=
  Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem (fun j : Fin 4 => stageDenominator k j)
    (Finset.mem_univ i)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourFixedParityInvariantTransport.r_dvd_denominator
statement:
theorem r_dvd_denominator (i : Fin 4) :
    MvPolynomial.X (.r i) ∣ denominator k
proof:
:= by
  exact dvd_trans ⟨MvPolynomial.X (.rho i), rfl⟩ (stageDenominator_dvd k i)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourFixedParityInvariantTransport.rho_dvd_denominator
statement:
theorem rho_dvd_denominator (i : Fin 4) :
    MvPolynomial.X (.rho i) ∣ denominator k
proof:
:= by
  refine dvd_trans ⟨MvPolynomial.X (.r i), ?_⟩ (stageDenominator_dvd k i)
  simp [stageDenominator, mul_comm]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourFixedParityInvariantTransport.localized_r_isUnit
statement: theorem localized_r_isUnit (i : Fin 4) : IsUnit (parameter k (.r i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [parameter, IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit_iff
    (x := mappedDenominator k)]
  exact ⟨1, by simpa [mappedDenominator, LocalizedGridIdentity.mappedDenominator,
    denominator, stageDenominator] using r_dvd_denominator (F k) i⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourFixedParityInvariantTransport.localized_rho_isUnit
statement: theorem localized_rho_isUnit (i : Fin 4) : IsUnit (parameter k (.rho i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [parameter, IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit_iff
    (x := mappedDenominator k)]
  exact ⟨1, by simpa [mappedDenominator, LocalizedGridIdentity.mappedDenominator,
    denominator, stageDenominator] using rho_dvd_denominator (F k) i⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourFixedParityInvariantTransport.r_mul_rInverse
statement: theorem r_mul_rInverse (i : Fin 4) : parameter k (.r i) * rInverse k i = 1
proof:
:=
  Ring.mul_inverse_cancel _ (localized_r_isUnit k i)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourFixedParityInvariantTransport.rho_mul_rhoInverse
statement:
theorem rho_mul_rhoInverse (i : Fin 4) :
    parameter k (.rho i) * rhoInverse k i = 1
proof:
:=
  Ring.mul_inverse_cancel _ (localized_rho_isUnit k i)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourFixedParityInvariantTransport.denominator_ne_zero
statement: private theorem denominator_ne_zero : denominator k ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  have heval := congrArg
    (MvPolynomial.eval (fun _ : Var => (1 : k))) hzero
  simpa [denominator, stageDenominator] using heval

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourFixedParityInvariantTransport.localizedEval_parameter
statement:
private theorem localizedEval_parameter
    (t : Var → k) (ht : MvPolynomial.eval t (denominator k) ≠ 0) (q : Var) :
    localizedConstantEval k (F k) (FamilyRing k) (denominator k) t ht
        (parameter k q) = algebraMap k (F k) (t q)
proof:
:= by
  simp [parameter, localizedConstantEval_algebraMap,
    LocalizedGridIdentity.constantEval]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourFixedParityInvariantTransport.stage_values_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem stage_values_ne_zero
    (t : Var → k) (ht : MvPolynomial.eval t (denominator k) ≠ 0)
    (i : Fin 4) : t (.r i) ≠ 0 ∧ t (.rho i) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hr
    apply ht
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := stageDenominator_dvd k i
    rw [hq, map_mul]
    simp [stageDenominator, hr]
  · intro hp
    apply ht
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := stageDenominator_dvd k i
    rw [hq, map_mul]
    simp [stageDenominator, hp]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourFixedParityInvariantTransport.localizedEval_rInverse
statement:
private theorem localizedEval_rInverse
    (t : Var → k) (ht : MvPolynomial.eval t (denominator k) ≠ 0)
    (i : Fin 4) :
    localizedConstantEval k (F k) (FamilyRing k) (denominator k) t ht
        (rInverse k i) = algebraMap k (F k) (t (.r i))⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  let ev := localizedConstantEval k (F k) (FamilyRing k) (denominator k) t ht
  have hr := (stage_values_ne_zero k t ht i).1
  have her : algebraMap k (F k) (t (.r i)) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [map_zero] using (algebraMap k (F k)).injective.ne hr
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ her
  have h := congrArg ev (r_mul_rInverse k i)
  rw [map_mul, map_one, localizedEval_parameter k t ht] at h
  calc
    algebraMap k (F k) (t (.r i)) * ev (rInverse k i) = 1 := h
    _ = algebraMap k (F k) (t (.r i)) *
        (algebraMap k (F k) (t (.r i)))⁻¹ := (mul_inv_cancel₀ her).symm
    _ = algebraMap k (F k) (t (.r i)) *
        algebraMap k (F k) ((t (.r i))⁻¹) := by rw [map_inv₀]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourFixedParityInvariantTransport.localizedEval_rhoInverse
statement:
private theorem localizedEval_rhoInverse
    (t : Var → k) (ht : MvPolynomial.eval t (denominator k) ≠ 0)
    (i : Fin 4) :
    localizedConstantEval k (F k) (FamilyRing k) (denominator k) t ht
        (rhoInverse k i) = algebraMap k (F k) (t (.rho i))⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  let ev := localizedConstantEval k (F k) (FamilyRing k) (denominator k) t ht
  have hp := (stage_values_ne_zero k t ht i).2
  have hep : algebraMap k (F k) (t (.rho i)) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [map_zero] using (algebraMap k (F k)).injective.ne hp
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ hep
  have h := congrArg ev (rho_mul_rhoInverse k i)
  rw [map_mul, map_one, localizedEval_parameter k t ht] at h
  calc
    algebraMap k (F k) (t (.rho i)) * ev (rhoInverse k i) = 1 := h
    _ = algebraMap k (F k) (t (.rho i)) *
        (algebraMap k (F k) (t (.rho i)))⁻¹ := (mul_inv_cancel₀ hep).symm
    _ = algebraMap k (F k) (t (.rho i)) *
        algebraMap k (F k) ((t (.rho i))⁻¹) := by rw [map_inv₀]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourFixedParityInvariantTransport.baseLinear_comp
statement:
private theorem baseLinear_comp
    (g₂ g₁ : ResidualAction.SourceAut (K := k)) :
    SourceAutExtension.baseLinear (sourceAutComp g₂ g₁) =
      (SourceAutExtension.baseLinear g₂).comp
        (SourceAutExtension.baseLinear g₁)
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  simp [SourceAutExtension.baseLinear, sourceAutComp,
    AlbertLean.Triality.GenericCoordinates.f0ToStructuredK_structuredToF0K]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourFixedParityInvariantTransport.extended_comp_apply
statement:
private theorem extended_comp_apply
    (g₂ g₁ : ResidualAction.SourceAut (K := k)) (x : Fin 27 → F k) :
    SourceAutExtension.linearEquiv (R := F k) (sourceAutComp g₂ g₁) x =
      SourceAutExtension.linearEquiv (R := F k) g₂
        (SourceAutExtension.linearEquiv (R := F k) g₁ x)
proof:
:= by
  change SourceAutExtension.linear (R := F k) (sourceAutComp g₂ g₁) x = _
  rw [SourceAutExtension.linear, baseLinear_comp k,
    FiniteIndexExtension.extend_comp]
  rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourFixedParityInvariantTransport.extended_family_linear
statement:
private theorem extended_family_linear
    (r : k) (w : W k) (rho : k) (hr : r ≠ 0) (hp : rho ≠ 0) :
    (SourceAutExtension.linearEquiv (R := F k)
        (fixedParitySourceAut k r w rho hr hp)).toLinearMap =
      SourceAutExtension.baseLinear (k := F k)
        (fixedParitySourceAut (F k) (algebraMap k (F k) r)
          (AlbertLean.Triality.RationalEvenFamilyNaturality.mapW
            (algebraMap k (F k)) w) (algebraMap k (F k) rho)
          (by simpa only [map_zero] using (algebraMap k (F k)).injective.ne hr)
          (by simpa only [map_zero] using (algebraMap k (F k)).injective.ne hp))
proof:
:=
  FixedParityFamilyFieldSubstitution.extended_family_linear k r w rho hr hp

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourFixedParityInvariantTransport.baseStageF0_eq_extended
statement:
private theorem baseStageF0_eq_extended
    (t : Var → k) (i : Fin 4)
    (hr : t (.r i) ≠ 0) (hp : t (.rho i) ≠ 0)
    (x : Fin 27 → F k) :
    familyF0 (SourceVectorPairDephase.parityVector : VCoord (F k)) 1 1
        (algebraMap k (F k) (t (.r i)))
        (fun j => algebraMap k (F k) (t (.omega i j)))
        (algebraMap k (F k) (t (.rho i)))
        (algebraMap k (F k) (t (.r i)))⁻¹
        (algebraMap k (F k) (t (.rho i)))⁻¹ x =
      SourceAutExtension.linearEquiv (R := F k)
        (baseStageAut k t i hr hp) x
proof:
:= by
  funext c
  change _ = SourceAutExtension.linear (R := F k)
    (baseStageAut k t i hr hp) x c
  let gF := fixedParitySourceAut (F k) (algebraMap k (F k) (t (.r i)))
    (fun j => algebraMap k (F k) (t (.omega i j)))
    (algebraMap k (F k) (t (.rho i)))
    (by simpa only [map_zero] using (algebraMap k (F k)).injective.ne hr)
    (by simpa only [map_zero] using (algebraMap k (F k)).injective.ne hp)
  have hf := familyF0_eq_sourceEvenAut
    (A := (SourceVectorPairDephase.parityVector : VCoord (F k))) (by simp)
    (algebraMap k (F k) (t (.r i)))
    (fun j => algebraMap k (F k) (t (.omega i j)))
    (algebraMap k (F k) (t (.rho i)))
    (by simpa only [map_zero] using (algebraMap k (F k)).injective.ne hr)
    (by simpa only [map_zero] using (algebraMap k (F k)).injective.ne hp)
    ((structuredEquivK (F k)).symm x)
  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at hf
  have hfc := congrFun hf c
  have htwoF :
      (RationalEvenRingAction.instInvertibleOfNat_albertLean :
        Invertible (2 : F k)) = functionTwo k := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  rw [htwoF] at hfc
  have hbase :
      familyF0 (SourceVectorPairDephase.parityVector : VCoord (F k)) 1 1
          (algebraMap k (F k) (t (.r i)))
          (fun j => algebraMap k (F k) (t (.omega i j)))
          (algebraMap k (F k) (t (.rho i)))
          (algebraMap k (F k) (t (.r i)))⁻¹
          (algebraMap k (F k) (t (.rho i)))⁻¹ x c =
        SourceAutExtension.baseLinear (k := F k) gF x c := by
    simp only [nV_parityVector, inv_one] at hfc
    change familyF0 (SourceVectorPairDephase.parityVector : VCoord (F k)) 1 1
        (algebraMap k (F k) (t (.r i)))
        (AlbertLean.Triality.RationalEvenFamilyNaturality.mapW
          (algebraMap k (F k)) (fun j => t (.omega i j)))
        (algebraMap k (F k) (t (.rho i)))
        (algebraMap k (F k) (t (.r i)))⁻¹
        (algebraMap k (F k) (t (.rho i)))⁻¹ x c = _ at hfc
    exact hfc
  have he := LinearMap.congr_fun
    (extended_family_linear k (t (.r i)) (fun j => t (.omega i j))
      (t (.rho i)) hr hp) x
  have hw :
      AlbertLean.Triality.RationalEvenFamilyNaturality.mapW
          (algebraMap k (F k)) (fun j => t (.omega i j)) =
        (fun j => algebraMap k (F k) (t (.omega i j))) := by
    funext j
    rfl
  rw [hw] at he
  change SourceAutExtension.linear (R := F k)
      (fixedParitySourceAut k (t (.r i)) (fun j => t (.omega i j))
        (t (.rho i)) hr hp) x =
    SourceAutExtension.baseLinear (k := F k)
      (fixedParitySourceAut (F k) (algebraMap k (F k) (t (.r i)))
        (fun j => algebraMap k (F k) (t (.omega i j)))
        (algebraMap k (F k) (t (.rho i)))
        (by simpa only [map_zero] using (algebraMap k (F k)).injective.ne hr)
        (by simpa only [map_zero] using (algebraMap k (F k)).injective.ne hp)) x at he
  have he' : SourceAutExtension.baseLinear (k := F k) gF x =
      SourceAutExtension.linear (R := F k)
        (baseStageAut k t i hr hp) x := by
    simpa only [gF, baseStageAut] using he.symm
  exact hbase.trans (congrFun he' c)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourFixedParityInvariantTransport.baseWordF0_eq_extended
statement:
private theorem baseWordF0_eq_extended
    (t : Var → k) (h : ∀ i, t (.r i) ≠ 0 ∧ t (.rho i) ≠ 0)
    (x : Fin 27 → F k) :
    baseWordF0 k t x =
      SourceAutExtension.linearEquiv (R := F k) (baseWordAut k t h) x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [baseWordF0, baseWordAut]
  rw [baseStageF0_eq_extended k t 0 (h 0).1 (h 0).2,
    baseStageF0_eq_extended k t 1 (h 1).1 (h 1).2,
    baseStageF0_eq_extended k t 2 (h 2).1 (h 2).2,
    baseStageF0_eq_extended k t 3 (h 3).1 (h 3).2]
  rw [extended_comp_apply k, extended_comp_apply k, extended_comp_apply k]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourFixedParityInvariantTransport.localizedEval_coefficient
statement:
private theorem localizedEval_coefficient
    (t : Var → k) (ht : MvPolynomial.eval t (denominator k) ≠ 0)
    (x : F k) :
    localizedConstantEval k (F k) (FamilyRing k) (denominator k) t ht
        (coefficientEmbedding k x) = x
proof:
:= by
  simp [coefficientEmbedding, localizedConstantEval_algebraMap,
    LocalizedGridIdentity.constantEval]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourFixedParityInvariantTransport.localizedEval_familyStage
statement:
private theorem localizedEval_familyStage
    (t : Var → k) (ht : MvPolynomial.eval t (denominator k) ≠ 0)
    (i : Fin 4) (x : Fin 27 → FamilyRing k) :
    mapF0 (localizedConstantEval k (F k) (FamilyRing k)
      (denominator k) t ht) (familyStage k i x) =
      familyF0 (SourceVectorPairDephase.parityVector : VCoord (F k)) 1 1
        (algebraMap k (F k) (t (.r i)))
        (fun j => algebraMap k (F k) (t (.omega i j)))
        (algebraMap k (F k) (t (.rho i)))
        (algebraMap k (F k) (t (.r i)))⁻¹
        (algebraMap k (F k) (t (.rho i)))⁻¹
        (mapF0 (localizedConstantEval k (F k) (FamilyRing k)
          (denominator k) t ht) x)
proof:
:= by
  let ev := localizedConstantEval k (F k) (FamilyRing k)
    (denominator k) t ht
  change mapF0 ev (familyStage k i x) =
    familyF0 (SourceVectorPairDephase.parityVector : VCoord (F k)) 1 1
      (algebraMap k (F k) (t (.r i)))
      (fun j => algebraMap k (F k) (t (.omega i j)))
      (algebraMap k (F k) (t (.rho i)))
      (algebraMap k (F k) (t (.r i)))⁻¹
      (algebraMap k (F k) (t (.rho i)))⁻¹ (mapF0 ev x)
  have hev : ev = localizedConstantEval k (F k) (FamilyRing k)
      (denominator k) t ht := rfl
  have hparity := map_parityVectorRing k ev
  have homega : mapW ev (omegaParameter k i) =
      fun j => algebraMap k (F k) (t (.omega i j)) := by
    funext j
    rw [hev]
    exact localizedEval_parameter k t ht (.omega i j)
  have hri : ev (rInverse k i) =
      algebraMap k (F k) (t (.r i))⁻¹ := by
    rw [hev]
    simpa only [map_inv₀] using localizedEval_rInverse k t ht i
  have hrhoi : ev (rhoInverse k i) =
      algebraMap k (F k) (t (.rho i))⁻¹ := by
    rw [hev]
    simpa only [map_inv₀] using localizedEval_rhoInverse k t ht i
  simp only [familyStage, map_familyF0]
  rw [hparity, map_one, homega, hri, hrhoi]
  rw [hev, localizedEval_parameter k t ht (.r i),
    localizedEval_parameter k t ht (.rho i)]
  simp only [map_inv₀]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourFixedParityInvariantTransport.localizedEval_fourFamily
statement:
private theorem localizedEval_fourFamily
    (t : Var → k) (ht : MvPolynomial.eval t (denominator k) ≠ 0)
    (frame projector : Fin 3) :
    mapF0 (localizedConstantEval k (F k) (FamilyRing k)
      (denominator k) t ht) (fourFamily k frame projector) =
      baseWordF0 k t (universalF0 k frame projector)
proof:
:= by
  let ev := localizedConstantEval k (F k) (FamilyRing k)
    (denominator k) t ht
  have hev : ev = localizedConstantEval k (F k) (FamilyRing k)
      (denominator k) t ht := rfl
  simp only [fourFamily]
  have huniversal : mapF0 ev
      (mapF0 (coefficientEmbedding k) (universalF0 k frame projector)) =
      universalF0 k frame projector := by
    funext j
    rw [hev]
    exact localizedEval_coefficient k t ht _
  rw [localizedEval_familyStage k t ht 0,
    localizedEval_familyStage k t ht 1,
    localizedEval_familyStage k t ht 2,
    localizedEval_familyStage k t ht 3,
    huniversal]
  simp only [baseWordF0]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourFixedParityInvariantTransport.localizedEval_familySubstitution
statement:
private theorem localizedEval_familySubstitution
    (t : Var → k) (ht : MvPolynomial.eval t (denominator k) ≠ 0) :
    (localizedConstantEval k (F k) (FamilyRing k) (denominator k) t ht).comp
        (familySubstitution k) = baseFamilySubstitution k t
proof:
:= by
  apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
  · intro c
    have hraw : rawToFunction k (MvPolynomial.C c) =
        algebraMap k (F k) c := by
      change (rawToFunctionAlg k)
        (algebraMap k (CoordinateRing k) c) = _
      exact (rawToFunctionAlg k).commutes c
    simpa [familySubstitution, baseFamilySubstitution,
      localizedEval_coefficient k t ht] using hraw.symm
  · intro q
    cases q with
    | entry frame projector coord =>
      simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, familySubstitution,
        baseFamilySubstitution, MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_X']
      exact congrFun (localizedEval_fourFamily k t ht frame projector) coord

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourFixedParityInvariantTransport.baseFamilySubstitution_eq_fractionAction
statement:
private theorem baseFamilySubstitution_eq_fractionAction
    (t : Var → k) (h : ∀ i, t (.r i) ≠ 0 ∧ t (.rho i) ≠ 0) :
    baseFamilySubstitution k t =
      (fractionAction k (baseWordAut k t h)).toRingHom.comp (rawToFunction k)
proof:
:= by
  apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
  · intro a
    simp only [baseFamilySubstitution, MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_C,
      RingHom.comp_apply]
    rw [rawToFunction, RingHom.comp_apply]
    change _ = fractionAction k (baseWordAut k t h)
      (algebraMap (ReducedCoordinateRing k) (F k)
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (MvPolynomial.C a)))
    rw [fractionAction_algebraMap_reduced]
    congr 1
    change Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (MvPolynomial.C a) =
      SourceReducedRawAutomorphism.reducedActionHom k _
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (MvPolynomial.C a))
    rw [SourceReducedRawAutomorphism.reducedActionHom_mk]
    congr 1
    simp [SourceRawAutomorphism.rawAction]
  · intro q
    cases q with
    | entry frame projector coord =>
      simp only [baseFamilySubstitution, MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_X',
        RingHom.comp_apply]
      rw [baseWordF0_eq_extended k t h]
      exact (congrFun (fractionAction_universalF0 k
        (baseWordAut k t h) frame projector) coord).symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourFixedParityInvariantTransport.cleared_fourFamily_identity
statement:
theorem cleared_fourFamily_identity
    (a b : CoordinateRing k) (hb : rawToFunction k b ≠ 0)
    (hinv : IsSourceInvariant k
      (rawToFunction k a / rawToFunction k b)) :
    familySubstitution k a * coefficientEmbedding k (rawToFunction k b) -
      coefficientEmbedding k (rawToFunction k a) * familySubstitution k b = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply eq_zero_of_localizedConstantEval_eq_zero k (F k) (FamilyRing k)
    (denominator k) (denominator_ne_zero k)
  intro t ht
  have hstage : ∀ i, t (.r i) ≠ 0 ∧ t (.rho i) ≠ 0 :=
    stage_values_ne_zero k t ht
  let g := baseWordAut k t hstage
  have hs := localizedEval_familySubstitution k t ht
  have hsa := DFunLike.congr_fun hs a
  have hsb := DFunLike.congr_fun hs b
  have hactual := baseFamilySubstitution_eq_fractionAction k t hstage
  have haa := DFunLike.congr_fun hactual a
  have hab := DFunLike.congr_fun hactual b
  have hi := hinv g
  have hgb : fractionAction k g (rawToFunction k b) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [map_zero] using (fractionAction k g).injective.ne hb
  have hcross :
      fractionAction k g (rawToFunction k a) * rawToFunction k b =
        rawToFunction k a * fractionAction k g (rawToFunction k b) := by
    apply (div_eq_div_iff hgb hb).mp
    simpa only [map_div₀] using hi
  simp only [map_sub, map_mul]
  have hsa' : localizedConstantEval k (F k) (FamilyRing k)
      (denominator k) t ht (familySubstitution k a) =
      baseFamilySubstitution k t a := by
    simpa only [RingHom.comp_apply] using hsa
  have hsb' : localizedConstantEval k (F k) (FamilyRing k)
      (denominator k) t ht (familySubstitution k b) =
      baseFamilySubstitution k t b := by
    simpa only [RingHom.comp_apply] using hsb
  rw [hsa', hsb']
  rw [localizedEval_coefficient k t ht, localizedEval_coefficient k t ht]
  have haa' : baseFamilySubstitution k t a =
      fractionAction k g (rawToFunction k a) := by
    simpa only [RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe,
      RingHom.comp_apply, g] using haa
  have hab' : baseFamilySubstitution k t b =
      fractionAction k g (rawToFunction k b) := by
    simpa only [RingEquiv.toRingHom_eq_coe, RingHom.coe_coe,
      RingHom.comp_apply, g] using hab
  rw [haa', hab', hcross, sub_self]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourFixedParityInvariantTransport.fourFactorSubstitution_eq_sourceEven
statement:
theorem fourFactorSubstitution_eq_sourceEven
    (phi : F k →+* E)
    (A B : VCoord E) (rho₀ : E)
    (hA : nV A ≠ 0) (hB : nV B ≠ 0)
    (hroot : rho₀ ^ 2 = nV A * nV B) (hrho₀ : rho₀ ≠ 0)
    (Q : AlbertLean.Triality.ParityEvenFourFactor.FourFixedParityFactorization
      A B rho₀ hA hB hroot hrho₀) :
    fourFactorSubstitution k phi Q =
      sourceEvenSubstitution k phi A B rho₀ hA hB hroot hrho₀
proof:
:= by
  apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
  · intro c
    simp [fourFactorSubstitution, sourceEvenSubstitution]
  · intro q
    cases q with
    | entry frame projector coord =>
      simp only [fourFactorSubstitution, sourceEvenSubstitution,
        MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_X']
      exact congrFun (congrArg (structuredEquivK E)
        (Q.action ((structuredEquivK E).symm
          (mapF0 phi (universalF0 k frame projector)))).symm) coord

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourFixedParityInvariantTransport.extension_denominator_unit
statement:
private theorem extension_denominator_unit (phi : F k →+* E)
    (r rho : Fin 4 → E) (w : Fin 4 → W E)
    (hr : ∀ i, r i ≠ 0) (hp : ∀ i, rho i ≠ 0) :
    IsUnit (MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom phi (extensionPoint r rho w)
      (mappedDenominator k))
proof:
:= by
  apply isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr
  have hprod : ∏ i : Fin 4, r i * rho i ≠ 0 := by
    exact Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr fun i _ => mul_ne_zero (hr i) (hp i)
  simpa [mappedDenominator, LocalizedGridIdentity.mappedDenominator,
    denominator, stageDenominator, extensionPoint] using hprod

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourFixedParityInvariantTransport.extensionEval_parameter
statement:
private theorem extensionEval_parameter
    (phi : F k →+* E) (r rho : Fin 4 → E) (w : Fin 4 → W E)
    (hr : ∀ i, r i ≠ 0) (hp : ∀ i, rho i ≠ 0) (q : Var) :
    extensionEval k (F k) (FamilyRing k) (denominator k) phi
      (extensionPoint r rho w) (extension_denominator_unit k phi r rho w hr hp)
      (parameter k q) = extensionPoint r rho w q
proof:
:= by
  simp [parameter, extensionEval, IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq, extensionPoint]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourFixedParityInvariantTransport.extensionEval_coefficient
statement:
private theorem extensionEval_coefficient
    (phi : F k →+* E) (r rho : Fin 4 → E) (w : Fin 4 → W E)
    (hr : ∀ i, r i ≠ 0) (hp : ∀ i, rho i ≠ 0) (x : F k) :
    extensionEval k (F k) (FamilyRing k) (denominator k) phi
      (extensionPoint r rho w) (extension_denominator_unit k phi r rho w hr hp)
      (coefficientEmbedding k x) = phi x
proof:
:= by
  simp [coefficientEmbedding, extensionEval, IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourFixedParityInvariantTransport.extensionEval_rInverse
statement:
private theorem extensionEval_rInverse
    (phi : F k →+* E) (r rho : Fin 4 → E) (w : Fin 4 → W E)
    (hr : ∀ i, r i ≠ 0) (hp : ∀ i, rho i ≠ 0) (i : Fin 4) :
    extensionEval k (F k) (FamilyRing k) (denominator k) phi
      (extensionPoint r rho w) (extension_denominator_unit k phi r rho w hr hp)
      (rInverse k i) = (r i)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  let ev := extensionEval k (F k) (FamilyRing k) (denominator k) phi
    (extensionPoint r rho w) (extension_denominator_unit k phi r rho w hr hp)
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ (hr i)
  have h := congrArg ev (r_mul_rInverse k i)
  rw [map_mul, map_one, extensionEval_parameter k phi r rho w hr hp] at h
  have h' : r i * ev (rInverse k i) = 1 := by
    simpa only [extensionPoint] using h
  calc
    r i * ev (rInverse k i) = 1 := h'
    _ = r i * (r i)⁻¹ := (mul_inv_cancel₀ (hr i)).symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourFixedParityInvariantTransport.extensionEval_rhoInverse
statement:
private theorem extensionEval_rhoInverse
    (phi : F k →+* E) (r rho : Fin 4 → E) (w : Fin 4 → W E)
    (hr : ∀ i, r i ≠ 0) (hp : ∀ i, rho i ≠ 0) (i : Fin 4) :
    extensionEval k (F k) (FamilyRing k) (denominator k) phi
      (extensionPoint r rho w) (extension_denominator_unit k phi r rho w hr hp)
      (rhoInverse k i) = (rho i)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  let ev := extensionEval k (F k) (FamilyRing k) (denominator k) phi
    (extensionPoint r rho w) (extension_denominator_unit k phi r rho w hr hp)
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ (hp i)
  have h := congrArg ev (rho_mul_rhoInverse k i)
  rw [map_mul, map_one, extensionEval_parameter k phi r rho w hr hp] at h
  have h' : rho i * ev (rhoInverse k i) = 1 := by
    simpa only [extensionPoint] using h
  calc
    rho i * ev (rhoInverse k i) = 1 := h'
    _ = rho i * (rho i)⁻¹ := (mul_inv_cancel₀ (hp i)).symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourFixedParityInvariantTransport.extensionEval_familySubstitution
statement:
private theorem extensionEval_familySubstitution
    (phi : F k →+* E) (r rho : Fin 4 → E) (w : Fin 4 → W E)
    (hr : ∀ i, r i ≠ 0) (hp : ∀ i, rho i ≠ 0) :
    (extensionEval k (F k) (FamilyRing k) (denominator k) phi
      (extensionPoint r rho w) (extension_denominator_unit k phi r rho w hr hp)).comp
        (familySubstitution k) = extensionFamilySubstitution k phi r rho w
proof:
:= by
  apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
  · intro c
    simp [familySubstitution, extensionFamilySubstitution,
      extensionEval_coefficient k phi r rho w hr hp]
  · intro q
    cases q with
    | entry frame projector coord =>
      simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, familySubstitution,
        extensionFamilySubstitution, MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_X']
      have hm :
          mapF0 (extensionEval k (F k) (FamilyRing k) (denominator k) phi
            (extensionPoint r rho w) (extension_denominator_unit k phi r rho w hr hp))
            (fourFamily k frame projector) =
          extensionFourFamily k phi r rho w frame projector := by
        simp only [fourFamily, familyStage, extensionFourFamily, extensionStage]
        have hparity := map_parityVectorRing k
          (extensionEval k (F k) (FamilyRing k) (denominator k) phi
            (extensionPoint r rho w) (extension_denominator_unit k phi r rho w hr hp))
        let ev := extensionEval k (F k) (FamilyRing k) (denominator k) phi
          (extensionPoint r rho w)
          (extension_denominator_unit k phi r rho w hr hp)
        have hev : ev = extensionEval k (F k) (FamilyRing k)
            (denominator k) phi (extensionPoint r rho w)
            (extension_denominator_unit k phi r rho w hr hp) := rfl
        have hone : ev 1 = 1 := map_one ev
        have hrParameter (i : Fin 4) : ev (parameter k (.r i)) = r i := by
          rw [hev]
          simpa only [extensionPoint] using
            (extensionEval_parameter k phi r rho w hr hp (.r i))
        have hrhoParameter (i : Fin 4) :
            ev (parameter k (.rho i)) = rho i := by
          rw [hev]
          simpa only [extensionPoint] using
            (extensionEval_parameter k phi r rho w hr hp (.rho i))
        have homega (i : Fin 4) : mapW ev (omegaParameter k i) = w i := by
          funext j
          change ev (parameter k (.omega i j)) = w i j
          rw [hev]
          simpa only [extensionPoint] using
            (extensionEval_parameter k phi r rho w hr hp (.omega i j))
        have huniversal : mapF0 ev
            (mapF0 (coefficientEmbedding k) (universalF0 k frame projector)) =
            mapF0 phi (universalF0 k frame projector) := by
          funext j
          change ev (coefficientEmbedding k (universalF0 k frame projector j)) =
            phi (universalF0 k frame projector j)
          rw [hev]
          exact extensionEval_coefficient k phi r rho w hr hp _
        have hri (i : Fin 4) : ev (rInverse k i) = (r i)⁻¹ := by
          rw [hev]
          exact extensionEval_rInverse k phi r rho w hr hp i
        have hrhoi (i : Fin 4) : ev (rhoInverse k i) = (rho i)⁻¹ := by
          rw [hev]
          exact extensionEval_rhoInverse k phi r rho w hr hp i
        rw [map_familyF0, map_familyF0, map_familyF0, map_familyF0]
        rw [hparity, hone, hrParameter 0, hrParameter 1,
          hrParameter 2, hrParameter 3,
          hrhoParameter 0, hrhoParameter 1, hrhoParameter 2, hrhoParameter 3,
          homega 0, homega 1, homega 2, homega 3,
          huniversal, hri 0, hri 1, hri 2, hri 3,
          hrhoi 0, hrhoi 1, hrhoi 2, hrhoi 3]
      exact congrFun hm coord

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourFixedParityInvariantTransport.extension_cleared_fourFamily_identity
statement:
theorem extension_cleared_fourFamily_identity
    (a b : CoordinateRing k) (hb : rawToFunction k b ≠ 0)
    (hinv : IsSourceInvariant k
      (rawToFunction k a / rawToFunction k b))
    (phi : F k →+* E) (r rho : Fin 4 → E) (w : Fin 4 → W E)
    (hr : ∀ i, r i ≠ 0) (hp : ∀ i, rho i ≠ 0) :
    extensionFamilySubstitution k phi r rho w a * phi (rawToFunction k b) =
      phi (rawToFunction k a) * extensionFamilySubstitution k phi r rho w b
proof:
:= by
  let ev := extensionEval k (F k) (FamilyRing k) (denominator k) phi
    (extensionPoint r rho w) (extension_denominator_unit k phi r rho w hr hp)
  have hz := congrArg ev (cleared_fourFamily_identity k a b hb hinv)
  have hs := extensionEval_familySubstitution k phi r rho w hr hp
  have hsa := DFunLike.congr_fun hs a
  have hsb := DFunLike.congr_fun hs b
  rw [map_sub, map_mul, map_mul, map_zero, sub_eq_zero] at hz
  have hsa' : ev (familySubstitution k a) =
      extensionFamilySubstitution k phi r rho w a := by
    simpa only [RingHom.comp_apply] using hsa
  have hsb' : ev (familySubstitution k b) =
      extensionFamilySubstitution k phi r rho w b := by
    simpa only [RingHom.comp_apply] using hsb
  rw [hsa', hsb'] at hz
  rw [extensionEval_coefficient k phi r rho w hr hp,
    extensionEval_coefficient k phi r rho w hr hp] at hz
  exact hz

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourFixedParityInvariantTransport.extensionStage_eq_factor
proof:
:= by
  funext c
  have hf := familyF0_eq_sourceEvenAut
    (A := (SourceVectorPairDephase.parityVector : VCoord E)) (by simp)
    (Q.r i) (Q.w i) (Q.s i) (Q.r_ne i) (Q.s_ne i)
    ((structuredEquivK E).symm x)
  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at hf
  have hfc := congrFun hf c
  have htwoE :
      (RationalEvenRingAction.instInvertibleOfNat_albertLean :
        Invertible (2 : E)) = targetTwo := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  rw [htwoE] at hfc
  rw [Q.factor_eq i]
  simpa only [extensionStage, nV_parityVector, inv_one,
    recoveryAutToSourceAut] using hfc

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourFixedParityInvariantTransport.extensionFamilySubstitution_eq_fourFactor
proof:
:= by
  apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
  · intro c
    simp [extensionFamilySubstitution, fourFactorSubstitution]
  · intro q
    cases q with
    | entry frame projector coord =>
      simp only [extensionFamilySubstitution,
        fourFactorSubstitution,
        MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_X']
      simp only [extensionFourFamily]
      rw [extensionStage_eq_factor Q 3,
        extensionStage_eq_factor Q 2,
        extensionStage_eq_factor Q 1,
        extensionStage_eq_factor Q 0]
      simp only [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourFixedParityInvariantTransport.extension_cleared_fourFactor_identity
statement:
theorem extension_cleared_fourFactor_identity
    (a b : CoordinateRing k) (hb : rawToFunction k b ≠ 0)
    (hinv : IsSourceInvariant k
      (rawToFunction k a / rawToFunction k b))
    (phi : F k →+* E)
    {A B : VCoord E} {rho₀ : E}
    {hA : nV A ≠ 0} {hB : nV B ≠ 0}
    {hroot : rho₀ ^ 2 = nV A * nV B} {hrho₀ : rho₀ ≠ 0}
    (Q : AlbertLean.Triality.ParityEvenFourFactor.FourFixedParityFactorization
      A B rho₀ hA hB hroot hrho₀) :
    fourFactorSubstitution k phi Q a *
        phi (rawToFunction k b) =
      phi (rawToFunction k a) *
        fourFactorSubstitution k phi Q b
proof:
:= by
  rw [← extensionFamilySubstitution_eq_fourFactor k phi Q]
  exact extension_cleared_fourFamily_identity k a b hb hinv phi
    Q.r Q.s Q.w Q.r_ne Q.s_ne

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourFixedParityInvariantTransport.extension_cleared_sourceEven_identity
statement:
theorem extension_cleared_sourceEven_identity
    (a b : CoordinateRing k) (hb : rawToFunction k b ≠ 0)
    (hinv : IsSourceInvariant k
      (rawToFunction k a / rawToFunction k b))
    (phi : F k →+* E)
    (A B : VCoord E) (rho₀ : E)
    (hA : nV A ≠ 0) (hB : nV B ≠ 0)
    (hroot : rho₀ ^ 2 = nV A * nV B) (hrho₀ : rho₀ ≠ 0)
    (Q : AlbertLean.Triality.ParityEvenFourFactor.FourFixedParityFactorization
      A B rho₀ hA hB hroot hrho₀) :
    sourceEvenSubstitution k phi A B rho₀ hA hB hroot hrho₀ a *
        phi (rawToFunction k b) =
      phi (rawToFunction k a) *
        sourceEvenSubstitution k phi A B rho₀ hA hB hroot hrho₀ b
proof:
:= by
  rw [← fourFactorSubstitution_eq_sourceEven k phi A B rho₀
    hA hB hroot hrho₀ Q]
  exact extension_cleared_fourFactor_identity k a b hb hinv phi Q

name: AlbertLean.Triality.ParityChartMovingCenter.curveOmega_pf
statement: theorem curveOmega_pf (t : K) : Pf (curveOmega t) = t ^ 7

:= by

name: AlbertLean.Triality.ParityChartMovingCenter.movingCenter_norm
statement: theorem movingCenter_norm (t : K) : nV (movingCenter t) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [movingCenter, norm_center 1 1 (curveOmega t) 1 (by norm_num)]

name: AlbertLean.Triality.ParityChartMovingCenter.movingCenter_r
statement: @[simp] theorem movingCenter_r (t : K) : (movingCenter t).r = 1
proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Triality.ParityChartMovingCenter.moved_r
statement:
theorem moved_r (A : VCoord K) (t : K) :
    (evenV parityVector (movingCenter t) A).r = pivotValue A t
proof:
:= by
  simp only [evenV, reflectV]
  change (A.r - (BV (movingCenter t) A / nV (movingCenter t)) *
      (movingCenter t).r) -
      (BV parityVector (reflectV (movingCenter t) A) / nV parityVector) *
        parityVector.r = pivotValue A t
  rw [movingCenter_norm, movingCenter_r]
  simp only [parityVector, mul_zero, sub_zero, div_one, mul_one]
  simp only [BV, BW, movingCenter, center, one_pow, div_one, curveOmega]
  rw [curveOmega_pf]
  unfold pivotValue
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RawOrthogonalAction.ringConjugate_symmetric
statement:
theorem ringConjugate_symmetric (Q A : Mat3 R) (hA : Matrix.transpose A = A) :
    Matrix.transpose (ringConjugate Q A) = ringConjugate Q A
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ringConjugate, Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.transpose_transpose,
    hA, Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RawOrthogonalAction.ringConjugate_mul
statement:
theorem ringConjugate_mul (Q A B : Mat3 R) (hQTQ : Matrix.transpose Q * Q = 1) :
    ringConjugate Q (A * B) = ringConjugate Q A * ringConjugate Q B
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ringConjugate, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc (Matrix.transpose Q) Q (B * Matrix.transpose Q),
    hQTQ, Matrix.one_mul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RawOrthogonalAction.ringConjugate_one
statement:
theorem ringConjugate_one (Q : Mat3 R) (hQQT : Q * Matrix.transpose Q = 1) :
    ringConjugate Q 1 = 1
proof: := by simp [ringConjugate, hQQT]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RawOrthogonalAction.ringConjugate_trace
statement:
theorem ringConjugate_trace (Q A : Mat3 R) (hQTQ : Matrix.transpose Q * Q = 1) :
    Matrix.trace (ringConjugate Q A) = Matrix.trace A
proof:
:= by
  calc
    Matrix.trace (Q * A * Matrix.transpose Q) =
        Matrix.trace (Matrix.transpose Q * (Q * A)) := Matrix.trace_mul_comm _ _
    _ = Matrix.trace A := by rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc, hQTQ, Matrix.one_mul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RawOrthogonalAction.ringConjugate_sum
statement:
theorem ringConjugate_sum {ι : Type v} [Fintype ι] (Q : Mat3 R) (A : ι → Mat3 R) :
    (∑ i, ringConjugate Q (A i)) = ringConjugate Q (∑ i, A i)
proof:
:= by
  simp [ringConjugate, Matrix.mul_sum, Matrix.sum_mul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RawOrthogonalAction.isRawPrimitiveFrameFamily_conjugate
statement:
theorem isRawPrimitiveFrameFamily_conjugate
    (Q : Mat3 R) (hQTQ : Matrix.transpose Q * Q = 1)
    (hQQT : Q * Matrix.transpose Q = 1) (P : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Mat3 R)
    (hP : IsRawPrimitiveFrameFamily P) :
    IsRawPrimitiveFrameFamily (conjugateFamily Q P)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro r i a b
    have hsymm : Matrix.transpose (P r i) = P r i := by
      ext x y
      simpa [Matrix.transpose_apply] using hP.symmetric r i y x
    have h := ringConjugate_symmetric Q (P r i) hsymm
    simpa [conjugateFamily, Matrix.transpose_apply] using congrFun (congrFun h b) a
  · intro r i
    change ringConjugate Q (P r i) * ringConjugate Q (P r i) = ringConjugate Q (P r i)
    rw [← ringConjugate_mul Q _ _ hQTQ, hP.idempotent]
  · intro r i
    exact (ringConjugate_trace Q (P r i) hQTQ).trans (hP.trace_one r i)
  · intro r
    change (∑ i, ringConjugate Q (P r i)) = 1
    rw [ringConjugate_sum]
    rw [hP.sum_one r, ringConjugate_one Q hQQT]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RawOrthogonalAction.rawAction_universalMatrix
statement:
@[simp] theorem rawAction_universalMatrix (Q : Mat3 k) (r i a b : Fin 3) :
    rawAction k Q (universalMatrix r i a b) =
      ringConjugate (coefficientMatrix k Q) (universalMatrix r i) a b
proof:
:= by
  simp [rawAction, conjugateFamily]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RawOrthogonalAction.map_rawFrameIdeal_le
statement:
theorem map_rawFrameIdeal_le (Q : Mat3 k)
    (hQTQ : Matrix.transpose Q * Q = 1) (hQQT : Q * Matrix.transpose Q = 1) :
    (rawFrameIdeal (R := k)).map (rawAction k Q) ≤ rawFrameIdeal (R := k)
proof:
:= by
  let I := rawFrameIdeal (R := k)
  let qmap : CoordinateRing k →+* CoordinateRing k ⧸ I := Ideal.Quotient.mk I
  let coeff : k →+* CoordinateRing k ⧸ I := qmap.comp MvPolynomial.C
  let U : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Mat3 (CoordinateRing k ⧸ I) :=
    fun r i => qmap.mapMatrix (universalMatrix r i)
  have hevalU : evaluationAlong coeff U = qmap := by
    apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
    · intro c; simp [evaluationAlong, coeff]
    · intro x
      cases x with
      | entry r i a b => simp [U, coeff, qmap, evaluationAlong, universalMatrix]
  have hU : IsRawPrimitiveFrameFamily U := by
    apply (equations_vanishAlong_iff coeff U).1
    intro e
    rw [hevalU]
    exact Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr (Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self e))
  let Qbar : Mat3 (CoordinateRing k ⧸ I) := coeff.mapMatrix Q
  have hQbarTQ : Matrix.transpose Qbar * Qbar = 1 := by
    have h := congrArg coeff.mapMatrix hQTQ
    simpa [Qbar, Matrix.transpose_map] using h
  have hQbarQT : Qbar * Matrix.transpose Qbar = 1 := by
    have h := congrArg coeff.mapMatrix hQQT
    simpa [Qbar, Matrix.transpose_map] using h
  have hconj : IsRawPrimitiveFrameFamily (conjugateFamily Qbar U) :=
    isRawPrimitiveFrameFamily_conjugate Qbar hQbarTQ hQbarQT U hU
  let targetEval := evaluationAlong coeff (conjugateFamily Qbar U)
  have hcomp : qmap.comp (rawAction k Q) = targetEval := by
    apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
    · intro c
      simp [rawAction, targetEval, coeff, qmap, evaluationAlong]
    · intro x
      cases x with
      | entry r i a b =>
          simp [rawAction, targetEval, conjugateFamily, ringConjugate,
            coefficientMatrix, U, Qbar, coeff, qmap, evaluationAlong,
            universalMatrix, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply]
  have hkill : I ≤ RingHom.ker targetEval := by
    have hv := (equations_vanishAlong_iff coeff (conjugateFamily Qbar U)).2 hconj
    refine Ideal.span_le.2 ?_
    rintro p ⟨e, rfl⟩
    exact RingHom.mem_ker.mpr (hv e)
  rw [Ideal.map_le_iff_le_comap]
  intro p hp
  change rawAction k Q p ∈ I
  apply Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp
  change qmap (rawAction k Q p) = 0
  rw [show qmap (rawAction k Q p) = targetEval p from DFunLike.congr_fun hcomp p]
  exact RingHom.mem_ker.mp (hkill hp)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuadraticNormTransport.map_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp] theorem map_algebraMap (f : A →+* B) (d x : A) :
    map f d (algebraMap A (QuadraticAlgebra A d 0) x) =
      algebraMap B (QuadraticAlgebra B (f d) 0) (f x)
proof:
:= by
  simp [map, RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuadraticNormTransport.map_omega
statement:
@[simp] theorem map_omega (f : A →+* B) (d : A) :
    map f d (QuadraticAlgebra.omega : QuadraticAlgebra A d 0) =
      (QuadraticAlgebra.omega : QuadraticAlgebra B (f d) 0)
proof:
:= by
  simp [map, Algebra.smul_def, RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuadraticNormTransport.map_eq
statement:
theorem map_eq (f : A →+* B) (d : A) (z : QuadraticAlgebra A d 0) :
    map f d z = algebraMap B (QuadraticAlgebra B (f d) 0) (f z.re) +
      algebraMap B (QuadraticAlgebra B (f d) 0) (f z.im) * QuadraticAlgebra.omega
proof:
:= by
  rw [← QuadraticAlgebra.re_smul_add_im_smul z]
  simp [Algebra.smul_def, map_algebraMap, map_omega]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuadraticNormTransport.re_map
statement:
@[simp] theorem re_map (f : A →+* B) (d : A) (z : QuadraticAlgebra A d 0) :
    (map f d z).re = f z.re
proof: := by rw [map_eq]; simp

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuadraticNormTransport.im_map
statement:
@[simp] theorem im_map (f : A →+* B) (d : A) (z : QuadraticAlgebra A d 0) :
    (map f d z).im = f z.im
proof: := by rw [map_eq]; simp

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuadraticNormTransport.norm_map
statement:
theorem norm_map (f : A →+* B) (d : A) (z : QuadraticAlgebra A d 0) :
    QuadraticAlgebra.norm (map f d z) = f (QuadraticAlgebra.norm z)
proof:
:= by
  simp [QuadraticAlgebra.norm_def, re_map, im_map]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuadraticCharacterDescent.Data.mem_fixedField
statement: @[simp] theorem mem_fixedField (x : Ω) : x ∈ D.fixedField ↔ D.tau x = x
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuadraticCharacterDescent.Data.fixedField_finrank
statement: theorem fixedField_finrank : Module.finrank k D.fixedField = 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [D.fixedFieldEquivSpace.finrank_eq, D.fixedSpace_finrank]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuadraticCharacterDescent.Data.fixedField_finiteDimensional
statement: theorem fixedField_finiteDimensional : FiniteDimensional k D.fixedField
proof:
:= by
  exact Module.finite_of_finrank_pos (by rw [D.fixedField_finrank]; decide)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuadraticCharacterDescent.Data.fixedField_unique_coefficients
statement:
theorem fixedField_unique_coefficients (x : D.fixedField) :
    ∃! v : k × k, algebraMap k Ω v.1 + algebraMap k Ω v.2 * D.u = (x : Ω)
proof:
:=
  D.unique_tau_fixed x.val x.property

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuadraticCharacterDescent.Data.fixedField_generated_by_u
statement:
theorem fixedField_generated_by_u :
    Subfield.closure (Set.range (algebraMap k Ω) ∪ {D.u}) = D.fixedField
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply Subfield.closure_le.mpr
    intro x hx
    rcases hx with ⟨a,rfl⟩ | hx
    · exact D.tau.commutes a
    · have hx' : x = D.u := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hx
      rw [hx']
      exact D.tau_u
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨a,d,h⟩ := (D.tau_fixed_iff x).mp hx
    rw [h]
    apply Subfield.add_mem
    · exact Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inl ⟨a,rfl⟩)
    · apply Subfield.mul_mem
      · exact Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inl ⟨d,rfl⟩)
      · exact Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inr (Set.mem_singleton _))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuadraticCharacterDescent.Data.u_sq_in_base
statement: private theorem u_sq_in_base : ∃ r : k, algebraMap k Ω r = D.u ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  apply (D.joint_fixed (D.u ^ 2)).mp
  constructor <;> simp [map_pow, D.tau_u, D.delta_u]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuadraticCharacterDescent.Data.radicand_spec
statement: theorem radicand_spec : algebraMap k Ω D.radicand = D.u ^ 2
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec D.u_sq_in_base

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuadraticCharacterDescent.Data.radicand_ne_zero
statement: theorem radicand_ne_zero : D.radicand ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hz : D.u ^ 2 = 0 := by rw [← D.radicand_spec, h, map_zero]
  exact (pow_ne_zero 2 D.u_ne) hz

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuadraticCharacterDescent.Data.radicand_not_square
statement: theorem radicand_not_square : ¬ IsSquare D.radicand
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨a,ha⟩
  have hs : (algebraMap k Ω a) ^ 2 = D.u ^ 2 := by
    rw [← D.radicand_spec, ha, map_mul, pow_two]
  rcases sq_eq_sq_iff_eq_or_eq_neg.mp hs with h | h
  · exact D.u_not_base ⟨a,h⟩
  · apply D.u_not_base
    refine ⟨-a,?_⟩
    rw [map_neg, h, neg_neg]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuadraticCharacterDescent.Data.generator_square
statement: theorem generator_square : D.generator ^ 2 = algebraMap k D.fixedField D.radicand
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change D.u ^ 2 = algebraMap k Ω D.radicand
  exact D.radicand_spec.symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuadraticCharacterDescent.Data.deck_generator
statement: theorem deck_generator : D.deck D.generator = -D.generator
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext D.delta_u

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuadraticCharacterDescent.Data.deck_fixed_iff
statement:
theorem deck_fixed_iff (x : D.fixedField) : D.deck x = x ↔
    ∃ a : k, algebraMap k D.fixedField a = x
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hδ : D.delta x.val = x.val := congrArg Subtype.val hx
    obtain ⟨a,ha⟩ := (D.joint_fixed x.val).mp ⟨x.property,hδ⟩
    exact ⟨a,Subtype.ext ha⟩
  · rintro ⟨a,rfl⟩
    exact D.deck.commutes a

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuadraticCharacterDescent.Data.radicand_factorization
statement:
theorem radicand_factorization : ∃ a b : k,
    algebraMap k Ω a = D.kappa ^ 2 ∧
    algebraMap k Ω b = D.eta ^ 2 ∧ D.radicand = a * b
proof:
:= by
  have hk : ∃ a : k, algebraMap k Ω a = D.kappa ^ 2 := by
    apply (D.joint_fixed _).mp
    constructor <;> simp [map_pow, D.tau_kappa, D.delta_kappa]
  have he : ∃ b : k, algebraMap k Ω b = D.eta ^ 2 := by
    apply (D.joint_fixed _).mp
    constructor <;> simp [map_pow, D.tau_eta, D.delta_eta]
  obtain ⟨a,ha⟩ := hk
  obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := he
  refine ⟨a,b,ha,hb,?_⟩
  apply (algebraMap k Ω).injective
  rw [D.radicand_spec, map_mul, ha, hb, u, mul_pow]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ReflectionDetectorChart.encoderA_reflectChart
statement:
theorem encoderA_reflectChart (a : K) (x : ExplicitFrameChart K) :
    encoderA (reflectChart a x) = theta a (encoderA x)
proof:
:= by
  apply JCoord.ext <;> try rfl
  apply VCoord.ext
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · funext i
    cases i <;> simp [reflectChart, encoderA, vectorA, theta, thetaV]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ReflectionDetectorChart.encoderB_reflectChart
statement:
theorem encoderB_reflectChart (a : K) (x : ExplicitFrameChart K) :
    encoderB (reflectChart a x) = theta a (encoderB x)
proof:
:= by
  apply JCoord.ext <;> try rfl
  apply VCoord.ext
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · funext i
    cases i <;> simp [reflectChart, encoderB, vectorB, theta, thetaV]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ReflectionDetectorChart.theta_diagonal
statement:
theorem theta_diagonal (a d1 d2 d3 : K) :
    theta a (diagonal d1 d2 d3) = diagonal d1 d2 d3
proof:
:= by
  apply JCoord.ext <;> try rfl
  · apply VCoord.ext
    · simp [theta, thetaV, diagonal]
    · simp [theta, thetaV, diagonal]
    · funext i
      cases i <;> simp [theta, thetaV, diagonal]
  · apply SCoord.ext <;> funext i <;> fin_cases i <;> simp [theta, thetaS, diagonal]
  · apply CCoord.ext <;> funext i <;> fin_cases i <;> simp [theta, thetaC, diagonal]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ReflectionDetectorChart.residualPair_reflectChart
statement:
theorem residualPair_reflectChart (a : K) (ha : a ≠ 0) (x : ExplicitFrameChart K) :
    residualPairOfChart (reflectChart a x) = reflect a (residualPairOfChart x)
proof:
:= by
  apply ResidualPair.ext <;> funext i j <;> fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [residualPairOfChart, reflectChart, reflect, AMatrix, XMatrix,
      thetaS, thetaC, D, Di, L, Li, Matrix.diagonal_mul, Matrix.mul_diagonal,
      div_eq_mul_inv] <;> field_simp [ha] <;> ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ReflectionDetectorChart.detector_reflectChart
statement:
theorem detector_reflectChart (a : K) (ha : a ≠ 0) (x : ExplicitFrameChart K) :
    sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1)
        (encoderA (reflectChart a x)) (encoderB (reflectChart a x)) =
      sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1) (encoderA x) (encoderB x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [encoderA_reflectChart, encoderB_reflectChart]
  have h := sourceDetector_map (linearEquiv a ha).toLinearMap
    (sourceProduct_theta a ha) (sourceTrace_theta a)
    (diagonal (-1) 0 1) (encoderA x) (encoderB x)
  change sourceDetector (theta a (diagonal (-1) 0 1))
    (theta a (encoderA x)) (theta a (encoderB x)) = _ at h
  rw [theta_diagonal] at h
  exact h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ReflectionDetectorChart.detector_eq_reflected_normalized
statement:
theorem detector_eq_reflected_normalized (a : K) (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (x : ExplicitFrameChart K)
    (hA : Matrix.det (residualPairOfChart x).A ≠ 0) :
    sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1) (encoderA x) (encoderB x) =
      normalized x.diagA x.diagB (x.z1 / a) (a * x.r1)
        (x.z2 / a) (a * x.r2)
        (Li a * (moment (residualPairOfChart x)).transpose * L a)
        (Matrix.det (residualPairOfChart x).A)
        (Matrix.det (residualPairOfChart x).A)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [← detector_reflectChart a ha x]
  have hd : delta (residualPairOfChart (reflectChart a x)) =
      Matrix.det (residualPairOfChart x).A := by
    rw [residualPair_reflectChart a ha, delta_reflect a ha]
  rw [sourceDetector_eq_normalized (reflectChart a x) (by rw [hd]; exact hA),
    residualPair_reflectChart a ha, moment_reflect a ha, delta_reflect a ha]
  rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.GLParameterDomain.diagonalUnit_mul_ring
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    ext r c <;> fin_cases r <;> fin_cases c <;>
    norm_num [diagonalUnitOver, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.GLParameterDomain.diagonalUnit_trace_ring
statement:
private theorem diagonalUnit_trace_ring {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (i : Fin 3) :
    Matrix.trace (diagonalUnitOver i : Mat3 R) = 1
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i <;> norm_num [diagonalUnitOver, Matrix.trace_fin_three, Fin.ext_iff]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.GLParameterDomain.diagonalUnit_sum_ring
statement:
private theorem diagonalUnit_sum_ring {R : Type*} [CommRing R] :
    (∑ i : Fin 3, diagonalUnitOver i : Mat3 R) = 1
proof:
:= by
  ext r c
  fin_cases r <;> fin_cases c <;>
    norm_num [diagonalUnitOver, Fin.sum_univ_succ, Fin.ext_iff]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.GLParameterDomain.localizedProjector_mul
statement:
theorem localizedProjector_mul (r : Fin 3) (i j : Fin 3) :
    localizedProjector k r i * localizedProjector k r j =
      if i = j then localizedProjector k r i else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [localizedProjector, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc (localizedInverse k r),
    localizedInverse_mul_matrix, Matrix.one_mul,
    ← Matrix.mul_assoc (diagonalUnitOver i), diagonalUnit_mul_ring]
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.GLParameterDomain.localizedProjector_trace
statement:
theorem localizedProjector_trace (r i : Fin 3) :
    Matrix.trace (localizedProjector k r i) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [localizedProjector, Matrix.trace_mul_cycle,
    localizedInverse_mul_matrix, Matrix.one_mul]
  exact diagonalUnit_trace_ring i

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.GLParameterDomain.localizedProjector_sum
statement:
theorem localizedProjector_sum (r : Fin 3) :
    ∑ i : Fin 3, localizedProjector k r i = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [localizedProjector, ← Matrix.mul_sum, ← Matrix.sum_mul]
  rw [diagonalUnit_sum_ring, Matrix.mul_one, localizedMatrix_mul_inverse]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.GLParameterDomain.localizedProjectors_are_raw
statement:
theorem localizedProjectors_are_raw :
    IsRawFrameFamily (localizedProjector k) where
  idempotent r i
proof:
:= by simpa using localizedProjector_mul k r i i
  trace_one := localizedProjector_trace k
  sum_one := localizedProjector_sum k

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.GLParameterDomain.rawFrameIdeal_le_ker_psi
statement:
theorem rawFrameIdeal_le_ker_psi :
    rawFrameIdeal (R := k) ≤ RingHom.ker (psi k)
proof:
:= by
  have hv := (equations_vanishAlong_iff
    (coefficientMap k) (localizedProjector k)).2 (localizedProjectors_are_raw k)
  exact Ideal.span_le.2 (fun p hp => by
    rcases hp with ⟨q, rfl⟩
    exact RingHom.mem_ker.mpr (hv q))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.GLParameterDomain.evalAway_localizedProjector
statement:
theorem evalAway_localizedProjector (f : k →+* L) (X : Fin 3 → Mat3 L)
    (hX : ∀ r, Matrix.det (X r) ≠ 0) (r i : Fin 3) :
    (evalAway f X hX).mapMatrix (localizedProjector k r i) =
      frameOfInvertible (X r) i
proof:
:= by
  rw [localizedProjector, map_mul, map_mul, evalAway_localizedMatrix,
    evalAway_localizedInverse]
  have he : (evalAway f X hX).mapMatrix
      (diagonalUnitOver i : Mat3 (ParameterRing k)) = diagonalUnit i := by
    ext a b
    simp [diagonalUnitOver, diagonalUnit]
  rw [he]
  rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualSourceMeasurements.plane_triality
statement:
theorem plane_triality (r z : K) (s : SCoord K) (c : CCoord K) :
    triality (planeVector r z) s c =
      r * evalU s.phi c.q + z * evalU c.psi s.p
proof:
:= by

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualSourceMeasurements.plane_muC_pairing
statement:
theorem plane_muC_pairing (r1 z1 r2 z2 : K) (s1 s2 : SCoord K) :
    BC (sourceMuC (planeVector r1 z1) s1)
      (sourceMuC (planeVector r2 z2) s2) =
      r1 * z2 * evalU s1.phi s2.p +
        r2 * z1 * evalU s2.phi s1.p
proof:
:= by

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualSourceMeasurements.plane_muS_pairing

    BS (sourceMuS c1 (planeVector r1 z1))
      (sourceMuS c2 (planeVector r2 z2)) =
      r2 * z1 * evalU c1.psi c2.q +

proof:
:= by

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualSourceMeasurements.within_gram_S

theorem within_gram_S (s1 s2 : SCoord K) (c1 c2 : CCoord K) :

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualSourceMeasurements.within_gram_C

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.GLParameterLocalization.map_ringInverse_of_isUnit
statement:
theorem map_ringInverse_of_isUnit {R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (f : R →+* S) (x : R) (hx : IsUnit x) :
    f (Ring.inverse x) = Ring.inverse (f x)
proof:
:= by
  have hl : f (Ring.inverse x) * f x = 1 := by
    rw [← map_mul, Ring.inverse_mul_cancel x hx, map_one]
  calc
    f (Ring.inverse x) = f (Ring.inverse x) * (f x * Ring.inverse (f x)) := by
      rw [Ring.mul_inverse_cancel _ (hx.map f), mul_one]
    _ = Ring.inverse (f x) := by rw [← mul_assoc, hl, one_mul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.GLParameterLocalization.mapMatrix_smul
statement:
theorem mapMatrix_smul {R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (f : R →+* S) (c : R) (A : Mat3 R) :
    f.mapMatrix (c • A) = f c • f.mapMatrix A
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  exact map_mul f c (A i j)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.GLParameterLocalization.evalAway_localizedMatrix
statement:
theorem evalAway_localizedMatrix (f : k →+* L) (X : Fin 3 → Mat3 L)
    (hX : ∀ r, Matrix.det (X r) ≠ 0) (r : Fin 3) :
    (evalAway f X hX).mapMatrix (localizedMatrix k r) = X r
proof:
:= by
  ext a b
  change evalAway f X hX
    (algebraMap (Base k) (ParameterRing k) (genericMatrix k r a b)) = _
  rw [evalAway_algebraMap]
  exact congrFun (congrFun (baseEval_genericMatrix f X r) a) b

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.GLParameterLocalization.evalAway_localizedInverse
statement:
theorem evalAway_localizedInverse (f : k →+* L) (X : Fin 3 → Mat3 L)
    (hX : ∀ r, Matrix.det (X r) ≠ 0) (r : Fin 3) :
    (evalAway f X hX).mapMatrix (localizedInverse k r) = (X r)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [localizedInverse, mapMatrix_smul, RingHom.map_adjugate,
    map_ringInverse_of_isUnit _ _ (localizedMatrix_det_isUnit k r),
    RingHom.map_det, evalAway_localizedMatrix]
  rw [Matrix.inv_def, Ring.inverse_eq_inv]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealReducedPairTraceOpen.evaluation_pairTracePolynomial
statement:
@[simp] theorem evaluation_pairTracePolynomial
    {R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    (P : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Mat3 S) (r s i j : Fin 3) :
    evaluation (R := R) P (pairTracePolynomial r s i j) =
      Matrix.trace (P r i * P s j)
proof:
:= by
  simp [pairTracePolynomial, Matrix.trace, Matrix.mul_apply]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealReducedPairTraceOpen.evaluation_cyclicPairTraceProduct
statement:
theorem evaluation_cyclicPairTraceProduct
    {R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    (P : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Mat3 S) :
    evaluation (R := R) P (cyclicPairTraceProduct R) =
      ((∏ i : Fin 3, ∏ j : Fin 3, Matrix.trace (P 0 i * P 1 j)) *
       (∏ j : Fin 3, ∏ l : Fin 3, Matrix.trace (P 1 j * P 2 l))) *
       (∏ l : Fin 3, ∏ i : Fin 3, Matrix.trace (P 2 l * P 0 i))
proof:
:= by
  simp [cyclicPairTraceProduct]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealReducedPairTraceOpen.witnessBasis_orthogonal
statement: theorem witnessBasis_orthogonal (r : Fin 3) : IsOrthogonal (witnessBasis k r)
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases r
  · exact PrimitiveOpenWitness.X_orthogonal
  · exact PrimitiveOpenWitness.Y_orthogonal
  · exact PrimitiveOpenWitness.Z_orthogonal

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealReducedPairTraceOpen.witnessFamily_isRaw
statement: theorem witnessFamily_isRaw : IsRawPrimitiveFrameFamily (witnessFamily k)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro r i a b
    simp [witnessFamily, columnProjector, mul_comm]
  · intro r i
    exact columnProjector_mul_self (witnessBasis k r) (witnessBasis_orthogonal k r) i
  · intro r i
    exact columnProjector_trace_one (witnessBasis k r) (witnessBasis_orthogonal k r) i
  · intro r
    simpa [Fin.sum_univ_succ, add_assoc, witnessFamily] using
      columnProjector_sum (witnessBasis k r) (witnessBasis_orthogonal k r)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealReducedPairTraceOpen.witness_pairTrace01_ne_zero
statement:
theorem witness_pairTrace01_ne_zero (i j : Fin 3) :
    Matrix.trace (witnessFamily k 0 i * witnessFamily k 1 j) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  change Matrix.trace (columnProjector (PrimitiveOpenWitness.X : Mat3 k) i *
    columnProjector PrimitiveOpenWitness.Y j) ≠ 0
  rw [trace_columnProjector_mul]
  exact pow_ne_zero 2 (PrimitiveOpenWitness.overlap_XY_ne_zero i j)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealReducedPairTraceOpen.witness_pairTrace12_ne_zero
statement:
theorem witness_pairTrace12_ne_zero (j l : Fin 3) :
    Matrix.trace (witnessFamily k 1 j * witnessFamily k 2 l) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  change Matrix.trace (columnProjector (PrimitiveOpenWitness.Y : Mat3 k) j *
    columnProjector PrimitiveOpenWitness.Z l) ≠ 0
  rw [trace_columnProjector_mul]
  exact pow_ne_zero 2 (PrimitiveOpenWitness.overlap_YZ_ne_zero j l)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealReducedPairTraceOpen.witness_pairTrace20_ne_zero
statement:
theorem witness_pairTrace20_ne_zero (l i : Fin 3) :
    Matrix.trace (witnessFamily k 2 l * witnessFamily k 0 i) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  change Matrix.trace (columnProjector (PrimitiveOpenWitness.Z : Mat3 k) l *
    columnProjector PrimitiveOpenWitness.X i) ≠ 0
  rw [trace_columnProjector_mul]
  exact pow_ne_zero 2 (PrimitiveOpenWitness.overlap_ZX_ne_zero l i)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealReducedPairTraceOpen.witness_evaluation_ne_zero
statement:
theorem witness_evaluation_ne_zero :
    evaluation (R := k) (witnessFamily k) (cyclicPairTraceProduct k) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [evaluation_cyclicPairTraceProduct]
  apply mul_ne_zero
  · apply mul_ne_zero
    · exact Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun i _ =>
        Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun j _ => witness_pairTrace01_ne_zero k i j))
    · exact Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun j _ =>
        Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun l _ => witness_pairTrace12_ne_zero k j l))
  · exact Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun l _ =>
      Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.mpr (fun i _ => witness_pairTrace20_ne_zero k l i))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealReducedPairTraceOpen.rawFrameRadical_le_witness_kernel
statement:
theorem rawFrameRadical_le_witness_kernel :
    (rawFrameIdeal (R := k)).radical ≤
      RingHom.ker (evaluation (R := k) (witnessFamily k)).toRingHom
proof:
:= by
  exact (RingHom.ker_isPrime _).radical_le_iff.mpr
    ((rawFrameIdeal_le_ker_iff (R := k) (witnessFamily k)).mpr (witnessFamily_isRaw k))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealReducedPairTraceOpen.reducedWitnessEvaluation_product
statement:
@[simp] theorem reducedWitnessEvaluation_product :
    reducedWitnessEvaluation k (reducedPairTraceProduct k) =
      evaluation (R := k) (witnessFamily k) (cyclicPairTraceProduct k)
proof:

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealReducedPairTraceOpen.reducedPairTraceProduct_ne_zero
statement: theorem reducedPairTraceProduct_ne_zero : reducedPairTraceProduct k ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  apply witness_evaluation_ne_zero k
  rw [← reducedWitnessEvaluation_product, hzero, map_zero]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealReducedPairTraceOpen.genericPairTraceProduct_ne_zero
statement: theorem genericPairTraceProduct_ne_zero : genericPairTraceProduct k ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  apply reducedPairTraceProduct_ne_zero k
  apply IsFractionRing.injective (ReducedCoordinateRing k) (ReducedFunctionField k)
  simpa [genericPairTraceProduct] using hzero

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.CarrierTrace.jordan_add_left
statement:
private theorem jordan_add_left (A B C : Carrier K) :
    jordan (A + B) C = jordan A C + jordan B C
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp only [coe_jordan, Submodule.coe_add, matrixJordan,
    Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.mul_add, smul_add]
  abel

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.CarrierTrace.jordan_smul_left
statement:
private theorem jordan_smul_left (a : K) (A B : Carrier K) :
    jordan (a • A) B = a • jordan A B
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp only [coe_jordan, Submodule.coe_smul, matrixJordan,
    Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, ← smul_add, smul_smul]
  ext i j
  simp only [Matrix.smul_apply]
  rw [mul_comm (2 : K)⁻¹ a]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.CarrierTrace.jordan_add_right
statement:
private theorem jordan_add_right (A B C : Carrier K) :

proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext

    Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.mul_add, smul_add]
  abel

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.CarrierTrace.jordan_smul_right
statement:
private theorem jordan_smul_right (a : K) (A B : Carrier K) :
    jordan A (a • B) = a • jordan A B
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp only [coe_jordan, Submodule.coe_smul, matrixJordan,
