name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.CarrierTrace.coordinateTrace_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem coordinateTrace_apply (x : Coordinates K) :
    coordinateTrace x = jordanTrace (K := K) (decode x : Mat6 K)
proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.CarrierTrace.coordinateProduct_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem coordinateProduct_apply (x y : Coordinates K) :
    coordinateProduct x y = coordinateJordan x y
proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.CarrierTrace.coordinate_leftMul_trace
statement:
theorem coordinate_leftMul_trace (x : Coordinates K) :
    LinearMap.trace K (Coordinates K) (leftMul coordinateProduct x) =
      5 * coordinateTrace x
proof:
:= by
  rw [LinearMap.trace_eq_matrix_trace K (Pi.basisFun K Index)]
  have repr_apply (z : Coordinates K) (i : Index) :
      (Pi.basisFun K Index).repr z i = z i := rfl
  simp only [Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag_apply, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply',
    leftMul, coordinateProduct, repr_apply]
  rw [coordinateTrace_apply]
  simp [coordinateJordan, encode, decode, jordan, carrierTraceLinear,
    grouped, topLeft, topRight, bottomLeft,
    unhat, hat, Matrix.fromBlocks, matrixJordan, jordanTrace,
    Matrix.trace, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose,
    Fintype.sum_sum_type, Fintype.sum_prod_type,
    Fin.sum_univ_succ, Pi.single_apply]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.CarrierTrace.coordinateAut_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem coordinateAut_apply (g : Aut (K := K)) (x : Coordinates K) :
    coordinateAut g x = encode (g.linear (decode x))
proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.CarrierTrace.coordinateAut_map_product
statement:
theorem coordinateAut_map_product (g : Aut (K := K)) (x y : Coordinates K) :
    coordinateAut g (coordinateProduct x y) =
      coordinateProduct (coordinateAut g x) (coordinateAut g y)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    coordinateAut g (coordinateProduct x y) =
        encode (g.linear (decode (coordinateProduct x y))) :=
      coordinateAut_apply g _
    _ = encode (g.linear (jordan (decode x) (decode y))) := by
      rw [coordinateProduct_apply, decode_coordinateJordan]
    _ = encode (jordan (g.linear (decode x)) (g.linear (decode y))) := by
      rw [g.map_jordan]
    _ = encode (jordan (decode (coordinateAut g x))
        (decode (coordinateAut g y))) := by
      rw [coordinateAut_apply, coordinateAut_apply, decode_encode, decode_encode]
    _ = coordinateProduct (coordinateAut g x) (coordinateAut g y) := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.CarrierTrace.jordanTrace_invariant
statement:
theorem jordanTrace_invariant (g : Aut (K := K)) (P : Carrier K) :
    jordanTrace (K := K) ((g.linear P : Carrier K) : Mat6 K) =
      jordanTrace (K := K) (P : Mat6 K)
proof:
:= by
  have h : coordinateTrace (coordinateAut g (encode P)) = coordinateTrace (encode P) := by
    refine trace_invariant_of_leftMul_trace (K := K) (V := Coordinates K)
      coordinateProduct coordinateTrace (5 : K) (by norm_num)
      coordinate_leftMul_trace (coordinateAut g) ?_ (encode P)
    intro x y
    exact coordinateAut_map_product g x y
  calc
    jordanTrace (K := K) ((g.linear P : Carrier K) : Mat6 K) =
        coordinateTrace (encode (g.linear P)) := by
      rw [coordinateTrace_apply, decode_encode]
    _ = coordinateTrace (coordinateAut g (encode P)) := by
      rw [coordinateAut_apply, decode_encode]
    _ = coordinateTrace (encode P) := h
    _ = jordanTrace (K := K) (P : Mat6 K) := by
      rw [coordinateTrace_apply, decode_encode]

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceEvenTriality.C_reflect_mul
statement:
private theorem C_reflect_mul (a v : VCoord K) (ha : nV a ≠ 0) :
    C (reflectV a v) * C a = -(C a * C v)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun E : Module.End K (SourceCliffordReflection.W K) => E * C a) (C_reflection a v ha)
  simp only [smul_mul_assoc, mul_assoc, C_square, mul_smul_comm, smul_smul,
    mul_one] at h
  have hn : -(nV a)⁻¹ * nV a = -1 := by simp [ha]
  rw [hn, neg_one_smul] at h
  exact h.symm

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceEvenTriality.C_evenV_intertwine
statement:
theorem C_evenV_intertwine (a b v : VCoord K)
    (ha : nV a ≠ 0) (hb : nV b ≠ 0) :
    (C a * C b) * C v = C (evenV a b v) * (C a * C b)
proof:
:= by
  have ha' := C_reflect_mul a (reflectV b v) ha
  have hb' := C_reflect_mul b v hb
  change (C a * C b) * C v = C (reflectV a (reflectV b v)) * (C a * C b)
  symm
  calc
    C (reflectV a (reflectV b v)) * (C a * C b) =
        (C (reflectV a (reflectV b v)) * C a) * C b := (mul_assoc _ _ _).symm
    _ = -(C a * C (reflectV b v)) * C b := congrArg (fun E => E * C b) ha'
    _ = -(C a * (C (reflectV b v) * C b)) := by
      apply LinearMap.ext
      intro x
      simp only [Module.End.mul_apply, LinearMap.neg_apply]
    _ = -(C a * (-(C b * C v))) := by rw [hb']
    _ = (C a * C b) * C v := by
      apply LinearMap.ext
      intro x
      simp only [Module.End.mul_apply, LinearMap.neg_apply, map_neg, neg_neg]

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceEvenTriality.evenS_muS_intertwine
statement:
theorem evenS_muS_intertwine (a b v : VCoord K) (rho : K)
    (s : SCoord K) (c : CCoord K) (ha : nV a ≠ 0) (hb : nV b ≠ 0) :
    evenS a b rho (sourceMuS c v) =
      sourceMuS (evenC a b rho c) (evenV a b v)
proof:
:= by
  have h := LinearMap.congr_fun (C_evenV_intertwine a b v ha hb) (s, c)
  have hs : sourceMuS (sourceMuC b (sourceMuS c v)) a =
      sourceMuS (sourceMuC a (sourceMuS c b)) (evenV a b v) := by
    simpa only [Module.End.mul_apply, C_apply] using congrArg Prod.fst h
  calc
    evenS a b rho (sourceMuS c v) =
        rho⁻¹ • sourceMuS (sourceMuC b (sourceMuS c v)) a := rfl
    _ = rho⁻¹ • sourceMuS (sourceMuC a (sourceMuS c b))
          (evenV a b v) := congrArg (rho⁻¹ • ·) hs
    _ = sourceMuS (rho⁻¹ • sourceMuC a (sourceMuS c b))
          (evenV a b v) := by
      change rho⁻¹ • muSLinear (evenV a b v) _ =
        muSLinear (evenV a b v) (rho⁻¹ • _)
      exact ((muSLinear (evenV a b v)).map_smul rho⁻¹ _).symm
    _ = sourceMuS (evenC a b rho c) (evenV a b v) := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceEvenTriality.evenC_muC_intertwine
statement:
theorem evenC_muC_intertwine (a b v : VCoord K) (rho : K)
    (s : SCoord K) (c : CCoord K) (ha : nV a ≠ 0) (hb : nV b ≠ 0) :
    evenC a b rho (sourceMuC v s) =
      sourceMuC (evenV a b v) (evenS a b rho s)
proof:
:= by
  have h := LinearMap.congr_fun (C_evenV_intertwine a b v ha hb) (s, c)
  have hc : sourceMuC a (sourceMuS (sourceMuC v s) b) =
      sourceMuC (evenV a b v) (sourceMuS (sourceMuC b s) a) := by
    simpa only [Module.End.mul_apply, C_apply] using congrArg Prod.snd h
  calc
    evenC a b rho (sourceMuC v s) =
        rho⁻¹ • sourceMuC a (sourceMuS (sourceMuC v s) b) := rfl
    _ = rho⁻¹ • sourceMuC (evenV a b v)
          (sourceMuS (sourceMuC b s) a) := congrArg (rho⁻¹ • ·) hc
    _ = sourceMuC (evenV a b v)
          (rho⁻¹ • sourceMuS (sourceMuC b s) a) := by
      change rho⁻¹ • muCLinear (evenV a b v) _ =
        muCLinear (evenV a b v) (rho⁻¹ • _)
      exact ((muCLinear (evenV a b v)).map_smul rho⁻¹ _).symm
    _ = sourceMuC (evenV a b v) (evenS a b rho s) := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceEvenTriality.evenS_add
statement:
theorem evenS_add (a b : VCoord K) (rho : K) (s t : SCoord K) :
    evenS a b rho (s + t) = evenS a b rho s + evenS a b rho t
proof:
:= by
  change rho⁻¹ • muSLinear a (muCLinear b (s + t)) =
    rho⁻¹ • muSLinear a (muCLinear b s) + rho⁻¹ • muSLinear a (muCLinear b t)
  rw [map_add, map_add, smul_add]

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceEvenTriality.evenC_add
statement:
theorem evenC_add (a b : VCoord K) (rho : K) (c d : CCoord K) :
    evenC a b rho (c + d) = evenC a b rho c + evenC a b rho d
proof:
:= by
  change rho⁻¹ • muCLinear a (muSLinear b (c + d)) =
    rho⁻¹ • muCLinear a (muSLinear b c) + rho⁻¹ • muCLinear a (muSLinear b d)
  rw [map_add, map_add, smul_add]

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceEvenTriality.BS_evenS
statement:
theorem BS_evenS (a b : VCoord K) (rho : K) (s t : SCoord K)
    (hrho : rho ^ 2 = nV a * nV b) (hrho0 : rho ≠ 0) :
    BS (evenS a b rho s) (evenS a b rho t) = BS s t
proof:
:= by
  have hst := nS_evenS a b rho (s + t) hrho hrho0
  rw [evenS_add, nS_add, nS_add,
    nS_evenS a b rho s hrho hrho0,
    nS_evenS a b rho t hrho hrho0] at hst
  linear_combination hst

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceEvenTriality.BC_evenC
statement:
theorem BC_evenC (a b : VCoord K) (rho : K) (c d : CCoord K)
    (hrho : rho ^ 2 = nV a * nV b) (hrho0 : rho ≠ 0) :
    BC (evenC a b rho c) (evenC a b rho d) = BC c d
proof:
:= by
  have hcd := nC_evenC a b rho (c + d) hrho hrho0
  rw [evenC_add, nC_add, nC_add,
    nC_evenC a b rho c hrho hrho0,
    nC_evenC a b rho d hrho hrho0] at hcd
  linear_combination hcd

name: AlbertLean.Triality.SourceEvenTriality.triality_even
statement:
theorem triality_even (a b : VCoord K) (rho : K)
    (v : VCoord K) (s : SCoord K) (c : CCoord K)
    (ha : nV a ≠ 0) (hb : nV b ≠ 0)
    (hrho : rho ^ 2 = nV a * nV b) (hrho0 : rho ≠ 0) :
    triality (evenV a b v) (evenS a b rho s) (evenC a b rho c) =
      triality v s c
proof:
:= by
  rw [← muS_triality, ← evenS_muS_intertwine a b v rho s c ha hb,
    BS_evenS a b rho (sourceMuS c v) s hrho hrho0, muS_triality]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticProjectorFrame.wordMap_injective
statement:
theorem wordMap_injective
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V)) (halt : ∀ x, omega x x = 0)
    (word : List (Step (K := K) (V := V))) :
    Function.Injective (wordMap omega word)
proof:
:= by
  induction word with
  | nil => exact fun _ _ h => h
  | cons step word ih =>
    rcases step with ⟨d, t⟩
    intro x y h
    apply ih
    apply (equiv omega halt d t).injective
    exact h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticProjectorFrame.intertwines_of_spanning_target
statement:
theorem intertwines_of_spanning_target
    (L : V →ₗ[K] V) (hL : Function.Injective L)
    (P Q : Fin 3 → V →ₗ[K] V) (u v e f : Fin 3 → V)
    (hLu : ∀ j, L (u j) = e j) (hLv : ∀ j, L (v j) = f j)
    (hPu : ∀ i j, P i (u j) = if i = j then u j else 0)
    (hPv : ∀ i j, P i (v j) = if i = j then v j else 0)
    (hQe : ∀ i j, Q i (e j) = if i = j then e j else 0)
    (hQf : ∀ i j, Q i (f j) = if i = j then f j else 0)
    (hspan : ∀ z : V, ∃ a b : Fin 3 → K,
      z = (∑ j, a j • e j) + ∑ j, b j • f j) :
    ∀ i, L.comp (P i) = (Q i).comp L
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro i
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  obtain ⟨a, b, hx⟩ := hspan (L x)
  have hx' : x = (∑ j, a j • u j) + ∑ j, b j • v j := by
    apply hL
    simpa only [map_add, map_sum, map_smul, hLu, hLv] using hx
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply]
  rw [hx']
  simp only [map_add, map_sum, map_smul, hPu, hPv, hLu, hLv,
    hQe, hQf, apply_ite, map_zero]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticProjectorFrame.exists_twelve_actual_frame_alignment
statement:
theorem exists_twelve_actual_frame_alignment
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V)) (halt : ∀ x, omega x x = 0)
    (hleft : IsLeftNondegenerate omega) (hright : IsRightNondegenerate omega)
    (P : Fin 3 → V →ₗ[K] V)
    (hidem : ∀ i, IsIdempotent (P i))
    (hself : ∀ i, IsSelfAdjoint omega (P i)) (hne : ∀ i, P i ≠ 0)
    (hsum : P 0 + P 1 + P 2 = LinearMap.id)
    (Q : Fin 3 → V →ₗ[K] V) (e f : Fin 3 → V)
    (htgt : HyperbolicTriple omega e f)
    (hQe : ∀ i j, Q i (e j) = if i = j then e j else 0)
    (hQf : ∀ i j, Q i (f j) = if i = j then f j else 0)
    (hspan : ∀ z : V, ∃ a b : Fin 3 → K,
      z = (∑ j, a j • e j) + ∑ j, b j • f j) :
    ∃ word : List (Step (K := K) (V := V)), word.length = 12 ∧
      ∀ i, (wordMap omega word).comp (P i) = (Q i).comp (wordMap omega word)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, v, huv, hPu, hPv⟩ :=
    exists_hyperbolicTriple_of_complete_frame omega hright P hidem hself hne hsum
  obtain ⟨word, hlen, hu, hv⟩ :=
    exists_fixed_twelve_triple_alignment omega halt hleft hright u v e f huv htgt
  exact ⟨word, hlen, intertwines_of_spanning_target (wordMap omega word)
    (wordMap_injective omega halt word) P Q u v e f hu hv hPu hPv hQe hQf hspan⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.commonPlaneForwardBackward_matrix_laws
statement:
theorem commonPlaneForwardBackward_matrix_laws
    (E E' : Fin 3 → Carrier K)
    (hEidem : ∀ i, (E i : Mat6 K) * E i = E i)
    (hEsum : (E 0 : Mat6 K) + E 1 + E 2 = 1)
    (hEidem' : ∀ i, (E' i : Mat6 K) * E' i = E' i)
    (hEsum' : (E' 0 : Mat6 K) + E' 1 + E' 2 = 1)
    (u v u' v' : Vec6 K) (p : Fin 3 → K)
    (hp : ∀ i, p i = (omega (K := K))
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v))
    (hp' : ∀ i, p i = (omega (K := K))
      (matrixAction (E' i : Mat6 K) u') (matrixAction (E' i : Mat6 K) v'))
    (hpne : ∀ i, p i ≠ 0)
    (S T : Mat2 K) (hST : S * T = 1) (hTS : T * S = 1) :
    let A
proof:
:= matrixOfLinear
      (commonPlaneForward E E' hEidem hEsum hEidem' hEsum'
        u v u' v' p hp hp' hpne S)
    let B := matrixOfLinear
      (commonPlaneBackward E E' hEidem hEsum hEidem' hEsum'
        u v u' v' p hp hp' hpne T)
    A * B = 1 ∧ B * A = 1 ∧
      A.transpose * symplecticJ * A = det2 S • symplecticJ := by
  let L := weightedCoordinateEquiv E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne
  let L' := weightedCoordinateEquiv E' hEidem' hEsum' u' v' p hp' hpne
  let forward := commonPlaneForward E E' hEidem hEsum hEidem' hEsum'
    u v u' v' p hp hp' hpne S
  let backward := commonPlaneBackward E E' hEidem hEsum hEidem' hEsum'
    u v u' v' p hp hp' hpne T
  let A := matrixOfLinear forward
  let B := matrixOfLinear backward
  have hforwardBackward : forward.comp backward = LinearMap.id := by
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro x
    have hc := LinearMap.congr_fun (commonPlaneMap_comp S T hST) (L'.symm x)
    change L' (commonPlaneMap S
      (L.symm (L (commonPlaneMap T (L'.symm x))))) = x
    rw [L.symm_apply_apply]
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.id_apply] at hc
    rw [hc, L'.apply_symm_apply]
  have hbackwardForward : backward.comp forward = LinearMap.id := by
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro x
    have hc := LinearMap.congr_fun (commonPlaneMap_comp T S hTS) (L.symm x)
    change L (commonPlaneMap T
      (L'.symm (L' (commonPlaneMap S (L.symm x))))) = x
    rw [L'.symm_apply_apply]
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.id_apply] at hc
    rw [hc, L.apply_symm_apply]
  have hAB : A * B = 1 := by
    apply matrixAction_injective
    rw [matrixAction_mul, matrixAction_matrixOfLinear,
      matrixAction_matrixOfLinear, hforwardBackward, matrixAction_one]
  have hBA : B * A = 1 := by
    apply matrixAction_injective
    rw [matrixAction_mul, matrixAction_matrixOfLinear,
      matrixAction_matrixOfLinear, hbackwardForward, matrixAction_one]
  have hpres (x y : Vec6 K) :
      (omega (K := K)) (forward x) (forward y) =
        det2 S * (omega (K := K)) x y := by
    change (omega (K := K)) (L' (commonPlaneMap S (L.symm x)))
      (L' (commonPlaneMap S (L.symm y))) = _
    have hL' (z : Vec6 K) :
        L' z = weightedCoordinateLinear E' u' v' z := rfl
    have hL (z : Vec6 K) :
        L z = weightedCoordinateLinear E u v z := rfl
    rw [hL', hL', weightedCoordinate_form E' hEidem' hEsum' u' v' p hp',
      commonPlaneMap_form,
      ← weightedCoordinate_form E hEidem hEsum u v p hp,
      ← hL, ← hL, L.apply_symm_apply, L.apply_symm_apply]
  have hform : A.transpose * symplecticJ * A = det2 S • symplecticJ := by
    ext i j
    rw [symplectic_product_entry]
    rw [← matrixAction_basisVector A i, ← matrixAction_basisVector A j,
      matrixAction_matrixOfLinear, hpres, omega_basisVector]
    rfl
  change A * B = 1 ∧ B * A = 1 ∧
    A.transpose * symplecticJ * A = det2 S • symplecticJ
  exact ⟨hAB, hBA, hform⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.exists_actual_same_ledger_pair_jordanAut_provenance
statement:
theorem exists_actual_same_ledger_pair_jordanAut_provenance
    (E F E' F' : Fin 3 → Carrier K)
    (hEidem : ∀ i, (E i : Mat6 K) * E i = E i)
    (hEsum : (E 0 : Mat6 K) + E 1 + E 2 = 1)
    (hFidem : ∀ i, (F i : Mat6 K) * F i = F i)
    (hFsum : (F 0 : Mat6 K) + F 1 + F 2 = 1)
    (hEidem' : ∀ i, (E' i : Mat6 K) * E' i = E' i)
    (hEsum' : (E' 0 : Mat6 K) + E' 1 + E' 2 = 1)
    (hFidem' : ∀ i, (F' i : Mat6 K) * F' i = F' i)
    (hFsum' : (F' 0 : Mat6 K) + F' 1 + F' 2 = 1)
    (u v u' v' : Vec6 K) (p : Fin 3 → K)
    (hp : ∀ i, p i = (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u)
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v))
    (hp' : ∀ i, p i = (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E' i : Mat6 K) u')
      (matrixAction (E' i : Mat6 K) v')) (hpne : ∀ i, p i ≠ 0)
    (hFu : ∀ i, matrixAction (F 0 : Mat6 K) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u) = p i • u)
    (hFv : ∀ i, matrixAction (F 0 : Mat6 K) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v) = p i • v)
    (hFu' : ∀ i, matrixAction (F' 0 : Mat6 K) (matrixAction (E' i : Mat6 K) u') = p i • u')
    (hFv' : ∀ i, matrixAction (F' 0 : Mat6 K) (matrixAction (E' i : Mat6 K) v') = p i • v')
    (hledger : ∀ i, jordanTrace (K := K) ((E i : Mat6 K) * (F 1 : Mat6 K)) =
      jordanTrace (K := K) ((E' i : Mat6 K) * (F' 1 : Mat6 K)))
    (hp12 : p 1 + p 2 ≠ 0)
    (hdisc : let L := weightedCoordinateEquiv E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne
      let B := fun i j => weightedBlock (coordinateConjugate L
        (matrixAction (F 1 : Mat6 K))) i j
      trace2 (B 0 1) ^ 2 - 4 * determinant (B 0 1) ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (g : ScalarJordanAut.Aut (K := K)) (A B : Mat6 K) (nu : K),
      A * B = 1 ∧ B * A = 1 ∧ nu ≠ 0 ∧
      A.transpose * symplecticJ * A = nu • symplecticJ ∧
      (∀ X : Carrier K,
        ((g.linear X : Carrier K) : Mat6 K) = A * (X : Mat6 K) * B) ∧
      (∀ i, g.linear (E i) = E' i) ∧
      (∀ i, g.linear (F i) = F' i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨T, S, hTS, hST, hblocks⟩ :=
    exists_actual_same_ledger_pair_block_conjugator E F E' F'
      hEidem hEsum hFidem hFsum hEidem' hEsum' hFidem' hFsum'
      u v u' v' p hp hp' hpne hFu hFv hFu' hFv' hledger hp12 hdisc
  have hdet : det2 S ≠ 0 := by
    change determinant S ≠ 0
    have hdetprod : determinant S * determinant T = 1 := by
      rw [determinant_eq_det, determinant_eq_det, ← Matrix.det_mul, hST,
        Matrix.det_one]
    intro hzero
    rw [hzero, zero_mul] at hdetprod
    exact zero_ne_one hdetprod
  let L := weightedCoordinateEquiv E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne
  let L' := weightedCoordinateEquiv E' hEidem' hEsum' u' v' p hp' hpne
  let B := coordinateConjugate L (matrixAction (F 1 : Mat6 K))
  let C := coordinateConjugate L' (matrixAction (F' 1 : Mat6 K))
  let g := commonPlaneJordanAut E E' hEidem hEsum hEidem' hEsum'
    u v u' v' p hp hp' hpne S T hST hTS hdet
  let A : Mat6 K := matrixOfLinear
    (commonPlaneForward E E' hEidem hEsum hEidem' hEsum'
      u v u' v' p hp hp' hpne S)
  let Ainv : Mat6 K := matrixOfLinear
    (commonPlaneBackward E E' hEidem hEsum hEidem' hEsum'
      u v u' v' p hp hp' hpne T)
  have hmatrix := commonPlaneForwardBackward_matrix_laws
    E E' hEidem hEsum hEidem' hEsum' u v u' v' p hp hp' hpne
    S T hST hTS
  dsimp only at hmatrix
  have hAAinv : A * Ainv = 1 := by
    simpa only [A, Ainv] using hmatrix.1
  have hAinvA : Ainv * A = 1 := by
    simpa only [A, Ainv] using hmatrix.2.1
  have hAform : A.transpose * symplecticJ * A = det2 S • symplecticJ := by
    simpa only [A] using hmatrix.2.2
  have hgCarrier (X : Carrier K) :
      ((g.linear X : Carrier K) : Mat6 K) = A * (X : Mat6 K) * Ainv := by
    simpa only [g, A, Ainv] using
      (commonPlaneJordanAut_apply_coe E E' hEidem hEsum hEidem' hEsum'
        u v u' v' p hp hp' hpne S T hST hTS hdet X)
  have hmap_of_coordinate_conjugacy (P Q : Carrier K)
      (hcoord : (commonPlaneMap S).comp
        ((coordinateConjugate L (matrixAction (P : Mat6 K))).comp
          (commonPlaneMap T)) =
        coordinateConjugate L' (matrixAction (Q : Mat6 K))) :
      g.linear P = Q := by
    dsimp only [g]
    apply commonPlaneJordanAut_maps_of_action E E' hEidem hEsum
      hEidem' hEsum' u v u' v' p hp hp' hpne S T hST hTS hdet P Q
    simpa only [commonPlaneForward, commonPlaneBackward, L, L'] using
      coordinate_transport L L' (matrixAction (P : Mat6 K))
        (matrixAction (Q : Mat6 K)) S T hcoord
  have hEcoord (i : Fin 3) :
      (commonPlaneMap S).comp
        ((coordinateConjugate L (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K))).comp
          (commonPlaneMap T)) =
        coordinateConjugate L' (matrixAction (E' i : Mat6 K)) := by
    rw [coordinateConjugate_first_frame E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne i,
      coordinateConjugate_first_frame E' hEidem' hEsum' u' v' p hp' hpne i,
      ← LinearMap.comp_assoc, commonPlaneMap_comm_standardProjector S i,
      LinearMap.comp_assoc, commonPlaneMap_comp S T hST]
    simp
  have hF0coord :
      (commonPlaneMap S).comp
        ((coordinateConjugate L (matrixAction (F 0 : Mat6 K))).comp
          (commonPlaneMap T)) =
        coordinateConjugate L' (matrixAction (F' 0 : Mat6 K)) := by
    rw [coordinateConjugate_first_projector E (F 0) hEidem hEsum
        u v p hp hpne hFu hFv,
      coordinateConjugate_first_projector E' (F' 0) hEidem' hEsum'
        u' v' p hp' hpne hFu' hFv',
      ← LinearMap.comp_assoc, commonPlaneMap_comm_weightedFirst S p,
      LinearMap.comp_assoc, commonPlaneMap_comp S T hST]
    simp
  have hF1coord :
      (commonPlaneMap S).comp
        ((coordinateConjugate L (matrixAction (F 1 : Mat6 K))).comp
          (commonPlaneMap T)) =
        coordinateConjugate L' (matrixAction (F' 1 : Mat6 K)) := by
    exact commonPlane_conjugates_operator_of_blocks B C T S hTS hST
      (by intro i j; exact hblocks i j)
  have hgE : ∀ i, g.linear (E i) = E' i := fun i =>
    hmap_of_coordinate_conjugacy (E i) (E' i) (hEcoord i)
  have hgF0 : g.linear (F 0) = F' 0 :=
    hmap_of_coordinate_conjugacy (F 0) (F' 0) hF0coord
  have hgF1 : g.linear (F 1) = F' 1 :=
    hmap_of_coordinate_conjugacy (F 1) (F' 1) hF1coord
  have hFsumCarrier : F 0 + F 1 + F 2 = (SelfAdjointCarrier.one : Carrier K) := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact hFsum
  have hFsumCarrier' : F' 0 + F' 1 + F' 2 = (SelfAdjointCarrier.one : Carrier K) := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact hFsum'
  have hgF2 : g.linear (F 2) = F' 2 := by
    have hsum := congrArg g.linear hFsumCarrier
    simp only [map_add, g.map_one, hgF0, hgF1] at hsum
    exact add_left_cancel (hsum.trans hFsumCarrier'.symm)
  have hgF : ∀ i, g.linear (F i) = F' i := by
    intro i
    fin_cases i
    · exact hgF0
    · exact hgF1
    · exact hgF2
  exact ⟨g, A, Ainv, det2 S, hAAinv, hAinvA, hdet, hAform,
    hgCarrier, hgE, hgF⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.exists_spanning_carrier_frame_eigenbasis
statement:
theorem exists_spanning_carrier_frame_eigenbasis
    (P : Fin 3 → Carrier K)
    (hidem : ∀ i, (P i : Mat6 K) * P i = P i)
    (htrace : ∀ i, jordanTrace (K := K) (P i : Mat6 K) = 1)
    (hsum : (P 0 : Mat6 K) + P 1 + P 2 = 1) :
    ∃ u v : Fin 3 → Vec6 K,
      HyperbolicTriple (omega (K := K)) u v ∧
      (∀ i j, matrixAction (P i : Mat6 K) (u j) =
        if i = j then u j else 0) ∧
      (∀ i j, matrixAction (P i : Mat6 K) (v j) =
        if i = j then v j else 0) ∧
      ∀ x : Vec6 K, ∃ a b : Fin 3 → K,
        x = (∑ j, a j • u j) + ∑ j, b j • v j
proof:
:= by
  let Q : Fin 3 → Vec6 K →ₗ[K] Vec6 K :=
    fun i => matrixAction (K := K) (P i : Mat6 K)
  have hQi : ∀ i, IsIdempotent (Q i) :=
    fun i => carrier_projector_action_idempotent (P i) (hidem i)
  have hQs : ∀ i, IsSelfAdjoint (omega (K := K)) (Q i) :=
    fun i => carrier_action_selfAdjoint (P i)
  have hQn : ∀ i, Q i ≠ 0 :=
    fun i => carrier_action_ne_zero_of_trace_one (P i) (htrace i)
  have hQsum : Q 0 + Q 1 + Q 2 = LinearMap.id :=
    carrier_frame_action_sum P hsum
  obtain ⟨u, v, huv, hPu, hPv⟩ :=
    exists_hyperbolicTriple_of_complete_frame (omega (K := K))
      omega_right_nondegenerate Q hQi hQs hQn hQsum
  obtain ⟨word, -, hwu, hwv⟩ :=
    exists_fixed_twelve_triple_alignment (omega (K := K)) omega_alternating
      omega_left_nondegenerate omega_right_nondegenerate
      u v standardE standardF huv standard_hyperbolicTriple
  refine ⟨u, v, huv, hPu, hPv, ?_⟩
  intro x
  obtain ⟨a, b, hx⟩ := standard_spans (wordMap omega word x)
  refine ⟨a, b, ?_⟩
  apply wordMap_injective (omega (K := K)) omega_alternating word
  simpa only [map_add, map_sum, map_smul, hwu, hwv] using hx

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.first_projector_image_spanned
statement:
theorem first_projector_image_spanned
    (P : Fin 3 → Carrier K)
    (hidem : ∀ i, (P i : Mat6 K) * P i = P i)
    (htrace : ∀ i, jordanTrace (K := K) (P i : Mat6 K) = 1)
    (hsum : (P 0 : Mat6 K) + P 1 + P 2 = 1) :
    ∃ u v : Fin 3 → Vec6 K,
      HyperbolicTriple (omega (K := K)) u v ∧
      (∀ i j, matrixAction (P i : Mat6 K) (u j) =
        if i = j then u j else 0) ∧
      (∀ i j, matrixAction (P i : Mat6 K) (v j) =
        if i = j then v j else 0) ∧
      ∀ x, matrixAction (P 0 : Mat6 K) x = x →
        ∃ a b : K, x = a • u 0 + b • v 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, v, huv, hPu, hPv, hspan⟩ :=
    exists_spanning_carrier_frame_eigenbasis P hidem htrace hsum
  refine ⟨u, v, huv, hPu, hPv, ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab⟩ := hspan x
  refine ⟨a 0, b 0, ?_⟩
  rw [← hx, hab]
  simp only [map_add, map_sum, map_smul, hPu, hPv]
  simp [Fin.sum_univ_succ]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.adj2_eq_adj
statement: private theorem adj2_eq_adj (X : Mat2 K) : adj2 X = adj X

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.exists_pair_conjugator_of_actual_weighted_data
statement:
theorem exists_pair_conjugator_of_actual_weighted_data
    (B C : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Mat2 K) (p q : Fin 3 → K)
    (hp : ∀ i, p i ≠ 0) (hp12 : p 1 + p 2 ≠ 0)
    (hdB : ∀ i, B i i = scalar2 (q i))
    (hdC : ∀ i, C i i = scalar2 (q i))
    (hrB : ∀ i, B i 0 + B i 1 + B i 2 = 0)
    (hcB : ∀ j, p 0 • B 0 j + p 1 • B 1 j + p 2 • B 2 j = 0)
    (hrC : ∀ i, C i 0 + C i 1 + C i 2 = 0)
    (hcC : ∀ j, p 0 • C 0 j + p 1 • C 1 j + p 2 • C 2 j = 0)
    (hsB : ∀ i j, p i • B i j = p j • adj2 (B j i))
    (hsC : ∀ i j, p i • C i j = p j • adj2 (C j i))
    (hiB : B 0 0 * B 0 0 + B 0 1 * B 1 0 + B 0 2 * B 2 0 = B 0 0)
    (hiC : C 0 0 * C 0 0 + C 0 1 * C 1 0 + C 0 2 * C 2 0 = C 0 0)
    (hdisc : trace2 (B 0 1) ^ 2 - 4 * determinant (B 0 1) ≠ 0) :
    ∃ T S : Mat2 K, T * S = 1 ∧ S * T = 1 ∧
      ∀ i j, B i j = T * C i j * S
proof:
:= by
  have hdB' : ∀ i, B i i = q i • (1 : Mat2 K) := by
    intro i; simpa [scalar2] using hdB i
  have hdC' : ∀ i, C i i = q i • (1 : Mat2 K) := by
    intro i; simpa [scalar2] using hdC i
  have hsB1 : p 1 • B 1 0 = p 0 • adj (B 0 1) := by
    simpa [adj2_eq_adj] using hsB 1 0
  have hsC1 : p 1 • C 1 0 = p 0 • adj (C 0 1) := by
    simpa [adj2_eq_adj] using hsC 1 0
  have hsB2 : p 2 • B 2 0 = p 0 • adj (B 0 2) := by
    simpa [adj2_eq_adj] using hsB 2 0
  have hsC2 : p 2 • C 2 0 = p 0 • adj (C 0 2) := by
    simpa [adj2_eq_adj] using hsC 2 0
  have htB := pivot_trace_relation B p q hdB' hrB hcB hsB1
  have htC := pivot_trace_relation C p q hdC' hrC hcC hsC1
  have ht : trace2 (B 0 1) = trace2 (C 0 1) := by
    apply (mul_left_cancel₀ (hp 0))
    linear_combination htB - htC
  have hdBrel := pivot_determinant_relation B p q hdB' hrB hcB hsB1 hsB2 hiB
  have hdCrel := pivot_determinant_relation C p q hdC' hrC hcC hsC1 hsC2 hiC
  have hd : determinant (B 0 1) = determinant (C 0 1) := by
    apply (mul_left_cancel₀ (mul_ne_zero (hp 0) hp12))
    rw [ht] at hdBrel
    linear_combination hdBrel - hdCrel
  have hBn := nonscalar_of_discriminant_ne_zero (B 0 1) hdisc
  have hCn : ¬ ∃ a : K, C 0 1 = a • (1 : Mat2 K) := by
    apply nonscalar_of_discriminant_ne_zero
    rw [← ht, ← hd]
    exact hdisc
  exact exists_all_blocks_conjugate B C p q (hp 1) (hp 2)
    hdB' hrB hcB hdC' hrC hcC hBn hCn ht hd

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3JordanCoefficientMap.map_matrixJordan
statement:
theorem map_matrixJordan (f : R →+* S) (A B : Mat3 R) :
    f.mapMatrix (matrixJordan A B) =
      matrixJordan (f.mapMatrix A) (f.mapMatrix B)
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp [matrixJordan, Matrix.mul_apply, map_invTwo, Fin.sum_univ_succ, mul_add]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3JordanCoefficientMap.coordinateMap_jordan
statement:
theorem coordinateMap_jordan (f : R →+* S) (x y : Sym3Coord R) :
    coordinateMap f (jordan x y) =
      jordan (coordinateMap f x) (coordinateMap f y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [jordan, jordan, ← fromMatrix_mapMatrix, map_matrixJordan,
    ← toSymMatrix_coordinateMap, ← toSymMatrix_coordinateMap]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3JordanCoefficientMap.matrixTrace_coordinateMap
statement:
theorem matrixTrace_coordinateMap (f : R →+* S) (x : Sym3Coord R) :
    matrixTrace (coordinateMap f x) = f (matrixTrace x)
proof:
:= by
  simp [matrixTrace, coordinateMap]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3JordanCoefficientMap.coordinateMap_single_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem coordinateMap_single_one (f : R →+* S) (q : Fin 6) :
    coordinateMap f (Pi.single q 1) = Pi.single q 1
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  by_cases h : i = q
  · subst i
    simp [coordinateMap]
  · simp [coordinateMap, Pi.single_apply, h]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexTripleOrbitExplicit.conjugate_comp
statement:
theorem conjugate_comp (P Q A : Mat3 K) :
    conjugate P (conjugate Q A) = conjugate (P * Q) A
proof:
:= by
  simp only [conjugate, Matrix.mul_inv_rev, Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexTripleOrbitExplicit.conjugate_inv_left_cancel
statement:
theorem conjugate_inv_left_cancel (X A : Mat3 K) (hX : X.det ≠ 0) :
    conjugate X⁻¹ (conjugate X A) = A
proof:
:= by
  rw [conjugate_comp, Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul X (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hX)]
  simp [conjugate]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexTripleOrbitExplicit.conjugate_inv_right_cancel
statement:
theorem conjugate_inv_right_cancel (X A : Mat3 K) (hX : X.det ≠ 0) :
    conjugate X (conjugate X⁻¹ A) = A
proof:
:= by
  rw [conjugate_comp, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv X (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hX)]
  simp [conjugate]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexTripleOrbitExplicit.frameOfInvertible_mul
statement:
theorem frameOfInvertible_mul (P X : Mat3 K)
    (hP : P.det ≠ 0) (hX : X.det ≠ 0) (i : Fin 3) :
    frameOfInvertible (P * X) i = conjugate P (frameOfInvertible X i)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [frameOfInvertible, conjugate, Matrix.mul_inv_rev, Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexTripleOrbitExplicit.transpose_conjugate_inverse
statement:
theorem transpose_conjugate_inverse (X A : Mat3 K) (hX : X.det ≠ 0) :
    Matrix.transpose (conjugate X⁻¹ A) =
      conjugate (Matrix.transpose X) (Matrix.transpose A)
proof:
:= by
  have hu : IsUnit X.det := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hX
  have hinv : (X⁻¹)⁻¹ = X := Matrix.nonsing_inv_nonsing_inv X hu
  simp only [conjugate, hinv, Matrix.transpose_mul,
    Matrix.transpose_nonsing_inv, Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexTripleOrbitExplicit.normalized_triple_orbit_explicit
statement:
theorem normalized_triple_orbit_explicit
    (A B : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Mat3 K)
    (hA : ∀ r, FrameLaws (A r)) (hB : ∀ r, FrameLaws (B r))
    (hA0 : A 0 = diagonalFrame) (hB0 : B 0 = diagonalFrame)
    (X Y : Mat3 K) (hX : X.det ≠ 0) (hY : Y.det ≠ 0)
    (hA1 : A 1 = frameOfInvertible X) (hB1 : B 1 = frameOfInvertible Y)
    (hopen : ∀ i j, overlapOf X i j ≠ 0)
    (hdet : Matrix.det
      (grading * encoder (B 1 0) (B 1 2) -
        encoder (B 1 0) (B 1 2) * grading) ≠ 0)
    (hledger : labelledLedger (primitiveMatrixTauTriple A) =
      labelledLedger (primitiveMatrixTauTriple B)) :
    ∃ Q : Mat3 K, Q.det ≠ 0 ∧
      ((∀ r i, conjugate Q (A r i) = B r i) ∨
       (∀ r i, conjugate Q (Matrix.transpose (A r i)) = B r i))
proof:
:= by
  have hover := overlap_eq_of_primitiveLedger_eq A B hA hB hA0 hB0
    X Y hA1 hB1 hledger
  obtain ⟨d, hd, hfix, hdirect | htranspose⟩ :=
    normalized_pair_orbit X Y hX hY hopen hover
  · let Q := Matrix.diagonal d
    have hQ : Q.det ≠ 0 := diagonal_det_ne_zero d hd
    let g := glAut Q hQ
    have hg0 : mapFamily g A 0 = diagonalFrame := by
      funext i; rw [mapFamily, hA0]; exact hfix i
    have hg1 : mapFamily g A 1 = B 1 := by
      funext i; rw [mapFamily, hA1, hB1]; exact (hdirect i).symm
    have hg2 := thirdFrame_eq_after_ledger_symmetry A B hA hB g.linear
      (ledgerSymmetry_of_aut g) (fun r => frameLaws_map_aut g _ (hA r))
      hg0 hg1 hB0 hdet hledger
    refine ⟨Q, hQ, Or.inl ?_⟩
    intro r i
    fin_cases r
    · exact (congrFun hg0 i).trans (congrFun hB0 i).symm
    · exact congrFun hg1 i
    · exact congrFun hg2 i
  · let Q := Matrix.diagonal d
    have hQ : Q.det ≠ 0 := diagonal_det_ne_zero d hd
    let g := transposeThenGLAut Q hQ
    have hg0 : mapFamily g A 0 = diagonalFrame := by
      funext i
      rw [mapFamily, hA0]
      change conjugate Q (Matrix.transpose (diagonalUnit i)) = diagonalUnit i
      have ht : Matrix.transpose (diagonalUnit i : Mat3 K) = diagonalUnit i := by
        ext p q; simp [diagonalUnit, Matrix.transpose_apply, eq_comm, and_comm]
      rw [ht]
      exact hfix i
    have hg1 : mapFamily g A 1 = B 1 := by
      funext i; rw [mapFamily, hA1, hB1]; exact (htranspose i).symm
    have hg2 := thirdFrame_eq_after_ledger_symmetry A B hA hB g.linear
      (ledgerSymmetry_of_aut g) (fun r => frameLaws_map_aut g _ (hA r))
      hg0 hg1 hB0 hdet hledger
    refine ⟨Q, hQ, Or.inr ?_⟩
    intro r i
    fin_cases r
    · exact (congrFun hg0 i).trans (congrFun hB0 i).symm
    · exact congrFun hg1 i
    · exact congrFun hg2 i

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexTripleOrbitExplicit.triple_orbit_explicit_of_bases
statement:
theorem triple_orbit_explicit_of_bases
    (A B : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Mat3 K)
    (hA : ∀ r, FrameLaws (A r)) (hB : ∀ r, FrameLaws (B r))
    (X0 X1 Y0 Y1 : Mat3 K)
    (hX0 : X0.det ≠ 0) (hX1 : X1.det ≠ 0)
    (hY0 : Y0.det ≠ 0) (hY1 : Y1.det ≠ 0)
    (hAX0 : A 0 = frameOfInvertible X0)
    (hAX1 : A 1 = frameOfInvertible X1)
    (hBY0 : B 0 = frameOfInvertible Y0)
    (hBY1 : B 1 = frameOfInvertible Y1)
    (hopen : ∀ i j, overlapOf (X0⁻¹ * X1) i j ≠ 0)
    (hdet : Matrix.det
      (grading * encoder (normalizeBy Y0 B 1 0) (normalizeBy Y0 B 1 2) -
       encoder (normalizeBy Y0 B 1 0) (normalizeBy Y0 B 1 2) * grading) ≠ 0)
    (hledger : labelledLedger (primitiveMatrixTauTriple A) =
      labelledLedger (primitiveMatrixTauTriple B)) :
    ∃ Q : Mat3 K, Q.det ≠ 0 ∧
      ((∀ r i, conjugate Q (A r i) = B r i) ∨
       (∀ r i, conjugate Q (Matrix.transpose (A r i)) = B r i))
proof:
:= by
  let NA := normalizeBy X0 A
  let NB := normalizeBy Y0 B
  have hX0i : (X0⁻¹).det ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Matrix.det_nonsing_inv, Ring.inverse_eq_inv]; exact inv_ne_zero hX0
  have hY0i : (Y0⁻¹).det ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Matrix.det_nonsing_inv, Ring.inverse_eq_inv]; exact inv_ne_zero hY0
  let gx := glAut X0⁻¹ hX0i
  let gy := glAut Y0⁻¹ hY0i
  have hNA : ∀ r, FrameLaws (NA r) := fun r => frameLaws_map_aut gx _ (hA r)
  have hNB : ∀ r, FrameLaws (NB r) := fun r => frameLaws_map_aut gy _ (hB r)
  have hNA0 : NA 0 = diagonalFrame := by
    funext i
    change conjugate X0⁻¹ (A 0 i) = diagonalUnit i
    rw [hAX0, frameOfInvertible]
    exact conjugate_inv_left_cancel X0 (diagonalUnit i) hX0
  have hNB0 : NB 0 = diagonalFrame := by
    funext i
    change conjugate Y0⁻¹ (B 0 i) = diagonalUnit i
    rw [hBY0, frameOfInvertible]
    exact conjugate_inv_left_cancel Y0 (diagonalUnit i) hY0
  have hrelX : (X0⁻¹ * X1).det ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_nonsing_inv, Ring.inverse_eq_inv]
    exact mul_ne_zero (inv_ne_zero hX0) hX1
  have hrelY : (Y0⁻¹ * Y1).det ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_nonsing_inv, Ring.inverse_eq_inv]
    exact mul_ne_zero (inv_ne_zero hY0) hY1
  have hNA1 : NA 1 = frameOfInvertible (X0⁻¹ * X1) := by
    funext i
    change conjugate X0⁻¹ (A 1 i) = frameOfInvertible (X0⁻¹ * X1) i
    rw [hAX1, ← frameOfInvertible_mul X0⁻¹ X1 hX0i hX1]
  have hNB1 : NB 1 = frameOfInvertible (Y0⁻¹ * Y1) := by
    funext i
    change conjugate Y0⁻¹ (B 1 i) = frameOfInvertible (Y0⁻¹ * Y1) i
    rw [hBY1, ← frameOfInvertible_mul Y0⁻¹ Y1 hY0i hY1]
  have hledN : labelledLedger (primitiveMatrixTauTriple NA) =
      labelledLedger (primitiveMatrixTauTriple NB) :=
    (primitiveLedger_mapFamily gx.linear (ledgerSymmetry_of_aut gx) A).trans
      (hledger.trans (primitiveLedger_mapFamily gy.linear
        (ledgerSymmetry_of_aut gy) B).symm)
  obtain ⟨D, hD, hdir | htrans⟩ := normalized_triple_orbit_explicit
    NA NB hNA hNB hNA0 hNB0 (X0⁻¹ * X1) (Y0⁻¹ * Y1) hrelX hrelY
    hNA1 hNB1 hopen hdet hledN
  · refine ⟨Y0 * D * X0⁻¹, ?_, Or.inl ?_⟩
    · rw [Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_nonsing_inv,
        Ring.inverse_eq_inv]
      exact mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero hY0 hD) (inv_ne_zero hX0)
    · intro r i
      have hh := congrArg (conjugate Y0) (hdir r i)
      change conjugate Y0 (conjugate D (conjugate X0⁻¹ (A r i))) =
        conjugate Y0 (conjugate Y0⁻¹ (B r i)) at hh
      rw [conjugate_comp, conjugate_comp,
        conjugate_inv_right_cancel Y0 (B r i) hY0] at hh
      exact hh
  · refine ⟨Y0 * D * Matrix.transpose X0, ?_, Or.inr ?_⟩
    · rw [Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_transpose]
      exact mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero hY0 hD) hX0
    · intro r i
      have hh := congrArg (conjugate Y0) (htrans r i)
      change conjugate Y0 (conjugate D (Matrix.transpose (conjugate X0⁻¹ (A r i)))) =
        conjugate Y0 (conjugate Y0⁻¹ (B r i)) at hh
      rw [transpose_conjugate_inverse X0 (A r i) hX0,
        conjugate_comp, conjugate_comp,
        conjugate_inv_right_cancel Y0 (B r i) hY0] at hh
      exact hh

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourcePeirceAttachment.sourceResidual_zero
statement:
private theorem sourceResidual_zero (x y : JCoord K) :
    residual (sourceProductLinear (K := K)) x y = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply sub_eq_zero.mpr
  simpa only [sourceProductLinear_apply] using
    AlbertLean.Comparison.GenericJordanExtension.sourceJordanIdentity x y

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourcePeirceAttachment.sourcePeirceReflection_formula
statement:
theorem sourcePeirceReflection_formula (p x : JCoord K) :
    sourcePeirceReflection p x =
      x - (8 : K) • sourceProduct p x +
        (8 : K) • sourceProduct p (sourceProduct p x)
proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourcePeirceAttachment.sourcePeirceLinearEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem sourcePeirceLinearEquiv_apply (p : JCoord K)
    (hp : sourceProduct p p = p) (x : JCoord K) :
    sourcePeirceLinearEquiv p hp x = sourcePeirceReflection p x
proof:
:= by
  exact reflectionEquiv_apply sourceProductLinear sourceProduct_comm
    sourceResidual_zero p hp x

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourcePeirceAttachment.sourcePeirceLinearEquiv_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem sourcePeirceLinearEquiv_one (p : JCoord K)
    (hp : sourceProduct p p = p) :
    sourcePeirceLinearEquiv p hp sourceOne = sourceOne
proof:
:= by
  exact reflectionEquiv_unit sourceProductLinear sourceProduct_comm
    sourceResidual_zero sourceOne p (sourceProduct_one_right p) hp

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourcePeirceAttachment.sourcePeirceLinearEquiv_product
statement:
theorem sourcePeirceLinearEquiv_product (p : JCoord K)
    (hp : sourceProduct p p = p) (x y : JCoord K) :
    sourcePeirceLinearEquiv p hp (sourceProduct x y) =
      sourceProduct (sourcePeirceLinearEquiv p hp x)
        (sourcePeirceLinearEquiv p hp y)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [sourcePeirceLinearEquiv_apply, sourcePeirceReflection,
    sourceProductLinear_apply] using
    reflection_mul sourceProductLinear sourceProduct_comm
      sourceResidual_zero p hp x y

name: AlbertLean.Generic.StandardTargetPairTable.normalizedMuV_smul
statement:
theorem normalizedMuV_smul (a b : K) (s : SCoord K) (c : CCoord K) :
    normalizedMuV (a • s) (b • c) = (a * b) • normalizedMuV s c
proof:
:= by
  apply VCoord.ext
  · simp [normalizedMuV, muV, evalU]; ring
  · simp [normalizedMuV, muV, evalU]; ring
  · funext i
    cases i <;> simp [normalizedMuV, muV, wedge2, dualWedge2, hodgeStar] <;> ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.StandardTargetPairTable.sourceMuS_smul
statement:
theorem sourceMuS_smul (a b : K) (c : CCoord K) (v : VCoord K) :
    sourceMuS (a • c) (b • v) = (a * b) • sourceMuS c v
proof:
:= by
  apply SCoord.ext <;> funext i <;> fin_cases i <;> simp [sourceMuS] <;> ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.StandardTargetPairTable.sourceMuC_smul
statement:
theorem sourceMuC_smul (a b : K) (v : VCoord K) (s : SCoord K) :
    sourceMuC (a • v) (b • s) = (a * b) • sourceMuC v s
proof:
:= by
  apply CCoord.ext <;> funext i <;> fin_cases i <;> simp [sourceMuC] <;> ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.StandardTargetPairTable.sourceMuS_smul_left
statement:
private theorem sourceMuS_smul_left (a : K) (c : CCoord K) (v : VCoord K) :
    sourceMuS (a • c) v = a • sourceMuS c v
proof:
:= by
  simpa using sourceMuS_smul a 1 c v

name: AlbertLean.Generic.StandardTargetPairTable.sourceMuC_smul_right
statement:
private theorem sourceMuC_smul_right (a : K) (v : VCoord K) (s : SCoord K) :
    sourceMuC v (a • s) = a • sourceMuC v s
proof:
:= by
  simpa using sourceMuC_smul 1 a v s

name: AlbertLean.Generic.StandardTargetPairTable.add_half_self
statement:
private theorem add_half_self {W : Type*} [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W] (x : W) :
    x + (1 / 2 : K) • x = (3 / 2 : K) • x
proof: := by module

name: AlbertLean.Generic.StandardTargetPairTable.sourceProduct_target_zero
statement:
theorem sourceProduct_target_zero (e : JCoord K) :
    sourceProduct e (diagonalUnit 0) = targetCross e
proof:
:=
  sourceProduct_diagonalUnit_zero e

name: AlbertLean.Generic.StandardTargetPairTable.sourceTrace_target_zero
statement:
theorem sourceTrace_target_zero (e : JCoord K) :
    sourceTrace (sourceProduct e (diagonalUnit 0)) = e.d1
proof:
:= by
  rw [sourceProduct_target_zero]
  simp [sourceTrace, targetCross]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.StandardTargetPairTable.add_targetCross
proof:
:= by
  apply JCoord.ext
  · change e.d1 + e.d1 = 2 * e.d1
    ring
  · change e.d2 + 0 = e.d2
    simp
  · change e.d3 + 0 = e.d3
    simp
  · change e.v + 0 = e.v
    simp
  · change e.s + (1 / 2 : K) • e.s = (3 / 2 : K) • e.s
    exact add_half_self (K := K) e.s
  · change e.c + (1 / 2 : K) • e.c = (3 / 2 : K) • e.c
    exact add_half_self (K := K) e.c

name: AlbertLean.Generic.StandardTargetPairTable.sourceProduct_targetCross
statement:
theorem sourceProduct_targetCross (e : JCoord K) :
    sourceProduct e (targetCross e) =
      { d1 := e.d1 ^ 2 + (nS e.s + nC e.c) / 2,
        d2 := nC e.c / 2,
        d3 := nS e.s / 2,
        v := (1 / 2 : K) • normalizedMuV e.s e.c,
        s := ((3 * e.d1 + e.d3) / 4) • e.s +
          (1 / 4 : K) • sourceMuS e.c e.v,
        c := ((3 * e.d1 + e.d2) / 4) • e.c +
          (1 / 4 : K) • sourceMuC e.v e.s }
proof:
:= by
  apply JCoord.ext
  · simp [sourceProduct_d1, targetCross, BS_smul_right, BC_smul_right,
      BS_self_eq_two_nS, BC_self_eq_two_nC]; ring
  · simp [sourceProduct_d2, targetCross, BC_smul_right, BC_self_eq_two_nC, BV, BW] <;> ring
  · simp [sourceProduct_d3, targetCross, BS_smul_right, BS_self_eq_two_nS, BV, BW] <;> ring
  · rw [sourceProduct_v_polarization, add_targetCross]
    simp [sourceSquare_v, targetCross, normalizedMuV_smul] <;> module
  · rw [sourceProduct_s_polarization, add_targetCross]
    simp [sourceSquare_s, targetCross, sourceMuS_smul_left] <;> module
  · rw [sourceProduct_c_polarization, add_targetCross]
    simp [sourceSquare_c, targetCross, sourceMuC_smul_right] <;> module

name: AlbertLean.Generic.StandardTargetPairTable.adjoint_zero_components
statement:
theorem adjoint_zero_components (e : JCoord K) (h : sourceAdjoint e = 0) :
    nS e.s = e.d1 * e.d3 ∧ nC e.c = e.d1 * e.d2 ∧
    normalizedMuV e.s e.c = e.d1 • e.v ∧
    sourceMuS e.c e.v = e.d2 • e.s ∧ sourceMuC e.v e.s = e.d3 • e.c
proof:
:= by
  rw [sourceAdjoint_eq_explicit] at h
  have h2 := congrArg JCoord.d2 h
  have h3 := congrArg JCoord.d3 h
  have hv := congrArg JCoord.v h
  have hs := congrArg JCoord.s h
  have hc := congrArg JCoord.c h
  change e.d1 * e.d3 - nS e.s = 0 at h2
  change e.d1 * e.d2 - nC e.c = 0 at h3
  change normalizedMuV e.s e.c - e.d1 • e.v = 0 at hv
  change sourceMuS e.c e.v - e.d2 • e.s = 0 at hs
  change sourceMuC e.v e.s - e.d3 • e.c = 0 at hc
  exact ⟨(sub_eq_zero.mp h2).symm, (sub_eq_zero.mp h3).symm,
    sub_eq_zero.mp hv, sub_eq_zero.mp hs, sub_eq_zero.mp hc⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.StandardTargetPairTable.pairTable_of_idempotent_adjoint_zero
statement:
theorem pairTable_of_idempotent_adjoint_zero (e : JCoord K)
    (hidem : sourceProduct e e = e) (hadj : sourceAdjoint e = 0) :
    ScalarMidpoint.PairTable sourceProductLinear e (diagonalUnit 0)
      (sourceProduct e (diagonalUnit 0)) e.d1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hS, hC, hV, hMS, hMC⟩ := adjoint_zero_components e hadj
  have hd := congrArg JCoord.d1 hidem
  have hs := congrArg JCoord.s hidem
  have hc := congrArg JCoord.c hidem
  change (sourceSquare e).d1 = e.d1 at hd
  change (sourceSquare e).s = e.s at hs
  change (sourceSquare e).c = e.c at hc
  rw [sourceSquare_d1] at hd
  rw [sourceSquare_s] at hs
  rw [sourceSquare_c] at hc
  have hts : (e.d1 + e.d2 + e.d3) • e.s = e.s := by
    calc
      _ = (e.d1 + e.d3) • e.s + sourceMuS e.c e.v := by rw [hMS]; module
      _ = e.s := hs
  have htc : (e.d1 + e.d2 + e.d3) • e.c = e.c := by
    calc
      _ = (e.d1 + e.d2) • e.c + sourceMuC e.v e.s := by rw [hMC]; module
      _ = e.c := hc
  rw [sourceProduct_target_zero]
  refine ⟨hidem, ?_, sourceProduct_target_zero e, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change sourceProduct (diagonalUnit 0 : JCoord K) (diagonalUnit 0) = _
    rw [sourceProduct_diagonalUnit_zero]
    apply JCoord.ext <;> simp [diagonalUnit, diagonal]
  · change sourceProduct e (targetCross e) =
      (1 / 2 : K) • (targetCross e + e.d1 • e)
    rw [sourceProduct_targetCross]
    apply JCoord.ext
    · simp [targetCross, smul_eq_mul]
      linear_combination (1 / 2 : K) * hd
    · simp [targetCross, hC, smul_eq_mul]; ring
    · simp [targetCross, hS, smul_eq_mul]; ring
    · simp [targetCross, hV]
    · change ((3 * e.d1 + e.d3) / 4) • e.s +
        (1 / 4 : K) • sourceMuS e.c e.v =
        (1 / 2 : K) • ((1 / 2 : K) • e.s + e.d1 • e.s)
      rw [hMS]
      calc
        _ = (1 / 4 : K) • ((e.d1 + e.d2 + e.d3) • e.s) +
            (e.d1 / 2) • e.s := by module
        _ = _ := by rw [hts]; module
    · change ((3 * e.d1 + e.d2) / 4) • e.c +
        (1 / 4 : K) • sourceMuC e.v e.s =
        (1 / 2 : K) • ((1 / 2 : K) • e.c + e.d1 • e.c)
      rw [hMC]
      calc
        _ = (1 / 4 : K) • ((e.d1 + e.d2 + e.d3) • e.c) +
            (e.d1 / 2) • e.c := by module
        _ = _ := by rw [htc]; module
  · change sourceProduct (diagonalUnit 0) (targetCross e) =
      (1 / 2 : K) • (targetCross e + e.d1 • diagonalUnit 0)
    rw [sourceProduct_comm, sourceProduct_diagonalUnit_zero]
    apply JCoord.ext <;> simp [targetCross, diagonalUnit, diagonal] <;> first | ring | module
  · change sourceSquare (targetCross e) =
      (e.d1 / 4) • (e + diagonalUnit 0 + (2 : K) • targetCross e)
    rw [sourceSquare_formula]
    apply JCoord.ext
    · simp [targetCross, diagonalUnit, diagonal, nS_smul, nC_smul, smul_eq_mul]
      linear_combination (1 / 4 : K) * hd
    · simp [targetCross, diagonalUnit, diagonal, nC_smul, hC, smul_eq_mul]; ring
    · simp [targetCross, diagonalUnit, diagonal, nS_smul, hS, smul_eq_mul]; ring
    · simp [targetCross, diagonalUnit, diagonal, normalizedMuV_smul, hV]; module
    · simp [targetCross, diagonalUnit, diagonal]; module
    · simp [targetCross, diagonalUnit, diagonal]; module

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.NonscalarBlockNormalizer.cyclicBasisAt_mul_inv
statement:
theorem cyclicBasisAt_mul_inv (X : Mat2 K) (v : Vec2 K)
    (hv : cyclicDet X v ≠ 0) :
    cyclicBasisAt X v * cyclicBasisAtInv X v = 1
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [cyclicDet] at hv
  have hn : -(cyclicBasisAt X v 1 0 * cyclicBasisAt X v 0 1) +
      cyclicBasisAt X v 0 0 * cyclicBasisAt X v 1 1 ≠ 0 := by
    convert hv using 1 <;> ring
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [cyclicBasisAtInv, cyclicDet, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two,
      Matrix.one_apply] <;> field_simp [hv, hn] <;> ring
  linear_combination mul_inv_cancel₀ hn

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.NonscalarBlockNormalizer.cyclicBasisAt_inv_mul

theorem cyclicBasisAt_inv_mul (X : Mat2 K) (v : Vec2 K)

:= by

  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [cyclicBasisAtInv, cyclicDet, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two,
      Matrix.one_apply] <;> field_simp [hv] <;> ring

      Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_two] <;> ring

statement: @[simp] theorem cyclicDet_e0 (X : Mat2 K) : cyclicDet X e0 = X 1 0

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.NonscalarBlockNormalizer.exists_three_cyclic
statement:
theorem exists_three_cyclic (X : Mat2 K)
    (hX : ¬ ∃ a : K, X = a • (1 : Mat2 K)) :
    ∃ v : Vec2 K, (v = e0 ∨ v = e1 ∨ v = e0 + e1) ∧ cyclicDet X v ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h10 : X 1 0 = 0
  · by_cases h01 : X 0 1 = 0
    · have hdiag : X 1 1 - X 0 0 ≠ 0 := by
        intro heq
        apply hX
        refine ⟨X 0 0, ?_⟩
        ext i j
        fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
          simp [Matrix.one_apply, h10, h01] at heq ⊢ <;> linear_combination heq
      refine ⟨e0 + e1, Or.inr (Or.inr rfl), ?_⟩
      simp [h10, h01]
      exact hdiag
    · exact ⟨e1, Or.inr (Or.inl rfl), by simpa using neg_ne_zero.mpr h01⟩
  · exact ⟨e0, Or.inl rfl, by simpa using h10⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.NonscalarBlockNormalizer.rational_intertwiner_of_nonscalar
statement:
theorem rational_intertwiner_of_nonscalar (X Y : Mat2 K)
    (hX : ¬ ∃ a : K, X = a • (1 : Mat2 K))
    (hY : ¬ ∃ a : K, Y = a • (1 : Mat2 K))
    (ht : trace2 X = trace2 Y) (hd : determinant X = determinant Y) :
    ∃ vx vy : Vec2 K,
      (vx = e0 ∨ vx = e1 ∨ vx = e0 + e1) ∧
      (vy = e0 ∨ vy = e1 ∨ vy = e0 + e1) ∧
      let T
proof:
:= cyclicBasisAt X vx * cyclicBasisAtInv Y vy
      let S := cyclicBasisAt Y vy * cyclicBasisAtInv X vx
      T * S = 1 ∧ S * T = 1 ∧ X * T = T * Y := by
  obtain ⟨vx, hvxmem, hvx⟩ := exists_three_cyclic X hX
  obtain ⟨vy, hvymem, hvy⟩ := exists_three_cyclic Y hY
  refine ⟨vx, vy, hvxmem, hvymem, ?_⟩
  have hc : companion X = companion Y := by simp only [companion, ht, hd]
  have hi : companion Y * cyclicBasisAtInv Y vy = cyclicBasisAtInv Y vy * Y := by
    calc
      companion Y * cyclicBasisAtInv Y vy =
          (cyclicBasisAtInv Y vy * cyclicBasisAt Y vy) * companion Y *
            cyclicBasisAtInv Y vy := by rw [cyclicBasisAt_inv_mul Y vy hvy, Matrix.one_mul]
      _ = cyclicBasisAtInv Y vy * (cyclicBasisAt Y vy * companion Y) *
            cyclicBasisAtInv Y vy := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = cyclicBasisAtInv Y vy * (Y * cyclicBasisAt Y vy) *
            cyclicBasisAtInv Y vy := by rw [← cyclicBasisAt_intertwines]
      _ = cyclicBasisAtInv Y vy * Y := by
        simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc, cyclicBasisAt_mul_inv Y vy hvy, Matrix.mul_one]
  dsimp only
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · calc
      _ = cyclicBasisAt X vx * (cyclicBasisAtInv Y vy * cyclicBasisAt Y vy) *
          cyclicBasisAtInv X vx := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = 1 := by rw [cyclicBasisAt_inv_mul Y vy hvy, Matrix.mul_one,
        cyclicBasisAt_mul_inv X vx hvx]
  · calc
      _ = cyclicBasisAt Y vy * (cyclicBasisAtInv X vx * cyclicBasisAt X vx) *
          cyclicBasisAtInv Y vy := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = 1 := by rw [cyclicBasisAt_inv_mul X vx hvx, Matrix.mul_one,
        cyclicBasisAt_mul_inv Y vy hvy]
  · calc
      _ = (X * cyclicBasisAt X vx) * cyclicBasisAtInv Y vy := by
        simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = (cyclicBasisAt X vx * companion Y) * cyclicBasisAtInv Y vy := by
        rw [cyclicBasisAt_intertwines, hc]
      _ = cyclicBasisAt X vx * (cyclicBasisAtInv Y vy * Y) := by rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, hi]
      _ = _ := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.NonscalarBlockNormalizer.nonscalar_of_discriminant_ne_zero
statement:
theorem nonscalar_of_discriminant_ne_zero (X : Mat2 K)
    (hdisc : trace2 X ^ 2 - 4 * determinant X ≠ 0) :
    ¬ ∃ a : K, X = a • (1 : Mat2 K)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨a, rfl⟩
  apply hdisc
  simp [trace2, determinant, Matrix.one_apply]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.NonscalarBlockNormalizer.exists_all_blocks_conjugate
statement:
theorem exists_all_blocks_conjugate (B C : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Mat2 K)
    (p q : Fin 3 → K) (hp1 : p 1 ≠ 0) (hp2 : p 2 ≠ 0)
    (hdB : ∀ i, B i i = q i • (1 : Mat2 K))
    (hrB : ∀ i, B i 0 + B i 1 + B i 2 = 0)
    (hcB : ∀ j, p 0 • B 0 j + p 1 • B 1 j + p 2 • B 2 j = 0)
    (hdC : ∀ i, C i i = q i • (1 : Mat2 K))
    (hrC : ∀ i, C i 0 + C i 1 + C i 2 = 0)
    (hcC : ∀ j, p 0 • C 0 j + p 1 • C 1 j + p 2 • C 2 j = 0)
    (hB : ¬ ∃ a : K, B 0 1 = a • (1 : Mat2 K))
    (hC : ¬ ∃ a : K, C 0 1 = a • (1 : Mat2 K))
    (ht : trace2 (B 0 1) = trace2 (C 0 1))
    (hd : determinant (B 0 1) = determinant (C 0 1)) :
    ∃ T S : Mat2 K, T * S = 1 ∧ S * T = 1 ∧
      ∀ i j, B i j = T * C i j * S
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨vx, vy, _, _, hTS, hST, hX⟩ :=
    rational_intertwiner_of_nonscalar (B 0 1) (C 0 1) hB hC ht hd
  exact ⟨_, _, hTS, hST,
    all_blocks_conjugate B C p q hp1 hp2 hdB hrB hcB hdC hrC hcC _ _ hTS hX⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FieldPointNilpotence.isNilpotent_of_forall_field_maps_zero
statement:
theorem isNilpotent_of_forall_field_maps_zero
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (r : R)
    (hfield : ∀ (L : Type u) (_ : Field L) (f : R →+* L), f r = 0) :
    IsNilpotent r
proof:
:= by
  rw [nilpotent_iff_mem_prime]
  intro p hp
  letI : p.IsPrime := hp
  let Q := R ⧸ p
  let L := FractionRing Q
  let j : Q →+* L := algebraMap Q L
  let f : R →+* L := j.comp (Ideal.Quotient.mk p)
  have hz : f r = 0 := hfield L inferInstance f
  have hq : Ideal.Quotient.mk p r = 0 := by
    apply (IsFractionRing.injective Q L)
    simpa [f, j] using hz
  exact Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp hq

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FieldPointNilpotence.tensorDifference_isNilpotent_of_field_embedding_agreement
statement:
theorem tensorDifference_isNilpotent_of_field_embedding_agreement
    (a : K)
    (hagree : ∀ (L : Type v) (_ : Field L)
      (left right : K →+* L),
      (∀ x : H, left (algebraMap H K x) = right (algebraMap H K x)) →
      left a = right a) :
    IsNilpotent
      (a ⊗ₜ[H] (1 : K) - (1 : K) ⊗ₜ[H] a : K ⊗[H] K)
proof:
:= by
  apply isNilpotent_of_forall_field_maps_zero
  intro L instL f
  let left : K →+* L := f.comp
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft (R := H) (S := H) (A := K) (B := K)).toRingHom
  let right : K →+* L := f.comp
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := H) (A := K) (B := K)).toRingHom
  have hbase : ∀ x : H,
      left (algebraMap H K x) = right (algebraMap H K x) := by
    intro x
    simp [left, right, Algebra.TensorProduct.algebraMap_apply']
  have ha : left a = right a := hagree L instL left right hbase
  simpa [left, right, sub_eq_zero] using ha

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FieldPointNilpotence.exists_base_of_field_embedding_agreement
statement:
theorem exists_base_of_field_embedding_agreement
    (H : Type u) (K : Type v) [Field H] [CharZero H] [Field K] [Algebra H K]
    (a : K)
    (hagree : ∀ (L : Type v) (_ : Field L) (left right : K →+* L),
      (∀ x : H, left (algebraMap H K x) = right (algebraMap H K x)) →
      left a = right a) :
    ∃ h : H, algebraMap H K h = a
proof:
:= by
  apply TensorDifferenceDescent.exists_base_of_difference_isNilpotent H K a
  exact tensorDifference_isNilpotent_of_field_embedding_agreement H K a hagree

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowGauge.normalizedX_eq_ratio
statement:
theorem normalizedX_eq_ratio (a0 b0 b1 : Mat3 K) (ha0 : a0.det ≠ 0) :
    normalizedX a0 b0 b1 = b1 * b0⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  simp only [normalizedX, anchor, mul_assoc]
  rw [Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv a0 (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr ha0), mul_one]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowGauge.det_b_eq
statement:
theorem det_b_eq {a : Fin 3 → Mat3 K} (S : RawSystem a) (i : Fin 3) :
    (S.b i).det = (a i).det
proof:
:=
  (parametrized_iff_adjugate_equations (a i) (S.b i) (S.c i) (S.b_ne i)).mpr
    (S.equations i) |>.1

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowGauge.c_eq_inverse_adjugate
proof:
:=
  (parametrized_iff_adjugate_equations (a i) (S.b i) (S.c i) (S.b_ne i)).mpr

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowGauge.ratio_eq_of_gaugeRelated
statement:
theorem ratio_eq_of_gaugeRelated {a : Fin 3 → Mat3 K}
    {S T : RawSystem a} (hg : GaugeRelated S T) : ratio S = ratio T
proof:
:= by
  rcases hg with ⟨h, hdet, hb, _⟩
  have hh : h.det ≠ 0 := by rw [hdet]; exact one_ne_zero
  have hhinv : h⁻¹ * h = 1 := Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul h (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hh)
  have hinv := inverse_after_right_change (S.b 0) h⁻¹ h (S.b_ne 0) hhinv
  rw [ratio, ratio, hb 1, hb 0, hinv]
  symm
  rw [mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc h h⁻¹,
    Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv h (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hh), one_mul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowGauge.gaugeRelated_of_ratio_eq
statement:
theorem gaugeRelated_of_ratio_eq {a : Fin 3 → Mat3 K}
    {S T : RawSystem a} (hratio : ratio S = ratio T) : GaugeRelated S T
proof:
:= by
  let h : Mat3 K := (S.b 0)⁻¹ * T.b 0
  have hs0 := S.b_ne 0
  have ht0 := T.b_ne 0
  have hb0 : S.b 0 * h = T.b 0 := by
    dsimp only [h]
    rw [← mul_assoc,
      Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv (S.b 0) (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hs0), one_mul]
  have hdet : h.det = 1 := by
    dsimp only [h]
    rw [Matrix.det_mul, det_b_eq T 0, ← det_b_eq S 0]
    exact Matrix.det_nonsing_inv_mul_det (S.b 0) (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hs0)
  have hh : h.det ≠ 0 := by rw [hdet]; exact one_ne_zero
  have hb1 : S.b 1 * h = T.b 1 := by
    have hm := congrArg (fun Z : Mat3 K => Z * T.b 0) hratio
    simp only [ratio, mul_assoc,
      Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul (T.b 0) (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr ht0), mul_one] at hm
    simpa only [h, mul_assoc] using hm
  have hb2 : S.b 2 * h = T.b 2 := by
    have hs := congrArg (fun Z : Mat3 K => Z * h) S.b_sum
    simp only [add_mul, zero_mul, hb0, hb1] at hs
    exact add_left_cancel (hs.trans T.b_sum.symm)
  have hb : ∀ i, T.b i = S.b i * h := by
    intro i
    fin_cases i
    · exact hb0.symm
    · exact hb1.symm
    · exact hb2.symm
  have hhinv : h⁻¹ * h = 1 := Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul h (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hh)
  have hc : ∀ i, T.c i = h⁻¹ * S.c i := by
    intro i
    rw [c_eq_inverse_adjugate T i, c_eq_inverse_adjugate S i, hb i,
      inverse_after_right_change (S.b i) h⁻¹ h (S.b_ne i) hhinv,
      mul_assoc]
  exact ⟨h, hdet, hb, hc⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowGauge.gaugeRelated_iff_ratio_eq
statement:
theorem gaugeRelated_iff_ratio_eq {a : Fin 3 → Mat3 K} (S T : RawSystem a) :
    GaugeRelated S T ↔ ratio S = ratio T
proof:
:=
  ⟨ratio_eq_of_gaugeRelated, gaugeRelated_of_ratio_eq⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowGauge.gaugeRelated_equivalence
statement:
theorem gaugeRelated_equivalence (a : Fin 3 → Mat3 K) :
    Equivalence (GaugeRelated (a := a))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro S
    exact (gaugeRelated_iff_ratio_eq S S).mpr rfl
  · intro S T h
    exact (gaugeRelated_iff_ratio_eq T S).mpr ((gaugeRelated_iff_ratio_eq S T).mp h).symm
  · intro S T W hST hTW
    exact (gaugeRelated_iff_ratio_eq S W).mpr
      (((gaugeRelated_iff_ratio_eq S T).mp hST).trans
        ((gaugeRelated_iff_ratio_eq T W).mp hTW))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowGauge.gauge_transporter_unique
statement:
theorem gauge_transporter_unique {a : Fin 3 → Mat3 K} (S T : RawSystem a)
    (h : Mat3 K) (hb0 : T.b 0 = S.b 0 * h) :
    h = (S.b 0)⁻¹ * T.b 0
proof:
:= by
  calc
    h = 1 * h := (one_mul h).symm
    _ = ((S.b 0)⁻¹ * S.b 0) * h := by
      rw [Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul (S.b 0) (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (S.b_ne 0))]
    _ = (S.b 0)⁻¹ * (S.b 0 * h) := by rw [mul_assoc]
    _ = (S.b 0)⁻¹ * T.b 0 := by rw [← hb0]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.PrimitiveFrame.diagonal_sandwich
statement:
theorem diagonal_sandwich (A : Mat3 K) (i : Fin 3) :
    diagonalUnit i * A * diagonalUnit i = A i i • diagonalUnit i
proof:
:= by
  ext r c
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases r <;> fin_cases c <;>
    simp [diagonalUnit, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.PrimitiveFrame.conjugated_diagonal_sandwich
statement:
theorem conjugated_diagonal_sandwich (X Y F : Mat3 K) (i : Fin 3) :
    (X * diagonalUnit i * Y) * F * (X * diagonalUnit i * Y) =
      (Y * F * X) i i • (X * diagonalUnit i * Y)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (X * diagonalUnit i * Y) * F * (X * diagonalUnit i * Y) =
        X * (diagonalUnit i * (Y * F * X) * diagonalUnit i) * Y := by
      simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = X * ((Y * F * X) i i • diagonalUnit i) * Y := by
      rw [diagonal_sandwich]
    _ = (Y * F * X) i i • (X * diagonalUnit i * Y) := by
      rw [Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.PrimitiveFrame.conjugated_diagonal_isPrimitive
statement:
theorem conjugated_diagonal_isPrimitive (X Y : Mat3 K)
    (hYX : Y * X = 1) (hXY : X * Y = 1) (i : Fin 3) :
    IsPrimitiveIdempotent (X * diagonalUnit i * Y)
proof:
:= by
  let P := X * diagonalUnit i * Y
  have hi : P * P = P := by
    have hEi : (diagonalUnit i : Mat3 K) * diagonalUnit i = diagonalUnit i := by
      simpa using FourRowProbeSeed.diagonalUnit_mul (K := K) i i
    change (X * diagonalUnit i * Y) * (X * diagonalUnit i * Y) =
      X * diagonalUnit i * Y
    simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc Y X, hYX, Matrix.one_mul,
      ← Matrix.mul_assoc (diagonalUnit i) (diagonalUnit i), hEi]
  have ht : Matrix.trace P = 1 := by
    change Matrix.trace (X * diagonalUnit i * Y) = 1
    rw [Matrix.trace_mul_cycle, hYX, Matrix.one_mul]
    exact FourRowProbeSeed.diagonalUnit_trace i
  have hn : P ≠ 0 := Sym3PrimitiveDictionary.trace_one_ne_zero P ht
  refine ⟨?_, hn, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [matrixJordan_self] using hi
  · intro F G hF hG hFG hsum
    change F + G = P at hsum
    have hFi : F * F = F := by simpa only [matrixJordan_self] using hF
    have hGi : G * G = G := by simpa only [matrixJordan_self] using hG
    obtain ⟨hzFG, hzGF⟩ :=
      Sym3PrimitiveDictionary.jordan_orthogonal_idempotents_mul_zero F G hFi hGi hFG
    have hPF : P * F = F := by rw [← hsum]; noncomm_ring [hFi, hzGF]
    have hFP : F * P = F := by rw [← hsum]; noncomm_ring [hFi, hzFG]
    let lam := (Y * F * X) i i
    have hc : F = lam • P := by
      have h := conjugated_diagonal_sandwich X Y F i
      change P * F * P = lam • P at h
      simpa only [hPF, hFP] using h
    have hli : (lam * lam) • P = lam • P := by
      calc
        (lam * lam) • P = (lam • P) * (lam • P) := by
          rw [Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, smul_smul, hi]
        _ = F * F := by rw [← hc]
        _ = F := hFi
        _ = lam • P := hc
    have hl : lam * lam = lam := by
      have h := congrArg Matrix.trace hli
      simpa only [Matrix.trace_smul, ht, smul_eq_mul, mul_one] using h
    have hl0 : lam * (lam - 1) = 0 := by
      calc
        lam * (lam - 1) = lam * lam - lam := by ring
        _ = 0 := sub_eq_zero.mpr hl
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hl0 with hlz | hlo
    · left
      simpa only [hlz, zero_smul] using hc
    · right
      have hl1 : lam = 1 := sub_eq_zero.mp hlo
      have hFP' : F = P := by simpa only [hl1, one_smul] using hc
      have hsum' : P + G = P + 0 := by simpa only [hFP', add_zero] using hsum
      exact add_left_cancel hsum'

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.PrimitiveFrame.diagonalUnit_isPrimitive
statement:
theorem diagonalUnit_isPrimitive (i : Fin 3) :
    IsPrimitiveIdempotent (diagonalUnit i : Mat3 K)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one] using
    conjugated_diagonal_isPrimitive (1 : Mat3 K) 1 (by simp) (by simp) i

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.PrimitiveFrame.primitiveFrame_of_nonzero_idempotents_sum
statement:
theorem primitiveFrame_of_nonzero_idempotents_sum (P : Fin 3 → Mat3 K)
    (hi : ∀ i, P i * P i = P i) (hn : ∀ i, P i ≠ 0)
    (hs : P 0 + P 1 + P 2 = 1) : IsPrimitiveFrame P
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨X, Y, hYX, hXY, hPX, hP⟩ := exists_two_sided_basis P hi hn hs
  have ho := orthogonal_of_idempotents_sum P hi hs
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, hs⟩
  · intro i
    rw [hP i]
    exact conjugated_diagonal_isPrimitive X Y hYX hXY i
  · intro i j hij
    simp only [matrixJordan, ho i j hij, ho j i (Ne.symm hij), add_zero, smul_zero]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.PrimitiveFrame.primitiveFrame_iff_nonzero_idempotents_sum
statement:
theorem primitiveFrame_iff_nonzero_idempotents_sum (P : Fin 3 → Mat3 K) :
    IsPrimitiveFrame P ↔
      (∀ i, P i * P i = P i) ∧ (∀ i, P i ≠ 0) ∧ P 0 + P 1 + P 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hp, _, hs⟩
    refine ⟨?_, fun i => (hp i).2.1, hs⟩
    intro i
    simpa only [matrixJordan_self] using (hp i).1
  · rintro ⟨hi, hn, hs⟩
    exact primitiveFrame_of_nonzero_idempotents_sum P hi hn hs

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.PrimitiveFrame.primitiveFrame_iff_raw
statement:
theorem primitiveFrame_iff_raw (P : Fin 3 → Mat3 K) :
    IsPrimitiveFrame P ↔
      (∀ i, P i * P i = P i) ∧ (∀ i, Matrix.trace (P i) = 1) ∧
        P 0 + P 1 + P 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hp
    obtain ⟨hi, hn, hs⟩ := (primitiveFrame_iff_nonzero_idempotents_sum P).mp hp
    exact ⟨hi, trace_one_of_nonzero_idempotents_sum P hi hn hs, hs⟩
  · rintro ⟨hi, ht, hs⟩
    exact primitiveFrame_of_nonzero_idempotents_sum P hi
      (fun i => Sym3PrimitiveDictionary.trace_one_ne_zero (P i) (ht i)) hs

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.PrimitiveFrame.primitiveFrame_frameLaws
statement:
theorem primitiveFrame_frameLaws (P : Fin 3 → Mat3 K) (hp : IsPrimitiveFrame P) :
    FrameLaws P
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hi, hn, hs⟩ := (primitiveFrame_iff_nonzero_idempotents_sum P).mp hp
  exact frameLaws_of_nonzero_idempotents_sum P hi hn hs

name: AlbertLean.Triality.RationalEvenFamilyNaturality.mapJ_eq_mapSource
statement:
theorem mapJ_eq_mapSource (f : K →+* L) (x : JCoord K) :

proof:
:= by

  fin_cases i <;> rfl

name: AlbertLean.Triality.RationalEvenFamilyNaturality.mapPf
statement:
theorem mapPf (f : K →+* L) (w : W K) :

proof:

  simp [mapW]

name: AlbertLean.Triality.RationalEvenFamilyNaturality.map_nV
statement:
theorem map_nV (f : K →+* L) (x : VCoord K) :
    nV (mapV f x) = f (nV x)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [nV, mapV, map_mul]
  rw [mapPf]
  simp only [map_add, map_mul]

name: AlbertLean.Triality.RationalEvenFamilyNaturality.map_BV
statement:
theorem map_BV (f : K →+* L) (x y : VCoord K) :
    BV (mapV f x) (mapV f y) = f (BV x y)
proof:
:= by
  simp [BV, mapV, BW, mapW]

name: AlbertLean.Triality.RationalEvenFamilyNaturality.map_center
statement:
theorem map_center (f : K →+* L) (alpha r : K) (omega : W K) (rho : K) :
    mapV f (center alpha r omega rho) =
      center (f alpha) (f r) (mapW f omega) (f rho)
proof:
:= by
  apply VCoord.ext
  · rfl
  · simp [center, mapV, mapPf, map_div₀]
  · rfl

name: AlbertLean.Triality.RationalEvenFamilyNaturality.center_cleared
statement:
theorem center_cleared (alpha r : K) (omega : W K) (rho : K)
    (ha : alpha ≠ 0) (hr : r ≠ 0) :
    alpha * r * (center alpha r omega rho).z =
      rho ^ 2 - alpha * Pf omega
proof:
:= by
  simp only [center]
  field_simp [ha, hr]

name: AlbertLean.Triality.RationalEvenFamilyNaturality.map_open_denominator
statement:
theorem map_open_denominator (f : K →+* L) (r rho : K) :
    f (r * rho) = f r * f rho
proof: := map_mul f r rho

name: AlbertLean.Triality.RationalEvenFamilyNaturality.map_reflectV
statement:
theorem map_reflectV (f : K →+* L) (a x : VCoord K) :
    mapV f (reflectV a x) = reflectV (mapV f a) (mapV f x)
proof:
:= by
  have hquot : f (BV a x / nV a) =
      BV (mapV f a) (mapV f x) / nV (mapV f a) := by
    rw [map_div₀, map_BV, map_nV]
  apply VCoord.ext
  · simp [reflectV, mapV, hquot]
  · simp [reflectV, mapV, hquot]
  · funext i
    simp [reflectV, mapV, mapW, hquot]

name: AlbertLean.Triality.RationalEvenFamilyNaturality.map_evenV
statement:
theorem map_evenV (f : K →+* L) (a b x : VCoord K) :
    mapV f (evenV a b x) = evenV (mapV f a) (mapV f b) (mapV f x)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [evenV, map_reflectV]

name: AlbertLean.Triality.RationalEvenFamilyNaturality.map_sourceMuS
statement:
theorem map_sourceMuS (f : K →+* L) (c : CCoord K) (x : VCoord K) :
    mapS f (sourceMuS c x) = sourceMuS (mapC f c) (mapV f x)
proof:
:= by
  apply SCoord.ext <;> funext i <;> fin_cases i <;>
    simp [sourceMuS, mapS, mapC, mapV, mapW] <;> ring

name: AlbertLean.Triality.RationalEvenFamilyNaturality.map_sourceMuC
statement:
theorem map_sourceMuC (f : K →+* L) (x : VCoord K) (s : SCoord K) :
    mapC f (sourceMuC x s) = sourceMuC (mapV f x) (mapS f s)
proof:
:= by
  apply CCoord.ext <;> funext i <;> fin_cases i <;>
    simp [sourceMuC, mapS, mapC, mapV, mapW] <;> ring

name: AlbertLean.Triality.RationalEvenFamilyNaturality.map_evenS
statement:
theorem map_evenS (f : K →+* L) (a b : VCoord K) (rho : K) (s : SCoord K) :
    mapS f (evenS a b rho s) =
      evenS (mapV f a) (mapV f b) (f rho) (mapS f s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [evenS, evenS, ← map_sourceMuC, ← map_sourceMuS]
  apply SCoord.ext <;> funext i <;>
    simp [mapS, map_inv₀]

name: AlbertLean.Triality.RationalEvenFamilyNaturality.map_evenC
statement:
theorem map_evenC (f : K →+* L) (a b : VCoord K) (rho : K) (c : CCoord K) :
    mapC f (evenC a b rho c) =
      evenC (mapV f a) (mapV f b) (f rho) (mapC f c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [evenC, evenC, ← map_sourceMuS, ← map_sourceMuC]
  apply CCoord.ext <;> funext i <;>
    simp [mapC, map_inv₀]

name: AlbertLean.Triality.RationalEvenFamilyNaturality.map_evenJEquiv
statement:
theorem map_evenJEquiv
    (f : K →+* L) (a b : VCoord K) (rho : K)
    (ha : nV a ≠ 0) (hb : nV b ≠ 0)
    (hrho : rho ^ 2 = nV a * nV b) (hrho0 : rho ≠ 0)
    (x : JCoord K) :
    mapJ f (evenJEquiv a b rho ha hb hrho hrho0 x) =
      evenJEquiv (mapV f a) (mapV f b) (f rho)
        (by simpa [map_nV] using f.injective.ne ha)
        (by simpa [map_nV] using f.injective.ne hb)
        (by simpa [map_nV] using congrArg f hrho)
        (by simpa only [map_zero] using f.injective.ne hrho0) (mapJ f x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [evenJEquiv_apply, evenJEquiv_apply]
  apply JCoord.ext
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · exact map_evenV f a b x.v
  · exact map_evenS f a b rho x.s
  · exact map_evenC f a b rho x.c

name: AlbertLean.Triality.RationalEvenFamilyNaturality.familyAut_natural
statement:
theorem familyAut_natural
    (f : K →+* L) (A : VCoord K) (hA : nV A ≠ 0)
    (r : K) (omega : W K) (rho : K) (hr : r ≠ 0) (hp : rho ≠ 0)
    (x : JCoord K) :
    mapSource f ((familyAut A hA r omega rho hr hp).linear x) =
      (familyAut (mapV f A) (by simpa [map_nV] using f.injective.ne hA)
        (f r) (mapW f omega) (f rho)
        (by simpa only [map_zero] using f.injective.ne hr)
        (by simpa only [map_zero] using f.injective.ne hp)).linear
        (mapSource f x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mapJ_eq_mapSource, ← mapJ_eq_mapSource]
  change mapJ f
      (evenJEquiv A (center (nV A) r omega rho) rho _ _ _ _ x) =
    evenJEquiv (mapV f A)
      (center (nV (mapV f A)) (f r) (mapW f omega) (f rho))
      (f rho) _ _ _ _ (mapJ f x)
  simpa only [map_center, map_nV] using
    (map_evenJEquiv f A (center (nV A) r omega rho) rho hA
      (norm_center_ne_zero (nV A) r omega rho hA hr hp)
      (center_root (nV A) r omega rho hA hr) hp x)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericOrientationAttachment.ground_le_gauge
statement: theorem ground_le_gauge : groundBase k ≤ gaugeBase k

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericOrientationAttachment.generic_z1_ne
statement: theorem generic_z1_ne : (genericChart k).z1 ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  change includeBase k (ι k (GenericDeterminantOpen.a k)) ≠ 0
  apply (map_ne_zero (includeBase k)).mpr
  intro hι
  have h : GenericDeterminantOpen.a k = 0 := by
    apply iota_injective k
    simpa using hι
  have hh := congrArg (witnessEval k) h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericOrientationAttachment.ledger_gauge_eq_gaugeAugmented
statement:
theorem ledger_gauge_eq_gaugeAugmented :
    ledgerField (gaugeBase k) (encoderA (genericChart k))
        (encoderB (genericChart k)) =
      gaugeAugmentedLedgerField (groundBase k) (genericChart k)
proof:
:= by
  let L := ledgerField (groundBase k) (encoderA (genericChart k)) (encoderB (genericChart k))
  let C := ledgerField (gaugeBase k) (encoderA (genericChart k)) (encoderB (genericChart k))
  let G := gaugeAugmentedLedgerField (groundBase k) (genericChart k)
  have hbase : gaugeBase k ≤ G := by
    apply Subfield.closure_le.2
    change gaugeGenerators k ⊆ G
    rintro z (⟨a,rfl⟩ | hz)
    · exact Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inl
        (Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inl (Subfield.subset_closure ⟨a,rfl⟩))))
    · rcases hz with rfl | rfl | rfl
      · exact Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)))
      · exact Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl))))
      · exact Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr rfl))))
  have hLC : L ≤ C := by
    apply Subfield.closure_le.2
    change (groundBase k : Set (FunctionField k)) ∪
      ledgerCells (encoderA (genericChart k)) (encoderB (genericChart k)) ⊆ C
    rintro z (hz | hz)
    · exact Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inl (ground_le_gauge k hz))
    · exact Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inr hz)
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply Subfield.closure_le.2
    change (gaugeBase k : Set (FunctionField k)) ∪
      ledgerCells (encoderA (genericChart k)) (encoderB (genericChart k)) ⊆ G
    rintro z (hz | hz)
    · exact hbase hz
    · exact Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inl (Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inr hz)))
  · apply Subfield.closure_le.2
    change (L : Set (FunctionField k)) ∪
      {(genericChart k).r1, (genericChart k).z1,
        (genericChart k).r2, (genericChart k).z2} ⊆ C
    rintro z (hz | hz)
    · exact hLC hz
    · rcases hz with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
      · rw [generic_r1]; exact C.one_mem
      · exact Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inl (gauge_mem_a k))
      · exact Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inl (gauge_mem_b k))
      · exact Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inl (gauge_mem_c k))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericOrientationAttachment.ledger_gauge_eq_orientation
statement:
theorem ledger_gauge_eq_orientation :
    ledgerField (gaugeBase k) (encoderA (genericChart k))

      orientationLedgerField (groundBase k) (genericChart k)
proof:
:= by

  exact gaugeAugmentedLedgerField_eq_orientationLedgerField
    (groundBase k) (genericChart k) (generic_r1 k) (generic_z1_ne k)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericOrientationAttachment.orientation_eq_invariantField

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericOrientationAttachment.orientationLedgerField_degree_two

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualLedgerPublic.map_sourceProduct
statement:
theorem map_sourceProduct (x y : JCoord ℚ) :
    structuredEquiv (sourceProduct x y) =
      structuredProduct (structuredEquiv x) (structuredEquiv y)
proof:
:=
  StructuredSourceProductAgreesWithF0 x y

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualLedgerPublic.map_spectralProjector
statement:
theorem map_spectralProjector (a : JCoord ℚ) (i : Fin 3) :
    structuredEquiv (spectralProjector a i) = projector (structuredEquiv a) i
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i
  · change structuredEquiv ((2 : ℚ)⁻¹ • (sourceSquare a - a)) =
      (2 : ℚ)⁻¹ • (structuredProduct (structuredEquiv a) (structuredEquiv a) - structuredEquiv a)
    rw [map_smul, map_sub, sourceSquare, map_sourceProduct]
  · change structuredEquiv (sourceOne - sourceSquare a) =
      one - structuredProduct (structuredEquiv a) (structuredEquiv a)
    rw [map_sub, structuredEquiv_sourceOne, sourceSquare, map_sourceProduct]
  · change structuredEquiv ((2 : ℚ)⁻¹ • (sourceSquare a + a)) =
      (2 : ℚ)⁻¹ • (structuredProduct (structuredEquiv a) (structuredEquiv a) + structuredEquiv a)
    rw [map_smul, map_add, sourceSquare, map_sourceProduct]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualLedgerPublic.map_diagonalUnit
statement:
theorem map_diagonalUnit (i : Fin 3) :
    structuredEquiv (diagonalUnit i : JCoord ℚ) =
      projector (structuredEquiv (diagonal (-1) 0 1)) i
proof:
:= by
  rw [← diagonal_projectors]
  exact map_spectralProjector _ i

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualLedgerPublic.sourceLedger_eq_public
statement:
theorem sourceLedger_eq_public (a b : JCoord ℚ) :
    sourceLedger a b = copyLedger (ledger (publicTriple a b))
proof:
:= by
  apply SourceLedger.ext
  · funext i j
    change sourceTraceForm (diagonalUnit i) (spectralProjector a j) = _
    rw [sourceTraceForm_agrees_with_f0, map_diagonalUnit, map_spectralProjector]
    rfl
  · funext j l
    change sourceTraceForm (spectralProjector a j) (spectralProjector b l) = _
    rw [sourceTraceForm_agrees_with_f0, map_spectralProjector, map_spectralProjector]
    rfl
  · funext l i
    change sourceTraceForm (spectralProjector b l) (diagonalUnit i) = _
    rw [sourceTraceForm_agrees_with_f0, map_spectralProjector, map_diagonalUnit]
    rfl
  · funext i j l
    simp only [sourceLedger, copyLedger, ledger, publicTriple,
      sourceTraceForm_agrees_with_f0, map_sourceProduct,
      map_diagonalUnit, map_spectralProjector]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TauTraceInvarianceCore.leftMul_conj
statement:
private theorem leftMul_conj
    (product : V →ₗ[K] V →ₗ[K] V) (g : V ≃ₗ[K] V)
    (hMul : ∀ x y, g (product x y) = product (g x) (g y)) (x : V) :
    leftMul product (g x) = g.conj (leftMul product x)
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro y
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := g.surjective y
  simp only [leftMul, LinearEquiv.conj_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe,
    LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply,
    hMul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TauTraceInvarianceCore.trace_invariant_of_leftMul_trace
statement:
theorem trace_invariant_of_leftMul_trace
    (product : V →ₗ[K] V →ₗ[K] V) (tau : V →ₗ[K] K) (c : K)
    (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (hOperator : ∀ x,
      LinearMap.trace K V (leftMul product x) = c * tau x)
    (g : V ≃ₗ[K] V)
    (hMul : ∀ x y, g (product x y) = product (g x) (g y)) (x : V) :
    tau (g x) = tau x
proof:
:= by
  have hcj := LinearMap.trace_conj' (leftMul product x) g
  rw [← leftMul_conj product g hMul x, hOperator, hOperator] at hcj
  exact (mul_left_cancel₀ hc hcj)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuadraticCharacterDescent.Data.fixedCoordinates_bijective
statement: theorem fixedCoordinates_bijective : Function.Bijective D.fixedCoordinates

  · intro v w h
    obtain ⟨q,_,hq⟩ := D.unique_tau_fixed
      (D.fixedCoordinates w).val (D.fixedCoordinates w).property
    exact (hq v (congrArg Subtype.val h)).trans (hq w rfl).symm
  · intro x
    obtain ⟨v,hv,_⟩ := D.unique_tau_fixed x.val x.property
    refine ⟨v, ?_⟩
    exact Subtype.ext hv
