name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.overlap_apply
statement:
theorem overlap_apply (X Y : Mat3 K) (i j : Fin 3) :
    overlap X Y i j = ∑ r : Fin 3, X r i * Y r j
proof:
:= by
  simp [overlap, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.trace_columnProjector_mul
statement:
theorem trace_columnProjector_mul (X Y : Mat3 K) (i j : Fin 3) :
    Matrix.trace (columnProjector X i * columnProjector Y j) =
      (overlap X Y i j) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simp [Matrix.trace_fin_three, columnProjector, overlap, Matrix.mul_apply,
      Matrix.transpose_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ] <;> ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.trace_three_columnProjectors
statement:
theorem trace_three_columnProjectors (X Y Z : Mat3 K) (i j l : Fin 3) :
    Matrix.trace
        ((columnProjector X i * columnProjector Y j) * columnProjector Z l) =
      overlap X Y i j * overlap Y Z j l * overlap Z X l i
proof:
:= by
  simp [Matrix.trace_fin_three, columnProjector, overlap, Matrix.mul_apply,
      Matrix.transpose_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ] <;> ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.trace_matrixJordan_columnProjectors
statement:
theorem trace_matrixJordan_columnProjectors (X Y Z : Mat3 K) (i j l : Fin 3)
    [Invertible (2 : K)] :
    Matrix.trace
        (TitsTracePairing.matrixJordan (columnProjector X i)
          (columnProjector Y j) * columnProjector Z l) =
      overlap X Y i j * overlap Y Z j l * overlap Z X l i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [TitsTracePairing.matrixJordan, Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.add_mul,
    Matrix.trace_smul, Matrix.trace_add]
  have hrev : Matrix.trace
      ((columnProjector Y j * columnProjector X i) * columnProjector Z l) =
      overlap X Y i j * overlap Y Z j l * overlap Z X l i := by
    rw [trace_three_columnProjectors]
    simp [overlap, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
    ring
  rw [trace_three_columnProjectors, hrev, ← two_smul K, smul_smul,
    invOf_mul_self, one_smul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.columnProjector_symmetric
statement:
theorem columnProjector_symmetric (X : Mat3 K) (i : Fin 3) :
    Matrix.transpose (columnProjector X i) = columnProjector X i
proof:
:= by
  ext r c
  simp [columnProjector, Matrix.transpose_apply, mul_comm]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.orthogonalConjugate_columnProjector
statement:
theorem orthogonalConjugate_columnProjector
    (q X Y : Mat3 K) (e : Fin 3 → K) (i : Fin 3)
    (hqX : q * X = Y * diagonalSign e) (he : (e i) ^ 2 = 1) :
    orthogonalConjugate q (columnProjector X i) = columnProjector Y i
proof:
:= by
  have hcol : ∀ r, (q * X) r i = Y r i * e i := by
    intro r
    have h := congrFun (congrFun hqX r) i
    simpa only [diagonalSign, Matrix.mul_diagonal] using h
  have hcov : orthogonalConjugate q (columnProjector X i) =
      columnProjector (q * X) i := by
    ext r c
    simp [orthogonalConjugate, columnProjector, Matrix.mul_apply,
      Matrix.transpose_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
    ring
  rw [hcov]
  ext r c
  change (q * X) r i * (q * X) c i = Y r i * Y c i
  rw [hcol r, hcol c]
  calc
    (Y r i * e i) * (Y c i * e i) =
        Y r i * Y c i * (e i) ^ 2 := by ring
    _ = Y r i * Y c i := by rw [he, mul_one]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.overlap_self_left
statement:
theorem overlap_self_left (X Y : Mat3 K) (hX : IsOrthogonal X) :
    X * overlap X Y = Y
proof:
:= by

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.overlap_transpose
statement:
theorem overlap_transpose (X Y : Mat3 K) :
    Matrix.transpose (overlap X Y) = overlap Y X
proof:
:= by
  simp [overlap, Matrix.transpose_mul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.gaugeOverlap_transpose
statement:
theorem gaugeOverlap_transpose (left right : Fin 3 → K) (U : Mat3 K) :
    Matrix.transpose (gaugeOverlap left right U) =
      gaugeOverlap right left (Matrix.transpose U)
proof:
:= by
  simp [gaugeOverlap, Matrix.transpose_mul, diagonalSign_transpose, Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.frameTransporter_orthogonal
statement:
theorem frameTransporter_orthogonal
    (X X' : Mat3 K) (epsilon : Fin 3 → K)
    (hX : IsOrthogonal X) (hX' : IsOrthogonal X')
    (he : ∀ i, (epsilon i) ^ 2 = 1) :
    IsOrthogonal (frameTransporter X X' epsilon)
proof:
:= by
  have hD : diagonalSign epsilon * diagonalSign epsilon = 1 := by
    simpa only [diagonalSign_transpose] using
      (diagonalSign_orthogonal epsilon he).transpose_mul
  constructor
  · simp only [frameTransporter, Matrix.transpose_mul,
      Matrix.transpose_transpose, diagonalSign_transpose, Matrix.mul_assoc]
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc (Matrix.transpose X') X', hX'.transpose_mul,
      Matrix.one_mul]
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc (diagonalSign epsilon) (diagonalSign epsilon),
      hD, Matrix.one_mul, hX.mul_transpose]
  · simp only [frameTransporter, Matrix.transpose_mul,
      Matrix.transpose_transpose, diagonalSign_transpose, Matrix.mul_assoc]
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc (Matrix.transpose X) X, hX.transpose_mul]
    simp only [Matrix.one_mul]
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc (diagonalSign epsilon) (diagonalSign epsilon),
      hD, Matrix.one_mul, hX'.mul_transpose]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.frameTransporter_mul_of_overlap_gauge
statement:
theorem frameTransporter_mul_of_overlap_gauge
    (X Y X' Y' : Mat3 K) (epsilon eta : Fin 3 → K)
    (hX : IsOrthogonal X) (hX' : IsOrthogonal X')
    (heta : ∀ j, (eta j) ^ 2 = 1)
    (hU : overlap X' Y' = gaugeOverlap epsilon eta (overlap X Y)) :
    frameTransporter X X' epsilon * Y = Y' * diagonalSign eta
proof:
:= by
  have hEta : diagonalSign eta * diagonalSign eta = 1 := by
    simpa only [diagonalSign_transpose] using
      (diagonalSign_orthogonal eta heta).transpose_mul
  have hleft : X' * overlap X' Y' = Y' := overlap_self_left X' Y' hX'
  rw [hU] at hleft
  have hh := congrArg (fun M : Mat3 K => M * diagonalSign eta) hleft
  simpa only [frameTransporter, gaugeOverlap, overlap, Matrix.mul_assoc,
    hEta, Matrix.mul_one] using hh

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.projectorTriple_related_of_overlap_gauges
statement:
theorem projectorTriple_related_of_overlap_gauges
    (X Y Z X' Y' Z' : Mat3 K) (epsilon eta zeta : Fin 3 → K)
    (hX : IsOrthogonal X) (hY : IsOrthogonal Y) (hZ : IsOrthogonal Z)
    (hX' : IsOrthogonal X') (hY' : IsOrthogonal Y') (hZ' : IsOrthogonal Z')
    (he : ∀ i, (epsilon i) ^ 2 = 1)
    (heta : ∀ j, (eta j) ^ 2 = 1)
    (hzeta : ∀ l, (zeta l) ^ 2 = 1)
    (hU : overlap X' Y' = gaugeOverlap epsilon eta (overlap X Y))
    (hW : overlap X' Z' = gaugeOverlap epsilon zeta (overlap X Z)) :
    ∃ q : Mat3 K, IsOrthogonal q ∧
      (∀ i, orthogonalConjugate q (columnProjector X i) = columnProjector X' i) ∧
      (∀ j, orthogonalConjugate q (columnProjector Y j) = columnProjector Y' j) ∧
      (∀ l, orthogonalConjugate q (columnProjector Z l) = columnProjector Z' l)
proof:
:= by
  let q := frameTransporter X X' epsilon
  have hq : IsOrthogonal q := frameTransporter_orthogonal X X' epsilon hX hX' he
  have hqX : q * X = X' * diagonalSign epsilon := by
    dsimp only [q, frameTransporter]
    simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    rw [hX.transpose_mul, Matrix.mul_one]
  have hqY : q * Y = Y' * diagonalSign eta :=
    frameTransporter_mul_of_overlap_gauge X Y X' Y' epsilon eta hX hX' heta hU
  have hqZ : q * Z = Z' * diagonalSign zeta :=
    frameTransporter_mul_of_overlap_gauge X Z X' Z' epsilon zeta hX hX' hzeta hW
  exact ⟨q, hq,
    fun i => orthogonalConjugate_columnProjector q X X' epsilon i hqX (he i),
    fun j => orthogonalConjugate_columnProjector q Y Y' eta j hqY (heta j),
    fun l => orthogonalConjugate_columnProjector q Z Z' zeta l hqZ (hzeta l)⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.projectorTriple_related_of_equal_overlap_measurements
statement:
theorem projectorTriple_related_of_equal_overlap_measurements
    (X Y Z X' Y' Z' : Mat3 K)
    (hX : IsOrthogonal X) (hY : IsOrthogonal Y) (hZ : IsOrthogonal Z)
    (hX' : IsOrthogonal X') (hY' : IsOrthogonal Y') (hZ' : IsOrthogonal Z')
    (hUnz : ∀ i j, overlap X Y i j ≠ 0)
    (hVnz : ∀ j l, overlap Y Z j l ≠ 0)
    (hWnz : ∀ l i, overlap Z X l i ≠ 0)
    (hUsq : ∀ i j, (overlap X' Y' i j) ^ 2 = (overlap X Y i j) ^ 2)
    (hVsq : ∀ j l, (overlap Y' Z' j l) ^ 2 = (overlap Y Z j l) ^ 2)
    (hWsq : ∀ l i, (overlap Z' X' l i) ^ 2 = (overlap Z X l i) ^ 2)
    (hC : ∀ i j l,
      overlap X' Y' i j * overlap Y' Z' j l * overlap Z' X' l i =
        overlap X Y i j * overlap Y Z j l * overlap Z X l i) :
    ∃ q : Mat3 K, IsOrthogonal q ∧
      (∀ i, orthogonalConjugate q (columnProjector X i) = columnProjector X' i) ∧
      (∀ j, orthogonalConjugate q (columnProjector Y j) = columnProjector Y' j) ∧
      (∀ l, orthogonalConjugate q (columnProjector Z l) = columnProjector Z' l)
proof:
:= by
  rcases overlap_triples_gauge_related
      (overlap X Y) (overlap Y Z) (overlap Z X)
      (overlap X' Y') (overlap Y' Z') (overlap Z' X')
      hUnz hVnz hWnz hUsq hVsq hWsq hC with
    ⟨epsilon, eta, zeta, he, heta, hzeta, hUe, hVe, hWe⟩
  have hU : overlap X' Y' = gaugeOverlap epsilon eta (overlap X Y) :=
    matrix_gauge_eq_of_entrywise _ _ _ _ hUe
  have hW : overlap Z' X' = gaugeOverlap zeta epsilon (overlap Z X) :=
    matrix_gauge_eq_of_entrywise _ _ _ _ hWe
  have hXZ : overlap X' Z' = gaugeOverlap epsilon zeta (overlap X Z) := by
    rw [← overlap_transpose Z' X', hW, gaugeOverlap_transpose,
      overlap_transpose]
  exact projectorTriple_related_of_overlap_gauges
    X Y Z X' Y' Z' epsilon eta zeta hX hY hZ hX' hY' hZ'
    he heta hzeta hU hXZ

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualMomentSubfield.triple_mem_of_pair_sums
statement:
theorem triple_mem_of_pair_sums [CharZero K] (F : Subfield K) (x y z : K)
    (hxy : x + y ∈ F) (hyz : y + z ∈ F) (hzx : z + x ∈ F) :
    x ∈ F ∧ y ∈ F ∧ z ∈ F
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : (2 : K) ∈ F := by simpa using F.add_mem F.one_mem F.one_mem
  have hx : x = ((x + y) + (z + x) - (y + z)) / 2 := by ring
  have hy : y = ((x + y) + (y + z) - (z + x)) / 2 := by ring
  have hz : z = ((y + z) + (z + x) - (x + y)) / 2 := by ring
  constructor
  · rw [hx]
    exact F.div_mem (F.sub_mem (F.add_mem hxy hzx) hyz) h2
  constructor
  · rw [hy]
    exact F.div_mem (F.sub_mem (F.add_mem hxy hyz) hzx) h2
  · rw [hz]
    exact F.div_mem (F.sub_mem (F.add_mem hyz hzx) hxy) h2

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualMomentSubfield.pair_mem_of_linear_mem
statement:
theorem pair_mem_of_linear_mem (F : Subfield K)
    (a b c d x y : K)
    (ha : a ∈ F) (hb : b ∈ F) (hc : c ∈ F) (hd : d ∈ F)
    (hdet : a * d - b * c ≠ 0)
    (hfirst : a * x + b * y ∈ F)
    (hsecond : c * x + d * y ∈ F) : x ∈ F ∧ y ∈ F
proof:
:= by
  have hx : x = (d * (a * x + b * y) - b * (c * x + d * y)) /
      (a * d - b * c) := by
    apply (eq_div_iff hdet).2
    ring
  have hy : y = (a * (c * x + d * y) - c * (a * x + b * y)) /
      (a * d - b * c) := by
    apply (eq_div_iff hdet).2
    ring
  have hden := F.sub_mem (F.mul_mem ha hd) (F.mul_mem hb hc)
  constructor
  · rw [hx]
    exact F.div_mem (F.sub_mem (F.mul_mem hd hfirst)
      (F.mul_mem hb hsecond)) hden
  · rw [hy]
    exact F.div_mem (F.sub_mem (F.mul_mem ha hsecond)
      (F.mul_mem hc hfirst)) hden

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualMomentSubfield.matrix_entries_mem
statement:
theorem matrix_entries_mem (F : Subfield K)
    (M : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) K) (r1 z1 r2 z2 : K)
    (hr1 : r1 ∈ F) (hz1 : z1 ∈ F) (hr2 : r2 ∈ F) (hz2 : z2 ∈ F)
    (hk : r1 * z2 - r2 * z1 ≠ 0)
    (hdiag : ∀ i, M i i ∈ F)
    (hS : M 0 1 + M 1 0 ∈ F)
    (hC : M 2 3 + M 3 2 ∈ F)
    (hUC : r1 * z2 * M 0 1 + r2 * z1 * M 1 0 ∈ F)
    (hUS : r2 * z1 * M 2 3 + r1 * z2 * M 3 2 ∈ F)
    (ht : ∀ i j, (i = 0 ∨ i = 1) → (j = 2 ∨ j = 3) →
      (r1 * M i j + z1 * M j i ∈ F) ∧
      (r2 * M i j + z2 * M j i ∈ F)) :
    ∀ i j, M i j ∈ F
proof:
:= by
  have hk' : r1 * z2 - z1 * r2 ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [mul_comm z1 r2] using hk
  have h01 := pair_mem_of_linear_mem F 1 1 (r1 * z2) (r2 * z1)
    (M 0 1) (M 1 0) F.one_mem F.one_mem
    (F.mul_mem hr1 hz2) (F.mul_mem hr2 hz1)
    (by intro h; apply hk; linear_combination -h)
    (by simpa only [one_mul] using hS) hUC
  have h23 := pair_mem_of_linear_mem F 1 1 (r2 * z1) (r1 * z2)
    (M 2 3) (M 3 2) F.one_mem F.one_mem
    (F.mul_mem hr2 hz1) (F.mul_mem hr1 hz2)
    (by simpa only [one_mul] using hk)
    (by simpa only [one_mul] using hC) hUS
  have cross (i j : Fin 4) (hi : i = 0 ∨ i = 1) (hj : j = 2 ∨ j = 3) :
      M i j ∈ F ∧ M j i ∈ F :=
    pair_mem_of_linear_mem F r1 z1 r2 z2 (M i j) (M j i)
      hr1 hz1 hr2 hz2 hk' (ht i j hi hj).1 (ht i j hi hj).2
  have h02 := cross 0 2 (Or.inl rfl) (Or.inl rfl)
  have h03 := cross 0 3 (Or.inl rfl) (Or.inr rfl)
  have h12 := cross 1 2 (Or.inr rfl) (Or.inl rfl)
  have h13 := cross 1 3 (Or.inr rfl) (Or.inr rfl)
  intro i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
  all_goals first
    | exact hdiag _
    | exact h01.1 | exact h01.2 | exact h23.1 | exact h23.2
    | exact h02.1 | exact h02.2 | exact h03.1 | exact h03.2
    | exact h12.1 | exact h12.2 | exact h13.1 | exact h13.2

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualMomentSubfield.exteriorQ_mem
statement:
theorem exteriorQ_mem (F : Subfield K)
    (M : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) K) (h : ∀ i j, M i j ∈ F) :
    exteriorQ M ∈ F
proof:
:= by
  exact F.sub_mem
    (F.add_mem
      (F.sub_mem
        (F.add_mem (F.add_mem (F.mul_mem (h 2 0) (h 1 3))
          (F.mul_mem (h 3 1) (h 0 2))) (F.mul_mem (h 1 0) (h 3 2)))
        (F.mul_mem (h 1 2) (h 3 0)))
      (F.mul_mem (h 0 1) (h 2 3)))
    (F.mul_mem (h 0 3) (h 2 1))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ResidualMomentSubfield.determinant_sum_mem
statement:
theorem determinant_sum_mem [CharZero K] (F : Subfield K)
    (s1 s2 : AlbertLean.Triality.ExteriorSix.SCoord K)
    (c1 c2 : AlbertLean.Triality.ExteriorSix.CCoord K)
    (hM : ∀ i j, momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2 i j ∈ F)
    (hUV : normalizedUV s1 s2 c1 c2 ∈ F) :
    deltaX s1 s2 c1 c2 + deltaStarA s1 s2 c1 c2 ∈ F
proof:
:= by
  have heq := normalizedUV_exterior_identity s1 s2 c1 c2
  have hs : deltaX s1 s2 c1 c2 + deltaStarA s1 s2 c1 c2 =
      exteriorQ (momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2) - normalizedUV s1 s2 c1 c2 := by
    rw [heq]
    ring
  rw [hs]
  exact F.sub_mem (exteriorQ_mem F _ hM) hUV

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFrameNormalization.thenAut_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem thenAut_apply (g h : SourceAut (K := K)) (x : JCoord K) :
    (thenAut g h).linear x = h.linear (g.linear x)
proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFrameNormalization.reflectionAut_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem reflectionAut_apply (p : JCoord K) (hp : sourceProduct p p = p)
    (x : JCoord K) :
    (sourcePeirceAut p hp).linear x = sourcePeirceReflection p x
proof:
:=
  sourcePeirceLinearEquiv_apply p hp x

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFrameNormalization.reflectionAut_trace
statement:
theorem reflectionAut_trace (p : JCoord K) (hp : sourceProduct p p = p)
    (x : JCoord K) : sourceTrace ((sourcePeirceAut p hp).linear x) = sourceTrace x
proof:
:= by
  rw [reflectionAut_apply]
  exact sourceTrace_reflection p x hp

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFrameNormalization.thenAut_trace
statement:
theorem thenAut_trace (g h : SourceAut (K := K))
    (hg : ∀ x, sourceTrace (g.linear x) = sourceTrace x)
    (hh : ∀ x, sourceTrace (h.linear x) = sourceTrace x) (x : JCoord K) :
    sourceTrace ((thenAut g h).linear x) = sourceTrace x
proof:
:= by
  rw [thenAut_apply, hh, hg]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFrameNormalization.map_laws
statement:
theorem map_laws (g : SourceAut (K := K))
    (hT : ∀ x, sourceTrace (g.linear x) = sourceTrace x)
    (P : Fin 3 → JCoord K) (hP : SourceFrameLaws.Laws P) :
    SourceFrameLaws.Laws (fun i => g.linear (P i))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i; rw [← g.map_product, hP.idempotent]
  · intro i; rw [hT, hP.trace_one]
  · change g.linear (P 0) + g.linear (P 1) + g.linear (P 2) = sourceOne
    rw [← map_add, ← map_add, hP.sum_one, g.map_one]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFrameNormalization.diagonalUnit_sum
statement:
theorem diagonalUnit_sum :
    diagonalUnit (K := K) 0 + diagonalUnit 1 + diagonalUnit 2 = sourceOne
proof:
:= by
  ext <;> simp [diagonalUnit, diagonal, sourceOne]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFrameNormalization.diagonalUnit_product
statement:
theorem diagonalUnit_product (i j : Fin 3) :
    sourceProduct (diagonalUnit (K := K) i) (diagonalUnit j) =
      if i = j then diagonalUnit i else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [diagonalUnit, sourceProduct_diagonal]
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    ext <;> norm_num [diagonalUnit, diagonal] <;> decide

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFrameNormalization.diagonalUnit_idempotent
statement:
theorem diagonalUnit_idempotent (i : Fin 3) :
    sourceProduct (diagonalUnit (K := K) i) (diagonalUnit i) = diagonalUnit i
proof:
:= by
  simp [diagonalUnit_product]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFrameNormalization.product_zero
statement: private theorem product_zero (x : JCoord K) : sourceProduct x 0 = 0
proof:
:=
  map_zero (sourceProductLinear x)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFrameNormalization.diagonalUnit_reflection
statement:
theorem diagonalUnit_reflection (i j : Fin 3) :
    sourcePeirceReflection (diagonalUnit (K := K) i) (diagonalUnit j) = diagonalUnit j
proof:
:= by
  rw [sourcePeirceReflection_formula]
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst j; rw [diagonalUnit_idempotent, diagonalUnit_idempotent]; module
  · simp [diagonalUnit_product, hij, product_zero]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFrameNormalization.swapCenter_idempotent
statement:
theorem swapCenter_idempotent (i j : Fin 3) :
    sourceProduct (swapCenter (K := K) i j) (swapCenter i j) = swapCenter i j
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : i = j
  · simp [swapCenter, h, diagonalUnit_idempotent]
  · simpa [swapCenter, h] using standardMidpoint_idempotent (K := K) i j h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFrameNormalization.swapCenter_trace
statement: theorem swapCenter_trace (i j : Fin 3) : sourceTrace (swapCenter (K := K) i j) = 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : i = j
  · simp [swapCenter, h]
  · simpa [swapCenter, h] using standardMidpoint_trace (K := K) i j h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFrameNormalization.swapCenter_reflection
statement:
theorem swapCenter_reflection (i j k : Fin 3) :
    sourcePeirceReflection (swapCenter (K := K) i j) (diagonalUnit k) =
      diagonalUnit ((Equiv.swap i j) k)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : i = j
  · subst j; simpa [swapCenter] using diagonalUnit_reflection (K := K) i k
  · simpa [swapCenter, h] using standardMidpoint_reflection_diagonalUnit (K := K) i j h k

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFrameNormalization.zero_target_components
statement:
theorem zero_target_components (e : JCoord K)
    (he : sourceProduct e (diagonalUnit 0) = 0) :
    e.d1 = 0 ∧ e.s = 0 ∧ e.c = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [sourceProduct_diagonalUnit_zero] at he
  have hd := congrArg JCoord.d1 he
  have hs := congrArg JCoord.s he
  have hc := congrArg JCoord.c he
  change e.d1 = 0 at hd
  change (1 / 2 : K) • e.s = 0 at hs
  change (1 / 2 : K) • e.c = 0 at hc
  exact ⟨hd, (smul_eq_zero.mp hs).resolve_left (by norm_num),
    (smul_eq_zero.mp hc).resolve_left (by norm_num)⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFrameNormalization.target_product_stays_zero
statement:
theorem target_product_stays_zero (e : JCoord K)
    (he : sourceProduct e (diagonalUnit 0) = 0) (i : Fin 3) (hi : i ≠ 0) :
    sourceProduct (sourceProduct e (diagonalUnit i)) (diagonalUnit 0) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hd, hs, hc⟩ := zero_target_components e he
  fin_cases i
  · exact (hi rfl).elim
  · change sourceProduct (sourceProduct e (diagonalUnit 1)) (diagonalUnit 0) = 0
    rw [sourceProduct_diagonalUnit_one, sourceProduct_diagonalUnit_zero]
    ext <;> simp [hc]
  · change sourceProduct (sourceProduct e (diagonalUnit 2)) (diagonalUnit 0) = 0
    rw [sourceProduct_diagonalUnit_two, sourceProduct_diagonalUnit_zero]
    ext <;> simp [hs]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFrameNormalization.midpoint_stays_zero
statement:
theorem midpoint_stays_zero (e : JCoord K)
    (he : sourceProduct e (diagonalUnit 0) = 0) (i : Fin 3) (hi : i ≠ 0) (s : K) :
    sourceProduct
      (ScalarMidpoint.midpoint e (diagonalUnit i) (sourceProduct e (diagonalUnit i)) s)
      (diagonalUnit 0) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ScalarMidpoint.midpoint, sourceProduct_smul_left, sourceProduct_add_left,
    he, diagonalUnit_product, if_neg hi, target_product_stays_zero e he i hi,
    add_zero, zero_add, smul_zero]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFrameNormalization.reflection_fixed_of_product_zero
statement:
theorem reflection_fixed_of_product_zero (p z : JCoord K)
    (hz : sourceProduct p z = 0) : sourcePeirceReflection p z = z
proof:
:= by
  simp [sourcePeirceReflection_formula, hz, product_zero]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFrameNormalization.exists_good_root
statement:
theorem exists_good_root (hroot : ∀ t : K, ∃ s : K, s ^ 2 = t)
    (t : K) (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    ∃ s : K, s ^ 2 = t ∧ s ≠ 0 ∧ s ≠ -1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hroot t
  have hs0 : s ≠ 0 := by intro h; apply ht; rw [← hs, h]; simp
  by_cases hneg : s = -1
  · refine ⟨-s, by simpa using hs, neg_ne_zero.mpr hs0, ?_⟩
    rw [hneg]; norm_num
  · exact ⟨s, hs, hs0, hneg⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFrameNormalization.overlap_eq_diagonal
statement:
theorem overlap_eq_diagonal (e : JCoord K) (i : Fin 3) :
    sourceTrace (sourceProduct e (diagonalUnit i)) = diagLinear i e
proof:
:= by
  rw [GenericTauLedger.sourceTrace_product_eq_traceForm,
    sourceTraceForm_symmetric, diagonal_trace]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFrameNormalization.exists_second_pivot
statement:
theorem exists_second_pivot (e : JCoord K) (hT : sourceTrace e = 1)
    (he : sourceProduct e (diagonalUnit 0) = 0) :
    ∃ i : Fin 3, i ≠ 0 ∧ sourceTrace (sourceProduct e (diagonalUnit i)) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hd := (zero_target_components e he).1
  by_cases h2 : e.d2 = 0
  · refine ⟨2, by decide, ?_⟩
    rw [overlap_eq_diagonal]
    change e.d3 ≠ 0
    intro h3
    simp [sourceTrace, hd, h2, h3] at hT
  · exact ⟨1, by decide, by simpa [overlap_eq_diagonal, diagLinear] using h2⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFrameNormalization.exists_first_pivot
statement:
theorem exists_first_pivot (e : JCoord K) (hT : sourceTrace e = 1) :
    ∃ i : Fin 3, sourceTrace (sourceProduct e (diagonalUnit i)) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases exists_nonzero_diagonal_of_sourceTrace_one e hT with h1 | h2 | h3
  · exact ⟨0, by simpa [overlap_eq_diagonal, diagLinear] using h1⟩
  · exact ⟨1, by simpa [overlap_eq_diagonal, diagLinear] using h2⟩
  · exact ⟨2, by simpa [overlap_eq_diagonal, diagLinear] using h3⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFrameNormalization.scalar_midpoint_reflection
statement:
private theorem scalar_midpoint_reflection
    {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    (μ : V →ₗ[K] V →ₗ[K] V) (hcomm : ∀ x y, μ x y = μ y x)
    (e f c : V) (t s : K) (h : ScalarMidpoint.PairTable μ e f c t)
    (hsquare : s ^ 2 = t) (hs0 : s ≠ 0) (hsneg : s ≠ -1) :
    PeircePolynomial.reflection μ (ScalarMidpoint.midpoint e f c s) e = f
proof:
:=
  ScalarMidpoint.midpoint_reflection_apply μ hcomm e f c t s h hsquare hs0 hsneg

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFrameNormalization.midpointAt_properties
statement:
theorem midpointAt_properties (e : JCoord K) (i : Fin 3) (s : K)
    (he : sourceProduct e e = e) (hT : sourceTrace e = 1)
    (hs : s ^ 2 = sourceTrace (sourceProduct e (diagonalUnit i)))
    (hs0 : s ≠ 0) (hsneg : s ≠ -1) :
    let p
proof:
:= ScalarMidpoint.midpoint e (diagonalUnit i) (sourceProduct e (diagonalUnit i)) s
    sourceProduct p p = p ∧ sourceTrace p = 1 ∧
      sourcePeirceReflection p e = diagonalUnit i := by
  have ht := pairTable_diagonalUnit e i he hT
  refine ⟨?_, sourceTrace_midpoint_diagonalUnit e i s hT hs hs0 hsneg, ?_⟩
  · exact ScalarMidpoint.midpoint_square sourceProductLinear sourceProduct_comm
      e (diagonalUnit i) (sourceProduct e (diagonalUnit i))
      (sourceTrace (sourceProduct e (diagonalUnit i))) s ht hs hs0 hsneg
  · exact scalar_midpoint_reflection sourceProductLinear sourceProduct_comm
      e (diagonalUnit i) (sourceProduct e (diagonalUnit i))
      (sourceTrace (sourceProduct e (diagonalUnit i))) s ht hs hs0 hsneg

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFrameNormalization.normalize_first
statement:
theorem normalize_first (hroot : ∀ t : K, ∃ s : K, s ^ 2 = t) (e : JCoord K)
    (he : sourceProduct e e = e) (hT : sourceTrace e = 1) :
    ∃ (p q : JCoord K) (hp : sourceProduct p p = p) (hq : sourceProduct q q = q),
      sourceTrace p = 1 ∧ sourceTrace q = 1 ∧
      (thenAut (sourcePeirceAut p hp) (sourcePeirceAut q hq)).linear e = diagonalUnit 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := exists_first_pivot e hT
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hs0, hsneg⟩ := exists_good_root hroot _ hi
  let p := ScalarMidpoint.midpoint e (diagonalUnit i) (sourceProduct e (diagonalUnit i)) s
  have hm := midpointAt_properties e i s he hT hs hs0 hsneg
  have hp : sourceProduct p p = p := hm.1
  have hpT : sourceTrace p = 1 := hm.2.1
  have hpe : sourcePeirceReflection p e = diagonalUnit i := hm.2.2
  refine ⟨p, swapCenter i 0, hp, swapCenter_idempotent i 0, hpT, swapCenter_trace i 0, ?_⟩
  simp only [thenAut_apply, reflectionAut_apply, hpe, swapCenter_reflection,
    Equiv.swap_apply_left]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFrameNormalization.normalize_second
statement:
theorem normalize_second (hroot : ∀ t : K, ∃ s : K, s ^ 2 = t) (e : JCoord K)
    (he : sourceProduct e e = e) (hT : sourceTrace e = 1)
    (hzero : sourceProduct e (diagonalUnit 0) = 0) :
    ∃ (p q : JCoord K) (hp : sourceProduct p p = p) (hq : sourceProduct q q = q),
      sourceTrace p = 1 ∧ sourceTrace q = 1 ∧
      (thenAut (sourcePeirceAut p hp) (sourcePeirceAut q hq)).linear (diagonalUnit 0) =
        diagonalUnit 0 ∧
      (thenAut (sourcePeirceAut p hp) (sourcePeirceAut q hq)).linear e = diagonalUnit 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi0, hi⟩ := exists_second_pivot e hT hzero
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hs0, hsneg⟩ := exists_good_root hroot _ hi
  let p := ScalarMidpoint.midpoint e (diagonalUnit i) (sourceProduct e (diagonalUnit i)) s
  have hm := midpointAt_properties e i s he hT hs hs0 hsneg
  have hp : sourceProduct p p = p := hm.1
  have hpT : sourceTrace p = 1 := hm.2.1
  have hpe : sourcePeirceReflection p e = diagonalUnit i := hm.2.2
  have hp0 : sourcePeirceReflection p (diagonalUnit 0) = diagonalUnit 0 :=
    reflection_fixed_of_product_zero p (diagonalUnit 0) (midpoint_stays_zero e hzero i hi0 s)
  refine ⟨p, swapCenter i 1, hp, swapCenter_idempotent i 1, hpT, swapCenter_trace i 1, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [thenAut_apply, reflectionAut_apply, hp0, swapCenter_reflection]
    rw [Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne (Ne.symm hi0) (by decide)]
  · simp only [thenAut_apply, reflectionAut_apply, hpe, swapCenter_reflection,
      Equiv.swap_apply_left]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFrameNormalization.fourReflectionAut_apply
statement:
theorem fourReflectionAut_apply (p q r s : JCoord K)
    (hp : sourceProduct p p = p) (hq : sourceProduct q q = q)
    (hr : sourceProduct r r = r) (hs : sourceProduct s s = s) (x : JCoord K) :
    (fourReflectionAut p q r s hp hq hr hs).linear x =
      (thenAut (sourcePeirceAut r hr) (sourcePeirceAut s hs)).linear
        ((thenAut (sourcePeirceAut p hp) (sourcePeirceAut q hq)).linear x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [fourReflectionAut, thenAut_apply]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFrameNormalization.fourReflectionAut_formula
statement:
theorem fourReflectionAut_formula (p q r s : JCoord K)
    (hp : sourceProduct p p = p) (hq : sourceProduct q q = q)
    (hr : sourceProduct r r = r) (hs : sourceProduct s s = s) (x : JCoord K) :
    (fourReflectionAut p q r s hp hq hr hs).linear x =
      sourcePeirceReflection s (sourcePeirceReflection r
        (sourcePeirceReflection q (sourcePeirceReflection p x)))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [fourReflectionAut, thenAut_apply, reflectionAut_apply]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFrameNormalization.frame_normalization_four_reflections
statement:
theorem frame_normalization_four_reflections
    (hroot : ∀ t : K, ∃ s : K, s ^ 2 = t)
    (P : Fin 3 → JCoord K) (hP : SourceFrameLaws.Laws P) :
    ∃ (p q r s : JCoord K)
      (hp : sourceProduct p p = p) (hq : sourceProduct q q = q)
      (hr : sourceProduct r r = r) (hs : sourceProduct s s = s),
      sourceTrace p = 1 ∧ sourceTrace q = 1 ∧ sourceTrace r = 1 ∧ sourceTrace s = 1 ∧
      ∀ i, (fourReflectionAut p q r s hp hq hr hs).linear (P i) = diagonalUnit i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, q, hp, hq, hpT, hqT, hfirst⟩ :=
    normalize_first hroot (P 0) (hP.idempotent 0) (hP.trace_one 0)
  let a := thenAut (sourcePeirceAut p hp) (sourcePeirceAut q hq)
  let Q : Fin 3 → JCoord K := fun i => a.linear (P i)
  have haT (x : JCoord K) : sourceTrace (a.linear x) = sourceTrace x :=
    thenAut_trace _ _ (reflectionAut_trace p hp) (reflectionAut_trace q hq) x
  have hQ : SourceFrameLaws.Laws Q := map_laws a haT P hP
  have hQ0 : Q 0 = diagonalUnit 0 := hfirst
  have hz : sourceProduct (Q 1) (diagonalUnit 0) = 0 := by
    rw [← hQ0]
    exact hQ.orthogonal (by decide : (1 : Fin 3) ≠ 0)
  obtain ⟨r, s, hr, hs, hrT, hsT, hfix, hsecond⟩ :=
    normalize_second hroot (Q 1) (hQ.idempotent 1) (hQ.trace_one 1) hz
  let g := fourReflectionAut p q r s hp hq hr hs
  have hg0 : g.linear (P 0) = diagonalUnit 0 := by
    have h : (thenAut (sourcePeirceAut r hr) (sourcePeirceAut s hs)).linear (Q 0) =
        diagonalUnit 0 := by rw [hQ0]; exact hfix
    simpa only [g, fourReflectionAut_apply, Q, a] using h
  have hg1 : g.linear (P 1) = diagonalUnit 1 := by
    simpa only [g, fourReflectionAut_apply, Q, a] using hsecond
  have hg2 : g.linear (P 2) = diagonalUnit 2 := by
    have hsum := congrArg g.linear hP.sum_one
    simp only [map_add, g.map_one, hg0, hg1] at hsum
    exact add_left_cancel (hsum.trans diagonalUnit_sum.symm)
  refine ⟨p, q, r, s, hp, hq, hr, hs, hpT, hqT, hrT, hsT, ?_⟩
  intro i
  fin_cases i
  · exact hg0
  · exact hg1
  · exact hg2

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFrameNormalization.exists_sourceAut_normalizing_frame
statement:
theorem exists_sourceAut_normalizing_frame
    (hroot : ∀ t : K, ∃ s : K, s ^ 2 = t)
    (P : Fin 3 → JCoord K) (hP : SourceFrameLaws.Laws P) :
    ∃ g : SourceAut (K := K), ∀ i, g.linear (P i) = diagonalUnit i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, q, r, s, hp, hq, hr, hs, _, _, _, _, h⟩ :=
    frame_normalization_four_reflections hroot P hP
  exact ⟨fourReflectionAut p q r s hp hq hr hs, h⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ScalarMidpoint.one_add_ne_zero
statement: private theorem one_add_ne_zero {s : K} (hs : s ≠ -1) : 1 + s ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply hs
  calc
    s = (1 + s) - 1 := by ring
    _ = -1 := by rw [h]; simp

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ScalarMidpoint.midpoint_products
statement:
theorem midpoint_products
    (μ : V →ₗ[K] V →ₗ[K] V) (hsym : ∀ x y, μ x y = μ y x)
    (e f c : V) (t s : K) (h : PairTable μ e f c t)
    (hsquare : s ^ 2 = t) (hs0 : s ≠ 0) (hsneg : s ≠ -1) :
    μ (midpoint e f c s) e = (1 / 2 : K) • e + (1 / (2 * s)) • c ∧
    μ (midpoint e f c s) f = (1 / 2 : K) • f + (1 / (2 * s)) • c ∧
    μ (midpoint e f c s) c = (s / 4) • (e + f) + (1 / 2 : K) • c
proof:
:= by
  subst t
  have hs1 := one_add_ne_zero hsneg
  have hfe : μ f e = c := (hsym f e).trans h.ef
  have hce : μ c e = (1 / 2 : K) • (c + s ^ 2 • e) :=
    (hsym c e).trans h.ec
  have hcf : μ c f = (1 / 2 : K) • (c + s ^ 2 • f) :=
    (hsym c f).trans h.fc
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  all_goals
    dsimp only [midpoint]
    simp only [map_add, map_smul, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
      h.ee, h.ff, h.ef, hfe, h.ec, hce, h.fc, hcf, h.cc]
    match_scalars <;> field_simp [hs0, hs1] <;> ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ScalarMidpoint.midpoint_square
statement:
theorem midpoint_square
    (μ : V →ₗ[K] V →ₗ[K] V) (hsym : ∀ x y, μ x y = μ y x)
    (e f c : V) (t s : K) (h : PairTable μ e f c t)
    (hsquare : s ^ 2 = t) (hs0 : s ≠ 0) (hsneg : s ≠ -1) :
    μ (midpoint e f c s) (midpoint e f c s) = midpoint e f c s
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨he, hf, hc⟩ := midpoint_products μ hsym e f c t s h hsquare hs0 hsneg
  have hs1 := one_add_ne_zero hsneg
  change μ (midpoint e f c s)
      ((2 * (1 + s))⁻¹ • (e + f + (2 / s) • c)) =
    (2 * (1 + s))⁻¹ • (e + f + (2 / s) • c)
  simp only [map_add, map_smul, he, hf, hc]
  match_scalars <;> field_simp [hs0, hs1] <;> ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ScalarMidpoint.midpoint_reflection_apply
statement:
theorem midpoint_reflection_apply
    (μ : V →ₗ[K] V →ₗ[K] V) (hsym : ∀ x y, μ x y = μ y x)
    (e f c : V) (t s : K) (h : PairTable μ e f c t)
    (hsquare : s ^ 2 = t) (hs0 : s ≠ 0) (hsneg : s ≠ -1) :
    e - (8 : K) • μ (midpoint e f c s) e +
      (8 : K) • μ (midpoint e f c s) (μ (midpoint e f c s) e) = f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨he, _, hc⟩ := midpoint_products μ hsym e f c t s h hsquare hs0 hsneg
  simp only [he, map_add, map_smul, hc]
  match_scalars <;> field_simp [hs0] <;> ring

name: FiniteCoordinateExtension.extend_id
statement:
theorem extend_id (j : k →+* R) :
    extend j (LinearMap.id : (Fin n → k) →ₗ[k] (Fin n → k)) = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  simp only [extend, LinearMap.toMatrix'_id, map_one, Matrix.toLin'_one]

name: FiniteCoordinateExtension.extend_comp
statement:
theorem extend_comp (j : k →+* R)
    (A B : (Fin n → k) →ₗ[k] (Fin n → k)) :
    extend j (A.comp B) = (extend j A).comp (extend j B)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [extend, LinearMap.toMatrix'_comp, map_mul, Matrix.toLin'_mul]

name: FiniteCoordinateExtension.extend_on_constants
statement:
theorem extend_on_constants (j : k →+* R)
    (A : (Fin n → k) →ₗ[k] (Fin n → k)) (x : Fin n → k) :
    extend j A (j ∘ x) = j ∘ A x
proof:
:= by
  funext p
  change ((LinearMap.toMatrix' A).map j *ᵥ (j ∘ x)) p = j (A x p)
  simpa only [LinearMap.toMatrix'_mulVec] using
    (RingHom.map_mulVec j (LinearMap.toMatrix' A) x p).symm

name: FiniteCoordinateExtension.bilinear_eq_of_standard_basis
statement:
theorem bilinear_eq_of_standard_basis
    (B C : (Fin n → R) →ₗ[R] (Fin n → R) →ₗ[R] (Fin n → R))
    (h : ∀ i j : Fin n,
      B (Pi.single i 1) (Pi.single j 1) = C (Pi.single i 1) (Pi.single j 1)) :
    B = C
proof:
:= by
  apply (Pi.basisFun R (Fin n)).ext
  intro i
  apply (Pi.basisFun R (Fin n)).ext
  intro j
  simpa only [Pi.basisFun_apply] using h i j

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuadraticCharacterDescent.Data.u_ne
statement: theorem u_ne : D.u ≠ 0
proof: := mul_ne_zero D.kappa_ne D.eta_ne

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuadraticCharacterDescent.Data.tau_u
statement: theorem tau_u : D.tau D.u = D.u
proof:
:= by
  simp [u, D.tau_kappa, D.tau_eta]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuadraticCharacterDescent.Data.delta_u
statement: theorem delta_u : D.delta D.u = -D.u
proof:
:= by
  simp [u, D.delta_kappa, D.delta_eta]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuadraticCharacterDescent.Data.tau_fixed_iff
statement:
theorem tau_fixed_iff (x : Ω) : D.tau x = x ↔
    ∃ a d : k, x = algebraMap k Ω a + algebraMap k Ω d * D.u
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hx
    let p := (x + D.delta x) / 2
    let q := (x - D.delta x) / (2 * D.u)
    have hp : D.tau p = p ∧ D.delta p = p := by
      constructor
      · simp only [p, map_div₀, map_add, map_ofNat D.tau 2, D.commute x, hx]
      · simp only [p, map_div₀, map_add, map_ofNat D.delta 2, D.delta_involutive x]
        ring
    have hq : D.tau q = q ∧ D.delta q = q := by
      constructor
      · simp only [q, map_div₀, map_sub, map_mul, map_ofNat D.tau 2,
          D.tau_u, D.commute x, hx]
      · simp only [q, map_div₀, map_sub, map_mul, map_ofNat D.delta 2,
          D.delta_u, D.delta_involutive x]
        field_simp [D.u_ne]
        ring
    obtain ⟨a,ha⟩ := (D.joint_fixed p).mp hp
    obtain ⟨d,hd⟩ := (D.joint_fixed q).mp hq
    refine ⟨a,d,?_⟩
    rw [ha, hd]
    dsimp [p, q]
    field_simp [D.u_ne]
    ring
  · rintro ⟨a,d,rfl⟩
    simp [D.tau_u]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuadraticCharacterDescent.Data.unique_tau_fixed
statement:
theorem unique_tau_fixed (x : Ω) (hx : D.tau x = x) :
    ∃! v : k × k, algebraMap k Ω v.1 + algebraMap k Ω v.2 * D.u = x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a,d,h⟩ := (D.tau_fixed_iff x).mp hx
  refine ⟨(a,d),h.symm,?_⟩
  rintro ⟨a',d'⟩ hv
  have he := hv.trans h
  have hδ := congrArg D.delta he
  simp only [map_add, map_mul, D.delta.commutes, D.delta_u] at hδ
  have ha2 : (2 : Ω) * (algebraMap k Ω a' - algebraMap k Ω a) = 0 := by
    linear_combination he + hδ
  have hd2 : (2 : Ω) * ((algebraMap k Ω d' - algebraMap k Ω d) * D.u) = 0 := by
    linear_combination he - hδ
  have h2 : (2 : Ω) ≠ 0 := by norm_num
  have ha : a' = a := (algebraMap k Ω).injective
    (sub_eq_zero.mp ((mul_eq_zero.mp ha2).resolve_left h2))
  have hd : d' = d := (algebraMap k Ω).injective (sub_eq_zero.mp
    ((mul_eq_zero.mp ((mul_eq_zero.mp hd2).resolve_left h2)).resolve_right D.u_ne))
  exact Prod.ext ha hd

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuadraticCharacterDescent.Data.u_not_base
statement: theorem u_not_base : ¬ ∃ a : k, algebraMap k Ω a = D.u
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨a,ha⟩
  have hδ : D.delta D.u = D.u := by rw [← ha]; exact D.delta.commutes a
  have hz : D.u = 0 := by
    have hm : (2 : Ω) * D.u = 0 := by rw [D.delta_u] at hδ; linear_combination -hδ
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hm).resolve_left (by norm_num)
  exact D.u_ne hz

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ReducedRawAutomorphism.rawAction_extended
statement:
private theorem rawAction_extended (g h : Aut (K := k))
    (x : Coordinates (CR k)) :
    mapCoordinates k g (extendedCoordinateAut k h x) =
      extendedCoordinateAut k h (mapCoordinates k g x)
proof:
:= by
  funext c
  change rawAction k g
      (∑ d : Index, MvPolynomial.C
        (coordinateAut h (Pi.single d 1) c) * x d) = _
  rw [map_sum]
  simp only [map_mul, rawAction_C, mapCoordinates]
  change (∑ d : Index, MvPolynomial.C
      (coordinateAut h (Pi.single d 1) c) * rawAction k g (x d)) = _
  rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ReducedRawAutomorphism.rawAction_comp_inverse
statement:
theorem rawAction_comp_inverse (g : Aut (K := k)) :
    (rawAction k g).comp (rawAction k (inverseAut k g)) = RingHom.id _
proof:
:= by
  apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
  · intro a
    simp [rawAction]
  · intro q
    rcases q with ⟨r,i,c⟩
    simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.id_apply, rawAction_X]
    have h := congrFun (rawAction_extended k g (inverseAut k g)
      (universalPoint k r i)) c
    rw [mapCoordinates_universal] at h
    change rawAction k g (transformedUniversal k (inverseAut k g) r i c) = _ at h
    rw [h]
    change (extendedCoordinateAut k g).symm
        (extendedCoordinateAut k g (universalPoint k r i)) c =
      universalPoint k r i c
    exact congrFun ((extendedCoordinateAut k g).symm_apply_apply
      (universalPoint k r i)) c

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ReducedRawAutomorphism.rawAction_inverse_comp
statement:
theorem rawAction_inverse_comp (g : Aut (K := k)) :
    (rawAction k (inverseAut k g)).comp (rawAction k g) = RingHom.id _
proof:
:= by
  apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
  · intro a
    simp [rawAction]
  · intro q
    rcases q with ⟨r,i,c⟩
    simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, RingHom.id_apply, rawAction_X]
    have h := congrFun (rawAction_extended k (inverseAut k g) g
      (universalPoint k r i)) c
    rw [mapCoordinates_universal] at h
    change rawAction k (inverseAut k g) (transformedUniversal k g r i c) = _ at h
    rw [h]
    change extendedCoordinateAut k g
        ((extendedCoordinateAut k g).symm (universalPoint k r i)) c =
      universalPoint k r i c
    exact congrFun ((extendedCoordinateAut k g).apply_symm_apply
      (universalPoint k r i)) c

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ReducedRawAutomorphism.reduced_comp_inverse

    (reducedActionHom k g).comp (reducedInverseHom k g) = RingHom.id _
proof:
:= by

  apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
  · intro a
    simp [reducedInverseHom, rawAction]
  · intro q
    have h := DFunLike.congr_fun (rawAction_comp_inverse k g) (MvPolynomial.X q)
    simpa [reducedInverseHom] using
      congrArg (Ideal.Quotient.mk (rawFrameIdeal k).radical) h

:= by

  apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
  · intro a
    simp [reducedInverseHom, rawAction]
  · intro q
    have h := DFunLike.congr_fun (rawAction_inverse_comp k g) (MvPolynomial.X q)
    simpa [reducedInverseHom] using
      congrArg (Ideal.Quotient.mk (rawFrameIdeal k).radical) h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.M3JordanExtension.coordLinear_comp_inverse

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.M3JordanExtension.mapCoord_single
statement:
private theorem mapCoord_single (q : Ix) :
    mapCoord (algebraMap k R) (Pi.single q 1) = Pi.single q 1
proof:
:= by
  funext z
  by_cases h : z = q
  · subst z; simp [mapCoord]
  · simp [mapCoord, Pi.single_apply, h]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.M3JordanExtension.coordJordan_map
proof:
:= by
  have hi : algebraMap k R ((2 : k)⁻¹) = ⅟(2 : R) := by
    simpa only [invOf_eq_inv] using
      RealRow.Sym3JordanCoefficientMap.map_invTwo (algebraMap k R)
  ext ⟨i,j⟩
  simp [coordJordan, mapCoord, matrixJordan, Matrix.mul_apply, hi]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.M3JordanExtension.baseCoordLinear_jordan
proof:
:= by
  apply coordEquiv.symm.injective
  simpa [baseCoordLinear, coordJordan] using
    g.map_jordan (coordEquiv.symm x) (coordEquiv.symm y)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.M3JordanExtension.linearEquiv_jordan
statement:
theorem linearEquiv_jordan (g : Aut (K := k)) (A B : Mat3 R) :
    linearEquiv (R := R) g (matrixJordan A B) =
      matrixJordan (linearEquiv (R := R) g A) (linearEquiv (R := R) g B)
proof:
:= by
  apply coordEquiv.injective
  change coordLinear (R := R) g (coordJordan (coordEquiv A) (coordEquiv B)) =
    coordJordan (coordLinear (R := R) g (coordEquiv A))
      (coordLinear (R := R) g (coordEquiv B))
  have hbilin :
      (coordJordanBilin (R := R)).compr₂ (coordLinear (R := R) g) =
        (coordJordanBilin (R := R)).compl₁₂ (coordLinear (R := R) g)
          (coordLinear (R := R) g) := by
    apply FiniteIndexExtension.bilinear_eq_of_standard_basis
    intro p q
    change coordLinear (R := R) g (coordJordan (Pi.single p 1) (Pi.single q 1)) =
      coordJordan (coordLinear (R := R) g (Pi.single p 1))
        (coordLinear (R := R) g (Pi.single q 1))
    have h := congrArg (mapCoord (algebraMap k R))
      (baseCoordLinear_jordan g (Pi.single p 1) (Pi.single q 1))
    simpa only [← coordLinear_on_constants, ← coordJordan_map, mapCoord_single] using h

  exact congrArg (fun H : Coord R →ₗ[R] Coord R →ₗ[R] Coord R =>
    H (coordEquiv A) (coordEquiv B)) hbilin

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.M3JordanExtension.linearEquiv_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem linearEquiv_one (g : Aut (K := k)) :
    linearEquiv (R := R) g (1 : Mat3 R) = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply coordEquiv.injective
  change coordLinear (R := R) g (coordEquiv (1 : Mat3 R)) = coordEquiv (1 : Mat3 R)
  have ho : coordEquiv (1 : Mat3 R) = mapCoord (algebraMap k R)
      (coordEquiv (1 : Mat3 k)) := by
    ext ⟨i,j⟩
    simp [mapCoord, Matrix.one_apply]
  rw [ho, coordLinear_on_constants]
  simp [baseCoordLinear, g.map_one]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.M3JordanExtension.linearEquiv_trace
statement:
theorem linearEquiv_trace (g : Aut (K := k)) (A : Mat3 R) :
    Matrix.trace (linearEquiv (R := R) g A) = Matrix.trace A
proof:
:= by
  let tr : Coord R →ₗ[R] R :=
    { toFun := fun x => Matrix.trace (coordEquiv.symm x)
      map_add' := by intro x y; simp
      map_smul' := by intro c x; simp }
  have ht (x : Coord k) : tr (mapCoord (algebraMap k R) x) =
      algebraMap k R (Matrix.trace (coordEquiv.symm x)) := by
    simp [tr, Matrix.trace, mapCoord]
  have hmaps : tr.comp (coordLinear (R := R) g) = tr := by
    apply (Pi.basisFun R Ix).ext
    intro q
    simp only [Pi.basisFun_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply]
    rw [← mapCoord_single (k := k) (R := R) q, coordLinear_on_constants, ht, ht]
    apply congrArg (algebraMap k R)
    change Matrix.trace (g (coordEquiv.symm (Pi.single q 1))) =
      Matrix.trace (coordEquiv.symm (Pi.single q 1))
    exact trace_invariant g _
  exact congrArg (fun T : Coord R →ₗ[R] R => T (coordEquiv A)) hmaps

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.M3JordanExtension.coordLinearEquiv_natural
statement:
theorem coordLinearEquiv_natural
    {S : Type w} [CommRing S] [Algebra k S] [Invertible (2 : S)]
    (f : R →ₐ[k] S) (g : Aut (K := k)) (x : Coord R) :
    (f ∘ coordLinearEquiv (R := R) g x) =
      coordLinearEquiv (R := S) g (f ∘ x)
proof:
:= by
  funext p
  change f (coordLinearEquiv (R := R) g x p) =
    coordLinearEquiv (R := S) g (f ∘ x) p
  rw [coordLinearEquiv_apply_coordinate, coordLinearEquiv_apply_coordinate]
  simp only [map_sum, map_mul, f.commutes, Function.comp_apply]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowSkew.skew3_mulVec
statement:
@[simp] theorem skew3_mulVec (a b c x y z : K) :
    skew3 a b c *ᵥ vec3 x y z =
      vec3 (a * y + b * z) (-a * x + c * z) (-b * x - c * y)
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;>
    simp [skew3, vec3, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_succ] <;>
    ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowSkew.skew3_zero_iff
statement:
@[simp] theorem skew3_zero_iff (a b c : K) :
    skew3 a b c = 0 ↔ a = 0 ∧ b = 0 ∧ c = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h01 := congrArg (fun M : Mat3 K => M 0 1) h
    have h02 := congrArg (fun M : Mat3 K => M 0 2) h
    have h12 := congrArg (fun M : Mat3 K => M 1 2) h
    simpa [skew3] using And.intro h01 (And.intro h02 h12)
  · rintro ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
    ext i j
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [skew3]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowSkew.skew3_ne_zero_coefficients
statement:
theorem skew3_ne_zero_coefficients {a b c : K} (h : skew3 a b c ≠ 0) :
    a ≠ 0 ∨ b ≠ 0 ∨ c ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ha : a = 0
  · by_cases hb : b = 0
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (fun hc => h (skew3_zero_iff a b c |>.2 ⟨ha, hb, hc⟩)))
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl hb)
  · exact Or.inl ha

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowSkew.vec3_ne_zero_coordinates
statement:
theorem vec3_ne_zero_coordinates {x y z : K} (h : vec3 x y z ≠ 0) :
    x ≠ 0 ∨ y ≠ 0 ∨ z ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x = 0
  · by_cases hy : y = 0
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (fun hz => h (by
        funext i
        fin_cases i <;> simp [vec3, hx, hy, hz])))
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl hy)
  · exact Or.inl hx

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowSkew.skew3_smul
statement:
theorem skew3_smul (t a b c : K) :
    skew3 (t * a) (t * b) (t * c) = t • skew3 a b c
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [skew3] <;> ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowSkew.skew3_smul_sub
statement:
theorem skew3_smul_sub (t p q r p' q' r' : K) :
    t • skew3 p' q' r' - skew3 p q r =
      skew3 (t * p' - p) (t * q' - q) (t * r' - r)
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [skew3] <;> ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowSkew.skew3_common_kernel_proportional
statement:
theorem skew3_common_kernel_proportional
    (a b c a' b' c' x y z : K)
    (hB : skew3 a b c ≠ 0)
    (hv : vec3 x y z ≠ 0)
    (hker : skew3 a b c *ᵥ vec3 x y z = 0)
    (hker' : skew3 a' b' c' *ᵥ vec3 x y z = 0) :
    ∃ t : K, skew3 a' b' c' = t • skew3 a b c
proof:
:= by
  rw [skew3_mulVec] at hker hker'
  have h0 : a * y + b * z = 0 := by
    simpa [vec3] using congrArg (fun v : Vec3 K => v 0) hker
  have h1 : -a * x + c * z = 0 := by
    simpa [vec3] using congrArg (fun v : Vec3 K => v 1) hker
  have h2 : -b * x - c * y = 0 := by
    simpa [vec3, Matrix.cons_val_two] using
      congrArg (fun v : Vec3 K => v 2) hker
  have h0' : a' * y + b' * z = 0 := by
    simpa [vec3] using congrArg (fun v : Vec3 K => v 0) hker'
  have h1' : -a' * x + c' * z = 0 := by
    simpa [vec3] using congrArg (fun v : Vec3 K => v 1) hker'
  have h2' : -b' * x - c' * y = 0 := by
    simpa [vec3, Matrix.cons_val_two] using
      congrArg (fun v : Vec3 K => v 2) hker'
  have hax : a * x = c * z := by linear_combination -h1
  have hbx : b * x = -(c * y) := by linear_combination -h2
  have hay : a * y = -(b * z) := by linear_combination h0
  have hcy : c * y = -(b * x) := by linear_combination -h2
  have hbz : b * z = -(a * y) := by linear_combination h0
  have hcz : c * z = a * x := by linear_combination h1
  have hax' : a' * x = c' * z := by linear_combination -h1'
  have hbx' : b' * x = -(c' * y) := by linear_combination -h2'
  have hay' : a' * y = -(b' * z) := by linear_combination h0'
  have hcy' : c' * y = -(b' * x) := by linear_combination -h2'
  have hbz' : b' * z = -(a' * y) := by linear_combination h0'
  have hcz' : c' * z = a' * x := by linear_combination h1'
  rcases vec3_ne_zero_coordinates hv with hx | hy | hz
  · have hc : c ≠ 0 := by
      intro hc
      have ha : a = 0 := by
        have hau : a * x = 0 := by simpa [hc] using hax
        exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hau).resolve_right hx
      have hb : b = 0 := by
        have hbu : b * x = 0 := by simpa [hc] using hbx
        exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hbu).resolve_right hx
      exact hB (skew3_zero_iff a b c |>.2 ⟨ha, hb, hc⟩)
    have ha : a = c * z / x := by
      apply (eq_div_iff hx).2
      exact hax
    have hb : b = -(c * y) / x := by
      apply (eq_div_iff hx).2
      exact hbx
    have ha' : a' = c' * z / x := by
      apply (eq_div_iff hx).2
      exact hax'
    have hb' : b' = -(c' * y) / x := by
      apply (eq_div_iff hx).2
      exact hbx'
    let t : K := c' / c
    have hta : a' = t * a := by
      rw [ha, ha']
      dsimp [t]
      field_simp [hc, hx]
    have htb : b' = t * b := by
      rw [hb, hb']
      dsimp [t]
      field_simp [hc, hx]
    have htc : c' = t * c := by
      dsimp [t]
      field_simp [hc]
    refine ⟨t, ?_⟩
    rw [hta, htb, htc]
    exact skew3_smul t a b c
  · have hb : b ≠ 0 := by
      intro hb
      have ha : a = 0 := by
        have hay0 : a * y = 0 := by simpa [hb] using hay
        exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hay0).resolve_right hy
      have hc : c = 0 := by
        have hcy0 : c * y = 0 := by simpa [hb] using hcy
        exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hcy0).resolve_right hy
      exact hB (skew3_zero_iff a b c |>.2 ⟨ha, hb, hc⟩)
    have ha : a = -(b * z) / y := by
      apply (eq_div_iff hy).2
      exact hay
    have hc : c = -(b * x) / y := by
      apply (eq_div_iff hy).2
      exact hcy
    have ha' : a' = -(b' * z) / y := by
      apply (eq_div_iff hy).2
      exact hay'
    have hc' : c' = -(b' * x) / y := by
      apply (eq_div_iff hy).2
      exact hcy'
    let t : K := b' / b
    have hta : a' = t * a := by
      rw [ha, ha']
      dsimp [t]
      field_simp [hb, hy]
    have htb : b' = t * b := by
      dsimp [t]
      field_simp [hb]
    have htc : c' = t * c := by
      rw [hc, hc']
      dsimp [t]
      field_simp [hb, hy]
    refine ⟨t, ?_⟩
    rw [hta, htb, htc]
    exact skew3_smul t a b c
  · have ha : a ≠ 0 := by
      intro ha
      have hb : b = 0 := by
        have hbw : b * z = 0 := by simpa [ha] using hbz
        exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hbw).resolve_right hz
      have hc : c = 0 := by
        have hcw : c * z = 0 := by simpa [ha] using hcz
        exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hcw).resolve_right hz
      exact hB (skew3_zero_iff a b c |>.2 ⟨ha, hb, hc⟩)
    have hb : b = -(a * y) / z := by
      apply (eq_div_iff hz).2
      exact hbz
    have hc : c = a * x / z := by
      apply (eq_div_iff hz).2
      exact hcz
    have hb' : b' = -(a' * y) / z := by
      apply (eq_div_iff hz).2
      exact hbz'
    have hc' : c' = a' * x / z := by
      apply (eq_div_iff hz).2
      exact hcz'
    let t : K := a' / a
    have hta : a' = t * a := by
      dsimp [t]
      field_simp [ha]
    have htb : b' = t * b := by
      rw [hb, hb']
      dsimp [t]
      field_simp [ha, hz]
    have htc : c' = t * c := by
      rw [hc, hc']
      dsimp [t]
      field_simp [ha, hz]
    refine ⟨t, ?_⟩
    rw [hta, htb, htc]
    exact skew3_smul t a b c

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowSkew.skew3_mul_skew3
proof:
:= by
  simp only [skew3, Matrix.mul_fin_three]
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp <;> ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowSkew.skew3_mul_eq_zero_right
statement:
theorem skew3_mul_eq_zero_right
    (a b c p q r : K)
    (hB : skew3 a b c ≠ 0)
    (hprod : skew3 a b c * skew3 p q r = 0) :
    skew3 p q r = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [skew3_mul_skew3] at hprod
  rcases skew3_ne_zero_coefficients hB with ha | hb | hc
  · have har : a * r = 0 := by
      have h : a * r = 0 := by
        simpa using congrArg (fun M : Mat3 K => M 0 2) hprod
      exact h
    have haq : a * q = 0 := by
      have h : -a * q = 0 := by
        simpa using congrArg (fun M : Mat3 K => M 1 2) hprod
      linear_combination -h
    have hr : r = 0 := (mul_eq_zero.mp har).resolve_left ha
    have hq : q = 0 := (mul_eq_zero.mp haq).resolve_left ha
    have hap : a * p = 0 := by
      have h : -a * p - c * r = 0 := by
        simpa using congrArg (fun M : Mat3 K => M 1 1) hprod
      have hneg : -(a * p) = 0 := by
        simpa only [hr, mul_zero, sub_zero, neg_mul] using h
      exact neg_eq_zero.mp hneg
    have hp : p = 0 := (mul_eq_zero.mp hap).resolve_left ha
    exact skew3_zero_iff p q r |>.2 ⟨hp, hq, hr⟩
  · have hbr : b * r = 0 := by
      have h : -b * r = 0 := by
        simpa using congrArg (fun M : Mat3 K => M 0 1) hprod
      linear_combination -h
    have hbp : b * p = 0 := by
      have h : -b * p = 0 := by
        simpa using congrArg (fun M : Mat3 K => M 2 1) hprod
      linear_combination -h
    have hr : r = 0 := (mul_eq_zero.mp hbr).resolve_left hb
    have hp : p = 0 := (mul_eq_zero.mp hbp).resolve_left hb
    have hbq : b * q = 0 := by
      have h : -b * q - c * r = 0 := by
        simpa using congrArg (fun M : Mat3 K => M 2 2) hprod
      have hneg : -(b * q) = 0 := by
        simpa only [hr, mul_zero, sub_zero, neg_mul] using h
      exact neg_eq_zero.mp hneg
    have hq : q = 0 := (mul_eq_zero.mp hbq).resolve_left hb
    exact skew3_zero_iff p q r |>.2 ⟨hp, hq, hr⟩
  · have hcq : c * q = 0 := by
      have h : -c * q = 0 := by
        simpa using congrArg (fun M : Mat3 K => M 1 0) hprod
      linear_combination -h
    have hcp : c * p = 0 := by
      have h : c * p = 0 := by
        simpa using congrArg (fun M : Mat3 K => M 2 0) hprod
      exact h
    have hq : q = 0 := (mul_eq_zero.mp hcq).resolve_left hc
    have hp : p = 0 := (mul_eq_zero.mp hcp).resolve_left hc
    have hcr : c * r = 0 := by
      have h : -a * p - c * r = 0 := by
        simpa using congrArg (fun M : Mat3 K => M 1 1) hprod
      have hneg : -(c * r) = 0 := by
        simpa only [hp, mul_zero, neg_zero, zero_sub, neg_mul] using h
      exact neg_eq_zero.mp hneg
    have hr : r = 0 := (mul_eq_zero.mp hcr).resolve_left hc
    exact skew3_zero_iff p q r |>.2 ⟨hp, hq, hr⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowSkew.skew3_inverse_scale_of_product
statement:
theorem skew3_inverse_scale_of_product
    (a b c p q r p' q' r' t : K)
    (hB : skew3 a b c ≠ 0)
    (ht : t ≠ 0)
    (hprod :
      skew3 a b c * (t • skew3 p' q' r' - skew3 p q r) = 0) :
    skew3 p' q' r' = t⁻¹ • skew3 p q r
proof:
:= by
  have hzero :
      skew3 (t * p' - p) (t * q' - q) (t * r' - r) = 0 := by
    apply skew3_mul_eq_zero_right a b c
        (t * p' - p) (t * q' - q) (t * r' - r) hB
    rw [← skew3_smul_sub]
    exact hprod
  have hdiff : t • skew3 p' q' r' - skew3 p q r = 0 := by
    rw [skew3_smul_sub]
    exact hzero
  have hscale : t • skew3 p' q' r' = skew3 p q r := sub_eq_zero.mp hdiff
  calc
    skew3 p' q' r' = t⁻¹ • (t • skew3 p' q' r') := by
      simp [smul_smul, ht]
    _ = t⁻¹ • skew3 p q r := congrArg (fun M : Mat3 K => t⁻¹ • M) hscale

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowSkew.eq_skew3_of_transpose_eq_neg
statement:
theorem eq_skew3_of_transpose_eq_neg
    (hchar : (2 : K) ≠ 0) (M : Mat3 K) (hM : M.transpose = -M) :
    M = skew3 (M 0 1) (M 0 2) (M 1 2)
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  have hij := congrArg (fun N : Mat3 K => N i j) hM
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
  · have hij' : M 0 0 = -M 0 0 := by
      simpa [Matrix.transpose_apply] using hij
    have hz : (2 : K) * M 0 0 = 0 := by
      linear_combination hij'
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hz).resolve_left hchar
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · have hij' : M 0 1 = -M 1 0 := by
      simpa [Matrix.transpose_apply] using hij
    change M 1 0 = -M 0 1
    linear_combination hij'
  · have hij' : M 1 1 = -M 1 1 := by
      simpa [Matrix.transpose_apply] using hij
    have hz : (2 : K) * M 1 1 = 0 := by
      linear_combination hij'
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hz).resolve_left hchar
  · rfl
  · have hij' : M 0 2 = -M 2 0 := by
      simpa [Matrix.transpose_apply] using hij
    change M 2 0 = -M 0 2
    linear_combination hij'
  · have hij' : M 1 2 = -M 2 1 := by
      simpa [Matrix.transpose_apply] using hij
    change M 2 1 = -M 1 2
    linear_combination hij'
  · have hij' : M 2 2 = -M 2 2 := by
      simpa [Matrix.transpose_apply] using hij
    have hz : (2 : K) * M 2 2 = 0 := by
      linear_combination hij'
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hz).resolve_left hchar

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowSkew.common_kernel_proportional
statement:
theorem common_kernel_proportional
    (hchar : (2 : K) ≠ 0) (B C : Mat3 K) (v : Vec3 K)
    (hBskew : B.transpose = -B) (hCskew : C.transpose = -C)
    (hB : B ≠ 0) (hv : v ≠ 0)
    (hBv : B *ᵥ v = 0) (hCv : C *ᵥ v = 0) :
    ∃ t : K, C = t • B
proof:
:= by
  have hBrep := eq_skew3_of_transpose_eq_neg hchar B hBskew
  have hCrep := eq_skew3_of_transpose_eq_neg hchar C hCskew
  have hvrep : v = vec3 (v 0) (v 1) (v 2) := by
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> rfl
  rw [hBrep] at hB hBv ⊢
  rw [hCrep] at hCv ⊢
  rw [hvrep] at hBv hCv hv
  exact skew3_common_kernel_proportional
    (B 0 1) (B 0 2) (B 1 2)
    (C 0 1) (C 0 2) (C 1 2)
    (v 0) (v 1) (v 2) hB hv hBv hCv

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowSkew.mul_eq_zero_right
statement:
theorem mul_eq_zero_right
    (hchar : (2 : K) ≠ 0) (B C : Mat3 K)
    (hBskew : B.transpose = -B) (hCskew : C.transpose = -C)
    (hB : B ≠ 0) (hprod : B * C = 0) : C = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hBrep := eq_skew3_of_transpose_eq_neg hchar B hBskew
  have hCrep := eq_skew3_of_transpose_eq_neg hchar C hCskew
  rw [hBrep] at hB hprod
  rw [hCrep] at hprod ⊢
  exact skew3_mul_eq_zero_right
    (B 0 1) (B 0 2) (B 1 2)
    (C 0 1) (C 0 2) (C 1 2) hB hprod

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowSkew.inverse_scale_of_product
statement:
theorem inverse_scale_of_product
    (hchar : (2 : K) ≠ 0) (B C C' : Mat3 K) (t : K)
    (hBskew : B.transpose = -B)
    (hCskew : C.transpose = -C)
    (hC'skew : C'.transpose = -C')
    (hB : B ≠ 0) (ht : t ≠ 0)
    (hprod : B * (t • C' - C) = 0) : C' = t⁻¹ • C
proof:
:= by
  have hBrep := eq_skew3_of_transpose_eq_neg hchar B hBskew
  have hCrep := eq_skew3_of_transpose_eq_neg hchar C hCskew
  have hC'rep := eq_skew3_of_transpose_eq_neg hchar C' hC'skew
  rw [hBrep] at hB hprod
  rw [hCrep] at hprod ⊢
  rw [hC'rep] at hprod ⊢
  exact skew3_inverse_scale_of_product
    (B 0 1) (B 0 2) (B 1 2)
    (C 0 1) (C 0 2) (C 1 2)
    (C' 0 1) (C' 0 2) (C' 1 2) t hB ht hprod

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3OrthogonalAut.conjugationLinear_jordan
statement:
theorem conjugationLinear_jordan (Q A B : Mat3 R)
    (hQTQ : Matrix.transpose Q * Q = 1) :
    conjugationLinear Q (TitsTracePairing.matrixJordan A B) =
      TitsTracePairing.matrixJordan (ringConjugate Q A) (ringConjugate Q B)
proof:
:= by
  unfold TitsTracePairing.matrixJordan
  rw [map_smul, map_add]
  change ⅟(2 : R) • (ringConjugate Q (A * B) + ringConjugate Q (B * A)) = _
  rw [ringConjugate_mul Q A B hQTQ, ringConjugate_mul Q B A hQTQ]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3OrthogonalAut.toSymMatrix_coordinateConjugate
statement:
theorem toSymMatrix_coordinateConjugate (Q : Mat3 R) (x : Sym3Coord R) :
    toSymMatrix (coordinateConjugate Q x) = ringConjugate Q (toSymMatrix x)
proof:
:= by
  apply toSymMatrix_fromMatrix
  exact ringConjugate_symmetric Q _ (toSymMatrix_symmetric x)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3OrthogonalAut.toSymMatrix_injective
statement: private theorem toSymMatrix_injective : Function.Injective (toSymMatrix (R := R))
proof:
:= by
  intro x y h
  simpa only [fromMatrix_toSymMatrix] using congrArg fromMatrix h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3OrthogonalAut.conjugate_transpose_left
statement:
theorem conjugate_transpose_left (Q A : Mat3 k) (hQ : IsOrthogonal Q) :
    ringConjugate (Matrix.transpose Q) (ringConjugate Q A) = A
proof:
:= by
  change Matrix.transpose Q * (Q * A * Matrix.transpose Q) * Q = A
  calc
    _ = (Matrix.transpose Q * Q) * A * (Matrix.transpose Q * Q) := by
      simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = A := by rw [hQ.transpose_mul]; simp

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3OrthogonalAut.conjugate_transpose_right
statement:
theorem conjugate_transpose_right (Q A : Mat3 k) (hQ : IsOrthogonal Q) :
    ringConjugate Q (ringConjugate (Matrix.transpose Q) A) = A
proof:
:= by
  change Q * (Matrix.transpose Q * A * Q) * Matrix.transpose Q = A
  calc
    _ = (Q * Matrix.transpose Q) * A * (Q * Matrix.transpose Q) := by
      simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = A := by rw [hQ.mul_transpose]; simp

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3OrthogonalAut.coordinateConjugate_inverse_left
statement:
theorem coordinateConjugate_inverse_left (Q : Mat3 k) (hQ : IsOrthogonal Q) :
    (coordinateConjugate (Matrix.transpose Q)).comp (coordinateConjugate Q) = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  apply toSymMatrix_injective
  change toSymMatrix (coordinateConjugate (Matrix.transpose Q) (coordinateConjugate Q x)) = _
  rw [toSymMatrix_coordinateConjugate, toSymMatrix_coordinateConjugate,
    conjugate_transpose_left Q _ hQ]
  rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3OrthogonalAut.coordinateConjugate_inverse_right
statement:
theorem coordinateConjugate_inverse_right (Q : Mat3 k) (hQ : IsOrthogonal Q) :
    (coordinateConjugate Q).comp (coordinateConjugate (Matrix.transpose Q)) = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  apply toSymMatrix_injective
  change toSymMatrix (coordinateConjugate Q (coordinateConjugate (Matrix.transpose Q) x)) = _
  rw [toSymMatrix_coordinateConjugate, toSymMatrix_coordinateConjugate,
    conjugate_transpose_right Q _ hQ]
  rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3OrthogonalAut.orthogonalLinearEquiv_toSymMatrix
statement:
theorem orthogonalLinearEquiv_toSymMatrix (Q : Mat3 k) (hQ : IsOrthogonal Q)

:=

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3OrthogonalAut.orthogonalAut_toSymMatrix
statement:
theorem orthogonalAut_toSymMatrix (Q : Mat3 k) (hQ : IsOrthogonal Q) (x : Sym3Coord k) :
    toSymMatrix (orthogonalAut Q hQ x) = ringConjugate Q (toSymMatrix x)
proof:
:=
  orthogonalLinearEquiv_toSymMatrix Q hQ x

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3OrthogonalAut.extension_orthogonal_toSymMatrix
statement:
theorem extension_orthogonal_toSymMatrix (Q : Mat3 k) (hQ : IsOrthogonal Q)
    (x : Sym3Coord R) :
    toSymMatrix (Sym3JordanExtension.linearEquiv R (orthogonalAut Q hQ) x) =
      ringConjugate ((algebraMap k R).mapMatrix Q) (toSymMatrix x)
proof:
:= by
  have hlinear :
      (toSymMatrixLinear (R := R)).comp
          (Sym3JordanExtension.linearEquiv R (orthogonalAut Q hQ)).toLinearMap =
        (conjugationLinear ((algebraMap k R).mapMatrix Q)).comp toSymMatrixLinear := by
    apply (Pi.basisFun R (Fin 6)).ext
    intro q
    simp only [Pi.basisFun_apply]
    change toSymMatrix (Sym3JordanExtension.linearEquiv R (orthogonalAut Q hQ) (Pi.single q 1)) =
      ringConjugate ((algebraMap k R).mapMatrix Q) (toSymMatrix (Pi.single q 1))
    rw [← coordinateMap_single_one (algebraMap k R) q,
      Sym3JordanExtension.linearEquiv_apply, Sym3JordanExtension.linearMap_on_constants,
      toSymMatrix_coordinateMap, orthogonalAut_toSymMatrix, toSymMatrix_coordinateMap]
    simp only [ringConjugate, map_mul] <;> rfl
  exact congrArg (fun T : Sym3Coord R →ₗ[R] Mat3 R => T x) hlinear

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3OrthogonalAut.extension_orthogonal_symmetric
statement:
theorem extension_orthogonal_symmetric (Q : Mat3 k) (hQ : IsOrthogonal Q)
    (A : Mat3 R) (hA : Matrix.transpose A = A) :
    toSymMatrix (Sym3JordanExtension.linearEquiv R (orthogonalAut Q hQ) (fromMatrix A)) =
      ringConjugate ((algebraMap k R).mapMatrix Q) A
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [toSymMatrix_fromMatrix hA] using
    extension_orthogonal_toSymMatrix R Q hQ (fromMatrix A)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3OrthogonalAut.extension_orthogonal_symCoordinates
statement:
theorem extension_orthogonal_symCoordinates (Q : Mat3 k) (hQ : IsOrthogonal Q)
    (A : Mat3 R) :
    toSymMatrix (Sym3JordanExtension.linearEquiv R (orthogonalAut Q hQ) (symCoordinates A)) =
      ringConjugate ((algebraMap k R).mapMatrix Q) (symmetrize A)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [toSymMatrix_symCoordinates] using
    extension_orthogonal_toSymMatrix R Q hQ (symCoordinates A)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexPairSeed.X_mul_Xi
statement: theorem X_mul_Xi : (X : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) K) * Xi = 1
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>

      Matrix.cons_val_two, Fin.ext_iff]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexPairSeed.frame_encoder
statement:
theorem frame_encoder :
    encoder (frame 0 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) K) (frame 2) =
      !![-2, 1, 0; -5, 5, -1; -11, 13, -3]
proof:
:= by
  have hf (l r c : Fin 3) : (frame l : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) K) r c =
      X r l * Xi l c := by
    fin_cases l <;> simp [frame, Matrix.mul_apply, diagonalUnit, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  ext i j
  simp only [encoder, Matrix.sub_apply, hf]
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    norm_num [X, Xi, Matrix.cons_val_two]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexPairSeed.frame_commutator_det
statement:
theorem frame_commutator_det :
    Matrix.det (grading * encoder (frame 0 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) K) (frame 2) -
      encoder (frame 0) (frame 2) * grading) = 22
proof:
:= by
  rw [frame_encoder, det_grading_commutator]
  norm_num [FourRowProbeSeparation.cycleDifference, Matrix.cons_val_two]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexPairSeed.frame_commutator_ne_zero
statement:
theorem frame_commutator_ne_zero :
    Matrix.det (grading * encoder (frame 0 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) K) (frame 2) -
      encoder (frame 0) (frame 2) * grading) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [frame_commutator_det]
  norm_num

name: AlbertLean.Generic.LocalizedGridIdentity.constantEval_mappedDenominator
statement:
theorem constantEval_mappedDenominator (D : MvPolynomial σ k) (t : σ → k) :
    constantEval k K t (mappedDenominator k K D) =
      algebraMap k K (MvPolynomial.eval t D)
proof:
:= by
  simp [constantEval, mappedDenominator, MvPolynomial.map_eval, Function.comp_def]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.LocalizedGridIdentity.localizedConstantEval_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp] theorem localizedConstantEval_algebraMap
    (D : MvPolynomial σ k)
    [IsLocalization.Away (mappedDenominator k K D) S]
    (t : σ → k) (ht : MvPolynomial.eval t D ≠ 0) (P : Base (σ := σ) K) :
    localizedConstantEval k K S D t ht (algebraMap (Base (σ := σ) K) S P) =
      constantEval k K t P
proof:
:= by
  exact IsLocalization.Away.lift_eq (mappedDenominator k K D) _ P

name: AlbertLean.Generic.LocalizedGridIdentity.eq_zero_of_localizedConstantEval_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_localizedConstantEval_eq_zero
    (D : MvPolynomial σ k) (hD : D ≠ 0)
    [IsLocalization.Away (mappedDenominator k K D) S]
    (x : S)
    (hx : ∀ (t : σ → k) (ht : MvPolynomial.eval t D ≠ 0),
      localizedConstantEval k K S D t ht x = 0) :
    x = 0
proof:
:= by
  let d : Base (σ := σ) K := mappedDenominator k K D
  let s := IsLocalization.Away.sec d x
  have hs : x * algebraMap (Base (σ := σ) K) S (d ^ s.2) =
      algebraMap (Base (σ := σ) K) S s.1 := IsLocalization.Away.sec_spec d x
  have hs1 : s.1 = 0 := by
    apply OpenGridIdentity.eq_zero_of_eval_algebraMap_eq_zero_of_denominator_ne_zero
      D s.1 hD
    intro t ht
    let ev := localizedConstantEval k K S D t ht
    have hev := congrArg ev hs
    have hx0 : ev x = 0 := hx t ht
    change constantEval k K t s.1 = 0
    simpa [ev, d, s, hx0] using hev.symm
  rw [hs1, map_zero] at hs
  have hu : IsUnit (algebraMap (Base (σ := σ) K) S (d ^ s.2)) :=
    by simpa only [map_pow] using
      (IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_pow_isUnit (S := S) d s.2)
  exact hu.mul_right_injective (by simpa [mul_comm] using hs)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.LocalizedGridIdentity.extensionEval_eq_zero_of_eq_zero
statement:
theorem extensionEval_eq_zero_of_eq_zero
    (D : MvPolynomial σ k)
    [IsLocalization.Away (mappedDenominator k K D) S]
    (x : S) (hx : x = 0) (φ : K →+* E) (b : σ → E)
    (hDunit : IsUnit
      (MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom φ b (mappedDenominator k K D))) :
    extensionEval k K S D φ b hDunit x = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [hx, map_zero]
