name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertActualDetectorPairCoefficients.mapped_sourceLedger_eq_of_rawLedgerAgreement
statement:
private theorem mapped_sourceLedger_eq_of_rawLedgerAgreement
    (phi : RawFunctionField k →+* N) (q : ExplicitFrameChart N)
    (halign : RawLedgerAligned k phi q)
    (left right : N →+* T)
    (hbase : ∀ z : rawLedgerField k,
      left (rawLedgerMap k phi z) = right (rawLedgerMap k phi z)) :
    sourceLedger (encoderA (mapChart left q)) (encoderB (mapChart left q)) =
      sourceLedger (encoderA (mapChart right q)) (encoderB (mapChart right q))
proof:
:= by
  rw [sourceLedger_mapChart, sourceLedger_mapChart]
  apply SourceLedger.ext
  · funext i j
    calc
      left ((sourceLedger (encoderA q) (encoderB q)).P i j) =
          left (phi (ledgerValue k (0, i, j, 0))) :=
        congrArg left (halign 0 i j 0)
      _ = right (phi (ledgerValue k (0, i, j, 0))) := by
        exact hbase ⟨ledgerValue k (0, i, j, 0),
          ledgerValue_mem_rawLedgerField k _⟩
      _ = right ((sourceLedger (encoderA q) (encoderB q)).P i j) :=
        congrArg right (halign 0 i j 0).symm
  · funext i j
    calc
      left ((sourceLedger (encoderA q) (encoderB q)).Q i j) =
          left (phi (ledgerValue k (1, i, j, 0))) :=
        congrArg left (halign 1 i j 0)
      _ = right (phi (ledgerValue k (1, i, j, 0))) := by
        exact hbase ⟨ledgerValue k (1, i, j, 0),
          ledgerValue_mem_rawLedgerField k _⟩
      _ = right ((sourceLedger (encoderA q) (encoderB q)).Q i j) :=
        congrArg right (halign 1 i j 0).symm
  · funext i j
    calc
      left ((sourceLedger (encoderA q) (encoderB q)).R i j) =
          left (phi (ledgerValue k (2, i, j, 0))) :=
        congrArg left (halign 2 i j 0)
      _ = right (phi (ledgerValue k (2, i, j, 0))) := by
        exact hbase ⟨ledgerValue k (2, i, j, 0),
          ledgerValue_mem_rawLedgerField k _⟩
      _ = right ((sourceLedger (encoderA q) (encoderB q)).R i j) :=
        congrArg right (halign 2 i j 0).symm
  · funext i j l
    calc
      left ((sourceLedger (encoderA q) (encoderB q)).C0 i j l) =
          left (phi (ledgerValue k (3, i, j, l))) :=
        congrArg left (halign 3 i j l)
      _ = right (phi (ledgerValue k (3, i, j, l))) := by
        exact hbase ⟨ledgerValue k (3, i, j, l),
          ledgerValue_mem_rawLedgerField k _⟩
      _ = right ((sourceLedger (encoderA q) (encoderB q)).C0 i j l) :=
        congrArg right (halign 3 i j l).symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertActualDetectorPairCoefficients.detectorPairCoefficients_agree
statement:
theorem detectorPairCoefficients_agree
    (phi : RawFunctionField k →+* N) (q : ExplicitFrameChart N)
    (halign : RawLedgerAligned k phi q)
    (hq : EquationsVanish (explicitFrameEquationValues q))
    (hopen : ResidualOpen (residualPairOfChart q))
    (a h sigma : N)
    (hr1 : q.r1 = 1) (hz1 : q.z1 = a)
    (hr2 : q.r2 = (h - sigma) / (2 * a))
    (hz2 : q.z2 = (h + sigma) / 2)
    (hsigma : sigma ≠ 0) (ha : 2 * a ≠ 0)
    (left right : N →+* T)
    (hbase : ∀ z : rawLedgerField k,
      left (rawLedgerMap k phi z) = right (rawLedgerMap k phi z)) :
    left (detectorPairSum q hopen) = right (detectorPairSum q hopen) ∧
      left (detectorPairProduct q hopen) =
        right (detectorPairProduct q hopen)
proof:
:= by
  let ql := mapChart left q
  let qr := mapChart right q
  let hopenl := residualOpen_mapChart left q hopen
  let hopenr := residualOpen_mapChart right q hopen
  have hledger : sourceLedger (encoderA ql) (encoderB ql) =
      sourceLedger (encoderA qr) (encoderB qr) :=
    mapped_sourceLedger_eq_of_rawLedgerAgreement k phi q halign left right hbase
  have hql : EquationsVanish (explicitFrameEquationValues ql) :=
    equationsVanish_mapChart left q hq
  have hqr : EquationsVanish (explicitFrameEquationValues qr) :=
    equationsVanish_mapChart right q hq
  have hfixedl := (equationsVanish_iff_source_fixedSpectrum ql).1 hql
  have hfixedr := (equationsVanish_iff_source_fixedSpectrum qr).1 hqr
  have hml := recovered_measurements (encoderA ql) (encoderB ql)
    hfixedl.2.2.1 hfixedl.2.2.2.2.2
  have hmr := recovered_measurements (encoderA qr) (encoderB qr)
    hfixedr.2.2.1 hfixedr.2.2.2.2.2
  rcases hml with ⟨hnVxl, hnSxl, hnCxl, hnVyl, hnSyl, hnCyl, hgVl,
    hgSl, hgCl, ht111l, ht211l, ht121l, ht112l, ht122l, ht212l,
    ht221l, ht222l, huVl, huSl, huCl⟩
  rcases hmr with ⟨hnVxr, hnSxr, hnCxr, hnVyr, hnSyr, hnCyr, hgVr,
    hgSr, hgCr, ht111r, ht211r, ht121r, ht112r, ht122r, ht212r,
    ht221r, ht222r, huVr, huSr, huCr⟩
  have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := by
    intro haz
    apply ha
    rw [haz, mul_zero]
  have hgram : gramV12 q = h := by
    rw [gramV12, hr1, hz1, hr2, hz2]
    field_simp [ha0]
    ring
  have hnVaq : nV (vectorA q) = a := by
    simp [nV, vectorA, Pf, BW, hr1, hz1]
  have ha_lr : left a = right a := by
    calc
      left a = left (nV (vectorA q)) := by rw [hnVaq]
      _ = nV (vectorA ql) := by
        simp [ql, mapChart, vectorA, nV, Pf, BW]
      _ = nVx (sourceLedger (encoderA ql) (encoderB ql)) := hnVxl.symm
      _ = nVx (sourceLedger (encoderA qr) (encoderB qr)) := by rw [hledger]
      _ = nV (vectorA qr) := hnVxr
      _ = right (nV (vectorA q)) := by
        simp [qr, mapChart, vectorA, nV, Pf, BW]
      _ = right a := by rw [hnVaq]
  have hh_lr : left h = right h := by
    calc
      left h = gramV12 ql := by rw [gramV12_mapChart, hgram]
      _ = BV (vectorA ql) (vectorB ql) := by
        simp [gramV12, BV, vectorA, vectorB, BW]
        ring
      _ = gV (sourceLedger (encoderA ql) (encoderB ql)) 1 1 := hgVl.symm
      _ = gV (sourceLedger (encoderA qr) (encoderB qr)) 1 1 := by rw [hledger]
      _ = BV (vectorA qr) (vectorB qr) := hgVr
      _ = gramV12 qr := by
        simp [gramV12, BV, vectorA, vectorB, BW]
        ring
      _ = right h := by rw [gramV12_mapChart, hgram]
  have hpair := normalized_detector_pair_eq_or_swapped ql qr hopenl hopenr
    hledger (left a) (left h) (left sigma) (right sigma) hql hqr
    (by simp [ql, mapChart, hr1])
    (by simp [ql, mapChart, hz1])
    (by
      simp [ql, mapChart, hr2]
      rw [map_ofNat])
    (by
      simp [ql, mapChart, hz2]
      rw [map_ofNat])
    (by simp [qr, mapChart, hr1])
    (by
      change right q.z1 = left a
      rw [hz1, ← ha_lr])
    (by
      change right q.r2 = (left h - right sigma) / (2 * left a)
      rw [hr2, map_div₀, map_sub, map_mul, map_ofNat, ha_lr, hh_lr])
    (by
      change right q.z2 = (left h + right sigma) / 2
      rw [hz2, map_div₀, map_add, map_ofNat, hh_lr])
    (by simpa only [map_zero] using left.injective.ne hsigma)
    (by simpa only [map_mul, map_ofNat, map_zero] using left.injective.ne ha)
  have hdl : left (detectorOfChart q) = detectorOfChart ql := by
    exact sourceDetector_mapChart left q
  have hdr : right (detectorOfChart q) = detectorOfChart qr := by
    exact sourceDetector_mapChart right q
  have hcl : left (companionDetectorOfChart q hopen) =
      companionDetectorOfChart ql hopenl := by
    exact companionDetector_mapChart left q hopen
  have hcr : right (companionDetectorOfChart q hopen) =
      companionDetectorOfChart qr hopenr := by
    exact companionDetector_mapChart right q hopen
  rcases hpair with hordered | hswapped
  · constructor
    · simp only [detectorPairSum, map_add, hdl, hdr, hcl, hcr]
      simp only [detectorOfChart, companionDetectorOfChart]
      rw [hordered.1, hordered.2]
    · simp only [detectorPairProduct, map_mul, hdl, hdr, hcl, hcr]
      simp only [detectorOfChart, companionDetectorOfChart]
      rw [hordered.1, hordered.2]
  · constructor
    · simp only [detectorPairSum, map_add, hdl, hdr, hcl, hcr]
      simp only [detectorOfChart, companionDetectorOfChart]
      rw [hswapped.1, hswapped.2]
      ring
    · simp only [detectorPairProduct, map_mul, hdl, hdr, hcl, hcr]
      simp only [detectorOfChart, companionDetectorOfChart]
      rw [hswapped.1, hswapped.2]
      ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertActualDetectorPairCoefficients.exists_rawLedger_pairCoefficients
statement:
theorem exists_rawLedger_pairCoefficients
    (phi : RawFunctionField k →+* N) (q : ExplicitFrameChart N)
    (halign : RawLedgerAligned k phi q)
    (hq : EquationsVanish (explicitFrameEquationValues q))
    (hopen : ResidualOpen (residualPairOfChart q))
    (a h sigma : N)
    (hr1 : q.r1 = 1) (hz1 : q.z1 = a)
    (hr2 : q.r2 = (h - sigma) / (2 * a))
    (hz2 : q.z2 = (h + sigma) / 2)
    (hsigma : sigma ≠ 0) (ha : 2 * a ≠ 0) :
    ∃ s p : rawLedgerField k,
      rawLedgerMap k phi s = detectorPairSum q hopen ∧
      rawLedgerMap k phi p = detectorPairProduct q hopen
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra (rawLedgerField k) N := (rawLedgerMap k phi).toAlgebra
  have hs := exists_base_of_field_embedding_agreement
    (rawLedgerField k) N (detectorPairSum q hopen) (by
      intro T iT left right hbase
      letI : Field T := iT
      letI : CharZero T := FiniteQuadraticRoots.charZero_of_embedding left
      exact (detectorPairCoefficients_agree k phi q halign hq hopen
        a h sigma hr1 hz1 hr2 hz2 hsigma ha left right (by
          intro z
          simpa only [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra] using hbase z)).1)
  have hp := exists_base_of_field_embedding_agreement
    (rawLedgerField k) N (detectorPairProduct q hopen) (by
      intro T iT left right hbase
      letI : Field T := iT
      letI : CharZero T := FiniteQuadraticRoots.charZero_of_embedding left
      exact (detectorPairCoefficients_agree k phi q halign hq hopen
        a h sigma hr1 hz1 hr2 hz2 hsigma ha left right (by
          intro z
          simpa only [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra] using hbase z)).2)
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hs
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hp
  exact ⟨s, p, hs, hp⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertActualDetectorPairCoefficients.original_detector_quadratic
statement:
theorem original_detector_quadratic
    (phi : RawFunctionField k →+* N) (hphi : Injective phi)
    (q : ExplicitFrameChart N)
    (hopen : ResidualOpen (residualPairOfChart q))
    (hdetector : phi (detectorValue k) = detectorOfChart q)
    (s p : rawLedgerField k)
    (hs : rawLedgerMap k phi s = detectorPairSum q hopen)
    (hp : rawLedgerMap k phi p = detectorPairProduct q hopen) :
    detectorValue k ^ 2 - s.1 * detectorValue k + p.1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply hphi
  simp only [map_add, map_sub, map_mul, map_pow, map_zero]
  change phi (detectorValue k) ^ 2 - rawLedgerMap k phi s *
      phi (detectorValue k) + rawLedgerMap k phi p = 0
  rw [hdetector, hs, hp]
  simp only [detectorPairSum, detectorPairProduct]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertActualDetectorPairCoefficients.exists_original_detector_quadratic
statement:
theorem exists_original_detector_quadratic :
    ∃ s p : rawLedgerField k,
      detectorValue k ^ 2 - s.1 * detectorValue k + p.1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨L, iL, cL, f, sigma, g, q, hq, hf, hdiag, hdiagFields,
      hA, hB, hkappa, hr1, hz1, hr2, hz2, hsquare, hdetectorRing,
      hcells, hdetectorSource, hsigmaSquare, hsigma, htwoaEval, hsep,
      hbeta, hroots, hopen⟩ := exists_actual_generic_chart_alignment k
  letI : Field L := iL
  letI : CharZero L := cL
  let phi : RawFunctionField k →+* L := actualFractionMap k f
  let aval := f (nV (comparisonA k).v)
  let hval := f (BV (comparisonA k).v (comparisonB k).v)
  have halign : RawLedgerAligned k phi q := by
    exact rawLedgerAligned_of_actualReducedMap_cells k f q hq hcells
  have haEval :
      evalR0 k (actualCoefficientMap k f) q
          (UniformMomentFiniteAlgebra.a k) = aval := by
    calc
      _ = f (comparisonEval k (UniformMomentFiniteAlgebra.a k)) :=
        DFunLike.congr_fun hsquare (UniformMomentFiniteAlgebra.a k)
      _ = aval := by rw [comparisonEval_a]
  have htwoa : 2 * aval ≠ 0 := by
    rw [haEval] at htwoaEval
    exact htwoaEval
  obtain ⟨s, p, hs, hp⟩ := exists_rawLedger_pairCoefficients k phi q halign
    hq hopen aval hval sigma hr1 hz1 hr2 hz2 hsigma htwoa
  refine ⟨s, p, ?_⟩
  apply original_detector_quadratic k phi
    (by
      dsimp only [phi, actualFractionMap]
      exact hf.comp (fractionEmbedding_injective k))
    q hopen (by simpa [phi, detectorOfChart] using hdetectorSource)
    s p hs hp

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FieldAmalgamation.exists_common_field
statement:
theorem exists_common_field
    {F L N : Type u} [Field F] [Field L] [Field N]
    (leftBase : F →+* L) (rightBase : F →+* N) :
    ∃ (E : Type u) (_ : Field E) (left : L →+* E) (right : N →+* E),
      Function.Injective left ∧ Function.Injective right ∧
        left.comp leftBase = right.comp rightBase
proof:
:= by
  letI : Algebra F L := leftBase.toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra F N := rightBase.toAlgebra
  let T := L ⊗[F] N
  let c : T →ₗ[F] L :=
    (TensorProduct.rid F L).toLinearMap.comp
      (TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id
        (TensorDifferenceAlgebraicity.scalarRetraction F N))
  have hc : c 1 = 1 := by
    change (TensorProduct.rid F L)
      ((TensorProduct.map (LinearMap.id : L →ₗ[F] L)
        (TensorDifferenceAlgebraicity.scalarRetraction F N))
          ((1 : L) ⊗ₜ[F] (1 : N))) = 1
    rw [TensorProduct.map_tmul]
    simp only [LinearMap.id_apply,
      TensorDifferenceAlgebraicity.scalarRetraction_one,
      TensorProduct.rid_tmul, one_smul]
  letI : Nontrivial T := ⟨⟨1, 0, by
    intro h
    have hz := congrArg c h
    rw [hc, map_zero] at hz
    exact one_ne_zero hz⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := Ideal.exists_maximal T
  letI : m.IsMaximal := hm
  let E := T ⧸ m
  letI : Field E := Ideal.Quotient.field m
  let q : T →+* E := Ideal.Quotient.mk m
  let il : L →ₐ[F] T := Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft (S := F)
  let ir : N →ₐ[F] T := Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight
  let left : L →+* E := q.comp il.toRingHom
  let right : N →+* E := q.comp ir.toRingHom
  refine ⟨E, inferInstance, left, right, left.injective, right.injective, ?_⟩
  ext x
  change q (il (algebraMap F L x)) = q (ir (algebraMap F N x))
  rw [il.commutes, ir.commutes]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.linear_eq_of_weightedBlock_eq
statement:
theorem linear_eq_of_weightedBlock_eq (A B : Vec6 K →ₗ[K] Vec6 K)
    (h : ∀ i j, weightedBlock A i j = weightedBlock B i j) : A = B
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  obtain ⟨a, b, hx⟩ := standard_spans (K := K) x
  rw [hx]
  simp only [map_add, map_sum, map_smul]
  congr 1 <;> apply Finset.sum_congr rfl <;> intro j hj <;> congr 1
  · funext q
    rcases q with i | i
    · have hij := congrFun (congrFun (h i j) 0) 0
      simpa [weightedBlock, weightedPairIndex, standardE] using hij
    · have hij := congrFun (congrFun (h i j) 1) 0
      simpa [weightedBlock, weightedPairIndex, standardE] using hij
  · funext q
    rcases q with i | i
    · have hij := congrFun (congrFun (h i j) 0) 1
      simpa [weightedBlock, weightedPairIndex, standardF] using hij
    · have hij := congrFun (congrFun (h i j) 1) 1
      simpa [weightedBlock, weightedPairIndex, standardF] using hij

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.weightedBlock_commonPlane_conjugate
statement:
theorem weightedBlock_commonPlane_conjugate
    (R T : Mat2 K) (B : Vec6 K →ₗ[K] Vec6 K) (i j : Fin 3) :
    weightedBlock ((commonPlaneMap R).comp (B.comp (commonPlaneMap T))) i j =
      R * weightedBlock B i j * T
proof:
:= by
  ext r s
  change (commonPlaneMap R)
      (B (commonPlaneMap T (basisVector (weightedPairIndex j s))))
      (weightedPairIndex i r) =
    (R * weightedBlock B i j * T) r s
  rw [commonPlaneMap_basis T j s]
  simp only [map_add, map_smul]
  fin_cases r <;> fin_cases s <;>
    simp [weightedBlock, weightedPairIndex, commonPlaneMap,
      Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, LinearMap.add_apply,
      LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] <;> ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.commonPlane_conjugates_operator_of_blocks
statement:
theorem commonPlane_conjugates_operator_of_blocks
    (B C : Vec6 K →ₗ[K] Vec6 K) (T S : Mat2 K)
    (hTS : T * S = 1) (hST : S * T = 1)
    (hblocks : ∀ i j, weightedBlock B i j =
      T * weightedBlock C i j * S) :
    (commonPlaneMap S).comp (B.comp (commonPlaneMap T)) = C
proof:
:= by
  apply linear_eq_of_weightedBlock_eq
  intro i j
  rw [weightedBlock_commonPlane_conjugate, hblocks]
  calc
    S * (T * weightedBlock C i j * S) * T =
        (S * T) * weightedBlock C i j * (S * T) := by
          simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = weightedBlock C i j := by rw [hST]; simp

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TauTransport.projector_toAlbert
statement:
theorem projector_toAlbert (x : AlbertLean.Coord) (i : Fin 3) :
    SecondStatement.projector (SecondStatement.toAlbert x) i =
      SecondStatement.toAlbert (AlbertLean.projector x i)
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i
  · change (2 : ℚ)⁻¹ •
        (SecondStatement.toAlbert x * SecondStatement.toAlbert x -
          SecondStatement.toAlbert x) =
      SecondStatement.toAlbert
        ((2 : ℚ)⁻¹ • (AlbertLean.structuredProduct x x - x))
    rw [toAlbert_smul, toAlbert_sub, toAlbert_product]
  · change 1 - SecondStatement.toAlbert x * SecondStatement.toAlbert x =
      SecondStatement.toAlbert
        (AlbertLean.one - AlbertLean.structuredProduct x x)
    rw [toAlbert_sub, toAlbert_one, toAlbert_product]
  · change (2 : ℚ)⁻¹ •
        (SecondStatement.toAlbert x * SecondStatement.toAlbert x +
          SecondStatement.toAlbert x) =
      SecondStatement.toAlbert
        ((2 : ℚ)⁻¹ • (AlbertLean.structuredProduct x x + x))
    rw [toAlbert_smul, toAlbert_add, toAlbert_product]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TauTransport.projectorPairing_toAlbert
statement:
theorem projectorPairing_toAlbert (x y : AlbertLean.Coord) (i j : Fin 3) :
    SecondStatement.pairing
        (SecondStatement.projector (SecondStatement.toAlbert x) i)
        (SecondStatement.projector (SecondStatement.toAlbert y) j) =
      AlbertLean.traceForm (AlbertLean.projector x i)
        (AlbertLean.projector y j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [projector_toAlbert, projector_toAlbert, pairing_toAlbert]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TauTransport.projectorJoint_toAlbert
statement:
theorem projectorJoint_toAlbert (x y z : AlbertLean.Coord)
    (i j l : Fin 3) :
    SecondStatement.pairing
        (SecondStatement.projector (SecondStatement.toAlbert x) i)
        (SecondStatement.projector (SecondStatement.toAlbert y) j *
          SecondStatement.projector (SecondStatement.toAlbert z) l) =
      AlbertLean.traceForm (AlbertLean.projector x i)
        (AlbertLean.structuredProduct (AlbertLean.projector y j)
          (AlbertLean.projector z l))
proof:
:= by
  rw [projector_toAlbert, projector_toAlbert, projector_toAlbert,
    ← toAlbert_product, pairing_toAlbert]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TauTransport.frame_toAlbert
statement:
theorem frame_toAlbert (x : AlbertLean.Coord)
    (h : AlbertLean.LawfulFrame x) : SecondStatement.Frame (SecondStatement.toAlbert x)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    constructor
    · rw [projector_toAlbert,
        ← toAlbert_product,
        (h.2.1 i).1]
    · rw [projector_toAlbert, tr_toAlbert]
      exact (h.2.1 i).2
  · intro i j hij
    rw [projector_toAlbert, projector_toAlbert, ← toAlbert_product,
      h.2.2.1 i j hij]
    exact toAlbertLinearEquiv.map_zero
  · rw [projector_toAlbert, projector_toAlbert, projector_toAlbert,
      ← toAlbert_add, ← toAlbert_add, h.2.2.2.1, toAlbert_one]
  · rw [projector_toAlbert, projector_toAlbert, ← toAlbert_sub,
      h.2.2.2.2]

statement: theorem ledgerCopy_injective : Function.Injective ledgerCopy

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TauTransport.ledger_mapTriple
statement:
theorem ledger_mapTriple (X : AlbertLean.WitnessTriple) :
    SecondStatement.ledger (mapTriple X) = ledgerCopy (AlbertLean.ledger X)
proof:
:= by
  rw [SecondStatement.Ledger.mk.injEq]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · funext i j
    exact projectorPairing_toAlbert X.cE X.cF i j
  · funext j l
    exact projectorPairing_toAlbert X.cF X.cK j l
  · funext l i
    exact projectorPairing_toAlbert X.cK X.cE l i
  · funext i j l
    change SecondStatement.pairing
          (SecondStatement.projector (SecondStatement.toAlbert X.cE) i)
          (SecondStatement.projector (SecondStatement.toAlbert X.cF) j *
            SecondStatement.projector (SecondStatement.toAlbert X.cK) l) -
          (SecondStatement.pairing
              (SecondStatement.projector (SecondStatement.toAlbert X.cE) i)
              (SecondStatement.projector (SecondStatement.toAlbert X.cF) j) +
            SecondStatement.pairing
              (SecondStatement.projector (SecondStatement.toAlbert X.cF) j)
              (SecondStatement.projector (SecondStatement.toAlbert X.cK) l) +
            SecondStatement.pairing
              (SecondStatement.projector (SecondStatement.toAlbert X.cK) l)
              (SecondStatement.projector (SecondStatement.toAlbert X.cE) i)) / 3 + 2 / 9 =
      AlbertLean.traceForm (AlbertLean.projector X.cE i)
          (AlbertLean.structuredProduct
            (AlbertLean.projector X.cF j)
            (AlbertLean.projector X.cK l)) -
          (AlbertLean.traceForm (AlbertLean.projector X.cE i)
              (AlbertLean.projector X.cF j) +
            AlbertLean.traceForm (AlbertLean.projector X.cF j)
              (AlbertLean.projector X.cK l) +
            AlbertLean.traceForm (AlbertLean.projector X.cK l)
              (AlbertLean.projector X.cE i)) / 3 + 2 / 9
    rw [projectorJoint_toAlbert,
      projectorPairing_toAlbert X.cE X.cF,
      projectorPairing_toAlbert X.cF X.cK,
      projectorPairing_toAlbert X.cK X.cE]

    ← toAlbert_product X.cF X.cK,

    ← toAlbert_product X.cE X.cK,
    ← toAlbert_product X.cF (AlbertLean.structuredProduct X.cE X.cK),
    ← toAlbert_sub]
  rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TauTransport.pushAut_transports
statement:
theorem pushAut_transports (g : AlbertLean.JordanAut)
    (X Y : AlbertLean.WitnessTriple) (h : AlbertLean.Transports g X Y) :
    SecondStatement.Transports (pushAut g) (mapTriple X) (mapTriple Y)
proof:
:= by
  intro r
  change pushLinear g (SecondStatement.toAlbert (AlbertLean.encoder X r)) =
    SecondStatement.toAlbert (AlbertLean.encoder Y r)
  rw [pushLinear_toAlbert]
  exact congrArg SecondStatement.toAlbert
    (AlbertLean.map_encoder_of_transports g X Y h r)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TauTransport.pullAut_transports
statement:
theorem pullAut_transports (g : SecondStatement.Aut) (X Y : AlbertLean.WitnessTriple)
    (h : SecondStatement.Transports g (mapTriple X) (mapTriple Y)) :
    AlbertLean.Transports (pullAut g) X Y
proof:
:= by
  have hr (r : Fin 3) :
      pullLinear g (AlbertLean.encoder X r) = AlbertLean.encoder Y r := by
    apply toAlbertLinearEquiv.injective
    change SecondStatement.toAlbert (pullLinear g (AlbertLean.encoder X r)) =
      SecondStatement.toAlbert (AlbertLean.encoder Y r)
    rw [toAlbert_pullLinear]
    simpa only [mapTriple] using h r
  exact ⟨hr 0, hr 1, hr 2⟩

      AlbertLean.FullRelated X Y
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨g, hg⟩
    exact ⟨pullAut g, pullAut_transports g X Y hg⟩
  · rintro ⟨g, hg⟩
    exact ⟨pushAut g, pushAut_transports g X Y hg⟩

name: AlbertLean.Triality.RationalEvenFamilyFixedBranch.familyAut_linear_eq_fixed_center
statement:
theorem familyAut_linear_eq_fixed_center
    (A B : VCoord K) (rho : K)
    (hA : nV A ≠ 0) (hB : nV B ≠ 0) (hBr : B.r ≠ 0)
    (hrho : rho ^ 2 = nV A * nV B) (hrho0 : rho ≠ 0) :
    (familyAut A hA B.r B.omega rho hBr hrho0).linear =
      (sourceEvenAut A B rho hA hB hrho hrho0).linear
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearEquiv.ext
  intro x
  unfold familyAut
  have hc : center (nV A) B.r B.omega rho = B :=
    center_eq (nV A) B rho hA hBr hrho
  change
    evenJEquiv A (center (nV A) B.r B.omega rho) rho hA _ _ hrho0 x =
      evenJEquiv A B rho hA hB hrho hrho0 x
  rw [evenJEquiv_apply, evenJEquiv_apply]
  rw [hc]

name: AlbertLean.Triality.RationalEvenFamilyFixedBranch.two_familyAut_apply_eq_fixed_centers
statement:
theorem two_familyAut_apply_eq_fixed_centers
    (A1 B1 A2 B2 : VCoord K) (rho1 rho2 : K)
    (hA1 : nV A1 ≠ 0) (hB1 : nV B1 ≠ 0) (hB1r : B1.r ≠ 0)
    (hroot1 : rho1 ^ 2 = nV A1 * nV B1) (hrho1 : rho1 ≠ 0)
    (hA2 : nV A2 ≠ 0) (hB2 : nV B2 ≠ 0) (hB2r : B2.r ≠ 0)
    (hroot2 : rho2 ^ 2 = nV A2 * nV B2) (hrho2 : rho2 ≠ 0)
    (x : JCoord K) :
    (familyAut A2 hA2 B2.r B2.omega rho2 hB2r hrho2).linear
        ((familyAut A1 hA1 B1.r B1.omega rho1 hB1r hrho1).linear x) =
      (sourceEvenAut A2 B2 rho2 hA2 hB2 hroot2 hrho2).linear
        ((sourceEvenAut A1 B1 rho1 hA1 hB1 hroot1 hrho1).linear x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [familyAut_linear_eq_fixed_center A1 B1 rho1 hA1 hB1 hB1r hroot1 hrho1,
    familyAut_linear_eq_fixed_center A2 B2 rho2 hA2 hB2 hB2r hroot2 hrho2]

name: AlbertLean.Triality.RationalEvenFamilyFixedBranch.differenceB1_norm

name: AlbertLean.Triality.RationalEvenFamilyFixedBranch.differenceB2_r
statement:
theorem differenceB2_r (a h sigma : K) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    (differenceB2 a h sigma).r = sigma / a
proof:
:= by
  change (-2 : K) * (targetRemainder a h sigma).r = sigma / a
  rw [targetRemainder_eq a h sigma ha]
  change (-2 : K) * (-sigma / (2 * a)) = sigma / a
  field_simp [ha]

name: AlbertLean.Triality.RationalEvenFamilyFixedBranch.differenceB2_norm
statement:
theorem differenceB2_norm (a h sigma : K) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    nV (differenceB2 a h sigma) = -(sigma ^ 2) / a
proof:
:= by
  rw [differenceB2, nV_smul, targetRemainder_norm a h sigma ha]

name: AlbertLean.Triality.RationalEvenFamilyFixedBranch.difference_centers_nonzero_r
statement:
theorem difference_centers_nonzero_r (a h sigma : K)
    (ha : a ≠ 0) (hsigma : sigma ≠ 0) :
    (differenceB1 a).r ≠ 0 ∧ (differenceB2 a h sigma).r ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [differenceB1_r]
    norm_num
  · rw [differenceB2_r a h sigma ha]
    exact div_ne_zero hsigma ha

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.InvariantField.genericCarrier_eq_mappedRoot
statement:
private theorem genericCarrier_eq_mappedRoot
    {K L : Type u} [Field K] [CharZero K] [Field L] [CharZero L]
    (phi : FF k →+* K) (j : K →+* L) (ell : Root k →+* L)
    (hsquare : j.comp phi = ell.comp (rootFractionEmbedding k))
    (r i : Fin 3) :
    genericCarrierAlong k L (j.comp phi) r i = mappedRootCarrier k L ell r i
proof:
:= by
  have hcoords : RawScalarTransport.genericPointAlong k L (j.comp phi) r i =
      ell ∘ encode (rootCarrier k r i) := by
    funext c
    change (j.comp phi)
        (RawScalarTransport.rawToFunction k (RawFrameIdeal.universalPoint k r i c)) =
      ell (encode (rootCarrier k r i) c)
    rw [DFunLike.congr_fun hsquare
      (RawScalarTransport.rawToFunction k (RawFrameIdeal.universalPoint k r i c))]
    exact congrArg ell (root_raw_coordinate_apply k r i c)
  apply Subtype.ext
  change RawFrameIdeal.ringMatrix
      (RawScalarTransport.genericPointAlong k L (j.comp phi) r i) =
    ell.mapMatrix (rootCarrier k r i : Mat6 (Root k))
  rw [hcoords, ← GSpFinalAgreement.map_ringMatrix_of_coordinates]
  apply congrArg ell.mapMatrix
  change (decode (encode (rootCarrier k r i)) : Mat6 (Root k)) =
    (rootCarrier k r i : Mat6 (Root k))
  rw [decode_encode]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.InvariantField.agree_at_of_ledger_agreement
statement:
theorem agree_at_of_ledger_agreement
    (f : FF k) (hf : f ∈ ordinaryInvariantField k)
    (K : Type u) [Field K] (phi psi : FF k →+* K)
    (hagree : ∀ x : ledgerField k, phi (x : FF k) = psi (x : FF k)) :
    phi f = psi f
proof:
:= by
  letI : CharZero K :=
    FiniteQuadraticRoots.charZero_of_embedding (phi.comp (scalarMap k))
  have hscalar : ∀ a : k, phi (scalarMap k a) = psi (scalarMap k a) := by
    intro a
    exact hagree ⟨scalarMap k a, scalarMap_mem_ledgerField k a⟩
  have hcells : ∀ q : LedgerIndex, phi (ledgerCell k q) = psi (ledgerCell k q) := by
    intro q
    exact hagree ⟨ledgerCell k q, ledgerCell_mem_ledgerField k q⟩
  have hcoeff := (genericData_agreement k K phi psi hscalar hcells).1
  obtain ⟨L, instL, j, ell, _hj, _hell, hsquare⟩ :=
    FieldAmalgamation.exists_common_field phi (rootFractionEmbedding k)
  letI : Field L := instL
  letI : CharZero L := FiniteQuadraticRoots.charZero_of_embedding j
  have hleft (r i : Fin 3) :
      genericCarrierAlong k L (j.comp phi) r i = mappedRootCarrier k L ell r i :=
    genericCarrier_eq_mappedRoot k phi j ell hsquare r i
  have hledger := (genericData_agreement k L (j.comp phi) (j.comp psi)
    (fun a => congrArg j (hscalar a))
    (fun q => congrArg j (hcells q))).2
  change ActualSplitThirdFrameAut.carrierLedger
      (fun i => genericCarrierAlong k L (j.comp phi) 0 i)
      (fun i => genericCarrierAlong k L (j.comp phi) 1 i)
      (fun i => genericCarrierAlong k L (j.comp phi) 2 i) =
    ActualSplitThirdFrameAut.carrierLedger
      (fun i => genericCarrierAlong k L (j.comp psi) 0 i)
      (fun i => genericCarrierAlong k L (j.comp psi) 1 i)
      (fun i => genericCarrierAlong k L (j.comp psi) 2 i) at hledger
  simp only [hleft] at hledger
  obtain ⟨hEi, hEt, hEs⟩ := genericCarrierAlong_laws k L (j.comp psi) 0
  obtain ⟨hFi, hFt, hFs⟩ := genericCarrierAlong_laws k L (j.comp psi) 1
  obtain ⟨hPi, hPt, hPs⟩ := genericCarrierAlong_laws k L (j.comp psi) 2
  obtain ⟨M, N, mu, hMN, hNM, hmu, hform, hE, hF, hP⟩ :=
    exists_mapped_template_gsp k L ell
      (fun i => genericCarrierAlong k L (j.comp psi) 0 i)
      (fun i => genericCarrierAlong k L (j.comp psi) 1 i)
      (fun i => genericCarrierAlong k L (j.comp psi) 2 i)
      hEi hEt hEs hFi hFt hFs hPi hPt hPs hledger
  have hpoint : ∀ r i,
      M * RawFrameIdeal.ringMatrix
          (RawScalarTransport.genericPointAlong k L (j.comp phi) r i) * N =
        RawFrameIdeal.ringMatrix
          (RawScalarTransport.genericPointAlong k L (j.comp psi) r i) := by
    intro r i
    change M * (genericCarrierAlong k L (j.comp phi) r i : Mat6 L) * N =
      (genericCarrierAlong k L (j.comp psi) r i : Mat6 L)
    rw [hleft]
    fin_cases r
    · exact hE i
    · exact hF i
    · exact hP i
  exact InvariantPointAgreement.invariant_agreement_of_GSp_after_embedding
    k phi psi j M N mu hMN hNM hmu hform hcoeff hpoint f hf

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.InvariantField.ordinaryInvariantField_le_ledgerField
statement:
theorem ordinaryInvariantField_le_ledgerField :
    ordinaryInvariantField k ≤ ledgerField k
proof:
:= by
  intro f hf
  obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := FieldPointNilpotence.exists_base_of_field_embedding_agreement
    (ledgerField k) (FF k) f (by
      intro K instK phi psi hbase
      letI : Field K := instK
      apply agree_at_of_ledger_agreement k f hf K phi psi
      intro x
      exact hbase x)
  rw [← hh]
  change (h : FF k) ∈ ledgerField k
  exact h.property

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.InvariantField.ordinaryInvariantField_eq_ledgerField
statement:
theorem ordinaryInvariantField_eq_ledgerField :
    ordinaryInvariantField k = ledgerField k
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact ordinaryInvariantField_le_ledgerField k
  · exact RawLedger.ledgerField_le_ordinaryInvariantField k

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceSpectralFrames.projector_laws_of_cubic
statement:
theorem projector_laws_of_cubic (x : JCoord K)
    (h3 : sourceProduct x (sourceProduct x x) = x)
    (hT : sourceTrace x = 0)
    (hT2 : sourceTrace (sourceProduct x x) = 2) :
    SourceFrameLaws.Laws (sourceProjector x)
proof:
:= by
  have h4 : sourceProduct (sourceProduct x x) (sourceProduct x x) =
      sourceProduct x x := by
    rw [sourceJordanIdentity x x, h3]
  have h3' : sourceProduct (sourceProduct x x) x = x := by
    rw [sourceProduct_comm, h3]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    fin_cases i
    · change sourceProductLinear
        ((2 : K)⁻¹ • (sourceProduct x x - x))
        ((2 : K)⁻¹ • (sourceProduct x x - x)) =
        (2 : K)⁻¹ • (sourceProduct x x - x)
      simp only [map_smul, map_sub, LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.sub_apply,
        sourceProductLinear_apply, h4, h3, h3']
      module
    · change sourceProductLinear (sourceOne - sourceProduct x x)
        (sourceOne - sourceProduct x x) = sourceOne - sourceProduct x x
      simp only [map_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply, sourceProductLinear_apply,
        sourceProduct_one_left, sourceProduct_one_right, h4]
      module
    · change sourceProductLinear
        ((2 : K)⁻¹ • (sourceProduct x x + x))
        ((2 : K)⁻¹ • (sourceProduct x x + x)) =
        (2 : K)⁻¹ • (sourceProduct x x + x)
      simp only [map_smul, map_add, LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.add_apply,
        sourceProductLinear_apply, h4, h3, h3']
      module
  · intro i
    fin_cases i
    · change sourceTraceLinear ((2 : K)⁻¹ • (sourceProduct x x - x)) = 1
      simp only [map_smul, map_sub, map_add]
      norm_num [sourceTraceLinear_apply, hT, hT2]
    · change sourceTraceLinear (sourceOne - sourceProduct x x) = 1
      simp only [map_sub]
      norm_num [sourceTraceLinear_apply, sourceTrace_one, hT2]
    · change sourceTraceLinear ((2 : K)⁻¹ • (sourceProduct x x + x)) = 1
      simp only [map_smul, map_sub, map_add]
      norm_num [sourceTraceLinear_apply, hT, hT2]
  · change (2 : K)⁻¹ • (sourceProduct x x - x) +
      (sourceOne - sourceProduct x x) +
      (2 : K)⁻¹ • (sourceProduct x x + x) = sourceOne
    module

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceSpectralFrames.projector_laws_of_fixed_spectrum
statement:
theorem projector_laws_of_fixed_spectrum (x : JCoord K)
    (hT : sourceTrace x = 0) (hS : sourceSpur x = -1) (hN : sourceNorm x = 0) :
    SourceFrameLaws.Laws (sourceProjector x)
proof:
:= by
  apply projector_laws_of_cubic x (cubic_of_fixed_spectrum x hT hS hN) hT
  rw [trace_square, hT, hS]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceSpectralFrames.inserted_chart_frames
statement:
theorem inserted_chart_frames (p : GenericNormalizedFrameChart.OpenParameters K) :
    SourceFrameLaws.Laws (sourceProjector
      (AlbertLean.Residual.FrameIdeal.encoderA (GenericNormalizedFrameChart.insert p))) ∧
    SourceFrameLaws.Laws (sourceProjector
      (AlbertLean.Residual.FrameIdeal.encoderB (GenericNormalizedFrameChart.insert p)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ha, hsa, hna, hb, hsb, hnb⟩ :=
    GenericNormalizedFrameChart.insert_source_fixedSpectrum p
  exact ⟨projector_laws_of_fixed_spectrum _ ha hsa hna,
    projector_laws_of_fixed_spectrum _ hb hsb hnb⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceRawScalarTransport.polynomialCoefficientMap_C
statement:
@[simp] theorem polynomialCoefficientMap_C (κ : k →+* K) (a : k) :
    polynomialCoefficientMap k K κ (MvPolynomial.C a) = MvPolynomial.C (κ a)
proof:
:= by

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceRawScalarTransport.polynomialCoefficientMap_X
statement:

    polynomialCoefficientMap k K κ (MvPolynomial.X q) = MvPolynomial.X q
proof:
:= by

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceRawScalarTransport.polynomialCoefficientMap_universalVector
statement:
@[simp] theorem polynomialCoefficientMap_universalVector (κ : k →+* K)
    (r i : Fin 3) (c : Fin 27) :
    polynomialCoefficientMap k K κ (universalVector (k := k) r i c) =
      universalVector (k := K) r i c
proof:
:= by

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceRawScalarTransport.map_productCoordinate
statement:
private theorem map_productCoordinate (κ : k →+* K)
    (x y : Fin 27 → CR k) (c : Fin 27) :
    polynomialCoefficientMap k K κ (productCoordinate x y c) =
      productCoordinate (polynomialCoefficientMap k K κ ∘ x)
        (polynomialCoefficientMap k K κ ∘ y) c
proof:
:= by
  simp [productCoordinate, polynomialCoefficientMap, Function.comp_apply]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceRawScalarTransport.polynomialCoefficientMap_equation
statement:
theorem polynomialCoefficientMap_equation (κ : k →+* K) (q : EquationIndex) :
    polynomialCoefficientMap k K κ (equation (k := k) q) =
      equation (k := K) q
proof:
:= by
  cases q with
  | idempotence r i c =>
      simp only [equation, map_sub, map_productCoordinate,
        polynomialCoefficientMap_universalVector]
      have hpoint : polynomialCoefficientMap k K κ ∘ universalVector r i =
          universalVector (k := K) r i := by
        funext d
        exact polynomialCoefficientMap_universalVector k K κ r i d
      rw [hpoint]
  | traceOne r i =>
      simp [equation, polynomialCoefficientMap_universalVector]
  | sumOne r c =>
      simp [equation, unitCoordinate, polynomialCoefficientMap_universalVector]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceRawScalarTransport.rawFrameIdeal_le_comap
statement:
theorem rawFrameIdeal_le_comap (κ : k →+* K) :
    rawFrameIdeal (k := k) ≤
      (rawFrameIdeal (k := K)).comap (polynomialCoefficientMap k K κ)
proof:
:= by
  apply Ideal.span_le.2
  rintro x ⟨q, rfl⟩
  change polynomialCoefficientMap k K κ (equation (k := k) q) ∈ rawFrameIdeal (k := K)
  rw [polynomialCoefficientMap_equation]
  exact Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self q)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceRawScalarTransport.rawFrameRadical_le_comap
statement:
theorem rawFrameRadical_le_comap (κ : k →+* K) :
    (rawFrameIdeal (k := k)).radical ≤
      (rawFrameIdeal (k := K)).radical.comap (polynomialCoefficientMap k K κ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.comap_radical]
  exact Ideal.radical_mono (rawFrameIdeal_le_comap k K κ)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceRawScalarTransport.reducedCoefficientMapOf_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem reducedCoefficientMapOf_mk (κ : k →+* K) (x : CR k) :
    reducedCoefficientMapOf k K κ (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ x) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (polynomialCoefficientMap k K κ x)
proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceRawScalarTransport.rawToFunction_eq_zero_of_mem
statement:
theorem rawToFunction_eq_zero_of_mem (x : CR k)
    (hx : x ∈ (rawFrameIdeal (k := k)).radical) : rawToFunction k x = 0
proof:
:= by
  change algebraMap (RR k) (FF k) (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ x) = 0
  rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr hx, map_zero]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceRawScalarTransport.polynomial_evaluation_square
statement:
theorem polynomial_evaluation_square :
    (polynomialEvaluation k K φ).comp
        (polynomialCoefficientMap k K (originalCoefficientEmbedding k K φ)) =
      φ.comp (rawToFunction k)
proof:
:= by
  apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
  · intro a
    simp [polynomialEvaluation, polynomialCoefficientMap,
      originalCoefficientEmbedding, evaluationAlong]
  · intro q
    cases q with
    | entry r i c =>
      simp [polynomialEvaluation, polynomialCoefficientMap, genericPointAlong,
        evaluationAlong, universalVector]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceRawScalarTransport.rawFrameIdeal_le_evaluationKer
statement:
theorem rawFrameIdeal_le_evaluationKer :
    rawFrameIdeal (k := K) ≤ RingHom.ker (polynomialEvaluation k K φ)
proof:
:= by
  apply Ideal.span_le.2
  rintro x ⟨q, rfl⟩
  apply RingHom.mem_ker.mpr
  rw [← polynomialCoefficientMap_equation k K
    (originalCoefficientEmbedding k K φ) q]
  change
    ((polynomialEvaluation k K φ).comp
      (polynomialCoefficientMap k K (originalCoefficientEmbedding k K φ)))
        (equation (k := k) q) = 0
  rw [DFunLike.congr_fun (polynomial_evaluation_square k K φ) (equation (k := k) q)]
  rw [RingHom.comp_apply]
  rw [rawToFunction_eq_zero_of_mem k (equation (k := k) q)
    (Ideal.le_radical (Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self q))), map_zero]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceRawScalarTransport.rawFrameRadical_le_evaluationKer
statement:
theorem rawFrameRadical_le_evaluationKer :
    (rawFrameIdeal (k := K)).radical ≤
      RingHom.ker (polynomialEvaluation k K φ)
proof:
:= by
  exact ((RingHom.ker_isPrime (polynomialEvaluation k K φ)).isRadical.radical_le_iff).2
    (rawFrameIdeal_le_evaluationKer k K φ)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceRawScalarTransport.evaluation_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem evaluation_mk (x : CR K) :
    evaluation k K φ (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ x) = polynomialEvaluation k K φ x
proof:
:=
  Ideal.Quotient.lift_mk _ _ _

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceRawScalarTransport.reduced_evaluation_square
statement:
theorem reduced_evaluation_square :
    (evaluation k K φ).comp (reducedCoefficientMap k K φ) =
      φ.comp (reducedInclusion k)
proof:
:= by
  apply Ideal.Quotient.ringHom_ext
  apply DFunLike.ext _ _
  intro x
  simp only [RingHom.comp_apply]
  rw [reducedCoefficientMap, reducedCoefficientMapOf_mk, evaluation_mk]
  change polynomialEvaluation k K φ
      (polynomialCoefficientMap k K (originalCoefficientEmbedding k K φ) x) =
    φ (rawToFunction k x)
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun (polynomial_evaluation_square k K φ) x

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceRawScalarTransport.reducedCoefficientMap_injective
statement:
theorem reducedCoefficientMap_injective :
    Function.Injective (reducedCoefficientMap k K φ)
proof:
:= by
  exact injective_of_evaluation_square
    (reducedInclusion k) (IsFractionRing.injective _ _)
    (reducedCoefficientMap k K φ) (evaluation k K φ) φ
    (reduced_evaluation_square k K φ)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceRawScalarTransport.reducedCoefficientMap_ne_zero
statement:
theorem reducedCoefficientMap_ne_zero (b : RR k)
    (hb : reducedInclusion k b ≠ 0) :
    reducedCoefficientMap k K φ b ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hb0 : b ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hb
    rw [h, map_zero]
  simpa only [map_zero] using (reducedCoefficientMap_injective k K φ).ne hb0

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceRawScalarTransport.evaluation_reducedCoefficientMap_ne_zero
statement:
theorem evaluation_reducedCoefficientMap_ne_zero (b : RR k)
    (hb : reducedInclusion k b ≠ 0) :
    evaluation k K φ (reducedCoefficientMap k K φ b) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  change ((evaluation k K φ).comp (reducedCoefficientMap k K φ)) b ≠ 0
  rw [DFunLike.congr_fun (reduced_evaluation_square k K φ) b]
  rw [RingHom.comp_apply]
  simpa only [map_zero] using φ.injective.ne hb

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericDeterminantOpen.witnessEval_N
statement:
theorem witnessEval_N : (N k).map (witnessEval k) =
    Matrix.diagonal ![-1, -2, -1, -2]
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [N, nA0, nA2, nB1, nB3, TA, TB, SA, SB, PA, PB, dA2, dB2,
      dA0, dA1, dB0, dB1, a, b, c, off, offX, diagX, gaugeX, x,
      witnessEval, witnessValue] <;> norm_num

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericDeterminantOpen.witnessEval_detN
statement: theorem witnessEval_detN : witnessEval k (Matrix.det (N k)) = 4
proof:
:= by
  rw [RingHom.map_det]
  change Matrix.det ((N k).map (witnessEval k)) = 4
  rw [witnessEval_N]
  norm_num [Matrix.det_diagonal, Fin.prod_univ_succ]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericDeterminantOpen.detN_ne_zero
statement: theorem detN_ne_zero : Matrix.det (N k) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have := congrArg (witnessEval k) h
  rw [witnessEval_detN] at this
  norm_num at this

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericDeterminantOpen.iota_injective
statement: theorem iota_injective : Function.Injective (ι k)
proof:
:=
  IsFractionRing.injective (R k) (B k)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericDeterminantOpen.iota_ne_zero
statement: private theorem iota_ne_zero {p : R k} (hp : p ≠ 0) : ι k p ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply hp
  apply iota_injective k
  simpa only [map_zero] using h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericDeterminantOpen.mapped_detN_ne_zero
statement: theorem mapped_detN_ne_zero : ι k (Matrix.det (N k)) ≠ 0

:=
  iota_ne_zero k (detN_ne_zero k)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericDeterminantOpen.PA_ne_zero
statement: theorem PA_ne_zero : ι k (PA k) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  apply iota_ne_zero k
  intro h
  have hh := congrArg (witnessEval k) h
  norm_num [PA, dA2, dA1, dA0, diagX, x, witnessEval, witnessValue] at hh

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericDeterminantOpen.PB_ne_zero
statement: theorem PB_ne_zero : ι k (PB k) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  apply iota_ne_zero k
  intro h
  have hh := congrArg (witnessEval k) h
  simp [PB, dB2, dB1, dB0, diagX, x, witnessEval, witnessValue] at hh

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericDeterminantOpen.rowScale_mul_rationalM
statement: theorem rowScale_mul_rationalM : rowScale k * rationalM k = (N k).map (ι k)
proof:
:= by
  have ha := PA_ne_zero k
  have hb := PB_ne_zero k
  simp only [ι] at ha hb
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [rowScale, rowPivot, rationalM, N, ι, Matrix.mul_apply,
      Fin.sum_univ_succ, mul_div_cancel₀ _ ha, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hb]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericDeterminantOpen.det_rationalM_ne_zero
statement: theorem det_rationalM_ne_zero : Matrix.det (rationalM k) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply mapped_detN_ne_zero k
  rw [RingHom.map_det]
  change Matrix.det ((N k).map (ι k)) = 0
  rw [← rowScale_mul_rationalM, Matrix.det_mul, h, mul_zero]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3JordanFractionAction.fractionAction_algebraMap_reduced
statement:
@[simp] theorem fractionAction_algebraMap_reduced (g : Aut (K := k))
    (x : ReducedCoordinateRing k) :
    fractionAction k g (algebraMap (ReducedCoordinateRing k) (FunctionField k) x) =
      algebraMap (ReducedCoordinateRing k) (FunctionField k) (reducedAction k g x)

:=
  IsFractionRing.ringEquivOfRingEquiv_algebraMap (reducedAction k g) x

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3JordanFractionAction.fractionAction_scalar
statement:
@[simp] theorem fractionAction_scalar (g : Aut (K := k)) (c : k) :
    fractionAction k g (scalarMap k c) = scalarMap k c
proof:
:= by
  rw [show scalarMap k c =
      algebraMap (ReducedCoordinateRing k) (FunctionField k)
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (MvPolynomial.C c)) from rfl]
  rw [fractionAction_algebraMap_reduced]
  change algebraMap (ReducedCoordinateRing k) (FunctionField k)
    (reducedActionHom k g (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (MvPolynomial.C c))) = _
