name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3JordanFractionAction.fractionAction_universalFamily
statement:
theorem fractionAction_universalFamily (g : Aut (K := k)) (r i : Fin 3) :
    (fractionAction k g).toRingHom.mapMatrix (universalFamily k r i) =
      (algebraMap (ReducedCoordinateRing k) (FunctionField k)).mapMatrix
        (transformedFamily k g r i)
proof:
:= by
  ext a b
  rw [universalFamily, RingHom.mapMatrix_apply, RingHom.mapMatrix_apply]
  change fractionAction k g
      (algebraMap (ReducedCoordinateRing k) (FunctionField k)
        (reducedUniversalFamily k r i a b)) = _
  rw [fractionAction_algebraMap_reduced]
  change algebraMap (ReducedCoordinateRing k) (FunctionField k)
    (reducedActionHom k g (reducedUniversalFamily k r i a b)) = _
  rw [reducedActionHom_universalMatrix]
  rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedInverseCoordinates.finiteOmega_eq_omega
statement:
private theorem finiteOmega_eq_omega (x y : Vec6 K) :
    finiteOmega x y = (omega (K := K)) x y
proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedInverseCoordinates.weightedCoordinateEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
theorem weightedCoordinateEquiv_symm_apply
    (E : Fin 3 → Carrier K)
    (hEidem : ∀ i, (E i : Mat6 K) * E i = E i)
    (hEsum : (E 0 : Mat6 K) + E 1 + E 2 = 1)
    (u v : Vec6 K) (p : Fin 3 → K)
    (hp : ∀ i, p i = (omega (K := K))
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u)
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v))
    (hpne : ∀ i, p i ≠ 0) (w : Vec6 K) (i : Fin 3) :
    let L
proof:
:= weightedCoordinateEquiv E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne
    (L.symm w) (Sum.inl i) =
        -((omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v) w) * (p i)⁻¹ ∧
      (L.symm w) (Sum.inr i) =
        (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u) w * (p i)⁻¹ := by
  dsimp only
  let L := weightedCoordinateEquiv E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne
  have h := weighted_pairing_extract_reverse E hEidem hEsum u v p hp
    (L.symm w) i
  change
    (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u) (L (L.symm w)) =
        (L.symm w) (Sum.inr i) * p i ∧
      (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v) (L (L.symm w)) =
        -((L.symm w) (Sum.inl i) * p i) at h
  rw [L.apply_symm_apply] at h
  have hleft :
      -((omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v) w) =
        (L.symm w) (Sum.inl i) * p i := by
    calc
      -((omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v) w) =
          -(-((L.symm w) (Sum.inl i) * p i)) := congrArg Neg.neg h.2
      _ = (L.symm w) (Sum.inl i) * p i := neg_neg _
  constructor
  · calc
      (L.symm w) (Sum.inl i) = (L.symm w) (Sum.inl i) * 1 :=
        (mul_one _).symm
      _ = (L.symm w) (Sum.inl i) * (p i * (p i)⁻¹) := by
        rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ (hpne i)]
      _ = ((L.symm w) (Sum.inl i) * p i) * (p i)⁻¹ := by
        rw [mul_assoc]
      _ = -((omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v) w) *
          (p i)⁻¹ := by rw [← hleft]
  · calc
      (L.symm w) (Sum.inr i) = (L.symm w) (Sum.inr i) * 1 :=
        (mul_one _).symm
      _ = (L.symm w) (Sum.inr i) * (p i * (p i)⁻¹) := by
        rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ (hpne i)]
      _ = ((L.symm w) (Sum.inr i) * p i) * (p i)⁻¹ := by
        rw [mul_assoc]
      _ = (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u) w *
          (p i)⁻¹ := by rw [← h.1]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedInverseCoordinates.weightedCoordinateEquiv_symm_eq_formula
statement:
theorem weightedCoordinateEquiv_symm_eq_formula
    (E : Fin 3 → Carrier K)
    (hEidem : ∀ i, (E i : Mat6 K) * E i = E i)
    (hEsum : (E 0 : Mat6 K) + E 1 + E 2 = 1)
    (u v : Vec6 K) (p : Fin 3 → K)
    (hp : ∀ i, p i = (omega (K := K))
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u)
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v))
    (hpne : ∀ i, p i ≠ 0) (w : Vec6 K) :
    let L
proof:
:= weightedCoordinateEquiv E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne
    L.symm w = weightedInverseFormula
      (fun i => matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u)
      (fun i => matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v)
      (fun i => (p i)⁻¹) w := by
  dsimp only
  funext q
  rcases q with i | i
  · rw [(weightedCoordinateEquiv_symm_apply E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne w i).1]
    simp only [weightedInverseFormula, finiteOmega_eq_omega]
  · rw [(weightedCoordinateEquiv_symm_apply E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne w i).2]
    simp only [weightedInverseFormula, finiteOmega_eq_omega]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedInverseCoordinates.weightedCoordinateEquiv_apply_eq_formula
statement:
private theorem weightedCoordinateEquiv_apply_eq_formula
    (E : Fin 3 → Carrier K)
    (hEidem : ∀ i, (E i : Mat6 K) * E i = E i)
    (hEsum : (E 0 : Mat6 K) + E 1 + E 2 = 1)
    (u v : Vec6 K) (p : Fin 3 → K)
    (hp : ∀ i, p i = (omega (K := K))
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u)
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v))
    (hpne : ∀ i, p i ≠ 0) (z : Vec6 K) :
    let L
proof:
:= weightedCoordinateEquiv E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne
    L z = weightedForwardFormula
      (fun i => matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u)
      (fun i => matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v) z := by
  dsimp only
  change weightedCoordinateLinear E u v z = weightedForwardFormula
    (fun i => matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u)
    (fun i => matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v) z
  funext q
  change
    ((∑ i, z (Sum.inl i) • matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u) +
      ∑ i, z (Sum.inr i) • matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v) q =
      (∑ i, z (Sum.inl i) * matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u q) +
        ∑ i, z (Sum.inr i) * matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v q
  simp only [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.add_apply, smul_eq_mul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedInverseCoordinates.coordinateConjugate_eq_formula
statement:
theorem coordinateConjugate_eq_formula
    (E : Fin 3 → Carrier K)
    (hEidem : ∀ i, (E i : Mat6 K) * E i = E i)
    (hEsum : (E 0 : Mat6 K) + E 1 + E 2 = 1)
    (u v : Vec6 K) (p : Fin 3 → K)
    (hp : ∀ i, p i = (omega (K := K))
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u)
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v))
    (hpne : ∀ i, p i ≠ 0) (T : Vec6 K →ₗ[K] Vec6 K) (z : Vec6 K) :
    let L
proof:
:= weightedCoordinateEquiv E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne
    coordinateConjugate L T z = coordinateConjugateFormula
      (fun i => matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u)
      (fun i => matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v)
      (fun i => (p i)⁻¹) T z := by
  dsimp only
  let L := weightedCoordinateEquiv E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne
  rw [show coordinateConjugate L T z = L.symm (T (L z)) by
    rfl]
  rw [weightedCoordinateEquiv_symm_eq_formula E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne]
  rw [weightedCoordinateEquiv_apply_eq_formula E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne]
  rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedInverseCoordinates.pivotBlock_entry_eq_formula
statement:
theorem pivotBlock_entry_eq_formula
    (E : Fin 3 → Carrier K)
    (hEidem : ∀ i, (E i : Mat6 K) * E i = E i)
    (hEsum : (E 0 : Mat6 K) + E 1 + E 2 = 1)
    (u v : Vec6 K) (p : Fin 3 → K)
    (hp : ∀ i, p i = (omega (K := K))
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u)
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v))
    (hpne : ∀ i, p i ≠ 0) (F1 : Carrier K) (r s : Fin 2) :
    let L
proof:
:= weightedCoordinateEquiv E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne
    weightedBlock (coordinateConjugate L (matrixAction (F1 : Mat6 K))) 0 1 r s =
      coordinateConjugateFormula
        (fun i => matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u)
        (fun i => matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v)
        (fun i => (p i)⁻¹) (matrixAction (F1 : Mat6 K))
        (basisVector (weightedPairIndex 1 s)) (weightedPairIndex 0 r) := by
  dsimp only
  exact congrFun
    (coordinateConjugate_eq_formula E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne
      (matrixAction (F1 : Mat6 K)) (basisVector (weightedPairIndex 1 s)))
    (weightedPairIndex 0 r)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertActualRawChartPoint.rawFamily_isRaw
statement:
theorem rawFamily_isRaw (q : ExplicitFrameChart K)
    (hq : EquationsVanish (explicitFrameEquationValues q)) :
    IsRawFrameFamily (rawFamily q)
proof:
:= by
  apply (sourceFrameFamily_iff_f0Raw
    (fun r => sourceProjector (sourceTriple q r))).1
  obtain ⟨hTA, hSA, hNA, hTB, hSB, hNB⟩ :=
    (equationsVanish_iff_source_fixedSpectrum q).1 hq
  intro r
  fin_cases r
  · have hstandard : sourceProjector (sourceTriple q 0) =
        fun i => ResidualLedgerPower.diagonalUnit (K := K) i := by
      funext i
      rw [sourceProjector_eq_spectralProjector]
      simpa [sourceTriple, residualTriple] using
        (ResidualLedgerPower.diagonal_projectors (K := K) i)
    change SourceFrameLaws.Laws (sourceProjector (sourceTriple q 0))
    rw [hstandard]
    exact SourceScheduleRawVanishing.standardFrameLaws (L := K)
  · exact SourceSpectralFrames.projector_laws_of_fixed_spectrum _ hTA hSA hNA
  · exact SourceSpectralFrames.projector_laws_of_fixed_spectrum _ hTB hSB hNB

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertActualRawChartPoint.radical_le_kernel
statement:
theorem radical_le_kernel (f : k →+* K) (q : ExplicitFrameChart K)
    (hq : EquationsVanish (explicitFrameEquationValues q)) :
    (rawFrameIdeal (k := k)).radical ≤ RingHom.ker (chartEvaluation k f q)
proof:
:= by
  apply (RingHom.ker_isPrime (chartEvaluation k f q)).radical_le_iff.mpr
  exact (rawFrameIdeal_le_ker_iff f (rawFamily q)).2 (rawFamily_isRaw q hq)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertActualRawChartPoint.reducedEvaluation_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem reducedEvaluation_mk (f : k →+* K) (q : ExplicitFrameChart K)
    (hq : EquationsVanish (explicitFrameEquationValues q)) (p : CoordinateRing k) :
    reducedEvaluation k f q hq
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (rawFrameIdeal (k := k)).radical p) =
      chartEvaluation k f q p
proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertActualRawChartPoint.rawFamily_sourceEncoders
statement:
private theorem rawFamily_sourceEncoders (q : ExplicitFrameChart K) :
    sourceEncoders (rawFamily q) = sourceTriple q
proof:
:= by
  funext r
  simp only [sourceEncoders, rawFamily, toF0Family,
    LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply, map_sub]
  change sourceProjector (sourceTriple q r) 2 -
      sourceProjector (sourceTriple q r) 0 = sourceTriple q r
  change (2 : K)⁻¹ •
      (sourceProduct (sourceTriple q r) (sourceTriple q r) +
        sourceTriple q r) -
    (2 : K)⁻¹ •
      (sourceProduct (sourceTriple q r) (sourceTriple q r) -
        sourceTriple q r) = sourceTriple q r
  rw [← smul_sub]
  have h :
      (sourceProduct (sourceTriple q r) (sourceTriple q r) +
          sourceTriple q r) -
        (sourceProduct (sourceTriple q r) (sourceTriple q r) -
          sourceTriple q r) =
        (2 : K) • sourceTriple q r := by
    rw [two_smul]
    abel
  rw [h, smul_smul]
  norm_num

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertActualRawChartPoint.chartEvaluation_ledger
statement:
theorem chartEvaluation_ledger (f : k →+* K) (q : ExplicitFrameChart K)
    (hq : EquationsVanish (explicitFrameEquationValues q)) :
    { P := fun i j => chartEvaluation k f q (pairP k i j)
      Q := fun j l => chartEvaluation k f q (pairQ k j l)
      R := fun l i => chartEvaluation k f q (pairR k l i)
      C0 := fun i j l => chartEvaluation k f q (centeredTriple k i j l) } =
      copySourceLedger (sourceLedger (encoderA q) (encoderB q))
proof:
:= by
  change ({ P := _, Q := _, R := _, C0 := _ } : LabelledLedger K) = _
  rw [show chartEvaluation k f q = evaluationAlong f (rawFamily q) from rfl]
  rw [evaluation_rawLabelledLedger_eq_tau k f (rawFamily q) (rawFamily_isRaw q hq),
    rawFamily_sourceEncoders, labelledLedger_mapTriple, sourceTriple,
    sourceLabelledLedger_residual]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertActualRawChartPoint.chartEvaluation_detector
statement:
theorem chartEvaluation_detector (f : k →+* K) (q : ExplicitFrameChart K) :
    chartEvaluation k f q (rawDetector k) =
      sourceDetector (diagonal (-1) 0 1) (encoderA q) (encoderB q)
proof:
:= by
  change evaluationAlong f (rawFamily q) (rawDetector k) = _
  rw [evaluation_rawDetector, rawFamily_sourceEncoders]
  rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertActualRawChartPoint.reducedEvaluation_ledgerCell
statement:
theorem reducedEvaluation_ledgerCell (f : k →+* K) (q : ExplicitFrameChart K)
    (hq : EquationsVanish (explicitFrameEquationValues q))
    (t : Fin 4) (i j l : Fin 3) :
    reducedEvaluation k f q hq (reducedLedgerCell k t i j l) =
      chartLedgerCell q t i j l
proof:
:= by
  have h := chartEvaluation_ledger k f q hq
  fin_cases t
  · exact congrFun (congrFun (congrArg LabelledLedger.P h) i) j
  · exact congrFun (congrFun (congrArg LabelledLedger.Q h) i) j
  · exact congrFun (congrFun (congrArg LabelledLedger.R h) i) j
  · exact congrFun (congrFun (congrFun (congrArg LabelledLedger.C0 h) i) j) l

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertActualRawChartPoint.companion_equations
statement:
theorem companion_equations (q : ExplicitFrameChart K)
    (hq : EquationsVanish (explicitFrameEquationValues q))
    (hx : ResidualOpen (residualPairOfChart q)) :
    EquationsVanish (explicitFrameEquationValues (companion q hx))
proof:
:= by
  rw [(companion_equations_and_sourceLedger q hx).1]
  exact hq

name: AlbertLean.Generic.AlbertActualRawChartPoint.companion_reducedEvaluation_ledger
statement:
theorem companion_reducedEvaluation_ledger (f : k →+* K)
    (q : ExplicitFrameChart K) (hq : EquationsVanish (explicitFrameEquationValues q))
    (hx : ResidualOpen (residualPairOfChart q))
    (t : Fin 4) (i j l : Fin 3) :
    reducedEvaluation k f (companion q hx) (companion_equations q hq hx)
        (reducedLedgerCell k t i j l) =
      reducedEvaluation k f q hq (reducedLedgerCell k t i j l)
proof:
:= by
  rw [reducedEvaluation_ledgerCell, reducedEvaluation_ledgerCell]
  unfold chartLedgerCell
  rw [(companion_equations_and_sourceLedger q hx).2]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.map_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem map_apply
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V)) (d : V) (t : K) (x : V) :
    map omega d t x = x + (t * omega d x) • d
proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.skew_of_alternating
statement:
theorem skew_of_alternating
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V))
    (halt : ∀ x, omega x x = 0) (x y : V) :
    omega x y = -omega y x
proof:
:= by
  have h := halt (x + y)
  simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply] at h
  have hxx := halt x
  have hyy := halt y
  linear_combination h - hxx - hyy

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.map_preserves
statement:
theorem map_preserves
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V))
    (halt : ∀ x, omega x x = 0) (d : V) (t : K) (x y : V) :
    omega (map omega d t x) (map omega d t y) = omega x y
proof:
:= by
  have hskew := skew_of_alternating omega halt d x
  have hdd := halt d
  simp only [map_apply, map_add, map_smul, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  linear_combination (norm := ring) (t * omega d y) * hskew +
    (t ^ 2 * omega d x * omega d y) * hdd

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.map_neg_comp
statement:
theorem map_neg_comp
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V))
    (halt : ∀ x, omega x x = 0) (d : V) (t : K) :
    (map omega d (-t)).comp (map omega d t) = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  have hdd := halt d
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, map_apply, LinearMap.id_apply, map_add,
    map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [hdd]
  module

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.map_comp_neg
statement:
theorem map_comp_neg
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V))
    (halt : ∀ x, omega x x = 0) (d : V) (t : K) :
    (map omega d t).comp (map omega d (-t)) = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [neg_neg] using map_neg_comp omega halt d (-t)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.equiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem equiv_apply
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V))
    (halt : ∀ x, omega x x = 0) (d : V) (t : K) (x : V) :
    equiv omega halt d t x = x + (t * omega d x) • d
proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.equiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem equiv_symm_apply
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V))
    (halt : ∀ x, omega x x = 0) (d : V) (t : K) (x : V) :
    (equiv omega halt d t).symm x = x + ((-t) * omega d x) • d
proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.equiv_preserves
statement:
theorem equiv_preserves
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V))
    (halt : ∀ x, omega x x = 0) (d : V) (t : K) (x y : V) :
    omega (equiv omega halt d t x) (equiv omega halt d t y) = omega x y
proof:
:=
  map_preserves omega halt d t x y

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.one_step_align
statement:
theorem one_step_align
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V))
    (halt : ∀ x, omega x x = 0) (x y : V)
    (hpair : omega y x ≠ 0) :
    equiv omega halt (y - x) (omega y x)⁻¹ x = y
proof:
:= by
  have hxx := halt x
  have hcancel : (omega y x)⁻¹ * omega y x = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ hpair
  simp only [equiv_apply, map_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply, hxx, sub_zero]
  rw [hcancel, one_smul]
  module

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.two_step_align
statement:
theorem two_step_align
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V))
    (halt : ∀ x, omega x x = 0) (x z y : V)
    (hxz : omega z x ≠ 0) (hzy : omega y z ≠ 0) :
    equiv omega halt (y - z) (omega y z)⁻¹
      (equiv omega halt (z - x) (omega z x)⁻¹ x) = y
proof:
:= by
  rw [one_step_align omega halt x z hxz]
  exact one_step_align omega halt z y hzy

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealLedgerInvariant.conjugate_sub
statement:
theorem conjugate_sub (Q A B : Mat3 F) :
    orthogonalConjugate Q (A - B) =
      orthogonalConjugate Q A - orthogonalConjugate Q B
proof:
:= by
  simp only [orthogonalConjugate, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealLedgerInvariant.conjugate_smul
statement:
theorem conjugate_smul (Q A : Mat3 F) (c : F) :
    orthogonalConjugate Q (c • A) = c • orthogonalConjugate Q A
proof:
:= by
  simp only [orthogonalConjugate, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealLedgerInvariant.conjugate_matrixJordan
statement:
theorem conjugate_matrixJordan (Q A B : Mat3 F) (hQ : IsOrthogonal Q) :
    orthogonalConjugate Q (matrixJordan A B) =
      matrixJordan (orthogonalConjugate Q A) (orthogonalConjugate Q B)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [matrixJordan, conjugate_smul, orthogonalConjugate_add,
    orthogonalConjugate_mul Q _ _ hQ]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealLedgerInvariant.matrixProjector_conjugate
statement:
theorem matrixProjector_conjugate (Q A : Mat3 F) (hQ : IsOrthogonal Q)
    (i : Fin 3) :
    matrixProjector (orthogonalConjugate Q A) i =
      orthogonalConjugate Q (matrixProjector A i)
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i <;>
    dsimp only [matrixProjector, Matrix.cons_val, Fin.reduceFinMk] <;>
    simp only [conjugate_smul, conjugate_sub, orthogonalConjugate_add,
      conjugate_matrixJordan Q _ _ hQ, orthogonalConjugate_one Q hQ]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealLedgerInvariant.matrixLedger_conjugate
statement:
theorem matrixLedger_conjugate (Q : Mat3 F) (hQ : IsOrthogonal Q)
    (T : Fin 3 → Mat3 F) :
    matrixLedger (fun r => orthogonalConjugate Q (T r)) = matrixLedger T
proof:
:= by
  simp only [matrixLedger, matrixProjector_conjugate Q _ hQ,
    ← conjugate_matrixJordan Q _ _ hQ,
    ← orthogonalConjugate_mul Q _ _ hQ, orthogonalConjugate_trace Q _ hQ]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealLedgerInvariant.primitiveLedger_conjugate
statement:
theorem primitiveLedger_conjugate (Q : Mat3 F) (hQ : IsOrthogonal Q)
    (P : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Mat3 F) :
    labelledLedger (primitiveMatrixTauTriple
      (fun r i => orthogonalConjugate Q (P r i))) =
      labelledLedger (primitiveMatrixTauTriple P)
proof:
:= by
  rw [primitiveLedger_eq_matrixLedger, primitiveLedger_eq_matrixLedger]
  simpa only [conjugate_sub] using
    matrixLedger_conjugate Q hQ (fun r => P r 2 - P r 0)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealLedgerInvariant.scalarMatrix_orthogonal
statement:
theorem scalarMatrix_orthogonal (Q : Mat3 k)
    (hQTQ : Matrix.transpose Q * Q = 1)
    (hQQT : Q * Matrix.transpose Q = 1) :
    IsOrthogonal ((scalarMap k).mapMatrix Q)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · have h := congrArg (scalarMap k).mapMatrix hQTQ
    simpa [Matrix.transpose_map] using h
  · have h := congrArg (scalarMap k).mapMatrix hQQT
    simpa [Matrix.transpose_map] using h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealLedgerInvariant.constantAction_universalFamily
statement:
theorem constantAction_universalFamily (Q : Mat3 k)
    (hQTQ : Matrix.transpose Q * Q = 1)
    (hQQT : Q * Matrix.transpose Q = 1) (r i : Fin 3) :
    (constantAction k Q hQTQ hQQT).toRingHom.mapMatrix (universalFamily k r i) =
      orthogonalConjugate ((scalarMap k).mapMatrix Q) (universalFamily k r i)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = (rawToField k).mapMatrix
        (ringConjugate (coefficientMatrix k Q) (universalMatrix r i)) := by
      ext a b
      exact constantAction_universal_generator k Q hQTQ hQQT r i a b
    _ = _ := by
      simp only [ringConjugate, map_mul]
      rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealLedgerInvariant.constantAction_universalLedger
statement:
theorem constantAction_universalLedger (Q : Mat3 k)
    (hQTQ : Matrix.transpose Q * Q = 1)
    (hQQT : Q * Matrix.transpose Q = 1) :
    mapLedgerValues (constantAction k Q hQTQ hQQT).toRingHom (universalLedger k) =
      universalLedger k
proof:
:= by
  change mapLedgerValues (constantAction k Q hQTQ hQQT).toRingHom
      (labelledLedger (primitiveMatrixTauTriple (universalFamily k))) = _
  rw [← primitiveLedger_map]
  simp only [constantAction_universalFamily]
  exact primitiveLedger_conjugate ((scalarMap k).mapMatrix Q)
    (scalarMatrix_orthogonal k Q hQTQ hQQT) (universalFamily k)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealLedgerInvariant.pairP_mem_constantInvariantField
statement:
theorem pairP_mem_constantInvariantField (i j : Fin 3) :
    (universalLedger k).P i j ∈ constantInvariantField k
proof:
:= by
  intro Q hQTQ hQQT
  exact congrArg (fun ell => ell.P i j)
    (constantAction_universalLedger k Q hQTQ hQQT)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealLedgerInvariant.pairQ_mem_constantInvariantField
statement:
theorem pairQ_mem_constantInvariantField (j l : Fin 3) :
    (universalLedger k).Q j l ∈ constantInvariantField k
proof:
:= by
  intro Q hQTQ hQQT
  exact congrArg (fun ell => ell.Q j l)
    (constantAction_universalLedger k Q hQTQ hQQT)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealLedgerInvariant.pairR_mem_constantInvariantField
statement:
theorem pairR_mem_constantInvariantField (l i : Fin 3) :
    (universalLedger k).R l i ∈ constantInvariantField k
proof:
:= by
  intro Q hQTQ hQQT
  exact congrArg (fun ell => ell.R l i)
    (constantAction_universalLedger k Q hQTQ hQQT)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealLedgerInvariant.centeredC0_mem_constantInvariantField
statement:
theorem centeredC0_mem_constantInvariantField (i j l : Fin 3) :
    (universalLedger k).C0 i j l ∈ constantInvariantField k
proof:
:= by
  intro Q hQTQ hQQT
  exact congrArg (fun ell => ell.C0 i j l)
    (constantAction_universalLedger k Q hQTQ hQQT)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealLedgerInvariant.ledgerCells_subset_constantInvariantField
statement:
theorem ledgerCells_subset_constantInvariantField :
    ledgerCells k ⊆ constantInvariantField k
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  rcases hx with ((hP | hQ) | hR) | hC
  · obtain ⟨⟨i, j⟩, rfl⟩ := hP
    exact pairP_mem_constantInvariantField k i j
  · obtain ⟨⟨j, l⟩, rfl⟩ := hQ
    exact pairQ_mem_constantInvariantField k j l
  · obtain ⟨⟨l, i⟩, rfl⟩ := hR
    exact pairR_mem_constantInvariantField k l i
  · obtain ⟨⟨i, j, l⟩, rfl⟩ := hC
    exact centeredC0_mem_constantInvariantField k i j l

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.RealLedgerInvariant.ledgerField_le_constantInvariantField
statement:
theorem ledgerField_le_constantInvariantField :
    ledgerField k ≤ constantInvariantField k
proof:
:= by
  apply Subfield.closure_le.mpr
  intro x hx
  rcases hx with hs | hc
  · obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hs
    exact scalar_mem_constantInvariantField k c
  · exact ledgerCells_subset_constantInvariantField k hc

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ScalarFibre.hat_mul
statement:
theorem hat_mul (u v : Vec3 K) :
    hat u * hat v = outer v u - dot u v • (1 : Mat3 K)
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [hat, outer, dot, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ] <;> ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ScalarFibre.adjugate_fin_three_trace
statement:
theorem adjugate_fin_three_trace (a : Mat3 K) :
    Matrix.adjugate a =
      a * a - Matrix.trace a • a +
        (((Matrix.trace a) ^ 2 - Matrix.trace (a * a)) / 2) •
          (1 : Mat3 K)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.adjugate_fin_three]
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [Matrix.trace, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ] <;> ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ScalarFibre.adjugate_of_projector_trace_one
statement:
theorem adjugate_of_projector_trace_one
    (a : Mat3 K) (u v : Vec3 K)
    (hblock : a * a - a = -(hat u * hat v))
    (htrace : Matrix.trace a = 1) :
    Matrix.adjugate a = -outer v u
proof:
:= by
  have hhat := hat_mul u v
  have hsq : a * a = a - outer v u + dot u v • (1 : Mat3 K) := by
    calc
      a * a = (a * a - a) + a := by abel
      _ = -(hat u * hat v) + a := by rw [hblock]
      _ = -(outer v u - dot u v • (1 : Mat3 K)) + a := by rw [hhat]
      _ = a - outer v u + dot u v • (1 : Mat3 K) := by abel
  have htrsq : Matrix.trace (a * a) = 1 + 2 * dot u v := by
    have h := congrArg Matrix.trace hsq
    simp [Matrix.trace, Fin.sum_univ_succ, outer, dot] at h htrace ⊢
    linear_combination h + htrace
  rw [adjugate_fin_three_trace, htrace, htrsq]
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [hsq, outer] <;> ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFrameLaws.triple_pairwise_orthogonal
statement:
theorem triple_pairwise_orthogonal
    (μ : V →ₗ[K] V →ₗ[K] V) (one p q r : V)
    (hcomm : ∀ x y, μ x y = μ y x)
    (hunit : ∀ x, μ x one = x)
    (hpp : μ p p = p) (hqq : μ q q = q) (hrr : μ r r = r)
    (hsum : p + q + r = one) :
    μ p q = 0 ∧ μ p r = 0 ∧ μ q r = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 : μ p q + μ p r = 0 := by
    have hpAll := congrArg (fun x => μ p x) hsum
    simp only [map_add, hpp, hunit] at hpAll
    linear_combination (norm := module) hpAll
  have hq0 : μ p q + μ q r = 0 := by
    have hqAll := congrArg (fun x => μ q x) hsum
    simp only [map_add, hqq, hunit] at hqAll
    rw [hcomm q p] at hqAll
    linear_combination (norm := module) hqAll
  have hr0 : μ p r + μ q r = 0 := by
    have hrAll := congrArg (fun x => μ r x) hsum
    simp only [map_add, hrr, hunit] at hrAll
    rw [hcomm r p, hcomm r q] at hrAll
    linear_combination (norm := module) hrAll
  have hpq2 : (2 : K) • μ p q = 0 := by
    linear_combination (norm := module) hp0 + hq0 - hr0
  have hpq : μ p q = 0 :=
    (smul_eq_zero.mp hpq2).resolve_left (by norm_num)
  have hpr : μ p r = 0 := by
    linear_combination (norm := module) hp0 - hpq
  have hqr : μ q r = 0 := by
    linear_combination (norm := module) hq0 - hpq
  exact ⟨hpq, hpr, hqr⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFrameLaws.Laws.orthogonal_triple
statement:
theorem Laws.orthogonal_triple {P : Fin 3 → JCoord F} (hP : Laws P) :
    sourceProduct (P 0) (P 1) = 0 ∧
      sourceProduct (P 0) (P 2) = 0 ∧
        sourceProduct (P 1) (P 2) = 0
proof:
:= by
  exact triple_pairwise_orthogonal sourceProductLinear sourceOne
    (P 0) (P 1) (P 2) sourceProduct_comm sourceProduct_one_right
    (hP.idempotent 0) (hP.idempotent 1) (hP.idempotent 2) hP.sum_one

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFrameLaws.Laws.orthogonal
statement:
theorem Laws.orthogonal {P : Fin 3 → JCoord F} (hP : Laws P)
    {i j : Fin 3} (hij : i ≠ j) : sourceProduct (P i) (P j) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h01, h02, h12⟩ := hP.orthogonal_triple
  have h10 := (sourceProduct_comm (P 1) (P 0)).trans h01
  have h20 := (sourceProduct_comm (P 2) (P 0)).trans h02
  have h21 := (sourceProduct_comm (P 2) (P 1)).trans h12
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp_all

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericDetectorMoment.baseInverseRows_mul
statement: private theorem baseInverseRows_mul : baseInverseRows k * rowScale k = 1
proof:
:= by
  ext i l
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases l <;>
    simp [baseInverseRows, rowScale, rowPivot, Matrix.diagonal_mul,
      ι] <;> first
      | exact inv_mul_cancel₀ (PA_ne_zero k)
      | exact inv_mul_cancel₀ (PB_ne_zero k)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericDetectorMoment.j_inverseRows
statement:
private theorem j_inverseRows :
    (inverseRows k).map (j k) = (baseInverseRows k).map (includeBase k)
proof:
:= by
  ext i l
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases l <;>
    simp [inverseRows, baseInverseRows, Matrix.map_apply]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericDetectorMoment.j_clearedMoment
statement:
private theorem j_clearedMoment :
    ((N k).map (coefficient k)).map (j k) = ((N k).map (ι k)).map (includeBase k)
proof:
:= by
  ext i l
  exact j_coefficient k (N k i l)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericDetectorMoment.j_localMoment
statement: theorem j_localMoment : (localMoment k).map (j k) = (rationalM k).map (includeBase k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [localMoment, Matrix.map_mul, j_inverseRows, j_clearedMoment,
    ← rowScale_mul_rationalM, ← Matrix.map_mul, ← Matrix.mul_assoc,
    baseInverseRows_mul, Matrix.one_mul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericDetectorMoment.j_localDeterminant
statement:
theorem j_localDeterminant :
    j k (localDeterminant k) = includeBase k (Matrix.det (rationalM k))
proof:
:= by
  rw [localDeterminant, RingHom.map_det]
  change Matrix.det ((localMoment k).map (j k)) = _
  rw [j_localMoment]
  exact (RingHom.map_det (includeBase k) (rationalM k)).symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericDetectorMoment.detN_factorization
statement:
theorem detN_factorization :
    ι k (Matrix.det (N k)) =
      (ι k (PA k)) ^ 2 * (ι k (PB k)) ^ 2 * Matrix.det (rationalM k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [RingHom.map_det]
  change Matrix.det ((N k).map (ι k)) = _
  rw [← rowScale_mul_rationalM, Matrix.det_mul]
  simp only [rowScale, Matrix.det_diagonal, rowPivot, Fin.prod_univ_succ]
  change (ι k (PA k) * (ι k (PB k) * (ι k (PA k) * (ι k (PB k) * 1)))) * _ = _
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericDetectorMoment.j_inverseDeterminant
statement:
theorem j_inverseDeterminant :
    j k (inverseDeterminant k) = (includeBase k (Matrix.det (rationalM k)))⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  simp only [inverseDeterminant, map_mul, map_pow, j_coefficient, j_inverseDetN]
  rw [detN_factorization]
  simp only [map_mul, map_pow, _root_.mul_inv_rev, inv_pow]
  have ha : includeBase k (ι k (PA k)) ≠ 0 :=
    (map_ne_zero (includeBase k)).mpr (PA_ne_zero k)
  have hb : includeBase k (ι k (PB k)) ≠ 0 :=
    (map_ne_zero (includeBase k)).mpr (PB_ne_zero k)
  field_simp [ha, hb]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.GenericDetectorMoment.determinant_mul_inverse
statement: theorem determinant_mul_inverse : localDeterminant k * inverseDeterminant k = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply j_injective k
  rw [map_mul, map_one, j_localDeterminant, j_inverseDeterminant]
  exact mul_inv_cancel₀ ((map_ne_zero (includeBase k)).mpr (det_rationalM_ne_zero k))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.LedgerInvariantField.map_reducedUniversalFamily
statement:
theorem map_reducedUniversalFamily (r i : Fin 3) :
    (reducedToFieldAlgHom k).toRingHom.mapMatrix (reducedUniversalFamily k r i) =
      universalFamily k r i
proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.LedgerInvariantField.fractionAction_universalFamily_extended
statement:
theorem fractionAction_universalFamily_extended (g : Aut (K := k)) (r i : Fin 3) :
    (fractionAction k g).toRingHom.mapMatrix (universalFamily k r i) =
      linearEquiv (R := FunctionField k) g (universalFamily k r i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [M3JordanFractionAction.fractionAction_universalFamily]
  change (reducedToFieldAlgHom k).toRingHom.mapMatrix
    (linearEquiv (R := ReducedCoordinateRing k) g (reducedUniversalFamily k r i)) = _
  rw [M3JordanReducedAction.linearEquiv_mapMatrix (k := k) (reducedToFieldAlgHom k),
    map_reducedUniversalFamily]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.LedgerInvariantField.fractionAction_universalLedger
statement:
theorem fractionAction_universalLedger (g : Aut (K := k)) :
    mapLedgerValues (fractionAction k g).toRingHom (universalLedger k) =
      universalLedger k
proof:
:= by
  change mapLedgerValues (fractionAction k g).toRingHom
    (labelledLedger (primitiveMatrixTauTriple (universalFamily k))) =
      labelledLedger (primitiveMatrixTauTriple (universalFamily k))
  rw [← RealLedgerNaturality.primitiveLedger_map]
  simp only [fractionAction_universalFamily_extended]
  exact M3LedgerInvariance.primitiveLedger_extension_invariant
    (F := FunctionField k) g (universalFamily k)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.LedgerInvariantField.scalar_mem_jordanInvariantField
statement:
theorem scalar_mem_jordanInvariantField (c : k) :
    scalarMap k c ∈ jordanInvariantField k
proof:
:= by
  intro g
  exact fractionAction_scalar k g c

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.LedgerInvariantField.pairP_mem_jordanInvariantField
statement:
theorem pairP_mem_jordanInvariantField (i j : Fin 3) :
    (universalLedger k).P i j ∈ jordanInvariantField k
proof:
:= by
  intro g
  exact congrArg (fun ell : LabelledLedger (FunctionField k) => ell.P i j)
    (fractionAction_universalLedger k g)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.LedgerInvariantField.pairQ_mem_jordanInvariantField
statement:
theorem pairQ_mem_jordanInvariantField (j l : Fin 3) :
    (universalLedger k).Q j l ∈ jordanInvariantField k
proof:
:= by
  intro g
  exact congrArg (fun ell : LabelledLedger (FunctionField k) => ell.Q j l)
    (fractionAction_universalLedger k g)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.LedgerInvariantField.pairR_mem_jordanInvariantField
statement:
theorem pairR_mem_jordanInvariantField (l i : Fin 3) :
    (universalLedger k).R l i ∈ jordanInvariantField k
proof:
:= by
  intro g
  exact congrArg (fun ell : LabelledLedger (FunctionField k) => ell.R l i)
    (fractionAction_universalLedger k g)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.LedgerInvariantField.centeredC0_mem_jordanInvariantField
statement:
theorem centeredC0_mem_jordanInvariantField (i j l : Fin 3) :
    (universalLedger k).C0 i j l ∈ jordanInvariantField k
proof:
:= by
  intro g
  exact congrArg (fun ell : LabelledLedger (FunctionField k) => ell.C0 i j l)
    (fractionAction_universalLedger k g)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.LedgerInvariantField.ledgerCells_subset_jordanInvariantField
statement:
theorem ledgerCells_subset_jordanInvariantField :
    ledgerCells k ⊆ jordanInvariantField k
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  rcases hx with ((hP | hQ) | hR) | hC
  · obtain ⟨⟨i, j⟩, rfl⟩ := hP
    exact pairP_mem_jordanInvariantField k i j
  · obtain ⟨⟨j, l⟩, rfl⟩ := hQ
    exact pairQ_mem_jordanInvariantField k j l
  · obtain ⟨⟨l, i⟩, rfl⟩ := hR
    exact pairR_mem_jordanInvariantField k l i
  · obtain ⟨⟨i, j, l⟩, rfl⟩ := hC
    exact centeredC0_mem_jordanInvariantField k i j l

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.LedgerInvariantField.ledgerField_le_jordanInvariantField
statement:
theorem ledgerField_le_jordanInvariantField :
    ledgerField k ≤ jordanInvariantField k
proof:
:= by
  apply Subfield.closure_le.mpr
  intro x hx
  rcases hx with hs | hc
  · obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hs
    exact scalar_mem_jordanInvariantField k c
  · exact ledgerCells_subset_jordanInvariantField k hc

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourcePivotCharts.pivotAut_standard
statement:
@[simp] theorem pivotAut_standard (i : Fin 3) :
    (pivotAut (K := K) i).linear (diagonalUnit 0) = diagonalUnit i
proof:
:=
  sourceSwapAut_apply_left 0 i

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourcePivotCharts.pivotAut_trace
statement:
theorem pivotAut_trace (i : Fin 3) (e : JCoord K) :
    sourceTrace ((pivotAut i).linear e) = sourceTrace e
proof:
:=
  sourcePermutation_trace (Equiv.swap 0 i) e

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourcePivotCharts.pivotAut_pullback
statement:
@[simp] theorem pivotAut_pullback (i : Fin 3) (e : JCoord K) :
    (pivotAut i).linear (pullback i e) = e
proof: := (pivotAut i).linear.apply_symm_apply e

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourcePivotCharts.pullback_trace
statement:
theorem pullback_trace (i : Fin 3) (e : JCoord K) :
    sourceTrace (pullback i e) = sourceTrace e
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pivotAut_trace i (pullback i e), pivotAut_pullback]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourcePivotCharts.pullback_idempotent
statement:
theorem pullback_idempotent (i : Fin 3) (e : JCoord K)
    (he : sourceProduct e e = e) :
    sourceProduct (pullback i e) (pullback i e) = pullback i e
proof:
:= by
  apply (pivotAut i).linear.injective
  rw [(pivotAut i).map_product, pivotAut_pullback, he]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourcePivotCharts.pullback_d1
statement:
theorem pullback_d1 (i : Fin 3) (e : JCoord K) :
    (pullback i e).d1 = diagLinear i e
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (pullback i e).d1 = sourceTrace (sourceProduct (pullback i e) (diagonalUnit 0)) :=
      (sourceTrace_target_zero _).symm
    _ = sourceTrace ((pivotAut i).linear
        (sourceProduct (pullback i e) (diagonalUnit 0))) := (pivotAut_trace i _).symm
    _ = sourceTrace (sourceProduct e (diagonalUnit i)) := by
      rw [(pivotAut i).map_product, pivotAut_pullback, pivotAut_standard]
    _ = diagLinear i e := by
      rw [sourceTrace_product_eq_traceForm, sourceTraceForm_symmetric, diagonal_trace]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourcePivotCharts.chart_idempotent
statement:
theorem chart_idempotent (i : Fin 3) (u : SCoord K) (v : CCoord K)
    (hD : chart0Denominator u v ≠ 0) : sourceProduct (chart i u v) (chart i u v) = chart i u v
proof:
:= by
  change sourceProduct ((pivotAut i).linear (chart0 u v))
    ((pivotAut i).linear (chart0 u v)) = (pivotAut i).linear (chart0 u v)
  rw [← (pivotAut i).map_product, chart0_idempotent u v hD]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourcePivotCharts.chart_trace
statement:
theorem chart_trace (i : Fin 3) (u : SCoord K) (v : CCoord K)
    (hD : chart0Denominator u v ≠ 0) : sourceTrace (chart i u v) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [chart, pivotAut_trace, chart0_trace u v hD]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourcePivotCharts.chart_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem chart_zero (i : Fin 3) :
    chart i (0 : SCoord K) (0 : CCoord K) = diagonalUnit i
proof:
:= by
  rw [chart, chart0_zero, pivotAut_standard]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourcePivotCharts.pullback_chart
statement:
@[simp] theorem pullback_chart (i : Fin 3) (u : SCoord K) (v : CCoord K) :
    pullback i (chart i u v) = chart0 u v
proof:
:=
  (pivotAut i).linear.symm_apply_apply _

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourcePivotCharts.chart_pivot
statement:
theorem chart_pivot (i : Fin 3) (u : SCoord K) (v : CCoord K) :
    diagLinear i (chart i u v) = (chart0Denominator u v)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pullback_d1, pullback_chart]
  rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourcePivotCharts.chart_pivot_ne_zero
statement:
theorem chart_pivot_ne_zero (i : Fin 3) (u : SCoord K) (v : CCoord K)
    (hD : chart0Denominator u v ≠ 0) : diagLinear i (chart i u v) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [chart_pivot]
  exact inv_ne_zero hD

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourcePivotCharts.denominator_extract
statement:
theorem denominator_extract (i : Fin 3) (e : JCoord K)
    (he : sourceProduct e e = e) (hT : sourceTrace e = 1) (hi : diagLinear i e ≠ 0) :
    diagLinear i e * chart0Denominator (extractSAt i e) (extractCAt i e) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hd : (pullback i e).d1 ≠ 0 := by rw [pullback_d1]; exact hi
  have ht : sourceTrace (pullback i e) = 1 := (pullback_trace i e).trans hT
  simpa only [extractSAt, extractCAt, pullback_d1] using
    chart0Denominator_extract (pullback i e) (pullback_idempotent i e he) ht hd

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourcePivotCharts.denominator_extract_ne_zero
statement:
theorem denominator_extract_ne_zero (i : Fin 3) (e : JCoord K)
    (he : sourceProduct e e = e) (hT : sourceTrace e = 1) (hi : diagLinear i e ≠ 0) :
    chart0Denominator (extractSAt i e) (extractCAt i e) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hh := denominator_extract i e he hT hi
  rw [h, mul_zero] at hh
  exact zero_ne_one hh

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourcePivotCharts.chart_reconstruct
statement:
theorem chart_reconstruct (i : Fin 3) (e : JCoord K)
    (he : sourceProduct e e = e) (hT : sourceTrace e = 1) (hi : diagLinear i e ≠ 0) :
    chart i (extractSAt i e) (extractCAt i e) = e
proof:
:= by
  have hd : (pullback i e).d1 ≠ 0 := by rw [pullback_d1]; exact hi
  have ht : sourceTrace (pullback i e) = 1 := (pullback_trace i e).trans hT
  rw [chart, extractSAt, extractCAt,
    chart0_reconstruct (pullback i e) (pullback_idempotent i e he) ht hd,
    pivotAut_pullback]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourcePivotCharts.chart_extract
statement:
theorem chart_extract (i : Fin 3) (u : SCoord K) (v : CCoord K)
    (hD : chart0Denominator u v ≠ 0) :
    extractSAt i (chart i u v) = u ∧ extractCAt i (chart i u v) = v
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [extractSAt, extractCAt, pullback_chart] using chart0_extract u v hD

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourcePivotCharts.exists_pivot_chart
statement:
theorem exists_pivot_chart (e : JCoord K) (he : sourceProduct e e = e)
    (hT : sourceTrace e = 1) :
    ∃ (i : Fin 3) (u : SCoord K) (v : CCoord K),
      chart0Denominator u v ≠ 0 ∧ chart i u v = e
proof:
:= by
  have hp : ∃ i : Fin 3, diagLinear i e ≠ 0 := by
    by_cases h1 : e.d1 = 0
    · by_cases h2 : e.d2 = 0
      · refine ⟨2, ?_⟩
        change e.d3 ≠ 0
        intro h3
        norm_num [sourceTrace, h1, h2, h3] at hT
      · exact ⟨1, by simpa [diagLinear] using h2⟩
    · exact ⟨0, by simpa [diagLinear] using h1⟩
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hp
  exact ⟨i, extractSAt i e, extractCAt i e,
    denominator_extract_ne_zero i e he hT hi, chart_reconstruct i e he hT hi⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Cayley.detUnit
statement:
private theorem detUnit {M : Mat3 K} (hM : Matrix.det M ≠ 0) :
    IsUnit (Matrix.det M)
proof: := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hM

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Cayley.cancel_right
statement:
private theorem cancel_right {L R M : Mat3 K}
    (hM : IsUnit (Matrix.det M)) (h : L * M = R * M) : L = R
proof:
:= by
  have h' := congrArg (fun X => X * M⁻¹) h
  simpa only [Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ hM, Matrix.mul_one] using h'

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Cayley.cancel_left
statement:
private theorem cancel_left {L R M : Mat3 K}
    (hM : IsUnit (Matrix.det M)) (h : M * L = M * R) : L = R
proof:
:= by
  have h' := congrArg (fun X => M⁻¹ * X) h
  simpa only [← Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ hM, Matrix.one_mul] using h'

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Cayley.cayley_mul
statement:
theorem cayley_mul {A : Mat3 K} (hplus : Matrix.det (I₃ + A) ≠ 0) :
    cayley A * (I₃ + A) = I₃ - A
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cayley, Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ (detUnit hplus),
    Matrix.mul_one]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Cayley.one_add_cayley_mul
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.one_mul, cayley_mul hplus]
  ext i j
  by_cases hij : i = j <;> simp [Matrix.one_apply, hij] <;> ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Cayley.one_sub_cayley_mul
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.sub_mul, Matrix.one_mul, cayley_mul hplus]
  ext i j
  simp [Matrix.one_apply]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Cayley.det_one_add_cayley_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  have hdet := congrArg Matrix.det (one_add_cayley_mul (A := A) hplus)
  rw [Matrix.det_mul, hzero, zero_mul] at hdet
  norm_num [Matrix.det_smul, Fintype.card_fin] at hdet

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Cayley.cayley_cayley
statement:
theorem cayley_cayley {A : Mat3 K}
    (hplus : Matrix.det (I₃ + A) ≠ 0) : cayley (cayley A) = A
proof:
:= by
  apply cancel_right (detUnit (det_one_add_cayley_ne_zero hplus))
  rw [cayley_mul (det_one_add_cayley_ne_zero hplus)]
  apply cancel_right (detUnit hplus)
  rw [one_sub_cayley_mul hplus, Matrix.mul_assoc, one_add_cayley_mul hplus]
  simp

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Cayley.cayley_orthogonal
statement:
theorem cayley_orthogonal {A : Mat3 K} (hA : IsSkew A)
    (hplus : Matrix.det (I₃ + A) ≠ 0) : IsOrthogonal (cayley A)
proof:
:= by
  have hu := detUnit hplus
  have huT : IsUnit (Matrix.det (Matrix.transpose (I₃ + A))) := by
    rwa [Matrix.det_transpose]
  have horth : Matrix.transpose (cayley A) * cayley A = I₃ := by
    apply cancel_left huT
    apply cancel_right hu
    calc
      (Matrix.transpose (I₃ + A) *
          (Matrix.transpose (cayley A) * cayley A)) * (I₃ + A) =
          Matrix.transpose (cayley A * (I₃ + A)) * (cayley A * (I₃ + A)) := by
            simp only [Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = Matrix.transpose (I₃ - A) * (I₃ - A) := by rw [cayley_mul hplus]
      _ = (Matrix.transpose (I₃ + A) * I₃) * (I₃ + A) := by
        simp only [Matrix.transpose_sub, Matrix.transpose_add, Matrix.transpose_one,
          show Matrix.transpose A = -A from hA, Matrix.mul_one]
        noncomm_ring
  exact ⟨horth, mul_eq_one_comm.mp horth⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Cayley.cayley_skew_of_orthogonal
statement:
theorem cayley_skew_of_orthogonal {Q : Mat3 K} (hQ : IsOrthogonal Q)
    (hplus : Matrix.det (I₃ + Q) ≠ 0) : IsSkew (cayley Q)
proof:
:= by
  have hu := detUnit hplus
  have huT : IsUnit (Matrix.det (Matrix.transpose (I₃ + Q))) := by
    rwa [Matrix.det_transpose]
  change Matrix.transpose (cayley Q) = -cayley Q
  apply cancel_left huT
  apply cancel_right hu
  calc
    (Matrix.transpose (I₃ + Q) * Matrix.transpose (cayley Q)) * (I₃ + Q) =
        Matrix.transpose (I₃ - Q) * (I₃ + Q) := by
          rw [← Matrix.transpose_mul, cayley_mul hplus]
    _ = -(Matrix.transpose (I₃ + Q) * (I₃ - Q)) := by
      simp only [Matrix.transpose_sub, Matrix.transpose_add, Matrix.transpose_one]
      noncomm_ring [hQ.transpose_mul]
    _ = (Matrix.transpose (I₃ + Q) * (-cayley Q)) * (I₃ + Q) := by
      rw [Matrix.mul_neg, Matrix.neg_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc, cayley_mul hplus]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.MappedTemplateComparison.map_symplecticJ
statement:
private theorem map_symplecticJ (ell : Root k →+* K) :
    ell.mapMatrix (symplecticJ : Mat6 (Root k)) = symplecticJ
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  rcases i with i | i <;> rcases j with j | j <;>

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.MappedTemplateComparison.mappedRootCarrier_laws
statement:
theorem mappedRootCarrier_laws (ell : Root k →+* K) (r : Fin 3) :
    (∀ i, (mappedRootCarrier k K ell r i : Mat6 K) *
      mappedRootCarrier k K ell r i = mappedRootCarrier k K ell r i) ∧
    (∀ i, jordanTrace (K := K)
      (mappedRootCarrier k K ell r i : Mat6 K) = 1) ∧
    ((mappedRootCarrier k K ell r 0 : Mat6 K) +
      mappedRootCarrier k K ell r 1 + mappedRootCarrier k K ell r 2 = 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hidem, htrace, hsum⟩ := rootCarrier_laws k r
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    have h := congrArg ell.mapMatrix (hidem i)
    simpa only [mappedRootCarrier, mapCarrier_coe, map_mul] using h
  · intro i
    have h := congrArg ell (htrace i)
    rw [map_jordanTrace] at h
    simpa only [mappedRootCarrier, mapCarrier_coe, map_one] using h
  · have h := congrArg ell.mapMatrix hsum
    simpa only [mappedRootCarrier, mapCarrier_coe, map_add, map_one] using h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.MappedTemplateComparison.mappedRootWeight_pairing
statement:
theorem mappedRootWeight_pairing (ell : Root k →+* K) (i : Fin 3) :
    mappedRootWeight k K ell i = (omega (K := K))
      (matrixAction (mappedRootCarrier k K ell 0 i : Mat6 K)
        (mappedRootU k K ell))
      (matrixAction (mappedRootCarrier k K ell 0 i : Mat6 K)
        (mappedRootV k K ell))
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg ell (rootWeight_eq_pairing k i)
  rw [map_omega] at h
  simpa only [mappedRootWeight, mappedRootCarrier, mapCarrier_coe,
    mappedRootU, mappedRootV, mapVec_matrixAction] using h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.MappedTemplateComparison.mappedRootWeight_ne
statement:
theorem mappedRootWeight_ne (ell : Root k →+* K) (i : Fin 3) :

proof:
:= by

    ell.injective.ne (rootWeight_ne k i)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.MappedTemplateComparison.mappedRoot_compresses_left
statement:
theorem mappedRoot_compresses_left (ell : Root k →+* K) (i : Fin 3) :
    matrixAction (mappedRootCarrier k K ell 1 0 : Mat6 K)
        (matrixAction (mappedRootCarrier k K ell 0 i : Mat6 K)
          (mappedRootU k K ell)) =
      mappedRootWeight k K ell i • mappedRootU k K ell
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (mapVec k K ell) (rootFirst_compresses_left k i)
  simpa only [mappedRootCarrier, mapCarrier_coe, mappedRootU,
    mappedRootWeight, mapVec_matrixAction, mapVec_smul] using h

statement:

proof:

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.MappedTemplateComparison.mappedRootWeight_ledger
statement:
theorem mappedRootWeight_ledger (ell : Root k →+* K) (i : Fin 3) :
    mappedRootWeight k K ell i = jordanTrace (K := K)
      ((mappedRootCarrier k K ell 0 i : Mat6 K) *
        (mappedRootCarrier k K ell 1 0 : Mat6 K))
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg ell (rootWeight_eq_actual_pair_ledger k i)
  rw [map_jordanTrace, map_mul] at h
  simpa only [mappedRootWeight, mappedRootCarrier, mapCarrier_coe] using h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.MappedTemplateComparison.mappedRootWeight_one_add_two_ne
statement:
theorem mappedRootWeight_one_add_two_ne (ell : Root k →+* K) :
    mappedRootWeight k K ell 1 + mappedRootWeight k K ell 2 ≠ 0
proof:
:= by

    ell.injective.ne (rootWeight_one_add_weight_two_ne k)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.MappedTemplateComparison.mappedRoot_splitter_laws
statement:
theorem mappedRoot_splitter_laws (ell : Root k →+* K) :
    mappedRootQ k K ell * mappedRootN k K ell = 1 ∧
    mappedRootN k K ell * mappedRootQ k K ell = 1 ∧
    (mappedRootQ k K ell).transpose * symplecticJ * mappedRootQ k K ell =
      symplecticJ
proof:
:= by
  have hQN := congrArg ell.mapMatrix (rootQN k)
  have hNQ := congrArg ell.mapMatrix (rootNQ k)
  have hQ := congrArg ell.mapMatrix (rootQ_symplectic k)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [mappedRootQ, mappedRootN, map_mul, map_one] using hQN
  · simpa only [mappedRootQ, mappedRootN, map_mul, map_one] using hNQ
  · simpa only [mappedRootQ, map_mul, map_transpose,
      map_symplecticJ] using hQ

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.MappedTemplateComparison.mappedRoot_first_split
statement:
theorem mappedRoot_first_split (ell : Root k →+* K) (i : Fin 3) :
    mappedRootN k K ell * (mappedRootCarrier k K ell 0 i : Mat6 K) *
        mappedRootQ k K ell = grouped (diagonalUnit i) 0 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg ell.mapMatrix (rootSplitFirst_standard k i)
  simpa only [rootSplitFrame, mappedRootN, mappedRootQ,
    mappedRootCarrier, mapCarrier_coe, map_mul, map_grouped,
    map_diagonalUnit, map_zeroVec3] using h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.MappedTemplateComparison.mappedRoot_second_split
statement:
theorem mappedRoot_second_split (ell : Root k →+* K) (i : Fin 3) :
    mappedRootN k K ell * (mappedRootCarrier k K ell 1 i : Mat6 K) *
        mappedRootQ k K ell = grouped (mappedRootSecondA k K ell i) 0 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg ell.mapMatrix (rootSplitSecond_grouped k i)
  simpa only [rootSplitFrame, mappedRootN, mappedRootQ, mappedRootSecondA,
    mappedRootCarrier, mapCarrier_coe, map_mul, map_grouped,
    map_zeroVec3] using h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.MappedTemplateComparison.mappedRoot_actualPivot
statement:
theorem mappedRoot_actualPivot (ell : Root k →+* K) :
    let L
proof:
:= weightedCoordinateEquiv
      (fun i => mappedRootCarrier k K ell 0 i)
      (mappedRootCarrier_laws k K ell 0).1
      (mappedRootCarrier_laws k K ell 0).2.2
      (mappedRootU k K ell) (mappedRootV k K ell)
      (mappedRootWeight k K ell) (mappedRootWeight_pairing k K ell)
      (mappedRootWeight_ne k K ell)
    weightedBlock (coordinateConjugate L
      (matrixAction (mappedRootCarrier k K ell 1 1 : Mat6 K))) 0 1 =
      ell.mapMatrix (rootActualPivot k) := by
  dsimp only
  ext r s
  have hs := WeightedInverseCoordinates.pivotBlock_entry_eq_formula
    (fun i => rootCarrier k 0 i) (rootCarrier_laws k 0).1
    (rootCarrier_laws k 0).2.2 (rootPairU k) (rootPairV k)
    (rootWeight k) (rootWeight_eq_pairing k) (rootWeight_ne k)
    (rootCarrier k 1 1) r s
  have ht := WeightedInverseCoordinates.pivotBlock_entry_eq_formula
    (fun i => mappedRootCarrier k K ell 0 i)
    (mappedRootCarrier_laws k K ell 0).1
    (mappedRootCarrier_laws k K ell 0).2.2
    (mappedRootU k K ell) (mappedRootV k K ell)
    (mappedRootWeight k K ell) (mappedRootWeight_pairing k K ell)
    (mappedRootWeight_ne k K ell)
    (mappedRootCarrier k K ell 1 1) r s
  have hT (z : Vec6 (Root k)) :
      mapVec k K ell
          (matrixAction (rootCarrier k 1 1 : Mat6 (Root k)) z) =
        matrixAction (mappedRootCarrier k K ell 1 1 : Mat6 K)
          (mapVec k K ell z) := by
    exact mapVec_matrixAction k K ell _ _
  have hm := congrFun
    (FiniteQuadraticDiagnostic.map_coordinateConjugateFormula ell
      (fun i => matrixAction (rootCarrier k 0 i : Mat6 (Root k))
        (rootPairU k))
      (fun i => matrixAction (rootCarrier k 0 i : Mat6 (Root k))
        (rootPairV k))
      (fun i => (rootWeight k i)⁻¹)
      (matrixAction (rootCarrier k 1 1 : Mat6 (Root k)))
      (matrixAction (mappedRootCarrier k K ell 1 1 : Mat6 K)) hT
      (basisVector (weightedPairIndex 1 s)))
    (weightedPairIndex 0 r)
  have hmapVec :
      (FiniteQuadraticDiagnostic.mapVec ell : Vec6 (Root k) → Vec6 K) =
        mapVec k K ell := rfl
  simp only [hmapVec, mapVec_basisVector] at hm
  have hEu : (fun i => mapVec k K ell
      (matrixAction (rootCarrier k 0 i : Mat6 (Root k)) (rootPairU k))) =
      fun i => matrixAction (mappedRootCarrier k K ell 0 i : Mat6 K)
        (mappedRootU k K ell) := by
    funext i
    exact mapVec_matrixAction k K ell _ _
  have hEv : (fun i => mapVec k K ell
      (matrixAction (rootCarrier k 0 i : Mat6 (Root k)) (rootPairV k))) =
      fun i => matrixAction (mappedRootCarrier k K ell 0 i : Mat6 K)
        (mappedRootV k K ell) := by
    funext i
    exact mapVec_matrixAction k K ell _ _
  rw [hEu, hEv] at hm
  have hInv : (fun i => ell ((rootWeight k i)⁻¹)) =
      fun i => (mappedRootWeight k K ell i)⁻¹ := by
    funext i
    simp [mappedRootWeight]
  rw [hInv] at hm
  change rootActualPivot k r s = _ at hs
  change weightedBlock
      (coordinateConjugate
        (weightedCoordinateEquiv
          (fun i => mappedRootCarrier k K ell 0 i)
          (mappedRootCarrier_laws k K ell 0).1
          (mappedRootCarrier_laws k K ell 0).2.2
          (mappedRootU k K ell) (mappedRootV k K ell)
          (mappedRootWeight k K ell) (mappedRootWeight_pairing k K ell)
          (mappedRootWeight_ne k K ell))
        (matrixAction (mappedRootCarrier k K ell 1 1 : Mat6 K))) 0 1 r s = _ at ht
  exact ht.trans (hm.symm.trans (congrArg ell hs).symm)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.MappedTemplateComparison.mappedRoot_discriminant_ne
statement:
theorem mappedRoot_discriminant_ne (ell : Root k →+* K) :
    let L
proof:
:= weightedCoordinateEquiv
      (fun i => mappedRootCarrier k K ell 0 i)
      (mappedRootCarrier_laws k K ell 0).1
      (mappedRootCarrier_laws k K ell 0).2.2
      (mappedRootU k K ell) (mappedRootV k K ell)
      (mappedRootWeight k K ell) (mappedRootWeight_pairing k K ell)
      (mappedRootWeight_ne k K ell)
    let C := fun i j => weightedBlock (coordinateConjugate L
      (matrixAction (mappedRootCarrier k K ell 1 1 : Mat6 K))) i j
    trace2 (C 0 1) ^ 2 - 4 * determinant (C 0 1) ≠ 0 := by
  dsimp only
  have hdRoot : trace2 (rootActualPivot k) ^ 2 -
      4 * determinant (rootActualPivot k) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← rootSigma_sq_actualPivot k]
    exact pow_ne_zero 2 (rootSigma_ne k)
  have hdMap := ell.injective.ne hdRoot
  rw [mappedRoot_actualPivot k K ell]
  simpa only [trace2, determinant, map_sub, map_pow, map_mul,
    map_add, map_zero, map_four, RingHom.mapMatrix_apply, Matrix.map_apply] using hdMap

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.MappedTemplateComparison.mapMatrix_injective
statement:
private theorem mapMatrix_injective (ell : Root k →+* K) :
    Function.Injective (ell.mapMatrix : Mat3 (Root k) → Mat3 K)
proof:
:= by
  intro A B h
  ext i j
  apply ell.injective
  exact congrFun (congrFun h i) j

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.MappedTemplateComparison.mappedRoot_left_opens
statement:
theorem mappedRoot_left_opens (ell : Root k →+* K) :
    let f
proof:
:= mappedRootSecondA k K ell
    let a := fun l => topLeft
      (mappedRootN k K ell *
        (mappedRootCarrier k K ell 2 l : Mat6 K) * mappedRootQ k K ell)
    let su := fun l => unhat (topRight
      (mappedRootN k K ell *
        (mappedRootCarrier k K ell 2 l : Mat6 K) * mappedRootQ k K ell))
    Matrix.det (grading * encoder (f 0) (f 2) -
      encoder (f 0) (f 2) * grading) ≠ 0 ∧
      (∀ l, Matrix.adjugate (a l) ≠ 0) ∧
      (∃ r s, su 0 r * su 1 s - su 0 s * su 1 r ≠ 0) := by
  dsimp only
  obtain ⟨hprobe, hadj, hrank⟩ := root_left_template_opens k
  have hgrading : ell.mapMatrix
      (grading : Mat3 (Root k)) = (grading : Mat3 K) := by
    ext i j
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
      simp [grading, Matrix.diagonal, Matrix.cons_val_two]
  have hencoder (x y : Mat3 (Root k)) :
      ell.mapMatrix (encoder x y) = encoder (ell.mapMatrix x) (ell.mapMatrix y) := by
    exact mapMatrix_sub k K ell y x
  have hprobeMap := ell.injective.ne hprobe
  rw [RingHom.map_det] at hprobeMap
  simp only [map_sub, map_mul, map_zero, hgrading, hencoder] at hprobeMap
  have haMap (l : Fin 3) :
      ell.mapMatrix (rootSplitThirdA k l) =
        topLeft (mappedRootN k K ell *
          (mappedRootCarrier k K ell 2 l : Mat6 K) *
            mappedRootQ k K ell) := by
    rw [rootSplitThirdA, map_topLeft]
    simp only [rootSplitFrame, mappedRootN, mappedRootQ,
      mappedRootCarrier, mapCarrier_coe, map_mul]
  have hadjMap : ∀ l, Matrix.adjugate
      (topLeft (mappedRootN k K ell *
        (mappedRootCarrier k K ell 2 l : Mat6 K) *
          mappedRootQ k K ell)) ≠ 0 := by
    intro l hz
    apply hadj l
    apply mapMatrix_injective k K ell
    rw [RingHom.map_adjugate, haMap l, hz]
    simp
  obtain ⟨r, s, hrs⟩ := hrank
  have huMap (l : Fin 3) :
      (fun i => ell (rootSplitThirdU k l i)) =
        unhat (topRight (mappedRootN k K ell *
          (mappedRootCarrier k K ell 2 l : Mat6 K) *
            mappedRootQ k K ell)) := by
    rw [rootSplitThirdU, map_unhat, map_topRight]
    simp only [rootSplitFrame, mappedRootN, mappedRootQ,
      mappedRootCarrier, mapCarrier_coe, map_mul]
  have hrsMap := ell.injective.ne hrs
  simp only [map_sub, map_mul, map_zero, congrFun (huMap 0),
    congrFun (huMap 1)] at hrsMap
  exact ⟨hprobeMap, hadjMap, ⟨r, s, hrsMap⟩⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.MappedTemplateComparison.exists_mapped_template_gsp
statement:
theorem exists_mapped_template_gsp
    (ell : Root k →+* K)
    (E' F' P' : Fin 3 → Carrier K)
    (hEidem' : ∀ i, (E' i : Mat6 K) * E' i = E' i)
    (hEtrace' : ∀ i, jordanTrace (K := K) (E' i : Mat6 K) = 1)
    (hEsum' : (E' 0 : Mat6 K) + E' 1 + E' 2 = 1)
    (hFidem' : ∀ i, (F' i : Mat6 K) * F' i = F' i)
    (hFtrace' : ∀ i, jordanTrace (K := K) (F' i : Mat6 K) = 1)
    (hFsum' : (F' 0 : Mat6 K) + F' 1 + F' 2 = 1)
    (hPidem' : ∀ i, (P' i : Mat6 K) * P' i = P' i)
    (hPtrace' : ∀ i, jordanTrace (K := K) (P' i : Mat6 K) = 1)
    (hPsum' : (P' 0 : Mat6 K) + P' 1 + P' 2 = 1)
    (hledger : ActualSplitThirdFrameAut.carrierLedger
        (fun i => mappedRootCarrier k K ell 0 i)
        (fun i => mappedRootCarrier k K ell 1 i)
        (fun i => mappedRootCarrier k K ell 2 i) =
      ActualSplitThirdFrameAut.carrierLedger E' F' P') :
    ∃ M MInv : Mat6 K, ∃ mu : K,
      M * MInv = 1 ∧ MInv * M = 1 ∧ mu ≠ 0 ∧
      M.transpose * symplecticJ * M = mu • symplecticJ ∧
      (∀ i, M * (mappedRootCarrier k K ell 0 i : Mat6 K) * MInv =
        (E' i : Mat6 K)) ∧
      (∀ i, M * (mappedRootCarrier k K ell 1 i : Mat6 K) * MInv =
        (F' i : Mat6 K)) ∧
      (∀ i, M * (mappedRootCarrier k K ell 2 i : Mat6 K) * MInv =
        (P' i : Mat6 K))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hEidem, hEtrace, hEsum⟩ := mappedRootCarrier_laws k K ell 0
  obtain ⟨hFidem, hFtrace, hFsum⟩ := mappedRootCarrier_laws k K ell 1
  obtain ⟨hPidem, hPtrace, hPsum⟩ := mappedRootCarrier_laws k K ell 2
  obtain ⟨hQN, hNQ, hQform⟩ := mappedRoot_splitter_laws k K ell
  obtain ⟨hprobe, hadj, hrank⟩ := mappedRoot_left_opens k K ell
  obtain ⟨A, B, nu, t, M, MInv, mu, hAB, hBA, hnu, hAform, ht,
      hM, hMInv, hmu, hMMInv, hMInvM, hmune, hMform, hME, hMF, hMP⟩ :=
    exists_actual_triple_gsp_of_one_splitter
      (fun i => mappedRootCarrier k K ell 0 i)
      (fun i => mappedRootCarrier k K ell 1 i)
      (fun i => mappedRootCarrier k K ell 2 i)
      E' F' P'
      hEidem hEtrace hEsum hFidem hFtrace hFsum hPidem hPtrace hPsum
      hEidem' hEtrace' hEsum' hFidem' hFtrace' hFsum'
      hPidem' hPtrace' hPsum' hledger
      (mappedRootU k K ell) (mappedRootV k K ell)
      (mappedRootWeight k K ell) (mappedRootWeight_pairing k K ell)
      (mappedRootWeight_ne k K ell)
      (mappedRoot_compresses_left k K ell)
      (mappedRoot_compresses_right k K ell)
      (mappedRootWeight_ledger k K ell)
      (mappedRootWeight_one_add_two_ne k K ell)
      (mappedRoot_discriminant_ne k K ell)
      (mappedRootQ k K ell) (mappedRootN k K ell) hQN hNQ hQform
      (mappedRootSecondA k K ell)
      (mappedRoot_first_split k K ell)
      (mappedRoot_second_split k K ell)
      hprobe hadj (Or.inl hrank)
  exact ⟨M, MInv, mu, hMMInv, hMInvM, hmune, hMform, hME, hMF, hMP⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.commonPlaneJordanAut_apply_coe
statement:
theorem commonPlaneJordanAut_apply_coe
    (E E' : Fin 3 → Carrier K)
    (hEidem : ∀ i, (E i : Mat6 K) * E i = E i) (hEsum : (E 0 : Mat6 K) + E 1 + E 2 = 1)
    (hEidem' : ∀ i, (E' i : Mat6 K) * E' i = E' i) (hEsum' : (E' 0 : Mat6 K) + E' 1 + E' 2 = 1)
    (u v u' v' : Vec6 K) (p : Fin 3 → K)
    (hp : ∀ i, p i = (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v))
    (hp' : ∀ i, p i = (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E' i : Mat6 K) u') (matrixAction (E' i : Mat6 K) v'))
    (hpne : ∀ i, p i ≠ 0) (S T : Mat2 K) (hST : S*T=1) (hTS : T*S=1)
    (hdet : det2 S ≠ 0) (P : Carrier K) :
    (((commonPlaneJordanAut E E' hEidem hEsum hEidem' hEsum' u v u' v' p
      hp hp' hpne S T hST hTS hdet).linear P : Carrier K) : Mat6 K) =
      matrixOfLinear (commonPlaneForward E E' hEidem hEsum hEidem' hEsum'
        u v u' v' p hp hp' hpne S) * (P : Mat6 K) *
      matrixOfLinear (commonPlaneBackward E E' hEidem hEsum hEidem' hEsum'
        u v u' v' p hp hp' hpne T)
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.WeightedProjectorGauge.commonPlaneJordanAut_maps_of_action
statement:
theorem commonPlaneJordanAut_maps_of_action
    (E E' : Fin 3 → Carrier K)
    (hEidem : ∀ i, (E i : Mat6 K) * E i = E i) (hEsum : (E 0 : Mat6 K) + E 1 + E 2 = 1)
    (hEidem' : ∀ i, (E' i : Mat6 K) * E' i = E' i) (hEsum' : (E' 0 : Mat6 K) + E' 1 + E' 2 = 1)
    (u v u' v' : Vec6 K) (p : Fin 3 → K)
    (hp : ∀ i, p i = (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v))
    (hp' : ∀ i, p i = (omega (K := K)) (matrixAction (E' i : Mat6 K) u') (matrixAction (E' i : Mat6 K) v'))
    (hpne : ∀ i, p i ≠ 0) (S T : Mat2 K) (hST : S*T=1) (hTS : T*S=1)
    (hdet : det2 S ≠ 0) (P Q : Carrier K)
    (haction : (commonPlaneForward E E' hEidem hEsum hEidem' hEsum'
        u v u' v' p hp hp' hpne S).comp ((matrixAction (P : Mat6 K)).comp
      (commonPlaneBackward E E' hEidem hEsum hEidem' hEsum'
        u v u' v' p hp hp' hpne T)) = matrixAction (Q : Mat6 K)) :
    (commonPlaneJordanAut E E' hEidem hEsum hEidem' hEsum' u v u' v' p
      hp hp' hpne S T hST hTS hdet).linear P = Q
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [commonPlaneJordanAut_apply_coe]
  apply matrixAction_injective
  rw [matrixAction_mul, matrixAction_mul, matrixAction_matrixOfLinear,
    matrixAction_matrixOfLinear]
  exact haction

name: AlbertLean.Comparison.GenericTraceAssociativity.traceAssocResidualMap_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem traceAssocResidualMap_apply (v : Fin 3 → F0Coord K) :
    traceAssocResidualMap (K := K) v =
      traceAssocResidual f0TraceFormLinearK f0ProductLinearK

name: AlbertLean.Comparison.GenericTraceAssociativity.traceAssocResidual_mapCoordQK
statement:
theorem traceAssocResidual_mapCoordQK (x y z : Coord) :
    traceAssocResidual f0TraceFormLinearK f0ProductLinearK
        (mapCoordQK K x) (mapCoordQK K y) (mapCoordQK K z) =
      algebraMap ℚ K
        (traceForm (structuredProduct x y) z -
          traceForm x (structuredProduct y z))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [traceAssocResidual, f0TraceFormLinearK_apply,
    f0ProductLinearK_apply, f0ProductK_mapCoordQK,
    f0TraceFormK_mapCoordQK, map_sub]

name: AlbertLean.Comparison.GenericTraceAssociativity.traceAssocResidual_basis_zero
statement:
theorem traceAssocResidual_basis_zero (i j l : Fin 27) :
    traceAssocResidual f0TraceFormLinearK f0ProductLinearK
        (Pi.basisFun K (Fin 27) i) (Pi.basisFun K (Fin 27) j)
        (Pi.basisFun K (Fin 27) l) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mapCoordQK_basis (K := K) i, ← mapCoordQK_basis (K := K) j,
    ← mapCoordQK_basis (K := K) l, traceAssocResidual_mapCoordQK,
    AlbertLean.traceFormAssociative, sub_self, map_zero]

name: AlbertLean.Comparison.GenericTraceAssociativity.traceAssocResidualMap_eq_zero
statement:
theorem traceAssocResidualMap_eq_zero :
    traceAssocResidualMap (K := K) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Module.Basis.ext_multilinear
    (fun _ : Fin 3 => Pi.basisFun K (Fin 27))
  intro v
  simp only [traceAssocResidualMap_apply, MultilinearMap.zero_apply]
  exact traceAssocResidual_basis_zero (K := K) (v 0) (v 1) (v 2)

name: AlbertLean.Comparison.GenericTraceAssociativity.f0TraceForm_associative
statement:
theorem f0TraceForm_associative (x y z : F0Coord K) :
    f0TraceFormK (f0ProductK x y) z =
      f0TraceFormK x (f0ProductK y z)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg
    (fun F : MultilinearMap K (fun _ : Fin 3 => F0Coord K) K =>
      F ![x, y, z]) (traceAssocResidualMap_eq_zero (K := K))
  change f0TraceFormK (f0ProductK x y) z -
    f0TraceFormK x (f0ProductK y z) = 0 at h
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp h

name: AlbertLean.Comparison.GenericTraceAssociativity.sourceTraceForm_associative
statement:
theorem sourceTraceForm_associative (x y z : JCoord K) :
    sourceTraceForm (sourceProduct x y) z =
      sourceTraceForm x (sourceProduct y z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sourceTraceForm_agrees_with_f0K, sourceTraceForm_agrees_with_f0K,
    GenericStructuredProductAgreesWithF0,
    GenericStructuredProductAgreesWithF0]
  exact f0TraceForm_associative _ _ _

name: AlbertLean.Comparison.GenericTraceAssociativity.sourceTrace_product_product_idempotent
statement:
theorem sourceTrace_product_product_idempotent
    (p x : JCoord K) (hp : sourceProduct p p = p) :
    sourceTrace (sourceProduct p (sourceProduct p x)) =
      sourceTrace (sourceProduct p x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sourceTrace_product_eq_traceForm, sourceTrace_product_eq_traceForm,
    ← sourceTraceForm_associative, hp]

name: AlbertLean.Comparison.GenericTraceAssociativity.sourceTrace_reflection
statement:
theorem sourceTrace_reflection (p x : JCoord K)
    (hp : sourceProduct p p = p) :
    sourceTrace (reflection sourceProductLinear p x) = sourceTrace x
proof:
:= by
  change sourceTraceLinear
      (x - (8 : K) • sourceProduct p x +
        (8 : K) • sourceProduct p (sourceProduct p x)) = sourceTrace x
  simp only [map_add, map_sub, map_smul, sourceTraceLinear_apply]
  rw [sourceTrace_product_product_idempotent p x hp]
  module

statement:

proof:

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ParameterLaurent.parameterTriple_cK
statement:

proof:

      f0EncoderB, structuredEquiv, structuredToF0, encoderB, vectorB,
      chartWithResidualPair, parameterKConst, parameterKPos, parameterKInv,
      parameterMoment_eq_witnessChart1_A, parameterResidualPair_X,
      parameterResidualPair_A_zero, parameterResidualPair_A_one,

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ParameterLaurent.parameterTriple_eq_laurentTriple
statement:
theorem parameterTriple_eq_laurentTriple (t : ℚ) (ht : t ≠ 0) :
    parameterTriple t ht =
      laurentTriple theta1E parameterFConst parameterFInv
        parameterKConst parameterKPos parameterKInv t
proof:

      ⟨(parameterTriple t ht).cE, (parameterTriple t ht).cF,
        (parameterTriple t ht).cK⟩ by
    cases parameterTriple t ht
    rfl]
