  rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TitsFrames.matrix_adjugate_identity
statement:
theorem matrix_adjugate_identity (M : Mat3 K) :
    M.adjugate = M * M - Matrix.trace M • M + Matrix.trace M.adjugate • 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.adjugate_fin_three, Matrix.trace_fin_three,
    Matrix.trace_fin_three]
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ, Matrix.one_apply] <;> ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TitsFrames.firstTitsSquare_eq_self_of_trace_one_of_sharp_eq_zero
statement:
theorem firstTitsSquare_eq_self_of_trace_one_of_sharp_eq_zero
    (z : FirstTits K) (htrace : trace3 z.1 = 1)
    (hsharp : firstTitsSharp z = 0) : firstTitsSquare z = z
proof:
:= by
  rcases z with ⟨A, B, C⟩
  have hA : adjugate3 A = B * C := by
    have h : adjugate3 A - B * C = 0 := by
      simpa [firstTitsSharp] using congrArg Prod.fst hsharp
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp h
  have hC : adjugate3 C = A * B := by
    have h : adjugate3 C - A * B = 0 := by
      simpa [firstTitsSharp] using congrArg (fun q => q.2.1) hsharp
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp h
  have hB : adjugate3 B = C * A := by
    have h : adjugate3 B - C * A = 0 := by
      simpa [firstTitsSharp] using congrArg (fun q => q.2.2) hsharp
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp h
  have hadj3 : adjugate3 A =
      A * A - trace3 A • A + trace3 (adjugate3 A) • 1 := by
    simpa only [trace3_eq_matrixTrace, adjugate3_eq_matrixAdjugate] using
      matrix_adjugate_identity A
  apply Prod.ext
  · change A * A - B * C + trace3 (B * C) • 1 = A
    calc
      A * A - B * C + trace3 (B * C) • 1 =
          A * A - adjugate3 A + trace3 (adjugate3 A) • 1 := by rw [hA]
      _ = A * A -
          (A * A - trace3 A • A + trace3 (adjugate3 A) • 1) +
            trace3 (adjugate3 A) • 1 :=
        congrArg (fun M : Mat3 K => A * A - M + trace3 (adjugate3 A) • 1) hadj3
      _ = trace3 A • A := by module
      _ = A := by rw [htrace, one_smul]
  · apply Prod.ext
    · change adjugate3 C - A * B + trace3 A • B = B
      rw [hC, htrace]
      simp
    · change adjugate3 B - C * A + trace3 A • C = C
      rw [hB, htrace]
      simp

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TitsFrames.toTau_mul_self_eq_self_of_trace_one_of_sharp_eq_zero
statement:
theorem toTau_mul_self_eq_self_of_trace_one_of_sharp_eq_zero
    (z : FirstTits K) (htrace : trace3 z.1 = 1)
    (hsharp : firstTitsSharp z = 0) :
    toTau z * toTau z = toTau z
proof:
:= by
  rw [← toTau_firstTitsSquare,
    firstTitsSquare_eq_self_of_trace_one_of_sharp_eq_zero z htrace hsharp]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.TitsFrames.toTau_sourceFrame
statement:
theorem toTau_sourceFrame (f : Fin 3 → FirstTits K) (hf : SourceFrame f) :
    (∀ i, TauCeti.AlbertAlgebra.trace (toTau (f i)) = 1) ∧
    (∀ i, toTau (f i) * toTau (f i) = toTau (f i)) ∧
    toTau (f 0) + toTau (f 1) + toTau (f 2) = 1 ∧
    toTau (f 0) * toTau (f 1) = 0 ∧
    toTau (f 0) * toTau (f 2) = 0 ∧
    toTau (f 1) * toTau (f 2) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have htr : ∀ i, TauCeti.AlbertAlgebra.trace (toTau (f i)) = 1 := by
    intro i
    rw [tauTrace_toTau, ← trace3_eq_matrixTrace]
    exact hf.trace_one i
  have hid : ∀ i, toTau (f i) * toTau (f i) = toTau (f i) := by
    intro i
    exact toTau_mul_self_eq_self_of_trace_one_of_sharp_eq_zero
      (f i) (hf.trace_one i) (hf.sharp_zero i)
  have hsum : toTau (f 0) + toTau (f 1) + toTau (f 2) = 1 := by
    rw [← map_add, ← map_add, hf.sum_one, toTau_firstTitsOne]
  have htwo : ∀ x : Albert K, x + x = 0 → x = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    have hm := congrArg (fun y : Albert K => ⅟(2 : K) • y) hx
    simpa only [← two_smul K x, smul_zero, smul_smul,
      invOf_mul_self, one_smul] using hm
  rcases pairwise_mul_eq_zero_of_sum_eq_one
      (toTau (f 0)) (toTau (f 1)) (toTau (f 2))
      (fun x y => mul_comm x y) htwo (hid 0) (hid 1) (hid 2) hsum with
    ⟨h01, h02, h12⟩
  exact ⟨htr, hid, hsum, h01, h02, h12⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexPairOpenSeed.seedOverlap_table
statement:
theorem seedOverlap_table :
    (fun i j => seedOverlap (K := K) i j) = printedOverlap
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    norm_num [seedOverlap, printedOverlap, X, Xi, Matrix.cons_val_two]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexPairOpenSeed.seedOverlap_ne_zero
statement: theorem seedOverlap_ne_zero (i j : Fin 3) : seedOverlap (K := K) i j ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [show seedOverlap (K := K) i j = printedOverlap i j from
    congrFun (congrFun (seedOverlap_table (K := K)) i) j]
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    norm_num [printedOverlap, Matrix.cons_val_two]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexPairOpenSeed.det_X_ne_zero
statement: theorem det_X_ne_zero : Matrix.det (X : Mat3 K) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hdet
  have h := congrArg Matrix.det (X_mul_Xi (K := K))
  rw [Matrix.det_mul, hdet, zero_mul, Matrix.det_one] at h
  exact zero_ne_one h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexPairOpenSeed.nonsing_inv_X
statement: theorem nonsing_inv_X : (X : Mat3 K)⁻¹ = Xi
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.inv_eq_left_inv
  exact Xi_mul_X (K := K)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexPairOpenSeed.overlapOf_X_eq_seedOverlap
statement:
theorem overlapOf_X_eq_seedOverlap (i j : Fin 3) :
    overlapOf (X : Mat3 K) i j = seedOverlap i j
proof:
:= by
  rw [overlapOf, nonsing_inv_X]
  rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexPairOpenSeed.overlapOf_X_ne_zero
statement:
theorem overlapOf_X_ne_zero (i j : Fin 3) :
    overlapOf (X : Mat3 K) i j ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [overlapOf_X_eq_seedOverlap]
  exact seedOverlap_ne_zero i j

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexPairOpenSeed.diagonal_conjugate_entry
statement:
theorem diagonal_conjugate_entry (U V : Mat3 K) (l r c : Fin 3) :
    ((U * diagonalUnit l * V) : Mat3 K) r c = U r l * V l c
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases l <;>
    simp [Matrix.mul_apply, diagonalUnit, Fin.sum_univ_succ]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexPairOpenSeed.frame_entry
statement:
theorem frame_entry (j r c : Fin 3) :
    (frame j : Mat3 K) r c = (X : Mat3 K) r j * (Xi : Mat3 K) j c
proof:
:=
  diagonal_conjugate_entry X Xi j r c

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexPairOpenSeed.standard_seed_frame_overlap
statement:
theorem standard_seed_frame_overlap (i j : Fin 3) :
    Matrix.trace (diagonalUnit i * (frame j : Mat3 K)) = seedOverlap i j
proof:
:= by
  rw [trace_diagonalUnit, frame_entry]
  rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexPairOpenSeed.standard_seed_frame_overlap_ne_zero
statement:
theorem standard_seed_frame_overlap_ne_zero (i j : Fin 3) :
    Matrix.trace (diagonalUnit i * (frame j : Mat3 K)) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [standard_seed_frame_overlap]
  exact seedOverlap_ne_zero i j

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexPairOpenSeed.seed_frame_laws
statement: theorem seed_frame_laws : ComplexRow.GLFrame.FrameLaws (frame (K := K))
proof:
:= by
  have hframe : (frame : Fin 3 → Mat3 K) =
      ComplexRow.GLFrame.frameOfInvertible (X : Mat3 K) := by
    funext i
    simp only [frame, ComplexRow.GLFrame.frameOfInvertible,
      ComplexRow.GLFrame.conjugate, nonsing_inv_X]
  rw [hframe]
  exact ComplexRow.GLFrame.frameOfInvertible_laws X det_X_ne_zero

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexPairOpenSeed.standard_frame_laws
statement:
theorem standard_frame_laws :
    ComplexRow.GLFrame.FrameLaws (diagonalUnit (K := K))
proof:
:= by
  have hframe : ComplexRow.GLFrame.frameOfInvertible (1 : Mat3 K) = diagonalUnit := by
    funext i
    simp [ComplexRow.GLFrame.frameOfInvertible, ComplexRow.GLFrame.conjugate]
  rw [← hframe]
  exact ComplexRow.GLFrame.frameOfInvertible_laws 1 (by simp)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexPairOpenSeed.seedTriple_frame_laws
statement:
theorem seedTriple_frame_laws (r : Fin 3) :
    ComplexRow.GLFrame.FrameLaws (seedTriple (K := K) r)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hr : r = 1
  · have heq : seedTriple (K := K) r = frame := by
      funext i
      simp [seedTriple, hr]
    rw [heq]
    exact seed_frame_laws
  · have heq : seedTriple (K := K) r = diagonalUnit := by
      funext i
      simp [seedTriple, hr]
    rw [heq]
    exact standard_frame_laws

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexPairOpenSeed.seedTriple_isRawFrameFamily
statement:
theorem seedTriple_isRawFrameFamily :
    IsRawFrameFamily (seedTriple (K := K))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun r i => (seedTriple_frame_laws r).idempotent i,
    fun r i => (seedTriple_frame_laws r).trace_one i, ?_⟩
  intro r
  simpa [Fin.sum_univ_succ, add_assoc] using (seedTriple_frame_laws (K := K) r).sum_eq_one

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexPairOpenSeed.seedTriple_commutator_det
statement:
theorem seedTriple_commutator_det :
    Matrix.det (grading * encoder (seedTriple (K := K) 1 0) (seedTriple 1 2) -
      encoder (seedTriple 1 0) (seedTriple 1 2) * grading) = 22
proof:
:= by
  simpa [seedTriple] using (frame_commutator_det (K := K))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexPairOpenSeed.exists_pair_open_commutator_triple_exact
statement:
theorem exists_pair_open_commutator_triple_exact :
    ∃ (E F G : Fin 3 → Mat3 K),
      IsRawFrameFamily (fun r i => ![E i, F i, G i] r) ∧
      (∀ i, E i = diagonalUnit i) ∧
      (∀ j, F j = frame j) ∧
      (∀ l, G l = diagonalUnit l) ∧
      (∀ i j, Matrix.trace (E i * F j) ≠ 0) ∧
      Matrix.det (grading * encoder (F 0) (F 2) -
        encoder (F 0) (F 2) * grading) = 22
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨diagonalUnit, frame, diagonalUnit, ?_, fun _ => rfl, fun _ => rfl,
    fun _ => rfl, standard_seed_frame_overlap_ne_zero, frame_commutator_det⟩
  have hfamily : (fun r i => ![diagonalUnit i, frame i, diagonalUnit i] r) =
      seedTriple (K := K) := by
    funext r i
    fin_cases r <;> simp [seedTriple, Matrix.cons_val_two]
  rw [hfamily]
  exact seedTriple_isRawFrameFamily

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexPairOpenSeed.exists_pair_open_commutator_triple
statement:
theorem exists_pair_open_commutator_triple :
    ∃ (E F G : Fin 3 → Mat3 K),
      IsRawFrameFamily (fun r i => ![E i, F i, G i] r) ∧
      (∀ i, E i = diagonalUnit i) ∧
      (∀ j, F j = frame j) ∧
      (∀ l, G l = diagonalUnit l) ∧
      (∀ i j, Matrix.trace (E i * F j) ≠ 0) ∧
      Matrix.det (grading * encoder (F 0) (F 2) -
        encoder (F 0) (F 2) * grading) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨E, F, G, hr, hE, hF, hG, ho, hd⟩ :=
    exists_pair_open_commutator_triple_exact (K := K)
  refine ⟨E, F, G, hr, hE, hF, hG, ho, ?_⟩
  rw [hd]
  norm_num

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ScalarJordanAut.conjugate_mem
statement:
theorem conjugate_mem (t : K) (ht : t ≠ 0) (P : Carrier K) :
    IsSelfAdjoint
      (scalarSimilitude t * (P : Mat6 K) * scalarSimilitudeInv t)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, u, v, hP⟩ := exists_grouped P
  rw [hP, scalarSimilitude_conjugates_grouped t ht]
  exact grouped_symplectic_selfadjoint _ _ _

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ScalarJordanAut.actLinear_coe
statement:
@[simp] theorem actLinear_coe (t : K) (ht : t ≠ 0) (P : Carrier K) :
    ((actLinear t ht P : Carrier K) : Mat6 K) =
      scalarSimilitude t * P * scalarSimilitudeInv t
proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ScalarJordanAut.scalarAut_grouped
statement:
@[simp] theorem scalarAut_grouped
    (t : K) (ht : t ≠ 0) (a : ScalarFibre.Mat3 K)
    (u v : ScalarFibre.Vec3 K)
    (P : Carrier K) (hP : (P : Mat6 K) = grouped a u v) :
    (((scalarAut t ht).linear P : Carrier K) : Mat6 K) =
      grouped a (t • u) (t⁻¹ • v)
proof:
:= by
  change scalarSimilitude t * (P : Mat6 K) * scalarSimilitudeInv t = _
  rw [hP, scalarSimilitude_conjugates_grouped t ht]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceMidpointTrace.one_add_ne_zero
statement: private theorem one_add_ne_zero {s : K} (hsneg : s ≠ -1) : 1 + s ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply hsneg
  calc
    s = (1 + s) - 1 := by ring
    _ = -1 := by rw [h]; ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceMidpointTrace.trace_midpoint
statement:
theorem trace_midpoint
    {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    (T : V →ₗ[K] K) (e f c : V) (s : K)
    (he : T e = 1) (hf : T f = 1) (hc : T c = s ^ 2)
    (hs0 : s ≠ 0) (hsneg : s ≠ -1) :
    T (midpoint e f c s) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [midpoint, map_smul, map_add, map_add, map_smul, he, hf, hc]
  change (2 * (1 + s))⁻¹ * (1 + 1 + (2 / s) * s ^ 2) = 1
  field_simp [hs0, one_add_ne_zero hsneg]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceMidpointTrace.sourceTrace_diagonalUnit
statement:
@[simp] theorem sourceTrace_diagonalUnit (i : Fin 3) :
    sourceTrace (diagonalUnit (K := K) i) = 1
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i <;> simp [diagonalUnit, diagonal, sourceTrace]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceMidpointTrace.sourceTrace_midpoint_diagonalUnit
statement:
theorem sourceTrace_midpoint_diagonalUnit
    (e : JCoord K) (i : Fin 3) (s : K)
    (htrace : sourceTrace e = 1)
    (hsquare : s ^ 2 = sourceTrace (sourceProduct e (diagonalUnit i)))
    (hs0 : s ≠ 0) (hsneg : s ≠ -1) :
    sourceTrace
      (midpoint e (diagonalUnit i) (sourceProduct e (diagonalUnit i)) s) = 1
proof:
:= by
  change sourceTraceLinear
    (midpoint e (diagonalUnit i) (sourceProduct e (diagonalUnit i)) s) = 1
  apply trace_midpoint sourceTraceLinear e (diagonalUnit i)
    (sourceProduct e (diagonalUnit i)) s
  · exact htrace
  · exact sourceTrace_diagonalUnit i
  · simpa only [sourceTraceLinear_apply] using hsquare.symm
  · exact hs0
  · exact hsneg

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceMidpointTrace.sourceMidpoint_trace
statement:
theorem sourceMidpoint_trace
    (e : JCoord K) (s : K) (htrace : sourceTrace e = 1)
    (hsquare : s ^ 2 = e.d1) (hs0 : s ≠ 0) (hsneg : s ≠ -1) :
    sourceTrace (sourceMidpoint e s) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [sourceMidpoint]
  apply sourceTrace_midpoint_diagonalUnit e 0 s htrace
  simpa only [StandardTargetPairTable.sourceTrace_target_zero] using hsquare
  exact hs0
  exact hsneg

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceMidpointTrace.exists_nonzero_diagonal_of_sourceTrace_one
statement:
theorem exists_nonzero_diagonal_of_sourceTrace_one
    (e : JCoord K) (htrace : sourceTrace e = 1) :
    e.d1 ≠ 0 ∨ e.d2 ≠ 0 ∨ e.d3 ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h1 : e.d1 = 0
  · by_cases h2 : e.d2 = 0
    · right
      right
      intro h3
      have : sourceTrace e = 0 := by simp [sourceTrace, h1, h2, h3]
      rw [htrace] at this
      exact one_ne_zero this
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl h2)
  · exact Or.inl h1

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceEncoderChartReadback.readback_isKappaLift
statement:
theorem readback_isKappaLift (x y : JCoord K) (sigma a h : K)
    (ha : a ≠ 0) (hx : x.v = targetFirst a)
    (hy : y.v = targetSecond a h sigma) :
    IsKappaLift (readback x y sigma)
proof:

    targetSecond, targetB, targetC, planeVector]
  field_simp [ha]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceEncoderChartReadback.equationsVanish_readback
statement:
theorem equationsVanish_readback (x y : JCoord K) (sigma a h : K)
    (hx : x.v = targetFirst a) (hy : y.v = targetSecond a h sigma)
    (hTx : sourceTrace x = 0) (hSx : sourceSpur x = -1)
    (hNx : sourceNorm x = 0) (hTy : sourceTrace y = 0)
    (hSy : sourceSpur y = -1) (hNy : sourceNorm y = 0) :
    EquationsVanish (explicitFrameEquationValues (readback x y sigma))
proof:
:= by
  apply (equationsVanish_iff_source_fixedSpectrum (readback x y sigma)).2
  rw [encoderA_readback x y sigma a hx,
    encoderB_readback x y sigma a h hy]
  exact ⟨hTx, hSx, hNx, hTy, hSy, hNy⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceEncoderChartReadback.readback_spec
statement:
theorem readback_spec (x y : JCoord K) (sigma a h : K)
    (ha : a ≠ 0) (hx : x.v = targetFirst a)
    (hy : y.v = targetSecond a h sigma)
    (hTx : sourceTrace x = 0) (hSx : sourceSpur x = -1)
    (hNx : sourceNorm x = 0) (hTy : sourceTrace y = 0)
    (hSy : sourceSpur y = -1) (hNy : sourceNorm y = 0) :
    encoderA (readback x y sigma) = x ∧
      encoderB (readback x y sigma) = y ∧
      IsKappaLift (readback x y sigma) ∧
      EquationsVanish (explicitFrameEquationValues (readback x y sigma))
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨encoderA_readback x y sigma a hx,
    encoderB_readback x y sigma a h hy,
    readback_isKappaLift x y sigma a h ha hx hy,
    equationsVanish_readback x y sigma a h hx hy hTx hSx hNx hTy hSy hNy⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceEncoderChartReadback.exists_finite_dephase_readback
statement:
theorem exists_finite_dephase_readback (x y : JCoord K)
    (ha : nV x.v ≠ 0)
    (hGram : 4 * nV x.v * nV y.v - (BV x.v y.v) ^ 2 ≠ 0)
    (hTx : sourceTrace x = 0) (hSx : sourceSpur x = -1)
    (hNx : sourceNorm x = 0) (hTy : sourceTrace y = 0)
    (hSy : sourceSpur y = -1) (hNy : sourceNorm y = 0) :
    ∃ (L : Type u) (_ : Field L) (_ : CharZero L)
      (f : K →+* L) (sigma : L) (g : ResidualAction.SourceAut (K := L))
      (q : ExplicitFrameChart L),
      Function.Injective f ∧
      sigma ^ 2 = f ((BV x.v y.v) ^ 2 - 4 * nV x.v * nV y.v) ∧
      sigma ≠ 0 ∧
      (∀ i, g.linear (diagonalUnit i) = diagonalUnit i) ∧
      encoderA q = g.linear (mapSource f x) ∧
      encoderB q = g.linear (mapSource f y) ∧
      IsKappaLift q ∧
      EquationsVanish (explicitFrameEquationValues q)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨L, iL, cL, f, sigma, g, hf, hsigma, hsigma0, hdiag, _, hx, hy⟩ :=
    exists_common_field_sourceAut x y ha hGram
  letI : Field L := iL
  letI : CharZero L := cL
  let X := g.linear (mapSource f x)
  let Y := g.linear (mapSource f y)
  let q := readback X Y sigma
  have hfa : f (nV x.v) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [map_zero] using hf.ne ha
  have hTX : sourceTrace X = 0 := by
    dsimp only [X]
    rw [SourceAutInvariants.sourceTrace_invariant, mapSource_trace, hTx, map_zero]
  have hSX : sourceSpur X = -1 := by
    dsimp only [X]
    rw [sourceSpur_invariant, sourceSpur_mapSource, hSx, map_neg, map_one]
  have hNX : sourceNorm X = 0 := by
    dsimp only [X]
    rw [sourceNorm_invariant, sourceNorm_mapSource, hNx, map_zero]
  have hTY : sourceTrace Y = 0 := by
    dsimp only [Y]
    rw [SourceAutInvariants.sourceTrace_invariant, mapSource_trace, hTy, map_zero]
  have hSY : sourceSpur Y = -1 := by
    dsimp only [Y]
    rw [sourceSpur_invariant, sourceSpur_mapSource, hSy, map_neg, map_one]
  have hNY : sourceNorm Y = 0 := by
    dsimp only [Y]
    rw [sourceNorm_invariant, sourceNorm_mapSource, hNy, map_zero]
  refine ⟨L, iL, cL, f, sigma, g, q, hf, hsigma, hsigma0, hdiag, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact encoderA_readback X Y sigma (f (nV x.v)) hx
  · exact encoderB_readback X Y sigma (f (nV x.v)) (f (BV x.v y.v)) hy
  · exact readback_isKappaLift X Y sigma (f (nV x.v))
      (f (BV x.v y.v)) hfa hx hy
  · exact equationsVanish_readback X Y sigma (f (nV x.v))
      (f (BV x.v y.v)) hx hy hTX hSX hNX hTY hSY hNY

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceDetectorTransport.map_sourceWord

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceDetectorTransport.sourceDetector_map

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.NormalizationOpen.conjugate_comp
statement:
theorem conjugate_comp (X Y A : Mat3 K) :
    conjugate X (conjugate Y A) = conjugate (X * Y) A
proof:
:= by
  simp only [conjugate, Matrix.mul_inv_rev, Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.NormalizationOpen.conjugate_sub
statement:
theorem conjugate_sub (X A B : Mat3 K) :
    conjugate X (A-B) = conjugate X A - conjugate X B
proof:
:= by
  simp only [conjugate, Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.sub_mul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.NormalizationOpen.conjugate_det
statement:
theorem conjugate_det (X : Mat3 K) (hX : X.det ≠ 0) (A : Mat3 K) :
    (conjugate X A).det = A.det
proof:
:= by
  rw [conjugate, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_nonsing_inv, Ring.inverse_eq_inv]
  field_simp [hX]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.NormalizationOpen.inverse_conjugate_frame_self
statement:
theorem inverse_conjugate_frame_self (X : Mat3 K) (hX : X.det ≠ 0) (i : Fin 3) :
    conjugate X⁻¹ (frameOfInvertible X i) = diagonalUnit i
proof:
:= by
  rw [frameOfInvertible, conjugate_comp,
    Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul X (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hX)]
  simp [conjugate]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.NormalizationOpen.inverse_conjugate_frame
statement:
theorem inverse_conjugate_frame (X Y : Mat3 K) (i : Fin 3) :
    conjugate X⁻¹ (frameOfInvertible Y i) = frameOfInvertible (X⁻¹ * Y) i
proof:
:= by
  exact conjugate_comp X⁻¹ Y (diagonalUnit i)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.NormalizationOpen.relative_overlap_eq_pair_trace
statement:
theorem relative_overlap_eq_pair_trace (X Y : Mat3 K) (hX : X.det ≠ 0)
    (i j : Fin 3) :
    overlapOf (X⁻¹ * Y) i j = Matrix.trace (frameOfInvertible X i * frameOfInvertible Y j)
proof:
:= by
  have hXi : (X⁻¹).det ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Matrix.det_nonsing_inv, Ring.inverse_eq_inv]
    exact inv_ne_zero hX
  rw [← trace_diagonalUnit_frameOfInvertible]
  calc
    Matrix.trace (diagonalUnit i * frameOfInvertible (X⁻¹ * Y) j) =
        Matrix.trace (conjugate X⁻¹ (frameOfInvertible X i) *
          conjugate X⁻¹ (frameOfInvertible Y j)) := by
      rw [inverse_conjugate_frame_self X hX, inverse_conjugate_frame]
    _ = Matrix.trace (conjugate X⁻¹ (frameOfInvertible X i * frameOfInvertible Y j)) := by
      rw [← GLFrame.conjugate_mul X⁻¹ hXi]
    _ = Matrix.trace (frameOfInvertible X i * frameOfInvertible Y j) :=
      GLFrame.conjugate_trace X⁻¹ hXi _

name: AlbertLean.Generic.ComplexRow.NormalizationOpen.normalized_encoderCommutator_det
statement:
theorem normalized_encoderCommutator_det (P : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Mat3 K)
    (Y : Mat3 K) (hY : Y.det ≠ 0) (hP0 : P 0 = frameOfInvertible Y) :
    Matrix.det (grading * encoder (normalizeBy Y P 1 0) (normalizeBy Y P 1 2) -
      encoder (normalizeBy Y P 1 0) (normalizeBy Y P 1 2) * grading) =
    Matrix.det ((P 0 2-P 0 0)*(P 1 2-P 1 0) -
      (P 1 2-P 1 0)*(P 0 2-P 0 0))
proof:
:= by
  have hYi : (Y⁻¹).det ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Matrix.det_nonsing_inv, Ring.inverse_eq_inv]
    exact inv_ne_zero hY
  have h0 : conjugate Y⁻¹ (P 0 2-P 0 0) = grading := by
    rw [conjugate_sub, hP0, inverse_conjugate_frame_self Y hY,
      inverse_conjugate_frame_self Y hY]
    exact diagonal_encoder_eq_grading
  have h1 : conjugate Y⁻¹ (P 1 2-P 1 0) =
      encoder (normalizeBy Y P 1 0) (normalizeBy Y P 1 2) := by
    rw [conjugate_sub]
    rfl
  have hc : conjugate Y⁻¹ ((P 0 2-P 0 0)*(P 1 2-P 1 0) -
      (P 1 2-P 1 0)*(P 0 2-P 0 0)) =
      grading * encoder (normalizeBy Y P 1 0) (normalizeBy Y P 1 2) -
        encoder (normalizeBy Y P 1 0) (normalizeBy Y P 1 2) * grading := by
    rw [conjugate_sub, GLFrame.conjugate_mul Y⁻¹ hYi,
      GLFrame.conjugate_mul Y⁻¹ hYi, h0, h1]
  rw [← hc, conjugate_det Y⁻¹ hYi]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceNormalizedChartReadback.moment_parameters
statement:
theorem moment_parameters (q : ExplicitFrameChart K)
    (hr : q.r1 = 1)
    (hq : EquationsVanish (explicitFrameEquationValues q))
    (hpA : q.diagA 1 - q.diagA 2 ≠ 0)
    (hpB : q.diagB 1 - q.diagB 2 ≠ 0) :
    GenericNormalizedFrameChart.moment (parameters q) = matrixM q
proof:
:= by
  have hd := omitted_diagonal q hq
  have hs := actual_diagonal_systems q hr hq
  have hA := solve_diagonal_pair
    (q.diagA 1) (q.diagA 2) (spurSumA (parameters q))
    (normWeightedA (parameters q)) (matrixM q 0 0) (matrixM q 2 2)
    hpA hs.1 hs.2.1
  have hB := solve_diagonal_pair
    (q.diagB 1) (q.diagB 2) (spurSumB (parameters q))
    (normWeightedB (parameters q)) (matrixM q 1 1) (matrixM q 3 3)
    hpB hs.2.2.1 hs.2.2.2
  have hm00 : m00 (parameters q) = matrixM q 0 0 := by
    rw [m00, pivotA, hd.1]
    exact hA.1
  have hm22 : m22 (parameters q) = matrixM q 2 2 := by
    rw [m22, hm00]
    linear_combination -hs.1
  have hm11 : m11 (parameters q) = matrixM q 1 1 := by
    rw [m11, pivotB, hd.2]
    exact hB.1
  have hm33 : m33 (parameters q) = matrixM q 3 3 := by
    rw [m33, hm11]
    linear_combination -hs.2.2.1
  ext i j
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst j
    fin_cases i <;>
      simp [GenericNormalizedFrameChart.moment, hm00, hm11, hm22, hm33]
  · simp [GenericNormalizedFrameChart.moment, hij, parameters]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceNormalizedChartReadback.matrixM_eq_residual_moment
proof:
:= by
  simpa [matrixM, residualPairOfChart,
    AlbertLean.Residual.SL4PairAction.moment] using
    (AlbertLean.Residual.ResidualMatrices.momentMatrix_eq_AMatrix_mul_XMatrix
      q.s1 q.s2 q.c1 q.c2)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceNormalizedChartReadback.chartWithResidualPair_self
statement:
private theorem chartWithResidualPair_self (x : ExplicitFrameChart K) :
    chartWithResidualPair x (residualPairOfChart x) = x
proof:
:= by
  apply ExplicitFrameChart.ext <;> try rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceNormalizedChartReadback.insert_openParameters_eq_normalized
statement:
theorem insert_openParameters_eq_normalized (q : ExplicitFrameChart K)
    (hr : q.r1 = 1) (hk : IsKappaLift q)
    (hq : EquationsVanish (explicitFrameEquationValues q))
    (hpA : q.diagA 1 - q.diagA 2 ≠ 0)
    (hpB : q.diagB 1 - q.diagB 2 ≠ 0)
    (hDelta : Matrix.det (residualPairOfChart q).X ≠ 0)
    (hMoment : Matrix.det (matrixM q) ≠ 0)
    (hbranch : Matrix.det (residualPairOfChart q).X ^ 2 ≠
      Matrix.det (matrixM q)) :
    let p
proof:
:= openParameters q hq hpA hpB hDelta hMoment hbranch hr
    let G := normalizingDetOneMatrix (residualPairOfChart q) hDelta
    GenericNormalizedFrameChart.insert p = actChart G q := by
  dsimp only
  let p := openParameters q hq hpA hpB hDelta hMoment hbranch hr
  let P := residualPairOfChart q
  let G := normalizingDetOneMatrix P hDelta
  have hMP : GenericNormalizedFrameChart.moment p.toParameters =
      AlbertLean.Residual.SL4PairAction.moment P := by
    rw [show p.toParameters = parameters q by rfl,
      moment_parameters q hr hq hpA hpB,
      matrixM_eq_residual_moment]
  have hresInsert : residualPairOfChart
      (GenericNormalizedFrameChart.insert p) = normalizedPair P := by
    rw [insert_residualPair]
    apply ResidualPair.ext
    · change GenericNormalizedFrameChart.moment p.toParameters *
        X0Inv (delta P) =
        AlbertLean.Residual.SL4PairAction.moment P * X0Inv (delta P)
      rw [hMP]
    · rfl
  have hresAct : residualPairOfChart (actChart G q) = normalizedPair P := by
    calc
      residualPairOfChart (actChart G q) = act G P :=
        residualPairOfChart_actChart G q
      _ = normalizedPair P := act_normalizingDetOneMatrix P hDelta
  have hres : residualPairOfChart (GenericNormalizedFrameChart.insert p) =
      residualPairOfChart (actChart G q) := hresInsert.trans hresAct.symm
  have hkappa : q.kappa = q.z2 - q.r2 * q.z1 := by
    have H := hk
    simp only [IsKappaLift, orientation, hr, one_mul] at H
    linear_combination -H
  have hactRecover :
      chartWithResidualPair q (residualPairOfChart (actChart G q)) =
        actChart G q := by
    change chartWithResidualPair (actChart G q)
      (residualPairOfChart (actChart G q)) = actChart G q
    exact chartWithResidualPair_self _
  have hinsertRecover :
      chartWithResidualPair q
        (residualPairOfChart (GenericNormalizedFrameChart.insert p)) =
          GenericNormalizedFrameChart.insert p := by
    calc
      chartWithResidualPair q
          (residualPairOfChart (GenericNormalizedFrameChart.insert p)) =
          chartWithResidualPair (GenericNormalizedFrameChart.insert p)
            (residualPairOfChart (GenericNormalizedFrameChart.insert p)) := by
        apply ExplicitFrameChart.ext
        · funext i
          change q.diagA i = (GenericNormalizedFrameChart.insert p).diagA i
          fin_cases i
          · rfl
          · rfl
          · change q.diagA 2 = dA2 (parameters q)
            exact (omitted_diagonal q hq).1.symm
        · funext i
          change q.diagB i = (GenericNormalizedFrameChart.insert p).diagB i
          fin_cases i
          · rfl
          · rfl
          · change q.diagB 2 = dB2 (parameters q)
            exact (omitted_diagonal q hq).2.symm
        · change q.r1 = 1
          exact hr
        · rfl
        · rfl
        · rfl
        · change q.kappa = q.z2 - q.z1 * q.r2
          rw [hkappa]
          ring
        · rfl
        · rfl
        · rfl
        · rfl
      _ = GenericNormalizedFrameChart.insert p := chartWithResidualPair_self _
  calc
    GenericNormalizedFrameChart.insert p = chartWithResidualPair q
        (residualPairOfChart (GenericNormalizedFrameChart.insert p)) :=
      hinsertRecover.symm
    _ = chartWithResidualPair q (residualPairOfChart (actChart G q)) := by
      rw [hres]
    _ = actChart G q := hactRecover

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GroupedBridge.scalarSimilitude_conjugates_grouped
statement:
theorem scalarSimilitude_conjugates_grouped
    (t : K) (ht : t ≠ 0) (a : Mat3 K) (u v : Vec3 K) :
    scalarSimilitude t * grouped a u v * scalarSimilitudeInv t =
      grouped a (t • u) (t⁻¹ • v)
proof:
:= by

    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GroupedBridge.scalarSimilitude_map_jordan
statement:
theorem scalarSimilitude_map_jordan
    (t : K) (ht : t ≠ 0) (A B : Mat6 K) :
    scalarSimilitude t * matrixJordan A B * scalarSimilitudeInv t =
      matrixJordan
        (scalarSimilitude t * A * scalarSimilitudeInv t)
        (scalarSimilitude t * B * scalarSimilitudeInv t)
proof:
:= by
  have hmul (X Y : Mat6 K) :
      scalarSimilitude t * (X * Y) * scalarSimilitudeInv t =
        (scalarSimilitude t * X * scalarSimilitudeInv t) *
          (scalarSimilitude t * Y * scalarSimilitudeInv t) := by
    symm
    calc
      (scalarSimilitude t * X * scalarSimilitudeInv t) *
          (scalarSimilitude t * Y * scalarSimilitudeInv t) =
        scalarSimilitude t * X *
          (scalarSimilitudeInv t * scalarSimilitude t) * Y *
            scalarSimilitudeInv t := by simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = scalarSimilitude t * X * 1 * Y * scalarSimilitudeInv t := by
        rw [scalarSimilitude_inv_mul t ht]
      _ = scalarSimilitude t * (X * Y) * scalarSimilitudeInv t := by
        simp [Matrix.mul_assoc]
  simp only [matrixJordan, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul]
  rw [Matrix.mul_add, Matrix.add_mul]
  rw [hmul A B, hmul B A]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GroupedBridge.scalarSimilitude_map_one
statement:
theorem scalarSimilitude_map_one (t : K) (ht : t ≠ 0) :

proof:

name: AlbertLean.Generic.PrimeKernelByFieldPoints.radical_eq_ker_of_prime_field_squares
statement:
theorem radical_eq_ker_of_prime_field_squares
    (J : Ideal R) (psi : R →+* S)
    (hJ : J ≤ RingHom.ker psi)
    (hsquare : ∀ (p : Ideal R) (hp : p.IsPrime), J ≤ p →
      ∃ (L : Type w) (_ : Field L) (j : R ⧸ p →+* L),
        Function.Injective j ∧
        ∃ e : S →+* L,
          e.comp psi = j.comp (Ideal.Quotient.mk p)) :
    J.radical = RingHom.ker psi
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact (RingHom.ker_isPrime psi).radical_le_iff.mpr hJ
  · rw [Ideal.radical_eq_sInf]
    refine le_sInf fun p hp => ?_
    obtain ⟨L, instL, j, hj, e, hcomm⟩ := hsquare p hp.2 hp.1
    intro x hx
    have hpoint := DFunLike.congr_fun hcomm x
    have hzero : j (Ideal.Quotient.mk p x) = j 0 := by
      calc
        j (Ideal.Quotient.mk p x) = e (psi x) := hpoint.symm
        _ = e 0 := by rw [RingHom.mem_ker.mp hx]
        _ = j 0 := by simp
    exact Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp (hj hzero)

proof:

theorem fixedTwelveMap_scheduleOfLengthTwelve
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SymplecticTransvection.exists_literal_fixed_twelve_triple_alignment
statement:
theorem exists_literal_fixed_twelve_triple_alignment
    (omega : BilinForm (K := K) (V := V)) (halt : ∀ x, omega x x = 0)
    (hleft : IsLeftNondegenerate omega) (hright : IsRightNondegenerate omega)
    (u v e f : Fin 3 → V) (hsrc : HyperbolicTriple omega u v)
    (htgt : HyperbolicTriple omega e f) :
    ∃ schedule : FixedTwelveSchedule (K := K) (V := V),
      (∀ i, fixedTwelveMap omega schedule (u i) = e i) ∧
      (∀ i, fixedTwelveMap omega schedule (v i) = f i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨word, hlen, hu, hv⟩ := exists_fixed_twelve_triple_alignment
    omega halt hleft hright u v e f hsrc htgt
  refine ⟨scheduleOfLengthTwelve word hlen, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    rw [fixedTwelveMap_scheduleOfLengthTwelve]
    exact hu i
  · intro i
    rw [fixedTwelveMap_scheduleOfLengthTwelve]
    exact hv i

statement:
private theorem a_det_ne_zero {a : Fin 3 → Mat3 K} (S : RawSystem a)
    (i : Fin 3) : (a i).det ≠ 0
proof:
:= by

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowGaugeReconstruction.componentSolution_ratio
statement:
theorem componentSolution_ratio {a : Fin 3 → Mat3 K} (S : RawSystem a)
    (hopen : OnReconstructionOpen S) :
    ComponentSolution (a 0) (a 1) (a 2) (ratio S)
proof:
:= by
  have hnorm : normalizedX (a 0) (S.b 0) (S.b 1) = ratio S :=
    normalizedX_eq_ratio (a 0) (S.b 0) (S.b 1) (a_det_ne_zero S 0)
  rw [← hnorm]
  apply componentSolution_of_adjugate_equations a S.b S.c S.b_ne
    S.equations S.b_sum S.c_sum
  simpa only [OnReconstructionOpen, hnorm] using hopen

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowGaugeReconstruction.gaugeRelated_iff_trace_ratio_eq
statement:
theorem gaugeRelated_iff_trace_ratio_eq {a : Fin 3 → Mat3 K}
    (S T : RawSystem a) (hS : OnReconstructionOpen S)
    (hT : OnReconstructionOpen T) :
    GaugeRelated S T ↔ Matrix.trace (ratio S) = Matrix.trace (ratio T)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hg
    exact congrArg Matrix.trace ((gaugeRelated_iff_ratio_eq S T).mp hg)
  · intro htrace
    apply (gaugeRelated_iff_ratio_eq S T).mpr
    exact eq_of_components_of_trace_eq (a 0) (a 1) (a 2)
      (a_det_ne_zero S 0) (a_det_ne_zero S 1) (a_det_ne_zero S 2)
      (componentSolution_ratio S hS) (componentSolution_ratio T hT) htrace

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowGaugeReconstruction.three_rawSystems_gaugeRelated_pair
statement:
theorem three_rawSystems_gaugeRelated_pair {a : Fin 3 → Mat3 K}
    (S T W : RawSystem a)
    (hS : OnReconstructionOpen S) (hT : OnReconstructionOpen T)
    (hW : OnReconstructionOpen W) :
    GaugeRelated S T ∨ GaugeRelated S W ∨ GaugeRelated T W
proof:
:= by
  rcases three_componentSolutions_pairwise_eq (a 0) (a 1) (a 2)
      (a_det_ne_zero S 0) (a_det_ne_zero S 1) (a_det_ne_zero S 2)
      (ratio S) (ratio T) (ratio W)
      (componentSolution_ratio S hS) (componentSolution_ratio T hT)
      (componentSolution_ratio W hW) with hST | hSW | hTW
  · exact Or.inl ((gaugeRelated_iff_ratio_eq S T).mpr hST)
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ((gaugeRelated_iff_ratio_eq S W).mpr hSW))
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ((gaugeRelated_iff_ratio_eq T W).mpr hTW))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.TwoTransvectionTransport.twoTransvections_clearedInvariant_extension
statement:
theorem twoTransvections_clearedInvariant_extension
    (a b : CoordinateRing k) (hb : rawToFunction k b ≠ 0)
    (hinv : ∀ g : ScalarJordanAut.Aut (K := k),
      fractionAction k g (rawToFunction k a / rawToFunction k b) =
        rawToFunction k a / rawToFunction k b)
    (d₁ d₂ : Vec6 K) (t₁ t₂ : K) :
    let A
proof:
:= reducedCoefficientMap k K φ
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (rawFrameIdeal k).radical a)
    let B := reducedCoefficientMap k K φ
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (rawFrameIdeal k).radical b)
    let T₁ := reducedAction K (wordJordanAut [(d₁, t₁)])
    let T₂ := reducedAction K (wordJordanAut [(d₂, t₂)])
    T₁ (T₂ A) * B = A * T₁ (T₂ B) := by
  dsimp only
  have hbR : reducedInclusion k
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (rawFrameIdeal k).radical b) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa [rawToFunction] using hb
  exact ratio_fixed_comp
    (reducedCoefficientMap k K φ
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (rawFrameIdeal k).radical a))
    (reducedCoefficientMap k K φ
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (rawFrameIdeal k).radical b))
    (reducedCoefficientMap_ne_zero k K φ _ hbR)
    (reducedAction K (wordJordanAut [(d₁, t₁)]))
    (reducedAction K (wordJordanAut [(d₂, t₂)]))
    (oneTransvection_clearedInvariant_extension
      k K φ a b hb hinv d₁ t₁)
    (oneTransvection_clearedInvariant_extension
      k K φ a b hb hinv d₂ t₂)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.TwoTransvectionTransport.twoTransvections_actualEndpointCross
statement:
theorem twoTransvections_actualEndpointCross
    (a b : CoordinateRing k) (hb : rawToFunction k b ≠ 0)
    (hinv : ∀ g : ScalarJordanAut.Aut (K := k),
      fractionAction k g (rawToFunction k a / rawToFunction k b) =
        rawToFunction k a / rawToFunction k b)
    (d₁ d₂ : Vec6 K) (t₁ t₂ : K) :
    let A
proof:
:= reducedCoefficientMap k K φ
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (rawFrameIdeal k).radical a)
    let B := reducedCoefficientMap k K φ
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (rawFrameIdeal k).radical b)
    let T₁ := reducedAction K (wordJordanAut [(d₁, t₁)])
    let T₂ := reducedAction K (wordJordanAut [(d₂, t₂)])
    evaluation k K φ (T₁ (T₂ A)) * φ (rawToFunction k b) =
      φ (rawToFunction k a) * evaluation k K φ (T₁ (T₂ B)) := by
  dsimp only
  have hclear := twoTransvections_clearedInvariant_extension
    k K φ a b hb hinv d₁ d₂ t₁ t₂
  have h := congrArg (evaluation k K φ) hclear
  simp only [map_mul] at h
  have ha := DFunLike.congr_fun (reduced_evaluation_square k K φ)
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk (rawFrameIdeal k).radical a)
  have hb' := DFunLike.congr_fun (reduced_evaluation_square k K φ)
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk (rawFrameIdeal k).radical b)
  simp only [RingHom.comp_apply] at ha hb'
  rw [ha, hb'] at h
  simpa [rawToFunction] using h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceStandardReflections.sourceFirstTits_sourceMatrix
statement:
@[simp] theorem sourceFirstTits_sourceMatrix (A : Mat3 K) :
    sourceFirstTitsEquiv (sourceMatrix A) = (A, 0, 0)
proof:
:=
  sourceFirstTitsEquiv.apply_symm_apply _

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceStandardReflections.sourceMatrix_product
statement:
theorem sourceMatrix_product (A B : Mat3 K) :
    sourceProduct (sourceMatrix A) (sourceMatrix B) =
      sourceMatrix (matrixJordan A B)
proof:
:= by
  apply sourceFirstTitsEquiv.injective
  rw [sourceFirstTits_product]
  simp only [sourceFirstTits_sourceMatrix, polarProduct_firstSummand]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceStandardReflections.midpointMatrix_idempotent
statement:
theorem midpointMatrix_idempotent (i j : Fin 3) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    matrixJordan (midpointMatrix (K := K) i j) (midpointMatrix i j) =
      midpointMatrix i j
proof:
:= by
  ext a b
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> fin_cases a <;> fin_cases b <;>
    simp_all [midpointMatrix, standardMatrixUnit, matrixUnit, matrixJordan,
      Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ] <;> field_simp <;> ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceStandardReflections.midpointMatrix_trace
statement:
theorem midpointMatrix_trace (i j : Fin 3) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    Matrix.trace (midpointMatrix (K := K) i j) = 1
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp_all [midpointMatrix, standardMatrixUnit, matrixUnit,
      Matrix.trace_fin_three] <;> field_simp <;> ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceStandardReflections.standardMidpoint_idempotent
statement:
theorem standardMidpoint_idempotent (i j : Fin 3) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    sourceProduct (standardMidpoint (K := K) i j) (standardMidpoint i j) =
      standardMidpoint i j
proof:
:= by
  rw [standardMidpoint, sourceMatrix_product, midpointMatrix_idempotent i j hij]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceStandardReflections.standardMidpoint_trace
statement:
theorem standardMidpoint_trace (i j : Fin 3) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    sourceTrace (standardMidpoint (K := K) i j) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sourceFirstTits_trace]
  simp [standardMidpoint, midpointMatrix_trace i j hij]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceStandardReflections.matrix_reflection_eq_conjugation
statement:
theorem matrix_reflection_eq_conjugation (P X : Mat3 K)
    (hP : P * P = P) :
    X - (8 : K) • matrixJordan P X +
        (8 : K) • matrixJordan P (matrixJordan P X) =
      ((1 : Mat3 K) - (2 : K) • P) * X * (1 - (2 : K) • P)
proof:
:= by
  have hright : X * P * P = X * P := by rw [mul_assoc, hP]
  simp only [matrixJordan, invOf_eq_inv, mul_add, add_mul, mul_sub, sub_mul,
    Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_smul, smul_add, smul_sub, smul_smul,
    one_mul, mul_one, ← mul_assoc, hP, hright]
  module

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceStandardReflections.sourceMatrix_reflection
statement:
theorem sourceMatrix_reflection (P X : Mat3 K)
    (hP : matrixJordan P P = P) :
    sourcePeirceReflection (sourceMatrix P) (sourceMatrix X) =
      sourceMatrix
        (X - (8 : K) • matrixJordan P X +
          (8 : K) • matrixJordan P (matrixJordan P X))
proof:
:= by
  rw [sourcePeirceReflection_formula, sourceMatrix_product,
    sourceMatrix_product]
  apply sourceFirstTitsEquiv.injective
  simp only [map_sub, map_add, map_smul, sourceFirstTits_sourceMatrix]
  ext <;> simp

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceStandardReflections.mul_standardMatrixUnit_mul
statement:
private theorem mul_standardMatrixUnit_mul (A B : Mat3 K) (k a b : Fin 3) :
    (A * standardMatrixUnit (K := K) k * B : Mat3 K) a b = A a k * B k b
proof:
:= by
  simp [Matrix.mul_apply, standardMatrixUnit, matrixUnit, ite_and,
    mul_ite, ite_mul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceStandardReflections.midpointMatrix_reflection_seed
statement:
theorem midpointMatrix_reflection_seed (i j k : Fin 3) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    ((1 : Mat3 K) - (2 : K) • midpointMatrix i j) * standardMatrixUnit k *
        (1 - (2 : K) • midpointMatrix i j) =
      standardMatrixUnit ((Equiv.swap i j) k)
proof:
:= by
  ext a b
  rw [mul_standardMatrixUnit_mul]
  by_cases hki : k = i
  · subst k
    by_cases ha : a = j <;> by_cases hb : b = j <;>
      simp_all [midpointMatrix, standardMatrixUnit, matrixUnit,
        Matrix.one_apply, Equiv.swap_apply_def, eq_comm] <;> field_simp <;> ring
  · by_cases hkj : k = j
    · subst k
      by_cases ha : a = i <;> by_cases hb : b = i <;>
        simp_all [midpointMatrix, standardMatrixUnit, matrixUnit,
          Matrix.one_apply, Equiv.swap_apply_def, eq_comm] <;> field_simp <;> ring
    · by_cases ha : a = k <;> by_cases hb : b = k <;>
        simp_all [midpointMatrix, standardMatrixUnit, matrixUnit,
          Matrix.one_apply, Equiv.swap_apply_def, eq_comm]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceStandardReflections.sourceMatrix_standardUnit
statement:
theorem sourceMatrix_standardUnit (k : Fin 3) :
    sourceMatrix (standardMatrixUnit (K := K) k) = diagonalUnit k
proof:
:= by
  apply sourceFirstTitsEquiv.injective
  rw [sourceFirstTits_sourceMatrix, sourceFirstTits_diagonalUnit]
  congr 1
  ext a b
  by_cases ha : a = k <;> by_cases hb : b = k <;>
    simp_all [standardMatrixUnit, matrixUnit, Matrix.diagonal_apply, Pi.single_apply, eq_comm]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceStandardReflections.standardMidpoint_reflection_diagonalUnit
statement:
theorem standardMidpoint_reflection_diagonalUnit
    (i j : Fin 3) (hij : i ≠ j) (k : Fin 3) :
    sourcePeirceReflection (standardMidpoint (K := K) i j) (diagonalUnit k) =
      diagonalUnit ((Equiv.swap i j) k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sourceMatrix_standardUnit k, ← sourceMatrix_standardUnit]
  rw [standardMidpoint, sourceMatrix_reflection]
  · congr 1
    rw [matrix_reflection_eq_conjugation]
    · exact midpointMatrix_reflection_seed i j k hij
    · have hJ := midpointMatrix_idempotent (K := K) i j hij
      simp only [matrixJordan, invOf_eq_inv] at hJ
      linear_combination (norm := module) hJ
  · exact midpointMatrix_idempotent i j hij

@[simp] theorem fromMatrix_toSymMatrix (x : Sym3Coord R) :

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3JordanCoordinates.toSymMatrix_symmetric

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3JordanCoordinates.toSymMatrix_fromMatrix_of_symmetric

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3JordanCoordinates.one_jordan

name: AlbertLean.Generic.RealRow.Sym3JordanCoordinates.trace_toSymMatrix
statement:
theorem trace_toSymMatrix (x : Sym3Coord R) :
    Matrix.trace (toSymMatrix x) = matrixTrace x
proof:
:= by
  simp [Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag, toSymMatrix, matrixTrace, Fin.sum_univ_succ,
    Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.vecHead, Matrix.vecTail, add_assoc]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowUniqueness.eq_or_eq_or_eq_of_quadratic_invariant
statement:
theorem eq_or_eq_or_eq_of_quadratic_invariant
    {K : Type u} [Field K] {A : Type v}
    (P : A -> Prop) (f : A -> K) (a b : K)
    (hroot : ∀ x, P x -> f x ^ 2 + b * f x + a = 0)
    (hinjective : ∀ {x y}, P x -> P y -> f x = f y -> x = y)
    {x y z : A} (hx : P x) (hy : P y) (hz : P z) :
    x = y ∨ x = z ∨ y = z
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_eq_or_eq_of_three_quadratic_roots b a (f x) (f y) (f z)
      (hroot x hx) (hroot y hy) (hroot z hz) with hxy | hxz | hyz
  · exact Or.inl (hinjective hx hy hxy)
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (hinjective hx hz hxz))
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (hinjective hy hz hyz))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowUniqueness.eq_of_goodSolution_of_trace_eq
statement:
theorem eq_of_goodSolution_of_trace_eq
    (U V : Mat3 K) (c d : K) {X Y : Mat3 K}
    (hX : GoodSolution U V c d X)
    (hY : GoodSolution U V c d Y)
    (htrace : Matrix.trace X = Matrix.trace Y) : X = Y
proof:
:= by
  have hRX :=
    matrix_eq_trace_reconstruction_of_det_ne_zero X U V c d
      hX.quadratic hX.det_eq hX.det_one_add_eq (by
        simpa only [reconstructionDenominator] using
          hX.denominator_det_ne_zero)
  have hRY :=
    matrix_eq_trace_reconstruction_of_det_ne_zero Y U V c d
      hY.quadratic hY.det_eq hY.det_one_add_eq (by
        simpa only [reconstructionDenominator] using
          hY.denominator_det_ne_zero)
  calc
    X = (c • 1 - V * U - Matrix.trace X • V) *
        (U ^ 2 - V + Matrix.trace X • U +
          (-d - 1 - c - Matrix.trace X) • 1)⁻¹ := hRX
    _ = (c • 1 - V * U - Matrix.trace Y • V) *
        (U ^ 2 - V + Matrix.trace Y • U +
          (-d - 1 - c - Matrix.trace Y) • 1)⁻¹ := by rw [htrace]
    _ = Y := hRY.symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowUniqueness.three_goodSolutions_pairwise_eq
statement:
theorem three_goodSolutions_pairwise_eq
    (U V : Mat3 K) (c d : K)
    (hc : c ≠ 0) (hd : d ≠ 0)
    (hdetV : V.det = c ^ 2)
    (hdetNegOne : (1 - U + V).det = d ^ 2)
    (X Y Z : Mat3 K)
    (hX : GoodSolution U V c d X)
    (hY : GoodSolution U V c d Y)
    (hZ : GoodSolution U V c d Z) :
    X = Y ∨ X = Z ∨ Y = Z
proof:
:= by
  let b : K := (quadraticPolynomial U V).coeff 5
  let a : K :=
    (quadraticPolynomial U V).coeff 4 + 2 * (1 + c + d) -
      (quadraticPolynomial U V).coeff 5
  apply eq_or_eq_or_eq_of_quadratic_invariant
    (P := GoodSolution U V c d) (f := Matrix.trace) a b
  · intro W hW
    simpa [a, b] using
      trace_satisfies_quadratic_of_matrix_constraints W U V c d
        hW.quadratic hc hd hW.det_eq hW.det_one_add_eq hdetV hdetNegOne
  · intro W W' hW hW' htrace
    exact eq_of_goodSolution_of_trace_eq U V c d hW hW' htrace
  · exact hX
  · exact hY
  · exact hZ

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowEntrySubfield.entries_one
statement: private theorem entries_one (E : Subfield Ω) : EntriesIn E (1 : Mat)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j
  by_cases h : i = j <;> simp [Matrix.one_apply, h]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowEntrySubfield.entries_add
statement:
private theorem entries_add {E : Subfield Ω} {M N : Mat}
    (hM : EntriesIn E M) (hN : EntriesIn E N) : EntriesIn E (M + N)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j; exact E.add_mem (hM i j) (hN i j)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowEntrySubfield.entries_sub
statement:
private theorem entries_sub {E : Subfield Ω} {M N : Mat}
    (hM : EntriesIn E M) (hN : EntriesIn E N) : EntriesIn E (M - N)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j; exact E.sub_mem (hM i j) (hN i j)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowEntrySubfield.entries_mul
statement:
private theorem entries_mul {E : Subfield Ω} {M N : Mat}
    (hM : EntriesIn E M) (hN : EntriesIn E N) : EntriesIn E (M * N)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j
  rw [Matrix.mul_apply]
  exact E.sum_mem fun l _ => E.mul_mem (hM i l) (hN l j)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowEntrySubfield.entries_smul
statement:
private theorem entries_smul {E : Subfield Ω} {r : Ω} {M : Mat}
    (hr : r ∈ E) (hM : EntriesIn E M) : EntriesIn E (r • M)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j; exact E.mul_mem hr (hM i j)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowEntrySubfield.entries_det
statement:
private theorem entries_det {E : Subfield Ω} {M : Mat}
    (hM : EntriesIn E M) : M.det ∈ E
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.det_fin_three]
  have hprod (i j k l m n : Fin 3) : M i j * M k l * M m n ∈ E :=
    E.mul_mem (E.mul_mem (hM i j) (hM k l)) (hM m n)
  exact E.sub_mem (E.add_mem (E.add_mem
    (E.sub_mem (E.sub_mem (hprod 0 0 1 1 2 2) (hprod 0 0 1 2 2 1))
      (hprod 0 1 1 0 2 2)) (hprod 0 1 1 2 2 0)) (hprod 0 2 1 0 2 1))
    (hprod 0 2 1 1 2 0)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowEntrySubfield.entries_adjugate
statement:
private theorem entries_adjugate {E : Subfield Ω} {M : Mat}
    (hM : EntriesIn E M) : EntriesIn E M.adjugate
proof:
:= by
  intro i j
  rw [Matrix.adjugate_fin_three]
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_two,
      Matrix.vecHead, Matrix.vecTail] <;>
    solve_by_elim (maxDepth := 12)
      [E.add_mem, E.sub_mem, E.neg_mem, E.mul_mem, hM]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowEntrySubfield.entries_inv
statement:
private theorem entries_inv {E : Subfield Ω} {M : Mat}
    (hM : EntriesIn E M) : EntriesIn E M⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.inv_def, Ring.inverse_eq_inv]
  exact entries_smul (E.inv_mem (entries_det hM)) (entries_adjugate hM)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowEntrySubfield.entries_trace
statement:
private theorem entries_trace {E : Subfield Ω} {M : Mat}
    (hM : EntriesIn E M) : Matrix.trace M ∈ E
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.trace_fin_three]
  exact E.add_mem (E.add_mem (hM 0 0) (hM 1 1)) (hM 2 2)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowEntrySubfield.entriesIn_of_trace_mem
statement:
theorem entriesIn_of_trace_mem
    (E : Subfield Ω) (X U V : Mat) (c d : Ω)
    (hX : GoodSolution U V c d X)
    (hU : EntriesIn E U) (hV : EntriesIn E V)
    (hc : c ∈ E) (hd : d ∈ E) (ht : Matrix.trace X ∈ E) :
    EntriesIn E X
proof:
:= by
  have hrepr := matrix_eq_trace_reconstruction_of_det_ne_zero X U V c d
    hX.quadratic hX.det_eq hX.det_one_add_eq hX.denominator_det_ne_zero
  rw [hrepr]
  apply entries_mul
  · exact entries_sub (entries_sub (entries_smul hc (entries_one E))
      (entries_mul hV hU)) (entries_smul ht hV)
  · apply entries_inv
    apply entries_add
    · exact entries_add (entries_sub (by simpa [pow_two] using entries_mul hU hU) hV)
        (entries_smul ht hU)
    · exact entries_smul
        (E.sub_mem (E.sub_mem (E.sub_mem (E.neg_mem hd) E.one_mem) hc) ht)
        (entries_one E)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowEntrySubfield.entryField_eq_traceField
statement:
theorem entryField_eq_traceField
    (base : Subfield Ω) (X U V : Mat) (c d : Ω) (hX : GoodSolution U V c d X)
    (hU : EntriesIn base U) (hV : EntriesIn base V)
    (hc : c ∈ base) (hd : d ∈ base) :
    entryField base X = traceField base (Matrix.trace X)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply Subfield.closure_le.2
    rintro x (hx | ⟨⟨i, j⟩, rfl⟩)
    · exact Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inl hx)
    · exact entriesIn_of_trace_mem _ X U V c d hX
        (fun a b => Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inl (hU a b)))
        (fun a b => Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inl (hV a b)))
        (Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inl hc))
        (Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inl hd))
        (Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inr (Set.mem_singleton _))) i j
  · apply Subfield.closure_le.2
    rintro x (hx | hx)
    · exact Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inl hx)
    · rcases Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hx with rfl
      apply entries_trace
      intro i j
      exact Subfield.subset_closure (Or.inr ⟨(i, j), rfl⟩)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFrameWord.map_reflection
statement:
theorem map_reflection
    {V W : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]
    (μ : V →ₗ[K] V →ₗ[K] V) (ν : W →ₗ[K] W →ₗ[K] W)
    (g : V →ₗ[K] W) (hg : ∀ x y, g (μ x y) = ν (g x) (g y)) (p x : V) :
    g (PeircePolynomial.reflection μ p x) =
      PeircePolynomial.reflection ν (g p) (g x)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [PeircePolynomial.reflection, map_add, map_sub, map_smul, hg]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFrameWord.sourceAut_reflection
statement:
theorem sourceAut_reflection (g : SourceAut (K := K)) (p x : JCoord K) :
    g.linear (sourcePeirceReflection p x) =
      sourcePeirceReflection (g.linear p) (g.linear x)
proof:
:=
  map_reflection sourceProductLinear sourceProductLinear g.linear.toLinearMap g.map_product p x

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFrameWord.reflection_inverse_apply
proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFrameWord.reflection_twice
statement:
theorem reflection_twice (p : JCoord K) (hp : sourceProduct p p = p) (x : JCoord K) :
    sourcePeirceReflection p (sourcePeirceReflection p x) = x
proof:
:= by
  have h := (sourcePeirceLinearEquiv p hp).symm_apply_apply x
  simpa only [reflection_inverse_apply, sourcePeirceLinearEquiv_apply] using h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFrameWord.absorb_center
statement:
theorem absorb_center (h : SourceAut (K := K))
    (hT : ∀ x, sourceTrace (h.linear x) = sourceTrace x)
    (hseed : ∀ j, h.linear (diagonalUnit j) = diagonalUnit j)
    (p : JCoord K) (hp : sourceProduct p p = p) (hpT : sourceTrace p = 1) :
    ∃ (z : ShiftPoint K) (h' : SourceAut (K := K)),
      (∀ x, sourceTrace (h'.linear x) = sourceTrace x) ∧
      (∀ j, h'.linear (diagonalUnit j) = diagonalUnit j) ∧
      ∀ x, h.linear (sourcePeirceReflection p x) = z.aut.linear (h'.linear x)
proof:
:= by
  have hq : sourceProduct (h.linear p) (h.linear p) = h.linear p := by
    rw [← h.map_product, hp]
  have hqT : sourceTrace (h.linear p) = 1 := (hT p).trans hpT
  obtain ⟨i, u, v, hD, hchart⟩ := exists_pivot_chart (h.linear p) hq hqT
  let z : ShiftPoint K := ⟨i, u, v, hD⟩
  let s : SourceAut (K := K) := sourcePeirceAut (diagonalUnit i) (standard_idempotent i)
  have hsapply (x : JCoord K) : s.linear x = sourcePeirceReflection (diagonalUnit i) x :=
    reflectionAut_apply (diagonalUnit i) (standard_idempotent i) x
  let h' : SourceAut (K := K) := thenAut h s
  refine ⟨z, h', ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact thenAut_trace h s hT (reflectionAut_trace (diagonalUnit i) (standard_idempotent i))
  · intro j
    change s.linear (h.linear (diagonalUnit j)) = diagonalUnit j
    rw [hseed]
    change (sourcePeirceAut (diagonalUnit i) (standard_idempotent i)).linear (diagonalUnit j) = _
    rw [reflectionAut_apply, diagonalUnit_reflection]
  · intro x
    rw [sourceAut_reflection]
    change sourcePeirceReflection (h.linear p) (h.linear x) =
      (shiftAut i u v hD).linear (s.linear (h.linear x))
    rw [shiftAut_apply, hsapply,
      reflection_twice (diagonalUnit i) (standard_idempotent i), hchart]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFrameWord.four_reflections_on_seed
statement:
theorem four_reflections_on_seed
    (p q r s : JCoord K)
    (hp : sourceProduct p p = p) (hq : sourceProduct q q = q)
    (hr : sourceProduct r r = r) (hs : sourceProduct s s = s)
    (hpT : sourceTrace p = 1) (hqT : sourceTrace q = 1)
    (hrT : sourceTrace r = 1) (hsT : sourceTrace s = 1) :
    ∃ z : Fin 4 → ShiftPoint K, ∀ j : Fin 3,
      sourcePeirceReflection p (sourcePeirceReflection q
        (sourcePeirceReflection r (sourcePeirceReflection s (diagonalUnit j)))) =
      applyFourShifts z (diagonalUnit j)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z0, h1, h1T, h1seed, h0eq⟩ :=
    absorb_center (identityAut (K := K)) (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl) p hp hpT
  obtain ⟨z1, h2, h2T, h2seed, h1eq⟩ := absorb_center h1 h1T h1seed q hq hqT
  obtain ⟨z2, h3, h3T, h3seed, h2eq⟩ := absorb_center h2 h2T h2seed r hr hrT
  obtain ⟨z3, h4, h4T, h4seed, h3eq⟩ := absorb_center h3 h3T h3seed s hs hsT
  have h0 (x : JCoord K) : sourcePeirceReflection p x = z0.aut.linear (h1.linear x) := by
    exact h0eq x
  refine ⟨![z0, z1, z2, z3], ?_⟩
  intro j
  change sourcePeirceReflection p (sourcePeirceReflection q
      (sourcePeirceReflection r (sourcePeirceReflection s (diagonalUnit j)))) =
    z0.aut.linear (z1.aut.linear (z2.aut.linear (z3.aut.linear (diagonalUnit j))))
  rw [h0, h1eq, h2eq, h3eq, h4seed]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.SourceFrameWord.exists_four_shifts_frame
statement:
theorem exists_four_shifts_frame
    (hroot : ∀ t : K, ∃ s : K, s ^ 2 = t)
    (P : Fin 3 → JCoord K) (hP : SourceFrameLaws.Laws P) :
    ∃ z : Fin 4 → ShiftPoint K, ∀ j : Fin 3,
      applyFourShifts z (diagonalUnit j) = P j
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, q, r, s, hp, hq, hr, hs, hpT, hqT, hrT, hsT, hN⟩ :=
    frame_normalization_four_reflections hroot P hP
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := four_reflections_on_seed p q r s hp hq hr hs hpT hqT hrT hsT
  refine ⟨z, ?_⟩
  intro j
  rw [← hz j, ← hN j, fourReflectionAut_formula]
  rw [reflection_twice s hs, reflection_twice r hr, reflection_twice q hq,
    reflection_twice p hp]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.Reconstruction.parameter_admissiblePair

  simpa only [parameterResidualPair_delta] using ht

name: AlbertLean.Generic.Reconstruction.original_publicFibre

:=

name: AlbertLean.Generic.Reconstruction.reciprocal_publicFibre
statement:

    PublicFibre t ht (parameterResidualPair (witnessScale / t)
      (reciprocalParameter_ne_zero t ht))
proof:
:=
  ⟨parameterResidualPair_fixedMoment _ _, parameter_ledger_reciprocal t ht⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.Reconstruction.publicFibre_roots
statement:
theorem publicFibre_roots (t : ℚ) (ht : t ≠ 0) (Q : ResidualPair ℚ)
    (hQ : PublicFibre t ht Q) :
    delta Q = t ∨ delta Q = witnessScale / t
proof:
:= by
  have hL : ledger (parameterTriple t ht) =
      ledger (parameterTriple (delta Q) hQ.1.1.1) :=
    hQ.2.symm.trans (coordinateTriple_ledger_normalForm Q hQ.1)
  have hs := (parameter_ledger_eq_iff t (delta Q) ht hQ.1.1.1).mp hL
  exact (reciprocal_sum_eq_iff witnessScale t (delta Q) ht hQ.1.1.1).mp hs

name: AlbertLean.Generic.Reconstruction.publicFibre_cover
statement:
theorem publicFibre_cover (t : ℚ) (ht : t ≠ 0) (Q : ResidualPair ℚ)
    (hQ : PublicFibre t ht Q) :
    FullRelated (parameterTriple t ht) (coordinateTriple Q) ∨
      FullRelated (parameterTriple (witnessScale / t)
        (reciprocalParameter_ne_zero t ht)) (coordinateTriple Q)
proof:
:= by
  have hn := coordinateTriple_normalForm Q hQ.1
  rcases publicFibre_roots t ht Q hQ with h | h
  · left
    simpa only [h] using hn
  · right
    simpa only [h] using hn

name: AlbertLean.Generic.Reconstruction.publicFibre_admissible
statement:
theorem publicFibre_admissible (t : ℚ) (ht : Admissible t)
    (Q : ResidualPair ℚ) (hQ : PublicFibre t ht.1 Q) : AdmissiblePair Q
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hQ.1, ?_⟩
  rcases publicFibre_roots t ht.1 Q hQ with h | h
  · simpa only [h] using ht
  · simpa only [h] using admissible_reciprocal t ht

name: AlbertLean.Generic.Reconstruction.fullRelated_iff_ledger_detector
statement:
theorem fullRelated_iff_ledger_detector (Q R : ResidualPair ℚ)
    (hQ : AdmissiblePair Q) (hR : AdmissiblePair R) :
    FullRelated (coordinateTriple Q) (coordinateTriple R) ↔
      ledger (coordinateTriple Q) = ledger (coordinateTriple R) ∧
      traceCubeDetector (coordinateTriple Q) = traceCubeDetector (coordinateTriple R)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨h.ledger_eq, h.traceCubeDetector_eq⟩
  · rintro ⟨hL, hD⟩
    have hFQ : PublicFibre (delta Q) hQ.2.1 Q :=
      ⟨hQ.1, coordinateTriple_ledger_normalForm Q hQ.1⟩
    have hFR : PublicFibre (delta Q) hQ.2.1 R :=
      ⟨hR.1, hL.symm.trans hFQ.2⟩
    exact (fullRelated_iff_detector_of_cover
      ((parameterDelta_ne_zero_iff _ hQ.2.1).mp hQ.2.2)
      (publicFibre_cover _ _ Q hFQ) (publicFibre_cover _ _ R hFR)).mpr hD

name: AlbertLean.Generic.Reconstruction.publicFibre_exactly_two
statement:
theorem publicFibre_exactly_two (t : ℚ) (ht : Admissible t) :
    let X₀
proof:
:= parameterTriple t ht.1
    let X₁ := parameterTriple (witnessScale / t) (reciprocalParameter_ne_zero t ht.1)
    PublicFibre t ht.1 (parameterResidualPair t ht.1) ∧
    PublicFibre t ht.1 (parameterResidualPair (witnessScale / t)
      (reciprocalParameter_ne_zero t ht.1)) ∧
    ¬ FullRelated X₀ X₁ ∧
    (∀ Q, PublicFibre t ht.1 Q → AdmissiblePair Q ∧
      LawfulFrameTriple (coordinateTriple Q) ∧
      (FullRelated X₀ (coordinateTriple Q) ∨ FullRelated X₁ (coordinateTriple Q))) ∧
    (∀ Q R, PublicFibre t ht.1 Q → PublicFibre t ht.1 R →
      (FullRelated (coordinateTriple Q) (coordinateTriple R) ↔
        traceCubeDetector (coordinateTriple Q) = traceCubeDetector (coordinateTriple R))) := by
  have hsep := (parameterDelta_ne_zero_iff t ht.1).mp ht.2
  exact ⟨original_publicFibre t ht.1, reciprocal_publicFibre t ht.1,
    not_fullRelated_of_traceCubeDetector_ne hsep,
    fun Q hQ => ⟨publicFibre_admissible t ht Q hQ,
      coordinateTriple_lawful Q hQ.1, publicFibre_cover t ht.1 Q hQ⟩,
    fun Q R hQ hR => fullRelated_iff_detector_of_cover hsep
      (publicFibre_cover t ht.1 Q hQ) (publicFibre_cover t ht.1 R hR)⟩

name: AlbertLean.Generic.Reconstruction.publicFibre_bit
statement:
theorem publicFibre_bit (t : ℚ) (ht : Admissible t)
    (Q : ResidualPair ℚ) (hQ : PublicFibre t ht.1 Q) :
    let X₀
proof:
:= parameterTriple t ht.1
    let X₁ := parameterTriple (witnessScale / t) (reciprocalParameter_ne_zero t ht.1)
    detectorBit X₀ X₁ (coordinateTriple Q) = 0 ∨
      detectorBit X₀ X₁ (coordinateTriple Q) = 1 :=
  detectorBit_zero_or_one ((parameterDelta_ne_zero_iff t ht.1).mp ht.2)
    (publicFibre_cover t ht.1 Q hQ)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.Reconstruction.publicFibre_iff_bit
statement:
theorem publicFibre_iff_bit (t : ℚ) (ht : Admissible t)
    (Q R : ResidualPair ℚ) (hQ : PublicFibre t ht.1 Q)
    (hR : PublicFibre t ht.1 R) :
    let X₀
proof:
:= parameterTriple t ht.1
    let X₁ := parameterTriple (witnessScale / t) (reciprocalParameter_ne_zero t ht.1)
    FullRelated (coordinateTriple Q) (coordinateTriple R) ↔
      detectorBit X₀ X₁ (coordinateTriple Q) = detectorBit X₀ X₁ (coordinateTriple R) := by
  have hsep := (parameterDelta_ne_zero_iff t ht.1).mp ht.2
  have hd := sub_ne_zero.mpr hsep.symm
  rw [fullRelated_iff_detector_of_cover hsep
    (publicFibre_cover t ht.1 Q hQ) (publicFibre_cover t ht.1 R hR)]
  simp only [detectorBit, div_left_inj' hd, sub_left_inj]

    (A : Matrix (Sum (Fin 3) (Fin 3)) (Sum (Fin 3) (Fin 3)) (CoordinateRing k))

    f (matrixCoordinates A c) = matrixCoordinates (f.mapMatrix A) c

  · rfl
  · rcases c with c | c <;> fin_cases c <;> simp [matrixCoordinates]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawFrameIdeal.mapMatrix_smul
statement:

    (A : Matrix (Sum (Fin 3) (Fin 3)) (Sum (Fin 3) (Fin 3)) (CoordinateRing k)) :

proof:
:= by

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawFrameIdeal.map_ringMatrix_universal
statement:
theorem map_ringMatrix_universal
    (f : k →+* L) (P : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Coordinates L)
    (r i : Fin 3) :
    (evaluationAlong k f P).mapMatrix (ringMatrix (universalPoint k r i)) =
      (decode (P r i) : Mat6 L)
proof:
:= by
  have eval_neg (q : CoordinateRing k) :
      MvPolynomial.eval₂ f (fun q => P q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) (-q) =
        -MvPolynomial.eval₂ f (fun q => P q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) q :=
    map_neg (evaluationAlong k f P) q
  ext a b
  rcases a with a | a <;> rcases b with b | b <;>
    fin_cases a <;> fin_cases b <;>
    simp [ringMatrix, ringHat, decode, grouped, evaluationAlong, universalPoint,
      hat, Matrix.fromBlocks, Matrix.transpose, eval_neg]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawFrameIdeal.matrixCoordinates_carrier
statement:
theorem matrixCoordinates_carrier (Q : Carrier L) (c : Index) :

proof:

  · rfl
  · rcases c with c | c <;> fin_cases c <;>
      rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawFrameIdeal.encode_one
statement:
theorem encode_one (c : Index) :
    encode (SelfAdjointCarrier.one : Carrier L) c =
      match c with
      | Sum.inl (a,b) => if a = b then 1 else 0
      | Sum.inr _ => 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases c with ⟨a,b⟩ | c
  · fin_cases a <;> fin_cases b <;>
      simp [encode, SelfAdjointCarrier.one, Matrix.one_apply, topLeft]
  · rcases c with c | c <;> fin_cases c <;>
      simp [encode, SelfAdjointCarrier.one, Matrix.one_apply, unhat, topRight, bottomLeft]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawFrameIdeal.evaluationAlong_productCoordinate
statement:
theorem evaluationAlong_productCoordinate
    (f : k →+* L) (P : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Coordinates L)
    (r i : Fin 3) (c : Index) :
    evaluationAlong k f P
        (productCoordinate k (universalPoint k r i) (universalPoint k r i) c) =
      coordinateJordan (P r i) (P r i) c
proof:
:= by
  rw [productCoordinate, map_matrixCoordinates]
  simp only [mapMatrix_smul, map_add, map_mul, map_ringMatrix_universal]
  rw [show evaluationAlong k f P (MvPolynomial.C ((2 : k)⁻¹) : CoordinateRing k) =
      (2 : L)⁻¹ by simp [evaluationAlong, map_ofNat]]
  change matrixCoordinates
    ((SelfAdjointCarrier.jordan (decode (P r i)) (decode (P r i)) : Carrier L) : Mat6 L) c = _
  exact matrixCoordinates_carrier
    (SelfAdjointCarrier.jordan (decode (P r i)) (decode (P r i))) c

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawFrameIdeal.jordanTrace_decode
statement:
theorem jordanTrace_decode (x : Coordinates L) :
    jordanTrace (decode x : Mat6 L) = ∑ i : Fin 3, x (Sum.inl (i, i))
proof:
:= by
  simpa [decode, Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag, Fin.sum_univ_succ] using
    (jordanTrace_grouped
      (fun i j => x (Sum.inl (i, j)))
      (fun i => x (Sum.inr (Sum.inl i)))
      (fun i => x (Sum.inr (Sum.inr i))))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawFrameIdeal.evaluationAlong_unitCoordinate
statement:
@[simp] theorem evaluationAlong_unitCoordinate
    (f : k →+* L) (P : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Coordinates L) (c : Index) :
    evaluationAlong k f P (unitCoordinate k c) =
      match c with
      | Sum.inl (a,b) => if a = b then 1 else 0
      | Sum.inr _ => 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases c with ⟨a,b⟩ | c
  · by_cases hab : a = b <;> simp [unitCoordinate, hab]
  · simp [unitCoordinate]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawFrameIdeal.equations_vanishAlong_iff
statement:
theorem equations_vanishAlong_iff
    (f : k →+* L) (P : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Coordinates L) :
    (∀ q, evaluationAlong k f P (equation k q) = 0) ↔ IsRawFrameFamily P
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro r i
      funext c
      rw [← evaluationAlong_productCoordinate k f P r i c]
      simpa [equation, sub_eq_zero] using h (.idempotence r i c)
    · intro r i
      simpa [equation, traceCoordinate, sub_eq_zero] using h (.traceOne r i)
    · intro r c
      simpa only [equation, map_sub, map_sum, evaluationAlong_universalPoint,
        evaluationAlong_unitCoordinate, sub_eq_zero] using h (.sumOne r c)
  · intro h q
    cases q with
    | idempotence r i c =>
        have hc := congrFun (h.idempotent r i) c
        simp only [equation, map_sub, map_zero, sub_eq_zero,
          evaluationAlong_universalPoint]
        rw [evaluationAlong_productCoordinate k f P r i c]
        exact hc
    | traceOne r i =>
        simpa [equation, traceCoordinate, sub_eq_zero] using h.trace_one r i
    | sumOne r c =>
        simpa only [equation, map_sub, map_sum, evaluationAlong_universalPoint,
        evaluationAlong_unitCoordinate, sub_eq_zero] using h.sum_one r c

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawFrameIdeal.rawFrameIdeal_le_ker_iff
statement:
theorem rawFrameIdeal_le_ker_iff
    (f : k →+* L) (P : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Coordinates L) :
    rawFrameIdeal k ≤ RingHom.ker (evaluationAlong k f P) ↔
      IsRawFrameFamily P
proof:
:= by
  rw [← equations_vanishAlong_iff k f P]
  constructor
  · intro h q
    exact RingHom.mem_ker.mp (h (Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_range_self q)))
  · intro h
    exact Ideal.span_le.2 (fun p hp => by
      rcases hp with ⟨q, rfl⟩
      exact RingHom.mem_ker.mpr (h q))

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.RawFrameIdeal.actual_frame_laws
statement:
theorem actual_frame_laws (P : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Coordinates L)
    (hP : IsRawFrameFamily P) (r : Fin 3) :
    (∀ i, ((decode (P r i) : Carrier L) : Mat6 L) * decode (P r i) =
      decode (P r i)) ∧
    (∀ i, AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ProjectorBlockBridge.jordanTrace
      ((decode (P r i) : Carrier L) : Mat6 L) = 1) ∧
    ((decode (P r 0) : Carrier L) : Mat6 L) + decode (P r 1) +
      decode (P r 2) = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    have h := congrArg decode (hP.idempotent r i)
    rw [decode_coordinateJordan] at h
    have hm := congrArg Subtype.val h
    change (2 : L)⁻¹ • ((decode (P r i) : Mat6 L) * decode (P r i) +
      (decode (P r i) : Mat6 L) * decode (P r i)) = (decode (P r i) : Mat6 L) at hm
    have htwo : (2 : L)⁻¹ + (2 : L)⁻¹ = 1 := by norm_num
    rw [smul_add, ← add_smul, htwo, one_smul] at hm
    exact hm
  · intro i
    rw [jordanTrace_decode]
    exact hP.trace_one r i
  · have hs : decode (P r 0) + decode (P r 1) + decode (P r 2) =
        (SelfAdjointCarrier.one : Carrier L) := by
      apply (linearEquiv (K := L)).injective
      change encode (decode (P r 0) + decode (P r 1) + decode (P r 2)) =
        encode (SelfAdjointCarrier.one : Carrier L)
      have henc (X Y : Carrier L) : encode (X + Y) = encode X + encode Y :=
        encodeLinear.map_add X Y
      rw [henc, henc, encode_decode, encode_decode, encode_decode]
      funext c
      rw [encode_one]
      simpa [Fin.sum_univ_succ, add_assoc] using hP.sum_one r c
    exact congrArg Subtype.val hs

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.CommonSplitBasis.planeScale_basis_right
statement:

proof:
:= by
  funext a
  rcases a with i | i
  · simp [planeScale, basisVector, Pi.single_apply]
  · by_cases h : i = j

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.CommonSplitBasis.weightedBlock_scaled_mixed
statement:
private theorem weightedBlock_scaled_mixed
    (C : Vec6 K →ₗ[K] Vec6 K) (t s : Fin 3 → K) (i j : Fin 3) :
    weightedBlock ((planeScale t).comp (C.comp (planeScale s))) i j 0 1 =
        s j * weightedBlock C i j 0 1 ∧
    weightedBlock ((planeScale t).comp (C.comp (planeScale s))) i j 1 0 =
        t i * weightedBlock C i j 1 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · change planeScale t (C (planeScale s (basisVector (Sum.inr j)))) (Sum.inl i) = _
    rw [planeScale_basis_right, map_smul]
    rfl
  · change planeScale t (C (planeScale s (basisVector (Sum.inl j)))) (Sum.inr i) = _
    rw [planeScale_basis_left]
    rfl
