name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.CommonSplitBasis.split_matrix_mixed
statement:
private theorem split_matrix_mixed
    (L : Vec6 K ≃ₗ[K] Vec6 K) (p : Fin 3 → K) (H S : Mat2 K)
    (P : Mat6 K)
    (h : ∀ i j,
      (S * weightedBlock (coordinateConjugate L (matrixAction P)) i j * H) 0 1 = 0 ∧
      (S * weightedBlock (coordinateConjugate L (matrixAction P)) i j * H) 1 0 = 0) :
    let Q
proof:
:= matrixOfLinear (splitForward L p H)
    let N := matrixOfLinear (splitBackward L p S)
    topRight (N * P * Q) = 0 ∧ bottomLeft (N * P * Q) = 0 := by
  let C := (commonPlaneMap S).comp
    ((coordinateConjugate L (matrixAction P)).comp (commonPlaneMap H))
  have hc : ∀ i j, weightedBlock C i j 0 1 = 0 ∧ weightedBlock C i j 1 0 = 0 := by
    intro i j
    simpa only [C, weightedBlock_commonPlane_conjugate] using h i j
  let A := (planeScale p).comp (C.comp (planeScale (fun i => (p i)⁻¹)))
  have ha : matrixAction
      (matrixOfLinear (splitBackward L p S) * P *
        matrixOfLinear (splitForward L p H)) = A := by
    rw [matrixAction_mul, matrixAction_mul, matrixAction_matrixOfLinear,
      matrixAction_matrixOfLinear]
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro x
    rfl
  have hm (i j : Fin 3) := weightedBlock_scaled_mixed C p (fun i => (p i)⁻¹) i j
  constructor
  · ext i j
    have hz : weightedBlock A i j 0 1 = 0 := by
      rw [(hm i j).1, (hc i j).1, mul_zero]
    change (matrixOfLinear (splitBackward L p S) * P *
      matrixOfLinear (splitForward L p H)) (Sum.inl i) (Sum.inr j) = 0
    rw [← matrixOfLinear_matrixAction
      (matrixOfLinear (splitBackward L p S) * P *
        matrixOfLinear (splitForward L p H)), ha]
    exact hz
  · ext i j
    have hz : weightedBlock A i j 1 0 = 0 := by
      rw [(hm i j).2, (hc i j).2, mul_zero]
    change (matrixOfLinear (splitBackward L p S) * P *
      matrixOfLinear (splitForward L p H)) (Sum.inr i) (Sum.inl j) = 0
    rw [← matrixOfLinear_matrixAction
      (matrixOfLinear (splitBackward L p S) * P *
        matrixOfLinear (splitForward L p H)), ha]
    exact hz

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.CommonSplitBasis.split_matrix_grouped
statement:
private theorem split_matrix_grouped
    (L : Vec6 K ≃ₗ[K] Vec6 K) (p : Fin 3 → K) (H S : Mat2 K)
    (P : Carrier K)
    (h : ∀ i j,
      (S * weightedBlock (coordinateConjugate L (matrixAction (P : Mat6 K))) i j * H) 0 1 = 0 ∧
      (S * weightedBlock (coordinateConjugate L (matrixAction (P : Mat6 K))) i j * H) 1 0 = 0)
    (hMN : matrixOfLinear (splitBackward L p S) * matrixOfLinear (splitForward L p H) = 1)
    (hN : (matrixOfLinear (splitBackward L p S)).transpose * symplecticJ *
      matrixOfLinear (splitBackward L p S) = symplecticJ) :
    let Q
proof:
:= matrixOfLinear (splitForward L p H)
    let N := matrixOfLinear (splitBackward L p S)
    N * (P : Mat6 K) * Q = grouped (topLeft (N * (P : Mat6 K) * Q)) 0 0 := by
  obtain ⟨hu, hv⟩ := split_matrix_mixed L p H S (P : Mat6 K) h
  have hmem := SimilitudeConjugation.conjugate_mem
    (matrixOfLinear (splitBackward L p S)) (matrixOfLinear (splitForward L p H))
    (1 : K) hMN (by simpa using hN) P
  have hg := grouped_extract _ hmem
  rw [hu, hv] at hg
  simpa only [unhat_zero_matrix] using hg.symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.CommonSplitBasis.planeScale_comm_standardProjector
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  funext a
  rcases a with j | j <;> by_cases h : j = i <;>
    simp [planeScale, standardProjector, coordinateLabel, h]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.CommonSplitBasis.standardProjector_matrix
statement:
private theorem standardProjector_matrix (i : Fin 3) :
    matrixOfLinear (standardProjector (K := K) i) = grouped (diagonalUnit i) 0 0
proof:
:= by
  ext a b
  rcases a with a | a <;> rcases b with b | b <;>
    simp [matrixOfLinear, standardProjector, coordinateLabel, basisVector,
      Pi.single_apply, grouped, diagonalUnit, hat_zero_matrix] <;>
    split_ifs <;> simp_all

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.CommonSplitBasis.exists_actual_common_splitter
statement:
theorem exists_actual_common_splitter
    (E F : Fin 3 → Carrier K)
    (hEidem : ∀ i, (E i : Mat6 K) * E i = E i)
    (hEsum : (E 0 : Mat6 K) + E 1 + E 2 = 1)
    (hFidem : ∀ i, (F i : Mat6 K) * F i = F i)
    (hFsum : (F 0 : Mat6 K) + F 1 + F 2 = 1)
    (u v : Vec6 K) (p : Fin 3 → K)
    (hp : ∀ i, p i = (SymplecticMatrixBridge.omega (K := K))
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v))
    (hpne : ∀ i, p i ≠ 0)
    (hFu : ∀ i, matrixAction (F 0 : Mat6 K) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u) = p i • u)
    (hFv : ∀ i, matrixAction (F 0 : Mat6 K) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v) = p i • v)
    (sigma : K) (hs : sigma ≠ 0)
    (hroot : let L := weightedCoordinateEquiv E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne
      let X := weightedBlock (coordinateConjugate L (matrixAction (F 1 : Mat6 K))) 0 1
      sigma ^ 2 = trace2 X ^ 2 - 4 * determinant X) :
    ∃ Q N : Mat6 K, ∃ f : Fin 3 → Mat3 K,
      Q * N = 1 ∧ N * Q = 1 ∧ Q.transpose * symplecticJ * Q = symplecticJ ∧
      (∀ i, N * (E i : Mat6 K) * Q = grouped (diagonalUnit i) 0 0) ∧
      (∀ j, N * (F j : Mat6 K) * Q = grouped (f j) 0 0)
proof:
:= by
  let L := weightedCoordinateEquiv E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne
  let A := coordinateConjugate L (matrixAction (F 1 : Mat6 K))
  let B := fun i j => weightedBlock A i j
  have hz := actual_second_projector_weighted_zero_compositions
    E F hEidem hEsum hFidem hFsum u v p hp hpne hFu hFv
  dsimp only at hz
  obtain ⟨hr0, hc0⟩ := weighted_block_zero_sums A p (hpne 0) hz.1 hz.2
  have hd0 := actual_weighted_diagonal_scalar
    E (F 1) hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne
  dsimp only at hd0
  choose q0 hq0 using hd0
  have hqledger (i : Fin 3) :
      q0 i = ProjectorBlockBridge.jordanTrace (K := K)
        ((E i : Mat6 K) * (F 1 : Mat6 K)) :=
    diagonal_scalar_eq_actual_pair_ledger
      E (F 1) hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne i (q0 i) (hq0 i)
  let q : Fin 3 → K := fun i =>
    ProjectorBlockBridge.jordanTrace (K := K)
      ((E i : Mat6 K) * (F 1 : Mat6 K))
  have hd : ∀ i, B i i = scalar2 (q i) := by
    intro i
    change weightedBlock A i i = scalar2 (q i)
    simpa only [A, L, q, hqledger] using hq0 i
  have hr : ∀ i, B i 0 + B i 1 + B i 2 = 0 := by
    intro i
    ext r s
    simpa [B, Fin.sum_univ_three] using hr0 i r s
  have hc : ∀ j, p 0 • B 0 j + p 1 • B 1 j + p 2 • B 2 j = 0 := by
    intro j
    ext r s
    simpa [B, Fin.sum_univ_three, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] using hc0 j r s
  obtain ⟨H, S, hH, hHS, hSH, hX⟩ := exists_ordered_sl2_split (B 0 1) sigma hs hroot
  have hdiag : ∀ i j, (S * B i j * H) 0 1 = 0 ∧ (S * B i j * H) 1 0 = 0 :=
    all_blocks_diagonal B p q (hpne 1) (hpne 2) hd hr hc H S hSH sigma hX
  let Q := matrixOfLinear (splitForward L p H)
  let N := matrixOfLinear (splitBackward L p S)
  obtain ⟨hQN', hNQ'⟩ := split_inverse L p hpne H S hHS hSH
  have hQN : Q * N = 1 := by
    apply matrixAction_injective
    rw [matrixAction_mul, matrixAction_matrixOfLinear, matrixAction_matrixOfLinear,
      hQN', matrixAction_one]
  have hNQ : N * Q = 1 := by
    apply matrixAction_injective
    rw [matrixAction_mul, matrixAction_matrixOfLinear, matrixAction_matrixOfLinear,
      hNQ', matrixAction_one]
  have hQ : Q.transpose * symplecticJ * Q = symplecticJ :=
    splitForward_symplectic E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne H hH
  have hN : N.transpose * symplecticJ * N = symplecticJ := by
    simpa using SimilitudeConjugation.inverse_form Q N (1 : K) hQN
      one_ne_zero (by simpa using hQ)
  have hE (i : Fin 3) : N * (E i : Mat6 K) * Q = grouped (diagonalUnit i) 0 0 := by
    have hecoord := coordinateConjugate_first_frame E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne i
    have ha : matrixAction (N * (E i : Mat6 K) * Q) = standardProjector i := by
      rw [matrixAction_mul, matrixAction_mul, matrixAction_matrixOfLinear,
        matrixAction_matrixOfLinear]
      change (planeScale p).comp
        (((commonPlaneMap S).comp
          ((coordinateConjugate L (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K))).comp
            (commonPlaneMap H))).comp (planeScale (fun i => (p i)⁻¹))) = _
      have hcommon : (commonPlaneMap S).comp
          ((coordinateConjugate L (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K))).comp
            (commonPlaneMap H)) = standardProjector i := by
        rw [hecoord, ← LinearMap.comp_assoc,
          commonPlaneMap_comm_standardProjector S i, LinearMap.comp_assoc,
          commonPlaneMap_comp S H hSH, LinearMap.comp_id]
      rw [hcommon, ← LinearMap.comp_assoc, planeScale_comm_standardProjector p i,
        LinearMap.comp_assoc,
        planeScale_comp p (fun i => (p i)⁻¹) (fun i => mul_inv_cancel₀ (hpne i)),
        LinearMap.comp_id]
    rw [← matrixOfLinear_matrixAction (N * (E i : Mat6 K) * Q), ha,
      standardProjector_matrix]
  have hF1 : N * (F 1 : Mat6 K) * Q =
      grouped (topLeft (N * (F 1 : Mat6 K) * Q)) 0 0 :=
    split_matrix_grouped L p H S (F 1) hdiag hNQ hN
  have hF0 : N * (F 0 : Mat6 K) * Q =
      grouped (topLeft (N * (F 0 : Mat6 K) * Q)) 0 0 := by
    apply split_matrix_grouped L p H S (F 0) _ hNQ hN
    intro i j
    rw [coordinateConjugate_first_projector E (F 0) hEidem hEsum
      u v p hp hpne hFu hFv]
    have hb : weightedBlock (weightedFirstAction p) i j = p j • (1 : Mat2 K) := by
      ext r s
      fin_cases r <;> fin_cases s <;>
        simp [weightedBlock, weightedPairIndex, weightedFirstAction, basisVector,
          Pi.single_apply, Matrix.one_apply]
    rw [hb, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_one, hSH]
    simp
  let f : Fin 3 → Mat3 K := fun j => topLeft (N * (F j : Mat6 K) * Q)
  have hF2 : N * (F 2 : Mat6 K) * Q = grouped (f 2) 0 0 := by
    have hsum : N * (F 0 : Mat6 K) * Q + N * (F 1 : Mat6 K) * Q +
        N * (F 2 : Mat6 K) * Q = 1 := by
      rw [← Matrix.add_mul, ← Matrix.mul_add, ← Matrix.add_mul,
        ← Matrix.mul_add, hFsum, Matrix.mul_one, hNQ]
    have hz : topRight (N * (F 2 : Mat6 K) * Q) = 0 ∧
        bottomLeft (N * (F 2 : Mat6 K) * Q) = 0 := by
      constructor <;> ext i j
      · change (N * (F 2 : Mat6 K) * Q) (Sum.inl i) (Sum.inr j) = 0
        have h := congrFun (congrFun hsum (Sum.inl i)) (Sum.inr j)
        rw [hF0, hF1] at h
        simpa [grouped, hat_zero_matrix, Matrix.one_apply] using h
      · change (N * (F 2 : Mat6 K) * Q) (Sum.inr i) (Sum.inl j) = 0
        have h := congrFun (congrFun hsum (Sum.inr i)) (Sum.inl j)
        rw [hF0, hF1] at h
        simpa [grouped, hat_zero_matrix, Matrix.one_apply] using h
    have hmem := SimilitudeConjugation.conjugate_mem N Q (1 : K) hNQ
      (by simpa using hN) (F 2)
    have hg := grouped_extract _ hmem
    rw [hz.1, hz.2] at hg
    simpa only [unhat_zero_matrix, f] using hg.symm
  refine ⟨Q, N, f, hQN, hNQ, hQ, hE, ?_⟩
  intro j
  fin_cases j
  · exact hF0
  · exact hF1
  · exact hF2

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.CommonSplitBasis.actual_common_splitter_of_ordered_split
statement:
private theorem actual_common_splitter_of_ordered_split
    (E F : Fin 3 → Carrier K)
    (hEidem : ∀ i, (E i : Mat6 K) * E i = E i)
    (hEsum : (E 0 : Mat6 K) + E 1 + E 2 = 1)
    (hFidem : ∀ i, (F i : Mat6 K) * F i = F i)
    (hFsum : (F 0 : Mat6 K) + F 1 + F 2 = 1)
    (u v : Vec6 K) (p : Fin 3 → K)
    (hp : ∀ i, p i = (SymplecticMatrixBridge.omega (K := K))
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v))
    (hpne : ∀ i, p i ≠ 0)
    (hFu : ∀ i, matrixAction (F 0 : Mat6 K) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u) = p i • u)
    (hFv : ∀ i, matrixAction (F 0 : Mat6 K) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v) = p i • v)
    (H S : Mat2 K) (hH : determinant H = 1)
    (hHS : H * S = 1) (hSH : S * H = 1) (sigma : K)
    (hX : let L := weightedCoordinateEquiv E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne
      let X := weightedBlock (coordinateConjugate L (matrixAction (F 1 : Mat6 K))) 0 1
      S * X * H = eigenvalues X sigma) :
    let L
proof:
:= weightedCoordinateEquiv E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne
    let Q := matrixOfLinear (splitForward L p H)
    let N := matrixOfLinear (splitBackward L p S)
    ∃ f : Fin 3 → Mat3 K,
      Q * N = 1 ∧ N * Q = 1 ∧ Q.transpose * symplecticJ * Q = symplecticJ ∧
      (∀ i, N * (E i : Mat6 K) * Q = grouped (diagonalUnit i) 0 0) ∧
      (∀ j, N * (F j : Mat6 K) * Q = grouped (f j) 0 0) := by
  let L := weightedCoordinateEquiv E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne
  let A := coordinateConjugate L (matrixAction (F 1 : Mat6 K))
  let B := fun i j => weightedBlock A i j
  have hz := actual_second_projector_weighted_zero_compositions
    E F hEidem hEsum hFidem hFsum u v p hp hpne hFu hFv
  dsimp only at hz
  obtain ⟨hr0, hc0⟩ := weighted_block_zero_sums A p (hpne 0) hz.1 hz.2
  have hd0 := actual_weighted_diagonal_scalar
    E (F 1) hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne
  dsimp only at hd0
  choose q0 hq0 using hd0
  have hqledger (i : Fin 3) :
      q0 i = ProjectorBlockBridge.jordanTrace (K := K)
        ((E i : Mat6 K) * (F 1 : Mat6 K)) :=
    diagonal_scalar_eq_actual_pair_ledger
      E (F 1) hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne i (q0 i) (hq0 i)
  let q : Fin 3 → K := fun i =>
    ProjectorBlockBridge.jordanTrace (K := K)
      ((E i : Mat6 K) * (F 1 : Mat6 K))
  have hd : ∀ i, B i i = scalar2 (q i) := by
    intro i
    change weightedBlock A i i = scalar2 (q i)
    simpa only [A, L, q, hqledger] using hq0 i
  have hr : ∀ i, B i 0 + B i 1 + B i 2 = 0 := by
    intro i
    ext r s
    simpa [B, Fin.sum_univ_three] using hr0 i r s
  have hc : ∀ j, p 0 • B 0 j + p 1 • B 1 j + p 2 • B 2 j = 0 := by
    intro j
    ext r s
    simpa [B, Fin.sum_univ_three, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] using hc0 j r s
  have hdiag : ∀ i j, (S * B i j * H) 0 1 = 0 ∧ (S * B i j * H) 1 0 = 0 :=
    all_blocks_diagonal B p q (hpne 1) (hpne 2) hd hr hc H S hSH sigma hX
  let Q := matrixOfLinear (splitForward L p H)
  let N := matrixOfLinear (splitBackward L p S)
  obtain ⟨hQN', hNQ'⟩ := split_inverse L p hpne H S hHS hSH
  have hQN : Q * N = 1 := by
    apply matrixAction_injective
    rw [matrixAction_mul, matrixAction_matrixOfLinear, matrixAction_matrixOfLinear,
      hQN', matrixAction_one]
  have hNQ : N * Q = 1 := by
    apply matrixAction_injective
    rw [matrixAction_mul, matrixAction_matrixOfLinear, matrixAction_matrixOfLinear,
      hNQ', matrixAction_one]
  have hQ : Q.transpose * symplecticJ * Q = symplecticJ :=
    splitForward_symplectic E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne H hH
  have hN : N.transpose * symplecticJ * N = symplecticJ := by
    simpa using SimilitudeConjugation.inverse_form Q N (1 : K) hQN
      one_ne_zero (by simpa using hQ)
  have hE (i : Fin 3) : N * (E i : Mat6 K) * Q = grouped (diagonalUnit i) 0 0 := by
    have hecoord := coordinateConjugate_first_frame E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne i
    have ha : matrixAction (N * (E i : Mat6 K) * Q) = standardProjector i := by
      rw [matrixAction_mul, matrixAction_mul, matrixAction_matrixOfLinear,
        matrixAction_matrixOfLinear]
      change (planeScale p).comp
        (((commonPlaneMap S).comp
          ((coordinateConjugate L (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K))).comp
            (commonPlaneMap H))).comp (planeScale (fun i => (p i)⁻¹))) = _
      have hcommon : (commonPlaneMap S).comp
          ((coordinateConjugate L (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K))).comp
            (commonPlaneMap H)) = standardProjector i := by
        rw [hecoord, ← LinearMap.comp_assoc,
          commonPlaneMap_comm_standardProjector S i, LinearMap.comp_assoc,
          commonPlaneMap_comp S H hSH, LinearMap.comp_id]
      rw [hcommon, ← LinearMap.comp_assoc, planeScale_comm_standardProjector p i,
        LinearMap.comp_assoc,
        planeScale_comp p (fun i => (p i)⁻¹) (fun i => mul_inv_cancel₀ (hpne i)),
        LinearMap.comp_id]
    rw [← matrixOfLinear_matrixAction (N * (E i : Mat6 K) * Q), ha,
      standardProjector_matrix]
  have hF1 : N * (F 1 : Mat6 K) * Q =
      grouped (topLeft (N * (F 1 : Mat6 K) * Q)) 0 0 :=
    split_matrix_grouped L p H S (F 1) hdiag hNQ hN
  have hF0 : N * (F 0 : Mat6 K) * Q =
      grouped (topLeft (N * (F 0 : Mat6 K) * Q)) 0 0 := by
    apply split_matrix_grouped L p H S (F 0) _ hNQ hN
    intro i j
    rw [coordinateConjugate_first_projector E (F 0) hEidem hEsum
      u v p hp hpne hFu hFv]
    have hb : weightedBlock (weightedFirstAction p) i j = p j • (1 : Mat2 K) := by
      ext r s
      fin_cases r <;> fin_cases s <;>
        simp [weightedBlock, weightedPairIndex, weightedFirstAction, basisVector,
          Pi.single_apply, Matrix.one_apply]
    rw [hb, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_one, hSH]
    simp
  let f : Fin 3 → Mat3 K := fun j => topLeft (N * (F j : Mat6 K) * Q)
  have hF2 : N * (F 2 : Mat6 K) * Q = grouped (f 2) 0 0 := by
    have hsum : N * (F 0 : Mat6 K) * Q + N * (F 1 : Mat6 K) * Q +
        N * (F 2 : Mat6 K) * Q = 1 := by
      rw [← Matrix.add_mul, ← Matrix.mul_add, ← Matrix.add_mul,
        ← Matrix.mul_add, hFsum, Matrix.mul_one, hNQ]
    have hz : topRight (N * (F 2 : Mat6 K) * Q) = 0 ∧
        bottomLeft (N * (F 2 : Mat6 K) * Q) = 0 := by
      constructor <;> ext i j
      · change (N * (F 2 : Mat6 K) * Q) (Sum.inl i) (Sum.inr j) = 0
        have h := congrFun (congrFun hsum (Sum.inl i)) (Sum.inr j)
        rw [hF0, hF1] at h
        simpa [grouped, hat_zero_matrix, Matrix.one_apply] using h
      · change (N * (F 2 : Mat6 K) * Q) (Sum.inr i) (Sum.inl j) = 0
        have h := congrFun (congrFun hsum (Sum.inr i)) (Sum.inl j)
        rw [hF0, hF1] at h
        simpa [grouped, hat_zero_matrix, Matrix.one_apply] using h
    have hmem := SimilitudeConjugation.conjugate_mem N Q (1 : K) hNQ
      (by simpa using hN) (F 2)
    have hg := grouped_extract _ hmem
    rw [hz.1, hz.2] at hg
    simpa only [unhat_zero_matrix, f] using hg.symm
  refine ⟨f, hQN, hNQ, hQ, hE, ?_⟩
  intro j
  fin_cases j
  · exact hF0
  · exact hF1
  · exact hF2

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.CommonSplitBasis.actual_common_splitter_of_cyclic_vector
statement:
theorem actual_common_splitter_of_cyclic_vector
    (E F : Fin 3 → Carrier K)
    (hEidem : ∀ i, (E i : Mat6 K) * E i = E i)
    (hEsum : (E 0 : Mat6 K) + E 1 + E 2 = 1)
    (hFidem : ∀ i, (F i : Mat6 K) * F i = F i)
    (hFsum : (F 0 : Mat6 K) + F 1 + F 2 = 1)
    (u v : Vec6 K) (p : Fin 3 → K)
    (hp : ∀ i, p i = (SymplecticMatrixBridge.omega (K := K))
      (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v))
    (hpne : ∀ i, p i ≠ 0)
    (hFu : ∀ i, matrixAction (F 0 : Mat6 K) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) u) = p i • u)
    (hFv : ∀ i, matrixAction (F 0 : Mat6 K) (matrixAction (E i : Mat6 K) v) = p i • v)
    (w : Vec2 K) (sigma : K) (hs : sigma ≠ 0)
    (hroot : let L := weightedCoordinateEquiv E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne
      let X := weightedBlock (coordinateConjugate L (matrixAction (F 1 : Mat6 K))) 0 1
      sigma ^ 2 = trace2 X ^ 2 - 4 * determinant X)
    (hw : let L := weightedCoordinateEquiv E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne
      let X := weightedBlock (coordinateConjugate L (matrixAction (F 1 : Mat6 K))) 0 1
      cyclicDet X w ≠ 0) :
    let L
proof:
:= weightedCoordinateEquiv E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne
    let X := weightedBlock (coordinateConjugate L (matrixAction (F 1 : Mat6 K))) 0 1
    let H := cyclicSplitBasis X sigma w
    let S := inverseSL H
    let Q := matrixOfLinear (splitForward L p H)
    let N := matrixOfLinear (splitBackward L p S)
    ∃ f : Fin 3 → Mat3 K,
      Q * N = 1 ∧ N * Q = 1 ∧ Q.transpose * symplecticJ * Q = symplecticJ ∧
      (∀ i, N * (E i : Mat6 K) * Q = grouped (diagonalUnit i) 0 0) ∧
      (∀ j, N * (F j : Mat6 K) * Q = grouped (f j) 0 0) := by
  let L := weightedCoordinateEquiv E hEidem hEsum u v p hp hpne
  let X := weightedBlock (coordinateConjugate L (matrixAction (F 1 : Mat6 K))) 0 1
  let H := cyclicSplitBasis X sigma w
  let S := inverseSL H
  have hH : determinant H = 1 := cyclicSplitBasis_det X sigma w hs hw
  have hHS : H * S = 1 := mul_inverseSL H hH
  have hSH : S * H = 1 := inverseSL_mul H hH
  have hX : S * X * H = eigenvalues X sigma := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, cyclicSplitBasis_intertwines X sigma w hroot,
      ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hSH, Matrix.one_mul]
  exact actual_common_splitter_of_ordered_split
    E F hEidem hEsum hFidem hFsum u v p hp hpne hFu hFv
    H S hH hHS hSH sigma hX

proof:

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ActualFrameJordanAut.word_conjugates_projector
statement:
theorem word_conjugates_projector
    (word : List (Step (K := K) (V := Vec6 K)))
    (P : Carrier K) (i : Fin 3)
    (hintertwine :
      (wordMap omega word).comp (matrixAction P) =
        (standardProjector i).comp (wordMap omega word)) :
    wordMatrix word * (P : Mat6 K) * inverseWordMatrix word =
      ((standardCarrierProjector (K := K) i : Carrier K) : Mat6 K)
proof:
:= by
  apply matrixAction_injective
  unfold wordMatrix inverseWordMatrix
  rw [matrixAction_mul, matrixAction_mul,
    matrixAction_matrixOfLinear, matrixAction_matrixOfLinear,
    matrixAction_standardCarrierProjector]
  calc
    ((wordMap omega word).comp (matrixAction P)).comp
        (wordMap omega (inverseWord word)) =
      ((standardProjector i).comp (wordMap omega word)).comp
        (wordMap omega (inverseWord word)) := by rw [hintertwine]
    _ = (standardProjector i).comp
        ((wordMap omega word).comp (wordMap omega (inverseWord word))) := by
      simp only [LinearMap.comp_assoc]
    _ = standardProjector i := by rw [inverseWord_right]; simp

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.ActualFrameJordanAut.exists_jordanAut_to_standard_frame
statement:
theorem exists_jordanAut_to_standard_frame
    (P : Fin 3 → Carrier K)
    (hidem : ∀ i, (P i : Mat6 K) * P i = P i)
    (htrace : ∀ i, jordanTrace (K := K) ((P i : Carrier K) : Mat6 K) = 1)
    (hsum : (P 0 : Mat6 K) + P 1 + P 2 = 1) :
    ∃ word : List (Step (K := K) (V := Vec6 K)), word.length = 12 ∧
      ∀ i, ((wordJordanAut word).linear (P i) : Carrier K) =
        standardCarrierProjector i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨word, hlen, hintertwine⟩ :=
    exists_twelve_actual_carrier_frame_alignment P hidem htrace hsum
  refine ⟨word, hlen, ?_⟩
  intro i
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact word_conjugates_projector word (P i) i (hintertwine i)

    (b : PolynomialFrameSchedule.Ix6) :
    rootPEval k (omegaColumn ℚ (direction ℚ r s) b) =
      match b with
      | Sum.inl i => -(rootSchedule k r s).1 (Sum.inr i)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GenericSplitterAttachment.rootPEval_transvectionMatrix
statement:
theorem rootPEval_transvectionMatrix (r : Fin 3) (s : Fin 12) :
    (rootPEval k).mapMatrix
        (transvectionMatrix ℚ (direction ℚ r s) (coefficient ℚ r s)) =
      matrixOfLinear (map omega (rootSchedule k r s).1
        (rootSchedule k r s).2)
proof:
:= by
  ext a b
  classical
  change rootPEval k
      ((if a = b then 1 else 0) + coefficient ℚ r s *
        omegaColumn ℚ (direction ℚ r s) b * direction ℚ r s a) =
    basisVector (K := Root k) b a +
      (rootSchedule k r s).2 *
        (omega (K := Root k)) (rootSchedule k r s).1
          (basisVector (K := Root k) b) *
        (rootSchedule k r s).1 a
  rw [map_add, map_mul, map_mul, rootPEval_coefficient,
    rootPEval_omegaColumn, rootPEval_direction, basisVector_apply_eq,
    omega_basis_eq_column]
  rcases b with b | b <;> simp

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GenericSplitterAttachment.rootPEval_neg_transvectionMatrix
statement:
theorem rootPEval_neg_transvectionMatrix (r : Fin 3) (s : Fin 12) :

        (transvectionMatrix ℚ (direction ℚ r s) (-coefficient ℚ r s)) =
      matrixOfLinear (map omega (rootSchedule k r s).1
        (-(rootSchedule k r s).2))
proof:
:= by
  ext a b
  classical
  change rootPEval k
      ((if a = b then 1 else 0) + (-coefficient ℚ r s) *
        omegaColumn ℚ (direction ℚ r s) b * direction ℚ r s a) =
    basisVector (K := Root k) b a +
      (-(rootSchedule k r s).2) *
        (omega (K := Root k)) (rootSchedule k r s).1
          (basisVector (K := Root k) b) *
        (rootSchedule k r s).1 a
  rw [map_add, map_mul, map_mul, map_neg, rootPEval_coefficient,
    rootPEval_omegaColumn, rootPEval_direction, basisVector_apply_eq,
    omega_basis_eq_column]
  rcases b with b | b <;> split_ifs <;> simp <;> ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GenericSplitterAttachment.rootCarrier_laws
statement:
theorem rootCarrier_laws (r : Fin 3) :
    (∀ i, (rootCarrier k r i : Mat6 (Root k)) * rootCarrier k r i =
      rootCarrier k r i) ∧
    (∀ i, ProjectorBlockBridge.jordanTrace
      (rootCarrier k r i : Mat6 (Root k)) = 1) ∧
    ((rootCarrier k r 0 : Mat6 (Root k)) + rootCarrier k r 1 +
      rootCarrier k r 2 = 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hraw := inverse_standard_isRaw
    (Root k) (wordJordanAut (rootWord k r))
  simpa only [rootCarrier, decode_encode] using
    (actual_frame_laws
      (fun _ i => encode (rootCarrier k r i)) hraw 0)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GenericSplitterAttachment.rootCarrier_matrix
statement:
theorem rootCarrier_matrix (r i : Fin 3) :
    (rootCarrier k r i : Mat6 (Root k)) =
      inverseWordMatrix (rootWord k r) *
        ((standardCarrierProjector (K := Root k) i : Carrier (Root k)) :
          Mat6 (Root k)) *
        wordMatrix (rootWord k r)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (rootCarrier k r i : Mat6 (Root k)) =
        (rootPEval k).mapMatrix (frame r i) :=
      (rootPEval_frame k r i).symm
    _ = _ := by
      rw [frame, map_mul, map_mul, rootPEval_inverseMatrix,
        rootPEval_standardMatrix, rootPEval_forwardMatrix]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GenericSplitterAttachment.standardProjector_zero_spans
statement:
private theorem standardProjector_zero_spans (y : Vec6 (Root k))
    (hy : standardProjector 0 y = y) :
    y = y (Sum.inl 0) • standardE (K := Root k) 0 +
      y (Sum.inr 0) • standardF (K := Root k) 0
proof:
:= by
  funext q
  rcases q with q | q
  · have hq := congrFun hy (Sum.inl q)
    fin_cases q <;>
      simp [standardProjector, coordinateLabel, standardE, standardF,
        basisVector, Pi.single_apply] at hq ⊢ <;> exact hq.symm
  · have hq := congrFun hy (Sum.inr q)
    fin_cases q <;>
      simp [standardProjector, coordinateLabel, standardE, standardF,
        basisVector, Pi.single_apply] at hq ⊢ <;> exact hq.symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GenericSplitterAttachment.inverseWord_standardProjector_spans
statement:
private theorem inverseWord_standardProjector_spans
    (word : List (Step (K := Root k) (V := Vec6 (Root k))))
    (x : Vec6 (Root k))
    (hx : wordMap omega (inverseWord word)
      (standardProjector 0 (wordMap omega word x)) = x) :
    ∃ a b : Root k,
      x = a • wordMap omega (inverseWord word)
          (standardE (K := Root k) 0) +
        b • wordMap omega (inverseWord word)
          (standardF (K := Root k) 0)
proof:
:= by
  let y := wordMap omega word x
  change wordMap omega (inverseWord word) (standardProjector 0 y) = x at hx
  have hy : standardProjector 0 y = y := by
    have hc := LinearMap.congr_fun (inverseWord_right word)
      (standardProjector 0 y)
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.id_apply] at hc
    calc
      standardProjector 0 y = wordMap omega word
          (wordMap omega (inverseWord word) (standardProjector 0 y)) := hc.symm
      _ = wordMap omega word x := congrArg (wordMap omega word) hx
      _ = y := rfl
  refine ⟨y (Sum.inl 0), y (Sum.inr 0), ?_⟩
  have hleft : Function.LeftInverse (wordMap omega (inverseWord word))
      (wordMap omega word) := by
    intro z
    exact LinearMap.congr_fun (inverseWord_left word) z
  apply hleft.injective
  rw [map_add, map_smul, map_smul]
  have hu := LinearMap.congr_fun (inverseWord_right word)
    (standardE (K := Root k) 0)
  have hv := LinearMap.congr_fun (inverseWord_right word)
    (standardF (K := Root k) 0)
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.id_apply] at hu hv
  rw [hu, hv]
  change y = y (Sum.inl 0) • standardE (K := Root k) 0 +
    y (Sum.inr 0) • standardF (K := Root k) 0
  exact standardProjector_zero_spans k y hy

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GenericSplitterAttachment.rootPair_spans_first_image
statement:
theorem rootPair_spans_first_image (x : Vec6 (Root k))
    (hx : matrixAction (rootCarrier k 1 0 : Mat6 (Root k)) x = x) :
    ∃ a b : Root k, x = a • rootPairU k + b • rootPairV k
proof:
:= by
  have hx' := hx
  rw [rootCarrier_action] at hx'
  rcases inverseWord_standardProjector_spans k (rootWord k 1) x hx' with
    ⟨a, b, hab⟩
  refine ⟨a, b, ?_⟩
  simpa only [rootPairU_eq_inverseWord, rootPairV_eq_inverseWord] using hab

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GenericSplitterAttachment.rootFirst_compresses_left
statement:
theorem rootFirst_compresses_left (i : Fin 3) :
    matrixAction (rootCarrier k 1 0 : Mat6 (Root k))
        (matrixAction (rootCarrier k 0 i : Mat6 (Root k)) (rootPairU k)) =
      rootWeight k i • rootPairU k
proof:
:= by
  have hs := scalar_compression_on_hyperbolic_image (omega (K := Root k))
    (matrixAction (rootCarrier k 1 0 : Mat6 (Root k)))
    (matrixAction (rootCarrier k 0 i : Mat6 (Root k)))
    (carrier_projector_action_idempotent _ ((rootCarrier_laws k 1).1 0))
    (carrier_action_selfAdjoint _) (carrier_action_selfAdjoint _)
    (rootPairU k) (rootPairV k) (rootPair_fixed_left k)
    (rootPair_fixed_right k) (rootPair_pairing k) omega_alternating
    (rootPair_spans_first_image k)
  have hi := hs.1
  have hover : (omega (K := Root k))
      (matrixAction (rootCarrier k 0 i : Mat6 (Root k)) (rootPairU k))
      (matrixAction (rootCarrier k 0 i : Mat6 (Root k)) (rootPairV k)) =
      (omega (K := Root k))
        (matrixAction (rootCarrier k 0 i : Mat6 (Root k)) (rootPairU k))
        (rootPairV k) := by
    calc
      _ = (omega (K := Root k))
          (matrixAction (rootCarrier k 0 i : Mat6 (Root k))
            (matrixAction (rootCarrier k 0 i : Mat6 (Root k))
              (rootPairU k))) (rootPairV k) :=
        (carrier_action_selfAdjoint (rootCarrier k 0 i)
          (matrixAction (rootCarrier k 0 i : Mat6 (Root k)) (rootPairU k))
          (rootPairV k)).symm
      _ = _ := by
        rw [SymplecticProjectorFrame.idempotent_apply
          (matrixAction (rootCarrier k 0 i : Mat6 (Root k)))
          (carrier_projector_action_idempotent
            (rootCarrier k 0 i) ((rootCarrier_laws k 0).1 i))]
  rw [rootWeight_eq_pairing, hover]
  exact hi

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GenericSplitterAttachment.rootFirst_compresses_right
statement:
theorem rootFirst_compresses_right (i : Fin 3) :
    matrixAction (rootCarrier k 1 0 : Mat6 (Root k))
        (matrixAction (rootCarrier k 0 i : Mat6 (Root k)) (rootPairV k)) =
      rootWeight k i • rootPairV k
proof:
:= by
  have hs := scalar_compression_on_hyperbolic_image (omega (K := Root k))
    (matrixAction (rootCarrier k 1 0 : Mat6 (Root k)))
    (matrixAction (rootCarrier k 0 i : Mat6 (Root k)))
    (carrier_projector_action_idempotent _ ((rootCarrier_laws k 1).1 0))
    (carrier_action_selfAdjoint _) (carrier_action_selfAdjoint _)
    (rootPairU k) (rootPairV k) (rootPair_fixed_left k)
    (rootPair_fixed_right k) (rootPair_pairing k) omega_alternating
    (rootPair_spans_first_image k)
  have hi := hs.2
  have hover : (omega (K := Root k))
      (matrixAction (rootCarrier k 0 i : Mat6 (Root k)) (rootPairU k))
      (matrixAction (rootCarrier k 0 i : Mat6 (Root k)) (rootPairV k)) =
      (omega (K := Root k))
        (matrixAction (rootCarrier k 0 i : Mat6 (Root k)) (rootPairU k))
        (rootPairV k) := by
    calc
      _ = (omega (K := Root k))
          (matrixAction (rootCarrier k 0 i : Mat6 (Root k))
            (matrixAction (rootCarrier k 0 i : Mat6 (Root k))
              (rootPairU k))) (rootPairV k) :=
        (carrier_action_selfAdjoint (rootCarrier k 0 i)
          (matrixAction (rootCarrier k 0 i : Mat6 (Root k)) (rootPairU k))
          (rootPairV k)).symm
      _ = _ := by
        rw [SymplecticProjectorFrame.idempotent_apply
          (matrixAction (rootCarrier k 0 i : Mat6 (Root k)))
          (carrier_projector_action_idempotent
            (rootCarrier k 0 i) ((rootCarrier_laws k 0).1 i))]
  rw [rootWeight_eq_pairing, hover]
  exact hi

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GenericSplitterAttachment.rootWEval_weightInv
statement:
theorem rootWEval_weightInv (i : Fin 3) :
    rootWEval k (weightInv i) = (rootWeight k i)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (rootWEval k) (weight_mul_weightInv i)
  simp only [map_mul, map_one, rootWEval_wloc, rootWeight] at h
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ (rootWeight_ne k i)
  calc
    rootWeight k i * rootWEval k (weightInv i) = 1 := h
    _ = rootWeight k i * (rootWeight k i)⁻¹ :=
      (mul_inv_cancel₀ (rootWeight_ne k i)).symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GenericSplitterAttachment.rootWEval_wFrame
statement:
theorem rootWEval_wFrame (r i : Fin 3) :
    (rootWEval k).mapMatrix (wFrame r i) =
      (rootCarrier k r i : Mat6 (Root k))
proof:
:= by
  ext a b
  change rootWEval k (wloc (frame r i a b)) = _
  rw [rootWEval_wloc]
  exact congrFun (congrFun (rootPEval_frame k r i) a) b

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GenericSplitterAttachment.rootFirstBlockAction_eq_actual
statement:
theorem rootFirstBlockAction_eq_actual (z : Ix → Root k) :
    rootFirstBlockAction k z =
      matrixAction (rootCarrier k 1 1 : Mat6 (Root k)) z
proof:
:= by
  rw [rootFirstBlockAction]
  rw [show (rootWEval k).mapMatrix (wFrame 1 1) =
      (rootCarrier k 1 1 : Mat6 (Root k)) by
    exact rootWEval_wFrame k 1 1]
  rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GenericSplitterAttachment.rootEu_eq_actual
statement:
theorem rootEu_eq_actual (i : Fin 3) :
    rootEu k i =
      matrixAction (rootCarrier k 0 i : Mat6 (Root k)) (rootPairU k)
proof:
:= by
  funext x
  change rootWEval k (wloc (Eu i x)) = _
  rw [rootWEval_wloc]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GenericSplitterAttachment.rootEv_eq_actual

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GenericSplitterAttachment.rootWeightInv_eq_actual
statement:
theorem rootWeightInv_eq_actual (i : Fin 3) :

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GenericSplitterAttachment.root_basis6_eq_basisVector
statement:
theorem root_basis6_eq_basisVector (j : Ix) :
    basis6 (R := Root k) j = basisVector j
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  rcases i with i | i <;> rcases j with j | j <;>
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [basis6, basisVector, Pi.single_apply]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GenericSplitterAttachment.rootWEval_firstBlockAction
statement:
theorem rootWEval_firstBlockAction (z : Ix → W) :
    mapVec (rootWEval k) (wFirstBlockAction z) =

proof:

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GenericSplitterAttachment.rootPivot_entry_finiteFormula
statement:
theorem rootPivot_entry_finiteFormula (r s : Fin 2) :
    rootPivot k r s =
      coordinateConjugateFormula (rootEu k) (rootEv k)
        (rootWeightInv k) (rootFirstBlockAction k)
        (basis6 (pairIndex 1 s)) (pairIndex 0 r)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrFun
    (map_coordinateConjugateFormula (rootWEval k) wEu wEv weightInv
      wFirstBlockAction (rootFirstBlockAction k)
      (rootWEval_firstBlockAction k) (basis6 (pairIndex 1 s)))
    (pairIndex 0 r)
  rw [mapVec_basis6] at h
  exact h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GenericSplitterAttachment.rootActualPivot_eq_rootPivot
statement: theorem rootActualPivot_eq_rootPivot : rootActualPivot k = rootPivot k
proof:
:= by
  ext r s
  have ha := pivotBlock_entry_eq_formula
    (fun i => rootCarrier k 0 i) (rootCarrier_laws k 0).1
    (rootCarrier_laws k 0).2.2 (rootPairU k) (rootPairV k)
    (rootWeight k) (rootWeight_eq_pairing k) (rootWeight_ne k)
    (rootCarrier k 1 1) r s
  change rootActualPivot k r s = coordinateConjugateFormula
      (fun i => matrixAction (rootCarrier k 0 i : Mat6 (Root k)) (rootPairU k))
      (fun i => matrixAction (rootCarrier k 0 i : Mat6 (Root k)) (rootPairV k))
      (fun i => (rootWeight k i)⁻¹)
      (matrixAction (rootCarrier k 1 1 : Mat6 (Root k)))
      (basisVector (weightedPairIndex 1 s)) (weightedPairIndex 0 r) at ha
  have hp := rootPivot_entry_finiteFormula k r s
  have hEu : rootEu k = fun i =>
      matrixAction (rootCarrier k 0 i : Mat6 (Root k)) (rootPairU k) :=
    funext fun i => rootEu_eq_actual k i
  have hEv : rootEv k = fun i =>
      matrixAction (rootCarrier k 0 i : Mat6 (Root k)) (rootPairV k) :=
    funext fun i => rootEv_eq_actual k i
  have hInv : rootWeightInv k = fun i => (rootWeight k i)⁻¹ :=
    funext fun i => rootWeightInv_eq_actual k i
  have hAct : rootFirstBlockAction k =
      matrixAction (rootCarrier k 1 1 : Mat6 (Root k)) :=
    funext fun z => rootFirstBlockAction_eq_actual k z
  have hBasis : basis6 (R := Root k) = basisVector :=
    funext fun j => root_basis6_eq_basisVector k j
  rw [hEu, hEv, hInv, hAct, hBasis] at hp
  simpa only [rootActualPivot, rootActualL, pairIndex, weightedPairIndex] using
    ha.trans hp.symm

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GenericSplitterAttachment.rootQEval_qPivot
statement:
theorem rootQEval_qPivot :

proof:

  simp [qPivot, rootPivot, rootQEval_qcoeff]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GenericSplitterAttachment.rootWEval_discr
statement:
theorem rootWEval_discr :
    rootWEval k discr = FiniteQuadraticDiagnostic.trace2 (rootPivot k) ^ 2 -
      4 * FiniteQuadraticDiagnostic.det2 (rootPivot k)
proof:
:= by
  change rootWEval k
    (FiniteQuadraticDiagnostic.trace2 pivot ^ 2 -
      4 * FiniteQuadraticDiagnostic.det2 pivot) = _
  rw [map_sub, map_pow, map_mul, map_ofNat,
    FiniteQuadraticDiagnostic.map_trace2, FiniteQuadraticDiagnostic.map_det2]
  rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GenericSplitterAttachment.rootWEval_cyclic
statement:
theorem rootWEval_cyclic :
    rootWEval k cyclic = cyclicDet (rootPivot k) cyclicVector
proof:
:= by
  rw [cyclic, map_cyclicDet]
  change cyclicDet (rootPivot k) (fun i => rootWEval k (cyclicVector i)) = _
  congr 1
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;> simp [cyclicVector]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GenericSplitterAttachment.rootWEval_discr_ne
statement: theorem rootWEval_discr_ne : rootWEval k discr ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := (rootField k).embedding.injective.ne (genericWEval_discr_ne k)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GenericSplitterAttachment.rootWEval_cyclic_ne

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GenericSplitterAttachment.rootSigma_sq_actualPivot
statement:
theorem rootSigma_sq_actualPivot :
    rootSigma k ^ 2 =
      BlockEigenbasis.trace2 (rootActualPivot k) ^ 2 -
        4 * BlockEigenbasis.determinant (rootActualPivot k)
proof:
:= by
  have hs := rootSigma_sq k
  rw [rootBaseMap_lloc, rootWEval_discr] at hs
  simpa only [rootActualPivot_eq_rootPivot,
    FiniteQuadraticDiagnostic.trace2, FiniteQuadraticDiagnostic.det2,
    BlockEigenbasis.trace2, BlockEigenbasis.determinant] using hs

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GenericSplitterAttachment.rootActualPivot_cyclic_ne
statement:
theorem rootActualPivot_cyclic_ne :
    NonscalarBlockNormalizer.cyclicDet (rootActualPivot k)
      (cyclicVector (R := Root k)) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hc : rootWEval k cyclic ≠ 0 := rootWEval_cyclic_ne k
  rw [rootWEval_cyclic, ← rootActualPivot_eq_rootPivot] at hc
  simpa only [FiniteQuadraticDiagnostic.cyclicDet,
    FiniteQuadraticDiagnostic.cyclicBasis,
    NonscalarBlockNormalizer.cyclicDet,
    NonscalarBlockNormalizer.cyclicBasisAt] using hc

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GenericSplitterAttachment.rootBaseMap_discrInv
statement:

proof:

  simp only [map_mul, map_one, rootBaseMap_lloc] at h

  rw [h, mul_inv_cancel₀ (rootWEval_discr_ne k)]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GenericSplitterAttachment.rootBaseMap_cyclicInv

  rw [h, mul_inv_cancel₀ (rootWEval_cyclic_ne k)]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GenericSplitterAttachment.rootQEval_sigmaInv
statement:
theorem rootQEval_sigmaInv :
    rootQEval k sigmaInv = (rootSigma k)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [sigmaInv, map_mul, rootQEval_algebraMap, rootBaseMap_discrInv,
    rootQEval_sigma]
  have hs : rootSigma k ^ 2 = rootWEval k discr := by
    simpa only [rootBaseMap_lloc] using rootSigma_sq k
  rw [← hs]
  field_simp [rootSigma_ne k]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GenericSplitterAttachment.rootQEval_dInv
statement:
theorem rootQEval_dInv :

proof:

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GenericSplitterAttachment.rootQEval_qCyclicBasis
statement:
theorem rootQEval_qCyclicBasis :
    (rootQEval k).mapMatrix qCyclicBasis =
      NonscalarBlockNormalizer.cyclicBasisAt (rootPivot k) cyclicVector
proof:
:= by
  rw [qCyclicBasis, map_cyclicBasis, rootQEval_qPivot]
  have hv : (fun i => rootQEval k (cyclicVector (R := Q) i)) =
      cyclicVector (R := Root k) := by
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [cyclicVector]
  rw [hv]
  ext i j
  by_cases hj : j = 0 <;>
    simp [cyclicBasis, NonscalarBlockNormalizer.cyclicBasisAt, hj,
      cyclicVector]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GenericSplitterAttachment.rootQEval_half
statement: theorem rootQEval_half : rootQEval k half = (1 / 2 : Root k)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GenericSplitterAttachment.rootQEval_lambdaPlus
statement:

proof:

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GenericSplitterAttachment.rootQEval_lambdaMinus
statement:

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GenericSplitterAttachment.rootQEval_eigenCoefficients
statement:
theorem rootQEval_eigenCoefficients :
    (rootQEval k).mapMatrix eigenCoefficients =
      CommonSplitBasis.eigenCoefficients (rootPivot k) (rootSigma k)
        (rootWEval k cyclic)
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
  all_goals simp [eigenCoefficients, CommonSplitBasis.eigenCoefficients,
    BlockEigenbasis.matrix, rootQEval_lambdaPlus, rootQEval_lambdaMinus,
    rootQEval_sigmaInv, rootQEval_dInv, div_eq_mul_inv]
  all_goals field_simp [rootSigma_ne k, rootWEval_cyclic_ne k] <;> ring

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GenericSplitterAttachment.rootH_eq_cyclicSplitBasis
statement:
theorem rootH_eq_cyclicSplitBasis :
    rootH k = CommonSplitBasis.cyclicSplitBasis

proof:
:= by
  rw [rootH, H, map_mul, rootQEval_qCyclicBasis,
    rootQEval_eigenCoefficients]
  rw [CommonSplitBasis.cyclicSplitBasis]
  have hd : rootWEval k cyclic =
      NonscalarBlockNormalizer.cyclicDet (rootPivot k) cyclicVector := by
    simpa only [FiniteQuadraticDiagnostic.cyclicDet,
    FiniteQuadraticDiagnostic.cyclicBasis,
    NonscalarBlockNormalizer.cyclicDet,
    NonscalarBlockNormalizer.cyclicBasisAt] using rootWEval_cyclic k
  rw [hd]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GenericSplitterAttachment.rootS_eq_inverseSL

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GenericSplitterAttachment.rootQEval_qEu

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GenericSplitterAttachment.rootQEval_qEv

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GenericSplitterAttachment.rootQEval_qWeight

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GenericSplitterAttachment.rootActualL_apply_eq_formula
statement:
theorem rootActualL_apply_eq_formula (z : Vec6 (Root k)) :
    rootActualL k z = weightedForwardFormula
      (fun i => matrixAction (rootCarrier k 0 i : Mat6 (Root k))
        (rootPairU k))
      (fun i => matrixAction (rootCarrier k 0 i : Mat6 (Root k))
        (rootPairV k)) z
proof:
:= by
  change WeightedProjectorGauge.weightedCoordinateLinear
      (fun i => rootCarrier k 0 i)
      (rootPairU k) (rootPairV k) z = _
  funext q
  change
    ((∑ i, z (Sum.inl i) • matrixAction
        (rootCarrier k 0 i : Mat6 (Root k)) (rootPairU k)) +
      ∑ i, z (Sum.inr i) • matrixAction
        (rootCarrier k 0 i : Mat6 (Root k)) (rootPairV k)) q = _
  simp only [weightedForwardFormula, Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply,
    Pi.add_apply, smul_eq_mul]

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GenericSplitterAttachment.rootActualL_symm_eq_formula
statement:
theorem rootActualL_symm_eq_formula (z : Vec6 (Root k)) :
    (rootActualL k).symm z = weightedInverseFormula
      (fun i => matrixAction (rootCarrier k 0 i : Mat6 (Root k))
        (rootPairU k))
      (fun i => matrixAction (rootCarrier k 0 i : Mat6 (Root k))
        (rootPairV k))
      (fun i => (rootWeight k i)⁻¹) z
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [rootActualL] using
    (weightedCoordinateEquiv_symm_eq_formula
      (fun i => rootCarrier k 0 i) (rootCarrier_laws k 0).1
      (rootCarrier_laws k 0).2.2 (rootPairU k) (rootPairV k)
      (rootWeight k) (rootWeight_eq_pairing k) (rootWeight_ne k) z)

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GenericSplitterAttachment.rootQEval_forwardAction
statement:
theorem rootQEval_forwardAction (z : Ix → Q) :
    mapVec (rootQEval k) (forwardAction z) =
      CommonSplitBasis.splitForward (rootActualL k) (rootWeight k) (rootH k)
        (mapVec (rootQEval k) z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [forwardAction, map_weightedForwardFormula, map_commonPlaneFormula,
    map_planeScaleFormula]
  rw [funext fun i => rootQEval_qEu k i,
    funext fun i => rootQEval_qEv k i,
    funext fun i => rootQEval_qWeightInv k i]
  rw [funext fun i => rootEu_eq_actual k i,
    funext fun i => rootEv_eq_actual k i,
    funext fun i => rootWeightInv_eq_actual k i]
  rw [← rootActualL_apply_eq_formula]
  rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GenericSplitterAttachment.rootQEval_backwardAction
statement:
theorem rootQEval_backwardAction (z : Ix → Q) :
    mapVec (rootQEval k) (backwardAction z) =
      CommonSplitBasis.splitBackward (rootActualL k) (rootWeight k) (rootS k)
        (mapVec (rootQEval k) z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [backwardAction, map_planeScaleFormula, map_commonPlaneFormula,
    map_weightedInverseFormula]
  rw [funext fun i => rootQEval_qWeight k i,
    funext fun i => rootQEval_qEu k i,
    funext fun i => rootQEval_qEv k i,
    funext fun i => rootQEval_qWeightInv k i]
  rw [funext fun i => rootEu_eq_actual k i,
    funext fun i => rootEv_eq_actual k i,
    funext fun i => rootWeightInv_eq_actual k i]
  rw [← rootActualL_symm_eq_formula]
  rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GenericSplitterAttachment.rootQ_eq_actualSplitForward
statement:
theorem rootQ_eq_actualSplitForward :
    rootQ k = matrixOfLinear
      (CommonSplitBasis.splitForward (rootActualL k) (rootWeight k) (rootH k))
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  have h := congrFun (rootQEval_forwardAction k (basis6 j)) i
  rw [mapVec_basis6, root_basis6_eq_basisVector] at h

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GenericSplitterAttachment.rootN_eq_actualSplitBackward
statement:

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GenericSplitterAttachment.rootPivot_eq_finiteFormula
statement:

    rootPivot k = (rootWEval k).mapMatrix pivot
proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GenericSplitterAttachment.rootN_eq_finiteFormula

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GenericSplitterAttachment.exists_actual_generic_common_splitter
statement:
theorem exists_actual_generic_common_splitter :
    ∃ f : Fin 3 → ScalarFibre.Mat3 (Root k),
      rootQ k * rootN k = 1 ∧ rootN k * rootQ k = 1 ∧
      (rootQ k).transpose * symplecticJ * rootQ k = symplecticJ ∧
      (∀ i, rootN k * (rootCarrier k 0 i : Mat6 (Root k)) * rootQ k =
        GroupedBridge.grouped
          (AlbertLean.Generic.FourRowProbeTrace.diagonalUnit i) 0 0) ∧
      (∀ j, rootN k * (rootCarrier k 1 j : Mat6 (Root k)) * rootQ k =
        GroupedBridge.grouped (f j) 0 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hsplit := CommonSplitBasis.actual_common_splitter_of_cyclic_vector
    (fun i => rootCarrier k 0 i) (fun i => rootCarrier k 1 i)
    (rootCarrier_laws k 0).1 (rootCarrier_laws k 0).2.2
    (rootCarrier_laws k 1).1 (rootCarrier_laws k 1).2.2
    (rootPairU k) (rootPairV k) (rootWeight k)
    (rootWeight_eq_pairing k) (rootWeight_ne k)
    (rootFirst_compresses_left k) (rootFirst_compresses_right k)
    (cyclicVector (R := Root k)) (rootSigma k) (rootSigma_ne k)
    (rootSigma_sq_actualPivot k) (rootActualPivot_cyclic_ne k)
  have hH : CommonSplitBasis.cyclicSplitBasis (rootActualPivot k)
      (rootSigma k) (cyclicVector (R := Root k)) = rootH k := by
    rw [rootActualPivot_eq_rootPivot]
    exact (rootH_eq_cyclicSplitBasis k).symm
  have hH' := hH
  have hQ' := rootQ_eq_actualSplitForward k
  have hN' := rootN_eq_actualSplitBackward k
  simp only [rootActualPivot, rootActualL] at hH'
  simp only [rootActualL] at hQ' hN'
  dsimp only at hsplit
  rw [hH'] at hsplit
  rw [← rootS_eq_inverseSL k] at hsplit
  rw [← hQ', ← hN'] at hsplit
  exact hsplit

name: AlbertLean.Generic.QuaternionRow.GenericSplitterAttachment.actual_generic_root_data
statement:
theorem actual_generic_root_data :
    Function.Injective (genericBaseMap k) ∧
    genericBaseMap k diagnosticOpen ≠ 0 ∧
    genericWEval k discr ≠ 0 ∧
    genericWEval k cyclic ≠ 0 ∧
    rootSigma k ≠ 0 ∧
    rootSigma k ^ 2 = rootBaseMap k (lloc discr) ∧
    rootQEval k diagnostic ≠ 0 ∧ rootQEvalNeg k diagnostic ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨genericBaseMap_injective k, genericBaseMap_diagnosticOpen_ne k,
    genericWEval_discr_ne k, genericWEval_cyclic_ne k, rootSigma_ne k,

name: AlbertLean.Comparison.GenericF0.GenericF0CubicComparison
statement:
theorem GenericF0CubicComparison :
    (structuredEquivK K (sourceOne : JCoord K) = f0OneK) ∧
    (∀ x : JCoord K,
      sourceTrace x = f0TraceK (structuredEquivK K x) ∧
      sourceSpur x = f0SpurK (structuredEquivK K x) ∧
      sourceNorm x = f0NormK (structuredEquivK K x)) ∧
    (∀ x y z : JCoord K,
      sourcePolar x y z =
        f0PolarK (structuredEquivK K x) (structuredEquivK K y)
          (structuredEquivK K z)) ∧
    (∀ x y : JCoord K,
      sourceTraceForm x y =
        f0TraceFormK (structuredEquivK K x) (structuredEquivK K y))
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨structuredEquivK_sourceOne,
    fun x ↦ ⟨sourceTrace_agrees_with_f0K x, sourceSpur_agrees_with_f0K x,
      sourceNorm_agrees_with_f0K x⟩,
    sourcePolar_agrees_with_f0K, sourceTraceForm_agrees_with_f0K⟩

  obtain ⟨sy, rfl⟩ := (structuredEquivK K).surjective y

  rw [← (structuredEquivK K).map_add sy sz]
  rw [← sourceTraceForm_agrees_with_f0K,
    ← sourceTraceForm_agrees_with_f0K,
    ← sourceTraceForm_agrees_with_f0K]

name: AlbertLean.Comparison.GenericF0Recovery.f0TraceFormK_smul_right
statement:

proof:

  obtain ⟨sy, rfl⟩ := (structuredEquivK K).surjective y
  rw [← (structuredEquivK K).map_smul a sy]
  rw [← sourceTraceForm_agrees_with_f0K,
    ← sourceTraceForm_agrees_with_f0K]
  have hlin := (sourceTraceFormLinear (K := K) sx).map_smul a sy
  change sourceTraceForm sx (a • sy) = a • sourceTraceForm sx sy at hlin
  simpa only [smul_eq_mul] using hlin

theorem f0TraceFormK_nondegenerate {x : F0Coord K}
    (h : ∀ y : F0Coord K, f0TraceFormK x y = 0) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨sx, rfl⟩ := (structuredEquivK K).surjective x
  have hs : ∀ sy : JCoord K, sourceTraceForm sx sy = 0 := by
    intro sy
    rw [sourceTraceForm_agrees_with_f0K]
    exact h (structuredEquivK K sy)
  have hx : sx = 0 := sourceTraceForm_nondegenerate hs
  rw [hx, map_zero]

name: AlbertLean.Comparison.GenericF0Recovery.structuredEquivK_map_sourceProduct_to_genericRecovery
statement:
theorem structuredEquivK_map_sourceProduct_to_genericRecovery
    (x y : JCoord K) :
    structuredEquivK K (sourceProduct x y) =
      (f0RecoveryDataK (K := K)).product
        (structuredEquivK K x) (structuredEquivK K y)
proof:
:= by
  change structuredEquivK K ((sourceRecoveryData (K := K)).product x y) = _
  apply (sourceRecoveryData (K := K)).map_product
    (f0RecoveryDataK (K := K)) (structuredEquivK K)
  · simpa [sourceRecoveryData, f0RecoveryDataK] using
      (structuredEquivK_sourceOne (K := K))
  · intro z
    simpa [sourceRecoveryData, f0RecoveryDataK] using
      (sourceTrace_agrees_with_f0K z).symm
  · intro z w
    simpa [sourceRecoveryData, f0RecoveryDataK] using
      (sourceTraceForm_agrees_with_f0K z w).symm
  · intro z w u
    simpa [sourceRecoveryData, f0RecoveryDataK] using
      (sourcePolar_agrees_with_f0K z w u).symm

theorem structuredEquiv_sourceAdjoint_eq_sharp (x : JCoord ℚ) :

proof:
:= by
  rw [sourceAdjoint_eq_explicit]
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;>
    simp [structuredEquiv, structuredToF0, sourceExplicitAdjoint, sourceMuS,
      sourceMuC, normalizedMuV, muV, nV, nS, nC, pf_coordinate, evalU,
      wedge2, dualWedge2, hodgeStar, sharp_coord_0, sharp_coord_1, sharp_coord_2,
      sharp_coord_3, sharp_coord_4, sharp_coord_5, sharp_coord_6, sharp_coord_7,
      sharp_coord_8, sharp_coord_9, sharp_coord_10, sharp_coord_11,
      sharp_coord_12, sharp_coord_13, sharp_coord_14, sharp_coord_15,
      sharp_coord_16, sharp_coord_17, sharp_coord_18, sharp_coord_19,
      sharp_coord_20, sharp_coord_21, sharp_coord_22, sharp_coord_23,
      sharp_coord_24, sharp_coord_25, sharp_coord_26, cubicPolar_eq_polarForm,
      polarForm, basisVec, v, q] <;> ring

statement:
theorem structuredEquiv_map_adjoint (x : JCoord ℚ) :
    structuredEquiv ((sourceRecoveryData (K := ℚ)).adjoint x) =
      f0RecoveryData.adjoint (structuredEquiv x)
proof:
:= by
  apply (sourceRecoveryData (K := ℚ)).map_adjoint f0RecoveryData structuredEquiv
  · intro a b
    simpa [f0RecoveryData, sourceRecoveryData] using
      (sourceTraceForm_agrees_with_f0 a b).symm
  · intro a b c
    simpa [f0RecoveryData, sourceRecoveryData] using
      (sourcePolar_agrees_with_f0 a b c).symm

name: AlbertLean.Comparison.StructuredProductF0.f0Adjoint_eq_sharp
statement: theorem f0Adjoint_eq_sharp (x : Coord) : f0RecoveryData.adjoint x = sharp x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := structuredEquiv.surjective x
  rw [← structuredEquiv_map_adjoint]
  change structuredEquiv (sourceAdjoint y) = sharp (structuredEquiv y)
  exact structuredEquiv_sourceAdjoint_eq_sharp y

name: AlbertLean.Comparison.StructuredProductF0.f0Cross_eq_cross
statement: theorem f0Cross_eq_cross (x y : Coord) : f0RecoveryData.cross x y = cross x y
proof:
:= by
  simp [RecoveryData.cross, cross, f0Adjoint_eq_sharp]

name: AlbertLean.Comparison.StructuredProductF0.f0RecoveredProduct_eq_structuredProduct
statement:
theorem f0RecoveredProduct_eq_structuredProduct (x y : Coord) :
    f0RecoveryData.product x y = structuredProduct x y
proof:
:= by
  have hSpur : f0RecoveryData.spurBilinear x y = AlbertLean.spurBilinear x y := by
    simp [f0RecoveryData, RecoveryData.spurBilinear, traceForm]
  rw [RecoveryData.product, structuredProduct, f0Cross_eq_cross]
  rw [hSpur]
  rfl

name: AlbertLean.Comparison.StructuredProductF0.structuredEquiv_map_sourceProduct_to_recovery
statement:
theorem structuredEquiv_map_sourceProduct_to_recovery (x y : JCoord ℚ) :
    structuredEquiv (sourceProduct x y) =
      f0RecoveryData.product (structuredEquiv x) (structuredEquiv y)
proof:
:= by
  apply (sourceRecoveryData (K := ℚ)).map_product f0RecoveryData structuredEquiv
  · simpa [sourceRecoveryData, f0RecoveryData] using structuredEquiv_sourceOne
  · intro a
    simpa [sourceRecoveryData, f0RecoveryData] using
      (sourceTrace_agrees_with_f0 a).symm
  · intro a b
    simpa [f0RecoveryData, sourceRecoveryData] using
      (sourceTraceForm_agrees_with_f0 a b).symm
  · intro a b c
    simpa [f0RecoveryData, sourceRecoveryData] using
      (sourcePolar_agrees_with_f0 a b c).symm

proof:
:= by
  intro x y
  rw [structuredEquiv_map_sourceProduct_to_recovery,
    f0RecoveredProduct_eq_structuredProduct]

name: AlbertLean.Comparison.GenericProductTransport.f0NormK_mapCoordQK

name: AlbertLean.Comparison.GenericProductTransport.f0PolarK_mapCoordQK

name: AlbertLean.Comparison.GenericProductTransport.f0TraceK_mapCoordQK
statement:
theorem f0TraceK_mapCoordQK (x : Coord) :

name: AlbertLean.Comparison.GenericProductTransport.f0TraceFormK_mapCoordQK
statement:
theorem f0TraceFormK_mapCoordQK (x y : Coord) :
    f0TraceFormK (mapCoordQK K x) (mapCoordQK K y) =
      algebraMap ℚ K (traceForm x y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [f0TraceFormK, traceForm, f0SpurBilinearK, spurBilinear,
    ← mapCoordQK_one, f0TraceK_mapCoordQK, f0TraceK_mapCoordQK,
    f0PolarK_mapCoordQK]
  simp

name: AlbertLean.Comparison.GenericProductTransport.mappedAdjoint_characterization
proof:
:= by
  let b := Pi.basisFun K (Fin 27)
  let lhs : F0Coord K →ₗ[K] K :=
    f0TraceFormLinearK (mapCoordQK K (f0RecoveryData.adjoint x))
  let rhs : F0Coord K →ₗ[K] K :=
    (2 : K)⁻¹ • f0PolarLinearK (mapCoordQK K x) (mapCoordQK K x)
  have hmaps : lhs = rhs := by
    apply b.ext
    intro i
    change f0TraceFormK (mapCoordQK K (f0RecoveryData.adjoint x))
        (Pi.basisFun K (Fin 27) i) =
      (2 : K)⁻¹ * f0PolarK (mapCoordQK K x) (mapCoordQK K x)
        (Pi.basisFun K (Fin 27) i)
    rw [← mapCoordQK_basis (K := K) i, f0TraceFormK_mapCoordQK,
      f0PolarK_mapCoordQK]
    have hQ := f0RecoveryData.adjoint_characterization x
      (Pi.basisFun ℚ (Fin 27) i)
    have hK := congrArg (algebraMap ℚ K) hQ
    simpa [f0RecoveryData, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm] using hK
  have hz := congrArg (fun f : F0Coord K →ₗ[K] K => f z) hmaps
  simpa [lhs, rhs, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm] using hz

name: AlbertLean.Comparison.GenericProductTransport.f0AdjointK_mapCoordQK
statement:
theorem f0AdjointK_mapCoordQK (x : Coord) :
    (f0RecoveryDataK (K := K)).adjoint (mapCoordQK K x) =
      mapCoordQK K (f0RecoveryData.adjoint x)
proof:
:= by
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  apply (f0RecoveryDataK (K := K)).traceForm_nondegenerate
  intro z
  change f0TraceFormLinearK
    ((f0RecoveryDataK (K := K)).adjoint (mapCoordQK K x) -
      mapCoordQK K (f0RecoveryData.adjoint x)) z = 0
  simp only [map_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply, f0TraceFormLinearK_apply]
  have hAdj := (f0RecoveryDataK (K := K)).adjoint_characterization
    (mapCoordQK K x) z
  change f0TraceFormK
    ((f0RecoveryDataK (K := K)).adjoint (mapCoordQK K x)) z =
      f0PolarK (mapCoordQK K x) (mapCoordQK K x) z / 2 at hAdj
  rw [hAdj]
  change f0PolarK (mapCoordQK K x) (mapCoordQK K x) z / 2 -
    f0TraceFormK (mapCoordQK K (f0RecoveryData.adjoint x)) z = 0
  rw [mappedAdjoint_characterization]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Comparison.GenericProductTransport.f0CrossK_mapCoordQK
statement:
theorem f0CrossK_mapCoordQK (x y : Coord) :
    (f0RecoveryDataK (K := K)).cross (mapCoordQK K x) (mapCoordQK K y) =
      mapCoordQK K (f0RecoveryData.cross x y)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [RecoveryData.cross]
  rw [← mapCoordQK_add, f0AdjointK_mapCoordQK,
    f0AdjointK_mapCoordQK, f0AdjointK_mapCoordQK,
    mapCoordQK_sub, mapCoordQK_sub]

name: AlbertLean.Comparison.GenericProductTransport.f0SpurBilinearK_mapCoordQK
statement:
theorem f0SpurBilinearK_mapCoordQK (x y : Coord) :

name: AlbertLean.Comparison.GenericProductTransport.f0RecoveredProductK_mapCoordQK
statement:
theorem f0RecoveredProductK_mapCoordQK (x y : Coord) :
    (f0RecoveryDataK (K := K)).product
        (mapCoordQK K x) (mapCoordQK K y) =
      mapCoordQK K (f0RecoveryData.product x y)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [RecoveryData.product]
  rw [f0CrossK_mapCoordQK]
  rw [f0SpurBilinearK_mapCoordQK]
  simp [f0RecoveryDataK, f0RecoveryData, f0TraceK_mapCoordQK,
    mapCoordQK_one, mapCoordQK_add,
    mapCoordQK_sub, mapCoordQK_smul]

name: AlbertLean.Comparison.GenericProductTransport.f0ProductK_mapCoordQK
statement:
theorem f0ProductK_mapCoordQK (x y : Coord) :

name: AlbertLean.Comparison.GenericProductTransport.f0RecoveredProductK_basis
statement:
private theorem f0RecoveredProductK_basis (i j : Fin 27) :
    (f0RecoveryDataK (K := K)).product
        (Pi.basisFun K (Fin 27) i) (Pi.basisFun K (Fin 27) j) =
      f0ProductK (Pi.basisFun K (Fin 27) i)
        (Pi.basisFun K (Fin 27) j)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = mapCoordQK K
        (f0RecoveryData.product (Pi.basisFun ℚ (Fin 27) i)
          (Pi.basisFun ℚ (Fin 27) j)) := by
          rw [← mapCoordQK_basis (K := K) i,
            ← mapCoordQK_basis (K := K) j]
          exact f0RecoveredProductK_mapCoordQK (K := K)
            (Pi.basisFun ℚ (Fin 27) i) (Pi.basisFun ℚ (Fin 27) j)
    _ = mapCoordQK K
        (structuredProduct (Pi.basisFun ℚ (Fin 27) i)
          (Pi.basisFun ℚ (Fin 27) j)) := by
          exact congrArg (mapCoordQK K)
            (f0RecoveredProduct_eq_structuredProduct _ _)
    _ = f0ProductK (Pi.basisFun K (Fin 27) i)
        (Pi.basisFun K (Fin 27) j) := by
          symm
          rw [← mapCoordQK_basis (K := K) i,
            ← mapCoordQK_basis (K := K) j]
          exact f0ProductK_mapCoordQK (K := K)
            (Pi.basisFun ℚ (Fin 27) i) (Pi.basisFun ℚ (Fin 27) j)

name: AlbertLean.Comparison.GenericProductTransport.f0RecoveredProductK_eq_f0ProductK
statement:
theorem f0RecoveredProductK_eq_f0ProductK (x y : F0Coord K) :
    (f0RecoveryDataK (K := K)).product x y = f0ProductK x y
proof:
:= by
  have hmaps : f0RecoveredProductLinearK (K := K) =
      f0ProductLinearK (K := K) := by
    apply LinearMap.ext_basis (Pi.basisFun K (Fin 27))
      (Pi.basisFun K (Fin 27))
    intro i j
    simpa using f0RecoveredProductK_basis (K := K) i j
  simpa only [f0RecoveredProductLinearK_apply, f0ProductLinearK_apply] using
    congrArg
      (fun B : F0Coord K →ₗ[K] F0Coord K →ₗ[K] F0Coord K => B x y) hmaps

statement:
theorem GenericStructuredProductAgreesWithF0 {K : Type*}

theorem f0ToStructured_structuredToF0 (x : JCoord ℚ) :

theorem sourceNorm_agrees_with_f0 (x : JCoord ℚ) :
    sourceNorm x = cubicNorm (structuredEquiv x)
proof:

name: AlbertLean.Comparison.StructuredF0.sourcePolar_agrees_with_f0
statement:
theorem sourcePolar_agrees_with_f0 (x y z : JCoord ℚ) :
    sourcePolar x y z =
      cubicPolar (structuredEquiv x) (structuredEquiv y) (structuredEquiv z)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sourcePolar, cubicPolar, sourceNorm_agrees_with_f0,
    map_add, f0_cubicNorm_zero, sub_zero]

name: AlbertLean.Comparison.StructuredF0.sourceSpur_agrees_with_f0
statement:
theorem sourceSpur_agrees_with_f0 (x : JCoord ℚ) :
    sourceSpur x = spurN (structuredEquiv x)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    sourceSpur x = sourcePolar (sourceOne : JCoord ℚ) x x / 2 := by
      rw [sourcePolar_one, sourceSpurPolar_diagonal]
      ring
    _ = cubicPolar (structuredEquiv (sourceOne : JCoord ℚ))
          (structuredEquiv x) (structuredEquiv x) / 2 := by
      rw [sourcePolar_agrees_with_f0]
    _ = cubicPolar one (structuredEquiv x) (structuredEquiv x) / 2 := by
      rw [structuredEquiv_sourceOne]
    _ = spurN (structuredEquiv x) := rfl

name: AlbertLean.Comparison.StructuredF0.sourceSpurPolar_agrees_with_f0
statement:
theorem sourceSpurPolar_agrees_with_f0 (x y : JCoord ℚ) :
    sourceSpurPolar x y = spurBilinear (structuredEquiv x) (structuredEquiv y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sourcePolar_one, sourcePolar_agrees_with_f0, structuredEquiv_sourceOne]
  rfl

name: AlbertLean.Comparison.StructuredF0.sourceTraceForm_agrees_with_f0
statement:
theorem sourceTraceForm_agrees_with_f0 (x y : JCoord ℚ) :
    sourceTraceForm x y = traceForm (structuredEquiv x) (structuredEquiv y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sourceTraceForm, traceForm, sourceTrace_agrees_with_f0,
    sourceTrace_agrees_with_f0, sourceSpurPolar_agrees_with_f0]

name: AlbertLean.Comparison.StructuredF0.SourceCubicAgreesWithF0
statement:
theorem SourceCubicAgreesWithF0 :
    sourceNorm (0 : JCoord ℚ) = 0 ∧
    structuredEquiv (sourceOne : JCoord ℚ) = one ∧
    (∀ x : JCoord ℚ,
      sourceTrace x = traceN (structuredEquiv x) ∧
      sourceSpur x = spurN (structuredEquiv x) ∧
      sourceNorm x = cubicNorm (structuredEquiv x)) ∧
    (∀ x y z : JCoord ℚ,
      sourcePolar x y z =
        cubicPolar (structuredEquiv x) (structuredEquiv y) (structuredEquiv z)) ∧
    (∀ x y : JCoord ℚ,
      sourceTraceForm x y = traceForm (structuredEquiv x) (structuredEquiv y))
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨sourceNorm_zero, structuredEquiv_sourceOne,
    fun x ↦ ⟨sourceTrace_agrees_with_f0 x, sourceSpur_agrees_with_f0 x,
      sourceNorm_agrees_with_f0 x⟩,
    sourcePolar_agrees_with_f0, sourceTraceForm_agrees_with_f0⟩

name: AlbertLean.CubicNorm.traceToDual_injective
statement:
theorem traceToDual_injective {B : V →ₗ[K] V →ₗ[K] K}
    (hB : LeftNondegenerate B) : Function.Injective (traceToDual B)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  apply hB (x - y)
  intro z
  have hz := DFunLike.congr_fun hxy z
  simpa [traceToDual] using sub_eq_zero.mpr hz

name: AlbertLean.CubicNorm.traceToDual_bijective_of_nondegenerate
statement:
theorem traceToDual_bijective_of_nondegenerate [FiniteDimensional K V]
    {B : V →ₗ[K] V →ₗ[K] K} (hB : LeftNondegenerate B) :
    Function.Bijective (traceToDual B)
proof:
:= by
  have hinj := traceToDual_injective hB
  refine ⟨hinj, ?_⟩
  exact (LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective_of_finrank_eq_finrank
    Subspace.dual_finrank_eq.symm).mp hinj

name: AlbertLean.CubicNorm.traceDualEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem traceDualEquiv_apply [FiniteDimensional K V]
    (B : V →ₗ[K] V →ₗ[K] K) (hB : LeftNondegenerate B) (x y : V) :
    traceDualEquiv B hB x y = B x y
proof: := rfl

name: AlbertLean.CubicNorm.traceDualEquiv_symm_apply_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem traceDualEquiv_symm_apply_apply [FiniteDimensional K V]
    (B : V →ₗ[K] V →ₗ[K] K) (hB : LeftNondegenerate B)
    (f : Module.Dual K V) (y : V) :
    B ((traceDualEquiv B hB).symm f) y = f y
proof:
:= by
  have h := (traceDualEquiv B hB).apply_symm_apply f
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun h y

name: AlbertLean.CubicNorm.RecoveryData.gradient_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem gradient_apply (x y : V) : D.gradient x y = D.polar x x y / 2

name: AlbertLean.CubicNorm.RecoveryData.adjoint_characterization
statement:

proof:
:= by

name: AlbertLean.CubicNorm.RecoveryData.cross_characterization
statement:
theorem cross_characterization [FiniteDimensional K V] (x y z : V) :
    D.traceForm (D.cross x y) z =
      (D.polar x y z + D.polar y x z) / 2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cross, map_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply]
  rw [D.adjoint_characterization, D.adjoint_characterization,
    D.adjoint_characterization]
  simp [div_eq_mul_inv]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.CubicNorm.RecoveryData.cross_comm
statement: theorem cross_comm [FiniteDimensional K V] (x y : V) : D.cross x y = D.cross y x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cross, add_comm]

name: AlbertLean.CubicNorm.RecoveryData.cross_add_left
statement:
theorem cross_add_left [FiniteDimensional K V] (x₁ x₂ y : V) :
    D.cross (x₁ + x₂) y = D.cross x₁ y + D.cross x₂ y
proof:
:= by
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  apply D.traceForm_nondegenerate
  intro z
  simp only [map_sub, map_add, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.add_apply]
  rw [D.cross_characterization, D.cross_characterization,
    D.cross_characterization]
  simp
  ring

name: AlbertLean.CubicNorm.RecoveryData.cross_smul_left
statement:
theorem cross_smul_left [FiniteDimensional K V] (a : K) (x y : V) :
    D.cross (a • x) y = a • D.cross x y
proof:
:= by
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  apply D.traceForm_nondegenerate
  intro z
  simp only [map_sub, map_smul, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
    smul_eq_mul]
  rw [D.cross_characterization, D.cross_characterization]
  simp
  ring

name: AlbertLean.CubicNorm.RecoveryData.cross_add_right
statement:
theorem cross_add_right [FiniteDimensional K V] (x y₁ y₂ : V) :
    D.cross x (y₁ + y₂) = D.cross x y₁ + D.cross x y₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [D.cross_comm x, D.cross_comm x, D.cross_comm x]
  exact D.cross_add_left y₁ y₂ x

name: AlbertLean.CubicNorm.RecoveryData.cross_smul_right
statement:
theorem cross_smul_right [FiniteDimensional K V] (a : K) (x y : V) :
    D.cross x (a • y) = a • D.cross x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [D.cross_comm x, D.cross_comm x]
  exact D.cross_smul_left a y x

name: AlbertLean.CubicNorm.RecoveryData.spurBilinear_add_left
statement:
theorem spurBilinear_add_left (x₁ x₂ y : V) :
    D.spurBilinear (x₁ + x₂) y =
      D.spurBilinear x₁ y + D.spurBilinear x₂ y
proof:
:= by
  simp [spurBilinear]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.CubicNorm.RecoveryData.spurBilinear_smul_left
statement:
theorem spurBilinear_smul_left (a : K) (x y : V) :
    D.spurBilinear (a • x) y = a * D.spurBilinear x y
proof:
:= by
  simp [spurBilinear]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.CubicNorm.RecoveryData.spurBilinear_add_right
statement:
theorem spurBilinear_add_right (x y₁ y₂ : V) :
    D.spurBilinear x (y₁ + y₂) =
      D.spurBilinear x y₁ + D.spurBilinear x y₂
proof:
:= by
  simp [spurBilinear]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.CubicNorm.RecoveryData.spurBilinear_smul_right
statement:
theorem spurBilinear_smul_right (a : K) (x y : V) :
    D.spurBilinear x (a • y) = a * D.spurBilinear x y
proof:
:= by
  simp [spurBilinear]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.CubicNorm.RecoveryData.product_add_left
statement:
theorem product_add_left [FiniteDimensional K V] (x₁ x₂ y : V) :
    D.product (x₁ + x₂) y = D.product x₁ y + D.product x₂ y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [product, cross_add_left, map_add, spurBilinear_add_left,
    add_smul]
  module

name: AlbertLean.CubicNorm.RecoveryData.product_smul_left
statement:
theorem product_smul_left [FiniteDimensional K V] (a : K) (x y : V) :
    D.product (a • x) y = a • D.product x y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [product, cross_smul_left, map_smul, spurBilinear_smul_left,
    smul_add, smul_sub, smul_smul]
  module

name: AlbertLean.CubicNorm.RecoveryData.product_comm
statement:
theorem product_comm [FiniteDimensional K V]
    (hB : ∀ x y, D.traceForm x y = D.traceForm y x) (x y : V) :
    D.product x y = D.product y x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [product, cross_comm]
  have hS : D.spurBilinear x y = D.spurBilinear y x := by
    rw [spurBilinear, spurBilinear, hB]
    ring
  rw [hS]
  module

name: AlbertLean.CubicNorm.RecoveryData.product_add_right
statement:
theorem product_add_right [FiniteDimensional K V]
    (hB : ∀ x y, D.traceForm x y = D.traceForm y x) (x y₁ y₂ : V) :
    D.product x (y₁ + y₂) = D.product x y₁ + D.product x y₂
proof:
:= by
  calc
    D.product x (y₁ + y₂) = D.product (y₁ + y₂) x := D.product_comm hB _ _
    _ = D.product y₁ x + D.product y₂ x := D.product_add_left _ _ _
    _ = D.product x y₁ + D.product x y₂ := by
      rw [D.product_comm hB y₁ x, D.product_comm hB y₂ x]

name: AlbertLean.CubicNorm.RecoveryData.product_smul_right
statement:
theorem product_smul_right [FiniteDimensional K V]
    (hB : ∀ x y, D.traceForm x y = D.traceForm y x) (a : K) (x y : V) :
    D.product x (a • y) = a • D.product x y
proof:
:= by
  calc
    D.product x (a • y) = D.product (a • y) x := D.product_comm hB _ _
    _ = a • D.product y x := D.product_smul_left _ _ _
    _ = a • D.product x y := by rw [D.product_comm hB y x]

name: AlbertLean.CubicNorm.RecoveryData.map_adjoint
statement:
theorem map_adjoint
    {W : Type*} [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]
    [FiniteDimensional K V] [FiniteDimensional K W]
    (E : RecoveryData K W) (e : V ≃ₗ[K] W)
    (hB : ∀ x y, E.traceForm (e x) (e y) = D.traceForm x y)
    (hP : ∀ x y z, E.polar (e x) (e y) (e z) = D.polar x y z)
    (x : V) : e (D.adjoint x) = E.adjoint (e x)
proof:
:= by
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  apply E.traceForm_nondegenerate
  intro w
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := e.surjective w
  simp only [map_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply]
  rw [hB, D.adjoint_characterization, E.adjoint_characterization, hP]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.CubicNorm.RecoveryData.map_cross
statement:
theorem map_cross
    {W : Type*} [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]
    [FiniteDimensional K V] [FiniteDimensional K W]
    (E : RecoveryData K W) (e : V ≃ₗ[K] W)
    (hB : ∀ x y, E.traceForm (e x) (e y) = D.traceForm x y)
    (hP : ∀ x y z, E.polar (e x) (e y) (e z) = D.polar x y z)
    (x y : V) : e (D.cross x y) = E.cross (e x) (e y)
proof:
:= by
  simp [cross, D.map_adjoint E e hB hP]

name: AlbertLean.CubicNorm.RecoveryData.map_product
statement:
theorem map_product
    {W : Type*} [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]
    [FiniteDimensional K V] [FiniteDimensional K W]
    (E : RecoveryData K W) (e : V ≃ₗ[K] W)
    (hOne : e D.one = E.one)
    (hTrace : ∀ x, E.trace (e x) = D.trace x)
    (hB : ∀ x y, E.traceForm (e x) (e y) = D.traceForm x y)
    (hP : ∀ x y z, E.polar (e x) (e y) (e z) = D.polar x y z)
    (x y : V) : e (D.product x y) = E.product (e x) (e y)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [product, map_smul, map_add, map_sub, D.map_cross E e hB hP,
    hTrace, spurBilinear, hB, hOne]

name: AlbertLean.Residual.ResidualTwoOrbit.sectionOfResidualPair_M
statement:
@[simp] theorem sectionOfResidualPair_M (P : ResidualPair K)

name: AlbertLean.Residual.ResidualTwoOrbit.sectionOfResidualPair_Delta

name: AlbertLean.Residual.ResidualTwoOrbit.sectionOfResidualPair_DeltaStar
statement:
@[simp] theorem sectionOfResidualPair_DeltaStar (P : ResidualPair K)
    (hP : ResidualOpen P) :
    AlbertLean.Residual.NormalizedRootSwap.DeltaStar
      (sectionOfResidualPair P hP) = deltaStar P
proof:
:= by
  apply (div_eq_iff hP.1).2
  simp [sectionOfResidualPair, moment, delta, deltaStar, Matrix.det_mul]

name: AlbertLean.Residual.ResidualTwoOrbit.sectionOfResidualPair_Sb
statement:
@[simp] theorem sectionOfResidualPair_Sb (P : ResidualPair K)
    (hP : ResidualOpen P) :

      (sectionOfResidualPair P hP) = baseRootSum P
proof:

name: AlbertLean.Residual.ResidualTwoOrbit.residualPairOfSection_moment
statement:
@[simp] theorem residualPairOfSection_moment
    (s : AlbertLean.Residual.NormalizedRootSwap.NormalizedResidualSection K) :
    moment (residualPairOfSection s) = s.M
proof:
:= by
  exact AlbertLean.Residual.NormalizedRootSwap.A0_mul_X0 s

name: AlbertLean.Residual.ResidualTwoOrbit.residualPairOfSection_delta
statement:
@[simp] theorem residualPairOfSection_delta
    (s : AlbertLean.Residual.NormalizedRootSwap.NormalizedResidualSection K) :

proof:
:= by
  exact AlbertLean.Residual.NormalizedRootSwap.det_X0 s

name: AlbertLean.Residual.ResidualTwoOrbit.residualPairOfSection_deltaStar
statement:
@[simp] theorem residualPairOfSection_deltaStar
    (s : AlbertLean.Residual.NormalizedRootSwap.NormalizedResidualSection K) :
    deltaStar (residualPairOfSection s) =
      AlbertLean.Residual.NormalizedRootSwap.DeltaStar s
proof:
:= by
  exact AlbertLean.Residual.NormalizedRootSwap.det_A0 s

name: AlbertLean.Residual.ResidualTwoOrbit.residualPairOfSection_open
statement:
theorem residualPairOfSection_open
    (s : AlbertLean.Residual.NormalizedRootSwap.NormalizedResidualSection K) :
    ResidualOpen (residualPairOfSection s)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · simpa using s.Delta_ne_zero
  · rw [residualPairOfSection_deltaStar]
    exact div_ne_zero s.detM_ne_zero s.Delta_ne_zero

name: AlbertLean.Residual.ResidualTwoOrbit.section_residual_roundtrip
statement:
@[simp] theorem section_residual_roundtrip
    (s : AlbertLean.Residual.NormalizedRootSwap.NormalizedResidualSection K) :
    sectionOfResidualPair (residualPairOfSection s)
      (residualPairOfSection_open s) = s
proof:
:= by
  apply AlbertLean.Residual.NormalizedRootSwap.NormalizedResidualSection.ext
  · exact residualPairOfSection_moment s
  · exact residualPairOfSection_delta s

name: AlbertLean.Residual.ResidualTwoOrbit.sameResidualBase_to_sectionSameBase
statement:
theorem sameResidualBase_to_sectionSameBase
    (P Q : ResidualPair K) (hP : ResidualOpen P) (hQ : ResidualOpen Q)
    (hbase : sameResidualBase P Q) :
    AlbertLean.Residual.SectionFibre.SameBase (sectionOfResidualPair P hP)
      (sectionOfResidualPair Q hQ)
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨hbase.1, by simpa using hbase.2⟩

name: AlbertLean.Residual.ResidualTwoOrbit.rootSwappedRepresentative_delta
statement:

    (P : ResidualPair K) (hP : ResidualOpen P) :

name: AlbertLean.Residual.ResidualTwoOrbit.rootSwappedRepresentative_deltaStar
statement:
@[simp] theorem rootSwappedRepresentative_deltaStar
    (P : ResidualPair K) (hP : ResidualOpen P) :
    deltaStar (rootSwappedRepresentative P hP) = delta P
proof:
:= by
  simp [rootSwappedRepresentative]

name: AlbertLean.Residual.ResidualTwoOrbit.rootSwappedRepresentative_baseMoment
statement:
@[simp] theorem rootSwappedRepresentative_baseMoment
    (P : ResidualPair K) (hP : ResidualOpen P) :
    baseMoment (rootSwappedRepresentative P hP) = baseMoment P
proof:

name: AlbertLean.Residual.ResidualTwoOrbit.rootSwappedRepresentative_baseRootSum
statement:
@[simp] theorem rootSwappedRepresentative_baseRootSum

proof:
