name: AlbertLean.Residual.ResidualTwoOrbit.rootSwappedRepresentative_open
statement:
theorem rootSwappedRepresentative_open
    (P : ResidualPair K) (hP : ResidualOpen P) :
    ResidualOpen (rootSwappedRepresentative P hP)
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> simp [hP.1, hP.2]

name: AlbertLean.Residual.ResidualTwoOrbit.not_related_rootSwappedRepresentative
statement:
theorem not_related_rootSwappedRepresentative
    (P : ResidualPair K) (hP : ResidualOpen P)
    (hbranch : delta P ≠ deltaStar P) :
    ¬ Related P (rootSwappedRepresentative P hP)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply hbranch
  simpa using (related_preserves_invariants h).2.1

name: AlbertLean.Residual.ResidualTwoOrbit.rootSwappedRepresentative_not_related
statement:
theorem rootSwappedRepresentative_not_related
    (P : ResidualPair K) (hP : ResidualOpen P)
    (hbranch : delta P ≠ deltaStar P) :
    ¬ Related (rootSwappedRepresentative P hP) P
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply hbranch
  simpa using (related_preserves_invariants h).2.1.symm

name: AlbertLean.Residual.ResidualTwoOrbit.related_families_disjoint
statement:
theorem related_families_disjoint
    (P : ResidualPair K) (hP : ResidualOpen P)
    (hbranch : delta P ≠ deltaStar P) (Q : ResidualPair K) :
    ¬ (Related P Q ∧ Related (rootSwappedRepresentative P hP) Q)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨hPQ, hSQ⟩
  apply hbranch
  calc
    delta P = delta Q := (related_preserves_invariants hPQ).2.1
    _ = delta (rootSwappedRepresentative P hP) :=
      (related_preserves_invariants hSQ).2.1.symm
    _ = deltaStar P := rootSwappedRepresentative_delta P hP

name: AlbertLean.Residual.ResidualTwoOrbit.sameResidualBase_iff_related_or_swapped
statement:
theorem sameResidualBase_iff_related_or_swapped
    (P : ResidualPair K) (hP : ResidualOpen P)
    (Q : ResidualPair K) (hQ : ResidualOpen Q) :
    sameResidualBase P Q ↔
      Related P Q ∨ Related (rootSwappedRepresentative P hP) Q
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hbase
    have hsection := sameResidualBase_to_sectionSameBase P Q hP hQ hbase
    rcases (AlbertLean.Residual.SectionFibre.sameBase_iff_eq_or_eq_rootSwap
      (sectionOfResidualPair P hP) (sectionOfResidualPair Q hQ)).mp hsection with
      hsame | hswap
    · left
      apply (AlbertLean.Residual.NormalizedOrbitSection.related_iff_same_moment_delta
        P Q hP.1 hQ.1).2
      constructor
      · exact hbase.1.symm
      · have hDelta := congrArg
          AlbertLean.Residual.NormalizedRootSwap.NormalizedResidualSection.Delta
          hsame
        simpa using hDelta.symm
    · right
      apply (AlbertLean.Residual.NormalizedOrbitSection.related_iff_same_moment_delta
        (rootSwappedRepresentative P hP) Q
        (rootSwappedRepresentative_open P hP).1 hQ.1).2
      constructor
      · calc
          moment (rootSwappedRepresentative P hP) = moment P := by
            simpa [baseMoment] using rootSwappedRepresentative_baseMoment P hP
          _ = moment Q := hbase.1.symm
      · have hDelta := congrArg
          AlbertLean.Residual.NormalizedRootSwap.NormalizedResidualSection.Delta
          hswap
        simpa using hDelta.symm
  · rintro (hPQ | hSQ)
    · have h := related_preserves_invariants hPQ
      exact ⟨h.1.symm, by
        simp only [baseRootSum]
        rw [h.2.1, h.2.2]⟩
    · have h := related_preserves_invariants hSQ
      constructor
      · calc
          baseMoment Q = baseMoment (rootSwappedRepresentative P hP) := h.1.symm
          _ = baseMoment P := rootSwappedRepresentative_baseMoment P hP
      · calc
          baseRootSum Q = baseRootSum (rootSwappedRepresentative P hP) := by
            simp only [baseRootSum]
            rw [← h.2.1, ← h.2.2]
          _ = baseRootSum P := rootSwappedRepresentative_baseRootSum P hP

name: AlbertLean.Residual.ResidualTwoOrbit.ResidualSL4BaseFibreTwoOrbitTheorem
statement:
theorem ResidualSL4BaseFibreTwoOrbitTheorem
    (P : ResidualPair K) (hP : ResidualOpen P)
    (hbranch : delta P ≠ deltaStar P) :
    let Pswap
proof:
:= rootSwappedRepresentative P hP
    delta Pswap = deltaStar P ∧
      deltaStar Pswap = delta P ∧
      baseMoment Pswap = baseMoment P ∧
      baseRootSum Pswap = baseRootSum P ∧
      ¬ Related P Pswap ∧
      ¬ Related Pswap P ∧
      (∀ Q : ResidualPair K,
        ¬ (Related P Q ∧ Related Pswap Q)) ∧
      ∀ Q : ResidualPair K, ResidualOpen Q →
        (sameResidualBase P Q ↔
          Related P Q ∨ Related Pswap Q) := by
  dsimp
  exact ⟨rootSwappedRepresentative_delta P hP,
    rootSwappedRepresentative_deltaStar P hP,
    rootSwappedRepresentative_baseMoment P hP,
    rootSwappedRepresentative_baseRootSum P hP,
    not_related_rootSwappedRepresentative P hP hbranch,
    rootSwappedRepresentative_not_related P hP hbranch,
    related_families_disjoint P hP hbranch,
    sameResidualBase_iff_related_or_swapped P hP⟩

name: AlbertLean.Residual.SectionFibre.sectionPolynomial_factor
statement:
theorem sectionPolynomial_factor (s : NormalizedResidualSection K) (z : K) :
    sectionPolynomial s z = (z - s.Delta) * (z - DeltaStar s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sectionPolynomial, Sb, ← Delta_mul_DeltaStar s]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Residual.SectionFibre.sectionPolynomial_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem sectionPolynomial_eq_zero_iff
    (s : NormalizedResidualSection K) (z : K) :
    sectionPolynomial s z = 0 ↔ z = s.Delta ∨ z = DeltaStar s
proof:
:= by
  rw [sectionPolynomial_factor]
  simp only [mul_eq_zero, sub_eq_zero]

name: AlbertLean.Residual.SectionFibre.sameBase_iff_eq_or_eq_rootSwap
statement:
theorem sameBase_iff_eq_or_eq_rootSwap
    (s t : NormalizedResidualSection K) :
    SameBase s t ↔ t = s ∨ t = rootSwap s
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hbase
    have htRoot : sectionPolynomial s t.Delta = 0 := by
      have ht := Delta_root_relation t
      rw [hbase.1, hbase.2] at ht
      exact ht
    rcases (sectionPolynomial_eq_zero_iff s t.Delta).mp htRoot with h | h
    · left
      apply NormalizedResidualSection.ext
      · exact hbase.1
      · exact h
    · right
      apply NormalizedResidualSection.ext
      · simpa using hbase.1
      · simpa using h
  · rintro (rfl | rfl)
    · exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨rfl, rootSwap_Sb s⟩

name: AlbertLean.Residual.SectionFibre.sectionFibre_eq_pair
statement:
theorem sectionFibre_eq_pair (s : NormalizedResidualSection K) :
    sectionFibre s = {s, rootSwap s}
proof:
:= by
  ext t
  simp only [sectionFibre, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_insert_iff,
    Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  exact sameBase_iff_eq_or_eq_rootSwap s t

name: AlbertLean.Residual.SectionFibre.self_ne_rootSwap
statement:
theorem self_ne_rootSwap (s : NormalizedResidualSection K)
    (hbranch : s.Delta ≠ DeltaStar s) :
    s ≠ rootSwap s
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply hbranch
  have hDelta := congrArg NormalizedResidualSection.Delta h
  simpa using hDelta

name: AlbertLean.Residual.SectionFibre.ResidualSectionTwoPointFibreTheorem
statement:
theorem ResidualSectionTwoPointFibreTheorem
    (s : NormalizedResidualSection K)
    (hbranch : s.Delta ≠ DeltaStar s) :
    (∀ z : K,
      sectionPolynomial s z = (z - s.Delta) * (z - DeltaStar s)) ∧
      (∀ z : K,
        sectionPolynomial s z = 0 ↔ z = s.Delta ∨ z = DeltaStar s) ∧
      sectionFibre s = {s, rootSwap s} ∧
      s ≠ rootSwap s
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨sectionPolynomial_factor s, sectionPolynomial_eq_zero_iff s,
    sectionFibre_eq_pair s, self_ne_rootSwap s hbranch⟩

name: AlbertLean.Residual.NormalizedOrbitSection.det_X0
statement: @[simp] theorem det_X0 (Delta : K) : Matrix.det (X0 Delta) = Delta
proof:
:= by
  simp [X0, Matrix.det_diagonal, Fin.prod_univ_succ]

name: AlbertLean.Residual.NormalizedOrbitSection.det_X0Inv
statement:
@[simp] theorem det_X0Inv (Delta : K) :
    Matrix.det (X0Inv Delta) = Delta⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  simp [X0Inv, Matrix.det_diagonal, Fin.prod_univ_succ]

name: AlbertLean.Residual.NormalizedOrbitSection.X0_mul_X0Inv
statement:
theorem X0_mul_X0Inv (Delta : K) (hDelta : Delta ≠ 0) :
    X0 Delta * X0Inv Delta = 1
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [X0, X0Inv, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ, hDelta]

name: AlbertLean.Residual.NormalizedOrbitSection.X0Inv_mul_X0
statement:
theorem X0Inv_mul_X0 (Delta : K) (hDelta : Delta ≠ 0) :
    X0Inv Delta * X0 Delta = 1
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [X0, X0Inv, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ, hDelta]

name: AlbertLean.Residual.NormalizedOrbitSection.act_normalizingDetOneMatrix
statement:
theorem act_normalizingDetOneMatrix (P : ResidualPair K)
    (hX : delta P ≠ 0) :
    act (normalizingDetOneMatrix P hX) P = normalizedPair P
proof:
:= by
  apply ResidualPair.ext
  · simp only [act_A, normalizingDetOneMatrix, normalizingMatrixInv,
      normalizedPair, moment]
    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc]
  · simp only [act_X, normalizingDetOneMatrix, normalizingMatrix,
      normalizedPair]
    rw [Matrix.mul_assoc,
      Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul P.X (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hX),
      Matrix.mul_one]

name: AlbertLean.Residual.NormalizedOrbitSection.normalizingMatrix_unique
statement:
theorem normalizingMatrix_unique (P : ResidualPair K) (hX : delta P ≠ 0)
    (g : Mat4 K) (hg : g * P.X = X0 (delta P)) :
    g = normalizingMatrix P
proof:
:= by
  calc
    g = g * (P.X * P.X⁻¹) := by
      rw [Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv P.X (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hX),
        Matrix.mul_one]
    _ = (g * P.X) * P.X⁻¹ := by rw [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = normalizingMatrix P := by rw [hg]; rfl

name: AlbertLean.Residual.NormalizedOrbitSection.act_transitionDetOneMatrix
statement:
theorem act_transitionDetOneMatrix (P Q : ResidualPair K)
    (hP : delta P ≠ 0) (hQ : delta Q ≠ 0)
    (hM : moment P = moment Q) (hDelta : delta P = delta Q) :
    act (transitionDetOneMatrix P Q hP hQ hM hDelta) P = Q
proof:
:= by
  apply ResidualPair.ext
  · simp only [act_A, transitionDetOneMatrix, transitionMatrixInv]
    calc
      P.A * (P.X * Q.X⁻¹) = moment P * Q.X⁻¹ := by
        rw [moment, ← Matrix.mul_assoc]
      _ = moment Q * Q.X⁻¹ := by rw [hM]
      _ = Q.A := by
        rw [moment, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv_cancel_right Q.X Q.A
          (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hQ)]
  · simp only [act_X, transitionDetOneMatrix, transitionMatrix]
    rw [Matrix.mul_assoc,
      Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul P.X (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hP),
      Matrix.mul_one]

name: AlbertLean.Residual.NormalizedOrbitSection.related_iff_same_moment_delta
statement:
theorem related_iff_same_moment_delta (P Q : ResidualPair K)
    (hP : delta P ≠ 0) (hQ : delta Q ≠ 0) :
    Related P Q ↔ moment P = moment Q ∧ delta P = delta Q
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨(related_preserves_invariants h).1,
      (related_preserves_invariants h).2.1⟩
  · rintro ⟨hM, hDelta⟩
    exact ⟨transitionDetOneMatrix P Q hP hQ hM hDelta,
      act_transitionDetOneMatrix P Q hP hQ hM hDelta⟩

name: AlbertLean.Residual.NormalizedOrbitSection.ResidualSL4NormalizedSectionTheorem
statement:
theorem ResidualSL4NormalizedSectionTheorem
    (P : ResidualPair K) (hP : delta P ≠ 0) :
    let G
proof:
:= normalizingDetOneMatrix P hP
    Matrix.det G.g = 1 ∧
      act G P = normalizedPair P ∧
      (∀ g : Mat4 K, g * P.X = X0 (delta P) → g = G.g) ∧
      (∀ Q : ResidualPair K, delta Q ≠ 0 →
        (Related P Q ↔ moment P = moment Q ∧ delta P = delta Q)) := by
  dsimp
  exact ⟨(normalizingDetOneMatrix P hP).det_g,
    act_normalizingDetOneMatrix P hP,
    fun g hg => normalizingMatrix_unique P hP g hg,
    fun Q hQ => related_iff_same_moment_delta P Q hP hQ⟩

statement:
theorem rootSwap_exchanges_normalized_determinants
    (s : NormalizedResidualSection K) :
    Matrix.det (X0 (rootSwap s)) = DeltaStar s ∧
      Matrix.det (A0 (rootSwap s)) = s.Delta
proof:

name: AlbertLean.Residual.NormalizedRootSwap.NormalizedResidualSectionRootSwapTheorem
statement:
theorem NormalizedResidualSectionRootSwapTheorem
    (s : NormalizedResidualSection K) :
    rootSwap (rootSwap s) = s ∧
      (rootSwap s).M = s.M ∧
      DeltaStar (rootSwap s) = s.Delta ∧
      Sb (rootSwap s) = Sb s ∧
      Matrix.det (X0 s) = s.Delta ∧
      Matrix.det (A0 s) = DeltaStar s ∧
      A0 s * X0 s = s.M ∧
      s.Delta * DeltaStar s = Matrix.det s.M ∧
      Matrix.det (X0 (rootSwap s)) = DeltaStar s ∧
      Matrix.det (A0 (rootSwap s)) = s.Delta ∧
      s.Delta ^ 2 - Sb s * s.Delta + Matrix.det s.M = 0 ∧
      DeltaStar s ^ 2 - Sb s * DeltaStar s + Matrix.det s.M = 0
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨rootSwap_involutive s, rootSwap_M s, rootSwap_DeltaStar s,
    rootSwap_Sb s, det_X0 s, det_A0 s, A0_mul_X0 s,
    Delta_mul_DeltaStar s, (rootSwap_exchanges_normalized_determinants s).1,
    (rootSwap_exchanges_normalized_determinants s).2,
    Delta_root_relation s, DeltaStar_root_relation s⟩

      encoderA, encoderB, vectorA, vectorB, matrixM, momentMatrix,

name: AlbertLean.Residual.FrameIdeal.equationsVanish_iff_source_fixedSpectrum
statement:
theorem equationsVanish_iff_source_fixedSpectrum
    (x : ExplicitFrameChart K) :
    EquationsVanish (explicitFrameEquationValues x) ↔
      (sourceTrace (encoderA x) = 0 ∧
       sourceSpur (encoderA x) = -1 ∧
       sourceNorm (encoderA x) = 0 ∧
       sourceTrace (encoderB x) = 0 ∧
       sourceSpur (encoderB x) = -1 ∧
       sourceNorm (encoderB x) = 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [explicitFrameEquationValues_eq_source]
  simp only [EquationsVanish, sourceFrameEquationValues]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hTa, hSa, hNa, hTb, hSb, hNb⟩
    refine ⟨hTa, ?_, hNa, hTb, ?_, hNb⟩
    · linear_combination hSa
    · linear_combination hSb
  · rintro ⟨hTa, hSa, hNa, hTb, hSb, hNb⟩
    refine ⟨hTa, ?_, hNa, hTb, ?_, hNb⟩
    · linear_combination hSa
    · linear_combination hSb

name: AlbertLean.Residual.ResidualMatrices.momentMatrix_eq_AMatrix_mul_XMatrix

name: AlbertLean.Residual.SL4PairAction.DetOneMatrix.det_gInv
statement:
theorem DetOneMatrix.det_gInv (G : DetOneMatrix K) :
    Matrix.det G.gInv = 1
proof:
:= by
  calc
    Matrix.det G.gInv = Matrix.det G.gInv * Matrix.det G.g := by
      rw [G.det_g, mul_one]
    _ = Matrix.det (G.gInv * G.g) := by rw [Matrix.det_mul]
    _ = 1 := by rw [G.gInv_mul_g, Matrix.det_one]

proof:

        P.A * (G.gInv * G.g) * P.X := by
      simp only [Matrix.mul_assoc]
    _ = P.A * P.X := by rw [G.gInv_mul_g, Matrix.mul_one]

name: AlbertLean.Residual.TrialitySquares.sourceSquare_eq_adjoint_trace_spur
statement:
theorem sourceSquare_eq_adjoint_trace_spur (x : JCoord K) :
    sourceSquare x =
      sourceAdjoint x + sourceTrace x • x - sourceSpur x • sourceOne
proof:
:= by
  rw [sourceSquare, sourceAdjoint_eq_product_square]
  module

name: AlbertLean.Residual.TrialitySquares.sourceSquare_formula
statement:
theorem sourceSquare_formula (x : JCoord K) :
    sourceSquare x =
      { d1 := x.d1 ^ 2 + nS x.s + nC x.c
        d2 := x.d2 ^ 2 + nC x.c + nV x.v
        d3 := x.d3 ^ 2 + nV x.v + nS x.s
        v := (x.d2 + x.d3) • x.v + normalizedMuV x.s x.c
        s := (x.d1 + x.d3) • x.s + sourceMuS x.c x.v
        c := (x.d1 + x.d2) • x.c + sourceMuC x.v x.s }
proof:
:= by
  rw [sourceSquare_eq_adjoint_trace_spur, sourceAdjoint_eq_explicit]
  apply JCoord.ext
  · change
      (x.d2 * x.d3 - nV x.v) + sourceTrace x * x.d1 - sourceSpur x * 1 =
        x.d1 ^ 2 + nS x.s + nC x.c
    simp [sourceTrace, sourceSpur]
    ring
  · change
      (x.d1 * x.d3 - nS x.s) + sourceTrace x * x.d2 - sourceSpur x * 1 =
        x.d2 ^ 2 + nC x.c + nV x.v
    simp [sourceTrace, sourceSpur]
    ring
  · change
      (x.d1 * x.d2 - nC x.c) + sourceTrace x * x.d3 - sourceSpur x * 1 =
        x.d3 ^ 2 + nV x.v + nS x.s
    simp [sourceTrace, sourceSpur]
    ring
  · change
      (normalizedMuV x.s x.c - x.d1 • x.v) + sourceTrace x • x.v -
          sourceSpur x • (0 : VCoord K) =
        (x.d2 + x.d3) • x.v + normalizedMuV x.s x.c
    simp [sourceTrace]
    module
  · change
      (sourceMuS x.c x.v - x.d2 • x.s) + sourceTrace x • x.s -
          sourceSpur x • (0 : SCoord K) =
        (x.d1 + x.d3) • x.s + sourceMuS x.c x.v
    simp [sourceTrace]
    module
  · change
      (sourceMuC x.v x.s - x.d3 • x.c) + sourceTrace x • x.c -
          sourceSpur x • (0 : CCoord K) =
        (x.d1 + x.d2) • x.c + sourceMuC x.v x.s
    simp [sourceTrace]
    module

statement:

name: AlbertLean.Residual.TrialitySquares.uV_parameterized_expansion
statement:
theorem uV_parameterized_expansion (alpha beta : K)
    (s1 s2 : SCoord K) (c1 c2 : CCoord K) :
    uV alpha beta s1 s2 c1 c2 =
      (momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2) 2 0 *
          (momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2) 1 3
        + (momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2) 3 1 *
          (momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2) 0 2
        + alpha * beta *
          ((momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2) 1 0 *
              (momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2) 3 2
            - (momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2) 1 2 *
              (momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2) 3 0
            + (momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2) 0 1 *
              (momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2) 2 3
            - (momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2) 0 3 *
              (momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2) 2 1)
        - alpha ^ 2 * deltaX s1 s2 c1 c2
        - beta ^ 2 * deltaStarA s1 s2 c1 c2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [uV, BV, muV, BW_add_left, BW_add_right, BW_smul_left,
    BW_smul_right]
  rw [BW_wedge_hodge_dual, BW_hodgeStar, wedge_dual_pairing]
  simp [momentMatrix, deltaX, deltaStarA]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Residual.TrialitySquares.uV_of_mul_eq_one
statement:
theorem uV_of_mul_eq_one {alpha beta : K} (h : alpha * beta = 1)
    (s1 s2 : SCoord K) (c1 c2 : CCoord K) :
    uV alpha beta s1 s2 c1 c2 =
      exteriorQ (momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2)
        - alpha ^ 2 * deltaX s1 s2 c1 c2
        - beta ^ 2 * deltaStarA s1 s2 c1 c2
proof:
:= by
  rw [uV_parameterized_expansion, h]
  simp [exteriorQ]
  ring

name: AlbertLean.Residual.TrialitySquares.normalizedUV_exterior_identity
statement:
theorem normalizedUV_exterior_identity
    (s1 s2 : SCoord K) (c1 c2 : CCoord K) :
    normalizedUV s1 s2 c1 c2 =
      exteriorQ (momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2)
        - deltaX s1 s2 c1 c2 - deltaStarA s1 s2 c1 c2
proof:
:= by
  simpa [normalizedUV, normalizedMuV, uV] using
    (uV_of_mul_eq_one (alpha := (1 : K)) (beta := (1 : K)) (by simp)
      s1 s2 c1 c2)

name: AlbertLean.Residual.TrialitySquares.TrialitySquaresAndExteriorTheorem
statement:
theorem TrialitySquaresAndExteriorTheorem :
    (∀ x : JCoord K,
      sourceSquare x =
        { d1 := x.d1 ^ 2 + nS x.s + nC x.c
          d2 := x.d2 ^ 2 + nC x.c + nV x.v
          d3 := x.d3 ^ 2 + nV x.v + nS x.s
          v := (x.d2 + x.d3) • x.v + normalizedMuV x.s x.c
          s := (x.d1 + x.d3) • x.s + sourceMuS x.c x.v
          c := (x.d1 + x.d2) • x.c + sourceMuC x.v x.s }) ∧
    (∀ M : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) K, exteriorQ Mᵀ = exteriorQ M) ∧
    (∀ (alpha beta : K), alpha * beta = 1 →
      ∀ (s1 s2 : SCoord K) (c1 c2 : CCoord K),
        uV alpha beta s1 s2 c1 c2 =
          exteriorQ (momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2)
            - alpha ^ 2 * deltaX s1 s2 c1 c2
            - beta ^ 2 * deltaStarA s1 s2 c1 c2) ∧
    (∀ (s1 s2 : SCoord K) (c1 c2 : CCoord K),
      normalizedUV s1 s2 c1 c2 =
        exteriorQ (momentMatrix s1 s2 c1 c2)
          - deltaX s1 s2 c1 c2 - deltaStarA s1 s2 c1 c2)
proof:

name: OneBit.rationalWitness
statement:
theorem rationalWitness :
    lawful false ∧ lawful true ∧
    (∀ r s, r ≠ s → ∀ i j, Finite.pair false r s i j = Finite.pair true r s i j) ∧
    (∀ i j l, Finite.triple false i j l = Finite.triple true i j l) ∧
    Finite.detector false = (-2591357 : ℚ)/62208 ∧
    Finite.detector true = (-1782559 : ℚ)/62208
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨lawful_proof false, lawful_proof true, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro r s hrs i j
    simpa only [pair_eq, source, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte] using Closeout.pair_same r s i j hrs
  · intro i j l
    simpa only [triple_eq, source, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte] using Closeout.tensor_same ![i,j,l]
  · simpa [detector_eq, source, AlbertLean.q] using AlbertLean.solution.witnessDetectorValues.1
  · simpa [detector_eq, source, AlbertLean.q] using AlbertLean.solution.witnessDetectorValues.2.1

name: OneBit.rationalWitness_not_equivalent_under_relabelling
statement:
theorem rationalWitness_not_equivalent_under_relabelling :
    ¬ ∃ (g : Aut ℚ) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) (π : Fin 3 → Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)),
      ∀ r i, g.linear (Finite.frames false r i) = Finite.frames true (σ r) (π r i)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨g,σ,π,hg⟩
  apply Closeout.not_equivalent
  refine ⟨Finite.toJordanAut g, σ, π, ?_⟩
  intro r i
  change g.linear (Closeout.family AlbertLean.witnessTheta1 r i) =
    Closeout.family AlbertLean.witnessThetaM (σ r) (π r i)
  simpa only [Finite.frames_eq, Finite.source, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte] using hg r i

name: OneBit.Closeout.pair_eq_marginal
statement:
theorem pair_eq_marginal (r s i j : Fin 3) (hrs : r ≠ s) :
    pair witnessTheta1 r s i j = marginal r s i j
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases r <;> fin_cases s <;> try contradiction
  all_goals
    simp only [pair, family, AlbertLean.encoder, witnessTheta1]
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
      simp only [projector, theta1E_square, theta1F_square, theta1K_square]
  all_goals
      norm_num [
        traceForm_eq_fast, traceLinearForm, spurPairForm,
        Theta1ESquare, Theta1FSquare, Theta1KSquare,
        theta1E, theta1F, theta1K, one, v, q, marginal, Fin.isValue]

name: OneBit.Closeout.tensor_same
statement: theorem tensor_same (a : Fin 3 → Fin 3) : tensor witnessTheta1 a = tensor witnessThetaM a
proof:
:= by
  have hc := congrFun (congrFun (congrFun (congrArg Ledger.C0 witnessSameLedger)
    (a 0)) (a 1)) (a 2)
  have hp := congrFun (congrFun witnessSameP (a 0)) (a 1)
  have hq := congrFun (congrFun witnessSameQ (a 1)) (a 2)
  have hr := congrFun (congrFun witnessSameR (a 2)) (a 0)
  change tensor witnessTheta1 a -
    ((ledger witnessTheta1).P (a 0) (a 1) + (ledger witnessTheta1).Q (a 1) (a 2) +
      (ledger witnessTheta1).R (a 2) (a 0)) / 3 + 2/9 =
    tensor witnessThetaM a -
    ((ledger witnessThetaM).P (a 0) (a 1) + (ledger witnessThetaM).Q (a 1) (a 2) +
      (ledger witnessThetaM).R (a 2) (a 0)) / 3 + 2/9 at hc
  rw [hp,hq,hr] at hc
  linarith

name: OneBit.Closeout.tripleForm_invariant
statement:
theorem tripleForm_invariant (g : JordanAut) (x y z : Coord) :
    tripleForm (g x) (g y) (g z) = tripleForm x y z
proof:
:= by
  unfold tripleForm
  rw [← g.map_circle, traceForm_invariant]

name: OneBit.Closeout.pair_same
statement:
theorem pair_same (r s i j : Fin 3) (hrs : r ≠ s) :
    pair witnessTheta1 r s i j = pair witnessThetaM r s i j
proof:
:= by
  have hp := congrFun (congrFun witnessSameP i) j
  have hq := congrFun (congrFun witnessSameQ i) j
  have hr := congrFun (congrFun witnessSameR i) j
  have hpt := congrFun (congrFun witnessSameP j) i
  have hqt := congrFun (congrFun witnessSameQ j) i
  have hrt := congrFun (congrFun witnessSameR j) i
  fin_cases r <;> fin_cases s <;> try contradiction
  · exact hp
  · exact (traceForm_symmetric _ _).trans (hrt.trans (traceForm_symmetric _ _))
  · exact (traceForm_symmetric _ _).trans (hpt.trans (traceForm_symmetric _ _))
  · exact hq
  · exact hr
  · exact (traceForm_symmetric _ _).trans (hqt.trans (traceForm_symmetric _ _))

name: OneBit.Closeout.not_equivalent
statement:
theorem not_equivalent :
    ¬ ∃ (g : JordanAut) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) (π : Fin 3 → Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)),
      ∀ r i, g (family witnessTheta1 r i) = family witnessThetaM (σ r) (π r i)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨g,σ,π,hg⟩
  have ht (a : Fin 3 → Fin 3) : tensor witnessTheta1 a = tensor witnessTheta1 (relabel σ π a) := by
    rw [tensor_same (relabel σ π a), tensor_relabel]
    rw [← hg 0 (a 0), ← hg 1 (a 1), ← hg 2 (a 2)]
    exact (tripleForm_invariant g _ _ _).symm
  obtain ⟨hs,hπ⟩ := tensor_stabilizer_trivial σ π ht
  have he (r : Fin 3) : g (AlbertLean.encoder witnessTheta1 r) = AlbertLean.encoder witnessThetaM r := by
    calc
      _ = g (family witnessTheta1 r 2 - family witnessTheta1 r 0) := by
        simp only [family]
        rw [(witnessTheta1Lawful r).2.2.2.2]
      _ = family witnessThetaM r 2 - family witnessThetaM r 0 := by
        change g.toLinearEquiv (_ - _) = _
        rw [map_sub]
        change g (family witnessTheta1 r 2) - g (family witnessTheta1 r 0) = _
        rw [hg, hg, hs, hπ r]
        rfl
      _ = _ := (witnessThetaMLawful r).2.2.2.2
  exact noUnitalProductAutomorphismTransports ⟨g, he 0, he 1, he 2⟩

name: OneBit.Closeout.edges_determine_frame
statement:
theorem edges_determine_frame (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3))
    (h : ∀ r s, r ≠ s → ∀ v : ℚ, edgeHas r s v ↔ edgeHas (σ r) (σ s) v) :
    σ = Equiv.refl _
proof:
:= by
  have h01z := h 0 1 (by decide) 0
  have h01v := h 0 1 (by decide) (1/36)
  have h12z := h 1 2 (by decide) 0
  have hi01 := σ.injective.ne (show (0 : Fin 3) ≠ 1 by decide)
  have hi02 := σ.injective.ne (show (0 : Fin 3) ≠ 2 by decide)
  have hi12 := σ.injective.ne (show (1 : Fin 3) ≠ 2 by decide)
  have hs : σ 0 = 0 ∧ σ 1 = 1 ∧ σ 2 = 2 := by
    clear h
    generalize h0 : σ 0 = a at *
    generalize h1 : σ 1 = b at *
    generalize h2 : σ 2 = c at *
    fin_cases a <;> fin_cases b <;> fin_cases c <;>
      norm_num [edgeHas, marginal, Fin.exists_fin_succ] at *
    all_goals rfl
  ext r
  fin_cases r <;> simp [hs.1, hs.2.1, hs.2.2]

name: OneBit.Closeout.marginal_zero_01
statement:
theorem marginal_zero_01 (i j : Fin 3) :
    marginal 0 1 i j = 0 ↔ i = 0 ∧ j = 0
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> norm_num [marginal]

name: OneBit.Closeout.marginal_column_injective
statement:
theorem marginal_column_injective (r : Fin 3) (i j : Fin 3) :
    (if r = 0 then marginal 0 1 i 0 else marginal r 0 i 0) =
    (if r = 0 then marginal 0 1 j 0 else marginal r 0 j 0) → i = j
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases r <;> fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> norm_num [marginal]

name: OneBit.Closeout.marginal_stabilizer_trivial
statement:
theorem marginal_stabilizer_trivial (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3))
    (π : Fin 3 → Equiv.Perm (Fin 3))
    (h : ∀ r s, r ≠ s → ∀ i j,
      marginal r s i j = marginal (σ r) (σ s) (π r i) (π s j)) :
    σ = Equiv.refl _ ∧ ∀ r, π r = Equiv.refl _
proof:
:= by
  have hs := edges_determine_frame σ (by
    intro r s hrs v
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨i,j,hij⟩
      exact ⟨π r i, π s j, (h r s hrs i j).symm.trans hij⟩
    · rintro ⟨i,j,hij⟩
      refine ⟨(π r).symm i, (π s).symm j, ?_⟩
      have he := h r s hrs ((π r).symm i) ((π s).symm j)
      simp only [Equiv.apply_symm_apply] at he
      exact he.trans hij)
  subst σ
  simp only [Equiv.refl_apply] at h
  have hz : marginal 0 1 (π 0 0) (π 1 0) = 0 := by
    rw [← h 0 1 (by decide) 0 0]
    norm_num [marginal]
  obtain ⟨h0,h1⟩ := (marginal_zero_01 _ _).mp hz
  refine ⟨rfl, ?_⟩
  intro r
  apply Equiv.ext
  intro i
  apply marginal_column_injective r
  fin_cases r
  · simpa [h1] using (h 0 1 (by decide) i 0).symm
  · simpa [h0] using (h 1 0 (by decide) i 0).symm
  · simpa [h0] using (h 2 0 (by decide) i 0).symm

name: OneBit.Closeout.tripleForm_swap23
statement: theorem tripleForm_swap23 (x y z : Coord) : tripleForm x y z = tripleForm x z y
proof:
:= by
  unfold tripleForm
  rw [productCommutative y z]

name: OneBit.Closeout.tripleForm_cycle
statement: theorem tripleForm_cycle (x y z : Coord) : tripleForm x y z = tripleForm z x y
proof:
:= by
  unfold tripleForm
  rw [← traceFormAssociative, traceForm_symmetric]

name: OneBit.Closeout.tripleForm_perm
statement:
theorem tripleForm_perm (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) (x : Fin 3 → Coord) :
    tripleForm (x (σ 0)) (x (σ 1)) (x (σ 2)) = tripleForm (x 0) (x 1) (x 2)
proof:
:= by
  have h01 := σ.injective.ne (show (0 : Fin 3) ≠ 1 by decide)
  have h02 := σ.injective.ne (show (0 : Fin 3) ≠ 2 by decide)
  have h12 := σ.injective.ne (show (1 : Fin 3) ≠ 2 by decide)
  generalize σ 0 = a at *
  generalize σ 1 = b at *
  generalize σ 2 = c at *
  fin_cases a <;> fin_cases b <;> fin_cases c <;> try contradiction
  · rfl
  · exact tripleForm_swap23 _ _ _
  · exact (tripleForm_swap23 _ _ _).trans (tripleForm_cycle _ _ _)
  · exact tripleForm_cycle _ _ _
  · exact (tripleForm_cycle _ _ _).symm
  · exact (tripleForm_cycle _ _ _).trans (tripleForm_swap23 _ _ _)

name: OneBit.Closeout.tensor_relabel
statement:
theorem tensor_relabel (X : WitnessTriple) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3))
    (π : Fin 3 → Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) (a : Fin 3 → Fin 3) :
    tensor X (relabel σ π a) =
      tripleForm (family X (σ 0) (π 0 (a 0)))
        (family X (σ 1) (π 1 (a 1))) (family X (σ 2) (π 2 (a 2)))
proof:
:= by
  simpa [tensor, relabel] using tripleForm_perm σ.symm
    (fun r => family X (σ r) (π r (a r)))

name: OneBit.Closeout.family_sum
statement:
theorem family_sum (X : WitnessTriple) (hX : LawfulFrameTriple X) (r : Fin 3) :
    (∑ i, family X r i) = one
proof:
:= by
  simpa [Fin.sum_univ_succ, family, add_assoc] using (hX r).2.2.2.1

name: OneBit.Closeout.family_sum_perm
statement:
theorem family_sum_perm (X : WitnessTriple) (hX : LawfulFrameTriple X)
    (r : Fin 3) (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) : (∑ i, family X r (π i)) = one
proof:
:= by
  rw [Equiv.sum_comp π, family_sum X hX]

name: OneBit.Closeout.tripleForm_sum3
statement:
theorem tripleForm_sum3 (x y : Coord) (z : Fin 3 → Coord) :
    (∑ i, tripleForm x y (z i)) = tripleForm x y (∑ i, z i)
proof:
:= by
  change (∑ i, tracePairing x ((leftMulLinear productQBilinear y) (z i))) =
    tracePairing x ((leftMulLinear productQBilinear y) (∑ i, z i))
  rw [map_sum, map_sum]

name: OneBit.Closeout.tripleForm_one3
statement: theorem tripleForm_one3 (x y : Coord) : tripleForm x y one = traceForm x y
proof:
:= by
  unfold tripleForm
  rw [(unitLaw y).2]

name: OneBit.Closeout.tripleForm_sum1
statement:
theorem tripleForm_sum1 (x : Fin 3 → Coord) (y z : Coord) :
    (∑ i, tripleForm (x i) y z) = tripleForm (∑ i, x i) y z
proof:
:= by
  change (∑ i, (tracePairing (x i)) (structuredProduct y z)) =
    (tracePairing (∑ i, x i)) (structuredProduct y z)
  simp only [map_sum, LinearMap.sum_apply]

name: OneBit.Closeout.tripleForm_sum2
statement:
theorem tripleForm_sum2 (x z : Coord) (y : Fin 3 → Coord) :
    (∑ i, tripleForm x (y i) z) = tripleForm x (∑ i, y i) z
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = ∑ i, tripleForm x z (y i) := Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => tripleForm_swap23 _ _ _)
    _ = tripleForm x z (∑ i, y i) := tripleForm_sum3 _ _ _
    _ = _ := tripleForm_swap23 _ _ _

name: OneBit.Closeout.tripleForm_one1
statement: theorem tripleForm_one1 (y z : Coord) : tripleForm one y z = traceForm y z
proof:
:= by
  rw [tripleForm_cycle, tripleForm_swap23, tripleForm_one3, traceForm_symmetric]

name: OneBit.Closeout.tripleForm_one2
statement: theorem tripleForm_one2 (x z : Coord) : tripleForm x one z = traceForm z x
proof:
:= by
  rw [tripleForm_swap23, tripleForm_one3, traceForm_symmetric]

name: OneBit.Closeout.tensor_stabilizer_trivial
statement:
theorem tensor_stabilizer_trivial (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3))
    (π : Fin 3 → Equiv.Perm (Fin 3))
    (h : ∀ a, tensor witnessTheta1 a = tensor witnessTheta1 (relabel σ π a)) :
    σ = Equiv.refl _ ∧ ∀ r, π r = Equiv.refl _
proof:
:= by
  have h01 (i j : Fin 3) :
      pair witnessTheta1 0 1 i j = pair witnessTheta1 (σ 0) (σ 1) (π 0 i) (π 1 j) := by
    have hs := congrArg (fun f : Fin 3 → ℚ => ∑ l, f l) (funext (fun l => h ![i,j,l]))
    simp only [tensor_relabel] at hs
    simp only [tensor, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
      Matrix.cons_val] at hs
    rw [tripleForm_sum3, tripleForm_sum3, family_sum _ witnessTheta1Lawful,
      family_sum_perm _ witnessTheta1Lawful, tripleForm_one3, tripleForm_one3] at hs
    exact hs
  have h12 (j l : Fin 3) :
      pair witnessTheta1 1 2 j l = pair witnessTheta1 (σ 1) (σ 2) (π 1 j) (π 2 l) := by
    have hs := congrArg (fun f : Fin 3 → ℚ => ∑ i, f i) (funext (fun i => h ![i,j,l]))
    simp only [tensor_relabel] at hs
    simp only [tensor, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
      Matrix.cons_val] at hs
    rw [tripleForm_sum1, tripleForm_sum1, family_sum _ witnessTheta1Lawful,
      family_sum_perm _ witnessTheta1Lawful, tripleForm_one1, tripleForm_one1] at hs
    exact hs
  have h20 (l i : Fin 3) :
      pair witnessTheta1 2 0 l i = pair witnessTheta1 (σ 2) (σ 0) (π 2 l) (π 0 i) := by
    have hs := congrArg (fun f : Fin 3 → ℚ => ∑ j, f j) (funext (fun j => h ![i,j,l]))
    simp only [tensor_relabel] at hs
    simp only [tensor, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
      Matrix.cons_val] at hs
    rw [tripleForm_sum2, tripleForm_sum2, family_sum _ witnessTheta1Lawful,
      family_sum_perm _ witnessTheta1Lawful, tripleForm_one2, tripleForm_one2] at hs
    exact hs
  apply marginal_stabilizer_trivial σ π
  intro r s hrs i j
  rw [← pair_eq_marginal r s i j hrs,
    ← pair_eq_marginal (σ r) (σ s) (π r i) (π s j) (σ.injective.ne hrs)]
  fin_cases r <;> fin_cases s <;> try contradiction
  · exact h01 i j
  · exact (traceForm_symmetric _ _).trans ((h20 j i).trans (traceForm_symmetric _ _))
  · exact (traceForm_symmetric _ _).trans ((h01 j i).trans (traceForm_symmetric _ _))
  · exact h12 i j
  · exact h20 i j
  · exact (traceForm_symmetric _ _).trans ((h12 j i).trans (traceForm_symmetric _ _))

name: OneBit.traceCube_eq_three_cubicNorm
statement:
theorem traceCube_eq_three_cubicNorm (X : AlbertLean.WitnessTriple) :
    AlbertLean.traceCubeDetector X = 3 * AlbertLean.cubicNormDetector X
proof:
:=
  AlbertLean.Generic.CommutatorGeometry.detectorFactorThree_unconditional X
